'enasume:: 1. <<'alaahe>> - ba'ewenate tamalaaki yahona maalate nawe. la'alaahe becaa yahona leyu mathariyaa seme nawe. bazihe seme 'eresu becaa 'eneji leelaa 'akaale 'ayetharaabateme. 2. <<'are-raahhemaane>> - teregwaameewe yasafi meherate baalabeete maalate nawe. 'eresu 'alaahe baraasu 'ejege rexeruhe nawe. 3. <<'are-rahhime>> - tadaraashenate yaalawe 'ezenate baalabeete maalate nawe. 'eresu ba'ezenatu kafethuraanu lafaqadawe yaazenaale. kasawoce makaakale 'amaanyoce bazihe ('ezenate) wesethe yekaatataalu.

yamesegaanaa `aayenate bathaqelaalaa, yaleqenaa 'enaa yamelu`enate magalachaa yahonu mesegune baaheriyaate hulu laleelaa saayehone laresu (la'alaahe) becaa yatagabu naacawe. <<`aalamine>> maalate <<`aalame>> yamilawe qaale yabezu quthere seyaamee sihone ka'alaahe weche yamiganyu nagarocene hulu yaakaatetaale.
baqadamawe 'aneqatze kaqarabawe mesegaanaa bamaqathale la'alaahe yaqaraba tachamaari wedaasee nawe.

batenesaa'eewe `elate lahulume nagare baalabeete mahonune bamagelatze 'alaahene maalaaqe nawe. baziyaane `elate maanenyaaweme nafese laleelaanyaawaa nafese 'anedaaceme nagare maaderage 'ateceleme. <<yawemadine>> maalate yameremaraa 'enaa menedaa `elate maalate nawe.

'amelekotene 'enaa taazaazhenatene laaneta becaa 'enaadaregaalane; ka'aneta weche yaalane 'akaale ba'aneta laaye tagaari 'anaadaregeme; sela gudaayocaacene hulu 'anetane becaa 'eredaataane 'enethayeqaalane; malekaame nagaroce hulu ba'ejehe naacawe. ka'aneta weche radaate yalame.

qathetanyaawene manegade meraane; baqathetanyaawe manegade laayeme 'araamedane; ba'eziyaame laaye 'atzenaane. qathetanyaawene manegade yamamaraate sekeetene chamerelene. <<'ase-siraathule-musetaqime>> themate yaleelabate geletze manegade maalate nawe. yeheme manegade 'alaahe muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalamene) yalaakabate yaselaame manegade nawe.

'eneda nabiyaate, 'ewenatanyoce, la`emenataacawe heyewataacawene 'enedasathu samaa`etaate, malekaame sawoce yamameraate sekeete tzagaane bamasethate qathetanyaawene manegade yamaraahacawene 'agalegaayocehene manegade meraane. ya'enasu gwaadanyenate ('enaresu bamiganyubate manegade laaye mahone) 'ejege yaamaara nawe. 'ewenatene taganezebawe yaaletakatalunaa yataqothaahebaacawe 'ayehudaawiyaanene manegade saayehone; 'enedihume 'ewenatene mafalagenaa ba'eresume mamaraatene 'ejege celaa kamaalataacawe yatanasaa qathetanyaawene manegade yasaatuteneme nasaaraawoce (keresetiyaanoce) manegade yaalehonawene meraane.

'alaahe wechiyaawi 'enaa wesethaawi huneetaacawe yaamaara yahonutene thenequqe 'amaanyocene baaheri kagalatza baxwaalaa wechiyaawiwenaa wesethaawiwe huneetaacawe yatabalaashutene kafile kahadiyaanene baaheri sigaletze 'enedihe 'ala::
'enaziyaa 'enedaayaamenu yageetaahe qaale gede yahonacebaacawe sawoce bathemataacawe 'enaa ba'emebitanyenataacawe qathaaye naacawe. 'enaresune maasethaneqaqeheme hona 'alamaasethaneqaqehe la'enasu 'ekule nawe.

yeheme kayaazute themate gaare 'alaahe balebonaawocaacawe laaye yaashagabaacawe 'enaa yazagaabaacawe bamahonu nawe. bamasemiyaawocaacawe laayeme bamaashagu yamaqabale 'enaa yamataazaze maademathene 'ayaadamethume. ba`eyetaacaweme laaye geredoshene bamaaderagu geletze honome saala 'ewenatene maayate 'ayecelume. la'enaresu bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame taalaaqe qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale.

'alaahe (subehaanahu wata`aalaahe) baqadamawe 'aneqatze wechiyaacawenaa wesethaacawe yatabalaashawene kahadiyaanene baaheri kagalatza baxwaalaa 'asekatelo lasawoce bamitaayawe maleku wechiyaawi huneetaacawe yaamaara nagare gene wesethaawi huneetaacawe beleshu yahonawene yamanaafeqaanene baaheri 'enedihe bamaalate galatza::
kasawoce <<'amaanyoce nane>> belawe yamimogetu budenoce 'alu. yehenene ba'anedabataacawe yaminaagarute heyewataacawene 'enaa neberataacawene katheqaate lamataadage nawe. nagare gene 'enaresu bawesethaacawe kahadiyaanoce naacawe.

kamahaayemenataacawe yatanasaa 'emenatene yefaa bamaaderagenaa kehedatene bamadabaqe 'alaahenenaa 'amaanyocene lamaataalale yemokeraalu ba'ewenatu yamiyaataalelute raasaacawene becaa nawe. yehunenaa yehenene 'ayeradume. mekeneyaatume 'alaahe misetherenenaa kaziyaame yatasawarane nagare yaaweqaale. yehene baaheriyaacawene 'enaa huneetaacaweneme lamu'eminoce galetzolaacawaale.

yehe yahonabateme mekeneyaate ('asemasaaye manaafeqaane yahonubate mekeneyaate) balebocaacawe wesethe therethaaree selaala nawe. batherethaareeyaacaweme laaye 'alaahe therethaareene chamaralaacawe; yaszeraa waagaa 'eneda szariwe nawe. lanaresu ka'esaate bataacenyaawe 'azaqethe wesethe 'asaamaami qethaate yethabeqaacawaale. yeheme 'alaahenenaa sawocene bamawaashataacawe, 'enedihume muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yezote yamathaawene male`ekete bamaasetabaabalaacawe nawe.

bakehedate, baxaathi'atoce 'enaa baleeloceme mathefo tagebaaraate bamedere wesethe thefaate 'atefatsemu sibaalu bamaasetabaabale malekaame szariwoce 'enaa yamalekaame hasaabe 'aqaneqaanyoce 'enedahonu yemogetaalu.
'ewenataawe gene 'enaresu yamathefo tagebaare 'aqaneqaanyoce mahonaacawe nawe; nagare gene yehene 'ayeradume. szeraacawe thefaate mahonuneme 'ayeganazabume.

yamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) baaledaraboce 'enedaamanute 'emenatene 'enediqabalu sitaazazume bamaqaawame 'enaa bamasaalaqe <<monyocu 'enedaamanute `aayenate 'emenate 'enemane?>> yelaalu. ba'ewenate monyocu 'enaresu naacawe; nagare gene yehene 'ayaawequme.

'amaanyocene siyaaganyu, 'enaaneta yametaamenutene nagare 'ewenate 'enelaalane bamaalate yenaagaraalu; yehene yaminaagarute 'amaanyocene bamaferaataacawe mekeneyaate nawe. ka'amaanyoce tanathelawe ka'alaqocaacawe gaare sihonu dagemo <<'enyaa ka'enaanetawe gaare nane; ka'amaanyoce gaare yamenehonawe lamaasemasale, ba'enaresu lamasaalaqenaa lamaafeeze nawe>> bamaalate 'enaresune 'enedamikatalu 'aseragethawe yenagerwacawaale.

'enaresu ba'amaanyoce laaye yamiyaafeezu selahonu yaszeraacawene lisathaacawe 'alaahe yaafeezebaacawaale. selaziheme bamederaawi heyewate ya'amaanyocene `aayenate denegaagee 'enedinoraacawe 'aderegwaale; bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame dagemo yakehedataacawene 'enaa ya'asemasaayenataacawene yaszeraa wetheete yesathaacawaale. bathemataacawe 'enaa bawasane zalalenataacaweme wesethe yatadanaagaru 'enaa yawaalalu honawe 'enediqoyu yetawaacawaale.
'emenatene bakehedate bamalawathaacawe monyocu 'enaresu naacawe. ba'alaahe yaalaacaweneme 'emenate bamakesaraacawe negedaacawe 'alaatarafame. wada 'ewenateme yatamaru 'alehonume.

'alaahe la'enaziyaa 'asemasaaye manaafeqaane hulate mesaaleewocene 'aqaraba. 'anedanyaawe ba'esaate yataqamatha mesaalee sihone leelaanyaawe baweha yatamasala nawe. ba'esaate yataqamathawe mesaaleeyaacawe berehaane lamaagenyate 'esaatene 'enedaaqathaathala sawe mesaalee nawe. yaaqathaathalawe 'esaate sidameqenaa berehaane 'enedamiyaaganye tasefaa maaderage sijamere 'esaatu kasama; demeqatu thafaa. ya'esaatu qaathalo becaa tarafa. ya'esaatu baalabeetoce 'anedaaceme nagare bamaayaayubate tzelematoce wesethe qathetanyaawene manegade yaaletamaru honawe qaru.
'ewenatene lamaqabale masemaate yamaayesamu daneqorowoce naacawe; 'ewenate yamaayenaagaru didaawoce naacawe; 'ewenatene yamaayemalakatu `eweroce naacawe; kathemataacaweme 'ayemalasume.

baweha yatamasalawe mesaaleeyaacawe dagemo yatadaraarabu chalamaawoce 'enedaalubate damanaa, nagodegwaadenaa maberaqe 'enedaalabate dofe zenaabe `aayenate nawe. yehe zenaabe basawoce laaye siwarede beretu cheneqate yeyezaacawenaa motene bamaferaate bathaatocaacawe chaafe jorowocaacawene 'enedamidafenute nawe. 'alaahe kahadiyaanene ba`eweqatu yaakaababa nawe; ka'eresu liyaamalethute 'ayecelume.

yamaberaqu natzaberaaqe 'enaa demeqate `eyetaacawene lisalebaacawe yeqarebaale. natzaberaaqu beleche baalanaa baabaraalaacawe quthere wadafite yeheedaalu. kaalaabaraame batzelemate wesethe yeqoyaalu. maneqasaaqase 'ayecelume;la'ewenate jarebaacawene bamasethataacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe bifaqede hulune kabaabi bahonawe celotaawe masemiyaacawene 'enaa mamalekacaacawene baasewagadanaa wadanaresume baaletamalasalaacawe nabare. kasamaaye yawaradawe zenaabe yaqure'aane; yanagodegwaadu demetze baqure'aane wesethe yamiganyute gesaatzeewoce tamesaalite nawe. yamaberaqu berehaane 'anedaanede gizee lamigalathelaacawe hhaqe, yanagodegwaadune beretaate baferehaate jorwacawene madefanaacawe dagemo kahhaqe lamaafanegathaacawenaa latheriwe malese laalamasethataacawe bamesaaleenate taqamethwale. ba'asemasaayoce 'enaa ba'enazihe yahulate mesaalee baalabeetoce makaakale yaalawe mamasaasale hulatume tathaqaamiwoce 'alamahonaacawe nawe. ba'esaatu mesaalee wesethe 'esaatune yaaqathaathalawe sawe kaaqathaathalawe 'esaate tzelemate 'enaa ba'esaatu kamaqaathale weche yaatarafawe nagare 'alenabarame. baweha bataqamathawe mesaalee wesethe dagemo zenaabe yawaradalaacawe sawoce kanagodegwaadenaa 'enaa kamaberaqu yamiyaasefaraacawene 'enaa yamiyaasebaragegaacawene nagare 'eneji leelaane 'alaaganyume. 'asemasaayoce (manaafeqaaneme) leke 'enedihu kaselaame beretaate 'enaa chekaanee 'eneji leelaane 'ayemalakatume.

'alaahe ya'amaanyoce, yakahadinaa ya'asemasaaye yasawocene kefele baaheriyaate kagalatza baxwaalaa 'eresune becanyaa tamalaaki 'enediyaadaregute huluneme 'enedihe bamaalate theri 'aqaraba::
yasawe lejoce hoye! geetaacehune becaa 'ameleku, yeheme 'eresu 'enaanetane 'enaa ka'enaaneta qadamete yahonu hhezebocene yafathara bamahonu nawe. ba'enaaneta 'enaa baqethaatu makaakale mathabaqiyaane taadaregu zanede te`ezaazune bamafatzame yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'amelekute.

'eresu yaa mederene yatazaragaanaa yatadalaadala; kamedere balaayeme samaaye genebaataawe yathanakara 'enedihone yaadaraga. zenaabene bamaawerade kamedere yatalayaayu feraafereewocene megebe 'enedihonwacehu yaabaqala nawe. ka'alaahe baashaagare leelaa fathaari 'enedaleela 'eyaawaqaacehu la'alaahe baalaanethaane 'enaa 'amesaayaane 'ataaderegu.

yasawe lejoce hoye! ba'agalegaayaacene bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye batawaradawe qure'aane batherethaaree wesethe betehonu, 'eresune yamimasele, barezemate kame`eraafocu hulu yaanasa 'anede me`eraafe 'enekwaa bihone 'amethetaacehu teqaawamute zanede yamaaszaane theyaaqee 'enaaqarebelaacexwaalane. bametemogetuteme 'ewenatanyoce betehonu matheraate yametecelutene radaatocaacehune hulu theru.

yehenene maaderage kaalecaalaacehu (maceeme bihone qure'aanene yamimasele maamethaate 'atecelume) laqethaate tagabi yahonu sawoce 'enaa sawoce yaamalekwaacawe yanabaru denegaayoce maqathaathayaawaa yahonawene 'esaate feru. yehecene 'esaate 'alaahe lakahadiyaane 'azagaajetwale.

kazihe balaaye yaqadamawe maasethaneqaqiyaa kahadiyaanene yatamalakata sihone; 'aneta nabiye hoye! malekaamene yamiszaru 'amaanyocene kahhenetzaawocaacawenaa kazaafocaacawe sere wanezoce bamifasubaacawenaa dasetaane bamiyaaganyubaacawe ya'atekelete seferaawoce (janate) 'abeseraacawe. kasisaaye bakule yaamaaru yahonu feraafereewocwane simagabu kaqerebitu `aalame feraafereewoce gaare bathaame bamamasaasalaacawe, yehemaa kazihe bafite yatamagabenawe nawe yelaalu. nagaru baqeretzaacawe 'enaa basemaacawe bamederaawi `aalame kamiyaaweqwaacawe fereewoce gaare tamasaasaaye yahonu fereewoce nawe yamiqarebelaacawe; yamiyaaweqwaacawe fereewoce bamahonaacawe thaa`emaacawene siqamesu kamiyaawequte thaa`eme fetzume yatalaya thaa`eme yaalaacawe honawe yaaganywacawaale. la'enaresu nafese kametethalaawe 'enaa baqerebitu `aalame sawoce batafathero kamitzayafwacawe nagaroce yatharu misetoce yenoraacawaale. kamiqwaarathawe yaduneyaa tzagaa taqaaraani bamaayaaqwaarethe zala`aalamaawi tzagaa wesethe yehonaalu.

'alaahe (subehaanahu wata`aalaa) bamifalegawe nagare mesaalee maaqerabe 'ayaafereme. batenenye mesaaleene yaaqarebaale. bateleqenate kareswa balaaye bahona, bateneshenate kareswa bataace bahoname nagare mesaaleene yesathaale. bazihe zuriyaa sawoce bahulate yekafalaalu:: 'amaanyoce 'enaa kahadiyaane. 'amaanyoce 'ewenate nawe silu yaaragaagethaalu; kamesaaleeweme basetajarebaa thebabe 'enedaala yeganazabaalu. kahadiyaanu gene 'alaahe 'eneda tenenye, zenebe, shararite 'enaa bamasaasalu leeloce tenaaneshe nafesaate mesaaleene lamene 'aqaraba?! silu bamasaalaqe yethayeqaalu. 'alaahe malese sisathe banazihe mesaaleewoce wesethe mamariyaawoce, theqomaawoce 'enaa lasawoce fatanaawoce 'enedaalubate yenaagaraale. kasawoce makaakale bezuwoce mesaaleewocune kamaasetanetane (batheleqate kamaasetawaale) bamaraaqaacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe yamiyaathamemaacawe yeganyaalu. kanaresume makaakale bezuwoce bamesaaleewocu mekerene bamawesadaacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe yamimaraacawe 'alu. manaafeqaanene yamasalu kate`ezaazu yaafanagathute lathemate tagabiwocene 'eneji 'alaahe leelocene 'ayaathameme.

'enaziyaane 'alaahe 'eresune yaamalekute zanede, 'enedihume yaqadamute nabiyaate yaabasarutene male'eketanyaa yekatalu zanede ka'enaresu yataqabalawene qaale kidaane yamiyaafaresutene 'eneji 'alaahe 'ayaathameme. 'enazihe la'alaahe yagabutene qaale kidaane yamikedute; baaheriyaacawe 'alaahe 'enediqathale yaazazawene zemedenaane bamaqurathe yamigalatze nawe. bahathi'ate bamedere laaye thefaatene lamaasefaafaate yetagaalu; bamederaawi heyewatenaa bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame `edelaacawe yagodala nawe.

kahadiyaanoce hoye! nagaraacehu yaasegaremaale; lamahonu baraasaacehu laaye ya'alaahene celotaa thaqwaami meleketocene 'eyatamalakataacehu 'enedeete 'alaahene tekedaalaacehu?! meneme 'alenabaraacehume; 'alaahe hheyaawe 'adaragaacehu; kaziyaame baxwaalaa lahulatanyaa gizee yegadelaacexwaale. qathelome ladegaami heyewate yeqasaqesaacexwaale. baasaalafaacehuteme nagare limanadaacehume wada 'eresu yemalesaacexwaale.

bamedere laaye yamiganyu nagarocene hulu wanezocene, zaafocenenaa quthere seferaacawe yamaayetaawaqu leeloce fetherataatocene yafatharalaacehu 'alaahe becaawene nawe. 'alaahe baagaraalaacehu nagare tethaqamaalaacehu; tedasataalaacehu. kaziyaame kasamaaye balaaye kafe yaalunaa yatasetakaakalu sabaate samaayaatene fathara; 'eresu 'eko `eweqatu nagarocene hulu yakababa nawe.

'eresune bamataazaze mederene heyaawe 'enediyaadaregwaate, bamedere wesethe kafilaacawe kafilaacawene yamitakaa yasawe lejoce zarene 'enedamiyaadarege 'alaahe lamalaa'eketoce nagaraacawe. malaa'eketocume ya'adame lejoce bamedere wesethe yamiyaathafu, damene babadale yamiyaafasesu sihonu lamene thebabe 'alaahe 'enedamifatheraacawe lamaradaate 'enaa lamaganezabe theyaaqee 'aqarabu. 'enyaa la'aneta taazaazhoce nane; 'anetane bamaamasegane 'eneqadesehalane; sela leqenaahe 'enaa melu`enatehe kebere 'enesathaalane; yeheneneme 'anesalaceme. 'alaaheme yasawe lejocene bamafethare wesethe yamiganyawene theleqe thebabenaa 'enaresune yamedere metekoce bamaaderage wesethe yaalawene 'enaaneta yamaataawequtene `aalaamaa 'enee 'aweqaalahu bamaalate malese sathaacawe.

ya'aadameneme (`alayehi 'asalaame) darajaa geletze lamaaderage 'alaahe 'aadamene ka'enesesaate 'enaa kage`uze 'akaalaate yanagarocene hulu seyaamee baqaaleme bateregumeme 'asetamaarawe. kaziyaame 'enazihene mathariyaawoce lamalaa'eketoce 'aqaraba, 'enediheme 'alaacawe:: <<'enyaa kazihe fethure ('aadame) balaaye yatakabarene 'enaa yatashaalene nane bamaalate selametenaagarute qaale 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu yanazihene nagaroce seyaameewoce negarunye.>>

'enaresume dekemataacawene bamanaazaze 'enaa leqenaane la'alaahe bamaaragaagatheme <<geetaacene hoye! yaferedehe 'enaa yadenegaageehe taqaaraaniwoce kamahone 'eneqadesehalane, 'enaaleqehalaneme. kaasaawaqekane weche leelaane 'anaaweqeme; 'anedaaceme nagare yamaayedabaqebehe `aawaaqi nahe. kawesaaneehe 'enaa kahegegaatehe nagarocene hulu bamigabaacawe botaa yametaadarege thebabanyaa nahe>> bamaalate tanaagaru.

bazihene gizee 'alaahe la'adame <<yanagarocune seyaameewoce negaraacawe>> 'alawe. banagaraacaweme gizee 'alaahe lamalaa'eketu <<'enee basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yatasawarane nagare hulu, 'enaanetame kahuneetaacehu geletze yametaadaregutene, bawesethaacehume yametaasebutene 'aweqaalahu 'alaalekwaacehumene?>> 'alaacawe.

malaa'eketoce la'adame yamaakebare segedatene 'enedisagedulate 'enedaazazaacawe 'alaahe galatza; ya'alaahene te`ezaaze lamafatzame tafaathenawe sagadu, nagare gene maszaratu ka'agaanenete yahonawe belise ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamaqaawame 'enaa ba'adame laaye bamakuraate 'emebitanyaa hona. baziheme mekeneyaate 'alaahene kakaadute hona.

'enediheme 'alaacawe:: <<'adame hoye! 'anetanaa thenedehene (hhawaa'e) bajanate wesethe 'eregu. 'adaferaashe yaleelabate, yaamaaranaa yasafaa sihone kajanate wesethe kafalagaacehute botaa tamagabu. nagare gene yakalakalekwaacehune yehecine zaafe kamaqerabe tathaneqaqu 'enedaatebalu. kazihece zaafe feree katamagabaacehu yaazazekwaacehune nagare bamathaase raasaacawene kabadalu sawoce tehonaalaacehu.>>

basehetate 'enaa hathi'ate laaye wadeqawe 'alaahe yakalakalaacawene zaafe feree 'esekibalu derase shayethwane 'enaresune kamagotegote 'enaa nagarocene lanaresu webe 'aderego kamaasaayate 'aletawagadame. menedaacaweme 'alaahe kanabarubate janate wesethe 'enaresune maasewathaate hona. la'enaresu 'enaa lashayethwane 'alaahe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<kafilaacehu yakafilu thalaate sihone wada medere waradu; la'enaaneta yaheyewate fetzaameeyaacehu 'esekidarese 'enaa tenesaa'eewe 'esekiqome derase bamareete wesethe manore 'enaa maqoyate 'enedihume bamareete wesethe bamiganyu malekaame nagaroce mathaqame tecelu zanede tafaqedolaacexwaale.>>

'adame 'alaahe wada 'eresu yaawaradawene qaalaatoce taqabala. ba'enazihe qaalaatoce mamaatzanene 'alaahe la'adame 'asaawaqawe. yekxaweme ba'a`eraafe me`eraafe wesethe (qala rabWana Zalamna 'anfusana wain lWam taGfir lana watarHamna lanakuwnanWa mina 'lkhasiriyna) <<geetaacene hoye! raasaacenene badalene, meheratene yamaatelagesane 'enaa yamaataazenelene kahona kakasaariwoce 'enehonaalane>> bamile yatathaqasawe nawe. 'alaahe nesehawene taqabalawe; meherateme 'adaragalate. 'eresu yataqadasawe geetaa labaarocu 'ejege mahhari 'enaa 'azaanye nawe.

'enediheme 'alenaacawe:: <<hulaacehume kajanate wada medere weradu; bamale'eketanyocee 'amaakaayenate mamariyaa yemathaalaacexwaale; mamariyaawene yatakatala 'enaa male'eketanyoceene yaamana bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame ferehaate 'ayenorebateme; bamederaawi heyewate selaamalathaweme nagare 'ayaazeneme.
'enaziyaa yakaadute 'enaa ba'aneqatzocaacene yaasetabaabalutemaa bawesethwa zawetaariwoce sihonu ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe.

yanabiyu yaa`eqube lejoce hoye! banaaneta laaye takataatelo yamisathaacehune ya'alaahene tzagaa 'awesu, 'amasegenume, ba'enee 'enaa bamale'eketanyocee bamaamane 'enedihume hegegaatoceene bamatagebare wadanaaneta yaadarasekutene qaale kidaaneene mulu. 'eneeneme becaa feru; qaale kidaaneene 'ataaferesu. yehene setefatzemu bamederaawiwe `aalame bamalekaame laanoraacehu, bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame dagemo yaamaara menedaa lesathaacehu yagabaahulaacehune qaale kidaane 'emolaalahu.>>

'alaahene ba'amelekote becanyaa sela maaderage (sela 'ahadenate) 'enaa sela muhhamade nabiyenate taweraate kamabarazu bafite bataweraate wesethe katathaqasawe nagare gaare yamisemaamaa male'ekete bayaazawenaa bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye baawaradekute qure'aane 'emanu. ba'eresume kamikedute yamajamariyaa cheferoce kamahoneme tathaneqaqu. 'aneqatzoceeneme baselethaane, bakebere 'enaa ba`aalamaawi theqite theqeme 'atelawethu. quthaayeene 'enaa qethaateene tathaneqaqu.

bamale'eketanyocee laaye yaawaradekutene hhaqe kameteqathefute hhasate gaare 'ateqalaaqelu. 'eyaawaqaacehu 'enaa ba'eresume 'eregethanyaa 'eyahonaacehu sela muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) baaheri bamatsehhafaacehu wesethe yatathaqasawene 'ewenataa 'atedabequ.

maa`ezanune, gedeetaawocune 'enaa sunaawocuneme 'amwaletaacehu salaatene segadu. 'alaahe ba'ejaacehu yaadaragawene yahabetaacehune zakaa 'awethu. kamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) teweledoce makaakale la'alaahe kamiyaagonabesute gaare 'aberaacehu 'agonebesu (segadu).

leelocene ba'emenate 'enaa bamalekaame szeraa 'eyaazazaacehu raasaacehune mazanegaataacehu, 'enedihume taweraatene yametaanabebu 'enaa ya'alaahene 'emenate selamakatale, nabiyaatocuneme 'ewenate selamaalate (bataweraate wesethe) yatathaqasawene te`ezaaze yametaawequ honaacehu kazihe maraaqaacehu menenyaa yakafaa nawe; ba'a`emerwacehu lamene tathaqaamiwoce 'atehonume?! ('a`emerwacehune 'ataaszarumene?!)

sela hulume `aalamaawi 'enaa 'emenataawi gudaayaacehu bate`egesete 'enedihume wada 'alaahe bamiyaaqarebaacehunaa ka'alaahe gaare bamiyaasetasaaseraacehu salaate 'egazaane falegu. 'alaahe yeradaacexwaale; yethabeqaacexwaale; yaalabaacehuneme gudaate yaasewagedelaacexwaale. salaate la'alaahe tanebarekaakiwoce lahonute siqare laleeloce kabaadenaa 'adaagaace nawe.

yeheme (la'alaahe raasaacawene zeqe yamiyaadaregu tanebarekaakiwoce) wada 'alaahe 'enedamigwaazu 'enaa baferedume `elate 'eresune 'enedamiyaaganyute; yaszeraacawene wetheete lisathaacaweme wada 'eresu 'enedamimalasu fetzumaawi 'eregethanyenate yaalaacawe bamahonu nawe.

yaseraa'eele lejoce hoye! ba'enaaneta laaye yafatzamekutene 'emenataawinaa 'enaa `aalamaawi tzagaawoceene; bazamanaacehu banabaru sawoce laaye hulu banegeszenaa 'enaa banabiyenate yaasebalathekwaacehu mahoneene 'asetaawesu.

te`ezaazaatene bamafatzame, kelekeloceneme bamaraaqe ba'enaaneta 'enaa baferedu `elate qethaate mahhakale geredoshene 'aderegu. yaa `elate maanenyaawaame nafese lamaanenyaaweme nafese 'anedaaceneme nagare yamaayethaqemebate; ba'alaahe feqaade kaalehona basetaqare gudaatene lamaasewagade, theqemeneme lamaamethaate ya'anedeme sawe 'amaalaajenate yamaayesetanaagadebate; mederene yamimolaa wareqe 'enekwaa bihone beezaa taqabaayenate yamaayaaganyebate `elate nawe. baziyaane `elate radaate yalaacaweme. lamahonuse 'amaalaaje, beezaa 'enaa radaate yamaayethaqeme kahona mashashaawe wadeete yehone?!

yaseraa'eele lejoce hoye! yaqethaatene `aayenate yaaqameswacehu kanabarute yafire`owene beetasaboce natzaa baawathaanaacehu gizee 'asetaawesu. tataki 'enedaayenoraacehu wanede lejocaacehune bamaarade sigadelunaa seetocaacehune 'ejege 'enaanetane lamaawaarade 'enaa lamaasaanase sibaale 'enediyaagalagelwacawe baheyewate siyaaseqaru yahonawene 'asetaawesu. geetaacehune taamasagenu zanede kafire`owene 'enaa katakataayocu yaqethaate 'eremejaa 'enaanetane natzaa bamaawethaate wesethe kageetaacehu yahona taalaaqe fatanaa 'ala.

la'enaanetame kawaalenelaacehu tzagaawocaacene makaakale baahherune sanetheqanelaacehu yametegwaazubatene daraqe manegade yaadaragenelaacehune 'enaa natzaa yaawathaanaacehune 'awesu. thalaataacehune fire`owenene 'enaa takataayocune hulu ba`aayenaacehu 'eyaayaacehu 'asathamenaacawe.

la'enaaneta kaadaragenaacawe tachamaari tzagaawoce makaakale berehaane 'enaa mamariyaa 'enedihone yataweraate mawerade yefatzame zanede musaane 'arebaa leelitocene baqatharenawe gizee yahonawene 'awesu. kaziyaa baxwaalaa gene musaa laqatharowe baheedabate waqete ka'enaaneta yataganyawe tagebaare thejaane maamelake hona; bazihe tagebaaraacehu badalanyoce honaacehu.
kaziyaame kazihe tagebaare batzatzate katamalasaacehu baxwaalaa yeqere 'alenaacehu. 'alaahene bamalekaame bamaamelake 'enaa bamataazaze taamasagenute zanedeme baszaraacehute 'aleqathaanaacehume.
katzagaawocee makaakale wada 'ewenate 'enedetemaru; 'ewenate 'enaa hhasatene, qathetanyaawene manegade 'enaa yathematene manegade yamilaye yahonawene taweraate lamusaa 'enedasathanawe 'asetaawesu.

'enedazihume katzagaawocee makaakale kathejaawe 'amelekote baxwaalaa wada nesehha 'enedetemalasu 'alaahe sekeetene yasathaacehu mahonune 'awesu. musaa <<thejaane yametaamalekute 'amelaake 'aderegaacehu bamayaazaacehu nafesocaacehune badelaacexwaale; wada fathaariyaacehu 'enaa geetaacehu tamalasu; kafilaacehu kafilaacehune yegedale; bazihe maleku nesehha maaderage ba'esaate wesethe zawetaari bamiyaadaregawe kehedate wesethe kamaqoyate yeshaalaacexwaale>> 'ala. ba'alaahe 'eredaataa yehene fatzamaacehu; 'alaaheme nesehhacehune taqabala. yeheme 'eresu batadagaagaami nesehhane taqabaaye 'enaa labaarocu 'azaanye bamahonu nawe.

'abaatocaacehu sere`aate baleelawe deferate lamusaa <<'alaahene ba`aayenaacene yaalageredoshe bageletze 'esekenaayawe derase 'anaameneleheme>> baalu gizee 'asetaawesu. maqesafete yaazaacawe; kafilaacawe kafilune 'eyatamalakata maqesafetu gadalaacawe.
yeheneneme tzagaa selawaalalaacehu 'alaahene taamasegenume zanede kamote baxwaalaa qasaqasenaacehu.

katzagaawocaacene makaakale bamedere wesethe thafetaacehu setewaalelu katzahhaye qaathalo yamigaaredaacehune damanaane malaakaacene; 'eneda walalaa maare yaalane thaafaache mathathe, 'eneda jegeraa yaala segaawe thaafaache baraarine maaweradaacenene 'asetaawesu. kalagasenaacehume malekaame nagaroce tamagabu 'alenaacehu. 'enazihene tzagaawoce bamakaadaacawe 'enaa `eweqenaa baalamasethataacawe 'enyaane 'alebadalume; yelequnese yamalekaame menedaa `edelaacawene bamaathebabenaa raasaacawene laqethaate bamaagaalathe nafesocaacawene badalu.

'alaahe la'enaaneta kawaalalaacehu tzagaawocu makaakale wada bayetale maqedise gebu; baziyaa kamiganyu malekaame nagaroce kafalagaacehute botaa yaamaaranaa safi sisaayene tamagabu; wadaziyaa setegabu la'alaahe raasaacehune zeqe yaadaragaacehu 'enaa 'agonebesaacehu gebu; 'alaaheneme 'enedihe bamaalate tamaatzanute:: <<geetaacene hoye! hathi'ataacenene sareyelene>>; metzanaacehune 'eneqabalaacexwaalane. 'enaziyaane szeraacawene malekaame lamiyaadaregute sela malekaame szeraacawe malekaame menedaane 'enechamerelaacawaalane.

nagare gene kanaresu yabadalute sawoce yataganyawe tagebaarune malawathe 'enaa qaaluneme maazaabaate nawe. bamaqamachaacawe 'eyatanefwaqaqu; ba'alaaheme qaale 'eyatasaalaqu <<batzagure wesethe yaalace qenethaate>> 'eyaalu gabu. kamanegadu wasane bamaalafaacawe 'enaa te`ezaazeneme bamaqaawamaacawe yatasathaacawe menedaa 'alaahe babadalute sawoce laaye kasamaaye yahonane qethaate maawerade nabare.

ka'alaaheme tzagaawoce makaakale bamedere laaye bawaalalaacehubatenaa 'ejege weha bathamaacehu waqete yahonawene 'asetaawesu. musaa wada geetaawe bamawaadaqe wehane 'enediyaawaredelaacehu thayaqa; babateru denegaayune 'enedimataa 'azazenawe. bagosaawocaacehu quthere leke 'aseraa hulate menechoceme karesu falaqu. bamakaakalaacehume gechete 'enedaayefathare la'eyaanedaanedu gosaa laresu yatalayalatene yamathachiyaa botaa galatzene. yaala dekaamenaa lefaate 'alaahe wadanaaneta kaamathaawe sisaaye tamagabu; thathume; bamedereme lathefaate 'aterwarwathu 'alenaacehu.

yageetaacehune tzagaa setekedunaa 'alaahe kawalalaa maarenaa kabaraari segaa yaawaradalaacehune mamagabe setesalacu yahonawene 'asetaawesu. bamaayelawathe 'anede `aayenate megebe laaye 'anetaagaseme bamaalate bamedere kamibaqelu takeloce, qethaalaa qethaloce, 'atekeletoce, 'enedihume kadubaa, kasenedee, kamesere 'enaa kashenekurete megebocene 'enediyaawathaalaacehu musaa 'alaahene 'enedilamene thayaqaacehute. musaa theyaaqeeyaacehune bamaqaawame <<yatashaalanaa yatakabara kahonawe yawalalaa maare 'enaa yabaraari wafe segaa yaanasa 'enaa zeqe yaala bahona megebe lawethene tefalegaalaacehune?>> 'ala. <<yaala lefaate 'enaa dekaame yemathaalaacehu nabare. kazihece medere wada yatenyaaweme manedare weradu; bamanedaru ya'ereshaa botaawocenaa yagabayaa seferaawoce yathayaqaacehutene taaganyaalaacehu>> 'alaacawe.semeetocaacawene bamakatalaacawe 'enaa 'alaaheme kamarathalaacawe nagare batadagaagaami bamaafanegathaacawe mekeneyaate kaweredate, kadehenate 'enaa kacegere 'enedaayelaaqaqu 'adaragenaacawe. ka'alaahe 'emenate bamaraaqaacawe, 'aneqatzocune bamakaadaacawe, nabiyaatene yaala 'agebaabe bagefe 'enaa bathelaacaa wasane bamaalafe bamagedalaacawe; 'alaahene bamaamatzaacawe 'enedihume denebarocune bamathaasaacawe ya'alaahene quthaa 'aterefawe tamalasu.

kazihe tewelede makaakale 'emenatene yataqabalu; 'enedihume kamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) malaake bafite kanabarute teweledoce ka'ayehudaawiyaane, kanaswaraawoce, kasaabiyoce (yatawasanu nabiyaate takataayoce naacawe) makaakale yaamanu, ba'alaahe 'enaa bamacharashaawe qane 'emenatene maqabalaacawe yataragaagathalaacawe sawoce 'alaahe zanede yamalekaame szeraa menedaa yethabeqaacawaale. bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame selamigathemaacawe nagare 'ayesagume;baziheme `aalame selaamalathaacawe nagare 'ayetakezume.

ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyocu taamenu zanede ka'enaaneta yawasadenawene yathabaqa qaale kidaanene 'asetaawesu; baqaale kidaanu maszeraate 'enedaatetawu lamaasefaraaraate 'enaa lamaasethaneqaqe 'enedihume bataweraate wesethe yaawaradenawene male`ekete ba'ewenate 'enaa bategaate yaalamazanaagaatenaa yaalaselecunate tagebaaraawi taadaregu zanede bamaazaze kabalaayaacehu taraaraane kafe 'aderegane 'anethaalalene. 'eresuneme bamafatzame ka'alaahe qethaate tethabaqu zanede bawesethu yatalaalafawene te`ezaaze thabequ, 'asetanetenuteme.

yehe thanekaaraa qaale kidaane ka'enaaneta katawasada baxwaalaa maafanegathe 'enaa hathi'ate 'eneji kanaaneta meneme 'aletaganyame. ya'alaahe terufaate ba'enaaneta laaye hono thefaataacehune baayaalefaacehu, nesehhacehuneme bamaqabale baayaazenelaacehu, bazihe 'afanegaachenataacehu 'enaa hathi'ataacehu mekeneyaate kakasaariwoce tehonu nabare.

yaqadametocaacehune zeenaa therethaaree baleelawe maleku ba'eregethe 'aweqaacexwaale. baziyaane `elate `aasaa maathemade yatakalakala sihone baqedaamee `elate `aasaane bamaathemade wasane 'alafu. kaqedaamee bafite marabene bamazaregaate, ba'ehudeme `elate yatathamadawene `aasaa bamasabesabe 'ataalalu; 'enazihene 'ataalaayoce latagebaaraacawe qethaate 'enedihone 'alaahe yatawaaradu zenejarowoce 'adaragaacawe.

yehecineme wasane yaalaface manedare la'agoraabaace manedarocenaa kareswa baxwaalaa lamimathu sawoce ya'ereswane `aayenate hathi'ate szaretawe qethaatu 'enedaayedaresebaacawe yethanaqaqu zanede magasachaa 'adaragenaate. wasanune bamithesu sawoce laaye 'alaahe yamiyaawaredawene qethaate lamifaru thenequqoce mamakariyaa 'adaragenaate.

kaqadametocaacehume zeenaa bamusaanaa ba'eseraa'eele lejoce makaakale yatakasatawene 'asetaawesu. musaa kalaamoce makaakale 'aneditene laame 'enediyaaredu 'alaahe 'enedaazazaacawe sinageraacawe fathenawe te`ezaazune kamatagebare yeleqe bageterenate <<masaalaqiyaa taadareganaalahene?>> bamaalate tanaagaru. musaame <<ba'alaahe laaye hhasatene kamiqathefunaa basawoce laaye kamisaalaqute kamahone ba'alaahe 'ethabaqaalahu>> 'ala.

<<'enedenaaredaate yaazazanene laame magalachaa yaaberaaraalene zanede geetaahene thayeqelene>> 'alute. musaame <<'alaahe laamitu yaalaarajace, thejaame yaalehonace, bahulatu makaakale makaakalanyaa yahonace naate yelaacexwaale; yageetaacehune te`ezaaze lamafatzame fethanu>> 'alaacawe.

bakerekeraacawe 'enaa bageterenataacawe bamaqathale <<musaa hoye! malekwaa mene `aayenate 'enedahona yegaletzelene zanede geetaahene thayeqelene>> 'alute. musaame <<geetaacehu laamitu wadareswa yamimalakatene hulu yamisebe damaaqe daalacaa maleke yaalaate naate yelaacexwaale>> 'alaacawe.

kaziyaame bageterenataacawe bamaqathale 'enedihe 'alu <<geetaahe selalaamwa tachamaari maaberaariyaa 'enedisathane thayeqelene; yatagalatzutene gatzetaawoce yamimaselu laamoce bezu bamahonaacawe kamahakalaacawe lenelayaate 'alecaaleneme; 'enyaa 'alaahe kafaqada 'enedetetaarade yatafalagacewene laame lamaagenyate yamenemaraa nane>> 'alu.

musaame; 'alaahe 'enedihe yelaale:: <<yazihece laame magalachaa ya'ereshaa szeraa bamaszeraate, 'ereshaaneme bamaathathaate yaaledakamace, kagedefate netzuhe yahonace, kadaalacaa malekwaa weche leelaa melekete yaleelabaate naate>> 'alaacawe. <<'ahune laamitune mulu bamulu malayate yamiyaasecele zerezere galatzaa 'amathaahelene>> bamaalate tanaagaru. laamitune bakerekere 'enaa bageteranyenate laalamaarade kaqarabu baxwaalaa 'aradwate.

ka'enaaneta makaakale 'anede sawe bagadalaacehu 'enaa bazihu gudaaye batakaraakaraacehu gizee yahonawene 'asetaawesu. bamakaakalacehu gechete 'esekifathare derase hulume sawe karaasu laaye yagedeyaa kesene bamaasewagade leelaawene makesase jamara. 'alaahe kaziyaa netzuhhe sawe gedeyaa yametedabequtene yefaa yaawathaale.

yatagadalawene sawe badene 'akaale bataaradacewe laame kafile 'akaale metu 'alenaacehu. yagadalawe maane 'enedahona 'enedinaagare 'alaahe hheyaawe yaadaregawaale; yeheneneme fatzamunaa mwace tanaseto yagadalawe sawe maane 'enedahona tanaagara. yehene yamota sawe 'enedaqasaqasawe hulu baferedu `elate 'alaahe mutaanene yeqasaqesaale. 'alaahe teganazabunaa ba'eresume ba'ewenate taamenu zanede bacelotaawe laaye 'aseraje yahonu geletze ta`aameraatocene yaasaayaacexwaale.

kanazihe methuqe mekerocenaa theleqe ta`aameraatoce baxwaalaa lebocaacehu 'eneda denegaaye 'esekihone derase daraqa, belome kadenegaayeme yabaasa yadaraqa hona; selahoname kaalabate huneetaa fetzume 'ayeqayareme. nagare gene denegaayoce yeqayaraalu; yelawathaalu; kadenegaayoce makaakale wanezoce yamifaleqebaacawe 'alu; kadenegaayoce makaakale yamisanathaqenaa kawesethu bamedere laaye yamifasu menechoce yamifalequbate 'ala; baziheme sawoce 'enaa 'enesesaatoce yethaqamubataale. kadenegaayoce makaakale ba'alaahe ferehaate kataraaroce kafetaa laaye yaminekabaalale 'ala. lebocaacehu gene 'enedazihe 'ayedalume. 'alaahe kameteszarute tagebaare zenegu 'ayedalame; `aawaaqi nawe; baresume yemanadaacexwaale.

'amaanyoce hoye! lamahonu 'ayehudaawiyaane 'emenatene laalamaqabale yaalaacawene geteranyenatenaa tachabaache 'ewenataacawene kataganazabaacehu baxwaalaa 'emenatene yeqabalaalu latheriyaacehu malese yesathaalu belaacehu tasefaa taadaregaalaacehune?! kaliqaawenetocaacawe yahonu cheferoce bataweraate wesethe yawaradawene ya'alaahene negegere yamisamu nabaru. kaziyaame kaawaqu 'enaa kataradute baxwaalaa yamifatzemute tagebaare kabaade hathi'ate mahonune 'eyaawaqu qaalaatocune 'enaa teregumaacawene yelawethaalu.

ka'ayehudaawiyaane yamithaarasu 'aqwaamoce makaakale kanaresu kafilocaacawe 'amaanyocene siyaaganyu banabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) taweraate wesethe bamiganyawe mesekerenate maszarate 'ewenatanyenate 'enaa selamale`eketaacawe tekekelanyaanate mesekerenate yesathaalu. nagare gene kafilaacawe wada kafilaacawe galale bamilebate gizee, ya'ewenate mesekerenate bamasethataacawe mekeneyaate 'anedaacawe leelaanyaacawene yewaqesaale. sela nabiyu 'ewenatanyenate basathaacehute mesekerenate muselimoce batenesaa'ee `elate maaserajaane yaaqarebubaacexwaale; bageetaacehu fiteme yekaraakarwacexwaale yebaabaalaalu.

'enedihe yaalane yatawagaza manegade yamikatalute 'ayehudaawiyaane 'alaahe kanegegeraacawe 'enaa kaszeraawocaacawe yamidabequtene 'enaa geletze yamiyaadaregutene yamiyaaweqe mahonune yezanagaalune?! 'alaahe labaarocu yefaa bamaaderage yaagaalethaacawaale.

ka'ayehudaawiyaane makaakale yatawasanute taweraatene maanabenabe 'eneji yaaqafawene qume nagare yamaayeradu yeganyaalu. kataalaalaaqocaacawe yawarasute 'ebelate 'eneji leelaa yalaacaweme. yehene 'ebelate 'alaahe yaawaradawe taweraate 'enedahona yaasebaalu.

la'enaziyaa matsehhafene ba'ejocaacawe katzaafu baxwaalaa bahhasate yehe ka'alaahe zanede yawarada nawe lamilute thefaatenaa beretu qethaate yethabeqaacawaale. hhaqe 'enaa qene manegadene bamakatale fanetaa ganezabenaa selethaane yamasalu teneshe theqemocene bamederaawi heyewate lishametu yeqathefaalu. ba'alaahe laaye selamiwaashute 'enaa ba'ejocaacawe selamitzefute nagare wayolaacawe. bazihe tagebaare yamiyaaganyute theqemenaa selethaane kamikatalawe thefaate 'enaa qethaate wayolaacawe.

bahhasate 'enaa bakuraate theqite qanaatene 'eneji 'esaate 'ayenakaaneme; 'esaateme 'anegabaame bamaalate tanaagaru. 'aneta nabiye hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<lamahonu bazihe laaye ka'alaahe yahona thebeqe qaale kidaane 'alaacehune?! yehe kahona ba'eregethe 'alaahe qaalune 'ayaathefeme; wayenese ba'alaahe laaye hhasatene, 'ebelatene 'enaa yamaataawequtene nagare tenaagaraalaacehu?!>>

nagaru 'enaresu 'enedamasalaacawe 'ayedalame. 'alaahe yakehedate hathi'ate yafatzamane, hathiyaa'atocume kahulume 'aqethaachaawoce yakababutene hulu yeqathaale. bawesethwame lazala`aalame zawetaariwoce lihonu 'esaate yaasegabaacawaale.
ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanu, malekaame szeraawoceneme yaszaru, 'alaahe zanede yaminoraacawe menedaa janate magebaate 'enaa bawesethwame zala`aalame maqoyate nawe.

yaseraa'eele lejoce hoye! 'alaahene ba'amelekote becanyaa 'enedetaadaregute 'enaa 'anedaaceneme tagaari 'enedaataadaregubate, lawalaajoce, laqerebe zamadoce, lamute lejoce, ladehawoce 'enaa mesekinoce malekaame 'enedetaadaregu, yaala chekaanee 'enaa daraqenate bamalekaame bamaazazenaa kakefu bamakalekale lasawoce malekaamene 'enedetenaagaru, 'enedataazazaacehute salaatene ba'agebaabu 'enedetefatzemu, bamulu feqaadanyenate nafesocaacehu wado lamigabaacawe bamaaderase zakaane (metzewaatene) 'enedetesathu, ka'enaaneta yakabadane qaale kidaane 'enedayaazene 'asetaawesu. nagare gene kazihe qaale kidaane baxwaalaa kanaaneta yataganyawe qaale kidaanune kamamulaate yeleqe jarebaacehune maazoraacehu 'eneji leelaa 'alenabarame.

kafilaacehu yakafilaacehune dame maafesase, kafilaacehu kafilaacehune kamanoriyaacawe maafanaaqale 'ereme sela mahonu bataweraate wesethe ba'enaaneta laaye yataqabalenawene yathanakara qaale kidaane 'asetaawesu. kaziyaame kanaaneta laaye selataqabalenawe qaale kidaane tekekelanyaanate masekaariwoce setehonu 'amanaacehu.

kaziyaame yehenene qaale kidaane 'aferesaacehu. kafilaacehu kafilaacehune yegadelaale. babadale 'enaa bathelaacaa wasane bamaalafe bathalaatoce bamataagaze kafilaacehu kafilaacehune kamanoriyaacawe yaafanaaqelaale. bathalaate 'eje merekonyoce honawe 'enaaneta zanede simathu dagemo ka'esere lamaasewathaate beezaane lamakefale teqarebaalaacehu. majamariyaa 'enaresune maafanaaqale ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme hono saala 'adaragaacehute. merekonyocene natzaa sela maawethaate gedeetaanate bataweraate wesethe yatathaqasawene 'amenaacehu, damene bamathabaqe 'enaa kafilaacehu kafilaacehune 'enedaayaafanaaqele batathaqasawe kelekalaa 'enedeete kahadi tehonaalaacehu?! ka'enaaneta makaakale yehenene yamifatzeme sawe bamederaawi heyewate weredatenaa nawerene 'eneji leelaane 'ayaaganyeme; bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame dagemo wada kafaa qethaate yemalasaale; 'alaahe bameteszarute tagebaare zenegu 'ayedalame; `aawaaqi nawe; sela 'eresume yemanadaacexwaale.

'enaresu 'eko thafiwene kazalaaqiwe nagare bamamerathenaa bamaasebalathe yaqerebitune `aalame bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame yalawathu naacawe. bamahonume bamacharashaawe `aalame qethaate 'ayeqalelaacaweme; baziyaame `elate yamiradaacawe radaate 'ayenoraacaweme.

lamusaa ba'eregethe taweraatene sathanawe. ba'eresume falage male'eketanyocene 'asekatalene. lamareyame leje `isaame 'ewenatanyenatune masekaari yahonutene mutaanene maqaseqase, `aayena sewerene 'enaa lametzene mafawase yamasaasalu geletze ta`aameraatocene sathanawe. bamale'aku jiberileme 'abarataanawe. yaseraa'eele lejoce hoye! ka'alaahe zanede yahona maanenyaaweme male`eketanyaa nafesocaacehu yamaatefalegawene nagare yezo bamathaa quthere ba'ewenate laaye tekoraalaacehune?! ba'alaahe male'eketanyoce laaye raasaacehune kafe taadaregaalaacehu? kafilocune male'eketanyoce 'asetabaabelaacehu, kafilocu laaye dagemo gedeyaane tefatzemaalaacehune?!

'ayehudaawiyaane muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laalamakatalaacawe yanabaraacawe maaserajaa <<lebocaacene yataqolafu naacawe; 'aneta kametenaagarawe yamidaresane nagare yalame; 'aneradaaweme>> maalataacawe nabare. 'ewenataawe 'enedamogatute 'ayedalame. yelequneme bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe ka'ezenatu selaabaararaacawe nawe; bamahonume 'alaahe kaawaradaweme theqitene 'eneji 'ayaamenume.

tekekelanyaa bahonu theqele maszaratoce bataweraate 'enaa banejile wesethe katathaqasu nagaroce gaare yamisemaamaa yahonawe qure'aane ka'alaahe zanede bamathaacalaawe gizee, qure'aane kamawaradu bafiteme nabiye yelaakaale, ba'eresume 'enaamenaalane; 'enekatalawaalane ba'agaariwoce laayeme delene 'eneqadaajaalane silu yanabaru sihone qure'aane 'enaa nabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'enaresu bamiyaawequte baahheri 'enaa bataradute 'ewenataa maszarate simathulaacawe kaadu. 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene bakaadu sawoce laaye ya'alaahe 'eregemaane yehune.

ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe lamaamane yanabaraacawene malekaame `edele malawathaacawe menenyaa kafaa. 'alaahe yaawaradawene male`ekete kaadu; male`eketanyaawene 'asetabaabalu, bamuhhamade laaye qure'aane 'enaa nabiyenate mawaradune bamamaqenyate 'enaa babadale tagafetawe kehedatene fatzamu. bamuhhamade bamakaadaacawe, kaziyaa bafiteme bataweraate wesethe yataqamathawene bamalawathaacawe ka'alaahe yahona yatadaraaraba quthaa yatagabaacawe honu. bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) nabiyenate kehedatene lafatzamu baferedu `elate 'awaaraaje qethaate yethabeqaacawaale.

la'enaziyaa 'ayehudaawiyaane, 'alaahe bamale'eketanyaawe laaye baawaradawe 'ewenate 'enaa mamariyaa 'emanu sibaalu yamenaamenawe banabiyaatocaacene laaye bawaradawe male'ekete nawe yelaalu. kaziyaa baashaagare bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye yawaradawene male`ekete yekedaalu. qure'aane 'ewenate 'enaa 'enaresu zanede kamiganyawe ya'alaahe matsehhafe gaare yamisemaamaa kamahonu gaare yekedutaale. 'enaresu laaye batawaradawe male`ekete ba'ewenate yamiyaamenu bihonu baqure'aaneme yaamenu nabare. nabiyu hoye! malese setesathaacawe 'enedihe bale - <<nabiyaatoce wada 'enaaneta yezawe bamathute bahhaqe yametaamenu kanabaraacehu kazihe baqadamu gizeeyaatoce ya'alaahene nabiyaate lamene nabare yametegadelute?!>>

male'eketanyaacehu musaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) sela 'ewenatanyenatu 'aseraje yahonu geletze ta`aameraatocene ba'eregethe yezolaacehu mathetwale. kaziyaame musaa lageetaawe qatharo kaheeda baxwaalaa thejaane 'amelaake 'aderegaacehu 'amalakaacehute. 'alaahe babecanyenate limalake yamigabaawe hono saala ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaarine bamaaderagaacehu badalanyoce honaacehu.

musaane (`alayehi 'asalaame)ne 'enedetekatalu 'enaa ka'alaahe yezote yamathaawene male'ekete 'enedeteqabalu; ka'enaaneta laaye beretu qaale kidaanene bawasadene gizee yahonawene 'asetaawesu. 'enaanetaneme lamaasefaraaraate taraaraawene kabalaayaacehu 'athalalene. yasathanaacehune taweraate bategaate yaazu; yamaqabale 'enaa yamataazaze maademathene 'ademethu; yehe kaalehona taraaraawene 'enethelebaacexwaalane 'alenaacehu. 'enaanetame bajorwacene samaane;batagebaaraacene 'amatzene 'alaacehu. bakehedataacaweme mekeneyaate yathejaawe 'ameleko balebocaacawe wesethe yasaratza hona. 'aneta nabiye hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<'amaanyoce kahonaacehu yehe 'alaahene 'enedetekedu yamiyaadaregaacehu 'amalakaakate bathaame yakafaa nawe. tekekelanyaa 'emenate kakehedate gaare 'ayeqoraanyeme.>>

'aneta nabiye hoye! la'ayehudaawiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame yameteganyawe janate leeloce yamaayegabwate, la'enaaneta becaa yatalayace kahonacenaa yehenene bamaalataacehu 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu yehene kebere bafethenate lamaagenyate 'enedihume kazihe `aalame dekaamenaa hasaabe lamagalaagale motene tamanyu.>>

'alaahene bamakaade, male'eketanyocune bamaasetabaabale, matsehhafune bamalawathe ba`aalamaawi hheyewataacawe baaseqadamute tagebaare mekeneyaate bafetzume motene 'ayemanyume. 'alaahe kanaresume hona kaleelocu badalanyocene yaaweqaale. 'eyaanedaaneduneme 'eneda szeraawe yemanadaawaale.

nabiyu hoye! meneme yaahele yatawaarada 'enaa yatanaaqa bihone 'enekwaa 'ayehudaawiyaane lahheyewate 'ejege gugu honawe taaganyaacawaalahe; kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase 'enaa yaszeraa meremaraa manorune kamaayaamenute thaa`otaaweyaaneme babalatha gugu honawe taaganyaacawaalahe. kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase 'enaa meremaraa manorune yamiyaamenu yamatsehhafe baalabeetoce bihonume ka'enaresu makaakale `edemeewe 'anede shihe `aamataate bidarese yamiwade 'ala. ya`edemeewe marezame ka'alaahe qethaate yamiyaareqawe 'ayedalame. 'alaahe szeraawocaacahune `aawaaqinaa tamalekaace nawe. kaszeraacehume ba'eresu laaye 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayedabaqebateme; baziyaame yemanadaacawaale.

nabiyu hoye! <<kamalaa'eketoce makaakale jiberile thalaataacene nawe>> belawe latanaagarute kafile 'ayehudaawiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<jiberilene yamithalaa kaala ba'alaahe faqaade balebehe laaye liyaasaferawe qure'aanene yezo yawaradawe 'eresu nawe. qure'aane 'eneda taweraate 'enaa nejile karesu yaqadamutene malakotaawi matsaahhefete 'aragaagaache, malekaame nagarocene thaqwaami, 'alaahe katzagaawoce yaazagaajaacawene nagaroce la'amaanyoce 'abesaari sihone yezote yawaradawe 'eresu jiberile nawe. baahheriyaatu 'enaa tagebaaraatu 'enedazihe yahonawene male'ake yathalaa sawe 'eresu kathamaamoce nawe.

'alaahene, malaa'eketune 'enaa male'eketanyocune, 'enedihume la'alaahe qerebe yahonutene hulatune malaa'ekete jiberilene 'enaa mikaa'eelene yamithalaa, 'alaahe yakahaadiyaane thalaate nawe. 'alaahe thalaatu yahonawe sawe geletze keserate wesethe gabetwale.>>

nabiyu hoye! yezahe yamathaakxawene nabiyenate 'enaa malakotaawi male'ekete tekekelanyaanate thaqwaami yahonu geletze 'aneqatzocene ba'eregethe wada 'aneta 'aweredanaale. 'aneqatzocu geletze 'enaa yefaa bamahonaacawe ka'alaahe manegade yaafanagathute 'eneji ba'eresu yamikede yalame.

ka'ayehudaawiyaane mathefo baaheri makaakale laraasaacawe qaale kidaanene sigabu (bataweraate selanabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yatathaqasawene 'ameno maqabalene chamero) ka'enaresu kafilocu yehene qaale kidaane yaafaresaalu. yelequneme 'abezaanyowocu 'alaahe baawaradawe nagare ba'ewenate 'ayaamenume, mekeneyaatume 'emenate qaalene lamamulaate yaanasaasaale.

muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) bataweraate wesethe katathaqasabate baahheriwe gaare yamisemaamaa ka'alaahe yatalaaka male'eketanyaa hono bamathaalaacawe gizee kanaresu kafilocu yataweraate male'ekete yathaqomawene nagare celaa yelaalu. bawesethu kamiganyawe 'ewenatenaa mamariyaa kamaayethaqame `eweqate 'alebaa maayeme sawe gaare bamamasaasale male'eketune kaqume nagare saayeqotherute kajarebaacawe xwaalaa yethelutaale.

'ayehudaawiyaane ya'alaahene mamariyaa batawu gizee ba'eresu fanetaa shayethwanaate basulayemaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) negeszenaa laaye yaqathafutene hhasate takatalu. sulayemaane negeszenaawene yaatzanaawe badegemete 'enedahona mogatu. 'ayehudaawiyaane 'enedamogatute sulayemaane degemetene bamaszeraate kehedatene 'alefatzamame; nagare gene lasawoce mamokariyaa 'enaa fatanaa bahulatu malaa'ekete hharute 'enaa maarute babaabilone lafatanaa yawaradawene degemete shayethwanaate sawocene bamaasetamaaraacawe mekeneyaate kaadu. 'enazihe hulate malaa'ekete 'enyaa lasawoce mafatanyaa 'enaa mamokariyaa nane, degemetene bamamaare kehedate wesethe 'ategebaa bamaalate saayaasethanaqequ 'anedeneme sawe degemetene 'alaasetamaarume. mekeraacawene yaaletaqabala degemetene ka'enaresu yemaaraale. kadegemeteme thelaacaane bamazeraate babaale 'enaa bamisete makaakale yamilayaayubatene nagare yemaaraalu. 'enazihe degemetanyoce ba'alaahe feqaade bihone 'eneji maaneneme magudaate 'ayecelume. yamigodaacawene 'enaa yamaayethaqemaacaweneme nagare yemaaraalu. 'ayehudaawiyaane ba'alaahe matsehhafe degemetene yalawatha bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame `edelenaa dereshaa 'enedaleelawe ba'eregethe yaaweqaalu. ba'alaahe malakotaawi male`ekete 'enaa mamariyaa meteke degemetene bamalawathe nafesocaacawene yashathubate nagare menenyaa kafaa. yamithaqemaacawene yamiyaawequ bihonu wadazihe 'asaafaari tagebaare 'enaa geletze thememate baalegabu nabare.

'ayehudaawiyaane ba'ewenate ba'alaahe biyaamenu, te`ezaazune bamatagebare 'enaa 'eresune maamatze bamatawe 'alaahene bifaru, 'enaresu kamiganyubate nagare ya'alaahe menedaa yatashaala yehonelaacawe nabare. yamithaqemaacawene biyaawequ 'alaahene bafaru nabare.

'alaahe 'enedihe bamaalate 'amaanyoce malekaame qaalaatocene mamerathe 'enedaminorebaacawe 'amalakata:: <<'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! 'ayehudaawiyaane male`eketune 'athaamemawenaa (ra`ina) "raa`inaa" "qilenate/monyenate" yamilawene yaqaalune teregume 'asebawe nabiyune (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) selamiyaanaagerubate ('amaanyoce nabiyune bamiyaanaagerubate 'agebaabe huneetaacenene takataatale yamile teregume yesathaale) yamilawene qaale 'atethaqamu. yehene bare lamazegaate 'alaahe qaalune mathaqame kalakala. bameteku yametenaagarawene 'esekeneradaa ('nZurna) "'unezurenaa" "thabeqane/taagasane" yamilawene qaale 'enedithaqamu 'amaanyocene 'azaza. yehe qaale 'ashaami baalehona maleku yamifalagawene melu`e teregumene yesathaale. 'alaahene lamikedu sawoce 'asaamaami yahona qethaate yethabeqaacawaale.

matsehhafune katasathute sawoceme hona kathaa`otaaweyaane 'enaziyaa kehedatene yafatzamute kageetaacehu zanede bezume yehune 'anasetanyaameneme `aayenate malekaame la'enaaneta mawaradune 'ayewadume. 'alaahe ba'ezenatu lanabiyenate, lamalakotaawi male'ekete, la'emenate kasawoce yafalagawene yemarethaale. 'alaahe yataalaaqe terufaate baalabeete nawe. fetherataate yamidaresaacawe malekaame nagaroce hulu ka'eresu yataganyu naacawe. male'eketanyaawene malaaku 'enaa matsehhafune maaweradu katerufaatocu makaakale yamithaqasu naacawe.>>

'alaahe (subehhaanahu wata`aalaa) kaqure'aane wesethe ya'aneditene 'aneqatze denegaagee wayeneme qaale sisherenaa sawoce sizanagute kaziyaa baxwaalaa baziyaace 'aneqatze meteke baqerebeme yehune zageyeto kareswa yabalatha thaqaamine 'aliyaame ya'ereswane `aayenate 'aneqatze 'enedamitakaa yenaagaraale. yehe ba'alaahe `eweqate 'enaa thebabe yamihone nagare nawe. 'aneta nabiye hoye! 'alaahe huluneme nagare caaye mahonune taaweqaalahe; yafalagawene yaadaregaale; yafalagaweneme yefaredaale.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'alaahe 'eresu yasamaayaate 'enaa yamedere baalabeete 'enedahona, yafalagawene 'enedamifarede, baarocuneme bafalagawe 'enedamiyaazeze, kafalagaweme 'enedamikalakelaacawe, kahegume yafalagawene 'enedamiyaatzanaanaa yafalagaweneme 'enedamishere ba'eregethe 'aweqahale. ka'alaaheme baashaagare la'enaaneta gudaayaacehune yamiyaasetanaabere wadaaje, kanaanetame gudaatene yamiyaasewagedelaacehu radaate yalaacehume. yazihe hulu xaalaafi 'enaa baziheme laaye caaye yahonawe 'alaahe becaa nawe.1

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! male'eketanyaacehune yataqaawemo 'enaa yageteranyenatene theyaaqee letethayequ 'ayegabaacehume. yamusaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) hhezeboce nabiyaacawe musaane ('arina 'llWaha jahra@) <<'alaahene bageletze 'asaayane>> bamaalate 'enedathayaqute `aayenate theyaaqee letethayequ 'ayegabaame. 'emenateneme bakehedate yalawatha qathetanyaawene manegade ba'eregetheme setwale.

banafesocaacawe wesethe bamiganyawe meqanyenate mekeneyaate ka'ayehudaawiyaane 'enaa naswaraawoce bezuwocu 'enaaneta 'emenatene kataqabalaacehu baxwaalaa qademo thaa`otene taamaleku 'enedanabaraacehute kahadiyaane 'aderegawe limaleswacehu yemanyaalu. yehene yamimanyute male`eketanyaawe ka'alaahe zanede yezo yamathaawe nagare 'ewenate mahonu katagalatzalaacawe baxwaalaa nawe. 'amaanyoce hoye! selamiyaadaregute tagebaare yeqere balu; ya'alaahe ferede 'esekimathaa derase sela`eweqate 'alebaanataacawenaa nafesocaacawe wesethe selaalawe kefaate bayeqeretaa 'elafu. ya'alaaheme ferede 'enaa te`ezaazu ba'eregethe mathaa; kahadiyaanoce selaamene kaalehona gebere makefalene 'aliyaame thorenatene 'enedimarethu tadaraga. 'alaaheme nagarune hulu caaye nawe; 'ayaamalethuteme.

'alaahe 'amaanyocene yakahadiyaanene tenekosaanaa seeraane 'eneditaagasu kaazazaacawe baxwaalaa ba'emenataacawe laaye 'eneditzanu 'enaa 'emenataacawene 'enediyaagolabetute siyaazezaacawe 'enedihe yelaale::
maa`ezanune, gedeetaawocune 'enaa sunaawocune hulu thabeqaacehu salaatene sagadu. yaganezabocaacehune zakaame lamigabaacawe sethu. baheyewataacehu maanenyaaweneme malekaame beteszaru 'enaa lanafesocaacehu seneqe 'aderegaacehu lawadiyaanyaawe `aalame betaaseqademu, menedaawene baferedu `elate geetaacehu zanede taaganyutaalaacehu. 'alaaheme yemanadaacexwaale; 'alaahe yameteszarutene nagare tamalekaace nawe. selahoname lahulume yamigabaawene yesathaale.

'ayehudocenaa naswaraawoce janate talayetaa la'enaresu becaa 'enedatazagaajace tanaagaru. 'ayehudoce:: <<'ayehudaawi kaalehona basetaqare leelaa maaneme janate 'ayegabaame>> 'alu. naswaraawoceme - <<naswaraa kaalehona basetaqare leelaa maaneme janatene yamigabaa yalame>> bamaalate tanaagaru. yehe kanetu menyotaacawe 'enaa qezhataacawe nawe. nabiyu hoye! 'enedihe bamaalate malese sethaacawe:: <<bametemogetute nagare 'ewenatanyoce betehonu maaserajaacehune 'amethu.>>

'enaho janate yamigabaawe yaa 'eresu wada 'alaahe fitune yaazora sihone 'amelekotene laresu netzuhe yaadaraga, kaziyaame male'eketanyaawene bamakatale 'amelekotune yaasaamara sawe (budene) nawe. kayatenyaaweme budene bihone janate yamigabaawe 'enedihe yaalawe sawe nawe. 'enedihe yaalute sawoce menedaacawe geetaacawe zanede nawe. bamachiwe `aalame kamigathemaacawe nagare segaate yalabaacaweme. kaziheme `aalame thelawe baheedute nagare hhazane 'ayegathemaacaweme. yehe nabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) katalaaku baxwaalaa la'alaahe fetzume taazaazhoce yahonute muselimoce becaa yamigalatzubate baaheri nawe.

'ayehudoce, <<keresetiyaanoce batekekelanyaa 'emenate laaye. 'ayedalume>> bamaalate tanaagaru. keresetiyaanoceme, <<'ayehudoce batekekelanyaa 'emenate laaye 'ayedalume>> bamaalate tanaagaru. yehenene yaminaagarute 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye yaawaradawene yaala leyunate banabiyaatoce hulu 'enediyaamenu yamiyaazwacawene malakotaawi matsaahhefete 'eyaanababu nawe. bazihe tagebaaraacawe male'eketanyocene 'enaa wada 'enaresu yatawaradutene matsaahhefete bamulu kaasetabaabalute thaa`otaaweyaane gaare yemasaasalaalu. bamahonume 'alaahe (subehhaanahu wata`aalaa) baferedu `elate bazihe gudaaye batawazaagabu sawoce makaakale 'eresu baawaradawe male`ekete hulu kaaletaamana basetaqare madehene 'enedaleela lasawoce batanaagarabate fetehawi feredu yedaanyaacawaale.

ya'alaahe seme bamasejidoce 'enedaayewasaanaa bawesethaacawe salaate, 'alaahene maawadase 'enaa qure'aanene maanebabe kakalakala 'enedihume masejidocene lamaaferase 'enaa lamaabalaashate masejidoce wesethe 'amelekote 'enedaayefatzame bamakalekaleme hona yamasejidocene genebaataa bamanaade bategaate kamirwarwathe sawe yabalatha badalanyaa yalame. 'enaresu kamiganyubate kehedate 'anetzaare 'enaa ka'alaahe manegade sawocene bamakalekalaacawe; masejidocene lamaabalaashate yamirwarwathu sawoce lebaacawe baferehate 'eyamataa bihone 'eneji wada masejidoce ligabu 'ayegabaacaweme. la'enaresu bamederaawiwe `aalame ba'amaanyoce 'eje weredate 'enedamikanaanebu tawasenwale. bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame dagemo sawocene ka'alaahe masejidoce bamakalekalaacawe mekeneyaate taalaaqe qethaate yethabeqaacawaale.

yameseraaqunaa yame`eraabu, bamakaakalaacaweme yamiganyawe hulu negeszenaa ya'alaahe nawe. baarocune yafalagawene yaazezaale; wadayateme fitaacehune betemalesu yametezorute wada 'alaahe nawe. wada bayetale maqedise wayeneme wada kaa`ebaa fitaacehune 'enedetaazoru biyaazezaacehu, wayeneme qibelaane betesetu wayeneme wada qibelaa mazore baayecaalaacehu 'aqethaachaawoce hulu ya'alaahe bamahonaacawe ba'enaaneta laaye hathi'ate yalabaacehume. 'alaahe ba'ezenatu 'enaa bacarenatu hulune fetherataatune basefaate yamiyaadaarese cerotaawe safi geetaa nawe. yasawocene hasaabenenaa tagebaareneme `aawaaqi nawe.

'ayehudaawiyaane, keresetiyaanoce 'enaa thaa`otaawiyaane <<'alaahe leje 'alawe>> bamaalate tanaagaru. 'alaahe kazihe yalaaqanaa yataqadasa nawe. 'eresu kafethuraanu hulu yatabeqaaqaa nawe. leje yamiyaasefalegawe nawe leje yamiyezawe. 'alaahe gene yasamaayaatenaa yamedere negeszenaa ya'eresu yahona geetaa nawe. fethuraane hulu la'eresu 'agalegaayoce 'enaa taazaazhoce naacawe. 'enedafalagaweme yaadaregaacawaale.

'alaahe samaayaatene, mederene 'enaa bamakaakalaacawe yamiganyu nagarocene hulu yaqadama 'amesaayaa saayenoraacawe fathara. 'anedene nagare siwasene 'enaa 'enedihone sifalage (kun) <<hune>> yelawaale; 'alaaheme 'enedihone bafalagawe maleku yehonaale. ya'eresune te`ezaaze 'enaa wesaanee yamimalese yalame.

ka'enaziyaa matsehhafene katasathute 'enaa kathaa`otaawiyaane makaakale 'ewenatene lamakaade <<'alaahe yaala 'aganaanye lamene baqathetaa 'ayaanaageraneme>> wayeneme dagemo <<la'enyaa becaa yatalaya tachabaache ta`aamere lamene 'ayaamathaaleneme?>> bamaalate thayaqu. meneme 'enekwaa zamanaacawe 'enaa seferaacawe bilayaayeme kazihe bafite male'eketanyocaacawene yaasetabaabalu hhezeboceme 'enedihu belawe nabare. hhaqe sinagaraacawe 'ewenate belawe lamiqabalu therethaaree lamaayegaarathebaacawenaa geteranyenate lamaayekalakelaacawe sawoce 'aneqatzocene ba'eregethe 'aberaaretanaale.

nabiyu hoye! 'amaanyocene bajanate letaabasere, kahadiyaanene kajahaname letaasethanaqeqe therethaaree baleelabate tekekelanyaa 'emenate lekanehale. male'eketune maaderase 'eneji leelaa xaalaafinate yalabeheme. kajahaname gwaadoce bamale'eketehe selaalaamanute sawoce 'alaahe 'ayethayeqeheme.

'alaahe nabiyune bamaaseganezabe 'enaa bamaasethaneqaqe 'enedihe.yelaacawaale:: <<selaamene 'esekaaletawekenaa 'enaresu yaalubatene manegade 'esekaaletakataleke derase 'ayehudaawiyaanenaa keresetiyaanoce 'anetane bafetzume 'ayewaduheme. yehe geletze yahona 'ewenate kamathaalehe baxwaalaa wadanaresu betezanabale ka'alaahe yamiyaadenehe radaate wayeme 'agaazhene 'ataaganyeme.>> yehe hhaqene yamatawe 'enaa kahhasate sawoce gaare ba'aberonate yamagwaaze 'adagaane kamagelatze 'anetzaare yatathaqasa nawe.

matsehhafe katasathute sawoca makaakale kafile cheferoce wadanaresu yatawaradawene 'enaa ba'ejocaacawe yamiganyawene matsehhafe 'enedamitagaberu 'enedihume yamatsehhafaacawene male'ekete batekekele 'enedamikatalu qure'aane yenaagaraale. 'enazihe sawoce bamatsaahhefetaacawe wesethe yamuhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'ewenatanyenate yamithaqumu meleketocene yaaganyaalu. selaziheme bafethenate baresu male`eketanyenate 'emenatene taqabalu. leeloce matsehhafe katasathu sawoce makaakale yahonu cheferoce dagemo bakehedataacawe laaye getere honawe qathalu. wetheetaacaweme keserate hona.

yaseraa'eele lejoce hoye! ba'enaaneta laaye yaawaalekutene qusaawinaa 'emenataawi tzagaawoceene 'asetaawesu. 'enee kazamanaacehu sawoce hulu banabiyenate 'enaa banegeszenaa tzagaa yaasebalathekwaacehu mahoneeneme chemere 'asetaawesu.

ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe ba'enaaneta 'enaa baferedu qane qethaate makaakale geredoshene 'aderegu. baziyaane qane maanenyaawaame nafese kaleelaawaa nafese yametaaganyawe 'eredaataa yalaateme. mene bezu bihoneme 'enekwaane beezaa kareswa taqabaayenatene 'ayaaganyeme. meneme yaahele yatakabara 'enekwaa hono lareswa maaneme bishamagele tasaminate 'ayenoraweme. ka'alaaheme wadiyaa yamiradaate 'agaazhe 'ayenoraateme.

'alaahe baariyaawene beraahimene (`alayehi 'asalaame) wadaresu baasetalaalafawe hegegaate 'enaa yate`ezaaze qaalaate sifatenawe yanabarawene huneetaa 'awesaa. 'eresu yataazazawene batamwalaa maleku fatzama. 'alaahe lanabiyu beraahime <<batagebaarocehe 'enaa basena megebaarehe sawoce yamikataluhe 'are'ayaa (mari) 'adaregehalahu>> 'alawe. beraahimeme <<geetaayee hoye! kazereyaawoceeme 'enedihu sawoce yamikatalwacawe mariwocene ('are'ayaawocene) 'aderege>> sile thayaqa. 'alaaheme <<lamarinate yasathahuhe qaale kidaane kateweledocehe badaayoce lahonute 'ayedareseme>> bamaalate malasalate.

'alaahe yatakabarawene beete (kaa`ebaane) yasawoce leboce banaafeqotenaa bawedeetaa yaminethalathalebate 'enaa katagwaazu baxwaalaa badegaami yamimalasubate mamalashaa yaadaragabatene huneetaa 'asetaawese. lasawoce dahenenate yamiyaaganyubate tzathetanyaame 'adaragenawe. 'enedihume lasawoce beraahime kaa`ebaane siganabaa yeqomebate kanabarawe seferaa 'enedisagedu 'azazenaacawe. (kaa`ebaane) salaatene maaqwaaqwaamiyaa 'adaragenawe. beraahime 'enaa leju semaa`ilene yatakabarawene beete netzuhe kaalehonu nagaroce 'enaa kathaa`otaate 'enediyaatzadu, bawesethu lathawaafe, la'amelekote 'enedihume 'eziyaawe lamaqoyate 'enaa basalaate 'alaahene lamigazu hulu 'enediyaamacaacute 'azazenaacawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! beraahime geetaawene bamimaatzanebate gizee <<geetaayee hoye! makaane bawesethu 'anedeme sawe lamathefo nagare yamaayegaalathebate tzathetanyaa 'agare 'aderegawe; nawaariwocuneme kaferaaferee `aayenatoce magebaacawe; yeheneneme sisaaye baanetanaa bamacharashaawe qane laamanute 'amaanyoce becaa yamigabaa 'aderegawe>> baala gizee 'asetaawese. 'alaaheme 'enedihe 'alawe:: <<ka'enaresu makaakale kehedatene lafatzama baqerebitu `aalame teneshene theqeme 'esathawaalahu; kaziyaame baferedu `elate bagedaaje wada 'esaate qethaate 'asethagaawaalahu. baferedume `elate yamimalasebate macharashaa bathaame kafaa.>>

'aneta nabiye hoye! beraahime 'enaa semaa`ile raasaacawene zeqe bamaaderage 'enaa la'alaahe bamatanaanase, <<geetaacene hoye! szeraacenene taqabalane; 'aneta latheriyaacene malese sachi; balebonaacene yaalawene hasaabaacenene 'enaa tagebaaraacenene `aawaaqi nahe>>; 'eyaalu yakaa`ebaane maszarate kafe siyaadaregu yahonawene 'asetaawese.

<<geetaacene hoye! lamamariyaahe fetzume taazaazhoce, la'aneta raasaacenene zeqe yamenaadarege, ka'aneta gaare 'anedeneme ya'amelekote tagaari yamaanaadarege 'aderegane. kateweledocaaceneme la'aneta fetzume taazaazhe yahonu hhezebocene 'aderege. ya'amelekotehe sere`aate 'enedeete 'enedahona 'asetamerane. 'anetane bamataazaze wesethe yaalabenene dekematenaa hathi'ate yeqere balane. 'aneta kabaarocehe wada 'aneta latamalasa sawe yeqere baaye, la'enaresume 'azaanye nahe.

geetaacene hoye! yaawaradekaacawene 'aneqatzocehene ba'enaresu laaye yamiyaanabebe; qure'aanenaa sunaane yamiyaasetameraacawe; ba'aneta laaye ya'amelekote tagaari kamaaderage 'enaa tzayaafe kahonu nagaroce hulu yamiyaatharaacawene kasemaa`ile zereyaawoce yahonane male'eketanyaa wada 'enaresu laake. 'enaho 'aneta 'ashanaafi, beretu, baszeraahe 'enaa baferedehe thebabanyaa nahenaa.>>

'ewenatene teto wada hhasate bamaheede raasune yaaqeela 'enaa 'akaaheedune yaabalaasha 'enedihume lanafesu zeqethatene yamarathanaa nafesune yabadala kaalehona basetaqare yaberaahimene 'emenate yamitawe 'enaa wada leelaa 'emenate yamizanabale sawe yalame. beraahimene baqerebitu `aalame wadaaje 'enaa male'eketanyaa 'aderegane marathenawe. bamacharashaawe `aalame dagemo 'alaahe gedeetaa yaadaragabaacawene katawathu 'enaa ya'eresune wedeetaa kaaganyute dagaage sawoce makaakale nawe.

'alaahe <<'amelekotene la'enee becaa netzuhe 'aderege, la'enee fetzume taazaazhe hune>> silawe la'alaahe malese bamasethate:: <<yasawoce fathaari 'enaa magaabiyaacawe, yanagaraacaweme 'asetanaabaari lahonawe 'alaahe fetzume taazaazhe nanye>> bamaalate fatheno raasune lageetaawe tagazhi bamaaderagu 'alaahe marathawe.

('aslamtu lirabWi 'l`alamiyna) <<'enee la`aalamaatu geetaa 'ejeene sathahu>> yametelawaane qaale beraahime lalejocu 'adaraa satha. yaa`equbeme 'enedihu yehecene qaale lalejocu 'adaraa satha. hulatume lalejocaacawe:: <<'alaahe la'enaaneta selaamene kahaayemaanote bakule marathalaacehu. la'alaahe bageletzeme hona basewere raasaacehune 'asaalefaacehu bamasethate mote 'esekimathaabaacehu derase selaamene 'athebeqaacehu yaazu>> bamaalate makaru.

'enaaneta yaa`eqube mote bamathaabate gizee yanabarawene huneetaa lamaayate taganyetaacehu nabarene? lejocune 'enedihe belo sithayeqaacawe? <<ka'enee mote baxwaalaa maanene nawe yametaamalekute?!>>; <<'enyaa yamenaamalekawe ya'anetane 'enaa ya'abaatocehene yaberaahimene, yasemaa`ilene 'enaa yasehhaqene 'agaare yaleelawene becanyaa 'amelaake nawe. 'enyaame la'eresu becaa 'ejaacenene yasathane fetzume taazaazhoce nane>> silu malese sathu.

'enazihe ka'enaaneta bafite baqadamute hhezeboce wesethe yaalafu teweledoce naacawe. wada 'aseqadamute szeraacaweme heedawaale. malekaameme yehune kefu yaszarute 'alaacawe; la'enaanetame yaszaraacehute 'alaacehu. selaszeraacawe 'atethayaqume; selaszeraacehume 'ayethayaqume; 'anede sawe baleelaa sawe hathi'ate 'ayeyaazeme; hulume bamiyaaseqademawe szeraa yemanadaale. ka'enaaneta bafite yanabaru hhezebocene szeraa mamalekate wada szeraacehu kamamalekate zenegu 'ayaaderegaacehu. ka'alaahe 'ezenate baxwaalaa malekaame szeraawe kaalehona basetaqare 'anedene sawe yamithaqemawe nagare yalame.

'ayehudaawiyaane lazihe tewelede <<'ayehude hunu qathetanyaawene manegade temaraalaacehu>> 'alu. keresetiyaanoceme 'enedazihu <<keresetiyaane hunu qathetanyaawene manegade temaraalaacehu>> 'alu. nabiyu hoye! malese setesathaacawe <<katasaasaata 'emenate wada tekekelanyaa 'emenate yaazanabalawene yaberaahimene manegade 'enekatalaalane;'eresu ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaari kaadaragute sawoce 'alenabarame>> balaacawe.

'amaanyoce hoye! ka'ayehudaawiyaane 'enaa kanaswaraawoce ya'enedihe yaala taqabaayenate yaleelawe 'emenate baalabeete lahonute ba'alaahe wadanyaa batawaradaweme qure'aane, wada beraahime 'enedihume wada zereyaawocu semaa`ile, sehhaqe 'enaa yaa`eqube batawaradawe; kayaa`equbeme lejoce nabiyaate bahonute laaye batawaradawe; 'alaahe lamusaa basathawe taweraate, la`isaame basathawe nejile, 'alaahe lanabiyaate hulu basathaacawe malakotaawi matsaahhefete 'amenanaale balu. bakafilu 'amenane bataqarute bamakaade bamakaakalaacawe leyunatene 'anaadaregeme. yelequneme bahulume 'enaamenaalane. 'enyaame la'eresu becaa fetzume taazaazhoce 'enaa raasaacenene zeqe 'aderaagiwoce nane balu.

'ayehudaawiyaane, naswaraawoce 'enaa leeloceme kahadiyaane 'enaaneta baamanaacehubate 'emenate kaamanu 'alaahe wada marathawe qathetanyaa manegade ba'eregethe tamaretawaale (lasekeete baqetawaale). banabiyaate hulu bamakaade wayeneme bakafile nabiyaate bamakaade ka'emenate birequ, bazihe gizee 'enaresu baleyunate 'enaa bataqaaraani manegade laaye naacawe. nabiyu hoye! bazihe 'atezane; 'alaahe ka'enaresu theqaate yetaadagehale; katanekolaacawe yethabeqehale; ba'enaresume laaye delene yaagonaatzefehale. 'eresu negegeraacawene sami; hasaabenaa szeraacaweneme `aawaaqi nawenaa.

bawesethaacehume bawechiyaawi gatzetaacehume 'alaahe baresu laaye yafatharaacehune ya'alaahene 'emenate 'athebeqaacehu yaazu. ka'alaahe 'emenate leelaa yatashaala 'emenate yalame. ya'alaahe haayemaanote katafathero gaare yamisemaamaa, malekaame nagarocene 'aseganyi, mathefo nagarocene takalaakaaye nawe. 'enediheme balu:: <<'enyaa 'anedeme ya'amelekote tagaari laleelawe la'alaahe becaa tagazhiwoce nane.>>

nabiyu hoye! 'enedihe bale:: <<yamatsehhafu baalabeetoce hoye! ka'enyaa yeleqe 'enaaneta la'alaahe 'enaa la'emenatu yabalatha tagabiwoce 'enedahonaacehu temogetunaalaacehune? 'alaahe yahulaaceneme geetaa nawe. la'enyaa 'enaaneta yamaatethayaqubate szeraawocaacene 'alune; la'enaanetame 'enyaa yamaanethayaqebate szeraawocaacehu 'alwacehu. hulume baszeraawe yemanadaale. 'enyaa ba'amelekote 'enaa bamataazaze 'alaahene becaa 'amelaakiwoce nane. ba'eresume laaye maaneneme 'anaagaaraame.>>

yamatsehhafu baalabeetoce hoye! lamahonu beraahime, semaa`ile, sehhaqe, yaa`eqube 'enaa kayaa`eqube lejoceme yahonu nabiyaate ba'ayehudaawinate wayeme bakeresetenaa 'emenate laaye nabaru telaalaacehune? nabiyu hoye! `aawaaqiwe 'alaahe nawe wayenese 'enaaneta?! bamaalate thayeqaacawe. yatathaqasute nabiyaate ba'enaresu 'emenate laaye 'enedanabaru katanaagaru ba'eregethe hhasate tanaagerawaale. mekeneyaatume nabiyaatocu yatalaakutenaa yaalafute kataweraate 'enaa kanejile mawarade bafite nabare. baziheme mugetaacawe ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyaawe laaye yataqathafa hhasate 'enedahona 'enedihume wadanaresu yawaradawene 'ewenataa yadabaqu mahonu geletze hona. 'eneda matsehhafu baalabeetoce ka'alaahe yaawaqawene yataragaagatha mesekerenate kadabaqa sawe balaaye badale yafatzama yalame. 'alaahe szeraacawene yamizanagaa 'ayedalame; yaszeraacawene waagaame yemanadaacawaale.

'enazihe ka'enaaneta bafite yaalafu hhezeboce naacawe. wada 'aseqadamute szeraacawe 'alefawaale. sela szeraacawe 'atethayaqume; 'enaresume sela 'enaaneta szeraa 'ayethayaqume; 'anedu baleelaawe hathi'ate 'ayeyaazeme; baleelaawe szeraame 'ayethayaqememe. yelequneme hulume baaseqadamawe szeraa yemanadaale.

'ayehudaawiyaane 'enaa ba'enaresu manegade laaye kamiganyu 'asemasaaye manaafeqaane makaakale qilocu; muselimoce kazihe bafite wada bayetale maqedise kanabaraacawe ya'amelekote 'aqethaachaa 'enedizoru mene 'adaragaacawe? silu yenaagaraalu. nabiyu hoye! 'enedihe bamaalate malese sethaacawe:: <<yameseraaqe, yame`eraabe 'enaa yaleelocume 'aqethaachaawoce negeszenaa hulu ya'alaahe nawe. kabaarocu yafalagawene wada falagawe 'aqethaachaa yaazoraale. 'eresu 'alaahe kasawoce yafaqadawene themate wadaleelabate qathetanyaa manegade yemaraale.>>

la'enaaneta yawadadenawene qibelaa (ya'amelekote 'aqethaachaa ) 'enedaadaragenawe hulu 'enaanetaneme merethe, fetehawi 'enaa kahhezeboce hulu makaakalanyaa 'adaragenaacehu. 'alaahe 'enediyaadaresu yaazazaacawene male`ekete nabiyaate lahhezebocaacawe 'enedaadarasu batenesaa'ee `elate temasakeru zanede 'enedihume male'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) wadanaaneta yatalaakabatene male'ekete 'enedaadarasa ba'enaaneta laaye masekaari lihone zanede mizaanaawi teweledoce 'adaragenaacehu. 'alaahe yadanagagawene yamiwadawene 'enaa la'eresunaa lamale'eketanyaawe taazaazhe yahonawene lamalayate 'eneji wadaziyaa fitehene 'azurahe tesagedebate yanabarawene ya'amelekote 'aqethaachaa bayetale maqedesene 'enedilawathe 'alaadarageneme. 'alaahe ba'eresu 'enediyaamenu 'enaa labaarocu yamidanagegaacawe mamariyaawoce theleqe thebabe yaalaacawe 'enedahonu 'enediganazabu sekeetene yasathaacawe 'amaanyoce siqaru laleeloce yamajamariyaawe qibelaa (ya'amelekote mafatzamiyaa 'aqethaachaa) lawethe kabaade nabare. 'alaahe ba'eresu maamanaacehune 'enedihume wada bayetale maqedise zoraacehu yasagadaacexwaacawene salaatocaacehune kanetu yamiyaadarege 'ayedalame. 'alaahe lasawoce reheruhe 'enaa 'azaanye nawe. bamikabedaacawe nagare 'ayaasechaneqaacaweme; yamalekaame szeraacawene menedaame kanetu 'ayaadaregeme.

'aneta nabiye hoye! qibelaahe 'aneta wadametewadawe ya'amelekote 'aqethaachaa 'enedilawathe yamiyaazeze malakotaawi male'ekete 'enediwarede bamafalage fitehene wada samaaye maagalaabathehene ba'eregethe 'enemalakataalane. 'aneta wadametewadawenaa wadametemarethawe ya'amelekote mafatzamiyaa 'aqethaachaa 'enaazorehalane. yehe 'aqethaachaa babayetale maqedise meteke yatalawathawe <<bayetu-laahile hharaame>> nawe. selaziheme bamakaa wadamiganyawe yatakabarawe ya'alaahe beete fitehene 'azure. 'amaanyoce hoye! yateme botaa betehonu basegedataacehu (basalaataacehu) waqete wadaresu 'aqethaachaa fitaacehune 'azuru. ka'ayehudaawiyaanenaa kanaswaraawoce matsehhafene yatasathute gudaayu bamatsehhafaacawe wesethe yatathaqasa bamahonu yaqibelaawe malawathe kageetaacawe yahona 'ewenate mahonune yaaweqaalu. 'enaziyaa ka'ewenate yaafanagathu sawoce kamiszarute nagare 'alaahe yazanagaa 'ayedalame. 'eresu ba'eregethe `aawaaqi nawe; baziyaame yaszeraacawene wetheete yesathaacawaale.

nabiyu hoye! yaqibelaawe lawethe 'ewenate lamahonu meneme yaahele ta`aameraatocene 'enaa maaserajaawocene yezahe 'enaziyaane ka'ayehude 'enaa kanaswaraawoce matsehhafene yatasathutene betemathaalaacawe, yaamathaakxawene lamakaade 'enaa 'ewenateneme laalamakatale yamikoru bamahonaacawe mekeneyaate ya'anetane qibelaa 'ayekatalume. 'anetame 'alaahe kaziyaa 'aqethaachaa kaazorahe baxwaalaa qibelaacawene yametekatale 'ayedalaheme. 'anedaacawe leelaanyaacawene kahadi yamiyaadarege bamahonume kafilaacawe yakafilune qibelaa yamikatalume 'ayedalume. therethaaree yaleelabate tekekelanyaa `eweqate kamathaalehe baxwaalaa baqibelaa gudaaye 'enaa bataqarute hegegaatoce ya'enaresune semeete yametekatale kahona, yaane gizee 'aneta qathetanyaawene manegade bamatawenaa semeetene bamakatale raasaacawene kabadalu sawoce tehonaalahe. yehe 'agalaalatze 'enaresune makatale yatawagaza sela mahonu lanabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yatanagarabate yehune 'eneji 'alaahe nabiyune yatathabaqu yaadaragaacawe bamahonu karesaacawe baxwaalaame laalute hhezebocaacawe yatasatha maasethaneqaqiyaa nawe.

ka'ayehudaawiyaane 'enaa kanaswaraawoce liqaawenete yahonute yamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) nabiyenate melekete selahonawe yaqibelaa lawethe gudaaye; lejocaacawene 'enedamiyaawequte 'ewenate mahonune yaaweqaalu. kamahonume gaare ka'enaresu yahonu kafile cheferoce kanafesaacawe bahona meqanyenate mekeneyaate tekekelanyaa mahonune 'eyaawaqu 'ewenatene yedabeqaalu.
yehe kageetaahe yahona 'ewenate nawe. nabiyu hoye! selatekekelanyaanatu kamitharaatharute 'atehune.

'eyaanedaanedu tewelede fitune yamiyaazorebate menaabaawime yehune tachabaache 'aqethaachaa 'alawe. yeheme bamahonu teweledoce ba'ameleko mafatzamiyaa 'aqethaachaa 'enaa 'alaahe badanagagalaacawe nagaroce yatalayaayu naacawe.ya'aqethaachaacawe malayaayate ba'alaahe te`ezaazenaa denegaagee maszarate yatafatzama 'esekahona derase cegere yalaweme. 'amaanyoce hoye! 'enedetetagaberwacawe wadataazazaacehute malekaame szeraawoce tasheqadaadamu. baferedume `elate baszeraacehu yemanadaacehu zanede yateme botaa betehonume 'alaahe yesabasebaacexwaale. 'alaahe banagaroce hulu laaye caaye nawe. 'enaanetane masabesabeme hona yaszeraacehune waagaa masethate 'ayecageraweme.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'anetame honeke takataayocehe kayatenyaaweme 'aqethaachaa betewathu 'enaa yateme betehonu kaziyaame salaatene masegade betefalegu, wada takabarawe masejide (masejidale hharaame) 'aqethaachaa fitaacehune 'azuru. yehe kageetaahe wada 'aneta yatalaalafa hhaqe nawe. 'alaahe kameteszarute nagare zenegu 'ayedalame. 'alaahe szeraacehune `aawaaqi nawe; baszeraacehume laaye yemanadaacexwaale.

'aneta nabiye hoye! bayateme 'aqethaachaa betewathaanaa segedatene betefalege yamasejidale hharaamene 'aqethaachaa yaaze. 'amaanyoce hoye! bayatenyaaweme 'aqethaachaa honaacehu salaatene masegade setefalegu fitaacehune wada takabarawe ya'alaahe beete 'aqethaachaa 'azuru. yehe sawoce ba'enaaneta laaye yamiyaaqarebute maaserajaa 'enedaayenoraacawe yahona nawe.nagare gene 'enaziyaa badalanyaa yahonute sawoce; 'enaresu bakehedataacawe yeqathelaalu; dakaamaa maaserajaawocene kamaaqerabe 'ayewagadume. yaazazawene bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaqothabe geetaacehune becaa feru; 'enaresune 'ateferu. 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye tzagaawene lifatzeme 'enaa kaleeloce hhezeboce yatalayaacehu liyaadaregaacehu wada kaa`ebaa 'aqethaachaa fitaacehune 'enedetaazoru danagaga. sawoce fitaacawene kamiyaazorubate 'aqethaachaa hulu balaache wadahonaweme 'aqethaachaa limaraacehu yehenene 'adaraga.

ba'enaaneta laaye 'aneqatzocaacenene yamiyaanabebe, malekaame 'enaa yalaaqu tagebaaraatene 'enedeteszaru yamiyaazezaacehu, kawedeqe 'enaa katathalu nagaroce bamakalekale 'enaanetane yamiyaatharaacehu, ka'enaanetawe yahonane male'eketanyaa wadanaaneta 'enedalaakene hulu ba'enaaneta laaye leeloce tachamaari tzagaawocene fatzamene. yehe male'eketanyaa ka'emenate 'enaa kahheyewate gudaaye yamaataawequtene yaasetameraacexwaale.

balebonaacehu 'enaa ba'akaalaacehu 'asetaawesunye; 'enaanetane bamaawadase 'enaa bamathabaqe 'awasaacexwaalahu. yaszeraa wetheete yaszeraawe `aayenate maleke 'alawe. ba'enaaneta laaye yawaalekutene tzagaayeene 'amasegenu; tzagaawoceene bamaasetabaabale 'enaa tzagaawoceene ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme batadaraga nagare laaye bamaawaale 'atekaadunye.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ba'enee 'amelekote 'enaa late`ezaazee 'eje bamasethate laaye bate`egesete 'enaa basalaate taagazu. 'alaahe kataagaashoce gaare nawe. yamalekaame nagarocene sekeete yesathaacexwaale.

'amaanyoce hoye! 'enaziyaa bategele meedaa ba'alaahe manegade yatasawetene 'enaresu mutaane naacawe, leeloce 'enedamimotute hulu motawaale 'atebalu. 'enaresu geetaacawe zanede hheyaawe naacawe; nagare gene 'enaaneta heyaawenataacawene 'ateradume. yatalaya `aalame bamahonume ka'alaahe bahona malakotaawi male'ekete kaalehona basetaqare yehene lamaawaqe yamicaalebate manegade yalame.

bacegere `aayenatoce 'enefatenaacexwaalane; thalaatocaacehune. bamaferaate, kamegebe 'etherate bamimathaa rahabe, bamaathaate, bakeserate 'aliyaame maagenyatene 'asecagaari bamaaderage, kaganezabe bamaqanase, heyewatene bamiyaathafu 'adagaawoce wayeneme ba'alaahe manegade samaa`ete bamaaderage kanafesoce bamawesade, medere kametaabaqelaweme feraaferee bamaqanase, 'enefatenaacexwaalane. 'aneta nabiye hoye! ba'enazihe fatanaawoce laaye taagaashe yahonutene bamederaawiwe `aalamenaa bamachiweme `aalame bamiyaasedasetaacawe nagare 'abeseraacawe.

'enaziyaa cegere bamiyaagaathemaacawe gizee, ya'alaahene wesaanee bamawedade 'enaa bamaqabale 'enyaa ya'alaahe neberatoce nane; 'alaahe ba'enyaa laaye yafaqadawene yaadaregaale; batenesaa'ee `elateme wada 'eresu tamalaashoce nane. yafatharane 'enaa yatalayaayu tzagaawoce yacarane 'eresu nawe. mamalashaacene 'enaa yanagaraacene madamedamiyaame wada 'eresu nawe;yamilutene taagaashoce 'abeseraacawe.

ba'enazihe baahheriyaate yamigalatzute la'enaresu balaayenyaawocu malaa'ekete zanede ya'alaahe wedaasee 'enaa mawesaate 'alaacawe. ba'enaresume laaye ya'alaahe 'ezenate yewaredaale. 'enaresume wada qathetanyaawe manegade yatamaru sekeetaamaa naacawe.

bakaa`ebaa 'aqeraabiyaa yamiganyute <<safaa>> 'enaa <<marewaa>> bamabaale yamitaawaqute hulatu korabetaawoce geletze yahonu selaamaawi marehoce magalachaawoce naacawe. yahhajene 'aliyaame ya`umeraane sere`aate lamafatzame wada 'alaahe beete yatagwaaza sawe bamakaakalaacawe bimalaalase hathi'ate yalabateme. ba'ezihe 'agabaabe hathi'ate yamilawe hhasaabe wedeqe yatadaragawe kamuselimoce makaakale badenequrenaa zamane botaawocu thaa`ote yanabarabaacawe bamahonu bamakaakalaacawe mamalaalase yamaayemenate zamane tagebaare nawe belo bamaamane lamichanaqe sawe maaragaagiyaa nawe. 'alaahe basafaanaa marewaa makaakale mamalaalase kahhaje sere`aatoce makaakale 'anedu 'enedahona galetswale. 'emenatune la'alaahe netzuhe 'aderego kamalekaame nagaroce bafaqaadanyenate yatagabara sawe 'alaahe 'eresune 'amasegaanye nawe.szeraawene yeqabalawaale; baszeraaweme yemanadaawaale, 'alaahe malekaame szarine 'enaa menedaa yamigabaawene `aawaaqi nawe.

ka'ayehudaawiyaanenaa kanaswaraawoce makaakale yanabiyunenaa nabiyu yezawete yamathutene male'ekete 'ewenatanyenate yamithaqumu yaawaradenaacawene geletze maaserajaawoce bamatsehhafaacawe wesethe kagalatzenawe baxwaalaa yamidabequtene 'alaahe ka'ezenatu yaabaareraacawaale; malaa'ekete, nabiyaate 'enaa sawoceme hulu yeragemwacawaale.

nagare gene 'enaziyaa geletze yahonu maaserajaawocene bamadabaqaacawe tatzatzetawe wada 'alaahe yatamalasu, geletzeme debeqeme yahonu szeraawocaacawene malekaame yaadaragu, ka`eweqatenaa kamamariyaame yadabaqutene yefaa yagalatzu; 'enazihe 'eneene wada mataazaze mamalasaacawene 'eqabalaalahu. 'enee kasawoce wadanee latamalasute sawoce taaraaqi 'enaa 'azaanye nanye.

'enaziyaa kehedatene yafatzamunaa nesehhame saayaadaregu bakehedate laaye yamotute ka'alaahe 'ezenate tabaarerawe 'eregemaanu waredobaacawaale. 'alaahe ka'ezenatu yaareqaacawe zanede yamalaa'eketeme yasawoceme 'eregemaane 'alabaacawe.
yehe 'eregemaane baqwaaminate yeqoraanyaacawaale; la'anede qaneme bihone qethaatu 'ayeqalelaacaweme; batenesaa'ee `elateme faataa 'ayesathaacaweme.

yasawe lejoce hoye! 'enaho 'ewenatanyaawe 'amelaakaacehu ba'akaalume babaahheriweme becanyaa nawe. ka'eresume basetaqare ba'ewenate yamimalake yalame. basawe lejoce laaye maalaqiyaa yaleelaacawe tzagaawocune bamaaderagu 'eresu yasafi meherate baalabeetenaa ruheruhe nawe.

basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere fetherate wesethe, ba'enaresume wesethe bamiganyu yamiyaasedanequ fetherataate, balalite 'enaa baqane mafaraaraqe, kamegebe, ka'alebaasaate, kanegede qusaaquse, sawocene yamithaqemu nagarocene tashakemawe babaahhere laaye baminesaafafu marekaboce, 'azemaraa 'enaa gethoshene bamaabeqale mederene kamotace baxwaalaa hheyaawe liyaadaregaate 'alaahe kasamaaye bamiyaawaredawe weha, bamedere wesethe kaasaraachaacawe heyaawe nagaroce, ka'anede 'aqethaachaa wada leelaanyaawe bamiyaasamaaraacawe nefaasoce, basamaaye 'enaa bamedere makaakale batagaraawe damanaa, ba'enazihe nagaroce wesethe lamiganazabu 'enaa lamiradu sawoce ya'alaahene 'anedenate thaqwaami yahonu geletze maaserajaawoce yeganyaale.

(ya'alaahene 'anedenatenaa 'amelaakenate) kamithaqumu yehenekamasalu geletze maaserajaawoce gaareme kasawoce makaakale ka'alaahe weche 'amaaleketocene yamiyezu 'alu; la'alaaheme baalaanethaa yaadaregwaacawaale. 'alaahene 'enedamiwadute yewadwacawaale. 'enaziyaa yaamanu sawoce gene ba'alaahe laaye 'anedeme ya'amelekote tagaarine yamaayaadaregu bamahonaacawe 'agaariwocu 'amaaleketaacawene kamiwadute balaaye 'alaahene yewadutaale. batadelaame yehune bacegere gizee 'alaahene yewadaalu. 'agaariwocu gene 'amaaleketaacawene yamitharute batadelaa gizee becaa nawe; bacheneqe gizee 'alaahene 'eneji leelaane 'ayethaarume.
