'enazihe ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaari bamaaderagenaa hathi'atene bamaszeraate nafesocaacawene yabadalu sawoce bamacharashaawe `aalame qethaatene bamimalakatubate gizee yaminoraacawene huneetaa bimalakatu; baxaayaalenate becanyaawe 'alaahe mahonunenaa 'eresune laamatza sawe 'alaahe qethaata-beretu 'enedahona baawaqunaa baresume laaye 'anedaaceneme nagare ya'amelekote tagaari baalaadaragu nabare.

sawoce yamikatalwacawe mariwoce kadakaamaa takataayocaacawe raasaacawene bamiyaagalelubate 'enedihume yaferedune `elate 'asefarinatenaa 'asechanaaqinate bamiyaayubate gizee yehe yehonaale. baziyaane gizee maamelachaa manegadoce 'enaa madaarashaawocaacawe hulu yethafubaacawaale.

dakaamocenaa takataayoce yanabarute: mariwocaacenene zaaree ka'enyaa raasaacawene 'enedaagalalu 'enyaame kamariwocaacene raasaacenene 'enaagalele zanede menawe wada mederaawi heyewate mamalase bacaalene bamaalate yemanyaalu. 'alaaheme bamachiwe `aalame beretu qethaatene 'enedamiyaasaayaacawe hulu bahhasate laaye mariwocaacawene yatakatalubatene yakafaa maabeqiyaacawene tzatzatoce 'enaa tekaazeewoce 'aderego yaasaayaacawaale. ka'esaateme maceeme yamiwathu 'ayedalume.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! bamedere wesethe kamiganyu 'enesesaatoce, 'etzewaatoce 'enaa baqaaye takeloce,batafaqadu manegadoce yataganyutene 'enedihume malekaame 'enaa thaafaache yahonutene, qoshaashaame yaalehonutene tamagabu. shayethwane 'enaanetane yamiyaataalelebaacawene manegadoce 'atekatalu; 'eresu geletze thalaataacehu nawe. 'asetawaaye sawe 'eresune lamaasaqaayate 'enaa lamaathemame yamilafaa thalaatune makatale 'ayegabaaweme.

'enaho 'eresu yamiyaazezaacehu ba'asekafi thefaatoce 'enaa kawanejaloceme yagazafu bahonu nagaroce nawe. ka'emenate 'enaa hegegaateme, ka'alaahe 'enaa kamale'eketanyocu baalemathaa `eweqate ba'alaahe laaye 'enedetenaagaru yaazezaacexwaale.

la'enaziyaa kahadiyaane 'alaahe yaawaradawene mamariyaa 'enaa berehaane takatalu batabaalu gizee bakehedate yatamolu honawe:: <<ka'emenate 'enaa kabaahele bakule 'abaatocaacenene yaaganyanebatene manegade 'enekatalaalane>> yelaalu. 'abaatocaacawe kamamariyaawe 'enaa kaberehanu 'anedaaceneme nagare yamaayeganazabu 'enaa 'alaaheme wadamiwadawe 'ewenate yaaletamaru bihonume 'enekwaa yekatalwacawaalene?!

'enaziyaa kahadiyaane qadamete 'abaatocaacawene sela makatalaacawe yaalaacawe mesaalee:: kabetocune 'eyachokxa 'enedamithaaraa 'eranyaa bithee 'enaa demetzune sametawe negegerune 'enedamaayeradute `aayenate nawe. bamithaqamubate huneetaa kamaademathe yadanaqorunaa 'anedabatocaacawe 'ewenatene manaagare yamiyaadaagetaacawe didaawoce naacawe; hhaqeneme kamaayate taawerawaale. selaziheme 'aneta theri yametaadaregelaacawene qene manegade 'ayeganazabume.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu hoye! 'alaahe kalagasaacehu 'enaa kafaqadalaacehu malekaame megeboce tamagabu. 'alaahe bageletzeme, basewereme selalagasaacehu tzagaawocu 'amasegenute. yaazazaacehuneme matagebare 'enaa yakalakalaacehune maraaqe 'eresune bamaamasegane wesethe yamikaatate nawe. ba'ewenate 'eresune becaa yametaamaleku 'enaa baresume laaye yamaataagaaru kahona yehenene fatzemu.

'enaho kamegebe ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme yaadaragabaacehu baselaamaawi marehe maszarate batekekele yaaletaaradane (yabakatane), yaminebwabwa fasaashe damene, yakarekarone 'enaa ya'asaamaa segaane, ba'eredeme gizee ka'alaahe weche yahona seme yatawasaabatene nawe. 'anede sawe 'enanyihene nagaroce lamabelaate 'asegadaaje huneetaa wesethe kahona yaala gudaaye bamabelaate yabadala hono saayehone tagado 'aliyaame nafesene yamaadaanene yaahele mathane saayaalefe bimagabe hathi'atenaa qethaate yalabateme. 'alaahe kabaarocu wadaresu lamimalasute taaraaqi, lanaresume 'azaanye nawe. ba'ezenatume mekeneyaate ba'asegadaaje huneetaa wesethe nafesene lamaaterafe 'enazihene bamaszaratu yatakalakalu nagarocene bamabelaate yamidarese hathi'atene yeqere belwale.

'ayehudaawiyaanenaa 'enaa naswaraawoce 'enedafatzamute 'alaahe yaawaradaacawene matsaahhefetenaa baziyaame wesethe yamiganyawene hhaqe 'enedihume yamuhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) nabiyenate thaqwaami maaserajaawocene yamidabequ, baziheme tagebaare: selethaane, ganezabe 'enaa keberene yamasalu teneshe `aalamaawi theqemocene yamigazu; 'enazihe wada hodaacawe yamiyaasegabute ba'esaate lamaqathaate mekeneyaate yamihonaacawene nagare nawe. batenesaa'ee `elate 'alaahe yamiyaasedasetaacawene nagare 'ayaanaageraacaweme; yelequneme yamiyaasekafaacawene nagare nawe yamiyaanaageraacawe; kahathi'ate 'ayaanatzaacaweme; 'asaamaami qethaateme yethabeqaacawaale.

kasawoce yamiyaasefalegaacawene `eweqate bamadabaqe yamigalatzute 'enazihe sawoce, tekekelanyaawene `eweqate sidabequ qenaacaane bathemate, ya'alaahene meherate ba'alaahe qethaate lawethawaale. wada 'esaate yamagebiyaa mekeneyaate yamihonaacawene tagebaare bamafatzame laaye mene te`egesete sathaacawe? huneetaacawe te`egesete maaderage selamicelu ba'esaate wesethe yamiganyawe qethaate gede yaalesathaacawe 'asemaselwacawaale.

yehe qethaate `eweqatene 'enaa mamariyaane yamidabequ sawocene yamiyaaganyaacawe 'alaahe malakotaawi matsaahhefetene ba'ewenate yaawarada sihone 'enazihe matsaahhefete yaaqafwacawe male'eketoce ligalatzu 'eneji lidabaqu yamaayegabaacawe bamahonu nawe. 'enaziyaa bamalakotaawi matsaahhefete wesethe yatawazaagabutenaa bakafilu 'amenawe kafilune yadabaqute ka'ewenate baruqe reqate wesethe naacawe.

'alaahe zanede tawadaaje yahonawe malekaame nagare wada meseraaqe 'enaa wada me`eraabe 'aqethaachaa mazore 'enaa baziheme mawazaagabe 'ayedalame. yelequneme malekaame nagare ba'alaahe becanyaa 'amelaakenate, bamalaa'ekete, bawaradu matsaahhefete, batalaakute nabiyaate bamulu yaala leyunate yaamana sawe yaalabate huneetaa nawe. 'enedazihume ganezabene 'eyawadada 'enaa 'eyagwaagwaa lazamadocu, 'akaala-mathane saayedaresu walaajocaacawene laathu hetzaanaate, lacegeranyoce, kabeetasabocu 'enaa kahagaru lataqwaaratha manegadanyaa, cegere sawocene 'enedithayeqe laasegadadawe sawe, kabaarenate 'enaa ka'esere sawocene natzaa lamaawethaate ganezabune yamilagese sawe tagebaare nawe malekaame yamibaalawe. 'alaahe baazazawe maleku salaatene yathabaqa, gedeetaa yahonabatene zakaa yasatha, qaale kidaaneme bagabu gizee qaalaacawene thabaaqiwoce, badehenate, bacegere 'enaa bahemame laaye taagaashoce bahonute, kathalaate gaare bamikaaheede tegele laaye yamaayeshashu, 'enaziyaa banazihe baahheriyaate yamigalatzu yahonute ba'emenataacawe 'enaa baszeraawocaacawe 'ewenatanyocu 'enaresu naacawe. 'alaahe yaazazaacawene bamafatzame, yakalakalaacaweneme bamaraaqe thenequqocu 'enaa 'alaahene fariwocu 'enaresu naacawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu hoye! bamaawaqenaa denebare bamaalafe leelocene yamigadelu sawocene, yagedeyaawene wanejale bafatzamubate 'amesaayaa maqethaate 'enediqathu 'alaahe gedeetaa 'adaragabaacehu. natzaa sawe banatzaa sawe, baariyaa babaariyaa, seete baseete yamote qethaate yefatzamebataale. bamote 'afaafe laaye 'eyaala mwace nafesu kamawethaatu bafite 'aliyaame zamadocu yadame kaasaane bamaqabale yagadaayene yamote qethaate yeqere bilu, kagadaaye kaasaane yamithayequbate manegade kamamatzaadaqe 'enaa kamaasecagare yaraaqa malekaame manegade yehune, gadaayeme yatathayaqawene yadame kaasaa saayaazagaye bamalekaame yaaderese, yehe yeqere maalate 'enaa yadame kaasaane maqabale geetaacehu yaaqalalaacehu nagare 'enaa 'alaahe bazihe tewelede laaye 'ezenate selaalawe yahona nawe. kayeqeretaa 'enaa kakaasaa kefeyaa baxwaalaa bagadaaye laaye denebare yaalafa laresu ka'alaahe yahona 'asaamaami qethaate 'alawe.

la'enaanetame 'alaahe badanagagawe ya'amesaayaa qethaate wesethe damaacehune bamathabaqe, bamakaakalaacehu bathelaacaa wasane maalafene bamaaseqarate hheyewate 'alaacehu. 'enaziyaa lahegegaatu tagazhiwoce, bate`ezaazu szariwocenaa 'alaahene fariwoce yahonu ya'a`emero baalabeetoce yehene yeradaalu.

'anedaacehu bamote 'afaafe laaye sihone 'enaa yamote mekeneyaatoce baqarabute gizee bezu habetene yatawa 'enedahona, lawalaajocu 'enaa lazemedenaa baalabeetoce selaame 'enedadanagagawe ka'anede szosetanyaa yaalebalatha habetune linaazaze yecelaale; ba'enaaneta laaye yehe tadanegegwaale; yehenene matagebare 'alaahene bamifaru sawoce laaye gedeetaa tadaregwaale. yehe hege yawerese 'aneqatzoce kamawaradaacawe bafite yeszaraabate nabare. yawerese 'aneqatzoce katawaradu baxwaalaa gene waraashoce maane 'enedahonu 'enaa yamigabaacawe yawerese mathane mene yaahele 'enedahona ba'aneqatzocu taberaaretwale.

katabaalawe bamachamare 'aliyaame bamaqanase wayeneme nuzaazeewene kaawaqa baxwaalaa batagebaare 'enedaayewele yakalakala; yazihe wanejale bamiqayerawe sawe laaye 'eneji baminaazazawe mwace laaye 'ayedalame. 'alaahe yabaarocune negegere sami 'enaa szeraawocaacaweneme `aawaaqi nawe. kanagaraacaweme 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayesawarebateme.

nuzaazeewene yatawa sawe ka'ewenate 'enedaazanabala wayeneme banuzaazeewe wesethe badale 'enedamiganye yaawaqa 'enaa tanaazaazhu banuzaazeewe yaabalaashawene yaasetakaakala, banuzaazeewe laaye yaaletasemaamutene waraashoce yaasetaaraqa sawe hathi'ate yalabateme. yelequneme malekaame bamaaderagu menedaane yaaganyaale. 'alaahe kabaarocu makaakale wadaresu latamalasute mahhari lanaresume 'azaanye nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalaacehu 'amaanyoce hoye! kageetaacehu zanede kazihe bafite banabarute hhezeboce laaye tzome 'enedatadanagaga hulu ba'enaanetame laaye tzome gedeetaa tadaraga. yeheme malekaamene bamaszeraate ba'enaanetanaa ba'alaahe qethaate makaakale makalaakayaane bamaaderage 'alaahene tefaru zanede nawe.

ba'enaaneta laaye gedeetaa yatadaragawe ka`aamatu wesethe theqite qanaatene 'enedetetzomu nawe. ka'enaaneta wesethe tzome 'enedikabedawe yamiyaadarege hemamene yataamama, 'aliyaame manegadanyaa yahona sawe tzomune mafetaate (maafethare) kaziyaame kaleeloce qanaate tzomune bafataabate qane quthere matzome yefaqadelataale. ba'enaziyaame matzome 'eyacaalu tzomene bafatu sawoce laaye tzome bafatubate qanaate leke 'anede cegeranyaane bamamagabe beezaane makefale tadanegegwaale. bamatzome wesethe yaalawene terufaate betaawequ, tzome kamafetaate 'enaa beezaane kamakefale yeleqe matzomaacehu la'enaaneta yatashaala nawe. yehe 'alaahe tzomene badanagagabate bamajamariyaawocu gizeeyaate yetagabare yanabara hege nabare. baziyaane waqete yafalaga sawe yetzomaale, yaalefalaga sawe dagemo 'ayetzomeme nagare gene bazihe meteke dehane yemagebe nabare. kaziyaa baxwaalaa 'alaahe latzome `edemeewe badarasa 'enaa bamicele sawe laaye hulu tzomene gedeetaa 'adaraga.

'alaahe matzomune ba'enaaneta laaye gedeetaa yaadaragawe baziyaace batakabaracewe leelite, banabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye qure'aane mawarade bajamarabate yaramadaane ware nawe. 'alaahe qure'aanene lasawoce mamariyaa sihone 'awaradawe; bawesethu sela qathetanyaawe manegade geletze yahonu mamariyaawoce yeganyaalu; ba'ewenate 'enaa bahhasate makaakale yamilayene masemare yaaseqamethaale. ka'enaaneta makaakale theenaamaa 'enaa bahagaru nawaari hono tzome yadarasabate sawe ba'eresu laaye matzome gedeetaa bamahonu yetzume. tzome yamikabedawe hemametanyaa 'aliyaame manegadanyaa (tagwaazhe) kahona tzomune mafetaate yefaqadelataale. tzomune sifataame yafataabaacawene qanaate qothero (baleelaa 'amaci gizee) matzome ba'eresu laaye gedeetaa nawe. 'alaahe la'enaaneta badanagagawe hege maaqelalene 'eneji maakebadene 'ayefalegeme. yawarune yatzome leke mulu. yaramadaanene ware bamatzome kaathanaaqaqaacehume baxwaalaa tzomene 'enedetetzomu sekeetene selasathaacehu 'enaa qalaale selaadaragalaacehu 'alaahene 'alequ. selaziheme 'eresu lawadadawe 'emenate selamaraacehu taamasagenute zanede (tzomene danagagalaacehu).

nabiyu hoye! baarocee selaqerebatee 'enaa tamaatzenwacawene selamaqabalee sithayequhe, 'enee la'enaresu qerebe, huneetaacaweneme `aawaaqi, tamaatzenwacaweneme sami mahoneene negaraacawe. 'amaalaaje 'ayaasefalegaacaweme; demetzaacawene kafe maaderageme gede 'ayehonebaacaweme. lemanaawene la'enee netzuhe 'aderego lamimaatzananye latheriwe melaashe 'esathaalahu. tamaatzenwacawene 'enedeqabalaacawe la'enee late`ezaazocee tagazhiwoce, ba'emenataacaweme laaye tzenuwoce yehunu. bazihe ba'emenataawi 'enaa ba`aalamaawi gudaayaacawe qathetanyaawene yemaru zanede `aayenatanyaa manegade nawe.

yamajamariyaa mamariyaa yanabarawe 'anede sawe batzome leelite tanyeto gohhe kamaqedadu bafite binaqaa mabelaate 'enaa wada baalabeetu maqerabe (yagebera-segaa genenyunate) yatakalakala nabare. 'amaanyoce hoye! 'alaahe yehenene bamashaare 'ahune batzome leelite seetocaacehune maganaanyatene faqadalaacehu. 'enaresu la'enaaneta mashashagiyaa 'enaa mathabaqiyaa naacawe. 'enaanetame la'enaresu mashashagiyaa 'enaa mathabaqiyaa naacehu. 'anedaacehu kaleelaanyaacehu yamibeqaaqaa 'ayedalame. yakalakalaacehune bamaszeraate raasaacehune taataalelu yanabaraacehu mahonaacehune 'alaahe ba'eregethe 'awaqa; 'azanalaacehu, taaraqaacehume; la'enaanetame nagarune 'aqalalalaacehu. 'ahune misetocaacehune taganaanywacawe; kazereyaame 'alaahe yawasanalaacehune falegu. kaleelitu chelamaa bamalayatu 'enaa bawagaagane yamigalatzawe 'ewenatanyaawe gohhe 'esekigalatzelaacehume derase baleelitu waqete tamagabu, thathume. kaziyaame gohhe siqade jamero 'eseka tzahhaye mathelaqe derase tzomene kamiyaabalaashu nagaroce bamaraaqe tzomaacehune mulu. bamasejide `etikaafene (yamaqoyate 'amelekotene) selamiyaafarese bamasejidoce bameteqoyubate gizee seetocene 'ateganaanyu. 'enazihe bahhalaale 'enaa bahharaame makaakale yamilayu ya'alaahe wasanoce bamahonaacawe bafetzume 'ateqerabwacawe. 'alaahe wasane wadaadaragawe nagare yaqaraba hharaame (kelekele) wesethe 'enedaayewadeqe yefaraalataale. 'alaahe 'enazihene hegegaate geletze bahona maleku 'enedagalatzawe hulu sawoce 'alaahe yaazazawene bamaszeraate yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe yefarute zanede 'aneqatzocune yaaberaaraalaacawaale.

kafilaacehu yakafilaacehune ganezabe baaletafaqada maleku, basereqote, bamanethaqe 'enaa bamaataalale 'ayewesade. bahathi'ate tanakeraacehu yasawocene yatawasana ganezabe lamawesade wada daanyaa heedaacehu 'atekaraakarubate. 'alaahe yehenene 'ereme yaadaraga mahonune 'eyaawaqaacehu 'atewesadu. 'ereme 'enedahona kamaawaqe gaare wada hathi'ate maqerabe 'ejege tzayaafe tagebaare 'enaa kabaade qethaate yamiyaasekatele nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! sawoce selacharaqaa 'afathaathare 'enaa selahuneetaawaa malawaawathe yethayequhale. yazihene thebabe 'enedihe bamaalate malese sethaacawe:: <<charaqaa sawoce ya'amelekote gizeeyaacawene yamiyaawequbaate yagizee maquthariyaa naate>> balaacawe. yahhaje waraate, yatzome ware, yazakaa `aamate mamulaatene (maderasene) yamiyaawequbate. kasawoce gaare yaalaacawene maahebaraawi genenyunatoce bamathane bamakafaafale 'enaa bamalakaate gizeene yamiqotherubate. badenequrenaawe zamane 'enedametaasebute malekaame szeraa hhajene 'aliyaame `umeraane lamafatzame setaasebu beetocene kajarebaa barocaacawe magebaate 'ayedalame. yelequnese malekaame szeraa maalate bageletzenaa basewere 'alaahene maferaate nawe. wada beetoce setegabume kafite lafite bare mamethaate la'enaaneta yaqalala 'enaa kamacagareme yaraaqa nawe. 'alaahe yamiyaasechaneqe 'enaa yamiyaasecagerene nagare 'alaasegadadaacehume. yametemanyutene bamaagenyate, kametefaruteme bamadaane sekeetaamaa tehonu zanede malekaame bamaszeraate ba'enaanetanaa ba'alaahe qethaate makaakale geredoshene (makalaakayaane) 'aderegu.

ya'alaahene qaale kafe lamaaderage, 'enaziyaane 'enaanetane ka'alaahe manegade lamaagade yamigaadalwacehune kahadiyaane taagalu. hhetzaanaatene, seetocene, 'aragaawiyaanene bamagedale wasane 'atelafu. 'enedihume sigaadalwacehu yagadalaacexwaacawene thalaatoce sawenate bamaqoraarathe denebare 'atelafu (yehene 'atefatzemu). 'alaahe badanagagawe 'enaa bafaradawe nagare denebare yamiyaalefu wasane 'alaafiwocene 'ayewademe.

'enaresune (ka'alaahe manegade lamaagade yamigaadalwacehune)baaganyaacehubaacawe botaa hulu gedalwacawe. 'enaresu kaasewathwacehume seferaa hulu maalateme kamakaa 'asewathwacawe. 'anedene 'amaanye ka'emenatu bamaagade 'enaa wada kehedate bamamalase wesethe yaalawe fatanaa kagedeyaa yakabada nawe. lakaa`ebaa kebere lamasethate setelu, 'enaresu batakabarawe masejide wesethe 'enaanetane magaadale 'esekaalejamaru derase 'enaaneta bawesethu 'ategaadalwacawe; masejidale hharaame (batakabarawe masejide) wesethe 'enaanetane magaadale kajamaru tagaadalwacawe. yehene yamasala qethaate (batakabarawe masejide wasane siyaalefu magadalaacawe) yakahadiyaane menedaa yehonaale.

'enaanetane kamagaadale 'enaa kakehedataacawe kataqothabu, 'enaanetame taqothabu. 'alaahe wadaresu latamalasa mahari nawe. baalafawe hathi'ataacawe 'ayeyezaacaweme. lanaresume 'azaanye nawe; baqethaateme 'ayaathaadefaacaweme.

ka'enaresu ba'alaahe maagaaraate, sawoceneme ka'alaahe manegade maagade 'enedihume kehedate 'esekamaayeganye 'enaa ya'alaaheme 'emenate yabalaaye 'esekihone derase kahadiyaanene tagaadalwacawe. kakehedataacawenaa sawocene ka'alaahe 'emenate maagadene kaaqomu 'enaresune magaadale 'aqumu. bakehedate 'enaa ka'alaahe 'emenate sawocene bamaagade badalene bafatzamu sawoce laaye 'eneji denebare maalafe yalame.

'alaahe basabaatanyaawe `aamata-hijeraa wada hharame 'enedetegabu 'enaa `umeraane 'enedetefatzemu yaasemacaacehu yatakabarawe ware, thaa`otaawiyaanu basedesetanyaawe `aamata-hijeraa wada hharame 'enedaategabu yakalakalwacehu ware meteke nawe. yatakabaru yamibaalute yatakabarawe masejidenaa yatakabarawene ware bamasaasalute wesethe wasane baalafute laaye ya'atzafaa maqathaachaa 'eremejaa yewasadebaacawaale. denebare yaalafabaacehune sawe yafatzamawene `aayenate qethaate malesulate. nagare gene wasane 'atelafubate. 'alaahe wasanune yamiyaalefutene 'ayewademe. 'eresu yafaqadalaacehune kamathaase 'alaahene tathaneqaqu. yamalekaame nagare sekeetene bamasethate 'enaa ba'eredaataawe 'alaahe 'eresune kamithanaqaqute sawoce gaare mahonune 'ewaqu.

ba'alaahe manegade bamataagale 'enaa bamasala malekaame nagaroce laaye ganezabaacehune lagesu; ba'alaahe manegade kamataagale 'enaa laresume masewaa`etenatene kamakefale wada xwaalaa bamaalate raasaacehune wada thefaate 'atewesadu. lamathefiyaacehu mekeneyaate wadahonu nagaroce raasaacehune bamawesade nafesaacehune 'ataathefu. ba'amelekotaacehu, bageberagabaacehu 'enaa babaahheriyaacehu 'asaamaariwoce hunu. bahulu nagaraacawe 'asaamaariwocene 'alaahe yewadedaale. menedaacawene yaataleqelaacawaale. qathetanyaawene manegade yamamaraate sekeetene yesathaacawaale.

ya'alaahene fite (batenesaa'eewe qane ka'alaahe gaare maganaanyate) bamafalage hhajene 'enaa `umeraane 'amwaletaacehu fatzemu. kamisawu 'enesasaate (kagemale, kakabete 'aliyaame kabage 'enaa feyale) yacaalaacehutene ('aqemaacehu yafaqadawene) 'eradu. kaziyaame <<hheraamaacehune>> fetu. 'erede bamifatzamebate qane (10nyaawe zule-hhijaa) 'enaa bataqarute yaminaa qoyetaa qanaatoce yamitaaradawe 'enesesaa babotaawe 'esekidarese 'enaa 'esekisawaa derase tzaguraacehune 'atelaachu; 'ataasaatheruteme. ka'enaaneta makaakale 'anedanyaacehu hharame kamagebaate yatakalakala kahona yatakalakalabate botaa laaye yerade. kahharameme yaaletakalakala 'enedahona ba'eredu qane 'enedihume bamiqathelute szosete (yaminaa) qanaate bahharame yerade. ka'enaaneta makaakale hemametanyaa yahona 'aliyaame baraase tzaguru wesethe 'eneda qemaale 'enaa masale tabaaye yaala cegere yaalabate gizeewe saayedarese cegerune lamaasewagade tzagurune bilaache, ba'eresu laaye hathi'ate yalabateme; selaziheme beezaane yekafelaale. szosete qanaatene yetzomaale wayeneme kahharame dehoce sedesete sawocene yemagebaale, 'aliyaame 'anede feyale 'aredo lahharame dehoce segaawene yaakafaafelaale. kasegaate weche setehonu, `umeraane kafatzama baxwaalaa 'eseka hhaje ware derase yatathaqama, gizeewe dareso lahhaje hheraame 'esekiyaadarege derase bahheraame yatakalakalu nagarocene bamaszeraate yatathaqama, kacaalawe nagare 'anede feyalene (bagene), wayeneme kasabaate sawoce gaare bamagaaraate gemalene 'aliyaame yaqanede kabete bamaarade beezaane yekefale. masewaa`etene maaqerabe 'aqemu kaalefaqada bameteku kahhaje mafatzamiyaa qanaatoce szosete qanaatene 'enaa wada beetasabocu katamalasa baxwaalaa sabaate qanaatene (bademeru 'asere qanaatene) yetzume. yehe mathaqame <<tamatu`e>> 'enaa beezaane makefale 'enedihume 'aqemu laalefaqada sawe dagemo 'asere qanaatocene matzome, bahharame 'enaa bahharame 'aqeraabiyaa yaminoru sawocene 'ayemalakateme. 'enaresu bahharame selaminoru mathaqame (tamatu`e) 'ayaasefalegaacaweme. ba`umeraahe 'eseka hhaje lamathaqamaacawe bakaa`ebaa zuriyaa thawaafe maaderagaacawe becaa baqi yehonelaacawaale. 'alaahe yadanagagawene bamakatale 'enaa denebarune bamathabaqe 'alaahene feru. 'alaahe te`ezaazune lamithesu qethaatu beretu mahonuneme 'ewaqu.

yahhaje gizeeyaate yamitaawaqu waraatoce naacawe. kashawaale ware jamero bazule-hhijaa 'aseranyaawe qane yethanaaqaqaalu. ba'enazihe waraate wesethe hhajene baraasu laaye gedeetaa yaadaraga 'enaa hheraamene yafatzama yagebera-segaa genenyunate 'enaa wadaziyaa yamiyaadaresu nagaroce kaheraamu 'esekamifataa derase ba'eresu laaye 'ereme naacawe. 'enedihume hathi'atene bamafatzame ka'alaahe te`ezaaze mawethaate, wada quthaa 'enaa cheqecheqe yamiyaamaraa kerekere maaderage ba'eresu laaye 'ereme yehonaale. yehe lahhaje gizeeyaatenaa yahhaje sere`aate lamifatzamebate botaa kebere yahona nawe. yameteszarutene malekaame nagare 'alaahe yaaweqawaale; baresume laaye yemanadaacexwaale. bahhaje szeraa laaye yamiyaasefalegaacehune megebe 'enaa yamithathu nagarocene (seneqe) bamayaaze taagazu. bagudaayaacehu laaye kametetaagazubaacawe nagaroce hulu balaachu ya'alaahe feraacaa mahonune 'ewaqu. ya'asetawaaye 'a`emero baalabeetoce hoye! te`ezaazoceene bamatagebare 'enaa yakalakalekuteneme bamaraaqe tathaneqaqunye.

bahhaje gizeeyaate wesethe banegede 'enaa bamasale nagaroce yatafaqada sisaayene betefalegu ba'enaaneta laaye hathi'ate yalabaacehume. bazathananyaawe qane `aarafaa kaqomaacehu baxwaalaa bazulehhijaa 10nyaawe lalite ka`aarafaate wada muzedalifaahe babudene setegwaazu bamuzedalifaahe, bamashe`arule-hharaame (batakabarawe ya'alaahe 'emenate magalachaa botaa) 'alaahene bamaatheraate, ya'alaahene becanyenate bamamasekare 'enaa du`aa'e bamaaderage 'alaahene 'awesu 'alaahe wada 'emenatu magalachaawoce, labeetu gubenyeteme sere`aate selamaraacehu 'alaahene 'asetaawesu. kaziyaa bafite baregetheme ya'eresune shari`aa (yahheyewate marehe) yazanagaacehu nabaraacehu.

kaziyaame badenequrenaawe zamane yanabaru sawoce 'enedamiyaadaregute saayehone yaberaahimene (`alayehi 'asalaame) manegade yatakatalu sawoce baadaragute `aayenate ka`aarafaate tamalasu. 'eresu kadanagagaacawe laagwaadalaacehuteme nagare 'alaahene meherate thayequ. 'alaahe kabaarocu wadaresu latamalasute mahhari 'enaa lanaresume 'azaanye nawe.

yahhajene szeraa 'enedaathanaaqaqaacehu 'enaa 'enedacharasaacehu 'alaahene 'asetaawesu; 'eresuneme 'awadesu. ba'abaatocaacehu 'enedametekoru 'enaa 'enaresuneme 'enedametaasetaawesu 'alaahene 'asetaawesu. yelequneme yametethaqamubaacawe tzagaawoce hulu ka'eresu zanede bamahonaacawe 'abaatocaacehune kametaasetaawesute balaaye geetaacehune 'asetaawesu. sawoce yatalayaayu naacawe; wesenu bazihece `aalame 'eneji bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame yamaayaamene; 'alaahene theenaa ganezabe 'enaa lejoce yamasaasalu mederaawi tzagaawocene 'enaa geethocene becaa yamithayeqe 'ala. 'enedihe yaalu sawoce yaqerebitwane `aalame becaa bamafalagaacawe 'enaa kawadiyaanyaawe `aalame bamaraaqaacawe bamachiwe `aalame 'alaahe la'amaanye baarocu kaazagaajawe tzagaa dereshaa yalaacaweme.

wesenu dagemo ba'alaahe 'enaa bamacharashaawe `aalame yamiyaamene, 'alaaheneme yamederaawi `aalame tzagaawoce 'enaa bamederaawi `aalame malekaame szeraane lamaszeraate sekeete maagenyatene 'enedihume bamacharashaawe `aalame bajanate madasatene 'enaa ka'esaate qethaate madaanene yamithayeqe 'ala.
'enazihe yamederaawine 'enaa yawadiyaanyaawene `aalame malekaame thayaaqiwoce bamederaawiwe `aalame laszarute malekaame szeraa yalaaqa menedaa 'alaacawe. 'alaahe szeraawocene fathaane gamegaami nawe.

batawasanu qanaatoce wesethe maalateme yazule hhijaa 11nyaa, 12nyaa 'enaa 13nyaa qanaatoce 'alaahene bamaalaaqe <<'alaahu 'akebare>> 'enaa 'anedenatune bamamasekare <<laalaaha laa 'alaahe>> bamaalate 'awesute. ba12nyaawe qane thatharene kawarawara baxwaalaa tacaakulo kaminaa yawathaa sawe laresu yamalekaame szeraa menedaa 'alawe; hathi'ate yalabateme. yeheme 'alaahe selaaqalalalate nawe. 'eseka 13nyaawe qane bamaqoyate thatharene warewero yawathaame laresu yamalekaame szeraa menedaa 'alawe; hathi'ate yalabateme. yelequneme yatamwalaawene ya'amelekote sere`aate tageberwale. yamale'eketanyaaweneme (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) falage hheyaawe 'aderegwaale. yehe hulu bahhaje sere`aate 'alaahene lafaraa 'enaa 'alaaheme yaazazawene 'amwaleto lafatzama nawe. te`ezaazaatune bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru. wadaresume becaa 'enedametemalasu 'eregethanyoce hunu; kaziyaame baszeraawocaacehu laaye yemanadaacexwaale.

'aneta nabiye hoye! kasawoce makaakale sela `aalamaawi gudaaye.sinaagare negegeru yamiyaasedaneqehe 'asemasaaye sawe 'ala. yanegegere qelethefenaawe yaamaara bamahonu ('anedabata-retu`e bamahonu) mekeneyaate 'ewenatanyaa nawe belahe yamisathawene mekere 'enedeteqabale yaadaregehale. `aalaamaawe gene nafesune 'enaa neberatune maasethabaqe nawe. hhasatanyaa hono saalame balebu wesethe yaalawe nagare 'emenate 'enaa malekaame nagare 'enedahona 'alaahene yaasemasakeraale. genaa 'eresu yamuselimoce thanekaaraa taqanaaqaanye 'enaa yabarataa thalaate nawe.

kaaneta zore 'enedaala 'enaa 'enedatalayaheme bahathi'ate thefaatene lamaasefaafaate bamedere laaye bategaate yerwarwathaale. 'azemaraane yeqorethaale; 'enesesaatene yegadelaale. 'alaahe bamedere laaye thefaatene 'enaa 'athefiwocene 'ayewadedeme.

lazihe 'athefi sawe (bamekere maleke) wasanune bamaakebare 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahene feraa sibaale; wada 'ewenate kamamalase 'emebitanyenate 'enaa kuraate yaagedawaale; bahathi'atume laaye yegafaabataale. yamimathenawe menedaa jahaaname magebaate nawe. jahaaname lanawaariwocwa bathaame yakafaace manoriyaa 'enaa maarafiyaa nace.
kasawoceme ya'alaahene wedeetaa bamafalage, ba'eresu manegade bamataagale geetaawene bamagazaate nafesune la'alaahe yamishathe 'ala. 'alaahe labaarocu 'ezenata-safi 'enaa ruheruhe nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu 'amaanyoce hoye! wada selaame thaqelelaacehu gebu. matsehhafune yatasathute sawoce bakafilu 'amenawe bakafilu 'enedakaadute `aayenate kaselaame 'anedaaceneme nagare 'atetawe. yashayethwaneneme faanaawoce 'atekatalu. 'eresu lanaaneta thalaatenatune yaaletadabaqa geletze thalaataacehu nawe.

bawesethaacawe therethaaree yaleelabaacawe geletze maaserajaawoce kamathulaacehu baxwaalaa kaqathetanyaawe manegade betezanabalu 'alaahe bacelotaawe 'enaa babalaayenatu 'ashanaafi, ba'asetadaadarunaa badenegaageewe thebabanyaa mahonune 'ewaqu. selazihe 'eresune ferute; 'alequteme.

yashayethwanene manegadoce yamikatalunaa kaqathetanyaawe manegade yatazanabalu sawoce, baferedu `elate 'alaahe bamakaakalaacawe lamaferade lageremaawenaa laleqenaawe bamigabaa huneetaa badamanaa thelaawoce wesethe hono mamethaatune; malaa'eketeme ba'enaresu zuriyaa yakababu honawe maweradaacawene 'eneji menene yethabeqaalu?! baziyaane gizee ya'alaahe ferede bamahakalaacawe yekaaheedaale; yefatzamaale. yafetherataate gudaaye 'enaa nagaraacawe hulu yamimalasawe wada 'alaahe nawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! laseraa'eele lejoce bawaqasaa theyaaqee 'aqerebelaacawe. <<male'eketanyoce 'ewenatanyaa selamahonaacawe yamithaqumu mene yaahele bezu geletze 'aneqatzocene 'alaahe 'aberaaraalaacehu? kaziyaame 'asetabaabalaacehu; ka'aneqatzocu 'afagafagaacehu. ya'alaahene tzagaawoce kataganazaba 'enaa geletze kahonulate baxwaalaa bakehedate 'enaa bamaasetabaabale ('aneqatzocune) yalawatha; 'alaahe lakahadiyaane 'enaa la'asetabaabaayoce qethaata-beretu nawe>> balaacawe.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe kehedatene yafatzamu sawoce yaqerebitwa `aalame hheyewate, bawesethwame yamiganyu thafi mathaqamiyaawoce 'enaa dasetaawoce tawaabalaacawe. ba'alaahe 'enaa bamacharashaawe qane bamiyaamenu sawoce laaye yesaalaqaalu. 'enaziyaa te`ezaazune bamafatzame 'enaa kakalakalawe bamaqothabe 'alaahene yafaru sawoce bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame ka'enazihe kahadiyaane balaaye naacawe. 'alaahe zala`aalamaawi bahona janate wesethe yaadaregaacawaale. 'alaahe kafetherataatu lafaqadawe yaala quthere 'enaa sefere tzagaawocune yesathaale.

sawoce ba'anede mamariyaa laaye 'anede 'aqwaame, ba'abaataacawe 'adame 'emenate laaye yamiganyu 'anede hhezeboce nabaru. nagare gene shayethwanaate 'athamamwacawenaa 'amaanye 'enaa kahadi honawe yatalayaayu honu; baziheme mekeneyaate 'alaahe nabiyaatene la'amaanyoce 'enaa lamalekaame szariwoce 'alaahe yaazagaajalaacawene 'ezenate 'abesaariwoce, lakahadiyaane dagemo 'alaahe yaazagaajalaacawene beretu qethaate 'asethaneqaaqiwoce 'aderego laaka. sawoce batawazaagabubaacawe gudaayoce lifaredubate zanedeme kamale'eketanyocu gaare therethere yaleelabate 'ewenatene yaaqafu matsaahhefetene 'awarada. geletze yahonu ya'alaahe maaserajaawoce lilayaayubate yamaayegabaacawe 'ewenate honawe kamathulaacawe baxwaalaa ka'ayehudaawiyaane 'enaziyaa yataweraatene `eweqate yatasathute 'eneji leeloce 'aletalayaayume. karaasaacawe bahona badale talayaayu. 'alaahe bafaqaadu 'enaziyaa yaamanutene sawoce kathemate yaraaqawene qene manegade maraacawe. 'alaahe bawesethu thememate wadaleelabate qathetanyaa wada honawe ya'emenate manegade yafalagawene sawe yemaraale.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! ka'enaaneta bafite yaalafute hhezeboce `aayenate fatanaa saayedaresebaacehu janate yametegabu masalaacehune?! ka'enaaneta bafite yanabaru teweledoce ya'ethote 'enaa yahemame cegere 'aganyaacawe; baferehaateme taneqathaqathu. fatanaawe ya'alaahene 'eredaataa bamathaadafe 'enedithayequ 'adaragaacawe. male'eketanyaawe 'enaa ka'eresu gaare yaalute 'amaanyoce <<ya'alaahe 'eredaataa yamimathaawe macee nawe?>> silu thayaqu. 'awaaje 'asetawelu! ya'alaahe 'eredaataa ba'eresu lamiyaamenu 'enaa baresume laaye lamimaku 'amaanyoce qerebe nawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! baaledarabocehe katalayaayu neberatocaacawe yatune 'enedamimatzawetu 'enaa yate 'enedamiyaawelute yethayequhale. 'enedihe bamaalateme malese sethaacawe - <<kamalekaame (katafaqadanaa thaqaami) yametematzawetutene nagare lawalaajoce, 'eneda cegeraacawe huneetaa kazemedenaa baalabeetoce lanaaneta qerebe lahonu sawoce, yatime (walaaje laathu) cegeranyaa lejoce, ganezabe laleelaacawe mesekinoce, guzowe kabeetasabu gaare maganaanyatenaa hagaru maderase laasetagwaagolawe manegadanyaa lagesu>> balaacawe. 'amaanyoce hoye! yameteszarute malekaame nagare theqiteme yehune bezu 'alaahe `aawaaqi nawe. kaszeraacehu 'anedaace nagare 'ayedabaqebateme; baresume laaye yemanadaacexwaale.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! ba'alaahe manegade mataagale yaganezabe 'enaa yanafese masewaa`etenatene selamithayeqe nafese batafatherowaa yametethalaawe bihoneme ba'enaaneta laaye gedeetaa tadaregwaale. 'anede nagare batachabaache la'enaaneta malekaame 'enaa thaqaami hono saala letethalute tecelaalaacehu; lamesaalee yalaaqa menedaa kamanoru gaare bathalaatoce laaye dele magonaatsafe 'enaa ya'alaahene qaale yabalaayenate yamiragaagathebate hono 'eyaala ba'alaahe manegade laaye mataagalene tethalaalaacehu. 'enedazihume 'anede nagare la'enaaneta mathefonaa thefaatene yamiyaasekatelebaacehu hono 'eyaala letewadedute tecelaalaacehu; lamesaalee:: weredatenaa yathalaate mashomene yamiyaasekatele hono saala 'alamataagalene tewadedaalaacehu. 'alaahe la'enaaneta yamithaqemwacehune 'enaa yamigodwacehune malekaamenaa 'enaa mathefo nagarocene bamigabaa yaaweqaale; 'enaaneta gene yehenene 'ataawequme. la'enaaneta malekaame nagare yayaaza bamahonu lamamariyaawe taazaazhe hunu.

'aneta nabiye hoye! sawoce batakabarute waraate (bazule qa`idaahe, bazule hhijaahe, bamuhharame 'enaa barajabe) wesethe sela tegele yaalawene beyene yethayequhale. 'enedihe malese sethaacawe:: <<thaa`otaawiyaane sawocene ka'alaahe manegade sawocene maagadaacawe yatathalaa tagebaare 'enedahona hulu; yatakabaru waraatoce wesethe magaadale 'alaahe zanede teleqe wanejale 'enaa yatathalaa tagebaare nawe. 'amaanyocene katakabarawe masejide makalekale, nawaariwocuneme kaziyaa maafanaaqale 'alaahe zanede batakabarute waraatoce wesethe kamagaadale yabalatha hathi'atenatu yagazafa nawe. 'enaresu yamiganyubate shireke (ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaari maaderage) kagedeyaa yakafaa nawe.>> 'amaanyoce hoye! kahadiyaane bicelu 'enaanetane ka'ewenatanyaawe 'emenataacehu wada hhasatanyaawe 'emenataacawe 'esekimaleswacehu derase 'enaanetane kamabadale 'enaa kamagaadale 'ayewagadume. ka'enaaneta makaakale ka'emenatu yamiqalabasenaa ba'alaaheme kehedate fatzemo yamimote yaqadama malekaame szeraawe baregethe wedeqe honwale. bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame yamithabeqawe maarafiyaa 'esaate nawe; baziyaame wesethe zawetaari yehonaale.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanu, wada 'alaahe 'enaa male'eketanyaawe bamasadade manoriyaacawene thelawe yaheedu, ya'alaaheme qaale yabalaaye yehone zanede yataagalu ya'alaahene 'ezenate 'enaa meheratene yefalegaalu. 'alaaheme labaarocu hathi'atocene mahhari la'enaresume 'azaanye nawe.

'aneta nabiye! baaledarabocehe selakxamere ('a`emerone yamishafene 'asekaari mathathe) selamathathaate, selamashathe 'enaa selamagezaate 'enedihume selaqumaare yethayequhale. 'enedihe bamaalate malese sethaacawe <<bahulatume (ba'asekaari mathathe 'enaa baqumaare) wesethe la'emenate 'enaa lahheyewate tzare yahonu bezu 'aferaashe nagaroce yeganyubaacawaale. 'a`emerone masaate, ganezabene maathaate, bathelaacaa 'enaa kurefiyaa wesethe magebaatene yaasekatelaalu.baterefe ragade theqite theqeme maagenyate yenoraale. nagare gene gudaataacawe 'enaa takatelwacawe yamimathaawe hathi'ate katheqemaacawe yabalatha nawe; katheqemu gudaatu yamibalethe nagarene dagemo theenaamaa 'a`emero yaalawe sawe yereqawaale.>> (yehe galatzaa 'alaahe 'asekaari mathathene yatakalakala liyaadaregawe bamajamariyaa waqete muselimocene zegeju yaadaragabate mekeneyaataawi galatzaa nawe) 'enedihume bafaqaadanyenate 'enaa babago 'aderaaginate kaganezabaacawe mene yaahele mamatzewate 'enedaalabaacawe yethayequhale. 'enedihe bamaalateme malese sethaacawe:: <<kaganezabaacehu wasaanye gudaayaacehu yatarafawene matzewetu>> balaacawe. (yehe bamajamariyaawe malakotaawi male`ekete gizee yanabaranaa kaziyaa baxwaalaa batawasanu yaneberate kefeloce 'enaa bataawaqa yazakaa lekeete gedaajenate yatalawatha te`ezaaze nawe). taasetawelu zanede yehene bamasalu fenetewe belawe bamitaayu galatzaawoce 'alaahe hegegaatocene yaaberaaraalaacexwaale.

bamederaawi `aalame 'enaa bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame yamithaqemaacehune batheleqate taasetawelu zanede yehenene 'alaahe danagaga. 'aneta nabiye hoye! baaledarabocehe yatimocene (walaaje yamotabaacawene lejoce) 'enedeete manekabaakabe 'enaa kanaresu gaare yaalaacawe genenyunate mene mamesale 'enedaalabate; 'enedihume ganezabocaacawene lanuro bamiyaasefalegaacawe wachiwoce, bamegebe 'enaa bamathathe kanaresu ganezabe gaare maaqalaaqale 'enedeete yetaayaale silu yethayequhale. 'enedihe malese sethaacawe:: <<warataa (kefeyaa) saatefalegu walaaje yamotabaacawene lejoce neberate (ganezabe) beteqothaatharulaacawe; theqeme bamisathaacawe maleku betaasetadaaderulaacawe; bamalekaame huneetaa beteyezulaacawe; yehe 'alaahe zanede la'enaaneta yatashaalanaa bezu yamalekaame szeraa menedaa yamiyaaseganye nawe. ya'enaresune ganezabe mathabaqiyaa bamahonu yatanasaa yehe laganezabaacawe malekaame nawe. ganezabaacawene kaganezabaacehu gaare bamaqalaaqale banuro, bamanoriyaa botaa 'enaa bamasaasalute heyewatene betegaarwacawe bazihe wesethe hathi'ate yalame. 'enaresu ba'emenate wanedemocaacehu naacawe; wanedemaamaacoce 'erese barese yedagaagafaalu; kafilaacawe lakafilaacawe gudaaye yeqomaale. 'alaahe walaajocaacawene bamote yatanathaqu hhetzaanaatene ganezabe kaganezabu gaare bamaqalaaqale maathefaatene yamifalegawene; ganezabaacawene maalemaate 'enaa bamithaqemaacawe malekaame manegade laaye maawaale kamifalegawe layeto yaaweqaale. 'alaahe 'enaanetane maasechanaqe bifalege nagarocene yaathabebaacehu nabare. nagare gene ya'alaahe hege nagarocene qalaale bamaaderage laaye yatamaszarata bamahonu ka'enaresu gaare 'aberaacehu yametenorubatene manegade qalaale 'adaragalaacehu.>> 'alaahe 'anedaaceme nagare dele yamaayenasaawe 'ashanaafi; ba'afathaatharu, sere`aata `aalamune bamaasetanaabaru 'enaa bahhegegaatu thebabanyaa nawe.

'amaanyoce hoye! ba'alaahe yamiyaagaaru seetocene 'alaahene babecanyaa 'amelaakenatu 'esekiyaamenunaa wada selaame 'esekigabu derase 'ataagebwacawe. ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanacenaa babaarenate qanebare sere yameteganye seete bawebatwa 'enaa baneberatwa kametaasedaneqaacehu thaa`otene kametaamaleke natzaa seete tebalethaalace. muselime seetoceneme la'agaari (thaa`otaawiyaane) wanedoce 'ataagaabu. 'anede ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyaawe yamiyaamene babaarenate qanebare sere yamiganye wanede habetunaa webatu kamiyaasedaneqaacehu thaa`otene kamiyaamaleke natzaa wanede yebalethaale.'enaziyaa ba'alaahe laayeya'amelekote tagaari bamaaderage yamitaawaqute (wanedocenaa seetoce) banegegeraacawe 'enaa batagebaaraacawe 'esaate wadamiyaasegabu nagaroce tathaariwoce naacawe. 'alaahe bafeqaadu 'enaa bacarenatu wada janate 'enaa meheratune wadamiyaaseganyu malekaame szeraawoce yethaaraale. 'alaahe 'aneqatzocune bamiyaaseradwacawe nagaroce yemakaru 'enaa yetagaberume zanede lasawoce yaaberaaraale.

'aneta nabiye hoye! baaledarabocehe sela yaware 'ababaa (batawasana yagizee reqate kaseetoce maahetzane selamifase dame) yethayequhale. 'enedihe bamaalate malese sethaacawe:: <<yaware 'ababaa netzuhe yaalehona fasaashe nawe;baaloceneme misetoceneme yamiyaasecagere nawe; yaware 'ababaa bamimathaabate gizee seetocene (bagebera segaa) kamaganaanyate raaqu. damu ka'enaresu 'esekiqwaarathenaa bamataathabe karesu 'esekinatzu derase batzotaawi genenyunate 'ateqerabwacawe. damu kanaresu siqwaarathenaa karesume bamataathabe netzuhe sihonu 'alaahe bafaqadalaacehu manegade netzuhoce honawe qerabwacawe.>> 'alaahe kahathi'ataacawe 'abezetawe tamalaashocenenaa netzuhe kaalehoname nagare raasaacawene 'ejege 'atheriwocene yewadedaale.

misetocaacehu leke feraafereene 'enedametaawathaa medere `aayenate la'enaaneta lejocene yamisathwacehu ya'azemaraa seferaacehu naacawe. ya'azemaraa seferaacehune (tzotaawi taraakebo yamidaragebate belete) bafalagaacehute 'aqethaachaa qerabu. malekaamene bamaszeraate laraasaacehu malekaamene 'aseqademu. 'anede sawe kahathi'ate lamathabaqe 'enaa wada 'alaahe lamaqaarabe bamaasabe 'enedihume malekaame teweledene kamaagenyate 'anetzaare baalabeetune batzotaawi felaagote maqerabu kamalekaame tagebaare yamiqothare nawe. yaazazawene bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru. kaziheme 'anedu 'alaahe seetocene batamalakata yadanagagalaacehu yeganyebataale. batenesaa'eewe `elate 'alaahene yameteganaanyunaa kafitu qwaamiwoce mahonaacehune 'ewaqu. yaszeraawocaacehune wetheeteme yesathaacexwaale. 'aneta nabiye hoye! 'amaanyoce geetaacawe 'alaahe fite bamiqarebubate qane bamigathemaacawe zala`aalamaawi tzagaanaa wada takabarawe fitu bamamalekate bamiyaaganyute fetzumaawi dasetaa 'abeseraacawe.

ba'alaahe seme mamaalene malekaamene kamaszeraate, 'alaahene kamaferaate 'enaa basawoce makaakale 'ereqe kamaawerade yamiyaagedaacehu kalekaaye maaserajaa 'ataaderegu. yelequneme malekaame szeraa laalamaszeraate mahhalaa kafatzamaacehu (bazihe mekeneyaate malekaame szeraawene kamatagebare 'ateqothabu) malekaamene szeraawene fatzemu; mahhalaawocaacehune 'abesu. 'alaahe negegerocaacehune sami tagebaarocaacehune `aawaaqi nawe;baziyaame laaye yaszeraacehune wetheete yemanadaacexwaale.

bamulu ya'a`emero genezaabee taasebo (hone tabelo)baaletadaraganaa bamelaase walametaa bametemelwacawe mahhalaawocaacehu 'alaahe 'ayetasaasabaacehume. 'anedaacehu <<ba'alaahe 'emelaalahu yehe 'ayedalame>>, <<ba'alaahe 'emelaalahu yehe 'eregethe nawe>> 'enedamilawe `aayenate. bazihe laaye kaasaa yamiyaasefalegawe beezaame hona qethaate yalame. nagare gene ka'enazihe mahhalaawoce ba`eweqatenaa bamulu ya'a`emero genezaabee hone belaacehu bafatzamaacehute mahhalaa 'alaahe yeyezaacexwaale. 'alaahe yabaareyaawocune hathi'atoce mahhari 'enaa baqethaateme yamaayaathaadefaacawe taagaashe nawe.

baalabeetocaacawene batzotaawi felaagote laalamaqerabe mahhalaane yafatzamu sawoce kamaalubate gizee jamero ka'araate waraate laalebalatha gizee mathabaqe yenorebaacawaale. yehe <<laa'e>> tabelo yetaawaqaale. baalabeetocaacawene batzotaawi felaagote laalamaqerabe mahhalaane kafatzamu baxwaalaa ba'araate ware 'aliyaame kaziyaa baanasa gizee wesethe misetocaacawene wadamaganaanyate bimalasu 'alaahe kanaresu lataganyawe mahhalaa mahhari nawe. kamahhalaawocaacawe yamitzadubateneme makaashaa beezaa bamadanegagu lanaresu 'azaanye nawe.

baalabeetocaacawene laalamaganaanyate baadaragute mahhalaa tzanetawe 'enaa qathelawe kaziyaame laalamamalase fecene biyaasebu 'alaahe fece yaazalawene negegeraacawene sami; huneetaacawene 'enaa hhasaabaacaweneme `aawaaqi nawe. baziheme maszarate yemanadaacawaale.

yatafatu seetoce laszosete gizeeyaate yaahele kaware 'ababaa matheraataacawene mathabaqe 'alabaacawe. yehe saayemwalaa leelaa tedaare wesethe magebaate 'ayefaqedelaacaweme ('ayecelume). ba'alaahe 'enaa bamacharashaawe qane yamiyaamenume kahonu 'alaahe bamaahetzanaacawe wesethe yafatharawene tzenese madabaqe yalabaacaweme. yafatwacawe baalocaacaweme bafecewe mekeneyaate yatafatharawene cegere maasewagadene 'enaa baalabeetocaacawene bamamalase yalebe maqaraarabene lamafethare kaasabu ya<<`idedaa>>we gizee saayaaleqe limaleswacawe tagabiwoce naacawe. misetoce kamabete 'enaa gedeetaa 'anetzaare yabaalocene `aayenate mabetenaa gedeetaa 'alabaacawe. wanedoce bamaasetadaadare 'enaa bafeci gudaaye baseetoce laaye yabalaayenate 'alaacawe. 'alaahe 'anedaace nagare yamaayesaanawe 'ashanaafi, badenegaageewe 'enaa bamaasetadaadarume thebabanyaa nawe.

baale misetune wada 'eresu mamalase yamicelebate feci hulate gizee nawe. 'anedee fateto yemalesaale;lahulatanyaa gizee fatetome yemalesaale. kanazihe hulate feciwoce baxwaalaa gene misetune bamalekaame lamaanore 'athebeqo mayaaze 'aliyaame lamisetu malekaame bamaaderage mabetwane thabeqo laszosetanyaa gizee bafeci maasanaabate yenorebataale. baaloce hoye! bafeci misetocaacehune bametaasanaabetubate gizee lamisetocaacehu kasathaacehute yamahhere (yatheloshe) ganezabe meneme letewasedu 'ayefaqadelaacehume. misete baalwane babaahheriwe wayeneme batafatherowe yathalaacewe kahona 'enaa baziheme thelaacaa mekeneyaate hulatu tagaabiwoce bamakaakalaacawe linore yamigabaawene yatedaare hhaqe 'alamwamwalaatene segaate kagabaacawe gudaayaacawene yazemedenaa tesesere laalaacawe sawoce yaaqerebu. zamadoce (halaafiwoceme) baalenaa misete bamakaakalaacawe yaalawene yatedaare hhaqe maagudalaacawene bifaru misete ganezabe bamakefale 'eraaswane kagaabecaawe tesesere yatafataace betaadarege wanejale yalabaacaweme. 'enazihe yaselaame hegegaate batafaqadunaa batakalakalu nagaroce makaakale yamilayu bamahonaacawe 'atetalaalafwacawe. batafaqadu 'enaa batakalakalu nagaroce makaakale yaalane malayaa yahonawene ya'alaahene denebare yathaasa 'enedihe `aayenate sawoce nafesocaacawene wada thefaate bamaawerade 'enaa la'alaahe quthaa bamagaalathe raasaacawene yabadalu naacawe.

laszosetanyaa gizee baalabeetwa kafataate; karesu leelaa yahonane sawe bafelaagote 'enaa mafaqaaqade laaye yatamaszarata tekekelanyaa gaabecaa 'agebetaa; 'agebeto lamafetaate 'asebaa mahone yalabateme; baziyaa gaabecaa kaagabaacewe wanede gaare genenyunatene fatzemawe, hulatanyaawe baalwa bafaqaadu kafataate 'aliyaame bamote katalayaate kaziyaa baxwaalaa 'eneji yamajamariyaawe baalwa maleso liyaagabaate 'ayeceleme. hulatanyaawe baalwa kafataate 'aliyaame kamota gene seetitu 'enaa yamajamariyaawe baalwa yaselaamene marehe 'enethabeqaalane belawe kaasabu ba'adise mahhere (theloshe) 'enaa nikaahhe (yagaabecaa wele) bigaabu hathi'ate yalabaacaweme. 'aweqawe yamithaqamute bamahonaacawe 'alaahe 'enazihene hegegaate marehhune 'enaa wasanocune lamiyaawequ sawoce yaaberaaraale.

seetocene kafataacehunaa ya`idedaacawe maalaqiyaa kataqaaraba bamalekaame maleswacawe 'aliyaame saatemaleswacawe bamalekaame 'asanaabetwacawe. badenequrenaawe zamane 'enedanabarawe `aayenate seetocene lamagudaate wasane maalafene 'asebaacehu 'atemaleswacawe. 'enaresune lamagudaate 'asebo yehenene yafatsama raasune lahathi'ate 'enaa laqethaate bamaagaalathe nafesune ba'eregethe badelwale. bachawaataa 'enaa badeferate ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce masaalaqiyaa 'ataaderegu; 'alaahe la'enaaneta yafatzamawene tzagaa 'asetaawesu; qure'aanene 'enaa yanabiyune yaheyewate falage banaaneta laaye maaweradu kataalaalaaqe tzagaawocu makaakale yamithaqase nawe. bamaagwaagwaate 'enaa bamaasethaneqaqe yegasetzaacexwaale. yaazazawene bamatagebare 'enaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru. 'alaahe sela hulume nagare `aawaaqi mahonune taganezabu. ka'eresu 'anedaace nagare 'ayesawareme. baszeraawocaacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

seetocaacehune kaszosete baanasa fece yafataacehu 'enaa `idaacawe yatathanaaqaqa kahona; yaseete beetasaboce hoye! kaqademo baalocaacawe gaare bagudaayu katasemaamu 'enaa kafaqadu ba'adise nikaahhe (yagaabecaa tesesere) wada baalocaacawe yemalasu zanede 'atekalekelwacawe. bazihe <<'atekalekelwacawe>> bamilawe mekere ka'enaaneta makaakale ba'alaahe 'enaa bamacharashaawe qane yamiyaamene sawe yegasatzebataale. yehe bamakaakalaacehu yamiganye malekaame nagarene yebalethe yamiyaasaadege, laszeraawocaacehu 'enaa lakeberaacehume yebalethe netzehhenaa yamisathe nawe. 'alaahe yanagarocene 'ewenataa 'enaa yamacharashaa fetzaameeyaacawene yaaweqaale; 'enaaneta gene 'ataawequme.

walaaje 'enaatoce lejocaacawene hulate mulu `aamataatene yaathabaalu. yeheme yahetzaanaate yathute mathebiyaa gizee mulu 'enedihone laasaba sawe nawe. lejoce kawaladu baxwaalaa kabaalocaacawe gaare bafeci yatalayaayu yatafatu 'athebi 'enaatoce 'enaa thute yamithabu hetzaanaate qalabenaa 'alebaasaate bamaahebarasabu genezaabee bamisathawe mathane leke yahetzaanu 'abaate maaqerabe yenorebataale. 'alaahe 'aneditene nafese kacelotaawaa (ka'aqemwa) balaaye 'ayaasegadedaateme. kahulatu walaajoce (leje kaafaru baxwaalaa bafeci yatalayaayu hulate baalenaa misete) 'anedaacaweme bihone yatawaladawene hhetzaane leelaanyaacawene lamagudaate mekeneyaate maaderage yalabateme. 'enaate balejwa, 'abaateme baleju mekeneyaate magodaate yalabaacaweme. 'abaate kamota 'enaa laleje yaqara ganezabe kaleela bahetzaanu waraashoce (yabaale beetasaboce laaye) ba'abaatu laaye yanabarawe `aayenate xaalaafinate yenorebaacawaale. hulatu walaajoce katamakaakaru 'enaa laleju bamibajawe nagare laaye katasemaamu 'enedihume hhetzaanu hulate `aamate saayemolaawe mathebaate maaqomune bifalegu hathi'ate yalabaacaweme.bamaahebarasabu genezaabee bamisathawe mathane leke lahetzaanu 'athebi yametaadaregutene wachi yaala maagudale 'enaa yaala maazageyate yametesathu kahona lalejaacehu ka'enaatu leelaa 'athebine betaamathu hathi'ate yalabaacehume. 'alaaheneme feru; 'alaahe yameteszarutene nagare tamalekaace mahonune 'ewaqu. ba'alaahe laaye 'anedaace nagare 'ayesawarebateme;yaszeraacehune waagaa yesathaacexwaale.

ka'enaaneta makaakale 'ereguze yaalehonu misetocene tetawe yamotu wanedoce misetocaacawe la'araate waraate ka'asere qane kabeete yaalamawethaate, yaalamagaageethe 'enaa leelaa 'adise tedaare yaala mamaserate gedeetaa 'alabaacawe.yaseetwa tathariwoce hoye! yehe ya'araate ware ka'asere qanaate gizee sithanaaqaqe bashari`aawe 'enaa bamaahebarasabu zanede malekaamenatu bamitaawaqe maleku seetocu kaziyaa bafite takalekelawe yaqoyubatene nagare biyaadaregu banaaneta laaye waqasaa yalabaacehume. 'alaahe 'enaaneta kametaadaregute nagare geletzume debequme yamaayeshashagebate, sela hulume nagare wesethe `aawaaqi nawe.

babaalwa mote 'aliyaame baszosetanyaa fece `idedaawaane (maahetsanwa ka'eregezenaa natsaa mahonu yamiragaagathebate yaqoyetaa yagizee gadabwane) 'eyaqotharace lameteganye seete yamaagebaate felaagotaacehune bageletse saatenaagaru <<`idedaashe sithanaaqaqe 'asaaweqinye>> `aayenate yagaabecaa felaagote 'enedaalaacehu yamiyaamalaakete theqomaa betaadaregu wayeneme `idedaawaa siyaabaqaa 'agabaataalahu belaacehu hasaabune balebaacehu saweraacehu betaaqoyu hathi'ate yalabaacehume. 'alaahe 'enaresune baberetu bamafalage semocaacawene 'enedametaanasu 'awaqa. yagaabecaa felaagotaacehune bageletze saayehone batheqomaa maamalaakateneme faqadalaacehu. ba`idaa waqete wesethe 'eyaalu yagaabecaa felaagotaacehune bamisethere kamanegare tathaneqaqu. malekaamenatu bamitaawaqe maleku theqomaane masethatene 'eneji ba`idaa gizee yagaabecaane wele 'atefatsemu. 'alaahe 'eresu kafaqadalaacehu 'enaa kakalakalaacehume nagare balebocaacehu yametaasaaderutene 'enedamiyaaweqe `ewaqu; te`ezaazuneme 'atetalaalafu. 'alaahe kabaarocu kathefaatu latamalasa mahhari, baqethaateme yamaayaathaadefe taagaashe mahonune `ewaqu.

yagaabecaa wele yafatzamaacehulaacawene seetoce tzotaawi genenyunate kamafatzamaacehu bafite 'enedihume maherene saateqorethulaacawe bafite feci betefatzemu hathi'ate yalabaacehume. bazihe huneetaa betefatwacawe maherene makefale ba'enaaneta laaye gedeetaa 'ayedalame. gedeetaa yamihonawe 'enaresu yamithaqamubatene 'enaa lebaacawe yamithaganebatene mathaqamiyaa masethate becaa nawe. sisaayu safi yatadaragalate baala habeteme hona sisaayu thabaabe yahonabate deha hulume 'eneda 'aqemu lafataate seete mathaqamiyaa masethate 'alabate. yehe batagebaaraacawe 'enaa bamaahebaraawi genenyunataacawe malekaame szariwoce bahonu sawoce laaye gedeetaa nawe.

yaagabaacexwaacawene 'enaa yamaherune leke yaqorathaacehulaacawene misetocaacehune tzotaawi genenyunate kamafatzamaacehu bafite betefatwacawe la'enaresu katasayamawe mahere gemaashune makefale ba'enaaneta laaye gedeetaa nawe. 'enaresu bafeqaadaacawe yeqere kaalaalu 'aliyaame baaloce maherune bamulu lamakefale kafaqadu 'eneji yamikafalawe gemaashu nawe. bamakaakalaacehu baalawe mabete yeqere mabaabaale 'alaahene lamaferaate yaqaraba nawe. kafilaacehu bakafilaacehu laaye yanabarawene malekaame cerotaa 'ateresu. 'alaahe yameteszarutene nagare tamalekaace nawe. ya'alaaheneme menedaa lamaagenyate malekaamene nagare bamaszeraate therate 'aderegu.

'alaahe 'enedaazazawe batamwalaa huneetaa bamasegade salaate 'asaameraacehu yaazu. kasalaatoce makaakaleme batalayeme yamahakalanyaawene (merethu salaate maalateme ya`asere salaatene) thabequ. basegedatocaacehume wesethe la'alaahe taazaazhoce 'enaa fariwoce bamahone qumu.

thalaatene 'enaa masale nagarene yafaraacehu kahonanaa salaatene batamwalaa maleku masegade baatecelu ba'egeraacehu 'eyataraamadaacehu 'aliyaame bagemale, bafarase 'enaa bamasaasalute nagaroce laaye tafanaathethaacehu; 'aliyaame bametecelute huneetaa honaacehu segadu. ferehaatume ka'enaaneta siwagade 'alaahe 'enedaasetamaaraacehu 'asetaawesute. basalaate wesethe batamwalaa huneetaa 'alaahene maawadase kazihe 'alaahe kaasetamaaraacehu `eweqate yamithaqase nawe.'enedihume 'alaahe kaberehaanu 'enaa kamamariyaawe kazihe bafite yamaataawequ yanabaraacehuteneme selaasetamaaraacehu 'asetaawesute.

ka'enaaneta (kawanedoce) makaakale misete thelawe yamimotu (misetocaacawe) bagathamaacawe hhazane yatasabara lebaacawene lamathagane 'enaa yamwaceneme yanuzaazee qaale lamathabaqe bamanoriyaa 'enaa banuro wachi mathaqame yecelu zanede waraashoce kabeete saayaasewathwacawe 'anede `aamate yaahele 'enediqoyu linaazazulaacawe yegabaale. 'anede `aamate saayemolaacawe bafeqaadanyenataacawe biwathu ba'enaaneta laaye tathayaaqinate yalame. 'enaresume kamaageethe 'enaa kamawaabe bamiyaadaregute hathi'ate yalabaacaweme. 'alaahe dele yaminasaawe yaleela 'ashanaafi, bamaasetadaadaru, bahegegaatu 'enaa bawesaaneewe thebabanyaa nawe. kaqure'aane tanetaanyoce makaakale bezuxaanu 'enedamiyaaseradute yehe 'aneqatze basuratule baqaraahe 234nyaa 'aneqatze laaye:: (wa'lWadhiyna yutawafWawna minkum wayadharuwna 'azwaj yatarabWaSna bi'anfusihinWa 'arba`a@a 'ashhur wa`ashr) <<ka'enaaneta makaakale 'ereguze yaalehonu misetocene tetawe yamotu wanedoce; misetoce la'araate waraate ka'asere qane kabeete yaalamawethaate, yaalamagaageethe 'enaa leelaa 'adise tedaare yaala mamaserate gedeetaa 'alabaacawe.>> bamilawe qaale tasherwale.

yatafatu seetoce bafeci latasabara lebaacawe mathaganyaa yamihone ganezabe, 'alebaasaatenaa leeloce 'asefalaagi mathaqamiyaa nagaroce, baminorubate maahebarasabe genezaabee bamiszathawenaa kabaale 'aqeme gaare bamithaathaame maleku lisathaacawe yegabaacawaale. yehe te`ezaazune bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamatawe 'alaahene lamifaru sawoce gedeetaa yatadaraga denegaagee nawe.
'amaanyoce hoye! teganazabunaa bagabireme tefatzemute zanede kazihe qadame 'enedataberaaraalaacehu `aayenate 'alaahe wasanocune 'enaa hegegaatune yaaqafu 'aneqatzocune yaaberaaraalaacexwaale.

'aneta nabiye hoye! bawarareshenye 'enaa baleeloce mekeneyaatoce 'enedaayemotu faretawe kamanedaraacawe selawathu 'ejege bezu sawoce zeenaa `eweqatehe 'aledarasabatemene? 'enaresu kaseraa'eele lejoce tewelede yahonu cheferoce nabaru; 'alaaheme <<mutu>> 'alaacawe motume; kaziyaame 'alaahe nagaroce hulu ba'eresu 'eje 'enedahona 'enaa 'enaresu laraasaacawe theqemene maamethaate, gudaateneme maasewagade 'enedamaayecelu liyaasaaweqaacawe kamote qasaqasaacawe. 'alaahe lasawoce yalegesenaa 'enaa yacerotaa baalabeete nawe. honome 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce 'alaahene sela tzagaawocu 'ayaamasagenuteme.

'amaanyoce hoye! ya'alaahene 'emenate lamaradaate 'enaa qaalune kafe lamaaderage ya'alaahene thalaatoce taagalu; 'alaahe negegeraacehune sami, hasaabaacehune 'enaa tagebaaraacehuneme `aawaaqi mahonune `ewaqu; baziyaame yemanadaacexwaale.

terefu bezu 'ethefe hono 'enedimalaselate, bamalekaame hasaabe 'enaa bamulu feqaadanyenate ganezabune ba'alaahe manegade laaye bamilagese bazihe tagebaarume ya'abadaarine `aayenate szeraa yamiszaraa maane 'ala?! 'alaahe bafetehawinatu bafaqadawe laaye sisaaye 'enaa theenaane yaathabebaale; 'enedihume lafaqadawe sawe sisaaye 'enaa theenaane yaasafaale. bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame wadaresu becaa temalasaalaacehu; kaziyaame baszeraawocaacehu yemanadaacexwaale.

'aneta nabiye hoye! kamusaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) zamane baxwaalaa selanabarute yaseraa'eele teweledoce yahonu shumaamenetoce zeenaa `eweqate 'aledarasaheneme?! bawaqetu lanabarawe nabiyaacawe <<ba'alaahe manegade ka'eresu gaare lenewaagaa yamiyaadareganene mari (negusze) 'aderegelene>> baalu gizee; nabiyaacaweme <<'enaaneta 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye mataagalene biwasenebaacehu (gedeetaa biyaadaregebaacehu) 'atetaagalume yehonaale>> 'alaacawe. nabiyaacawe selanaresu yaalawene therethaaree bamaqaawameme 'enedihe 'alu:: <<tegelene 'enedenaadarege yamiyaasegadede tachabaache 'eyaala lamahonu lamene 'anetaagaleme?! thalaatocaacene kamanoriyaa hagaraacene 'abaarerawenaale; lejocaaceneneme maarekawaale ('aserawaale); hagaraacenene lamaasemalase 'enaa lejocaacenene lamaasefataate 'enetaagalaalane.>> honome 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye tegelene gedeetaa siyaadaregebaacawe 'afagafagu. kanaresu theqitoce becaa 'eneji yagabutene qaale kidaane yafatzama 'aletaganyame. 'alaahe kate`ezaazu 'afanegaachocene, qaale kidaanune 'aferaashe badalanyocene yaaweqaale; sela szeraacaweme yemanadaacawaale.

nabiyaacaweme 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<'alaahe babaanediraawe sere tetaagalu zanede la'enaaneta "thaalute"ne mari negusze 'aderego shumolaacexwaale.>> shumaamenetume yanabiyaacawene negegere bamaqaawame:: <<'enyaa lanegeszenaa karesu yeleqe tagabiwoce honane 'eyaalane 'enedeete 'eresu ba'enyaa laaye shumate yenorawaale? kanagaszetaate zereyaame (lejeme) 'ayedalame; banegeszenaawe laaye yamitaagazebateneme baqi habeteme 'aletasathawe>> 'alu. nabiyaacaweme:: <<'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye shumotaale; ba`eweqate 'enaa ba'akaale thenekaareeme belechaane sathetotaale >> 'alaahe bathebabu 'enaa ba'ezenatu negeszenaawene lafaqadawe sawe yesathaale. 'alaahe cerotaawe safi nawe; ka'agalegaayocu tagabi yahonawene `aawaaqi nawe.

nabiyaacaweme:: <<'eresu ba'enaaneta laaye mari negusze hono yamamarathu maaragaagachaa 'alaahe ka'enaaneta yatawasadawene saathene la'enaaneta mamalasu nawe. (yaseraa'eele lejoce kebere yamisathute 'enaa yatawasadabaacawe saathene nabare.) saathenune maragaagaate yegodaanyawaale. 'enedihume yamusaa 'enaa yaharune beetasaboce yataweraatene qerite (lamesaalee ta'ameranyaayetu batere), taweraate yawaradabate lawehhe (szaleedaa) bawesethu yeganyaale. malaa'eketoceme tashakemawete yemathaalu. 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyoce kahonaacehu bazihe wesethe geletze meleketoce yeganyaalu.>>

thaaluteme szaraawitune 'asekatelo kamanedaritu siwathaa:: <<'alaahe 'enaanetane bawaneze weha yefatenaacexwaale. kawanezu weha yathathaa ba'enee manegade laaye 'ayedalame, bategelume 'ayegodaanyanyeme. ka'eresu yaalethathaa gene 'eresu ba'enee manegade laaye nawe; bategelume kanee gone yesalafaale theme 'asegadedote ba'eju 'anede zegene yaahele yatagonacha gene meneme yalabateme>> 'alaacawe. theqitoce yabarataa theme wesethe honaweme 'eyaalu te`egesete siyaadaregu bezuwocu yaszaraawitu 'abaalaate gene kaziyaa waneze thathu. thaalute 'enaa karesu gaare yaalu 'amaanyoce wanezune batashaagaru gizee, kafile yaszaraawitu 'abaalaate zaaree jaalutene 'enaa szaraawitune lamawaagaate 'aqeme yalaneme bamaalate tanaagaru. bazihe gizee 'enaziyaa batenesaa'eewe `elate 'alaahe fite 'enedamiqomu 'eregethanyaa yahonute sawoce theqite quthere yaalaacawe ya'amaanye cheferoce barekaataa quthere yaalaacawe yakahadiyaanene cheferoce ba'alaahe feqaade 'ejege bezu gizee 'ashanefawaale bamaalate tanaagaru. delene lamaqadaajate wasaanyu nagare maane 'eneji yaquthere mabarekate 'ayedalame; 'alaahe ka'agalegaayocu makaakale kate`egesetanyoce gaare nawe; yaagezaacawaale; yeradaacawaaleme.

jaalute 'enaa szaraawitu zanede 'enedadarasunaa fite lafite 'enedatagaafathu:: <<geetaacene hoye! balebonaacene laaye te`egesetene 'anebwabwalene, bathalaatocaacene fiteme 'enedaaneshanafe 'enaa 'enedaaneshashe 'egerocaacenene 'atzenaalene; bakahadiyaane laayeme baxaayelehe 'enaa ba'eredaataahe 'agezane; deleneme 'aqadaajane>> silu batamaatzeno wada 'alaahe fitaacawene 'azoru.

ba'alaaheme feqaade 'ashanafwacawe. daawedeme yathalaatocaacawene mari jaalutene gadalawe. 'alaahe ladaawede negeszenaa 'enaa nabiyenatene sathawe. 'alaahe kafaqadawe `eweqatoceme 'asetamaarawe. yamederaawi 'enaa yamacharashaawene `aalame malekaame nagaroce lagasawe. 'alaahe batafatherwawi hegu yakafile sawocene thefaate bakafile sawoce yamimalese baayehone medere ba'athefiwoce 'amebaagananenate tebalaashe nabare. 'alaahe lafetherataatu yacarenate baalabeete nawe; selaziheme yamithaqemaacawene yaadaregaale.

'aneta nabiye hoye! bamiyaasetalaalefute zeenaa 'ewenatene 'enaa fetehene yaaqafu sihonu 'enazihe ba'aneta laaye yamenaanabebaacawe geletze yahonu ya'alaahe 'aneqatzoce naacawe. 'aneta ka`aalamaatu geetaa katalaakute male'eketanyoce 'anedu nahe.

'enazihe laaneta yathaqasenelehe male'eketanyoce bamalakotaawi male'ekete, batakataayoce bezaate 'enaa badarajaawoce kafilaacawene kakafilu 'abalaalethanaacawaale. kanaresu makaakale 'eneda musaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) yaalawene 'alaahe yaanaagarawe yeganyaale; kanaresume 'eneda muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yaalawene dagemo lasawe lejoce hulu bamalaake, yanabiyaate madamedamiyaa bamaaderage 'enaa hhezebocuneme kataqarute hhezeboce hulu balaache bamaaderage 'alaahe badarajaa kafe yaadaragaweme 'ala. lamareyame leje la`isaame nabiye mahonune 'aseraje yahonu geletze ta`aameraatene sathanawe lamesaalee mutaanene maqaseqase, `aayena sewerene 'enaa lametze yaalabatene ba'alaahe faqaade mafawasenenaa yamasalu ta`aameraatocene sathanawe. ya'alaaheneme te`ezaaze yefatzeme zanede bataqadasawe manefase bajiberile (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'abarataanawe. 'alaahe bifaqede noro kamale'eketanyoce baxwaalaa yamathute hhezeboce geletze yahonu maaserajaawoce kamathaalaacawe baxwaalaa baaletagadaadalu nabare; nagare gene tawazaagabu 'enaa takafaafalu; kanaresu makaakale ba'alaahe yaamana 'ala; bamakaakalaacaweme ba'alaahe kehedatene yafatzama yeganyaale. 'alaahe 'enedaayegadaadalu bifaqede baaletagadaadalu nabare; nagare gene 'alaahe yafaqadawene yaadaregaale; yafaqadawene bacerotaawe 'enaa ba'ezenatu yemaraale; yafalagaweneme bathebabu 'enaa bafetehu yaathamemaale.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male`eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu 'amaanyoce hoye! yaferedu `elate kamamethaatu bafite 'enyaa kalagasenaacehu, katalayaayu yatafaqadu nagaroce metzewaatene lagesu. baziyaane qane maanenyaaweme sawe yamithaqemawene yamiyaaganyebate negede, bamakaraa gizee yamithaqeme wadaajenate, gudaatene yamimakete, 'alaahe lafaqadawe 'enaa lawadadawe sawe 'eneji theqemeneme yamiyaamathaa shemegelenaa 'enaa 'amaalaajenate yalame. kahadiyaaneme 'alaahene bamakaadaacawe mekeneyaate badalanyocu 'enaresu naacawe.

'alaahe yaa 'eresu babecanyenate ba'ewenate 'amelekote yamigabaawe becanyaawe 'amelaake nawe. mote 'enaa gudelate yamaayekatalawe hheyaawe nawe. kafethuraane hulu yatabeqaaqaa baraasu qwaami; yasamaayaate 'enaa yamedere fetherataate hulu karesu mabeqaaqaate yamaayecelu sihonu baresu yaqomu naacawe. maanegolaajateme hona 'eneqelefe 'ayezaweme; yeheme bahheyaawenatu 'enaa baqwaaminatu zala`aalamaawi selahona nawe. basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaala negeszenaa hulu ya'eresu nawe; karesu faqaade 'enaa wedeetaa baxwaalaa 'eneji maaneme 'akaale laleelaa 'akaale liyaamaalede 'ayeceleme. kafethuraanume gudaaye takaseto yaalafane 'enedihume yaaletakasata 'enaa lawadafite yamikasatawene nagare yaaweqaale.'eresu liyaasaaweqaacawe kafaqadawe nagare 'eneji karesu `eweqate 'anedaaceneme nagare 'ayaakaabebume ('ayaawequme). yakuresiye manebaru (ya'alaahe hulate ya'egerocu madaafe maarafiyaa nawe) sefaate samaayaatene 'enaa mederene kasefaataacawenaa kagezefataacawe gaare yamiyaathaqaalele nawe. samaayaatene 'enaa mederene mathabaqeme 'ayesaanaweme.'eresu bahhelewenaawe, bacelotaawe 'enaa ba'ashanaafinatu yabalaaye; banegeszenaawe 'enaa baselethaanu yalaaqa taalaaqe nawe.

'anede sawe wada selaame 'enedigabaa maasegadade yalame; selaame 'ewenate 'enaa geletze 'emenate kamahonu 'anetzaare maaneme sawe bagede 'enediqabalawe 'ayegadademe. qathetanyaawe manegade kathemate manegade talayetwale.ka'alaahe weche bamimalaku hulu yakaadanaa ka'enaresume yatzadaa, ba'alaahe babecanyenatume yaamana baferedu `elate lamadaane mekeneyaate yamihonawene thanekaaraa gamade ba'eregethe chabethwale. 'alaahe yabaarocune negegere sami tagebaaraacaweneme `aawaaqi nawe; baresume yemanadaacawaale.

'alaahe ya'enaziyaa ba'eresu laamanute wadaajenaa thabaaqi nawe; lamalekaame nagare sekeetene yesathaacawaale; yeradaacawaale. kakehedate 'enaa kamaayemenate chelamaawoce 'asewatheto wada 'emenate 'enaa `eweqate berehaane yemaraacawaale. 'enaziyaa kehedatene yafatzamu sawoce wadaajocaacawe thaa`otoce 'enaa ka'alaahe baashaagare yamimalaku wedeqe (hhasatanyaa) 'amaaleketoce naacawe. kehedatene 'asaamerawe yaasaayuwaacawaale. kamaane 'enaa ka`eweqate berehaane wada kehedate 'enaa maayemenate chelamaa yaashagaagerwacawaale; 'enaresu ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe; bawesethwa zala`aalamaawi zawetaariwoceme naacawe.

'alaahe hulatune cheferoce kathaqasa baxwaalaa lahulatume mesaalee siyaaqarebe 'enedihe 'ala::
'aneta nabiye hoye! 'alaahe negeszenaane selasathawe wasane bamaalafu beraahimene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) sela 'alaahe geetenate 'enaa 'anedenate katakaraakarawe 'amebaaganane bachefene deferate yamibalethe `aayetahe taaweqaalahene?! beraahime yageetaawene magalachaa 'enedihe sile 'aberaaraalate:: <> 'amebaagananume bakehedate <<'eneeme yafaqadekutene bamagedale 'enaa yafaqadekuteneme meherate bamasethate 'anoraalahu; 'egadelaalahume 'ala. beraahimeme (`alayehi wasalame) kamajamariyaawe yabalatha maaserajaa 'enedihe bamaalate 'aqarabalate:: <<'enee yamaamalekawe geetaa tzahhayene kameseraaqe 'aqethaachaa yaawathaataale; 'aneta dagemo kame`eraabe 'aqethaachaa 'enedetewathaa 'aderegaate>> 'alawe. bazihe gizee 'amebaagananu tadanaagara; kamugetu kamaqothabe wechi leelaa `edele 'alenabaraweme. baberaahime yamaaserajaa thenekaaree tashanafa. 'alaahe babadalaacawe 'enaa ba'amebaagananenataacawe mekeneyaate labadalanyaa hhezeboce ya'eresune manegade yamamaraate sekeetene 'ayesathaacaweme.

'enedazihume dagemo manoriyaawocwa bathaaraawocaacawe yatadafu, gedegedaawocaacawe yafaraarasu, nawaariwocwa yaalaqu, 'asefari 'enaa baado bahonacewe manedare 'athagabe yaalafawene sawe tamalakatekene?! yehe sawe bamagarame <<'alaahe yehecene manedare 'enedihe kawadamace baxwaalaa nawaariwocwane 'enedeete nawe kamote yamiqasaqesaacawe?!>> sile thayaqa; 'alaahe 'eziyaawe seferaa baziyaawe qetzebate 'enedimote 'adaragawe; 'anede mato `aamataateneme 'aqoyawe; kaziyaame heyaawe 'aderegote <<'ezihe seferaa mene yaahele gizee qoyahe?>> sile thayaqawe; <<la'anede qane wayeme yaqane gemaashe yaahele qoyecaalahu>> sile malese satha. <<'ayedalame, yelequneme 'ezihe seferaa mute honahe 'anede mato `aamataatene mulu qoyetahale>> 'alawe. <<yezakxawe wadanabarawe megebe 'enaa mathathe tamalekate; yekxawe 'eresu yaaletalawatha sihone banabarabate huneetaa laaye yeganyaale. (megeboce 'enaa mathathoce lamalawathe fathaane kamahonaacawe gaare) yayaazekawe megebe 'aletalawathame; magwaagwaazhaahe wadanabarawe mute 'aheyaahe tamalekate. 'alaahe sawocene kamote baxwaalaa bamaqaseqasene caaye mahonune sawoce 'enediradunaa la'enaresu geletze ta`aamere liyaadaregehe zanede yabasabasu 'enaa yatabataatanu yahonu ya'aheyaane 'athenetoce 'enedamene 'enedameneqasaqesawe (heyewate 'enedamenezaraabate) kafilune kakafilu gaare 'enedeete 'enedamenegathaathemawe tamalekate; kaziyaa baxwaalaa segaa 'enaalabesawaalane; bawesethume hheyewatene 'enemalesaalane.>> yehe sawe yehenene batamalakata gizee yanagaru 'ewenataa geletze honalate; ya'alaaheneme celotaa 'awaqa. 'alaahe maanenyaaweme nagare caaye mahonune 'aweqaalahu>> sileme mesekerenatune satha.

'aneta nabiye hoye! beraahime (`alayehi 'asalaame) <<geetaayee hoye! mutaanene 'enedeete 'enedameteqasaqese ba`aayenee 'asaayanye>> baala gizee 'asetaawese. 'alaaheme <<bazihe gudaaye ka'ahune bafite 'emenate 'alenabarahemene?>> 'alawe. beraahimeme <<baregethe 'emenate 'alanye; nagare gene yebalethe lebee yetzanaa zanede nawe>> 'ala. 'alaaheme 'enedihe 'alawe:: <<'araate baraari wafowocene yaazenaa wada raasehe 'asethagetahe qoraarethaacawe; kaziyaame yataqoraaratha 'akaalaacawene 'eyakafaafaleke bazuriyaahe bamiganyu taraaroce laaye 'aseqamethe; kaziyaame semaacawene 'eyathaqaseke theraacawe; hheyewate tazaretobaacawe bafethenate wada 'aneta yemathaalu. beraahime hoye! 'alaahe banegeszenaawe 'ashanaafi, bate'ezaazu, bahhegegaatu 'enedihume ba'afathaatharu thebabanyaa mahonune `ewaqe.>>

ganezabocaacawene ba'alaahe manegade yamilagesu 'amaanyoce mesaalee gabaree bamalekaame lame mareete laaye 'enedamitakelaate 'anedite feree nawe. yehece feree sabaate qanezaloce 'abeqelaa, 'eyaanedaanedu qanezale bacheneqelaatu laaye mato fereewocene yamiyaazele zalalaane 'enedatashakama takele mesaalee nawe. 'alaahe kabaarocu lafalagawe menedaane 'ethefe derebe yaadaregaale. 'alaahe bacerotaawe 'enaa basethotaawe safi, 'ethefe derebe menedaa yamigabaawe maane 'enedahona `aawaaqi nawe.

'alaahene bamataazaze 'enaa wedeetaawene falegawe ganezabocaacawene yamilagesu kaziyaame metzewaataacawene banegegeraacawe bamamatzaadaqenaa batagebaaraacawe bamaasecagare menedaacawene bamiyaabalaashe nagare yamaayaasekatelu lawadafite selamigathemaacawe nagare ferehate yalabaacaweme. yamiyaaganyute tzagaame yalaaqa bamahonu baalafawe nagare matakaze 'ayenorebaacaweme.

ba'amaanye sawe lebe wesethe dasetaane yametaasegabubate ya'akeberote negegere 'enaa kefuneme laadaraga yeqere maalataacehu mamatzaadaqe 'enaa maasecagare kamikatalawe metzewaate yatashaala nawe. 'alaahe kabaarocu yatabeqaaqaa baqethaateme yamaayaathaadefaacawe taagaashe nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu sawoce hoye! metzewaate yametesathutene sawe banegegeraacehu bamamatzaadaqe hona batagebaaraacehume bamaasecagare yametzewaataacehune menedaa 'ataabalaashu. 'enedihe yamiyaadarege sawe mesaalee sawoce 'enediyaayute 'enaa 'enediyaamogesute ganezabune 'enedamilagese 'enedihume ba'alaahe, baferedu `elate 'enaa baziyaa `elate baminorawe yamalekaame szeraa malekaame menedaa 'enedihume yamathefo szeraa qethaate 'enedamaayaamene sawe nawe. yazihe sawe mesaalee dofe zenaabe waredobate 'anedaace nagare saayetawe 'athebo leethaawene 'enedaaseqarawe, 'afare 'enedataqamathabate lemuthe denegaaye nawe; la`eyulenye yamimatzawetu sawoce mesaaleeme 'enedihu nawe. yaszeraawocaacawe 'enaa yametzewaataacawe menedaa 'alaahe zanede yamiqare nagare 'ayenoraweme. 'alaahe kahadi hhezebocene wadamiwadawe nagare 'ayemaraacaweme.

ya'alaahene wedeetaa lamafalage, nafesocaacawe ba'alaahe qaale kidaane 'eregethanyaa yahonunaa yaaletagadadu sihone bafaqaadanyenate ganezabocaacawene yamilagesu 'amaanyoce mesaalee, kafe baalanaa batawaaba botaa laaye 'enedamiganye ya'atekelete seferaa nawe. beretu zenaabe 'enedaaganyawe 'enaa yagomaraa feree 'enedasathame `aayenate; bamareetu lamenate mekeneyaate bezu zenaabeme baayehone kaafiyaame 'agenyeto bateneshe weha yaamaara fereene 'enedamisathe ya'atekelete seferaa bithee nawe. leke 'enedazihu 'alaahe la'eresu belawe yalagasu sawocene yametzewaate menedaa teneshe 'enekwaa bihone 'ethefe derebe yaadaregelaacawaale. 'alaahe yameteszarutene nagare tamalekaace nawe. lataayetaa yamiszaru 'enaa la'eresu belawe yamiszarutene yaaweqaale; huluneme 'enedamigabaacawe yemanadaacawaale.

kazihe baxwaalaa 'alaahe ganezabune layeyulenye yamisathe sawe mesaalee mene 'enedamimasele 'enedihe 'aseradaa::
lamahonu 'anedaacehu ba'atekelete seferaawe wesethe kamalekaame feraafereewoce hulu yaminorawe sihone 'anedaacehu bawesethu yatamere 'enedihume yawayene zaafoce yaalubate bamahakalume wehacawe yamithaafethe jeratoce yamifasesubate ya'atekelete seferaa norote ya'atekeletume baalabeete 'erejenaa daresobate maszeraate 'enaa maamerate 'aqetote 'enedihume szeraa yamaayecelu dakaamaa lejoce norawete, yehene webe ya'atekelete seferaa bawesethu kabaade 'esaate yaazala xaayelanyaa nafaase biyaaganyawenaa mulu bamulu biyaaqaathelawe sela 'erejenaawe 'enaa sela lejocu dekemate ya'atekelete seferaawe 'ejege yamiyaasefalegawe hono saala 'enediqaathalebate yamifalege 'alane? layetaayelenye ganezabune wache yamiyaadarege sawe mesaaleeme 'enedazihe nawe. yamalekaame szeraa menedaa 'ejege 'asefalaagiwe bamihonebate `elate yaala menedaa 'alaahe fite yeqomaale. 'alaahe 'enaaneta taasetanatenubate zanede bamederaawi heyewatenaa bamacharashaawe `aalame yamithaqemaacehune maaberaariyaa yesathaacexwaale.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu hoye! szaretaacehu kaaganyaacehute yatafaqada 'enaa malekaame ganezabaacehune 'enedihume kamedere takeloceme kaawathaanelaacehu nagare metzewaate lagesu. setematzawetu rekaashe yahonawene 'ataasebu. rekaashenatune bamathelaate `aayenocaacehune yameteshafenu honaacehu 'eneji bisathwacehu yamaateqabalutene 'atesethu. laraasaacehu yamaatewadutene 'enedeete la'alaahe tewadaalaacehu?! 'alaahe kametzewaataacehu yatabeqaaqaa baszeraaweme baraasu mesegune mahonune `ewaqu.

'alaahe 'amaanyoce malekaame nagare 'enedimatzawetu kaazazaacawe baxwaalaa kashayethwane seeraa 'enaa gutegotaa 'enedihe sile 'asethanaqaqaacawe::
shayethwane badehenate yaasefaraaraacexwaale; wada sesetaamenateme yegafaafaacexwaale; wanejalene 'enaa 'amatzene 'enedetefatzemume yegaabezaacexwaale. 'alaahe dagemo lawanejalocaacehu taalaaqe meherate 'enedamiyaadarege, safi sisaayeneme 'enedamisathaacehu qaale yegabaalaacexwaale. 'alaahe cerotaawe safi yabaarocuneme huneetaa `aawaaqi nawe.

'alaahe yanegegere retu`enatene, yaszeraa sekeetaamaanatene 'enaa thebabene kasawoce lafalagawe yesathaale. yehene thebabe yatasatha baregethe bezu malekaamene tasathetwale. ba'alaahe 'aneqatzoceme yamelu`e 'a`emero baalabeetoce 'eneji leeloce 'ayemakarume; 'ayegasatzume.

ya'alaahene wedeetaa lamafalage kametzewaate tenesheme yehune teleqe yaawathaacehutene 'enedihume 'alaahene lamataazaze baraasaacehu laaye gede yaadaragaacehutene selate 'alaahe huluneme yaaweqaale; 'eresu zanede kazihe tagebaare kanetu yamiqare yalame; selaziyaame yalaaqa menedaa yekafelaacexwaale. ba'enaresu laaye gedeetaa yahonabaacawene nagare lamikalakelu 'enaa ya'alaahene denebare lamitalaalafu badalanyoce baferedu `elate qethaatene ka'enaresu mamalase yamicelu radaatoce 'ayenoraacaweme.

yametelagesutene yaganezabe metzewaate yefaa betaadaregu metzewaataacehu bathaame yaamaara yehonaale. dabeqaacehu ladehoce betesathu dagemo geletze kamaawethaatu yatashaala nawe. yehe szeraane la'alaahe becaa netzuhe lamaaderage yaqaraba nawe. szeraane la'alaahe becaa netzuhe lamiyaadaregu matzewaacoce lahathi'ataacawe shefaane 'enedihume meherate 'alaacawe. 'alaahe yameteszarutene nagare wesethe `aawaaqi nawe; kahuneetaacehu karesu 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayesawarebateme.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'ewenatene 'enediqabalu, la'ewenate taazaazhoce 'enedihonunaa 'ewenatene 'eneditagaberu mameraate ba'aneta laaye gedeetaa 'ayedalame. ba'aneta laaye gedeetaa yamihonawe ya'ewenatene manegade mathaqome 'enaa maasaawaqe nawe. 'ewenatene yamaagenyate sekeete bamasethate 'enaa wada 'ewenate lebonaawocene mameraate ba'alaahe 'eje yamiganye gudaaye nawe. 'eresu yafalagawene yemaraale; 'alaahe kametzewaataacehu yatabeqaaqaa kamalekaame nagare yametematzawetute theqemu wadanaaneta tamalaashe nawe; metzewaataacehu la'alaahe becaa netzuhe yehune. ba'ewenate 'amaanyoce ya'alaahene wedeetaa falegawe 'eneji metzewaatene 'ayesathume; tenesheme yehune bezu kamalekaame yametesathutene metzewaate yaaletagwaadala 'enaa yatamwalaa sihone temanadubataalaacehu; 'alaahe maaneneme 'ayebadeleme.

baresu manegade metzewaate sela masethate kathaqasanaa 'amaanyocene wadaziyaa kagaabaza baxwaalaa metzewaataacawene yamiyaawelubatene 'aqethaachaa 'enedihe bamaalate galatzalaacawe -
ba'alaahe manegade laaye yamiyaadaregute tegele sisaayaacawene lamafalage bamedere laaye 'enedaayegwaazu laadaragaacawe mesekinoce metzewaataacehune 'aderegu; sawocene kamathayaqe yataqothabu bamahonaacawe mekeneyaate selanaresu yamaayaaweqe sawe baalatzagaawoce 'aderego yaasebaacawaale; sela'enaresu yamiyaasetawele bamagalachaa meleketocaacawe yaaweqaacawaale. sawocene baceketaa 'ayethayequme; kaganezabe 'enaa neberate yametematzawetutene nagare 'alaahe `aawaaqi nawe; baresume laaye taalaaqe menedaane yesathaacexwaale.

ya'alaahene fite bamafalage, yeyulenye 'enaa yesemulenye saayenorebaacawe ganezabocaacawene balalite 'enaa baqane, basewere 'enaa bageletze yamimatzawetu 'enazihe lanaresu batenesaa'ee `elate geetaacawe zanede yamalekaame szeraa menedaa 'alaacawe. ka'alaahe bahona cerotaa 'enaa tzagaa wadafite selamigathemaacawe nagare ferehate, kamederaawi heyewate selaamalathaacawe nagareme tekaazee yalabaacaweme.

'alaahe bamuselimoce makaakale yamatabaabarenaa yamatagaagaze manese'ee yahonawene ba'eresu manegade laaye lamamatzewate kaanasaasaa baxwaalaa yehenene `aalaamaa yamitzaararawene yawalade tagebaare 'asethanaqaqa; 'enediheme 'ala::
'enaziyaa bawalade yamithaqaaqamunaa walade yamibalu sawoce batenesaa'eewe `elate kaqaberaacawe siqasaqasu (sinasu) 'akwaaxwaanaacawe leke yashayethwane lekefete yaalabate `aayenate nawe; kaqaberaacawe sinasu yamithele bashetaa yaalabate sawe manasaate sifalege 'eyaqomanaa 'eyawadaqa 'enedaminefaraagathawe nawe yamiqasaqasute. yeheme yahonabate walade mabelaate yatafaqada nawe bamaalataacawe 'enaa bawalade 'enedihume 'alaahe bafaqadawe yagebeyete szeraa makaakale baalamalayataacawe saabiyaa nawe; negedeme hona walade ganezabene wada maabezaatenaa maabarekate yamiyaamaraa bamahonunaa bamafaqade ragademe <> 'alu. 'alaahe malese bamasethate maamasaakariyaacawene wedeqe bamaaderage weshataamenataacawene 'aragaagatha; 'alaahe negedene yafaqadawe bawesethu 'athaqaalaayenaa leyu theqemoce yaazala bamahonu 'enaa walade dagemo yasawene ganezabe kaalameneme 'atzafaa bagefenaa babadale yaala'agebaabe mabelaate bamahonu 'ereme 'enedaadaragaweme galatza. kawalade maasethaneqaqenenaa makalekalene yaazala tagesaatze simathaalate katagebaaru yataaqabanaa wada 'alaahe batzatzate yatamalasa kazihe qadame sela balaawe walade meneme hathi'ate yalabateme dereshaawe ya'eresu nawe; yawadafitune batamalakatame nagaru wada 'alaahe yemalasaale. ka'alaahe zanede kelekalaawe kadarasawe 'enaa maaserajaawe katzanaabate baxwaalaa waladene wada mathaqame katamalasa ba'eregetheme 'esaate wesethe magebaatenaa bawesethu mazawetareme yegabaawaale. 'ezihe botaa laaye zawetaari sibaale razame laala gizee bawesethwa maqoyate lamaalate nawe. mekeneyaatume ba'esaate wesethe qwaami zawetaarinate yaalawe lakahadiyaane becaa nawe. nagare gene yatawehhide sawoce (ya'alaahene becanyaa 'amelaakenate 'aragaagachoce) 'esaate wesethe baqwaaminate zawetaari 'ayehonume.

'alaahe (subehaanahu wata`aalaa) baresu manegade laaye mamatsewate 'enaa 'araathaa mabelaatene katanaagara baxwaalaa bahulatume makaakale yaalawune yaminedaa leyunate galetso 'enedehe 'ala
'alaahe yawaladene ganezabe batachabaache yaathafaawaale, barakatuneme bamanesaate yaawademawaale. ba'anetzaarume metzewaatene yaabaraketawaale; menedaaweneme 'ethefe derebe bamaaderage yaabalatzegawaaleme. malekaame szeraane ba'asere 'eseka sabaate matome kaziyaame balaaye bamaathafe derebe yaadaregawaale; yamatzewaacoceneme ganezabe yaabaraketaale. 'alaahe getere kahadine, 'ereme yahonawene 'enedatafaqada 'aderego yamigalagalene 'enedihume bawanejalenaa hathi'ate laaye zawetaarinaa qwaami yahona sawene 'ayewademe.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanu, male`eketanyaawene yatakatalu, malekaame szeraa yaszaru, 'alaahe badanagagawe maszarate salaatene 'amwaletawe yasagadu 'enaa yazakaate ganezabaacawene lamigabaawe 'akaale ba'agebaabu yalagasu menedaacawe geetaacawe zanede nawe. wadafite bamigathemaacawe nagare laaye segaate 'ayegabaacaweme; kaqerebitu `aalameme tzagaa baamalathaacaweme nagare 'ayaazenume.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu; te`ezaazune bamafatsame yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru. ba'eregetheme ba'alaahe 'enedihume selakalakalaacehume walade yametaamenu kahona sawe zanede yaqaraacehune walade 'atethayequ.

yataazazaacehutene yamaatetagaberu kahona ka'alaahenaa kamale'eketanyaawe thore 'enedamigathemaacehu 'ewaqu 'eregethanyaame hunu; tatzatzetaacehu wada 'alaahe neseha yametegabu kahonaacehunaa waladene katawaacehu yaabadaraacehute theree ganezabaacehu yegabaacexwaale. kaabadaraacehute theree ganezabaacehu tachamaari bamaqabale maaneneme letebadelu 'ayegabaame; kawaanaa ganezabaacehume taqanesobaacehume 'atebadalume.

yaalabatene `edaa 'enedikafele yametefalegute sawe `edaawene makefale yamaayecele cegeretanyaa kahoname ganezabe 'esekimacaacelate 'enaa `edaawene yamakefale 'aqeme 'esekinorawe derase yayekafalanye theyaaqeeyaacehune 'azageyute; mathayaqene tetaacehu mulu bamulu wayeneme yatawasanawene `edaawene bamasaraze betematzawetute 'alaahe zanede yaalawene darajaa yametaawequ betehonu la'enaaneta balaache 'enaa merethe nawe.

hulaacehume wada 'alaahe yametemalasubatene; kafitume yameteqomubatene kaziyaame 'eyaanedaanedwa nafeseme baszaraacewe malekaameme hona mathefo tagebaare yametemanadaabatene 'enaa yamalekaame szeraacawe menedaane bamaqanase 'aliyaame bahathi'ataacawe laaye qethaatene bamachamare yamaayebadalubatene qane qethaate feru.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu hoye! baqana gadabe bedere setebadaadaru yehenene bedere tsaafute; bamakaakalaacehu yaalaweneme yabedere wele sanade shari`aawi 'agebaabenate baalawe maleku mizaanaawinaa haqanyaa yahona tzahafi yetzaafe; tzahafiweme 'alaahe bafetehe 'eneditzefe baazazawe maszarateme welune matzaafe 'emebi lile 'ayegabaame. nagarune maatzenaatu yeragaagathe zanedeme baala`edaawe 'eneditzefe bamiyaazezawe maszarate welune yemazegebe;
