geetaawene 'alaaheneme yeferaa. bederuneme bamathane, ba`aayenate hona bayezatu meneme nagare liyaagwaadele 'ayegabaame. baala`edaaweme 'anagaagare baayecele; hetzaane wayeme 'ebede bamahonu dakaamaa bihone 'enedihume manaagare baalamacaalume hona batalayaayu mekeneyaatoce maatzaafe yamaayecele bihone ya'eresu tathari yahonawe 'asetadaadaariwe 'eresune taketo haqenenaa fetehene maszarate bamaaderage yaasemazegebelate. lagudaayume hulate basaalenaa mizaanaawi yahonu wanedocene 'asemasekeru; hulate wanedoce kaaletaganyu 'anede wanedenaa haayemaanotaacawenenaa taamaanyenataacawene yametefaqedwacawene hulate seetocene 'asemasekeru; meneme 'enekwaa 'anedwa seete beterasaa leelaanyaawaa taasetaawesaataalacenaa; mesekeroceme sela bederu mesekerenate bitharu 'emebi lilu 'ayegabaacaweme; yelequneseme lazihu gudaaye sitharu mesekerenataacawene lisathu yegabaale. yebezaame yenaseme yagizee gadabe yataqamathalatene bedere maatzaafe selecu 'atehunu. yabedere wele sanade mamazegabe ba'alaahe haayemaanote maszarate taalaaqe mizaanaawinate; mesekerenateneme lamaatzenaatenaa tafatzaami lamaaderage 'enedihume yabedere mathane yagizee gadabe 'enaa `aayenate laaye therethaareene lamaasewagade wasaanye nawe. nagare gene bamahakalaacehu yaalawe yanegede wele ba'eje laaye baalanaa waagaaweme 'eje ba'eje yamikafale kahona welune matzaatzaafu 'asefalaagi selaalehona biqare hathi'ate yalabaacehume. yakerekere manegadene lamazegaate sibaaleme maasemasekare tadanegegolaacexwaale. tzahafiwocenenaa mesekerocene magudaate 'ayefaqademe; 'eneditzefelaacawe wayeme 'enedimasakerelaacawe yamifalegutene saweneme magudaate 'ayefaqademe. bamahakalaacehu magodaadaate kataganya yehe deregite ka'alaahe te'ezaaze 'afanegetho wada hathi'ate magwaaze nawe. 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! yaazazaacehune bamataazazenaa yakalakalaacehuneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru; 'alaaheme laqerebume heyewate yehune lamacharashaawe `aalame yamibajaacehune `eweqate yaasaaweqaacexwaale. 'alaahe hulune nagare `aawaaqi nawe; ka'enaresu meneme nagare 'ayesawarebateme.

tagwaazhoce honaacehu yabedere wele sanade yamitzefelaacehu tzahafi kaalaaganyaacehu baala`edaawe (tabadaariwe) la'abadaariwe maaseyaazhaa masethatu baqi nawe; yeheme labederu waasetenaa nawe. 'erese ba'eresaacehu yametetamaamanu kahona mamazegabe, maasemasekareme hona maaseyaaze yagede 'ayedalame; bazihe gizeeme `edaawe batabadaariwe chaaneqaanaa xaalaafinate laaye yehonenaa la'abadaariwe limalesawe yamigabaa `edaa yehonaale; ba'ezihe yamatamaamane kxidate laaye 'alaahene maferaate yenorebataale; meneme likede 'ayegabaame; bikedeme bawaqetu yanabarawe mesekere mamasekare yenorebataale; qaaluneme madabaqe yalabateme; mesekerenatene yadabaqa lebu 'amatzanyaa lebe nawe; 'alaahe yameteszarutene yamiyaaweqenaa sela 'enaaneta meneme nagare yamaayesawarebatenaa baszeraacehu yamimanadaacehu geetaa nawe.

basamaaye wesethe 'enaa bamedere wesethe laalute hulu fathaari, 'asetanaabaarinaa baalabeete 'alaahe becaa nawe. balebaacehu wesethe yaalawene geletse betaadareguteme, betedabequme 'alaahe yaaweqaale; ba'eresume yemarameraacexwaale. kaziyaame bacarenatunaa ba'azaanyenatu yaashaawene yeqere sile bathebabunaa bafetehu dagemo yaashaawene yeqathaale; 'alaahe hulune nagare caaye nawe.

male'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) kageetaawe bawaradawe hulu 'amana; 'amaanyoceme 'enedihu; 'eyaanedaanedaacaweme ba'alaahe, bahulume malaa'ekete, banabiyaate laaye bawaradute matsaahhefete 'enaa batalaakute male'eketanyoceme hulu 'amanu; bamale'eketanyocu siyaamenume <<ka'alaahe male'eketanyoce 'anedaacawene saanelaye 'enaamenaalane>> bamaalate nawe. <<selaazazekaneme hona selakalakalekane sametanaale; yaazazekawene bamatagebarenaa yakalakalekawene bamatawe taazezanaale. geetaacene hoye! yeqeretaane 'enethayeqehalane; bahulume gudaayaacene laaye mamalashaacene wadaaneta becaa nawe>> yelaalu.

'alaahe maanenyaawaaneme nafese ka'aqemwa balaaye 'ayaashakemaateme; yeheme yahonabate mekeneyaate ya'alaahe haayemaanote bamaageraate laaye yatamaszaratanaa cegere 'enaa cheneqe yaleelabate haayemaanote bamahonu nawe. malekaame yaszaraa meneme saayeqanasebate yaszeraawene waagaa yaaganyaale; kefu yaszaraame yaszeraawene waagaa maaneme yamaayeshakamelate sihone raasu yemanadaale. male`eketanyaawenaa 'amaanyoceme <<geetaacene hoye! benerasaa wayeme saanaasebawe banegegereme hona batagebaare benesaasaate 'ateqethaane; geetaacene hoye! ka'enyaa bafite 'enedaalafute 'ayehudoce 'enedachaanekebaacawe `aayenate ba'enyaa laayeme yamaanecelawenenaa yamikabedanene 'atechaanebene ('ataashakemane); yamaanecelawenenaa yamaaneqwaaqwaamawene te`ezaazaatenaa kelekalaawoceneme 'enedaataashakemane; wanejalaacenene yeqere balane; maaraneme; bacarenateheme 'ezanelene; 'aneta radaataacenenaa geetaacene nahenaa bakahadiyaanoce laaye 'eredaane>> yelaalu.

(lm) 'alife, laame, mi..me (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale. baziheme `aaraboce 'enanyihene yamasalu mehetzaara-qaalaatene bamaamethaate laaye caaye 'alamahonaacawene yamiyaaseradaa nawe; meneme 'enekwaane 'enaresu yaminaagarute ya`aarabenyaa qwaaneqwaa qaalaate ba'enanyihe `aayenate fidalaate yatamaszaratu bihonume 'enaresu gene yaqure'aanene mehetzaara-qaalaate `aayenate maamethaate tasenwacawaale.)

'alaahe maalate yaa ka'eresu leelaa ba'ewenate yamimalake 'amelaake yaleela sihone becanyaa 'amelaake nawe. moteme gudelateme yamaayenakaawe hheyaawe nawe. baraasu yatabeqaaqaa, kafethuraanu yamaayekajele; leeloce fethuraanene yamiyaaqwaaqume; fethuraane hulu yaminorute baresu nawe. banagaraacawe hulu ka'alaahe mabeqaaqaate 'ayecelume.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'alaahe qure'aanene bamiyaasetalaalefawe zeenaa 'ewenatene yaaqafa (bayaazawe hegegaateme fetehene yaazala), karesu bafite yaalutene malakotaawi matsaahhefetene yamiyaaragaagethe, bamahakalaacawe mathaarase yaleela sihone baaneta laaye 'awaradawe. qure'aanene baaneta laaye kamaaweradu bafite taweraatene bamusaa laaye; nejileneme ba`isaa laaye 'awarada. 'enanyihe malakotaawi matsaahhefete hulaacaweme lasawoce la'emenataacawe 'enaa hheyewataacawe maamaare 'asefalaagi yahonu mamariyaawocene yaaqafu naacawe. ('ewenatene kaweshate qenaacaaneme kathemate yamilaye yahonawene fureqaaneneme 'awarada). 'enanyaa 'alaahe baaneta laaye yaawaradaacawene 'aneqatzoce yamikedu lanaresu beretu qethaate 'alalaacawe. 'alaaheme ba'anedaace nagare yamaayerataa 'ashanaafi male`eketanyocune yaasetabaabalute 'enaa yataqaawamutene dagemo yamibaqale nawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'alaahe qure'aanene bamiyaasetalaalefawe zeenaa 'ewenatene yaaqafa (bayaazawe hegegaateme fetehene yaazala), karesu bafite yaalutene malakotaawi matsaahhefetene yamiyaaragaagethe, bamahakalaacawe mathaarase yaleela sihone baaneta laaye 'awaradawe. qure'aanene baaneta laaye kamaaweradu bafite taweraatene bamusaa laaye; nejileneme ba`isaa laaye 'awarada. 'enanyihe malakotaawi matsaahhefete hulaacaweme lasawoce la'emenataacawe 'enaa hheyewataacawe maamaare 'asefalaagi yahonu mamariyaawocene yaaqafu naacawe. ('ewenatene kaweshate qenaacaaneme kathemate yamilaye yahonawene fureqaaneneme 'awarada). 'enanyaa 'alaahe baaneta laaye yaawaradaacawene 'aneqatzoce yamikedu lanaresu beretu qethaate 'alalaacawe. 'alaaheme ba'anedaace nagare yamaayerataa 'ashanaafi male`eketanyocune yaasetabaabalute 'enaa yataqaawamutene dagemo yamibaqale nawe.
'alaahe bamedereme hona basamaaye 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayedabaqebateme. ba`eweqatu geletzeme debeqeme yahonute nagarocene hulu yaakaababa nawe.

'eresu, yaa ba'enaatocaacehu maahetzane wesethe bafalagawe qeretze yamiqaretzaacehu nawe. wanede wayeme seete; maleku yaamaara wayeme maleka-thefu; thequre wayeme qaye 'aderego yamifatheraacehu nawe. ka'eresu basetaqare ba'ewenate yamimalake 'amelaake yalame 'eresume yamaayedafare 'ashanaafi, bamafetharu, ba'asetadaadaru 'enaa bahegegaatu fetehawi nawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'eresu 'alaahe qure'aanene baaneta laaye yaawarada nawe; karesume therethaaree (mamasaasale) yaleelabaacawe kamaaserajaa bakule geletze yahonu 'aneqatzoce 'alu 'enaresume yamatsehhafu maszaratoce 'enaa waanaawocu, baleyunateme gizee mamalashaa waabiwoce naacawe. ka'eresume leeloce barekaataa teregumocene yamiyaasetanaagedu 'aneqatzoce 'alu; ba'abezaanyoce laaye yemasaasalebaacawaale; 'enanyaa balebocaacawe wesethe ka'ewenate mazanebale yaalabaacawe yaanene yatzanaawene 'aneqatze tetawe barekaataa teregume 'azale 'enaa tamasaasaaye yahonawene yekatalaalu, baziheme fatanaane, maqaseqasene 'enaa sawocene maathemamene yefalegaalu. yatabalaasha 'emenataacawene bamigatheme maleku 'aneqatzocune badama-nafesaacawe maszarate mataregomene yefalegaalu. ya'aneqatzocuneme 'ewenatanyaa teregume 'enaa yamiyaabaqubateneme macharashaacawene 'alaahe 'eneji maaneme 'ayaaweqeme. ba`eweqate yathalaqute 'enaa yatadalaadalute baqure'aanu bahulume 'amenanaale; hulume kageetaacene zanede nawe bamaalate tamasaasaaye 'enaa barekaataa teregume 'azale yahonawene batzanaawe 'enaa mamalashaa bahonawe 'aneqatze yetaragumutaale; 'enanyaa yasalaamaawi 'a`emero baaletabeetoce 'eneji leeloce 'ayemakarume, 'ayegasatzume.

'enaziyaa ba`eweqate yathalaquteme 'enedihe yelaalu:: <<geetaacene hoye! qathetanyaawene manegade kamaraakxane baxwaalaa lebocaacenene wada themate 'ataazanebelebene; ka'ewenate yatazanabalu sawoce kadarasabaacawe fatanaa thabeqane, lebocaaceneneme yametemaraabatene kathemateme yamenethabaqebatene kaaneta zanede yahonane safi 'ezenate sethane; geetaacene hoye! sethotaahe yasafaa care nahe.

geetaacene hoye! 'aneta sawocene hulu letegamagemaacawe baziyaa therethaaree yaleelabate bahonawe qane tesabasebaacawaalahe; 'eresume machi nawe; 'ayeqareme. geetaacene hoye! 'aneta qaale kidaanene yametaathefe 'ayedalaheme>> yelaalu.

'enaziyaa 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyocune yakaadu sawoce ganezabocaacawe 'enaa lejocaacawe baqerebitume hona bamachiweme `aalame ka'alaahe qethaate 'ayaadenwacaweme. 'enaziyaa ba'enazihe magalachaawoce yatagalatzute kahadiyaane baferedu `elate jahaname yameteqathaathalebaacawe maagadowoce naacawe.

ya'enazihe sawoce mesaalee 'eneda fire`one 'enaa ka'eresu bafiteme 'enedanabarute 'alaahene 'enaa 'aneqatzocune 'enedaasetabaabalute sawoce `aayenate nawe; bawanejalocaacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe qathaacawe; ganezabocaacawe 'enaa lejocaacawe 'ayethaqemwacaweme; 'alaahe 'eresune lakaadu 'enaa 'aneqatzocuneme laasetabaabalu sawoce qethaata-beretu nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa batalayaayu 'emenatoce laaye laalu kahadiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<'amaanyoce yaashanefwacexwaale; bakehedateme laaye temotaalaacehu; 'alaaheme wada jahanama-'esaate yesabasebaacexwaale; menethaafenatume menenyaa kafaa.>>

'enaziyaa babadere `elate lamagaadale batagaathamute hulatu cheferoce wesethe la'enaaneta mamakariyaa 'enaa maasetawaayaa melekete honalaacehu; 'anedanyaawe budene ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'enaa baaledarabocaacawe yakawanute yame`emanaane cheferaa sihone ba'alaahe manegade yaresu qaale yabalaaye 'enedihone 'enaa ya'enaziyaa yakahadiyaane qaale dagemo yabataace 'enedetehone yegaadalaalu. leelocu dagemo bamakofase bataayetaa 'enaa ba'emebitanyenate yawathute yamakaa thaa`otaawiyaane kahadi cheferoce nabaru. 'amaanyocume kahadiyaanune ba`aayene `eyetaa ya'enaresune hulate 'ethefe 'aderegawe yemalakatwacawaale. 'alaaheme wadaajocune me`emanaanene 'agaza, yabalaayeme 'adaragaacawe; 'alaaheme ba'egazaawe yafalagawene yeradaale. ba'ezihe kesetate wesethe lalebonaa baalabeetoce mamakariyaa melekete 'alabate. yeheme me`emanaane baquthere yaanasu bihonume yadele baaletabeetoce 'enedamihonu kahadiyaaneme baquthere yabarakatu bihonume yashenefate baaletabeetoce 'enedahonu yaawequ zanede nawe.

'alaahe (subehhaanahu wata`aalaa) sawocene yefatenaacawe zanede yaqerebitwane hheyewate kejaalotocene (felaagotocene) seetocene, lejocene, kawareqe 'enaa kabere yatakamaacu bezu ganezabocene, yatabajaaju lamaageechaa yatazagaaju farasocene, kagemale, kaqanede kabete kabage 'enaa kafeyale yahonu 'enesesaate kamedere 'azemaraame 'enedaasegeethalaacawe yenaagaraale. yehe sawoce theqite gizeene tathaqemawebate kaziyaame yamiwagade yaqerebitwa heyewate mathaaqamiyaa nawe. 'anede 'amaanye lebu ba'enanyihe nagaroce linethalathale 'ayegabaaweme. 'alaaheme 'eresu zanede malekaame mamalashaa 'ala; 'eresume 'agedematu (sefaatu) samaayaatene 'enaa mederene hulu yamiyaathaqaalelawe janate nawe.

'alaahe (subehhaanahu wata`alaa) yazihece `aalame tzagaa yamiqwaarathe mahonune kathaqoma baxwaalaa kazihe yabalatha 'enaa zalaaqi lahona tzagaa sawoce 'enedisheqadaadamu maanaqaaqiyaa sisatheme 'enedihe yelaale::
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'enanyihe yanafese felaagotoce yabalatha yaamaara nagare lenegaraacehune balaacawe:: <>

'enanyaa yajanate sawoce geetaacawene simaatzanu <<geetaacene hoye! 'enyaa baaneta 'amanene, bamale'eketanyaahe laaye baawaradekaweme 'amanene, yaanetaneme mamariyaa takatalene; kawanejale laszaraanawe meheratene 'aderegelene ka'esaateme qethaate thabeqane>> yamilu naacawe.

'enaresume te`ezaazene bamafatzame yatakalakalane bamaraaqe 'enaa bafatanaame laaye taagaashoce, banegegeraacawe 'enaa batagebaaraacawe 'ewenatanyoce, la'alaaheme melu`e taazaazhoce, ganezabocaacaweneme ba'alaahe manegade lagaashoce, leboce kamithamadubaacawe nagaroce selamirequ 'enaa yamidaragawe du`aame malese lamaagenyate yaqaraba bamahonu balalite maabeqiyaa laayeme 'alaahene mehheratene thayaaqiwoce naacawe.

'alaahe baawaradawe 'aneqatzoce 'enaa bafetherata-`aalamu baaseganyaacawe fethuraaneme meleketoce karesu leelaa ba'ewenate yamimalake 'amelaake 'enedaleela masakara; malaa'eketeme 'enedihu masakaru; ya`eweqate baaletabeetoceme wada 'alaahe 'anedenate bamathaaraataacawe 'enaa bamaaberaaraataacaweme masakaru. kamimasakarelate nagare hulu yalaaqa yahonawene ya'alaahene 'anedenate 'enaa 'eresume bafetehe laaye yaqoma mahonune masakaru. 'eresume 'ashanaafi yaleelawe 'ashanaafi, nagarocene bamigabaacawe botaa yamiyaaseqamethe thebabanyaa, karesume baashaagare leelaa 'amelaake yaleela becanyaa 'amelaake nawe.

'alaahe zanede taqabaayenate yaalawe 'emenate selaame becaa nawe. yeheme 'eresune bamataazaze la'alaahe mawaadaqe, babaarenateme laresu 'ejene masethate, bamale'eketanyoce hulu maamane, yamale'eketanyoce madamedamiyaa bahonute muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame), 'alaaheme male'eketune baresaacawe 'enedafatzama maamane nawe. ka'eresu manegade weche 'alaahe 'ayeqabaleme. 'enanyaa matsehhafene katasathute sawoce 'ayehudoce 'enaa keresetiyaanoce yatalayaayu budenoce 'enaa cheferoce honawe yatakafaafalute `eweqatu wadanaresu bamamethaatu tekekelanyaa maaserajaa kadarasaacawe baxwaalaa nawe; yeheme karaasaacawe bataganya meqanyenate 'enaa lazihece `aalame theqeme baalaacawe gugute yatanasaa nawe. bamale`eketanyaawe laaye bawaradute ya'alaahe 'aneqatzoceme yamikede, 'alaahene lakaada 'enaa male`eketanyocuneme laasetabaabala sawe bagemegamaa bakule fathaane nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaresu baaneta laaye batawaradawe `ewenate zuriyaa bikaraakaruhe 'enedihe bamaalate malese sethaacawe:: <<'enee 'enaa 'eneeneme yatakatalute me`emanaane wada 'alaahe fitaacenene 'azuranaale; 'ejaaceneneme laresu sathetanaale.>> la'enanyaa matsehhafetene latasathute 'ayehudoce 'enaa keresetiyaanoce 'enedihume maayemaane lahonute thaa`otaaweyaaneme dagemo 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<'amelekotene la'alaahe yaatharaacehu, 'enee yezhee yamathaahuteneme takataaye yahonaacehu taazaazhoce (muselimoce) honaacehune?!>> 'eje kasathu ba'eregethe baqenu manegade laaye taguzawaale; nagare gene kaselaame birequ gene yatalaakebatene nagare la'enaresu maaderase 'eneji leelaa yalabeheme; feredaacaweme wada 'alaahe nawe; 'eresu baarocune tamalekaace 'enaa 'eyaanedaaneduneme baszaraawe szeraa yamimanadaa nawe.

'enanyaa 'alaahe wadanaresu yaawaradaacawene 'aneqatzoce yamikedu, nabiyaateneme yaala'ewenate babadale 'enaa wasane bamaalafe yamigadelu, kasawoceme makaakale bafetehe 'enaa bamalekaame yamiyaazezutene 'enedihume kakefu yamikalakelutene yamigadelu 'enanyaa gadaaye kahadiyaanene ba'asaamaami qethaate 'abeseraacawe.

'enanyaame sawoce szeraawocaacawe tabalaashetawaale; wedeqe honawaale. baqerebitume hona bamachiwe `aalame 'ayethaqamubaacaweme; yeheme 'alaahene bamakaadaacawe mekeneyaate nawe. lanaresume qethaatene yamiyaasewagedulaacawe radaatoce yalwacaweme.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'enanyaa taweraatene 'enaa nabiyenateheneme thaqwaami yahonaweneme yamaawaqe `edele yasathanaacawene 'ayehudaayaawiyaane huneetaa tamalakatekene?! batawazaagabubate nagare yedaanyaacawe zanede wada 'alaahe matsehhafe wada taweraate sigaabazunaa kaziyaame kaliqaawenetocaacawe 'enaa 'alaqocaacawe makaakale semeetocaacawene selamaayegatheme kamatsehhafu ferede yereqaalu; tsehhufune 'enedamikatalu 'eyamogatu baalubate huneetaa lanaresu tagabiwe nagare wadaresu kamafaarade 'anetzaare kasawoce hulu yafathanu mahonaacawe nabare.

yehe kahhaqe mazore 'enaa celaa maalate mekeneyaatu bamacharashaawe `aalame 'esaate yamiyaaganyane latawasanu qanaatoce becaa nawe kaziyaame janate gabiwoce nane bamaalate selamimogetu nawe. yehe karaasaacawe yafatharute yaweshate 'enaa kanetu gemete 'ataalalaacawenaa 'alaahene 'enaa haayemaanotune tadaafaru.

taadiyaa ba`elatu huneetaacawenaa tzatzataacawe 'enedeete yehone?! meneme therethaaree baleelawe yatenesaa'eewe `elate lameremaraa bamiqarebubate 'enaa 'eyaanedaanedwame nafese kamalekaame szeraawaa meneme saayeqanase wayeme wanejalwa laaye meneme saayechamare yaszeraawaane waagaa bamigabaate maleku bametesathebateme `elate huneetaacawe 'ejege yakafaa nawe yamihonawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahene 'eyaamogaseke 'enaa 'eyaalaaqeke 'enedihe bale:: <<'alaahe hoye! 'aneta baqerebitu 'enaa bamacharashaayetu `aalame yaalawe negeszenaa hulu baalabeete nahe. lafethuraaneheme lafalagekawe negeszenaane tesathaalahe; kafalagekaweme negeszenaane tenatheqaalahe; kanaresume yafalagekawene taaleqaalahe, yafalagekaweneme taawaaredaalahe. yehe hulu kaaneta bahona thebabe 'enaa fetehe nawe. malekaame hulu baaneta 'eje becaa nawe; 'anetame hulune nagare caaye nahe.

kacelotaahe magalachaawoceme makaakale lalitene baqane wesethe 'asegabetahe yaqanu gizee maraazamu; qaneneme balalite wesethe taasegabaanaa yalalitu gizee yerazemaale; hheyaaweneme kamute taawathaalahe lamesaaleeme kakahadi 'amaanyene, buqaayaaneme kaqenethaate maawethaatehe nawe. muteneme kahheyaawe taawathaalahe lamesaaleeme ka'amaanye kahadine, 'enequlaalene kadoro 'enedametaawathaawe `aayenate; yafalagekaweneme yaala hhisaabe 'enaa lekeete safi sisaayene tesathawaalahe.>>

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! kahadiyaanene yametewadwacawe 'enaa yameteradwacawe sihone kamu'eminoce baashaagare wadaajoce 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazu, yeheneneme yamiyaadarege sawe 'eresu baregethe ka'alaahe yatharaa hona, 'alaaheme karesu yatharaa (netzuhe) honwale. 'enaaneta banaresu selethaane sere honaacehu laraasaacehu bamasegaate lanaresu yaalaacehune thelaacaa balebe kamayaaze gaare banegegeraacehu betelasaalasu, batagebaareme gare betehonu cegere yalaweme. 'alaaheme karaasu yaasethanaqeqaacexwaale feruteme; wanejaleneme bamaszeraate laquthaawe 'ategaalathu. baferedume `elate baaroce hulu yamimalasute wada 'alaahe nawe. kaziyaame selaszeraawocaacawe yemanadaalu.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'enedihe bale:: <<kahadiyaanene mawadaajatene `aayenate, 'alaahe kakalakalaacehu nagare balebocaacehu betedabequ wayeneme geletze betaawathute 'alaahe yaaweqawaale 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayedabaqebateme; basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalane hulu yaaweqaale. 'alaaheme 'anedaace nagare yamaayesaanawe hulune nagare caaye nawe.>>

baferedu `elate nafese hulu malekaame yaszaraacewe yaaletaqanasa huno taaganyawaalace; kefu yaszaraacewene dagemo ba'eresu 'enaa bareswa mahakale rajeme zamane binore temanyaalace; yatamanyacewene nagare 'enedeetese taaganyaalace? 'alaaheme raasu yaasethanaqeqaacexwaale. wanejalene bamaszeraate laquthaawe 'ategaalathu. 'alaaheme labaarocu rexeruxe nawe; selaziheme yaasethanaqeqaacawaale, yaasefaraaraacawaaleme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'alaahene ba'ewenate yametewadu kahona 'enee yezhee yamathaahutene nagare bageletseme badebeqeme takatalu. yaane gizee ya'alaahene wedeetaa taaganyaalaacehu. wanejalocaacehuneme yemerelaacexwaale>> balaacawe. 'alaaheme kabaarocu wadaresu latamalasute mahhari la'enaresume 'azaanye nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale:: <<te`ezaazocene bamafatzamenaa yatakalakalutene bamaraaqe 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene taazazu. kaziheme kaafanagathu 'enaho 'alaahe 'eresune 'enaa male`eketanyaawene yamiqaawamu kahadiyaanene 'ayewademe.>>

'alaahe (subehanahuwata'alaa) 'adamene marathawe 'enaa malaa'eketene 'asagadalate; nuhhene marathawenaa yamale`eketanyoce majamariyaa 'adaragawe; yaberaahimene beetasaboce marathanaa nabiyenate bazereyaawe wesethe qari 'enedetehone 'adaraga; ya`imeraaneneme beetasaboce marathaacawe. 'enanyihene hulu marathaacawe, bazamanaacawe kaalu sawoceme balaache 'adaragaacawe.

'enanyihe kanabiyaate 'enaa 'enaresune katakatalute teweledocaacawe kafilaacawe kakafilaacawe yahonu zereyaawoce, ya'alaahene 'anedenate bamathabaqe, bamalekaame szeraawoce dagaage 'enaa sanaaye sena megebaarene yatawaraarasu naacawe. 'alaahe yabaarocune negegeroce sami tagebaaraacaweneme `aawaaqi nawe. selaziheme kanaresu yafalagawene yemarethaale; yaasebalethaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yamareyame 'enaate, ya`imeraane baalabeete <<geetaayee hoye! bahodee 'aregezheewe yaalahutene leje laaneta becaa yahona; 'anetane 'enaa beeta maqedasehene lamaagalegale kahulu nagare yanatzaa lihone zanede laaneta tasaalekunye. yehenene taqabalanye 'aneta lemanaayeene sami hasaabeeneme `aawaaqi nahe>> yaalacewene 'awesaa.

'eregezenaawaame batathanaaqaqanaa yatzanasacewene 'enedawaladace yaaragazacewe wanede 'enedihone tasefaa 'aderegaa selanabare cegerwane setenaagare <<geetaayee hoye! seete honaa waladekwaate>> 'alace. 'alaaheme yawaladacewene yaaweqaale. yatasathacewe seete leje baxaayeleme hona ba'afathaathare 'enedatamanyacewe wanede leje 'ayedalaceme. <<mareyame beyee sayemeeyaataalahu; 'ereswane 'enaa zereyaawaane ka'aneta 'ezenate katabaararawe shayethwane tanekolenaa seeraa baaneta 'enedetethabaqe 'aderegeeyaalahu.>>

'alaaheme selatwane bamalekaame 'aqabaabale taqabalawe; malekaame 'asetadaadageneme 'asaadagaate. kabaarocume yamalekaamocune sawoce leboce 'enediyaazenulaate 'adaraga. ya'enekebekaabeewaaneme xaalaafinate lazakariyaa sathawe. zakariyaame mareyame 'alaahene taamalekebate wada nabaracebate mekuraabe bagabaa quthere malekaame sisaayene yaaganye nabare - siyaanaageraateme <<mareyame hoye! yehe sisaaye kayate nawe? 'alaate setemaleselateme <<yehe sisaaye (megebe) ka'alaahe zanede nawe. 'alaaheme yafalagawene yaala lekeete sisaayene yesathawaale 'alace.

zakariyaa 'alaahe la`imeraane leje lamareyame kazihe bafite 'alaahe sawocene kamimagebebate manegade layate baala maleku sisaayene siyaaqarebelaate baaya gizee, meneme 'enekwaane `edemeewe yagafaa 'enaa baaletabeetume makaane kamahonwa gaare 'alaahe lejene 'enedisathawe kajala. <<geetaayee hoye! malekaame lejene sethanye 'enaho 'aneta lalamanahe sawe lemanaawene taqabaaye nahenaa>> 'ala.

'eresu 'alaahene bamiyaamalekebate botaa bamehheraabu wesethe 'eyasagada saala malaa'ekete tharute 'enediheme 'alute:: <<'alaahe yahheyaa tabelo yamitharaa leje 'enedametewalede yaabaserehale; magalachaaweme ka'alaahe yahonane qaale 'aragaagaache yahonane (ka'alaahe yayehune qaale yamiwaladawene `isaa yamareyamene leje nabiyenatene yamiyaaragaagethe sihone 'afathaatharu liyu huno ba 'alaahe qaale yamiwalade yehonaale.) 'enedihume kaleju magalachaa makaakaleme, ba`eweqate 'enaa ba'amelekote bahhezebocu laaye 'alaqaa yamihone, nafesune kasemeetwa yamikalakelaate 'enaa seetoceneme kamaqerabe yatathabaqa, lageetaawe 'amelekoteme raasune yaagalala 'enaa kadagaage ya'alaahe baaroce 'enaa nabiyeme bahona leje yaabaserehale.>>

zakariyaame malaa'ekete baabasarute gizee <<geetaayee hoye! 'enee kaarajahu, miseteeme yamaatewalede makaane kahonace baxwaalaa 'enedeete leje linoranye yecelaale!>> 'ala. 'alaaheme lanegegeru malese sisathawe:: <<ka'erejenaahe 'enaa kabaalabeetehe makaane mahone gaare laaneta yahheyaane masethate 'alaahe sawoce kamiyaawequte weche bata`aamere yamifalegawene 'enedamifatherawe `aayenate nawe. yeheme 'alaahe bathebabu 'enaa ba`eweqatu yamifalegawene nagare selamiyaadarege 'enaa hulune nagare caaye bamahonu nawe.>>

zakariyaame <<geetaayee hoye! misetee kanee lamaaregazwa leyu meleketene 'aderegelenye>> 'ala. 'alaaheme <<yamisetehe yamaaregazwa melekete 'aneta szosete qanaatene kanalalitaacawe bamelekete kaalehona basetaqare sawocene maanaagare 'alamacaalehe nawe; yeheme yamidaresebehe cegere saayenore nawe; bamahonume bathwate bamaataa 'alaahene babezaate 'awadesenaa 'awesaa.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! malaa'eketeme lamareyame 'enedihe yaalutene 'awesaa:: <<'aneci bametegalachebate yalaaqa sena megebaare mekeneyaate 'alaahe marethoshaale; kagedefatoceme 'anetzetoshaale; baaneci zamane kaalu seetoce hulu 'asebalethoshaale.
mareyame hoye! basegedate wesethe maqomene 'arezemi; lageetaasheme segaji; kadagaage baarocume makaakale ka'agonebaashocu gaare 'agonebeshi (kasagaajoce gaareme segaji).>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehe yazakariyaa 'enaa yamareyame zeenaa wadaaneta kamenaasetalaalefawe yaruqe zeenaa makaakale nawe; <<mareyamene maane yaasaadegaate?>> bamile 'enanyaa dagaage liqaawenete batakaraakarubate gizee 'aneta 'eziyaa 'alenabarekeme; `ethaa bamathaathaaleme tasemaamu 'enaa ba`ethaaweme zakariyaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) mareyamene lamaasaadage 'ashanaafi hona.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! malaa'eketeme lamareyame 'enedihe yaalutene 'asetaawese:: <<mareyame hoye! 'alaahe yaala 'abaate ba"hune" qaalu yamiwalade leje yaabasereshaale; ba 'alaahe feqaade wanede yehonaale yalejume seme masihhe yamareyame leje yebaalaale; baqerebitume bamacharashaaweme `aalame yatakabara yehonaale; wada 'alaaheme kaqarabute baalamwaloce makaakaleme nawe.>>

yamanaagare `edemeene saayedarese ba'aneqalebaa yataazala leje hono saala sawocene yaanaageraale, lathenekaaree yadarasa golemaasaa honome sawocene la'emenataacawe 'enaa hheyewataacawe yamibaju nagarocene yaanaageraacawaale; szeraacawe 'enaa negegeraacaweme kaamaaralaacawe ya'alaahe dagaage baaroce makaakaleme nawe.

mareyame yaala baale leje yenoreshaale mabaalwa garemwate:: <<'eneene bahegaawime yehune batakalakala manegade wanede saayeqarebanye 'enedeete leje linoranye yecelaale?!>> 'alace. male'akume 'enedihe sile malasalaate:: <<'alaahe kazihe bafite basawoce zanede baaletalamada maleku laaneci yaalabaale lejene 'enedamisatheshe hulu yafalagawene yefatheraale;maanenyaaweneme nagare 'enedihone sifalege "hune" yelawaale yehonaaleme.

matsehhafene banegegere 'enaa batagebaareme, sekeete 'enaa thebabene yaasetamerawaale. bamusaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) laaye yaawaradaweneme taweraatene baresume laaye lawadafite yamiyaawaredawene nejileneme yaasetamerawaale.

'enedihume wada seraa'eele lejoce yamilaakeme male'eketanyaa yaadaregawaale; 'enediheme yelaacawaale:: "'enee wadanaaneta yatalaaku ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa nanye; lanabiyenatee 'amalaakaace yahonu ta`aameraatene ba'eregethe yezhee matheceelaacexwaalahu; kaziheme makaakale kacheqaa 'adebolebuyee yabaraari wafene qeretze 'eszaraalaacehunaa 'esetenefaasene 'enafaabataalahu ba'alaaheme faqaade hheyaawe baraari yehonaale; `aayena sewere hono yatawaladaneme 'adenaalahu, tamalekaace `aayenaamaame yehonaale; lametzeneme 'asheraalahu balametze bashetaame yatayaazawe qodaawe theenanyaa yehonaale;yamotaneme 'eqasaqesaalahu, yehe hulu ba'alaahe feqaade nawe; baletaacehu yamathaacehutene 'enedihume babeetocaacehu yametaakamaacutene, yametedabequteneme 'enageraacexwaalahu. ba'enanyihe ba'alaahe faqaade kaalehona basetaqare sawe liyaadaregaacawe bamaayecelaacawe, 'enee bathaqasekulaacehu nagaroce wesethe 'enaaneta yametaamenu 'enaa maaragaagathe yametefalegu betehonu lanabiyenatee taalaaqe meleketoce nawe.

batachamaarime ka'enee bafite yatawaradaweneme taweraate 'aragaagaache sehone wada 'enaaneta mathecee'alahu; ba'enaaneta laaye lamaageraate 'enaa lamaaqelale sibaale kazihe bafite ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme tadarego kanabarawe nagare kafilune yatafaqada laadaregelaacehume chemere nawe yamathaahute. selamelaacehume nagare maaragaagachaanateme geletze yahonane maaserajaa 'ametheceelaacexwaalahu. yaazazawene bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru; theri yamaadaregelaacehuneme taazazunye.

yeheme 'alaahe ya'eneeme ya'enaanetame geetaa bamahonu nawe; litaazazute 'enaa lithanaqaqute yamigabaawe 'eresune nawe; 'eresune becaa 'ameleku. yeheme 'alaahene 'enedetaamalekunaa 'enedetetaazazuteme yaazazekwaacehu 'eresu thememate yaleelabate qathetanyaawe manegade nawe.>>

`isaame (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enaresu bakehedate laaye getere mahonaacawene 'enedaawaqame yaseraa'eele lejocene 'eyaanaagara 'enedihe 'ala:: <<wada 'alaahe bamaadaregawe theri yamiyaagezanye maanawe?>> katakataayocume merethocu <<'enyaa ya'alaahe dine radaatoce nane; ba'alaahe 'amenanaale; 'anetaneme takatelanaale; 'alaahene babecanyenate bamaamelake 'enaa 'eresuneme bamataazaze la'alaahe 'ejaacenene yasathane mahonaacenene masekerelene>> 'alu.

hhawaareyaatu 'enediheme 'alu:: <<geetaacene hoye! yaawaradekawene nejile 'amenanaale; `isaaneme (`alayehi 'asalaame)neme takatelanaale; bamahonume ba'aneta 'enaa bamale`eketanyoceheme kaamanute 'ewenatanyaa masekaariwoce 'aderegane.>>

'enaziyaame kaseraa'eele lejoce yakaadute `isaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) lamagedale 'aseeru; 'alaaheme 'aseerabaacawenaa bathememataacawe wesethe tawaacawe; ya`isaaneme 'amesaayaa maleke baleelaa sawe laaye 'anora ('asaasaataacawe). 'alaaheme kamiyaaseerute hulu balaachu nawe; 'alaaheme bathalaatocu laaye kamiyaaseerawe balaache seeraa yalamenaa.

batachamaarime 'alaahe `isaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enedihe belo siyaanaageraweme 'aseerabaacawe:: <<`isaa hoye! 'enee 'anetane yaalamote wada 'enee 'ewesedehalahu; 'akaaleheneme hona nafeseheneme wada 'enee kafe 'adaregehalahu; baanetame kakaadute kahadiyaanoceme rekusate 'atharaahalahu 'areqehalahume; ba'ewenatanyaaweme haayemaanote (bamuhhamade, salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) maamaneneme chamero yatakataluhene 'eseka `elata tenesaa'eeweme derase baaneta kakaadute bamaaserajaanaa baleqenaa yabalaaye 'adaregaacawaalahu; kaziyaame mamalashaacehu wada 'enee yehonaale; tewazaagabubate banabaraacehute nagare laaye bamahakalaacehu ba'ewenate 'efaredaalahu.

'enanyaane baaneta 'enaa 'aneta yezahe bamathaakxawe 'ewenate yakaadutene baqerebitu `aalame ba'esere, bagedeyaa 'enaa baweredate; bamachiwe `aalame dagemo ba'esaate beretu qethaatene 'eqathaacawaalahu; la'enaresume qethaatene yamikalaakalulaacawe radaatoce yalaacaweme.

'enanyaa baaneta 'enaa 'aneta yezahe yamathaakxawene 'ewenate yaamanutene 'enaa salaate, zakaahe, tzome, zemedenaanene maqathale 'enaa masale malekaame szeraawocene yaszarutene 'alaahe yaszeraacawe menedaa meneme saayeqanase yatamwalaa 'aderego yesathaacawaale.>> yehe `isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) nabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) kamalaakaacawe bafite takataayocune yaabasarabate zeenaa nawe. 'alaahe badaayocene 'ayewademe; kabadaleme hulu taalaaqu badale ba'alaahe laaye tagaari maaderagenaa male`eketanyocene maasetabaabale nawe.

yeheme sela `isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) zeenaa yamenetarekelehe baaneta latawaradawe male'ekete 'ewenatanyenate maaragaagachaa geletze meleketoce 'anedu nawe; lame'emanaaneme maasetaawashaa 'enaa kanetu nagare yamaayegathemawe geletzenaa yatzanaame nawe.

ya`isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'afathaathare 'alaahe zanede 'adamene yaala walaaje 'abaatenaa 'enaate ka'afare 'enedafatharawe `aayenate nawe. 'alaahe <<sawe hune>> 'alawe 'alaahe 'enedafalagaweme sawe hona; lamahonu 'adame yaala walaaje 'abaatenaa 'enaate mafatharune 'aragaagaachoce honawe saala ya`isaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) yaala 'abaate mafathare 'eneda maaserajaa bamaaqerabe 'amelaakenatune yemogetaalune?!!

`isaane (`alayehi wasalame) batamalakata baaneta laaye ka'alaahe zanede yatawaradawe 'ewenataa yehe nawe; kawalaawaaye tatharaathaariwoceme 'atehune; 'aneta zanede baalawe 'ewenataa letetzanaa yegabaahale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! `isaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) batamalakata tekekelanyaawe `eweqate wadaaneta kamathaa baxwaalaa ya'alaahe baariyaa 'ayedalame bamaalate yamikaraakaruhe kaalu 'enedihe balaacawe:: lejocaacenene 'enaa lejocaacehune, seetocaacenene 'enaa seetocaacehune, raasaacenene 'enaa raasaacehune huluneme 'enediganyu 'enegaabeze, hulaaceneme 'eneganye, kaziyaame 'alaahe ka'enyaame ka'enaanetame makaakale baweshataamocu laaye 'eregemaanene yaawarede zanede bamawaadaqe 'enelamenawe balaacawe.

'enaho yehe `isaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) batamalakata laaneta yanagarenehe zeenaa weshate 'enaa therethaaree yaleelabate 'ewenatanyaa zeenaa nawe. ka'alaahe basetaqare ba'ewenate limalake yamigabaawe 'amelaake yalame; 'eresume banegeszenaawe wesethe 'ashanaafi bamaasetadaadaru 'enaa bamafethareme thebabanyaa nawe.
'aneta kaamathaakxawe manegade yaafanagathu 'enaa yamaayekataluheme kahona, yaa kanaresu thefaate nawe. 'alaahe bamedere laaye 'athefiwocene 'ayewademe; baresume laaye yemanadaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'ayehudoce 'enaa lakeresetiyaanoce <<'enaaneta yamatsaahhefetu baaletabeetoce hoye! hulaaceneme bamizaane 'ekule wadamenehonebate fetehawi qaale nu! 'alaahene babecanyenate lenaamalekawe; meneme 'enekwaane darajaawe kafe yaala 'akaale bihoneme 'enekwaa baresu ba'alaahe laaye meneneme maaneneme laanaagaaraa; kafilaacene kafilaacenene ka'alaahe leelaa yamiyaamalekute 'enaa yamitaazazute geetaa 'aderegane laaneyeze nu!>> balaacawe. yaane gizee 'aneta theri kaadaragekelaacawe 'ewenatanyaa 'enaa fetehawi qaale yaafanagathu kahona <<'enyaa la'alaahe 'ejaacenene yasathane taazaazhoce; muselimoce mahonaacenene masekeru>> balwacawe.

'enaaneta yamatsehhafu baaletabeetoce hoye! yaberaahimene 'emenate batamalakata selamene tekaraakaraalaacehu? 'ayehudoce <<beraahime 'ayehude nabare>>; keresetiyaanoceme <<beraahime keresetiyaane nabare>> yelaalu. taweraate 'enaa nejileme karesu hhelefate baxwaalaa 'eneji 'enedaaletawaradu taaweqaalaacehu; yanegegeraacehune wedeqate ba'a`emerwacehu 'atedaresubatemene 'ategasatzumene?!!

'enaaneta yamatsehhafu baaletabeetoce hoye! yekxawe 'enaaneta ka'emenataacehu kaalaacehu `eweqate 'enaa ba'enaaneta laaye batawaradaweme gudaaye male'eketanyaawene takaraakaraacehu; beraahimene 'enaa 'emenatune batamalakata gene 'enaaneta `eweqate baleelaacehu 'enedihume bamatsehhafaacehume selaaletathaqasawe 'enaa nabiyaatocaacehu yezawete selaalemathute gudaaye selamene tekaraakaraalaacehu?! 'alaahe yanagarocene 'ewenataa yaaweqaale 'enaaneta gene 'ataawequme.

beraahime (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'ayehudaawime, keresetiyaaneme 'alenabarame, gene kawedeqe 'emenate wada 'ewenate yaazanabala, lageetaawe taazaazhe muselime nabare. ya`aarabe thaa`otaawiyaane ba'enaresu manegade laaye 'enedahona 'enedaminaagaruteme ba'alaahe yamiyaagaaraa thaa`otaawime 'alenabarame.

'eraasaacawene wada beraahime bamaasethagaate tagabi yahonute sawoce 'enanyaa beraahime bazamanu yatasathawene nagare yatakatalute, yeheme nabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'enaa 'enanyaame baresu yaamanute me`emanaane naacawe. 'alaaheme yame`emanaane wadaaje, 'agaazhaacawe 'enaa thabaaqiyaacaweme nawe.

'enanyaa ka'ayehude 'enaa kakeresetiyaane matsaahhefete yatasathute kafile cheferoce 'alaahe kamaraacehu 'ewenataa liyaathamemwacehu tamanyu. raasaacawene 'eneji leelaane 'ayaathamume; me'emanaanene lamaathemame mathaaraacawe thematene 'eneji 'ayechamerelaacaweme dagemo yaszeraawocaacawene maabeqiyaa madamedamiyaa 'ayaawequme, 'ayeradume.

'enaaneta yamatsehhafu baaletabeetoce 'ayehudoce 'enaa keresetiyaanoce hoye! lamahonu ba'enaaneta laaye ka'alaahe batawaradawenaa bawesethaacaweme yamuhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) nabiyenatene yamiyaaseradu 'aneqatzoce; matsaahhefetocaacehu yaaragaagathute 'ewenate 'enedahona raasaacehu masekaariwoce honaacehu 'eyaala ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce lamene tekedaalaacehu?!

'enaaneta yamatsehhafu baalabeetoce hoye! lamahonu bamatsehhafaacehu wesethe yawaradawene 'ewenate 'enaaneta zanede bamiganyawe hasate lamene tedabaaleqaalaacehu?! 'ewenatene kaweshate; qenune manegade kathamaamaawe layetaacehu yametaawequ honaacehu saalame bamatsehhafu wesethe yamuhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) nabiyenatene chamero yamiganyawene 'ewenatenaa qene manegade lamenese tedabeqaalaacehu?!

ka'ayehude liqaawenete wesenocu baqanu yamajamariyaa kefele bame'emanaane laaye bawaradawe qure'aane bageletse 'amanunaa wada 'amashaashu dagemo ba'eresu kaadu; yeheme 'enaaneta kaamanaacehu baxwaalaa setekedu 'enaresu ba'emenataacawe laaye therethaaree 'enedichaarebaacawenaa 'enaresu ka'enyaa batashaala ya'alaahene matsehhafe yamiyaawequ honawe saalu wada xwaalaa tamalasu bamaalate yeqalabasu zanede nawe yelwacawaale.

'enediheme 'alu:: <<'emenataacehune latakatala sawe 'eneji 'atemanu>>; 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<wada 'ewenate meraacaa maalate 'enaaneta yatasathaacehutene `aayenate belechaanaa terufaate leelaa sawe 'enedaayesathe 'aliyaame 'amaanyoce ba'enaresu laaye yawaradawene yaaragaagathaacehu 'enedahona geetaacehu zanede 'enedaayekaraakarwacehu bamasegaate yaalaacehubate maasetabaabalenaa kehedate saayehone ya'alaahe meraacaa nawe>>;balaacawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enediheme balaacawe:: <<terufaatenaa belechaa ba'alaahe 'eje nawe kabaarocu lafalagawe yesathaale; terufaatu ka'anedu hhezebe talayeto laleelaawe yamisathe 'ayedalame; 'alaaheme cerotaawe yasafaa 'enaa lamaane 'enedamigabaawe `aawaaqi nawe>>

kafethuraanoceme yafalagawene ba'ezenatu yelayaale; meraacaane, nabiyenateneme hona barekaataa sethotaawocene bamalagase malekaame yewelelataale. 'alaaheme wasane yaleelawe yataalaaqe cerotaa baaletabeete nawe.

kamatsehhafu baaletabeetoceme ba'emenate barekaataa ganezabe 'adaraa 'eresu zanede betaaseqamethe 'adaraawene bataamaanyenate yamimalese 'ala; leelocune dagemo ba'emenate theqite ganezabe 'adaraa betaaseqamethe larajeme gizee 'athebeqahe kaalethayaqekawe wayeneme bakese kaalehona basetaqare 'adaraawene yamaayemaleseleheme 'ala. yeheme yahonabate ba`aarabocenaa ganezabocaacawene bamabelaate laaye hathi'ate yalabeneme mekeneyaatume 'alaahe ganezabaacawene lanyaa faqedolenaalenaa yamile beleshu 'emenate selaalaacawe nawe. ba'alaahe laaye maqethafaacawene 'eyaawaqu yehenenu weshate yenaagaraalu.

nagaru 'enaresu 'enedamilute 'ayedalame; yelequnese hathi'ate 'alabaacawe. genaa ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyocu bamaamane la'alaahe yagabaawene qaale kidaane, lasawoceme yagabaawene qaale kidaane yamolaa 'alaahe yaazazawene bamafatzame 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe 'alaahene yatathanaqaqa 'alaahe thenequqocene yewadaale; yatakabara menedaaneme yesathaacawaale.

'enanyaa 'alaahe bamatsehhafu yaawaradawene 'enaa male'eketanyoceneme yalaakabatene 'enedikatalu 'adaraa yaalaacawene 'enaa la'alaahe yagabutene qaale kidaane lamamulaate yamaalutene mahalaa baqerebitu `aalame theqite theqeme yalawathu; kamacharashaawe `aalame menedaa 'anedaaceme dereshaa yalaacaweme; batenesaa'eeweme `elate 'alaahe bamiyaasedasete nagare 'ayaanaageraacaweme; ba'ezenateme 'ayemalakataacaweme; yelequnese 'asaamaami qethaate nawe yatazagaajalaacawe.

ka'ayehudoceme ka'alaahe kawaradawe taweraate yaalehonane nagare melaasocaacawene bamaaneshaafafe yamiyaanabebu 'alu; yeheme 'enaaneta yamiyaanabebute nagare kataweraate nawe belaacehu 'enedetaasebu nawe; 'eresu gene 'enaresu kafabarakute qethefate 'eneji kataweraate 'ayedalame. <<'enyaa yamenaanabawe katawaradawe taweraate nawe>> yelaalu; ka'alaahe yatawaradaweme 'ayedalame ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyocume laaye 'enedamiwaashu 'eyaawaqu ba'alaahe laaye weshatene yenaagaraalu.

la'anede sawe 'alaahe ka'eresu zanede yatawaradane matsehhafe kasathawe `eweqatene 'enaa maradaateneme kagathamawe nabiyeme kaadaragawe baxwaalaa sawocene ka'alaahe baashaagare la'enee baaroce hunulenye lile 'ayegabaaweme; yelequnese sawoce hoye! baawaqaacehute yameteszaru `aawaaqiwoce, lasawoce yawaradalaacaweneme matsehhafe sawocene 'asetamaariwoce, 'enaanetame baawaqaacehute 'enaa bataradaacehute sawocene yametaanetzu, gudaayaacaweneme 'asaamaariwoce hunu lilaacawe nawe yamigabaawe.

'enedihume malaa'eketene 'enaa nabiyaatene ka'alaahe leelaa yametegazwacawe 'amaalekete 'aderegaacehu 'enedeteyezu liyaazezaacehume 'ayegabaaweme; 'enaaneta la'alaahe 'ejaacehune yasathaacehu muselimoce kahonaacehu baxwaalaa bakehedate yaazezaacexwaalene?! (liyaazezaacehu 'ayegabaame).

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe nabiyaatene meneme 'enekwaa ba'enaaneta laaye yamaawaredawene matsehhafe, yamaasetameraacehuneme thebabe besathaacehunaa 'anedaacehume yatenyaaweneme `aayenate keberenaa darajaa bidareseme kaziyaame male`eketanyaayee muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'enaaneta zanede yaalawene matsehhafe 'enaa thebabe 'aragaagaache hono yamathaalaacehu 'enedahona baresu letaamenu, 'eresuneme bamakatale leteradute yegabaale yaalaacawenenaa nabiyaatoce hoye! yehenene 'amenaacehu yathabaqa qaale kidaaneeneme taqabelaacexwaalene?! yaalaacawene 'asetaawese. 'enaresume yehenenu 'aragaagethanaale belawe malese sathu; 'alaaheme 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<baraasaacehu 'enaa bahhezebocaacehu laaye masekeru 'eneeme ka'enaaneta gaare ba'enaaneta 'enaa bahhezebocaacehu laaye kamasekaariwocu nanye.>>
kazihe ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyoce kataragaagathawe yakabada qaale kidaane baxwaalaa bakehedate yamiqalabase kaala 'enanyaa ka'alaahe 'emenate 'enaa la'eresume kamataazaze yaafanagathu naacawe.

lamahonu 'enanyihe ka'alaahe 'emenate 'enaa mataazaze yaafanagathu sawoce 'alaahe labaarocu kamarathawe 'emenate (selaame) weche yaalane 'emenate yefalegaalune?! la'alaahe basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalu fethuraane hulu 'eneda me'emanaane bafeqaadanyenate 'eneda kahadiyaane bagedeetaa 'ejaacawene yasathu sihone kaziyaame baferedu `elate lagemegamaa 'enaa lamenedaa fethuraane hulu wadaresu yemalasaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'alaahe ba'amelaakenatu 'amanene; baazazaneme nagare hulu taazazene; ba'enyaame laaye baawaradawe malakotaawi male'ekete 'amanene; baberaahime, basemaa`ile, basehhaqe 'enaa bayaa`eqube laaye batawaradawe; kayaa`eqube lejoceme nabiyaatu batawaradalaacawe musaame, `isaame, nabiyaate hulu kageetaacawe batasathute matsaahhefete 'enaa 'aneqatzoce 'amenanaale; ba'anedu 'amenane baleelaawe bamakaade banabiyaate makaakaleme 'anenathaatheleme 'enyaame la'eresu la'alaahe taazaazhoce nane; balaacawe.

'alaaheme labaarocu kamarathawe 'emenate kaselaame weche 'emenatene yamifalege kaala; 'alaahe yaanene karesu 'ayeqabaleme, 'eresume bamacharashaawe `aalame nafesune la'esaate bamadaarage kakasaariwocu yehonaale.

ba'alaahe kaamanu 'enaa male'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yezo yamathaawe nagare 'ewenate mahonune kamasakaru baxwaalaa; laziheme tekekelanyaanate geletze yahonu maaserajaawoce kadaraswacawe baxwaalaa yakaadu hhezebocene 'alaahe 'enedeete la'emenate yemaraacawaale? 'alaahe 'enanyaane baqenaacaa faanetaa thematene yamarathutene badaaye hhezebocene la'emenate 'ayegathemaacaweme.

ya'enanyaa themematene yamarathu badaayoce menedaame; ya'alaahe, yamalaa'eketu 'enaa yasawoce hulu 'eregemaane ba'enaresu laaye maweradu nawe. ka'alaaheme 'ezenate yaraaqu 'enaa yatabaararu yehonaalu.
ka'esaate yamaayewathu ba'ereswa wesethe zawetaariwoce yehonaalu; kaqethaatwa 'ayeqaneselaacaweme `edelume selaabaqaa kathefaataacawe 'enedimalasu 'enaa cegeraacaweneme 'enedinaagaru 'ayethabaqume.
nagare gene kakehedataacawe 'enaa badalaacawe baxwaalaa yatamalasu, szeraacawene laasaamaru 'alaahe kabaarocu wadaresu latamalasute mahhari 'enaa 'azaanye nawe.

'enanyaa ka'emenataacawe baxwaalaa yakaadu, 'esekimotume derase bakehedataacawe yaqathalu, gizeewe selaalafabaacawe bathaa'era-mote gizee tawebataacawe taqabaayenatene 'ayaaganyeme; 'enanyaa wada 'alaahe yamiyaadaresawene qathetanyaa manegade yasaatu naacawe.

'enanyaa yakaadute 'enaa bakehedataacaweme laaye yamotute; 'anedaacawe ka'esaate natzaa yewathaa zanede mederene yamolaa wareqene beezaa biyaaqarebe taqabaayenatene 'ayaaganyeme; 'enanyaa 'asaamaami qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale; la'enaresume baferedu `elate qethaatene yamiyaasewagedulaacawe radaatoce yalaacaweme.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! ba'alaahe manegade kametewadute neberataacehu wachi 'eseketaadaregu derase yamalekaame sawocene darajaanaa malekaamenatene 'ataaganyume; kamalekaame nagare yametematzawetutene tenesheme yehune teleqe 'alaahe sela 'eresu `aawaaqi nawe. hasaabaacehune yaaweqaale, 'eyaanedaanedaacehuneme baszeraacehu yemanadaacexwaale.

seraa'eele (yaa`eqube) taweraate kamawaradu bafite baraasu laaye 'ereme yaadaragaacawe siqaru malekaame megeboce hulu laseraa'eele lejoce yatafaqadu nabaru; 'ayehudoce <<yehe makalekale bataweraate wesethe yatakaatata nawe>> 'enedamilute 'ayedalame. 'aneta nabiye hoye! <<bametenaagarute 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu taweraatene 'amethu 'enaa 'anebebu>> balaacawe; yaane gizee 'ejege yedanagethunaa malese 'ayaamathume; yehe nagare 'ayehudoce kataweraate yezate wesethe yaaletakaatatane bamachamare lamaqethafaacawe melekete nawe.

yaa`eqube (`alayehi 'asalaame) ka'alaahe zanede yatakalakala saayehonebate baraasu laaye 'ereme yaadaraga mahonu maaserajaawe kamathaanaa katagalatza baxwaalaa ba'alaahe laaye weshatene yamiqathefu; 'enanyaa 'ewenatene bamatawe raasaacawene yabadalu naacawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! <<'alaahe sela yaa`eqube (`alayehi 'asalaame) batanaagarawe 'enedihume bahegegaatume baawaradawe nagare hulu 'ewenatene tanaagara>> balaacawe; yaberaahimeneme manegade takatalu; 'eresu katasaasaatute ya'emenate manegadoce yaraaqa 'enaa wada selaame yatazanabala nabare; ba'alaahe laaye kamiyaagaaruteme thaa`otaawiyaane 'alenabarame.

sawoce bawesethu 'alaahene yaamalekubate zanede bamedere laaye lamajamariyaa gizee yataqamathawe yatanagabaawe beete yaa babakaa (makaa) yaalawe yatakabarawe ya'alaahe beete nawe; 'eresume ya'emenateme yahheyewateme theqeme yaalabate yatabaaraka nawe; la`aalamaateme bawesethu ya'emenate sere`aataacawene yamifatsemubate mamariyaa 'ala.

bazihe beete wesetheme leqenaawene 'enaa belechaawene thaqwaami yahonu geletze meleketoce 'alu; ya'emenate magalachaawoce yatsalote sere`aatoce, 'enedihume beraahime yakaa`ebaane gedegedaa genebaataa kafe lamaaderageme sile yaqomabate denegaaye yeganyebataale; 'eziyaa yagabaa sawe cegere yamaayedaresebate, ferehatu yatawagadalate tzathetanyaa yehonaale; 'alaaheme basawoce laaye wadaresu guzo maaderagene bacaala hulu laaye beetune yegobanyu zanede gedeetaa 'aderegobaacawaale; 'aqemu 'eyacaala yahhajene gedeetaanateneme yakaada; 'alaahe kazihe kahadi 'enaa ka`aalamaate hulu yatabeqaaqaa nawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! <<'enaaneta ka'ayehude 'enaa keresetiyaanoce matsaahhefete yatasathaacehu hoye! lamahonu taweraate 'enaa nejilene yezawe kamathute yamale`eketanyaawene 'ewenatanyenate thaqwaami yahonutene maaserajaawoce lamene tekedaalaacehu? 'alaaheme baszeraawocaacehu laaye masekaari nawe yaaweqaacexwaale, baziyaame laaye yemanadaacexwaale>>; balaacawe.

<<'enaaneta matsehhafe yatasathaacehu 'ayehudocenaa keresetiyaanoce hoye! kasawoce makaakale baresu yaamanutene sawoce ka'alaahe manegade lamene tekalakelaalaacehu? ya'alaahe manegade ka'ewenate wada weshate 'enedetaazanabele ya'emenate baaletabeetoceme kaqenaacaa wada themate 'enedimathu yametefalegu setehonu lamene sawocene ka'emenate taagedaalaacehu? yehe 'emenate, 'enaaneta zanede yaalawene 'aragaagaache 'enaa 'ewenate mahonune 'eyaawaqaacehu, 'eyamasakaraacehu? 'alaaheme 'eresune bamakaade kamanegadume sawocene bamakalekale yameteszarutene kamaawaqe yazanagaa 'ayedalame; selaszeraacehume yemanadaacexwaale; balaacawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu hoye! ka'ayehude 'enaa kakeresetiyaanoce yahonu kafile cheferoce yamilutene beteqabalu 'enaa batetaazazwacawe; bawesethaacawe baalawe meqanyenate 'enaa 'ewenatene masaate mekeneyaate 'enaanetane ka'emenate baxwaalaa wada kehedate yeqalabeswacexwaale.

lamahonu ba'alaahe kaamanaacehu 'enaa ba'emenataacehume laaye tetzanu zanede yamiradaacehu taalaaqe sababe ba'ejaacehu 'eyaala; qure'aane 'eyatanababalaacehu male'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yamiyaaberaarulaacehu honawe 'eyaalu 'enedeete tekedaalaacehu?! ya'alaahene matsehhafe 'enaa yamale'eketanyaaweneme falage 'athebeqo yayaaza ba'eregetheme meneme themate laleelabate qathetanyaa manegade 'alaahe sekeetaamaa 'aderegotaale.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalaacehu hoye! 'alaahe yaazazawene bamatagebare yakalakalawene bamaraaqe, tzagaawene bamaamasegane, 'eresu lifaraa 'enedamigabaawe ferute; 'enaanetame yehenene 'athebeqaacehu yaazu mote 'esekimathaa deraseme bazihu laaye tzenu.

me'emanaane hoye! qure'aanenaa yamale`eketanyaawene falage 'athebeqaacehu yaazu; laleyunate yamidaaregaacehune tagebaareme 'atefatsemu; kaselaame bafiteme thalaatoce honaacehu batheqaaqene gudaayoce tegadaadalu kanabaraacehu baxwaalaa baselaame lebaacehune 'anede bamaaderage 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye yawaalawene welataa 'asetaawesu; batzagaaweme yametetazaazanunaa yameteradaadu ya'emenate wanedemaamaacoce honaacehu. kazihe bafite bakehedataacehu mekeneyaate 'esaate lamagebaate 'afaafe laaye nabaraacehu; 'alaahe ba'eselemenaa mekeneyaate ka'esaate 'adaanaacehu la'emenatume sekeetaamaa 'adaragaacehu. yeheneneme 'enedaaberaaraalaacehume hulu wada qenu manegade 'enedetemarunaa baqathetanyaawe godaanaa laayeme tegwaazu zanede baqerebitume `aalame hona bamacharashaawe `aalame huneetaacehune yamiyaasaamerelaacehune nagare yaaberaaraalaacexwaale.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! ka'enaaneta makaakaleme 'alaahe wadamiwadawenaa hhelinaame therunatune wadamiqabalawe malekaame nagare yamithaaru, shari`aawe kakalakalawe 'enedihume hhelinaame mathefonatune kaamanabate kefu nagare yamikalakelu hhezeboce yenuru; ba'enanyihe baahheriyaate yamigalatzute 'enaresu bazihenyaaweme hona baziyaanyaawe `aalame batamwalaa sekeete wesethe naacawe.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! 'enedanaziyaa talayaayetawe siyaabaqu 'ahhezaabe 'enaa cheferoce 'enedahonute; ka'alaahe zanedeme geletze yahonu maaserajaawoce kamathaalaacaweme baxwaalaa bahaayemaanotaacawe laaye 'enedatawazaagabute yamatsehhafu baalabeetoce 'enedaatehonu; 'enanyaa bazihe baahheriye yatathaqasute ka'alaahe zanede taalaaqe qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale.

yeheme taalaaqe qethaate batenesaa'eewe baziyaane kadasetaanaa kafesehha yatanasaa ya'amaanyoce fite bamiyaashabareqebate 'enedihume kahhazanenaa katekaazee yatanasaa yakahadiyaane fite bamithaqurebatenaa bamikasemebate `elate qethaatu yeragaagathebaacawaale. bazihe taalaaqe `elateme 'enanyaa fitaacawe yathaqoranaa yakasamabaacawe sawoce batecetenaa waqasaa 'enedihe yebaalaalu:: <<lamahonu kaamanaacehunaa kaaragaagathaacehu baxwaalaa ba'alaahe becanyenate 'enaa ba'eresu laaye meneme tagaari laataadaregubate yagabaacehutene qaale kidaane kaadaacehune?! bakehedataacehume saabiyaa la'enaaneta yatazagaajalaacehune ya'alaahene qethaate qemasu.>>

'enanyaa fitocaacawe yaashabaraqute sawoce manoriyaacawe bamadasacaayetu ya'atekelete seferaa ba'alaahe 'ezenate wesethe naacawe; baziyaame bamaayelawathe 'enaa bamaayewagade tzagaa wesethe lazalaalame zawetaariwoce yehonaalu.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'enanyihe ya'alaahene qaale kidaanene 'enaa zaacaawene yaaqafu 'aneqatzocene bazeenaacawe 'ewenatene, baferedaacaweme fetehene yaazalu sihone baaneta laaye 'enaanabaacawaalane; 'alaaheme ka`aalamaate lamaaneme badalene 'ayefalegeme; maaneneme sawe baaleszaraawe 'ayeqathaaweme.

basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalu fetherataatene hulu; yamafethareme yamaazazeme negeszenaawe la'alaahe becaa nawe; yafethuraanu gudaayoce hulu mamalashaacawe wada 'alaahe nawe, 'enaame 'eyaanedaanedune 'enedamigabaawe yemanadaawaale.

'enaaneta yamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame)hhezeboce hoye! 'alaahe lasawoce kafatharaacawe hhezeboce hulu ba'emenataacehunaa baszeraacehu; lasawoceme kametaaseganyute theqeme 'anetzaare kahhezeboce hulu balaache honaacehu. shari`aawe yaaseradaawenaa malekaame hhelinaa yataqabalawene malekaame tagebaare taazezaalaacehu; shari`aawe yakalakalakalawenenaa malekaame hhelinaa yaaletaqabalawene mathefo nagareneme tekalakelaalaacehu; batagebaare bamiragaagathawenaa ba'eregethanyenateme ba'alaahe taamenaalaacehu. yehunenaa yamatsaahhefetu baalabeete yahonute 'ayehudaawiyaanenaa nasaaraawoce (keresetiyaanoce) bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) biyaamenu noro laduneyaacaweme lamacharashaawe `aalamaacaweme malekaame yehonelaacawe nabare. kamatsaahhefetu baalabeetoceme muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yezote yamathaawene male'ekete yamiyaamenu theqitoce sihonu 'abezaanyocu gene ka'alaahe haayemaanote 'enaa mamariyaa yaafanagathu naacawe.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! la'enaaneta yaalaacawe thelaacaa mene yagazafa bihoneme ba'emenataacehume, bahheyewataacehume bamelaasaacawe 'emenatene bamaaneqwaashashe 'enaa bamasaalaqe 'enaanetane kamaasecagare baashaagare 'ayegodwacehume. bigaadalwacehume kafitaacehu tashanefawe yeshashaalu; bafetzumeme ba'enaaneta laaye dele 'enediqadaaju 'ayedaragume.

'ayehudocene yateme botaa bihonu weredatenaa teneshenate yakababaacawenaa yamaayelaaqaqaacawe tadaregwaale; ka'alaahe bahona yasalaame qaale 'aliyaame kasawoce batasathaacawe yasalaame qaale kaalehona basetaqare huleeme basegaate nawaariwoce naacawe; ka'alaahe yahonane quthaa yezawe tamalasu; dehenate 'enaa kefu felaagote yamaayelaqaacawe hono tawasanabaacawe; yeheme ba'enaresu laaye yatawasanawe 'enaresu 'alaahene bamakaadaacawe, nabiyaatene yaalaagebaabe babadale bamagedalaacawe, ya'alaaheneme denebare bamatalaalafaacawe mekeneyaate nawe.

'alaahe ya'abezaanyocune yamatsehhafe baalabeetocene huneetaa kagalatza baxwaalaa; ba'ewenate laaye selaqomute theqitoce huneetaa bamaasemalekate 'enedihe 'ala::
yamatsehhafu baalabeetoce hulu bahuneetaacawe hulume 'anede `aayenate 'ayedalume; yelequnese ka'enasu makaakaleme matsehhafe yatasathaacawe sawoce hulu 'anede `aayenate 'ayedalume. ka'enaresu makaakale ba'alaahe 'emenate laaye yatzanu, 'alaahe baazazawe 'enaa bakalakalawe nagare 'enedamifalagawe qathe yaalu 'enaa la'alaaheme yamisagedu sihonu balalite sa`aatoce ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce yamiyaanabebu cheferoce 'alu. 'enanyihe cheferoce kanabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) malaake bafite yanabaru naacawe; ka'enaresu makaakale banabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) malaake gizee yadarasute salemawaale.

ba'alaahe 'enaa bamacharashaawe qane 'ewenatanyaa 'emenate yaamenaalu, bamalekaame nagare yaazezaalu, katathalaa 'enaa kakefu nagare yekalakelaalu; lamalekaame szeraawoce yesheqadaadamaalu; 'alaahene yamitaazazubatene `edele yethaqamaalu; 'enanyihe ba'enazihe baahheriyaate yatagalatzute 'enanyaa hasaabaacawe 'enaa szeraacawe kaamaaralaacawe ya'alaahe baaroce naacawe.

'enazihe sawoce tenesheme yehune barekaataa, malekaame nagare laszarute malekaame menedaawene 'ayekaadume ('ayaathuteme); menedaawe 'ayeqanasebaacaweme; 'alaaheme te`ezaazune yamifatzemutene 'enaa yakalakalawene yamirequtene thenequqocune `aawaaqi nawe; kaszeraawocaacaweme 'anedaace nagare 'ayedabaqebateme baresume laaye yemanadaacawaale.

'enanyaa ba'alaahe 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yakaadu sawoce ganezabocaacawe 'enaa lejocaacawe ka'alaahe 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayaadenwacaweme; 'ezenatune 'ayaamathulaacaweme, qethaatuneme 'ayemalesulaacaweme; 'enediyaaweme qethaatene 'enaa tzatzatene yechamerulaacawaale. 'enanyaa 'enaresu zawatere bawesethwa yaminoru ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe.

'enaziyaa kahadiyaane bazihece `aalame lamalekaame szeraa yamiyaawathute wache 'enaa sela'eresume yamithabequte menedaa mesaaleewe wanejalene bamaszeraate raasaacawene yabadalu sawoce yaalaacawene 'azemaraa kabaade wereche 'enedaaganyawe 'enaa 'enedaabalaashawe bithee nawe. 'enaresu ka'azemaraawe malekaame wetheetene thabeqawe saala wereche simataawe gene meneme lithaqamubate 'alecaalume. kehedateme 'enedazihu 'enaresu yamikajelutene yamalekaame szeraa menedaane yaabalaashebaacawaale. 'alaahe 'alebadalaacaweme yelequnese 'enaresu 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyocune bamakaade raasaacawene badalu.

'enaaneta 'alaahene yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalaacehu me'emanaane hoye! misetheraacehune 'enaa yagele gudaayaacehune galetzaacehu lamaasaawaqe kamu'eminoce weche yagele wadaajocene 'ateyaazu; 'enaresu (kahadiyaane) 'enaanetane lamagudaate 'enaa huneetaacehune lamaabalaashate kamafalage wada xwaalaa 'ayelume; thelaacaa 'enaa thalaatenataacawe ba'anedabataacawe ba'eregethe geletze yahona 'emenataacehune bamaaneqwaashashe 'anedaacehune kaleelaacehu gaare bamaathaalaate misetheraacehune bamaawethaate yaabalaashaalu; balebocaacawe yamidabequte thelaacaa dagemo kazihe yabalatha nawe. kageetaacehu wada 'enaaneta yatawaradawene yameteganazabu kahona laziheceme hona lamachiweme `aalame hheyewataacehu yamibajaacehune maaserajaa hulu ba'eregethe 'aberaaraanelaacehu.

yekxawe 'enaaneta me'emanaane 'enaresune (kahadi) yahonutene hhezeboce tewadwacawaalaacehu; lanaresume malekaamene temanyaalaacehu, 'enaresu gene 'ayewadwacehume sela'enaanetame malekaame 'ayemanyume 'enediyaaweme yethalwacexwaale. 'enaaneta bamatsaahhefetu hulu taamenaalaacehu; 'enaresu gene 'alaahe banabiyaacehu laaye baawaradawe matsehhafe 'ayaamenume, 'enaanetaneme siyaaganyu ba'anedabataacawe 'amenanaale yelaalu. 'enaresu labecaacawe sihonu dagemo ba'enaaneta laaye bahhazane 'enaa baquchete, 'enaaneta yaalaacehubatene 'anedenate, masemaamaate 'enaa yaselaamene yabalaayenate, 'enedihume yaalubateneme yabataacenate thaletawe thaatocaacawene yenakesaalu; 'aneta nabiye hoye! bahhazane 'enaa baqucheteme mutu balaacawe; 'alaahe leboce laaye yaalawene 'emenate 'enaa kehedate, malekaame 'enaa kefaate yaaweqaale.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! bathalaate laaye yabalaayenatene maqadaajate, baganezabe 'enaa balejoce chemaareene maagenyate `aayenate malekaame nagare sigathemaacehu, cheneqate 'enaa hhazane yesamaacawaale, yaasekafaacawaaleme; yathalaate yabalaayenate, yaganezabe 'enedihume yalejoceme 'ethote makaraa bigathemaacehu dagemo yedasataalu; ba'enaanetame yesaalaqaalu. ba'alaahe te`ezaaze laaye betetzanu 'enaa karesu quthaa betethanaqaqu ya'enaresu seeraa 'enaa maasecagare 'ayegodaacehume; 'alaahe yamiyaaseerutene seeraa ba`eweqatu kabaabi nawe; 'awaaredome yemalesaacawaale.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'agaariyaanene 'uhhude laaye lamawaagaate kamadinaa bathwatu kefela gizee setewathaanaa 'enedihume 'eyaanedaanedune 'amaanye yawegiyaa botaa botaacawene bamaaseyaaze la'eyaanedaanedu maarafiyaawene 'enedaaberaaraahelaacawe yanabarawene 'asetaawese; 'alaaheme negegeraacehune sami; szeraacehuneme `aawaaqi nawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! ba'uhhude `elate ba'enanyaa hulate cheferoce bani salimaahe 'enaa bani hhaarisahe mene 'enedatakasata 'awesaa; manaafeqaanu kathore meedaa wada madinaa batamalasu gizee 'enaresume dekaame tasametwacawe mamalasene siyaasebu, 'alaaheme 'enaresune bagedeyaa laaye bamaatzenaate 'enaa kaasabute nagare zaware bamaaderage 'enaresune 'agaazhe nawe; me'emanaaneme bahuneetaacawe hulu ba'alaahe laaye becaa yemaku.

babadere thorenate 'enaaneta baquthereme bazegejeteme yaanasaacehu setehonu 'alaahe baregethe bakahadiyaane laaye yabalaaye 'adaragaacehu; banaaneta laaye yawaalawene tzagaame taamasagenu zanede 'alaahene feru.

'aneta nabiye hoye! babadere `elate me'emanaane lathaa`otaawiyaane tachamaari xaayele 'eyamathaalaacawe nawe yamilawene kasamu baxwaalaa; 'enaresune lamaaragaagaate <<geetaacehu 'alaahe 'enaanetane bategelaacehu liyaabaratwacehu 'enaa liyaagezwacehu zanede kasamaaye bamiwaredu szosete shihe malaa'ekete 'enaanetane maredaatu 'ayebaqaacehumene?!>> baaleke gizee 'asetaawese.

'awone! yehe yebaqaacexwaale! la'enaanetame ka'alaahe bakule leelaa yabeseraate zeenaa 'alalaacehu; bategelu laaye betetaagasu, 'alaaheneme betefaru, thalaatocaacehuneme lamaredaate radaate xaayeloce bafethenate wada 'enaaneta 'eyagasagasu bimathu; geetaacehu raasaacawenenaa farasocaacawene baleyu malayaa yatalayu bahonu 'amesete shi malaa'eketoce yeradaacexwaale.

'alaaheme yehenene 'egazaa, bamalaa'ekete maredaatene, lebocaacehu yeragaagubate zanede 'asedasaace zeenaa 'eneji 'alaadaragaweme. 'alabalaziyaa gene tekekelanyaawe dele ba'enanyihe kalaaye bamitaayu sababoce becaa 'ayeragaagatheme; dele bahulu nagare laaye 'ashanaafi, bamaasetanaabarume thebabanyaa kahonawe 'alaahe zanede becaa nawe.

yehene babadere thorenate la'enaaneta yataragaagathawene dele 'alaahe 'enanyaa yakaadu sawocene liyaathafaabate leeloce cheferoceneme (manaafeqaanene) liyaawaaredebate bashenefataacaweme liyaaseqochaacawe; bakeserate 'enaa baweredateme 'aferawe 'enedimalasu falego nawe.

nabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) ka'uhhude kesetate baxwaalaa thaa`otaawiyaane mariwocene 'alaahe 'enediyaathafaacawe silamenute 'alaahe 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<'aneta ba'enaresu gudaaye laaye 'anedaace wesaanee yalaheme; wesaaneewe hulu ya'alaahe nawe. 'alaahe bamakaakalaacehu 'esekifarede wayeme latzatzate 'abeqetwacawe 'esekisalemu 'aliyaame bakehedataacawe laaye qathelawe 'esekiqathaacawe; badalanyoce bamahonaacaweme 'esaate yamigabaacawe 'enedahona 'esekilaye derase taagase.>>

basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalawene hulu mafethareme maasetanaabareme ya'alaahe nawe. kabaarocu lafalagawe ba'ezenatu hathi'atocene yemeraale bafetehawinatume yafalagawene yeqathaale. 'alaaheme kabaarocu wadaresu latamalasute mahhari, la'enaresume 'azaanye nawe.

ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu me'emanaane hoye! 'enanyaa maayemaanoce 'enedamiyaadaregute 'enaaneta kaabadaraacehute waanaa ganezabaacehu weche yahonawene 'ethefe derebe walade kamawesade taaqabu; baqerebitume `aalame hona bamacharashaawe `aalame 'ezenatene tegonaatsafu zanedeme yaazazawene bamatagebare 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru.
malekaame bamaszeraate 'enaa 'eremocene bamaraaqe 'alaahe 'eresune lakaadu sawoce kaazagaajawe qethaatenaa ka'enaaneta makaakale makalaakayaane 'aderegu.
baqerebitume `aalame hona bamacharashaawe `aalame 'ezenatene tegonaatzafu zanede te`ezaazaatene bamatagebare 'enaa kelekalaawocene bamaraaqe 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene taazazu.

ka'alaahe yahonacene teleqe meheratene 'enedihume 'alaahe kabaarocu makaakale lathenequqocu wadaazagaajaate 'agedematwa samaayaatene 'enaa mederene yamiyaakaatete wadahonacewe ya'atekelete seferaa (janate) malekaame nagarocene bamaszeraate 'enaa wada 'alaahe bamaqaarabe tasheqadaadamu.

thenequqocu 'enanyaa ganezabocaacawene batadelaa gizee 'enedihume bacheneqeme gizee yamimatzawetu mabaqale sicelume kaquthaacawe takalekaayoce (quchetaacawene yamiwethu) yabadalaacaweneme yeqere yamilu naacawe. 'alaaheme ba'enanyihe sanaaye sena megebaaroce tagalaache yahonutene 'asaamaariwoce yewadaale.

'enanyaa teleqe wanejale baszaru gizee 'aliyaame kateleqe wanejale bataace teneneshe wanejalocene bamaszeraate raasaacawene bamabadale malekaame `edelene baathu gizee 'alaahene yaawasaalu; 'eresume wanejalanyocene yaasefaraaraabatene, lathenequqocume yagabaawene qaale kidaane yaasetaawesaalu; bamatzatzateme geetaacawe wanejalaacawene 'enedidabeqelaacawe baresume 'enedaayeqathaacawe yelamenutaale; ka'alaahe basetaqareme wanejalene yamimere yalame; 'enaresume wanejalene 'eyaszaru mahonaacawene 'eyaawaqu bawanejalaacawe laaye 'ayezawaterume; 'alaaheme wanejalene hulu yemeraale.

'enanyaame ba'enanyihe yatamasaganu baahheriyaate 'enaa yalaaqu sena megebaaroce yamigalatzute menedaacawe 'alaahe hathi'ataacawene mashafanu, meheratene maaderagu, 'enaresuneme yeqere maalatu nawe. la'enaresume bamachiwe `aalame dagemo kahhenetzaawocwa sere jeratoce yamifasubaate ya'atekelete seferaa tazagaajetolaacawaale. 'alaaheneme bamataazaze yamiszaru sawoce menedaa menenyaa 'amaara.

mu'eminoce ba'uhhude thorenate batalayaayu makaraawoce katafatanu baxwaalaa 'alaahe 'eyaatzenaanaacawe 'enedihe 'ala:: <<ka'enaaneta bafite ba'eregethe 'alaahe kahadiyaanene yaathafaabate; katafatanume baxwaalaa yamacharashaawene yaamaara maabeqiyaane lamu'eminoce yamaaderage 'amelaakaawi hege ba'eregethe 'alefwale. bamedere laaye yatagwaazunaa 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyocune yaasetabaabalu sawoce mamalashaacawe 'enaa maabeqiyaacawe 'enedeete 'enedanabara 'asetawaaye setehonu tamalekatu. manoriyaawocaacawe baado hunawaale; negeszenaacaweme tawagedwale.>>

yehe yatakabara qure'aane la'ewenate maaberaariyaa, sawocene hulu kawedeqe nagare maasethaneqaqiyaa, wada qenaacaa mamariyaa, thenequqocene magasachaa nawe. yeheme bawesethu baalawe mamariyaa 'enaa qenaacaa tathaqaamiwocu 'alaahene fariwocu 'enaa thenequqocu selahonu nawe.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! waneeyaacehu 'ayemute! ba'uhhude zamacaa `elate bagathamaacehume nagare 'atezanu; yeheme la'enaaneta tagabi 'ayedalame; 'enaaneta ba'emenataacehu, ba'alaaheme 'eredaataa, 'egazaaweneme bamakajale ba'alaahe 'enaa lathenequqe baarocume bagabaawe qaale kidaane yametaamenu kahona yabalaayocu 'enaaneta naacehu.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! ba'uhhude zamacaa `elate maqusale 'enaa magadale bigathemaacehu 'enaanetane yagathamaacehu 'ayenate maqusale 'enaa magadaleme kahadiyaanene gathemwacawaale. 'alaahe qanaatene 'anedee badele leelaa gizee bashenefate ba'amaanye 'enaa bakahadiyaane makaakale yaalawaawethaacawaale. yeheme yathalaqa thebabe nawe. 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyocene kakahadiyaane lilayebate, yafalagaweneme bamanegadu bamasawaate liyaakaberawe yaaqayaayerawaale. ba'eresu manegade tegelene bamatawe raasaacawene yamibadelu sawoceneme 'alaahe 'ayewadaacaweme.

ka'enanyihe thebaboce makaakale 'alaahe me'emanaanene kahathi'aataacawe liyaatharaacawe, wesethaacaweneme ka'asemasaayoce lamaatzedaate, kahadiyaanene liyaathafaacawe 'enaa liyaabesaacawe yehenene yaadaregaale.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! ba'alaahe manegade ba'ewenate yamitaagalute sawoce 'enedihume badarasabaacawe cegere laaye taagaashoce talayetawe yamitaawaqubate fatanaa saayemathaabaacehu janate letegabu 'asabaacehune?

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! ba'alaahe manegade masewaa`ete mahonene bamafalage kahadiyaanene lamagethame setemanyu nabare; kafile wanedemocaacehu babadere zamacaa `elate 'enedagathamaacawe yamotene manese'ee 'enaa chenequneme kamaayataacehu bafite motene setemanyu nabare; yekxawe yatamanyaacehutene ba'uhhude `elate ba`aayenaacehu batachabaache tamalakataacehute.

ba'uhhude zamacaa `elate basawoce makaakale nabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) tagadalu yamile zeenaa batasaraacha gizee kafile sawoce ba'alaahe manegade bazihe sababe kamataagale siyaafagafegu 'enaresune lamaweqase 'alaahe 'enedihe 'ala -
muhhamademe kazihe bafite bamoteme hona bamagadale laalafute ya'alaahe male'eketanyoce `aayenate nawe; lamahonu bimote 'aliyaame bigadale ka'emenataacehu teqalabasaalaacehune, tegeluneme 'eregefe 'aderegaacehu tetawetaalaacehune?! ka'enaaneta ka'emenatu yataqalabasa 'alaahene 'anedaaceneme nagare 'ayegodaaweme; 'alaahe beretu 'enaa 'ashanaafi nawe; ka'emenatu yataqalabasame baziheceme bamachiweme `aalame nafesune lakisaaraa bamadaarage raasune 'eneji leelaane 'ayegodaame. 'alaaheme ba'emenatu laaye bamatzenaate 'enaa ba'eresume manegade bamataagale 'eresune yamiyaamasagenutene malekaame menedaane yemanadaacawaale.

maanenyaawaame nafese ba'alaahe wesaanee 'alaahe yatzaafalaatenaa yawasanalaatene yagizee gadabe meneme saayechamare 'enaa saayeqanase saataamolaa 'atemoteme. baszeraaweme yaqerebitune `aalame menedaane yamifalege laresu yatawasanalatene 'enesathawaalane; bamachiwe `aalameme dereshaa yalaweme. baszeraaweme 'alaahe zanede yaalawene yamachiwene `aalame menedaane yamifalege 'enesathawaalane; geetaacawene 'amasegaanyocene yalaaqa menedaane 'enemanadaacawaalane.

ka'alaahe nabiyaate wesethe takataayocu yahonu cheferoce ba'alaahe manegade laaye badarasabaacawe gedeyaa 'enaa quselate mekeneyaate yaalefaru, thalaateneme kamawaagaate yaaledakamu 'enaa lanaresume yaaletawaaradu; yelequneme bategele meedaa yataagasu 'enaa yatzanu 'aberaweteme yatawaagu senete 'enaa senete nabiyaate 'alu; 'alaaheme bamanegadu laaye bamigathemaacawe cheneqe 'enaa cegere laaye taagaashe yahonutene yewadaale.

'enedaziyaa yaala makaraa 'enaa cheneqeme badarasabaacawe gizee 'enanyaa taagaashoce negegeraacaweme - <<geetaacene hoye! wanejalocaacenene maarane, banagaraacene denebarene maalafaacenene 'elafelene, thalaataaceneneme bafelemiyaa seneganaanye 'egerocaacenene 'atzenaalene, bakahadiyaane hhezeboce laayeme delene 'aqadaajane>>; yamile nawe.

'alaaheme 'enaresune ladele bamaabeqaate 'enaa bamaasemacate yaqerebitune `aalame menedaane; ka'enaresume bamawedade 'enedihume bajanate yazala`aalame manoriyaa bamacare yamachiwene `aalame yaamaara menedaane sathaacawe; 'amelekotaacawe 'enaa tagebaaraacawene batheraate la'eresu becaa yamiyaadaregutene 'alaahe yewadaacawaale.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male`eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu hoye! ka'ayehude, kakeresetiyaanoce 'enaa kathaa`otaawiyaane makaakale 'enanyaa yakaadutene sawoce 'enaresu yamiyaazwacehune thememate betekatalwacawe ka'emenataacehu baxwaalaa wadanabaraacehubate kehedate yemaleswacexwaale; baziheme mekeneyaate baqerebitume bamachiweme `aalame yakasaraacehu honaacehu temalasalaacehu.

'enanyaa kahadiyaanene betetaazazwacawe 'ayeradwacehume; bathalaatocaacehu laaye yamiradaacehu wadaajaacehu 'alaahe nawe; 'eresuneme taazazute 'alaahe karajiwoce hulu balaache nawe; ka'eresu baxwaalaa maaneme 'ayaasefalegaacehume.

ba'enanyaame bakahadiyaane leboce wesethe 'enaanetane mawaagaate 'esekamaayecelu derase beretu ferehatene 'enelaqebaacawaalane; yeheme 'enaresu ba'alaahe laaye selanaresu ya'amelaakenate maaserajaane yaalaawaradabatene badama nafesaacawe yaamalakwaacawene 'amaalekete tagaari bamaaderagaacawe nawe. 'enaresume bamacharashaawe `aalame yamimalasubate maarafiyaacawe 'esaate nawe. yabadaayoce maarafiyaa yahonawe 'esaate menenyaa kafaa.

ba'uhhude zamacaa laaye thalaatocaacehune ba'alaahe faqaade 'ejege 'eyachafachafaacexwaacawe 'eyaala 'alaahe dele 'enedameteqadaaju qaale yagabaalaacehune fatsemolaacehu nabare. genaa ya'alaahe male`eketanyaa 'enedetetzanu baazazaacehu botaa laaye matzenaate 'aqetwacehu, 'aqeme 'athetaacehu ferehate wararaacehu; 'enaame botaacene laaye maqoyate 'alabene 'aliyaame thelane mereko wada masabesabu maheede 'alabene bamaalate tawazaagabaacehu; bameneme maleku bihone yaalaacehubatene botaa fetzume maleqaqe yalabaacehume yamilawene yamale`eketanyaawene te`ezaaze thaasaacehu. yehe hulu yahonawe 'alaahe yametewadutene bathalaate laaye dele maqadaajatene kaasaayaacehu baxwaalaa nawe. kafilocaacehu yaduneyaane mereko falaagiwoce sihonu 'enaresume yatamadabubatene botaa laqawe yaheedute naacawe. kafilocaacehu dagemo yamacharashaawene `aalame menedaa yamifalegu naacawe; 'enazihu yamale'eketanyaawene te'ezaaze bamaakebare botaacawene yaalelaqaqute naacawe. 'enaanetane kanaresu galale 'adaragaacehu 'enaa 'enaresune ba'enaaneta laaye shoma; ka'enaaneta makaakale nafesu yadakamacewene 'egeru yatanesharaatatacewene 'enaa bacegere laaye ba'aqwaamu yatzanaawene lamalayate lifatenaacehu zanede yehenene 'adaraga. yamale'eketanyaawene te'ezaaze bamathaase yafatzamaacehutene wanejale 'alaahe yeqere 'alaacehu; wada 'emenate manegade bamameraatu, thefaataacawene yeqere bamaalatu, bamakaraacehu laaye menedaane bamasethatu 'alaahe bame'emanaane laaye yataalaaqe terufaate baaletabeete nawe.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! ba'uhhude zamacaa waqete yamale'eketanyaawene te'ezaaze bamathaasaacehu saabiyaa shenefate gathemwacehu maaneme maaneneme saayethabeqe basheshete kaseferaawe reqaacehu baheedaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawe ba'enaaneta 'enaa ba'agaariwoce mahakale honawe kaxwaalaacehu <<ya'alaahe baaroce hoye! nu wadanee; ya'alaahe baaroce hoye! nu wadanee>> 'eyaalu 'eyatathaaru thelaacehu bamaheedaacehu 'alaahe baamalathaacehu delenaa mereko wesethaacehune 'enediyaamemaacehu 'enaa 'enedetechanaanaqu; nabiyu tagadalu yamilawe waree bamanazaatu bamajamariyaawe yawesethe hemamenaa cheneqate leelaa bamachamare waagaacehune sathaacehu. 'alaahe yehenene hulu yaawaradabaacehu nabiyu 'enedaaletagadalu 'aweqaacehu yahulume nagare hemame, seqaaye 'enaa cegere qalelolaacehu selaamalathaacehu deleme hona mereko hhazane 'enedaayegabaacehu nawe. 'alaahe yameteszarutene wesethe `aawaaqi yalebaacehu huneetaame hona ya'akaale tagebaaraacehu yamaayesawarebate geetaa nawe.

qathelome kaseqaayenaa kacheneqatu baxwaalaame maragaagaatenaa matamaamanene 'awaradalaacehu; yeheme ka'enaaneta yatawasanute batalayeme ya'alaahene qaale kidaane 'eregethe yaalute balebaacawe wesethe baalaacawe maragaagaatenaa tzathetaa yatanasaa maaneqalaafaate jamaru; leeloce dagemo tzathetaame hona maaneqalaafaate 'alaaganyaacaweme; 'enaresume sela raasaacawe 'eneji yamaayaasechaneqaacawe manaafeqaane naacawe; bacheneqatenaa basegaate wesethe naacawe; bamahonume 'enanyaa la'alaahe tagabiwene kebere 'enedamaayesathute yadenequrenaawe zamane sawoce `aayenate therethaaree; 'alaahe lamale`eketanyaawe dele 'ayesatheme 'enedihume baariyaawocune 'ayeradaame yamile kefu therethaaree sela 'alaahe yetharatheraalu. 'enazihu manaafeqaane sela 'alaahe baalamaawaqaacaweme 'enedihe yelaalu:: <<'enyaa wada thore meedaa lamawethaate 'aliyaame laalamawethaate hasaabaacene taqabaayenatene 'alaaganyame; kanagaru meneme yalaneme hasaabaacene taqabaayenatene biyaaganye noro baalewathaane nabare.>> 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bamaalate malese sethaacawe:: <<nagaru hulu ya'alaahe nawe; 'eresu yafalagawene yewasenaale; yafalagawene yefaredaale; wada zamacaawe mawethaataacehune yawasanawe 'eresu nawe.>> 'enanyihe manaafeqaane laaneta bageletze kamiyaanetzabaarequte yatalaya 'enaa yabaasa balebaacawe wesethe kefu 'amalakaakatenaa therethaaree dabeqawaale; 'enediheme yelaalu:: <<'enyaa wada zamacaawe selamawethaate 'enaa 'alamawethaate hasaabaacene taqabaayenatene biyaaganye noro 'ezihe baaletagadalene nabare.>> 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bamaalateme malese sethaacawe:: <<meneme kamote 'enaa kagedeyaa seferaa reqaacehu babeetocaacehu beteqamathu 'enekwaa kanaaneta makaakale 'alaahe mote yawasanabaacawe sawoce wada magadayaa seferaacawe yewathu nabare. 'alaahe yehenene yawasanawe balebaacehu wesethe yaalawene `aalaamaanaa hasaabe lifatene; bawesethu yaalawene 'emenate wayeme 'asemasaayenate layeto lamaasaayate nawe; 'alaahe babaarocu lebe wesethe yaalawene `aawaaqi bamahonu meneme nagare 'ayesawarebateme.>>

'enaaneta yanabiyu baaledaraboce hoye! 'enanyaa ba'uhhude `elate yathaa`otaawiyaane cheferoce kame'emanaane cheferoce bataganaanyubate `elate wada xwaalaa yaafagafagute wada sehetate yawasadaacawe yaanesharaatataacawe shayethwane nawe;yeheme yahonawe 'enaresu baszarute wanejale mekeneyaate nabare; 'alaaheme yeqere 'alaacawe; ba'ezenatu 'enaa baterufaatu mekeneyaateme bawanejalaacawe 'aleqathaacaweme. 'alaahe tatzatzetawe wadaresu latamalasute mahhari; laqethaateme yamaayaathaadefe taagaashe geetaa nawe.

'enaaneta 'alaahene yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalaacehu me'emanaane hoye! yaqerebe zamadocaacawe sisaaye felagaa wayeme zamaace honawe bimotu 'aliyaame bigadalu ka'enyaa gaare bihonu 'enaa baayeheedu wayeme baayezametu noro 'ayemotume 'ayegadalumeme nabare 'enedamilute kahadi manaafeqaane 'enedaatehonu. 'alaahe yehenene 'emenate balebaacawe wesethe yaadaragabaacawe bawesethaacawe tzatzatenaa hhazane 'enedichamerebaacawe falego nawe. bafaqaadu heyaawe 'aderaagi gadaayeme 'alaahe becaa nawe; kategele maqerate wesaaneewene 'ayaazagayaweme; wada tegeleme mawethaate 'ayaafathenaweme; 'alaahe yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace; kaszeraacehu meneme 'ayesawarebateme; 'enedayaszeraacehu yemanadaacexwaale.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! ba'alaahe manegade laaye betegadalu 'aliyaame betemotu 'alaahe taalaaqe meheratene yemeraacexwaale; ba'ezenatume yaazenelaacexwaale; yeheme kazihece heyewate 'enedihume baduneyaa wesethe yamiganyu sawoce kamisabasebute thafi tzagaa fetsume yatashaala nawe.
bayatenyaaweme maleku betemotu waye betegadalu hulaacehume wada 'alaahe tamalaashoce naacehu; baszeraawocaacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

'aneta nabiye hoye! ka'alaahe bahona taalaaqe tzagaame kabaaledarabocehe gaare yaalahe sena megebaare gare hona; lazabekelaacawe; banegegerehe 'enaa batagebaareheme thanekaaraa, leba-daraqe betehone noro batabatanu 'enaa kaaneta baraaqu nabare. yaanetane mabete biyaagodelu 'elafaacawe; meherateneme thayeqelaacawe; maamaakare bamiyaasefalegawe gudaaye laayeme 'amaakeraacawe; hasaabaacaweneme semaa. kamekekereme baxwaalaa banagaru laaye kaqoratheke ba'alaahe laaye tamakaa 'enaa qathelebate; 'alaaheme ba'eresu laaye yamimakutene yewadaale; lasekeete yaabaqaacawaale, yaagezaacawaaleme.

'alaahe ba'egazaawe 'enaa ba'eredaataawe biradaacehu bamedere yaalute hulu bisabasabu 'enekwaa 'enaanetane yamiyaashanefe 'ayenoreme. 'enaanetane maredaate bitawe 'enaa wadaraasaacehu biyaasethagaacehu ka'eresu leelaa 'enaanetane liradaa yamicele yalame. dele hulu ba'eresu 'eje nawe; 'amaanyoceme bamaaneme laaye saayehone ba'alaahe laaye becaa yemaku.

'alaahe kawasanalate weche maaneme nabiye kamereko dabeqo liwasede 'ayefaqadelateme; kanaaneta makaakale yamereko ganezabene dabeqo yamiwasede kaala baferedu `elate yawasadawene tashakemo bamamethaate bafethuraanu fite yewaaradaale. kaziyaame 'eyaanedaanedwa nafese yaszaraacewe szeraa yaaletagwaadala hono tesathaalace; baaleszarute wanejale bamathayaqe; kaszarute malekaame szeraa menedaane bamaathaate 'ayebadalume.

ba'alaahe zanede ba'emenate 'enaa bamalekaame szeraa ya'eresune wedeetaa yamifalege 'enaa yamikatale; 'alaahene bamakaade 'enaa tzayaafe szeraaneme bamaszeraate ka'alaahe zanede kabaade quthaane yezo yatamalasa 'enaa manoriyaaweme jahaaname yahona sawe 'ekule 'ayedalume. jahaanameme manoriyaanatunaa maarafiyaanatu 'ejege yakafaa nawe.

hulatume baqerebitu `aalame 'enaa bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame 'alaahe zanede baalaacawe darajaa yatalayaayu naacawe; 'alaaheme yamiszarutene nagare tamalekaace nawe; ka'eresu 'anedaaceme 'ayeshashagebateme; huluneme 'enedayaszeraawe yemanadaale.

'alaahe lame'emanaane karaasaacawe wagane hono qure'aane yamiyaanabelaacawe; ba'alaahe kamaagaaraate (kashireke) 'enedihume kakefu sena megebaare yamiyaatzadaacawene qure'aanene 'enaa ya'eresune falage; 'alaahe balebonaawe laaye yaasaadarawene thebabe yamiyaasetameraacawene nabiye balaakalaacawe gizee bago nagare waalalaacawe. 'enaresu yehe nabiye wadanaresu kamalaaku bafite ba'eregetheme katekekelanyaawe manegade 'enaa kaqenaacaa bageletze themate wesethe nabaru.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! lamahonu ba'uhhude thorenate batashanafaacehu 'enaa cheneqeme badarasabaacehu 'enaa kanaanetame yatagadala batagadala gizee, babadere `elate kamagedaleme kamamaarakeme yazihene hulate 'ethefe 'agenyetaacehu saala 'enyaa me`emanaane honane; nabiyume bamahakalaacene 'eyaala yehe kayate lidaresabene caala 'alaacehune? 'aneta nabiye hoye! yadarasabaacehu nagare ba'aqwaame bamalayaayataacehu 'enaa bamachaqaachaqaacehu bamale'eketanyaawe laaye bamaamatzaacehu mekeneyaate kanaanetawe yamathaa nawe balaacawe. 'alaahe nagarocene hulu caaye nawe; yafalagawene yeradaale yafalagaweneme yaawaaredaale.

ba'uhhude zamacaa `elate ya'enaaneta budene 'enaa yathaa`otaawiyaanu budene batagaathamabate gizee yadarasabaacehu magadale, maqusale 'enaa mashanafe ba'alaahe feqaade 'enaa wesaanee nawe; 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyoceme talayetawe yetaawaqubate zanede lataalaaqe thebabeme nawe.

'asemasaayoce geletze yewathu zanede nawe. ba'alaahe manegade tagaadalu 'aliyaame yamuselimocene quthere bamaabezaate takalaakalu batabaalu gizee, <<baziyaa botaa wegiyaa 'enaa gedeyaa yenoraale belane benaasebe noro 'enekatalaacehu nabare genaa 'enyaa banaaneta 'enaa ba sawocu makaakale thorenate yenoraale belane 'alaasabeneme>> yelaalu. 'enaresume baziyaane gizee ka'emenate yeleqe wada kehedate yaqarabu mahonaacawune yamiyaamalaakete balebocaacawe yaleelawene nagare bamelaasocaacawe yenaagaraalu; 'alaaheme balebonaacawe yamidabequtene kamaaneme balaaye `aawaaqi nawe; selasume saayeqathaacawe 'ayeqareme.

'enaresu 'enanyaa kathorenate wada xwaalaa yaqaru ba'uhhude zamacaa `elate latagodute zamadocaacawe 'enyaane bisamune, bitaazazune 'enaa wada thorenate baayewathu noro baaletagadalu nabare yaalute naacawe. 'aneta nabiye hoye!
