'enedihe bamaalateme malese sethaacawe:: <<'enaresu 'enyaane bisamune baaletagadalu nabare; lamadaanaaceneme sababu kategele meedaa maqerataacene nawe>> yaalaacehute 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu mote ba'enaaneta laaye sithaade karaasaacehu laaye 'aseqarute.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'enanyaane ba'alaahe manegade sitaagalu yatagadalutene mutaane naacawe belahe 'ataasebe; 'enaresu bageetaacawe zanede bakebera manegesetu batalaya hheyewate wesethe heyaawe naacawe; 'alaahe 'eneji leelaa 'akaale kamaayaaweqawe sisaayeme yemagabaalu.

'alaahe katerufaatu basathaacawe nagare tadelaa 'enaa dasetaa yatanebashaabashu honawe yenoraalu; baqerebitwa `aalame wada xwaalaa yaqarute wanedemocaacaweme kanaresu gaare maqalaaqalaacaweneme yethabeqaalu; 'enaresume 'enedanaresu ba'alaahe manegade laaye yatagadalu 'enedahona 'enaresu yaaganyutene terufaate 'enedamiyaaganyu yaamenaalu; bamachiwe `aalame kamigathemaacawe nagare segaate 'enaa ferehate yalabaacaweme kaqerebitu `aalame dereshaa selaamalathaacawe nagare 'ayetakezume.

kazihe gaare ka'alaahe bakule bamigathemaacawe taalaaqe menedaa, taalaaqe bahonawe terufaatu yedasaasataalu; 'alaaheme ba'eresu yaamanutene sawoce menedaa yamaayaathafu bamahonu 'enediyaaweme menedaacawene yatamwalaanaa 'ethefe derebe 'aderego nawe yamisathaacawe.

'enanyaa ba'alaahe manegade lamataagale 'enediwathu batatharu gizee la'alaahe 'enaa lamale'eketanyaawe theri malese yasathu; ba'uhhude thorenate qusele 'eyaalabaacawe <<bahhameraa'ale-'asade>> zamacaa thaa`otaawiyaanune 'enediwaagu batatharu gizee malese lasathute 'enaa lataazazute; ya'alaahene 'enaa yamale`eketanyaawene theri lamaqabale maqusalaacawe yaalekalakalaacawe; ka'enaresu makaakaleme szeraawocaacawene laasaamarute ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamathabaqe 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe 'alaahene lafarute; ka'alaahe yahona taalaaqe tzagaa tazagaajetolaacawaale; 'eresume janate nawe.

'enanyaa 'anedaanede thaa`otaawiyaane qurayeshoce <<ba'abu sufeyaane marinate 'enaanetane lamawaagaate 'enaa 'eremejaa lamawesade bezu tawaagiwocene 'enaa yathore masaariyaawocene sabesebawaale ferwacawe 'enaresune mawaagaate 'enedaataasebu>>; baalwacawe gizee yehe zeenaa 'alaahene maamane 'enaa qaale kidaanuneme 'eregethe maalatene chamaralaacawe; 'alaahe baqiyaacene nawe; mamakiyaacene 'enaa mathagiyaaceneme 'eresu menenyaa 'amaara 'eyaalu wada tegele meedaa lawathute taalaaqe menedaa tazagaajetolaacawaale.

wada hhameraa'ale-'asade kawathume baxwaalaa ka'alaahe yahona taalaaqe menedaa, kadarajaacaweme chemaari tagonaatzefawe, kathalaatocaacaweme gedeyaa 'enaa maqusele saayedaresebaacawe baszalaame tamalasu. ya'eresune te`ezaaze bamathabaqenaa ba'eresu laaye kamaamatzeme bamaqothabe ya'alaahene wedeetaa takatalu; 'alaahe 'amaanye lahonu baarocu yataalaaqe terufaate baaletabeete nawe.

'enaho yamiyaasefaraaraacehu shayethwane nawe; ba'agaazhocu 'enaa babaaledarabocu yaashaberaacexwaale; 'ateferwacawe; 'enaresu belehateme xaayeleme yalaacaweme. ba'ewenate 'eresune 'amaanyoce kahonaacehu te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'alaahene feru.

'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa ka'emenate bamaqalebase wada kehedate yamisheqadaadamute 'asemasaayoce hhazane wesethe 'ayeketatuhe. 'enaresu 'alaahene 'ayegoduteme 'alaahene kamaamane 'enaa 'eresuneme kamataazaze bamaraaqaacawe yamigodute raasaacawene nawe. 'alaahe 'enaresune bamaawaaradenaa lasekeete baalamaabeqaate bamacharashaawe `aalame wesethe meneme yatzagaa dereshaa 'enedaayenoraacawe falego nawe; yelequnese ba'esaate wesethe taalaaqe qethaate nawe yatazagaajalaacawe.

'enanyaa 'emenatene bakehedate yalawathu 'alaahene 'anedaaceneme nagare 'ayegoduteme; yelequne yamigodute raasaacawene nawe. la'enaresume bamacharashaawe `aalame 'asaamaami qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale.

'enanyaa geetaacawene yakaadu 'enaa haayemaanotune yataqaawamu; bazihu kehedate laaye 'eyaalu qethaataacawe mazageyatu 'aliyaame `edemeeyaacawe maraazamu la'enasu malekaame 'enedaayemaselaacawe; fetzume nagaru 'enedamigametute 'ayedalame. yelequnese hathi'ate 'abezetawe bamaszeraate bawanejalaacawe laaye wanejalene 'enedichameru nawe yamenaazagayaacawe. 'awaaraaje qethaateme tazagaajetolaacawaale.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! kamanaafeqaane gaare taqalaaqelaacehu, 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyoce saayelayu, bagedeetaawoce 'enaa batakataataaye fatanaawoce 'azezwacehu malekaame 'amaanye kamathefowe 'asemasaaye 'esekilaye derase; 'enaanetane baalaacehubate huneetaa laaye maaqoyatu ya'alaahe tafatherwawi kxidate 'ayedalame. 'alaahe 'enedihu 'ayetawaacehume. 'enaaneta 'amaanyocene ka'asemasaayoce layetaacehu yametaawequbatene debeqe `eweqatene maasaawaqe ka'alaahe thebabe 'ayedalame. nagare gene 'alaahe male'eketanyaawene muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) selamanaafeqaane baahheriyaate 'enedaasaawaqawe hulu kamale'eketanyocume yafalagawene maretho kafile debeqe `eweqatene yaasaaweqaacawaale. ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale`eketanyaawe yaalaacehune 'emenateme 'aragaagethu. ba'ewenate betaamenu, te`ezaazune bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene betefaru, la'enaaneta 'alaahe zanede taalaaqe menedaa 'alalaacehu.

'enanyaame 'alaahe katerufaatu basathaacawe nagare ya'alaahene hhaqe bamakalekale yamisasetu sawoce; sesetaacawe la'enaresu malekaame 'enedahona 'ayaasebu. yelequnese lanaresu yakafaa nawe. 'enaresu yasasatubate nagare baferedu `elate ba'anegataacawe tathaleqo yamiqathubate yehonaale. basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalawe nagare hulu mamalashaawe wada 'alaahe nawe; fetherataatu hulu kathafu baxwaalaa hheyaawe becaa waraashe 'eresu nawe. 'enaaneta yameteszarutene raqiqe nagaroce hulu 'alaahe `aawaaqi nawe; ba'eresume laaye 'alaahe yemanadaacexwaale.

'alaahe 'ayehudaawiyaanu:: <<'alaahe ka'enyaa bederene bamathayaqu deha nawe; 'enyaa dagemo 'enyaa zanede baalawe neberate habetaamoce nane.>> yaalutene ba'eregetheme sametwale. selaqethefataacawe 'enaa bageetaacaweme laaye selafabarakute weshete yatanaagarutene, 'enedihume yaala'ewenate nabiyaateneme magedalaacawene 'enetzefaalane. ba'esaate wesetheme 'aqaathaayune qethaate qemasu 'enelaacawaalane.
'ayehudoce hoye! yeheme qethaate 'ejocaacehu baaseqadamute wanejaloce 'enaa weredatoce mekeneyaate nawe; 'alaaheme baarocuneme hona maaneneme badaaye baalamahonu nawe.

'enaresu baqethefate 'enaa baweshate:: <<'alaahe bamatsaahhefetu 'enaa banabiyaate 'anedabateme qaalune yamiyaaragaagethene nagare, 'enedihume 'esaate kasamaaye waredo yamibalaawene qurebaane yezo 'esekimathaa derase bamaaneme male`eketanyaa 'enedaanaamene 'azezonaale>> yaalute naacawe. yehene yaazazane 'alaahe nawe bamaalataacawenaa yamale`eketanyoceneme 'ewenatanyenate maaragaagachaanaa magalachaane bazihu bamagadabaacawe weshataamoce naacawe. bamahonume 'alaahe male`eketanyaawene muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'enedihe bamaalate malese 'enedisathe 'azaza:: <<ka'enee bafite kaalafute male`eketanyoce 'ewenatanyenataacawene bageletze yamiyaaseradaa maaserajaanaa 'esaate kasamaaye waredo yamibalaawene qurebaane yametelutene yezawe mathetawe nabare; selametelute 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu lamahonu lamene 'asetabaabalaacexwaacawe?! lamenese gedeyaa fatsamaacehubaacawe?!>>

'aneta nabiye hoye! biyaasetabaabeluheme hhazane 'ayesamaahemale'eketanyoce geletze maaserajaawocene mekere 'enaa tagesaatze 'azale matsaahhefetene 'enedihume hegegaate 'enaa mamariyaawocene yayaazu matsaahhefetene yezawe mathetawe saala masetabaabale gathemwacawaale.

maanenyaawaame nafese motene qamaashe naate. maaneme sawe baqerebitu `aalame mataalale yalabateme. batenesaa'eewe `elate yaszeraacehu menedaa meneme saayegwaadale mulu hono yekafalaacexwaale. taadiyaa 'alaahe ka'esaate yaaraaqawe 'enaa janateme yaasegabaawe yamimanyawene malekaame 'aganya (sekeetaamaa hona); kamifaraaweme daana. yaduneyaa heyewate thafi shaqathe 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame; bamahonume yatamonya kaalehona basetaqare lebune ba'ereswa laaye 'ayaanethalatheleme.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! baganezabocaacehu, baneberate laaye gede yahonu mabetoce bamasethate, bamigathemaacehu 'adagaa 'enedihume banafesocaacehu shari`aawe yaazazawene nagare bamatagebare, bamigathemwacehu yacegere `aayenatoce tefatanaalaacehu. ka'enanyaa ka'enaaneta bafite matsaahhefete katasathute thaa`otaawiyaane 'enaanetane 'enaa 'emenataacehune bakefaate bamaanesaate bezu yamiyaasekafu nagarocene tesamaalaacehu. bamidaresebaacehu makaraa 'enaa fatanaa laaye betetaagasu, yaazazaacehune bamatagebare 'enaa kakalakalaacehume bamaraaqe 'alaahene betefaru yehe nagare ba'eregethe qurethanyenatene yamifalegu tasheqadaadaamiwoce lisheqadaadamubate kamigabaacawe nagaroce makaakale nawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'alaahe matsaahhefetene katasathute 'ayehudoce 'enaa keresetiyaanoce liqaawenete ya'alaahene matsehhafe lasawoce letaaberaaru, bawesethu yaalaweneme mamariyaa yanabiyu muhhamadeneme (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) male`eketanyenate laatedabequ belo kanaresu qaale kidaanene bayaaza gizee 'asetaawese. qaale kidaanuneme wada xwaalaa warawarute; wadaresume 'alezorume; 'ewenatene dabeqawe weshatene galatzu. ya'alaahene qaale kidaane selethaanene 'enaa ganezabene bamimasele tenaaneshene theqeme lawathu; ya'alaahene qaale kidaane yalawathubate waagaa menenyaa kafaa.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'enanyaa baszarute tzayaafe tagebaare yamidasatutene, baaleszarute malekaame nagare sawoce 'enediyaawadeswacawe yamiwadu kaqethaate yedenaalu, salaame yehonaalu, belahe 'ataasebe. manoriyaacawe jahaaname nawe; lanaresu 'asaamaami qethaate 'alalaacawe.
bamafethareme hona bamaasetanaabare basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalawe negeszenaa hulu ya'alaahe becaa nawe; 'alaahe nagarocene hulu caaye nawe.

yaqadama masaaye yaalenabaraacawe sihone samaayaate 'enaa mederene mafethare, lalite 'enaa qane mafaraaraqe, marezame 'enaa maathare, mabalaalathaacawe wesethe theenaamaa 'a`emero laalaacawe hulu geletze meleketoce 'alu; 'amelekote babecanyenate yamigabaawe becanyaa fathaari 'enedaala yethaqumwacawaale.

'enaziyaa 'enaresu 'alaahene bamaanenyaaweme huneetaa yamiyaawasu naacawe; qomawe, taqamethawe, tagaademawe 'alaahene yaawasaalu. yasamaayaate 'enaa yamederene 'afathaathare 'eyaasetanatanu - <<geetaacene hoye! yehenene taalaaqe fetherate laqalede yaalaqume nagare 'alefatharekaweme; kaqalede 'enaa kabwalete yatharaahe nahe; 'enyaane lamalekaame nagaroce sekeetaamaa bamaaderage 'enaa kakefu nagaroce bamaaraaqe ka'esaate qethaate thabeqane>> yelaalu.

geetaacene hoye! kafethuraanehe makaakale 'aneta 'esaate yaasegabaakxawene sawe ba'eregethe 'awaaredakxawaale. baferedume `elate la'enanyaa labadaayoce ka'alaahe qethaate yamiyaatarefwacawe radaatoce yalwacaweme.

geetaacene hoye! 'enyaa wada maane yamithaaraane tathaarihene nabiyehene muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) samaane; ba'alaahe bageetaacehu, babecanyaawe 'amelaake 'emanu belo sithaaraa 'eresu batathaaraawe nagare 'amanene, manegaduneme takatalene wanejalocaacenene yeqere balelene; 'ataawaaredane; hathi'ataacenene 'elafelene; bawanejale 'ateyaazane; kadagaage baarocehe gaare lasekeete 'abeqaane; kakefu szeraame 'areqakxane gedalane.

<< geetaacene hoye! bamale'eketanyoce 'anedabate qaale yagabaahelenene, bamalekaame mamaraate 'enaa delene sethane baferedume `elate wada 'esaate bamaasegabaate 'ataawaaredane. geetaacene hoye! 'aneta qaalehene yamaataathefe care geetaacene nahe>> yelaalu.

geetaacaweme lemanaacawene taqabalaacawe; wanedeme yehune seete biyaaneseme bibazaame yaszaraacehune menedaa kanetu 'alaadaregaweme; 'enedahaayemaanotu feredaacehu yakafilaacehu kakafilaacehu tamasaasaaye nawe; lawanede 'ayechamereme kaseeteme 'ayegodeleme; 'enanyaa ba'alaahe manegade yatasadadu, kahadiyaanume kamanoriyaacawe yaabaararwacawe, geetaacawene bamataazazaacawe mekeneyaateme cegere 'enaa cheneqe yaaganyaacawe; ba'alaahe manegade taagelawe ya'alaahe qaale yabalaaye tehone zanede yatagadalu; baferedu `elate hathi'aataacawene yeqere 'elaacawaalahu. kahhenetzaawocwa sere jeratoce wadamifasubaate ya'atekelete seferaa 'asegabaacawaalahu. ya'alaahe menedaa sihone yegabaalu. 'alaaheme 'eresu zanede 'amesaayaa yaleelawe malekaame menedaa 'alawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! ya'enanyaa kahadiyaane ba'agaru 'enedalebaacawe mazawaawaraacawe 'enaa mamacaacataacawe, yanegedaacawe masefaate 'enaa yasisaayaacawe mabarekate 'enedaayaataalelehe; sela huneetaacawe hhazane 'enaa tekaazee 'ayeyaazehe.

yehece 'enaresu yaalubaate zalaqeetaa yaleelaate teneshe mathaaqamiyaa nace; kaziyaame baferedu `elate yamimalasubate macharashaacawe yajahaaname 'esaate nawe. yehe ya'esaate menethaafe menenyaa kafaa.

gene 'enanyaa te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe geetaacawene yafaru sawoce kahhenetzaawocwa sere jeratoce yamifasubaate ya'atekelete seferaa janate 'alacelaacawe. ka'alaahe yahona menedaa sihone bawesethwa zawetaariwoce lihonu yegabwataale. 'alaaheme kabaarocu dagaage lahonute yaazagaajawe mamalashaa kahadiyaanu kamidasatubaate yaqerebitu `aalame mathaqaaqamiyaa yabalatha nawe.

matsaahhefete yatasathute sawoce hulume 'anede `aayenate 'ayedalume. ka'enaresu makaakale ba'alaahe, wadanaanetame batawaradawe 'ewenataa 'enaa mamariyaa, 'enaa kamatsaahhefetaacaweme wada 'enaresu batawaradawe yamiyaamenu; 'enedihume ba'anedu 'amenawe baleelaawe bamakaade ba'alaahe male`eketanyoce makaakale yamaayenathaathelu, 'eresu zanede yaalawene bamakajale la'alaahe yatawaadaqu 'enaa yatawaaradu ba'alaahe 'aneqatzoceme `aalamaawi theqemene yamaayelawethu 'alu. 'enaziyaa ba'enanyihe baahheriyaate yamigalatzu la'enaresu geetaacawe zanede taalaaqe menedaa 'alaacawe; 'alaaheme laszeraawoce fathaane gamegaami 'enaa menedaa sachime nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu hoye! shari`aawe baazazaacehu nagaroce laaye ka`aalamaawi cegere bamigathemaacehu nagare laaye taagasu; kakahadiyaane bate`egesete yabalaaye hunu 'enaresu ka'enaaneta balaaye taagaashoce 'enedihonu manegade 'atesethu. ba'alaahe manegade bamataagaleme qathe balu, te`ezaazune bamathabaqe, yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru yeheme ka'esaate natzaa bamawethaate, janatene bamaagenyate menyotaacehu yesaakaalaacehu zanede nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! geetaacehune feru 'eresu yaa 'enaanetane ka'anedite nafese, ka'abaataacehu 'adame yafatharaacehu nawe ka'adameme thenedune, 'enaataacehune hhawaa'ene fathara kahulatume bamedere gatzetaawoce laaye bezu sawocene, wanedocene 'enaa seetocene 'asaraacha kafilaacehu kafilaacehune baresu yamithayeqebatene 'alaahene feru bamahakalaacehu yamiyaasetasaaseraacehuneme zemedenaane maqurathe tathaneqaqu 'enaho 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye taqothaathaari hona kaszeraacehu 'anedaaceme 'ayeshashagebateme; yemazagebawaale; baziyaame yemanadaacexwaale

'enaaneta nuzaazeene yataqabalaacehu sawoce hoye! yatime hhetzaanaatene yaadagu 'enaa qenaacaane yadarasu bahonu gizee ganezabaacawene (neberataacawene) yaaletagwaadala sihone sethwacawe yatafaqadane 'ereme bahonawe 'atelawethu kaneberataacawe merethe 'enaa wedune wasedaacehu, kaneberataacehu wedaaqi 'enaa mathefone bamasethate 'atelawethu. yayatime lejoceneme ganezabe wada ganezabaacehu bamaqalaaqale 'atewesadu 'eresu 'alaahe zanede taalaaqe hathi'ate honwale

ba'enekebekaabeeyaacehu sere yaalutene yatime seetocene 'agebetaacehu maasetakaakalene 'enaa fetehawi mahonene, la'enaresu gede yahonane yagaabecaa sethotaane maagudalene 'aliyaame bamalekaame maasetadaadarene betefaru ka'enaresu reqaacehu kaseetoce malekaame hunawe kataayuwaacehu makaakale hulate hulatene, szosete szosetene, 'araate 'araateneme 'agebu bamakaakalaacawe maasetakaakalene betefarume 'aneditene becaa 'agebu 'aliyaame ba'ejocaacehu yezotaa sere yaalu tathaqaaqamu yeheme lachawaa seetoce gede yahonawe la'enaresu (la'agalegaaye seetoce) gede baalamahonu nawe yehe baseete walaaje 'alebaa lejoce, ba'anede seete gaabecaame mawasane 'enaa baseete baaroceme mathaqaaqame 'enedaatebadelu 'enaa kafetehe 'enedaataazanabelu yaqaraba nawe
seetoceneme yagaabecaa sethotaacawene gedeetaa sihone sethwacawe. yaalamaasegadademe nafesocaacawe faqedawe kagaabecaa sethotaacawe bisathwacehu, yaamaara 'enaa yatamasagana sihone belute

'enaaneta xaalaafiwoce hoye! ganezabocene la'enanyaa maasetadaadarene lamaayaawequ 'atesethu 'enanyiyaane ganezaboce 'alaahe lasawoce nuro maasaamariyaa 'enaa maqwaaqwaamiyaa 'aderegwaacawaale. 'enanyihe sawoce dagemo ganezabene lamaasetadaadare 'enaa lamathabaqe tagabiwoce 'ayedalume wachiyaacawene shafenu kareswame 'alebeswacawe malekaame negegereneme tanaagarwacawe lathenekaaree badarasu 'enaa maasetadaadare bamicelu gizee neberataacawene 'enedametaaserakebwacawe bamalekaame negegere qaale gebulaacawe

'enaaneta xaalaafiwoce hoye! yatime lejocene lathenekaaree maderasaacawene fatenwacawe wache yamiyaadaregutene kafile ganezabaacawene sethwacawenaa maasetadaadarene bicelunaa beqaataacawe katagalatzalaacehu, neberataacawe saayegwaadale bamulu 'aserakebwacawe bamiyaasefalegaacehu gizee kaneberataacawe 'enedetethaqamu 'alaahe kaaseqamathawe denebareme 'alefaacehu 'atebelu siyaadegu muluwene yewasedaalu belaacehu maadagaacawene bamasheqadaadame 'atebelu kanaaneta makaakale yamiyaabeqaaqaawe ganezabe yaalawe kayatimu neberate kamabelaate yeqothabe. neberate yaleelawe dehame bihone yamiyaasefalegawene yaahele becaa yebelaa kadarasu 'enaa beqaataacawene kaawaqaacehu baxwaalaa neberatocaacawene setaaserakebwacawe mabetene lamathabaqe 'enaa cheqecheqene lamaaseqarate mesekeroce 'enediganyu 'aderegu baziheme kamesekerenate bakule baszeraawocaacaweme laaye baarocene kamagamegame bakule ba'alaahe baqaa

lawanedoce walaajoce, 'eneda wanedeme 'enaa 'agotoce yaalu yaqerebe zamadoce thelawe kamotute neberate yawerese dereshaa 'alaacawe badenequrenaa zamane seetoce 'enaa hhetzaanaate kawerese 'enedamikalakalute `aayenate saayehone laseetoceme 'enaziyaa katawute neberate yebezaame yenaseme yawerese dereshaa 'alaacawe yehe dereshaa ka'alaahe zanede yatadanagaga 'enaa leku yamitaawaqe nawe

baqathetaa werese yamaayegabaacawe yazemedenaa baaletabeetoce, yatime hhetzaanaate 'enaa dehoce yawerese kefefele laaye yataganyu 'enedahona, ganezabu kamakafaafalu bafite dase yelaacawe zanede karesu sethwacawe malekaame negegereneme tanaagarwacawe

'enanyaame kabasetajarebaacawe tenaaneshe dakaamaa lejocene thelawe bimotu ba'enaresu laaye mathefaatene yamisagu sawoce baxaalaafinataacawe sere yaalu yatime lejocene kamabadale 'alaahene yeferu 'enaresume layatimocu 'enedaasaamaru hulu 'alaahe kamotaacawe baxwaalaa lejocaacawene yaminekabaakabu sawocene yaagaraalaacawe zanede 'alaahene yeferu nuzaazeewe laaye yataganyu sawoce balejocu badale 'enedaayefatzeme la'enaresu saayenaazaze bamatawe malekaame menedaa kamaagenyate raasune 'enedaayebadeleme 'ewenate 'azale yahona malekaame negegere yenaagarute

'enanyaa yayatime lejocene neberate wasedawe babadale 'enaa bathelaacaa wache yamiyaadaregu sawoce 'enaho bahodaacawe yamibalute yametaaqaathelaacawene 'esaate nawe baferedume `elate 'aqaathaaye wada honace 'esaate yegabaalu

yalejocaacehune yawerese dereshaane batamalakata 'alaahe yaazezaacexwaale werese bamahakalaacawe sikafaafale lawanede leje yahulate seete lejoce dereshaa yesathawaale mwaceme yaala wanede leje kahulate balaaye seete lejocene thelo kamota katawawe neberatu hulate szosetanyaawe yesathaacawaale 'anedite seete leje becaa kahonace dagemo katawawe gemaashu yesathaataale kamwace walaajoce la'eyaanedaanedaacawe katawawe 'anede sedesetanyaawe 'alaacawe yeheme wanede wayeme seete leje thelo kamota nawe leje yaleelawe kahona 'enaa kawalaajocu leelaa waraashe kaleelawe; la'enaatu 'anede szosetanyaawe yesathaataale, yataqarawe werese la'abaatu nawe mwace hulate 'enaa kaziyaa balaaye wanedemoce 'enaa ka'anede 'enaateme yehune katalayaayu 'enaatoce yahonu 'ehetoce binorute; la'enaatu 'anede sedesetanyaawe 'alaate yataqaraweme la'abaate yesathaale lawanedeme 'enaa 'ehetoce meneme 'ayenoraacaweme yeheme yamwace neberate kefefele ka'anede szosetanyaa 'ayebelathe 'eneji mwace katanaazazawe yayesathelenye nuzaazee 'enaa yaalabatene `edaa kamakefale baxwaalaa mahone 'alabate 'alaahe yawerese kefefele bazihe maleku 'adaraga yeheme 'enaaneta ka'abaatoceme yehune kalejoce la'enaaneta baqerebitwame yehune bamachiwe `aalame maanenyaaweme 'enaanetane bamatheqame yaqaraba 'enedahona 'ataawequme mwace 'anede waraashune bamalekaame 'asebote neberatune hulu la'eresu becaa lisathe; leelaanyaawene dagemo bakefaate 'asebote likalakelawe 'enaa kaziyaame baxwaalaa batagebaare sitaaye yaziyaa taqaaraani likasate yecelaale yazihene 'ewenataa yamiyaaweqawe 'anedaaceme nagare yamaayeshashagebate 'alaahe becaa nawe selaziheme yaweresene dereshaa 'enedagalatzawe 'adaraga karesume yahona baarocu lifatzemute yamigabaa gedeetaa 'adaragawe 'alaaheme labaarocu malekaame kahonu nagaroce yamaayedabaqebate `aawaaqi, bahegegaatu 'enaa ba'asetadaadaru thebabanyaa nawe

'enaaneta baaloce hoye! misetocaacehu ka'enaanetame yehune kaleelaa baale wanedeme yehune seete leje saayenoraacawe yamotu 'enedahona katawute neberataacawe gemaashu 'alaacehu wanedeme yehune seete leje kaalaacawe dagemo katawute neberate 'anede 'araatanyaawe 'alaacehu yeheme dereshaa 'enaresu misetoce kaasetalaalafute nuzaazee 'enaa yaalabaacawe `edaa katakafala baxwaalaa nawe lamisetoceme 'enaaneta baaloce ka'enaresume yehune kaleelaa misete wanedeme yehune seete leje saayenoraacehu yamotaacehu 'enedahona katawaacehute neberate 'anede 'araatanyaawe 'alaacawe wanedeme yehune seete leje yaalaacehu 'enedahona katawaacehute neberate 'anede semenetanyaawe 'alaacawe yeheme kefefele 'enaaneta kaasetalaalafaacehute nuzaazee 'enaa yaalabaacehume `edaa katakafala baxwaalaa nawe 'anede wanede, walaaje 'enaa leje saayenorawe kamota, 'anedite seeteme walaaje 'enaa leje saayenoraate kamotace mwace ka'enaate yahona wanedeme wayeme 'ehete binorawe waye binoraate la'eyaanedaanedu wanedeme wayeme 'ehete 'anede sedesetanyaa 'alaacawe ka'enaate yahonu wanedemoce 'enaa 'ehetoce ka'anede balaaye kahonu dagemo hulaacaweme yamikaafalute 'anede szosetanyaa 'alaacawe baziyaa wesethe wanedeme, seeteme 'ekule dereshaa yenoraacawaale yeheme yaneberate kefefele mwace waraashocene bamaayegodaa maleku kaasetalaalafawe nuzaazee 'enaa yaalabate `edaa katakafala baxwaalaa nawe yehe 'aneqatzocu yaazalute hege 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye gedeetaa yaadaragawe 'enaa wadanaanetame yaasetalaalafawe mekere nawe 'alaahe baziheme bamachiweme `aalame labaarocu yamithaqemaacawene nagare `aawaaqi, siyaathafume baqethaate yamaayaacaakulaacawe taagaashe nawe

'enanyihe yatime hhetzaanaate 'enaa leelocuneme yamithaqesu hegegaate, litagaberwacawe zanede 'alaahe labaarocu yadanagagaacawe naacawe 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene, te`ezaazune bamafatzame 'enedihume yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe yamitaazazene sawe 'alaahe kahhenetzaawocwa sere jeratoce yamifasubaatene ya'atekelete seferaa bahonace, janate yaasegabaawaale bawesethwame thefaate yamaayaaganyaacawe sihonu lazala`aalame yenoraalu yeheme 'amelaakaawi menedaa maaneme yamaayewadaadarawe taalaaqe sekeetenaa dasetaa nawe

hegegaatune wedeqe bamaaderage 'enaa matagebareneme bamatawe 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yamiyaametze yahegegaatuneme denebare yamithese bawesethwa zawetaari sihone 'alaahe 'esaatene yaasegabaawaale laresume 'awaaraaje qethaate 'alalate

'enanyaa bagaabecaa thebeqe kahonu, kaalaagabume seetocaacehu makaakale yazemutene tzayaafe tagebaare yamifatzemutene ba'enaresu laaye fetehawi yahonu 'araate muselime wanedocene 'asemasekerubaacawe tzayaafe yazemute tagebaare mafatzamaacawene bimasakerubaacawe, la'enaresu maqathaachaa yehone zanede mote 'esekiwasedaacawe 'aliyaame 'alaahe la'enaresu babeete kamaaqoyate weche manegade 'esekiyaadaregelaacawe derase babeete wesethe 'aqoyuwaacawe kaziyaame 'alaahe manegadune 'aberaaraa yaalaagabaace lejaagarade zemute kafatzamace mato jeraafe 'enedetegarafe 'enaa ka'akaabaabiwe 'anede `aamate 'enedetereqe, baalatedaare seete yazamotace kahona dagemo 'enedetewagare danagaga

'enanyaa yazemutene tzayaafe szeraa yamifatzemutene wanede 'enaa seete bagaabecaa yatathabaquteme yaaletathabaquteme zemutene bafatzamu gizee 'enaresune maawaaradene bamiyaaragaagethe maleku ba'anedabate 'enaa ba'eje qethwacawe, weqaswacawe 'enaresume tatzatzetawe kawanejalu biwagadu 'enaa 'akaaheedaacaweneme kasaamaru yaane gizee kanaresu taqothabu kathefaatume yatamalasa hathi'ate 'enedaleelabate nawe 'alaaheme kabaarocu makaakale kathefaatu latamalasa taaraaqi la'enaresume 'azaanye nawe bazihe maleku bamaqethaate mabeqaaqaate bashari`aawe denegaagee majamariyaa laaye yeszaraabate yanabara sihone baxwaalaa laaye gene yaalaagabaa wanede 'enaa yaalaagabaace seetene zemute kafatzamu mato jeraafe bamagerafe 'enaa 'anede `aamate ka'akaabaabiwe bamaaraaqe, bagaabecaa yatathabaqu kahonu dagemo bamawegare taqayerwale

'enaho 'alaahe nesehacawene, mamalasaacawene yamiqabalaacawe sawoce 'enanyaa yawanejalune maabeqiyaa yahathi'ate darajaane baalamaawaqe lafatzamu 'enaa kaziyaame motene kamaayataacawe bafite baqerebu wada geetaacawe yamimalasute naacawe 'enaziyaane 'alaahe tzatzataacawene yeqabalaacawaale hathi'ataacaweneme yaalefelaacawaale 'alaaheme yabaarocune huneetaa `aawaaqi bawesaaneewocu 'enaa bahegegaatume thebabanyaa nawe

'alaahe ya'enanyaane bawanejale laaye yamizawaterutene, thaa`era mote kaalemathaabaacawe basetaqare kawanejalaacawe yamaayemalasutene tzatzate 'ayeqabaleme baziyaane gizee 'anedaacawe, <<'enee 'ahune kaszaraahute wanejale tatzatzecaalahu>> yelaale; 'alaahe 'ayeqabalaweme bakehedate laaye yazawataru honawe kamimotuteme 'alaahe tzatzatene 'ayeqabaleme la'enanyaa bawanejale zawetaari lahonute 'emebitanyoce 'enaa bakehedataacawe laaye 'eyaalu lamotute 'asaamaami yahona qethaate 'azagaajetanelaacawaale

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalaacehu hoye! ganezabe 'enedamiwarase ya'abaatocaacehune misetoce letewaresu, yaalafelaagotaacaweme letaagaabwacawe, lafalagaacehuteme letederwacawe, kamaagebaateme letekalakelwacawe 'ayefaqadelaacehume zemutene yamasalane geletze tzayaafe tagebaare kaalefatzamu basetaqare kasathaacexwaacawe yagaabecaa sethotaa 'enaa leelaa neberate bamaasegadade 'enedisathwacehu, 'enaresune lamagudaate bamaasabe yametethalwacawene misetocaacehune bagaabecaa wele 'asero maaqoyateme la'enaaneta 'aletafaqadame geletzenaa tzayaafe nagarene bafatzamu gizee kasathaacexwaacawe neberate kafelawe raasaacawene natzaa 'esekiyaadaregu 'enaresune maaqoyate 'enaa ba'enaresu laaye maathebabe tafaqadalaacehu seetocaacehuneme magudaatene bamatawe, malekaameneme bamatagebare bamalekaame 'anurwacawe `aalamaawi lahoname nagare 'enaresune betethalu, menaalebaateme 'enaaneta 'anedaacene nagare thaletaacehu saala 'alaahe baziyaa nagare wesethe baqerebitwame bamachiweme `aalame malekaamene nagare liyaaseqamethebate yecelaale

baaloce hoye! misetene mafetaate 'enaa bametekwaa leelaane maagebaate betefalegu ba'enaaneta laaye hathi'ate yalame letefatwateme yawasanaacehutene seete la'ereswa lagaabecaa sethotaa barekaataa ganezabe sathetaacehu yanabaraacehu betehonu 'enekwaa kaziyaa 'anedaace mawesade 'ayefaqadelaacehume 'eresuneme mawesade geletze qethefate 'enaa wanejaleme nawe

ba'enaaneta makaakale kanabarawe tesesere, mawaadade, mathaqaaqame, shefene galaane 'enaa misethirene kamaawaqe baxwaalaa la'enaresu yasathaacehutene 'enedeete tewasedaalaacehu? kazihe hulu baxwaalaa ba'ejocaacawe yaalawene ganezabe mawesadene makajale katzayaafe yeqotharaale ka'enaanetame yathabaqa qaale kidaane yezawaale yaame ya'alaahene seme tharetaacehu 'akaalaacawene yatafaqada maaderagaacehu nawe

kaseetoceme 'abaatocaacehu yaagabwacawene 'ataagebu yaa 'ereme nawe nabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) kamalaakaacawe bafite banabarawe denequrenaa zamane yaalafa kaalehona basetaqare; baziyaa mathayaqe yalame yaame (yalejoce ya'abaatocaacawene misetoce maagebaate) 'alaahe zanede yathelaacaawe 'enaa yaquthaawe sababe sihone manegadenatume yakafaa nawe

'enaatocaacehune maagebaate ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme hona wada laaye kafe sileme 'enedihu ya'enaate walaaje 'ayaatene maagebaateme, seete lejocaacehuneme, wadataace zeqe sileme, yaseete leje seete lejene, yawanede leje seete lejene, ka'enaate 'enaa ka'abaate wayeme ka'anedaacawe yahonu 'ehetocene maagebaateme, ya'abaate 'ehetocene ('akesetocene) ya'abaate wayeneme ya'enaate 'akesetoceneme, ya'enaate 'ehetoceneme yawanedeme 'enaa ya'ehete seete lejoceneme; zeqe silu ya'enaresuneme seete lejocene, thute yaathabwacehune yathute 'enaatocaacehune yathute 'ehetocaacehuneme 'aberaacehu genenyunatene yafatzamaacehuteme, yaalefatzamaacehuteme misetocaacehu 'enaatocene, babeetocaacehu wesethe yamiyaadegutene kaleelaa yatawaladu yamisetocaacehune seete lejoce, 'enaatocaacawene yataganaanyaacehu kahona 'ereme yehonaalu yaaletaganaanyaacexwaacawe kahona gene kafece baxwaalaa lejocaacawene betaagabu wanejale yalabaacehume ka'aberaakaacehu yahonu wanede lejocaacehune misetoce maagebaateme ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme hona lejocaacehu baayeganaanywacaweme 'ereme naacawe yathute lejocaacehu misetoceme bazihu hege sere yegabaalu badame 'aliyaame bathute yamiganaanyu hulate 'ehetoceneme maagebaate 'ereme nawe kaziyaa badenequrenaa zamane yaalafawe siqare, yaanene 'alaahe yeqere belotaale. 'alaaheme kabaarocu wadaresu lamimalasute mahari la'enaresume 'azaanye nawe banabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) falage, sunaa dagemo 'anedite seetene ka'abaatwa wayeme ka'enaatwa 'ehete ka'akesetwa gaare 'abero maagebaate 'enedihu 'ereme tadaregwaale

kaseetoceme bagaabecaa thebeqe yahonutene maagebaate 'ereme tadaragabaacehu ba'alaahe manegade laaye tegele wathetaacehu bathorenate ba'ejocaacehu yaasegabaacexwaacawe merekonyaa seetoce kaalehonu basetaqare 'enaziyaane maahetzanaacawe kaware 'ababaa kanatzaa baxwaalaa maganaanyate tafaqadalaacehu ka'enanyihe weche yaalutene seetoce letaagabume tafaqadalaacehu zemutene yamaataasebu setehonu baganezabocaacehu nafesocaacehune letethabequ 'enaa letaatzadu faqadalaacehu ka'enaresume makaakale bagaabecaa wele yatathaqaaqamaacehubaacawene 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye gede yaadaragaatene yagaabecaa sethotaa, maherene sethwacawe gede yahonawe yagaabecaa sethotaa mahere katasatha baxwaalaame bamahakalaacehu bamifathare masemaamaate, waye chameraacehu letesathu waye kaziyaawe bitawulaacehu wanejale yalabaacehume 'alaaheme sela fethuraanu `aawaaqi, 'anedaace nagare yamaayeshashagebate, badenegaageewe 'enaa bamaasetanaabarume thebabanyaa nawe

'enaaneta wanedoce hoye! ka'enaaneta makaakale ganezabe 'atherote chawaa seetocene maagebaate kaalecaala neberatenataacawe laleeloce kahonu seete baaroce maagebaate yecelaale la'enaaneta bageletze 'enedamitaayawe 'amaanye baaroce kahonu letaagabwacawe tecelaalaacehu. 'alaaheme ya'emenataacehune 'ewenatanyenate 'enaa yahuneetaacehune wesetha mesethire yaaweqaale 'enaanetame, 'enaresume ba'emenate 'enaa basabe'awinate 'anede naacehu 'enaresune kamaagebaateme 'atetzayafu. ba'asaadaariwocaacawe faqaade 'agebwacawe yaalamaagudale 'enaa yaalamaazageyateme yagaabecaa sethotaacawene sethwacawe yeheme 'enaresu seete baarocu thebeqoce, bageletze zemutene fatsaamiwoce 'enedihume badebeqeme yazemute weshemaa yaazhoce yaalehonu 'enedahona nawe 'enazihe seete baaroce katagabu baxwaalaa yazemute tzayaafe tagebaarene bifatzemu bachawaa seetoce laaye yaalawe qethaate gemaashu 'alabaacawe, haamesaa jeraafe yegarafaalu, 'ayewagarume yehe 'amaanye 'enaa thebeqe yahonu seete baarocene maagebaate mafaqadu ka'enaaneta makaakale zemute laaye mawedaqene lafaraa 'enaa chawaa seetene lamaagebaate 'aqeme laathaa sawe nawe lejoceneme kabaarenate lamaaraaqe seete baariyaane kamaagebaate mataagase balaache nawe 'alaaheme kabaarocu wadaresu latamalasu mahari la'enaresume 'azaanye nawe ka'ezenatume yatanasaa 'anede sawe zemute laaye mawedaqene bafaraa gizee kaseete baaroce 'amaanyoce 'enaa thebeqe yahonutene 'enediyaagabaa faqadalate

'alaaheme 'enanyihene hegegaate la'enaaneta bamadanegagu ya'emenatune 'enaa yahegune temeherete 'aberaaraalaacehu ba`aalamaawi 'enedihume ba'emenate gudaayaacehume la'enaaneta yamibajene nagare ligaletzelaacehu yefalegaale bamafeqade 'enaa bamakalekaleme ka'enaaneta bafite yanabarutene yanabiyaatene manegade limaraacehu yeshaale 'enaresuneme 'enedetekatalu 'enaa yataqadasa manegadaacawene, yatakabara taarikaacaweneme liyaaberaaraalaacehu, 'eresuneme kamaamatze yeleqe wadamataazaze limalesaacehu yefalegaale 'alaaheme labaarocu yamibajawene yaaweqaale laziheme danagagalaacawe. bawesaaneewe 'enaa bahegegaatume thebabanyaa nawe
'alaaheme 'enaanetane mataaraqe 'enaa hathi'ataacehune mamaare yefalegaale 'enanyaa semeetocaacawene yamikatalute dagemo kaqathetanyaawe manegade taalaaqe mazanebalene 'enedetezanabalu yefalegaalu

'alaaheme badanagagawe nagare ba'enaaneta laaye maageraatene yefalegaale. 'enaaneta bamaatecelute nagare 'alaasegadadaacehume yeheme yasawe leje ba'afathaatharu 'enaa babaaheriwe dakaamaa bamahonu nawe

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu hoye! 'anedaacehu yaleelaacehune ganezabe babadale, baqemiyaa, basereqote, bamusenaa 'enaa bamasaasalute 'ayebelaa yaa ganezabe wadedawe kamigabayaayu sawoce yamathaa kahona gene 'eresune mabelaate 'enaa baresume mathaqame tafaqada kafilaacehume kafilaacehune 'ayegedale 'anedaacehume nafesune 'ayegedale wada thefaateme 'ayewesadaate 'alaahe la'enaaneta 'azaanye nawenaa ka'ezenatume yatanasaa damaacehune, ganezabaacehune 'enaa keberaacehune yatathabaqa 'enaa yatakabara 'adaragawe

'enee yakalakalekwaacehune nagare yamifatzeme, yaleelaane ganezabe yamibalaa, bagedeyaame basawe laaye denebare yamiyaalefe, saweneme yamibadele, baalamaawaqe 'enaa bamaresaate saayehone hone belo 'eyataawaqawe yamiyaathafaa, 'alaahe baferedu `elate wada taalaaqe 'esaate yaasegabaawaale qaathalowaane 'enaa qethaatwane yeqamesaale yeheme la'alaahe qalaale nawe 'eresu bahulu nagare laaye caaye 'anedaaceme nagare yamaayesaanawe nawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ba'alaahe laaye maagaaraatene, walaajocene mabadalene, nafese magedalene, walade mabelaatene `aayenate telaaleqe wanejalocene yametethabaqu kaziyaa yameterequ kahona yameteszarutene tenaaneshe wanejalocene 'enemerelaacexwaalane 'alaahe zanede yatakabarawe seferaa 'enaasegabaacexwaalane, 'ereswame janate nace

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! wadamathelaate 'enaa meqanyenate 'enedaayaadaresaacehu 'alaahe kafilaacehune bakafilaacehu laaye yaabalathabatene tzagaa 'atemanyu laseetoceme 'alaahe wanedocene yanathalabatene nagare mamanyate 'ayegabaame la'eyaanedaanedu yamigathemawe yaszeraa `aayenate 'alawe 'alaaheneme katerufaatu 'enedichamerelaacehu thayequte 'alaaheme huluneme nagare `aawaaqi nawe la'eyaanedaanedume yaszeraa `edele sathetotaale

la'eyaanedaanedaacehume walaajoce 'enaa zamadoce katawete yawerese ganezabe yamiwarese zamade 'adereganaale 'enanyaaneme lamatabaabare 'enaa lamaagaze yathabaqa qaale kidaanene yafatzamaacehulaacawene 'akaalaate kawerese yamigabaacawene dereshaa sethwacawe 'alaaheme bahulu nagare laaye masekaari hona baqaale kidaanaacehu 'enaa bamahalaawocaacehu mamasekarume kanazihe 'anedu nawe baqaale kidaane 'enaa sememenatene bamafatzame mawaraarase bashari`aawe majamariyaa laaye yetagabare yanabara sihone kaziyaa baxwaalaa 'alaahe bawerese 'aneqatzoce sherotaale

wanedoce baseetoce laaye yabalaaye 'asetadaadaariwoce naacawe, seetocene yethabeqaalu, gudaayaacawene yefatzemaalu yeheme 'alaahe kafilaacawene bakafilaacawe laaye bamaabelathu 'enaa wanedoceme ba'enaresu laaye bamiyaawathute wache 'enedihume 'enaresuneme bamaasetadaadaraacawe mekeneyaate nawe kaseetoce makaakale malekaamoce yahonute lageetaacawe belome labaalocaacawe taazaazhoce, 'alaaheme 'enaresune bamathabaqu 'enaa bamagethamu 'enaresu baleelubate raasaacawene 'enaa neberataacawene thabaaqiwoce naacawe 'enanyaaneme banegegereme, batagebaareme baalocaacawe laaye kafe yamilu 'enaa yamiyaametzutene 'amatzaacawene betefaru baaloce hoye! 'enaresune bamagasatze 'enaa 'alaaheneme 'enedifaru bamaasetaawase jameru lazihe malese baayesathu bamanyetaa ka'enaresu raaqu, jarebaacehune sethwacawe baziheme baayemalasu 'aqusaaye yaalehona mete metwacawe yatamalasume 'enedahona babadaleme hona bawaqasaa denebare 'atelafubaacawe 'alaaheme bahulu nagare laaye yabalaayenate baaletabeete 'enaa taalaaqeme hona, ferute

'enaaneta yahulate tagaabi xaalaafiwoce hoye! bamahakalaacawe yaalawe cheqecheqe wada thelaacaa 'enaa maraaraaqe yaamaraale belaacehu betefaru karesu beetasabe fetehawi yahona shemaagelee 'enaa ka'ereswame beetasabe fetehawi yahona shemaagelee laaku 'enanyaame shemaageleewoce waye kamaalayaayate waye kamaasetaaraqe bamibajaacawe nagare laaye yeferadu maasetaaraqe tawadaaje 'enaa balaacheme nawe 'enanyaa shemaageleewoce maasetaaraqe bifalegunaa wadaziyaa malekaame 'akaaheede biheedu 'alaahe bahulatu mahakale yegathemaale, yaasemaamaale 'alaahe kabaarocu 'anedaaceme nagare yamaayeshashagebate balebocaacawe wesethe yadabaqutene raqiqe nagare hulu `aawaaqi nawe

la'eresu bamataazaze 'alaahene 'ameleku ba'eresume laaye ba'amelekote maaneneme 'ataagaaru walaajoceneme bamaakebarenaa bamaagalegale, lazamadoce layatime lejoce 'enaa ladehoce, yazemedenaa baaletabeete lahona gorabeete, baa`ede lahoname gorabeete, bamanegade lamigodaanyaacehu gwaadanyaame seneqe lataqwaarathabate manegadanyaa, la'agalegaaye baarocaacehu hulu malekaame waalu 'alaaheme baraasu yamidanaqenaa basawoce laaye yamikoraane, raasune yamiyaamogese guranyaane 'ayewademe

'enanyaa 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye kacaraacawe sisaaye gede yaadaragabaacawene yaminafegu sesetaamocene, leeloce sawoceneme batagebaaraacawe 'enaa banegegeraacawe basesete yamiyaazutene, 'alaaheme katerufaatu yasathaacawene sisaaye 'enaa `eweqate yamidabequtene, weshatene 'eneji lasawoce 'ewenatene yamaayegaletzutene 'ayewadedaacaweme 'enazihe yakahadiyaane baaheriyaate naacawe lakahadiyaaneme 'awaaraaje qethaatene 'azagaajetanaale.

la'enanyaa sawoce 'enediyaayuwaacawe 'enaa 'enediyaamogeswacawe ganezabocaacawene wache lamiyaadaregu, ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane lamaayaamenu sawoce 'awaaraaje qethaate 'azagaajetanaale shayethwanene makatale 'eneji leelaa 'alaathamamaacaweme lashayethwane gwaadanyaa yahona sawe gwaadanyenatu menenyaa kafaa

'enanyaa sawoce 'enaresu ba'ewenate ba'alaahe 'enaa bamacharashaaweme qane biyaamenu 'enaa 'alaaheme kacaraacawe sisaaye ba'eresu manegade bimatzawetu mene gudaate nabarabaacawe? yaa! ba'eregethe la'enaresu yatashaala 'enaa yabalatha nabare 'alaaheme sela'enaresu huneetaa `aawaaqi nawe; ka'enaresume 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayedabaqebateme

'alaahe baarocune ya'anedite qenethaatene kebedate yaahele 'enekwaane yamaayebadele fetehawi nawe kamenedaacawe 'anedaaceme 'ayeqaneseme, yaaleszarutene wanejaleme 'ayetzefebaacaweme yaqenethaate yaahele malekaame kahonace dagemo 'ethefe derebe 'aderego taalaaqe menedaane ka'eresu zanede yesathaale

baferedu `elate ka'eyaanedaanedu hhezebe makaakale ba'enaresu laaye baszarute szeraa yamimasakerebaacawene nabiye bamenaamathaabate; 'anetaneme ba'enanyihe hhezebocehe laaye masekaari 'aderegane bamenaamathaahe `elate gudaayu 'enedeete yehonaale? ('ejege yagazafa nagare nawe)

baziyaa taalaaqe `elate, 'enanyaa 'alaahene yakaadu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yaamatzu sawoce medere yametesetakaakalebaacawe 'afare bihonu yewadaalu kaszarute 'anedaaceme nagare ka'alaahe 'ayedabequme; yeheme 'alaahe 'anedabataacawene zageto yasawenate 'akaalaacawe ba'enaresu laaye selamimasakere 'alaahene 'ayedabequteme

'enaaneta 'alaahene yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalaacehu me`emanaane hoye! yametelutene nagare 'eseketelayu derase sakeraacehu solaatene 'ateqerabu (yehe 'asekaari mathathe mulu bamulu 'ereme kamadaragu bafite nabare) 'eseketetaathabume derase bazare feree (yafetewate fasaashe) mafesase mekeneyaate barekusate laaye honaacehu 'atesegadu (bawesethu laalamaqoyate) lamaalafe becaame kaalehona masejide 'ategebu baweha lamataathabe yamaayaasecele hemame bigathemaacehu wayeme manegadanyoce betehonu, wayeme kamatzadaajaa setewathu, wayeme seetocene beteganaanyu 'enaa yametetaathabubate weha baataaganyu, netzuhe 'afarene 'asebu, tathaqamu, baresume fitocaacehune 'enaa 'ejocaacehune 'abesu. 'alaaheme maagudalaacehune yeqere baaye, mahari nawe

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'enanyaane 'alaahe kataweraate `eweqate dereshaa yasathaacawe 'ayehudaawiyaanene gudaaye 'alaawaqekemene? themematene baqenenate yelawethaalu 'enaanetane 'amaanyoceneme kaqathetanyaawe manegade 'enedetethamemu, yamale'eketanyaawene manegade tetaacehu ya'enaresune thamaamaa manegade 'enedetekatalu yefalegaalu

'alaahe thalaatocaacehune ka'enaaneta balaaye `aawaaqi nawe. me'emanaane hoye! 'enaresune maanenataacawene nagaraacehu thalaatenataacaweneme galatzalaacehu 'enaanetane ka'enaresu theqaate bamathabaqeme kawadaajenate bakule 'alaahe baqi hona kaseeraacawe 'enaanetane bamaadaane, ba'enaresume laaye yabalaaye bamaaderage karadaate bakule 'alaahe baqaa

ka'ayehudoce makaakale 'alaahe yaawaradawene qaale yamilawethu kefu hhezeboce 'alu 'alaahe baalaawaradaweme maleku yeqayerutaale. lamale'eketanyaaweme ba'anede nagare siyaazaacawe, <<qaalehene samaane te`ezaazehene 'amatzene>> yelaalu 'eyatasaalaqu <<semaa qaalaacenene 'atesemaanaa>> yelaalu <<raa`inaa>> bamile qaalaacaweme <<masemiyaahene 'awesane>> yamilu maselawe <<jelaacene (qilaacene)>> maalatene 'asebawe melaasaacawene yaathaamemaalu; baselaameme masaalaqene yefalegaalu 'enaresu <<qaalehene samaane te`ezaazeheneme fatzamene, ka'enyaa semaa yaanetaneme negegere 'esekeneradaa thabeqane>> bilu noro majamariyaa laaye kaalute yatashaalanaa yatasetakaakalame yehone nabare yeheme kamale'eketanyaawe gaare linore yamigabaawene sere`aate yathabaqa bamahonu nawe gene 'enaresune 'alaahe ragamaacawe bakehedataacaweme mekeneyaate ka'ezenatu 'araaqaacawe, yamithaqemaacawene 'emenatene 'ayaamenume

'enaaneta matsehhafe yatasathaacehu 'ayehude 'enaa keresetiyaanoce hoye! 'enaaneta zanede kataweraate 'enaa kanejile yaalawene 'aragaagaache bahonawe bamuhhamade laaye baawaradenawe malakotaawi male'ekete 'emanu! fitocene balaayaacawe laaye yaalutene yasemeete hhewaasaate 'abesane wada jarebaa kamaazoraacene bafite waye 'enanyaa katakalakalu baxwaalaa `aasaane bamaathemade denebare yaalafutene sawoce 'enedaragamenaacawe 'enaa malekaacawene wada zenejaronate 'enedalawathenawe saaneragemaacehu bafite 'emanu ya'alaahe te`ezaaze 'enaa wesaaneeme baregethe tafatzaami nawe

'alaahe ba'eresu laaye kafethuraanu 'anedu bigaaraabatenaa karesu gaare bimalake 'ayemereme kamaagaaraate 'enaa kakehedate malese yaalu wanejalocene gene lafalagawe bacerotaawe yemeraale waye bafetehawinatu kanaresu yafalagawene baszaraawe wanejale leke yeqathaale ba'alaahe laaye leelaa bamagazaate sherekene (maagaaraatene) yatagabara baregethe teleqe wanejalene fatherwale ba'alaahe laaye qathefwale

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'enanyaane raasaacawene 'enaa szeraawocaacawene lamaatheraate nafesaacawene yamiyaawadesu sawocene 'alaayahemene? ba'ewenatu kabaarocu yafalagawene yamiyaamogese 'enaa yamiyaatharaawe 'alaahe becaa nawe yeheme leboce yamidabequtene hulu `aawaaqi bamahonu nawe yatamere feree gelefaafi yaahele 'ayebadalume kaszaruteme 'ayeqanasebaacaweme
raasaacawene bamaawadase 'enedeete ba'alaahe laaye qethefatene 'enedamifatheru tamalekate baziheme lathememataacawe galaache wanejale kamahone 'anetzaare baqi hona

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaane kamatsehhafu ya`eweqate dereshaa wadatasathute 'ayehudaawiyaane 'aletamalakatekeme 'enaa 'aletagaramekemene?! badegemete 'enaa ka'alaahe leelaa 'amelaake 'aderegawe bayaazute yaamenaalu 'enanyaa ba'alaahe laaye yaagaarute thaa`otaawiyaane kahadiwoce ka'enanyihe kamuhhamade baaledaraboce manegade yabalatha yataqaanu naacawe yelaalu

'enanyaa 'enedihe yaala beleshu 'emenate yamiyaamenu 'enaresu 'alaahe ka'ezenatu yaaraaqaacawe 'enaa yaragamaacawe naacawe 'alaahe ka'ezenatu laaraaqawe sawe dagemo yamiwadaajawe 'agaazhe 'ataaganyelateme
kanegeszenaame 'anedaace nagare yalaacaweme yaa binoraacawemaa ba'anedite yatamere feree chaafe laaye yaalacene nathebe yaahele 'enekwaa lasawoce 'anedaace nagare 'ayesathume

sawoce muhhamadene 'enaa baaledarabocune (kanabiyenate, ka'emenate 'enaa bamedere laaye kamaamacaacate) 'alaahe katerufaatu basathaacawe tzagaa yemaqanywacawaale baregethe kaziyaa bafite laberaahime zereyaawoce kasamaaye yatawaradane matsehhafe; kamatsehhafe wecheme 'enyaa wadanaresu kaasetalaalafenawe thebabe taalaaqe negeszenaaneme sathetanaacawe saala lamene yemaqanyaalu?!

matsaahhefete katasathute makaakale baberaahime 'enaa ka'eresume baxwaalaa kazereyaawocu batalaakute nabiyaate laaye 'alaahe baawaradawe matsehhafe yaamana 'ala ka'eresu kamaamaneme yaafagafaga 'ala bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laayeme yaalaacaweme 'aqwaame yehene yemaselaale kanaresume lakaadute ka'aqaathaaye 'esaate bakule 'anetzaare jahaname baqaace

'enanyaa 'aneqatzocaacenene yakaadutene sawoce baferedu `elate 'enaresune kabaabi wada honace 'esaate 'enaasegabaacawaalane qodaacawe bataqaathalace quthere kareswa leelaa yahonane qodaa 'enelawethelaacawaalane yaame qethaatune 'enediqamesu 'enaa 'enedizawaterebaacawe zanede nawe 'alaaheme hulune 'ashanaafi, bamiyaasetanaaberawe 'enaa bamifaredawe hulu thebabanyaa nawe

'enanyaa 'alaahene yaamanu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalu, 'alaaheme yaazazawene malekaame szeraawoce yamiszaru bawesethwa zawetaariwoce sihonu kahhenetzaawocwa sere jeratoce yamifasubaatene ya'atekelete seferaa 'enaasegabaacawaalane la'enaresume bawesethwa kaqoshaashaawoce hulu yanatzu thenedoce (misetoce) 'alwacawe bawesethume muqatenaa qezeqaazee yaleelawe yamiyaasethalele safi yahona thelaa sere 'enaasegabaacawaalane

'alaahe 'enaaneta yataamanaacehubatene nagare wada baalabeetu 'enedetaadaresu, basawoce makaakaleme setefaredu, bafetehe 'enedetefaredu 'enedaatezanabalu 'enaa 'enedaatebadelume yaazezaacexwaale banagaraacehu hulu 'alaahe 'enaanetane yamimakerebate, yamimaraabate nagare menenyaa 'amaara. 'alaaheme negegeraacehune sami, tagebaaraacehuneme tamalekaace nawe

'enaaneta 'alaahene yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu hoye! 'alaahene taazazu, male'eketanyaawene 'enedihume bawanejale 'esekaalaazazwacehu derase ka'enaaneta yahonu yaselethaane baaletabeetocene (yame`emanaane mariwocene) taazazu ba'anedaace nagare betewazaagabu, baatesemaamume wada 'alaahe matsehhafe (qure'aane) 'enaa wada nabiyu falage (hhadise) malesute ba'alaahe 'enaa bamacharashaawe qane yametaamenu kahona 'enedihe 'aderegu yeheme bacheqecheqe wesethe kamaqoyate 'enedihume badama nafese kamanaagare wada 'alaahe matsehhafe 'enaa wada male'eketanyaawe falage mamalasaacehu yatashaala 'enaa madamedamiyaawe yaamaara nawe

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaane ka'ayehudoce makaakale negegeraacawe yamithaarase yahonutene 'asemasaayoce 'alaayahemene? baweshate baaneta 'enaa kaaneta bafiteme banabarute male'eketanyoce laaye bawaradawe 'enedamiyaamenu yenaagaraalu bacheqecheqaacawe gizee gene sawoce baaseqamathute ka'alaahe hege weche bahona thaa`otaawi ferede mafaaradene yefalegaalu yaanene 'enedikedu baregethe taazezawe nabare shayethwaneme kaziyaa baxwaalaa liyaasaasetaacawenaa yaraaqa thememate liyaathamemaacawe yefalegaale

'enanyaa 'asemasaayocene 'alaahe bamatsehhafu wesethe wadaaseqamathawe ferede, male'eketanyaaweme bakerekeraacehu yefaredelaacehu zanede wadaresu nu sibaalu wada leelaa lifaaradu kaaneta mashashene sishashu taayaacawaalahe

'asemasaayocu bamiszarute wanejale mekeneyaate cegere biyaaganyaacawenaa kaziyaame 'enyaa kaaneta weche bamafaaradaacene malekaamene nagare, 'enedihume batakaraakaariwocu mahakale maasemaamaatene 'eneji leelaa 'alaasabeneme belawe wadaaneta bimathu huneetaacawe 'enedeete yehone? baziheme 'enaresu weshataamoce naacawe 'enaho maasaamare ya'alaahene hege basawoce mahakale faraaje maaderage becaa nawe

'enanyaa balebocaacawe yamidabequtene maasemasale 'enaa kanetu felaagotaacawene 'alaahe yaaweqawaale 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! tawaacawe ka'enaresume raaqe 'eyaasekajaleke 'enaa 'eyaasefaraaraahe ya'alaahene ferede gelatzelaacawe banafesocaacawe wesethe yamimalaalase beretu qaale tanaagaraacawe

kamale'eketanyoce 'aneduneme male'eketanyaa ba'alaahe feqaade 'enaa wesaanee bamiyaazezawe nagare litaazazute 'eneji 'alelaakeneme 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaresu wanejalene bamaszeraate raasaacawene babadalu gizee, yaszarutene wanejale 'eyatanaazazu tatzatzaacoce 'enaa wada 'alaahe tamalaashoce honawe wadaaneta mathetawe, ka'alaahe yahonane meherate bithayequ 'anetame ya'alaahene meherate betethayeqelaacawe 'alaahe tzatzatene taqabaayenaa mahari hono yaaganyute nabare

gene nagaru 'enanyaa 'asemasaayoce 'enedaasabute 'ayedalame bageetaahe yehunebenye ('alaahe baraasu simele nawe) bamahakalaacawe batafatharawe 'alamasemaamaate 'anetane faraaje 'esekiyaadaregu kaziyaame feredehene 'enediwadu balebaacaweme kaferedu therethaaree 'enaa mathababe 'esekamaayenore mulu mataazazeneme 'esekitaazazu 'enaa 'eje 'esekisathu derase 'ewenatanyaa `emenatene 'ayaamenume

'enyaa ba'enaresu laaye kafilaacawe kafilaacawene 'enedigadele wayeme kamanoriyaacawe 'enediyaabaarere gede benaadaregebaacawe noro, theqitocaacawe 'eneji yamifatzemute 'ayenorume gene 'alaahene yaamasegenu; bamaayecelute 'alaazazaacaweme 'enaresume 'alaahene kamataazaze bakule yamigasatzubatene bitagaberu noro kamaqaarane yatashaala la'emenataacaweme matzenaate yabarataa yehone nabare yaane gizee ka'enyaa zanede taalaaqe menedaane 'enesathaacawe nabare wada 'alaahe 'enaa wada janate yamiwasedawene manegade 'enemaraacawe nabare

yehe yatathaqasawe menedaa 'alaahe babaarocu laaye yawaalawe cerotaawe nawe szeraawocene kamaawaqe 'anetzaareme `aawaaqinate ba'alaahe baqaa baszeraawocaacaweme yemanadaacawaale

'enaaneta 'alaahene yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalaacehu me`emanaane hoye! 'enaresune bamawaagaate yamiradaacehune madaarashaa bamayaaze kathalaatocaacehu mathabaqiyaane yaazu babudene babudene takafaafelaacehu waye ba'anedenate honaacehume wadanaresu wethu yeheme hulu la'enaaneta bamibaje 'enaa thalaatocaacehuneme bamigodaa maleku yehune

ka'enaanetame makaakale kaferehataacawe yatanasaa thalaatocaacehune lamagaadale setewathu yamizagaye 'ala raasaacawene 'azageyetawe leeloceneme wadaxwaalaa yaaseqaraalu 'enanyaame 'asemasaayoce 'enaa ba'emenate dakaamocu naacawe magadale wayeme mashanafeme bigathemaacawe, 'anedaacawe 'eresu bamaterafu bamadasate 'enee ka'enaresu gaare thorenate laaye baalamasaatafee 'alaahe dage welolenyaale, cegereme 'alaaganyanyeme yelaale

muselimoce hoye! 'enaanetane, ka'alaahe yahona cerotaa badele 'enaa bamereko malekaame biyaaganyaacehu dagemo, yaa kathorenate wada xwaalaa yaqarawe leke ka'enaaneta 'enedaalehona 'enedihume ba'enaaneta 'enaa ba'eresu makaakale wedeetaa 'enedaalenabara 'aderego bazihe thorenataacawe 'aberee banabareku 'enaresu yaaganyutene mereko bamaagenyate taalaaqe dasetaane bedasate 'enedeete theru nabare yelaale

'enanyaame yaqerebitwane `aalame neqawe, yamacharashaawene `aalame heyewate naafeqawe 'alaahene yamigazu 'amaanyoce ya'alaahe qaale yabalaaye tehone zanede ba'alaahe manegade yegaadalu ya'alaaheme qaale yabalaaye tehone zanede ba'alaahe manegade laaye sigaadale samaa`ete yahona wayeme yaashanafa 'enaa delene yataqadaaja taalaaqe menedaane 'enesathawaalane yaame janate 'enaa ya'alaahe wedeetaa nawe

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! 'enaaneta ya'eresune qaale yabalaaye letaadaregu ba'alaahe manegade 'enedaatetaagalu yamikalakelaacehu menedene nawe 'enanyaaneme kawanedoce kaseetoce 'enaa kalejoce dakaamaa yahonutene tetaadagu zanede kategele mene kalakalaacehu? 'enanyaane <<geetaacene hoye! kazihece nawaariwocwa badaaye kahonubate manedare 'awethaane, bathebaqaa 'enaa ba'enekebekaabee yamiyezanene wadaaje, ka'enyaame gudaatene yamiyaamathaalene radaate kaaneta zanede 'aderegelene>> belawe 'alaahene yamilamenutene lamataadage ba'alaahe manegade kamataagale mene 'agadaacehu?

'enanyaa 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyoce qaalune kafe lamaaderage ba'alaahe manegade laaye yegaadalaalu 'enanyaa kahadiyaane dagemo ba'amaaleketaacawe manegade laaye yegaadalaalu yashayethwaneneme radaatoce tagaadalwacawe 'enaaneta yataagalaacexwaacawe kahona taashanefwacawaalaacehu yeheme yashayethwane seeraa ba'alaahe laaye yamimaku sawocene magudaate yamaayecele dakaamaa bamahonu nawe

`elata motaacehu yadarasa 'enedahona yateme botaa betehonu mote yaaganyaacexwaale kategele meedaa ruqe 'enaa bamigabaa bataanatzu thanekaaraa takalaakaaye hhenetzaawoce wesethe 'enekwaa betehonu mote yaaganyaacexwaale 'enanyaane 'asemasaayoce yamiyaasedasetaacawe leje 'enaa bezu neberate siyaaganyu <<yehece ka'alaahe zanede nace>> yelaalu baleje, 'enedihume basisaaye yamithalute cheneqe siyaaganyaacawe dagemo nabiyune gadabise bamaaderage <<yehece kefu nagare baaneta mekeneyaate yamathaace nace>> yelaalu 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! malese setesathaacaweme - <<dasetaame, gudaateme hulume yamiragaagathute ba'alaahe ferede 'enaa wesaanee nawe>> balaacawe 'enazihe 'enedihe yaalane negegere yaminaagaru, yametelaacawene negegerehene yamaayeradute mene 'alaacawe?!

ya'adame leje hoye! kalejeme hona kasisaaye 'anetane yamiyaasedasetehene nagare biyaaganyehe, yaa ka'alaahe terufaate nawe balejeme hona basisaaye 'anetane yamiyaasekafaahe bigathemehe, 'aneta basaraakxawe wanejale mekeneyaate nawe 'aneta nabiye hoye! lasawoce hulu male'eketanyaa 'aderegane, yageetaacawene male'ekete tenageraacawe zanede laakenehe laanetame 'ewenatanyenate kamesekere bakule 'alaahe baqi hona

te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe male'eketanyaawene yataazazu; baregetheme la'alaahe te`ezaaze malese sathetwale 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta te`ezaaze yaafanagathane sawe szeraawene yameteqothaathare baresu laaye tathabaabaaqi 'aderegane 'alelaakeneheme szeraawene mazegebane yamenetasaasabawe 'enyaa nane

'enanyaa 'asemasaayoce te`ezaazehene 'enethabeqaalane, 'enetagaberaalane yelaalu kaaneta zanede bawathu gizee kanaresu yahonu cheferoce laaneta kagalatzulehe weche yahonane nagare badebeqe yaaseeraalu yamiyaaseerutene nagare 'alaahe kamaaneme balaaye `aawaaqi nawenaa baseeraacawe yemanadaacawaale. ba'enaresu gudaaye 'atethamade, 'anedaaceme 'ayegoduheme nagarehene hulu wada 'alaahe 'asethagaa, baresume tamakaa, mamakiyaa ba'alaahe baqaa

'enanyaame 'asemasaayoce yamuselimoce tzathetaa 'enaa dasetaa yaalabate 'aliyaame ferehate 'enaa tekaazee yayaaza zeenaa bamathaalaacawe gizee yaabaazutaale, yaasaraachutaale banagaru bitaagasu 'enaa wada male'eketanyaawe, 'enedihume yahasaabe, ya`eweqate 'enaa yamekere baaletabeete wada honu sawoce biyaamathute nore gudaayune batamalakata zeenaawe yesaraache waye yedabaqe bamilawe nagare mene madarage 'enedaalabate yahasaabe 'enaa yamaasetanetane baaletabeetoce yaawequte nabare. 'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! 'alaahe baselaame cerotaawe 'enaa baqure'aane 'ezenatu baaleyaazaacehu 'enaa 'enazihe 'asemasaayoce kawadaqubate fatanaa baayethabeqaacehu noro kanaaneta theqitoce siqaru yashayethwanene gutegotaa batakatalaacehu nabare

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! qaalune yabalaaye lamaaderage ba'alaahe manegade tagaadale kaaneta weche selaala sawe 'atethayaqeme, 'ategadadememe yeheme bategele laaye bametecelawe 'eneji baalamagadadehe nawe 'amaanyoceneme bategele laaye 'anasaasaacawe, 'abarataataacawe 'alaaheme bategelaacehu yakahadiyaanene theqaate liyaasewagede yecelaale 'alaaheme baxaayele 'enaa baqethaate bakule beretu nawe

laleeloce theqemene lamaaseganyate yamithaathaare kamenedaa dereshaa yenorawaale leelocene lamagudaate yamirwarwatheme kawanejale dereshaa yenorawaale 'alaaheme yasawe leje bamiszaraawe nagare laaye hulu masekaari nawe; yemanadaawaale kanaaneta makaakale lamalekaame nagare maganyate mekeneyaate yahona la'eresu kaziyaa menedaa dereshaa 'alawe lakefu nagare maganyateme madaarashaa yahona la'eresu kaziyaa hathi'ate dereshaa 'alawe

'anede sawe la'enaaneta salaametaa yaaqaraba 'enedahona 'eresu 'enaanetane kaakabarabate salaametaawe babalatha malesulate wayeme salaame yaalabatene `aayenate salaametaa malesulate babalatha mamalase balaache nawe 'alaahe bameteszarute laaye taqothaathaari selahona huluneme 'enedayaszeraawe yemanadaawaale

'alaahe ka'eresu baashaagare ba'ewenate yamimalake yalame baszeraacehu limanadaacehu laziyaa therethere yalabateme batenesaa'ee `elate hulaacehune hulu yesabasebaale banegegereme bakule ka'alaahe yabalatha 'ewenatanyaa yalame

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ka'asemasaayoce gaare baminorwacehu genenyunate hulate taqaaraani budenoce yahonaacehute lamenedene nawe? kafilaacehu kahadiyaane selahonu 'enegaadalaacawe, kafilaacehu dagemo 'amaanyoce selahonu magaadale 'ayebaqaame bamile lamene talayaayaacehu? bagudaayaacehu letelayaayu 'ayegabaame baszeraawocaacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe wada kehedate 'enaa thememate maleswacawaale 'alaahe wada 'ewenate yaalemaraawene 'enaaneta letemaru falagaacehune? 'alaahe baszeraawe mekeneyaate yaathamamawene la'eresu yaqenenate manegadene 'ataaganyelateme

'enanyaame 'asemasaayoce ba'enaaneta laaye batawaradawe betekedu 'enaa bakehedateme ka'enaresu gaare betesetakaakalu tamanyu. la'emenataacawe mesekere yehone zanede kakehedate hagare wada selaame hagare 'esekisadadu derase kathelaacaacawe gaare wadaajoce 'aderegaacehu 'enedaateyezwacawe ka'emenate kaafagafagu 'enaa bahuneetaacaweme laaye yaqathalu honawe kataganyu, baaganyaacexwaacawe botaa hulu yaazwacawe 'enaa gedalwacawe ka'enaresume banagaraacehu laaye yamiwadaajaacehu wadaajene, 'enedihume bathalaatocaacehu laayeme yamiyaagezaacehu 'agaazhene 'ateyaazu

ka'enaresu makaakale ba'enaaneta 'enaa ba'enaresu mahakale yathabaqa qaale kidaane yaalaacawe sawoce zanede yadarasa, wayeme dagemo 'enaanetaneme hhezebocaacaweneme lamagaadale yamaayefalegu honawe lebocaacawe baquchete yatathaababu honawe yamathubaacehu siqaru (leelocene 'atewadaaju) 'alaahe bifalege noro 'enaresune banaaneta laaye shumo yegaadalwacehu nabare ya'alaahene salaame 'aderaaginate taqabalu bamagedaleme bamamaarakeme 'enaresune 'ategaafathu 'enaanetane yamaayegaadalu honawe bireqwaacehu 'enaanetane magaadalene tetawe salaamaawi honawe bimathu yaane gizee 'alaahe la'enaaneta ba'enaresu laaye yamagedalene 'enaa yamaasarene manegade 'alaadaragame

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! leelocene dagemo ka'enaaneta gaare salaame yamahone 'emenatene yamigaletzu 'enaa kakahadiyaane hhezebocaacaweme salaame lamahone kehedatene yamigaletzulaacawe honawe taaganywacawaalaacehu 'alaahene maagaaraate 'enaa 'eresuneme wada makaade batatharu quthere 'ejegunu yenakaraalu (yezafaqaalu) 'enedazihe `aayenatocu 'enaanetane kamagaadale 'esekaaletawu 'enaa salaamaawi honawe 'esekaalemathulaacehu, ka'enaanetame 'ejocaacawene 'esekaalesabasabu derase baaganyaacehubaacawe botaa hulu yaazwacawe 'enaa gedalwacawe 'enaziyaane bazihe baaheriyaate tathaqaashocune 'enaresune lamayaaze 'enaa lamagedale la'enaaneta me'emanaane lakehedataacawe 'enaa seeraacawe geletze maaserajaane 'adereganaale

'anede 'amaanye leelaane 'amaanye basehetate yatakasata kaalehona basetaqare ligadele 'ayegabaaweme basehetate 'anedene 'amaanye yagadala sawe lawanejalu maabashaa yehonelate zanede 'amaanye yahonacene seete baariyaa natzaa maawethaate 'enaa bagadaaye beetasaboceme laaye latagadaaye beetasaboce yamisathute yadame kaasaa 'alabaacawe yamwace beetasaboce yadame kaasaawene yeqere belawe kaaletawute basetaqare (yadame kaasaa 'alabaacawe) mwace 'amaanye hono 'enaanetane kamiwaagu sawoce makaakale kahona bagadaaye laaye 'amaanye yahonacene seete baariyaa natzaa maawethaate 'alabate, yadame kaasaa gede 'ayehoneme mwace 'amaanye saayehone gene ba'enaaneta 'enaa ba'enaresu mahakale basalaame yamanore qaale kidaane kaalaacehu sawoce makaakale kahona, bagadaaye beetasaboce laaye lamwace waraashe beetasaboce yamisathe yadame kaasaa 'ala gadaaye dagemo 'amaanye yahonacene seete baariyaa natzaa maawethaate 'alabate natzaa yamiyaawathaawene 'aliyaame waagaawene lamakefale yaalaaganya bamahakalaacawe yaalamaaqwaarathe hulate waraate 'akataatelo matzome 'alabate yeheme 'alaahe kafatzamawe wanejale litaaraqawe zanede nawe 'alaaheme yabaarocene szeraa 'enaa hasaabe `aawaaqi, badenegaageewe 'enaa bamaasetanaabarume thebabanyaa nawe

'anedene 'amaanye sitaawaqawe yaala'agebaabe yagadala menedaawe bawesethu zawetaari lihone zanede jahaname magebaate nawe 'alaaheme yeqothaabataale ka'ezenatume yaareqawaale yeheneneme kabaade wanejale bamafatzamu mekeneyaate 'alaahe taalaaqe qethaate 'azagaajetolataale

'enaaneta 'alaahene yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalaacehu hoye! lategele ba'alaahe manegade bawathaacehu gizee yametewaagutene sawe gudaaye layetaacehu 'ewaqu 'eselemenaawene yamigaletze nagare yaasaayaacehunenaa salaame yaalaacehune sawe <<'aneta 'amaanye 'ayedalaheme selaamene 'enedetaasaaye yaadaragahe badamehe 'enaa neberatehe laaye yaalahe segaate nawe>> 'atebalute karesu merekonaa teneshe `aalamaawi theqemene falegaacehu 'ategedalute 'alaahe zanede bezu merekowoce 'alu yaame kazihe yatashaala 'enaa yabalatha nawe 'enaanetame 'enedihu kahhezebocu maamanune 'enedamidabeqawe sawe `aayenate nabaraacehu 'alaaheme baselaame 'abalatzagaacehu 'enaa damaacehune yatathabaqa 'adaragawe nagarene layetaacehu 'ewaqu, 'aragaagethu 'alaahe yameteszarute nagare wesethe `aawaaqi nawe baresume yemanadaacexwaale

'eneda hhemametanyoce 'enaa `aayena seweraane kaalehonu basetaqare kamu'eminoce makaakale 'enanyaa ba'alaahe manegade kamataagale yataqamathute 'enaa ganezabocaacawene 'enedihume nafesocaacawene masewaa`ete bamaaderage ba'alaahe manegade yamitaagalute 'ekule 'ayedalume 'alaahe 'enanyaane baresu manegade taagaayocene kataqamaachocu balaaye badarajaa 'asebalatha lahulume ba'alaahe manegade lamitaagaluteme, bamekeneyaate kategele laqaruteme, 'alaahe yamigabaacawene menedaa yekafelaale 'alaaheme taagaayocene karesu zanede yahonane taalaaqe menedaa bamasethate bataqamaachoce laaye 'abalathaacawe
yeheme menedaa, kafilu bakafilu laaye belechaa yaalawe darajaa sihone 'abalathaacawe badarajaawoce 'alaahe labaarocu wanejaloce mahari 'enaa la'enaresume 'azaanye nawe

'enanyaa kakehedate hagare wada selaame hagare masadadene bamatawe raasaacawene yabadalu sihonu malaa'ekete yamigadelwacawe sawoce 'enaresune bamaweqase maleku malaa'eketu 'esetenefaasaacawene siwasedu <<bamene huneetaa laaye nabaraacehu, kathaa`otaawiyaanuse bamene talayaacehu?>> yelwacawaale (mekeneyaateneme bamaaqerabe maleku) <<bamedere laaye gudaatene karaasaacene laaye yamenekalaakalebate belehateme hona xaayele yaalenabarane dakaamoce nabarene>> yelaalu. malaa'eketume <<kaweredate 'enaa kashenefate tedenu zanede letesadadubaate ya'alaahe medere safi 'alenabaracemene?>> yelwacawaale ya'enanyaame yaaletasadadute sawoce menedaa 'esaate nawe. kamamalashaame bakule menenyaa yakafaace nace

'enedihe kaalawe qethaateme 'enanyaa kawanedoce, kaseetoce 'enaa kahhetzaanaate yacegere baaletabeetoce 'enaa dakaamoce yahonute, karaasaacawe badalene 'enaa shenefatene mamakate yamaayecelute, kaalubateme weredate lamawethaate manegadene yamaayaawequte 'ayekaatatubateme 'enaziyaane 'alaahe ba'ezenatu 'enaa bareheraaheewe limeraacawe yekajalaale 'alaaheme baarocune yeqere baaye 'enaa ka'enaresume yatamalasutene taaraaqi nawe

'enedihe kaalawe qethaateme 'enanyaa kawanedoce, kaseetoce 'enaa kahhetzaanaate yacegere baaletabeetoce 'enaa dakaamoce yahonute, karaasaacawe badalene 'enaa shenefatene mamakate yamaayecelute, kaalubateme weredate lamawethaate manegadene yamaayaawequte 'ayekaatatubateme 'enaziyaane 'alaahe ba'ezenatu 'enaa bareheraaheewe limeraacawe yekajalaale 'alaaheme baarocune yeqere baaye 'enaa ka'enaresume yatamalasutene taaraaqi nawe

ba'alaahe manegade laaye celotaawe 'eyaala 'alamasadade kabaade mahonune ka tanaagara baxwaalaa sawoce 'enedesadadu 'enedihe bamaalate 'anasaasaa
ya'alaahene wedeetaa yamifalege hono kakehedate hagare wada selaame hagare yamisadade kaala, katasadadabate 'agare mazawaawariyaa 'enaa katawaweme mareete leelaa mareetene, bawesethwame keberene 'enaa safi sisaayene yaaganyaale kabeetume wada 'alaahe 'enaa male'eketanyaawe lamasadade watheto masadajaa hagaru saayedarese bafite mote yaaganyawe baregethe menedaawe ba'alaahe laaye tzanaa wada masadajaawe 'alamaderasu 'ayegodaaweme. 'alaaheme baarocune taaraaqi 'enaa 'azaanye nawe

bamedere laaye bametegwaazubate gizee, kakahadiyaane yametethalute nagare 'enedaayedaresebaacehu yametefaru kahona baala 'araate raka`aa salaatocene wada hulate raka`aa 'asaatheraacehu betesagedu banaaneta laaye hathi'ate yalabaacehume kahadiyaaneme la'enaaneta yaalaacawe thalaatenate geletze nawe thorenate balaleebate waqeteme guzo laaye 'esekahonu derase salaatene 'asaathero masegade ba tekekelanyaawe hhadise taragaagethwale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! thalaatene bamawaagaate gizee szaraawitu wesethe kahonekenaa ka'enaresu gaare salaatene maaqwaaqwaame betefalege szaraawitune bahulate cheferaa kefalawe 'anedanyaawe budene kaaneta gaare yesegade basegedatocaacaweme wesethe yathore masaariyaacawene yeyaazu leelaanyaawe budene dagemo 'enaanetane bamathabaqe laaye yequme yamajamariyaawe budene sawoce kaaneta kamaamu gaare 'anede raka`aane kasagadu yataqarawene baraasaacawe yaamwalu kaziyaame bathalaate salefe bakule kabasetajarebaacehu yequmu yaalesagadute 'enaa 'enaanetane bamathabaqe laaye yanabarute sawoce dagemo kaaneta kamaamu gaare 'anede raka`aa yesegadu 'anetame bacharaseke gizee yataqarawene salaataacawene baraasaacawe yaathanaaqequ kathalaatocaacawe mathaneqaqiyaacawene yeyaazu masaariyaacaweneme yetaathaqu, 'enanyaa yakaadute sawoce 'enaaneta bametesagedubate gizee kamasaariyaawocaacehu 'enaa ka`eqaawocaacehu yatazanaagaacehu kahonaacehu ba'enaaneta laaye ba'anedee tazanebelawe liyaathaqwaacehu yemanyaalu bazenaabe mekeneyaate cegere biyaaganyaacehu wayeme hemametanyoce betehonu 'enaa masaariyaawocaacehune betaaseqamethu banaaneta laaye wanejale yalabaacehume bameteceluteme hulu kathalaatocaacehu tathabaqu 'alaaheme lakahadiyaane 'awaaraaje yahonacene qethaate 'azagaajetolaacawaale

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! salaateme baabaqaacehu gizee bamaawadase,bamaamasegane 'enaa 'anedenatune bamamasekare bahuneetaacehu hulu qomaacehume, taqamethaacehume bagonaacehu tagaademaacehume 'alaahene 'awesu ferehateme ka'enaaneta batawagada 'enaa bataragaagaacehu gizee salaatene kamaa`ezanaatwa, kagedeetaawocwa 'enedihume katawadaaje tagwaadaanye kefelocwa gaare yatamwalaace 'aderegaacehu segadwate salaateme ba'amaanyoce laaye bagizee yatagadabace, gedeetaa honace selaziheme kawaqetwa bacegere kaalehona basetaqare maazageyate 'ayehoneme yehe bamanoriyaacehu setehonu nawe baguzo laaye gene maasaathare 'enaa masabesabeme tafaqedolaacexwaale

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! kahadiyaane thalaatocaacehune bamakatale 'enaa bamafalage 'atedekamu, 'atesalecu kamigathemaacehu gedeyaa 'enaa maqusele hemame bisamaacehu 'enaresume 'enedihu 'enaaneta 'enedametetaamamute yetaamamaalu 'enaaneta laaye yamidaresawe cegere `aayenate yedaresebaacawaale ya'enaresu te`egesete ka'enaaneta balaaye mahone yalabateme 'enaresu ka'alaahe yamaayekajelutene menedaa, 'eredaataa 'enaa 'egazaane 'enaaneta ka'alaahe tasefaa taadaregaalaacehu 'alaaheme yabaarocune huneetaa `aawaaqi bamaasetanaabaru 'enaa bahegegaatume thebabanyaa nawe

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enyaa baaneta laaye qure'aanene 'ewenatene yaaqafa 'aderegane 'awaradenawe badama nafesehe 'enaa bagele hasaabehe saayehone 'alaahe baasetamaarahe 'enaa baasaawaqahe basawoce mahakale tefaredebate zanede 'awaradenawe raasaacawene lamiyaataalelu 'enaa 'adaraacaweneme lamibalu sawoce 'enaresune ba'ewenate kamifaaradwacawe sawoce takaraakaari 'enaa dagaafi 'atehune
ka'alaahe meheratene 'enaa yeqeretaane thayeqe 'alaaheme kabaarocu makaakale wadaresu latamalasa mahari la'enaresume 'azaanye nawe
ka'enanyaame raasaacawene kamiyaataalelu sawoce gaare 'atekaraakare 'alaaheme 'ataalaaye 'enaa wanejalanyaa yahonane 'ayewademe

baferehate 'enaa ba'eferate wanejale sifatzemu kasawoce yedabaqaalu, ka'alaahe gene 'ayedabaqume ba`eweqatu 'enaresune bamakebabu 'alaahe ka'enaresu gaare nawe kanegegere 'eresu yamaayewadawene badebeqe bamiyaaseerubate gizee 'anedaaceme 'ayedabaqebateme kawanejalanyaawe lamakalaakale netzuhe yahonaweneme lamawanejale siyaaseeru 'alaahe yaaweqaacawaale 'alaaheme 'enaresu badebeqe 'enaa bageletzeme yamiszarutene ba`eweqatu yaakaababa nawe baszeraawocaacawe yemanadaacawaale

'enaaneta ya'enanyaa wanejale yamiszaru sawoce gudaaye yamiyaasechaneqaacehu hoye! baqerebitwa `aalame netzuhenataacawene lamaatzedaqe 'enaa ka'enaresume qethaatene lamaasewagade takaraakaraacehulaacawe baferedu `elate yahuneetaacawene 'ewenate yamiyaaweqawene 'alaahene maane nawe yamikaraakarelaacawe? baziyaaneme qane selanaresu tathayaaqi yamihonawese maanawe? maaneme yehenene 'enedamaayecele therethere yalaweme

'anede tzayaafe szeraane yaszaraa wayeme wanejalene bamaszeraate raasune yamibadele kaziyaame baxwaalaa thefaatune yatanaazaza, kawanejalu yaraaqa 'ena yatatzatzata hono ya'alaahene meherate yathayaqa 'alaahene maceeme lawanejalu mahari la'eresume 'azaanye hono yaaganyawaale
tenesheme yehune teleqe wanejale yaszaraa sawe 'enaho qethaatu ba'eresu laaye becaa nawe wada leelaa 'ayetalaalafeme 'alaahe yabaarocune szeraa `aawaaqi, bahegegaatume thebabanyaa nawe

wanejaleneme basehetate yafatzama wayeme 'eyataawaqawe hathi'ate yaszaraa belome kaziyaa wanejale fetzume netzuhe yahonane sawe yawanejala baziyaa tagebaaru baregethe teleqe 'ebelatene 'enaa hathi'atene tashakama

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'anetane bamathabaqe ya'alaahe terufaate baalenabara ka'enanyaa raasaacawene yamiyaataalelu sawoce cheferoce ka'ewenate liyaathamuhenaa yaalafeteheme 'enedetefarede liyaadareguhe 'asebawe nabare ba'ewenatu raasaacawene 'eneji leelaa 'ayaathamume. mekeneyaatume sawocene yamaasaasaate wanejale qethaatu wadanaresu tamalaashe bamahonu nawe 'alaaheme baaneta laaye matsehhafune 'awarada balebeheme laaye thebabene 'asaadara kaziyaa bafite yamaataaweqaweneme mamariyaa 'enaa berehaaneneme 'asaawaqahe laaneta yanabiyenate shumatene bamasethate 'enaa kasehetateme bamathabaqe 'alaahe baaneta laaye yawaalawe cerotaawe yalaaqa nawe

yelequneme ka'enaresu seeraa 'alaahe natzaa 'awethetotaale ba'akaale 'enaa bamanefasume chemere wadaresu kafe 'aderegotaale 'alaaheme banegeszenaawe 'ashanaafi, bamaasetanaabaru 'enaa bahegegaatume thebabanyaa nawe

matsehhafe katasathute sawoce makaakale baresu ba`isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) bamacharashaawe zamane bamiwaredebate gizee 'enaa kamamotu bafite baresu yamiyaamene bihone 'eneji 'anedeme 'ayenoreme. baferedume `elate `isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) baszaruteszeraa laaye ya'alaahene hege bamifatsemawe 'enaa bamithaarasawe laaye masekaari yehonaale

ba'ayehudoceme badale mekeneyaate kaziyaa bafite yatafaqadu kanabarute malekaame megeboce makaakale kafilune 'ereme 'adaragenebaacawe. baalathefere yahonutene hulu ba'enaresu laaye 'ereme 'adaragene kaqanede kabetoce, kabage 'enaa feyaloce jarebaawocaacawe yatashakamutene 'eneji yahode moraacawene 'ereme 'adaragenebaacawe raasaacawene 'enaa leeloceneme ka'alaahe manegade babezaate bamakalekalaacawe 'enaa sawoce kamalekaame makalekale magalachaa baaheriyaacawe bamahonu malekaame nagarocene 'ereme 'adaragenebaacawe

'alaahe 'enedaayethaqamu kakalakalaacawe baxwaalaa ya'araathaa ganezabene bamawesadaacawe yaala 'agebaabeme yasawocene neberate bamabelaataacawe ragamenaacawe ka'enaresume lakahadiyaanu 'asaamaami yahona qethaate 'azagaajanelaacawe

yamatsehhaafe baaletabeetocene mathefo gone katanaagara baxwaalaa kanasu mahaale 'amaanyocene thaqasanaa 'enedehe 'ala.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! gene ka'ayehudoce makaakale 'enanyaa ba`eweqate yamathaqute 'enaa yatzanute 'alaahe baaneta laaye baawaradawe qure'aane, taweraate 'enaa nejileneme bamasalu 'alaahe kaaneta bafite banabarute male'eketanyoce laaye baawaradaacaweme yaamenaalu salaatene yaaqwaaqumaalu,kaganezabocaacaweme zakaa yesathaalu ya'alaahene 'amelaakenate yaaragaagethaalu, bamacharashaaweme qane yaamenaalu 'enanyaaneme ba'enanyihe baaheriyaate tathaqaashocene taalaaqe menedaane 'enesathaacawaalane

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta bafite wadanabarute nabiyaate 'enedaawaradenawe hulu wadaanetame malakotaawi male'eketene 'asetalaalafene kamale'eketanyoceme mathee 'ayedalaheme wada nuhhe, karesu baxwaalaa wada mathuteme nabiyaate, wada beraahime wada hulate lejocu semaa`ile 'enaa sehhaqeme, wada sehhaqeme leje yaa`eqube, kayaa`eqube 'aseraa hulate lejoce zereyaa yaleje lejoce wadahonute nabiyaate male'eketene 'aweredanaale wada `isaa; 'ayube; yunuse; haarune;sulayemaane; malakete lekanaale. ladaawudeme matsehhafe sathetanawaale. 'eresume zabure nawe.

baaneta laaye taarikaacawene yathaqasenawene baanetame laaye yaaletarakenaacawene male'eketanyoce lekanaale 'alaaheme musaane yaala'aganaanye baqathetaa karesu kebere 'enaa le`elenaa bamigatheme maleku 'ewenatanyaa maanaagarene 'anaagerotaale

ba'alaahe yaamanane bataalaaqe menedaa 'abesaariwoce, yakaadaneme bakabaade qethaate 'asethaneqaaqiwoce 'aderegane laakenaacawe yeheme lasawoce male'eketanyoce wadanaresu katalaaku baxwaalaa maamelachaa maaserajaa 'enedaayenoraacawe laakene 'alaaheme banegeszenaawe 'ashanaafi baferedume thebabanyaa nawe

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'ayehudoce 'anetane biyaasetabaabeluheme 'alaahe kaqure'aane wadaaneta baawaradawe nagare 'ewenatanyenate yemasakeraale 'eresu kamiwadawe 'enaa kamithalaawe nagare baarocune liyaasaaweqebate ka`eweqatu 'awaradawe malaa'eketume bazihe bamathaakxawe nagare 'ewenatanyenate yemasakeraalu, kamesekerenate bakuleme 'alaahe baqaa
'enanyaa banabiyenatehe yakaadu 'enaa sawoceneme kaselaame yamikalakelu ka'ewenate ruqe yahona maraaqene baregethe reqawaale

'enanyaa 'alaahe 'enaa male'eketanyocune yakaadu nafesocaacaweneme bakehedate laaye bamaaqoyate yabadalu, 'alaahe 'enaresu yazawatarubatene kehedate limerelaacawe, ka'esaate yamithabeqaacaweneme manegade yamimaraacawe 'alehoname
bawesethwa zawetaariwoce lihonu wada jahaaname 'esaate yametewasedaacawene manegadene 'eneji (limaraacawe 'alehoname) yeheme ba'alaahe laaye gare hona 'anedaaceme 'ayaadaagetaweme

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! male'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) baregethe ka'alaahe yahonane mamariyaa 'enaa 'emenate yezo mathaacelaahu 'eresu yezo bamathaalaacehu 'emanu baziheceme bamachiweme `aalame la'enaaneta yabaja yehonaale 'alaahene betekedu 'alaahe ka'enaaneta 'emenate yatabeqaaqaa nawe kehedataacehu 'ayegodaaweme la'eresume basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere bamahakalaacawe yaalawe negesenaa hulu 'alawe 'alaaheme mamaraate lamaane 'enedamigabaa `aawaaqi banegegeru 'enaa batagebaaraatume thebabanyaa nawe

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaaneta matsehhafe yatasathaacehu yanejile baaletabeetoce keresetiyaanoce hoye! ba'emenataacehu denebare 'atelafu `isaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) batamalakata ba'alaahe laaye 'ewenatene 'eneji leelaa 'atenaagaru 'enaho 'alemasihhe yamareyame leje 'alaahe ba'ewenate yalaakawe male'eketanyaawe nawe. jiberilene wada mareyame balaakabaate ya<<hune>>qaalu fatharawe. 'enedafalagaweme sawe hono tafathara 'eresume jiberile ba'alaahe te`ezaaze bamareyame maahetzane 'enedinafaa taazo yanafaabaate 'esetenefaase nawe ba'alaahe 'enaa bamahakalaacaweme saatenathaathelu bamale'eketanyoce bamulu 'emanu 'amaalekete szosete selaaseewoce naacawe 'atebalu kazihece yaweshate 'abaabaale taqothabu kareswame maqothabe baziheceme bamachiweme `aalame lanaaneta yabaja yehonaale. 'enaho 'alaahe ka'agaare 'enaa kaleje yatharaa becanyaa 'amelaake nawe 'eresume yatabeqaaqaa nawe la'eresume yasamaayaate yamedere 'enaa bamahakalaacaweme yaala `aalame hulu negeszenaa 'alawe ka'asetanaabaari 'enaa katanekabaakaabime bakule ba'alaahe baqaa

`isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) la'alaahe baariyaa kamahone 'ayethayafeme, 'ayekoraame 'alaahe wadaresu yaaqarabaacawe darajaacawene kafe yaadaragawe malaa'eketeme 'enedihu 'ayethayafume 'enaame `isaane 'enedeete 'amelaake 'aderegaacehu teyezaalaacehu? 'agaariwocese malaa'eketene 'enedeete yaamalekwaacawaale? 'alaaheneme kamagazaate, kamaamelake yamithayafe 'enaa yamikoraa 'alaahe baferedu `elate huluneme wadaresu yesabasebaale huluneme 'enedamigabaawe yemanadaawaale

'alaahe baferedu `elate huluneme 'enedamisabasebaacawe kagalatza baxwaalaa ya'eyaanedaanedune menedaa sinaagare 'enedihe 'ala -
'enanyaa ba'alaahe yaamanunaa male'eketanyocuneme yaaragaagathu, la'alaahe yaatharu honawe malekaame szeraawocene bahegegaatu maszeraate yaszaru yaaletaqanasabaacawe sihone yaszeraawocaacawene menedaa yesathaacawaale baziheme laaye katerufaatu 'enaa kabago 'aderaaginatu yechamerelaacawaale 'enanyaa 'alaahene kamagazaate, 'enedihume kamataazazeme yatathayafu 'enaa yakorutene 'asaamaami bahona qethaate yeqathaacawaale ka'alaahe baashaagare 'enaresune yamiwadaaje 'enaa theqeme wayeme gudaate yamiyaamathaalaacawe radaate 'ayaaganyume

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! kageetaacehu zanede baregethe mekeneyaatene yamiqorethenaa mamasaasaleneme yamiyaasewagede geletze maaserajaa mathaalaacehu. 'eresume muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) nawe geletze yahonaneme berehane 'aweredanelaacexwaale 'eresume qure'aane nawe.

'enanyaa ba'alaahe yaamanu 'enaa 'alaahe banabiyaacawe laaye yaawaradaweneme qure'aane 'athebeqawe yayaazu, 'alaahe janate bamaasegabaate yaazenelaacawaale. menedaane 'enaa badarajaa kafe maalateneme yechamerelaacawaale bawesethu thememate yaleelabatene qathetanyaawene manegade yemaraacawaale yaame zala`aalamaawi wadahonawe janate yamiyaadaresawe manegade nawe

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'abaateme lejeme saayenorawe yamimotene sawe yawerese gudaaye yethayequhale <<'alaahe 'eresune batamalakata yaalawene ferede yesathaacexwaale>> balaacawe 'anede sawe 'abaateme lejeme saayenorawe kamota, ka'enaatu waye ka'abaatu yahonace 'ehete kaalacewe, teto kamotawe ganezabe gemaashu 'alalaate. ka'enaatu waye ka'abaatu becaa yahona wanedemu dagemo karesu gaare yagedeetaa leelaa waraashe kaleela batathabaabaaqinate yataqarawene neberate yewasedaale yagedeetaa leelaa waraashe 'abero kaala gene wanedeme kaziyaa baxwaalaa yataqarawene yewaresaale ka'enaateme ka'abaateme yahonu 'aliyaame ka'abaate becaa yahonu 'ehetoce ka'anede balaaye kahonu gene gede sihone hulate szosetanyaawene yewaresaalu ka'enaate 'enaa ka'abaate 'aliyaame ka'abaate becaa yahonu wanedemoce 'enaa 'ehetoce kahonu dagemo lawanede leje yahulate seetocene dereshaa bamasethate yewaresaalu 'alaaheme bawerese gudaaye manegade 'enedaatesetu zanede 'aneqatzocune yaaberaaraalaacexwaale 'alaahe nagarune hulu `aawaaqi nawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! ba'enaaneta 'enaa bafathaariyaacehu mahakale 'enedihume ba'enaaneta 'enaa ba'alaahe baaroce mahakale yatagabaawene yakabada qaale kidaane mulu. 'alaahe ka'eresu bahona 'ezenate lamaadaa 'enesasaatene; gemaloce, kabetoce 'enedihume bage 'enaa feyalocene 'aredaacehu 'enedetebalu faqada. 'eremenatu ba'enaaneta laaye yaminababawe siqare. 'enedihume bahhaje wayeneme ba`umeraa 'esaabee laaye saalaacehu kayabese 'adane ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme yaadaragawe siqare. 'alaahe bathebabu maszarate kamafeqade 'enaa 'ereme kamaaderageme bakule yafalagawene yefaredaale. 'eresune 'asegadaaje fereduneme taqaawaami yalame.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahe 'enedetaalequte yaazazaacehune yatakabaru denebarocune bamadefare yatafaqadu 'ataaderegu. kahheraame (kahhaje 'enaa `umeraa laaye yaa'elaacehu 'enedeteqothabu yatadaragu) kelekeloceme tathabaqu. 'enasume yatasafaa lebese 'eneda malebase, kahharameme yatakabaru nagaroce 'eneda 'adane, batakabaru waraate wesethe magaadalene, la'alaaheme lisawaa wada hharame yaminadaane 'enesesaa bamanethaqe wayeme wadabotaawe 'enedaayedarese bamakalekale 'eremene yatafaqada 'ataaderegu. lamasawaate kasufe 'enaa kamasaasalute yahona maasariyaa gamademe yaalabaacawene 'enesesaate 'atedefaru. yanegedene terefe 'enaa ya'alaahene wedeetaa 'asaabiwoce honawe wada 'alaahe beete 'aqethaachaa (yamiyaasebu) sawoceneme 'atedefaru. bahhaje 'enaa `umeraa 'esaabee hheraame yafataacehu bahonaacehu 'enaa kahharame setewathu kafalagaacehu yaane gizee 'adane 'akaahidu. yasawoce 'enaanetane katakabarawe beete yamakalekalaacawe thelaacaa ba'enaresu laaye badalene 'enedetefatzemu 'enaa fetehene 'enedeterequ 'ayaaderegaacehu. 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! yataazazaacehutene bamaszeraate yatakalakalaacehuteneme bamaraaqe tagaagazu. qethaate bamiyaasekatele wanejale 'enaa basawoce dame; ganezabe;'enedihume keberene bamadefare laaye 'atetabaabaru. te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'enaa ka'amatze bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru. 'alaahe laamatzawe sawe qethaata beretu nawe, kaqethaatume tathaneqaqu.
