'alaahe ka'enesesaate bahheyewate saala saayetaarade yamotane, yabakatane 'ereme 'adaragabaacehu. fasaashe dameneme, ya'asaamaa 'enaa yakarekaro segaaneme, sitaarademe ka'alaahe seme weche yatawasaabatene, taaneqaa yamotacene, baberetu mete yamotaceneme, kagadale 'afaafe wadeqaa, baqanede tawagetaa yamotaceneme hulu 'ereme 'adaraga. 'eneda 'anebasaa, nabere, jebe 'enaa takulaa yaalu 'awereewoce yanakaswacawene 'enaaneta baheyewate saalu daresaacehu yaaradaacehute siqare 'ereme tadaraga. lathaa`ote yatasawaaneme 'enedihu 'ereme 'adaraga. <<'aderege>>, <<'ataaderege>> yatatzaafabaacawene `ethaa mathaathaayaane 'enechate wayeme denegaayocene bamathaqame 'alaahe dereshaa yaadaragalaacehune lamaawaqe debeqe `eweqatene mafalagaacehuneme 'ereme 'adaraga. 'enanyihe yatathaqasutene 'ereme nagaroce mafatzame ka'alaahe te`ezaaze maafanegathe nawe. zaaree 'enanyaa kahadiyaane yaselaamene xaayaalenate kaayu baxwaalaa muselimoce ka`emenate yemalasaalu maalatene tasefaa qorethawebataale. 'enaresune 'ateferwacawe; 'eneene becaa feru. zaaree 'emenataacehune selaamene molaahulaacehu. geletze 'enaa debeqe yahonu tzagaawoceene hulu 'amwalaahulaacehu. lahheyewataacehu mamariyaame selaamene marathekulaacehu. karesu baashaagare leelaa `emenatene 'aleqabaleme. wada wanejaleme yatazanabala saayehone barahabe mekeneyaate bakete lamabelaate yatagadada baresu laaye haathi'ate yalabateme. 'alaahe mahhari 'enaa 'azaanye nawe.

'alaahe bamabele ragade yatakalakalutene kazarazara baxwaalaa yatafaqadaweneme sinaagare 'enedihe 'ala -
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! baaledarabocehe <<'alaahe kamibalaa nagare yafaqadawe menedene nawe?>> silu yethayequhale. 'enediheme balaacawe <<'alaahe kamibalu nagaroce malekaamocene faqada. baala keraanecaa therese yahonu 'eneda weshaa 'enaa nabere yaalu 'enedihume 'eneda nesere 'amoraa baala thefere yahonu, ba'adane yasalathanu 'enesesaate, 'alaaheme kaasaawaqaacehu ya'adane sere`aate yaasetamaaraacexwaacawe 'adaanye 'enesesaateme kaadanute lamabelaate tafaqadalaacehu. 'adaanye 'enesesaatu sitaazazu kataazazu, sikalakalume katakalakalu, baadanuteme nagare laaye taamaanye kahonu yaadanute yatafaqada nawe. bigadeluteme 'enekwaane yaadanutene belu. 'adaanye 'enesesaatuneme la'adane setaasamaarwacawe ya'alaahene seme 'awesu. te`ezaazune bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru. 'alaahe laszeraawoce gemegamaawe fathaane nawe.

zaaree malekaame nagarocene mathaqame tafaqadalaacehu. ka'ayehude 'enaa nasaaraa matsaahhefete yatasathute sawoce yaaradute, tafaqadalaacehu. ya'enaanetame 'erede la'enaresu tafaqada. ka'amaanye seetoce chawaa 'enaa thebeqe yahonutene maagebaate tafaqadalaacehu. ka'enaaneta bafiteme matsaahhefete katasathute 'ayehude 'enaa nasaaraa makaakale thebeqe 'enaa chawaa yahonutene maagebaate tafaqadalaacehu. yaame yagaabecaa sethotaane (maherene) yasathaacehu 'enedahona, yazemutene tzayaafe tagebaare kamaszeraate yatathabaqaacehu. ka'enaresu gaare zemute lamafatzame debeqe wadaaje ('afeqaari) yaazhiwoceme saatehonu maagebaate tafaqadalaacehu. 'alaahe labaarocu yadanagagaacawene hegegaate yamikede szeraawe baregethe tabalaasha. 'eresume baferedu `elate 'esaate bamagebaate kakasaariwoce yehonaale.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! salaate lamasegade maqome setefalegu, teneshu menaabaawi qoshaashaa yanakaacehu kahonaacehu wudu'e 'aderegu. yaame fitocaacehune bamaathabe, 'ejocaacehuneme kakerenoce gaare bamaathabe, raasaacehune (tzaguraacehune) bamaabase 'egerocaacehune (yabaate 'enaa yamaregachaa 'egerene yamilayutene hulate wathaa yaalu 'athenetocene) qurechemechemitocene chamero bamaathabe wudu 'aderegu. telequ rekesateme biyezaacehu sawenataacehune taathabu. hemametanyoce honaacehu yahemamune machamare 'aliyaame yamadaane gizeewene maraazame betefaru wayeme batheenenate baguzo laaye betehonu wayeme wada matzadaajaa heedaacehu teneshu rekesate biyaaganyaacehu (wudu mafetaate) wayeme seetocene bamaganaanyate telequ rekesate biyaaganyaacehunaa yametetzadaadubate weha falegaacehu betaathu, yaane gizee netzuhhe yamareete gatzetaane 'asebu. mareetuneme 'anedee bamadaafocaacehu metunaa fitocaacehune 'enaa 'ejocaacehune 'abesu. 'alaaheme 'enaanetane wada magudaate yamiyaadarese, mene gizeeme baweha mathaqamene gede bamaaderage ba'enaaneta laaye bahegegaatu cheneqe maaderage 'ayefalegeme. 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye yawaalawene tzagaaweneme lamaamwalaate lacegere 'enaa lahemame, weha bataathaa gizee baresu faanetaa ba'afare mathaqame meteke 'adaragalaacehu. baziheme taamasagenute zanede 'agaraalaacehu.

'alaahe 'enaanetane wada selaame bamameraatu yawaalalaacehune tzagaawene 'asetaawesu. 'enaanetame male'eketanyaawene batadelaame bacegereme gizee lamasemaate 'enaa lamataazaze, qaalehene samaane te`ezaazehene 'akabarene baalaacehu gizee 'alaahe ka'enaaneta yawasadawene qaale kidaane 'asetaawesu. te`ezaazune bamafatzame yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru. 'alaaheme leboce wesethe yaalawene `aawaaqi nawe. kaziyaame 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayedabaqebateme.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! ya'eresune fite yafalagaacehu honaacehu 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye yaalawene mabete yametaadaresu hunu. babadale saayehone bafetehe masekaariwoce hunu. yasawoce thelaacaa fetehene 'enedeterequ 'ayaaderegaacehu. fetehawinate lawadaajeme lathalaateme tagabi nawenaa. kahulatume gaare fetehawi hunu. fetehe 'alaahene wada maferaate, badaleme baresu laaye wada maamatze yaqaraba nawe. 'alaaheneme feru. 'alaaheme yameteszarutene nagare wesethe `aawaaqi nawe. kaszeraawocaacehume 'anedaaceme 'ayedabaqebateme.

qaalune yamaayaathefawe 'alaahe 'enanyaane baresu 'enaa bamale'eketanyoce yaamanutene 'enaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszarutene wanejalocaacawene 'enedamimere 'enaa lamalekaame szeraacaweme janate bamaasegabaate taalaaqe menedaane 'enedamisathaacawe qaale gabaalaacawe.

'enanyaa 'alaahene yakaadu 'enaa 'aneqatzocuneme yaasetabaabalu 'enaresu ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe. bakehedataacawe 'enaa bamaasetabaabalaacawe mekeneyaate 'esaate yegabwataale. gwaadanyaame gwaadanyaawene 'athebeqo 'enedamiyezawe 'ayenathalwateme.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! 'enanyaa yakaadu sawoce 'enaanetane liyezwacehu 'enaa liyaathaqwaacehu 'ejocaacawene wadanaaneta lamazaregaate baasabu gizee, 'alaahe balebocaacawe wesethe ferehate bamanezaate kanaaneta galale baadaragaacawe 'enaa 'enaanetane bathabaqa gizee banaaneta laaye yawaalawene tzagaawene balebonaacehu 'enaa ba'anedabataacehu 'awesu. 'alaaheneme feru. me`emanaaneme baqerebitwame hona bamachiwe `aalame yamibajaacawene lamaagenyate ba'alaahe laaye becaa yemaku.

'alaaheme kaseraa'eele lejoce yakabadane qaale kidaane yaaza. 'aseraa hulate tathariwoceneme banaresu laaye shumo laakabaacawe. 'eyaanedaanedu mari baseru lamimaraawe taqothaathaari nabare. 'alaaheme laseraa'eele lejoce 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<'enaaneta batagabiwe manegade salaatene kaaqwaaqwaamaacehu kaganezabocaacehume zakaa kasathaacehu, bamale`eketanyoceeme bamahakalaacawe saatenathaathelu bahulume kaamanaacehu, kaakabaraacexwaacawe 'enaa karadaacexwaacawe, bamalekaame manegade laaye kamatzawataacehu, 'enee 'enaanetane bamaredaate 'enaa bamaagaze 'abereeyaacehu nanye. 'enanyihene tagebaaraate kafatzamaacehu yaszaraacehutene wanejale hathi'ataacehune 'abeselaacexwaalahu. kahhenetzaawocwa sereme jeratoce yamifasubaatene ya'atekelete seferaa baferedu `elate 'asegabaacexwaalahu.>> kanaresume 'enedihe yaalawe yakabada qaale kidaane katayaaza baxwaalaa yakaada baregethe qathetanyaawene manegade setwale.

kanaresu yatayaazaweneme qaale kidaane bamaaferasaacawe mekeneyaate ka'ezenataacene 'abaararenaacawe. lebocaacaweneme yadaraqu 'adaragenaacawe. malekaame yamaayedaresebaacawe 'enaa mekere yamaayegabaacawe honu. ya'alaaheneme negegere qaalaatune bamalawathe semeetocaacaweneme bamigatheme maleku teregumune bamaazore kamaszarataawi botaawe yelawethutaale. batagasatzubate bakafilu maszeraateneme tawu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'enaresu 'alaahene 'enaa ya'alaahene baaroce siyaataalelu kamaayate 'atewagademe. 'alaahe 'enaresune yayaazawene qaale kidaane yafatzamute theqitoce naacawe. yeqere balaacawe, 'ateyaazaacawe. sitaawaqeheme 'elafaacawe. yaame kamaasaamare nawe. 'alaahe 'asaamaariwocene yewadaale.

ka'ayehudoce yakabada qaale kidaane 'enedayaazene hulu, ya`isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) takataayoce nane bamaalate raasaacaweneme kamiyaatharute keresetiyaanoceme yakabada qaale kidaanaacawene yaazene. qadametocaacawe 'ayehudoce 'enedazanagute hulu 'enaresume yatagasatzubatene nagare maszeraatene tawu, zanagu. bamakaakalaacaweme 'eseka feredu `elate yamiqoye kerekere 'enaa kabaade thelaacaane 'aseqamathene. kafilaacaweme kafilaacawene bakehedate yamigaletze, 'erese barese yamithalaalu 'enaa yamigaadalume honu. 'alaaheme yeszarute yanabarawene nagare yenageraacawaale; baziyaame laaye yemanadaacawaale.

'alaahe (subehaanahu wata`aalaa) yamatsaahhefetune sawoce, 'eresume kanaresu yayaazawene qaale kidaane 'enaa qaalaacaweneme maaferasaacawene kathaqasa baxwaalaa bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'enediyaamenu theri 'aqarabalaacawe. 'enediheme 'ala -
'enaaneta yataweraate 'enaa yanejile baaledaraboce, yamatsaahhefetu baaletabeetoce hoye! male'eketanyaacene muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame), wadanaaneta katawaradawe matsehhafe bezuwene tedabequte yanabaraacehutene nagare yamiyaaberaaraalaacehu, kaziyaame 'enaanetane maasaathaate 'enaa maawaarade 'eneji leelaa theqeme yaleelawene 'abezaanyaawene nagare yamiyaalefe hono mathaalaacehu. ka'alaahe yahona matsehhafe qure'aane mathaalaacehu. sawoce manegade yamimarubate berehaane, ba`aalamaawi 'enedihume ba`emenate gudaayaacawe yamiyaasefalegaacawene nagare 'aberaari yahoname matsehhafe mathaalaacehu.

baziheme matsehhafe 'alaahe ba`emenate 'enaa bamalekaame szeraa ya'eresune wedeetaa yamikatale sawe kaqethaate yamidenebatene manegade yemaraabataale. yaame wada janate yamiyaadaresawe manegade nawe. baziheme bafeqaadu kakehedate chalamaawoce wada `emenate 'enaa mataazaze berehaane yaawathaacawaale. wada qathetanyaaweme yaselaame godaanaa yemaraacawaale.

kakeresetiyaanoce makaakale 'enanyaa 'alaahe maalate 'eraasu 'alemasihhe `isaa yamareyame leje nawe yaalute baregethe kedawaale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe yamareyame leje masihhene, 'enaatune mareyamene 'enaa bamedere laaye yaalutene fethuraane bamulu liyaathafaacawe bifalege liyaadenaacawe yamicelawe maanawe? balaacawe. 'enaame 'alaahe yehenene kamaaderage yamikalakelawe 'anedaaceme 'akaale 'alamanoru karesu baqare ba'ewenate limalake yamigabaa leelaa 'amelaake 'enedaleela yaaseradaale. 'enedihume hulaacaweme, `isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enaatume mareyame 'enaa bamedere laaye yaalu fethuraane bamulu ya'alaahe baaroce mahonaacawene yethaqumaale. yasamaayaatu, yamederu 'enaa bamahakalaacawe yaalu nagaroce negeszenaa hulu ya'alaahe nawe. yafalagawene yefatheraale. lifatheraacawe kafalagaacawe 'enaa kafatharaacawe 'akaalaate makaakale dagemo ya'alaahe baariyaa 'enaa male'eketanyaawe yahonawe `isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) yeganyebataale. 'alaaheme hulune nagare caaye nawe.

'ayehudoce 'enaa keresetiyaanoce hulaacaweme <<'enyaa ya'alaahe lejoce 'enaa wadaajoce nane>> silu tanaagaru. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! malese setesathaacaweme <<'enegediyaawese baszaraacehute wanejale selamene yeqathaacexwaale? lejocu 'enaa wadaajocu betehonume bazihece `aalame bamagedale 'enaa malekaacehuneme wada zenejaronate bamalawathe bamachiweme `aalame ba'esaate baaleqathaacehu nabare>> balaacawe. mekeneyaatume yawadadawene 'ayeqathaamenaa. yelequse 'enaaneta 'enedataqarute sawoce hulu sawoce naacehu. kanaaneta makaakale yaasaamarane bajanate yemanadaawaale. yaathafaane 'enaa yaabalaashane dagemo ba'esaate yeqathaawaale. 'alaaheme baterufaatu lafalagawe yemeraale. yafalagaweneme bafetehaawinatu yeqathaale. basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere, bamahakalaacaweme yaalu nagaroce negesenaa hulu ya'alaahe nawe. mamalashaame wadaresu becaa nawe.

'enaaneta ka'ayehude 'enaa kakeresetiyaanoce matsaahhefete yatasathaacehu hoye! male'eketanyaacene muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) male`eketanyoce bataqwaachubate 'enaa 'eresuneme wadasawoce malaake 'asefalaagi bahona gizee mathaalaacehu. yeheme, <<ya'alaahe menedaane yamiyaabaserane kaqethaatume yamiyaasethanaqeqane male'eketanyaa 'alemathaaleneme>> belaacehu mekeneyaate 'enedaataaqarebu nawe. ya'alaahene menedaa yamiyaabaseraacehu 'enaa kaqethaatume yamiyaasethanaqeqaacehu male`eketanyaa baregethe mathaalaacehu. 'alaaheme nagarocene hulu caaye 'enaa 'anedaaceme nagare yamaayesaanawe nawe. kacelotaaweme male'eketanyocene malaaku 'enaa muhhamadeneme (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) madamedamiyaacawe maaderagu nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! musaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) lahhezebocu, laseraa'eele lejoce, hhezebocee hoye! 'enaanetane wada qathetanyaawe manegade yamitharwacehune nabiyaatene banaaneta wesethe baadaraga 'enaa sawoce baaroce kaadaragwaacehu baxwaalaa natzaa 'awethetwacehu nagaszetaateme baadaragaacehu, bazamanaacehume kaalute `aalamaate makaakale lamaaneme yaalesathawene sisaaye basathaacehu gizee 'alaahe yawaalalaacehune tzagaa balebonaacehu 'amenaacehu ba'anedabataacehu masekeru baala gizee 'awesaa.

musaame - <<hhezebocee hoye! yaacine 'alaahe 'enedetegabwate 'enaa bawesethwame yaalutene kahadiyaane 'enedetewaagu la'enaaneta yatatzaafutene 'enaa qaale yagabaalaacehune yataqadasacewene medere (bayetale maqedise 'enaa 'akaabaabiwocwane) gebubaate, wada xwaalaame 'atemalasu; ba'amebaagananocu fite tashanaafiwoce 'atehunu; macharashaacehu baziheceme, bamachiweme `aalame kisaaraa yehonaale. yakasaraacehu honaacehu temalasaalaacehu>> baala gizee 'awesaa.

hhezebocume, <<musaa hoye! bataqadasacewe mareete wesethe 'amebaaganane 'enaa yaxaayele baaletabeete yahonu hhezeboce 'alu. yeheme kamagebaate yekalakelanaale. 'enazihe bawesethwa 'eyaalu lamaceeme 'anegabaabaateme, mekeneyaatume 'enaresune yamenewaagaabate xaayeleme belehaateme yalaneme. 'enaresume kareswa kawathu 'enyaa yaane gizee wadareswa gabiwoce nane>> 'alute.

kamusaame baaledaraboce makaakale 'alaahene kamifaru 'enaa kamithanaqaquteme, 'alaahe 'eresune lamataazaze bamagethame tzagaawene yaagonaatsafaacawe yahonu hulate sawoce hhezebocaacawene yamusaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) te`ezaazene 'enedifatzemu yamiyaanasaaswacawe honawe ba'enanyaa 'amebaagananoce laaye yakatamaayetune bare becaa 'alefaacehu gebu. barune 'alefaacehu bagabaacehu gizeeme ba'alaahe faqaade taashanefaalaacehu. ba'ewenate 'amaanyoceme 'enedahonaacehu ba'alaahe laaye becaa tamaku.

kabani seraaloceme yamusaa hhezeboce yanabiyaacawene yamusaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) te`ezaaze bamaqaawame laaye yatzanu honawe; <<'enanyaa 'amebaagananoce bawesethwa 'esekaalu derase bafetzume 'anegabaame. musaa hoye! 'aneta 'enaa geetaahe hidunaa 'enanyaane 'amebaagananocene tawaagu. 'enyaa gene kanaaneta gaare heedane yamenewaagaa saayehone 'ezihu baalanebate botaa 'eneqoyaalane>> 'alute.

musaame lageetaawe; <<geetaayee hoye! 'enee baraasee 'enaa bawanedemee harune laaye 'eneji baleeloce laaye yamaazaze selethaane yalanyeme. ba'eneenaa ka'aneta 'enedihume kamale'eketanyaahe te`ezaaze baafanagathu sawoce mahakale feredene sethe.>>

'alaaheme lanabiyu musaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enedihe 'ala <<'alaahe babani seraa'eele laaye la'arebaa `aamate bayetale maqedise magebaatene 'ereme 'aderegwaale. bazihe gizee wesethe 'enaresu wada 'agaraacawe yamaayemarunaa babarahaa wesethe yawaalalu honawe yeqoyaalu. musaa hoye! 'enazihe ka'alaahe te`ezaaze baafanagathu sawoce mekeneyaate 'atezane. cegere bigathemaacawe ba'emebitanyenataacawe mekeneyaate yamathaabaacawe qethaate nawe.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'enanyaa ka'ayehudoce makaakale meqanyoce 'enaa badaayoce bahonute laaye ya'enanyaane yahulatune ya'adamene lejoce qaabile 'enaa haabile taarike therethere yaleelabate 'ewenataa sihone 'awesaalaacawe - <<hulataacaweme wada 'alaahe yamiqaarabubatene qurebaane ba'aqarabu gizee 'alaahe taanaashu haabile yaaqarabawene qurebaane taqabala. yaame 'eresu 'alaahene kamifarute sawoce selanabare nawe. yaqaabileneme qurebaane saayeqabale qara. yaame 'alaahene kamifaru sawoce yaalenabara bamahonu nawe. kaziyaame qaabile bameqanyenate yahaabile qurebaane taqabaayenate maagenyatune thalaa. "haabile hoye! 'enee 'egadelehalawe" 'alawe haabileme "'enaho! 'alaahe qurebaanene yamiqabalawe te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe 'eresune kamifaru sawoce nawe" 'alawe.

"'aneta 'eneene lamagedale bamaasabe 'ejehene wadanee betezaragaa, 'enee 'aneta yaadaragekawene lamamalase beyee 'ejeene wadaaneta 'alezaragaame. yaa dagemo baferehaate saayehone 'enee ya`aalamaatune geetaa selamefaraa nawe" 'alawe.

'eyaasefaraaraaweme, "'eneene babadale yagadalekebatene wanejale kaqademo wanejalehe gaare 'akelahe 'enedetemalase 'enaa kaziyaame baferedu `elate wada 'esaate kamigabute ya'esaate gwaadoce 'enedetehone 'efalegaalahu. yeheme yadenebare 'alaafiwoce menedaa nawe. 'enee dagemo 'anetane yamagedalene wanejale tashakemee ka'esaate gwaadoce mahonene 'alefalegeme" 'alawe.

laqaabileme yaace bakefu 'azaazhe yahonace nafesu yawanedemune yahaabilene gedeyaa malekaame 'aderegaa 'asaayacewe 'enaa gadalawe. baziheme malekaame `edelene bamaasaathaate nafesocaacawene kakasaru sawoce hona.

'alaaheme 'anede 'amoraane yamotane 'amoraa liqabere mareetene yamichere sihone wada 'eresu laaka. yeheme yawanedemune 'asekereene 'enedeete 'enedamishafene liyaasaayawe nabare. wanedemune gadaayeme 'amoraawune baaya gizee 'ala wayenee yawanedemeene 'akaale lamaqebare 'enedazihe 'amoraa mahone 'aqaatanyene? bamaalateme shafanawe katatzatzaacoceme hona.

qaabileme wanedemune bamagedalu mekeneyaate yaseraa'eelene lejoce 'enedihe senele 'asaawaqene - <<sawene gadelo ba'atzafaa, wayeme bakehedate 'enaa bathorenate bamedere wesethe bamaathefaate kaalehona basetaqare yaala 'anedaace mekeneyaate netzuhe nafesene yagadala, sawocene hulu 'enedagadala yeqotharebataale. mekeneyaatume 'eziyaa sawe zanede netzuhe 'enaa wanejalanyaa 'ekule bamahonaacawe nawe. 'alaaheme 'ereme yaadaragaatene nafese 'eremenatune 'ameno kamagedale yataqothaba, 'aneditene la'adagaa yatagaalathace nafeseneme yaradaa sawocene hulu heyaawe 'enedaadaraga yeqotharelataale.>> male'eketanyocaaceneme wada seraa'eele lejoce geletze yahonu maaserajaawocene yezawe mathulaacawe. yehe kamahonu gaare gene 'abezaanyocaacawe wanejalene bamaszeraate 'enaa male'eketanyocene bamaqaawame bamedere laaye ya'alaahene denebare yatalaalafu honu.

'enaho ya'enanyaa 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yamiwaagu, thalaatenatene yefaa yamiyaadaregu, sawene bamagedale, ganezabene bamazerafe 'enaa manegadene bamaqwaarathe bamedere laaye thefaatene yamiyaasefaafu sawoce menedaacawe ligadalu, 'aliyaame lisaqalu wayeme 'ejoce 'enaa 'egerocaacawe 'eyatanaagu liqorathu (majamariyaa qanye 'eje 'enaa geraa 'egere, katamalasabate dagemo geraa 'eje 'enaa qanye 'egere) wayeme kamedere libaararu 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame. yehe qethaate la'enaresu bamedere laaye weredate nawe. la'enaresume bamachiwe `aalame 'asaamaami yahona qethaate 'alaacawe.

'enaaneta yamaasetadaadare baaletabeetoce hoye! kananyaa 'amatzanyoce makaakale 'enaaneta saatedaresubaacawe bafite wada 'alaahe yatamalasute siqaru katzatzataacawe 'enaa kamamalasaacawe baxwaalaa 'alaahe 'enaresune mahari 'enaa la'enaresume 'azaanye mahonune `ewaqu. ka'ezenatume makaakale 'alaahe batzatzataacawe mekeneyaate qethaatene kanaresu wedeqe maaderagu nawe.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru. yaazazaacehuneme bamafatzame wadaresu maqerabene falegu. baziheme yametefalegutene nagare taaganyu 'enaa kametethaluteme terequ zanede nawe.

'enanyaa 'alaahe 'enaa male'eketanyocune yakaadu la'enaresu bamedere laaye yaalawe nagare hulu ya'eresu 'amesaayaa chemere binoraacawe 'enaa baferedu `elate raasaacawene natzaa lamaawethaate biyaaqarebute yehe beezaa ka'enaresu taqabaayenatene 'ayaaganyeme. la'enaresume 'asaamaami yahona qethaate 'alalaacawe.
'esaate wesethe bagabu gizee kareswa liwathu yefalegaalu, yaa 'enedeete lihone yecelaale. 'enaresu kareswa yamiwathu 'ayedalume. lanaresume bawesethwa zawetaari qethaate 'alalaacawe.

'alaahe yasawocene neberate bageletze baqemiyaa 'enaa bazarafaa 'enedihume bashefetenate yamiwasedutene sawoce ferede katanaagara baxwaalaa badebeqe basereqote yamiwasedutene 'asekatalanaa 'enedihe 'ala -
'enaaneta baalaselethaanaate hoye! wanede 'enaa seete leebocene yasawene neberate yaala'agebaabe bamawesadaacawe baszarute szeraa ka'alaahe yahona qethaate 'enaa menedaa 'enedihume la'enaresume hona laleeloce maqathaachaa yehone zanede qanye 'ejocaacawene qurathu. 'alaahe 'anedaaceme yamaayesaanawe 'ashanaafi bahegegaatume thebabanyaa nawe.

kasereqote bamatzatzate wada 'alaahe yatamalasa 'enaa szeraaweneme yaasaamara 'alaahe baterufaatu tzatzatune yeqabalawaale. yaame 'alaahe kabaarocu wadaresu latamalasute sawoce wanejale mahari la'enaresume 'azaanye bamahonu nawe. gene gudaayu wada faraajoce kadarasa baxwaalaa qethaatu 'ayeqarelaacaweme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe yasamaayaate 'enaa yamedere negeszenaa la'eresu 'enedahona 'ataaweqeme 'enedee (`ewaqe) yafalagawene bafetehawinatu yeqathaale, yafalagaweneme baterufaatu yemeraale. 'alaahe 'anedaaceme nagare yamaayesaanawe hulu nagare caaye nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'anetane lamaanaadade yakehedatene szeraa geletze bamaaderage laaye yamicaakolu sawoce hhazane wesethe 'ayeketatuhe. ka'enanyaa 'emenatene geletze 'aderegawe kehedatene balebocaacawe kamiyezu 'asemasaayoce makaakale 'enedihume bathelaacaa wadaaneta yaalemathu 'alaqocaacawene yamisamu 'enaa yamikatalute 'ayehudoce 'ayaasetakezuhe. bataweraate wesethe yaalawene ya'alaahene qaale lasemeetocaacawe bamitheme maleku yelawethutaale. latakataayocaacaweme <<yamuhhamade ferede ya'enaanetane semeete yagathama kahona takatalute. yamiqaarane kahona tathaneqaqute>> yelaalu. 'alaahe kasawoce makaakale bathemematu mekeneyaate liyaathamemawe yafalagawene, karesu themematene yamiyaasewagedelate 'enaa wada 'ewenatanyaawe manegademe yamimaraawe 'ataaganyelateme. 'enanyaa ka'ayehudoce 'enaa ka'asemasaayoce makaakale ba'enanyihe baaheriyaate tagalaachocu 'enanyaa 'alaahe yalebocaacawene kakehedate manetzaate yaalefalagalaacawe naacawe. la'enaresu baqerebitu `aalame weredate bamachiwe `aalame dagemo taalaaqe qethaate 'alalaacawe. yaame yajahaname 'esaate nawe.

'enanyihe 'ayehudaawiyaane weshatene babezaate yamisamu, 'enaa 'eneda walade yaalane 'ereme ganezabeneme babezaate yamibalu naacawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaresu wadaaneta katafaaradu kafalageke bamahakalaacawe ferade, kaalefalagekeme bamahakalaacawe kamaferade raaqe. kahulate 'anedune yamamerathe mabete 'alahe. bamahakalaacawe kamaferade betereqeme ba'anedaaceme nagare ligoduhe 'ayecelume. bamahakalaacawe betefaredeme meneme 'enekwaa badaayoce 'enaa thalaatoce bihonume bafetehe ferade. 'alaahe tafaraajocu kathalaatoce bihonu 'enekwaa kafaraajoce bamisathute ferede fetehawi yahonutene yewadaale.

ya'enanyihe 'ayehudaawiyaane gudaaye yamigareme nawe. 'enaresu baaneta 'eyakaadu 'enedaganaa semeetocaacawene bamigatheme nagare 'aneta zanede lifaaradu yefalegaalu. 'enaresu 'enedamiyaamenubate yaminaagarute taweraate bamahakalaacawe 'ala. bawesethume ya'alaahe ferede 'alabate. kaziheme baxwaalaa semeetaacawene bamiqaarane nagare setefarede kaziyaa yaafanagethaalu. bamatsehhafaacawe wesethe baalawe nagare bamakaade 'enaa kaanetame ferede bamaraaqe hulate thefaatene sabasabu. ya'enanyihe sawoce szeraa ya'amaanyoce 'ayedalame. 'enaresume ba'eregethe 'amaanyoce 'ayedalume.

'enyaa taweraatene bamusaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) laaye 'awaradene. bawesethu yamalekaame nagare thaqwaami 'enaa maaserajaa 'alabate. sawoce yamimarubateme berehaane 'alabate. kaseraa'eele lejoce liqaawenete makaakale 'enanyaa la'alaahe bamataazaze yatawaadaqute yefaredubataale. 'alaaheme bamatsehhafu laaye thabaaqi selaadaragaacawe 'enanyaame sawocene ba`eweqate yamikotokutu `aawaaqiwoce 'enaa liqoce yefaredubataale. 'enaresuneme 'alaahe matsehhafu 'enedaayebaraze 'enaa 'enedaayelawathe baala'adaraawoce 'aderegwaacawaale. 'eresu 'ewenate 'enedahona masekaariwocume 'enaresu naacawe. baresume gudaaye sawoce wadanaresu yemalasaalu. 'enaaneta 'ayehudoce hoye! sawocene 'ateferu. 'eneene becaa feru. 'alaahe baawaradaweme matsehhafe bamaferade meteke ganezabe 'enaa selethaane yamasalutene teneshe `aalamaawi waagaane 'atelawethu. 'eremune yatafaqada nawe, wayeme sawe saraashe hegu ka'alaahe hege yebalethaale, wayeme ya'alaahe 'enaa sawe saraashu hege 'ekule naacawe belo bamaamane ba'alaahe hege maferadene yatawa (yaalefarada), 'enaho 'enaresu ba'ewenate kahaadiwoce naacawe.

bataweraate wesetheme ba'ayehudoce laaye, 'anede yaala 'agebaabe sitaawaqawe nafese yagadala bagadalawe qethaate yegadale, sitaawaqawe `aayene yaathafaa `aayenu yethefaa. sitaawaqawe 'afenechaane yaqoratha 'afenechaawe yeqorathe, joroneme bamaawaqe yaqoratha jorowe yeqorathe, thereseneme yaawalaqa theresu yewelaqe maalatene danagagene, gede 'adaragene. bamaaqusale wesethe dagemo 'aqusaaye baaqosalawe leke yeqathaa, 'atzafaawene yaagenye bamaalate danagagene. wanejalanyaaweneme yeqere yaala, yeqere baayenatu lawanejalu maabashaa yehonelataale. ba'atzafaa melaashe 'enaa baleeloceme gudaayoce 'alaahe baawaradawe hege yaalefarada 'enaresu ya'alaahene denebare yathaasu badaayoce naacawe.

baseraa'eele lejoce mahakale batalaakute nabiyaate faanaa yamareyame lejene `isaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'asekatalene. bataweraate wesethe baalawe yamiyaamene baresume yamifarede 'adereganeme laakenawe. nejileneme ya'ewenate mamariyaane yaaqafa, kamaaserajaawoceme maamasaasayaawocene yamiyaasewagede, kahegegaatume cegerocene yamifataa, katashaaru theqite hegegaate basetaqare karesu bafite bataweraate wesethe yaalutene hegegaate yamiyaaragaagethe sihone sathanawe. nejileneme sawoce yamimarubate mamariyaa 'enaa 'alaaheme yakalakalaacawene kamaszeraate gasaache 'adaragenawe.

yanejileme sawoce 'alaahe banejile wesethe baawaradawe yemanu. kamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) wadanaresu malaake bafiteme ba'eresu yeferadu 'alaaheme baawaradawe yamaayefaredu 'enanyaa ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yaafanagathu, 'ewenatene yatawewe wada thememateme yaazanabalu naacawe.

'alaahe taweraatene 'enaa nejilene kaawasaa 'enaa kaamogasa baxwaalaa bamaqathale qure'aanene 'awasaa 'enaa 'awadasa; 'enediheme 'ala -
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! qure'aanene baaneta laaye ka'alaahe lamahonu therethaaree yaleelabate 'ewenataa sihone wadaaneta 'awaradenawe. karesu bafite yanabarutene malakotaawi matsaahhefete 'aragaagaache, banaresume laaye yabalaaye taqothaathaari sihone 'awaradenawe. selaziheme qure'aanene yagathamawe 'ewenate nawe; kaqure'aane gaare yamithaarasawe dagemo weshate nawe. 'alaaheme kaqure'aane wadaaneta baawaradawe nagare basawoce mahakale ferade. wadaaneta yatawaradawene therethaaree yaleelabatene 'ewenataane tetahe 'enaresu yayaazutene semeetocaacawene 'atekatale. la'eyaanedaanedume hhezebe baszeraa yamitaragomu hegegaate 'enaa yamimarubate geletze manegadene 'adereganaale. 'alaahe zerezere hegegaatune 'anede maaderage bifalege noro lahulume hhezebe tamasaasaaye hegegaatene yaawarede nabare. gene 'eresu la'eyaanedaanedu hhezebe 'eraasune yacaala yaheyewate mamariyaane (hegene) 'adaraga. baziheme 'alaahe basathaacehu hhege maane taazaazhu 'enaa maane 'afanegaache 'enedahona lamafatane yatalayaaya 'adaragawe. malekaamene maszeraate 'enaa ka'ekuye tagebaare bamaraaqe tasheqadaadamu. baferedu `elate mamalashaacehu wada 'alaahe becaa nawe. 'enaaneta tewazaagabubate yanabaraacehutene nagare 'alaahe yenageraacexwaale. kaszeraawoceme baaseqadamaacehute yemanadaacexwaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bamahakalaacawe 'alaahe baawaradawe hege ferade. semeetene kamakatale yamanacha xaasaabaacawene 'atekatale. 'alaahe wadaaneta kaawaradawe nagare 'anetane bamaazanebale 'enedaayefatenuhe tathaneqaqaacawe. yehenene kamaaderage wada xwaalaa 'ayelume. 'alaahe wadaaneta baawaradawe nagare kametesathaacawe ferede yaafagafagu 'enedahona, 'alaahe bazihece `aalame bakafile wanejalaacawe liqathaacawe 'enedamifalege `ewaqe. bamachiwe `aalame dagemo bahulume yeqathaacawaale. kasawoce 'abezaanyocu ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yaafanagathu naacawe.

'enanyaa basemeetocaacawe ferede yamisathutene yadenequrenaa zamane sawocene, yathaa`otaawiyaanune ferede falegawe kaaneta ferede yaafanagethaalu 'enedee? 'alaahe bamale'eketanyocu laaye yaawaradawene nagare bamigabaa yamiganazabu sawoce zanede ka'alaahe ferede yatashaala ferede yalame.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanaacehu hoye! 'ayehudocene 'enaa kakeresetiyaanoce makaakale yalebe wadaaje 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazu. 'ayehudocu yamiwadaajute ba'emenataacawe laaye yaalane sawe nawe. keresetiyaanocume 'enedazihu. 'anede yamiyaadaregaacawe la'enaaneta yaalaacawe thelaacaa nawe. kanaaneta makaakale 'enaresune yamiwadaaje sawe 'eresu kanaresu yeqotharaale. 'alaaheme kahadiyaanene bamawadaajate raasaacawene yabadalu sawocene 'ayemereme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa ba'emenataacawe dakaamaa yahonutene 'asemasaayoce, <<'enaresu dele 'aderegawe yabalaayenate kataqadaaju kanaresu bakule yamidaresebenene theqaate selamenefaraa nawe>> bamaalate 'ayehudocene 'enaa keresetiyaanocene siwadaaju taayaacawaalahe. 'alaaheme delene lamale`eketanyaawe 'enaa la'amaanyoce liyaadarege 'aliyaame ka'eresu yahonane te`ezaaze 'ametheto ya'ayehudocu 'enaa kanaresu gaare yatasalafute sawoce hulu xaayele tawagedo, 'enanyaame 'enaresune bamawadaajate laaye yatasheqadaadamute 'asemasaayoce yanabaraacawe therethaaree wedeqe bamahonu balebocaacawe badabaqute nefeqenaa yamitzatzatu lihonu yekajalaale.

kaziyaame kafilaacawe lakafilaacawe <<'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! ba'emenate bamaagaze 'enaa ba'eredaataa ka'enaaneta gaare 'enedamihonu yathabaqa mahalaacawene yamaalute 'enanyihe naacawe 'enedee?>> lilu yekajalaale. 'asemasaayocume szeraawocaacawe tabalaashubaacawe. yaasabuteme saayesaakaa selaalafabaacawe 'enaa 'alaaheme qethaatene yaazagaajalaacawe bamahonu yakasaru honu.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! kanaaneta makaakale ka'emenatu wada kehedate yamimalase kaala, 'alaahe ba'enaresu meteke hhezebocene yaamathaale. ba'emenate laaye qathe bamaalataacawe yamiwadaacawene, 'enaresume yamiwadutene, la'amaanyoce 'azaanyoce 'enaa lakahadiyaane beretuwocene, baganezabocaacawe 'enaa banafesocaacawe ya'alaahe qaale kafe 'enedetele yamitaagalutene, ya'alaaheneme wedeetaa kafethuraane wedeetaa balaaye bamaasebalathaacawe yawaqaashene waqasaa yamaayefaru baarocene yaamathaale. yeheme 'alaahe kabaarocu lafalagawe yamisathawe sethowe nawe. 'alaaheme bacerotaa 'enaa bamaasaamaru safi, cerotaawe yamigabaawene `aawaaqi, belome sachi, yamaayegabaaweneme `aawaaqi belome yamikalakelawe nawe. 'alaahe (subehaanahu wata`aalaa) 'ayehudocene,

keresetiyaanocene 'enaa leelocuneme kahadiyaane yalebe wadaaje 'aderego mayaazene kakalakala baxwaalaa mu'eminoce maanene mawadaajate 'enedaalabaacawe sinaagare 'enediheme 'ala -
'ayehudoceme, keresetiyaanoceme, leelocume kahadiyaane la'enaaneta wadaajoce 'ayedalume. 'enaho wadaajaacehu 'alaahe 'enaa male'eketanyaawe, 'enanyaame salaatene yatamwalaace 'aderegawe yamiyaaqwaaqwaamu, yaganezabocaacaweneme zakaa la'alaahe yamitanaanasu honawe yamisathute 'amaanyoce naacawe.
'alaahene, male'eketanyaawene 'enaa 'amaanyoceneme yamiwadaaje 'enaziyaa 'enaresu ya'alaahe hhezeboce naacawe. ya'alaaheme hhezeboce 'alaahe selamiradaacawe 'ashanaafiwocu 'enaresu naacawe.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! kananyaa matsaahhefetene katasathute 'ayehudoce 'enaa keresetiyaanoce 'enedihume kathaa`otaawiyaane 'enanyaa 'emenataacehune masaalaqiyaa 'enaa machaawacaa 'aderegawe yamiyezutene radaate 'enaa wadaaje 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazu. 'enaanetame 'eresu baawaradawe male'eketu ba'ewenate 'amaanyoce kahonaacehu 'alaahene feru.

'enaaneta wada solaate theri bametaadaregubateme gizee 'enedihu yesaalaqaalu yechaawataalu. salaate wada 'alaahe kamiyaaqaarebu ya'amelekote zarefoce waananyaawaa honaa saala. yeheme 'enaresu 'alaahe labaarocu manegade yaadaragaatene shari`aawene 'enaa ya'ameleko teregumune yamaayeradu bamahonaacawe nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! matsaahhefete katasathute sawoce makaakale latasaalaaqiwocu - <<'enaaneta 'enyaa ba'alaahe, 'alaaheme wadanyaa baawaradawe, kanyaame bafiteme baawaradawe maamanaacenene 'enedihume ka'enaaneta makaakale 'abezaanyocu 'emenatene bamatawe 'enaa yaazazaweneme bamathaase yaafanagathu naacawe belane maamanaacenene 'eneji kanyaa mene thalaacehu? menese gedefate 'aganyaacehubene? 'enaaneta lanyaa maweqashaa 'aderegaacehu yametethaqesute nagare lanyaa mamaseganyaa 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! naweru, gedefatu linagarelate tagabi, qethaatume kazihe yakafaa yahonane sawe lenegaraacehune? balaacawe:- <<'enaresume 'alaahe ka'ezenatu yaabaararaacawe, yaragamaacawenaa malekaacaweneme qayero zenejaroce 'enaa karekarowoce yaadaragaacawe thaa`otaateneme yaamalaku qadamete 'abaatocaacehu naacawe. thaa`ote maalate maanenyaawume ka 'alwahe wuchi bafelaagotu yamimalake nawe. kalaaye yatazarazarute bamulu baferedu `elate yaalaacawe botaa 'ejege yakafaa 'enaa kaqathetanyaawe manegademe 'ejege yaraaqu naacawe>> balaacawe.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! ka'enaresu yahonu 'asemasaayoce wadanaaneta simathu kanaresu yahonane maasemasayaa 'emenatene yegaletzulaacexwaale. 'ewenataawe 'enaresu sigabume siwathume bamaasemasale (banefeqenaa) yatashafanu honawe mamethaataacawe nawe. kaziyaame tagebaaraacawe 'aletawagadume. meneme 'enekwaa 'enaresu la'enaaneta 'emenatene geletze biyaadaregume balebonaacawe yadabaqutene kehedate 'alaahe kamaaneme balaaye `aawaaqi nawe. 'enaame baresu yemanadaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'enanyaa ka'ayehudoce 'enaa ka'asemasaayocume baweshate babadaleme basawoce laaye denebare bamaalafe ba'erememe yasawocene ganezabe bamabelaate 'enaa bamasalute wanejaloce laaye sisheqadaadamu taayaacawaalahe yamiszarute nagare menenyaa kafaa.

'enanyaa mariwocaacawe 'enaa `aawaaqiwocaacawe 'enaresu kamirwarwathubate, weshatene kamanaagare, baweshateme kamamasekare, yasawoceneme ganezabe yaala'agebaabe kamabelaate bikalakelwacawe mene nabare? ya'enanyaame thefaatene 'eyaayu yamaayekalakelwacawe mariwoce 'enaa `aawaaqiwoce szeraa menenyaa kafaa.

'ayehudoceme cegerenaa dereqe bayaazaacawe gizee - <<ya'alaahe 'eje malekaame kamalagase 'enaa kamasethate yataasarace, yataqwaatharace nace>> 'alu. 'ejocaacawe malekaamene kamaszeraate 'enaa kamasethateme yataasaru yehunu. yeheneneme bamaalataacawe ka'alaahe 'ezenate tabaararu. yelequneme ya'alaahe 'ejoce bamalekaame 'enaa bacarenate yatazaragu naacawe. 'enedafalagame yesathaale, yezaragaaleme, yesabasebaaleme, laresume kalekaayeme 'asegadaajeme yalaweme. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehe baaneta laaye yatawaradawe malakotaawi male'ekete la'ayehudocu denebare maalafene, 'enaa kehedatene 'eneji 'ayechamerelaacaweme. yeheme 'enaresu baalubate meqanyenate sababe nawe. ba'ayehudocu cheferoce mahakale thalaatenatene 'enaa thelaacaane 'aseqamathene. 'enaresu lathorenate sawocene basabasabu, lareswa mazagaajatene batazagaaju 'enaa thorenateneme lamaaqathaathale badolatu quthere 'alaahe 'anedenataacawene yebataatenawaale. xaayelaacawene yaasewagedawaale. bamedere wesethe maathefaate yaalabatene wanejale kamaszeraate, selaamene lamaakeshafe 'enaa laresume bamaaseere kamarwarwathe 'ayewagadume. 'alaahe dagemo yathefaate sawocene 'ayewademe.

'enanyaa matsaahhefetene yatasathute 'ayehudoce 'enaa keresetiyaanoce muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yezo bamathaawe nagare biyaamenu, kawanejaleme bamaraaqe 'alaahene bifaru noro yaszarutene yawanejale hathi'atoce bibazume kanaresu 'enaabeselaacawe nabare. baferedume `elate madasacaa 'enaa mathaaqamiyaa yahonacene ya'atekelete seferaa 'enaasegabaacawe nabare.

'ayehudoceme bataweraate wesethe baalawe, keresetiyaanoceme nejile wesethe baalawe biszaru 'enedihume hulatume cheferoce baqure'aane wesethe yatanagarawene batagebaare biyaawelu, kabalaayaacawe kazenaabe kabataaceme kamedere bamaabeqale yasisaayene meneche 'enaadaregelaacawe nabare. kanaresume matsaahhefetene katasathute makaakale ba'ewenate laaye yatzanaa fetehaawi sawe 'ala. 'abezaanyaacawe gene baalamaamanaacawe mekeneyaate yamiszarute menenyaa kafaa.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kageetaahe wadaaneta yatawaradawene huluneme 'aderese. karesume 'anedaaceneme 'atedabeqe. karesume baataadarese 'enaa 'anedaaceneme betedabeqe yaane gizee 'aneta yageetaahene male`ekete 'aderaashe 'ayedalaheme. (ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa muhhamademe (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) lamaaderase 'enedataazazute 'adaraacawene tawathetawaale, 'aderesawaale. yazihene taqaaraani nagare yamiyaamene 'enaa 'alaadarasume yamile kaala ba'alaahe laaye taalaaqe qethefatene fatherwale) kazaareeme baxwaalaa 'alaahe kasawoce theqaate yethabeqehale. 'anetane ligodu 'ayecelume. baaneta laaye maaderase 'eneji leelaa yalabeheme. 'alaaheme 'enanyaane qenenatene yamaayefalegu kahadiyaanene kamalekaame nagare gaare 'ayegathemaacaweme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa matsaahhefetene latasathute 'ayehudoce 'enaa keresetiyaanoce - <<'enaaneta bataweraate 'enaa banejile wesethe baalawe 'ewenataa 'enaa ba'eresu 'eneji 'emenataacehume taqabaayenate baleelaweme qure'aane wesethe batathaqasawe 'ewenataa 'eseketeszaru derase 'enaaneta ka'emenate kaqume nagare bamiqothare nagare laaye 'ayedalaacehume>> balaacawe. matsaahhefeneme latasathute sawoce yaa baaneta laaye yatawaradawe nagare bameqanyenataacawe mekeneyaate denebare maalafene 'enaa kehedatene 'eneji 'ayechameralaacaweme. ka'enaresu bakaadute sawoce mekeneyaateme hhazane 'ayegebaahe. kame`emanaane batakataluhe wesethe mabeqaaqaate 'alahe.

ka'enanyaa kaamanute takataayocehe; ka'ayehudaaceme, kasaabi'oceme (kafile nabiyaatene yamikatalu cheferoce naacawe) kakeresetiyaanoceme ka'enaresu makaakale ba'alaahe, 'enaa bamacharashaaweme yaferede `elate yaamanu 'enaa malekaame szeraawoceneme yaszaru lawadafite bamigathemaacawe nagare segaate 'enaa ferehaate yalabaacaweme kaqerebitwame `aalame baamalathaacawe dereshaa 'ayetakezume.

kaseraa'eele lejoceme nabiyaatune lamasemaate 'enaa lamataazaze yathabaqane qaale kidaane baregethe yaazene. kanaresu yatayaazawene qaale kidaane 'afarasu. nabiyaate yezawe kamathute bamaafagefage nafesocaacawe yamizanabalubatene semeetaacawene takatalu. kafiluneme 'asetabaabalu kafiluneme gadalu.

qaale kidaanene maaferasaacawe, nabiyaatene maasetabaabaalaacawe 'enaa magedalaacawe meneme gudaate 'enedamaayaamathaabaacawe 'aderegawe gamatu 'enaa yaalaasabute takasatabaacawe. kaziyaame ka'ewenate taawaru. wadaresume yataqanu 'alehonume. 'ewenatene lamaqabale kamasemaate danaqoru. kaziyaame 'alaahe bacarenatu taaraqaacawe kaziyaame 'enedaganaa taawaru danaqorume. yeheme ba'abezaanyocaacawe laaye takasata. 'alaaheme yamiszarutene tamalekaace nawe.

kakeresetiyaanoce makaakale 'amelekotene la`isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) bamaaderage, 'alaahe maalate 'alemasihe yamareyame leje nawe yaalute baregethe kedawaale. `isaa yamareyame leje raasu, <<'enaaneta yaseraa'eele lejoce hoye! 'alaahene babecanyenate tagazute, 'amelekute. 'eresu 'alaahe geetaayee ya'enaanetame geetaa nawe. 'eresune bamaamelake 'enaa laresume baaroce bamahone 'eneeme 'enaanetame 'ekule nane.>> ka'alaahe weche yaalane 'akaale ba'amelekote ka'alaahe gaare yamiyaagaaraa 'alaahe baresu laaye janate magebaatene 'ereme 'aderegobataale. manoriyaaweme yajahaname 'esaate nace. laresume 'alaahe zanede yamiradaawe; kamithabaqaweme qethaate yamiyaadenawe yalaweme.

'enanyaa 'alaahe yaszosetu 'amelaakoce (selaaseewoce; 'abe, walede 'enaa manefase qeduse) szosetanyaa nawe yaalu sawoce baregethe kedawaale. 'alaaheme 'enaresu kamilute 'ejege yalaaqa nawe. 'alaahe kefelefaayeme 'ayedalame. 'enaho 'eresu 'agaare yaleelawe becanyaa 'amelaake nawe. 'enaresume kazihece 'asaafaari 'abaabaale yamaayeqothabu kahona 'asaamaami qethaate saayaaganyaacawe 'ayeqareme; yaaganyaacawaaleme.

'enanyihe sawoce 'enedazihe kaalawe kabaade 'abaabaalaacawe wada 'alaahe bamamalase neseha 'ayegabumene? ba'alaaheme bamaagaaraate kafatzamute wanejale 'alaahene meherate 'ayethayequmene? 'anede sawe wanejalu mene bihone wada 'alaahe katamalasa 'alaahe mahhari nawe. la'amaanyoceme 'azaanye nawe.

yamareyame leje 'alemasihhe `isaa karesu bafite 'enedaalafute male'eketanyoce 'anede male`eketanyaa 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame. banaresu laaye yadarasawe moteme 'eresune bagizeewe yaaganyawaale. 'enaatume mareyame ya'alaahene 'amelaakenate yaaragaagathace 'ewenatanyaa ya'alaahe baariyaa nace. megebe yamiyaasefalegaacaweme sabe`aawi fethuraane bamahonaacaweme megebe yebalu nabare. 'enaame megebe yamibalaa 'akaale 'enedeete limalake yegabaale? 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'alaahene 'anedenate yamiyaasaayu, 'enedihume yaleeloce 'amelaakenatene wedeqe yamiyaadaregu 'aneqatzocene 'enedeete 'enedamenaaberaaraa tamalekate. 'enedihe kamahonu gaare 'enanyihene 'aneqatzoce yeqaawamaalu kaziyaame ka'enanyihe geletze 'aneqatzoce gaare 'enedeete ka'ewenate 'enedamizanabalu tamalekate.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! maaserajaane setaaqarebelaacaweme 'enedihe bale - <<'enaaneta ka'alaahe baashaagare la'enaaneta theqemene yamaayaamathaalaacehune gudaateneme kanaaneta yamaayaasewagedelaacehune taamalekaalaacehune?>> 'alaahe gene theraate yegabaawe kagedefate hulu yatharaa nawe. 'alaahe negegeraacehune sami szeraawocaacehuneme `aawaaqi nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lakeresetiyaanocu 'enedihe balaacawe - <<'ewenatene takatalu batabaalaacehubate nagare denebarene 'atelafu, nabiyaatene yemasele 'alequ 'enaa 'atalequ batabaalaacehubateme nagare wasanene 'atetalaalafu. leke ba`isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) gudaaye ya'amelaakenatene baahheri sathetaacehute 'enedaamalakaacehute `aayenate denebarene 'atelafu. ka'enaaneta bafite yanabarute raasaacawe thamemawe, kasawoce bezuwoceneme yaathamamutene belome kaqathetanyaawe manegade yathamamutene sawoce zenebaalee 'enaa kefu felaagote 'atekatalu.>>

'alaahe bazihece 'aneqatze badaawede (`alayehi 'asalaame) laaye baawaradawe matsehhafe zabure 'enedihume ba`isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) laaye baawaradawe matsehhafu, nejile wesethe kaseraa'eele lejoce makaakale kahadiyaanune 'enedaragamaacawe ka'ezenatume 'enedaaraaqaacawe yenaagaraale. yaziheme 'eregemaane sababu 'enaresu baszarute wanejaloce 'enaa 'alaahe 'ereme yaadaragaacawene nagaroce bamadaafare 'enaa denebare bamaalafe maamatze nawe.

'anedaacawe leelaacawene wanejalene kamaszeraate yamikalaakele 'alenabarame 'enedaweme 'amatzanyocu yaszarutene wanejaloce 'enaa tzayaafe nagaroce 'eneda jabedu bamaquthare bageletze yenaagarute nabare. yaame 'enaresu yatagabarutene tzayaafe yamiqaawame baalamanoru nawe. katzayaafe nagare makalekalene bamatawaacawe yaszarute menenyaa kafaa.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'enanyaa 'ayehudoce makaakale 'abezaanyocu 'agaariwocene thaa`otaawiyaanune siwadu 'enaa siwadaaju, wadanaresu sizanabalu, 'anetane 'enaa 'amaanyocene sithalu temalakataalahe. thaa`otaawiyaanune mawadaajataacawe menenyaa kafaa. yaame la'enaresu ya'alaahene quthaa lamashamate 'enedihume bawesethwa zawetaariwoce honawe linoru lamaceeme kareswa laayewathu yajahaaname 'esaatene lamagebaataacawe sababe honwale.

'enanyaa 'ayehudoce ba'ewenate ba'alaahe 'enaa banabiyume muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) biyaamenu, thaa`otaawiyaanune kamu`eminoce baashaagare wadaaje baalaadaragwaacawe nabare. yaame 'amaanyoce kahadiyaanene kamawadaajate bamakalekalaacawe nawe. nagare gene ka'enanyaa 'ayehudoce 'abezaanyocu 'alaahene kamataazaze 'enedihume 'alaahene 'enaa mu`eminocene kamawadaajate yaafanagathu naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! baaneta 'enaa 'aneta yezahe bamathaakxawe male'ekete laamanu sawoce kathelaacaa bakule 'ayehudocene 'enaa thaa`otaawiyaanune 'ejege yabaratu honawe taaganyaacawaalahe. yeheme 'ayehudocu kaalaacawe thelaacaa meqanyenate 'enaa kuraate yatanasaa nawe. thaa`ote 'amelaakiyaanu 'enaa ba'alaahe 'agaariwoce yahonuteme 'enedihu baalamaawaqe 'enaa bakuraate tawatherawe nawe. baaneta 'enaa baaneta male`eketanyenate laamanu sawoce dagemo bawedeetaa bakule 'enanyaane 'enyaa keresetiyaanoce nane yaalutene yaqarabu honawe taaganyaacawaalahe. yeheme bawesethaacawe qasaawesete 'enaa manakosaate bamanoraacawe 'enaa 'enaresume yamaayekoru bamahonaacawe nawe. kuraatanyaame malekaame nagare wada lebu 'ayedareseme.

'enazihe ('eneda najaashi 'enaa baaledarabocu yaalu sawoce) lebocaacawe yagaru naacawe. wada male'eketanyaawe yawaradawene qure'aane basamu gizee 'enaa ka'ewenatume baawaqute nagare `aayenocaacawe ba'enebaa yatamolu honawe taayaalahe. 'alaahene bamaferaate 'enaa bamatanaanase yaalaqesaalu. yamareyame leje `isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) yezo yamathaawene bamaawaqaacaweme geetaacene hoye! bamale'eketanyaahe bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'enaa baresume laaye baawaradekawe bamathaaweme 'ewenataa 'amanene. baferedume `elate baleeloce hhezeboce laaye masekaari honawe bamiqarebute laanetame 'anedenatehene kamasakarute yamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) hhezeboce gaare 'aderegane, mazegebane yelaalu.

<<'enyaa ba'alaahe 'enaa wadanyaa bamathaaweme 'ewenataa yamaanaamenebate mene mekeneyaate 'alane? 'enyaame geetaacenene 'alaahene taazaazhoce 'enaa fariwoce kahonute nabiyaate 'enaa dagaage baarocu gaare janate 'enediyaasegabaane 'enekajelaalane>> yelaalu.

'alaaheme ba'emenataacawe 'enaa 'ewenateneme bamanaazazaacawe mekeneyaate bawesethwa zawetaariwoce honawe linoru, kahhenetzaawocwa 'enaa kazaafocwa sere jeratoce yamifasesubaatene ya'atekelete seferaa manadaacawe. yeheme 'asaamaariwoce, 'ewenatene bamakatalaacawe 'enaa yaalameneme qedema huneetaa la'ewenate tagazhiwoce bamahonaacawe yatasathaacawe menedaa nawe.

'enanyaame 'alaahe 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yakaadu, 'alaaheme bamale'eketanyaawe laaye baawaradawe 'aneqatzocu yaasetabaabalu, 'enanyaa yataqathaathalacewe 'esaate baaledaraboce naacawe lamaceeme kareswa 'ayewathume.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahe la'enaaneta yafaqadaacawene malekaamoce, kamegebe kamathathe 'enedihume tedaarene kamamaserateme bazihece `aalame quthebe 'enehune bamile 'esaabee nafese yametefalegaacawene yatafaqadu nagaroce baraasaacehu laaye 'ereme 'ataaderegu. 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme yaadaragaweneme denebare 'atethaasu. 'alaaheme ya'eresune denebare yamithesutene 'ayewadaacaweme.

'alaahe wadanaaneta yaamathaawene sisaaye yatanathaqa wayeme yatasaraqa 'ereme ganezabe saayehone yatafaqada 'enaa malekaame yahonawene belu. te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe yaanene 'eresune yametaamenutene 'alaahene feru. ba'eresu yaalaacehu 'emenate 'enedetefarute yaadaregaacexwaale.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! 'alaahe 'enaanetane sitaawaqaacehu saayehone balemaade melaasocaacehu laaye bamigalaabathawe mahalaacehu 'ayetasaasabaacehume. gene 'enaaneta baqorathaacehute lebocaacehume baqwaatharacewe 'enaa sitaawaqaacehu bamaalaacehute 'alaahe yeyezaacexwaale. 'enaaneta yamaalaacehubate 'enaa yatanaagaraacehubate wanejale maabashaawe 'amaaraache sihone kamiqathelute szosete nagaroce 'anedu nawe. 'anedu bahagaraacehu beetasabocaacehune kameteqalebute makaakalanyaa megebe 'asere dehocene la'eyaanedaanedu dehaa gemaashe qunaa yamihone maabelaate wayeme balemaade lebese kamibaale nagare 'aserune maalebase wayeme 'anedite 'amaanye yahonacene seete baariyaa natzaa maawethaate nawe. kanazihe katathaqasute szosetu yamahhalaa maabashaawoce maagenyate yaalecaala szosete qanaatene bamatzome yaabese. me`emanaane hoye! ba'alaahe yamaalaacehu 'enaa ba'anedabataacehume batanaagaraacehute gizee yamahalaa wanejalaacehune maabashaa yehe nawe. ba'alaahe mamaaleneme kamaazawetare malekaamene laalamaszeraate kaalehona basetaqareme yamaalaacehubatene nagare qaale 'abaaye kamahone mahalaawocaacehune thabequ. yamahalaa wanejalocaacehuneme 'abesu. (malekaame 'aleszaraame belo yamaala sawe 'elaaye batathaqasute maabashaawoce yenatzaanaa wada malekaame szeraawe yemalasaale) 'alaahe yamahalaa maabashaa manegadene 'enedaaberaaraalaacehu hulu yatafaqadane 'enaa yatakalakalane yamigaletzu hegegaatuneme yaaberaaraalaacexwaale. 'enaanetame 'alaahe kazihe bafite yamaataawequte yanabaraacehutene nagare bamaasaawaqu taamasagenute zanedeme nawe.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! 'a`emerone kaminatheqawe 'asekaari mathathe, kahulate wagane tawaatheto 'anedu kamibalaawe yaqumaare ganezabe, thaa`otaawiyaanume lamaamelake 'enaa 'eresu zanede 'enesesaatene lamasawaate kamitakelute denegaaye, ya'alaaheneme yadebeqe yasisaaye kefefelene lamaawaqe bamile kametaawathwacawe ya`ethaa mathaathaayaa 'enechatoce hulume qoshaashaa yashayethwane yamaasaamariyaa szeraawocu naacawe. bazihece `aalame yakabara hheyewatene 'enaa bamachiweme `aalame yajanate tzagaane lamaagenyate setelu yehenene hulu raaqu.

'enaho shayethwane la'enaaneta 'asekaari mathathene 'enaa qumaarene malekaame 'aderego bamaasaayate balebocaacehu mahakale thalaatenatene 'enaa thelaacaane maaderagene, 'enedihume 'alaahene kamaawesaate 'enaa kasalaateme liyaazanaagaacehu yefalegaale. 'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! taadiyaa 'enanyihene tzayaafe nagaroce yametetawewe naacehune? matawaacehu la'enaaneta yebajaale 'enaame raaqute, takalekaluteme.

shari`aawe (ya'emenatu hege) yaazazawene bamatagebare 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe 'alaahene taazazu male`eketanyaaweneme taazazu. baszeraame banegegereme kamaqaarane tathaneqaqu. yehenene kamatagebare betaafagafegu bamale`eketanyaawe laaye yaalawe gedeetaa 'alaahe 'aderese yaalawene nagare maaderase nawe baregetheme 'adereswale. beteqanu laraasaacehu nawe. betaathafume baraasaacehu laaye nawe.

'asekaari mathathe hharaame mahonune yamitegaletse 'aneqatse ba waredace gizee 'anedaanede mu'eminoce yeci 'aneqatse kamaweradwa bafite yamotu muselime wanedemocaacawe huneetaane maawaqe sifaligu takataayewaa 'aneqatse waradace.
ba'enanyaa ba'alaahe baamanute 'enaa wadaresume lamaqaarabe malekaame szeraawocene bamiszarute, 'enaresu 'alaahe 'ereme yaadaragabaacawene ('asekaari mathathene 'enaa qumaarene) yatathanaqaqu, yaamanu 'enaa malekaame szeraawoceneme baszarute, kaziyaame 'ereme yatadaragu nagarocene tathaneqeqawe yaamanu honawe yatathanaqaqu 'enaa 'alaahe 'enedamiyaayaacawe honawe szeraacawene baasaamaru sawoce laaye ('asekaari mathathe) 'ereme kamadaragu bafite yethathu banabarute nagare laaye wanejale yalabaacaweme, 'alaahe baalafawe 'ayethayeqaacaweme. 'alaaheme 'asaamaariwocene yewadaale.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! 'enaaneta bahhaje wayeme ba`umeraa 'esaabee (hheraame) laaye 'eyaalaacehu 'alaahe wadanaaneta baminadaawe yadure 'araawite yefatenaacexwaale. tenaaneshocune ba'ejocaacehu telaaleqocune dagemo bathorocaacehu yametaaganywacawe setehonu; 'alaahe ka'enaaneta makaakale ya'alaahe `eweqate hulune daraashe mahonune 'aweqo baruqe yamifaraawene ligaletze zanede yefatenaacexwaale. 'eresu bahhaje wayeme ba`umeraa 'esaabee, hheraame laaye hono yayabese 'araawitene bamaadane ya'alaahene denebare yathaasa 'alaahe yakalakalawene bamadaafaru mekeneyaate la'eresu baferedu `elate 'asaamaami qethaate 'alalate.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! 'enaaneta bahhaje wayeme ba`umeraa 'esaabee, hheraame laaye 'eyaalaacehu yadure 'araawitene 'ategedalu. ka'enaanetame makaakale sitaawaqawe yagadala kaala ya'eresu kefeyaa basawenate mathane tamasaasaaye yahonawene kagemale, kakabete 'enedihume kabage 'enaa feyale yerade. baziheme laaye kamuselimoce yahonu hulate yafetehe baaletabeetoce yefaredubataale. 'enaresume yehe nawe belawe yafaradute wada kaa`ebaa daraashe hono bahharaame litaarade wadaziyaa yewasadaale. wayeme yaresune waagaa la'eyaanedaanedu deha gemaashe qunaa yesathaale wayeme gemaashe qunaa 'anede qanene yamitakaa sihone faraajocu bawasanute maszarate tagabi qanaatene yetzomaale. yehe hulu yadure 'araawite gadaaye yaszaraawene qethaate yaaganye zanede nawe. 'alaahe kaziyaa bafite yaalawene yahharamene 'araawite 'enedihume bahheraame laaye yaala sawe yadure 'araawitene yamaadane wanejalene 'alefwale; 'ayethayeqaacehume. 'ereme katadaraga baxwaalaa yatamalasabate gene 'enaho 'alaahe yebaqalawaale. 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi 'enaa 'eresuneme laamatzawe sawe yamabaqale baaletabeete nawe.

'alaahe la'enaaneta yaweha wesethe 'enesesaatene, 'eneda `aasaa yaalune, baheyewate saalume motaweme baahhere wadanaaneta gafeto yaamathaawe la'enaaneta basafaraacehu saalaacehu mathaqamiyaa 'enaa latagwaazhoceme seneqe yehone zanede yatafaqada 'adaragalaacehu. 'enaaneta bahhaje wayeme ba`umeraa 'esaabee, hheraame wesethe kaalaacehu dagemo yayabese 'araawitene maadane 'ereme tadaragabaacehu. yaanene baferedu `elate wadaresu yametemalasu yahonaacehubatene 'alaahene feru.

'alaahe yatakabarawene beete kaa`ebaane lasawoce maqwaaqwaamiyaa 'adaragawe. 'emenataawi theqemaacawe, 'eneda salaate, hhaje, `umeraa yaalu nagaroce yamithabaqubate, `aalamaawi theqemaacaweme 'eneda tzathetaa, yaferaaferee wadaziyaa mamethaate, yemasele 'enedithabaqe 'adaraga. yatakabaru waraateneme zule-qa`edaa, zule-hhijaa, muhharame 'enaa rajabe bawesethu bamiragaagathawe salaame lasawoce maqwaaqwaamiyaa 'adaragawe. wada hharame baminaduteme yamisawe 'enesesaate 'enedihume bagamadoce yataasaru ya'erede kabetocene baalabeetocaacawe batzathetaa wada hharame selaminadwacawe lanaresume laleeloceme mathaqamiyaa 'adaraga. 'enanyihe nagarocene ba'enaaneta laaye yaabalatzagawe 'enaaneta 'alaahe basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalawene hulu 'enedamiyaaweqe 'enaa 'alaaheme nagarocene hulu `aawaaqi mahonune taawequ zanede nawe. 'alaahe la'enaaneta 'anedaacene nagare yamidanagegawe, theqeme saayaamalethaacehu gudaateme saayedaresebaacehu bafite linageraacehu nawe. yeheme yabaarocene theqeme lamaasethabaqe lamahonu 'aseraje nawe.
sawoce hoye! 'alaahe: la'amatzanyaa qethaata beretu 'enedihume kathefaatu wadaresu latamalasame mahari 'enaa 'azaanye mahonune `ewaqu.

bamale'eketanyaawe laaye 'alaahe maaderase yaazazawene maaderase 'eneji leelaa yalabateme. sawocene qene maaderage yaresu 'ayedalame. sawocene la'emenate lebaacawene maaqenaate ya'alaahe nawe. 'alaaheme yametegaletzutene 'enaa yametedabequtene yaaweqaale. baziyaame yemanadaacexwaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! mathefo nagare mene yabarakata bihone kamaanenyaaweme malekaame nagare gaare 'ayesetakaakaleme. mabezaatu mabelathene 'ayaaseganyeme. 'enaaneta yalebonaa baaletabeetoce hoye! yafaraacehutene tethabaqu yatamanyaacehuteneme taaganyu zanede kamathefo bamaraaqe 'enaa bamalekaameme bamasheqadaadame 'alaahene feru.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! lagizeewe bamaayaasefalegaacehu gudaayoce nabiyaacehune 'atethayequ. ba'emenataacehu laaye kameteradaacehu nagare yaalehonecene 'ate thayequ. yaace nagare yatagalathacelaacehu 'enedahona bametaasetalaalefawe kabaade te`ezaaze mekeneyaate taasekafaacexwaalacenaa; 'enaanetame kaqure'aane yahona malakotaawi male`ekete bamiwaredebate gizee betethayequ geletze yedaragelaacexwaale. yeheme ba'alaahe laaye gare nawe. qure'aane yaalethaqasawene nagare 'alaahe 'alefwacexwaale. falefelaacehu mathayaqaacehu yaanene bamafatzame te`ezaaze matheto 'enedaatecagaru (qademaacehu 'atethayequ) 'alaaheme te`ezaazune lathabaqute mahari baarocuneme baqethaate yamaayaacaakule taagaashe nawe.
ka'enaaneta bafite yanabaru hhezeboceme masale theyaaqeewocene 'anesetawe nabare. te`ezaazu bamathaa 'enaa batagadadu gizee baalamatagebare yakaadu honawaale.

'alaahe 'enesesaatene labaarocu yatafaqadu 'aderegwaale. thaa`otaawiyaane la'amaaleketocaacawe belawe baraasaacawe laaye 'ereme yaadaragutene nagare 'alaahe 'ereme 'alaadaragaweme. 'alaaheme bahhiraane (yatawasanu gelegalocene kawaladace baxwaalaa jorowocwa yamiqorathu gemalene), saabaaneme (yatawasana ya`edemee kelele setedarese lathaa`otaate yametesathe gemalene), wasilaaneme ('akataatelaa seete yawaladace kaziyaame lathaa`otaate yatatawace gemalene), hhaameneme (ka'aberaaku bamiwathaa yazare feree yatawasanu yagemale gelegaloce katawaladu baxwaalaa lathaa`otaatu yamitawe koremaa gemalene) 'alaahe 'ereme 'alaadaragame. 'enanyaa yakaadute sawoce ba'alaahe laaye yafabarakute weshate 'enaa qethefate sihone 'alaahe gene 'ereme 'aderegwaale yelaalu, 'abezaanyocaacaweme 'ewenataawene 'ayeganazabume.

'enanyaa, kafile 'enesesaatene 'ereme bamaaderage ba'alaahe laaye weshatene yamifatheru sawocene, yatafaqadane 'enaa yatakalakalane taawequ zanede 'alaahe kaqure'aane wadaawaradawe 'enaa wada male'eketanyaawe negegere nu batabaalu gizee, <<'enyaa kaqadamete 'abaatocaacene `emenate, negegerenaa tagebaare yayaazenawe yebaqaanaale>> yelaalu. qadamete 'abaatocaacawe 'anedaace nagarene yamaayaawequ, wada 'ewenateme yaaletamaru sihonu 'enedeete yanaresu 'are'ayaanate yebaqaacawaale; ka'enaresu yabalatha yadanaqoranaa kamanegademe bakule yathamama kaalehona basetaqare 'ayekatalaacaweme. 'enanyihe 'alaawaaqiwoce 'enaa thamaamoce naacawe.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! nafesocaacehune yamibajaacawene nagare bamatagebare thabeqwaacawe. 'enaaneta yataqaanaacehu kahona kasawoce makaakale yathamama 'enaa la'enaanetame theri malese yaalesatha 'ayegodaacehume. ka'enaaneta qenenate makaakale bamalekaame maazazaacehu kakefume makalakalaacehu 'alabate. baferedume `elate mamalashaacehu wada 'alaahe becaa nawe. baqerebitwa `aalameme teszarute yanabaraacehute yenageraacexwaale. baziyaame yemanadaacexwaale.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'anedaacehu yamotene melekete baaya gizee banuzaazeewe laaye ka'enaaneta hulate yafetehe baaletabeetocene wayeme bamedere wesethe betegwaazu 'enaa yamoteme 'adagaa binakaacehu muselimocene baataaganyu muselime kaalehonu hulate sawocene 'asemasekeru. bahulatu sawoce mesekerenate betetharaatharu kasolaate baxwaalaa 'aqumwacawe. <<yamenemasakerelate sawe yazemedenaa baaletabeete bihone 'enekwaa bamesekerenataacene theqemene 'anelawetheme, ya'alaaheneme mesekerenate 'anedabeqeme. dabeqaneme beneganye baziyaane gizee 'enyaa kaxaathi'atanyoce nane>> belawe yemaalu.

ya'enanyaa hulate masekaariwoce 'ataalaayenate 'enaa baweshate mamasekareme bidarasebate, lamwace qerebe yahonu hulate leeloce sawoce ba'enaresu meteke yequmunaa - <<ya'enyaa banaresu weshataamenate laaye mamasekaraacene 'enaresu banuzaazeewe laaye kamasakarubate nagare balaaye 'ewenatanyaa 'enaa tagabi nawe. bazihe mesekerenataaceneme wasanene 'alaalafeneme yaane gizee 'enyaa ya'alaahene denebare kathaasute badaayoce nane>> belawe ba'alaahe yemaalu.

yeheme kasalaate baxwaalaa maasemasekare yamesekerenate qaalene batagabiwe botaa laaye lamaaseganyate wayeme kamahalaawocaacawe baxwaalaa mahalaawoce wada mwace waraashoce (qerebe beetasaboce) tamalesaa mawaaradaacawene lamaferaate bathaame yaqaraba nawe. yaazazawene bamatagebare 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru. yametebaaluteneme matagebare, yamikatalawene masemaate semu. 'alaahe kate`ezaazu yaafanagathu sawocene qathetanyaa manegadene 'ayemaraame.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'alaahe baferedu `elate male'eketanyocene hulu sabesebo - <<'enee 'enaanetane wada naresu yalaakwaacehu hhezebocaacehu mene malese sathwacehu?>> bamilebate `elate; male'eketanyoceme malesune wada 'alaahe yaasethagu honawe - <<'enyaa `eweqate yalaneme. `eweqate hulu 'eneta zanede nawe. 'aneta debeqene nagare `aawaaqiwe nahe>> bamilubate gizee 'asetaawesu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe yamareyamene leje `isaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) - <<'aneta yamareyame leje `isaa hoye! 'anetane yaala 'abaate bafatharekuhe, 'enaateheneme mareyamene bareswa zamane kanabaru seetoce hulu bamarathekwaate, baqedusu manefaseme bajiberile baabarataahuhe, sawoceneme wada 'alaahe manegade yametetharaacawe setehone balejenatehe bametaanaageraacawe, bagolemaasaanateheme waqete 'alaahe wadanaresu balaakahe nagare yametenaageraacawe setehone tzehhufene baasetamaarekuhe, bamusaame laaye yaawaradekutene taweraatene baasetamaarekuhe; baanetame laaye yatawaradawene nejilene baasetamaarekuhe 'enaa yashari`aawene misethere, hegegaate 'enaa thebabocuneme baasetamaarekuhe, kacheqaame 'adebolebulahe 'esetenefaasene setenafaabate bafeqaadee baraari wafe bamihonebateme, `aayena sewerenehuno yatafatharawene sawu me bafeqaadee bametaasherebate, lametzaaneme bamadaabase kalametzu deno baala malekaame qodaa bamihone gizee 'alwahene bamamaatsane mutaaneneme bameteqasaqese gizee yehee hulu banee faqaade sihone yawaalekulehene malekaame tzagaayeene 'awesaa. yaseraa'eele lejoceneme geletze bahonu ta`aameraatene yezahe bamathaahelaacawe gizee bata`aameraatu kedawe ligadeluhe sifalegu 'enedaayedaresubehe kaaneta kalakalekwaacawe. ta`aameraatuneme baayu gizee 'enanyaa kahadiyaane yehe geletze yahona degemete 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame 'alu.

ba'enee 'enaa bamale'eketanyaayeeme 'emanu bamaalate baradaatocehe lebonaa wesethe `eweqatene baaseqamatheku gizee yawaalekulehene tzagaa 'awesaa; 'enaresume 'amenanaale geetaacene hoye! taazaazhoce, muselimoce lamahonaacene masekerelene 'alu.>>

hhawaareyaatume (ya`isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) radaatoce) <<`isaa hoye! geetaahe 'aneta kalamanekawe kasamaaye maa`edene liyaawaredelene yecelaalene?>> baalu gizee 'awesaa. `isaame (`asa) ba'enaresu laaye bathayaqute theyaaqee sababe fatanaa 'enedaayemathaabaacawe bamaferaate <<'amaanyoce 'enedahonaacehu 'alaahene feru, yehene theyaaqee tawe>> 'alaacawe.

hhawaareyaatume la`isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) <<kazihece maa`ede mabelaate 'enefalegaalane. lebonaaceneme ba'alaahe celotaa melu`enate 'anetame male'eketanyaawe 'enedahoneke 'enedetaamene 'enaa 'enedeteragaa 'enefalegaalane; 'anetame ka'alaahe wadanyaa yezahe yamathaakxawene nagare 'ewenatanyaa 'enedahoneke 'enaaweqaalane. kasawoceme yehece maa`ede setewarede laalaaya masekaariwoce 'enehonaalane>> 'alu.

`isaame (`alayehi 'asalaame) latheyaaqeeyaacawe malese bamasethate 'anedihe sile 'alwahene lamana <<'alaahe hoye! la'enyaa yatawaradabatene qane yamenaataleqebate madasacaa ba`aale yamenaadaregawene, 'ahune baheyewote laaye laaluteme hona kanyaa baxwaalaa lamimathuteme yamesegaanaa qane tehone zanede la'anetame becanyaa geetenate melekete 'enaa maaserajaa yamihonanene 'enedihume yaaneta male'eketanyaa mahoneeneme yametaaragaagethe yahonace maa`ede 'aweredelene. 'anetane lamagazaate yamiyaagezanene sisaaye sethane. 'anetame kamagaabiwoce hulu balaache magaabi, basisaayeme 'abaletzaagi nahenaa.>> sile 'alaahene thayaqa.

'alaaheme ya`isaane (`asa) theri taqabala, 'enediheme 'ala - <<yehece ba'enaaneta laaye 'enedetewarede yathayaqaacehutene maa`ede 'aweraaje nanye. 'enee kaawaradekwaate baxwaalaa yakaada gene 'eraasune 'eneji leelaa 'enedaayewaqese. ka`aalamaate maaneneme yaaleqathaahutene qethaate 'eqathaawaalahu.>> (yeheme ta`aamerune ba`aayenu kaaya baxwaalaa makaadu ya'emebitanyenate kehedate bamahonu nawe.) kaziyaame 'alaahe (subehaanahu wata`aalaa) yathayaqutene maa`ede kasamaaye bamaawerade qaale kidaanune 'aragaagathalaacawe.

'alaaheme baferedu `elate `isaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) siyaanaagerawe 'awesaa. <<'aneta yamareyame leje `isaa hoye! 'aneta lasawoce 'eneene 'enaa 'enaateene ka'alaahe baashaagare yamenemalake hulate 'amelaakoce 'aderegune belahaalene?>> yelawaale. `isaame (`alayehi 'asalaame) geetaawene siyaatharaa - <<'enee 'ewenatene 'eneji leelaa lenageraacawe 'ayegabaanyeme. 'enedihe beyeeme 'enedahona 'aneta taaweqawaalahe. balebonaayee yamedabeqawene taaweqawaalahe. 'aneta wesethe yaalawene gene 'alaaweqeme. 'aneta debeqe nagarocene hulu 'ejege 'awaaqi nahe. yatasawarane 'enaa yatadabaqane hulu taaweqaalahe>> yelaale.

`isaame (`alayehi 'asalaame) yelaale - <<'enee lasawoce 'enedele yaazazekanyene 'eneji leelaa 'alaalekwaacaweme. ya'eneene 'enaa ya'enaanetane geetaa 'alaahene 'ameleku nawe yaalekute. 'enee bawesethaacawe banabarekubate gizee ba'enaresu laaye baalute nagare masekaari nabareku, ya'eneene ba'enaresu wesethe maqoyateene baqorathekawenaa bahheyewateeme wada samaaye kafe kaadaragekanye baxwaalaa gene 'aneta ba'enaresu laaye tathabaabaaqi nahe. 'anetame bamaanaacaweme nagare laaye masekaari nahe 'enee bawesethaacawe saalahu yaalekuteme ka'enee baxwaalaa yaaluteneme hulu taaweqaalahe.>>

geetaayee hoye! beteqathaacawe baarocehe naacawe. banaresu laayeme yashaahene taadaregaalahe. kanaresu yaamananeme bameherate betaalefawe kalekaaye yalabeheme. 'aneta 'ashanaafiwe 'enaa bamaasetadaadareme thebabanyaawe nahe.

'alaaheme (subehaanahu wata`aalaa) la`isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enedihe yelawaale - <<zaaree 'enanyaa ba'esaabeeyaacawe, banegegeraacawe 'enaa tagebaaraacawe 'ewenatanyaa yahonu sawoce 'ewenatanyenataacawe yamithaqemaacawe `elate nawe. lanaresume kahhenetzaawocwa 'enaa kazaafocwa sere jeratoce yamifasubaate ya'atekelete seferaa 'alaacawe. lamaceeweme bawesethwa yezawateraalu. moteme 'ayenakaacaweme. 'alaaheme lamaceeme banaresu yamaayeqothaa sihone lanaresune wadada. 'enaresume bazawetaari tzagaawe 'eresu wadadu. 'enedihe yaalane menedaa maagenyate 'enaa ba'alaaheme mawedade 'eresu taalaaqe dasetaa nawe.>>

yasamaayaate 'enaa yamedere negeszenaa hulu ya'alaahe nawe. 'eresu fathaariyaacawe 'enaa yanagaraacaweme 'asetanaabaari nawe. 'eresume bafethuraane hulu laaye selethaane 'alawe. 'eresume banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe. yamisaanawe nagare yalame.

thaqelaaye yahona melu`enate, kawedeetaa gaare yataqoraanya malekaame mugasaa hulu samaayaatene 'enaa mederene yaala'amesaayaa lafatharawe, leelitene chalamaa; qanene dagemo berehaane huno 'enedifaraaraqu laadaragawe 'alaahe yatagabaa nawe gene 'enanyaa yakaadute sawoce 'enanyaane 'anedaaceneme yaalefatharutene 'akaalaate kageetaacawe ka'alaahe gaare yaasetakaakelaalu

sawoce hoye! geetaacehu 'alaahe maalate yaa 'abaataacehune 'adamene baaseganya gizee ka'afare yafatharaacehu nawe kaziyaame baqerebitwa `aalame wesethe yameteqoyubatene gizee wasana 'eresu 'eneji leelaa 'akaale yamaayaaweqawe sihone 'enaanetane baferedu `elate liqasaqesebate leelaa qatharo 'adaraga kazihe hulu baxwaalaa 'enaaneta baresu yamaqaseqase celotaa laaye tetharaatharaalaacehu

'eresu basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere becanyaa tamalaakiwe nawe. baresu laaye 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayeshashagebateme kahasaabe, kanegegere 'enaa katagebaareme 'enaaneta yametedabequtene, geletze yametaadareguteneme yaaweqaale baziyaame laaye yemanadaacexwaale

'enanyihene thaa`otaawiyaane kareswa yamirequ 'enaa yamiyaasetabaabelu bihone 'eneji 'anedaaceme maaserajaa yalaacaweme ya'alaahe 'anedenate, yamale'eketanyaawene 'ewenatanyenate yamiyaamalaaketu geletze maaserajaawoce baregethe mathetolaacawaale, kaziheme gaare kareswa reqawaale ka'ewenateme 'afagefegawaale

'enaresu kadarasaacawe geletze maaserajaa yaraaqu bihonu 'ayegarememe kazihe balaaye male'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'ewenatanyenatune yamiyaawequ sihone yezo yamathaawene qure'aane 'asetabaabelawaale baferedume `elate qethaate bamiyaayubate gizee yesaalaqubate yanabarawene ya'ewenate zeenaa baregethe yaawequtaale

'enanyihe kahadiyaane 'alaahe badaaye hhezebocene bamaathefaate yaalawene lemaade 'ayaawequmene? 'alaahe la'enanyihe yaalesathawene ka'enaresu bafite lanabarute hhezeboce xaayelene 'enaa bamedere laaye yamaqoyate madaarashaane sathaacawe takataataaye zenaabene laakalaacawe kabeetocaacawe sere yamifasu jeratoce sathaacawe gene 'alaahene 'amatzu 'alaaheme baszarute wanejale mekeneyaate 'athafaacawe bametekaacaweme leeloce hhezebocene qasaqasa

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bawaraqate laaye yatatzaafa matsehhafe baaneta laaye benaawaredenaa ba`aayenocaacawe bimalakatute, ba'ejocaacaweme bamadaabase biyaaragaagethu bakahadinataacawe 'enaa ba'emebitanyaanataacawe mekeneyaate 'ayaamenubateme yehe yaamathaakxawe nagare geletze degemete kamahone yaraaqa 'ayedalame, 'anaamenebateme yelaalu

'enanyiheme kahadiyaane - <<'alaahe kamuhhamade gaare 'enyaane yamiyaanaagerane 'enaa nabiyenatuneme yamimasakere male'aake bileke noro 'enaamene nabare>> 'alu 'enyaa 'enaresu bafalagute maleku male'aake lekane 'enaa 'enaresume kamaamane biyaafanagethu theqiteme gizee saanaaqoyaacawe 'enaathafaacawaalane; male'aaku kawarada baxwaalaa latzatzate 'enekwaa gizeene 'anesathaacaweme

wadanaresu yamilaakawene male'eketanyaa male'ake benaadaregawe noro karesu masemaate, maqamaamathe 'enaa maradaate yecelu zanede basawe maleke 'enaadaregawe nabare mekeneyaatume bamale'ake maleku bimathaa mathaathaame selamaayecelu basawe maleke 'aderegane benelekawe dagemo yamiyaamasaaselubatene nagare 'aderegane 'enaamasaaselebaacawe nabare

'enanyihe kahadiyaane male'ake 'enediwaredelaacawe bamathayaqe baaneta laaye bisaalaqu, kaaneta bafite batalaakute male'eketanyoceme 'enedihu hhezebocaacawe tasaaleqawebaacawaale 'enanyaaneme ba'alaahe qethaate sisethanaqaqu yatasaalaqu sawocene yesaalaqubate yanabarawe qethaate 'akaabaabaacawe

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa 'asetabaabaaye kahadiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe:- <<bamedere laaye tagwaazu 'enaa ba'alaahe male'eketanyoce yaasetabaabalu sawoce macharashaacawe mene 'enedanabarace tamalekatu 'enaa 'asetawelu 'enaresu kanabarubate xaayele 'enaa beretaate baxwaalaa ya'alaahe qethaate taragaagethobaacawe thafetawaale >>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<yasamaayaatu yamederu 'enaa bamahalaacawe yaalawe `aalame negeszenaa hulu lamaane nawe?>> balaacawe malese baayesathuheme, <<negeszenaawe hulu ya'alaahe nawe>> balaacawe babaarocu laaye lamacareme sile 'ezenatene baraasu laaye tzaafa laqethaateme 'ayaacaakulaacaweme kathefaate baayemalasume baferedu `elate hulaacaweneme yesabasebaacawaale yeheme qane lamamethaatu therethaaree yalaweme 'enanyaa bakehedate mekeneyaate 'eraasaacawene yaakasaru sawoce 'ayaamenume raasaacaweme kakeserate 'ayaadenume

yahulu nagare negeszenaa ya'alaahe nawe baqanenaa baleelite yaragaawe `aalame negeszenaa hulu yaresu nawe 'eresume negegeraacawene sami szeraawocaacaweneme `aawaaqi nawe baziyaame laaye yemanadaacawaale

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa ka'alaahe gaare leelocene thaa`otaate 'enaa 'amaalekete bamagazaate ba'alaahe laaye yamiyaagaarutene <<'eseki ka'alaahe baashaagare yamewadaajawe 'enaa 'eredaataane yamethayeqawe wadaaje linoranye yegabaalene?>> balaacawe <<'eresu yaa yaqadama 'amesaayaa saayenoraacawe samaayaatene 'enaa mederene yafathara, baarocuneme yafalagawene yamimagebe 'eresume yamaayemagabe hono saala karesu baashaagare wadaaje leyaazene?>> balaacawe, <<kazihe hhezebe makaakale lageetaawe kataazaza 'enaa katawaadaqa sawe yamajamariyaawe 'enedehone, 'anedaace nagare yaalefatharu 'akaalaatene ka'eresu laaye leelocene kaagaarute 'atehune sileme geetaayee 'azezonyaale>> balaacawe

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'enee sherekene 'enaa yamasalawene geetaayee yakalakalanyene nagare bamafatzame 'aliyaame 'eresune kamaferaate 'enaa kamataazaze bamazanegaate geetaayeene yaamatzekunye 'enedahona, baferedu `elate taalaaqe qethaate 'enedaayeqathaanye 'efaraalahu>> bale
'alaahe baferedu `elate yaanene qethaate yaaraaqalate 'enaa yaasewagadalate 'alaahe baregethe 'azenolataale yaame kaqethaate madaane geletze yahona sekeete 'enaa dasetaa nawe

'aneta ya'adame leje hoye! ka'alaahe yahona makaraa bigathemehe 'eresu 'alaahe kaalehona basetaqare leelaa 'asewagaaje yalaweme karesu zanede malekaame nagare bidaresehe laresu kalekaaye, cerotaaweneme malaashe yalaweme 'eresu 'anedaaceme nagare yamaayesaanawe banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe

'eresume babaarocu laaye 'ashanaafi, bahulu nagare kanaresu yalaaqa, maaneme yamaayaashanefawe nawe hulume laresu yatawaadaqu naacawe karesu keberenaa leqenaa bamigatheme maleku kabaarocu balaaye nawe 'eresume bamafethare 'enaa bamaasetanaabare bakule thebabanyaa, 'anedaaceme nagare yamaayeshashagebate wesethe `aawaaqi nawe

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<la'enee 'ewenatanyenate kamesekerenate bakule yagazafa 'enaa yatalaqa maane nawe?>> balaacawe - <<selanee 'ewenatanyete kamesekerenate bakule 'alaahe kahulu balaaye nawe. ba'enee 'enaa banaaneta mahale 'eresu masekaari nawe. 'enee yezhee yamathaahutene 'enaanetame yametesathunyene malese yaaweqaale. 'enaanetane 'enedihume kasaweme kagaaneeneme zeenaawe yadarasawene hulu 'enedaasethanaqeqebate yehenene qure'aane wadanee 'aweredotaale 'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! ka'alaahe gaare ya`aalamene `ethaa fanetaa yamiwasenu leeloce 'amaaleketoce 'alu telaalaacehune? 'enaaneta yatanaazazaacehutene nagare 'ewenate nawe beyee 'alemasakereme. 'enaho 'alaahe 'agaare yaleelawe becanyaa 'amelaake nawe. 'enee 'enaaneta baresu laaye kametaagaarute nagare hulu yatharaahu nanye>> balaacawe.

'enanyaa taweraate yasathanaacawe 'ayehudoce 'enaa nejileneme yasathanaacawe keresetiyaanoce, muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) lejocaacawene kaleeloce lejoce layetawe yamiyaawequtene yaahele yaawequtaale. 'enanyaa bakehedate mekeneyaate 'esaate bamagebaate raasaacawe yakasaru sawoce 'ayaamenume.

la'alaahe 'agaare bamaaderage ka'alaahe weche yaalane 'akaale kaamalaka, 'alaaheme bamale`eketanyaawe laaye baawaradawe 'aneqatze kaasetabaabala sawe balaaye badaaye yalame. 'enanyaa la'alaahe 'agaarene bamaaderage 'enaa ba'aneqatzocume bamaasetabaabale yabadalute kaaletatzatzatu 'enaa kaaletamalasu basetaqare 'ayedenume.

'enyaa baferedu `elate 'anedaacaweneme saanetawe hulaacaweneme sabesebane kaziyaame 'enanyaane ka'alaahe baashaagare leelocene yaamalakutene bamaathaathaale, 'enanyaa baqethefate ba'alaahe laaye taagaarwacawe yanabarute 'amaalekete yate naacawe? bamenelebate gizee 'asetaawese.

kaziyaame 'enaresu ka'amaaleketu 'eraasaacawene yaagalalu mahonaacawene magelatze 'eneji yamiyaaqarebute maamelachaa 'ayenoraacaweme. baweshateme bageetaacene ba'alaahe yehunebene baqerebitwa `aalame bageetaacene yamenaagaaraa 'alenabareneme. baresu yaamanene 'eresune babecanyenate 'amelaakiwoce nabarene yelaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyihe sawoce ba'alaahe maagaaraataacawene bamaasetabaabale baraasaacawe laaye 'enedeete 'enedamiwaashu tamalekate. baqerebitwa hheyewataacawe la'alaahe 'agaaroce yaadaragwaacaweme hulu kanaresu raaqu, liradwacawe 'alecaalume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'agaariwoce makaakale qure'aanene setaanabe 'anetane yamiyaadaamethe 'ala. gene 'enaresu bamiyaadaamethute nagare 'ayethaqamume. yeheme ba'emebitanyenataacawe 'enaa bamaafanegathaacawe mekeneyaate balebocaacawe laaye shefaanene, bajorowocaacaweme laaye denequrenaane selaadaragene nawe. mene geletze 'aserajiwocene biyaayu 'enekwaa 'ayaamenume. wadaaneta bamathu gizee baweshate yekaraakaruhale. yehe yezahe yamathaakxawe nagare kaqadamete matsaahhefete yatagalabatha yaqadamete sawoce tarataa tarate 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame yelaalu.

sawoce bamale'eketanyaawe 'enedaayaamenu yekalakelwacawaale. 'eraasaacaweme kamale`eketanyaawe yereqaalu. baresu yamithaqamene maaneneme 'ayetaweme. 'enaresume 'ayethaqamubateme. bazihe szeraacawe 'eraasaacawene 'eneji leelaa maaneneme 'ayegodume. yamilute nagare nafesocaacawene maathefiyaa 'eneji leelaa 'enedaalehona 'ayaawaqeme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyihe kahadiyaane ba'esaate laaye bamithaadubate gizee baquchete - <<'enyaa wada majamariyaayetu heyewataacene batamalasene, ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce baalaasetabaabalene 'enaa ba'alaaheme kaamanute sawoce benehone mene nabarabate?>> silu betaayaacawe kakafaa huneetaacawe yamigareme nagarene temalakate nabare.

gudaayu wada medera `aalame benemalase 'enaamenaalane 'enedaalute 'ayedalame. yelequneme yasawenate 'akaalaacawe banaresu laaye bamasakara gizee wa'llWahi rabWina ma (kun)Wa mushrikiyna <<ba'alaahe yehunebene 'agaariwoce 'alenabareneme>> belawe melawe yadabaqute nagare yegalathelaacawaale. 'enaresu wada qerebitu `aalame yemalasu bibaale 'enekwaa takalekelawe wadanabarute kehedate 'enaa maagaaraate yemalasu nabare. benemalase 'enaamene nabare baalute nagare yamiwaashu 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalume.
'enanyaa 'agaariwoceme 'enyaa kamenenorebaate hheyewate baashaagare leelaa hheyewate yalame 'enyaame lagemegamaa yameneqasaqase 'ayedalaneme 'alu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa maqaseqasene yaasetabaabalu sawoce kageetaacawe fite bamithaadubate gizee betaaye noro bakafaa huneetaacawe yamidaneqe nagare taaye nabare. 'alaaheme yehe 'enaaneta taasetabaabelute yanabaraacehute maqaseqase therethaaree yaleelabate 'eregethe 'ayedalamene? bamilaacawe gizee 'enaresume bafatharane geetaacene 'enemelaalane 'eresu therethaaree yaleelabate 'enaa yatzanaa 'ewenate nawe yelaalu. 'alaaheme baziyaane gizee - <<bazihe qane bamakaadaacehu mekeneyaate qethaate qemasu baqerebitwame `aalame saalaacehu taasetabaabelute yanabarawe nawe>> yelaacawaale.

'enanyaa baferedu `elate maqaseqasene 'enaa 'alaahe fite maqomene yaasetabaabalu sawoce baregethe kasaru. sa`aatitume denegate bametemathaacawe gizee baberetu quchete 'alaahene bamakaade 'enaa laferedume `elate baalamazagaajataacene ka'alaahe bakule laagodalenawe nagare waa! tzatzataacene, waa! yatasefaacene kanetunate yelaalu. wanejalocaacaweneme bajarebaawocaacawe yeshakamaalu. 'enanyaa kawanejaloce bakule yatashakamute nagare menenyaa kafaa!

yehece 'enaaneta yametemakubaate yaqerebitwa `aalame 'alaahene yamiyaasedasete nagare lamaayeszaraabaate sawe chawaataa 'enaa mataalayaa 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaceme. yaace yamacharashaayetu `aalame gene lananyiyaa ba'emenate 'enaa 'eresune bamataazaze 'alaahene lafarute sawoce balaache nace. 'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! yehenene 'ataasetawelumene? 'amenaacehume malekaame szeraane 'ateszarumene?

'aneta male'eketanyaa waye! 'enanyihe kahadiyaane 'anetane bageletze maasetabaabalaacawe 'enedamiyaasetakezehe baregethe 'enaaweqaalane. gene `ewaqe 'enaresu yaanetane 'ewenatanyaanate 'enaa taamaanyenate selamiyaawequ balebonaacawe 'ayaasetabaabeluheme. gene 'enaresu badaaye hhezeboce naacawe. meneme 'enekwaane balebonaacawe 'ewenate mahonune biyaawequme ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce yaasewaashaalu, te`ezaazeheneme maqabalene bageletze yeqaawamaalu.

yehe maasetabaabale 'aneta yezahe lamathaakxawe male'ekete becaa 'enedahona 'aderegahe 'ataasebe. kaaneta bafite yanabaru male'eketanyoceneme 'asetabaabelawaale. hhezebocaacaweme 'asaqaayetawaacawaale. ka'alaaheme yahona dele 'esekamathaacawe gizeeme wada 'alaahe bamathaaraate 'enaa ba'alaahe manegademe bamataagale laaye taagasu. 'alaahe lamale'eketanyocu yagabaalaacawene qaale kidaane 'enaa yatzaafawene dele yamiqayere maaneme yalame. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta bafite yanabarute male'eketanyoce zeenaa, kahhezebocaacawe yaaganyutene yakafaa malese 'enaa seqaaye belome 'alaahe bathalaatocaacawe laaye yaagonaatzafaacawene dele yamiyaatete zeenaa baregethe mathetolehale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'enanyihe kahadiyaane yamidaresebehe seqaaye, 'aneta yezahe yamathaakxawene 'ewenate maasetabaabalaacawe 'enaa karesume maraaqaacawe kakabadahe, bamedere wesethe qadaadaane 'aliyaame wada samaaye mawathaachaa masalaale 'aderegahe 'enaresune yametaasaamenebatene maaserajaa lamaamethaate mokere gene 'ayaamenume. 'alaahe 'enaresune 'aneta yezahe bamathaakxawe mamariyaa laaye masabesabe bifalege ta`aamerene 'aweredo 'anede yaadaregaacawe nabare gene lathebabu sile 'asegadedo 'anede 'alaadaragaacaweme. selazihe yehenene kamaayaawequte honahe nafesehe bazihe gudaaye bamatzatzate ruqe yameteheede 'atehune.

'aneta yamathaahebatene 'ewenate bamaqabale latherihe malese yamisathute 'enanyaa negegerene sametawe yamiradu naacawe. kahadiyaane gene kazihe dereshaa yalaacaweme lebocaacawe motawaale mutaanene dagemo 'alaahe baferedu `elate yeqasaqesaacawaale. kaziyaaneme baszarute szeraa yemanadaacawe zanede wadaresu becaa yemalasaalu.

'enanyaa thaa`otaawiyaane ba'emebitanyenate 'enaa ka'emenate lamaafagefage silu muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) kageetaawe yezo bamathaawe nagare 'aseraje yehone zanede lamene sawe liyaadaregawe yamaayecelawe ta`aamere baresu laaye 'alewaradame yelaalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye - <<'alaahe 'enaresu 'enedamifalegute ta`aamerene bamaawerade laaye caaye nawe. gene yehe ta'amere 'enedaresu felaagote lathebabe yamiwarede 'eneji 'enedasemeetocaacawe 'ayehoneme>> bale. yehenene 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme.

bamedere gatze laaye kamineqasaaqasu 'enesesaate basamaaye kamibare baraari leke 'enedanaanetawe (ya'adame lejoce) bafetherate 'enaa basisaaye tamasaasaaye hhezeboce bihonu 'eneji leelaa yalame. bamatsehhafume batathabaqawe saleedaa yaaragaagathenawe bihone 'eneji yatawenawe nagare yalame. yahulaacaweme `eweqate 'alaahe zanede nawe. kaziyaame baferedu `elate bamahakalaacawe baferede yelaye zanede wadageetaacawe yemalasaalu. kaziyaame 'eyaanedaanedune bamigabaawe yemanadaawaale.

'enanyaa ba'aneqatzocaacene yakaadu sawoce 'enedamaayesamu daneqorowoce, 'enedamaanaagarume didaawoce bithee naacawe. 'enedihe kamahonaacaweme gaare maayate yamaayecelu bachalamaawoce wesethe naacawe.
