'alaahe kasawoce makaakale bathemematu mekeneyaate liyaathamemawe yafalagawene yaathamemawaale. baqenenatu mekeneyaateme limaraawe yafalagawene thememate baleelabate qathetanyaa manegade laaye yaadaregawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa thaa`otaawiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe - <<ka'alaahe yahona qethaate wayeme mamethaatwa yatanagaraacehute yaferede sa`aate bimathaabaacehu yamidaresebaacehune makaraa 'enaa seqaaye yegalethelaacehu zanede ka'alaahe leelaa yaalane 'akaale nawe yametetharute? 'amaaleketocaacene theqemene yaamathulenaale gudaateneme yaasewagedulenaale bametelute nagare 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu malese sethu.

ba'ewenatu kahona baziyaa gizee yafatharaacehune 'alaahene 'eneji leelaane 'atethaarume. 'eresume sifalege makaraane yaanasaalaacexwaale. gudaateneme yegalethelaacexwaale. 'amaaleketocaacehu gene 'ayethaqemume, 'ayegodumeme maalatene 'aweqaacehu tetawaacawaalaacehu.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta bafite wadanabarute hhezeboce baregethe male'eketanyocene lekanaale; 'asetabaabalwacawe. yezawe kamathwacawe nagaroce 'afanagathu. 'afanegaachocume lageetaacawe 'enediwaadaqu 'enaa 'eneditanaanasu bamaaderage bamakaraa 'enaa babashetaa gudaate yaazenaacawe.

ya'enyaa makaraame wadanaresu bamathaa gizee la'alaahe bitanaanasu 'enaa biwaadaqu noro makaraane kanaresu bagalathene nabare. gene yaanene 'alaadaragume. lebocaacawe daraqu. 'aletamakarume. shayethwaneme yeszarute yanabarutene wanejale 'enaa kehedate 'asegeethalaacawe. banabarubate maafanegatheme qathalubate.

'enaresume kamaathaate cegere 'enaa kabashetaa gudaateme yatamakarubatene bazanagu 'enaa ya'alaaheneme te`ezaaze batawu gizee 'enaresune lamaazanaagaate yahulu nagarene baroce 'enaa yasisaayene dajaafoce kafatenelaacawe. kamaathaate baxwaalaa 'abalatzagenaacawe. kahhemame baxwaalaame theenaamaa 'adaragenaacawe. baziheme kuraate yezwacawe badasetaa bafanathazunaa batathaqamubate nagare batakofasu gizee qethaataacene denegate chabathaacawe. wadiyaaweme tasefaa yaqorathu 'enaa yatadanaagarume honu.

male'eketanyocene bamaredaate 'enaa yakehedate baaletabeetocene 'esekamacharashaacawe bamaathefaate yabadaaye hhezeboce jarebaa taqoratha. thalaatocune bamaathefaatu 'enaa wadaajocuneme bamaredaatu ya`aalamaatu geetaa 'alaahe mesegaanaa tagabaawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa thaa`otaawiyaane - <<'alaahe bathemataacehu mekeneyaate masemiyaacehune wasedo yaadanaqoraacehu, maayaacehuneme wasedo yaasaawaraacehu 'enedahona 'enedihume balebonaacehume laaye 'atemo 'anedaaceneme nagare maradaate baatecelu yehene yaathaacehutene nagare yatenyaawe 'amelaake nawe limaleselaacehu yamicelawe?>> balaacawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enyaa maaserajaawocene 'enedeete 'enedamenaaberaaraalaacawe tamalekate kaziyaame 'enedeete ka'ewenate 'enedamizanabalu 'asetawele.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe, <<ya'alaahe qethaate 'enaaneta saayetaawaqaacehu badenegate bimathaa wayeme ba`aayenaacehu 'eyaayaacehu bageletze bimathaabaacehu 'enanyaa 'alaahene bamakaade 'enaa male`eketanyaawene bamaasetabaabale yabadalu sawoce 'eneji yamithafu 'alune?>> balaacawe.

kamale'eketanyoce 'anedaacaweneme 'amaanyocene 'enaa lageetaacawe taazaazhocene yamaayaaleqe 'enaa yamaayeqwaarathe 'enedihume zawetaari bahona tzagaa 'abesaariwoce, yakehedate 'enaa ya'emebitanyenate baaletabeetocene dagemo 'enyaa zanede baala beretu qethaate 'asethaneqaaqiwoce 'aderegane 'eneji 'anelekeme. bamale`eketanyocu yaamanu 'enaa szeraacaweneme yaasaamaru bamachiwe `aalame bamigathemaacawe nagare laaye ferehate, kaqerebitume `aalame thelawe baheedute tekaazee yalabaacaweme.
'enanyaa ba'aneqatzocaacene yaasetabaabalute dagemo ka'alaahe te`ezaaze bamaafanegathaacawe mekeneyaate qethaate yeyezaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyihe thaa`otaawiyaane - <<'enedafalageku wache yamaadaregawe ya'alaahe yahabete delebe 'enee zanede 'ala 'alelaacehume, 'alaahe bamalakotaawi male'eketu kaasaawaqanye basetaqare karuqe `eweqate 'aweqaalahu 'aleleme, kamalaa'ekete 'anede male'ake nanye 'aleleme, 'enee ka'alaahe yatalaaku male`eketanyaa nanye. wadanee yatawaradane 'eneji 'alekataleme. lanee yaalehonane yanee nawe 'aleleme>> balaacaweme. `eyetaawe ka'ewenate yataawarace kahadi 'enaa 'ewenatene `aayeto yaamanabate 'amaanye yesetakaakalaalune? 'enaaneta kahadiyaanehoye! 'ataasetawelumene, 'ataasetanatenumene?

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaane wadageetaacawe masabesabene yamifaru sawocene bazihe baqure'aane 'asethaneqeqaacawe - la'enaresu ka'alaahe weche theqeme yamiyaamathaalaacawe wadaaje gudaateme yamiyaasewagedelaacawe 'amaalaaje yalaacaweme. te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'enaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene yefaru zanede 'asethaneqeqaacawe. baqure'aane yamithaqamute 'enaresu naacawenaa.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kathaa`otaawiyaane makaakale taalaalaaqocune letaasewadede zanede 'enanyaane yageetaacawene fite yamifalegu 'amelekoteneme laresu yaatharu honawe bathwate 'enaa bamaataa yamilamenutene deha ya'alaahe baarocene kagubaa'eehe 'ataabaarere. ya'enanyaa dehoce gemegamaa baaneta laaye yalabeheme. hhisaabaacawe 'alaahe zanede nawe. kanaresume hhisaabe baaneta laaye yalame. kagubaa'eehe yaabaararekaacawe gizee 'aneta kabadaayocu tehonaalahe.

leke 'enedihu kafilaacawene bakafilaacawe fatanene. ba`aalamaawi dereshaacaweme yatalayaayu 'adaragenaacawe. kahadiyaane baalatzagaawoce deha 'amaanyocene bamaasemalekate, 'alaahe kamakaakalaacene maretho baqenaacaa yaabalatzagaacawe sawoce 'enanyihe naacawene? 'emenate malekaame bihone noro 'enaresu baaleqadamune nabare 'enedilu fatanenaacawe. 'alaahe tzagaawocune 'amasegaanyocene `aawaaqi 'ayedalame 'enedee? baregethe nawe. selaziheme la'emenate manegade yegathemaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa ya'anetane 'ewenatanyenate bamimasakeru 'aneqatzocaacene yamiyaamenu sawoce simathulehe salaame banaaneta laaye yesefane setele yamaakebare salaametaane malesalaacawe. ba'alaahe 'ezenate safinateme 'abeseraacawe. 'alaaheme baraasu laaye 'ezenatene gede 'adaraga kanaaneta makaakale baalamaawaqe 'enaa bamonyenate hathi'atene yafatzama kaziyaame baxwaalaa yatatzatzata 'enaa yatamalasa belome szeraawene yaasaamara 'alaahe wanejalune yemerelataale. 'alaahe kabaarocu wadaresu latamalasute mahari lanaresume 'azaanye nawe.
kazihe bafite yatathaqasawene 'enedaaberaaraanelehe hulu ya'amatzanyoce manegade 'enaa 'akaaheede yefaa hono mathaneqaqu yemace zanede 'aneqatzocune 'enaa maaserajaawocene 'enaaberaaraalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale geetaayee 'enaaneta ka'alaahe baashaagare yametaamalekwaacawene 'akaalaate kamaamelake kalekelonyaale. ka'alaahe leelaa yaalutene bamaamelake 'enee zenebaaleeyaacehune 'alekataleme. bazihe ragade zenebaaleeyaacehune yatakataleku 'enedahona kaqathetanyaawe manegade kathamamute 'ehonaalahu. wadaresume 'alemaraame. yehe yaala 'anedaace maaserajaa semeetune yamikatale sawe manegade nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa lathaa`otaawiyaane, <<'enee banafesee zenebaalee laaye saayehone kageetaayee bahona geletze maaserajaa laaye nanye balaacawe. 'enaaneta gene yehenene geletze maaserajaa 'asetabaabelaacexwaale. 'enaaneta yametecaakolubate qethaate 'enaa yametefalegute ta`aamere 'enee zanede yalame. yaa ba'alaahe 'eje nawe. 'enaaneta yafalagaacehute nagare feredu ya'alaahe 'eneji yaleelaame 'ayedalame. 'alaahe 'ewenatene yenaagaraale. baresume yefaredaale. 'eresu 'asetabaabaayene ka'ewenatanyaa sawe kamilaye hulu balaache faraaje nawe.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<yehe 'enaaneta yametecaakolubate nagare 'enee zanede 'enaa baquthetheree wesethe bihone noro ba'enaaneta laaye 'awaredawe nabare. baziyaame gizee ba'eneenaa banaaneta mahakale nagare yelaye nabare. 'alaaheme badaayocene mene yaahele 'enedamiyaaqoyaacawe 'enaa mace 'enedamiqathaacawe kamaaneme balaaye 'awaaqi nawe.

yadebeqe nagare delebe 'alaahe zanede becaa nawe. karesu weche yaala maaneme 'akaale 'ayaaweqaweme. bayabese yaalu fethuraanene bamulu 'enesesaatune, `etzewaatune ge`uze nagarocene hulu babaahhereme yaalu 'enesesaatene 'enaa `etzewaatene hulu yaaweqaale. 'anediteme yatabathasace qethale, bamedere chelamaawoce yatadabaqace 'erethebeme tehune daraqe feree hulune 'aberaari bahonawe thebeqe saleedaa wesethe tatzefo yaala bihone 'eneji kazihe weche 'ayedalame.

'alaahe maalate yaa 'esetenefaasaacehune ba'eneqelefe gizeeyaawi masabesabene yamisabasebe nawe. baneqaataacehume gizee baqane wesethe mene 'enedaszaraacehu yaaweqaale. kaziyaame ba'eneqelefe 'esetenefaasaacehune kamasabesabe baxwaalaa 'alaahe zanede yatawasanawe `elata motaacehu 'esekidarese derase baqane wesethe szeraacehune letaakanaawenu yeqasaqesaacexwaale. kaziyaame baferedu `elate mamalashaacehu wadaresu nawe. kaziyaame baqerebitu `aalame teszarute yanabaraacehutene nagare hulu yenageraacexwaale baziyaame yemanadaacexwaale.

'alaahe babaarocu laaye 'ashanaafi nawe. 'enaresune yaagaraacawe 'enaa bahulume 'aqethaachaa kanaresu yalaaqa, keberune 'enaa le`elenaawene bamigatheme maleku yabalaaye nawe. sawoce hoye! 'anedaacehu mote bamimathaa `elate male'aka mote 'enaa gebera 'abarocu kataazazute nagare yamaayaagwaadelu sihonu ya'enaanetane 'esetenefaase 'esekisabasebume derase 'enaanetane tathabaabaaqi 'enaa szeraawocaacehune yamimazagebu malaa'eketene yelekaale.

kaziyaame baszeraawocaacawe laaye yemanadaacawe zanede 'esetenefaasaacawe yatasabasabace sawoce hulu wada 'ewenatanyaawe geetaacawe yemalasaalu. malaashe yaleelawe wesaanee 'enaa fetehawi ferede hulu yaresu nawe. 'eresu kagamegaamiwoce hulu fathaanu nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa lathaa`otaawiyaane, <<bayabese 'enaa babaahhere chelamaawoce kamigathemwacehu 'adagaawoce 'aterefwacehu salaame yamiyaadaregaacehu, bageletzeme badebeqeme laresu yatawaaradaacehu 'enaa yatanaanasaacehu honaacehu kazihece makaraa yaadaanane 'enedahona ka'amasegaanyoce 'enehonaalane belaacehu yametetharute 'enaa yamiyaadenaacehu maanawe?>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<kaziyaace cheneqe yamiyaatarefaacehu, kamakaraa hulu yamiyaadenaacehu 'alaahe nawe>> balaacawe. gene 'enaaneta cegere 'alefo tadelaa siyaaganyaacehu karesu gaare leelocene taagaaraalaacehu. kazihe tagebaaraacehu balaaye mene yakafaa badale 'ala?

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bale - 'eresu 'alaahe 'eneda denegaaye, maberaqe 'enaa bawehaa maathelaqelaqe 'ayenate qethaate kabalaayaacehu 'enedihume 'eneda mareete maneqatheqathe 'enaa yamareete masemathe `aayenate qethaate kabataacaacehu lilekebaacehu, waye balebocaacehu mahakale bamaalayaayate hulaacehume semeetune takataaye hono kafilaacehu kafilaacehune yamigaadale, kafilaacehu yakafilaacehune theqaate yamiqamese liyaadaregaacehu yecelaale. 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! 'enaresu 'aneta yezahe yamathaakxawene 'ewenataa yeradu zanede 'aneqatzotsocene 'enaa maaserajaawocene 'enedeete 'enedamenaaberaaraalaacawe tamalekate.

yehe qure'aane therethere yaleelabate ka'alaahe yahona 'ewenataa hono saala hhezebocehe 'asetabaabalute. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'enee ba'enaaneta laaye taqothaathaari 'ayedalahume. beretu qethaate kamamethaatu bafite qademee 'asethaneqaaqi 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalahume>> balaacawe.

la'eyaanedaanedu zeenaa yamiyaabaqaabate macharashaa 'enaa yamiragaagathebate gizee 'alawe. yamaabeqiyaacehu 'enaa yamamalashaahu zeenaa kazihu makaakale nawe. bameteqasaqasubate yaferede `elateme yehene hulu taaweqaalaacehu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa kahadiyaane ba'aneqatzocaacene bamaashofe 'enaa bamasaalaqe maleke sinagaagaru kasamaahe kaziyaa weche wadaala negegere 'esekigabu derase kanaresu raaqe. shayethwaneme 'aserasetohe kanaresu gaare yataqamaamatheke 'enedahona kaasetaawaseke baxwaalaa ka'enanyaa denebare zalale badaaye hhezeboce gaare 'ateqamaamathe.

ba'enanyaa te`ezaazune bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahene bamifaru sawoce laaye ya'enanyaa badaaye sawoce gemegamaa yalabaacaweme. gene ya'alaahene te`ezaaze 'enedithabequ 'enaa kamifatzemuteme wanejale yeqothabu zanede 'enaresune magasatze 'alabaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa 'emenataacawene machaawacaa 'enaa masaalaqiyaa 'aderegawe yayaazutene bawesethwa baazalacewe gizeeyaawi 'enaa tawagaaje theqeme yaqerebitwa `aalame yaataalalacaacawene kahadiyaanene tawaacawe. sawoceneme 'anedite nafese baszaraacewe wanejale 'enedaateyaaze, baqure'aane 'asethaneqeqe. 'anedite nafese bawanejalwa bameteyaazebate `elate, ka'alaahe baashaagare yamiradaate wadaaje, ya'alaaheneme qethaate yamimaleselaate 'amaalaaje 'ayenoraateme. ka'alaaheme qethaate lamadaane beezaane hulu betaaqarebe taqabaayenatene 'ataaganyeme. 'enanyaa baszarute wanejale mekeneyaate lathefaate yatadaaragu 'enaa bathefaataacawe yatayaazu naacawe. la'enaresu baferedu `elate yekedu banabarute mekeneyaate 'ejege yafalaa mathathe 'enaa 'asaamaami yahona qethaate 'alalaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa lathaa`otaawiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe - <<'enyaa ka'alaahe baashaagare theqeme yamaayaamathulenenaa gudaateneme yamaayesathunene 'enaamalekaalane? 'alaaheme wada 'emenate kamaraane baxwaalaa wada xwaalaa tamalesane 'enedaziyaa shayethwanaate 'enedaathamamute 'enaa manegaduneme seto 'enedatadanaagara sawe 'enehonaalane?>> balaacawe, <<la'eresume baqathetanyaa manegade laaye qomawe wada 'ewenate 'enedimathaa yamitharute gwaadanyoce 'alute. 'eresu gene ba'emebitanyenate malese 'ayesathaacaweme. 'enedazihe sawe 'enehune?>> balaacawe. 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! <<'enaho 'ewenatanyaa mamariyaa maalate ya'alaahe manegade nawe. 'alaaheme ya'alamaatu geetaa sihone 'eresune babecanyenate bamaamelake te`ezaazune 'enedenethabeqe 'enaa la'eresume 'ejaacenene 'enedenesathe taazezanaale>> balaacawe.

salaateneme 'enedenaaqwaaqume, yaazazawene bamatagebare 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe 'enedenefaraawe taazezanaale. baferedu `elate fethuraane bamulu basarute szeraa yemanadaacawe zanede yamisabasabuteme wadaresu becaa nawe.

'eresume yaa samaayaatene 'enaa mederene laqume nagare yafathara nawe. 'alaaheme 'anedene nagare hune silawe yehonaale. baferedume `elate mutaanene qumu silaacawe yeqomaalu. qaalume sinaagarawe yamifatzame nawe qerote yalaweme. baferedu `elate thurumebaawe baminafaabate gizee negesenaa hulu ya'eresu nawe. debeqe 'enaa geletze nagarene hulu `aawaaqi, bamafetharu 'enaa bamaasetanaabaru thebabanyaa kanagaroceme 'anedaace nagare yamaayeshashagebate wesetha `aawaaqi nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! - <<beraahime kahadi 'abaatune 'aazarene, 'abaatee hoye! thaa`otaatene ka'alaahe baashaagare yametaamalekaacawe 'amaaleketoce 'aderegahe teyezaalahene? 'enee 'aneta 'enaa thaa`otaatene yamiyaalekute hhezebocehe bageletze themate laaye honaacehu 'ayaacexwaalahu>> baalaacawe gizee 'awesaa.

beraamene ya'abaatune 'enaa yahhezebocune manegade masaate 'enedaasaayanawe hulu, ba'alaahe 'anedenate 'enedihume 'amelekote laresu becaa yamigabaawe mahonune 'aseraje 'enedihonawe, 'alaaheme becanyaa 'amelaake 'enedahona ka'eregethanyoce yehone zanede beraahimene kasamaayaate 'enaa kamedere malakote negeszenaa 'enaasaayawaalane.

laliteme baresu laaye bachalama gizee kokobene 'aya <<yehe geetaayee nawe 'ala. kokabume bathalaqa gizee, 'enee yamithaleqene 'alewademe 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaake hulee nawaari 'eneji yamithaleqe 'ayedalame>> 'ala.

charaqaame setewathaa baaya gizee <<yehe geetaayee nawe>> 'ala. bathalaqaceme gizee <<'alaaheme 'eresune babecanyenate lamaamelake qanaawene manegade yamaayemaraanye kahona, katekekelanyaawe 'emenatu karaaqute 'enaa kathamamute hhezeboce mahonee nawe>> 'ala.

tzahhayeme setewathaa baaya gizee <<yehe geetaayee nawe. yehe kakokobume kacharaqaaweme yabalatha nawe>> 'ala. tzahhayewaame bathalaqace gizee <<hhezebocee hoye! 'enaaneta ba'alaahe laaye kametaagaarwacawe 'amaalekete yatharaahu nanye>> 'alaacawe.

hhezebocume ka'alaahe baashaagare kamiyaamalekwaacawe 'amaalekete yatharaa mahonune baayu gizee <<'enaase menedene nawe yametaamalekawe?!>> belawe bithayequte -
beraahimeme - <<'enee laziyaa yaalaqadaami mesaalee samaayaatene 'enaa mederene lafatharawe 'alaahe 'emenateene 'atharaahu. ba'alaahe laaye kamaagaaraate 'eresune babecanyenate wadamaamelakeme yatazanabaleku sehone fiteene wada 'alaahe 'azoreku. 'eneeme ka'alaahe gaare leelocene 'akelawe kamiyaamalekute 'agaariwoce 'ayedalahume>> 'alaacawe.

'enanyaa thaa`otaawiyaane hhezebocume ba'alaahe 'anedenate takaraakarute; bathaa`otaatume 'asefaraarute. <<'alaahe wada qathetanyaa manegade yamaraanye sihone 'eresune babecanyenate bamaamelake 'enaa 'eresuneme ba'amelekote bamanathale tekaraakarunyaalaacehune? 'enee 'amaaleketaacehune 'alefaraame. 'alaahe yafaqada kaalehona basetaqareme 'amaaleketaacehu theqemene 'ayaamathulenyeme; gudaateme 'ayaamathubenyeme. 'alaahe yafaqadawe yehonaale. 'alaahe hulune nagare ba`eweqatu yaakaababa nawe. basamaaye 'enaa bamedere yaala nagare hulu baresu laaye 'ayedabaqeme. hhezebocee hoye! 'enaaneta yaalaacehubatene kehedate 'ataasetawelume? 'enaa ba'alaahe babecanyaa 'amelaakenatu 'ataamenumene?>> 'alaacawe.

'alaahe 'anedaace maaserajaa yaalaawaradabatene nagare ba'alaahe bamaagaaraataacehu yamaatefaru setehonu 'enee ba'alaahe laaye yametaagaarwacawene 'amaalekete 'enedeete lefaraa yegabaanyaale? lamahonu 'alaahene babecanyenate kamiyaamalekute 'enaa ba'alaaheme kamiyaagaarute sawoce makaakale kahulatu cheferoce latzathetanyenate tagabiwoce yatenyocu naacawe? 'ewenatene betaawequ kahulatu lasalaame tagabiwocu 'enamaane naacawe? yaalatherethere 'alaahene babecanyenate 'amelaakiwocu naacawe.

'enanyaa yaamanu 'enaa 'eresu yadanagagawene manegade yatakatalu 'emenataacawene babadalenaa bashereke yaaleqalaaqalu 'enanyaa tzathetaa 'enaa salaame 'alalaacawe. 'enaresume 'alaahe laqathetanyaawe manegade yagathamaacawe 'enaa yataqanute naacawe.

yeheceme...fa'ayWu 'lfariyqayni 'aHaqWu bi'l'amni (kahulatu cheferoce latzathetaa tagabiwoce yatenyocu naacawe...) yametelawaa beraahime, hhezebocune melaashe maaserajaa 'esekiyaathu derase yaashanafabate laberaahime yasathanaate maaserajaacene nace. baqerebitume hona bamachiweme `aalame kabaarocaacene yafalagenawene badarajaawoce kafe 'enaadaregaalane. 'enaho geetaahe bamafethare 'enaa bamaasetanaabare thebabanyaa, selabaarocume huneetaa `aawaaqi nawe.

laberaahimeme lejune sehhaqene yaleje lejuneme yaa`equbene, sathanawe. hulaacaweneme wada qathetanyaawe manegade maraanaacawe. kanaresume bafite nuhhene maraanawe. kanuhheme zereyaa yahonutene daawedene, lejuneme sulayemaanene, 'ayubeneme, yusufeneme, musaaneme, wanedemune haruneneme, huluneme maraanaacawe. nabiyaatene bamalekaame szeraacawe malekaame nagarene 'enedamanadaanaacawe hulu 'asaamaariwoceneme bamalekaame 'enemanadaacawaalane.
zakariyaaneme, yahheyaaneme, yamareyame lejene `isaaneme, leyaaseneme maraane. hulaacaweme 'alaahe lamale`eketanyenate yaachaacawe 'enaa kadagaage ya'alaahe baaroceme makaakale naacawe.
semaa`ilene, yasa`ene, yunusene, lutheneme maraane 'enanyihene hulu nabiyaate ba`aalamaate laaye 'abalathenaacawe.

ka'abaatocaacawe kafilune, kalejocaacaweme, kawanedemocaacaweme 'enedihu yafalagenawene qathetanyaawene manegade maraanawe. marathenaacaweme. 'alaaheneme babecanyenate maamelakene yaamaakala wadahonawe qathetanyaawe manegademe maraanaacawe.

yeheme 'enaresu lasekeete yabaqubate qathetanyaa manegade 'alaahe kabaarocu yafalagawene yamimaraabate mamariyaawe nawe. ba'alaaheme laaye karesu weche yaalu 'akaalaatene biyaagaaru noro, maagaaraate malekaame szeraane selamiyaabese, yeszarute yanabarute malekaame szeraawoce hulu wedeqe yehonubaacawe nabare.

'enaziyaa yatathaqasute nabiyaate, matsaahhefetene, thebabene 'enaa nabiyenatene yasathanaacawe naacawe. 'enazihe hhezebocehe ba'enanyihe nagaroce bikedu bareswa bafetzume kahadi yaalehonu hhezebocene 'azagaajetanaale. 'enaresume ba'alaahe male'eketanyaa yaamanute muhaajiroce taqabaayocaacawe 'anesaaroce 'enaa 'enaresuneme 'eseka feredu `elate bamalekaame yamikatalwacawe me'emanaane naacawe.

'enanyaa nabiyaate, kanaresume gaare yatathaqasute 'abaatocaacawe, lejocaacawe 'enaa wanedemocaacawe 'alaahe latekekelanyaawe manegade yagathamaacawe naacawe. 'enaresuneme 'are'ayaa bamaaderage bamamariyaacawe tamaraa. lahhezeboceheme yehenene qure'aane la'enaaneta bamaaderasee ka'enaaneta menedaane 'alethayeqeme. qure'anume wada qathetanyaawe manegade yemaru zanede la`aalamaate (lasawocenaa la'agaanenete) tagesaatze 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame balaacawe.

thaa`otaawiyaanu lanabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'alaahe basawe leje laaye kamalakotaawi male'ekete 'anedaaceme 'alaawaradame baalu gizee 'alaahene batagabiwe manegade 'alaakabaruteme. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye 'enedihe balaacawe - <<lahhezebocu berehaane 'enaa mamariyaa sihone bamusaa laaye taweraatene yaawaradawe maane nawe? yaanene semeetocaacehune yamigathemawene geletze 'aderegaacehu yamaayegathemawene dagemo yametedabequtene 'enaa kefelefaaye yaadaragaacehutene maane 'awaradawe? 'enaaneta dagemo 'agaariwocu, 'enaanetame honaacehu 'abaatocaacehu kazihe bafite yamaataawequtene kaqure'aane tamaaraacehu. 'enaa maane 'awaradawe?>> 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'alaahe nawe>> balaacawe. kaziyaame mote 'esekimathaacawe derase badenequrenaa 'enaa themataacawe wesethe yamichaawatu sihonu tawewaacawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! yehe qure'aane karesu bafite yawaradutene malakotaawi matsehhafete 'aragaagaache sihone baaneta laaye yaawaradenawe yatabaaraka matsehhafe nawe. yakatamoce 'enaate yahonacewene yamakaane nawaariwoce 'enaa ba`aalame kameseraaqeme kame`eraabeme bareswa zuriyaa kaalu katamoce nawaariwocene letaasethanaqeqebate 'awaradenawe. 'enanyaa bamachiwe `aalame yamiyaamenute baqure'anu yaamenaalu. bawesethu baalaweme yeszaraalu. 'enaresume sa`aataacawene bamathabaqe hegegaatocwanenaa gedeetaawocwane 'enaa sunaawocwane bamaamwalaate basegedataacawe laaye yezawateraalu.

'alaahe basawe leje laaye 'anedaaceneme nagare 'alaawaradame, wayeme wadaresu 'anedaaceme nagare yaaletalaalafa sihone malakotaawi male'ekete wadanee talaalefwale wayeme 'alaahe yaawaradawene `aayenate 'awaredaalahu bamaalate ba'alaahe laaye weshatene kafabaraka sawe balaaye maane badaaye 'ala? 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye - 'enanyaa badaayocene yamote sekaare bamiyaaganyaacawe gizee 'enaa malaa'eketeme 'enaresune bamametaate 'enaa bamaqethaate 'ejocaacawene wadanaresu bamizaragubate gizee, 'enaresuneme bamaathaathaale maleku nafesocaacehune 'awethu 'enyaa 'enesabasebaataalane, zaaree ba'alaahe laaye ka'ewenate yaraaqa weshate tefabareku yanabaraacehu bamahonu 'enaa ba'aneqatzocu kamaamaneme tekoru banabaraacehute sababe yaweredatene qethaate temanadaalaacehu bamilwacawe gizee betemalakate 'asedanegaache nagarene taaye nabare.

bamaqaseqashaaweme `elate, zaaree 'enedafatharenaacehu yaala chaamaa, 'ereqaanaacehune 'enaa yaaletagarazaacehume setehonu, ganezabeme, selethaaneme yaleelaacehu labecaacehu honaacehu, yasathanaacehune nagare saatewadu bagede kabasetajarebaacehu tetaacehu mathaacehune, zaaree 'enanyaane 'amaalaajocaacene naacawe, 'amelekoteme yamigabaacawe ya'alaahe 'agaaroce naacawe belaacehu temogetulaacawe yanabarutene 'agaarocaacehuneme 'anaayelaacehume. bamahakalaacehu yaalawe genenyunate baregethe taqwaaratha. ka'amaalaajenataacaweme temogetute yanabarawe babotaawe 'aletaganyame yebaalaalu.

'alaahe yaa qenethaatene faleqeqo buqaayaane, yafereene 'atheneteme faleqeqo yatamere beqaayene yamiyaawathaa nawe. yasawe lejene 'enedihume 'enesesaatene kafetewate thabetaa 'enedamiyaaseganyawe kamute heyaawene yaawathaale, kasawe 'enaa 'enesesaateme yafetewate thabetaane kadorome 'enequlaalene 'enedamiyaawathaawe `aayenate mutene kaheyaawe yaawathaale. yehenene hulu yamiyaadaregawe yaa 'enaanetane yafatharawe 'alaahe nawe. 'enaaneta 'agaariyaane hoye! yehenene yamidaneqe 'afathaatharune 'eyatamalakataacehu ka'ewenate 'enedeete taafanegethaalaacehu?

'eresu yaa yathewaatene berehaane, gohhene kaleelite chalamaa faleqaaqi nawe. baarocume baqane manoriyaacawene bamafalage kadakamu baxwaalaa liyaarefubate zanede leelitene maregiyaa yaadaraga nawe. tzahhayene 'enaa charaqaaneme batawasanalaacawe lekeete 'enedishekarakaru 'adaraga. yeheme bahulu nagaru 'ashanaafi 'enaa labaarocu yamibajaacawene nagare babotaawe 'aseqamaache thebabanyaa yahonawe ya'alaahe maazagaajate nawe.

'enaaneta ya'adame lejoce hoye! 'alaahe maalate yaa la'enaaneta baguzwacehu bayabese 'enaa babaahhere chalamaawoce manegadoce simasaasalubaacehu temarubaacawe zanede kawaakebetene yafatharalaacehu nawe. celotaacenene thaqwaami yahonu geletze maaserajaawoceneme lamiyaawequ sawoce baregethe 'aberaaretanaale.

'eresume yaa ka'anedite nafese ka'abaataacehu 'adame yafatharaacehu nawe. 'eresune ka'afare fatharanaa 'enaanetaneme karesu 'aseganyaacehu. la'enaanetame ka'enaatoce maahetzane maregiyaane ka'abaatoceme jarebaa maqamachaane 'adaragalaacehu. ya'alaahene negegereme lamiradu sawoce 'aneqatzocene baregethe 'aberaaraane.

'eresume yaa yazenaabene weha kasamaaye yamiyaawarede nawe. kaziyaame kabaqaaye katalayaayu `aayenatoce 'enaabaqelebataalane kabaqaayeme 'azemaraane 'enaa 'aranegwaadee zaafeneme 'enaawathaalane. karesume bazalalaa laaye 'enedaalute `aayenate 'erese barese yatadaraarabu qenethaatocene 'enaawathaalane. katamereme zaafe ka'enebuthwa yataqaraarabu yahonu zalalaawoce yewathaalu. kawayene, qethalocaacawe tamasaasaaye, fereewocaacawe dagemo yatalayaayu yahonu yazayetune 'enaa yarumaane 'atekeletocene 'enaawathaalane sawoce hoye! zaafe majamariyaa siyaafaraa 'enaa fereeweme kabasala baxwaalaa tamalekatu. bazihe nagare wesethe lamiyaamenu sawoce ya'alaahene celotaa thaqwaami yahonu ta`aameraate 'alu.

'agaariwocume jinoce theqemene yaamathaalu gudaateneme yaasewagedaalu belawe baamanu gizee la'alaahe baalaanethaawoce 'adaragwaacawe. yeheme 'alaahe jinocune yafatharaacawe kamahonu gaare nawe. 'eresu 'eneji leelaa 'akaale 'alaaseganyaacaweme. limalake tagabiwe 'eresu becaa nawe. la'alaaheme, 'ayehudoce `uzayerene nasaaraame `isaane, thaa`otaawiyaanume malaa'eketene 'enedaadaragute wanede lejoce 'enaa seete lejoceneme 'adaragulate. 'enanyihe yaweshate baaletabeetoce 'eresune kamigaletzubate nagare hulu 'alaahe theraate tagabaawe yalaaqame hona.

'eresume yaa yaala qadaami 'amesaayaa samaayaatene 'enaa mederene yafathara nawe. maqanaajo (misete) saayenorawe leje linorawe 'enedeete yecelaale. hulune nagare fathara bahulume nagare laaye `aawaaqi nawe. 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayeshashagebateme.

sawoce hoye! yehe ba'enanyihe baahheriyaate tathaqaashu 'eresu geetaacehu 'alaahe nawe. karesume baashaagare geetaa, 'enaa ba'ewenate yamimalake 'amelekote yamigabaawe 'amelaake yalame. 'eresu yahulu nagare fathaari nawe. babecanyenate 'amelekute 'eresume yahulu nagare thabaaqi nawe.
`eyetaawoce 'ayaakaabebuteme 'eresu gene `eyetaawocene yaakaabebaale 'eresume ladagaage baarocu 'ejege 'azaanye ya'enaresuneme wesethe `aawaaqi nawe.

sawoce hoye! kageetaacehu zanede geletze yahonu maaserajaawoce baregethe mathaalaacehu. yaanene yataganazabanaa yataazaza theqemu laraasu nawe. kaziyaa yataawara, yaaletaganazaba, yaaletaazazame gudaatu baraasu laaye nawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'enaho 'enee szeraacehune yameqothaathare ba'enaaneta laaye tathabaabaaqi 'ayedalahume yamiqothaatharaacehu geetaayee nawe>> balaacawe.

ya'alaahene celotaa 'aberaari yahonu maaserajaawocene 'enedaaqarabene hulu yabeseraate, yazaacaa 'enaa yamekere 'aneqatzoceneme 'enaaberaaraalane. 'enanyaame 'agaariwoce yehe yataqabalekawe malakotaawi male'ekete saayehone kaaneta bafite matsaahhefene katasathute yatamaarekawe nawe yelaalu. 'ewenatene 'aweqawe lamikatalu me'emanaaneme 'aneqatzocene bamazarezare 'enaaberaaraalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kageetaahe zanede wadaaneta yatalaalafawene 'ewenate takatale. 'eresu theraate yatagabaawe geetaa karesu baashaagare ba'ewenate tamalaaki yalame ka'enanyaa 'agaariwoceme raaqe. bakehedataacawe 'enaa ba'emebitanyenataacawe 'a`emerohene 'ataasechaneqe. mamalashaacaweme wada 'alaahe nawe.

'alaahe 'enedaayaagaaru bifalege noro baresu laaye 'anedaaceneme baalaagaaru nabare. gene saayaasegadede merechaawene lanaresu tawa. 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye!szeraacawene yametekataatale banaresu laaye taqothaathaarime 'alaadarageneme 'asetakaakaayaacaweme 'ayedalaheme. 'aneta maaderase becaa yamithabaqebehe male'eketanyaa 'eneji leelaame 'ayedalaheme.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! 'enanyaa 'agaariwoce yamiyaamalekwaacawene thaa`otaate meneme 'enekwaane mawaarade yamigabaacawe, yawadaqu bihonume 'atesedabwacawe. 'enanyaa 'agaariwoce ba'atzafaawe baalamaawaqe 'enaa denebareneme bamaalafe 'alaahene yesadebaalunaa. la'enanyihe thaa`otaawiyaane thememataacawene 'enedaasegeethenelaacawe hulu la'eyaanedaanedu hhezebe bamalekaameme batzayaafeme lenefatenaacawe szeraawocaacawene 'asegeethenelaacawe. kaziyaame baferedu `elate mamalashaacawe wada geetaacawe nawe. baqerebitu `aalameme yeszarute yanabarutene yenageraacawaale. yemanadaacawaaleme.

'enanyaa 'agaariwoceme 'enediqarebelaacawe yathayaqutene ta`aamere muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yezolaacawe yamathaa 'enedahona 'enedamiyaamenu yamicelutene hulu ba'alaahe thanekaaraa mahalaawocaacawene maalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'enaho ta`aameraate hulu ba'alaahe 'eje nawe. yafalagame gizee yaawaredaacawaale. ba'enee 'eje 'ayedalume>> balaacawe. 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! 'enanyihe 'agaariwoce bathayaqute maszarate ta`aameraate bimathaalaacawe yamaayaamenu mahonaacawene mene 'asaawaqaacehu? 'enaresu qenaacaane yamaayefalegu bamahonaacawe ta`aameraate bimathulaacaweme bakehedate 'enaa 'emebitanyenataacawe laaye yamizawateru naacawe.

ta`aamere matheto yaalaamanu gizee majamariyaaweneme yaqure'aane 'aneqatze matheto yaalaamanu 'enedanabarute hulu ba'enaresunaa wada haqe bamamaraate mahhakale geredoshe bamaaderage lebonaacawene 'enaa `eyetaacawene 'enegalabethaalane. kaziyaame bathemataacawe 'enaa denebareme bamaalafaacawe wesethe yatadanaagaru 'enaa yawaalalu sihonu 'enetawaacawaalane.

'enaresu 'enediqarebelaacawe yathayaqutene nagare taqabelanaacawe malaa'eketene benaawaredelaacawe 'enaa bimalakatwacawe, mutaaneme kamote tanasetawe biyaanaagerwacawe 'aneta yamathaahebate manegade 'ewenate mahonune binagerwawe, bageletze fite lafiteme liyaayute 'enediqarebelaacawe yathayaqutene hulu benesabasebelaacawe, geetaahe la'emenate yagathamawe siqare 'ayaamenume. gene 'abezaanyocaacawe yehenene 'ayaawequme. 'alaaheme la'emenate yegathemaacawe zanede wadaresu 'ayethagume.

'anetane ba'enanyihe 'agaariyaane thalaatenate 'enedafatanenehe hulu kaaneta bafite yatalaakutene nabiyaate hulu fatenanaale. la'eyaanedaanedume nabiye kasawoce 'enaa kajinoce yahonune tanekwaashocene thalaate 'adaragenelaacawe. sawoceneme liyaataalelubate kafilaacawe wada kafilaacawe baweshate yatashalamane negegere yaasetalaalefaalu. 'alaahe bifalege noro baalaadaragute nabare. gene lifatenaacawe falaga. 'enaresume yamiqathefutene weshate 'enaa kehedate tawawe; 'atechanaqebate.

ya'enanyaa bamacharashaawe qane yamaayaamenu sawoce lebonaa 'enaresu wadamiqathaathefute nagare taazanabele zanede, 'enediqabalute 'enaa 'enediwadute kawanejale 'enaa kamaafanegathe yamiszarutene yeszaru zanede lenefatenaacawe (yatashalama) 'adaragenawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa ka'alaahe baashaagare leelocene bamaamelake 'agaariwoce lahonute, <<ba'enaaneta 'enaa ba'enee mahakale yefarede zanede ka'alaahe leelaa faraaje 'adaregaalahune? 'efalegaalahune?>> balaacawe. qure'anu hulune nagare yaakaatata 'aberaari sihone wadanaaneta yaawaradawe 'alaahe nawe. 'enanyaa taweraatene yasathanaacawe 'ayehudoce 'enaa nejileneme yasathanaacawe keresetiyaanoce yehe qure'aane 'ewenatene 'aqefo wadaaneta 'enedatawarada yaaweqaalu. wadaanetame kaawaradenawe 'ewenataa katatharaathaariwoce 'atehune.

ya'alaaheme qaale qure'aane banegegere 'enaa bazeenaawocu ka'ewenate thegenaa kafeteheme denebare dareswale. negegeruneme lawaache yalaweme. 'eresume yabaarocune negegere sami 'ereswame `aawaaqi nawe. 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayeshashagebateme. qaaluneme lamalawathe yamirwarwathutene hulu yemanadaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bamedere laaye 'abezaanyocene betesamaa 'enaa betekatale ka'alaahe manegade yaathamuhale. ya'alaahe lemede 'ewenate katheqitoce gaare tehone zanede 'alefaalace. 'abezaanyoce maaserajaa yaleelawene therethaaree 'eneji 'ayekatalume. 'amaaleketocaacawe 'alaahe zanede yaaqaarebunaale belawe gamatu 'enaresume baziyaa wesethe yamiwaashu, bagemete tanaagaariwoce 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalume.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kasawoce maane kamanegadu 'enedathamama wada 'emenatume maane 'enedataqanaa yataqanutene `aawaaqiwe 'eresu geetaahe nawe kaziheme 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayeshashagebateme.
sawoce hoye! ba'ewenate ba'aneqatzocume yametaamenu kahona ba'erede gizee ya'alaahe seme yatawasaabatene belu.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme yaadaragawene 'enaa leterequteme yamigabaacehune nagare baregethe 'aberaaretolaacehu saala ya'alaahe seme yatawasaabatene 'erede yamaatebalubate la'enaaneta mene 'alaacehu, mene kalakalaacehu? macagare wadaresu yaasethagaacehu kahonawe basetaqare, 'ereme yaadaragabaacehune raaqu. macagare yatakalakalane yatafaqada yaadaregaale. ka'agaariwoceme 'abezaanyocaacawe yaala`eweqate bakefu zenebaaleeyaacawe mekeneyaate takataayocaacawene ka'ewenate yaareqaalu. baziheme 'alaahe yafaqadawene 'ereme, 'ereme yaadaragaweneme yatafaqada yaadaregaalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaho geetaahe denebarune yamithesu sawocene kamaaneme balaaye `aawaaqi nawe 'enaame baqethaate yemanadaacawaale.
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! wanejalocene bageletzeme badebeqeme kamatagebare raaqu. 'enanyaa wanejalocene bageletzeme badebeqeme yamifatzemu 'alaahe kawanejale baszarute yemanadaacawaale.

'enaaneta muselimoce hoye! yaanene ka'alaahe seme weche yaala 'akaale seme biwasaabateme baayewasaabateme ya'alaahe seme yaaletawasaabatene 'erede 'atebelu. karesume mamagabe 'alaahene kamataazaze wada maamatze mawethaate nawenaa. 'enaho shayethwanaate mutene sela mabelaate laaye yekaraakarwacehu zanede wada wadaajocaacawe maamasaasayaa qaalaatene 'enediyaasetalaalefu yegotagutwacawaale. 'enaaneta muselimoce mutene bamabelaate 'enaresu bamiyaamathute maamasaasayaa qaalaate 'enaresune yataazazaacehu 'enedahona yaane gizee 'enaaneta ka'agaariwoce tehonaalaacehu.

yaa 'alaahe wada 'ewenate saayemaraawe bafite kaalabate kehedate, 'alamaawaqe 'enaa wanejale mekeneyaate mute yanabaranaa wada 'emenate 'enedihume wada `eweqate 'enaa mataazaze bamameraataacene heyaawe yaadaragenawe 'enaa yaa bakehedate, bawanejale 'enaa baalamaawaqe tzelematoce wesethe yaala, manegadoceme yatamasaasalubate, mawechaawoceme yachalamubate, katzelemateme mawethaate yaalecaala yesetakaakalaalune? leke lananyihe 'agaariwoce yaalubate maagaaraate, mutene mabelaate, baweshateme makaraakare malekaame hono 'enedataayaacawe hulu la'enanyaa kahadiyaaneme baferedu `elate 'asaamaami bahona qethaate yemanadubate zanede yamiszarute wanejale tashalamalaacawe.

leke yamakaa taalaalaaqe 'agaariwoce ka'alaahe manegade sawocene lamakalekale 'enedaadaragute hulu ba'eyaanedaanedu manedare wesethe taalaalaaqe 'athefiwocwane wada sayethaane manegade bamathaaraate male`eketanyocenenaa takataayocaacaweneme lamawaagaate bawesethwa 'enediyaaseeru 'adaragene. baregethe seeraacawe 'enaa tanekolaacawe yamimalasawe wadanaresu nawe. gene 'enaresu baalamaawaqaacawe 'enaa semeetocaacawene bamakatalaacaweme yehenene 'ayeganazabume.

'enanyaane yakahadiyaane mariwocene 'alaahe banabiyu laaye kamiyaawaredaacawe 'aneqatzoce 'anedwa setemathaalaacawe, 'alaahe lanabiyaate yasathawe `aayenate nabiyenate 'enaa yamale'eketanyenate shumate 'esekamisathane derase bafetzume 'anaameneme 'alu. 'alaahe lamale`eketanyenate 'enaa xaalaafinatwaneme lamashakame maane tagabi 'enedahona, male`eketuneme yate maaderage 'enedaalabate kamaaneme balaaye `aawaaqi nawe. laziheme tagabiwene lanabiyenate 'enaa male`eketanyenate yemarethaale. 'enanyihene denebare zalalocene ka'ewenate bamaafanegathaacawe mekeneyaate qeleete 'enaa weredate, baseeraacawe mekeneyaateme beretu qethaate yedaresebaacawaale.

'alaahe wada qenaacaa manegade limaraawe yafalagawene sawe lebune yaasafaalataale. selaameneme lamaqabale yaazagaajawaale. litawawe 'enaa laqenaacaame laayegathemawe yafalagawene dagemo lebune leke wada samaaye 'enedamiwathaa 'enaa matanefaseme 'enedamichaneqawe lebune yatachanaqa 'enaa yatathababa yaadaregawaale. baziheme raasune wada samaaye kafe maaderage 'enedamaayecelawe hulu 'ewenateme lebonaawe wesethe kamagebaate yekalakalaale. 'alaaheme yathamaamaane huneetaa 'enedazihe yabarataa cheneqe 'enedaadaraga hulu bamaayaamenu sawoce laaye qethaatene yaadaregaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehe laaneta yadanagagenelehe 'emenate 'eresu yaa thememate yaleelabate qathetanyaa manegade nawe. maradaate 'enaa maneqaate belome magasatzene lamicelu sawoce bazihe maleku 'aneqatzocene 'enaaberaaraalane.
la'enaresume katathalaa nagare hulu salaame yamihonubate 'agare 'alaacawe 'ereswame janate nace. 'enaresume kamalekaamoce baszarute mekeneyaate 'alaahe rajiyaacawe 'enaa 'agaazhaacaweme nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe kasawoce 'enaa kajinenoce hulate budenocene bamiqasaqesebate `elate yamihonawene 'awesaa. kaziyaame 'alaahe, <<'enaaneta yajine cheferoce hoye! kasawoce yaathamamaacehutene 'enaa ka'alaaheme manegade yakalakalaacehutene 'abazaacehu>> yelaacawaale. kasawoceme jinenocune yatakatalute lageetaacawe malesene sisathu, <<geetaacene hoye! kafilaacene kakafilaacene tathaqaaqama. jinenu sawoce 'eresune bamataazazaacawe, sawoceme semeetocaacawene bamaagenyataacawe kafilaacene kafilaacenene tathaqaaqama 'enyaame baqatharekaate gizee darasene>> yelaalu. yaame yaferedu `elate nawe. 'alaaheme 'enedihe yelaale - <<kaqaberocaacehu taqaseqesaacehu wada jahaname 'eseketegabu yaalacewene 'alaahe yafalagaatene theqitene gizee siqare bawesethwa zawetaariwoce letehonu 'esaate maregiyaacehu naate>>. 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! 'enaho geetaahe bawesaaneewe 'enaa bamaasetanaabaru thebabanyaa, kabaarocume qethaate yamigabaawene `aawaaqi nawe.

kajinenoce tanekwaashocune shumane bakafile kahadiwoce laaye 'enedalaakenaacawe hulu la'anede badaaye batanekole laaye yamiyaanasaasaawe 'enaa yamigafaafaawene, kamalekaameme yamiyaareqawene 'enaa kamalekaameme 'ejune 'enediyaasaathere yamiyaadaregawene kafile badaayene 'eneshomebataalane. yaame yeszarute banabarute wanejaloce mekeneyaate nawe.

baferedume `elate'enedihe 'enelaacawaalane - <<'enaaneta yasawoce 'enaa yagaaneene cheferoce hoye! ka'enaaneta yahonu male`eketanyoce wada 'enaaneta 'alemathumene? 'aneqatzoceene ba'enaaneta laaye yamiyaanabu, yaziheneme yaferedune `elate genenyunate yamiyaasethanaqeqwaacehu honawe 'alemathulaacehumene?>> lageetaacaweme <<'awone baraasaacene laaye masakarene. baregethe male`eketanyocu mathetawelenaale; yatalaakubateneme 'aderesawenaale>> yelaalu. <<gene male'eketanyocehene 'enaa yeheneneme yamaganaanyaa qane 'asetabaabalene>> yelaalu. yaqerebitwa `aalameme yayaazacewe geethaageethe 'enaa tawagaaje theqeme 'ataalalaacaacawe. 'enaresume baqerebitwa `aalame qoyetaacawe ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyocu kahadiyaane yanabaru mahonaacawene baraasaacawe laaye yemasakeraalu. gene baziyaane qane yehene manaazazaacawe 'enaa maamanaacawe 'ayethaqemaacaweme. mekeneyaatume `edelu yaalafa bamahonu nawe

yeheme male'eketanyocene wada sawoce 'enaa jinoce bamalaake maasethaneqaqe, 'anede sawe male'eketanyaa yaaletalaakabate hono therime saayedaresawe baszaraawe wanejale 'enedaayethayaqe zanede nawe. kahhezeboceme wadanaresu male`eketanyocene kalaakene 'enaa kaasethanaqaqene baxwaalaa 'eneji 'aneqathaame.

la'eyaanedaanedume baszeraacawe maszarate darajaawoce 'alwacawe. kefu szeraawe bezu yahona 'enaa baalatheqite `ekuye szeraa 'ayekatakaakalume. takataayeme ka'asekataaye gaare 'ayesetakaakalume. ya'enanyaa malekaamocene yamiszaru sawoce menedaa hulu 'ayesetakaakaleme. geetaaheme yeszarute kanabarute yazanagaa 'ayedalame. yelequne hulune `aawaaqi nawe. karesume 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayeshashageme baszeraacaweme laaye yemanadaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe 'eresu kabaarocu kanaresume ka'amelekotaacaweme yatabeqaaqaa nawe. kehedataacaweme 'ayegodaaweme. kanaresume kamabeqaaqaatu gaare la'enaresu 'azaanye nawe. 'enaaneta 'amatzanyaa baaroce hoye! 'enaanetane maathefaate bifalege karesu bahona qethaate yefajaacehu 'enaa 'enaanetaneme kaleeloce teweledoce 'enedaaseganyaacehu hulu 'enaanetane kaathafaa baxwaalaa leelocene baresu yamiyaamenu 'enaa yamitaazazutene yaaseganyaale.

'enaaneta kahadiyaane hoye! kamaqaseqase, masabesabe, magamegame 'enaa maqathaate yameteqatharute nagare therethaaree yaleelabate sihone machi nawe. geetaacehune shashetaahu bafetzume 'ataamalethuteme 'eresu 'anaataacehune yaazhe 'enaa qachiyaacehume nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale - <<hhezebocee hoye! baalaacehubate manegade laaye, 'enedihume baalaacehubate kehedate 'enaa themate laaye tzenu. geletze bahona maaderase banaaneta laaye maaserajaane 'aqumeeyaalahu. kaziyaa baxwaalaa bakehedataacehu 'enaa themataacehu yamechanaqe 'ayedalahume. yelequne baalahubate 'ewenate laaye 'etzanaalahu. baqerebitwame `aalame dele yamaane 'enedamihone maane mederene 'enedamiwaresaate, yamachiweme `aalame sekeete yamaane 'enedamihone lawadafite taaweqaalaacehu. 'enaho 'agaariwoce baqerebitume hona bamachiweme `aalame 'ayesaakaalaacaweme. baqerebitu `aalame meneme yaahele yatathaqaaqamu bihonu 'enekwaa maabeqiyaacawe kisaaraa nawe.>>

'enanyaa ba'alaahe laaye leelocene yaagaaru sawoce la'alaahe 'eresu kafatharawe 'azemaraa 'enaa 'enesasaa dereshaane 'adaragulate. 'anedanyaawene kefele la'alaahe 'enedahona tanaagaru leelaanyaawene dagemo lathaa`otocaacawe 'enaa 'amaaleketaacawe 'enedahona tanaagaru. 'enaresu la'amaaleketaacawe yawasanute nagare 'alaahe 'enedisathe badanagagabate manegade laaye ladehoce 'enaa lacegeranyoce 'ayedareseme. la'alaahe belawe yawasanute gene lathaa`otocaacawe 'enaa 'amaaleketocaacawe 'enaresuneme bamithaqeme laaye wachi yedaragaale. lebe balu! feredaacawe 'enaa maakafaafalaacawe menenyaa kafaa.

'enanyaa shayethwanaate lathaa`otaawiyaanu yehenene babadale yatamolaa ferede malekaame 'aderegawe 'enedaasaayute hulu la'agaariwocu dagemo badehenate feraacaa lejocaacawene 'enedigadelu, 'alaahe 'ereme yaadaragaateneme nafese bamaathefaate liyaathafwacawe, 'emenataacaweneme banaresu laaye yatadabalaalaqa lamaaderagenaa karesume yatadanagagawene 'enaa yaaletadanagagaweneme layetawe 'esekamaayaawequ derase mathefone nagare malekaame 'asemaselawe 'asaayuwaacawe. 'alaahe yehenene 'enedaayaadaregu bifalege noro 'ayaadareguteme nabare. gene latalaqace thebabe 'adaragawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyihene thaa`otaawiyaane ba'alaahe laaye kamiqathaathefute weshate gaare tawaacawe. 'enedihe maaderageheme 'enaame gudaayaacawene la'alaahe tawawe.

'enanyaa thaa`otaawiyaane 'enedihe 'alu - <<'enanyihe 'enesesaate 'enaa 'azemaraawoce yatakalakalu naacawe>>. bamugetaacawe 'enaa baqethefataacawe 'enaresu kathaa`otaate 'agalegaayoce 'enaa kamifalegwaacawe 'akaalaate 'eneji leeloce 'ayemagabuteme. 'enanyihe dagemo jarebaawocaacawe 'ereme yatadaragu 'enesesaate naacawe 'eneda bahhiraa, saabaa 'enaa hhaame `aayenate yamaayesaafarwacawe, lathaa`otaate yatadaragu 'alu. kafile 'enesesaatene dagemo bamiyaaredwacawe gizee ya'amaaleketocune seme 'eneji ya'alaahene seme 'ayaawasume. yehenene hulu leke ka'alaahe 'enedatadanagaga 'aderegawe ba'alaahe laaye weshatene bamafaberake fatzamute. 'alaaheme baresu laaye bamawaashataacawe mekeneyaate baqethaatu yemanadaacawaale.

'enediheme 'alu - <<ba'enanyihe 'enesesaate, lathaa`otaatu katadaragute saabaa 'enaa bahhiraa maahetzane wesethe yaalawe thejaa hheyaawe hono katawalada mabelaatu lawanedocaacene yatafaqada 'enaa baseetocaacene laaye 'ereme yatadaraga nawe. mute hono katawalada gene wanedocu 'enaa seetocu baresu yamigaaru yehonaalu>> 'alu. 'enediheme bamaalataacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe yamigabaacawene yemanadaacawaale. 'eresume badenegaageewe 'enaa bamafetharu bamaasetanaabareme thebabanyaa, ba'enaresume huneetaa `aawaaqi nawe.

'enanyaa bamonyenate 'enaa baalamaawaqe lejocaacawene yagadalu sawoca baregethe kasaru. ba'alaaheme laaye baaledanagagawe nagare qethefatene bamafaberake 'alaahe yasathaacawene baraasaacawe laaye 'ereme 'adaragu. kaqathetanyaaweme manegade baregethe raaqu wadaresume yatamaru 'alehonume.

'alaahe maalate yaa genede yaleelaacawene bamedere laaye yamizaragu. bagenedocaacaweme laaye kafe yamilu ya'atekelete seferaawocene yafathara nawe. yatamere zaafeneme ba`aayenate 'enaa bathaa`eme yatalayaayu yahonu 'azemaraawoceneme yafathara nawe. 'eresume yaa yawayeraa zaafene zayetunene 'enaa yarumaane zaafeneme, qethalocaacawe yatamasaasalu yafereewocaacawe thaa`eme yamilayaaye 'aderego yafathara nawe. 'enaaneta sawoce hoye! ya'enazihene zaafoce feree bamiyaafaru gizee belu fereeweme bamisabasebe `elate yagedeetaa metzewaatune (zakaawene) sathu. bamabelaate 'enaa bamamatzewateme katadanagagawe manegade denebare 'atelafu. 'alaaheme denebarocune yamithesu sawocene 'ayewademe. yehenene hulu yafatharawe yaa 'eresu labaarocu 'enanyihene yafaqadawe nawe. thaa`otaawiyaane ka'enanyihe nagaroce 'anedaacaweneme 'ereme yamaaderage selethaane yalaacaweme

'eresu yaa ka'enesesaate la'enaaneta 'eneda telaaleqe gemaloce `eqaa lichaanebaacawe yamicelutene 'enesesaate 'enedihume 'eneda tenaaneshe gemaloce, bage 'enaa feyaloce yamaayechaanebaacaweneme yafathara nawe. 'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'alaahe ka'enanyihe nagaroce yafaqadalaacehune belu. 'alaahe 'ereme yaadaragawene bamafeqade 'enedihume yafaqadawene bamakalekale yashayethwanene faanaawoce 'atekatalu. sawoce hoye! 'enaho shayethwane lanaaneta geletze yahona thalaate nawe. baziheme 'alaahene 'enedetaametzu yefalegaale.

semenete `aayenate 'enesesaatene fatharalaacehu. kabage hulate thenedene wanede 'enaa seetene, kafeyaleme hulate thenedene, 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye lamusherekocu! <<'alaahe kahulatu `aayenate wanedocune wanede selahonu 'ereme 'aderegwaalene?>> balaacawe. <<'awone>> kaalu <<seetocenese lamene 'ereme 'adaragaacehu?>> setele thayeqaacawe. <<wayese 'enesetocune 'ereme 'aderegwaalene?>> balaacawe. <<'awone>> kaaluhe <<wanedocunese lamene 'ereme 'adaragaacehu?>> balaacawe. <<wayeme dagemo yahulatu maahetzanoce yatashakamutene 'ereme 'aderegwaalene?>> balaacawe. <<'awone>> kaaluhe <<'enaase maahetzanoce katashakamute 'anedee wanedocune leelaame gizee seetocune lamene 'ereme taadaregaalaacehu? yehe 'eremenate ka'alaahe zanede nawe bametelute 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu ka`eweqate lazihe maaserajaanate yametethaqamutene negarunye>> balaacawe.

kagemaleme hulate thenedocene, wanede 'enaa seetene kakabetoceme hulate thenedocene fatharalaacehu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'agaariwocu, <<'alaahe kahulatu `aayenatoce wanedocune 'ereme 'adaragane wayese seetocune wayese yahulatu 'enesetoce maahetzane yaaqafawene 'ereme 'adaraga? wayese 'alaahe 'enanyihene nagaroce 'ereme bamaaderage nuzaazeene siyaasetalaalefe babotaawe nabaraacehune?>> balaacawe. ba'alaahe laaye weshatene kaqathaathafanaa sawoceneme ka'alaahe baalehona `eweqate kaqathetanyaawe manegade lamaathemame 'alaahe 'ereme yaalaadaragawene 'ereme 'aderegwaale belo wada 'alaahe kaasethagaa sawe balaaye kabadale bakule yagazafa, kawanejaleme bakule yatalaqa yalame. 'alaahe 'enanyaane ba'eresu laaye weshatene bamafaberake denebarene yaalafu badaayocene laqenaacaa manegade 'ayegathemaacaweme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'alaahe wadanee kaasetalaalafawe malakotaawi male'ekete wesethe bamimagabe sawe laaye 'ereme yaadaragawene 'alaaganyeme. saayetaarade yamotane baketene, wayeme fasaashe damene waye qoshaashaa 'enaa kelekele yahonawene yakarekaro 'enaa 'asaamaa segaane, wayeme lathaa`otaate 'enedamisawaa `aayenate ba'eredu gizee ya'alaahe seme yaaletawasaabatene kaalehona basetaqare leelaane 'alaaganyeme>> balaacawe. bamabelaate madasaasatene falaagi saayehone 'enaa ya'anegabegaabinate lekuneme saayaalefe ka'enanyihe 'ereme katadaragu nagaroce lamabelaate cegere yaasegadadawe sawe bibalaa wanejale yalabateme. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaho geetaahe cegeretanyaawe tacagero bibalaa mahhari 'enaa 'azaanyeme nawe.

'alaahe basawoce hulu laaye 'ereme yaadaragawene kathaqasa baxwaalaa, 'agaariwocu ka'enesesaate 'ereme yaadaragute nagare yashayethwanene gutegotaa takatelawe 'eneji ka'alaahe bahona `eweqate maszarate 'ereme yaalaadaragu mahonaacawene lamagelatse sile kazihe bafite ba'ayehudocu laaye 'ereme yaadaragawene sigaletze. 'enediheme 'ala -
ba'ayehudoce laaye 'eneda kabetoce 'enaa gemaloce shehonaacawe yaaletakafala yahonutene, 'eneda farase 'enaa 'aheyaa yaalutene, baaladefene shehonaa 'enesesaatene hulu 'ereme 'adaragenebaacawe. kakabetoce kabage 'enaa feyaleme, jarebaawocaacawe, yahode `eqaawocaacawe wayeme ka'athenete gaare yatadabaalaqa kefele siqare moraawocaacawene 'ereme 'adaragenebaacawe. denebarene bamathaasaacawe mekeneyaate yehenene ba'enaresu laaye 'ereme bamaaderage baqethaate manadaanaacawe. 'enyaame bamenenaagarawe laaye 'ewenatanyoce nane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yaasetabaabaluheme 'enaa kageetaaheme yezahe yamathaakxawene yaaletaqabaluhe kahona, 'enaresune lamaanasaasaate, <<'enaho geetaacehu yasafi 'ezenate baaletabeete nawe. ka'ezenatume 'enaanetane baqethaate 'alamaacaakolu 'enaa maazageyatu magalachaawe nawe>> balaacawe. 'enaresuneme lamaasethaneqaqe <<qethaatume kananyaa thefaatene 'enaa wanejalene kamifatzemute hhezeboce 'ayemalaseme>> balaacawe.

'agaariwoce ba'alaahe lamaagaaraataacawe ya'alaahene feqaade 'enaa wesaanee maaserajaa bamaaderage, 'alaahe 'enyaame 'abaatocaaceneme 'enedenaagaaraabate baayefalege noro baalagaaraanebate nabare. baraasaacene laaye 'ereme yaadaragenawene nagare 'ereme 'enedaanaadarege bifalege 'ereme baalaadaragene nabare yelaalu. leke 'enedanaresu `aayenate wedeqe bahonu maaserajaawoce kanaresu bafite yanabaruteme kahadiyaane <<'enyaa male'eketanyocune 'enedenaasetabaabele 'alaahe baalefalaga noro baalaasetabaabalene nabare>> belawe kaadu. 'enyaame ba'enaresu laaye yaawaradenawene qethaate 'esekaqamasubate `elateme bazihe maasetabaabale qathalubate. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa 'agaariwoce <<'alaahe baresu laaye maagaaraataacehune, 'ereme yaadaragaweneme yafaqadaacehubatene yafaqadaweneme 'ereme yaadaragaacehubatene yamiyaaseradaa `eweqate 'enaaneta zanede 'alane?>> balaacawe. bazihe gudaaye therethaareene 'eneji leelaane 'atekatalume. therethaaree ka'ewenate yamiyaabeqaaqaa 'ayedalame. 'enaanetame yametewaashu 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaacehume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'agaariwocu, <<la'enaaneta 'ezihe kaaqarabaacehute dakaamaa maaserajaawoce weche leelaa maaserajaawoce yaleelaacehu kahona, 'alaahe zanede yaaqarabaacehutene wedeqe yametaadarege, yametenethalathalubateneme maasemasayaa yametaakaseme qoraache maaserajaa 'alaahe zanede 'alace. 'alaahe bifalege hulaacehuneme la'ewenate yegatheme nabare>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'agaariwocu, <<'alaahe 'enazihene 'enaaneta 'ereme yaadaragaacexwaacawene nagaroce 'ereme maaderagune yamimasakeru mesekerocaacehune 'aqerebu>> balaacawe. 'alaaheme 'enazihene yatafaqadu nagaroce 'ereme 'aderegwaale belawe yaala `eweqate bimasakeru 'aneta 'aberahe 'atemasekere; 'ateqabalaacawe. 'enanyaaneme zenebaaleewocaacawene faraaje yaadaragutene 'atekatalaacawe. 'alaahe yafaqadalaacawene 'ereme baadaragume gizee ba'aneqatzocaacene 'asetabaabelawaale. 'enanyaaneme bamacharashaawe `aalame yakaadutene, leeloceneme kageetaacawe gaare 'ekule yamiyaadaregutene 'atekatale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lasawoce'enedihe balaacawe - <<nu geetaacehu banaaneta laaye 'ereme yaadaragawene nagare laanebebelaacehu>>. kafethuraanu maaneneme baresu laaye maagaaraataacehune, la'enaresu malekaame mawaale gede sihone walaajocene mabadalene, 'enaanetaneme 'enaresuneme yamenemagebawe 'enyaa honane saala yadenequrenaa zamane sawoce yaadaregute 'enedanabaruteme kadehenate feraacaa lejocaacehune magedalaacehune, katzayaafe nagareme kazemute bageletzeme badebeqeme yamiszaraawene 'ereme 'adaraga. selaziheme 'ateqerabwate. kamathabaqe baxwaalaa zemutene 'enedamafatzame, kaamanume baxwaalaa 'enedamakaade bamagedaleme 'atzafaane batagabiwe manegade mamalasene 'eneji 'alaahe yaakabaraatene netzuhhe nafesene magedale 'ereme 'adaraga. 'enaanetame ka'alaahe te`ezaazaatune 'enaa kelekalaawocune teganazabu zanede 'alaahe baresu yaazezaacexwaale, yemakeraacexwaale.

yayatimene (la'aqeme saayedarese walaaje 'abaatune yaathaane leje) ganezabe la'aqeme dareso qenenate karesu 'esekisetawaale derase laresu bamibaje 'enaa ganezabume 'enedichamere bahona manegade 'eneji maqerabene 'ereme 'adaraga. basefere 'enaa bamizaane maseraqene (maagudalene) banaaneta laaye 'ereme 'adaraga. bamashathe 'enaa magezaate wesethe bafetehe mawesade 'enaa maqabale gede nawe. 'anediteme nafese kametecelawe balaaye 'ategadademe. basefere 'enaa bamasaasalute kamaqanase 'enaa kamachamare mathaneqaqu bamaayecaalebate gudaaye mathayaqe yalame. meneme yaqerebe zemedenaa baaletabeete bihone 'enekwaa banegegeraacehu fetehawi hunu. banegegereme, bamesekerenateme ka'ewenate yaraaqa nagare manaagaraacehune 'ereme 'adaraga. la'alaahe qaale yagabaacehu 'enedahona wayeme ya'alaahene seme tharetaacehu yagabaacehutene qaale kidaane maaferasaacehune 'ereme 'adaraga. selaziheme qaale kidaanune mamulaate gede honabaacehu. bazihe batathaqasawe nagare 'alaahe thebeqe te'ezaazene 'azazaacehu. yaame yanagaraacehune maabeqiyaa taasetaawesu zanede nawe.

yathememate godaanaawocene 'enaa manedocuneme makatalene banaaneta laaye 'ereme 'adaraga. bawesethu thememate yaleelabatene qathetanyaawene ya'alaahe manegade makatale gede nawe. yathememate manegadoce wada maganethale 'enaa kaqathetanyaaweme manegade wada maraaqe selametaadaresaacehu 'atekatalwate. yeheneneme qathetanyaawene ya'alaahene manegade makatalene 'alaahe baresu 'azaazaacehu. yeheme 'eresu yaazazawene bamafatsame 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe tefarute zanede nawe.

kazihe katathaqasawe zeenaame baxwaalaa lamusaa latzagaacene maamwayaa 'enaa szeraaneme bamaasaamaru, ba'emenate gudaayeme 'asefalaagi yahonu nagarocene hulu lamaaberaaraate, la'ewenateme maaserajaa, 'ezenateme sihone, baferedu `elate geetaacawene bamaganaanyate 'enediyaamenu 'enaa laziyaame bamalekaame szeraa yezagaaju zanede taweraatene 'enedasathanawe 'enenageraalane.

yehe qure'aane yatabaaraka sihone yaawaradenawe matsehhafe nawe. `aalamaawi 'enedihume 'emenataawi theqemocene hulu yaaqafa bamahonu yatabaaraka nawe. yawaradabatene nagare takatalu. meherateme taaganyu zanede 'eresune maqaaranene tathaneqaqu.

yeheme qure'aanene wadanaaneta maaweradaacene baferedu `elate 'enaho matsehhafu (taweraate 'enaa nejile) yatawaradawe kanyaa bafite banabarute hulate cheferoce, ba'ayehudoce 'enaa keresetiyaanoce laaye nawe. banyaa laaye matsehhafe 'aletawaradame. 'enanyaane matsehhafoce dagemo baqwaaneqwaacene yaaletawaradu bamahonaacawe 'enaresune lamaanebabe yamaanaaweqe (yazanagaane) nabarene 'enedaatelu nawe.

'enedihume 'alaahe ba'ayehude 'enaa keresetiyaanoce laaye matsehhafe 'enedaawaradawe `aayenate banyaa laaye matsehhafe biyaawarede noro kanaresu yabalatha yataqanaane 'enehone nabare 'enedaatelu nawe. 'alaaheme banabiyaacehu bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye baqwaaneqwaacehu yaawaradawe matsehhafe baregethe mathaalaacehu. yaame geletze maaserajaa, wada 'ewenate mameriyaa 'enaa lasawoceme 'ezenate nawe. ba'alaahe 'aneqatzoce kakaada 'enaa kareswame kaazanabala sawe balaaye badaaye yalame. 'enanyaane ka'aneqatsocaacene yamizanabalutene bamazanebalaacawe 'enaa bamaafanegathaacawe mekeneyaateme yajahaname 'esaate wesethe bamaasegabaate beretu qethaate 'eneqathaacawaalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa 'asetabaabaayoce yamote male'ake 'enaa gebera 'abarocu 'esetenefaasaacawene lamasabesabe wadanaresu mamethaataacawene, 'aliyaame geetaahe baferedu `elate babaarocu mahale lamaferade mamethaatune wayeme 'eneda tzahhaye kabasetame'eraabe bakule mawethaatwane `aayenate yasa`aatitune mamethaate thaqwaami yahonu kafile yageetaahe meleketoce mamethaataacawene 'eneji leelaane 'ayethabequme. kafile yageetaahe meleketoce bamimathubate `elateme kahadine baziyaa qane maamanu ba'emenatume kaziyaa bafite yaaleszaraawe malekaame szeraa 'ayethaqemaweme. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa 'asetabaabaaye 'agaariwoce ka'enanyihe nagaroce 'anedaacawene thabequ 'enyaame tathabaabaaqiwoce nane balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa bakafilu bamaamane 'enaa bakafilume bamakaade 'emenataacawene yatanathaathala yaadaragu 'ayehudoce 'enaa keresetiyaanoce, baziyaame yamiwazaagabu budenoceme yahonute 'aneta kanaresu bameneme wesethe 'ayedalaheme. 'enaresu kaalubate thememate 'aneta yatharaahe nahe. 'enaresune maasethaneqaqe 'eneji leelaa nagare yalabeheme. gudaayaacawe wada 'alaahe yatathagaa nawe. kaziyaame 'eresu baferedu `elate baqerebitwa `aalame yeszarute banabarute nagare yenageraacawaale. baziyaame yemanadaacawaale.

baferedu `elate ka'amaanyoce malekaame nagarene yezo yamathaa 'alaahe laresu 'asere 'ethefocene yesathawaale. kefu nagareneme yezo yamathaa bateneshume batelequme 'amesaayaawe 'eneji 'ayemanadaame 'enaresume baferedu `elate kamalekaame szeraacawe menedaa bamaagudaleme yehune baaleszarute wanejale bamathayaqe 'ayebadalume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa 'asetabaabaaye 'agaariwoce 'enedihe balaacawe - <<'enaho geetaayee yazihecene `aalame 'enaa yamachiwene `aalame malekaame hulu yamisabasebe wada honawe qathetanyaawe ya'emenate manegade maretonyaale>> balaacawe. yaame wada 'ewenate yatazanabala 'enaa ka'agaariwoceme yaalenabarawe yaberaahime manegade nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'enaho segedatee, 'eredeeme ba'alaahe seme 'enaa la'alaahe becaa nawe. hheyewateeme moteeme hulu la`aalamaatu geetaa la'alaahe becaa nawe. karesu weche laala 'akaale kazihe 'anedaaceme dereshaa yalaweme>> bale.

<<'eresu theraate yatagabaawe geetaa 'agaare yalaweme. karesu baashaagare yamimalake yalame. baziheme kamaagaaraate yatharaa bahonawe 'emenate geetaayee 'azonyaale 'eneeme kazihe hhezebe yamajamariyaawe taazaazhe nanye>> bale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa 'agaariwoce 'enedihe balaacawe - <<'eresu yanagaroce hulu geetaa hono saala ka'alaahe weche geetaane 'efalegaalahune? 'eresu karesu baashaagare yametaamalekwaacawe 'amaalekete hulu geetaa nawe>>. netzuhhe saweme yaleelaawene wanejale 'ayeshakameme. kaziyaame baferedu `elate mamalashaacehu wadaresu nawe. bazihece `aalameme ba'emenate gudaayaacehu tewazaagabubate selanabaraacehute nagare yenageraacexwaale

'alaahe maalate yaa mederene taasegeethwate zanede kanaaneta bafite yaqadamutene teweledoce takiwoce yaadaragaacehu nawe. basathaacehu nagare lifatenaacehume kafilaacehune bakafilaacehu laaye ba'afathaathare 'enaa basisaaye darajaawocene 'abalaalatha. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaho geetaahe qethaata fathaane nawe. yamimathaa nagare hulu qerebe nawe. 'enedihume kabaarocu wadaresu latamalasute mahari 'enaa 'azaanyeme nawe.
(lm)S <<'alife, laame, mimeswade>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yatakabarawe qure'aane 'alaahe wadaaneta yaawaradawe matsehhafe nawe. balebehe wesethe sela'eresu machanaqe 'enaa matharaathareme 'ayenure. sawocene letaasefaraaraabate, maaserajaaneme letaaqomebate, yamithaqamubate 'enaresu naacawenaa me'emanaaneme letegasetzebate 'awaradenawe.

sawoce hoye! geetaacehu wadanaaneta yaawaradawene matsehhafe, yanabiyaacehuneme falage takatalu. zenebaaleewocaacehume bamigotagutwacehu ya'enanyaane kageetaacehu baashaagare yaalutene kashayethwanaate 'enaa kakefu liqaaweneteme wadaajoce 'aderegaacehu 'atekatalwacawe. theqiteme 'ategasatzume? betegasatzumaa ka'ewenate weche yaalawene baaletakatalaacehu, male`eketanyaawe yezo yamathaawene batakatalaacehu, batagabaraacehu 'enaa karesu leelaa yaalaweneme batawaacehu nabare.

bakehedataacawe 'enaa bathememataacawe laaye bamazawetaraacawe mekeneyaate kabaade qethaataacenene balalitu 'adaare 'enaa baqanu rafaade laaye 'enaresu yazanagu sihonu yaawaradenebaacawe 'enaa yaathafaanaacawe senete 'enaa senete yamanedare nawaariwoce 'alefawaale. 'enaresume qethaatune karaasaacawe maawerade yecelaalu yatabaalute 'amaaleketeme qethaatune kanaresu mamalase 'alecaalume.
qethaatu kawarada baxwaalaa 'alaahene bamakaadaacawe badalaacawene maaragaagathe 'eneji leelaa 'aletanaagarume.

baferedume `elate 'enanyaane male'eketanyocene yalaakenebaacawene hhezeboce lamale'eketanyocu yasathutene melaashe, male`eketanyocuneme lahhezebocaacawe male`eketaacenene selamaaderasaacawe; hhezebocaacaweme selasathwacawe melaashe 'enethayeqaacawaalane.

ba'eyaanedaanedu fetherate laayeme yaszarutene szeraa kanyaa bahona `eweqate 'enetarekaalane. szeraawocaacawene hulu `aawaaqi nane. kareswa 'anedaaceme 'ayeshashagebeneme. bayatenyaaweme gizee kanaresu yaraaqene 'alenabareneme.

baferedume `elate yaszeraawoce mizaane madelo 'enaa badale yaleelabate sihone bafetehe yamiqome yehonaale. bamamazaneme gizee yamalekaame szeraawocu mizaane kakefu szeraawocu yakabadulate, 'enanyaa yamifalegutene yaaganyu kamifaruteme yadaanute naacawe.

yakefu szeraawocu mizaaneme bamalekaame szeraawocu mizaane laaye yakabadubate sawe 'enanyaa ba'alaahe 'aneqatzoce bamakaadaacawe mekeneyaate baferedu `elate wada nafesocaacawene mathefiyaa mawerajaa bamaawerade yakasaru naacawe.

'enaaneta ya'adame lejoce hoye! bamedere laaye baregethe 'asemacanaacehu. bawesethwame yahheyewate madaarashaa manoriyaane 'adaragenelaacehu. baziheme 'alaahene bamigabaa letaamasagenute tagabi nabare gene yametaamasagenute theqitune nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'abaataacehune 'adamene fatharene kaziyaame baamaara maleke 'enaa baamaara takela sawenate laaye qaratzenawe. kaziyaaneme malaa'eketene yakebere segedate 'enedisagedulate 'azazene. ba'emebitanyenate 'enaa bakuraateme kasagaajoce lihone yaalefaqadawe belise siqare, malaa'ekete hulu yageetaacawene te`ezaaze bamafatzame sagadu.

'alaaheme belisene bamaweqase - <<la'adame segadelate beyee saazezehe te`ezaazeene 'enedaatefatzeme yakalakalahe menedene nawe?>> 'alawe. beliseme <<'enee karesu yabalatheku nanye. 'eneene ka'esaate, 'eresune gene kacheqaa fatharekawe; 'esaate kacheqaa balaache nawe. yakebere segedatene 'enedaalesagedelate yaadaraganye yehe nawe>> 'ala.

'alaaheme <<kajanate werade, bawesethwa letekoraa 'ayegabaaheme. 'ereswa yamalekaamoce 'enaa yanetzuhane 'agare nace. bawesethwa leteqoye 'ayegabaaheme. 'eraasehene ka'adame 'enedametebalethe 'enedametaasebawe 'ayedalaheme. 'enaho 'aneta kaanasute 'enaa katawaaradute nahe>> 'alawe.
beliseme; <<geetaayee hoye! kasawoce maathemame yamecelawene hulu 'enedaathameme 'eseka feredu `elate 'aqoyanye 'ala.
'alaaheme; <<belise hoye! thurumebaawe tanafeto fethuraanu hulu 'esekamimotubate `elate kamiqoyute nahe>> 'alawe.

<<'enee te`ezaazehene baalamathabaqee 'enaa 'eneeneme baathamamekebate yehunebenye! la'adame lejoce baqathetanyaawe manegadehe laaye 'eqamathelaacawaalahu. 'eneeme la'abaataacawe la'adame kamasegade 'enedathamamekute hulu kaqathetanyaawe manegade 'asewathaacawaalahu, 'athamemaacawaalahu.

kaziyaame kafite lafitaacawe, kaxwaalaacaweme, kabasetaqanyocaacawe, kabasetageraacaweme, ka'aqethaachaawoce hulu 'emathaabaacawaalahu. machiwene `aalame 'enedaayefalegu 'enaa qerebitwane `aalame 'enedikajelu maasemasayaawocene bamaamethaate, semeetocaacawene bamaasaamare 'eqarebaacawaalahu. kaziyaame kakehedateme bamegotagutaacawe mekeneyaate 'abezaanyocune laaneta 'amasegaanyoce honawe 'ataaganyaacaweme.>> 'ala.

'alaaheme - <<belise hoye! kajanate yatawaqaseke 'enaa ka'ezenateeme yatabaarareke honahe wethaa. kanaresume yatakatalahene baferedu `elate jahanamene kaaneta 'enaa yageetaacawene te`ezaaze bamathaase 'anetane batakataluhe hulu 'emolaataalahu.>> 'ala

'alaaheme la'adame, <<'adame hoye! 'aneta 'enaa thenedeheme hhawaa'e bajanate nuru. bawesethwa yaalutene malekaame nagaroce hulu kafalagaacehute belu. kaziheceme 'alaahe `aayenatwane kagalatzaate zaafe 'enedaatebalu. 'enaaneta kakalakalekwaacehu baxwaalaa kareswa betemagabu ya'alaahene denebare kamithesute badaayoce tehonaalaacehu.>>

beliseme yatashafanawene haferata galaacawene galetho liyaasaayaacawe badebeqe qaale gotagotaacawe. <<geetaacehu 'eneda malaa'ekete 'aliyaame bajanate wesethe zawetaariwoce 'enedaatehonu bamathelaate 'eneji kazihece zaafe 'enedaatebalu 'alekalakalaacehume>> 'alaacawe.
ba'alaaheme maalalaacawe; <<'adame 'enaa hhawaa'e hoye! basathaxwaacehu theqomaa 'enaho 'enee la'enaaneta malekaame kamimanyu makaariwoce nanye>> 'alaacawe.

bamaataalale 'enaa bamakedaateme kanabarubate darajaa 'awaradaacawe. 'enaresume katakalakalute zaafe feree babalu gizee haferata galaacawe yatagalatha hona. haferata galaacawene lamashafaneme kajanate qethaloce raasaacawe laaye yelathaathefu jamare. geetaacaweme 'enedihe sile tharaacawe; <<kazihece zaafe kamabelaate 'alekalakalekwaacehumene? 'enaanetaneme 'asethaneqaaqi sehone shayethwane lanaaneta geletze thalaate nawe 'alaalekwaacehumene?>>

'adame 'enaa hhawaa'eme; <<geetaacene hoye! 'enedaanebalaa yakalakalekanene bamathaase kazaafitu feree bamabelaate raasaacenene badalene, wanejalaacenene yamaatemerelene 'enaa ba'ezenateheme yamaataazenelene kahona malekaame `edelaacenene bamaathaate kakasaariwoce 'enehonaalane>> 'alu.

'alaaheme la'adame, lahhawaa'e 'enaa belise 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<kajanate wada medere weradu. kafilaacehume lakafilaacehu thalaate yehonaale. lanaanetame bamedere yameteragubate botaa 'enaa 'esekatawasana qatharome mathaqaaqamiyaa 'alaacehu.>>

'alaaheme 'adamene, hhawaa'ene 'enaa zereyaawocaacawene siyaanaagere 'enedihe 'ala - <<bazihece medere laaye 'alaahe 'esekawasanalaacehu gizee tenoraalaacehu. bawesethwame temotaalaacehu. teqabaraalaacehu. kaqaberaacehume bamaqaseqase tewathaalaacehu.

'enaaneta ya'adame lejoce hoye! 'enyaa haferata galaacehune lamashafane gede 'enaa 'anegabegaabi yahona lebesene 'adaragenelaacehu. basawoce mahakale yametaageethubateneme chemaaree lebesene 'adaragenelaacehu. 'alaahene yamaferaate lebese (te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe yamiganyawe) yaa qusaawi kahonawe lebese balaache nawe. yeheme yatathaqasawe lebese ya'alaahene celotaa kamigaletzu meleketocu nawe. yeheme yatanagaraacehu 'alaahe banaaneta laaye yawaalawene tzagaawocune 'asetaawesaacehu taamasagenute zanede nawe.

'enaaneta ya'adame lejoce hoye! 'enaho shayethwane, haferata galaane yamishafenawene qusaawi lebese 'enedihume ya'alaahene feraacaa lebese bamaasetawe wanejalene bamaasegeethe walaajaacaacehune ('adamene 'enaa hhawaa'ene) yatakalakalutene zaafe mabelaatene bamaasegeethe kajanate 'enedaasewathaacawe bawetheetume haferata galaacaweme 'enedigalathe 'enedaadaragawe 'enaanetane 'ayefatenaacehu. shayethwane 'enaa zereyaawocume 'enaaneta kamaataayewaacawe bakule yaayuwaacexwaale. 'enyaame shayethwanaatene lananyaa ba'alaahe lamaayaamenute sawoce wadaajoce 'adaragenaacawe. 'enanyaa yaamanutene 'enaa malekaame yamiszarute gene wadanaresu maqerabiyaa manegade yalaacaweme.

'enanyaa 'agaariwoce, ba'alaahe laaye 'enedamaagaaraate 'enedihume 'ereqaanaacawene bakaa`ebaa zuriyaa mazorene `aayenate tzayaafe nagare sitagaberu, 'abaatocaacawe sitagaberute 'enedaaganywacawe 'enaa 'alaaheme 'enedaazazaacawe yenaagaraalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe batzayaafe wanejaloce 'ayaazezeme yelequne yekalakelaale 'enedeete yehene ba'alaahe laaye tenaagaraalaacehu? baweshate 'enaa baqethefate ba'alaahe laaye yamaataawequtene tenaagaraalaacehune?>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa la'agaariwoce - <<'alaahe fetehene 'azaza. tzayaafene 'enaa yamithalaane nagare 'alaazazame. 'amelekotene batheqelu laresu 'enedetaatharu 'azaza. batalaye bamasejidoce wesethe. mataazazeneme laresu yaatharaacehu honaacehu 'enedetelamenute 'azaza. majamariyaa laaye kaalenabaraacehubate 'enedafatharaacehu hulu lahulatanyaame gizee heyaawe 'aderego yeqaseqesaacexwaale. 'afathaatharaacehune bamajamare laaye caaye yahonawe 'enaanetane bamamalase 'enaa bamaqaseqase laayeme caaye nawe,>> balaacawe.

'alaahe sawocene hulate cheferoce 'adaraga. kafilune wada qanaa manegade maraa yaqenaacaa madaarashaaneme 'agaraalate, kalekaayuneme yaazalate, kafilu dagemo kaqathetanyaawe manegade mathemame gede honabate. 'enaresume ka'alaahe baashaagare shayethwanaatene wadaajoce bamaaderagaacawe, yaala`eweqateme bamakatalaacawe nawe. baziheme wada qathetanyaawe manegade yatamaru 'aderegawe yaasebaalu.

'enaaneta ya'adame lejoce hoye! basegedate 'enaa bathawaafeme waqete haferata galaacehune yamishafenene yametegeethubateneme tzedu`e 'enaa netzuhhe lebesene lebasu. 'alaaheme kafaqadaacawe malekaame nagaroce yafalagaacehutene belu thathu. yamizaanaawinate denebareneme 'atelafu. katafaqadame nagare 'alefaacehu wadatakalakalawe 'ateqerabu. 'alaaheme yamizaanaawinate denebarene yamithesutene 'ayewademe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa 'alaahe kalebese, kamegeboce 'enaa kaleeloceme yafaqadaacawene malekaamoce 'ereme lamiyaadaregute 'agaariwoce, <<la'enaaneta geethe yahonawene lebese banaaneta laaye 'ereme yaadaragawe maanawe? 'alaaheme kamagabaacehu kamibalu 'enaa kamithathu malekaamoce 'ereme yaadaragabaacehu maanawe?>> balaacawe. 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! <<'enanyihe malekaame nagaroce meneme 'enekwaa bigaarwacaweme 'enaresu baqerebitu `aalame ya'amaanyoce nace>> balaacawe. bamachiwe `aalame dagemo kahadi janate selamaayegabaa la'amaanyoce becaa yatanathalace tehonaalace. 'enedihe baala `aayenate galatzaa lamiyaawequ sawoce 'aneqatzocene 'enaaberaaraalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa 'alaahe yafaqadawene 'ereme lamiyaadaregu thaa`otaawiyaane - <<'enaho 'alaahe babaarocu laaye 'ereme yaadaragawe geletzeme yehune debeqe tzayaafe nagarene, (wanejalocene bamulu) basawoce dame, ganezabe 'enaa kebere laaye babadale denebare maalafene, yaaneneme la'enaaneta maaserajaa yaleelaacehune 'akaale ba'alaahe laaye maagaaraataacehune, basemocu, babaahheriyaatu, baszeraawocu 'enaa bahegegaatu yaala `eweqate ba'alaahe laaye manaagaraacehune nawe>> balaacawe.
la'eyaanedaanedume hhezebe tewelede yatawasana yamote qatharo 'alawe yaame yatawasanawe qatharwacawe simathaa teneshe gizee 'ayezagayume teneshe gizeeme 'ayeqademume.

'enaaneta ya'adame lejoce hoye! kahhezebocaacehu makaakale, 'enee kamalakotaawi matsaahhefetee wadanaresu yaawaradekutene yamiyaanabebu honawe male`eketanyocee yaamathwacawe 'enedahona taazazwacawe. yamathubateneme nagare takatalu. 'enanyaa yaazazawene bamatagebare 'enaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene yamifarute 'enaresu baferedu `elate ferehate yalabaacaweme kaduneyaame dereshaa baamalathaacawe 'ayetakezume.

'enanyaa 'aneqatzocaacenene yaasetabaabalute 'enaa bareswa yaalaamanute kahadiwoce, male`eketanyoce yezawe bamathute nagare kamaszeraate yakoru 'enaa yatakofasute 'enanyaa bawesethwa zawetaariwoce sihonu ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe.

kaziyaa 'agaarene wada 'alaahe bamaasethagaate 'aliyaame yaalawene bamaqanase, yaleelawene bamachamare wayeme wadaqathetanyaawe manegade bamimarute geletze 'aneqatzocu kaasetabaabala sawe balaaye badaaye yalame. 'enanyaa sawoce kaqerebitwa `aalame mathaqamiyaa batathabaqawe saleedaa yatatzaafawe dereshaacawe yedaresaacawaale. yamote male'ake 'enaa gebera 'abarocu 'esetenefaasaacawene lamasabesebe bamimathu `elate bawaqasaa maleku <<'enanyaa ka'alaahe baashaagare taamalekwaacawe yanabarute 'amaaleketocaacehu yataalu?>> yelwacawaale; <<yethaqemwacehu zanede therwacawe 'eneji>> yelaalu. 'agaariwocume lamalaa'eketu - <<'enaamalekaacawe yanabarute 'amaaleketoce kanyaa reqawaale>> yelaalu. kahadiyaane 'enedanabarume baraasaacawe laaye yemasakeraalu. gene baziyaa gizee maaragaagathaacawe 'enaa maamanaacawe banaresu laaye maaserajaa yehonaale 'eneji 'ayethaqemaacaweme.

'alaaheme, 'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! kajinoce 'enaa kasawoce bakehedate 'enaa bathememate kanaaneta bafite yaalafu wada honu hhezeboce gebu yelaacawaale. kahhezeboceme 'anede hhezebe bagabaa quthere qademo wada 'esaate yagabaawene 'ehetune (masalune) yeraagamaale. baziyaame bataganaanyu 'enaa batasabaasabu gizee, qathelo yagabaawe hhezebe (takataayoce 'enaa zeqetanyaa yahonute lamajamariyaawe) taalaalaaqoce 'enaa mariwoce lahonute - <<geetaacene hoye! 'enanyihe kaqenaacaa manegade yaathamamune taalaalaaqoce naacawe. lanyaa themematene bamaasaamaraacaweme mekeneyaate qethaatene 'ethefe derebe 'aderegebaacawe>> yelaalu. 'alaaheme malese sisathaacawe - <<la'eyaanedaanedaacehu yatadaraaraba yaqethaate dereshaa 'alaacehu. gene 'enaaneta yehenene yamaataawequ 'enaa yamaateradu selahonaacehu nawe>> yelaacawaale.

mariwocume: latakataayocaacawe - <<'enaaneta takataayoce hoye! qethaate 'enediqanaselaacehu yamiyaadarege belechaa banyaa laaye yalaacehume. hhisaabe wesethe yamigabaawe yaszaraacehute szeraa nawe; weshate lamakatale mekeneyaate 'alenabaraacehume kakehedate 'enaa kawanejale teszarute banabaraacehute 'enyaa 'enedaqamasenawe 'enaanetame qethaatune qemasute>> yelwacawaale.

'enanyaa geletze bahonu 'aneqatzocaacene yaasetabaabalu, lareswame 'eje kamasethate 'enaa kamataazaze yakoru kamalekaame nagaroce hulu tasefaa yaqorathu naacawe. bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate yasamaaye dajaafoce laszeraawocaacawe 'ayekafatulaacaweme. bamimotume gizee lanafesocaacawe 'ayekafatulaacaweme. 'enaresume (ka'enesesaate hulu gezufe yahonawe) gemale kanagaroce hulu thabaabe bahonacewe yamarefee qadaadaa 'esekisholeke derase janate 'ayegabume. yehe dagemo bafetzume lihone yamicele nagare 'ayedalame. chebethu bafetzume janate magebaate 'alamacaalaacawe nawe. 'enedihe baala qethaate 'alaahe wanejalu yabazaane 'amatzanyaa hulu yemanadaabataale.

la'enanyaa 'asetabaabaayoce 'enaa kuraatanyoce kajahaname yamiyaanathefute menethaafe, kabalaayaacaweme ya'esaate shefaane tazagaajetolaacawaale. 'enanyaaneme bakehedate 'enaa bamaafanegathe ya'alaahene denebare yamitalaalafutene badaayoce bazihe maleku 'enemanadaalane.

'enanyaame bageetaacawe yaamanu 'enaa bamicelute yaahele malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru ('aneditene nafese kametecelawe balaaye yamaanaasegadedaate sihone) 'enanyaa bawesethwa zawetaariwoce honawe linorubaate yajanate gwaadoce naacawe.

bajanate wesethe kamiyaaganyute tzagaawoce melu`enateme yatanasaa 'alaahe balebocaacawe wesethe yaalane thelaacaa 'enaa meqanyenatene naqelo yaawathaawaale. kaserocaacaweme jeratoce 'enedifasesu yaadaregaale. 'enaresume ya'alaahene tzagaawoce simasakeru - <<lazihece darajaa yaadarasane, malekaame szeraa yagathamane 'alaahe mesegaanaa yegabaawe. 'alaahe baalemaraane noro banafesaacene celotaa yamenemaraa 'alenabareneme. baqaale kidaane 'enaa bazaacaa yageetaacene male'eketanyoce therethere yaleelabatene 'ewenataane baregethe yezawe mathetawaale>> yelaalu. banaresume wesethe tathaari:- <<yageetaacehu male'eketanyoce sinagerwacehu yanabaracewe ya'atekelete seferaa yehece nace. baqerebitwa `aalame teszarute banabaraacehute malekaame szeraawoce mekeneyaate geetaacehu 'enedetewareswate 'adaragaacehu>> belo yaasamaacawaale.

hulatume bayatamadabalaacawe seferaa kagabu baxwaalaa yajanate baaledaraboce ya'esaate gwaadocene yethaaraalu - <<'enyaa geetaacene sela janate yagabaalenene qaale kidaane ba'ewenate takasaace hono 'agenyetanawaale. janateme gabetanaale. 'enaanetase kahadiyaane geetaacehu yaasefaraaraacehune 'esaate ba'ewenate takasaace honaa 'aganyaacexwaatene>> yelwacawaale. kahadiyaaneme <<geetaacene yazaatabenene 'esaate baregethe 'agenyetanaale>> yelaalu. tathaarime 'alaahene yamithayeqe hono yethaaraale - <<'enaho ya'alaahe 'eregemaane ba'enanyaa ya'ezenatune bare kafetolaacawe kaziyaame bamaraaqe 'eraasaacawene babadalu kahadiyaane laaye yewerade>> yelaale.

'enazihe badaayoce baraasaacawe ka'alaahe manegade yaraaqu, leeloceneme ka'alaahe manegade 'enedirequ yamiyaadaregu. ya'ewenateme manegade sawoce liheedubate yamaayecelubate thamaamaa 'enedetehone yamifalegu, bamacharashaaweme `aalamene yakaadu 'enaa lareswame yamaayezagaaju nabaru.

bamahakalaacaweme geredoshe 'ala. ba'enanyihe hulate cheferoce (bajanate 'enaa 'esaate gwaadoce) mahakale kafe yaala 'a`eraafe yamisanye maaqoyaa 'ala. baziheme kafe baalawe maaqoyaa laaye malekaame 'enaa 'ekuye szeraacawe 'ekule yahonabaacawe sawoce 'alu. 'enaresume yajanate sawocene bameleketaacawe, bafitaacawe maashaberaqe, ya'esaate sawoceneme bameleketaacawe, bafitaacawe thequrate yaaweqwaacawaale. 'enanyaame ya'a`eraafe sawoce yajanate sawocene bamaakebare <<salaame banaaneta laaye yesefane>> yelwacawaale. yajanate sawoceme ganaa janate 'alegabume ba'alaahe 'ezenate 'enedamigabwate yekajelaalu.

ya'a`eraafe sawoce `eyetaa wada 'esaate gwaadoce setezore, yaalubateneme beretu qethaate simalakatu, <<geetaacene hoye! bakehedate 'enaa baanetame bamaagaaraate 'eraasaacawene kabadalute sawoce 'ataaderegane>> belawe 'alaahene yemaatzanaalu.

'enanyaame ya'a`eraafe sawoce ka'esaate gwaadoce makaakale 'enanyaane bafitocaacawe thequrate 'enaa ba`aayenocaacaweme samaayaawinate yamiyaaweqwaacawene sawoce 'enedihe silu yetharwacawaale - <<baganezabe 'enaa basawe mabarekataacehu 'alethaqamaacehume. bakuraate 'enaa bamakofaseme ka'ewenate maraaqaacehu 'alefayadaacehume.>>

'alaaheme kahadiyaanune siwaqese - <<'alaahe ba'ezenatu 'ayedaresaacaweme 'eyaalaacehu temelubaacawe yanabarute sawoce 'enanyihe naacawene?>> yelaacawaale. lame'emanaaneme <<janate gebu, lawadafiteme bamigathemaacehu ferehaate yalabaacehume. qwaami tzagaane bamaagenyataacehu kaqerebitwa `aalame dereshaa baamalathaacehu 'atetakezume>> yelaacawaale.

'enanyaa ya'esaate gwaadoceme yajanate baaledarabocene kanaresu falaagi honawe - <<'enaaneta yajanate sawoce hoye! weha 'aliyaame geetaacehu kamagabaacehu megebe 'anebwabulene>> belawe yethaarwacawaale. yajanate sawoceme <<'enaho 'alaahe hulatuneme bakahadiyaane laaye 'ereme 'aderegwaacawaale. 'alaahe 'ereme baadaragawe 'anedareselaacehume>> yelwacawaale.

'enanyihe kahadiyaane, 'enanyaa 'emenataacawene masaalaqiyaa 'enaa machaawacaa yaadaragute naacawe. yaqerebitwa `aalameme bageethocwa 'enaa batheqemocwa 'ataalalacaacawe. baferedume `elate 'enaresu yaanene `elate yazanagu 'enaa laresume baalamazagaajataacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe yerasaacawaale. ba'alaahe geletze 'aneqatzoceme bamakaadaacawe 'enaa 'ewenatenataacaweneme bamaasetabaabalaacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe bakabaade qethaate yamisaqaayu sihonu yetawaacawaale.

bazihe bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye batawaradawe qure'aane 'amathaanelaacawe ka'enyaame bahona `eweqate 'aberaaraanawe. 'eresume me'emanaanene wada qenaacaa 'enaa ya'ewenate manegade mari nawe. yaqerebituneme, yamachiweneme `aalame malekaame nagaroce thaqwaami bamahonu 'ezenateme nawe.

'enanyaame kahadiyaane gudaayaacawe yamiyaabaqaabatene 'enaa 'enedamikasate yatanagarutene 'asaamaami qethaate 'eneji leelaa 'ayethabequme. kaziyaame yatanagarute nagare 'enedihume me'emanaaneme yataqatharute malekaame menedaa bamimathaabate `elate 'enanyaa baqerebitu `aalame qure'aanene yazanagute, yezo bamathaaweme yaaleszarute, yageetaacene male`eketanyoce baregethe 'ewenatene, ka'alaaheme lamahonu therethereme yaleelabatene 'ewenataa yezawe mathetawaale. 'alaaheme kaqethaate yaadenane zanede 'amaalaajoce binorune, wayeme wada qerebitwa `aalame yamamalase `edele binorane 'enaa 'eneszaraawe banabarawe mathefo szeraa meteke ka'esaate yamenedenebatene malekaame szeraane baszaraane belawe yemanyaalu. 'enanyaa kahadiyaane bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate wada thefaate botaa bamaweradaacawe raasaacawe baregethe kasaru. ka'alaaheme baashaagare yaamalekwaacawe yanabarute 'amaalekete kanaresu tasawaru 'alethaqamwacaweme.

sawoce hoye! 'enaho geetaacehu yaa samaayaatene 'enaa mederene yaala qadaami 'amesaayaa basedesete qanaate yafatharawe 'alaahe nawe. kaziyaame karesu kebere 'enaa le`elenaa bamigatheme maleku ka`aareshe balaaye kafe 'ala. ('enedeetaawene leneradaa 'aneceleme) 'eresume yalalitune chelamaa baqane berehaane; yaqanuneme berehaane baleelite chelamaa yaasekeedawaale. 'anedaacawe leelaacawene mazageyate baleelabate fathaane makatale yekatalawaale. tzahhayene, charaqaane 'enedihume kawaakebetene late`ezaazu yatagaru 'enedihonu fatharaacawe. lebe balu! mafethare hulu ya'alaahe nawe. maazazeme laresu becaa nawe. malekaamenatu yatalaqa, bago 'aderaaginatume yabazaa, baleqenaa 'enaa bamelu`enate baahheriyaate tagalaachu ya`aalamaatu geetaa nawe.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! geetaacehune bamelu`e matanaanase, bamawaadaqe 'enaa demetzaacehune zeqe 'aderegaacehu lemanaacehuneme kataayetaa 'enaa baresume leelocene kamaagaaraate yaatharaacehu honaacehu lamenute.
