'eresume balemanaa denebare yamiyaalefutene 'ayewademe. denebarune kamaalafe telaaleqe thaa`otaawiyaanu 'enedamiyaadaregute leelocene ka'alaahe gaare bamaagaaraate malamane nawe.

medereneme 'alaahe male'eketanyocene bamalaake kaabajaate 'enaa sawoceme 'eresune babecanyenate bamagazaate kaasaamarwate baxwaalaa wanejale bamafatzame mederene 'ataabalaashwate qethaatuneme bamaferaate, menedaaweneme tasefaa bamaaderage 'alaahene lamenute. ya'alaaheme 'ezenate la'asaamaariwoce qerebe nawe.

'alaahe maalate yaa ka'ezenatu yatanasaa kazenaabe bafite 'abesaari 'aderego nefaasocene yamileke nawe. 'enanyaa nefaasoce baweha yakabada damanaa batashakamu gizee yaanene yakabada damanaa wada daraqe medere 'enenadaawenaa baziyaa zenaabene 'enaawaredaalane. bawehaweme kaferaaferee `aayenatoce hulu 'enaawathaalane. feraafereewocene bazihe maleku 'enedamenaawathaa hulu mutaaneneme kaqaberocaacawe 'enaawathaalane. yeheneneme yamenaadaregawe 'enaaneta ya'alaahene celotaa 'enaa yamathaqa szeraawene 'enedetaasetawelu, 'eresume mutaanene bamaqaseqase laaye caaye mahonune taasetaawelu zanede nawe.

malekaame mareete yametaabaqelawene ba'alaahe faqaade yaamaara 'aderegaa taawathaalace leke 'enedihu 'amaanye mekerene yesamaale. yethaqamebataale. bawetheetume malekaame szeraa yeganyebataale. 'asidaamaa 'enaa chawaamaa yahonace mareete gene yametaabaqelawe dakaamaa, yatacagara hono yewathaale, kahadime 'enedihu bamekere 'ayethaqameme bawetheetu 'eresu yamithaqamebatene malekaame szeraa 'ayaaseganyeme. leke 'enedihe baala yataberaaraa maaserajaa ya'alaahene tzagaawoce lamiyaamasagenu sawoce 'aneqatzocene 'enaaberaaraalane.

nuhhe hhezebocune 'alaahene babecanyenate 'enediyaamaleku yamitharaacawe sihone wada hhezebocu male`eketanyaa 'aderegane baregethe laakenawe. 'eresume <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene babecanyenate 'amelekute. lanaanetame karesu leelaa 'amelaake yalaacehume. 'enaanetame bakehedate laaye bamazawetaraacehu ba'enaaneta laaye yataalaaqune qane qethaate 'efaraalaacexwaalahu>> 'alaacawe.
kahhezebocume mariwocu 'enaa taalaalaaqocu <<'enyaa geletze bahona thememate laaye nahe belane nawe yamenaamenawe>> 'alute.

nuhheme kahhezebocu lataalaalaaqocu, <<hhezebocee hoye! 'enaaneta 'enedaalaacehute thememate yalabenyeme. yeleqe 'enee kageetaayee bahona qenaacaa laaye nanye. 'eneeme geetaayee 'enaa geetaacehu kahonawe ka 'alamaatu geetaa 'alaahe zanede yatalaaku male'eketanyaa nanye>> 'alaacawe.

<<'alaaheme wadanee kaasetalaalafawe nagare 'adaresaacexwaalahu. 'enaanetaneme ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatzamaacehu yametaaganyutene menedaa bamaasekajale, yaamatzaacehute 'enedahona yamidaresebaacehune qethaate bamaasethaneqaqe lanaaneta malekaamene 'emakeraalahu, malekaamene 'asebaalahu. bamalakotaawiwe male'eketeme bakule 'enaaneta yamaataawequtene nagare ka'alaahe zanede 'aweqaalahu.>> 'alaacawe.

<<kanaaneta makaakale bahona bamahakalaacehu baadaga, weshataameme thamaamaame baalehona, kaleelaa gosaa baalehona 'anede sawe 'anedabate laaye ka'alaahe yahona tagesaatze selamathaalaacehu tagaramaacehune? yaasetabaabalaacehu 'enaa yaamatzaacehu kahona 'alaahe yahonane qethaate liyaasethanaqeqaacehu, te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe 'alaahene 'enedetefaru, yaamanaacehubateme kahona mehherate taaganyu zanede mathaahulaacehu.>>

hhezebocume 'asetabaabalute. baresume 'alaamanume. bakehedataacaweme qathalubate. 'alaaheme 'enediyaathafaacawe lamana. 'eresune 'enaa ka'amaanyoceme 'eresune yatakatalutene baweha kamathelaqelaqe bamarekabitu natzaa 'awathaanaacawe. 'enanyaaneme ba'aneqatzocaacene yaasetabaabalute 'enaa bakehedataacawe yaqathalutene 'eneqathaacawe zanede bamaasemathe (baweha bamaathelaqelaqe) 'athafaanaacawe. 'enaresu lebocaacawe yataawarace hhezeboce nabaru.

wada `aade nagadoceme wanedemaacawene kanaresu yahonane male'eketanyaa hudene laakenebaacawe. <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene babecanyenate tagazute lanaanetame karesu leelaa 'amelaake yalaacehume. te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'enaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene 'atefarume 'enaa kaqethaatume 'atedenumene?>> 'alaacawe.

kahhezebocume 'enanyaa ba'alaahe yakaadute 'enaa male'eketanyocuneme yaasetabaabalute shumaamenete. <<hude hoye! 'aneta wada 'alaahe 'amelekote becaa setetharaane 'amaaleketocaacenene 'enedenetawe setaazezaneme baqilenate 'enaa 'ebedate wesethe 'enedaalahe 'enaayehalane('enaasebehalane). male'eketanyaa nanye belahe bametenaagarawe nagare kaweshataamocu nahe belane 'enaamenaalane>> 'alute.
hudeme lahhezebocu malese sisathaacawe - <<hhezebocee hoye! 'enaaneta 'enedametelute qilenate 'enaa 'ebedate yalabenyeme yelequne 'enee ka`aalamaatu geetaa yatalaaku male'eketanyaa nanye>> 'alaacawe.

'alaaheme 'eresune babecanyenate kamaamelake 'enaa kahegegaatume wadanaaneta 'enedaadarese yaazazanyene 'adareselaacexwaalahu. 'eneeme wadanaaneta lamaaderase bataazazekute nagare makaari 'enaa yamaalaagodeleme yamaalechamereme taamaanye nanye 'alaacawe.

kageetaacehu zanede kamalaa'eketeme, kagaaneeneme saayehone kanaaneta bahona sawe 'amaakaayenate 'enaanetane lamaasethaneqaqe male`ekete yezo bamamethaatu tedanaqaalaacehune? kanuhhe hhezeboce baxwaalaa bamedere laaye tatakiwoce (waraashoce) baadaragaacehu, ba'akaaleme thenekaareene bachamaralaacehu gizee yawaalalaacehune tzagaa 'awesu. tedenu zanede ya'alaahene tzagaawoce 'asetaawesu.

hhezebocume - <<hude hoye! 'alaahene babecanyenate 'enedenegazaa, 'abaatocaaceneme yaamalekwaacawe yanabarutene 'amaalekete 'enedenetawe letaazezane nawe yamathaakxawe? bametelawe nagare ka'ewenatanyocu 'enedahoneke 'enyaane yametaasefaraaraabatene qethaate 'amethaabene>> 'alute.

hudeme 'enedihe sile malasalaacawe - <<ya'alaahe qethaate 'enaa quthaa liwaredebaacehu baregethe tagabiwoce honaacexwaale 'eresume yaalatherethere yemathaabaacexwaale. ba'ewenatu yamamalake mabete yaleelaacawe sihone 'enaaneta 'enaa 'abaatocaacehu 'amaalekete belaacehu basayamaacexwaacawe ge`uze 'akaalaate temwagatunyaalaacehune? 'enaaneta 'amaalekete baalaacehute nagare yametaaseradubate 'anedaaceme maaserajaa 'alaahe 'alaawaradame. kaqethaateme 'enedicaakole yathayaqaacehutene thabequ 'eneeme kanaaneta gaare katathabaabaaqiwocu nanye.>>

hudene 'enaa karesu gaare yanabarutene 'amaanyoce kanyaa bahona 'ezenate 'adaanenaacawe. 'enanyaaneme 'aneqatsotzocaacenene yaasetabaabalutene baqethaate 'aragafenaacawe. kahadiyaane 'eneji 'amaanyoce 'alenabarume qethaateme tagabaacawe.

wada samude gosaawoce wanedemaacawene saalihhene 'alaahene babecanyete wada maamelake yamithaaraacawe 'aderegane laakenawe. saalihheme <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene babecanyenate tagazu, karesu leelaa 'amelaake yalaacehume, 'enee yamathaahubate nagare 'ewenatanyetene yamimasakere ta`aamere baregethe ka'alaahe zanede yezhee mathaahu. yehece la'enaaneta ta`aamere yahonacewe ya'alaahe gemale nace. ba'alaahe medere wesetheme tebalaa zanede tawewaate theqaateme 'ataaderesubaate. yaasecagaraacexwaateme 'enedahona 'asaamaami qethaate yeyezaacexwaale>> 'alaacawe.

'alaahe ka`aade hhezeboce baxwaalaa tatakiwoce baadaragaacehu gizee 'asetaawesu. yametethaqaaqamu sihone bamedere laaye 'asafaraacehu (yeheme `aadocene bakehedataacawe naa bamaasetabaabalaacawe mekeneyaate kaathafaa baxwaalaa nawe) bameedaa laaye hhenetzaawocene teganabaalaacehu kataraaroceme tharebaacehu (falefelaacehu) beetocene teszaraalaacehu. taamasagenu zanede ya'alaahene tzagaawoce 'asetaawesu. kehedatenenaa wanejalene bamatawe 'amasenyu. bamedere laayeme thefaatene lamaasefaafaatetherate 'ataaderegu.

'enanyaame kahhezebocu makaakale yakorute shumaamenetoce lananyaa 'enaresu lamineqwaacawe yasaalihhe takataayoce ('amaanyoce) saalihhe kageetaawe zanede ba'ewenate yatalaaka male`eketanyaa 'enedahona taaweqaalaacehune? 'alwacawe. dakaamocu, me'emanaaneme - <<'enyaa saalihhe batalaakabate 'amaanyoce laresume taazaazhoce nane>> 'alu.
yakoruteme - <<'enyaa 'enaaneta baamanaacehubate kahadiwoce nane 'anaamenebateme 'anekatalawememe>> 'alu.

kefu 'ataaderesubaate yaalaacaweneme gemale wagwaate, 'aradwate kageetaacaweme te`ezaaze ba'emebitanyenate 'afanagathu. <<saalihhe hoye! 'aneta ba'ewenate kamale`eketanyocu kahoneke 'enyaane taasefaraaraabate yanabarekawene yakabada qethaate 'amethaabene>> 'alute.

'enanyaaneme kahadiyaane yecaakolute yanabarawe qethaate kabaade maneqatheqathe (yamale'ake kabaade chukxate) mathaabaacawe bamanedaraacaweme tanebarakaku (fitaacawe 'enaa gulebataacawe kamareete gaare yatathaabaqa honawe 'adaru) kanaresu 'anedeme kaqethaate yaamalatha yalame.

saalihheme bahhezebocu tasefaa baqoratha gizee kanaresu tagalala. 'enediheme 'ala - <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahe wadanaaneta 'enedaadarese yaazazanyene nagare baregethe 'adarasekulaacehu. bamaasekajale 'enaa bamaasethaneqaqeme makarekwaacehu. gene 'enaaneta bamalekaame yamiyaazaacehune 'enaa kakefume yamiyaasethanaqeqaacehune makaari 'atewadume.>>

lutheneme hhezebocu tagebaaraacawe yatathalaa mahonunaa <<yehene tzayaafe tagebaare (wanedocene basemeete maqerabene) tefatzemaalaacehune? bazihece ka`aalamaate yaqadamaacehu yalame>> baala gizee 'awesaa.

<<semeetocene lamaarekaate yatafatharu seetocene tetaacehu wanedocene basemeete teqarebaalaacehune? bazihe tagebaaraacehu 'a`emerone, salaamaawi tafatherone 'enaa malekaame 'are'ayaane 'aletakatalaacehume. yelequne 'enaaneta kasawe leje tafathero'awi mizaane bamaraaqe denebare yatalaalafaacehu hhezeboce naacehu>> 'alaacawe.

yaanene tzayaafe tagebaare yefatzemu yanabarute hhezebocu maleseme:- <<luthene 'enaa takataayocune kamanedaraacehu 'abaarwacawe. 'enaresu 'enyaa yameneszaraawene yamithayafu, sawoce naacawe selaziheme bamahakalaacene liqoyu 'ayegabaacaweme 'asewathwacawe>> maalate 'eneji leelaa 'alenabarame.

'eresune 'enaa takataayocune kaziyaace qethaatu kamiyaarefebate manedare balalite 'enediwathu bamaaderage kaqethaate 'adaanenaacawe, misetu seteqare. 'ereswa yanaresu 'agaazhe nabaracenaa kahhezebocwa gaare qarace. yaaganyaacaweme qethaate 'aganyaate. kathafiwocume honace.

banaresume laaye yakabaade qethaate zenaabe 'azanabenebaacawe (bajahaname wesethe batagaagara shakelaa denegaaye dabadabenaacawe) manedaritune galabathenaate (yalaayenyaawe kefele yataacenyaawe hona) 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'enanyaa 'athefi yaluthe hhezeboce madamedamiyaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara tamalekate. macharashaacawe thefaate 'enaa weredate nabare.

wada madeyane gosaame wanedemaacawene shu`aayebene laakene 'enediheme 'alaacawe - <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene babecanyenate 'amelekute. lanaaneta karesu leelaa 'amelaake yalaacehume. 'ewenatanyaanateene masekaari yahonu geletse maaserajaawoce baregethe kageetaacehu zanede mathaalaacehu. seferene 'enaa mizaanene bamamulaate yasawocene mabete thabequ. bamaselabe 'enaa bamaataalaleme yasawocene neberate 'ataagudelu. 'alaahe nabiyaatene bamalaake kaasaamaraate baxwaalaa wanejale bamaszeraate bamedere wesethe 'ataathefu. 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce kahonaacehu yehe yatanagaraacehu nagare la'enaaneta yatashaala 'enaa yaamaara nawe.>>yehe 'emenate wanejalene matawe, 'alaahe yakalakalawene maraaqe, 'alaahe yaazazaweneme bamafatzame wada 'alaahe maqaarabe selaalabate nawe.

<<sawocene letaasefaraarubate 'enaa neberatocaacaweneme letezarefu, ya'alaaheneme qene manegade zenebaaleewocaacehune yatakatalace thamaamaa 'enedetehone bamafalage wada 'alaahe manegade mamaraate yamifalegutene sawoce yametekalakelu honaacehu bamanegadoce laaye 'ateqamathu. ya'alaaheneme tzagaa 'asetaawesu. qutheraacehu 'anaasaa nabare 'abarakataacehu. ka'enaaneta bafite yanabarute 'athefiwoce macharashaacawe mene 'enedanabara 'asetawelu. madamedamiyaacawe thefaate 'enaa 'eleqite nabare.

ka'enaaneta yahonu kafile cheferoce 'enee batalaakubate yaamanu 'enedahonanaa leeloce cheferoce dagemo saayaamenu biqaru, 'alaahe bamahakalaacene ferede 'esekisathe derase bate`egesete thabequ 'enaho 'eresu kafaraajoce hulu balaachu fetehawiwe nawe.>>

'enanyaame kahhezebocu makaakale yakorute shumaamenete - <<'aneta shu`aayebe hoye! 'anetane 'enaa baanetame bamaamane yatakataluhene hulu kazihece kamanedaraacene 'enaabaareraacexwaalane, wayeme dagemo wada 'emenataacene letemalasu yegabaale>> 'alute. 'eresume <<yehe 'emenataacehu wedeqe mahonune bamaawaqaacene yathalaanawe benehoneme 'enekwaane bamaasegadade 'enedenekatalawe taadaregunaalaacehune?>> 'alaacawe.

<<'alaahe kareswa natzaa kaadaragane baxwaalaa 'enaaneta yaalaacehubatene kehedate 'enaa ba'alaahe laaye maagaaraatene taqabelane wadanaaneta manegade yatamalasene 'enedahona baregethe ba'alaahe laaye weshatene faberekanaale. geetaaceneme 'alaahe hulume 'akaale laresu felaagote 'enediwaadaqe kaalefalaga basetaqare 'enyaa wadanaaneta wedeqe 'emenate lenemalase 'ayehoneleneme. geetaaceneme hulune nagare ba`eweqatu yaakaababa nawe. 'anedaaceme nagare karesu 'ayeshashageme. wada qathetanyaawe manegade yemaraane 'enaa kajahaanameme manegade yethabeqane zanede ba'alaahe laaye tamakaane. geetaacene hoye! banyaanaa ba'ewenate bakaadute sawoce mahakale ferede sethe. tabadaayune 'amaanye babadaayu 'emebitanyaa laaye delene 'aqadaajaawe. 'anetame kafaraajoce hulu balaache faraaje nahenaa.>>

kahhezebocume 'enanyaa ya'alaahene ya'anedenate theri yataqaawamute mariwoce 'enaa shumaamenete hhezebocaacawene siyaasethanaqequ, <<'enaaneta 'emenataacenene kedaacehu shu`aayebene yametekatalu kahona 'enaaneta yaane gizee kathafiwoce 'enaa kakasaariwoce tehonaalaacehu>> 'alu.
beretu yahonace maneqatheqatheme yaazacaacawe bamanedaraacaweme yathafu, bagulebataacawe 'enaa bafitocaacawe laaye yatadafunaa yamotu honawe nagaa.

'enanyaa shu`aayebene yaasetabaabalute hulaacaweme thafu. bahagaraacawe 'enedaalenabaru 'enaa 'enedaaletathaqaaqamu honu. 'enanyaa shu`aayebene yaasetabaabalu sawoce kasaariwoce honu. raasaacawene 'enaa neberatocaacawene 'akasaru. 'enanyaa 'asetabaabaaye kahadiyaane belawete 'enedanabarawe 'amaanyocu kasaariwoce 'alehonume.

nabiyaacawe shu`aayebe (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enaresu bathafu gizee kanaresu tagalalanaa - <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahe wadanaaneta 'enedaadarese yaazazanyene nagare baregethe 'adarasekwaacehu. makarekwaacehume gene mekereene 'aletaqabalaacehume. lamamariyaayeeme taazaazhe 'alehonaacehume. 'alaahene bakaadunaa bakehedataacaweme bazawataru sawoce laaye 'enedeete 'azenaalahu?>> 'ala.

kanabiyaate 'anedene nabiye ba'anedite manedare wesethe lekane sawocu yaasetabaabalu 'enaa yakaadu kahona bacegere 'enaa babashetaa yamataanaate betehone 'eneji yaqarace manedare yalaceme. yeheme 'enaresu yaalubatene kehedate 'enaa kuraate tetawe la'alaahe yewaadaqu zanede nawe. yehe 'alaahe baqadamete kahadi hhezeboce laaye yawasadawene 'eremejaa bamatheqase laqurayeshoce 'enaa lamasale kahadiyaane yatasatha maasethaneqaqiyaa nawe.

kaziyaame bacegere 'enaa babashetaa kachabathenaacawe baxwaalaa neberataacawe 'esekibarakete ganezabaacawe 'esekibazaa derase malekaame, safi sisaayene 'enaa tzathetaane takaanelaacawe gene rasute, qadamete 'abaatocaaceneme 'enedihu cegere 'enaa bashetaa naketwacawe nabare 'adise 'ayedalame 'alu. yadarasabaacawe qethaate 'enedimakaru lamaaderage yaaganyuteme tzagaa 'enaresune lamaazanaagaate mahonune 'aletaradume. kaziyaame saayaawequte 'enaa yaaletathabaabaqute sihonume denegate baqethaate chabathenaacawe.

'enanyihe male'eketanyocaacenene yalaakenebaacawe manedare nawaariwoce male'eketanyocu yezawe yamathutene male`ekete biyaamenu, kehedatene 'enaa 'amatzene bamatawe yageetaacaweneme te`ezaaze bamathabaqe 'alaahene fariwoce bihonu noro yamalekaame nagarocene dajaafoce kaya'aqethaachaawe 'enekafetelaacawe nabare. kasamaaye malekaamene 'aweredane kamedere malekaamene 'abeqelane 'enemagebaacawe nabare. gene 'alaamanume, 'aletathanaqaqume, male`eketanyoce yaamathuteneme 'asetabaabalu. yeszarute banabarawe wanejale mekeneyaate baqethaate yaazenaacawe.
'enanyaa kahadi yahonu yazihece manedare nawaariwoce 'enaresu tanyetawe ba'erafetaacawe wesethe yasamathu honawe qethaataacene wadanaresu 'alamamethaatune tamaamanune?
wayeme yamanedaritu nawaariwoce 'enaresu bahheyewate gudaayaacawe yatathamadu honawe qethaataacene rafaade laaye 'alamamethaatune tamaamanune?

'enanyaa qadametocaacawe bawanejalocaacawe mekeneyaate kathafu baxwaalaa mederene yawarasute sawoce 'alaahe 'enaresune bawanejalocaacawe mekeneyaate liqathaacawe bishaa noro kanaresu bafite yanabarutene 'enediqathaa baqethaatu lichabethaacawe 'enedamicele 'aletagalatzalaacawemene? balebocaacawe laaye yaatemaale, bamekereme 'ayegasatzume maasetaawaseme 'ayethaqemaacaweme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye - 'enanyihene yaalafutene manedaroce yanuhhene, yahudene, yasaalihhene, yaluthe 'enaa yashu`aayebene hhezeboce manoriyaawoce mamakare lamicelu sawoce zeenaawocaacawene, yanabarubatene maasetabaabaale 'enaa 'emebitanyenate baaneta laaye 'enetarekaalane. ya'enanyihene manedare nawaariwoce male`eketanyocaacawe la'ewenatanyenataacawe geletze maaserajaawocene yezawe baregethe mathulaacawe. male'eketanyocume yezawe bamathute nagare kaziyaa bafite baasetabaabalute yamiyaamenu 'alehonume. 'alaaheme leke banaziyaa manedare nawaariwoce laaye 'enedaatamawe hulu bakahadiyaane leboce laayeme yaatemaale. wada 'emenate yatamaru 'ayehonume.

male'eketanyoce yatalaakubaacawe 'abezaanyocu hhezeboce qaale kidaanene thabaaqiwoce 'alaaheme lamakaraacawe nagare tagebaariwoce honawe 'alaaganyanaacaweme. ya'alaahene te`ezaazaate 'akebaariwoce 'alehonume. yelequne 'abezaanyocaacawene ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yaafanagathu nawe yaaganyanaacawe.

kaziyaame ka'enanyaa male'eketanyoce baxwaalaa musaane 'ewenatanyenatune masekaari bahonu 'aneqatzocaacene 'enaa maaserajaawocaacene wada fire`one 'enaa hhezebocu laakenawe. ka'enaresume ba'enanyaa 'aneqatzoce makaade 'enaa maasetabaabale 'eneji leelaa 'aletaganyame. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'enanyaa 'athefiwoce yanabarute yafire`one 'enaa hhezebocu madamedamiyaa mene 'enedanabara tamalekate. 'alaahe bamaasemathe 'athafaacawe. baziheceme bamachiweme `aalame karesu 'ezenate 'enedirequme 'adaragaacawe.
musaame! 'alaahe wada fire`one balaakawe gizee, <<fire`one hoye! 'enee ka`aalamaatu fathaari 'enaa yagudaayaacaweme 'asetanaabaari kahonawe 'alaahe yatalaaku nanye>> 'alawe.

musaame, <<'enee ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa honyee baresu laaye 'ewenatene 'eneji leelaane 'enedamaalenaagare 'eregethe nawe. 'eneeme ka'alaahe bakule yatalaaku lamahonee geletze maaserajaawocene yezhee baregethe mathaahulaacehu. yaseraa'eele lejoceneme kaalubate 'esere 'enaa seqaaye leqaqelenye>> 'alawe.
musaame baterune warawara, geletzeme yahonace yameteselakalake teleqe zanedo honaame taayace.
'ejuneme kabebetu sere 'awathaa, 'ereswa latamalekaacoce kaberehaanwa demeqate yatanasaame nache honaa taayace.
'enanyiheneme ta`aameraate batamalakatu gizee yafire`one hhezeboce yahonute shumaamenete 'enaa mariwoce yehe badegemete `eweqate yamathaqa degemetanyaa nawe.
badegemetu 'enaanetane kazihece medere (gebetze) liyaasewathaacehu yaasebaale 'alu. fire`oneme lamekere <<mene theqomaa tesathaalaacehu>> 'alaacawe.
'alume - <<musaane 'enaa wanedemune harunene 'aqoyaacawe 'enaa kaziyaame bakatamoce wesethe degemetanyocene yamisabasebu laake.>>
sabesaabiwocume badegemete `eweqatu yamathaqa degemetanyaane hulu sabesebawe yaamathulehale 'alute.
fire`oneme sabesaabiwocune laakanaa degemetanyocene hulu 'amathulate. degemetanyocume lafire`one <<'ashanaafiwocu 'enyaa kahonene menedaa 'alane?>> 'alute.
fire`oneme - <<'awone yaane gizee 'enaaneta kaqerebe baalamwaloce tehonaalaacehu>> 'alaacawe.
degemetanyocume musaane 'enedamiyaashanefu 'eregethanyoce honawe. bamakuraate 'enaa bamakofase musaa, merathe - <<'aneta warewere wayeme 'enyaa warewaariwoce 'enehune>> 'alute.

musaame malese sisathaacawe, <<'enaaneta wareweru>> 'alaacawe. bawarawarume gizee yasawocene `aayenoce katekekelanyaa `eyetaawoce bamaazore dagamubaacawe 'asefaraarwacawe. batamalekaacoceme `eyetaa taalaaqe degemete yezawe mathu.

'alaaheme wada musaa <<baterehene wada mareete thaale>> bamaalate male'ekete 'asetalaalafalate. wadiyaaweneme 'ereswa 'enaresu bazanegoce 'enaa bagamadoce bamaqathaathafe yaszarutene degemete tewethawe jamare.
'ewenateme taragaagatha. musaa yezo yamathaawe 'ewenate 'enaa yadegemetanyoceme weshate tagalatha. yeszarute yanabarawe degemeteme kashafa.
degemetanyocume taalaaqune ya'alaahene celotaa baasetawaalu 'enaa geletze yahonutene meleketoce baayu gizee la'alaahe bagenebaaraacawe tadafu.
degemetanyocume: <<ba`aalamaatu geetaa 'amanene;>>
<<bamusaa 'enaa bahaarune geetaa 'amanene; la'amelekoteme tagabiwe 'eresu nawe>> 'alu.

fire`oneme degemetanyocune ba'alaahe kaamanu baxwaalaa siyaasefaraaraacawe - <<'enee saalefaqedelaacehu 'amanaacehulatene? yehe 'enaaneta 'enaa musaa yakatamaayetune nawaariwocekakatamaawe lamaasewathaate zanede yaaseeraacehute seeraa maataalale nawe. baziheme yamiyaarefebaacehune qethaate 'enaa yamidaresebaacehune makaraa lawadafitu taawequtaalaacehu>> 'alaacawe.

<<'ejocaacehune 'enaa 'egerocaacehune 'eyaanaagaahu (qanye 'eje, geraa 'egere) 'eqorethaalahu. kaziyaame 'enaanetane lamimalakate hulu maqathaachaa 'enaa maasefaraariyaa tehonu zanede batamere zaafe gutowoce laaye 'esaqelaacexwaalaahu>> 'alaacawe.
degemetanyocume lafire`one zaacaa malese sisathu - <<'enyaa wada geetaacene tamalaashoce nane; laaneta maasefaraariyaa 'anebagareme>> 'alute.

<<fire`one hoye! yageetaacene ta`aamere bamusaa 'eje bamathaa gizee baresu maamanaacenene 'eneji kanyaa yametethalaawe nagare yalaheme. yehe yaminawarubate wanejale kahona wanejalaacene nawe>> 'alu. kaziyaame wada 'alaahe bamamalase - <<geetaacene hoye! te`egesetene banyaa laaye 'awerede. te`egesete shafenaaneme bafatanaa laaye yamenetzanaa 'aderegane, te`ezaazehene 'akebaariwoce, male'eketanyocehene takataaye muselimoce 'aderegakxaneme gedalane>> 'alu.

kafire`one hhezeboceme shumaamenetu 'enaa mariwocu fire`onene bamusaa 'enaa batakataayocu laaye siyaanasaasute - <<fire`one hoye! musaane 'enaa hhezebocune bamedere laaye thefaatene 'enediyaasefaafu, tetawaacawaalahene? 'anetane 'enaa 'amaaleketocehene 'eneditawe wada 'alaaheme 'amelekote 'eneditharaa tefaqedelataalahene?>> 'alute 'eresume - <<kaseraa'eele lejoce wanedoce lejocaacawene 'enegadelaalane; seetocaacaweneme liyaagalagelune 'enetawaacawaalane. 'enyaa kanaresu balaaye baxaayele 'ashanaafiwoce 'enaa yabalaayoce nane>> 'ala.

musaame lahhezebocu - <<hhezebocee hoye! gudaatene karaasaacehu laaye lamaasewagade 'enaa theqemene lamaaqerabe bageetaacehu ba'alaahe taagazu. baalaacehubate fatanaa laayeme taagaashoce hunu. medere yafire`one 'enaa masalocu saatehone ya'alaahe nace. 'alaaheme 'enedafeqaadu basawoce mahakale yaagalabaabethaataale. kabaarocume lafalagawe yaawaresaataale. meneme fatanaa bibazaabaacaweme yaaci yaamaaracewe macharashaa ya'alaahene te`ezaaze lamifatzemu 'enaa kakalakalaweme lamirequte 'eresune fariwoce lahonute thenequqoce nace>> 'alaacawe.

kaseraa'eele lejoceme yamusaa hhezeboce lamusaa - <<'aneta wadanyaa kamamethaatehe bafite bafire`one 'eje wanedocaanene bamagedale 'enaa seetocaacenene bamatawe tasaqaayane. kamathaakxabene baxwaalaame 'enedihu, tasaqaayane>> 'alute. musaame (`alayehi 'asalaame) simakeraacawe 'enaa badeleme siyaabaseraacawe - <<geetaacehu 'alaahe thalaataacehune fire`onene 'enaa hhezebocune liyaathafaa bamedere laayeme litakaacehu 'enaa liyaasemacaacehu kaziyaame kamesegaanaame yehune kakehedate mene 'enedameteszaru limalakataacehu yekajalaale.>>

yafire`onene beetasaboce, badereqe, kaferaafereewoceme bamaqanase qathaanaacawe yeheme yagathamaacawe nagare bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate 'enedahona 'enediganazabu 'enaa wada 'alaaheme yemalasu zanede nawe.

yafire`oneneme beetasaboce yamareete malamelame, ya'azemaraa maamaare 'enaa yawaagaa maqanase `aayenate malekaame nagare sigathemaacawe, <<yehece 'enyaa becaa yatalayanebaate 'enaa lanyaa tagabi yahonace nace>> yelaalu. dereqe, ya'azemaraa maqanase 'enaa yabashetaawoce mabezaate `aayenate kefaate sigathemaacawe dagemo <<bamusaa 'enaa takataayocu gada-bisenate mekeneyaate nawe>> yelaalu. 'enaho 'ethaa fanetaacawe 'alaahe zanede nawe. 'ewenatu, yamusaa ba'enaresu laaye 'alaahene 'enediqathaacawe malamane 'enedaala hono yadarasabaacawe nagare hulu ba'alaahe wesaanee nawe. gene yeheenene 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme.

yafire`one hhezeboceme 'ewenatene bamakaade lamusaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) - <<'enyaane kaalanebate 'aqwaame letaazorane meneme ta`aamere betaamathaa, laaneta tekekelanyaanate 'enaa la'enyaa sehetate meneme maaserajaa betaaqarebe 'enyaa laaneta 'amaanyoce 'ayedalaneme>> 'alu.

bakehedataacawe 'enaa ba'emebitanyaanataacawe laaye maqathaachaa yehonaacawe zanede gorefe laakenebaacawe 'azemaraacawene 'athelaqalaqawe. ya'anebathaa manegaane laakenebaacawe; meretaacawene 'athafaawe. qemaale laakenebaacawe; ba'akaalaacawe tasaqaayu. 'enequraaritocene laakenebaacawe; `eqaawocaacawene molute, megebaacawene 'abalaashute, ya'erafete 'eneqelefene naswacawe. dame laakenebaacawe; yawehaa gudegwaadocaacawe 'enaa wanezocaacawe badame tamolu. yataberaarunaa kafilaacawe kafilaacawene yamikatalu yatalayaayu meleketoce laakenebaacawe. gene kagathamaacawe qethaate bamagasatze kathefaate tamalaashe 'alehonume. 'ewenatene kamaqabale 'enaa male'eketanyaawe musaa yezo yamathaawene kamaaragaagathe koru. 'afanegaache 'enaa wanejalanyaa hhezeboceme honu.

ba'enanyiheme nagaroce qethaate badarasabaacawe gizee <<musaa hoye! geetaahe 'anetane banabiyenate bamamerathu 'enaa batzatzateme gizee qethaatene lamaanesaate bagabaalehe qaale kidaanu lamenelene. yehenene qethaate kanyaa yaanasaalene 'enedahona baaneta 'enaamenaalane yaseraa'eele lejoceneme kaaneta gaare 'enelekaacawaalane; 'enelaqaacawaalane>> yelaalu.

'enaresu daraashe 'esekahonawe qatharo derase (bamathelaqelaqe 'esekathafaabate gizee) qethaatune kanaresu senegalethe lamaamane 'enaa yaseraa'eele lejocene lamaleqaqe yagabutene qaale kidaane yaafaresaalu bakehedataacaweme yeqathelaalu.

yaqethaate qatharwacawe badarasa gizee tabaqalenaacawe ba'aneqatzocaaceneme bamaasetabaabalaacawe 'enaa kamithaqumuteme kamaayeqarawe 'ewenataa bamaafanegathaacawe mekeneyaate babaahhere wesethe 'asamathenaacawe.

'enanyaame fire`one 'enaa hhezebocu yaawaaredwacawe 'enaa yaadakemwacawe yanabarutene hhezeboce yaacene bawesethwa barakatene yaaseqamathenebaatene medere (yashaamene 'agare) meseraaqocwane 'enaa me'eraabocwane 'awarasenaacawe. yaseraa'eeleme lejoce bamataagasaacawe mekeneyaate - (wanuriydu 'an nWamunWa `ala~ 'lWadhiyna 'stuD`ifuw fiy 'l'arDi wanaj`alahum 'ay'imWa@ wanaj`alahumu 'lwarithiyna) (ba'enanyaa bamedere laaye batawaaradute laaye lenaabalatzege, mariwoce 'enaa waraashoceme lenaadaregaacawe 'enefalegaalane.) (suratule qasase:5) yametelawaa malekaamitu yageetaahe qaale molaace (tafatzaami hona). fire`one 'enaa hhezebocu ka'azemaraa 'enaa kamanoriyaa yeszarute kahhenetzaawoceme yeganabute yanabarutene 'athafaane.

yaseraa'eele lejoceneme musaa babeteru bamataawe 'enaa batakafala gizee baahherune 'ashaagarenaacawe. ka'alaahe baashaagare yamiyaamalekwaacawe thaa`otocaacawe zanede bamiqomu sawoce 'athagabeme 'alafu. yaseraa'eele lejoceme lamusaa - <<musaa hoye! 'enanyihe yamiyaamalekwaacawe thaa`otaate 'enedaalaacawe hulu lanyaame yamenaamalekawe thaa`otene 'aderegelene>> 'alu. musaame:- <<hhezebocee hoye! 'enaaneta la'alaahe yamigabaawene babecanyenate yamamalake mabete 'enaa yamaayegabaaweneme baresu laaye maagaaraatene layetaacehu yamaataawequ hhezeboce naacehu>> 'alaacawe.
'enanyihe thaa`otaatune bamaamelake qwaamiwoce yahonute 'enaresu yaalubate yathaa`ote 'amelekote thafi 'enedihume ba'alaaheme bamaagaaraataacawe yeszarute yanabarawe hulu kanetu nawe.

musaame: <<hhezebocee hoye! ka'alaahe baashaagare yametaamalekute 'amelaake lefalegelaacehu 'enedeete yegabaale 'eresu bagizeeyaacehu kaalu `aalamaate hulu, thalaataacehune bamaathefaate 'enaa 'enaanetane tatakiwoce bamaaderage bamedere laaye bamaasemacate yaabalathaacehu hono saala?!>> 'alaacawe?

kafire`one beetasaboceme, yakafaa qethaatene yamiyaaqameswacehu, wanedocaacehune yamigadelu seetocaacehune yamitawe sihonu kaziyaa weredate natzaa baawathaanaacehu gizee 'asetaawesu. baziyaa (kaweredate bamadaanaacehu) wesethe taamasagenu zanede kageetaacehu taalaaqe yahona fatanaa 'ala.

'alaaheme male'eketanyaawene musaane liyaanaagerawe szalaasaa qanaatene qatharawe. kaziyaame 'asere qanaatene bamachamare molaate. yageetaaweme qatharo 'arebaa leelitocene molu. musaame geetaawene lamaanaagare maheede bafalaga gizee lawanedemu laharune 'enedihe 'alawe - <<harune hoye! bahhezebocee wesethe yanee meteke hune. bamalekaame 'asetadaadare; ba'ezenateme gudaayaacawene 'asaamere; wanejaleneme bamaszeraate ya'athefiwocene manegade 'atekatale; la'amatzanyoceme 'agaazhe 'atehune>> 'alawe.

musaame geetaawene lamaanaagare batasathawe qatharo maszarate ('arebaa leelitocune kamolaa baxwaalaa) bamathaa gizee, geetaaweme kate`ezaazaate, kakelekalaawoceme liyaanaagerawe yafalagawene baanaagarawe gizee, yamusaa nafese geetaawene wada maayate gwaagwaace 'enaa musaame <<geetaayee hoye! 'asaayanye wadaaneta lemalekate>> 'ala. 'alaaheme <<musaa hoye! 'aneta bamedere `aalame 'eyaalahe 'aqemehe selamaayefaqede bafetzume letaayanye 'ateceleme, gene wada taraaraawe tamalekate 'enee tagalecheelate babotaawe katzanaa 'anedaaceme yaalehona bihone taayanyaalahe>> 'alawe. 'alaaheme lataraaraawe batagalatza gizee faraarasa. musaame 'eraasune seto wadaqa. kawadaqabateme baanesaraaraanaa banaqaa gizee <<geetaayee hoye! laaneta kamaayegatheme nagare hulu yatharaahe nahe theraate yegabaahe. bamedere `aalame leyehe kamaalateeme tatzatzecaalahu kahhezeboceeme ya'amaanyoce majamariyaa nanye>> 'ala.

'alaaheme lamusaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enedihe 'alawe - <<musaa hoye! 'enee wada sawoce male`eketanyaa 'aderegee balaakuhe gizee lamale`eketocee marathekuhe, 'asebalathekuhe. yaala madaarashaame baqathetaa 'anetane bamaanaagaree banegegeree marathekuhe. kazihe taalaaqe belechaa yasathahuhene yaaze. bazihe taalaaqe sethotaame 'alaahene kamiyaamasagenute hune>>

lamusaame kathaawelaa bahonu saleedaawoce laaye yaseraa'eele lejoce bamederaawi hheyewataacawe 'enaa ba'emenataacaweme yamiyaasefalegaacawene hulu tzaafenelate. kanaresu lamimakare mekerene; maberaaraate lamigabaacawe hegegaate maaberaariyaane, tzaafenelate. musaa hoye! taweraatene kalebehe 'athebeqahe yaaze. hhezebocehene banu seraa'eeleneme 'eneda te`egesete 'enaa sawocene yeqere 'enedamaalate menedaawe teleqe kahona nagare batamwalaa maleku 'eneditagaberu 'ezazaacawe. yaneene te`ezaaze yataqaaranutene kate`ezaazeeme yaafanagathutene sawoce maabeqiyaa 'agare, maafanegathaacawe yamiyaasekatelebaacawene thefaate 'enaa wedemateme 'asaayaacexwaalahu.

'enanyaame saayegabaacawe babaarocee laaye 'enedihume 'ewenatene kamaqabale yamikorutene dagemo, ba'ademaasoce 'enedihume balebonaawoce wesethe 'aneqatzoceene kamaasetawaale 'enaa kamaasetanetane, yamatsehhafeeneme 'aneqatsoce kamaradaate 'azoraacawaalahu. ta`aamerene hulu biyaayu 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene bamaqaawamaacawe balebonaacawe selamirequ 'enaa selamiqaaranu 'ayaamenume. wada 'alaahe wedeetaa yamiyaadaresawene ya'ewenate manegade biyaayu 'ayekataluteme; 'ayefalegutememe. yathememate 'enaa yamaafanegathe 'enedihume wada 'alaahe quthaa yamiyaadaresene manegade siyaayu yekatalutaale. yehe yahonawe male'eketanyoce yamathubatene 'ewenataane thaqwaami bahonute ya'alaahe 'aneqatzoce bamaasetabaabalaacawe wadareswame kamaasetawaale bamazanegaataacawe nawe.

'enanyaa yamale'eketanyocaacenene 'ewenatanyenate thaqwaami yahonutene 'aneqatzocaacene yaasetabaabalu baferedu `elate 'alaahe fite laferede maqomene yaasewaashu szeraawocaacawe kanetu honawaale. yataqabaayenate qedema huneetaa (maaneme) bamataathaatu, bamalekaame szeraawocaacawe 'ayemanadume. baferedume `elate ba'alaahe kamakaade 'enaa baresume kamaagaaraate yaszarutene 'eneji leelaane 'ayemanadume. yazihe menedaa dagemo ba'esaate wesethe mazawetare nawe.

yamusaa hhezeboce musaa geetaawene liyaanaagere baheedabate karesu xwaalaa kageethocaacawe, 'esetenefaase yaleelawene nefaase ba'anede 'akaalu gabeto baleelaawe bamawethaatu yamiyaagwaaraane yathejaa mesele yaalawe thaa`otene szaru. yehe thejaa 'enedamaayaanaageraacawe, tachabaacheme, menaabaawime wada hona qathetanyaa manegade 'enedamaayemaraacawe, theqeme 'enedamaayaamathaalaacawe, gudaateme 'enedamaayaamathaabaacawe 'ayaawequme 'enedee? yamimalake thaa`ote 'aderegawe yaazute, baziyaame laraasaacawe badaaye honu.

batatzatzatu, batadanaagaru 'enaa thejaaweneme ka'alaahe leelaa yamimalake thaa`ote 'aderegawe bamayaazaacawe kaqathetanyaawe manegade 'enedathamamu baawaqu gizee wada 'alaahe tawaadaqu. <<'alaaheme 'eresune 'enedenetaazazawe bamagethame kaalaazanalene, bathejaawe 'ameleko laszaraanawe wanejale meherate kaalaadaragalene bamederaawiweme bamachiweme `aalame kakasarute sawoce 'enehonaalane>> 'alu.

musaame kageetaawe gaare katanagaagara baxwaalaa thejaawene bamaamelakaacawe banaresu laaye yataqothaa 'enaa yaazana hono wada hhezebocu batamalasa gizee - <<hhezebocee hoye! kanaaneta katagalaleku baxwaalaa 'eneene yatakaacehubate nagare thefaatene 'enaa manaathinatene yamiyaasekatele kamahonu 'anetzaare menenyaa kafaa, yageetaacehune te`ezaaze tacaakolaacehutene? 'eneene mathabaqe salacaacehu 'enaa wada thejaa 'ameleko gabaacehune?>> 'ala. kagathamaweme kafetanyaa nedeete 'enaa hhazaneme yatanasaa yayaazawene yataweraate saleedaa warawarawe 'enaa yawanedemune (yaharunene) raase 'enaa tzime 'athebeqo yezo wadaresu yegotetawe jamare. haruneme lamusaa mekeneyaatune siyaaqarebe 'enaa 'ezenatene yamifalege hono - <<ya'enaatee leje hoye! sawocu dakaamaa 'aderegawe 'ayunye 'enaa naaqunye ligadelunyeme qarabu. thalaateme 'enedidasatebenye yamiyaadarege qethaate 'ateqethaanye banee bamaqothaatehe kananyaa thejaawene bamaamelakaacawe 'eraasaacawene kabadalu sawoce taretaa 'ataasalefanye>> 'alawe.

musaame 'alaahene lamana - <<geetaayee hoye! lanee 'enaa lawanedemee haruneme meheratene 'aderege. ba'ezenateheme wesethe 'asegabaane. 'ezenateheneme kaya'aqethaachaawe yametekabane 'aderegaate. geetaacene hoye! 'aneta lanyaa kamiyaazenute hulu balaache 'azaanye nahenaa>> 'ala.

'enanyaa thejaawene yamimalake 'amelaake 'aderegawe yayaazute sawoce kageetaacawa yahona beretu quthaa yaaganyaacawaale. geetaacaweneme bamaaseqothaataacawe bazihece mederaawi `aalame weredate yegathemaacawaale. ba'alaahe laaye weshatene yamifabarekutene 'enaa yamiqathefutene hulu bazihe maleku 'enemanadaalane.

'enanyaa ba'alaaha kamaagaaraate, wanejaleneme kamafatzame bakule `ekuye szeraane yaszaru, kaziyaame baresu bamaamane wada 'alaahe yatamalasu, kawanejaleme yeszarute kanabarute yataqothabu, 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaho geetaahe lanaresu katzatzate, kashereke wada 'emenate, kamaamatzeme wada mataazaze katamalasu baxwaalaa, wanejalaacawene bamashafane 'enaa bamaalafe lanaresu mahari 'enaa 'azaanye nawe.

musaame kanedeetu baqazaqaza 'enaa bataragaagaa gizee banedeete beretaate yawarawarawene yataweraate saleedaa 'anasaawe. bataweraatume tsehhufe wesethe kathememate mamariyaa, ya'ewenateme maaberaariyaa, geetaacaweneme lamifaru 'enaa qethaatuneme lamisagu sawoce 'ezenate 'alabate.

musaame kahhezebocu makaakale qilocaacawe lafatzamute yathejaa 'amelekote yeqeretaane yethayequ zanede sabaa sawocene maratha. 'alaaheme yamiqarebubatene qatharo sathaacawe. baqarabume gizee 'alaahene bamadaafare musaane 'alaahene baqathetaa ba`aayenaacawe 'enediyaasaayaacawe thayaqute. yamareete maneqatheqathe yaazacaacawenaa kaferehataacawe yatanasaa danegethawe motu. musaame wada geetaawe bamawaadaqe - <<geetaayee hoye! 'enaresune 'enaa 'eneeneme 'aberahe maathefaatene betefalege kazihe bafite letaathafaane tecele nabare. 'enanyaa kanyaa makaakale hasaaba-theree qiloce baadaragute taathafaanaalahene? hhezeboceeme yafatzamute yathejaa 'amelekote 'aneta yafalagekawene yametaathamemebate 'enaa yafalagekaweneme yametaaqanaabate fatanaahe 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaceme. 'aneta wadaajaacene nahe. wanejalaacenene maarane. basafiwe 'ezenateheme 'ezanelene. 'aneta wanejalene kamaara hathi'ateneme kaalafa hulu balaache nahenaa>> 'ala.

kananyaame bamedere `aalame batzagaawoce 'enaa batheenaa kaakabarekaacawe, lamalekaame szeraame kagathamekaacawe, bamacharashaawe `aalameme janatene kaazagaajahelaacawe malekaame baarocehe mazegebane. <<'enyaa wadaaneta batzatzate tamalasene gudelataaceneneme bamanaazaze wadaaneta tamalasene>> 'alu. 'alaaheme - qethaatee kabaarocee yamanaathinate madaarashaane yamiszaraa yamefalegawene 'edaresebataalahu 'ezenateeme bamedere `aalame hulune 'akaabebaalace. ya'alaahe 'ezenate yadarasawe terufaatu 'enaa bago 'aderaaginatu yashafanawe bihone 'eneji 'anedeme fethure yalame. bamachiwe `aalame 'ezenateene la'enanyaa te`ezaazeene bamathabaqe 'enaa kakalakalekuteme bamaraaqe 'eneene latathanaqaqunye, yaganezabocaacaweneme zakaa lamigabaacawe lamisathute ba'aneqatzocaaceneme lamiyaamenute 'etzefaataalahu.

'enanyaa geetaawe wadaresu yamiyaasetalaalefawene yamikatale 'eneji maanebabeme matzaafeme yamaayecelawene nabiye, bamusaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) laaye batawaradawe taweraate, ba`isaame (`alayehi 'asalaame) laaye batawaradawe nejile wesethe tatzefo yaalawene muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yamikatalu, malekaame mahonu yataawaqa 'enaa tekekele wada honawe nagare hulu yamiyaazaacawene, batafatherome hona batekekelanyaa 'a`emero 'asetasaasabe mathefo mahonu kamitaawaqe nagare hulu yamikalakelaacawene, kamegebe, kamathatheme, gaabecaane kamafatzame malekaamocene yamifaqedelaacawe 'enaa tzayaafe kahonu bamakalekale, ba'enaresu laaye yanabaracene kabaade shakeme 'enaa halaafinatene(basehhetateme hona'awuqo yagedeyaane wanejale bafatzama sawe laaye yamote ferede yefaradebate yanabara sihone yeheenenenaa yamasaasalute hegegaatocene) yamiyaaqalelaacawene nabiye yamikatalu ya'alaahe 'ezenate yatatzaafacelaacawe naacawe. kaseraa'eele lejoceme hona kaleeloce 'enanyaa baresu yaamanu, yaatalaqute 'enaa yaakabarute, kakahadiyaaneme bamithalute thalaatocu laaye yaradute, baresu laaye yatawaradaweneme mari berehaane qure'aanene yatakatalu, 'enanyaa 'enaresu yamimanyutene yamiyaaganyu, kafaruteme yamidenu sekeetaamaawoce naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa, sawoce hoye! 'enee wada hulaacehume (yatalaakeku) yasamaayaatu 'enaa yamederu negeszenaa hulu laresu kahonawe karesume leelaa ba'ewenate yamimalake 'amelaake kaleelawe, mutaanene heyaawe hheyaaweneme mutaane kamiyaadaregawe 'alaahe zanede yatalaaku ya'alaahe male`eketanyaa nanye bale. sawoce hoye! ba'alaahe 'emanu, maanebabe 'enaa matzaafe bamaayecelawe wadaresu batawaradawe, karesu bafite banabarute nabiyaate laaye batawaradawe yaalamanathaathale bamiyaamenawe nabiyu muhhamade 'emanu, bazihece mederaawi `aalame 'enaa bawadiyaanyaaweme `aalame temaru zanede kageetaawe yezo bamathaawe nagare takatalute.

'alaahe yaseraa'eele lejoce thejaawene bamaamelakaacawe yathamamu mahonaacawene kathaqasa baxwaalaa kanaresu makaakale 'enazihene bamaqaarane qene manegade yamikatalu 'enedaalu sinaagare 'enedihe 'ala -
kamusaa hhezeboce kaseraa'eele lejoce makaakale batekekelanyaawe 'emenate laaye qathe yaalu, sawocene ba'ewenate yamimaru, baresume bafetehe yamifaredu 'enaa kabadaleme yamirequ 'alu.

yaseraa'eelene lejoce 'aseraa hulate gosaawoce 'enaa hhezeboce 'aderegane kafaafalenaacawe. wada musaame hhezebocu ka'alaahe yamathathe wehane 'enedilamenelaacawe bathayaqute gizee - <<musaa hoye! babaterehe denegaayune metaawe>> belane 'asetalaalafene, musaame denegaayune mataawe. bagosaawocu quthereme 'aseraa hulate menechoce kadenegaayu falaqu. sawoceme hulu kanaresu gosaa weche saayeheedu mathachaa botaacawene baregethe 'awaqu. 'enaresume sigwaazu yamigwaaze, siqomume yamiqome damanaa 'anethaalalene, kawalalaa maare yahonane thaafaache mathathene salewaa yatasanya baraari segaame banaresu laaye 'awaradene. kamagabenaacehu malekaamoce belu 'alenaacawe. kanaresu bataganyawe badale 'enaa yatzagaawoce kehedate 'enyaane 'alebadaluneme gene `edelaacawene bamazegaate ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamaqaarane 'enaa wada thefaateme bamameraate yabadalute nafesocaacawene nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe laseraa'eele lejoce bayetale maqedise gebu, kamanedarocu feraafereewoceme kafalagaacehubate botaa 'enaa bafalagaacehute gizeeme belu; <<geetaacene hoye! wanejalocaacenene 'araagefelene balu>>, lageetaacehu 'agonebaashoce 'enaa tawaaraajoce honaacehu dajaafune gebu; yeheneneme yaadaragaacehu 'enedahona wanejalocaacehune 'enemeraalane kazihece `aalame 'enaa kamachiweme la'asaamaariwoce malekaamene 'enechameraalane baala gizee 'awesaa.

kanaresume 'enanyaa badaayocu 'enedaalute kataazazute weche yahona qaale lawathu. yataazazubatene ya'alwahene 'ezenate kamathayaqe fanetaa leelaa qaale bamaqayare 'enedihume yataazazutene tagebaare teto leelaa bamafatzamaacawe 'eresume 'anegatocaacawene yaagonabasu, la'alaahe yatanaanasu honawe 'enedigabu taazaweme saala 'anegatocaacawene qathe bamaaderage bamaqamachaawocaacawe 'eyatanefwaqaqu gabu. yefatzemute banabarute badale mekeneyaate kasamaaye qethaate 'awaradenebaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaane 'ayehudaawiyaane 'alaahe qadamete 'abaatocaacawene selaqathaabate nagare lamaasetaawase selaziyaace babaahheru 'agoraabaace selanabarace manedare nawaariwoce thayeqaacawe. 'alaahe kakalakalaacawe baxwaalaa baqedaamee `elate `aasaawocene bamaasegare ya'alaahene denebaroce batalaalafu gizee, 'alaaheme 'enaresune lamafatane baqedaamee `elate `aasaawocaacawe babaahheru daarecaa laaye geletze honawe 'enedimathu 'adaraga. kaqedaamee weche bahonu qanaatoce 'ayemathume. 'alaaheme kate`ezaazu bamaafanegathaacawe 'enaa wanejaloceneme bamafatzamaacawe bazihe fatanaacawe. la`aasaa maasegaraacaweme zadeene qayasunaa ba`aarebe `elate gudegwaadene qoferawe, wathemadaacawene 'aqumawe `aasaawocaacawe baqedaamee `elate bamarabu sisagasagu yewelaalu, ba'ehude `elateme yaanene 'awethetawe yebalaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'awesaa. kanaresume yahonu cheferoce kazihe `ekuye szeraa bamikalakelwacawe 'enaa bamiyaasethanaqeqwaacawe gizee, leeloce cheferoce, <<'alaahe bazihece `aalame bamiszarute wanejale yamiyaathafaacawe wayeme baferedu `elate baberetu qethaate yamiqathaacawe yahonu hhezebocene selamene temakerwacawaalaacehu?>> 'alwacawe. makaariwocume, <<la'enaresu mekere malagasaacene, bamalekaame bamaazaze 'enaa kakefume kamakalekale 'alaahe banyaa laaye yathaalawene xaalaafite mawathaataacenene 'alaahe zanede sithayeqane lamaaqerabe 'enaresume bamekeraacene tathaqemawe kawanejalaacawe bamaraaqe yethanaqaqu zanede nawe>> 'alu.

'enanyaa 'amatzanyoceme makaariwocu kalagaswacawe tagesaatze baafanagathunaa kathefaate baaletaqothabume gizee 'enanyaane ka`ekuye tagebaaraacawe kalekaayocune natzaa 'awathaanaacawe. 'enanyaaneme baqedaamee `elate `aasaane bamaathemade denebare yaalafutene, ka'alaahe te`ezaaze bamaafanegathaacawenaa bawanejale laaye bamazawetaraacaweme mekeneyaate baberetu qethaate yaazenaacawe.

bakuraate 'enaa ba'emebitanyenate 'alaahene bamawanejale wesethe denebarene baalafunaa kamamakareme baraaqu gizee, <<'enaaneta 'amatzanyoce hoye! yatawaaradaacehu zenejarowoce hunu>> 'alenaacawe. 'alaahe 'enedaalaweme honu. 'alaaheme ya'anedene nagare makasate sifalege <<hune>> yelawaale hono yeganyaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe 'ayehudocene bamederaawi qoyetaacawe 'esekaferedu `elate derase yamiyaawaaredaacawe 'enaa yamiyaasaanesaacawene 'akaale 'enedamishomebaacawe mamasaasale yaleelabatene geletze maasaawaqene baasaawaqaacawe gizee 'awesaa. 'enaho geetaahe laamatzawe gemegamaawe fathaane, kafalagame baqerebitu `aalame qethaatune yamiyaafaathene, kabaarocume latatzatzatu wanejalaacawene mahhari 'enaa 'azaanye nawe.

katasabasabume baxwaalaa bamedere laaye bataatanenaacawe, yatalayaayu cheferoceme 'aderegane nathaathalenaacawe. kanaresume ya'alaahene 'enaa yabaarocuneme mabetoce yamithabequ dagaagoce 'alu. kanaresume makaakalanyoce, kanaresume bawanejaloce baraasaacawe laaye denebarene yaalafu 'alu. kaalubateme thefaate yemalasu zanede bamalekaamoce (sisaayene bamaasefaate),bacheneqeme (sisaayene bamaathebabe) fatanenaacawe.

kananyiheme baxwaalaa 'enaresune yamitaku yakefaate baaletabeetoce mathu. taweraatene kaqedema 'abaatocaacawe yaazu. yaanabwataale gene 'ayetagaberwateme, ya'alaahene matsehhafe lamalawathe 'enaa 'alaaheme baalaawaradawe kamaferade wedaaqi kahonawe mederaawi theqeme gubone yewasedaalu. 'alaaheme wanejalaacawene 'enedamimere laraasaacawe yemanyaalu. wedaaqi yahona yaqademowene masaaye mederaawi theqeme daageme bimathaalaacawe dagaagemawe yewasedaalu. ya'alaahene qaale kamaathaamamenaa kamalawatheme baashaagare ba'alaahe laaye 'ewenatene 'eneji leelaane 'enedaayelu kanaresu qaale-kidaane tayezo yalamene? ba'alaahe matzehhafeme 'alamaszeraataacawe baalamaawaqe saayehone 'eyaawaqu nabare. bawesethu yaalawene 'anebebawe 'aweqawaale. wanejalaacaweme yakafaa hona. la'enanyaame te`ezaazune bamafatzamenaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene lamifarunaa lamithanaqaqu sawoce yamacharashaayetu 'agarenaa bawesethwame yaalawe zawetaari tzagaa thafi kahonawe `aalamaawi theqeme balaache nawe. 'enanyaame ya'alaahene qaale bamalawathe, thafi `aalamaawi theqemene yamiwasedu sawoce 'alaahe lathenequqocu yaazagaajawe tzagaa balaache mahonune 'ayeradumene?

'enanyaame matsehhafune 'athebeqawe yamiyezu, bawesethume baalawe yamiszaru, gedeetaawocwane 'enaa tawadaaje gatzetaawaaneme bamathabaqe salaatene yamiyaaqwaaqumu 'alaahe baszeraawocaacawe yemanadaacawaale. 'alaaheme ya'asaamaariwocene (szeraacawe yaamaaralaacawene) sawoce menedaane kanetu 'ayaadaregeme.

male'eketanyaacene muhhamade hoye! yaseraa'eele lejoce bataweraate wesethe yaalutene hegegaate kamaqabale baamatzu gizee taraaraawene leke karaasaacawe balaaye 'enedaala 'enedamiyaanethaalelaacawe daamanaa naqelane kafe baadaragene gizee 'awesaa. banaresu laaye 'enedamiwadeqe 'eregethanyoce honu. ka'alaaheme qethaate tethanaqaqu zanede yasathanaacehune bamere 'enaa baqurethanyenate 'athebeqaacehu yaazu. 'alaaheneme tefaru zanede 'alaahe bawesethu yadanagagalaacehune hegoce 'awesu 'ateresume tabaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye - geetaahe ka'adame lejoce jarebaa ('aberaake) yateweledocaacawene 'esetenefaase baawathaa gizeenaa batafathero wesethaacawe baaseqamathawe fathaariyaacawe 'enaa geetaacawe mahonune 'enediyaaragaagethu baadaragaacawe, <<'enee geetaacehu 'ayedalahumene?>> bamaalate baraasaacawe laaye baasemasakaraacawe, 'enaresume, <<baregethe geetaacene nahe masakarene!>> baalu gizee yahonawene 'awesaa. 'eresume <<'enaho yafatanenaacehu 'enaa kanaanetame qaale kidaanene yayaazenawe baferedu `elate 'alaahe banaaneta laaye yaaqomawene maaserajaa 'enedaatekedunaa bazihe 'anedaaceme `eweqate yalaneme 'enedaatelu nawe.>>

wayeme dagemo, baferedu `elate, qaale kidaanune yaafarasute 'enaa ba'alaaheme yaagaarute 'abaatocaacehu 'enedahonu, 'enaanetame 'abaatocaacehune bamaagaaraate laaye bamaagenyataacehu 'enaresune tekatalu 'enedanabaraacehu, <<geetaacene hoye! 'abaatocaacene baszarute, bamaagaaraate szeraawocaacawene baabalaashute mekeneyaate 'enyaane teyezanaalahene, teqathaanaalahene? 'enyaa ya'abaatocaacene takataayoce 'eneji wanejale yalabeneme>> 'enedaatelu zanede nawe.

ya'asetabaabaaye hhezebocene macharashaa 'enedaaberaaraane hulu la'alaahe bagabute qaale maszarate kaalubate maagaaraate 'alaahene babecanyenate wadamaamelake yemalasu zanede lananyiheme 'agaariwoce 'aneqatzocene 'enaaberaaraalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! laseraa'eele lejoce yaziyaane kanaresu yahona 'aneqatzocaacenene yasathanawene, yaawaqaacawene 'enaa yamithaqumuteneme 'ewenataane yataganazabawene, kaziyaame matagebarene yatawawene sawe taarike 'awesaalaacawe. 'aneqatzocaacenene tawaacawe 'enaa kanaresume tanesharaateto wathaa. shayethwaneme takatalawe. quraanyaame honawe. kaqenocu kahona baxwaalaa wada xwaalaa bamamalase kathafute thamaamoce wesethe hona.

bananyihe 'aneqatzoce 'eresune matheqame benefalege noro wada tagebaare 'enedilawethaacawe bamagethame bamederaawiweme bamachiweme `aalame darajaawene kafe baadaragene nabare gene 'eresu wada `aalamaawi theqeme baazanabala 'enaa kamachiweme `aalame qerebitune baasebalatha, 'enedihume nafesu kaweshate yametekajalawene batakatala gizee wada weredatu yamiwasedawene manegade maratha. yazihe sawe mesaalee la`aalamaawi theqeme kaalawe gugute 'anetzaare betaasaadedaweme 'enedamiyaalakaleke, betetawaweme 'enedamiyaalakaleke weshaa bithee nawe. yehe ya'enanyaa ba'aneqatzocaacene bamaasetabaabalaacawe yathamamu sawoce mesaalee nawe. 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! yaasetanatenu, kaalubateme maasetabaabalenaa thememate yegasatzume zanede taarike tarekelaacawe.

'enanyaa 'aneqatzocaacene yaasetabaabalu, yaalaamanubaateme, nafesocaacaweneme wada thefaate bamaameraate raasaacawene badaayoce yahonu sawoce kamesaalee bakule menenyaa kafu kanaresu balaaye yakafaa yalame.

'alaahe wada qathetanyaawe manegade yagathamawe sawe 'eresu baregethe yatamaraawe nawe. bathemematume mekeneyaate kaqathetanyaawe manegade yaaraaqawe 'enanyaa yanafesocaacawene `edele yaagodalu, baferedume `elate raasaacawene 'enaa beetasabocaacawene yaakasaru naacawe. yaa dagemo geletze yahona kisaaraa nawe.

yajahaname nawaariwocene szeraa 'enedamiszaru bamaawaqaacene kagaaneene 'enaa kasawoce bezuwocene lajahaname fatheranaale. yamithaqemaacawene 'enaa yamigodaacawene layetawe yamaayaawequbate lebonaawoce 'alwacawe. banafesoce 'enaa ba'ademaasoce wesethe yaaluteneme 'alaahene 'aneqatsotzoce 'enaa ta`aameraate yamaayaasetawelubate `aayenoce, yeganazabu zanede ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce yamaayesamu, jorowoce, 'alwacawe. 'enaziyaa ba'enanyihe baahheriyaate tathaqaashoce 'a`emerone bamaathaate bakule 'eneda 'enesesaate 'enediyaaweme bathemate ka'enesesaateme yabaasu naacawe. 'enaresume ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane kamaamane yazanagu naacawe.

la'alaaheme leqenaawene 'enaa melu`enatune yamithaqumu, ka'enekane yatharu yatawaabu semoce 'alute. yametefalegutene bamathayaqe bareswa wada 'alaahe taqaarabu 'enaresune bamatheqase lamenute 'awadesuteme. 'enanyaaneme bananyihe semoce wesethe leelocene basemu bamatheraate, karesu wedeqe bamaaderage, teregumwane bamaathaamame 'enaa leelocene karesu gaare bamaamasaasale ba'alaahe semoce yamithamemutene tawuwaacawe. 'enanyaane bareswa kaqathetanyaawe manegade yamizanabalutene yeszarute banabarute mekeneyaate 'asaamaami qethaatene 'enemanadaacawaalane.
kafatharenaacaweme sawoce makaakale baraasaacawe wada 'ewenate yamimaru, sawoceneme wada 'ewenate yamigaabezu, bafetehe yamifaredu 'enaa yamaayebadelume hhezeboce 'alu.

'enanyaa 'aneqatzotsocaacenene yaasetabaabalutene, yaalaamanutene, yakaadutene, 'enaresune lamaakebare saayehone bathefaate yeqoyu zanede lamaazanaagaate yasisaaye dajaafocene 'enekafetelaacawaalane kaziyaame saayezagaajubate badenegate kaalasabubate 'aqethaachaa baqethaate 'eneyezaacawaalane.

'aneqathaame belawe 'esekiyaasebu derase qethaatene kanaresu 'azagayaalahu. qethaateme 'esakidaraarabelaacawe bamaasetabaabalaacawe 'enaa bakehedataacawe wesethe yezawateraalu. 'enaho seeraayee beretu nawe. lanaresu bago maaderagene 'asaayecaacawe weredataacawene 'efalegelaacawaalahu.

'enanyaa ba'alaahe 'aneqatzocenaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaasetabaabalu, baaledarabaacawe muhhamade 'ebedate 'enedaleelabate geletze yehonelaacawe zanede 'ayaasetanatenume 'enaa 'a`emerwacawene 'ayaasarumene?

'enanyaa kahadiyaane basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalawene ya'alaahene negesenaa yamaasetawaale `eyetaane 'ayaayumene? 'alaaheme ka'enesesaate 'enaa ka`etzewaateme kaleeloceme yafatharawene, 'ayemalakatumene? maabeqiyaa madamedamiyaacawe menaalebaateme qerebe letehone wadametecelawe yamote qatharwacawene tamaleketawenaa tatzatzetawe yemalasu zanede 'ayemalakatumene? 'enaresu baqure'aanenaa baaqafaweme qaale kidaane 'enaa maasethaneqaqiyaa kaalaamanu bayatenyaawe zeenaa liyaamenu nawe?!

wada 'ewenate bamameraate 'alaahe yaalaagazawe, kaqathetanyaawe manegade yaaraaqawe, wadaresu yamimaraawe mari yalaweme. 'alaaheme wada meneme nagare yaaletamaru, bathemataacawe wesethe yawaalalu honawe yetawaacawaale.

'enanyaa bate'ebite yatawatharu 'asetabaabaayoce selaferedu `elate yethayequhale. makasacaawaa mace nawe yeluhale. muhhamade hoye! yareswa `eweqate 'alaahe zanede 'eneji 'eneeme zanede, leelaa 'akaaleme zanede yalame balaacawe. yatawasanalaateneme gizee 'eresu 'alaahe 'eneji yamiyaaweqe yalame. basamaaye 'enaa bamedere nawaariwoce hulu laaye yamagalachaawaa `eweqate debeqe honwale badenegate 'eneji 'atemathaabaacehume. 'aneta ba`eweqatwa yaakaababeke yemasele selareswa yethayequhale. <<'enaho yareswa `eweqate 'alaahe zanede becaa nawe!>> balaacawe gene yehenene kasawoce 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme.

muhhamade hoye! bale - <<'enee 'alaahe yafaqadawene 'eneji laraasee theqemene maamethaate, gudaateneme karaasee maasewagade 'aleceleme. yaa hulu ba'alaahe 'eje nawe. 'alaaheme yaasaawaqanyene 'eneji debeqe `eweqatene 'alaaweqeme. debeqe `eweqatene baaweqe noro lamalekaame madaarashaane hulu 'aderegee malekaamene baabazaahu kefu nagareme baalenakaanye nabare. ka'alaaheme zanede yatalaaku male'eketanyaa 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalahume. yaresu male'eketanyaa mahoneene lamiyaamenu, yamathaahubateneme nagare lamiyaaragaagethu sawoce kakabaade qethaatu 'asethaneqaaqi, bamalekaame menedaaweme 'abesaari 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalahume>> bale.

sawoce hoye! 'eresu 'alaahe maalate yaa 'enaanetane ka'anedite nafese (ka'aadame) yafatharaacehu nawe. ka'adameme, kagone 'athenetu wadareswa yeragaagaa zanede thenedune hhawaa'ene fathara. 'adameme 'ereswane batashafanaate (bataganaanyaate gizee) qalaale 'eregezenaane 'aragazace. baregezenaawaame yanuro felaagotwane lamafalage 'eyatalaawasace ('eyataneqasaaqasace) zamanene 'asaalaface. tzenesume bahodwa batalaqanaa bakabadaceme gizee hulatu thenedoce geetaacawene 'enedihe silu lamanu - <<geetaacene hoye! 'afathaatharu yaamaarane malekaame lejene yasathakxane 'enedahona tzagaahene kamiyaamasagenute 'enehonaalane.>>

'alaaheme lemanaacawene basamaanaa batheyaaqeeyaacaweme maszarate malekaame leje basathaacawe gizee 'alaahe basathaacawe leje `aabedulehharise bamaalate lejaacawene laleelaa bamaasegazaate la'alaahe baalaanethaawocene 'adaragulate. 'alaaheme ka'agaare hulu yatharaa nawe. bageetenate 'enaa ba'amelaakenatume becanyaa nawe.
'enanyihene thaa`otaate 'enaa leeloceneme 'anedaacene mafethare yamaayecelu fethuraane mahonaacawene 'eyaawaqu la'alaahe baalaanethaa yaadaregwaacawaalene?
'enanyihe 'amaalekete 'amelaakiwocaacawene maredaate raasaacaweneme maagaze 'ayecelume. 'enedeete yaamalekwaacawaale?

'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! 'enanyihene 'enaaneta ka'alaahe leelaa tamalaaki 'aderegaacehu yayaazaacexwaacawene thaa`otaate wada qene manegade betetharwacawe malese 'ayesathwacehume. yamaayaasetawelu, yamaayesamu 'enaa yamaayenaagaru ge`uze 'akaaloce bamahonaacawe 'enaresune matheraate 'enaa 'alamatheraate banaaneta laaye 'ekule nawe.

'enaaneta thaa`otaawiyaane hoye! 'enanyaa ka'alaahe baashaagare yametelamenwacawe 'enaa yametaamalekwaacawe 'akaalaate yanaanetawe bithee ba'alaahe quthethere sere yaalu baaroce, 'enaa fethuraane naacawe. 'enediyaaweme 'enaaneta kanaresu teshaalaalaacehu. 'enaaneta manaagare, maraamade, masemaate 'enaa mamalekate yametecelu naacehu. thaa`otaatu gene yehene 'ayecelume. 'enaaneta selanaresu bametenaagarute 'ewenatanyoce betehonu therwacawenaa malese yesethwacehu.

'enaresu taraamedawe lafelaagotaacehu malese yamisathubate 'egere 'alaacawene? kanaaneta gudaatene yamikalaakalubate, yamichabethubate 'ejocese 'alaacawene? kanaanetame `eweqate yaraaqane nagare `aayetawe yaminaagarubate `aayenoce 'alwacawene? kanaanetame masemiyaa yaraaqane sametawe 'enaanetane yamiyaasaawequbate jorocese 'alwacawene? 'enaame yehe hulu wedeqe kahona theqemene 'enediyaaqarebulaacehu 'enaa gudaatene 'enediyaasewagedulaacehu bamaasabe 'enedeete taamalekwaacawaalaacehu? 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lathaa`otaawiyaanu, 'enanyaane ka'alaahe gaare 'ekule yaadaragaacexwaacawene 'agaarocaacehune therwacawenaa 'eneene lamagudaate zayedu gizeeme 'atesethunye balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'enaho wadaajee, radaatee 'enaa thabaaqiyee yaa banee laaye lasawoce mamariyaa yehone zanede matsehhafune yaawaradawe 'alaahe nawe. ka'eresu 'eneji kaleelaa 'alekajeleme, karesu weche maaneneme 'alefaraame. 'eresu yaa kabaarocu dagaagocene yamiwadaaje, yamithabeqaacawenaa yamiyaagezaacawe nawe>> bale.

'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! 'enanyaa 'enaaneta ka'alaahe baashaagare yametaamalekwaacawe thaa`otaate 'enaanetane, nafesocaacaweneme liradu 'ayecelume. kazihe hulu yadakamu naacawe. 'enedeete 'enaresune taamalekaalaacehu?

'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! 'enaziyaane yametaamalekwaacawene thaa`otaate baqenenete betegaabezwacawe theriwocaacehune 'ayesamume. bataqaratzulaacawe `aayenoce wadaaneta yaafathathu honawe taayaacawaalahe gene ge`uze kamahonaacawe yatanasaa 'ayemalakatume. thaa`otaawiyaanu 'amaaleketocaacawene 'ejoce, 'egeroce, 'enaa `aayenoce yaalwacawe 'aderegawe basawe leje 'enaa ba'enesesaate 'amesaayaa yeqaretswacawe nabare.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kasawoce nafesocaacawe faqedawe yaszarutene, kaszeraame kabaahherime yagaraalaacawene yaaze (taqabale). yatafathero celotaa yaalefaqadalaacawene bamikabedaacawe nagareme 'ataasegadedaacawe. yaashashaacawaalenaa. bamalekaame szeraa 'enaa basanaaye sena megebaare 'ezaze. 'alaawaaqi kahonuteme raaqe. kanaresu bamonye nagare yaqarabahene 'ateqerabe, yaasecagarahene 'ataasecagere, yakalakalaheneme 'atenefage.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! shayethwane bagutegotaawe yaqarabahe, kamalekaame szeraa yaazanaagaahe hono katasamaahe wada 'alaahe tathagaa baresume tathabaqe. 'eresu lametenaagarawe sami yaresune thebaqaa bamafalageheme `aawaaqi nawe. karesu yethabeqehale.

'enanyaa te`ezaazaatune bamathabaqe 'enaa kakalakalaacaweme bamaraaqe 'alaahene fariwoce yahonute yashayethwane gotegwaace yanakaacawenaa wanejale laaye bawadaqu gizee, 'alaahe la'amatzanyaa wanejaloce yaazagaajawene qethaate 'enaa lataazaazhoce yaazagaajawene menedaa yaasetaawesaalu. kawanejalaacawe yetzatzataalu. wada 'alaahe yemalasaalu. wada haqe qathe yaalu, kanabarubate zenegunate yanaqu 'enaa kawanejale yaraaqu yehonaalu.

'amatzanyoce 'enaa kakahadiyaane yahonuteme yashayethaanocu wanedemoce, shayethwanaatu bathemate wesethe bawanejale laaye wanejalene lanaresu kamachamare 'ayewagadume. shayethwanaatume kamaathemame 'enaa kamaasaasaate, kasawoceme thamaamocu lanaresu kamataazaze 'enaa kamaathefaate wadaxwaalaa 'ayelume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ta`aamere yezahe betemathaalaacawe yaasetabaabelaalu. kaanetame yereqaalu. ta`aamere baataamathaalaacawe lamene kaaneta zanede 'atefabarekaateme, 'ateqathaathefaateme yelaalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<karaasee ta`aamere laamathaa 'aleceleme. wadanee yatalaalafawene malakotaawi male`ekete 'eneji leelaa 'alekataleme. yehe banaaneta laaye yamaanabawe qure'aane kafathaariyaacehu 'enaa kagudaayaacehu 'asetanaabaari ka'alaahe zanede yamathaa maaserajaa, kabaarocu 'amaanyoce lahonuteme mamariyaa 'enaa 'ezenate nawe. ka'amaanyoce weche yaalutemaa thamaamoce 'enaa manaathiwoce naacawe.
qure'aane baminababebate gizee, geetaacehu 'alaahe yaazenelaacehu zanede manababune 'ademethu, 'atenagaagaru, baleelaa nagare 'atethamadu.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yatawaadaqeke, yatanaanaseke 'enaa yafaraahe honahe geetaahene 'alaahene 'awesaa. theriheneme demetzene kafe 'enaa zeqe bamaaderage mahakale mizaanaawi 'aderege, gizeewocu belechaa kaalaacawe baqane majamariyaa 'enaa maabeqiyaa laaye geetaahene 'awesaa. geetaacawene kamaawesaate kazanagute 'atehune.

'enanyaa geetaahe zanede yaalute malaa'ekete geetaacawene lamaamelake 'ayekorume. taazaazhoceme honawe 'amelekotene yefatzemaalu. 'ayaaqwaarethume, 'ayesalacume. 'alaaheneme bathwate 'enaa bamaataa yaatharutaale; yaawadesutaale. laresu becaa yesagedaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! baaledarabocehe, selamereko neberate 'enedeete 'enedamikafaafale, lamaane 'enedamikafaafale, yethayequhale. latheyaaqeewocaacawe malese setesathaacaweme - <<yamereko ganezaboce la'alaahe 'enaa lamale'eketanyaawe naacawe. yamaakafafale selethaane 'enaa hegegaatume ya'alaahe 'enaa yamale'eketanyaawe nawe. kanaanetame mataazaze 'enaa 'eje masethate yethabaqaale.>> 'amaanyoce hoye! te`ezaazune bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru. bamakaakalaacehu yaalawene maqoraarathe 'enaa makoraarafe, bamawaadade, bamaganaanyate, bamalekaame sena megebaare 'enaa yeqere bamabaabaaleme 'asetakaakelu; 'asaameru. ya'alaahe 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyoce kahonaacehu raasaacehune la'alaahe 'enaa lamale`eketanyaawe te`ezaaze 'asegazu. maane, malekaame bamaszeraatenaa kawanejale lamathabaqe 'anasaashe nawe. yehe theyaaqee yatanasaawe kabadere zamacaa kesetate baxwaalaa nabare.

'enaho 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyoce maalate, 'enanyaa 'alaahe bamiwasaabate gizee lebocaacawe yamifaru, lebocaacawe 'enaa 'akaalaacawe 'alaahene lamataazaze yaminasaasu, ya'alaaheme 'aneqatzoce banaresu laaye sinababu bamaasetanetanaacawe mekeneyaate bamaanaacawe laaye maanene yamichameru, theqemene lamaagenyate gudaateneme lamaasewagade bageetaacawe laaye becaa yamimaku naacawe.
'enanyaame salaatene batamwalaa gatzetaawaa gizeewaane thabeqawe yamisagedu kalagasenaacaweme yagedeetaa 'enaa yawedeetaa metzewaate yamisathu naacawe.

'enanyaame ba'enanyihe baahheriyaate tagalaachocu, ya'emenatene `aayenatoce 'enaa yaselaamene yatagebaare magalachaawoce 'anede laaye bamasabesabaacawe batekekele 'amaanyocu 'enaresu naacawe. menedaacaweme geetaacawe zanede kafe yaalu darajaawocenaa lawanejalaacaweme mehheratene 'enaa yatakabara sisaayene maagenyate nawe. yaame 'alaahe katzagaawoce yaazagaajalaacawe nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe yamerekone ganezabe kefefelene batamalakata feredune wadaresu 'enaa wada 'aneta 'enedaadaraga hulu 'alaahe wadaaneta baawaradawe malakotaawi male'eketu thaa`otaawiyaanune lamagaadale kamadinaa 'enedetewathaa 'azazahe. ka'amaanyoce kafile cheferoce gene mawethaatehene yamithalu nabaru.

'enanyaame kame'emanaane yahonu cheferoce 'agaariwocene magaadalene batamalakata gudaayu makasatu katagalathalaacawe baxwaalaa leke wada mote 'enedaminadu 'enaa ba`aayenaacaweme 'enedamimalakatute thaletawe yekaraakaruhale. yaa yahonabate mekeneyaate lathorenatu wesethaawi 'enaa qusaawi zegejetene yaalaadaragu bamahonaacawe wada thorenate mawethaatune bamathelaataacawe nabare.

'enaaneta (me'emanaane hoye) geetaacehu ka'agaariwoce ba'anedanyaawaa cheferaa laaye delene 'enedameteqadaaju qaale bagabaalaacehu gizee 'asetaawesu. yanegede qusocene yatashakamacewene cheferaa neberatwane maarekaacehu letewasedu 'aliyaame kabeete lathorenate yawathutene thaa`otaawiyaane tagaadelaacehu banaresu laaye delene leteqadaaju zanede qaale tagabaalaacehu. 'enaaneta gene maqothaatharu qalaale yahonawene yaala gedeyaame merekone lamaagenyate yagaraawene yaacine yaxaayele baaletabeete yaalehonacewe qefelate lanaaneta 'enedetehone wadadaacehu. 'alaahe dagemo 'enaanetane bathorenate bamaazaze, yathaa`otaawiyaanune qunechowoce bamaasewagade yaselaame xaayele yegalatze zanede bezuwocuneme 'enedetemaareku bamaaderage bate`ezaazu 'ewenatene maaragaagathene yefalegaale.

selaamene 'enaa takataayocune 'amaanyoce kafe bamaaderage la'ewenatanyenatu masekaari yahonu nagarocene bamaaseganyate 'ewenatene maaragaagathe, bamiyaaqarebawe maaserajaame yaweshatene weshatenatene maagaalathe 'enaa weshatene mathaale yefalegaale. 'enanyaa 'amatzanyaa 'agaariwoce yehenene bithalu 'enekwaane 'alaahe 'ewenatene yabalaaye yaadaregawaale.

babadere zamacaa `elate kageetaacehu 'eredaataane bafalagaacehu, bathalaataacehu laaye delene 'enediyaaqadaajaacehu geetaacehune bathayaqaacehu gizee geetaacehume - <<'enee kafilaacawe kafilaacawene yamikatale sihone ba'anede shihe takataataaye malaa'ekete 'eradaacexwaalahu>> belo lemanaacehune bataqabalaacehu gizee yahonawene 'awesu.

'alaaheme yehenene bamalaa'ekete maredaatune la'enaaneta la'amaanyoce bathalaatocaacehu laaye 'enedamiyaagezaacehu beseraate, nafesocaacehume badele 'eregethe 'enedilu 'eneji 'alaadaragaweme. deleme baquthere bezaate baquseme maganyate 'enaa mabarekate 'ayedalame. 'enaho dele ka'alaahe zanede nawe. 'eresume banegeszenaawe baalaanethaa yaleelawe 'ashanaafi, bahegegaatu 'enaa bawesaaneeweme thebabanyaa nawe.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! 'alaahe 'enaanetane kathalaataacehu `eyetaa badarasabaacehu ferehaate batzathetaa wesethe liyaadaregaacehu banaaneta laaye maanegolaajatene baadaraga gizee 'awesu. (janaabaa) karekesate liyaatzadaacehu, yashayethwanene gutegotaa 'enaa qoshaashaame liyaasewagede, thalaateneme bamagethame gizee 'akaaloce 'eneditzanu lebocaacehune lamaathanekare, 'egeroce 'enedaayenesharaatatume 'ashawaamaa mederune lamaathathare kasamaaye banaaneta laaye zenaabene baawarada gizee 'asetaawesu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe me'emanaanene liradaabate babadere wada 'awaradaacawe malaa'ekete - <<'enee ba'eredaataayee kanaaneta gaare nanye 'amaanyocene 'atzenwacawe, thalaatocaacawene bamagaadale laaye baalaacawe qurethanyenate 'athanekerwacawe. ba'enanyaa bakaadute sawoce leboce wesethe beretu ferehaatene 'aseqamethaalahu>> belo wadanaresu male'eketene baasetalaalafa gizee 'awesaa. 'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! (yemotu zanede) yakahadiyaanene 'anegate metu 'enaanetaneme kamagaadale yekalakalu zanede bawegiyaa gizee magathaathamiyaacawene 'enaa ya'ejocaacawene chaafeme metu.

yeheme bamagedale 'enaa malayaayaacaweneme bamametaate bakahadiyaane laaye yadarasawe theqaate 'enaresu 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene bamaqaaranaacawe, yataazazutene baalamafatzamaacawe katakalakaluteme baalamaqothabaacawe mekeneyaate nawe. baziheme gudaaye 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yamiqaarane 'enaho laresu bazihe `aalame bamagadale 'enaa bamamaarake, bamachiwe `aalameme 'esaatene bamaasegabaate 'alaahe yeqathaawaale. 'alaaheme qethaata beretu nawe.

'enaaneta 'alaahene 'enaa male`eketanyaawene yameteqaaranu kahadiyaane hoye! yehe la'enaaneta bamedere `aalame yatazagaajalaacehu qethaate nawenaa qemasute. bakehedataacehu 'enaa ba'emebitanyenataacehu zaweteraacehu yamotaacehume kahona lanaaneta bamachiwe `aalame ya'esaate qethaate 'alalaacehu.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalaacehu 'amaanyoce hoye! 'enanyaane kahadiyaanene bathore meedaa lawegiyaa sigwaazu yataqaraarabaacehu honaacehu katagaathamaacehu kanaresu ferehate 'ateshanafu; yameteshashu honaacehume jarebaawocaacehune 'ataazurulaacawe. bafite lafitaacawe tzenu 'enaresuneme bamagaadale taagasu. 'alaahe ba'egazaawe 'enaa ba'eredaataawe kanaaneta gaare nawe.

baziyaaneme gizee, lawegiyaa seletene lamaqayare (maatheqaatene falego) bamashashe maleke 'enedamiyaataalelaacawe `aayenate 'aliyaame kame'emanaane wada honu cheferoce dajanene lamaagenyate yamithagaa kaalehona basetaqare basheshete jarebaawene yamiyaazorelaacawe sawe baregethe ka'alaahe yahonane quthaa yezo tamalasa. manoriyaaweme 'esaate nawe. 'eresume kamamalashaa bakule menenyaa kafaa.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! babadere zamacaa `elate thaa`otaawiyaanune babelehaataacehu 'enaa baxaayelaacehu 'alegadalaacexwaacaweme. gene 'alaahe baziyaa laaye 'agazaacehu, gadalaacexwaacawe. 'anetame nabiyu hoye! chebethe 'afarene wadanaresu bawarawareke gizee 'alemataahacaweme, gene 'alaahe wada `aayenocaacawe bamaaderase mataacawe. 'alaaheme me'emanaanene bathalaatocaacawe laaye yabalaayenatene bamaaqadaajatu bawaalalaacawe tzagaa yaamasagenute 'enedahona bamalekaame limokeraacawe yehenene 'adaraga. 'alaaheme lemanaacehune 'enaa negegeraacehune sami, szeraawocaacehune 'enaa lanaanetame yamibajaacehune `aawaaqi nawe.

yehe kahadiyaanune kamagedale, 'esekishanafu 'enaa shashetaweme 'esekimalasu 'enaresune mametaate 'amaanyoceneme bamaredaate bathalaataacawe laaye yabalaayenate kamaaqadaajate yatathaqasawe hulu 'alaahe kahadiyaane baselaame laaye yamiyaaseerutene seeraacawene 'adekaami bamahonu nawe.

'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! 'alaahe qethaatune badenebare zalale badaayoce laaye 'enediyaawarede betethayequ yekxawe 'alaahe yathayaqaacehutene banaaneta laaye 'awarada. la'enaaneta maqathaachaa lame'emanaaneme mamakariyaa yahonane nagare 'alaahe 'awaradabaacehu. yeheneneme kamafalage beteqothabu lanaaneta yatashaala nawe. menaalebaateme baqethaate saayaacaakulaacehu gizee yesathaacehu yehonaale. wada badale 'enaa me'emanaanene wada mawaagaateme betemalasu 'enyaame banaaneta laaye qethaatene wada maawerade 'enaa me'emanaaneneme wada maredaate 'enemalasaalane. meneme 'enekwaa baquthere 'enaa baquse yabazu bihonume cheferocaacehu 'enaa 'agaazhocaacehu 'anedaace 'ayethaqemwacehume. 'alaahe ba'egazaawe 'enaa ba'eredaataawe kame'emanaane gaare nawe. 'alaahe karesu gaare yahona sawe 'ashanaafi yalaweme.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalaacehu hoye! te`ezaazune bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene taazazu. ya'alaahe 'aneqatzoce banaaneta laaye sinababu 'eyasamaacehu te`ezaazune bamaqaawame 'enaa yakalakalaweneme bamafatzame 'ateqaaranute. karesume 'ataafagefegu.

'enedananyaame qure'aane sinababe sametanaale 'enedamilute kaziyaame yamaasetanetanene 'enaa yamagasatzene masemaate 'enedamaayesamute 'enaa 'enedamaayethaqamute 'asemasaayoce 'enaa kahadiyaane 'atehunu.

bamedere laaye kamigwaazu fethuraane hulu kefuwocu 'enanyaa 'ewenatene lamaqabale yamaayesamu daneqorowoce, 'ewenateneme ba'anedabataacawe yamaayenaagaru didaawoca naacawe. 'enaresume 'alaahe yaazazawene 'enaa yakalakalaweneme yamaayeganazabu naacawe.

'alaahe ba'enanyaa 'asetabaabaaye kahadiyaane wesethe malekaame nagarene biyaaganye, (biyaaweqe) yamithaqamubatene, bamaaserajaawoceme gizee yamiganazabubatene yaasamaacawe nabare. gene 'alaahe bawesethaacawe malekaame 'enedaleela 'awaqa. yehune bibaalenaa 'alaahe biyaasamaacawe 'enekwaa yamiyaafagafegu honawe ba'emebitanyenate ka'emenate yemalasaalu.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu hoye! 'alaahe 'enaa male'eketanyaawe ka'ewenate 'enaanetane heyaawe wadamiyaadaregaacehu nagare sitharwacehu yaazazutene bamafatzame 'enaa kakalakaluteme bamaqothabe malese sethu. yeheneneme beteqaawamu 'alaahe ba'anede sawe 'enaa balebonaawe mahale 'enedamigaarede 'eregethanyaa hunu (`ewequ). selaziheme wada mataazaze tashaqadaadamu baferedume `elate wadaresu, wada 'alaahe 'enedametesabasabu `ewaqu. kaziyaame baszaraacehute leke yemanadaacexwaale.

'enanyaane kanaaneta makaakale yabadalutene wanejalanyocene becaa nathelo yamaayaathaqaa, wanejalanyaaweneme leelaaweneme yamiyaathaqaalelawene qethaate feru (tathaneqaqu). yeheme yamihonawe thefaate sibazaanaa kalekaaye sithafaa nawe. 'alaahene laamatza sawe qethaata beretu mahonune `ewequ. selazihe 'eresune kamaamatze tathaneqaqu.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye - bamakaa qutheraacehu 'anaasaa, nawaariwocwa yamineqwaacehu 'enaa yamiyaathaqwaacehu, thalaatocaacehume bafethenate 'enedaayezwacehu, 'enaa 'enedaayenatheqwaacehu yametefaru yanabaraacehubatene gizee 'asetaawesu. 'alaahe tzathetanyaa wada honace mashashiyaa (madinaa) 'asethagaacehu. bathore meedaame bathalaatocaacehu laaye delene 'aqadaajetwacehu ba'egazaawe 'abarataacehu. kamalekaamoceme magabaacehu. kaziheme kathalaatocaacehu yawasadaacehute mereko 'alabate. 'alaahe yehene yaadaragawe tzagaawene 'enedetaamasagenu 'enaa bamaamaseganaacehume 'enedichamerelaacehu, 'enedaatekedu 'enaa baziheme 'enedaayenafegaacehu belome 'enedaayeqathaacehume nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalaacehu hoye! te`ezaazune mafatzame bamatawe kakalakalaweme baalamaqothabe 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene 'atekaadu. belome ka`edaa 'enaa kaleelaame yataamanaacehubatene baalamaaderase (kedate mahonune 'eyaawaqaacehu) 'atekaadu.

yaganezabe 'enaa yaleje feqere 'anedene baareyaa wada kehedate selamiwasedu; fatanaa mahonaacawene 'alwahe (suwe) 'enedehe bamaalate nagarane.
'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! 'enaho ganezabocaacehu 'enaa lejocaacehu 'alaahe 'enaanetane lamafatanyaa yasathaacehu mahonune `ewaqu (lamachiwe `aalame kamaszeraate likalakelwacehu) wada kehedateme liwasedwacehu yecelaalu. 'alaahe 'eresu zanede taalaaqe menedaa 'enedaalawe `ewaqu. ganezabocaacehune 'enaa lejocaacehune lamanekabaakabe belaacehu banaresume mekeneyaate kehedate wesethe bamagebaate yehe taalaaqe menedaa 'enediyaamalethaacehu 'ayaaderegwaacehu.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaaweneme yatakatalaacehu hoye! 'enaaneta te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaqothabe 'alaahene yafaraacehu kahona 'ewenatene kaweshate yametenathelubate malayaa 'enedamiyaadaregelaacehu `ewaqu. kaziyaame banaaneta laaye 'ayemasaasalebaacehume. yaszaraacehutene thefaate yaabeselaacexwaale. wanejalocaacehune yemerelaacexwaale. 'alaaheme yataalaaqe terufaate baaletabeete nawe. 'alaahe lathenequqe baarocu yaazagaajaate janate kataalaaqe terufaatu nace.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa kahadiyaane baaneta gudaaye batasabaasabunaa liyaaseruhe wayeme ligadeluhe, wayeme dagemo kaalahebate hagare wada leelaa liyaasewathuhe baaseeru gizeebahonawene 'asetaawese. 'enaresu kefaatene yaaseeraalu 'alaahe dagemo seeraacawene wadanaresu yemalesaale. 'alaaheme kamiyaaseeru hulu balaache nawe.

'aneqatzocaaceneme banaresu laaye baminababubate gizee 'ewenatene bamakaade 'enaa bate`ebiteme, <<kazihe bafite yazihene bithee sametanaale. benefalege 'enedazihe qure'aane `aayenate qaalene 'enenaagaraalane. yeheme yasamaanawe qure'aane yaqadamete sawoce yaweshate tarate 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame>> yelaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa 'agaariwoce bamasaalaqe, kehedate laaye bamaderase - <<'alaahe hoye! yehe muhhamade yezote yamathaawe nagare kaaneta zanede yahona 'ewenataa kahona 'enyaane lamaasaawaqe kasamaaye yametaathafaa yahonacene denegaaye 'azenebebene 'aliyaame 'asaamaami qethaate 'amethaabene>> baalu gizee 'awesaa.

'alaaheme 'aneta hheyaawe honahe, bawesethaacawe 'eyaalahe hulaacawene bamiyaathafaa qethaate liqathaacawe 'alehoname (mahalaacawenaa maganyatehe kaqethaate lamaterafe waasetenaacawe nawe) 'enaresume kawanejalocaacawe mehherate 'eyathayaqute 'alaahe 'enaresune qachi 'ayedalame.

qethaatune gede yamiyaadaregu nagarocene 'eyafatzamu 'alaahe 'enaresune yamaayeqathaabate mene 'alawe? 'enaresune kamaqethaate mene yekalakelaale? sawocene yatakabarawe masejidene thawaafe 'enedaayaadaregu, salaateme 'enedaayesagedubate yamikalakelunaa ya'alaahe wadaajoce saayehonu 'enaresune kamaqethaate mene yekalakelaale? ya'alaahe wadaajoce 'enanyaa te`ezaazune yathabaqu, kakalakalaweme yaraaqu, 'eresune fariwoce 'eneji 'agaariwocu 'ayedalume. gene 'abezaanyocaacawe yehene 'ayaawequme.

thaa`otaawiyaanume batakabarawe masejide wesethe yamifatzemute segedate, fuchate 'enaa chebechabaa 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame. 'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! 'alaahene bamakaadaacehu 'enaa male`eketanyaaweneme bamaasetabaabalaacehu bagedeyaa 'enaa ba'eseraate maleku yabaderene `elate qethaate qemasu.

'enaziyaa 'alaahene yakaadu sawoce ganezabaacawene sawocene ka'alaahe manegade lamakalekale wache yaadaregaalu. lawadafiteme wache yaadaregaalu gene felaagotaacawe 'atesaakaame. kaziyaame wache yaadaragubate maabeqiyaawe yataaqadalatene `aalaamaa bamasaatu tzatzate yehonebaacawaale. kaziyaame 'amaanyoce banaresu laaye delene bamaqadaajataacawe yeshanafaalu. 'enaziyaame 'alaahene yakaadute baferedu `elate wada jahaname yenadaalu, yesabasabaalu. bawesethwame zawetaariwoce lihonu yegabaalu.

'alaahe yakahadiyaane kemecete yahonawene qoshaashaa, ya'amaanyoce sebesebe kahonawe malekaame yelaye zanede 'enanyaa ganezabaacawene sawocene ka'alaahe manegade lamakalekale wache yaadaragutene wada jahaname yesabasebaale. kasawoce, kaszeraawoce 'enaa kaganezaboceme yahonu qoshaashocene kafilu bakafilu laaye yatadaraaraba yaadaregawe 'enaa bajahaname 'esaate wesethe yechamerawaale. 'enanyaa 'enaresu baferedu `elate raasaacawene 'enaa beetasabaacawene yakasaru naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kahhezebocehe lananyaa 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene lakaadute 'enaresu kakehedataacawe 'enaa yaamanu sawoceneme ka'alaahe manegade kamalekale yamiqothabunaa 'eje yamisathu kahona 'alaahe kawanejalaacawe yaqadamawene 'enedamimerelaacawe negaraacawe. selaame yaqadama wanejalene wedeqe yaadaregaalenaa. wada kehedataacawe 'enaa 'amaanyoceneme ka'alaahe manegade wada makalekale bimalasu 'alaahe qadametocene baasetabaabalunaa bakehedataacaweme bazawataru gizee bathefaate yaacaakolabaacawe manegade baregethe qademwale. yanaresume yekatalaale.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! 'enanyaane kahadi thalaatocaacehune, ba'alaahe yamaagaaraate, 'amaanyoceneme ka'alaahe manegade yamakalekale fatanaa 'esekamithafaa, 'amelekote 'enaa mataazaze hulume la'alaahe becaa 'esekihone derase tawaagwaacawe. kahadiyaanume kanabarubate kehedate 'enaa thefaate yataqothabu kahona tawewaacawe. 'alaahe szeraawocaacawene tamalekaace nawe. 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayeshashegebateme.

'alaahene kamakaade 'enaa sawoceneme kamanegadu kamakalekale 'enediqothabu kataazazute nagare yaafanagathu 'enaa fitaacawene yaazoru kahona, 'amaanyoce hoye! `ewaqu, 'eregethe balu, 'alaahe wadaajaacehu, banaresu laaye 'agaazhaacehu nawe. menenyaa yaamaara wadaaje yaamaarame radaate nawe. 'alaahe yatawadaajawe yesaakaalataale, yaradaaweme yaashanefaale.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! `ewaqu! ba'alaahe manegade kakahadiyaane gaare tawaagetaacehu yamaarakaacehute neberate ba'amesete botaawoce yekafaafalaale. 'araate 'amesetanyaawe (ka'amesete 'araate 'eju) bathorenatu laaye latasaatafute taagaayoce yekafaafalaale. 'anede 'amesetanyaawe dagemo maleso wada 'amesete yekafalaale. 'anede 'eje lamuselimoce thaqelaalaa 'agalegelote lihone ya'alaahe 'enaa yamale'eketanyaawe nawe. 'anede 'eju kabanu hhashime 'enaa banu muthalibe lahonu yanabiyu beetasaboce yehonaale 'anede 'eju layatime lejoce, 'anede 'eju lacegeretanyoce 'enaa dehoce, 'anede kefelu seneqe lataqwaarathabaacawe manegadanyoce, yehonaale. 'enaaneta ba'alaahe 'enaa bamalayaaweme qane, hulatu cheferoce (kahadiyaane 'enaa 'amaanyoce) bataganaanyubate 'alaahene 'enaanetane bathalaatocaacehu laaye baradaanaa ba'ewenate 'enaa weshate mahale balayabate yabadere `elate babaariyaacene bamahhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye baawaradenawe yametaamenu kahona yehene taqabalu. 'enaanetane yaradaacehu 'alaahe banagaroce hulu laaye caaye nawe.

'enaaneta kabadere shalaqo kamadinaa bakule kaalacewe qerebitu daarecaa banabaraacehubate, 'agaariwocu kamakaa bakule kaalacewe ruqwaa daarecaa, yanagaadeewocu qefelate dagemo kanaaneta bataace kaqaye baahhere daarecaa bakule banabarubate gizee yahonawene 'asetaawesu. 'enaaneta 'enaa 'agaariwocu babadere lamaganaanyate beteqathaatharu noro baqatharo telayaayu nabare. gene 'alaahe mahone yaalabatene nagare lamafatzame, 'amaanyocene 'enaa 'emenatune yabalaaye, kahadiyaanune 'enaa kehedatene yabataace liyaadaregebate, belome 'eselaamene kafe 'aderego sherekene lamaawaarade 'enaa kamusherekocu yamithafume 'alwahe mu'eminocene kabezaateme 'anaasaa tetheqaacawume teneshe huno saala musherekocu laaye dele maaderagaacawune geletze yahonawenewe maaserajaa kaasaayaacawe baxwaalaa bamote 'enedithafu yaminorume yeheenene 'alwahe geletze yaadaragalatene 'aweqo 'enedinore 'alaahe yehene fatzama. kezihe baxwaalaa 'alwahe zanede lamaaneme makaraakareyaa 'ayenoreme. 'alaahe yahulune negegere sami, szeraawocaacaweneme `aawaaqi nawe. meneme nagare ka'eresu yamidabaqe selaleela yemanadaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe 'agaariwocene bahhelemehe quthere 'anaasaa 'aderego baasaayahe gizee, 'anetame 'amaanyocene yehene nagerahacawe bamalekaame batadasatu 'enaa thalaatocaacawene lamagaathameme qurethanyenataacawe babarataa gizee 'alaahe yawaalalehene tzagaa 'awesaa. 'alaahe 'enaresune quthera bezu 'aderego biyaasaayehe noro yabaaledarabocehe qurethanyenate batadaakamanaa wegiyaaweneme bafaru nabare. gene 'alaahe kazihe natzaa 'adaragaacehu. kaferehateme thabaqaacehu. 'eresu leboce yamiyezutene nafesoceme yamidabequtene `aawaaqi nawe.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! 'alaahe 'enanyaane kahadiyaane batagaathamaacehu gizee qutheraacawene 'anaasaa 'aderego baasaayaacehu 'enaa 'enaanetame lawegiyaa badafaraacehu gizee, 'enaanetaneme ba`aayenocaacawe quthera 'anaasaa 'aderego 'asaayetwacawe ligathemwacehu bamathu gizee yawaalalaacehune tzagaa 'asetaawesu. 'alaaheme 'agaariwocune bamagedale 'enaa bamamaarake lame'emanaane dagemo delene lamaaqadaajate 'enaa yabalaaye lamaaderage mahone yaalabatene nagare lamafatzame yehene 'adaraga. nagaroce hulu wada 'alaahe yemalasaalu. 'athefiweneme bathefaatu 'asaamaariweneme babago szeraawe yemanadaawaale.
