'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu hoye! ya'enanyaane yakahadiwocene cheferaa bathore meedaa setegaathamu bawegiyaa laaye tzenu. 'ateferume. yafalagaacehutene yesathaacehu kafaraacehuteme yethabeqaacehu zanede 'alaaheneme babezu 'awesute, lamenuteme. 'eresu 'enaanetane banaresu laaye bamaredaate caaye nawe.

'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene banegegeraacehu, batagebaaraacehu 'enaa banagaraacehu hulu taazazu. bahasaabeme 'atelayaayu, 'atechaqaachaqu, tekasemaalacehu. leyunate ladekemataacehu 'enaa laxaayelaacehume mawagade sababe nawe. thalaataacehune bametegathemu gizee taagasu. 'alaahe ba'eredaataawe 'enaa ba'egazaawe kataagaashoce gaare nawe. 'alaahe karesu gaare yahona therethere yaleelawe 'ashanaafi nawe.

'enedananyaa kamakaa bakuraate, lasawoceme lamataayate (lataayetaa) 'enedawathute, sawoceneme ka'alaahe manegade yamikalakelu 'enedahonute 'agaariwoce 'atehunu. 'alaahe yamiszarutene nagare ba`eweqatu kabaabi nawe. kaszeraacawe 'anedaaceme 'ayedabaqebateme, baresume yemanadaacawaale.

shayethwaneme lathaa`otaawiyaanu szeraawocaacawene baasaamaralaacawe gizee yahonawene 'awesu. muselimocene bamagaathame 'enaa bamagaadale laaye 'adafaafaraacawe. zaaree 'enaanetane 'ashanaafi yalame 'enee raji'aacehu 'enaa kathalaatocaacehume thabaaqiyaacehu nanye 'alaacawe. hulatu cheferoce ('aberawaacawe yamiyaagezwacawe malaa'ekete yaalubate yamu'eminoce cheferaa 'enaa lawadafite yamikadaacawe shayethwane yaalabate yakahadiyaane cheferaa) sigaathamu shayethwane bamashashe 'afagafaga. lathaa`otaawiyaanume - <<'enee kanaaneta yanatzaahu nanye. 'enee 'enaaneta yamaataayutene ('amaanyocune lamaredaate yamathutene tawaagi malaa'eketene) 'ayaalahu. 'enee 'alaahe 'enedaayaathafaanye 'efaraawaalahu. 'alaaheme qethaata beretu nawe>> 'alaacawe.

'enanyaa 'asemasaayoce 'enaa balebocaacawe wesethe bashetaa yaalabaacawe 'emenata dakaamoce - <<'enanyihene muselimoce kaqutheraacawe 'enaa tetheqaacawe maanase gaare: 'enedihume kathalaataacawe bezaate 'enaa baqi tetheqegaare: banaresu laaye delene teqadaajaalaacehu belo qaale yamigabaalaacawe 'emenataacawe 'ataalalaacawe>> baalu gizee 'asetaawesu. ba'alaahe yatamakaa 'enaa deleme 'enedamisathawe yatamaamana 'alaahe radaatu nawe. meneme dakaamaa bihone 'ayethelaweme. 'alaaheme bafelaagotu laaye 'ashanaafi bawesaaneewe 'enaa hegegaatume thebabanyaa nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! malaa'eketu 'enanyaane 'alaahene 'enaa male`eketanyaawene yakaadu sawocene wadanaresu siqethaachu fitocaacawene kanaresume basheshete sizoru jarebaawocaacawene 'eyamatu bamiyaazwacawe 'enaa 'esetenefaasaacawene baminathequ gizee <<'enaaneta kahadiyaane hoye! 'aqaathaaye yahonawene qethaate qemasu>> silwacaweme yamihonawene betaaye 'asefari nagarene temalakate nabare.

'enaaneta kahadiyaane hoye! yehe nafesocaacehu siyaazu yamigathemaacehu 'asaamaami qethaate, baqabere 'enaa bamacharashaawe `aalameme yamiyaaganyaacehu 'aqaathaaye qethaate bamederaawi `aalame 'ejocaacehu baszarute wanejale mekeneyaate nawe; 'alaahe baarocune badaaye 'ayedalame. bamahakalaacawe bafetehe yefaredaale. 'eresu fetehawi faraaje nawe.

yehe bakahadiyaanu laaye yataragaagathawe ya'alaahe qethaate lanaresu becaa yatanathala 'ayedalame. 'alaahe bayazamanu 'enaa bayabotaawe bakahadiyaane laaye yamiyaaraamedawe manegadu nawe. bafire`one 'enaa babeetasabocu kanaresume bafite banabarute kahadiyaane laaye ya'alaahe 'aneqatzocene bakaadu gizee qathaacawe. bawanejalocaacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe 'ashanaafi 'enaa caaye yahonane 'akaale 'ayaayaaze yaazaacawe. baqethaate chabathaacawe. 'alaaheme yamaayeshanafe beretu laamatzaweme qethaatu kabaade nawe.

'enedihe yaalawe beretu qethaate yataragaagathabaacawe, 'alaahe ba'anede hhezebe laaye karesu bahona tzagaa kaabalatzagaacawe baxwaalaa 'eraasaacawene kaalubate malekaame huneetaa - ka'emenate 'enaa qathe kamaalate wada kehedate, 'amatze 'enaa ya'alaahene tzagaa wada makaade mathefo gatzetaa 'esekilawethu derase 'alaahe tzagaawene yamaayenatheqaacawe bamahonu, 'alaaheme yabaarocune negegere sami szeraawocaacaweneme `aawaaqi bamahonu nawe. la'alaaheme meneme nagare 'ayeshashagebateme.

ya'enanyihe kahadiyaane huneetaa kanaresu weche 'enedaalute, 'eneda fire`one beetasabocenaa kanaresu bafiteme 'enedanabarute kahadiyaane bithee nawe. yageetaacawene 'aneqatzoce 'asetabaabalu. bafatzamute wanejale mekeneyaate 'alaahe 'athafaacawe. yafire`one beetasabocene babaahhere wesethe bamaasemathe 'athafaacawe. yafire`one beetasaboce 'enaa kanaresu bafite yanabaruteme kahadiyaane hulume ba'alaahe bamakaadaacawe 'enaa 'eresume laaye bamaagaaraataacawe raasaacawene yabadalu nabaru. ya'alaahe qethaate tagabaacawe. 'alaaheme qethaatune 'awaradabaacawe.

bamedere laaye kamilaawasu fethuraane hulu kefuwocu 'enanyaa 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyocune yakaadu naacawe. bakehedate laaye ceke kamaalataacaweme yatanasaa meneme ta`aamere betemathaacawe 'ayaamenume. yaqenaacaa madaarashaa yahonute 'a`emero, masemiyaa 'enaa maayaa hulu ba'enaresu zanede theqeme yalaacaweme.

'enanyaa 'eneda banu-qurayezaa yaalu qaale kidaanene yataqabalekaacawe kaziyaame yagabulehene qaale kidaane bayagizeewe yamiyaafaresu 'enaresu 'alaahene 'ayefarume. kanaresu yatayaazawene qaale kidaaneneme 'ayemolume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyihe qaale kidaanene yaafarasutene bathore meedaa laaye yaaganyahacawe kahona leelocaacawe 'enedisamu 'enaa yaalubatene huneetaa 'enediganazabu, 'anetane kamawaagaate 'enaa thalaatoceheneme baaneta laaye kamaagaze 'enedifaru beretu qethaate qethaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kananyaa kanaresu qaale kidaane kataqabalekaacawe sawoce bamitaayuhe meleketoce maataalalane 'enaa makedaatene yametefaraa kahona ('anetame 'enaresume nagarune bamaawaqe 'ekule 'eseketehonu derase) sememenatu maferasune 'asaaweqaacawe, qaale kidaanaacawene maleselaacawe. badenegate maatheqaatehe kedate nawenaa saataasaaweqaacawe badenegate 'ataatheqaacawe. 'alaahe kahadiwocene 'ayewademe.
'enanyaa yakaadu sawoce ka'alaahe qethaate yaamalathu 'aderegawe 'ayaasebu. 'enaresu 'alaahene 'ayaataaketuteme yaaganyaacawaale; yeqathaacawaale.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! lathalaatocaacehu yathore masaariyaa xaayele, lathore meedaame yamiwelu yawegiyaa farasoce yatacaalaacehune yaahele hulu 'azagaaju. yaanene ya'alaahene thalaatoce, 'adagaane yamithabaabaqulaacehune thalaatocaacehune yametaasefarubatene, 'enanyaaneme 'enaaneta yamaataaweqwaacawene 'alaahe yamiyaaweqaacawene, balebaacawe lanaaneta thelaacaa yamiyaazelutene debeqe thalaatoceneme yametesefaraarubatene xaayele 'azagaajulaacawe. ba'alaahe manegade 'anedaace nagare wache betaadaregu bamederaawiwe `aalame yetakaalaacexwaale. bamachiwe `aalame menedaawe yatamwalaa sihone yesathaacexwaale. 'enaanetame meneme nagare 'atebadalume.

wada sememenate 'enaa wegiyaane wada matawe kaazanabalu 'anetame wadaresu tazanebale. qaale tagaabaacawe. ba'alaahe tamakaa, baresume tamaamane. 'eresu 'asaalefo 'ayesatheheme. 'eresume negegeraacawene sami hasaabaacawene 'enaa tagebaaraacaweneme `aawaaqi nawe.

wada sememenate 'enaa wegiyaane wada matawe bamazanebalaacawe 'anetane maazanaagaate 'enaa makedaatene yamifalegu kahona, 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kanaresu seeraa 'enaa kehedate 'alaahe thabaaqihe nawe. 'eresu yaa karesu bahona 'eredaataa 'enaa kamuhhajiroce 'enaa 'anesaaroce (kasedatanyoce 'enaa taqabaayoce) bahonu 'amaanyoce yaagazahe nawe.

balebocaacawe mahaleme (yatalayaayu kanabaru baxwaalaa) ba'emenate 'asemaamaa. balebocaacawe mahale letaasemaamaa medere laaye yaalane ganezabe hulu wache betaadarege 'ataasemaamaame. gene 'alaahe bamahalaacawe 'asemaamaa 'eresu taqanaaqaanye yaleelawe 'ashanaafi bahegegaatume bawesaaneeweme thebabanyaa nawe.
'aneta nabiye hoye! 'alaahe laanetame 'anetane latakatalute 'amaanyoceme kathalaatocaacehu baqiyaacehu nawe. selazihe baresu tamakaa.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'amaanyocene bawegiyaa laaye 'anasaasaacawe (yamawaagaate qurethanyenataacawene yahasaabe thenekaareeyaacawene yamichamerelaacawene nagare tanaagaraacawe) kanaaneta kame'emanaane kahadiwocene bamataagale laaye haayaa taagaashoce binoru hulate mato kahadiyaanene yaashanefaalu; kanaanetame 'anede mato taagaashoce binoru kakahadiyaanu 'anede shihene yaashanefaalu. yeheme 'enanyaa kahadiyaane, 'alaahe wadaajocune bamaredaate, thalaatocuneme bamathaale yaalawene manegadune, yamawaagaateneme `aalaamaa yamaayeradu bamahonaacawe nawe. 'enaresu yamiwaagute bamedere `aalame yabalaaye lamahone nawe. 'amaanyoce dagemo ya'alaahe 'emenate yabalaaye yehone zanede nawe.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! 'ahune banaaneta wesethe dekematene selaaganya (selaawaqa) lanaaneta 'aqalalalaacehu. ba'anedaacehume laaye 'asere kahadiyaanene kamagaafathe yeleqe bahulate fite 'enediqome 'adaraga. kanaaneta makaakale mato taagaashoce kaalu hulate mato kahadiyaanene yaashanefaalu. kanaanetame 'anede shihe taagaashoce kaalu hulate shihe kahadiyaanene ba'alaahe feqaade yaashanefaalu. 'alaahe ba'eredaataawe taagaashe kahonu 'amaanyoce gaare nawe.

'anede nabiye bamedere wesethe 'eresune kamigaadalu kahadiyaane makaakale magedalene 'esekiyaabazaa derase merekonyaa linorawe 'ayegabaame. yeheme 'eresune wada mawaagaate 'enedaayemalasu ferehaatene balebocaacawe yaadarege zanede nawe. 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! 'enaaneta yabadere merekonyocene bamayaaze 'enaa ganezabe taqabelo bamaleqaqe yaqerebitwane `aalame theqeme tefalegaalaacehu. 'alaahe dagemo 'emenatune bamaagaze 'enaa yabalaaye bamaaderage yameteganyawene yamacharashaayetune hagare yefalegelaacexwaale. 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi 'enaa thebabanyaa nawe.

'alaahe yamereko ganezabe mathaqamene 'enaa merekonyaaneme babeezaa maleqaqene yafaqadabate wesaaneewe baayaalefe noro ka'alaahe te`ezaaze saayemathaa bafite kabadere merekonyoce bataqabalaacehute yabeezaa ganezabe ka'alaahe yahona taalaaqe qethaate yeyezaacehu nabare.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! kakahadiyaane bathorenate kamaarakaacehute nagare yatafaqadawene 'enaa malekaamune belu. te`ezaazune bamathabaqe 'enaa kakalakalaweme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru. 'alaaheme 'amaanye baarocune mahhari, 'azaanyeme nawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! ba'ejocaacehu quthethere (yezotaa) wesethe laalute yabadere merekonyoce - 'alaahe balebocaacehu wesethe yamalekaame `aalaamaane 'enaa yahasaabe maamaarene yaaganya (yaawaqa) 'enedahona kanaaneta babeezaa katawasadawe yatashaala nagare yesathaacexwaale. 'alaahe kabaarocu kathefaate latamalasute mahhari. lanaresume 'azaanye nawe balaacawe. yehe ya'alaahe qaale banabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'agote ba`aabaase bine `aabedule muthalibe 'enaa baleeloceme kaziyaa baxwaalaa basalamute laaye taragaagethwale.

muhhamade hoye! laaneta bamigalatzelehe negegeraacawe 'anetane maataalalene bifalegu ('ayegarememe) kazihe bafite baregethe 'alaahene kedawe 'alaahe banaresu laaye delene bamaqadaajate, bamagedale 'enaa bamaasare 'asemacetohale. yatamalasu 'enedahona 'enedihe `aayenatune yethabequ. 'alaaheme labaarocu yamibajawene `aawaaqi baferedume thebabanyaa nawe.

'enanyaa ba'alaahe yaamanu, male'eketanyaawene yaaragaagathu, ba'alaahe hegeme yaszaru, kakehedate hagare wada selaame hagare 'aliyaame 'alaahene basalaame magazaate wadamicelubate seferaa yatasadadu, ya'alaaheneme qaale kafe lamaaderage ganezabocaacawene 'enaa nafesocaacawene masewaa`ete 'aderegawe yataagalu, 'enanyaame 'enaresune bamanoriyaacawe botaa yaasethagwaacawe 'enaa yaradwacawe, 'enanyaa sedatanyocu 'enaa taqabaayocaacawe 'enaresu kafilaacawe lakafilaacawe ba'eredaataa 'enaa ba'egazaa wadaaje naacawe. 'enanyaa 'alaahene yaamanu gene kakehedate 'agare wada selaame hagare yaaletasadadu, ba'alaahe manegade 'esekamisadadu derase 'enaresune yamaredaate 'enaa yamakalaakale wadaajenate yalaacehume. kahadiyaane kabadalwacawenaa kanaaneta ya'emenate 'eredaataane kafalagu, banaaneta 'enaa baathaqwaacawe sawoce mahakale yasememenate qaale baalaacehu sawoce laaye siqare baleelocu laaye 'eredwacawe. 'alaahe yameteszarutene nagare tamalekaace nawe. kaszeraacehu 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayedabaqebateme.

'enanyaa yakaadu sawoce kafilaacawe yakafilaacawe wadaaje nawe. kehedate yaamasaaselaacawaale. kafilaacawe kafilaacawene yeradaale. 'amaanye yahona sawe kahadine 'ayewadaaje. 'amaanyene yamaatewadaaju 'enaa kahadineme yamaatethalu kahona, bamedere laaye la'amaanyoce fatanaa yehonaale. ka'emenate wanedemocaacawe yamiradaacawene yaathaalu. sawoceneme bazihe maleku ka'alaahe ya'emenate manegade bamakalekale taalaaqe thefaate yekasataale.

'enanyaa 'alaahene yaamanu 'enaa ba'alaaheme manegade yatasadadu, 'enanyaame ba'alaahe manegade yatasadadutene (muhhajiroce) yaasethagu 'enaa yaradwacawe ('anesaaroce) 'enanyaa ba'ewenate 'amaanyocu 'enaresu naacawe. lanaresume lawanejalocaacawe meherate ka'alaaheme yahona yatakabara sisaaye 'alaacawe. yaame 'alaahe yaazagaajalaacawe janate nawe.

'enanyaame qademawe wada selaame kagabute sedatanyoce 'enaa kataqabaayocaacawe ('aneswaroce) baxwaalaa yaamanu, kakehedate hagareme wada selaame hagare yatasadadu. ya'alaahe qaale yabalaaye, yakehedate qaale yabataace tehone zanede ba'alaahe manegade yataagalu, 'enanyaa (kanaaneta) kamu'eminoce naacawe. lanaresu kamabete bakule 'enaaneta yaalaacehu `aayenate 'alaacawe. kagedeetaame yaalabaacehu `aayenate 'alabaacawe. kanaanetame makaakale yasegaa zemedenaa baaletabeetoceme ba'alaahe yawerese hege kafilaacawe lakafilaacawe yatagabaa nawe. 'alaahe banagaroce hulu `aawaaqi nawe. kazihe bafite ba'emenate 'enaa basedate banabara tesesere mawaraarase yanabara bamahonu nawe.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! yehe ka'alaahe 'enaa kamale'eketanyaawe yahona wadananyaa qaale kidaane wada tagaabaacexwaacawe 'agaariwoce yamidarese netzuhhenaa yaqaale kidaane maabeqiyaa maasaawaqiyaa nawe.

'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! 'araate waraate yaahele tzathetanyoce (szalaame) honaacehu bamedere wesethe tagwaazu, kaziyaame baxwaalaa qaale kidaaneme tzathetaame(szalaameme) yalaacehume. 'enaanetame bakehedataacehu yazawataraacehu 'enedahona ka'alaahe qethaate 'enedamaataamalethu, 'alaaheme kahadiyaanene baqerebitu `aalame bagedeyaa 'enaa ba'esere bamachiwe `aalame dagemo 'esaatene bamaasegabaate 'awaaraajaacawe 'enedahona 'ewaqu.yehe qaale kidaanaacawene yaafarasu 'enaa qaale kidaanaacawe bagizee yaaletagadabane kahadiyaanene yaathaqaalelaale. ka'araate waraate balaaye bihoneme qaale kidaanu bagizee yatagadaba kahona gene 'esekamaabeqiyaawe yeqoyaale.

yehe ka'alaahe 'enaa kamale'eketanyaawe yahona bataalaaqu hhaje qane yatanagara, 'alaahe 'enedihume male'eketanyaawe ka'agaariwoce yanatzu mahonaacawe lasawoce hulu yadarasa maasaawaqiyaa nawe. 'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! kamaagaaraataacehu betemalasu lanaaneta malekaame nawe. betaafanagethu gene 'alaahene 'ataakaacoce 'enedaalehonaacehu 'enaa ka'alaahe qethaate 'enedamaataamalethu 'ewaqu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa yakaadutene sawoce yamikafaacawe zeenaa negaraacawe 'eresume lanaresu 'asaamaami yahona qethaate 'enedaalalaacawe nawe.

'enanyaa qaale kidaane yatagaabaacexwaacawe, qaale kidaanaacaweneme yamolu kaziyaame 'anedaaceme yalaagodalute 'agaariwoce siqaru 'enaresu kaalafawe ferede yatanathalu naacawe. lanaresu 'eseka qaale kidaanu maabeqiyaa yagizee gadabe derase qaalaacehune thabequlaacawe mululaacawe. 'alaaheme qaale kidaanaacawene bamamulaate te`ezaazune thabaaqiwoce, kakehedateme bamaraaqe yakalakalawene yamaayedaafaru thenequqocene yewadaale.

thalaatocaacehune tzathetanyaa szalaame yaadaragaacehubaacawe yatakabarute waraate siyaabaqu 'enanyaane 'agaariwoce baaganyaacehubaacawe botaa laaye gedalwacawe. bayamanoriyaacawe 'agetwacawe, bayamanegadume keelaane 'aderegaacehu taqamathulaacawe. kamaagaaraateme wada 'alaahe katamalasu, salaateneme kaaqwaaqwaamu, yaganezabocaacawene zakaame kasathu, baselaame wanedemocaacehu honawaalenaa manegadocaacawene leqaqulaacawe, 'enaresune kamagaadaleme taqothabu 'alaaheme kabaarocu latatzatzatute mahhari lanaresume 'azaanye nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'agaariwoce 'anedaacawe theganyenatene yathayaqahe 'enedahona ya'alaahene negegere (qure'aanene) 'esekisamaa derase kalalaa 'aderegelate, kaziyaame tzathetanyaanatune 'esekamitamaamanebate botaa derase 'aderesawe. yeheme kahadiyaane yazihene 'emenate 'ewenataa baalamaawaqaacawe nawe. qure'aaneneme bamasemaate yaawaqute 'enedahona limaru yekajalaalenaa nawe.

'enanyaa batakabarawe beete zanede qaale yatagaabaacexwaacawe siqaru laleeloce 'agaariwoce, 'alaahe 'enaa male`eketanyaawe zanede 'enedeete qaale kidaane linoraacawe yegabaale? ('ayegabaame) 'enanyaa bahhudayebiyaahe sememenate yatakabarawe beete zanede qaale yatagaabaacexwaacawe 'agaariwoce qaalaacawene 'esekathabaqunaa 'esekaalaagodalwateme derase qaalaacehune thabequlaacawe, 'ataaferesute. 'alaaheme te`ezaazune yamithabequtene kakalakalaweme yamirequ thenequqocene yewadaale.

thalaatocaacehu sihonu 'enedeete lanaresu tzathetaa yegabaacawaale? ba'enaaneta laaye bishomu (yabalaaye bihonu) zemedenaaneme qaale kidaaneneme 'ayethabequlaacehume. 'alaahene 'ayefarume; yakafaa qethaatene yaaqameswacexwaale. 'anedabatocaacawe baminaagarute malekaame negegeroce yaasewadedwacexwaale. lebocaacawe gene yaane 'ayeqabalume. yamiluteneme 'ayemolume. 'abezaanyocaacawe qaalene bamaaferase ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yaafanagathu naacawe.

qaale kidaanene bamamulaate yamiyaazutene ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce kamakatale wada semeetocaacawe 'enaa zenebaaleewocaacawe yamidaresubatene teneshene waagaa lawathu. raasaacawene 'enaa sawoceneme ya'alaahene manegade kamakatale kalakalu. karesume raaqu. 'enaresu yeszarute yanabarawe menenyaa kafaa.

'amaanyene batamalakata kaalaacaweme thelaacaa yatanasaa zemedenaaneme ya'alaahene qaale kidaaneneme 'ayethabequme. kamigalatzubateme badale 'enaa thelaacaame yatanasaa 'enaresu ya'alaahene denebare yamithesu denebare zalaloce naacawe.

kakehedataacawe wada 'alaahe katamalasu, hulatune yamesekerenate qaale katanaagaru (laa laahaa lalaahe muhhamadune rasululaahe) kaalu salaateneme kaaqwaaqwaamu, kaganezabaacaweme zakaa kasathu, yaane gizee muselimoce honawaale. ya'emenate wanedemocaacehu naacawe. lanaaneta yaalaacehu mabete lanaresume 'alaacawe. banaanetame laaye yaalabaacehu gedeetaa banaresume laaye yenoraale. yaanee 'enaresune magaadale 'ayefaqadelaacehume. 'eselemenaacawe, damaacawene, ganezabaacawene 'enaa keberaacawene yethabeqelaacawaale. lamiyaawequme hhezeboce 'aneqatsotzocene 'enaaberaaraalane. yamithaqamubaacawe 'enaresu naacawenaa.

'enanyaa 'agaariwoce 'enaresune kamawaagaate latawasana gizee yagabaacehulaacawene qaale kidaane biyaafaresu, 'emenataacehuneme biyaanaweru 'enaa biyaathaathelu, 'enanyaane yakehedate qunechowocene tagaadalwacawe. 'enaresu qaale kidaane yalaacaweme. kakehedataacawe, qaale kidaanene kamaaferasaacawe 'enaa 'emenataacehuneme kamaaneqwaashashe yekalakalu zanede tagaadalwacawe.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! 'enanyaa qaale kidaanaacawene yaafarasu sawocene, male'eketanyaaweneme kamakaa lamaabaarare lamaaseere badaarane-nadewaa yatasabaasabutene, bathorenateme 'enaresu yajamarwacehu honawe saala 'ategaadalwacawemene? 'enaresune lamagaadale 'ateqademumene tefarwacawaalaacehune? 'enaaneta ba'ewenate 'amaanyoce kahonaacehu letefarute yamigabaacehu 'alaahene nawe. qurayeshocene bamahhalaa yatawadaajutene yabakere gosaawocene bamaagaze yanabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yamahhalaa wadaajoce yahonutene yakxuzaa`aa gosaawocene bamawegaate thorenatene jamaru.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! 'enanyaa 'agaariwocene tagaadalwacawe. 'enaaneta yametegaadalwacawe kahona 'enaresune bamagedale yeqathaacawaale. bashenefate 'enaa ba'esereme yaawaaredaacawaale. deleneme lanaaneta bamaaderage yeradaacexwaale. bathalaataacawe dele manasaate 'enaa weredate ba'amaanyoceme yabalaayenate mekeneyaate bathorenatu yaaletasaatafu 'amaanyocene leboce yaasherebataale.

banaresume laaye baaganyute dele mekeneyaate (yabaarocune) yalebocaacawene quchete yaareqebataale. bafatehu makaahe 'enedataganyaweme `aayenate 'alaahe ka'enanyaa 'agaariwoce makaakale bafalagawe laaye yetaaraqaale (mehheratene yaawaredaale) 'eresume yatatzatzaacene hhasaabe 'ewenatanyenatune `aawaaqi, bamafetharu 'enaa bahegegaatume thebabanyaa nawe.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! 'alaahe yaalafatanaa litawaacehu 'asabaacehune? fatanaa kamanegadocu makaakale 'anedu nawe 'alaahe kanaaneta makaakale 'enanyaane szeraacawene laresu bamaatheraate baresu manegade yamitaagasutene, ka'alaahe, kamale'eketanyaawe 'enaa ka'amaanyoceme baashaagare yamiwadaajute yalebe wadaajene yaaleyaazutene layeto 'esekiyaaweqe (labaarocu 'esekiyaasaaweqe) derase yefatenaacexwaale. 'alaaheme yameteszarutene nagare wesethe `aawaaqi nawe. baszeraawocaacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

la'enanyaa la'agaariwoce baraasaacawe laaye kehedatene masekaariwoce honawe saala ya'alaahene masejidoce ba'amelekote, 'alaahene bamataazaze liyaasegeethu 'enaa liganabu 'ayegabaacaweme. 'enaresu yamalekaame szeraane yataqabaayenate masefaretene (maanene) selaaleyaazu szeraawocaacawe wedeqe honawaale. 'enaresume baferedu `elate bawesethwa lizawateru yajahaname 'esaate gabiwoce naacawe. (kakehedataacawe yatamalasu 'enaa yatatzatzatu kaalehona basetaqare)

'enaho ya'alaahene masejidoce liyaasegeethu 'enaa yamigabaacaweneme haqe lithabequlaacawe tagabiwocu 'enanyaa ba'alaahe babecanyenatu yaamanu, baresume meneneme, maaneneme yaalaagaaru, baferedu `elate yaamanu, salaatene yaaqwaaqwaamu, kaganezabaacaweme zakaa yasathu, ka'alaahe baashaagare maaneneme yamaayefaru naacawe. 'enanyaa wada qathetanyaawe manegade katamarute 'enaa kataqanute lihonu yekajalaale. 'agaariwocu gene kazihe 'ejege yaraaqu naacawe.

'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! hhajaajocene yaathathu 'enaa yatakabaraweneme masejede yaasegeethu sawocene, ba'alaahe 'enedaamana, baresume maaneneme 'enedaalaagaaraa, baferedume `elate 'enedaamana, ya'alaaheme qaale yabalaaye yehone zanede, yakaadu sawoceme qaale yabataace tehone zanede banafesu 'enaa baneberatu 'enedataagala sawe, 'alaahe zanede baalawe kebere 'ekule 'adaragaacehutene? 'alaahe zanede 'ayesetakaakalume. 'alaahene bamaagaaraate yabadalu sawocene hhajaajocene 'enedamaathathaate `aayenate malekaame nagarene biszarume malekaame 'ayegathemaacaweme.

'enanyaa ba'alaahe yaamanu, kakehedate 'agareme selaame wadatamacaacabate hagare yatasadadu, baganezabaacawe 'enaa banafesocaacaweme ya'alaahe qaale yabalaaye yehone zanede ba'alaahe manegade yataagalu, 'enaresu kaleeloce yeleqe badarajaa 'alaahe zanede yatalaqu naacawe. 'enanyaa ba'enanyihe baahheriyaate yatagalatzute 'enaresu bajanate tadasaacocu naacawe.

'alaahe karesu yahona 'ezenate 'enedamiyaaganyaacawe, wedeetaaweme banaresu laaye 'enedamiragaagathe, banaresu laaye lamaceeme 'enedamaayeqothaa, lanaresume zawetaari yahona sisaaye yaalabate mabaletzagiyaa ya'atekelete (janate) seferaa 'enedamiyaasegabaacawe yaabaseraacawaale.

baziyaace ya'atekelete seferaa (janate) maabeqiyaa yaleelawe maqoyatene yeqoyaalu. lamaceeme yezawateraalu. (yeheme baqerebitwa `aalame yeszarute banabarute malekaame szeraawoce 'amaakaanyenate nawe) 'alaaheme 'amelekotene laresu bamaatheraate te`ezaazune lafatzama 'enaa kakalakalaweme laraaqa 'eresu zanede yalaaqa menedaa 'alawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe 'enaa male'eketanyaawe yezo yamathaawene nagare yaamanaacehu hoye! 'abaatocaacehune 'enaa wanedemocaacehune 'enaresu ka'emenate yeleqe kehedatene yawadadu, yaasebalathu honawe siganyu yame'emanaanene misethere yametaakaafelwacawe yaqerebe wadaajoce 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazwacawe. wedeetaane lanaresu bamagelatze kanaresume gaare bamamakaakare 'enaresune yamiwadaaje 'enaziyaa nafesocaacawene lathefaate bamadaarage raasaacawene yabadalu naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lame'emanaanu:- <<'abaatocaacehu, lejocaacehu, wanedemocaacehu, misetocaacehu, zamadocaacehu, yaafaraacexwaacawe neberatocaacehu, keserataacawene yametefarulaacawe negedocaacehu, yametewadwacawe beetocaacehu, 'enazihe hulu ka'alaahe, kamale'eketanyaawe, ba'alaaheme manegade kamataagale 'enaaneta zanede yabalatha tawadaaje kahonu, 'alaahe qethaatune 'esekiyaamathaabaacehu derase thabequ>> balaacawe 'alaaheme karesu te`ezaaze yaafanagathu sawocene wada miwadawe nagare 'ayemaraacaweme, lasekeete 'ayaabaqaacaweme.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! 'alaahe babezu yathorenate botaawoce (qutheraacehu 'enaa zegejetaacehu kamaanasu gaare) babezaataacehu saatedanaqu ba'alwahe laaye bamamakaataacehu 'enaa 'asebaabocene bamayaazaacehu becaa bathalaatocaacehu laaye delene 'aqadaajetwacexwaale, radetwacexwaale. bahhunayene thorenate laayeme radetwacexwaale gene yaqutheraacehu mabezaate baasegaramaacehu 'enaa (zaaree baquthere maanase mekeneyaate 'aneshanafeme) baalaacehu gizee 'asetaawesu. yaqutheraacehu mabezaate lanaaneta 'anedaaceneme nagare 'alaatarafaacehume. thalaatocaacehu banaaneta laaye baratu medere kamasefaatwa gaare thababacebaacehu. kaziyaame kathalaatocaacehu fite zoraacehu 'enaa tashanefaacehu shashaacehu.

kaziyaame kathalaatocaacehu kashashaacehu baxwaalaa 'alaahe maragaagaatene bamale'eketanyaawe 'enedihume bame'emanaane laaye 'awarada. bawegiyaa meedaawe laaye tsanu. 'enaaneta yaalaayaacexwaacawene yamalaa'ekete szaraawitene 'awarada. 'enanyaa kahadiyaaneneme bagedeyaa, ba'esere 'enaa beetasabocaacawene 'enaa neberatocaacawene bamamaarakeme qathaacawe. yeheme ya'enanyaa ba'alaahe 'enaa male'eketanyaawe yatalaakabatene nagare yakaadu sawoce menedaa nawe.

kaziyaame 'alaahe bazihe maleku kaqathaawe baxwaalaa kakehedatu 'enaa kathematu yatamalasa 'alaahe yetaaraqawaale. tzatzatuneme yeqabalawaale. 'alaaheme kabaarocu latatzatzatu mahhari lanaresume 'azaanye nawe. kakehedate 'enaa wanejalene kamaszeraate baxwaalaa tzatzataacawene yeqabalaacawaale.

'enaaneta 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yaamanaacehu, yadanagagaweneme yatakatalaacehu me'emanaane hoye! 'enaho 'agaariwocu kaalubate kehedate, 'ekuye sena megebaare 'enaa kefu lemaade yatanasaa qoshaashoce 'enedihume yarakasu naacawe. kazihe `aamataacawe (kazathananyaawe `aamata hhijeraa) baxwaalaa yatakabarawene masejide (hharamale makiye 'enaa kaa`ebaane) hhaje 'enaa `umeraane fatzaamiwoce bihonu 'enekwaane kakehedataacawe gaare 'ayegebu. 'enaresu kanaaneta bamaqoraarathaacawe mekeneyaate yezawe yemathute yanabarawe megebe 'enaa yanegede quse bamaqeratu dehenatene yametefaru kahona 'alaahe kafalaga katerufaatu yaabeqaaqaacexwaale. 'alaahe 'enaaneta yaalaacehubatene huneetaa `aawaaqi lanaanetame bamidanagegawe nagare thebabanyaa nawe.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ka'enanyaa matsaahhefetene katasathute 'ayehudoce 'enaa keresetiyaanoce makaakale 'enanyaane ba'alaahe becanyaa 'amelaakenate, baferedu `elate yamaayaamenutene, 'alaahe 'enaa male'eketanyaawe banaresu laaye 'ereme yaadaragutene, kabakete, ka`aasaamaa segaa, ka'asekaari mathathe 'enaa ka'araathaa ganezabe yamaayerequtene, 'alaaheme ladanagagawe hege tagazhiwoce yaalehonutene, yaqalalu 'enaa yatawaaradu honawe gebere ba'ejocaacawe 'esekisathu derase tagaadalwacawe.

'ayehudocu <<`uzayere ya'alaahe leje nawe>> 'alu. keresetiyaanoceme <<'alemasihhe (`isaa) ya'alaahe leje nawe>> 'alu. yehe ka'alaahe zanede 'anedaaceme dagaafi maaserajaa yaleelawe ba'afocaacawe yafabarakute qaalaacawe nawe. kazihe bafite <<malaa'ekete ya'alaahe seete lejoce naacawe>> belawe yakaadutene sawoce qaale yaamasaaselaalu. 'alaaheme ragamaacawe. geletse kahonawe 'ewenate 'enedeete wada thememate yezoraalu?

'ayehudocu liqaawenetocaacawene, keresetiyaanoceme manakosaataacawene ka'alaahe baashaagare geetoce 'aderegawe yaazwacawe. 'alaahe yakalakalawene yefaqedulaacawaale; yafaqadaweneme 'ereme yaadaregubaacawaale. keresetiyaanoceme 'alemasihhe `isaane ka'alaahe gaare leelaa 'amelaake 'aderegawe 'amalakute. 'alaaheme liqaawenetene, baahhetaawiyaanuneme, `uzayereneme `isaaneme 'anedene 'amelaake 'enediyaamaleku 'eneji 'alaazazaacaweme. karesume baashaagare leelaa 'amelaake yalame. 'eresume 'enanyaa 'agaariwoce baresu laaye kamiyaagaarubate nagare yalame, yataqadasame nawe.

'enazihe kahadiwoce 'enaa leeloceme banaresu manegade laaye yaalute hulu 'enedihe yaalu qethefatocene bamafaberake 'enaa male'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yezo yamathaawene 'ewenataa bamaasetabaabale ya'alaahene berehaane selaamene, ya'alaaheneme 'anedenate lamaaragaagathe yamathaawene geletze maaserajaa maathefaatene yefalegaalu. 'alaahe gene 'emenatune mamulaatene 'enaa yabalaaye maaderagene 'eneji 'ayeqabaleme. yaselaamene yabalaayenate kahadiyaanu bithaluteme 'alaahe yabalaaye yaadaregawaale. 'eresu ya'anedaacene nagare mahone kafalaga yaleeloce felaagote hulu wedeqe yehonaale.

'alaahe (subehaanahu wata`aalaa) yaa 'agaariwocu bithalume male'eketanyaawene muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame), yasawoce mamariyaa bahonawe qure'aane 'enaa 'ewenatanyaa bahonawe yahheyewate marehe, 'emenate (selaame) bawesethu baazalawe geletze maaserajaawoce ka'emenatoce hulu kafe liyaadaregawe yalaakawe nawe.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu 'enaa 'alaahe badanagagaweme nagare yaszaraacehu hoye! 'enaho ka'ayehude liqaawenete, 'enaa kakeresetiyaanoce manakosaate 'abezaanyocu yasawene ganezabe yaala'agebaabe yebalaalu. sawoceneme wada 'alaahe 'emenate 'enedaayegabu yaagedaalu. 'enanyaame wareqene 'enaa berene yamiyaakamaacu kaziyaame banaresu laaye gede yahonawene zakaa yamaayaawathu, yamaayesathu baferedu `elate lanaresu 'asaamaami yahona qethaate 'enedaalalaacawe 'asekafi bahona zeenaa 'abeseraacawe.

yaferedume `elate 'enaresu yaakamaacute wareqe 'enaa bere 'esaate yeqathaathalaale. muqatume 'ejege bachamara gizee genebaarocaacawe, gonocaacawe 'enaa jarebaawocaacawe baziyaa yetakosaalu (laziyaane `elate 'asaamaami qethaate 'abeseraacawe) bawaqasaame maleke, yehe gede yahonabaacehune metzewaate bamakalekale leteqathubate zanede lanafesocaacehu yaakamaacaacehute nawe; taakamaacute yanabaraacehuteneme qemasute yebaalaalu.

ba'alaahe ferede 'enaa wesaanee samaayaatene 'enaa mederene kamafetharu bafite batathabaqawe saleedaa baasafarawe maszarate ya`aamatu waraate quthere 'aseraa hulate nawe. kananyiheme makaakale 'alaahe bawesethaacawe mawaagaatene bamakalekale 'ereme yaadaragaacawe 'araate waraate (zule qa`idaa, zule hhijaa, muhharame 'enaa rajabe) 'alu. yeheme kawaraate quthere 'aseraa hulate mahone 'enaa kanaresume makaakale 'araatu 'ereme madaragaacawe qathetanyaawe 'emenate nawe. bawesethaacaweme thorenatene bamaakaaheede, 'eremenataacaweneme bamadaafare nafesocaacehune 'atebadelu. 'agaariwoce 'enaanetane batheqele 'enedamigaadalwacehu hulu 'enaanetame batheqele tagaadalwacawe. 'alaaheme ba'eredaataawe 'enaa bamaatzenaatu kananyaa te`ezaazune kamithabequ 'enaa yakalakalaweneme kamirequ thenequqe baarocu gaare mahonune `ewaqu. 'alaahe 'aberote yahona sawe 'ashanaafi yalaweme.

badenequrenaa zamane 'agaariwoce yaadaregute 'enedanabarawe 'anedene 'ereme yahonane ware baleelaa batafaqada ware bamatakaate 'eremenatune maazageyate (ba'alaahe yaware 'asetadaadaarinate makaade bamahonu) bakehedate laaye yatachamara kehedate nawe. baziheme 'enanyaa yakaadute sawoce yethamubataale. 'alaaheme 'ereme yaadaragaacawene yawaraate quthere yegathemu zanede ba'anede `aamate 'eremenatune yatafaqada 'aderegawe baleelaa `aamate dagemo 'eremenatune yaakaberaalu. ('enedihe bamaaderageme 'alaahe katakabarute waraate 'ereme yatadaragutene yatafaqadu yaadaregaalu). baziheme hegune yeqaawamaalu yethesaalu. kefu szeraawocaacaweme tageethulaacawe. 'alaaheme kahadi yahonu hhezebocene wada qathetanyaawe manegade 'ayemaraame.

'enaaneta 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yaamanaacehu hoye! thalaatocaacehune tegaadalu zanede ba'alaahe manegade lamataagale setetharu wada mareete yametewazafute, babeetocaacehu wesethe wada maqerate yametaazanabelute mene 'alaacehu? menedene nawe gudaayaacehu? 'alaahe baresu manegade lamitaagalute yaazagaajawene yamachiwene `aalame zawetaari tzagaa tawagaaje bahonawe yaqerebitwa `aalame mathaqamiyaa 'enaa taqwaaraache bahonaweme thefethenaawaa malawathe falagaacehune? wadadaacehune? yazihece yaqerebitwa `aalame mathaaqamiyaame kamacharashaawe `aalame tsagaa gaare siwadaadare theqite 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame. 'asetawaaye sawe 'enedeete zawetaarine bathafi yelawethaale?

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! thalaatocaacehune lamawaagaate ba'alaahe manegade yamaatewathu kahona bashenefate 'enaa baweredate yeqathaacexwaale. ba'alaahe manegade wethu sibaalu bamiwathu taazaazhe hhezeboceme yetakaacexwaale. te`ezaazune bamaqaawameme 'anedaaceme 'ategoduteme. 'eresu kanaaneta yatabeqaaqaa nawe. 'enaaneta ka'eresu kajaayoce naacehu. 'eresu 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayesaanaweme. yaalanaanetame 'emenatune 'enaa nabiyune maredaate caaye nawe.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! 'enaaneta male'eketanyaawene yamaateradu, ba'alaahe manegade lamataagaleme theri siyaaqarebelaacehu malese yamaatesathute betehonu, 'enanyaa yakaadute sawoce kamakaa baasewathute gizee 'eresume yahulate hulatanyaa hono bawaashaawe wesethe tadabeqawe banabaru 'enaa labaaledarabaawe (la'abubakare) 'atetakeze ('alaahe ba'eredaataawe kanyaa gaare nawe) baalawe gizee baregethe radetotaale. 'alaaheme maragaagaatune baresu bamale'eketanyaawe laaye 'awarada. 'enaaneta bamaataayuwaacawe szaraawite (bamalaa'ekete) radaawe. ya'enanyaane yakahadiwocune yakehedate qaale yabataace 'adaraga. ya'alaahe qaale selaame 'eresu yabalaaye ('ashanaafi) nawe. 'alaaheme thalaatocune 'ashanaafi bahegegaatu bamafetharume thebabanyaa nawe.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! baqelelateme bakebedateme, bamecoteme, bacheneqateme, bawathaatenateme, bashemegelenaame ba'alaahe manegade lamawaagaate wethu. baganezabocaacehume banafesocaacehume taagalu. yametaawequ betehonu yehe ba'alaahe manegade mawethaate 'enaa baganezabeme banafeseme mataagale baziheme bamachiweme `aalame ganezabaacawene 'enaa nafesaacawene lamaadaane beete kataqamathute yatashaala nawe. yeheneneme kaawaqaacehu baresu laaye tasheqadaadamu.

'enanyaa 'asemasaayoce wadaxwaalaa lamaqerate 'anetane yaasefaqadubate, 'aneta 'enaresune yatharaahebate tegele baqalaalu yamiganye mereko, dekaameme yaleelabate guzo bihone noro yekataluhe nabare. gene, yatharaahebaacawe yategele manegade raaqabaacawe 'enaa wada xwaalaa qaru. 'enanyaame kategelu wada xwaalaa yaqarute wadanaresu setemalase - <<ba'alaahe yehunebene! kanaaneta gaare mawethaate benecele noro 'enewathaa nabare>> bamaalate yemelaalu. kategele bamaqerataacawe 'enaa baweshateme bamamaalaacawe mekeneyaate raasaacawene lathefaate yedaaregaalu. 'alaaheme 'enaresu weshataamoce mahonaacawene yaaweqaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kategele wadaxwaalaa lamaqerataacawe feqaade masethatehene 'alaahe yeqere belohale. mekeneyaate bamaaqerabaacawe 'ewenatanyocu kaweshataamocu 'esekilayulehe weshataamocuneme 'eseketaaweqe derase lamene faqadekelaacawe? kaziyaame weshatanyocune tetahe la'ewenatanyocu tefaqede zanede gudaayu saayegalathe lamene faqadeke?

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa ba'alaahe 'enaa bamacharashaawe qane ba'ewenate yamiyaamenute me'emanaane baganezabocaacawe 'enaa baneberatocaacawe ba'alaahe manegade kamataagale lamaqerate 'ayaasefaqeduheme. magalachaacawe lategele wethu setelaacawe mawethaate nawe. 'alaaheme kalekaaye cegere kaalegathamaacawe basetaqare kategele meedaa wadaxwaalaa yamaayeqarutene 'eresune fari baarocune `aawaaqi nawe.

'enaho ba'alaahe manegade kamataagale lamaqerate kaaneta feqaade yamithayequte 'enanyaa ba'alaahe 'enaa bamacharashaawe qane yamaayaamenute 'asemasaayocu, lebocaacaweme ba'alaahe haayemaanote laaye bamatharaathare talakefawaale. 'enaresume batherethaareewocaacawe wesethe yewaalelaalu. (wada tekekelanyaawe manegade 'ayemarume.)

ba'alaahe manegade lamataagale kaaneta gaare lamawathaate 'enefalegaalane bamilawe negegeraacawe 'ewenatanyoce bihonu noro lamawethaate zegejete baasanaadu nabare. gene 'alaahe kaaneta gaare mawethaataacawene thalaa mawethaatene 'akabadabaacawe, 'asanafaacawe. babeetocaacawe kataqamathute sawoce gaare hunu tabaalu.

'enanyaa 'asemasaayoce kategele meedaa maqerataacawe 'amaanyocene baasetakaza gizee 'alaahe mawethaataacawe kamaqerataacawe yabalatha goji 'enedahona bamaaberaaraate 'aragaagaacawe. 'enediheme 'ala -
'enazihe 'asemasaayoce kanaaneta gaare 'alamawethaataacawe malekaame nawe. kanaaneta gaare biwathu noro salefene bamalayaayate 'enaa maasemasayaaneme bamaamethaate thefaate 'eneji leelaa 'ayechamerulaacehume. 'enaanetaneme lamanathaathale waree lamaazaamate yefathenaalu. kanaaneta makaakale 'enaresu yamiyaasaraachutene weshate 'enaa yafatanaa qaale yamiyaadaamethu 'enaa yamiyaasaraachu 'alu. kaziyaame bamahakalaacehu bahasaabe malayaayate yemathaale. 'alaaheme ba'amaanyoce makaakale therethaareene 'enaa yamiyaachaqaacheqe wareene yamiyaasaraachutene badaayoce `aawaaqi nawe.

'enanyaa 'asemasaayoce katabuke zamacaa bafite ya'amaanyocene qaale bamanathaathale, 'anedenataacaweneme bamalayaayate baregethe fatanaa falegawe nabare. 'anetaneme lategele lamawethaate yaalahene qurethanyenate lamaaseqayare zadeewocene bamaqayase nagarocene galebethawelehe 'enaa 'asefetawelehe nabare. kaziyaame ya'alaahe 'eredaataa 'enaa 'egazaa mathaa, 'enaresume 'eyathalute 'alaahe 'emenatune 'ashanaafi 'adaragawe; thalaatocune 'awaarada. 'enaresu weshate ba'ewenate laaye delene 'enediqadaaje falaagiwoce nabaru.

kamanaafeqaane makaakale yatalayaayu yawushate mekeneyaatocene bamaaqerabe 'enedihe yamile yeganyaale - <<ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa hoye! kategele meedaa 'enedeneqare feqaade sethanye; yathalaate seetocene (romaawiyaanene) simalakate fataanye bamahonaacawe mekeneyaate hathi'ate 'enedaalenakaa ('enedaayenakaanye) ka'aneta gaare (wada tegele 'enedewathaa) 'ataasegadedanye!>> 'asetawelu! kamogatute yabalatha fatanaa laaye (nifaaqe laayenaa kategele meedaa wada xwaalaa maqerate laaye) wadaqu. batenesaa'ee `elate jahaname kahadiyaanene yaakababa nawe. kanaresu 'anedeme 'ayaalefaweme. kaziyaa yamiyaamalethubatene 'ayaaganyume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! dele wayeneme merekone yamasalu yamiyaasedasetu ya'alaahe tzagaawoce siyaaganyuhe yehene yethalaalu. 'asecagaari huneetaa wayeneme bathalaate dele mahonene yamasalu fatanaawoce siyaagaathemuhe 'enaziyaa manaafeqaane 'enedihe yelaalu:- <<'amaanyoce lategele 'enedawathute (lategele) baalamawethaate lanafesaacene theneqaaqeene 'adereganaale. qurethanyenatene yezanaale.>>

male'eketanyaacene hoye! la'enaziyaa manaafeqaane 'enedihe bale:- <<'alaahe la'enyaa katzaafawe (kawasanawe) weche (basetaqare) leelaa nagare 'ayenakaaneme. 'eresu kagudelate theraate yatagabaawe 'alaahe 'alaqaacene (geetaacene) 'enaa wada 'eresu yamenemalasebate mathagiyaacene nawe. 'enyaa sela gudaayaacene ba'eresu laaye tamaketanaale.>> 'amaanyoce gudaayaacawene hulu wada 'eresu becaa yaasethagaalu. 'eresu yebaqaacawaale; yaamaara mamakiyaa nawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'enediheme balaacawe - <<delene maagenyate wayeneme samaa`ete mahone ba'enyaa laaye 'esekikasate derase nawene yametethabequte? 'enyaa 'alaahe ka'eresu zanede yahona qethaate 'esekiyaawaredebaacehunaa 'esekiyaathafaacehu wayeneme 'enaanetane mataagale sifaqedelene bamotenaa bamereko ba'enyaa 'eje 'esekiqathaacehu derase 'enethabeqaalane. macharashaacenene thabequ; macharashaacehune 'enethabeqaalane.>>

male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<bafeqaadanyenatenaa bagedeetaa yametaafasutene (yametaawathutene) ganezabaacehune 'afesesu ('awethu). bakehedataacehunaa ka'alaahe te`ezaaze bamawethaataacehu yasathaacehutene bafetzume 'ayeqabalaacehume.>>

metzewaataacawe (legasaacawe) taqabaayenate 'enedaayaaganye yakalakalaacawe szosete nagaroce naacawe: 'alaahenaa male'eketanyaawene makaadaacawe; sisagedu bamasaanafaacawenaa bamataakataacawe, 'enedihume ganezabaacawene baraase feqaadanyenate yamaayelagesunaa bagedeetaa yamilagesu bamahonaacawe (nawe); mekeneyaatume basalaataacaweme hona balegasaacawe (ya'alaahene) menedaa 'ayaasebume ('ayemanyume).

male'eketanyaacene hoye! yamanaafeqaane ganezabe (habete)naa lejocaacawe 'ayaasedamemehe. malekaame 'aderegahe 'atemalekatawe. yaganezabaacawenaa yalejocaacawe macharashaa mathefo nawe. bakehedate laaye 'eyaalu 'alaahe nafesaacawene 'esekiyaawathaawenaa ba'esaate yamacharashaawe zeqethate wesethe bazala`aalamaawinate 'esekiqathu derase, (habetenaa lejoce) lamaagenyate bamiyaadaregute wethaa weradenaa lefaate 'enedihume (bahabetaacawenaa balejocaacawe) bamiyaawaredebaacawe cegeroce 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye (habetaacawenaa lejocaacawe) qethaate 'enedihonubaacawe yaadaregaacawaale.

'amaanyoce hoye! manaafeqaane ka'enaaneta makaakale 'enedahonu bahasate yemelulaacexwaale. meneme 'enekwaa ka'enaaneta gaare 'enedahonu kalaaye geletze biyaadaregume bawesethaacawe ka'enaaneta gaare 'ayedalume. nagare gene 'enaresu ba'agaariyaane laaye yatakasatawene `aayenate motenaa mereko ba'enaresume laaye 'enedaayekasate yefaraalu. selaziheme latheneqaaqee muselimenataacawene! geletze yaadaregaalu.

'enaziyaa manaafeqaane raasaacawene yamithabequbate mathagiyaa meshege, wayeneme yamidabaqubate bataraaroce laaye yamiganye waashaa, wayeneme yamigabubate yamareete sere magwaazhaa gudegwaade biyaaganyu wadaziyaa yethagunaa bafethenate yegabu nabare.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! kamanaafeqaane makaakale bametzewaate kefefele waqete yamifalegutene saayaaganyu siqaru yamiyaanaweruhe yeganyaalu. kametzewaate yathayaqutene setesathaacawe 'anetane yewadaalu. yathayaqutene saatesathaacawe seteqare waqasaacawene, kefaataacawenenaa besechetaacawene geletze yaadaregaalu.

bametzewaate kefefele yamiyaanaweruhe 'enazihe manaafeqaane: 'alaahe la'enaresu yawasanalaacawene 'enedihume male'eketanyaawe yasathaacawene biwadedunaa <<'alaahe baqiyaacene nawe, kacerotaawe yafaqadawene yesathanaale, male'eketanyaaweme 'alaahe kasathawe yesathanaale, 'enyaa kacerotaawe 'enedisathane ka'alaahe becaa 'enefalegaalane>> bilunaa yehene bifatzemu 'anetane kamaanaware yeshaalaacawe nabare.

ya'alaahene male'eketanyaa bametzewaate kefefele siyaanaweru male`eketanyaawene lamaatheraate 'alaahe metzewaate wachi yamihonebatene manegade lametzewaate tagabi yamihonu 'akaalaatene 'enedamikatalawe galatza.
yagedeetaa zakaawoce ladahawoce lisathu yegabaale. (dahawoce maalate) bamuyaacawe szaretawe, wayeneme baleelaa szeraa ganezabe yaalaacawe nagare gene yamiyaaganyute ganezabe yamaayebaqaacawenaa tekurate yamaayesathaacawe (cegeraacawene geletze yamaayaawathu) 'eredaataa falaagiwoce naacawe. lamesekinoce meneme neberate yaleelaacawe bahuneetaacawe wayeneme banegegeraacawe mekeneyaate (cegeranyoce mahonaacawe) kasawoce yamaayesaware yahonu naacawe; bazakaa masabesabe szeraa laaye latasamaaru yamuselimoce mari yazakaane ganezabe 'enedisabasebu lamiyaasamaaraacawe sawoce; lakahadiyaane selaamene 'enediqabalu lamaabarataataatenaa lamadaga, selaamene 'enedilamaamadu lamaaderage, 'enedihume 'emenataacawe dakaamaa yahonabaacawe sawoce 'emenataacawe 'enedithanakere; labaariyaawoce kabaarenate qanebare raasaacawene natzaa 'enediyaawathu lamaagazenaa lamaaderage; kahathi'atenaa kabekenate wechi bahona huneetaa ba`edaa latazafaqunaa yaalabaacawene `edaa mamalase latasaanaacawe sawoce; ba'alaahe manegade laaye yamitaagalu sawocene lamaazagaajate; bamanegade laaye (baguzo laaye) seneqe lataqwaarathabaacawe sawoce; zakaane kalaaye latathaqasute becaa masethate 'alaahe yaaseqamathawe gedeetaa nawe. 'alaahe lasawoce thaqaami yahonawene yaaweqaale. bahegegaatocunaa nagarocene bamaasetanaabaru thebabanyaa nawe.

kamanaafeqaane makaakale ya'alaahene male'eketanyaa banegegere yamiyaasecageru yeganyaalu. yamale'eketanyaawene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) taagaashenatene simalakatu <<'eresu huluneme yaadamethaale; 'ewenate nawe belo yeqabalaale; hhasatenaa 'ewenate malayate 'ayeceleme.>> bamaalate yenaagaraalu. male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<male'eketanyaawe malekaamene 'eneji leelaa 'ayaadametheme; 'alaahene 'ewenate yelaale; 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyoce yaminagerutene 'ewenate yelaale; yaazenelaacawaale.>> (yamale'eketanyaawe) malaake ba'eresu laamanabate 'ezenate nawe. bamaanenyaaweme `aayenate 'asecagaari nagaroce male'eketanyaawene yamiyaasecageru (sawoce) 'asaamaami qethaate yethabeqaacawaale.

'amaanyoce hoye! manaafeqaane nabiyune yamiyaasecagere (yamiyaasekafaa) 'anedeme nagare 'enedaaletanaagaru ba'alaahe yemelulaacexwaale. yehene yamiyaadaregute 'enaresune 'enedetewadu nawe. 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyoce kahonu ba'emenatenaa bamalekaame szeraa 'alaahenaa male'eketanyaawene 'enediwadu maaderage yebalethe nabare.

'enaziyaa manaafeqaane bazihe tagebaaraacawe 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene yamithalu (thalaate 'aderegawe yamiyezu) mahonaacawene 'enedihume 'alaahenenaa male`eketanyaawene thalaate 'aderego yamiyeze batenesaa'ee `elate bajahaname 'esaate wesethe lazala`aalame 'enediqoye yamigabaa mahonune 'ayaawequmene!? yehe teleqe weredate nawe.

manaafeqaane yamidabequtene kehedate la'amaanyoce yamiyaawathaabaacawene yaqure'aane me`eraafe 'alaahe bamale'eketanyaawe laaye 'enedaayaawarede yefaraalu. male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe:- <<manaafeqaane hoye! ba'emenate laaye yametefatzemutene feezenaa naqafaa qathelu; 'alaahe yaqure'aane me`eraafene bamaawerade wayeneme lamale'eketanyaawe bamanegare yametefarutene geletze yaawathaawaale.>>

male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'alaahe kanagarahe (kaasaawaqahe) baxwaalaa manaafeqaane 'amaanyocene bamaanawarenaa bamasedabe selatanaagarute betethayeqaacawe 'enedihe yelaalu - <<bawaree wesethe 'eyaqaladene nabare. yameraacenene 'alenabarame ('ayedalame).>> male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'enedihe bale <<ba'alaahe, ba'aneqatzocunaa bamale'eketanyaawe taafeezu nabarene?>>

lazihe hhasatanyaa nagare mekeneyaate 'ataaqerebu. bafeezaacehu qademo tedabequte yanabarawene kehedataacehune yefaa 'awethetaacehutaale. nefeqenaane bamatawaacawenaa kanefeqenaa baneseha bamamalasaacawe 'enedihume la'alaahe becaa fetzume taazaazhe bamahonaacahu ka'enaaneta kafilocune benaalefeme ka'enaaneta kafilocu banefeqenaa laaye getere honawe bamaqathalaacawe, kanefeqenaa baneseha baalamamalasaacawe mekeneyaate 'eneqathaacawaalane.

manaafeqaane wanedoceme seetocume banefeqenaa huneetaa laaye yatasemaamu naacawe. ka'amaanyoce bataqaaraani huneetaa laaye yeganyaalu. bamathefo nagare yaazezaalu; kamalekaame nagare yekalakelaalu; ganezabaacawene yesasetaalu; ba'alaahe manegade laaye 'ayelagesuteme. la'alaahe taazaazhe mahone tetawaale; 'alaahe sekeetune kamasethate tawaacawe; manaafeqaane ka'alaahe te`ezaazenaa ka'ewenate manegade wada hathi'atenaa themate manegade yawathu naacawe.

'alaahe: baneseha yaaletamalasu manaafeqaanenenaa kahadiyaanene baziyaa wesethe zala`aalame 'enediqoyu wada jahaname 'esaate 'enedamiyaasegabaacawe qatherwacawaale. jahaname baqi qethaate yehonaacawaale; 'alaahe ka'ezenatu 'abaarerwacawaale. yamaayaaqwaarethe qethaate yaaganyaalu.

yamanaafeqaane sebeseboce hoye! bakehedataacehunaa bamaafeezaacehu ka'enaaneta bafite yaasetabaabalu hhezebocene temaselaalaacehu ka'enaaneta yagazafa xaayele, ka'enaaneta yabazaa ganezabenaa lejoce nabarwacawe. kamederaawi heyewate dasetaawocenaa yasemeete zenebaaleewoce yatatzaafalaacawene dereshaa fanathazu (tathaqamu). manaafeqaane hoye! yaqadamu 'asetabaabaaye hhezeboce badereshaacawe 'enedafanathazu ('enedatathaqamu) 'enaanetame batatzaafalaacehu dereshaa fanethezu (tathaqamu). (qadamete 'asetabaabaaye hhezeboce) male'eketanyaacawene hasate bamaalatenaa bamaanaware 'enedatazafaqute, 'enaanetame 'ewenatene hasate bamaalate male'eketanyaawene bamaanaware (bamaneqafe) wesethe tazafaqaacehu. bazihe tawaqaashe (weguze) baaheri yamigalatzu sawoce bakehedate 'alaahe zanede szeraawocaacawe yatabalaashubaacawe naacawe. (nafesocaacawene) wada thefaate 'azaqete bamaawerade raasaacawene (nafesocaacawene)yaakasaru naacawe.

'enazihe manaafeqaane ka'alaahe yamathaalaacawene male'ekete 'enaa male'eketanyaacawene hasate yaalu teweledoce (hhezeboce) yafatzamute tagebaarenaa ba'enaresu laaye yatafatzamawene qethaate zeenaa 'aledarasaacawemene?! yanuhhe hhezeboce, yahude hhezeboce, yaswalihhe hhezeboce, yaberaahime hhezeboce, yamadeyane nawaariwoce, yaluthe hhezeboce manedare male'eketanyocaacawe geletze maaserajaawocenaa, ba'asaamaanye makaraakariyaawoce (`eweqatoce) wada 'enaresu mathetawelaacawe nabare. 'alaahe yamibadelaacawe 'alenabarame. male'eketanyocaacawe 'asethaneqeqawaacawe nabare; nagare gene banabarubate ya'alaahe kehedatenaa male'eketanyaawene hasate yamaalate (yamaasetabaabale) mekeneyaate nafesocaacawene yebadelu nabare.

wanede 'amaanyocenaa seete 'amaanyoce 'emenate yasabasabaacawe bamahonu kafilocu yakafilocu radaatenaa dagaafiwoce naacawe. bamalekaame yaazezaalu, (malekaame maalate 'alaahene babecanyenate maamelakenaa salaatene yamasalu 'eresune ('alaahene) kamataazaze 'anetzaare yamifatzemute 'alaahe yamiwadaacawe huluneme `aayenate nagaroce maalate nawe) kamathefo yekalakelaalu (mathefo maalate hathi'ate kehedatenaa waladene yamasalu huluneme `aayenate 'alaahe yamithalaacawe nagaroce maalate nawe) salaataacawene batamwalaa huneetaa batagabiwe manegade yefatzemaalu; 'alaahene yetaazazaalu; male'eketanyaawene yetaazazaalu; ba'enedazihe `aayenate yatamasaganu baaheriyaatoce yamigalatzu sawoce 'alaahe wada 'ezenatu yaasegabaacawaale. 'alaahe 'ashanaafi nawe; 'anedeme yamiyaashanefawe yalame; bafetherataatu, bamaasetanaabarunaa, badenegaageewocu thebabanyaa nawe.

'alaahe baresu lamiyaamenu lawanede 'amaanyocenaa laseete 'amaanyoce batenesaa'ee `elate kahenetzaawocwa sere wanezoce yamifasubaate janatene baziyaa wesethe zala`aalamaawi 'enedihonu 'enedamiyaasegabaacawe qaale kidaane sathetwacawaale. bajanate wesethe 'ayemotume; yamiyaaganyute tzagaame 'ayeqwaaratheme; bamanoriyaa janatoce malekaame beetoce wesethe 'enedamiyaasegabaacawe qaale kidaane sathetwacawaale. kazihe hulu dagemo 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye yamiyaadaregawe wedeetaawe yebalethaale. yehe yatathaqasawe menedaa 'anedeme `aayenate sekeete yamaayeqarebawe taalaaqe sekeete nawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! kahadiyaanene baxaayele taagalaacawe. manaafeqaanene bagalatzaanaa ba`eweqate taagalaacawe. bahulatume laaye beretu hune. yehe yegabaacawaale. batenesaa'ee `elate maarafiyaacawe jahaname nawe. mamalashaacawe yakafaa nawe.

sela 'enaresu yadarasahe 'anetane mazelafaacawenaa 'emenatehene maanawaraacawene 'enedaaletanaagaru ba'alaahe bahhasate yemelaalu. sela 'enaresu yadarasahene kahadi yamiyaadaregaacawene nagare ba'eregethe tanaagerawaale. 'emenatene kaasaayu baxwaalaa kehedataacawene yefaa 'aderegawaale. yaalaasaakutene (yaalaaganyutene) nabiyune maatheqaatene (banabiyu laaye gudaate maaderasene) 'asabu. liqaawamute yamaayegabaane nagare 'eneji leelaane nagare 'aletaqaawamume. yekxaweme 'alaahe lanabiyu kalagasaacawe mereko la'enaresu habete bamasethate cerotaawene ba'enaresu laaye maaderagu nawe. kanefeqenaacawe baneseha wada 'alaahe bimalasu nesehacawe banefeqenaa laaye kamaqathale la'enaresu yatashaala nawe. wada 'alaahe baneseha kamamalase jarebaacawene biyaazoru ('alaahe) bamederaawi heyewate bamotenaa bamereko 'asaamaami qethaatene yeqathaacawaale. 'enedazihume bamacharashaawe `aalameme ba'esaate 'asaamaami qethaate yeqathaacawaale. yamiradaacawenaa kaqethaate yamiyaadenaacawe radaate, qethaatene kanaresu laaye yamikalaakale 'agaazhe 'ayenoraacaweme.

<<'alaahe kacerotaawe kasathane lacegeranyoce metzewaatene 'enesathaalane; tagebaaraacawe katasetakaakala malekaame sawoce 'enehonaalane>> bamaalate kamanaafeqaane makaakale la'alaahe qaale kidaane yasatha 'ala.

'alaahe kacerotaawe sisathaacawe la'alaahe yasathutene qaale kidaane 'alethabaqume. yelequneme ganezabaacawene sasatu. meneme `aayenate metzewaatene (legasaane) 'alesathume. ka'emenate 'afanegethawe jarebaacawene 'azoru.
ya'alaahene qaale kidaane bamaaferasaacawenaa bahasataacawe 'enediqathu qethaataacawene balebonaacawe wesethe 'eseka tenesaa'ee `elate derase tzaneto yamiqoye nefeqenaane ('alaahe) 'adaraga.

manaafeqaane baweyeyete maderakaacawe (bamiqamathubaacawe seferaawoce) yamidabequtene seeraanaa tanekole 'alaahe yamiyaaweqenaa 'enaa 'alaahe yaruqene misethire yamiyaaweqe (yamaayesawarebate) mahonune 'ayaawequmene!? kaszeraawocaacawe 'anedeme nagare 'ayesawarebateme. baziyaame yaszeraacawene waagaa yesathaacawaale.

'aqemaacawe yacaalawene yaahele theqitene 'eneji leelaane maagenyate yamaayecelu theqitene yaahele metzewaate yasathu bago feqaadanyaa 'amaanyocene yamiyaanaweru (manaafeqaane) <<yehe metzewaataacawe (legasaacawe) mene faayedaa 'alawe?>> bamaalate ba'enaresu laaye yaafeezaalu. ba'amaanyoce laaye bamaafeezaacawe bamelaashu 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye yaafeezebaacawaale. 'asaamaami qethaateme yethabeqaacawaale.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! la'enaresu meheratene betethayeqelaacaweme, baatethayeqelaacaweme, sabaa yaahele gizee meheratene betethayeqelaacawe, yehe meneme yaahele bezu bihone 'enaresu 'alaahenaa male'eketanyaawene yakaadu bamahonaacawe la'enaresu ya'alaahene meherate bafetzume 'ataadareseme. 'alaahe kamamariyaawe (kahegegaatu) bamaawaqe hone belawe yawathu sawocene 'ewenatene yamaagenyate sekeetene 'ayesathaacaweme.

'enazihene kategele wada xwaalaa yaqaru manaafeqaane bathafiwe mederaawi `aalame wesethe theqite yaahele yesaaqu. bamederaawi heyewate bafatzamute kehedate hathi'atenaa wanejale mekeneyaate zala`aalamaawi bahonawe yamacharashaawe `aalame bezu yaalaqesaalu.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'alaahe banefeqenaacawe laaye tzenu honawe wada qoyu kafile manaafeqaane kamalasahenaa baleelaa zamacaa ka'aneta gaare 'aberawe lamawethaate feqaade kathayaquhe 'enedihe balaacawe <<manaafeqaane hoye! qethaate 'enedihonaacehunaa ka'enee gaare bamahonaacehu yamikatalawene thefaate lamathaneqaqe ka'enee gaare ba'alaahe manegade laaye lamataagale bafetzume 'atewathume. katabuke zamacaa wada xwaalaa maqeratenaa maqamathene wadaacexwaale. wada xwaalaa kamiqaru hemametanyoce, seetocenaa hetzaanaate gaare 'aberaacehu taqamathu; qoyu.>>

'alaahe ba'eresu nabiye muhhamade laaye ba'alaahe yamaamanenaa ba'eresu manegade laaye yamataagale te`ezaazene yaaqafa yaqure'aane me`eraafene siyaawarede ka'enaresu baala habetocenaa mecote laaye yamiganyute ka'aneta (tanathelawe) wada xwaalaa lamaqerate feqaade yethayeqaalu. 'enediheme yelaalu - <<mekeneyaate katasathaacawe 'aqema dakaamoce gaare wada xwaalaa 'enedeneqare tawane.>>

'enazihe manaafeqaane mekeneyaate katasathaacawe sawoce gaare wada xwaalaa maqeratene simarethu lanafesocaacawe weredatenaa zeqethatene wadadu. bakehedataacawenaa banefeqenaacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe lebocaacawene dafanabaacawe. thaqameetaacawe (yamithaqemaacawe) nagare yamiganyebatene 'ayaawequme.

male'eketanyaanaa 'amaanyoce gene 'enedanaresu ba'alaahe manegade laaye kamataagale wada xwaalaa 'aleqarume. yelequneme baganezabocaacawenaa banafesocaacawe ba'alaahe manegade laaye taagalu. 'alaahe zanede yanabaraacawe menedaame mederaawi theqemenaa yamacharashaawene `aalame sekeete maagenyate hona.

'alaahe kahenetzaawocwa sere wanezoce yamifasubaatene janate baziyaa wesethe lazala`aalame 'enediqoyu 'azagaajetolaacawaale. mote 'ayaaganyaacaweme. yehe wetheete (menedaa) 'anedeme `aayenate madehene yamaayeqarebawe taalaaqe madehene nawe.

bamadinaanaa bazuriyaawaa yamiganyu gathareewocenaa nawaariwoce ya'alaahene male'eketanyaa ba'alaahe manegade laaye lamataagale kamawethaate feqaade 'enedisathwacawe mekeneyaate lamaaqerabe wada 'alaahe male'eketanyaa mathu. leeloce sawoce dagemo nabiyune 'ewenate baalamaalataacawenaa ba'alaahe qatharo baalamaamanaacawe kamanashaaweme mekeneyaate 'alaaqarabume. 'enazihene bazihe kehedataacawe mekeneyaate 'asaamaami qethaate yaaganyaacawaale.

seetoce, hetzaanaate, hememetanyaa, shemaageleewoce, `aayena seweraane, raasaacawene lamaazagaajate yamiyaasefalegaacawene ganezabe yamaayaaganyu sawoce 'enazihe hulu baalamawethaataacawe hathi'ate yalabaacaweme. mekeneyaatume hasaabaacawene la'alaahenaa lamale'eketanyaawe netzuhe kaadaragunaa ba'alaahe mamariyaawoce kaszaru taqabaayenate yaalawe mekeneyaate 'alaacawe. 'enedazihe yaalu baala mekeneyaatoce malekaamocu laaye (ya'alaahe) qethaate ba'enaresu laaye yamihonebate manegade yalame. 'alaahe yamalekaame szariwocene hathi'ate mahari nawe. la'enaresume 'azaanye nawe.

'enedazihume male'eketanyaacene hoye! yamigwaagwaazubatene magwaagwaazhaa mathetawe yathayaquhenaa yameteheedubate magwaagwaazhaa 'alaaganyeme bamaalate yanagarekaacawe baraasaacawe wayeneme 'aneta zanede yamiyaawathutene wachi maagenyate baalamacaalaacawe bahazane `aayenocaacawe 'enebaa 'eyaafasasu yatamalasunaa ka'aneta tanathelawe baqarute laaye hathi'ate yalame.

qethaatenaa tathayaaqinate manegade yaminorawe (male'eketanyaacene hoye) yamizagaajubate yatamwalaa bamahonu 'eyacaalu kategele wada xwaalaa lamaqerate 'anetane feqaade yamithayequ naacawe. beete wesethe kamiqaru sawoce gaare bamaqerate lanafesocaacawe weredatene marathu. 'alaahe lebonaacawene dafenotaale. gesaatzee tatze'eno 'ayaasaaderebateme. bazihe yalebocaacawe madafane mekeneyaate yamithaqemaacawene maawaqenaa mamerathe, yamigodaacaweneme maraaqe 'ayecelume.

muselimoce kategele simalasu kategele wada xwaalaa yaqaru manaafeqaane dakaamaa mekeneyaatocene yaaqarebaalu. 'alaahe ya'eresune nabiyenaa 'amaanyocene malese 'enedisathu yaazezaacawaale. hasatanyaa mekeneyaatocene 'ataaqerebu; yanagaraacehunene bafetzume 'anaameneme. banafesocaacehu wesethe yamiganyutene kafile nagaroce 'alaahe 'asaaweqonaale. 'alaahenaa male'eketanyaawe yemalakataalu; neseha 'aderegaacehu, 'alaahe nesehacehune yeqabale yehone? wayenese banefeqenaacehu laaye teqathelaalaacehu? kaziyaame huluneme nagare wada miyaaweqawe 'alaahe temalasunaa seteszarute selanabarawe tagebaare yenageraacexwaale. baziyaame yaszeraacehune waagaa yesathaacexwaale. wada nesehanaa malekaame szeraawoce tashaqadaadamu.

'enazihe wada xwaalaa yaqaru manaafeqaane 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce wada 'enaresu setemalasu waqasaanaa wegezate 'enedaataadaresubaacawe bamaferaate hasatanyaa mekeneyaatocene lamaaragaagathe ba'alaahe seme yemelaalu. deregitaacawene bamathelaate tawaacawe. jarebaacehune sethwacawe. 'enaresu wesethaacawe yatabakalanaa yaqoshasha sawoce naacawe. selafatzamute nefeqenaanaa hathi'ate menedaa maarafiyaacawe jahaname nawe.

'amaanyoce hoye! 'enazihe wada xwaalaa yaqaru manaafeqaane 'enaanetane lamaasewadadenaa mekeneyaataacawene 'enedeteqabalwacawe lamaaderage yemelaalu. ka'enaresu 'atewedadu; ka'enaresu kawadadaacehu geetaacehune taqaarenaacexwaale. 'eresu ('alaahe geetaacehu) bakehedatenaa banefeqenaa kate`ezaazu yamiwathu sawocene 'ayewademe. muselimoce hoye! 'alaahe yamaayewadawene sawe kamawedade tathaneqaqu.

yagathare sawoce sikedunaa banefeqenaa wesethe sigabu kehedataacawenaa nefeqenaacawe yakatamaa nawaari kahonu leeloce sawoce yabalatha yakafaa nawe. nefeqenaacawe kanazihe nefeqenaa yethanakeraale. la'emenate `eweqate 'alebaanate yabalatha yaqarabu naacawe. bamiganyubate daraqenaa yakarara chekaanee huneetaanaa maahebaraawi wehedataacawe (kasawoce gaare yaalaacawe maahebaraawi wehedatenaa qeleqele) 'anasetanyaa bamahonu mekeneyaate 'alaahe bamale'eketanyaawe laaye yaawaradaacawene gedeetaawoce, yaheyewate falagoce, yahegegaate marehoce laalamaawaqe yaqarabu naacawe. 'alaahe huneetaacawene yaaweqaale. kahuneetaacawe 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayesawarebateme. bahegegaatocunaa bamaasetanaabarume thebabanyaa nawe.

kagathare nawaari manaafeqaane makaakale ba'alaahe manegade laaye yamiyaawathaawene ganezabe balegasaawe ya'alaahene menedaa 'enedamaayaaganyenaa ganezabe kamaawethaate biqothabe 'alaahe 'enedamaayeqathaawe bamagamatu mekeneyaate 'eneda keseratenaa `edaa yamiyaasebe 'ala. kaziheme gaare gene 'anedaanedee latheneqaaqee (laraasu shefaane lamasethatenaa) la'eyulenye ganezabe yaawathaale. ba'enaaneta 'amaanyoce laaye tanekole (kefu nagare) 'enedidaresebaacehunaa 'enaanetane liyaathafaacehu yethabaabaqaale. yelequneme manaafeqaane ba'amaanyoce laaye 'enedidarese yamifalegutene (yamimanyutene) tanekolenaa macharashaawe mesegune yaalehona yagizee malawaawathe ba'amaanyoce laaye saayehone ba'enaresu (bamanaafeqaane) laaye 'enedikasate 'alaahe 'adaraga. 'alaahe yametenaagarutene yesamaale; bawesethaacehu yameteyezutene yaaweqaale.

kagathare sawoce ba'alaahe yamiyaamene, bamacharashaawe qane (batenesaa'ee `elate) yamiyaamene, ba'alaahe manegade laaye yamilagesawene ganezabe wada 'alaahe maqaarabiyaa (malekaame szeraanaa) yamale'eketanyaawene du`aanaa meherate theyaqaa lamaagenyate yamiyaadarege 'ala. 'asetawelu! ba'alaahe manegade laaye malagasunaa la'eresu male'eketanyaawe yamiyaadaregulate du`aa wada 'alaahe yamiyaaqaarebawe nagare nawe. 'alaahe zanede yazihene menedaa yaaganyaale. 'alaahe meheratunaa janatune baaqafa safi 'ezenatu wesethe yaasegabaawaale. 'alaahe wada 'eresu baneseha yamimalasu 'agalegaayocene mahari nawe. la'enaresume ruheruhe nawe.

'enaziyaa baqedemiyaa wada 'emenate yamathu kasedatanyoce (kamuhajeroce) kahagaraacawenaa kamanedaraacawe wada 'alaahe yatasadadute, karadaatoce (degaafe 'aqeraabiwoce; ka'aneswaroce) nabiyune yaradute 'enedihume wada maane qadaami yahonute muhajerocenaa 'aneswarocene ba'emenate, banegegerenaa batagebaare bamalekaame huneetaa yatakatalu 'alaahe 'enaresune wadwale; malekaame szeraacaweneme taqabelwale. selasathaacaweme taalaaqe yaszeraa wetheete menedaa 'enaresume 'alaahene wadawaale. kahenetzaawocwa sere wanezoce yamifasubaatene janate 'azagaajetolaacawaale. baziyaa wesethe zawatere yeqoyaalu. taalaaqe madehene maalate yehe menedaa nawe.

kamadinaa qerebe kahonu yagathare nawaariwoce wesethe manaafeqaanoce yeganyaalu. kamadinaame nawaariwoce banefeqenaa laaye yaqathalu yatzanu manaafeqaane yeganyaalu. male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'aneta 'ataaweqaacaweme. 'alaahe nawe yamiyaaweqaacawe. 'alaahe hulate gizee yeqathaacawaale. 'anede gizee bamederaawi heyewate nefeqenaacawene yefaa bamaaderagenaa baleeloce nagaroce, baleelaa gizee dageme bamacharashaawe `aalame baqabere qethaate (yeqathaacawaale) kaziyaame batenesaa'ee `elate ba'esaate yamacharashaawe 'azaqete wesethe wada taalaaqe qethaate yemalasaalu.

kamadinaa nawaariwoce yaala mekeneyaate kazamacaa yaqaru leeloce sawoce yeganyaalu. yaqarubate mekeneyaate 'enedaalenabaraacawe balegasaacawe laaye maaragaagaachaa sathetawaale. hasatanyaa mekeneyaatoce yezawe 'alemathume. kazihe bafite 'alaahene bamataazaze ya'eresune hegegaatocene 'athebeqo bamayaaze, ba'eresu manegade laaye bamataagale yeszaru yanabarawene yaqadama malekaame szeraa bamathefo szeraa qalaaqalu. 'alaahe neseha 'enedisathaacawe hathi'ataacawene 'enediyaalefaacawe yemanyaalu. 'alaahe kabaariyaawocu wada 'eresu latamalasa mahari nawe. labaariyaawocume 'azaanye nawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! ba'eresu kahathi'atenaa kawanejale 'edefe (bekelate) yametaatzadaacawene, malekaame menedaacawene (szeraacawene) yametaasaadegebate (yametaadaaberebate) <<zakaane>> ('alaahe baqure'aane lazarazaraacawe semenete `aayenate yatalayaayu yasawe lejoce madabe yamisathe yagedeetaa metzewaatene) kaganezabaacawe taqabale. zakaawene kataqabaleke baxwaalaa du`aa 'aderegelaacawe. ya'aneta du`aa (tamaatzeno, lemanaa) la'enaresu 'ezenate 'enaa salaame nawe. 'alaahe tamaatzenohene yesamaahale. ya'enaresune szeraanaa hasaabeneme yaaweqaale.

kategele yaqarunaa wada 'alaahe baneseha yatamalasu sawoce 'alaahe wada 'eresu yamimalasu 'agalegaayocune neseha yamiqabale mahonune yewaqu. meneme 'enekwaa 'eresu yatabeqaaqaanaa habetaame bihoneme metzewaatocene yeqabalaale; metzewaate sachine sela metzewaatu yamalekaame szeraa menedaa yesathawaale. 'eresu kagudelate hulu yatharaa yahonawe 'alaahe kabaariyaawocu baneseha latamalasa sawe nesehane sachi nawe. la'enaresu ruheruhe nawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! kategele wada xwaalaa laqarutenaa kahathi'ataacawe baneseha latamalasute la'enazihe sawoce 'enedihe balaacawe - <<yaalafaacehune gudaate thagenu; szeraacehune la'alaahe becaa netzuhe 'aderegu; 'eresu yamiwadawene szeru". 'alaahe, male'eketanyaawenaa 'amaanyoce szeraacehune yemalakataalu. batenesaa'ee `elate huluneme wadamiyaaweqawe geetaacehu temalasaalaacehu. yameteszaruteneme, geletze yametaadareguteneme yaaweqaale. bamederaawi heyewate teszaru selanabarawe yenageraacexwaale. baziyaame menedaacehune yesathaacexwaale.>>

katabuke zamacaa kaqaru sawoce makaakale mekeneyaate yaalenabaraacawe leeloce sawoce yeganyaalu. 'enazihe la'alaahe wesaaneenaa ba'enaresu laaye lamisathawe ferede 'enedizagayu tadaregawaale. 'eresu ('alaahe) ba'enaresu laaye 'enedafaqadawe yefaredaale. wada 'eresu baneseha kaaletamalasu yeqathaacawaale; wayeneme neseha kaadaragu nesehane yesathaacawaale. 'alaahe ya'eresu qethaatenaa, ya'eresu yeqeretaa yamigabaawene yaaweqaale. badenegaageewocunaa bamaasetanaabaru thebabanyaa nawe. 'enazihe sawoce maraaraa benu rabi`e, ka`abe bene maalikenaa hilaale bine 'umayaa nabaru.

'enedazihume kamanaafeqaane makaakale 'alaahene kamataazaze (kamalekaame szeraa) wechi lahona gudaaye yelequneme muselimocene lamagudaate, yanefeqenaa baalabeetocene bamaathanaakare kehedatene yefaa lamaaderage, ('ashanaafinaa yabalaaye lamaaderage), ba'amaanyoce makaakale malayaayatene lamafethare, kamasejide genebaataa bafite 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene latawaagaa mazagaajiyaanaa mathabaqiyaa lamaaderage 'enaziyaa masejidene yaganabute yeganyaalu. 'enazihe manaafeqaane <<lamuselimoce reheraaheene 'eneji leelaane 'alaasabeneme>> bamaalate la'enaaneta yemelaalu. bazihe theriyaacawe hasatanyoce mahonaacawene 'alaahe yemasakeraale.

'aneta nabiye hoye! yehene `aayenate gatzetaa yaalawe masejide manaafeqaane ba'eresu wesethe 'enedetesagede yamiyaaqarebulehene theri 'ateqabale. kazihe bakehedate laaye katamaszarata masejide kamajamariyaawe (kamanashaawe jamero) 'aneseto simaszarate ba'alaahe feraacaa laaye yatamaszaratawe yaqubaa masejide ba'eresu wesethe masegadehe yabalatha nawe. baqubaa masejide wesethe ka'akaalaawi qoshaashaawoce baweha, kahathi'ate dagemo baneseha meheratene bamathayaqe netzuhe mahonene yamiwadu merethoce yeganyaalu. 'alaahe ka'akaalaawi qoshaashaawocenaa kahathi'ate netzuhe yahonu sawocene yewadaale.

ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatzame, kelekele yaadaragaacawene nagaroce bamaqothabe maszaratune ba'alaahe ferehaate laaye yamaszarata ya'alaahene wedeetaa lamaagenyate malekaame szeraawocene yaasafaa, muselimocene lamagudaatenaa kehedatene lamaathanekare 'enedihume ba'amaanyoce makaakale leyunatene lamafethare masejidene kaganabaa gaare 'ekule yehonaalene?! bafetzume 'ekule 'ayehonume. yamajamariyaawe maszaratu (genebaataawe) yathanakara nawe. yewadeqaale tabelo 'ayefaraalateme. yahulatanyaawe mesaalee dagemo bagadale (bagudegwaade) chaafe laaye maszaratune 'enedathaala nawe. maszaratu wada jahaname theleqate baresu laaye tanaadabate. bakehedate, banefeqenaanaa baleeloce nagaroce badalanyaa yahonu sawocene 'alaahe sekeete 'ayesathaacaweme.

lagudaatenaa latherethaaree banefeqenaa yaganabute masejidaacawe balebocaacawe wesethe matzenaatu bamote lebocaacawe 'esekiqorathu derase 'ayeqwaaratheme. 'alaahe yabaariyaawocune szeraa `aawaaqi nawe. bamalekaameme hona bamathefo selamifaredawe menedaa thebabanyaa nawe.

'alaahe kategele wada xwaalaa yaqaru manaafeqaanene kagalatza baxwaalaa ba'eresu manegade laaye yamitaagalu sawoce yamiyaaganyutene menedaa sithaqese 'enedihe 'ala.
'alaahe ka'amaanyoce ka'eresu bahona cerotaa nafesocaacawene bawede waagaa (bajanate) gazetwale meneme 'enekwaa 'enaresu raasaacawe yaresu neberate bihonume. ya'alaahe qaale yabalaaye 'enedihone kahadiyaane yetaagalaalu. 'alaahe bataweraate wesethe (lamusaa bawarada matsehhafe) banejile wesethe (la`isaa bawarada matsehhafe) 'enedihume baqure'aane (bamuhhamade laaye bawarada matsehhafe) selazihe 'ewenatanyaa qatharo sathetwale. ka'alaahe yabalatha qaale kidaanune yamiyaamwalaa 'anedeme yalame. 'amaanyoce hoye! ka'alaahe gaare selafatzamaacehute negede tadasatu. taalaaqe terefe 'agenyetaacexwaale. taalaaqe sekeete maalate yehe negede nawe.

yehene menedaa yamiyaaganyu sawoce 'alaahe kamithalaawenaa kamiqothaabate nagare wadamiwadawe tagebaare yamimalasu (yatamalasu) naacawe. la'alaahe ferehaate raasaacawene zeqe bamaaderage yaasaanasu naacawe. 'alaahene bamataazaze laaye therate yaadaregaalu. bahulume huneetaawoce geetaacawene yaamasagenaalu. tzomanyoce naacawe; sagaajoce naacawe. 'alaahe yaazazawene wayeneme male`eketanyaawe yaazazutene yaazezaalu. 'alaahe 'enaa male'eketanyaawe yakalakalutene yekalakelaalu. ya'alaahene te`ezaazaate bamakatale yethabeqaalu. kelekelocune yeqothabaalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bazihe baaheri yatagalatzu 'amaanyoce ba`aalamaawi (bamederaawi) heyewatenaa bamacharashaawe `aalame yamiyaasedasetaacawene 'enedamiyaaganyu negaraacawe.

lanabiyunaa la'amaanyoce meneme yaqerebe zamadocaacawe bihonu 'enekwaa ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaari 'aderegawe bamamotaacawenaa ya'esaate sawoce mahonaacawe katagalatzalaacawe baxwaalaa la'agaariyaane ka'alaahe meherate lithayequ 'ayegabaame.

beraahime (thaa`ote 'agaari lanabarawe) 'abaatu meherate yathayaqawe selaamene 'enediqabale bamamanyate meheratene 'enedamithayeqelate (la'abaatu) qaale kidaane selasatha nabare. 'abaatu mekere (gesaatzee) yamithaqemawe baalamahonu wayeneme bamalakotaawi male'ekete kahadi hono 'enedamimote siyaaweqenaa 'abaatu ya'alaahe thalaate mahonu geletze sihonelate ka'eresu (ka'abaatu) raasune 'araaqa. la'abaatu meheratene mathayaqu beraahime tekekelanyaa tagebaare 'enedahona yagamatawe hasaabe nabare. 'alaahe wada 'eresu yaawaradawene malakotaawi male'ekete lamatzaarare 'alenabarame. beraahime wada 'alaahe bezu tamaatzenone yamiyaabazaa, labadalanyaa hhezebocu bezu yeqere yamilenaa yamiyaalefe nabare.

kanaresu maqothabe gedeetaa yahonu kelekalaawocene 'esekamigaletzelaacawe derase yaqathetanyaawene manegade sekeete kasathaacawe baxwaalaa 'alaahe basawoce laaye themematene yamifarede 'ayedalame. kelekele 'enedaadaragawe kagalatzalaacawe baxwaalaa yakalakalawene sifatzemu themematene yefaredebaacawaale. 'alaahe bahulume nagare `aawaaqi nawe. 'anedeme nagare 'ayesawarebateme. ba'eregethe yamaataawequte yanabarawene 'asaaweqwaacexwaale.

'alaahe yasamaayaate negeszenaanaa yamedere negeszenaa ya'eresu nawe. ba'enaresu wesethe tagaari yalaweme. ba'enaresu wesetheme 'anedeme yamidabaqe nagare 'ayesawarebateme. yafaqadawene heyaawe yaadaregaale. yafaqadaweneme mute yaadaregaale. yasawe lejoce hoye! gudaayocene yamiqothaathare radaate ka'alaahe weche yalaacehume. mathefone yamikalaakalaacehu, bathalaataacehu laaye yamiradaacehu radaate (dagaafi) ka'alaahe weche yalaacehume.

manaafeqaane katabuke zamacaa wada xwaalaa 'enediqaru bamafeqade (lafatzamute sehetate) 'alaahe lanabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) nesehane 'adaraga (meheratene satha) 'enedazihume kanabiyu wada xwaalaa laaleqarute muhajerocenaa 'aneswaroce (nesehane) meheratene 'adaraga. yelequneme kamuqatu beretaate, ba'ejocaacawe laaye yaalawe nagare teneshe kamahonunaa yathalaataacawe thenekaaree beretu kamahonume gaare huneetaawe bathaame beretu thanekaaraa bamahonu mekeneyaate ka'enaresu kafilocu yatabuke zamacaane lamatawe lebocaacawe lamazanebale kaqaraba baxwaalaa (male'eketanyaawene) takatalu. kaziyaame 'alaahe tzenaatenenaa wada zamacaawe yamawethaatene sekeete sathaacawe. ba'enaresu laaye nesehawene 'adaraga. 'eresu kagudelate hulu yatharaawe 'alaahe la'enaresu ruheruhenaa 'azaanye nawe. yanesehane sekeete 'enediyaaganyu maaderagenaa nesehacawene maqabalu ka'ezenatu yamikaatate (yamithaqase) nawe.

ba'eregethe 'alaahe baszosetu laaye nesehawene 'aderegwaale. (nesehacawene taqabelwacawaale) 'enaresume ka`abe bene maalike, muraaraa bene rabi`e, hilaale bene 'umayaa naacawe. 'enazihe kaneseha wada xwaalaa 'enediqaru yatadaragunaa nesehacawe taqabaayenate kamaagenyate 'enedizagaye yatadaragabaacawe wada tabuke karasule (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) gaare kamaheede wada xwaalaa kaqaru baxwaalaa; rasule (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) sawoce 'enedireqwaacawe te`ezaaze sathetawe nabare. bazihe mekeneyaate mareete safi kamahonwa gaare 'eseketethabaacawe derase hazanenaa cheneqate 'agenyetwacawe nabare. batafatharabaacawe yabecanyenate semeete mekeneyaate lebocaacawe tachanaqa. wada 'eresu yamishashubate mathagiyaa ka'alaahe weche 'enedaleelaacawe 'awaqu. yaneseha sekeetene bamasethate kaziyaame nesehacawene bamaqabale 'azanalaacawe. 'alaahe labaariyaawocu 'ejege bathaame nesehane (meheratene) sachi nawe. la'enaresume ruheruhe nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu, male`eketanyaawene yatakatalaacehu, hegegaatocune yatagabaraacehu, 'alaahe yaazazawene bamafatzamenaa kakalakalawe bamaqothabe 'alaahene feru. ba'emenataacawe, batagebaaraacawe, banegegeraacawe 'ewenatanyaa kahonute gaare hunu. ba'ewenate kaalehona madehene yalaacehume.

male'eketanyaawe wada tegele siwathaa lamadinaa sawoceme hona bazuriyaawaa lamiganyu yagathare nawaariwoce kamale'eketanyaawe wada xwaalaa liqaru yatagabaa 'ayehoneme. kamale'eketanyaawe nafese yaraasaacawene nafese lisasetunaa lithabequ 'ayegabaame. yelequneme nafesaacawe ya'eresune nafese lamakalaakale lilagesu yegabaale. mekeneyaatume 'enaresu ba'alaahe manegade bamiyaaganyaacawe yaweha theme, dekaame, rahabe baziyaa maganyataacawe thalaatene bamiyaaseqoche botaa hulu siganyu, bazihe 'alaahe yamalekaame szeraa menedaane yetzefelaacawaale. ka'enaresume yeqabalaale. 'alaahe yamalekaame sawocene menedaa kanetu 'ayaadaregeme. yelequneme mulu 'aderego yefatzemelaacawaale. baziyaame laaye yechamerelaacawaale.

theqiteme hona bezu ganezabe silagesu, shalaqowocene siyaaqwaarethu, balegasaanaa baguzo yamiyaadaregutene 'alaahe menedaacawene sisathaacawe yetzefelaacawaale. bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame yeszarute kanabarawe szeraa yatashaala menedaa yesathaacawaale.

thalaatocaacawe 'ashanaafi kahonu mulu bamulu 'enedaayegaraseswacawe 'amaanyoce hulu lategele liwathu 'ayegabaame. ka'enaresu kafile yaahelu lategele kawathu leeloce kafiloce ka'alaahe male'eketanyaa gaare lamaqoyate biqarunaa kamale'eketanyaawe bamiyaadamethute qure'aanenaa 'emenataawi denegaageewoce biganazabu kaziyaame wada hhezebocaacawe simalasu ka'alaahe qethaate 'enedithanaqaqu, ya'alaahene te`ezaaze 'enedifatzemunaa, kakalakalawe 'enediqothabu bamafalage batamaarute `eweqate (hhezebocaacawene) 'enediyaasethanaqequ, yehe ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa wada talayaayu seferaawoce selamilekwaacawe budenoce yatagalatza nawe. ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa batalayaayu tale`ekowoce kasahaaboce yatawasanutene yemarethu nabare.

'amaanyoce ba'enaresu laaye 'adagaa yamigaarethubaacawene ka'athagabaacawe yamiganyu kahadiyaanocene 'eneditaagalu 'alaahe 'azazaacawe. 'enedazihume tanekolaacawene lamamalase thenekaareeyaacawene geletze 'enediyaadaregu 'azazaacawe. 'alaahe ba'eredaataawenaa badegaafu 'eresune kamifaru 'amaanyoce gaare nawe.

'alaahe bamale'eketanyaawe laaye yaqure'aane me`eraafe siyaawarede kamanaafeqaane makaakale bamaafeezenaa bamaashofe yeheci me`eraafe muhhamade yezote selamathaawe male'ekete 'emenate yamichamerelate maane nawe! bamaalate yamithayeqe yeganyaale. 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanunaa male'eketanyaawene 'ewenate yaalu yaqure'aane me`eraafe maweradu baqadama 'emenataacawe laaye 'emenatene yechamerelaacawaale. baziyaa wesethe mederaawi, `aalamaawinaa yawadiyaanyaawe `aalame thaqameetaacawe yamiganye bamahonu bawaradawe malakotaawi male'ekete dasetanyoce yehonaalu.

manaafeqaane gene yaqure'aane mawerade bawesethu bamiganyute denegaageewocenaa taarikoce yawaradawene male`ekete hasate bamaalataacawe mekeneyaate bashetaanaa bekelatene yechamerelaacawaale. yalebaacawe hemame qure'aane mawerade baqathala quthere yechameraale. mekeneyaatume meneme `aayenate malakotaawi male'ekete qure'aane siwarede selawaradawe nagare semotaa yaaqarebaalu. bakehedateme laaye yemotaalu.

manaafeqaane 'alaahe 'enedamifatenaacawenaa baya`aamatu 'anedeenaa hulatee huneetaacawene 'enedamiyaagaalethe 'enedihume nefeqenaacawene yefaa 'enedamiyaawathaawe 'ayemalakatumenaa temeherete 'ayewasedumene? kaziyaame gene yehene yaadaragabaacawe 'alaahe mahonune 'eyaawaqu kakehedataacawe baneseha wada 'eresu 'ayemalasume. kanefeqenaacawe 'ayewathume. yadarasabaacawe ka'alaahe 'enedahona 'ayegasatzume.

'alaahe bamale'eketanyaawe laaye yamanaafeqaane huneetaa yatathaqasabatene yaqure'aane me`eraafe siyaawarede kafile manaafeqaane wada kafile manaafeqaane 'eyatamalakatu 'enedihe yelaalu. yamimalakataacehu sawe 'alane? 'anedeme sawe kaaletamalakataacawe kamaqamachaa botaa raasaacawene yaagalelaalu. tanasetawe yeheedaalu. 'asetawelu! qenune manegade yamamaraate sekeetene kamaagenyatenaa kamalekaame nagare lebocaacawene 'alaahe 'azurotaale. yamaayeganazabu sawoce bamaaderage 'awaaredwacawaale. zeqe 'aderegwaacawaale.

ka'enaaneta zereyaa yahona male'eketanyaa mathetolaacexwaale 'eresu 'enedanaanetawe nawe. 'enaanetane yamiyaasechaneqaacehu nagare gudaaye yaasechaneqawaale. wada qathetanyaawe manegade selamamaraataacehunaa sela 'enaaneta 'enekebekaabee beretu felaagote 'alawe. 'eresu male'eketanyaawe batalaye la'amaanyoce bezu 'azaanyenaa ruheruhe nawe.

ka'aneta fitaacawene biyaazoru, yezahe yamathaakxawene male`ekete baayaamenu male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe ba'ewenate ka'eresu weche yamimalake yaleela yahonawe 'alaahe baqiyee nawe. ba'eresu laaye becaa tadagefeeyaalahu. 'eresu kagudelate netzuhe yahonawe 'alaahe yataalaaqu zufaane `areshe baalabeete nawe.
(lr) <<'alife, laame, rwa>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)

kasawe zare yahonane sawe (sawocene) ka'alaahe qethaate 'enediyaasethanaqeqe te`ezaaze sathetanawe malakotaawi male`eketene yaawaradenelate mahonu la'amesaayaawocu yasawe lejoce 'ageraamotene yamiyaachere gudaaye nawene!? 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'alaahe yaamanu sawoce lafatzamwacawe malekaame tagebaaraate menedaa, 'amelaakaacawe zanede yalaaqa darajaa 'enedaalaacawe yamiyaasedasetaacawene beseraate negaraacawe. kahadiyaanoce 'enedihe 'alu:- <<'enazihene 'aneqatzoce yaamathaawe yehe sawe geletse yahona degemetanyaa nawe.>>

'enaaneta 'ageraamote yayaazaacehu sawoce hoye! geetaacehu 'eko samaayaatene kanagezefataacawe, mareetene kanasefaatwa basedesete qanaatoce wesethe yafathara nawe. kaziyaame ka`areshe balaaye kafe 'ala. ka'enaanetawe yasawe zare yahonane male'eketanyaa bamalaaku 'enedeete tegaramaalaacehu!? 'eresu ('alaahe) basafaa gezaatu yamifaredawenaa yamiwasenawe becaawene nawe. 'eresu yawadadawenaa yafaqadalate 'amaalaaje kaalehona 'anedeme 'akaale 'eresu zanede liyaamaalede 'ayeceleme. geetaacehu 'alaahe ba'enedazihe yaalu (xaayaalenatune bamiyaaseradu) baaheriyaate yatagalatza nawe. 'amelekotaacehune hulu la'eresu becaa netzuhe 'aderegu. ba'enazihe hulu meleketocenaa maaserajaawoce ya'alaahene becanyaa tamalaakinate (yameteqabalunaa) yametemakaru 'atehonumene!? 'anasetanyaa genezaabee yaalawe 'enekwaa yehene yaaweqaale. baziheme yaamenaale.

yatenesaa'ee `elate mamalashaacehu wadaresu becaa nawe. baszeraawocaacehu yemanadaacewaale. 'alaahe yamaayaafaresawene yehene 'ewenatanyaa qaale kidaane lasawoce sathetwale. 'eresu yehene bamaaderage laaye caaye nawe. fetheratene yaalameneme yaqadama mesaalee kaalenabarabate yaaseganyaale. kaziyaame kamote baxwaalaa yeqaseqesawaale. ba'alaahe 'amenawe malekaame tagebaaraate yaakanaawanutene bafetehe yemanadaacawaale. kamalekaame tagebaaraacawe 'ayeqanaseme. mathefo tagebaaraacaweme yachamara 'ayehoneme. 'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale`eketanyaawe kehedatene yafatzamu gelatu kafetanyaa chaafe yadarasa mathathe (qethaate 'enedihonaacawe) yethabeqaacawaale. 'anejataacawene yebathaathesawaale. ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe bamakaadaacawe mekeneyaate 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe.

'eresu ('alaahe) tzahhaye baberehaane 'enedetedameqenaa berehaane 'enedetaasaraache, charaqaa 'enedetaabaraanaa maberaatwa thaqaami 'enedihone yaadaraga nawe. (yacharaqaa) guzone bahaayaa semenete yaguzo masemare mathane wasenotaale. malakiyaacawe baya`elatu baqanenaa balalite yamiyaaqwaarethute reqate nawe. sawoce hoye! yehe yahonawe batzahhaye yaqanaatocene quthere bacharaqaa dagemo yawaraatocenenaa ya`aamataatene quthere 'enedetaawequbate nawe. 'alaahe samaayaatenenaa mederene xaayaalenatunaa taalaaqenatu lasawoce geletze 'enedihone laqume nagare (lahaqe) 'eneji 'alefatharame. 'alaahe ya'eresune becanyaa tamalaakinate yamiyaamalaaketutene 'enazihene geletze maaserajaawocenenaa 'asaamaanye meleketocene `eweqate laalaacawenaa (banazihe maaserajaawoce 'eresu becanyaa tamalaaki mahonune lamaasaayate) meleketocune bamaaserajaanate lamithaqamu hhezeboce yaaseradaale.

yaqanenaa yalalite bafetherataate laaye mafaraaraqe, 'eresuneme takatelo yamikasatawe chalamaanaa berehaane, ya'anedaacawe marezamenaa yaleelaanyaawe maathare basamaayaatenaa bamedere yamiganyu fetherataate, 'alaahe yaazazaacawene bamataazaze yakalakalaacawene bamakalekale 'alaahene lamifaru sawoce ya'alaahene xaayaale celotaa yamiyaasaayu meleketoce naacawe.
