kahadiyaane maalate 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe gaare yamiganaanyu mahonaacawene yamaayegametu naacawe. baziheme mekeneyaate 'alaahene yamaayefarunaa ('eresu gaare laalawe malekaame nagare) yamaayegwaagu naacawe. kazalaalamaawiwe yawadiyaanyaawe `aalame heyewate thafiwenaa qerebitune `aalame heyewate yaaseqademaalu. nafesocaacaweme bamederaawi heyewate wedeetaa yaragaanaa yasakara (yafanathaza) nawe. ba'enezelaalenate ka'alaahe 'aneqatzocenaa meleketoce 'afanegaachocenaa celaa baayoce naacawe.
banazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatzute 'enazihe sawoce batenesaa'eewe `elate bamakaadaacawenaa bamaasetabaabalaacawe mekeneyaate yamiheedubate yamacharashaa maarafiyaacawe 'esaate nawe.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanunaa malekaamene yaszaru bazihe 'emenataacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe wada 'eresu wedeetaa yamiyaadaresu yahonu malekaame szeraawoce yemaraacawaale kaziyaame batenesaa'ee `elate kaserocwa wanezoce bamifasubaate zawetaarinaa tzagaane yatamolaace janate wesethe yaasegabaacawaale.

bajanate wesethe tsalotaacawe 'alaahene maawadasenaa maatheraate 'enedihume ya'eresune seme maalaaqe nawe. ya'alaahe salaametaa yamalaa`ekete salaametaa ya'erese barese salaametaacawe <<salaame>> yamilawe qaale sihone yamacharashaa tsalotaacawe yahulume fetherataate geetaa yahonawene maawadase nawe.

sawoce baquthaa qetzebataacawe waqete banafesocaacawe, balejocaacawenaa baneberataacawe laaye yamiyaadaregutene mathefo tsalote, 'alaahe malekaame tsalotaacawane 'enedamiqabale bafethenate biqabalaacawe yethafu nabare. nagare gene 'alaahe yetawaacawaale. 'alaahe 'eresune yamaayefarunaa ya'eresune malekaame menedaa yamaayemanyu bamahonaacawe ka'eresu gaare maganaanyataacawene yamaayethabequ sawoce selatenesaa'ee (sawoce hulu yaszeraacawene waagaa selamiyaaganyubate yameremaraa qane) geraa yagabaacawe yawaalalu tatharaathaariwoce 'enedihonu yetawaacawaale.

banafesu laaye wasane 'alaafi yahona sawe hemame wayeme mathefo huneetaa siyaagaathemawe yadarasabate cheneqate 'enedinasaalate qumome taqamethome, tagaademome raasune zeqe 'aderego batamasethetho yemaatzananaale. lemanaawene seneqabalawenaa ba'eresu laaye yaalawene cegere senaanasaalate kacheneqatu 'enedenegalaagelawe tamaatzeno siyaadarege 'enedaalenabara hulu qademo banabarabate thefaate yeqathelaale. lazihe 'afanegaache sawe bathemate laaye maqathale malekaamenaa yatawaaba tagebaare hono 'enedamitaayawe hulu 'enedazihume bakehedate wasane 'alaafi yahonu sawoce yamifatzemute kehedatenaa hathi'ate malekaame tagebaare hono yetaayaacawaale. yehene (mathefo) tagebaaraacawene 'ayetaweme.

'enaaneta 'agaariyaane hoye! ya'alaahene male'eketanyoce bamaasetabaabalaacawenaa hathi'atene bamafatzamaacawe ka'enaaneta bafite yanabaru hhezeboce 'athefetanaale. wadanaresu yalaakenaacawe male`eketanyoce kageetaacawe zanede bamathubate male'ekete 'ewenatanyaa mahonaacawene yamiyaaragaagethu geletze maaserajaawocene yezawe wada hhezebocaacawe yatalaaku bihonume (hhezebocaacawe) 'emenatene lamaqabale zegeju yanabaru baalamahonaacawe yamiyaamenu lihonu 'alecaalume. 'alaahe yatawaaradu 'adaragaacawe. (male'eketanyocaacawene 'enediqabalu) `edelanyaa 'alaadaragaacaweme. 'enaziyaane badalanyaa hhezeboce bazihe maleku (yamathefo szeraacawene waagaa) 'enedasathanawe hulu, bahulume gizeenaa bahulume medere 'enaresune yamasalu hhezebocene (tamasaasaaye) menedaa 'enesathaalane.

kazihe baxwaalaa 'enaaneta sawoce hoye! yameteszarutene lamamalekate 'asetabaabaaye hunawe baathafaanaacawe hhezeboce takaanaacehu. malekaame szaretaacehu malekaame temanadaalaacehu wayenese mathefo szaretaacehu teqathubataalaacehu?

'alaahe becanyaa 'amelekote yamigabaawe mahonune yamiyaamalaaketu geletze yaqure'aane 'aneqatzoce sinabubalaacawe kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yamiyaasetabaabelu, ka'alaahe malekaame menedaane maagenyate yamaayefalegunaa qethaatuneme yamaayefaru sawoce 'enedihe 'alu - <<muhhamade hoye! thaa`otaatene kamisadebawe yehe qure'aane lewaache leelaa qure'aane 'amethaalene; wayeneme ka'enyaa semeete gaare bamisemaamaa maleku mulu bamulu wayeneme bakafile qayerawe.>> male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<'enee (qure'aanene) malawathee tekekelanyaa tagebaare 'ayehoneme. 'enediyaaweme yehene maaderagenaa leelaane maamethaate 'aleceleme. kaqure'aane yafaqadawene malawathenaa maqayare yamicelawe 'alaahe becaa nawe. yamekatalawe ka'alaahe yamiszathanyene malakotaawi male'ekete becaa nawe. ya'enaanetane faqaadenaa felaagote ba'eshitaa bamamalase ka'alaahe feqaade 'enedaalewathaanaa bataalaaqu yatenesaa'ee `elate qethaate 'enedaayedaresebenye 'efaraalahu. (selaziheme theyaaqeeyaacehune 'aleqabaleme)>>

male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe: <<'alaahe qure'aanune 'enedaanabelaacehu baayefaqede noro 'alaanabelaacehume nabare; wada 'enaanetame 'alaadaresaweme nabare. 'alaahe baayefaqede noro banee 'anedabate qure'aanene baalaasaawaqaacehu nabare. bamahakalaacehu matzaafeme hona maanebabe saalecele razheme `aamataatene (40 `aamate) qoyecaalahu. tzehufenaa nebaabe mamaareme hasaabume felaagotume 'alenabaranyeme. wada 'enaaneta yezheewe yamathaahute male'ekete ka'alaahe zanede yawarada mahonunenaa 'enee baresu laaye meneme dereshaa yaleelanye mahonune ba'a`emerwacehu maganezabe 'enedeete yamisaanaacehu yehonaale!?

ba'alaahe laaye weshatene kaqathafa yabalatha badaaye maaneme yalame. 'enee qure'aanene bamaqayare ba'alaahe laaye hhasatene manaagare 'enedeete yecaalanyaale?>> nagaru ba'alaahe laaye bamawaashate ya'alaahene wasane yamithesu felaagotaacawene maasaakaate 'ayecelume.

'agaariwoce ba'alaahe laaye ka'alaahe leelaa yamaayethaqemenenaa yamaayegodaane yahhasate <<'amelaake>> yaamalekaalu 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaake 'enedafalagawe matheqamenaa magudaate yecelaale. 'enazihe 'agaariwocenaa bahhasate selamiyaamalekwaacawe yahhasate 'amaalekete bawanejalaacene mekeneyaate qethaate 'enedaayaaganyane 'alaahe zanede yamiyaamaaledune 'amaalaajocaacene naacawe bamaalate yenaagaraalu. male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<'alaahe tagaari 'enedaalawe `eweqatene tenagerutaalaacehune? 'eresu basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe laresu tagaari 'enedaalawe 'ayaaweqeme. 'alaahe 'agaariwoce kaminaagarute hhasatenaa wedeqe nagare yatharaa yalaaqanaa yataqadasa nawe.>>

sawoce 'alaahene babecanyenate yamigazunaa 'amaanye yahonu 'anede hhezebe 'eneji leelaa 'alenabarume. kaziyaa baxwaalaa talayaayu. ka'enaresu makaakale kafilu ba'emenatu yatzanaa hona. leeloce kafiloce dagemo kahadiwoce honu. yataqorathanaa yaqadama ya'alaahe wesaanee hono 'alaahe sawoce batalayaayubate nagare bamederaawi `aalame feredene 'ayesatheme. basawoce makaakale feredene yamiszathawe batenesaa'ee `elate nawe. yehe baayehone 'enaa 'alaahe sawoce batalayaayubaacawe gudaayoce bamederaawi heyewate feredene yamiszathe bihone noro qathetanyaawene manegade yatamaraawe bathemate manegade kamigwaazawe talayeto yetaawaqe nabare.

'agaariwoce 'enedihe yelaalu - << bamuhhamade laaye 'ewenatanyaanatune yamiyaamalaakete ta`aamere ka'alaahe biwaredelate mene 'ala?>> male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<yata`aameraate mamethaate 'alaahe becaa yamiyaaweqawe yaruqe mesethire nawe; yathayaqaacehutene ba`aayene yamitaaye tachabaache ta`aamere thabequ; 'eneeme ka'enaanetawe gaare 'ethabeqaalahu>>

'agaariwoce (musherikoce) kagathamaacawe dereqenaa cegere baxwaalaa yazenaabene tzagaa senaaqamesaacawe 'aneqatzocaacenene yaasetabaabelaalu; yaashofaalu male'eketanyaacene hoye! lanazihe 'agaariwoce 'enedihe balaacawe:- <<'alaahe bawathemadu fathaane nawe. 'enedihume 'azanaagi qachi nawe>> banaaneta laaye yatamadabu thabaaqi malaa`ekete yametaaseerutene tanekole yemazagebaalu. yamiyaamalethaacawe nagare yalame. yehe kahona 'enaresune yafathara 'alaahe dagemo 'enedeete yaamalethawaale batanekolaacehu 'alaahe yemanadaacawaale.

sawoce hoye! bamedere laaye ba'egerocaacehu 'enedeteraamadunaa bagaamaa kabetocaacehu 'enedetegwaazu, 'enedazihume babaahere laaye bamarekabe 'enedetesaafaru yamiyaasecelaacehu 'eresu 'alaahe nawe. babaahere guzo waqete marekabitwa bamalekaame sese nefaase 'eyatagafaace setenagude, manegadanyoce badasetaa yemolaalu. bazihe dasetaacawe mahale laaye xaayelanyaa nafaase yemathaabaacawaale. bahulume 'aqethaachaa bamaa`ebale yekababaalu. tasefaa bamaathaate yaheyewataacawe fetzaamee 'enedadadarasa yaasebaalu. bazihe waqete ba'alaahe laaye 'anedeneme tagaari saayaadaregu yatamaatzeno theriyaacawene wada 'alaahe becaa yaasamaalu:- <<geetaacene hoye! kazihe 'awedaami fatanaa kaawathaahene ba'enyaa laaye yafatzamekaacawene tzagaawoce yamenaamasagene 'enehonaalane>> silu yenaagaraalu.

'alaaheme tamaatzenwacawene taqabelo kanabarubate fatanaa kaadaanaacawe baxwaalaa wada nabarubate kehedatenaa hathi'ate yemalasaalu. 'enaaneta sawoce nequ! yamathefo szeraawocaacehu wetheete macharashaawe banaanetawe laaye nawe. 'alaahene 'amatzaacehu 'ayegodaaweme. ba'emebitanyaanataacehu thafi bahonacewe mederaawi heyewate becaa nawe yametefanathezute. kaziyaa batenesaa'ee `elate mamalashaacehu wada 'enyaa nawe. 'enyaame teszarute yanabarawene hulu 'enenageraacexwaalane. yaszeraacehuneme waagaa 'enesathaacexwaalane.

'enaaneta yametefanathezubate mederaawi heyewate ba'achere yamithanaaqaqe heyewate yamahonu mesaalee, kamareete takeloce (sawoce kamimagabu 'aze`eretenaa feraaferee 'enedihume 'enesesaatoce kamimagabwacawe yasaare `aayenatocenaa masale nagaroce) gaare 'enedatawaahada yazenaabe weha (mesaalee) nawe. (yazenaabe wehanaa yamareete takeloce siwaahadunaa) mareete ba'ababaa qalamoce setedameqe, baleyu leyu 'aze`eretoce webatene setelaabase, yamareete baalabeetoce meretaacawene masabesabe 'enedamicelu maasabe yejameraalu. banazihe qetzebatoce mahakale 'enyaa 'enedetethafaa yawasanawe te`ezaaze wada mareetu yedaresaale. (mareetu) katheqite bafite bazaafocenaa batakeloce yatawaaba mareete 'enedaalenabara hulu (thefaate yawaradabate) medera badaa 'enaadaregawaalane. yamederaawi heyewatene huneetaanaa ba'acheru yametethanaaqaqe `aalame mahonwane 'enedagalatzenelaacehu hulu 'enedazihume lamiyaasetanatenu (batheleqate lamimalakatu)naa lamigasatzu sawoce maaserajaawocenenaa meleketoce 'enaaseradaalane.

'alaahe yasalaame hagare wada honacewe janatu sawocene hulu yetharaale. bajanate wesethe sawoce kacegere, kahasaabenaa kamote natzaa yehonaalu. 'alaahe kabaariyaawocu yamarathawene wadazihe yasalaame hagare madaarashaa manegade wadahonawe selaame yemaraale.

'alaahe banaresu laaye gedeetaa yaadaragabaacawene te`ezaazaate baamaara huneetaa lafatzamu 'enaa 'alaahe kelekele yaadaragabaacawene hathi'atoce kamafatzame raasaacawene yaaraaqu sawoce yaamaara menedaa 'alaacawe; yehe yaamaara menedaa janate nawe. baziyaame laaye (kajanatu yabalatha) chemaarine yaaganyaalu. yehe dagemo yatakabarawene ya'alaahene fite yamamalekate `edele nawe. 'enazihe sawoce fitocaacawene 'abwaraa 'ayeshafenaweme. weredatene yatalaabasume 'ayehonume. bazihe yamalekaamenatenaa (szeraawoce yamaasaamare) baaheri yatagalatzute yajanate sawoce naacawe. bajanate wesethe zala`aalamaawi heyewatene yaaganyaalu.

'enaziyaa yakehedatenaa ya'amatzanyenatene wanejale yaszaru yathefaataacawene mathane yamimathene yaqethaate menedaa bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame yaaganyaalu. fitocaacawe baweredate yatashafana yehonaale. 'alaahe qethaatune banaresu laaye siyaawarede karesu qethaate kalalaa yamihonaacawe 'anedeme 'akaale yalame. yajahaname qaathalo chese fitaacawene siwarerawe yafitaacawe gatzetaa 'eneda lalite deqedeqe chalamaa thequratene yalabasu yemaselaale. bazihe baaheri yatagalatzu sawoce yajahaname baaledaraboce naacawe. baziyaame wesethe zeneta `aalame yeqoyaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! batenesaa'ee `elate fetherataatene hulu bameneqasaqesebate gizee yamihonawene 'asetaawese. baziyaane `elate bamederaawi heyewate ba'alaahe laaye sharikene laadaragu 'agaariyaane (thaa`otaawiyaane) 'enedihe 'enelaacawaalane. <<'agaariyaane hoye! 'enaanetanaa ka'alaahe weche setegazwacawe yanabaru 'amaaleketoce baalaacehubate qumu.>> ba'amaaleketocunaa batagazhiwocaacawe makaakale malayaayatene 'enaadaregaalane. 'amaaleketocu <<'enyaane setegazu 'alenabarame?>> bamaalate sigazwacawe kanabaru 'agaariyaane (bakehedate) raasaacawene yaareqaalu.

baziyaane waqete ka'alaahe weche yegazwacawe yanabaru 'amaaleketocaacawe yereqwaacawaale. 'enediheme yelwacawaale <<bamesekerenate 'alaahe baqiyaacene nawe; 'enyaa 'amelekune 'alaalenaacehume; setaamalekuneme dasetanyaa 'alenabareneme 'enedametaamalekuneme 'anaaweqeme nabare.>>

baziyaa yatenesaa'ee taalaaqe maderake 'eyaanedaanedwa nafese bamederaawi heyewate baasaalafacewe tagebaare tefatanaalace. 'agaariyaane (musherikoce) yaszeraacawene hhisaabe wadamimaramerawe 'alaahe gudaayaacawene yemalesaalu. 'amaaleketocaacene yaamaaledunaale bamaalate siwaashu yanabarawe yethafaabaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'alaahe laaye tagaarine laadaragute 'agaariyaane (thaa`otaawiyaane) 'enedihe balaacawe. <<kawada samaaye zenaabene bamaawerade sisaayene yamiszathaacehu maanawe!? takelocene 'enedetaabaqelenaa, maa`edenaatene yaaqaface 'enedetehone bamaaderage kamareete sisaayene yamiszathaacehu maanawe!? kamute nagare heyewatene yamiyaaseganye maanawe!? (lamesaalee kafetewate thabetaa yasawene leje, ka'enequlaale qerefite baraari wafene maaseganyate); kaheyaawe nagare mute nagarene yamiyaawathaawe maanawe!? (lamesaalee kasawe leje yafetewete thabetaane, kabaraari wafoce 'enequlaalene maawethaate) samaayaatenaa mederene 'enedihume bawesethaacawenaa balaayaacawe yamiganyu fetherataatene gudaaye yamiyaasetanaaberawe (bathebabanyaa manegade yamimaraawe) maanawe!?>> la'enazihe hulu theyaaqeewoce <<yehene hulu 'aderaagiwe 'alaahe nawe>> yamile malese yeszathaalu. 'enedihe balaacawe - <<yehene kaawaqaacehu yaazazaacehune bamafatzamenaa kakalakalaacehu bamaqothabe 'alaahene yametethanaqaqu 'atehonumene!?>>

sawoce hoye! 'ewenataawe yehe nawe; 'enazihene nagaroce hulu yamiyaakanaawenawe 'enaa gudaayaacehune yamiyaasetanaaberawe 'ewenatanyaa fathaariyaacehu 'alaahe nawe. 'ewenatene kaawaqu baxwaalaa 'alamakatale bathefaate mawaalalenaa ka'ewenate maraaqe 'eneji leelaa nagare lihone 'ayeceleme. kazihe geletse 'ewenataa 'a`emerwacehu wadeete yeheedaale!?

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'ewenatanyaa fathaarinatenaa yafetherata `aalamu becanyaa 'amelaakenate la'alaahe yataragaagatha 'enedahonawe hulu, 'enedazihume bagetere 'amatzanyenate ka'ewenate manegade yawathu sawoce yamaayaamenu mahonaacawe bageetaahe yawesaanee qaale tatzefwale (tadanegegwaale).

male'eketanyaacene hoye! la'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce (thaa`otaawiyaane) 'enedihe balaacawe - <<ka'alaahe gaare batagaarinate kametegazwacawe 'amaaleketocaacehu makaakale yaala'anedaace qadaami mesaalee fetheratene yamiyaaseganye 'enaa kaziyaame kamota baxwaalaa yamiqasaqese 'alane!? 'alaahe yaalaqadaami mesaalee fetheratene yaaseganyaale kaziyaame yeqasaqesawaale>> belahe negaraacawe. 'enaaneta thaa`otaawiyaane hoye! 'enedeete nawe ka'ewenate wada hhasate yameteheedute?

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<ka'alaahe weche kametaamalekwaacawe 'amaaleketocaacehu makaakale wada 'ewenatanyaa manegade mameraate yamicele 'alane!? wada 'ewenatanyaa manegade mameraate yamicelawe 'eresu 'alaahe becaa nawe>> belahe negaraacawe. makatale tagabi yamihonawe sawocene wada 'ewenatanyaa manegade yamimaraanenaa wadaziyaame ('ewenatanyaa manegade) theri yamiyaadaregelaacawene nawe? wayenese yaleelaane 'akaale 'agaazhe degaafe kaalaaganyu baraasaacawe 'aqeme manegadene mamaraate yamaayecelutene 'amaaleketocaacehune? 'enazihe 'amaaleketocaacehu ya'alaahe tagaari mahonaacawene bamamogate 'enedeete yahhasate ferede tesathaalaacehu!? 'alaahe kazihe negegeraacehu ba'ejegu yalaaqa nawe.

bezu 'agaariyaane (thaa`otaawiyaane) yamikatalute selaresu `eweqate yaleelaacawene, tachabaache yaalehona qezhatenaa therethaareene nawe. therethaareeme ya`eweqatene botaa litakaa 'ayeceleme. ka`eweqate 'ayaabeqaaqaame. 'alaahe yamiyaadaregutene hulu yaaweqaale. katagebaaraacawe makaakale ka'alaahe yamisawarebate 'anedaaceme nagare yalame. yaszeraacaweneme waagaa yesathaacawaale.

sawoce 'eresune yamasala (matsehhafe) maamethaate yatasaanaacawe bamahonu yehe qure'aane hasatanyaa nawe libaalenaa (yaawaradawe 'akaale baalabeetenate) ka'alaahe weche lamiganye 'akaale lisathe 'ayegabaame. (qure'aane) karesu bafite yawaradutene malakotaawi matsaahhefete 'ewenatanyenate yamiyaaragaagethenaa (banaziyaa matsaahhefete) batheqelu yatathaqasu hegegaatocene yamiyaaberaaraa matsehhafe nawe. yafetherataate hulu geetaa kahonawe 'alaahe yatalaaka male`ekete mahonu meneme therethere yalaweme.

'enaziyaa (thaa`otaawiyaane) <<yehe qure'aane muhhamade raasu bahasate yadarasawenaa wada 'alaahe yaasethagaawe nagare nawe>> bamaalate yenaagaraalune!? male'eketanyaacene hoye! (lazihe hasatanyaa mugetaacawe) malese sethaacawe. <<'enee ya'enaanetawe `aayenate 'amesaayaa sawe nanye; yehene qure'aane baraasee yaamathaahutenaa yadarasekute kahona 'eresune yamimasele 'anede me`eraafe 'enekwaa baraasaacehu daresaacehu 'amethulenye. baziheme laaye degaafe 'enedisathwacehu matheraate yametecelutene hulu 'asabaasebu. qure'aane hasatanyaanaa yatadarasa male`ekete nawe bamilawe yaqethefate mugetaacehu 'ewenatanyaa kahonaacehu yehene mokeru. qure'aanene yamimasele nagare maamethaate bafetzume yamicaalaacehu 'ayehoneme. ba'anedabata retu`enatenaa basena-qwaaneqwaa `eweqataacehu mesekerenate yamaayaashaacehu honaacehu yehene maaderage (yaqure'aanene 'anede me`eraafe 'enekwaa yamasala male'ekete maamethaate) yatasaanaacehu mahonu qure'aane ka'alaahe yatalaaka male`ekete mahonune yaaseradaale.>>

malese 'alesathume. yelequneme qure'aanene baqethu saayeradutenaa male'eketune batheleqate saayemarameru liyaasetabaabelute tacaakolu. kanaresu bafite yanabaru hhezeboceme 'enedihe `aayenate tamasaasaaye kehedatene fatsemawaale. baziheme thefaate waredobaacawaale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'alaahene male'ekete yaasetabaabalu hhezeboce fetzaamee mene yemasele 'enedanabarenaa 'alaahe 'enedeete 'enedaathafaacawe 'asetawele.

ka'agaariyaane makaakale kahelefatu bafite baqure'aane yamiyaamene yenoraale. 'enedazihume kamakaakalaacawe bachefene geterenatunaa batemekehetanyenatu mekeneyaate baqure'aane saayaamene 'eseka heyewatu fetsaamee yamiqathele yenoraale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe kehedatene yamuthinye yaalutene yaaweqaacawaale. yakehedataacaweneme waagaa yesathaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! hhezebocehe hasatanyaa nahe biluhe 'enedihe negaraacawe - <<yaszeraayeene menedaa 'aganyaalahu; szeraayee yamiyaasekatelawene wetheete xaalaafinateneme raaseewe 'ewesedaalahu. 'enedazihume 'enaanetame yaszeraacehune menedaa taaganyaalaacehu; qethaatume yamidaresawe baraasaacehu laaye nawe. ba'enee tagebaare mekeneyaate ba'enaaneta laaye qethaate 'ayedareseme. 'enedihume ba'enaaneta tagebaare mekeneyaate 'enee laaye qethaate 'ayedareseme.>>

male'eketanyaacene hoye! qure'aanene setaanabe ka'agaariyaane (kathaa`otaawiyaane) makaakale yamaradaatenaa yamaqabale tanasaashenate saayenoraacawe (nebaabehene) yamiyaadaamethu 'alu. masemaate yatasaanawene sawe 'enediyaadamethe maaderage tecelaalahe!? 'enedazihume 'ewenate yamaayaasetawelunaa 'enedaayesamute yatadafanutene qathetanyaawene manegade letemaraacawe 'ateceleme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'agaariyaane makaakale balebonaa `aayenu saayehone bawechaawi (ba'akaalaawi) `aayenu yamimalakatehe 'ala; `aayenu yatagaaradabatene 'enedimalakate maaderage tecelaalahe? 'enedazihume lebonaawe yataawarabatene sawe wada 'ewenate 'enedimaraa maaderage 'ateceleme.

'alaahe baariyaawocune kamabadale fetzume yatharaa nawe. yabenaanye kebedate yaahele 'ayebadelaacaweme; nagare gene 'enaresu raasaacawe yahasate chefene takataaye bamahone, bageterenatenaa batemekehete ('ewenatene kamaqabale bamaafagefage) raasaacawene wada thefaate godaanaa bamameraataacawe mekeneyaate nafesocaacawene yebadelaalu.

yaszeraacawene hhisaabe 'enediyaaganyu batenesaa'ee `elate 'alaahe sawocene kaqabere qaseqeso sisabasebaacawe bamedere heyewatenaa baqabere heyewate qoyetaa yaasaalafute thaqelaalaa yagizee mathane ka`elate ya'anede sa`aate mathanene yaahele becaa hono yesamaacawaale. 'erese baresaacawe yetawaawaqaalu; kaziyaame gene bamimalakatute yatenesaa'ee `elate 'asefari te`eyenate mekeneyaate matawaawaqaacawe taneno yethafaale. batenesaa'ee `elate kageetaacawe gaare maganaanyataacawene hasate yaalu sawoce baregethe kaserawaale. bamederaawi heyewataacawe kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase 'enedaala yamiyaamenu 'alenabarume. selaziheme kakeserate yamidenu 'alehonume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kahelefatehe bafite kaqatharenaacawe qethaate kafilune 'enaasaayehe yehonaale; wayeneme kaziyaa bafite wada helefata heyewatehe 'enewasedehalane. bahulatume huneetaa batenesaa'ee `elate mamalasaacawe wada 'enyaa nawe. 'alaahe yeszarute yanabarawene hulu yaaweqaale; katagebaaraacawe karesu yamisawarebate 'anedeme nagare yalame. yaszeraacawene waagaa yeszathaacawaale.

kazihe bafite yanabaru qadamete teweledoce (hhezeboce) hulume male'eketanyaa dareswacawaale. 'anede male'eketanyaa yataazazawene male'ekete siyaadaresenaa hhezebocu hasatanyaa nahe silute ba'eresunaa ba'enaresu makaakale 'alaahe bafetehe yefaredaale. 'alaahe bacerotaawe male'eketanyaawene natzaa yaawathaale (yaadenaale). yaasetabaabalute hhezeboce lafetehe qethaatu yedaresaacawaale. bamiyaaganyaacawe yaszeraacawe waagaa 'anediteneme nagare 'ayebadalume.
bametemogetute nagare 'ewenatanyaa kahonaacehu yametaawarulene yathefaate qatharo macee nawe silu 'enaziyaa kahadiyaane bachefene geterenatenaa bamagadaadare yethayeqaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe negaraacawe - <<laleeloce qareto lanafeseeme bihone gudaatene yamaamethaatenaa gudaatene yamaaseqarate 'enedihume theqemene yamasethate selethaane yalanyeme ya'alaahe feqaade kaalehona yaruqene mesethire 'enedeete maawaqe yamicaalanye yehonaale? 'alaahe yathefaate zaacaa yasathaacawe hhezeboce hulu yazaacaa qatharowe banaresu laaye tafatzaami yamihonebate gizee 'ala. yehene gizee yamiyaaweqawe 'alaahe becaa nawe. yaqatharowe gizee sidarese 'anediteneme yasa`aate qenethaate wadafiteme wadaxwaalaame 'ayeleme.>>

seteqatharute yanabarawu qethaate katafatzamabaacehu baxwaalaa 'emenatene teqabalaalaacehune? yaqadama 'emenate lanabaraate nafese 'eneji, qethaatu kawadaqa baxwaalaa baziyaa qetzebate 'emenatene maqabale nafesene yamithaqemaate (kaqethaate yamiyaadenaate) 'ayehoneme. kazihe qadame (ya'alaahe yaqethaate qatharo) hhaszate nawe bamaalate, ('ewenate kahona) qethaatu 'enedifathene taacwakulu nabare; 'ahune (qethaatu katafatzama baxwaalaa) taamenaalaacehune?

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'alaahene qethaate lamiyaacaakulute 'enedihe balaacawe - <<ya'alaahe qethaate ba'anede yaqane wayeneme yalalite qetzebate bidaresebaacehu kazihe qethaate yametecakululate nagare menedenawe!?>>

jahaname wesethe kagabu baxwaalaa kaziyaa mawethaate 'enedicelu sithayequ yamacharashaawene `aalame zala`aalamaawi qethaate qemasu letaaganyute yamitecelu seteszaru yanabarawene yakehedatenaa hathi'ate wetheete becaa nawe yamile malese yaaganyaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'agaariyaane 'enedihe silu yethayequhale. <<yehe yatazaatabene yaqethaate qatharo 'ewenate nawene!?>>; <<'awone ba'alaahe yehunebenye 'ewenate nawe>> belahe negaraacawe. kazihe qethaate maamelathe 'atecelume.

'agaari (thaa`otaawi) sawe bamedere laaye yamiganyu wede habetoce hulu yaresu bihonunaa (bakefeyaa kajahaname) raasune yamaadaane `edele bisathawe ka'alaahe qethaate lamadaane huluneme babeezaanate yaaqarebe nabare. thaa`otaawiyaane yatenesaa'ee `elate qethaatene simalakatu bakehedataacawe yatasamaacawene tzatzate lidabequ yemokeraalu. 'alaahe bamakaakalaacawe bafetehe yefaredaale. badale 'ayedaresebaacaweme. yamiyaaganyute yaszeraacawene menedaa nawe.

nequ! basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaala negeszenaa bamulu ya'alaahe becaa nawe. kahadiyaanene 'enedamiqathaa 'alaahe yamisathawe qatharo makasatu yamaayeqare nawe; therethere yalaweme. nagare gene bezuwoce yehene selamaayaawequ yedanaagaraalu (yetharaatharaalu).
'alaahe mutaanene (kaqabere) yeqasaqesaacawaale. heyaawaanene yaamotaacawaale. batenesaa'ee `elate yametemalasute wada 'eresu becaa nawe. yaszeraacehune wetheete yeszathaacawaale.

yasawe lejoce hoye! yaqure'aane male'ekete dareswale; 'asetaawaashe, 'abesaarinaa 'asethaneqaaqi male'eketoce bawesethu yeganyaalu. balebonaa wesethe lamiganyu yatherethaareenaa yamadanaagare bashetaawoce fawese nawe. wada qene manegade yaamalaaketaale. bawesethu la'amaanyoce 'ezenate 'ala; baqure'aane male'ekete lithaqamu yamiceluteme 'enaresu naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lasawe lejoce 'enedihe belahe negaraacawe - <<muhhamade yezote yamathaawe qure'aane ka'alaahe la'enaaneta yawarada cerotaanaa 'ezenate nawe; qure'aanene bamaawerade 'alaahe basathaacehu bazihe cerotaanaa 'ezenate tadasatu. muhhamade yezote yamathaawe male'ekete sawoce kamisabasebute thafi yamederaawi heyewate teraafi (habete) yatashaala nawe.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa 'agaariyaane 'enedihe balaacawe - <<sisaayene bamaawerade 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye selafatzamawe tzagaa negarunye; yanafese zenebaaleeyaacehune (semeetaacehune) bamakatale kafilune (hhalaale) yatafaqada, kafilune 'ereme 'adaragaacehu.>> 'enedihe thayeqaacawe - <<yehene lamaaderage ya'alaahene feqaade 'agenyetaacexwaalene!? wayenese ba'alaahe laaye hhasatene 'eyaqathafaacehu nawe!?>>

ba'alaahe laaye hasatene yamiqathefu sawoce batenesaa'ee `elate selamiyaagaathemaacawe nagare mene gemete 'alaacawe!? meheratene yamiyaaganyu 'enedahonu yaasebaalune!? yehe yamaayehone (ruqe) menyote nawe.'alaahe basawoce laaye baala bezu tzagaa nawe. baqi gizeene yesathaacawaale; qethaatune 'ayaafathenebaacaweme. honome gene bezuwocu ya'alaahene tzagaa bamakaade 'amasegaanyoce 'ayehonume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bayatenyaaweme gudaaye laaye setehone, qure'aaneneme setaanabe, ('enedazihume) 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! bayatenyaaweme tagebaare laaye setehonu selahuneetaacehu 'enaaweqaalane; 'enesamaacexwaalane. basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yabenaanye yaahele kebedate yaalawe kaziyaame yaanasanaa yabalatha nagare 'enekwaa bihone kageetaahe ('alaahe) `eweqate yatasawara 'ayedalame. (yehe hulu) huluneme nagare bamiyaasafere geletze matsehhafe wesethe yasafara hono yeganyaale.
nequ! ('asetawelu!) ya'alaahe wadaajoce yatenesaa'ee `elate 'asechanaaqi te`eyenete ferehate yalabaacaweme. bamederaawi `aalame selaalafaacawe `aalamaawi dereshaame hhazane 'ayesamaacaweme.

'enazihe ya'alaahe wadaajoce ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) maamane magalachaa (baaheriyaacawe) nabare. yataazazutene bamafatzamanaa katakalakalute bamaqothabe 'alaahene yethanaqaqu nabare.

bamederaawi heyewataacawe kageetaacawe yahona beseraate 'alaacawe bamimalakatwacawe malekaame helemocenaa sawoce lanaresu bamisathute kabareetaa. bamote 'afaafe laaye sihonunaa kamote baxwaalaa, 'enedihume sawoce bamisababubate yatenesaa'ee `elate dagemo kamalaa'ekete beseraatene yaaganyaalu. 'alaahe yasathaacawe malekaame qatharo 'ayelawatheme. yanafese felaagote hulu yamisaakaabatenaa ka'asefari nagaroce hulu madehene yamiganyebate bamahonu yehene menedaa maagenyate teleqe sekeete nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'emenatehene lamaneqafenaa lamaanaware baminaagarute nagare hhazane 'ayegebaahe. 'ashanaafinatenaa dele bamulu ya'alaahe nawe. 'eresune yamiyaaqetawe (yamisaanawe) nagare yalame. negegeraacawene yesamaale; szeraacaweneme yaaweqaale. laziyaame menedaa yeszathaacawaale (waagaacawene yekafelaacawaale).

nequ! basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yaalawe negeszenaa hulu ya'alaahe becaa nawe. ka'alaahe weche yaalane nagare yamiyaamalekute 'agaariwoce yamikatalute menedenawe!? ba'ewenate yamikatalute therethaareene becaa nawe. kaminaagarute nagare 'alaahe ba'ejegu yalaaqa nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! kadekaamenaa kawethaa werade `erafete 'enedetaaganyu lalitene yaadaragalaacehu 'eresu ('alaahe) becaa nawe. nurowaacehune lamwamwalaate 'enedeteneqasaaqasu dagemo yaqanune kefele berehaanaamaa 'adaragawe. bamaganezabenaa bamaqabale semeete lamiyaadaamethu hhezeboce yehe geletze maaserajaa ('amalaakaace nagare) nawe.

kafile thaa`otaawiyaane <<'alaahe malaa'eketocene seete lejoce 'aderego yezwacawaale>> bamaalate tanaagaru. kazihe negegeraacawe 'alaahe yatharaa (yataqadasa) nawe. kafetherataatu hulu meneme yamifalegawe nagare yalame. basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yaalu nagaroce selethaane yaresu nawe. 'enaaneta 'agaariyaane hoye! negegeraacehu maaserajaa yalaweme. 'eresu leje 'alawe bamaalate ba'alaahe laaye kabaade qaalene tenaagaraalaacehune!?
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe negaraacawe - <<'alaahe leje 'alawe bamaalate ba'alaahe laaye hasatene yamiqathefu sawoce yamifalegutene 'ayaaganyume; kamifaruteme nagare 'ayedenume.>>

bamederaawi heyewate bamifanathezubate `aalamaawi dasetaa 'ayetaalalu. 'acherenaa thafi fanethazeyaa nawe. kaziyaame batenesaa'ee `elate mamalashaacawe wadanyaa nawe. 'alaahene bamakaadaacawenaa male'eketanyocene bamaasetabaabalaacawe mekeneyaate thanekaaraa qethaatene 'enesathaacawaalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'asetabaabaaye lahonute lanaziyaa 'agaariyaane yanuhene taarike tarekelaacawe. nuhhe lahhezebocu 'enedihe sile tanaagara:- <<hhezebocee hoye! bamahhakalaacehu manoree kakabadaacehunaa ba'alaahe 'aneqatzoce yamesathaacehu gesaatzee 'asecagaari kahonabaacehu, baziheme mekeneyaate 'eneene lamagedale wesaanee laaye kadarasaacehu, tanekolaacehu 'enedikashefe mamakaateene ba'anede 'alaahe laaye becaa 'aderegeeyaalawe. gudaayaacehune fatzemu; heyewateene lamaathefaate qurathu; ba'amaaleketocaacehu hulu lamaradaate theri 'aderegu. seeraacehu yatashafana debeqe 'ayehune. qetzebatene yaahele 'enekwaa gizee 'atesethunye. hhasaabaacehune fatzemu.

katheriyee kaafanagathaacehu - yageetaayeene male'ekete wada 'enaaneta bamaaderasee ka'enaaneta yathayaqekute kefeyaa 'enedaleela taaweqaalaacehu theriyeene beteqabalume hona theriyeene betekedu yaszeraayeene menedaa yamaaganyawe ka'alaahe nawe. 'alaahe bamalekaame szeraanaa ya'eresune manegade bamakatale fetzume taazaazhe 'enedehone 'azezonyaale.>>

hhezebocu hasatanyaa nahe 'alute male'eketanyaanatuneme 'ewenate 'alaalume. 'eresunenaa karesu gaare yanabarutene 'amaanyoce bamarekabitwa natzaa 'awathaanaacawe. kanaresu bafite lanabarute yamedere tatakiwoce 'adaragenaacawe. (nuhe) yezo yamathaawene ta`aameraatenaa maaserajaa yaasetabaabalutene baweha maa`ebale 'athafaanaacawe. 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! nuhhe 'asethaneqeqwaacawe 'emenatene yaaletaqabalu sawoce fetzaamee mene 'enedamimasele 'asetawele!

kaziyaame katawasana zamane baxwaalaa kanuhhe baxwaalaa leeloce male'eketanyocene wada hhezebocaacawe lekanaale. male'eketanyoce lahhezebocaacawe ta`aameraatocenenaa maaserajaawocene yezawe qarabu. hhezeboce gene male'eketanyocene hasatanyaa yamaalate yaqadama yaalaacawe bamahonu 'emenatene lamaqabale felaagote 'alenabaraacaweme. 'alaahe lebonaacawene dafanawe. ('ashagabaacawe). baalafute male'eketanyoce hhezeboce lebonaa laaye yatakasatawe yehene `aayenate yalebe madafane (mataashage) bayatenyaaweme botaanaa gizee bakehedate ya'alaahene wasane bamiyaalefu kahadiyaane lebonaawoce laaye yekasataale.

kaziyaame katawasana zamane baxwaalaa, kanaziyaa male'eketanyoce baxwaalaa musaanenaa wanedemune harune 'ewenatanyaanataacawene bamiyaaragaagethu ta`aameraatoce wada gebetze negusze fire`owenenaa yahhezebocu taalaalaaqoce laakenaacawe. fire`owenenaa takataayocu yamathaalaacawene male'ekete kamaqabale kuraate 'agadaacawe. 'alaahene bamakaadaacawenaa male'eketanyocune bamaasetabaabalaacawe 'amatzanyaa hhezeboce nabaru.

musaanaa harune yezawe yamathute 'emenate fire`owenenaa yahhezebocu taalaalaaqoce sidaresaacawe musaa 'ewenatanyaa mahonune 'enediyaamalaaketu yatasathutene ta`aameraatoce geletze degemetoce 'eneji 'ewenate 'ayedalume silu 'asetabaabalu.

musaame yatanaagarutene bamaqaawame 'enedihe 'ala - <<'ewenate wada 'enaaneta simathaa degemete nawe bamaalate tenaagaraalaacehune!? kazihe negegere taqothabu; yehe degemete 'ayedalame; degemetanyaa zeneta `aalame madehene 'enedamaayaaganye 'aweqaalahu; 'enedeetese 'enee 'efatzemawaalahu!?>>

yafire`owene hhezeboce lamusaa 'enedihe silu malese sathu - <<bazihe degemete wada 'enyaa yamathaakxawe 'abaatocaacenene kaaganyenebate 'emenate letaasewathaanenaa 'anetanaa wanedemehe negeszenaa 'enedinoraacehu nawe!? musaanaa harune hoye! wada 'enyaa yatalaakaacehu male'eketanyoce selamahonaacehu 'eweqenaa 'anesathaacehume.>>
fire`owene lahhezebocu <<degemetene bamigabaa yatakaanunaa yamiyaawequ dagaamiwocene (metehaatanyocene) bamulu 'amethulenye>> sile thayaqa.
hhezebocu degemetanyocene yezawe wada fire`owene siqarebu musaa ba'enaresu laaye bamiyaaganyawe dele bamatamaamane <<'enaaneta degemetanyoce hoye! yametethelutene metehate wareweru>> 'ala.

yayaazutene degemete siwaraweru musaa 'enedihe 'alaacawe <<yehe te`eyenetaacehu degemete nawe; 'alaahe metehataacehune tatse`eno yaleelawe wedeqe yaadaregawaale. bazihe yadegemete tagebaaraacehu mederene 'eyabakalaacehu nawe; 'alaahe 'athefi yahonane sawe tagebaare malekaame 'ayaadaregeme.>>
kahadinaa 'amatzanyocu yafire`owene beetasaboce ('agaaroce) bithalume 'alaahe 'ewenatene tsenu yaadaregaale; bawesaanee qaale delene yesathawaale.

meneme 'enekwaa musaa bageletze ta`aameraatoce wadanaresu yamathaa bihoneme ka'ewenate lamaafanegathe qurethe wesaanee laaye darasu. male'eketune 'amenawe yataqabalute yaresu hhezeboce yahonute yabani seraa'eele wathaatoce nabaru. (yamusaane male'ekete maqabalaacawe) katagalatza yafire`owenenaa yahhezebocu taalaalaaqe sawoce liyaadaresubaacawe bamicelute seqaaye ka'emenate 'enedaayaasewathwacawe yefaru nabare. fire`owene bagebetzenaa banawaariwocu laaye 'amebaaganane kuraatanyaa nabare. bakehedate, sawocene bamagedalenaa bani seraa'eelocene bamaasaqaayate wasane yaalafa nabare.

musaa lahhezebocu 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<hhezebocee hoye! ba'alaahe ya'ewenate 'emenate kayaazaacehunaa baregethe maselimoce kahonaacehu ba'alaahe laaye becaa tamaku. ba'alaahe laaye mamakaate mathefone nagare yemaleselaacexwaale; malekaame nagare yaamathaalaacexwaale.>>

hhezebocume lamusaa 'enedihe silu malese sathute:- <<ba'alaahe laaye becaa tamaketanaale. geetaacene hoye! badalanyocene banyaa laaye xaayelene 'atesethaacawe. bamaasaqaayatenaa bamagedale (yeheme kaalehona) bamaataalale ka'emenataacene yefatenunaale.>>

natzaanataacenene gafefawe babaarenate qanebare sere 'adaragune; bagedeyaanaa seqaaye bamaaderase 'asecagarune; geetaacene hoye! kahadiyaane kahonute yafire`owene hhezeboce ba'ezenatehe natzaa 'awethaane."

musaanaa wanedemu harune hhezebocaacawe 'alaahene babecanyenate yamigazubate beetocene marethawe 'enediyaazagaaju, beetocaacaweneme wada qibelaa (bayetale maqedase) 'aqethaachaa 'enediyaadaregunaa salaataacaweneme batamwalaa huneetaa 'enedisagedu male'ekete 'awaradenelaacawe. musaa hoye! ya'alaahe degaafenaa dele 'enedamimathaa, thalaatocaacawe 'enedamithafunaa yamedere tatakiwoce 'enedamihonu la'amaanyoce yamiyasedasetaacawene (beseraate) negaraacawe.

musaa 'enedihe 'ala - <<geetaacene hoye! lafire`owenenaa lahhezebocu taalaalaaqe sawoce yamederaawi heyewatene webatene habete sathetahacawaale. lasathahacawe tzagaa mesegaanaa 'alaadarasuleheme. yelequneme kamanegadehe sawocene lamaathemame tathaqamubate. geetaacene hoye! habetaacawene fatsemahe 'athefaawe; lebocaacawene 'adereqawe. 'asaamaamiwene qethaate kaaletamalakatu basetaqare 'emenate 'ayeqabalume. qethaatene baayu gizee maamane dagemo 'ayethaqemaacaweme.>>

'alaahe 'enedihe 'ala - <<musaanaa harune hoye! bafire`owenenaa bahhezebocu taalaalaaqe sawoce laaye yaadaragaacehutene tsalote (theri) taqabeyaacexwaalahu. ba'emenataacehu laaye tzenu ba'emenataacehu kamatzenaate 'enedaatenesharaatatunaa ya'ewenatene manegade yamaayaawequ maayemaanene manegade bamakatale ka'ewenate 'enedaataafanagethu.>>

kafalaqaqenawe (kakafalenawe) baxwaalaa baaherune maaqwaarathe la'eseraa'eele lejoce qalaale 'adaragenawe. baahherune baszalaame 'aqwaarathute. fire`owene kaszaraawitu gaare babadalenaa bagefanyenate (semeete) 'asaadadaacawe. yatakafalawe baahhere ba'eresu laaye tadaafenobate sathama. yamaterafe tasefaawe yaabaqaalate mahonune taradaa. bazihene gizee 'enedihe 'ala:- <<ya'eseraa'eele lejoce yamiyaamenubate 'amelaake kaalehona leelaa ba'ewenate yamigazute 'amelaake 'enedaleela 'amenyaalahu. te`ezaazaatune bamafatzame la'alaahe taazaazhe nanye.>>

yehenene katamalakatu baxwaalaa neseha maaderage yamaayecaale bamahonu 'alaahe 'enedihe 'alawe.
<>

<<fire`owene hoye! zaaree badenehene kazihe baahere 'enaawathaahalane. ka'aneta baxwaalaa lamimathu teweledoce maganezabiyaa 'enedetehone kafe baala yamitaaye seferaa 'enaadaregehalane.>> bezu sawoce xaayaalenataacenene kamiyaamalaaketu maaserajaawoce yatazanaagu naacawe. batheleqate 'ayaasetawelume.

ya'eseraa'eele lejocene batabaarakawe yashaame medere, batamasagananaa batawadada maarafiyaa botaa 'asafarenaacawe; yatafaqada malekaame sisaayene lagasenaacawe. bataweraate wesethe sela muhhamade yaanababutene 'ewenate yamiyaaragaagethe bamahone yawaradawe qure'aane 'esekidaresaacawe derase ba'emenataacawe gudaaye yatalayaayu 'alenabarume. yehene 'ewenate siyaasetabaabelu mareetaacawene tanathaqu ('athu). (male'eketanyaacene hoye!) geetaahe batenesaa'ee `elate bamilayaayubate gudaaye laaye feredene yesathaale. kanaresu makaakale tekekelanyaanaa thefaatanyaa lahonute 'enedamigabaacawe yemanadaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! wada 'aneta baawaradenawe qure'aane 'ewenatanyaanate laaye bahhasaabe geraa magaabaate wesethe kahoneke 'emenatene yataqabalunaa taweraatene yamiyaanabu 'ayehudaawiyaanene, nejilene yamiyaanabu naswaraawocene thayeqe. bamatsehhafaacawe wesethe yaqure'aanene magalachaa baaheriyaate selamiyaanabu ba'aneta laaye yatawaradawe male'ekete 'ewenate 'enedahona yenageruhale. fetzume yamaayaatharaathere 'ewenate kageetaahe zanede wada 'aneta mathetwale. katatharaathaariwoce 'atehune.

ya'alaahene geletse maaserajaawocenenaa meleketocene hasate kamilu (sawoce) 'atehune. (kanaresu kahoneke) bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate nafesaacawene wadathefaate 'azaqete kawarawarute kasaariwoce tehonaalahe. yehe hulu maasethaneqaqiyaa (ba'alaahe male'ekete laaye) therethaareene maasaadare lithanaqaqute yamigabaa gudaaye 'enedahona lamagelatze nawe. yehe nawe 'eneji male'eketanyaawe 'enedihe `aayenate therethaaree baresaacawe laaye kamakasate yatathabaqu naacawe.
bakehedate laaye getere bamahonaacawe ya'alaahe yaferede qaale yataragaagathabaacawe sawoce 'esekamacharashaawe 'emenatene 'ayeqabalume.

huluneme `aayenate tafatherwawi ta`aameraatocene bimalakatu 'enekwaa 'asaamaamiwene qethaate batachabaache 'esekiyaayu derase 'ayaamenume. (qethaatune kaayu baxwaalaa) baziyaane waqete maamanaacawe meneme yamithaqemaacawe 'ayehoneme.

male'eketanyaacenene kalaakenelaacawe katamoce ya'alaahe qethaate saayefatzamebaacawe bafite yamifalagawene 'emenate yataqabalutenaa 'emenataacawe yathaqamaacawe ('emenataacawe ya'alaahe qethaate 'ewene kamahonu bafite bamamethaatu) yayunuse hhezeboce becaa nabaru. 'ewenatanyaa maanene siyezu bamederaawi heyewate kaweredate qethaate natzaa 'awathaanaacawe. ('atarafenaacawe) fetzaameeyaacawe 'esekidareseme ba`aalamaawi heyewataacawe 'asedasatenaacawe(thaqamenaacawe).

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bamedere yaalu hulu 'enediyaamenu geetaahe bifalege noro hulume 'emenatene yeqabalu nabare. nagare gene 'eresu bamiyaaweqawe thebabe (geetaahe) yehene 'alefaqadame. bafetehawinatu yafalagawene sawe ka'emenate 'enedithameme yaadaregawaale. yafaqadawene sawe dagemo bacerotaawe qathetanyaawene manegade yemaraawaale. sawoce bagede 'emenatene 'enediqabalu maaderage yamicaalehe 'ayedalame. yamaanene sekeete masethate ba'alaahe 'eje becaa yaala nagare nawe.

'alaahe sifaqede 'eneji 'anediteme nafese baraaswa 'aqeme 'emenate maqabale 'ateceleme. yamaane sekeete ba'alaahe feqaade becaa yamikasate nagare nawe. 'emenatene baalamaqabalaacawe selanaresu nafesehe baquchete 'ateyaaze. 'alaahe maaserajaawocene, te`ezaazaatunenaa yakalakalaacawene nagaroce bamaayeradute laaye qethaatenaa weredatene yaadaregaale.

sela ta`aameraatoce lamithayequhe thaa`otaawiyaane 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yamiganyu ya'alaahene becanyaa 'amelaakenatenaa xaayaalenate yamiyaaseradu ta`aameraatocene 'asetawelu. yata`aameraatocenaa maaserajaawoce mawerade, yamale`eketanyoce (malaake), bakehedate laaye getere 'aqwaame bamayaazaacawe 'emenate lamaqabale zegejunate laleelaacawe hhezeboce thaqameetaa yalaweme.>>

'enazihe 'asetabaabaayoce yamithabequte kazihe qadame yanabaru hhezeboce yamale'eketanyocaacawene tale`eko hasatanyaa bamaalataacawe 'alaahe yakasatabaacawene `aayenate kesetate nawene!? 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe negaraacawe:- <<ya'alaahene qethaate tathabaabaqu; 'eneeme yageetaayeene qatharo ka'enaaneta gaare 'ethabeqaalahu.>>

kaziyaame banaresu laaye qethaataacenene 'enaawaredaalane. male'eketanyocaacenene 'enaa 'amaanye takataayocaacawene therethere baleelaawe maleku natzaa 'enaawathaacawaalane. yehenene maaderage ba'enyaa laaye yatzanaa (yataragaagatha) nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe belahe negaraacawe - <<'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'alaahene babecanyenate maamelake 'enedamiyaasefalege selamiyaasetamerawenaa theri selamaadaregelaacehu 'emenate therethaaree kaalaacehu 'eneeme ka'alaahe weche yametaamalekubate 'emenate sehetate selamahonu 'eregethanyaa nanye. selaziheme bafetzume 'emenataacehune 'alekataleme. ka'alaahe weche bahasate yametaamalekutene 'enee 'alaamalekeme. 'enee mote yamiyaamathaabaacehune 'alaahene 'egazaalahu. 'emenatene laresu becaa netzuhe yamaadarege sehone ka'amaanyoce 'enedehone 'azezonyaale.

'enedazihume kahulume 'emenatoce wadaresu 'enedezorenaa (bazihe) ba'ewenatanyaawe 'emenate laaye batzenaate 'enedeqome 'azezonyaale. baresu laaye ya'amelekote tagaarine kamiyaadaregu sawoce 'enedaalehone kalekelonyaale.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! theqeme lisathuhenaa gudaate liyaamathubehe selethaane yaleelaacawene thaa`otaatenaa 'amaaleketocene 'enedihume masalocaacawene 'atemaatzane ('ataameleke). 'enaresune yametaamaleke kahona ba'alaahe hhaqenaa banafesocaacawe laaye wasane kaalafute badalanyoce tehonaalahe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe bacegere bifatenehenaa cegerune 'enediyaasewagedelehe betemaatzanawe karesu basetaqare cegerehene yamiqarefelehe yalame. 'alaahe sekeete lisathehe bifalege dagemo yaresune cerotaa likalakele yamicele 'anedeme yalame. kabaariyaawocu lafaqadawe cerotaawene yesathaale. 'eresune yamiyaasegadedawe yalame. ('alaahe) baneseha wadaresu lamimalasu baariyaawocu meheratene sachi ruheruhe nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<yasawe lejoce hoye! kageetaacehu wada 'enaaneta qure'aane waredwale; baresu yamiyaamenenaa yamimaraa ba'emenate yamiyaaganyawe theqeme laraasu nawe. sawoce 'eresune bamaamelakaacawe 'alaahe yamithaqamawe nagare yalame. 'enedazihume manegadene yathamama yathematu mathefo wetheete yamiwadeqawe baraasu laaye nawe. yasawoce 'amatzanyenate 'alaahene 'ayegodaaweme. 'enee szeraacehune yamekataatalenaa meremaraa yamaadaregebaacehu thabaaqi 'ayedalahume.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe wada 'aneta yamiyaawaredawene malakotaawi male'ekete takatale. baszeraame taregumawe. kahhezebocehe 'emenatehene yaaletaqabalute bamiyaasecageruhe gudaaye 'enaa yatasathahene male'ekete bamaaderase laaye te`egesete 'aderege. 'alaahe banaresu laaye 'esekifaredenaa baqerebitu `aalame banaresu laaye delene 'esekiyaagonaatzefehe 'enedihume bakehedate laaye 'eyaalu kamotu bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame 'esekiqathaacawe derase bate`egesetehe laaye tzenu honahe qathale.

(lr) <<'alife, laame, rwa>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.) qure'aane 'aneqatzocu kamiyaasetamerute (kamiyaasetalaalefute) yamale'ekete teregumenaa ya'aqaraarabe selete 'anetzaare yatamwalaa matsehhafe nawe. ba'aneqatzocu wesethe kefetatenaa gudelate 'ayeganyeme. yatafaqadunaa 'ereme yatadaragu, te`ezaazocenenaa kelekelocene, beseraatocenenaa maasethaneqaqiyaawocene, taarikocene (tereketocene) 'enaa leeloceneme re`esa gudaayoce ba'aneqatzocu yaaberaaraale. selabaariyaawocu wesethaawi huneetaanaa selamithaqemaacawe nagare yamiyaaweqe kahona geetaa, bahege denegaageewocunaa bamaasetanaabaru thebabanyaa kahona fathaari yawarada male'ekete nawe.

bamuhhamade laaye yawaradute 'enazihe 'aneqatzoce theqele hhasaabe sawoce ka'alaahe gaare ba'ameleko tagaarinate leeloce nagarocene 'enedaayaamaleku makalekale nawe. <<yasawe lejoce hoye! 'enee 'alaahene kaamatzaacehunaa baresu laaye kehedatene kafatzamaacehu ya'alaahe qethaate 'enedaayaaganyaacehu 'asethaneqaaqiyaacehu nanye; 'enedazihume ba'alaahe kaamanaacehunaa baresume hege katamaraacehu selamisathaacehume beseraate yamenageraacehu nanye.>>

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! lahathi'ataacehu meheratene kageetaacehu thayequ. sela gudelataacehu batzatzate wada 'eresu tamalasu. yatatzaafalaacehu `edemee 'esekamiyaaleqe derase bamederaawi heyewataacehu malekaamene nagare yaamathaalaacexwaale. bamalekaame tagebaarunaa bataazaazhenatu kebere laalawe hulu yaaletaqanasa mulu yaszeraawene waagaa 'alaahe yeszathawaale. kageetaayee yezhee bamathaahute male'ekete kamaamane fitaacehune betaazoru beretu te`eyenete yamitaayebate yatenesaa'ee `elate qethaate ba'enaaneta laaye 'enedaayedarese 'efaraalahu.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! yatenesaa'ee `elate yametemalasute wada 'alaahe becaa nawe 'eresu ('alaahe) hulune nagare caaye nawe. yamisaanaweme nagare yalame. kamote baxwaalaa la'enaaneta heyewatene masethate, 'enedihume kamote kaqasaqasaacehu baxwaalaa selaszeraacehu meremaraa maaderage bafetzume 'ayaaqetaweme.

nequ! 'enaziyaa 'agaariyaane lebocaacawe wesethe yaalawene therethaaree lamadabaqe darataacawene zeqe yaadaregaalu. (yehene yamiyaadaregute) sela 'alaahe `eweqate yaleelaacawe bamahonu nawe. yaraase qelaacawene balebesocaacawe sishafenu, 'alaahe yamidabequtenenaa geletze yamiyaadaregutene yaaweqaale. 'eresu lebonaawoce yamisawerutene (yamidabequtene) mesethire yaaweqaale.

bamareete gatzetaa laaye yamineqasaaqase huluneme `aayenate fetherate sisaayune 'enedamilagesawe 'alaahe karesu bahona cerotaa xaalaafinatene wasedolataale. 'alaahe yafethurune yamaarafiyaa botaa yaaweqaale; heyewatu yamiyaalefebatene yamamocaa seferaaweneme yaaweqaale. yahulume taneqasaaqaashe fetherate sisaaye, yamaarafiyaanaa yamaalafiyaa botaa geletze bahonawe mazegabe (matsehhafe) (yatathabaqawe saleedaa) laaye yeganyaale.

samaayaatenenaa mederene (kanamulu gezefataacawe) yafatharawe le`elenaa yatagabaawe ya`aalamaatu geetaa 'alaahe nawe. banaresu wesethe yamiganyu nagarocene basedesete qanaate wesethe fathara. 'enaresu kamafatharaacawe bafite zufaanu baweha laaye nabare. sawoce hoye! yehe yahonawe ka'enaaneta makaakale yatenyaawe 'alaahe yamiwadawene malekaame tagebaare 'enedamiszaraanaa yatenyaawe 'alaahene yamiyaaseqothaa mathefo tagebaarene yamifatzeme 'enedahona lamafatane nawe. 'alaahe lahulume 'enedayaszeraawe yamigabaawene menedaa yesathaale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<sawoce hoye! sela szeraacehu letemaramaru kamote baxwaalaa teqasaqasaalaacehu setelaacawe 'alaahene yakaadutenaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase hasate nawe yaalute sawoce yehe yametaanabelene qure'aane geletze degemetenaa yamaayaatharaathere wedeqe nagare nawe>> bamaalate yenaagaraalu.

bamederaawi heyewate banaresu laaye lifatzame tagabi yahonawene qethaate latheqite qanaatoce yaahele senaazagayawe 'agaariyaane qethaatune bamaacaakolenaa bamaafeeze yehene qethaate yamiyaazagayawe menedenawe?! silu yedamathaalu (yenaagaraalu). 'asetawelu; la'enaaneta tagabi yamihonawe qethaate 'alaahe zanede yatawasana yaqane qatharo 'alawe. bamimathaabate waqete karesu yamikalaakalelaacawene 'ayaaganyume. qethaatu tafatzaami yehonebaacawaale. bamaafeezenaa bamaashofe sithaadafulate yanabarawe qethaate kahulume 'aqethaachaa yekabebaacawaale.

lasawe leje kanyaa yahonane tzagaa benesathawe ('eneda theenenatenaa hhabete) kaziyaame yasathanawene tzagaa benewasedebate ka'alaahe 'ezenate babezu tasefaa yaqoratha hono yeganyaale. 'alaahene tzagaawoce batelequ yekedaale. 'alaahe yasathawene maleso siwasedebate kazihe bafite tzagaa tasathetote 'enedanabara yezanagaale.

kaagaathamawe dehenatenaa bashetaa baxwaalaa safi sisaayenenaa theenenatene senesathawe mathefo nagare kanee gwaazune thaqalala; cegeree tawagada yelaale. 'alaahene 'ayaamasageneme. fanethazeyaanaa temekehete yaabazaale.

ba'asecagaari fatanaawoce, ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatzamenaa, kakalakalaacawe nagaroce bamaqothabe te`egesete yamiyaadaregu sawoce baaheri kazihe yatalaya nawe. tasefaa 'ayeqorethume. ya'alaahene tzagaawoce 'ayekedume. basawoce laaye wasanene 'ayaalefume. ('ayekorume) yehene `aayenate baaheri magalachaacawe yahonu sawoce lahathi'ataacawe 'alaahe meherate yesathaacawaale. bawadiyaanyaawe `aalameme taalaaqe (malekaame) menedaa 'alaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! selatamalakatekawe (selatagaafathekawe) kehedataacawe, ta`aameraatocene 'asaayane bamaalate mathayaqaacawenaa chefene geterenataacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe 'enedetaadarese kaazazahe male'ekete batagebaare laaye maawaale yamikabedaacawenaa kafile lamatawe taasebe yehonaale. <<hhabetaame (baalatzagaa) yamiyaadaregawe yahabete kemecete kasamaaye 'ayewaredelatemene?! wayeneme 'ewenatanyaa nawe yamile male'ake 'aberote 'ayemathaamene?!>> 'enedaayelu bamasegaate male'eketune kamaaderase lebehe yechanaqaale. bazihe mekeneyaate yamiwaredelehene malakotaawi male'ekete 'atetawe. 'aneta 'alaahe 'enedetaadarese yasathahene male'ekete yametaaderese 'asethaneqaaqi becaa nahe. yamithayequtene ta`aameraate yamaamethaate gedeetaa yalabeheme ('ayethabaqebeheme). 'alaahe hulumene nagare thabaaqi nawe.

'enedazihume thaa`otaawiyaane yehe qure'aane ka'alaahe yatalaaka malakotaawi male'ekete saayehone muhhamade yadarasawe nagare nawe bamaalate yenaagaraalune!? 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bamaalate yamaasaane theyaaqee 'aqerebelaacawe. yatadarasa nawe bamaalate bahhasate 'enedametemogetute `aayenate 'ewenatanyaa qure'aane 'enedetaamathu yamithabaqebaacehu saayehone, qure'aane yamimaselu 'asere yatadarasu me`eraafocene 'amethulenye; baziyaa laaye degaafe lamaagenyate matheraate yametecelutene hulu 'asabaasebu. qure'aane yatadarasa leba-walade nawe bamaalate yametaadaregute 'ewenatanyaa kahona yehenene fatzemu.

laaqarabaacehute theyaaqee melaashe yamisathaacehu kaalehona (malese masethate yamicaalaacawe selaalehona) 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! qure'aane yatadarasa lebe walade saayehone 'alaahe ba`eweqatu wada male'eketanyaawe yalaakawe male'ekete mahonune 'eregethanyaa `eweqatene yaazu. ka'alaahe basetaqare ba'ewenate yamiyaamalekute 'amelaake 'enedaleelame taganezabu. kazihe ta'amaaninaa geletze maaserajaa baxwaalaa la'alaahe taazaazhoce naacehune!?

baszeraawe yawadiyaanyaawene `aalame heyewate saayehone yamederaawi heyewatene thafi fanethazeyaa lamifalege sawe yaszeraawene menedaa bazihu mederaawi heyewate 'enesathawaalane. theenenaate dehenate safi hhabete kaszeraawe menedaa meneme yamiqanasebate 'ayehoneme.

bazihe mathefo tawaqaashe yahona yaszeraa hhisaabe yatagalatzu sawoce batenesaa'eewe `elate yamiyaaganyute yaszeraa menedaa 'ayenoreme. yamithabeqaacawe yamimaagadubate 'esaate becaa nawe. tagebaaraacawe ka'emenate yamanacha, 'enedihume ya'alaahene fite mamalekatenaa yawadiyaanyaawene `aalame malekaame nagaroce maagenyatene yaalama selaalenabare, yaszeraacawe menedaa yatasarazanaa tagebaaraacawe taqabaayenate yaleelawe wedeqe yehonaale.

kageetaawe zanede maaserajaawoce yaalute, ka'alaahe zanede yahona masekaari yaalawe (bazihe 'agebaabe masekaari tabelo yatathaqasawe jiberile nawe) 'enedazihume kaziyaame bafite bamusaa laaye yawaradawe taweraate nabiye mahonune yamasakaralate, yasawoce 'are'ayaanaa sawoce ya'alaahene 'ezenate 'enediyaaganyu mekeneyaate yahonawe male'eketanyaa muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'eresunaa 'amaanye takataayocu bathemate manegade wesethe katazafaqute kahadiyaane gaare bafetsume 'ekule yamiqamathu 'ayedalume. 'amaanyocu batakabarawe qure'aanenaa yaqure'aane male'ekete bawaradalate male'eketanyaa (muhhamade) yaamenaalu. 'eresune yamikedu yatalayaayu ya'emenate sawoce batenesaa'eewe `elate qatharwacawe 'esaate nawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! baqure'aanenaa batasathaacawe qatharo therethaaree 'ayegebaahe meneme therethere yaleelawe 'ewenate nawe. nagare gene meneme 'enekwaa geletze maaserajaawoce yatamwalu bihonume bezu sawoce 'emenate 'ayeqabalume.

la'alaahe tagaari wayeneme leje 'alawe bamaalate hasatene kamidarese sawe yabalatha badalanyaa sawe yalame. ba'alaahe laaye hasatene yamidaresu (yamiqathefu) sawoce sela szeraacawe lithayaqu batenesaa'ee `elate bageetaacawe fite yeqarebaalu. banaresu laaye mesekere yahonute malaa'eketenaa nabiyaate (male'eketanyoce), tagaari bamaaderagenaa leje 'alawe bamaalate ba'alaahe laaye hasatene yaqathafute 'enazihe naacawe bamaalate yemasakeraalu. ba'alaahe laaye hasatene bamanaagare badalanyaa yahonu sawocene 'alaahe ka'ezenate yaraaqu (yatabaararu) yaadaregaacawe!

kaqathetanyaawe ya'alaahe manegade sawocene yamiyaagedunaa, 'anedeme sawe baziyaa manegade 'enedaayemaraa ya'alaahe manegade 'eneqefaate yabazaabate yatathaamama 'enedahona yamifalegu, kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase manorune yamikedunaa yamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce naacawe.

bazihe baaheri yatagalatzu sawoce ya'alaahe qethaate banaresu laaye siwarede bamareete wesethe lishashu yamicelubate 'aqeme yalaacaweme. ka'alaahe weche qethaatune kanaresu makalaakale yamicelu radaatocenaa 'agaaroce yalaacaweme. nafesocaacawenenaa leelocene sawoce ka'alaahe manegade yaathamamu bamahonaacawe batenesaa'ee `elate qethaate yechamarebaacawaale. bamederaawi heyewataacawe bamaqabale semeete 'ewenatene baqene manegade mamaraatene maademathe yamicelu 'alenabarume. ka'ewenate bakabaade huneetaa yaafanagathu bamahonaacawe batafathero wesethe yamiganyu ya'alaahene ta`aameraatoce yamiyaasetawelunaa ka'asetawelotaacawe yamithaqemaacawene genezaabee yamiyaaganyu 'alehonume.

ka'alaahe gaare leelaane ya'ameleko tagaari bamayaaze nafesocaacawene bathefaate 'azaqete wesethe yaakaatatute (kalaaye batathaqasawe) bazihe baaheri yamigalatzu sawoce naacawe. 'amaalaajenaa tagaari 'aderegawe bahhasate yafatharwacawe nagaroce kanaresu yesawaraalu.

kehedatene bamaane, yawadiyaanyaawene `aalame heyewate, bamederaawi heyewate, 'ezenatene baqethaate yalawathu bamahonaacawe batenesaa'ee `elate gebeyetaacawe yakasara yahonawe ba'ewenate 'enaresu naacawe.

ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanu, malekaame tagebaaraatocene yafatzamu, la'alaahe raasaacawene zeqe yaadaragunaa 'eresune yamithanaqaqu sawoce janatene waraashoce naacawe. bajanate wesethe zala`aalamaawi qoyetaane yaaganyaalu.

yakahadiyaanenaa ya'amaanyoce hulate yatalayaayu budenoce mesaalee 'enedihe nawe. 'enedamaayemalakate `aayena sewerenaa masemaatene 'enedamaayecele jorowe yatadafana sawe - yehe 'ewenatene bamaqabale semeete yamiyaadaamethutenaa yamaayemalakatute yakahadiyaane budene mesaalee nawe. ya`aayene berehaane yaalawenaa, masemaate yamicele sawe mesaalee maademathenaa bamaasetawaale mamalekatene 'athaamero yayaazawe ya'amaanyoce budene mesaalee nawe.'enazihe hulate budenoce babaaheri galatzaa bahuneetaa 'ekule lihonu yecelaalune!? bafetzume 'ekule lihonu 'ayecelume. 'ekule baalamahonaacawe genezaabeene 'atewasedumene!? yamitaawaqawe yathaa`otaawiyaane

(ya'agaariyaane) kamaane 'afanegaache yamahone huneetaa sikasate 'alaahe nabiyune 'atzenaanetwacwale. hhezebocu yaasetabaabalute yamajamariyaawe male`eketanyaa 'enedaalehonu bamagelatze yanabiyaatocene taarike 'awesetolaacawaale.
baregethe male'eketanyaa 'aderegane nuhene wada hhezebocu laakene. 'enediheme 'alaacawe - <
'alaahene becaa 'enedetaamaleku theri 'adaregelaacexwaalahu. 'eresune 'eneji leelaane nagare 'ataameleku. ya'asaamaamiwe qane qethaate ba'enaaneta laaye 'enedaayedarese 'efaraalahu.>>

kahhezebocu 'emenatene yaaletaqabalute 'alaqocenaa mariwoce 'enedihe 'alute - <<ka'enyaa bameneme yametelaye baalamahonu therihene 'aneqabaleheme; ya'enyaawe `aayenate sawe nahe; 'enedamenaasetawelawe ka'enyaa wesethe yatakataluhe dakaamaa yahonute sawoce becaa naacawe. ya'enaanetane manegade 'enedenekatale bequ yamiyaadaregaacehu tachamaari kebere, hhabetenaa selethaane yalaacehume. 'enediyaaweme bametemogetute theri hasatanyaa mahonaacehune 'enegametaalane.>>

nuhhe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<hhezebocee hoye! negarunye 'ewenatanyaa mahoneene yamiyaaragaagethe geetaayee yasathanyene maaserajaa yayaazekunaa bamale`eketanyaanatee maamane gedeetaa yahonabaacehu bihonese; 'alaahe karesu yahona 'ezenate sathetonyaale. (bazihe 'agebaabe 'ezenate tabelo yatathaqasawe yatasathawe male`eketenaa nabiyenatu nawe.>> baalamaawaqaacehu mekeneyaate yehe ka'enaaneta yatasawara bihone bazihe male'ekete 'enedetaamenu lenaasegadedaacehunaa lebaacehune kafetane baxaayele (ba'emenate) lenechamere 'enecelaalane?! yehene maaderage 'aneceleme. yamaanene sekeete yamisathawe 'alaahe becaa nawe.

hhezeboce hoye! yatasathanyene male'ekete bamaaderasee ka'enaaneta ganezabene 'alethayeqeme. yaszeraayee menedaa ka'alaahe nawe. ka'enee 'enedaareqaacawe yathayaqaacehunyene dakaamaa 'amaanyoce katemeheretee 'enedirequ yamaadarege 'ayedalahume. 'enasu batenesaa'ee `elate geetaacawene yamiganaanyu naacawe. ba'emenataacaweme (malekaame) menedaane yesathaacawaale. hhehezebocee hoye! dakaamaa 'amaanyene ka'athagabee 'enedaareqe theyaaqee setaaqarebu, yamale'eketeene 'ewenatanyaa gatzetaa yaaletaradaacehu mahonune 'emalakataalahu.

hhezebocee hoye! 'enazihene dakaamaawoce (mesekinoce) yaalathefaataacawe ka'athagabee baareqaacawe ya'alaahene qethaate 'enee yamikalaakalelenye maanawe? 'ategasatzumene!? wadamithaqemaacehu malekaame nagare 'atefathenumene!?

hhezebocee hoye! ya'alaahe sisaaye kemecete 'enee zanede nawe; kaamanaacehu 'esathaacexwaalahu, 'alelaacehume. 'enedazihume yaruqene mesethire 'aweqaalahu, 'enee kamalaa`eketoce 'anedu nanye 'aleleme. ya'enaanetawe 'amesaayaa sawe nanye. baneqate selametemalakatwacawenaa zeqe selametaadaregwaacawe mesekinoceme 'alaahe sekeetene wayeneme qathetanyaawene manegade mamaraatene 'ayesathaacaweme 'aleleme. huneetaacawenenaa yalebe hasaabaacawene 'alaahe yaaweqaale. 'enee yehene 'aweqaalahu beyee bemogete ya'alaahe qethaate banaresu laaye mafatzamu tagabi kamihonebaacawe badalanyoce 'ehonaalahu.

(hhezebocu) bageterenatenaa bate`ebite 'enedihe 'alute - <<nuhhe hoye! 'enyaane makaraakare mamogate bathaame 'abazaahe. yametemogetawe nagare 'ewenate kahona yametaawaraalenene qethaate yezahebene naa.>>

nuhhe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<qethaatune ba'enaaneta laaye yamaamathaawe 'enee 'ayedalahume. faqaadu sihone ba'enaaneta laaye qethaatune yamiyaamathaawe 'alaahe nawe. 'alaahe liqathaacehu bifaqede kaqethaatu bafetzume maamelathe yametecelu 'ayedalaacehume>>

bate`ebitaacehu mekeneyaate kaqathetanyaawe manegade yathamamaacehu 'enedetehonu ya'alaahe feqaade kahona yamesathaacehu mekerenaa gesaatzee 'ayethaqemaacehume. 'eresu geetaacehu nawe; selagudaayaacehu mulu selethaane yaalawe 'eresu nawe. faqaadu kahona manegadene yasaataacehu yaadaregaacexwaale. batenesaa'ee `elate mamalashaacehu wada 'eresu becaa nawe. baszeraacehu yemanadaacexwaale.

yanuhhe hhezeboce yakehedate mekeneyaate nuhhe yezote yamathaawe yehe 'emenate ba'alaahe laaye yaqathafawe nawe belawe bahasate mamogataacawe nawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe <<male'eketeene bahasate yafatharekute kahona yahathi'atee qethaate yamifatzamawe ba'enee laaye becaa nawe. yakehedataacehu hathi'ate qenethaate yaaheleme ba'enee laaye 'ayehoneme. 'enee kakehedataacehu fetzume yatharaahu nanye.>>

'alaahe wada nuhhe male'eketene 'awarada - <<nuhhe hoye! 'enaho kahhezebocehe kazihe qadame 'emenatene yataqabalute siqaru leelocu 'ayaamenume. nuhhe hoye! therihene baadaragekebate razheme gizee yefatsemute banabarawe kehedatenaa feeze mekeneyaate hazane 'ayesamaahe.>>

ba'enyaa `eyetaanaa thebaqaa sere, bamenaasetaamerehe manegade marekabitwane szeraa. bakehedate nafesocaacawene labadalute sawoce gizee 'enedesathaacawe 'atethayeqanye bakehedate laaye getere bamahonaacawe mekeneyaate baweha maa`ebale yesathemaalu. yehe ba'eregethanyenate tafatsaami nawe.

nuhhe lageetaawe (la'alaahe) te`ezaaze taazaazhe hona. marekabitwane maszeraate jamara. yahhezebocu 'alaqoce ba'athagabu baalafu quthere weha baleelabate medere marekabe lamaszeraate bamanasaatu yaashofubate nabare. batadagaagaami siyaafeezubate 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<hhezebocee hoye! marekabitwane seneszaraa zaaree ba'enyaa laaye betaashofu yamithabeqaacehune yaweha maa`ebale baalamaawaqaacehu 'enyaame ba'enaaneta laaye 'enaashofaalane.>>
bazihe mederaawi `aalame weredatene yamiyaalabese qethaate bamaane laaye 'enedamimathaanaa batenesaa'eewe `elate zala`aalamaawi 'esaate bamaane laaye 'enedamiwarede baqerebu temalakataalaacehu.

nuhhe 'alaahe 'enediszaraa yaazazawene marekabe ganebeto 'athanaaqaqa. yamathefaataacawe te`ezaaze sidarese megebaacawene kamiyaabaselubate medejaa sere maa`ebale makasatune yamithaqumawe weha mafelaqe jamara. lanuhhe 'enedihe 'alenawe - "bamareete laaye kamiganyu 'enesesaatoce hulu thenede seetocenenaa wanedocene bamarekabitwa laaye 'asaafere. 'emenatene baalamaqabalu bamaa`ebalu 'enedamisatheme yaqadama ferede yaalabatene siqare beetasabocehenenaa ka'aneta gaare yaamanutene bamarekabitwa laaye chaane. (nuhe) wada 'alaahe theri 'eyaadaraga baqoyabaacawe razheme gizeeyaate karesu gaare yaamanute takataayoce bathaame teneshe nabaru.

nuhhe 'emenatene lataqabalute beetasabocunaa takataayocu 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<maqezafiyaawaanaa maarafiyaawaa ba'alaahe seme sihone bamarekabitwa laaye tasaafaru. geetaayee wada 'eresu batzatzate lamimalasu baariyaawocu meheratene lagaashenaa 'azaanye nawe. 'azaanye bamahonume kaweha thefaate yaadenaacawaale.>>

marekabitwa sawocenenaa leeloce yayaazacaacawene chenatoce tashakemaa bataalaaqu maa`ebale laaye setegwaaze taraaraa temaselaalace. ba'abaataawinate semeete nuhhe 'emenatene laaletaqabalawe leju theri 'adaraga. ba'anede seferaa ka'abaatunaa kahhezebocu talayeto nabare. <<lejee hoye! ka'enyaa gaare bamarekabitwa tasaafare; kamasemathe tedenaalahe kakahadiyaanoce gaare 'atehune; 'enaresune yamiyaaganyaacawe maa`ebale 'anetaneme yaaganyehale.>>

yanuhhe leje la'abaatu 'enedihe 'ala - <<wehawe 'enedaayedaresebate kafe wadaala taraaraa 'ethagaalahu.>> nuhhe laleju 'enedihe 'ala:- <<yafaqadawene kamasethame yamiyaadenebate ya'alaahe 'ezenate kaalehona baqare zaaree ka'alaahe yamaa`ebale qethaate yamiyaadene nagare yalame.>> maa`ebalu nuhene 'enaa 'emenate yaaletaqabalawe lejune 'alayaayaacawe. yanuhhe leje kakahadiwoce bamahonu mekeneyaate bawehaawe maa`ebale kasathamute hona.

maa`ebalu kataragaagaa baxwaalaa 'alaahe lamareete 'enedihe 'alaate <<mareete hoye! balaayeshe laaye yaalawene weha 'aserechiwe; samaaye hoye! wehane yaaze, zenaabehene 'aqume.>> wehawe qanasa; mareete daraqace. 'alaahe kahadiyaanene 'athafaacawe. yanuhhe marekabe <<judeye>> batasanya taraaraa laaye 'araface. bakehedate ya'alaahene wasane bamiyaalefu hhezeboce laaye thefaatenaa ka'alaahe 'ezenate maraaqe yatagabaa hona.

nuhhe batamaatzeno 'enedihe sile geetaawene tathaaraa - <<geetaayee hoye! natzaa 'enedametaawathaacawe qaale kagabaahelaacawe beetasabocee makaakale lejee yeganyebataale. ya'aneta yaqatharo qaale kidaane yamaayefarese 'ewenate nawe. 'aneta kafaraajoce hulu fetehaawiwenaa huluneme yametaaweqe nahe.>>

'alaahe lanuhhe 'enedihe 'alawe - <<nuhhe hoye! madehene 'enedeszathawe yathayaqekanye lejehe natzaa 'enedamaawathaacawe qaale kagabaahulehe beetasabocehe makaakale 'ayedalame. 'emenatene yaaletaqabala kahadi nawe. nuhhe hoye! yehene theyaaqee maaqerabehe ka'aneta yamithabaqe tagabi yahona tagebaare 'ayedalame. ba'aneta darajaa laaye kamiganye nabiye 'ayethabaqeme. 'eweqate selaleelahe nagare 'atethayeqanye. thebabeenenaa 'eweqateene yamiqaarane theyaaqee bamaaqerabe kamaayaawequ sawoce 'enedaatehone 'asethanaqeqehaalawe>>.

nuhhe 'enedihe 'ala - <<geetaayee hoye! selamaalaaweqawe nagare 'anetane kamathayaqe ba'aneta 'ethabaqaalahu. wada 'aneta 'ethagaalahu. lathefaatee meheratehene kaalagasekanyenaa 'ezenatehene kaalesathahenye bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame 'edelaacawene kaathu yakasaru sawoce 'ehonaalahu>>.

'alaahe lanuhhe 'enedahe 'alawe - <<nuhhe hoye! ba'anetanaa ka'aneta baxwaalaa bamimathute ka'aneta gaare bamarekabitwa wesethe banabaru zereyaawoce 'amaanyoce laaye 'alaahe balagasahe bezu tzagaawoce yataadaleke setehone kamarekabitwa laaye basalaamenaa dahenenate werade. kahadiyaane yahonu leeloce teweledoce kazereyaacawe yewathaalu. yamederaawi heyewate theqemocene 'enesethaacawaalane. kaziyaame bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame ka'enyaa yahona qethaate yaaganyaacawaale.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! wada 'aneta kaawaradenawe kazihe malakotaawi male'ekete bafite yehene yanuhhe taarike 'anetanaa hhezebocehe yamaataawequte yaruqe mesethire zeenaa nabare. nuhhe bate`egesete 'enedasaalafawe hhezebocehe bamiyaasetabaabelutenaa bamiyaasecageruhe gudaayoce laaye te`egesete 'aderege. delenaa 'ashanaafinate ya'alaahene te`ezaaze lamifatzemunaa kakalakalaacawe nagaroce lamiqothabute nawe.

wada `aade hhezeboce hude wanedemaacawene male'eketanyaa 'aderegane laakene. hude 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene babecanyenate tagazu; karesume gaare 'anedeneme nagare ya'amelekote tagaari 'ataaderegu. ba'ewenate letaamalekute yamigabaa ka'alaahe basetaqare leelaa 'amelaake yalaacehume. 'alaahe ya'amelekote tagaari 'enedaalawe bametemogetute nagare hhasatanyoce naacehu.

kageetaayee yatasathanyene male'ekete wada 'enaaneta bamaaderaseenaa wada male'eketu theri selaadaragekulaacehu ka'enaaneta menedaane 'alethayeqeme. yaszeraayee menedaa kafatharanye 'alaahe zanede nawe. yehene 'ateganazabumene!?

hhezebocee hoye! meheratene ka'alaahe thayequ. kahathi'ataacehume telequ hathi'ataacehu ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaari maaderagaacehu nawe wadaresu batzatzate tamalasu. bezu zenaabene bamaawerade menedaane yeszathaacexwaale. hhabetaacehunenaa zereyaacehune (teweledaacehune) bamaabezaate 'ahune baalaacehu kebere laaye tachamaari keberene yelagesaacexwaale. ba'alaahe bamakaadenaa yekxeewe yaamathaahutene male'ekete hhasate bamaalate theri kamaadaregelaacehu male'ekete fitaacehune 'ataazuru. yehene kaadaragaacehu ka'amatzanyoce tehonaalaacehu.>>

hhezebocu 'enedihe 'alute - <<hude hoye! 'enedenaamenehe yamiyaadaregane geletze maaserajaa yezahe 'alemathaaheme. bamarajaa laaletadagafa negegerehe belane 'amaaleketocaacenene magazaate yamenetawe 'ayedalaneme. male'eketanyaa nanye bamaalate selametenaagarawe nagare 'anaameneheme.>>

'enaresune 'enedaanaamaleke setaasethanaqeqe kafile 'amaaleketocaacene bakefu (ba`ebedate) saayenakuhe (saayelakefuhe) 'aleqarame 'enelaalane. hude 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<'alaahe mesekeree nawe; 'enaanetaneme 'asemasekeraalahu; ka'alaahe weche kametaamalekwaacawe 'amaaleketocaacehu fetzume yanatzaahu nanye. 'enaanetane ba`ebedate 'enedalakafunye yametemogetwacawe 'amaaleketoce ba'anede laaye tanekolaacehune sharebu; meneme gizee 'atesethunye.

'enaresune 'enedaanaamaleke setaasethanaqeqe kafile 'amaaleketocaacene bakefu (ba`ebedate) saayenakuhe (saayelakefuhe) 'aleqarame 'enelaalane. hude 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<'alaahe mesekeree nawe; 'enaanetaneme 'asemasekeraalahu; ka'alaahe weche kametaamalekwaacawe 'amaaleketocaacehu fetzume yanatzaahu nanye. 'enaanetane ba`ebedate 'enedalakafunye yametemogetwacawe 'amaaleketoce ba'anede laaye tanekolaacehune sharebu; meneme gizee 'atesethunye.

mamakaateene ba'alaahe laaye becaa 'aderegeeyaalahu. bagudaayu laaye hulu 'eresune tadagefeeyaalahu. 'eresu 'alaahe ya'enaanetame ya'eneeme fathaari geetaa nawe. bamareete laaye yamineqasaaqase nagare hulu baresu negeszenaanaa xaayaalenate sere raasune zeqe yaadaraga nawe. 'alaahe 'enedafaqaadu yaadaregawaale. 'alaahe geetaayee fetehawinaa 'ewenatanyaa nawe. ba'ewenate laaye bamahoneenaa bahasate laaye bamahonaacehu ba'enee laaye 'ashanaafinatene 'ayesathaacehume.

yezheewe kamathaahute male'ekete fitaacehune betaazorunaa jarebaacehune betesathu 'enee yaalabenye xaalaafinate male'eketeene maaderase becaa nawe. 'alaahe yalaakanyene male`ekete hulu wada'enaaneta 'adereshaalahunye. marajaa (maasethaneqaqiyaa) dareswacexwaale. 'alaahe yaathafaacexwaale. ba'enaaneta seferaame leeloce tataki hhezebocene yaamathaale. kamale'eketu fitaacehune bamaazoraacehunaa bamaafanegathaacehu (tenesheme hona teleqe) 'alaahene qenethaate 'ategoduteme. 'eresu kafetherataatu meneme yamifalegawe nagare yalame. ya'enee geetaa huluneme nagare taqothaathaari nawe. ba'enee laaye kametethanasesute mathefo seeraa yamithabeqanyeme 'eresu nawe.>>
yahudene hhezeboce yamiyaathafaawe te`ezaazaacene simathaa hudenenaa karesu gaare 'aberawe yaamanutene bahhezebocaacawe laaye kadarasawe beretu qethaate ba'ezenataacene natzaa 'awathaanaacawe.

ya`aade hhezeboce 'enazihe naacawe; bageetaacawe ta`aameraatoce kehedatene fatsamu. male'eketanyaacawene hudene 'amatzute. ba'ewenate laaye yamiszaraa, 'ewenatene maqabale yamaayefalegenaa la'ewenate 'ejune yamaayesathe wasane yaalafa sawe manegadene (te'ezaazene) takatalu.

bazihe mederaawi `aalame ka'alaahe 'ezenate mabaararenaa weredate gathamaacawe. bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate 'enedazihume batenesaa'eewe `elate ka'alaahe 'ezenate 'enedirequ yatadaragu yehonaalu. 'alaahe kamalekaame nagaroce hulu yaraaqu, wada mathefo nagaroce hulu yaqarabu 'adaragaacawe.

wada samude hhezeboce swalihe wanedemaacawene laakene. swalihe lahhezebocu 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene becaa tagazu ba'ewenate 'amelekote yamigabaawe 'amelaake karesu weche yalaacehume. 'abaataacehune 'adame bamafethare kamareete 'afare yaaseganyaacehu (wada manore yaamathaacehu) 'eresu nawe. yamedere 'ademaaqiwoce 'adaragaacehu. ka'alaahe meheratene thayequ. kaziyaame malekaame szeraawocene bamaszeraatenaa hathi'atocene bamatawe wada 'eresu tamalasu. 'amelekotene laresu becaa therete laadaraga sawe 'alaahe qerebe nawe. yamimaatzanawene sawe theri yeqabalaale.>>

hhezebocu 'enedihe 'alute - <<swalihe hoye! kazihe therihe bafite ka'enyaa wesethe teleqe darajaa yaalahenaa tasefaa yamithaalebehe sawe nabareke. lasawoce mekere yametesathe, yamiyaamaakeruhe, 'asetawaaye sawe 'enedetehone 'enemanyeme nabare. 'enaame 'ahune 'abaatocaacene yaamalekute yanabarawene 'amaalekete 'enedaanaamaleke tekalakelanaalahene!? 'alaahene becaa tagazu 'eyaaleke wadaresu theri yametaadaregelenene nagare batherethaaree 'enaayawaalane; ba'alaahe laaye hasatene 'eyatanaagareke 'enedahona 'enegametaalane.>>

swalihe lahhezebocu 'enedihe sile malese satha - <<hhezebocee hoye! negarunye; kageetaayee yahona geletze maaserajaa yaalanyenaa 'eresu 'ezenatune (bazihe 'agebaabe 'ezenate nabiyenate maalate nawe) yasathanye bihone, wada 'enaaneta 'enedaadaresawe yaazazanyene male'ekete bamatawe 'eresune baametze karesu qethaate yamiyaadenanye maanawe!? 'enaaneta letechamerulenye yametecelute themematenaa ka'alaahe wedeetaa maraaqene becaa nawe.

hhezebocee hoye! yeheci ya'alaahe gemale 'ewenatanyaa selamahonee la'enaaneta yatasathace melekete naate. ba'alaahe medere 'enedetemagabe tawewaate. meneme cegere 'ataaderesubaate. bametewagwaate waqete qerebe qethaate yaaganyaacexwaale.>>

bamaasetabaabalaacawe ba'ejegu bamagefaataacawe gemalitwane 'aradwate. swalihe 'enedahe 'alaacawe - <<kazihe tagebaaraacehu baxwaalaa bamareetaacehu laaye szosete qanaatocene yaahele becaa basalaamaawi heyewate fanethezu; kaziyaame ya'alaahe qethaate yemathaabaacewaale; qethaatu mamethaatu hasatenate yalaweme. yamaayaatharaathere 'ewenatanyaa qatharo nawe.>>

hhezebocu 'enedathafu yawesaanee te`ezaazaatene simathaa swalihenenaa karesu gaare yaamanutene ka'enyaa bahona 'ezenate natzaa 'awathaanaacawe. (salaame 'adaragenaacawe) kaziyaane `elate weredate 'adaanenaacawe. <<'atarafenaacawe>> 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe 'eresune yamaayaashanefawe yaleela xaayaalenaa 'ashanaafi nawe. selaziheme 'asetabaabaaye hhezebocene 'athafaacawe.
samudene yaathafaawe thanekaaraa yademetse chukxate yaazaacawe. bathenekaareewe wadaqu (motu); bagenebaaraacawe tadafu; fitocaacawene 'afare shafanawe.

batzagaanaa batamacaaca nuro bamareetaacawe 'enedaalenoru honu. 'asetawelu! yasamude hhezeboce bageetaacawe 'alaahe laaye kehedatene fatzamu; ka'alaahe 'ezenate 'enedirequ yatadaragu kamahone 'aletawagadume.

yaa`eqube kaziyaame sehhaqe yamisanyu lejocene 'enedamiyaaganyu laresunaa lamisetu beseraatene lamasethate malaa'eketoce basawe qeretze 'amesaayaa wada beraahime mathu. malaa`eketocu <<szalaame>> 'alute. beraahime <<szalaame>> sile malese sathaacawe. kaziyaame bafethenate heeda. sawoce naacawe belo bamaasabu 'enedimagabu yatathabasa yathejaa segaa yezolaacawe qaraba.

beraahime 'ejocaacawune wada thejaawe segaa 'enedaalezaragunaa 'alamamagabaacawene simalakate tagebaaraacawe (huneetaacawe) geraa gabaawe. selanaresu yataszamaawene ferehate bawesethu dabeqo yaaza. malaa'eketocu 'enedafaraacawe simalakatu <<'ateferaa; qethaate 'enedenefatzemebaacawe wada luthe hhezeboce 'alaahe lekone nawe.>> 'alute.

yaberaahhime misete saaraa qumaa nabare. sehhaqene 'enedametewalede, sehhaqeme <<yaa`eqube>> yatasanya leje 'enedaminorawe yamiyaasedasetaatene beseraate nagarenaate. basamaacewe nagare badasetaa saaqace; malekaame nagare 'enedametaaganye 'asabace.

malaa'eketoce beseraatune sinagerwate saaraa 'enedihe 'alace:- <<leje kamawelade tasefaa yaqorathekunye `edemeeyee yagafaa seete honyee 'enedeete nawe yamewaledawe!? yeheme baalee yashemegelenaa `edemeewe laaye dareswale. bazihe huneetaa leje mawelade bathaame yamidaneqe nagare nawe. yatalamada 'ayedalame.>>

babeseraatu setegarame malaa'eketoce lasaaraa 'enedihe 'alwate - <<ba'alaahe feredenaa wesaanee tedanaqiyaalashene!? 'alaahe yehene bamasala nagare laaye caaye selamahonu 'anecine lamasalace seete yamisaware 'ayedalame. (yaberaahime beetasaboce hoye!) ya'alaahe 'ezenatenaa rade'eete ba'enaaneta laaye yehune. 'alaahe babaaheriwenaa batagebaaru yatamasagana yale`elenaanaa yaleqenaa baalabeete nawe.>>

yaaqarabawene megebe yaaletamagabute 'enegedocu yafatharubate ferehaate kaberaahime laaye siwagade (malaa'ekete mahonaacawene siyaaweqenaa sehhaqe kaziyaame yaa`eqobe 'enedamiwaladulate 'asedasaace zeenaa sidaresawe) yamifatzamebaacawene qethaate 'enediyaazagayulaacawe 'enedihume luthenenaa beetasabocune 'enediyaadenu kamalaa`eketocu gaare makaraakare jamara.
beraahhime hodasafi taagaashe nawe. qethaate 'enedizagaye yamiwade. raasune zeqe 'aderego geetaawene mamaatzanenaa malamane yamiyaabazaa. wada geetaawe baneseha tamalaashe nawe.

malaa'eketoce 'enedihe 'alute - <<beraahime hoye! sela luthe hhezeboce kametaadaregawe kazihe kerekere taqothabe! banaresu laaye 'alaahe yawasanawe qethaate 'enedamifatzamebaacawe yageetaahe te`ezaaze mathetwale. yaluthe hhezeboce taalaaqe qethaate yaaganyaacawaale. tsalotenaa kerekere qethaatune 'ayemalesaweme.>>

malaa'eketoce basawe qeretze 'amesaayaa wada luthe simathu, luthe bamamethaataacawe takafaa. seetocene tetawe batzotaawi semeete wanedocene yamimarethu yahonute hhezeboce theqaate 'enedaayaadaresubaacawe bamaferaate lebu tachanaqa. hhezebocu 'enegedocune falegawe baxaayele 'enedamiyaashanefute bamagamatu zaaree beretu 'asechanaaqi qane nawe sile tanaagara.

hhezebocu 'enedihe 'alute - <<luthe hoye! kaseete lejoceheme hona kahhezebocehe seetoce gudaaye 'enedaleelane taaweqaalahe. (lanaresu) tzotaawi semeete yalaneme. yamenefalegawe wanedocene becaa nawe. mene 'enedamenefalege bamigabaa taaweqaalahe.>>
luthe 'enedihe 'ala - <<'enaanetane makalaakale yamecelebate 'aqeme binoranye, wayeneme zamadocee bikalaakalulenyenaa 'enegedocee laaye 'enedaatedaresu maaderage becele 'emanyaalahu.>>

malaa'eketoce laluthe 'enedihe 'alute - <<luthe hoye! 'enyaa 'alaahe yalaakane malaa'eketoce nane. hhezebocehe wada 'aneta bamathefo lidaresubehe 'ayecelume. beetasabocehene yezahe kazihe katamaa balalite chalamaa wethaa. maanaacehume wadaxwaalaacehu 'atemalekatu- misetehe seteqare. hhezebocehene yaaganyawe qethaate 'ereswaneme yamiyaaganyaate bamahonu yehene te`ezaaze bamaqaarane wadaxwaalaa temalakataalace. yamathefiyaacawe qatharo negaate nawe; qerebe qatharo nawe. negaate qerebe 'ayedalamene!?>>

yaluthe hhezeboce 'enedithafu te`ezaazaacene sidarese manedaraacawene wadalaaye kafe 'aderegane kalaaye wadataace galabathenawe. 'athagabe la'athagabe (gone lagone) kafilu bakafilu laaye yatadaradaru yadaraqe cheqaa denegaayocene 'azanabenebaacawe.

yehe denegaaye ka'alaahe zanede leyu melekete yatadaragabate nawe. yehene yamasala denegaaye kaqurayeshenaa kaleeloce badalanyoce ruqe 'ayedalame. qerebe nawe. banaresu laaye 'enediwarede ya'alaahe wesaanee bahonabate qetsebate yewaredaale.

wada madeyane hhezeboce shu`ayebe wanedemaacawene laakene. shu`ayebe 'enedihe 'ala - <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene becaa 'ameleku; karesu basetaqare 'amelekote yamigabaawe leelaa 'amelaake yalaacehume. lasawoce setesaferunaa setemazenu seferenaa mizaanene 'ataagudelu. basafi hhabetenaa tzagaa wesethe 'enedahonaacehu 'emalakataalahu. ya'alaahene tzagaanaa cerotaa bahathi'ate 'ateqayeru. 'eyaanedaanedaacehu laaye yamidaresenaa hulune yamikabebe qethaate ba'enaaneta laaye yamidaresebatene qane 'efaraalahu. kaziyaane `elate qethaate mashashiyaanaa mashashagiyaa 'ataaganyume.

hhezebocee hoye! lasawoce setesaferunaa setemazenu masefariyaanenaa mizaanene bafetehe yatamwalaa 'aderegu. mizaanene bamaagudale, bamaataalalenaa bamaachebarebare kasawoce haqe qenethaate yaahele 'ateqanesu; gedeyaa bamafatzame baleeloce hathi'atoce mederene 'ataabalaashu.

mederene bamaabalaashatenaa mizaanene bamaagudale kametaaganyute chemaari (terefe), yasawocene mabetenaa hhaqe kamwalaacehu baxwaalaa 'alaahe yamiyaaseqarelaacehu qari netzuhe nagare yabalatha theqemenaa rade'eete 'alawe. 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyoce kahonaacehu yehene qari netzuhe nagare yametewadu hunu. 'enee szeraacehune yamekataatalenaa baziyaa laaye hhisaabe yamaadarege taqothaathaari 'ayedalahume. szeraacehune yamiqothaatharawe geletzenaa debeqe mesethirocene yamiyaaweqawe 'alaahe nawe.>>

shu`ayebe lahhezebocu 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<hhezebocee hoye! kageetaayee bahona geletze maaserajaanaa `eweqate laaye yahoneku behone mene `aayenate huneetaa 'enedaminoraacehu negarunye. 'alaahe karesu zanede netzuhe sisaayene lagaszanye. (nabiyenate bazihe wesethe yekaatataale) ka'anede tagebaare yamekalakelaacehunaa yaanene tagebaare bamaszeraate yameqaaranaacehu mahonene 'alefalegeme. 'alaahene babecanyenate 'enedetaamalekunaa laresu taazaazhe 'enedetehonu bamaadaregelaacehu theri la'enaaneta yamefalegawe malekaamene nagare nawe. 'aqemee bafaqada mathane. sekeeteene yamaaganyawe ka'alaahe becaa nawe. bahulume gudaayocee ba'alaahe laaye becaa tamakeceeyaalahu. mamalashaayeeme wadaresu nawe.>>

hhezebocee hoye! la'enee yaalaacehu thelaacaa male'eketeene hhasate nawe lamaalate 'ayegefaacehu. yanuhhe hhezeboce, yahude hezeboce, yaswalihe hhezeboce laaye yadarasawe qethaate 'amesaayaa ba'enaanetame laaye 'enedaayedarese 'efaraalahu. kagizeeme hona kabotaa reqate 'anetzaare yaluthe hhezeboce ka'enaaneta ruqe 'ayedalume. yadarasabaacawene taaweqaalaacehu. genezaabeene wesadu.

hhezebocu lashu`ayebe 'enedihe 'alute - <<shu`ayebe hoye! yezakxawe yamathaakxawe nagare bezu 'ayegabaaneme. `aayenehe bamadekamu wayeneme bamataawaru 'enyaa 'aqemabise 'enedahoneke nawe yamenemalakatehe. zamadocehe ba'enyaawe ya'emenate manegade laaye bamahonaacawe 'eneji badenegaaye wagerane 'enegadelehe nabare. 'anetane magedale yamiyaasefaraane kebere yamenesathawe sawe 'ayedalaheme. lazamadocehe kebere senele nawe 'anetane kamagedale yataqothabenawe.>>

shu`ayebe lahhezebocu 'enedihe 'ala - <<hhezebocee hoye! ka'alaahe geetaacehu (fathaariyaacehu) beeta zamadocee 'enaaneta zanede yabalatha yamifarunaa yamikabaru naacawene. 'eresu wada 'enaaneta yalaakawene male'eketanyaa baalamaqabale 'alaahene kajarebaacehu tawaacehute. ya'enee geetaa ('alaahe) yameteszarutene szeraa huluneme yaaweqaale. katagebaaraacehu yamisawarebate nagare yalame. bamederaawi heyewate 'enedetethafu bamaaderage bawadiyaanyaawe `aalame ba'esaate qethaate yaszeraacehune waagaa yesathaacexwaale.
