hhezebocee hoye! bawadadaacehute (bamarathaacehute) manegade yametecelutene (yafaqadaacehutene) szeru; 'enee bawadadekute (bamarathekute) manegade yamecelawene 'eszaraalahu. ka'enyaa makaakale 'enediqathaabate yamiyaawaaredawe qethaate maane 'enedamimathaabate, baminaagarawe nagare maane hhasatanyaa 'enedahona wadafite taaweqaalaacehu. ya'alaahene wesaanee thabequ; 'eneeme ka'enaaneta gaare 'ethabeqaalahu.>>

yashu`ayebe hhezeboce 'enedithafu te`ezaazaacene simathaa, ka'enyaa bahona 'ezenate shu`ayebenenaa karesu gaare yaamanutene natzaa 'awathaanaacawe. kahhezebocu badalanyaa yahonutene 'athefi yahonu beretu yademetze chukxate 'aganyaacawe. motu; bagenebaaraacawe tadafu; fitocaacawe ba'afare tashafana.
kaziyaa qadame 'enedaalenorubate hona. 'asetawelu! yasamude hhezeboce ka'alaahe 'ezenate 'enedaraaqute ya'alaahe quthaa safenobate <<madeyane>> ka'alaahe 'ezenate raaqa (tabaarara)
'alaahe 'amelekote yamigabaawe becanyaa mahonune bamiyaamalaaketu ta`aameraatocenaa 'ewenatanyaa male'eketanyaa mahonune bamiyaasaayu geletse maaserajaawoce musaane laakenawe.

wada fire`owenenaa hhezebocu taalaalaaqoce laakenawe. yahhezebocu taalaalaaqoce ba'alaahe 'enedikedu yaadaragaacawene yafire`owenene te`ezaaze takatalu. yafire`owene te`ezaaze 'ewenatene yachabatha yamikatalute 'ayenate 'ayedalame ('alenabarame).
batenesaa'eewe `elate fire`owene hhezebocune 'eyamaraa 'esaate wesethe yechameraacawaale. wadaresu yamiyaawaredaacawe mawerajaa bathaame yakafaa nawe.

bamasethame kaaganyaacawe qethaate batachamaari bamederaawi `aalame yataragamunaa ka'alaahe 'ezenate yatabaararunaa yaraaqu 'enedihonu 'adaragaacawe. 'eregemaanenaa qethaate bahulatume `aalame (bamederaawinaa bamacharashaawe `aalame) yatathaamarabaacawe mahonu bathaame yakafaa hona.

bafatzamenebaacawe yathefaate qethaate 'alebadalenaacaweme. nagare gene 'alaahene bamakaadaacawe nafesaacawene yathefaate 'azaqete wesethe bamawareware raasaacawene badalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye!- ya'alaahe te`ezaaze simathaa ka'alaahe weche siyaamalekwaacawe yanabaru 'amaaleketoce banaresu laaye yawaradabaacawene qethaate 'aletakalakalulaacaweme. 'amaaleketocaacawe yaaseganyulaacawe tachamaari keseratenaa thefaatene becaa nabare.

'enedazihume 'alaahe male'eketune yaasetabaabalawene katamaa yayaazabatenaa kasere maszaratu yaathafaabate qethaate, (tamasaasaaye thefaatene bamifatzemu katamoce laaye) bahulume gizeenaa botaa lihone yecelaale. 'alaahe badalanyaa katamaane baqethaate yamiyezebate huneetaa 'asaamaaminaa beretu nawe.

badalanyaa katamaane 'alaahe baberetu qethaatu yayaazabate huneetaa yatenesaa'eene `elate lamifaraa mekerenaa temeherete nawe. selaszeraacawe meremaraa 'enedidaragebaacawe 'alaahe sawocene yamisabasebebate yaane `elate; kamote baxwaalaa taqaseqesawe yamisabasabute sawoce yamiganyubate yamasabesabiyaa te`eyenetaawi `elate nawe.
lamitaawaqe yaahele theqite yagizee qutherocene 'eneji yaane yamasabesabiyaa `elate 'anaazagayaweme.

yaa `elate simathaa ba'alaahe feqaade kaalehona 'anediteme nafese bamarajaame yehune bamelejaa fetzume 'atenaagareme. baziyaane `elate sawoce hulate `aayenate huneetaa yenoraacawaale ('esaate yamigabu `edelabisocenaa, janate yamiwaresu dasetanyoce).

bakehedataacawenaa babeleshu megebaaraacawe mekeneyaate `edela bise yahonute 'esaate wesethe yegabaalu; bamisaqaayubate yanabalebaale beretaate ba'esaate wesethe 'esetenefaasaacawenaa chukxataacawe kafe yaala yehonaale.

baziyaa wesethe zala`aalamene yeqoyaalu. samaayaatenaa medere 'esekamiqoyubate derase ka'esaate 'ayewathume. 'alaahene babecanyenate siyaamaleku kanabaru hathi'atanyoce makaakale 'alaahe bafeqaadu ka'esaate liyaawathaawe yafaqadawe siqare. 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe yafaqadawene szari nawe. le`elenaa laresu yahonawe 'alaahe 'asegadaaje yalaweme.

ba'emenataacawenaa bamalekaame megebaaraacawe ka'alaahe dasetaane yatatzaafalaacawe `edelanyoce bajanate wesethe yehonaalu. baziyaa wesethe zala`aalame yeqoyaalu (samaayaatenaa medere 'esekamiqoyubate gizee derase) janate kamagebaataacawe bafite 'alaahe 'esaate liyaasegabaacawe yafaqadawe 'amaanye hathi'atanyoce siqaru. 'alaahe lajanate sawoce yamisathawe tzagaa bafetzume yamiqwaarathe 'ayedalame.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa 'agaariyaane yamiyaamalekwaacawe nagaroce beleshu selamahonaacawe bageraa magaabaatenaa therethaaree wesethe 'atehune. tekekele selamahonaacawe liyaaqarebute yamicelute malakotaawinaa 'a`emerwawi maaserajaa yalame. ka'alaahe weche yamiganyu nagarocene 'enediyaamaleku yamigafaacawe mekeneyaate 'abaatocaacene bachefene makatalaacawe becaa nawe.

lamusaa taweraate sathanawe sawoce baresu yatalayaayu honu. kafilocu 'emenatene taqabalu; kafilocu kehedatene fatzamu. qethaatune 'ahune 'enedamaayaafathenawenaa 'eresu lamiyaaweqawe thebabe wada `elata tenesaa'ee 'enedamiyaazagayawe ka'alaahe yahona wesaanee yaqadama baayehonenoro bamederaawi `aalame tagabi yamihonaacawe qethaate yewaredebaacawe nabare. ka'agaariyaanenaa ka'ayehudaawiyaane yahonu kahadiyaane selaqure'aane batherethaaree laaye naacawe. geraa magaabaate wesethe wadeqawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yatathaqasute yatalayaayu (hhezeboce) geetaahe yaszeraacawene waagaa mulu 'aderego yesathaacawaale. malekaame yanabara yaszeraawe waagaa malekaame yehonaale; mathefo yanabara yaszeraawe waagaa mathefo yehonaale. 'alaahe yeszarute yanabarawene qenethaate zerezeroce hulu yaaweqaale. kanaresu szeraa baresu laaye yamidabaqebate meneme nagare yalame.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe 'enedaazazahe hulegizeeme qathetanyaawene manegade 'athebeqahe yaaze. 'alaahe yaazazahene fatseme; kakalakalahe taqothabe. ka'aneta gaare neseha yagabu 'amaanyoceme tzenu yehunu. hathi'atene bamafatzame wasane 'enedaataalefu. 'alaahe yameteszarutene tamalekaace nawe. kaszeraacehu 'anediteme nagare 'ayesawarebateme. yaszeraacehuneme menedaa yesathaacexwaale.
bamamasaasale wayeneme bawedeetaa badalanyaa wadahonu kahadiyaanoce 'ataazanebelu. bazihe zenebaalee mekeneyaate 'esaate yenakaacawaale. kazihe yamiyaadenaacehu ka'alaahe weche radaate yalaacehume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! baqane chaafoce (baqanu magebiyaa thawaatenaa, baqanu macharashaa meshete) 'enedihume balalitu yasa`aate kefele batamwalaa huneetaa salaatene segade. malekaame tagebaaraatoce 'anasetanyaa hathi'atocene yeszareyaalu. yehe mekere lamiqabalu sawoce gesaatzee nawe. genezaabeene lamiwasedu sawoce temeherete nawe

batzenaate laaye 'enedetehone bataazazekawe 'enedihume wasane 'enedaataalefunaa wada badalanyoce 'enedaataazanabele katakalakalekawe bamaqothabe laaye te`egesete yenurehe. 'alaahe yamalekaame szariwocene tagebaare wedeqe 'ayaadaregeme. 'enediyaaweme katagebaaraacawe yaamaara (yatashaala) yeqabalaacawaale. yeszarute kanabarawe batashaala yaszeraacawene waagaa yesathaacawaale.

ka'enaaneta bafite qethaate kawaradabaacawe teweledoce yatarafu yamalekaame szeraanaa cerotaa sawoce binorunaa 'enaziyaane teweledoce (hhezeboce) kakehedatenaa mederene bahathi'ate kamabakale bikalakelu mene nabare?! 'enedazihe `aayenate sawoce 'alenabaraacaweme. kamathefo tagebaare yamiyaasethanaqequte theqitoce becaa nabaru. badalanyaa hhezebocaacawe senaathafaa 'enaresune natzaa 'awathaanaacawe ('atarafenaacawe) yahhezebocaacawe badalanyoce yanabarubatene qethe yaathaa qenethote takatalu (qathalu). baziheme badalanyoce honu.
nawaariwocu malekaame sawoce yahonubatene katamaa geetaahe yamiyaathafaa 'ayedalame. katamaane yamiyaathafaawe nawaariwocu bakehedate, babadalenaa bahathi'ate 'abalaashiwoce sihonu nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yasawe lejoce ba'ewenate laaye 'anede hhezeboce 'enedihonu yageetaahe feqaade bihone yehene yaadarege nabare. nagare gene geetaahe yehene 'alefaqadame. yanafese semeetenenaa wasane maalafene bamakatale mekeneyaate baresu yatalayaayu kamahone 'ayewagadume.

qathetanyaawene manegade yamamaraatene sekeete bamasethate 'alaahe yaazanalaacawe siqaru. 'enaresu 'alaahene babecanyenate bamaamelake laaye leyunate 'ayenoraacaweme. selaziheme bamalayaayate yamifatanu 'enedihume le`elenaa yatagabaawe 'alaahe fatharaacawe. jahanamene yashayethwane takataaye bahonu sawocenaa 'agaanenetoce 'enedamimolaa geetaahe <<baqadametenate>> yawasanawe yawesaanee qaalu tafatzama.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'aneta bafite selanabarute male'eketanyoce zeenaane yamenetarekelehe lebehene ba'ewenate lamaatzenaate 'enaa lamaathanekare nawe. bazihe me`eraafe therethaaree yaleelawe 'ewenate wada 'aneta dareswale. bazihe wesetheme lakahadiyaane mekere, 'enedihume bagesaatzee lamithaqamu 'amaanyoce maasetaawashaa mathetwale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'alaahe lamaayaamenutenaa 'eresune babecanyenate lamaayaamaleku sawoce 'enedihe balaacawe <<ka'ewenate bamaafanegathe, sawoce wada 'ewenate 'enedaayeheedu bamakalekale 'akaaheedaacehune (manegadaacehune) qathelu. 'enyaame batzenaate wada 'ewenate sawocene bamatheraatenaa bate`egesete bamanegadaacene 'eneqathelaalane.
ba'enyaa laaye yamiwaredawe mene 'enedahona thabequ; 'enyaame ba'enaaneta laaye yamiwaredawene 'enethabeqaalane.>>

basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yamiganyu mesethirocene 'alaahe becaa yaaweqaale. karesu meneme yamidabaqebate nagare yalame. batenesaa'ee `elate yahulume nagare gudaaye yamimalasawe wada 'eresu nawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'eresune ('alaahene) becaa 'ameleke. bahulume gudaayocehe baresu laaye tamakaa. geetaahe kameteszarute tagebaare zenegu 'ayedalame. szeraacehune yaaweqaale. huluneme 'enedayaszeraawe yemanadaale.

(lr) <<'alife, laame, rwa>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale). bazihe me`eraafe yawaradute 'aneqatzoce yaakaatatute male`ekete geletze yaqure'aane 'aneqatzoce naacawe.
`aarabaawiyaane hoye! male'eketune 'enedeteganazabu 'enyaa qure'aanene ba`aarabenyaa qwaaneqwaa 'awaradenawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehene qure'aane 'aneta laaye bamaawerade 'ewenatanyaa yahonu, batasetakaakalu qaalaatocenaa batheleqe manegade yatagalatzu webe taarikocene 'enetarekelehalane. yehe male'ekete kamaweradu bafite selanazihe taarikoce meneme `eweqate yaleelahe kazeneguwoce nabareke.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yusufe la'abaatu yaa`eqobe <<'abaatee hoye! bahelemee 'aseraa 'anede kewaakebetene, tzahhayenenaa charaqaane 'ayahu; 'enazihe hulu la'enee siszagedu tamalakatekunye.>> bamaalate sinaagare yahonawene huneetaa 'enetarekelehalane. yehe heleme layusufe yatasathawe yafathana beseraate nabare.

yaa`eqube laleju yusufe 'enedihe 'alawe - <<lejee hoye! yatamalakatekawene heleme lawanedemocehe 'atenegare; male'eketu yegabaacawaale; baziyaame yemaqanyuhale; baqenaataacawe tagafetawe seeraane yethanasesubehaale; shayethwane lasawe lejoce geletze thalaate nawe.

yusufe hoye! yehene 'enedatamalakatekawe, 'enedazihume geetaahe yaheleme feciwocene liyaasetamerehe yemarethehale; kazihe bafite ba'abaatocehe (beraahimenaa sehhaqe) laaye tzagaawene 'enedamolaawe, 'anetame laaye tzagaawene banabiyenate mulu yaadaregaale. geetaahe selafetheratu yaaweqaale. bamaasetanaabarume thebabanyaa nawe.>>
bayusufenaa bawanedemocu taarike wesethe selataarikaacawe lamithayequ sawoce bezu temeheretocenaa gesaatzeewoce yeganyaalu.

wanedemocu 'erese ba'eresaacawe 'enedihe 'alu - <<yusufenaa ya'enaatenaa ya'abaate kefaaye wanedemu ka'enyaa babalatha 'abaataacene zanede yatawadadu naacawe. 'enyaa bezu quthere yaalane sebesebe nane. 'enedeete ka'enyaa yaasebalethaacawaale!? la'enyaa geletze yahona yataradaanawe mekeneyaate saayenore ka'enyaa 'enaresune bamaasebalathu 'abaataacene bageletze sehetate laaye yamiganye hono 'enaayawaalane.

yusufene gedalute; wayeneme wadaruqe medere wasedaacehu dabezaawene 'athefute; ya'abaataacehu fite ya'enaaneta becaa yehonaale. fetzume 'enaanetane becaa yamiwadaacehu yehonaale. yusufene bamagedale wayeneme dabezaawene bamaathefaate kametefatzemute wanejale (deregite) baxwaalaa kahathi'ataacehu neseha bamagebaate malekaame sawoce tehonaalaacehu.>>

kawanedemocu 'anedu 'enedihe 'ala - <<yusufene 'ategedalute; nagare gene selaresu bametaawarute gudaaye qurethanyoce kahonaacehu wada theleqe yaweha gudegwaade wesethe warewerute; baziyaa yamiyaalefu manegadanyoce yezawete yeheedaalu. 'eresune kamagedale yeleqe yehe zeqe yaala 'adagaa nawe.>>

yayusufene dabezaa lamaathefaate sememenate laaye sidaresu wada 'abaataacawe yaa`eqube mathetawe 'enedihe 'alute - <<'abaataacene hoye! bayusufe laaye yamenetaamane yamaataadaregane lamenedenawe?! bathaame 'enaazenelataalane; mathefo nagare 'enedaayenakaawe 'enethabeqawaalane; baszalaame wada 'aneta 'esekamimalase derase la'eresu thebaqaa bamaaderagenaa 'eresune bamanekabaakabe 'emenate yamithaalebene nane. ka'enyaa gaare 'enedaayeheede yamikalakelehe menedenawe?!
naga ka'enyaa gaare yezanawe 'enedeneheede feqadelene bachaawataanaa bamegebe tadaseto yewelaale. kamiyaagaathemute 'adagaawoce hulu 'enyaa 'enethabeqawaalane.>>

yaa`eqobe lalejocu 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<karesu yamalayate te`egesete selaleelanye yezaacehute beteheedu hhazane yesamaanyaale. 'enedazihume bachawaataanaa ba'eranyenate (bagocene bamathabaqe) setezenaanu takulaa 'enedaayebalaawe 'esagaalahu.>>

la'abaataacawe 'enedihe 'alute - <<'enyaa bezu honane yusufene takulaa kabalaawe, bazihe huneetaa 'enyaa meneme malekaame nagare yaleelane 'eresune katakulaa theqaate mataadage yamaanecele 'erebaanaa bisoce nane.>>

yaa`eqube ka'enaresu gaare laakawe raaqe 'aderegawe siwasedute wada weha gudegwaade liwarawerute qurethe wesaanee laaye darasu. bazihene gizee wada yusufe malakotaawi male`ekete 'awaradenelate - <<wadafite yehene tagebaaraacawene tenageraacawaalahe; bametenageraacawe waqete dagemo 'aneta mahonehene 'ayaawequme.>>
bameshete (ba'eraate sa`aate) yayusufe wanedemoce seeraacawe 'enedaayetaawaqe yahasate 'enebaacawene 'eyaafasasu wada 'abaataacawe mathu.

'enediheme tanaagaru - <<'abaataacene hoye! yaruchaanaa yathore werewaraa wededere lamaaderage heedane; yusufene lebesenaa megebaacenene (seneqaacenene) 'enedithabeqe tawenawe. 'enaame takulaa balaawe. 'aneta ('abaataacene) meneme 'enekwaa banagarenehe nagare batachabaache 'ewenatanyoce benehoneme yametaamenane 'ayedalaheme.>>

lawareeyaacawe maaragaagachaa belehaatene fatharu. takulaawe yusufene yabalaawe selamahonu melekete nawe bamaalate lamaasemasayaa yaresu baalehona dame yatachamaalaqawene yayusufe lebese yezawe mathu. yaa`eqube qamisu yaaletaqadada mahonune siyaasetawele hasatanyaa 'enedahonu wadiyaawe taganazaba. <<gudaayu 'enedanagaraacehunye 'ayedalame.>> 'alaacawe. <<yelequneme baresu laaye yafatzamaacehutene mathefo tagebaare theru mahonune 'enedetemalakatu nafesaacehu shanagalaacehu. tasefaa maqurathe yamaayenorebatene malekaame te`egesete 'adaregaalahu; selametenaagarute sela yusufe gudaaye 'eredaataane yamethayeqawe ka'alaahe nawe.>>

'alaafi manegade yanabarawe yanegede qefelate darasa. kagudegwaade weha yamiyaawathaalaacawene sawe laaku; weha maqejiyaa baalediwene wada gudegwaadu warawara. yusufe bagamadu tanethalathala. gamadune yawarawarawe sawe yusufene simalakate <<waa! beseraate; yehe taadaagi leje>> sile badasetaa tanaagara. 'eresunaa kafile gwaadanyocu <<'eqaa nawe!>> bamaalate kaleeloce yanegede qefelatu tagwaazhoce, `aayene yusufene dabaqute. bayusufe laaye yafatzamubatene 'enegeletenaa 'eresune yamashathe hhasaabaacawene 'alaahe yaaweqaale. katagebaaraacawe qenethaate nagare 'ayesawarebateme.

kawehawe gudegwaade yaawathaawe sawenaa gwaadanyocu bagebetze wesethe barekaashe waagaa (bathaate liqotharu bamicelu 'anasetanyaa dinaaroce) shathute. bafethenate ka'ejaacawe 'enedawathaa yafalagu bamahonu bezu tekurate 'alesathuteme. kahuneetaawe 'enedataradute baariyaa 'ayedalame. selaziheme beetasabocune faru. yehe ka'enaresu gaare razheme gizeene 'enedaayeqoye 'alaahe ba'ezenatu yaadaragalate nawe.

bagebetze yagazaawe sawe lamisetu 'enedihe 'alaate - <<malekaame 'ayaayaaze 'aderegilate; ka'enyaa gaare bamiyaasaalefawe nuro 'akeberote sechiwe; yamenefalegaacawene 'anedaanede szeraawoce (gudaayoce) bamafatzame lithaqemane yecelaale; wayeneme bagudifacaa lejaacene 'enaadaregawaalane.>> yusufene kagedeyaa 'enedaatarafenawenaa kaweha gudegwaade 'enedaawathaanawe, 'enedazihume ya<<`azize>>ne lebe ruheruhe 'adaragenelate. yahelemocene feci 'enedenaasetamerawe bagebetze wesethe 'amacaacanelate. (sekeetene 'agonaatzafenawe). 'alaahe bagudaayoce hulu 'ashanaafi nawe; te`ezaazu hulu tafatzaami nawe; le`elenaa yatagabaawe geetaa 'asegadaaje yalabateme. nagare gene bezu sawoce (kahadiyaane) yehene 'ayaawequme.

yusufe mulu yasawenate thenekaaree yamiyaaganyebate 'edemee laaye sidarese genezaabeene 'enaa `eweqatene sathanawe. la'eresu yasathanawene yehene `aayenate menedaa (cerotaa) 'enedazihume 'alaahene bamalekaame lamiyaamaleku hulu 'enesathaalane.

ya<<`azize>> misete baleselaaseenaa babelehaate tzayaafe tagebaare (zemute) 'enedifatzemu yusufene thayaqacewe. fetzume becaacawene kasawoce galale 'enedilu baraafocene zagaace; <<naa wadanee; fethane;>> 'alacewe. yusufe 'enedihe 'alaate - <<wada 'eresu katharaashenye nagare ba'alaahe 'ethabaqaalahu; 'alaqaayee "`azize" karesu gaare baalanye nuro malekaamene 'aderegolenyaale; 'alekadaaweme; 'eresune kakadaahute kabadalanyoce 'ehonaalahu; badalanyoce 'ayedenume.>>

nafeswa zemute mafatzamane ba'eregethe tamanyetwale. kaziyaa yamithabeqawenaa yamiyaareqawene ya'alaahene ta`aamere baayemalakate nuro 'eresume yehe hhasaabe beqe belobate nabare. karesu laaye mathefone nagare lenaasewagedelate, kazemutenaa kakedaate lenaareqawe yehene 'asaayanawe. yusufe lamale'eketanyaanatenaa nabiyenate yatamaratha baariyaacene nawe.

yusufe raasune lamaadaane; 'ereswa dagemo 'enedaayewathaa lamakalekale wada baraafe tashaqadaadamu. qamisune yaazacewe; kajarebaawe bakule taqadada. baziyaawe qetzebate baalwane baraafu laaye 'aganyute. ya`azize misete batanekole labaalwawaa 'enedihe 'alacewe - <<`azize hoye! misetehene bazemute laasaba sawe yamigabaawe qethaate (waagaa) 'eseraate wayeneme yamisaqaayebate bathaame 'asaamaami qethaate 'eneji leelaa lihone 'ayegabaame.>>

yusufe 'enedihe 'ala - <<tzayaafe tagebaare 'enedenefatzeme yathayaqacenye 'ereswa nace; 'enee 'alefalagekume;>> ka`azize misete beetasaboce ba'aneqalebaa laaye yamiganye hetzaane bamesekerenate manaagare 'enedicele 'alaahe 'adaregawe; bamesekerenateme tanaagara - <<yayusufe lebese kafite lafite kataqadada 'eraaswane 'eyatakalaakalace 'enedanabara selamihone, yehe 'ereswa 'ewenatanyaa mahonwane yaamalaketaale; 'eresu hasatanyaa nawe.
lebesu kabasetaxwaalaawe yataqadada kahona, 'eyaasaadadacewenaa 'eresu 'eyashasha selamihone 'eresu 'ewenatanyaa nawe; 'ereswa hasatanyaa naate.>>

`azize simalakate yayusufe lebese kabasetaxwaalaawe tatareterwale. yusufe 'ewenatanyaa mahonune 'aragaagatha. 'enediheme 'ala - <<baresu laaye yalathafeshebate hasate seetaawi seeraa nawe; 'enaaneta seetoce hoye! seeraacehu bathaame thanekaaraa nawe.>>
`azize layusufe 'enedihe 'alawe - <<gudaayune bayeqeretaa 'elafawe; lamaaneme bihone 'atenaagare; 'aneci yusufene kanafesu bamaasaadade hathi'atanyaa bamahoneshe lahathi'ateshe meheratene thayeqi;>>

ya`azize misete waree bakatamaawe tasaraacha. kafile seetoce bamaawegaze manefase 'enedihe maalataacawe tasamaa - <<ya`azize misete 'agalegaaye baariyaawaane wada nafeswa tetharaalace; feqeru lebwane saresero gabetwale. 'agalegaaye baariyaawaa hono saala 'eresune bamawedadwanaa bamamanyatwa geletze manegadene yasaatace honaa 'enaayaataalane.>>

yakatamaawe seetoce 'enedaamwatenaa 'enedaawagazwate ya`azize misete setesamaa yusufene 'enedimalakatunaa mekeneyaatwa 'enediradulaate male'ekete laakacebaacawe. maqamachaa feraashenaa teraasoce yatadaradarubate botaane 'azagaajace. megebe yamiqorethubate bilaawaa sathacaacawe. kaziyaame layusufe <<wada 'enaresu wethaa>> 'alacewe; simalakatute taalaaqe hono taayaacawe. maleku 'asedamamaacawe; webatu 'asedanaqaacawe. bawebatu kamadanaqaacawe bezaate lasegaa maqurachaa bayaazute bilaawaa 'ejocaacawene qorathu. 'enediheme 'alu:- <<'alaahe leqenaa yegabaawe; yehe leje sawe 'ayedalame; basawe laaye yehene `aayenate webate taayeto 'ayetaawaqeme. katakabaru malaa'eketoce 'anedu nawe.>>

huneetaacawene setaaye ya`azize misete 'enedihe 'alace - <<'eresune bamawedadee yaanawaraacehunye taadaagi yehe nawe; baregethe raasee thayeqeewaalahu. laataalelaweme mokereeyaalahu. 'eresu gene 'emebitanyaa hona. kazihe baxwaalaa yamethayeqawene kaalefatzama wada 'esere beete yegabaale wayeneme katawaaradute sawoce yehonaale.>>

yusufe 'alaahene (geetaawene) bamamaatzane 'enedihe 'ala - <<geetaayee hoye! wada'eresu kamitharunye tzayaafe tagebaare (zemute) 'eserene 'emarethaalahunye. seeraacawene kaalaasewagadekelenye wadanaresu laazanabele 'ecelaalahu; yehene kaadaragekunyenaa ka'enee yamifalegutene kafatzamekunye kamaayemoce 'ehonaalahu.>>

'alaahe lemanaawene taqabalawe; ya`azize misetene 'enaa yakatamaawene seetoce seeraa 'asewagadalate. 'alaahe yayusufe 'enaa yamimaatzanawene hulu sawe lemanaa sami nawe. yayusufene 'enaa yahuluneme fetherataate huneetaa yaaweqaale.
`azizenaa sawocu yusufe netzuhe mahonune bamaaserajaa kaaragaagathu baxwaalaa (gamanaacawe 'enedaayegaalathe) laaletawasana gizee yusufe 'eneditaasare wasanu.

yusufe taasara; hulate 'agalegaaye baariyaawoce karesu gaare wada 'esere beete gabu. 'anedanyaawe 'agalegaaye layusufe 'enedihe 'ala <<bahelemee 'asekaari mathathe lamaazagaajate wayene sethameqe tamalakatekunye>> 'ala. hulatanyaawe dagemo <<bacheneqelaatee megebe tashakemee 'amoraawoce kaziyaa simagabu tamalakateku>> 'ala. <<yusufe hoye! kamalekaame sawoce nahe belane 'enaasebaalane yatamalakatenawene heleme feci negarane>> 'alute.

yusufe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<kaneguszu zanede yamimathaalaacehu megebe wayeneme leelaa nagare 'enaaneta gaare kamaderasu bafite menenatunenaa `aayenatune 'enageraacexwaalahu; yehe yamaaweqawe yaheleme feci 'alaahe yaasetamaaranye nawe; theneqolaanaa yakewaakebete qotharaa 'ayedalame. ba'alaahe yamaayaamenunaa bamacharashaawe `aalame yakaadu sawocene manegade tecaalahu.>>

ya'abaatoceene yaberaahhimene, yasehhaqene, yayaa`eqobene, 'emenate ('amelekote la'alaahe becaa netzuhe yamidaragebate 'emenate) takateyaalahu. ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaarine maaderage la'enyaa tagabi 'ayehoneme. 'eresu 'alaahe babecanyaa tamalaakinatu yatalaya nawe. 'eneenaa 'abaatocee yaalanebate yehe 'alaahene babecanyenate maamelakenaa maane, 'alaahe lazihe yataadalene bamaaderage yasathane cerotaa nawe. 'alaahe bazihe ya"tawehide" 'enaa ya"maane" male'ekete nabiyaatocene malaakume 'alaahe basawe lejoce hulu laaye yafatzamawe cerotaa nawe. nagare gene bezu sawoce selatzagaawe 'alaahene 'ayaamasagenume. yelequneme kehedatene yefatzemaalu.

kaziyaame yusufe ba'esere beete wesethe lamiganyute hulate 'agalegaayoce 'enedihe sile thayaqaacawe - <<barekaataa quthere yaalaacawene yahasate 'amaaleketocene maamelake yeshaalaalene wayenese tagaari yaleelawene, dele yamaayenasaawenenaa hulune 'ashanaafiwene 'anede 'alaahene becaa maamelake?!

ka'alaahe weche yametaamalekwaacawe 'amaaleketoce 'enaanetanaa 'abaatocaacehu yaalaseyaameeyaacawe 'amelaake belaacehu yasayamaacexwaacawe mathariyaawoce naacawe. qenethaate yaahele ya'amelaakenate dereshaa yalaacaweme. lanaresu yaszathaacehute seyaamee tekekelanyaa mahonune yamithaqume maaserajaa 'alaahe 'alaawaradame. bafetherataate hulu laaye negeszenaa yaalawe, 'enaanetanaa 'abaatocaacehu lasayamaacewaacawe la'enazihe seyaameewoce saayehone la'alaahe becaa nawe. 'alaahe 'amelekotene laresu becaa 'enedetaadaregu 'azwacawaale. karesu gaare leelaane tagaari 'enedaateyezu kalekelwale. yehe 'amelekotene la'alaahe becaa maaderage themate yaleelabate qathetanyaawe 'emenate nawe. nagare gene bezu sawoce yehene 'ayaawequme. selaziheme kafile ya'alaahe fethuraanene bamaamelake ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaarine yaadaregaalu.>>

ya'esere beete gwaadanyocee hoye! <<'asekaari mathathe lamaazagaajate wayene sithameqe yatamalakatawe ka'esere natzaa yewathaale; wada szeraawe tamaleso neguszune yaathathaale. bacheneqelaatu laaye megebe tashakemo baraari wafe simagabawe yatamalakatawe yegadalaale; kaziyaame yesaqalaale. baraari wafe yacheneqelaate segaawene yemagabawaale. teregumune yathayaqaacehute gudaaye tathanaaqwaale. makasatu therethere yalaweme.>>

kahulatu 'eseranyo natzaa yewathaale belo lagamatawe (lanegusu 'athachi) yusufe 'enedihe 'ala - <<sela 'enee taarikenaa gudaaye laneguszu negare. ka'esere natzaa 'enediyaawathaanye 'emanyaalahu.>> yaneguszu 'athachi yayusufene gudaaye laneguszu 'enedaayenaagare shayethwane 'aserasaawe. yusufe ba'esere beete la`aamataate qoya.

neguszu 'enedihe 'ala - <<bahelemee sabaate yadalabu waferaame laamoce leeloce sabaate kasitaa laamocene sibalu tamalakateku; 'enedihume sabaate 'aranegwaadee lamelame zalalaawocene 'enaa leeloce sabaate daraqe zalalaawocene 'ayahu. 'alaqocenaa yatakabaraacehu sawoce yaheleme fecine yametaawequ kahona selazihe helemee feci negarunye.>>
laneguszu 'enedihe 'alute - <<helemehe qezhate yatadabaalaqawe nawe; 'enedazihe kahona dagemo feci linorawe 'ayeceleme; yatadabaalaqa heleme feci `eweqate yalaneme.>>

kayusufe gaare ba'esere beete kanabarute hulate 'agalegaayoce makaakale ka'esere beete yawathaawe yaneguszu 'athachi karazheme gizee baxwaalaa yusufenenaa yaheleme feci `eweqatune 'asetaawasa. <<neguszu yaayawene heleme feci, yaheleme feci `eweqate yaalawene sawe thayeqee 'enageraacexwaalahu. negusze hoye! yahelemehene feci 'enedinageranye wada yusufe laakanye.>> sile thayaqa.

ka'esere natzaa yawathaawe 'agalegaaye yusufe zanede sidarese 'enedihe 'ala - <<yusufe hoye! sabaate yadalabu waferaame laamoce, leeloce sabaate kasitaa laamocene sibalu 'enedihume sabaate lamelame zalalaawocene 'enaa leeloce daraqe zalalaawocene yatamalakata sawe heleme fecine negarane. wada neguszunaa ka'eresu gaare wadamiganyu sawoce tamaleshee yaneguszune heleme feci 'enediyaawequ 'enedazihume ya'anetane keberenaa darajaa 'enedisamu 'emanyaalahu.>>

yusufe yahelemune feci 'eyataragoma 'enedihe 'ala - <<sabaate takataataaye `aamataatocene bakafetanyaa tegaate tezaraalaacehu; ba'enazihe sabaate `aamataate baya`aamatu yametaachedutene merete lamegebe yamiyaasefalegaacehune yaahele becaa wasedaacehu qariwe beleshete 'enedaayegathemawe bazalalaawocu wesethe tawete.

kazaraacehubaacawe kanazihe lamelame meretaamaa sabaate `aamataate baxwaalaa: sabaate yadereqe `aamataatoce yemathaalu; sawoce baqadamute sabaate meretaamaa `aamataate (yaachadutene hulu yemagabaalu lazare yamiyaaseqarute theqite merete becaa siqare).

kaziyaame kanazihe yadereqe `aamataate baxwaalaa zenaabe yamiwaredebate `aamate yemathaale; 'azere`etoce yebaqelaalu. sawoce lichamaqu yamifalagu nagarocene hulu (wayene, wayeraa zayete, 'agadaa) yechameqaalu.>>

neguszu yayusufe heleme feci sidaresawe laradaatocu - <<ka'esere beete 'awethute; 'enee zanede yezaacehute nu>> 'ala. yaneguszu male'eketanyaa wada yusufe simathaa yusufe ka'esere kamawethaatu bafite wanejale yaalefatzama mahonu geletze 'enediwathaa 'enedihe 'ala - <<wada neguszu tamalase, 'ejocaacawene babilaawaa selaqorathute seetoce thayeqawe; geetaawe 'alaahe 'eneene bamaasaadade yaadaragutene yaaweqaale; selaziyaa karesu 'anedeme nagare 'ayesawarebateme.>>

neguszu laseetocu 'enedihe 'ala - <<yusufe ka'enaaneta gaare zemute 'enediszaraa babelehaate yathayaqaacehute gudaaye menedenawe!?>>seetoceme 'alu <<yusufene kamawanejale ba'alwahe 'enethabaqaalane; basu laaye meneme yamanaaweqawe kefu nagareyalame >> baalu gizee; ya`azizu misete yaadaragacewene bamaamane <<'ahune 'ewenatu yefaa wathetwale. 'enee laasaasetawe mokereeyaalahu. 'eresu liyaasaasetanye 'alemokarame. fatzemwale beyee kalathafekubate hasate netzuhe nanye belo yaminaagarawe 'ewenate nawe.>>

ya`azizu misete 'enedihe 'alace - <<'enee raasee nanye laasaasetawe yamokarekute; 'eresu 'ewenatanyaa nawe beyee lamaamane sewasene baleelabate baresu laaye hasate yaaletanaagareku mahoneene yusufe yewaqelenye. kahonawe nagare 'alaahe hasate laminaagarenaa seeraane lamithanasese sawe sekeete 'enedamaayesathe tagaletzolenyaale.>>

ya`azize misete negegerwane bamaqathale 'enedihe 'alace - <<nafesee mathefone nagare kamaasabe yatzadaace naate beyee 'alenaagareme. baziheme bihone lanafesee yanetzehenaa mesekerenate lamasethate 'alemokarekume. yasawe leje nafese wadametefalegawe nagare yaazanabalacenaa kaziyaa nagare 'enedeteqothabe maaderage 'asecagaari bamahonu babezaate bamathefo taazezaalace; 'alaahe yaazanalaate nafese becaa seteqare: kamathefo gutegotaa 'alaahe yethabeqaataale. geetaayee wadaresu baneseha lamimalasu baariyaawocu yeqere baayenaa 'azaanye nawe.>>

yusufe kawanejale natzaa mahonu 'enedatagalatzanaa 'enedataawaqa neguszu laradaatocu <<yezaacehulenye nu; ya'enee becaa laaderegawe>> 'ala. yezawelate mathu. yusufene siyaanaagerawe `eweqatunaa 'asetawaayenatu geletze belo taayawe. 'enediheme 'alawe - <<yusufe hoye! zaaree 'enee zanede darajaanaa kebere yaalahe taamaanye sawe honahaale.>>

yusufe laneguszu 'enedihe 'alawe - <<yagebetzene yaganezabenaa seneqe gemejaa beete xaalaafinatene sethanye. taamaanye yagemejaa beete xaalaafi nanye; batasathanye xaalaafinate laaye `eweqatenaa `eyetaa 'alanye.>>

ka'eserenaa kahhasatanyaa wanejale natzaa 'enediwathaa malekaame 'enedawaalenelate, 'enedazihume bagebetze medere wesethe bafaqadawe botaa yamiyaarefenaa yaminore 'enedihone malekaame tzagaane 'amacaacanelate. bamederaawi `aalame kabaariyaawocaacene lafaqadenawe ka'ezenataacene 'enesathawaalane. yamalekaame szariwocene menedaa 'anaathafaame; meneme yaaletaqanasa yatamwalaa hono 'enesathaacawaalane.

'alaahe yaazazawene bamatagebarenaa kakalakalawe bamaqothabe 'alaahene lamithanaqaqunaa ba'eresu laamanute 'alaahe bamacharashaawe `aalame yaazagaajawe menedaa kamederaawi `aalame menedaa yatashaala nawe.

yayusufe wanedemoce shaqathaacawene yezawe (`eqaawocaacene shakefawe) wada gebetze mathu. wada yusufe gabu (qarabu) 'eresu wanedemocu 'enedahonu 'awaqaacawe; 'enaresu gene rajeme gizee yaalafanaa huneetaawe yatalawatha bamahonu 'eresu wanedemaacawe mahonune 'alaawaqume. wada wehawe gudegwaade siwarawerute leje nabare.

yathayaqutene (yafalagutene) yaguzo megebenaa seneqe kasathaacawe baxwaalaa ba'abaate yamiganaanyute 'anede wanedeme 'enedaalaacawenaa ka'abaataacawe gaare tetawete 'enedamathu sinagerute, <<ka'abaataacehu yahonawene wanedemaacehune 'amethulenye, ya'anede gemale chenate 'esathaacexwaalahu; mulu masefariyaa 'enedamaadaregenaa 'enedamaalaagodele 'enedihume theru 'enegedaa taqabaaye mahoneene 'atemalakatumene!?>> 'alaacawe.

<<'eresune yezaacehulenye kaalemathaacehu ba'abaate yameteganaanyute wanedeme 'enedaalaacehu yatanaagaraacehute hasate geletze yehonaale; 'ehele bafetzume 'alesaferelaacehume; wada hagareeme 'ateqarebume ('ategabume).>>
wanedemocu 'enedihe 'alute - <<'abaatune 'enethayeqaalane; yamenecelawene therate 'enaadaregaalane; yaazazekanene nagare yaalamaamanetaate 'enefatzemaalane.>>

yusufe laszaraatanyocu 'enedihe 'ala - <<wada hagaraacawe simalasu kanaresu yaalegazaanaacawe mahonune 'enediyaawequ ya'enazihene sawoce shaqathe (`eqaa) malesulaacawe. yusufe zanede 'ewenatanyaa hono lamataayatenaa `eqaacawene 'enediqabalaacawe- wanedemaacawene yezawe badegaami 'enedimathu yaadaregaacawaale.>>

wada 'abaataacawe simalasu yusufe selaadaragalaacawe kebere yaalawene 'aqabaabale tarakulate - <<'abaataacene hoye! wanedemaacenene yezane kaalemathaane sefere takalekelanaale. ka'enyaa gaare laakawe. yehene kaadarageke 'ehele yesafarelenaale; wada'aneta basalaame 'esekamimalase thebaqaa 'enedamenaadaregelate qaale kidaane 'enegabaalane.>>

'abaataacawe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<kazihe bafite bawanedemu yusufe laaye 'emenate 'enedathaalekubaacehu kaalehona basetaqare ba'eresuse 'enedeete 'amenaacexwaalahu!? 'enedametethabequte qaale kidaane gabaacehu; 'eneeme 'amanekwaacehu; nagare gene qaalaacehune 'alethabaqaacehume. 'enedametethabequte bametegabute qaale kidaane 'emenate yalanyeme. 'emenateene yamethelawe ba'alaahe laaye nawe. 'eresu 'alaahe ya'eresune thebaqaa lafalaga malekaame thabaaqi nawe; 'ezenatune lafalaga 'ejege bathaame 'azaanye nawe.>>

'ehele yaamathubatene `eqaa sikafetu yakafalute waagaa ka`eqaacawe gaare tamaleso 'aganyute. la'abaataacawe 'enedihe 'alu - <<'abaataacene hoye! kaziyaa yatakabara sawe kazihe balaaye mene `aayenate carenatene mathayaqe 'enecelaalane!? yakafalenawe yamegebaacenene waagaa yatakabarawe sawe malekaamene liyaadaregelene yekxawe malasalene. selaziheme labeetasabaacene megebe 'enaamathaalane. 'anetane kamiyaasefaraahe nagare wanedemaacenene 'enethabeqaalane. 'eresune yezane bamaheedaacene yagemale chenatene chemaari 'enaaganyaalane. ya'anede gemale chenate chemaari laziyaa yatakabara sawe qalaale gudaaye nawe.>>

'abaataacawe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<hulaacehuneme yamiyaaganyenaa mamalase yaalaasecaalaacacehu 'anedaacehuneme yamaayaasetarefe, letekalaakalute yamaatecelute 'adagaa daresobaacehu kaalehona baqare wada 'enee 'enedametemalesute ya'alaahene qaale kidaane saatesathunye ka'enaaneta gaare 'alelekaweme.>> bazihe gudaaye laaye yathabaqa ya'alaahene qaale kidaane sisathute 'enedihe 'ala - <<bamenaagarawe nagare 'alaahe mesekeree nawe; ya'eresu mesekerenate yebaqaanyaale.>>

'abaataacawe bamekere qaale 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<baheberate honaacehu ba'anede yamagebiyaa bare wada gebetze 'ategebu; nagare gene batalayaayu yamagebiyaa baraafoce gebu. yehe ba'enaaneta laaye 'adagaa mathaale yamifalege 'anede 'akaale yaala kahona bahulaacehume laaye gudaate 'enedaayaadaresebaacehu dahenenatu yatashaala nawe. yehene yamelawe 'alaahe yafaqadawe gudaate kaala ka'enaaneta laaye lemalesawe 'ayedalame; 'enedazihume 'alaahe yaalefaqadawene theqeme la'enaaneta laamathaame 'ayedalame. wesaaneewe hulu ya'alaahe becaa nawe. te`ezaazu hulu ya'eresu nawe; bahulume gudaayocee ba'eresu laaye becaa tamakeceeyaalahu. tamakiwoce bagudaayaacawe hulu ba'eresu laaye becaa yemaku.>>

manegadaacawene qathalu yayusufe wanedeme kanaresu gaare 'abero hona. 'abaataacawe 'enedaazazaacawe batalayaayu yamagebiyaa baraafoce gabu. batalayaayu baraafoce magebaataacawe 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye kawasanawe nagare meneme yaahele yamikalakelelaacawe 'alenabarame. 'enediyaawe becaa yaa`eqube balejocu laaye geletze yaadaragawenaa 'adaraa yaalaacawe 'abaataawi reheraahee becaa nabare. wesaaneewe hulu ya'alaahe 'enedahona yaaweqaale. yaa`eqube ba'alaahe wesaanee maamane 'enaa mekeneyaatocene (sababoce) mayaaze 'enedaminorebate baasetamaarenawe gudaaye 'awaaqi nawe. bezu sawoce yehene 'ayaawequme.

yayusufe wanedemoce (kanaresu gaare wanedemune yezawe) wada yusufe sigabu yusufe wanedemune 'aqafa. bamesethireme 'enedihe 'alawe. <<'enee ya'enaatehenaa ya'abaatehe leje wanedemehe yusufe nanye. wanedemocehe yeszarute banabarawe meqanyenate, maasecagarenaa beselata yagodalawe tagebaare 'atezane.>>

yusufe la'agalegaayocu yawanedemocune gemaloce bamegebe 'enedichenu te`ezaaze sisathaacawe megebe lamiwasedu sawoce megebe ('ehele) yamisaferebatene yaneguszu masefariyaa bawanedemu `eqaa wesethe 'enediyaadaregute 'azazaacawe (wanedemune ka'eresu gaare lamaaseqarate belehate bamafethare). wada hagaraacawe yamalese guzo sijameru wadiyaawenu tathaari tathaaraa - <<'enaaneta megebe yachaanaacehu baalagemaloce hoye! 'enaaneta saraaqiwoce naacehu.>>
yayusufe wanedemoce wada tathaariwenaa 'aberawete wadaalute gwaadanyocu zorawe <<basereqote 'enedetetharatherune yaadaragaacehu mene thafetwacehu nawe>> silu thayaqu.

tathaariwe kagwaadanyocu gaare 'anede laaye bamahone 'enedihe 'ala - <<yaneguszu masefariyaa thafetwale; kafetashaa bafite masefariyaawene laamathaa sawe ya'anede gemale chenate shelemaate 'alawe; yehe 'enedamihone waasetenaa 'eszathawaalahu>>

yayusufe wanedemoce 'enedihe 'alu - <<ba'alaahe yehunebene kahuneetaacene 'enedatamalakataacehute netzehenaacenene taaweqaalaacehu. 'athefiwoceme lenehone wada gebetze medere 'alemathaaneme. baheyewataacene sereqotene 'anaaweqeme>>
tathaariwenaa gwaadanyocu 'enedihe 'alu - <<kasereqote natzaa selamahonaacehu bametenaagarute nagare hasatanyaa kahonaacehu ba'enaaneta zanede yasaraqa sawe qethaate menedenawe!?>>

yayusufe wanedemoce 'enedihe 'alu - <<'enyaa zanede yasaraqa sawe qethaate yatasaraqawe nagare ba`eqaawe wesethe yataganyabate sawe latasaraqabate sawe baariyaa 'enedihone talaalefo yesathaale; bazihe maleku saraaqiwocene 'eneqathaalane>>

`eqaawocaacawene lamafatasha wada yusufe malaswacawe. belehaatu 'enedaayetaawaqe ka "shaqiqe" wanedemu `eqaa 'aseqademo ya'enaresune `eqaa mafatasha jamara. kaziyaame ya "shaqiqe" wanedemune `eqaa fetashaa sijamare ka`eqaawe wasethe yaneguszune masefariyaa 'awathaa. yaneguszune masefariyaa bawanedemu `eqaa wesethe 'enediyaadarege 'enedaasaawaqenawe 'enedazihume wanedemocu yasaraqane sawe latasaraqabate sawe baariyaa bamiyaadaregawe baraasaacawe yasaraaqi sawe yaqethaate hege gudaayune 'enediqabalute 'adaragenelate. baneguszu yaqethaate hege bihone yanegusu yaqethaate hege yaleebaa qethaate gerefaate (madabedabe)naa yaganezabe qethaate nabare (yehe yamisaakaa 'ayehoneme nabare). 'alaahe yafaqadawe leelaa qenebere kaalehona baqare; 'alaahe bazihe laaye caaye nawe. yayusufene darajaa kafe 'enedaadaragenawe yafalagenawene sawe darajaa kafe 'enaadaregaalane. ka'eyaanedaanedu ya`eweqate sawe balaaye leelaa ya`eweqate sawe 'ala. kahulume `eweqate balaaye huluneme yamiyaaweqawe ya'alaahe `eweqate yabalaaye nawe.

yayusufe wanedemoce 'enedihe 'alu - <<bisareqe yamigareme nagare 'ayedalame; kazihe bafite wanedemu (yusufene maalataacawe nawe) sareqwaale.>> yusufe bazihe negegeraacawe yatasamaawene makafaate 'ameqo yaazawe. lanaresu geletze 'alaadaragalaacaweme. bawesethu 'enedihe 'ala - <<netzuhe kefaate maalate yaalaacehubate meqanyenatenaa kazihe bafite yaadaragaacehute mathefo szeraa nawe. yametenaagarutene hasate 'alaahe yaaweqaale>>

yayusufe wanedemoce layusufe 'enedihe 'alute - <<yatakabarekawe hoye! `edemee yaadaqaqawe shemaagelee 'abaate 'alawe. 'ejege bathaame yewadawaale. ba'eresu meteke 'anedaacenene ka'enyaa wesade. la'enyaame hona laleeloce sawoce bametesathawe 'enekebekaabee malekaame sawe 'enedahoneke 'enaasebaalane. bazihe gudaaye malekaamene waalelene.>>

<<baleelaa sawe badale netzuhe yahonane sawe kamabadale ba'alaahe 'ethabaqaalahu.: yaneguszune masefariyaa ba`eqaawe wesethe kaaganyanebate sawe wechi leelaane sawe beneyeze, wanejalanyaawene tetane netsuhene sawe bamaqethaataacene 'enyaa badalanyoce nane.>>

yusufe basathaacawe malese tasefaa siqorethu weyeyete lamaaderage galale 'alu. taalaaqe wanedemaacawe 'enedihe 'ala - <<bahulaaceneme laaye yadarasa lenekalaakalawe yaalecaalenawe cegere kaalegathamane basetaqare lejune wada 'eresu 'enedamenemaleselate 'abaataacene ba'enyaa laaye yathabaqa ya'alaahe qaale kidaanene 'enedayaaza 'asetaawesaacexwaalahu. kaziyaa bafite bayusufe laaye yaadaragenawe 'enezelaalenate yetaawaqaale. selayusufe la'abaataacene yagabaanawe qaale kidaanene 'alaakabareneme. 'abaatee wada 'eresu 'enedemalase faqaadune 'esekisathanye wayeneme wanedemeene 'enedewasede 'alaahe 'esekiwasenelenye derase yagebetzene medere 'alelaqeme. 'alaahe kafaraajoce hulu malekaame nawe; ba'ewenatenaa bafetehe yefaredaale.>>

taalaaqe wanedemaacawe qathala - <<wada 'abaataacehu tamalasu. 'enediheme balute, lejehe saraqa; basereqotume mekeneyaate yatakabarawe gebetzaawi baqethaate baariyaa 'adaragawe. yaneguszu masefariyaa ka`eqaawe siwathaa ya`aayene mesekeroce nane; yamenenagerehe ba`aayenaacene yatamalakatenawene nawe. 'enedamisareqe yamenaaweqawe nagare 'alenabarame. yehene benaaweqe 'enedamenemalesawe qaale kidaane 'anesatheheme nabare.

'abaataacene hoye! 'ewenatanyaa mahonaacenene lamaaragaagathe yaqoyanebaacawene yagebetze nawaariwoce thayeqe; 'aberawene yamathutene yanegede qefelate sawoceneme thayeqe; yanagarenehene dagemawe yenageruhale. sereqote selamafatzamu batanaagarenawe nagare 'ewenatanyoce nane.>>

'abaataacawe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<sela sereqotu gudaayu 'enedametenaagarute 'ayedalame. bawanedemu yusufe laaye kazihe bafite 'enedaaseeraacehute baresume laaye seeraane 'enedetethanasesu nafesaacehu shanagalaacehu. te`egeseteenaa semotaayeene la'alaahe becaa yamaasamaabate malekaame te`egesete yehonaale. 'alaahe huluneme yusufene, wanedemunenaa taalaaqe wanedemaacawene wada 'enee 'enedamimaleselenye tasefaa 'adaregaalahu. le`elenaa yatagabaawe 'alaahe selahuneetaayee yaaweqaale; gudaayeene bamaasetanaabareme thebabanyaa nawe.>>

ka'enaresu zoro raaqe 'ala; 'enediheme 'ala - <<waa! bayusufe laaye yahazanee beretaate>> sela yusufe bezu 'enebaane bamaafesasu ya`aayenu thequrate nache hona. bahhazanenaa bahhasaabe yatawaatha bihoneme hhazanune kasawoce yedabeqe nabare.
yayusufe wanedemoce la'abaataacawe 'enedihe 'alu <<'abaataacene hoye! ba'alaahe yehunebene hemamehe 'esekithanaanaa 'eseketemote derase yusufene maasetaawasenaa baresu masaqaayatehene 'aletawekeme>>

'abaataacawe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<sela'agaathamanye hhazanenaa cheneqate semotaa yamaaqarebawe la'alaahe becaa nawe. sela 'alaahe 'ezenatenaa malekaamenate, latachanaqa sawe tamaatzeno selamisathawe malese, latafatana sawe selamisathawe menedaa yamaataawequtene 'aweqaalahu.>>

'abaataacawe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<lejocee hoye! hidu sela yusufe zeenaa thayaayequ. ka'alaahe 'ezenate madehene tasefaa 'atequrathu ka'alaahe yacheneqe galaagaayenate tasefaa yamiqorethute kahadiyaane becaa naacawe. mekeneyaatume ya'alaahene celotaa xaayaalenatenaa debeqe carenatune 'ayaawequme.>>

yusufenenaa wanedemune lamafalage ya'abaataacawene te`ezaaze lamafatzame faqadu. wada yusufe zanede sigabu 'enedihe 'alute:- <<cegerenaa dehenate 'agaathamane; rekaashenaa yawadaqa shaqathe (`eqaa) yezane mathetanaale. kazihe bafite taadarege 'enedanabarawe moletahe sefarelene; metzewaateneme baziyaa laaye chamerelene; wayeneme yawadaqa shaqathaacenene (`eqaacenene) 'asaalefelene. 'alaahe metzewaate sachewocene bamalekaame yemanadaale.>>

negegeraacawene siyaadamethe bathaame 'azanalaacawe; raasune 'asetawaawaqaacawe. 'enediheme 'alaacawe - <<yametaadaregutene tagebaare fetzaamee yamaataawequ banabaraacehubate gizee bayusufenaa bawanedemu laaye yaadaragaacehutene taasetaawesaalaacehune?!>>

bathaame tadanaagathu; 'enediheme 'alu - <<'aneta yusufe nahene?!>> yusufe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<'awone 'enee yusufe nanye; yehe yametemalakatute dagemo wanedemee nawe. kanabarenebate natzaa bamaawethaatenaa darajaacenene kafe bamaaderage 'alaahe cerotaane 'aderegolenaale. 'alaahe yaazazawene bamataazaze, kakalakalawe bamaqothabe 'alaahene yamifaraa 'enedihume bafatanaawoce laaye te`egesetene yamiyaadarege, yehe szeraawe malekaame tagebaare nawe. 'alaahe yamalekaame szariwocene szeraa 'ayaathafaame. yethabeqelataale.>>

wanedemocu baresu laaye selafatzamute thefaate yeqeretaa bamathayaqe 'enedihe 'alute - <<ba'alaahe yehunebene 'alaahe basathahe yatamwalaa baaheri ba'eregethe kanyaa 'asebalethohale; ba'aneta laaye bafatsamenawe tagebaare sehetatanyocenaa badalanyoce nabarene.>>

yusufe yeqeretaacawene taqabala. 'enediheme 'alaacawe <<zaaree yamiyaaseqathaacehume hona yamiyaasewaqesaacehu waqasaa yalabaacehume. 'alaahe meheratene 'enedisathaacehu 'elamenawaalahu. 'eresu ka'azaanyoce hulu yabalatha 'azaanye nawe.>>

ya'abaatu `aayene selahonawe huneetaa sinagerute lebesune sathaacawe; 'enediheme 'alaacawe:- <<yehene lebeseene yezaacehu hidu; ba'abaatee fite laaye warewerute. `aayenu yemalaselataale. beetasabaacehune huluneme 'asekatelaacehu wada 'enee tamalasu.>>

yanegede qefelatu kagebetze bamanasaate guzowene sijamerenaa mederitwane silaqe yaa`eqube lalejocunaa ka'eresu gaare bahagaru lamiganyu sawoce 'enedihe 'ala - <<yehe shemaagelee raasune maawaqe tasaanawe; yaminaagarawene masaate jamara; bamaalate bathanaa 'erejenaanaa bamaayemenate 'enedaatetharatherunye 'eneji yayusufe tharane yeshatanyaale.>>

karesu gaare kanabarute lejocu 'anedanyaawe 'enedihe 'ala - <<ba'alaahe yehunebenye yusufe 'aneta zanede baalawe kebere badegaami 'ayawaalahu bamilawe gudaaye laaye 'ahuneme bamaayechabathawe yadero menyotehe wesethe nahe.>>

layaa`eqube 'asedasaace beseraate yaminagerawe male'eketanyaa simathaa yayusufene lebese bafitu laaye thaalawe. bazihe gizee yaa`eqube lalejocu 'enedihe 'alaacawe:- <<sela 'alaahe 'ezenatenaa malekaame 'aderaaginate 'enaaneta yamaataawequtene 'aweqaalahu 'alaalekwaacehumene?!>>

lejocu bayusufenaa bawanedemu laaye selafatzamute deregite 'abaataacawene yaa`equbene yeqeretaa bamathayaqe 'enedihe 'alu:- <<'abaataacene hoye! bayusufenaa bawanedemu laaye baadaragenawe deregite thefaate fatzemanaale. baalafawe hathiyaataacene ka'alaahe meherate thayeqelene.>>
'abaataacawe 'enedihe 'alaacawe:- <<kageetaayee meheratene 'ethayeqelaacexwaalahu; wada 'eresu batzatzate lamimalasu baariyaawocu 'alaahe meheratene sachinaa 'azaanye nawe.>>

yaa`equbenaa beetasabu yusufene lamaagenyate kahagaraacawe wathetawe wada gebetze guzo jamaru. yusufe zanede siqarebu yusufe 'abaatunenaa 'enaatune 'aqafaacawe. lawanedemocunaa labeetasabocu 'enedihe 'ala:- <<wada gebetze ba'alaahe feqaade basalaame gebu; 'ezihe cegere 'ayedaresebaacehume.>>

baraasu yamaqamachaa zufaane laaye walaajocune 'aseqamatha; walaajocunaa 'aseraa 'anede wanedemocu bagenebaaraacawe wada mareete bamadafaate szalaametaa 'aqarabulate:: (yehe 'akeberotene lamagelatze yatadaraga szalaametaa 'eneji ya'amelekote genebaarene wada mareete madefaate 'alenabarame.) bahelemu 'enedatamalakatawe ya'alaahe wesaanee 'ewene hona. selaziheme yusufe la'abaatu 'enedihe 'ala - <<'ahune yaadaragaacehulenye ya'akeberote salaametaa (bagenebaare wada mareete madafaate) kazihe bafite yatamalakatekutenaa 'abaatee la'aneta yatarakulehe heleme feci nawe. geetaayee 'ewene 'adaragawe. ka'esere 'enedewathaa siyaadareganye 'enedihume shayethwane ba'eneenaa bawanedemocee makaakale kaabalaasha baxwaalaa karuqe hagare 'enedetemathu siyaadarege malekaame welolenyaale. 'alaahe (geetaayee) yafaqadawene bamaasetanaabare raqiqe nawe. yabaariyaawocune huneetaa yamiyaaweqenaa bamaasetanaabarume thebabanyaa nawe.>>

kaziyaame yusufe geetaawene tamaatzana; 'enediheme 'ala - <<geetaayee hoye! yagebetzene negeszenaa sathakxanye; yahelemeneme feci 'asetamaarekanye. samaayaatenaa mederene yaalaqedema mesaalee yaaseganyakxawe fathaari hoye! bamederaawi `aalamenaa bamacharashaawe `aalame gudaayeene hulu yameteqothaatharawe 'aneta nahe. yaheyewatee fetzaamee sidarese "muselime" 'aderegahe wesadanye. bataalaaqu yaferedawese janate wesethe ka'abaatoceenaa kaleeloce nabiyaatenaa malekaame sawoce gaare 'adereganye.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! - selatathaqasawe wada 'aneta selaawaradenawe yayasufenaa wanedemocune taarike `eweqate 'alenabaraheme. yayasufe wanedemoce wanedemaacawene baweha gudegwaade wesethe liwarawerute qurethe wesaanee siyaadaregunaa seeraa sithanasesu ka'esu gaare 'alenabarekeme; nagare gene selazihe (taarike) 'enyaa male'ekete 'awaradenelehe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! - 'emenatehene 'enediqabalu meneme yaahele therate betaadarege bezu sawoce 'ayaamenume; selaziheme selanaresu nafesehe baquchete 'ayeyaaze.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! - maasetawaale bicelu (bamale'eketanyaanatehe) yaamenu nabare; baqure'aaneme hona wadaresu theri bametaadarewe gudaaye kanaresu menedaane 'atethayaqeme. qure'aane lasawe lejoce hulu yamathaa gesaatzee 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame.

basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe ya'alaahene becanyaa 'amelaakenate yamithaqumu barekaataa ta`aameraatoce tasaraachetawaale. ba'enazihe ta`aameraatoce 'athagabe yaalefaalu. nagare gene selanazihe ta`aameraatoce kamaasetawaale zeneguwoce naacawe; temeherete 'ayewasedume. ba'anekerome 'ayemalakatume.

bezu sawoce ya'alaahene fathaarinate, sisaayene lagaashenate, heyaawe 'aderaaginatenaa heyewatene wasaajenate yamiyaamenute thaa`otaatene 'eyaamalaku, 'alaahe leje 'alawe bamaalate bahasate 'eyamogatu nawe.

'enazihene 'agaariyaane (thaa`otaawiyaane) bamederaawiwe `aalame likalaakalute yamaayecelute yamishafaafenaacawene zuriyaacawene yamikabebaacawe qethaate 'enedamaayemathaabaacawe yaamenaalune!? wayeneme mamethaatune saayaasebutenaa zegejete saayaadaregubate tenesaa'ee denegate 'enedimathaabaacawe nawe yamithabequte!? yeheme selahona nawe 'emenatene yamaayeqabalutene!?

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! theri lametaadaregelaacawe sawoce 'enedihe bale. <<yehe manegadee nawe; sawocene wadazihe manegade ba`eweqatenaa bageletze maaserajaa 'eneenaa manegadeene yatakatalu, falageene yamarathu takataayocee 'enethaaraalane. 'alwahe kagudelate hulu wayeme yaalaagebaabe wadasu kaasethagutenaa kamaayegabaawu nagare hulu yatharaa geetaa nawe. ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaarine yamaadarege 'ayedalahume; 'enee le`elenaa laresu yahonawene 'alaahene babecanyenate yamaamaleke nanye.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! wada 'aneta 'enedaawaradenawe malakotaawi male'ekete lanaresume male`ekete yamenaawaredelaacawe sihone ka'aneta bafite wada sawoce yalaakenawe hulume male'eketanyaa yanaresuwe (yahhezebocu) 'amesaayaa yahonane sawe nawe malaa'ekete 'alaadaragenaacaweme. 'anetane hhasatanyaa yaaluhe sawoce bamareete laaye taguzawe kanaresu bafite male'eketanyocaacawene hhasatanyaa yaalu hhezeboce fetzaamee mene 'enedamimasele 'ayaasetaawelumene?! 'alaahene lamithanaqaqu sawoce bamacharashaawe `aalame yamiganyawe tzagaa kamederaawi `aalame tzagaa yatashaala nawe. yehene 'ataaseweluneme? selaziheme yaazazawene bamafatzame telequ tafatzaami mahone yaalabate te`ezaaze maane nawe, kakalakawe bamaqothabe (telequ maqothabe yamiyaasefalegawe kelekele ba'alaahe laaye tagaarine maaderage nawe) 'alaahene 'atefarumene!?

wada sawoce yamenelekaacawe ya'enazihene male'eketanyoce thalaatoce gizee 'enesathaacawaalane. wada wathemadaacawe tazanaagetawe 'enedigabu qethaataacawene 'anaathaadefaweme. yamathefiyaacawe qatharo sizagayenaa male'eketanyocu tasefaa siyaathu, male`eketune hhasatanyaa kaalaacehu yemathaalaacexwaale bamaalate lamale'eketanyocaacawe yanagarwacawe yathefaate qatharo hhasate 'enedahona kahadiyaanocu maasabe sijameru 'amaanyocene natzaa lamaawethaate lamale'eketanyocaacene 'eredaataacene yemathaale. ba'asetabaabaayoce laaye kamiwaredawe qethaate male'eketanyocene 'enaa 'amaanye takataayocene 'enaadenaalane ka'amatzanyaa hhezeboce qethaataacene yamimalase 'ayehoneme.

bamale'eketanyocenaa bahhezebocaacawe 'enedihume bayusufenaa bawanedemocu taarike wesethe yanetzuhe 'a`emero baalabeetoce yamigasatzubate mekere 'ala. yehene taarike yayaazawe qure'aane ba'alaahe laaye yataqathafa deresate 'ayedalame. nagare gene ka'alaahe yawaradu samaayaawi malakotaawi matsaahhefetocene yamiyaaragaagethe 'enedihume zerezere yamiyaasefalegaacawene hegegaatocenaa denegaageewocene yamitanatene wada malekaame yamimaraa, la'amaanyoce 'ezenate yahona matsehhafe nawe. bawesethu baalawe male'ekete yamithaqamute 'enaresu 'amaanyoce naacawe.

(lm)r <<'alife, laame, mime, rwa>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.) 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe ba'aneta laaye yaawaradawe qure'aanenaa bazihe me`eraafe yamiganyu yalaaqu 'aneqatzoce, ka'alaahe zanede yawaradu 'ewenatoce selamahonaacawe meneme therethere yalaweme. nagare gene bezu sawoce bageterenataacawenaa bakuraataacawe mekeneyaate 'ayaamenume.

meneme yametemalakatute mesoso saayenoraacawe samaayaatene wada laaye kafe 'aderego yafatharawe 'alaahe nawe. kaziyaame laresu batagabaanaa kafethuraanu gaare bamaayemasaasale huneetaa ka`areshe balaaye kafe 'ala.tzahhayenenaa charaqaane lafetherataatu theqeme 'enedisathu yatagaru 'adaragaacawe. tzahhayenaa charaqaa ba'alaahe `eweqate latawasana zamane yegwaazaalu. basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe 'alaahe yafaqadawene gudaaye yefatzemaale. batenesaa'ee `elate 'eresune yameteganaanyu mahonaacehune 'enedetaaragaagethunaa bamalekaame szeraa zegeju 'enedetehonu ('alaahe) xaayaalenatune yamiyaaseradu ta`aameraatocene ('aneqatzocene) yaaberaaraale.

mareetene yazaragaawe 'eresu 'alaahe nawe; mareete basawoce laaye 'enedaatewaalelenaa qwaami cekaaloce 'enedihonu taraarocene fathara. bareswa wasethe sawoceme thathetawe maasaacawunenaa kabetocaacaweneme yamiyaathathu yawuhaa jeratocene 'adaragalaacawe. kahulume `aayenate 'aze`erete hulate leke 'enede 'enesesaa yawanedeenaa yaseetee thenedocene 'adaraga. lalitu qanune yelabesawaale; berehaane bachalamaa yewaathaale. bazihe wesethe ya'alaahene szeraa selamiyaasetanatenunaa batheleqate selamiyaasetawelu sawoce maaserajaawocenaa meleketoce yamithaqamuteme 'enedazihe `aayenate sawoce naacawe.

bamareete wesethe yataqaraarabu seferaawoce, yawayene 'ereshaawoce, 'aze`eretoce, ba'anede maszarate yatasabasabunaa yatanaathale maszarate yaalaacawe yatamere zaafoce yeganyaalu. 'aze`eretocunaa 'ereshaawocu 'anede 'ayenate weha yethathaalu; nagare gene meneme 'enekwaa 'anede `aayenate wehane yathathunaa ka'anede mareete yabaqalu bihoneme bathaqameetaacawenaa baleeloce nagaroce 'enedilayaayu,'enedihume yakafilu thaa`eme kakafilu thaa`eme 'enedibalaalathe 'enaadaregaalane. bazihe batathaqasawe huneetaa wesethe la'a`emero baalabeetoce (genezaabeene yamiwasedu 'enaresu bamahonaacawe) 'amalaakaace maaserajaawocenaa meleketoce yeganyaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bahona 'anede nagare yametegarame kahona magaramehe ba'ewenate tagabi yamihonawe,kamotene 'enedihume 'afarenaa yabasabasa 'athenete kahonane baxwaalaa daageme heyaawe honane 'eneqasaqasaalane!? bamile yataqaawemo yakehedate makaraakariyaa negegeraacawe kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase manorune hhasate bamaalataacawe nawe. 'enazihe kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase manorune yamikedu sawoce bageetaacawe laaye kehedatene yafatsamunaa yamutaanene yamaqaseqase celotaane yaaletaqabalu naacawe. batenesaa'ee `elate ya'esaate sanesalate ba'anegataacawe laaye yeqamathaale. ya'esaate baaledaraboce naacawe. baziyaame wesethe lazala`aalame yeqoyaalu; 'ayethafaame yamidaresebaacawe qethaateme 'ayeqwaaratheme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'agaariyaane yatzaafalaacawene tadelaa kamacharasaacawe bafite banaresu laaye qethaate 'enediwarede menawe zagaya!? 'eyaalu 'alwahe yatzaafalaacawune tzagaa saayecharesu qethaatu 'enedimathaabaacawe yaathaadefuhale. yanaresu 'amesaayaa 'asetabaabaaye yaqadamu teweledoce qethaate tafatzemwale. lamene 'ayegasatzume!? 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe sawoce thefaate kamafatzamaacawe gaare yaalefaacawaale. wada 'eresu batzatzate yamamalashaa gizee 'enediyaaganyu baqethaate 'ayaathaadefaacaweme. nagare gene bakehedataacawe laaye bageterenate lamiqathelutenaa baneseha wada 'eresu lamaayemalasute qethaatu beretu nawe.

ba'alaahe laaye kehedatene yafatzamu sawoce:- ya'alaahene manegade bamazegaataacawenaa bageterenataacawenaa wasane bamaalafe (bamusaanaa ba`isaa laaye 'enedawaradawe `aayenate) ta'amere bamuhhaamade(salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) laayeme kageetaawe 'ayewaredelateme nabare bamaalate yenaagaraalu. 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! sawocene ka'alaahe qethaate yamesetaasethanaqeqe 'asethaneqaaqi nahe; 'alaahe yasathahe ta`aameraate becaa 'eneji leelaa linorehe 'ayeceleme. hulume hhezeboce wada qene manegade yamimarunaa yamiyaamalaketu nabiyaatoce nabarwacawe.

'alaahe yahulune seetoce maahetzane yamishakamawene yaaweqaale (sela maahetzanu huluneme nagare yaaweqaale) bamaahetzane wesethe yamifatharawene maqanasenaa machamare, theenenatenaa yatheenaa 'ekele yaaweqaale. hulume nagare le`elenaa batagabaawe 'alaahe zanede bamathane yatawasana nawe. kaziyaa 'ayechamereme; kaziyaame 'ayeqaneseme.

'alaahe kasawe lejoce yasemeete hewaasaatoce yatasawaru nagarocene hulu yaaweqaale. 'enedihume yasawe lejoce basemeete hewaasocaacawe lidaresulaacawe yamicelutene nagaroce hulu yaaweqaale. 'alaahe babaaheriyaatu, basemocunaa baderegitu taalaaqe nawe. ba'akaalunaa (banafesunaa) babaaheriyaatu kafetherataatu hulu kafe yaala nawe.

mesethireneme debeqeneme yaaweqaale yasawe lejoce hoye! ka'enaaneta makaakaale negegerune yadabaqame hona yefaa yaadaraga la'alaahe `eweqate 'ekule nawe. balalite chalamaa kasawoce `aayene yamisawarenaa baqane berehaane baszeraawe geletze hono yamitaaye 'enedazihu ba'alaahe `eweqate 'ekule yetaawaqaalu.

'alaahe basawe lalejoce laaye yamithabaabaaqu (yamifaraaraqu) malaa'eketoce 'alute. kafilocu balalite kafilocu dagemo baqane yemathaalu. basawe lejoce laaye 'enedaayekasatu yatawasanu nagaroce (wesaaneewoce) basawoce laaye 'enedaayedaresu ba'alaahe te`ezaaze yasawe lejocene yethabeqaalu yasawe lejocene szeraanaa negegere yemazagebaalu. yasawe lejoce 'alaahene kamaamasegane raasaacawene kaaleqayaru basetaqare 'alaahe yasawe lejoce yamiganyubatene malekaame huneetaa wada maayaasedasetaacawe leelaa huneetaa 'ayeqayereme. 'alaahe hhezebocene maathefaate kafalaga feqaadune mamalase yamicele maaneme yalame. yasawe lejoce hoye! ka'alaahe weche gudaayaacehune yamiqothaathare maane radaate 'alaacehu!? maaneme yalaacehume. yanakaacehune makaraa lamaasewagade wada 'alaahe tathagu.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'alaahe maberaqene yaasaayaacexwaale. baziyaa wesethe yamaqesafete ferehatenaa yazenaabe tasefaane ba'anede laaye yaathaamerawaale. thanekaaraa yazenaabe wehane yaazala yakabada damanaane yamifatherawe 'alaahe nawe.

nagodegwaade 'alaahene bale`elenaa kamesegaanaa gaare yaawadesaale. malaa'eketoce bamaferaate, bamaalaaqenaa bamaakebare 'alaahene yaawadesaalu ('alaahe) yamaqesefate 'esaatene bafaqadawe fethenate laaye yaawaredaale. baziyaame yaathafaawaale. kahadiyaane ba'alaahe 'anedenate laaye yekaraakaraalu. 'alaahe 'eresune bamiyaametzute laaye beretu thebabenyaanaa xaayaale nawe. meneme nagare maseraate falego saayesaraawe 'ayeqareme.

babecenyenate mamalakenaa malamane 'alaahene becaa nawe. bazihe laaye 'alaahe 'anedeme tagaari yalaweme. 'agaariyaane ka'alaahe weche yamimaatzanwacawe thaa`otaate bayatenyaaweme gudaaye theri bamiyaadaregelaacawe sawe tamaatzeno malese masethate 'ayecelume. 'agaariyaane la'enazihe thaa`otaate yamiyaadaregute tamaatzeno mesaalee baweha themaate 'enedataqaathalanaa wehawe wada 'afu 'enedidaresenaa 'enedigabaa 'ejocune wada weha 'enedazaragaa sawe nawe. wehawe wada 'afu yamidarese 'ayehoneme. kahadiyaane lathaa`otocaacawe yamiyaadaregute tamaatzeno ka'ewenate yaraaqa bekunenate nawe. thaa`otocaacawe la'enaresu theqemene yamasethateme hona gudaatene yamaasewagade selethaane yalaacaweme.

basamaayaatenaa bamedere yamiganyu hulu basegedate la'alaahe raasaacawene zeqe yaadaregaalu. kahadiyaaneme 'amaanyoceme yehene 'ekule yefatzemaalu. 'amaanye bafaqaadanyenate la'alaahe yesagedaale. 'eraasune zeqe 'aderego yenebarakakaale. kahadi yaala faqaade tafathero'awi baaheriwe 'asegadedote bagedeetaa la'alaahe taazaazhe hono yenebarakakaale. baqanu majamariyaanaa macharashaa thelaa yaalawe fetherate hulu la'alaahe yetaazazaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'alaahe gaare leeloce 'amaaleketocene batagaarinate lamiyaamaleku kahadiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe (thayeqaacawe) <<samaayaatenaa mederene yafatharawenaa gudaayaacawene yamiyaasetanaaberawe (yamiyaasetadaaderawe) maanawe!?>> male'eketanyaacene hoye! tanaagare <<samaayaatenaa mederene yafatharawe 'enedihume gudaayaacawene yamiyaasetanaaberawe 'alaahe nawe. 'enaanetame yehenene taaragaagethaalaacehu.>> 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bale <<maaderage yamaayecelu dakaamaa radaatocene laraasaacehu yaazaacehune!? laraasaacawe 'enekwaa theqeme maamethaate, gudaatene maasewagade 'ayecelume; yehe kahona bamene huneetaa nawe laleeloce yehene maaderage (theqemene masethate) yamicelute!?>> 'aneta male'ekatanyaa hoye! negaraacawe - <<yalebu berehaane yataawara kahadinaa qene manegadene yatamaraa yalebe berehaane yaalawe 'amaanye 'ekule naacawene!? wayeneme chalamaawoce yahonawe kehedatenaa berehaane yahonawe 'emenate 'ekule yehonaalune!? wayenese 'alaahe yafatharawene `aayenate 'amesaayaa yafatharu yamafethare tagaariwocene la'alaahe 'aderegawe ya'alaahe fetherataate kathaa`otocaacawe fetherataate gaare taqalaaqalabaacawe!? 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yahulume nagare fathaari 'alaahe becaa nawe. bamafethare laaye 'anedeme tagaari yalaweme. ba'amelekoteme 'eresu becaa limalake yamigabaa tagaari yaleelawe becanyaa xaayaale ('ashanaafi) nawe.>>

hasate 'enedamidabazeze 'ewenate tzenu hono 'enedamiqathele kasamaaye bamiwaredenaa 'enedamathanaacawe teleqenaa teneshe bahonu shalaqowoce bamifase yazenaabe weha 'alaahe mesaaleewocene 'aseqamethwale. yagorefe weha kofaratenaa 'arafaane kalaaye 'anesaafo yeshakamaale. hasate kagorefe weha balaaye 'enedaminesaafafe 'erebaanaa yaleelawe kofarate nawe. 'ewenate 'enedamithathaa weha netzuhenaa therete yaala nawe. feraafereewocenaa takelocene yaabaqelaale. la'ewenatenaa lahasate kazihe leelaame mesaalee sathetwale. yatakabaru maa`edenaatene lamaaqelathenaa sawoce yamiwaabubaacawene geethaageethocene lamaszeraate sawoce yamiyaaqathaathelutene kafile nagare mesaalee 'aderegwaale. hasate yamaa`edene maqelathe 'enedamiyaasewagedawe zegate nawe. 'enedihume 'ewenate kaqathala baxwaalaa 'enedamiqarawenaa sawoce 'enedamithaqamubate maa`edene nawe. ba'enedazihe yaalu mesaaleewoce 'alaahe sela 'ewenatenaa hasate mesaaleewocene yesathaale. 'enedazihume 'enazihene mesaaleewoce 'enedasathawe 'ewenate kahasate talayeto 'eneditaawaqe 'alaahe mesaaleewocene lasawe lejoce yaaseqamethaale.

'alaahe 'eresune babecanyenate 'enediyaamalekutenaa 'eneditaazazute theri siyaadaregelaacawe yageetaacawene theri lataqabalu 'amaanyoce malekaame (yajanate) menedaa 'alaacawe. 'alaahe 'eresune babecanyenate 'enediyaamalekunaa 'eneditaazazu yaaqarabalaacawene theri yaaletaqabalu kahadiyaanocene bamathefo szeraawocaacawe hulu yethayaqaalu. maarafiyaa mathagiyaacawe jahaname nawe. 'esaate yahonawe manyetaacawe (bathaame) mene yaahele yakafaa nawe.bamareete yamiganyu yahabete `aayenatoce hulu 'enaa yaziyaanu yaahele 'ethefe habete ya'enaresu bihone raasaacawene kaqethaate lamaadaane huluneme babeezaanate yaaqarebu nabare.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe ba'aneta laaye yaawaradawe male`ekete therethere yaleelawe 'ewenate mahonune, yamiyaaweqe ba'alaahe yamiyaamenenaa la'alaahe theri malese yasatha sawenaa la'alaahe theri malese yaalesatha, ba'alaahe laaye kehedatene yafatzama yataawara sawe 'ekule lihonu 'ayecelume. bazihe gesaatzeene yamiwasedute netzuhe 'e`emero yaalaacawe naacawe.

'enaziyaa la'alaahe theri malese yasathute, la'alaahe wayeneme lasawoce yagabutene qaale kidaane yamiyaakaberu naacawe. ka'alaahe gaare wayeneme kasawoce gaare yagabutene yathabaqa qaale kidaane 'ayaafaresume.

'alaahe 'enediqathale yaazazawene zemedenaa yamiqathelu naacawe. 'alaahene yefaraalu; selaziheme yaazazaacawene yefatzemaalu; kakalakalaacawe yeqothabaalu. sela fatzamute 'eyaanedaanedu hathi'ate 'alaahe 'enedaayethayeqaacawe yefaraalu (yesagaalu) baszeraawe meremaraa yatadaragabate sawe yaresu gudaaye yaabaqaa yehonaale. madaane 'ayeceleme.

la'alaahe fetzume taazaazhe bamahone laayenaa 'alaahe banaresu laaye bawasanawe yamiyaasedaseteme hona yamiyaasekafaa gudaaye laaye te`egesete yaadaragu naacawe. ya'alaahene wedeetaa 'asebawe (falegawe) kelekele nagarocene kamafatzame te`egesete 'aderegawaale salaataacawene batamwalaa huneetaa fatzemawaale. 'alaahe kalagasaacawe sisaaye gedeetaacawene sathetawaale. bafeqaadanyenate, ka'eyulenye bamaraaqe kasawe `aayene sawerawe, 'enedaziheme sawocene bamalekaame nagare laaye bamaanasaasaate bayefaa metzewaatene sathetawaale; mathefo yafatzamabaacawene sawe deregite bamalekaame tagebaare yemalesaalu. banazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatzu sawoce batenesaa'ee `elate yatamasagana macharashaane yaaganyaalu.

yehe yatamasagana macharashaa zala`aalame batzagaawoce wesethe yamiqoyubate janate nawe. baziyaa wesethe yamiyaaganyute tzagaa melu`e 'enedihone kanaresu gaare bamalekaame manegade laaye batzenaate yanabaru 'abaatocaacawe, 'enaatocaacawe, yatedaare 'agaarocaacawe, lejocaacawe janatene yewaresaalu ('enaresune bamaagenyataacawe dasetaacawe fetzume 'enedihone) bajanate wesethe bamiganyu maarafiyaawocaacawe magebiyaawoce malaa'eketoce beseraatene 'eyanagarwacawe yegabaalu.

malaa'eketoce bamigabubate hulume waqete <<banaaneta laaye salaame yehune>> yamile salaametaa yesathwacawaale. 'alaahene bamataazaze 'enedihume bamigomazezu ya'alaahe wesaaneewocenaa 'alaahe kakalakalawe tagebaare bamaqothabe laaye te`egesete bamaaderagaacehu kathefaate salaame honaacexwaale. yamacharashaawe `aalame bathaame yaamaara nawe yelwacawaale

'alaahe banazihe 'aneqatzoce ya'amaanyocene baaheri kagalatza baxwaalaa bamaqathaleme 'emebitanyaa yahonu kahadiyaanoce baaherine yegaletzaale.
kathabaqa baxwaalaa ya'alaahe qaale kidaanene yamiyaafaresu, 'alaahe 'enediqathale yaazazawene zemedenaa yamiqorethu 'enazihe `ethaa fanetaa yaleelaacawe yaraaqu, ka'alaahe 'ezenate yebaararaalu. mathefo macharashaa ('esaate) yethabeqaacawaale.

'alaahe lafaqadawe sawe sisaayene yaasafaale. lafaqadawe sawe sisaayene yaathabaale. yasisaaye masefaate batayaayaazhenate `edelanyaanatenaa ya'alaahene wedeetaa yamithaqume melekete 'ayedalame. 'enedazihume yasisaaye mathebabe ya`edela bisenate melekete 'ayedalame. kahadiyaanoce bamederaawi heyewate fanathazu; wada mederaawi heyewate raasaacawene 'asethagu. bamederaawi heyewate sathamu (taragaagu) yamederaawi `aalame heyewate kamacharashaawe `aalame heyewate gaare sinatzaatzare thafi yahona theqite madasacaa becaa nawe.

ba'alaahenaa bata`aameraatocu yakaadu sawoce 'enedihe yelaalu - <<'enedenaamenebatenaa 'ewenatanyaanatune 'enedithaqume bamuhhamade laaye yamidaasase tachabaache ta`aamere kageetaawe 'ayewaredelateme nabarene?>> 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehene hhasaabe lasanazarute sawoce negaraacawe - <<'alaahe yafalagawene sawe yaathamemaale, baziheme fetehawi nawe. wada 'eresu batzatzate lamimalase sawe qathetanyaawene manegade yemaraale. sekeete ba'ejaacawe yaala gudaaye 'ayedalame (lamene ta`aameraatocene kamaayate gaare yaazaamedutaale!?)>>

'alaahe qathetanyaawene manegade yamimaraacawe 'enaziyaa yaamanutene nawe. 'alaahene bamaawesaate, bamaamaseganenaa bamaawadase 'enedihume qure'aanene bamaqeraate; bamasemaate 'enaa yatalayaayu yazekere 'ayenatocene bamaazawetare lebaacawe 'erekaataane yaaganyaale. 'asetawelu! 'alaahene becaa bamaasetaawase leboce 'erekaataa yaaganyaalu.(yaleboce) tafatherwawi baaheri 'anedaziyaa nawe.
'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanunaa wada 'alaahe yamiyaaqarebaacawene malekaame szeraawoce yaszaru 'amaanyoce bamacharashaawe `aalame malekaame nuro, malekaame macharashaane (janatene) yaaganyaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! qadamete male'eketanyocene wada hhezebocaacawe 'enedalaakenawe hulu 'enedazihume wada 'aneta yaawaradenawene qure'aane 'enedetaanabelaacawe 'anetaneme wada hhezebocehe laakenehe. qure'aane 'ewenatanyaa selamahonehe baqi 'amalekaace nawe. nagare gene hhezebocehe yehene ta`aamere yekedaalu. mekeneyaatume leelaane ya'amelekote tagaari bamayaaze 'ba'aleraahemaane' (ba'alaahe) laaye kehedatene yefatzemaalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<baresu laaye ya'amelekote tagaari yametaadaregubate "'aleraahemaane" karesu basetaqare ba'ewenate yamiyaamalekute 'amelaake yaleela geetaayee nawe. bahulume gudaayocee baresu laaye tamakeceeyaalahu. nesehhayeeme wadaresu nawe.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yamalakotaawi matsehhafe magalachaa baaheri taraarocene kabotaacawe yamiyaathafaa,mareetene yamisanatheqenaa mareete menechocenaa wanezoce 'enedetehone yamiyaadarege, wayeneme bamutaane laaye sinababe heyewatene yamizaraabaacawe bihone noro (qure'aane 'enedaziyaa yehone nabare) 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahene yamifaraa lebe sinoraacawe qure'aane maaserajaanatu geletzenaa teleqe tatze'eno yamifathere nabare. nagare gene 'enaresu yamiyaamenu 'ayedalume; kahadiwoce naacawe. ta`aameraatocene yamaawerademe yehune yaleelaa gudaayu hulu wesaanee ya'alaahe nawe. 'alaahe sawoce hulu qathetanyaawene manegade yemaraacawe 'enedanabare ba'alaahe yamiyaamenu 'amaanyoce 'ayaawequmene!? nagare gene yehene 'alefaqadame. 'enaziyaa 'alaahene yakaadu sawoca bamifatzemute kehedatenaa hathi'ate mekeneyaate beretu 'asedanegaache nagare ba'enaresu laaye maderasu 'ayelayaacaweme. wayeneme qathaayenate yaalawe ya'alaahe yaqethaate qatharo 'esekimathaa derase yehe 'asedanegaache nagare kamanoriyaacawe baqerebe yekasataale. 'alaahe yawasanalate gizee simathaa yasathawene qatharo kamafatzame 'ayetaweme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! hhezebocu hhasatanyaa yaalutenaa yaafeezubate yamajamariyaawe male'eketanyaa 'aneta 'ayedalaheme. ka'aneta bafite yanabaru hhezeboce bamale'eketanyaacawe laaye 'afizawaale. male'eketanyaacawene hasatanyaa belawaale. male'eketanyocaacawene yakaadu sawoce 'alaahe thefaate 'enedamiyaamathaabaacawe 'esekiyaasebunaa 'esekimotu derase 'alaahe 'azagayaacawe. katheqite yacaletaa gizee baxwaalaa baleyu leyu qethaatoce yaazaacawe. ya'alaahe qethaate mene yemasele nabare!? bathaame beretu qethaate nabare.

'amelekote yamigabaawe yahuluneme fetherataate sisaaye yamithabeqe (yamilagese) 'enaa nafesoce hulu yamiszarutene yamiqothaathare, yaszeraacaweneme waagaa yamisathe nawe wayenese 'enazihene limalaku tagabi yamaayehonu thaa`otaate!? kahadiyaane babadalenaa bahasate la'alaahe ya'amelekote tagaarine baregethe 'adaragu. 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<batheriyaacehu 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu ka'alaahe gaare ya'amelekote tagaari bamaaderage yametaamalekwaacawene tagaariwoce seme theqasulene (sayemulene) 'alaahe bamedere yamaayaaweqawe tagaari nuro tenagerutaalaacehune!? wayenese tachabaachenate ('ewenatenate) yaleelawe kalaaye becaa yamitaaye wareene tenagerutaalaacehu!? lanazihe kahadiyaanoce shayethwane mathefo seeraacawene malekaame webe 'aderego 'asaayaacawene? 'alaahene kaadu. baziheme kaqenenaa kaqathetanyaawe manegade 'azoraacawe 'alaahe kaqathetanyaawe manegade yaathamamawe sawe qathetanyaawene manegade limaraawe yamicele maaneme yalame.

bamederaawi heyewate qethaate yaaganyaalu; yamithabeqaacawe yamacharashaawe `aalame qethaate dagemo beretunaa yamaayeqwaarathe zala`aalamaawi bamahonu kamederaawi `aalame qethaate yabarataanaa yakafaa nawe. batenesaa'ee `elate ka'alaahe qethaate yamiyaadenaacawe takalaakaaye yalaacaweme.>>

'eresu yaazazaacawene bamafatzamenaa kakalakalaacawe bamaqothabe 'alaahene lamifaru sawoce 'alaahe yaazagaajaate ('enedamiyaawaresaacawe qaale kidaane) yagabaawe janate gatzetaa (yehene yemaselaale) kahenetzaawocwanaa kazaafocwa sere wanezoce yefasubaataale. bawesethwa yamiganyu fereewoce zala`aalamaawi naacawe; 'eneda mederaawi fereewoce 'ayeqwaarathume. thelaawocaacawe qwaamiwoce naacawe; 'ayethafume; 'ayeqanasume. yaazazawene bamafatzamenaa kakalakalawe bamaqothabe 'alaahene yamithanaqaqe sawoce maderashaa (macharashaa) yehe nawe. yakahadiwoce macharashaa gene zala`aalame yamiqoyubate 'esaate nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! taweraatene yasathanaacehu 'ayehudaawiyaane, 'enedihume nejelene yasathanaacawe naswaraawoce banaresu laaye kawaradawe male`ekete gaare bakafile yamisemaamaa (yamimasaasale, yamigathaathame) bamahonume 'aneta laaye bawaradawe male'ekete yedasataalu. ka'ayehudaawiyaanenaa kanaswaraawoce kafile budenoce kasemeetaacawe (kafelaagotaacawenaa kanafese zenebaaleewocaacawe) gaare yamaayethaathaame bamahonume wayeme yawaradalaacawene male'ekete 'enedilawathunaa 'enedaazaabu yamigaletzaacawe bamahonu ba'aneta laaye yawaradawene male'ekete kafile yamikedu yeganyaalu. 'aneta male`eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<'alaahe yaazazanye 'eresune becaa 'enedaamalekenaa ba'eresu laaye 'anedeme ya'amelekote tagaari 'enedaalaadarege nawe. wada 'alaahe (wada 'eresu) becaa theriyeene 'adaregaalahu. ka'eresu gaare 'anedeme nagare tagaari 'aderegee 'aletharaame. mamalashaayeeme wadaresu becaa nawe. yataweraatenaa yanejileme male`eketoce 'enedazihu nabaru.>>

'aneta male'ekatanyaa hoye! 'enedazihume qadamete malakotaawi matsaahhefetocene male'eketume batalaakalaacawe hhezeboce qwaaneqwaa (lesaane) 'enedaawaradenelaacawe qure'aaneneme ba'aneta laaye 'ewenatene radaatenatenaa yamigaletzenaa yamiyaaberaaraa qaale sihone ba`aarabenyaa qwaaneqwaa 'awaradenawe. 'alaahe yaasetamaarahe `eweqate kadarasahe baxwaalaa kasemeetocaacawe gaare yamaayethaathaamawene 'enedetesareze yamatsaahhefetu baalabeetoce ('ayehudaawiyaanenaa naswaraawoce) yamiyaadaraaderuhene yanafese zenebaaleeyaacawene (semeetaacawene) betekatale nagarehene yamiqothaatharelehe, bathalaatocehe laaye yamiradaahe ka'alaahe yahona radaate 'ayenoreheme ka'alaahe qethaate yamikalaakaleleheme yalaheme.

'aneta male'ekatanyaa hoye! ka'aneta bafite male'eketanyocene wada hhezebocaacawe lekanaale. 'eneda 'amesaayaacawe yasawe lejoce misetocenenaa lejocene sathetanaacawaale. tedaare yamaayemasaretunaa lejocene yamaayewaledu malaa`eketoce 'alaadaregenaacaweme. 'anetame kanazihe kamiyaagabunaa lejocene kamiwaledu male'eketanyoce makaakaale 'anedu nahe. 'enedihe bamahonehe 'agaariyaane yamiyaasedasetaacawe menedenawe?! male'eketanyaa ya'alaahe feqaade hono ta`aameraatocene kaalaamathaa basetaqare karaasu ta`aamerocene maamethaate 'ayeceleme 'alaahe yawasanawe hulume gudaaye yatamazagababate matsehhafe 'ala. (ya'alaahe wesaanee) wadafiteme wada xwaalaame yamaayaalefawe yagizee gadabe 'alawe.

malekaameme, mathefome, dasetaame, hazaneme, leelaame nagare bihone 'alaahe liyaasewagedawe yafalagawene nagare yaasewagedawaale. 'eneditzanaa yafalagawene yaatzanaawaale. yatathabaqawe saleedaa 'eresu zanede yeganyaale. yatathabaqawe saleedaa yahulume (wesaanee) nagare maathaaqashaa (mamarekozhaa 'enaa mamalashaa) nawe. yamikasate (yamifatzame) maasewagademe hona maatzenaate batathabaqawe saleedaa laaye kasafarawe gaare yatasemaamaa nawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! helefatehe bafite yaqatharenaacawene qethaate kafilune benaasaayehe wayeneme kaqethaataacawe kafilune saanaasaayehe betaalefe wesaaneewe ya'alaahe nawe. ka'aneta yamithabaqawe 'enedetaadaresawe yaazazenehene male`ekete maaderase becaa nawe. szeraacawene mamaremanaa yaszeraacawene menedaa masethate 'ayethabaqebeheme. yehe ya'alaahe tagebaare nawe. yehe ba'alaahe laaye nawe.

selaamene lamaasefaafaate yakehedatene mareete kachaafocu 'enedameneqanesawe 'enaziyaa kahadiyaane 'ayemalaketumene?! 'alaahe babaariyaawocu makaakale 'enedafaqadawe yefaredaale, yewasenaale. bamaqanaseme,bamachamareme, bamalawatheme feredune yegebaanye yamile 'anedeme yalame. 'eresu 'alaahe meremaraawe fathaane nawe. ba'anede `elate kamajamariyaawe 'eseka macharashaawe yamiganyu fetherataatocene yemarameraale:

kazihe bafite yanabaru hhezeboce bamale'eketanyocaacawe laaye seeraawocene thanesesawaale. male'eketanyocaacawe yezawe yamathutene male'ekete hasate belawaale. seeraane bamale'eketanyocaacawe laaye bamathanesasaacawe mene 'adaragu?! mene sekeetene 'aganyu?! meneme 'alaaganyume. mekeneyaatume wetheetaamaa 'eqede ya'alaahe `eqede becaa nawe. 'enedihume 'alaahe nafesocaacawe yamiszarutene hulu yaaweqaale kaseraawocaacaweme meneme nagare kasu yamidabaqe yalame. baziyaame laaye yaszeraacawene menedaa yesathaacawaale. baziyaane waqete ba'alaahe baalamaamanaacawe mene yaahele sehetate 'enedasaru, 'amaanyoce mene yaahele 'ewenate laaye 'enedanabarunaa batagebaaraacawe janatenenaa malekaame macharashaa 'enedaaganyu yeganazabaalu.

kahadiyaane 'enedihe yelaalu - <<mahhamade hoye! ka'alaahe yatalaakehe male'eketanyaa 'ayedalaheme?>> male'eketanyaawe hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<'enee kageetaayee wada 'enaaneta yatalaaku male'eketanyaa selamahonee ba'eneenaa ba'enaaneta makaakale ya'alaahe mesekerenate baqi nawe. 'enedazihume kasamaaye yawaradu yanabiyenate magalachaawocee yatathaqasubatene malakotaawi matsaahhefetocene yamiyaaweqe sawe mesekerenate baqi nawe.>> sela 'ewenatanyaanatu mesekeru 'alaahe yahonalate sawe hasatanyaa nahe yamilute sawoce negegere 'ayegodaaweme.

(lr) <<'alife, laame, raa'e> (ba`arabenyaa fedalaate (mehetzaara qaale ) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.) male'eketanyaa hoye! yehe qure'aane kakehedate, kamaahaayemenatenaa kathemate wada 'emenate, ba'alwahe faqaade 'enaa 'egazaa maaneme yamaayaashanefawene kebere yatagabaawe 'ashanaafi yahonawe wada 'alaahe manegadenaa bahulume nagaroce mesegune wada honawe yaselaame qathetanyaa manegade sawocene 'enedetaawathaa wada 'aneta yaawaradenawe matzehhafe nawe.

basamaayaate wesethe yamiganyawe negesenaa la'alaahe becaa nawe. bamedere wesethe yamiganyawe negeszenaa la'alaahe becaa nawe. 'eresu ('alaahe) babecanyenate limalakenaa baresu 'amelekote laaye kafethuraanu 'anedeme tagaari laayedaragebate yegabaawaale. kahadiyaanoce thanekaaraa qethaate yaaganyaacawaale.

kahadiyaanoce yamederaawi heyewatenaa bawesethwa yamiganyu 'a`elaafe tzagaawocene ka'akxiraa heyewatenaa bawesethu kamiganyu zala`aalamaawi tzagaawoce yemarethaalu. sawocene ka'alaahe manegade yaathamemaalu. 'anedeme sawe ya'alaahene manegade 'enedaayekatale, (manegadune yatakataluteme) katzenaate 'enedisharaatatunaa ka'ewenate 'enediyaafanagethu ya'alaahene manegade bamathefo liyaathalashute yefalegaalu. bazihe baaheri yamigalatzu sawoce ka'ewenate baraaqa thememate wesethe yeganyaalu.

wada hhezebocu yatalaaka male'eketanyaa hulu hhezebocu ka'alaahe zanede yatalaakabatene male'ekete baqalaalu maradaate 'enedicelu yahhezebocene qwaaneqwaa (lesaane) yenaagaraale. ba'alaahe bamaamane laaye hhezebocune 'enediyaasegadede male'eketanyaane 'alelaakeneme. 'alaahe bafetehawinatu yafalawene yaathamemaale; bacerotaawe dagemo lafalagawe qathetanyaawene manegade yamamaraatene sekeete yesathaale. 'eresu ('alaahe) 'anedeme dele yamaayesaanawe 'ashanaafi nawe. ba'afathaatharunaa `aalamaatene bamaasetanaabaru thebabanyaa nawe.

musaane baregethe (wada hhezebocu) laakenawe. ka'alaahe yatalaaka 'enedahona 'ewenatanyaanatune bamiyaamalaaketu ta`aameraatoce 'abarataanawe. hhezebocu kakehedatenaa maayemenate wada 'emenatenaa `eweqate 'enediyaamathaa, tzagaawocene yaaganyubatene ya'alaahene qanaatoce 'enediyaasetaawesaacawe 'azazenawe. ba'enaziyaa qanaatoce ya'alaahene becanyaa tamalaakinatenaa celotaa ba'amaanyoce laaye tzagaane yaadaraga mahonune yamithaqumu geletze maaserajaawoce yeganyaalu. 'alaahene bamataazaze te`egesetene yamiyaadaregunaa sela tzagaawocunaa legesenaawene zawatere 'alaahene yamiyaamasagenu sawoce bazihe yethaqamaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! musaa yageetaawene te`ezaaze bamafatzame lahhezebocu ya'eseraa'eele lejoce 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye yafatzamawene tzagaa 'eyaasetaawasaacawe yatanaagarawene 'asetaawese. <<hhezebocee hoye! kafire'owene takataayocu natzaa bamaawethaatenaa kagefaacawe salaame bamaaderage 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye yafatzamawene tzagaa 'asetaawesu. ka'enaaneta wesethe yafire'owenene zawede (negeszenaa) yamiwasede wanede 'enedaayefathare wanede lejocaacehune bamaarade kefu qethaate yefatzemebaacehu nabare. seetocaacehune lamaawaaradenaa lamazelafe baheyewate yaaqoyaacawe nabare. yehe deregitaacawe yatafatanaacehubate mukaraa nabare. te`egesetene batelequ yamifataatane nabare. bazihe fatanaa laaye bate`egesete bamatzenaataacehu kafire'owenenaa katakataayocu natzaa bamaawethaate late`egesetaacehu 'elehe malekaame melaashe sathaacehu.>>

musaa 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<geetaacehu retu`e bahona manegade yaasaawaqaacehune temeherete (`eweqate) 'asetaawesu; banazihe (batathaqasute tzagaawoce) 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye selafatzamaacawe tzagaawoce (malekaamenaa bago nagaroce) 'alaahene kaamasaganaacehu 'alaahe kacerotaawocunaa katzagaawocu yechamerelaacexwaale. ba'enaaneta laaye yafatzamaacawene tzagaawoce kakaadaacehunaa kaalaamasaganaacehu 'alaahe tzagaawocune bamikedunaa bamaayaamasagenu sawoce laaye qethaatu beretu nawe.>>

musaa lahhezebocu 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<hhezebocee hoye! 'enaaneta betekedu 'enedihume bamareete laaye yamiganye hulu ka'enaaneta gaare kehedatene bifatzeme yakehedataacehu mathefo gudaate yamimalasawe ba'enaanetawe laaye nawe. 'alaahe banafesu yatabeqaaqaanaa mesegaanaa yatagabaawe nawe. ya'amaanyoce 'emenate 'ayethaqemaweme. yakahadiyaanoce kehedate 'ayegodaawe.

kahadiyaane hoye! ka'enaaneta bafite yaqadamunaa 'asetabaabaaye yanabaru teweledoce yanuhhe hhezeboce, ya'ade hhezeboce, yasamade hhezebocenaa kanaresu baxwaalaa yatafatharu 'ejege bezunaa qutheraacawene 'alaahe becaa yamiyaaweqawe hhezeboce yamathefaataacawe zeenaa 'aledarasaacehumene?!>>male'eketanyocaacawe bageletze maaserajaawoce mathulaacawe. 'ejocaacawene ba'afocaacawe laaye bamaaderage bamale'eketanyocaacawe laaye baquchete thaatocaacawene nakasu. male'eketanyocaacawene 'enedihe 'alu - <<yatalaakaacehubatene male'ekete 'enyaa kedanaale; wada 'eresu theri kametaadaregulene nagare geraa magaabaatene bamiqasaqese therethaaree wesethe nane.>>

male'eketanyocaacawe la'enaresu malese bamasethate 'enedihe 'alu:- <<ba'alaahe 'anedenatenaa 'amelekote la'eresu becaa bamaaderage laaye yamiyaatharaathere nagare 'alane!?
