'eresu ('alaahe) yasamaayaate 'enedihume yamedere fathaarinaa yaaseqadama mesaalee yaaseganyaacawe nawe. ba'eresu 'enedetaamenunaa baziyaame yaqadama hathi'ataacehune lisarezelaacehu, bamederaawi heyewate yatatzaafalaacehu `edemee 'esekithanaaqaqe derase liyaaqoyaacehu theri yaadaregelaacewaale.>> yamale'eketanyaa hhezeboce lamale'eketanyocaacawe 'enedihe 'alu - <<'enaaneta ya'enyaawe 'amesaayaa sawoce naace. ba'enyaa laaye leyu (mabetenaa) belechaa yalaacehume felaagotaacehu 'abaatocaacene yaamalekute kanabarawe nagare 'enyaane maasewathaate nawe. ka'alaahe yatalaakene male'eketanyoce nane bamaalate bametemogetute gudaaye 'ewenatanyaa mahonaacehune yamiyaamalaketu geletze maaserajaawocene 'amethulene.>>

male'eketanyocaacawe malese bamasethate 'enedihe 'alu:- <<ya'enaanetawe 'amesaayaa yasawe lejoce 'eneji leelaa (fethure) 'ayedalaneme. ya'enaanetawe 'amesaayaawoce mahonaacenene 'anekedeme honome gene yehe mamasaasale bahulume nagaroce mamasaasale manorune 'ayethaqumeme. 'alaahe ka'agalegaayocu lafaqadawe yaleyu tzagaane cerotaa bamalagase wada sawoce yamilaake male'eketanyaa 'aderego yemarethawaale. yathayaqaacehutene maaserajaa ba'alaahe feqaade bihone 'eneji maamethaataacene tagabi 'ayehoneme. yehene maamethaate ka'enyaa 'aqeme wechi nawe. bazihe laaye celotaa yaalawe 'alaahe becaa nawe. ba'eresu (ba'alaahe) yamiyaamenu 'amaanyoce bahulume gudaayocaacawe ba'alaahe laaye becaa mamakaate 'alabaacawe.

ba'alaahe laaye 'enedaanemakaa yamiyaadaregane mekeneyaate wayeneme geredoshe menedenawe?! kahulume balaaye geletze wadahonanaa wada tasetakaakala manegade maretonaale. hhasatanyoce bamaalatenaa bamaafeeze ba'enyaa laaye bametaadaresute kefaate (cegere) te`egesete 'enaadaregaalane. mu'emenoce bahulume gudaayocaacawe ba'alaahe laaye becaa yemaku>>

kahadiyaane yahonu yamale'eketanyoce hhezeboce ba`eweqate male'eketanyocaacawene maashanafenaa makaraakare siyaaqetaacawe 'enedihe 'alu - <<kakatamaacene 'enaasewathaacexwaalane; 'aliyaame 'emenataacehune bamatawe wada 'enyaa 'emenate temalasaalaacehu>> 'alaahe batzenaate 'enedithanakeru malakotaawi male'eketune wada male'eketanyocu 'awarada - <<ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyocu kehedatene yafatzamu badalanyocene 'enaathafaacawaalane.

male'eketanyocenaa takataayocaacawe hoye! 'enaresune kaathafaane baxwaalaa bamedere 'enaanoraacexwaalane. yehe yatathaqasawe; 'asetabaabaaye kahadiyaanene maathefaatenaa kanaresu mathefaate baxwaalaa male'eketanyocene 'enaa takataayocaacawene yamedere waraashoce maaderage yamiganyawe (yamihonawe) taalaaqenateene laasetaawasa, 'enedamemalakatawe laasabanaa yaqethaate maasethaneqaqiyaayeene latathanaqaqa (lafaraa) nawe.>>

male'eketanyoce 'alaahe bathalaatocaacawe laaye delene 'enediyaagonaatzefaacawe ('eredaataane 'enedisathaacawe) theyaaqee 'aqarabu. ba'ewenate laaye kuraatanyaanaa getere yahona 'enedihume geletze kahonalate baxwaalaa 'ewenatene yamaayekatale sawe hulu kasara.

batenesaa'ee `elate lazihe kuraatanyaa (sawe) kafite lafitu yamithabeqawe 'esaate 'ala. baziyaa (bajahaname) wesethe ka'esaate sawoce yamifasawene magele yethathaale. themaatune 'ayeqorethelateme. bathemaatenaa batalayaayu qethaatoce 'eyatasaqaaya yenoraale.

fasaashu maraare, 'ejege yamiyaaqaathele yamishate bamahonu yatanasaa batadagaagaami lamathathaate yetaagalaale. lamawaathe 'aqeme 'ayenorawe. bamiyaaganyawe qethaate kabaade seqaaye mekeneyaate mote kahulume 'aqethaachaa yekabawaale. bamote 'erafete maagenyate 'ayeceleme. baqethaatu 'eyatasaqaaya yenoraale. kafite lafitu yamithabeqawe leelaa beretu qethaate yeganyaale.

kahadiyaane yamiyaakanaawenwacawe malekaame tagebaaraate (metzewaate 'enedamasethate, malekaame 'enedamaaderage, ladakaamoce 'enedamaazane yamasaasalute tagebaaraate) mesaalee nafaashaa bahona 'anede `elate xaayelanyaa nefaase 'enedabarataabatenaa qenethaate saayeqare bahulume 'aqethaachaa 'eneda tabatana 'amade (mesaalee) nawe. yakahadiyaane (malekaame) tagebaare yakehedate maa`ebale yaathafaawaale (yenafesebataale) bate`enesaa'ee `elate 'ayethaqemaacaweme. bamaane laaye yaaletamasarata szeraa ka'ewenate manegade yaraaqa themate nawe.

'aneta sawe hoye! 'alaahe samaayaatenenaa mederene ba'ewenate yafathara mahonune 'ataaweqemene?! lakanetu 'alefatharaacaweme. yasawe lejoce hoye! ('alaahe) 'enaanetane maasewagadenaa kaziyaame ba'enaaneta meteke 'eresune yamiyaamalekutenaa yamitaazazu fetherataatene maamethaate bifalege (yehene maaderage yecelaale). yehene maaderage (la'alaahe) bathaame qalaale gudaaye nawe.
'enaanetane maathefaatenaa leeloce fetherataatene maamethaate kebere latagabaawe 'alaahe yamisaanawe 'ayedalame. 'eresu ('alaahe) hulune nagare caaye nawe. yamisaanawe nagare yalame.

baqatharo `elate fetherataate kamaqaaberaacawe wada 'alaahe yewathaalu. dakaamaa takataayoce la'alaqocaacawenaa lamariwocaacawe 'enedihe yelaalu <<'enyaa ya'enaaneta takataayoce nabarene; te`ezaazaacehune 'enekatale nabare. yakalakalaacehutene 'enekalekale nabare. 'ahune ka'alaahe qethaate qenethaatene temalesulenaalaacehune?!>> 'alaqocenaa mariwoce 'enedihe yelaalu:- <<'alaahe qathetanyaawene manegade yamamaraate sekeetene bisathane wadaziyaa (manegade) 'enemaraacehu nabare. (baziheme) hulaaceneme kaqethaatu 'enedene nabare. nagare gene themematene takatelane 'enaanetaneme 'athamamenaacehu (ya'alaahene) qethaate mashakame 'aqetone baaneqwaaqwaamaweme wayeneme baqethaatu laaye te`egesete benaadaregeme ba'enyaame laaye ba'enaanetame laaye (leyunate yalaweme) 'ekule nawe. kaqethaatu maamelachaa yalaneme.>>

yajanate sawoce janate sigabunaa ya'esaate sawoce 'esaate sigabu shayethwane 'enedihe yelaale - <<'alaahe 'ewenatanyaa qatharone sathaacehu. yaqatharowene qaale fatzamalaacehu. 'enee hasatanyaa qatharone sathaxwaacehu; qaale kidaaneene 'alemolaahulaacehume. bamederaawiwe `aalame bakehedatenaa bathememate laaye 'enedetehonu 'enaanetane yamaasegadedebate xaayele 'alenabaranyeme. nagare gene wada kehedate theri 'adaragekulaacehu. hathi'atocene 'asewaabekulaacehu. 'eneene lamakatale tasheqadaadamaacehu. selatakasatawe thememataacehu 'eneene 'ateweqasu; nafesocaacehune weqasu; waqasaa tagabi yamihonawe lanafesocaacehu nawe. la'enaaneta 'eredaataa bamasethate qethaatene lekalaakalelaacehu 'aleceleme. 'enaanetame yamidaresebenyene qethaate bamamalase 'eneene maredaate 'atecelume. 'eneene ba'alaahe 'amelekote laaye bamaaderagaacehu kejaalahunye. bamederaawi heyewate ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaarine bamaaderagenaa kehedatene bamafatzame badalanyaa yahonu sawoce batenesaa'eewe `elate 'asaamaami qethaate yethabeqaacawaale.>>

'alaahe lamaasethaneqaqenaa (lamaasefaraaraate) batenesaa'eewe `elate kahadiyaane yamithabeqaacawene fetzaamee (`ethaa fanetaa) kathaqasa baxwaalaa bamaqathaleme 'amaanyoce yamithabeqaacawene fetzaamee bamagelatze lafetzaameewe siyaagwaagwaa 'enedihe 'ala -
kabadalanyoce fetzaamee (`ethaa fanetaa) bataqaaraani 'enaziyaa yaamanute malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru kahenetzaawocwanaa kazaafocwa sere wanezoce bamifasubaate janate 'enedigabu yehonaale. bageetaacawe feqaade bajanate wesethe zala`aalame yeqoyaalu. 'erese baresaacawe salaametaa yesathaathaalu; malaa'eketoce salaametaa yesathwacawaale; kebere laresu yatagabaawe 'alaahe geetaacawe salaametaa yesathaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<laa laaha lalwahe>> (ka'alaahe basetaqare ba'ewenate liyaamalekute yamigabaa 'amelaake yalame) lamilawe ya"tawehhide" qaale 'alaahe 'enedeete bamalekaame zaafe (batamere zaafe) mesaaleene 'enedaaseqamatha 'ataaweqemene?! genedwa bamareete hode wesethe saretzo'ale; bamalekaame serocwa wehane tethathaalace; qerenechaafocwa wada samaaye yatazaragu naacawe yatheezaa weha yethathaalu; malekaame 'ayare yemagabaalu (yemegaalu).
yeheci malekaame zaafe ba'alaahe feqaade zawatere malekaame fereewocwane telagesaalace. gesaatzeewocene 'enediwasedu 'alaahe lasawoce mesaaleewocene yaadaregaale.

ya"shereke" (yamaagaaraate) mathefo qaale mesaalee 'eneda mathefo zaafe mesaalee nawe. 'eneda 'enebwaye zaafe nawe. serocu yatanaqalu naacawe. bamareete laaye tzenaate yalaweme. 'enedazihume wada samaaye kafetaa yalaweme. yemotenaa (yewadeqenaa) nefaase yebatenawaale. yakehedate qaale macharashaame 'enedihu thefaate nawe. yakehedate qaale baalabeete wada 'alaahe yamiwathaa malekaame szeraa yalaweme.

bamederaawi `aalame tzenu bahonawe ya"tawehide" qaale bamelu`e 'emenate 'amaanyocene 'alaahe yaatzanaacawaale (bazihu 'emenate laaye bamote 'esekiyaalefu derase) 'enedazihume bamaqaaberaacawe wesethe bamithayaqubate gizeenaa batenesaa'eewe `elate tzenaatene yesathaacawaale. ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekotene tagaari bamaaderagenaa bakehedate badalanyaa yahonutene 'alaahe ka'ewenatenaa kaqenu manegade yaathamemaacawaale. 'alaahe yafaqadawene yefatzemaale. 'enedithameme yafalagawene sawe bafetehawinate yaathamawaale. qenune manegade 'enedimaraa yamifalegawene sawe bacerotaawe wada qathetanyaawe manegade yemaraawaale. kebere la'eresu yatagabaa yahonawene 'alaahe yamiyaasegadedawe 'anedeme yalame.

ba'alaahenaa bamale'ekatanyaawe yakaadute qurayeshoce 'alaahe "hharaamene" tzathetanyaa bamaaderage 'enyaa ka'enaresu muhhamadene male'eketanyaa 'aderego bamalaake yafatzamalaacawene tzagaa silawethu (meteke siyaadaregulate) temalakataacawaalahe. kanazihe tzagaawoce (malekaame nagaroce) yeleqe (male'eketanyaawe) yezolaacawe yamathaawene male`ekete hhasate bamaalate ba'alaahe tzagaawoce makaadene marathu. baziheme kahhezebocaacawe bakehedate laaye yatakatalwacawene sawoce wada thefaate hagare (qulequle) nadwacawe.
yathefaate hagare maalate jahaname nawe. baziyaa wesethe yegabaalu. bagelatu yesaqaayaalu. ya'eresume yamacharashaa madaarashaa yakafaa yafetzaamee madaarashaa nawe.

'agaariyaane (thaa`otaawiyaane) raasaacawe kaqathetanyaawe manegade kathamamu baxwaalaa yamikatalwacawene sawoce ka'alaahe manegade laaye lamaasaasaate (lamaathemame) la'alaahe 'amesaayaawocenaa 'acaawocene 'adaragulate. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<bazihe mederaawi `aalame bametewaanyubaacawe semeetaawi gudaayocenaa bametaasaraachaacawe yamaametaacaa hasaaboce fanethezu. batenesaa'ee `elate mamalashaacehu 'esaate nawe. kazihe weche leelaa mamalashaa yalaacehume.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'amaanyoce 'enedihe balaacawe - <<'amaanyoce hoye! salaataacehune batamwalaa huneetaa fatzemu; 'alaahe kalagasaacehu sisaaye yagedeetaanaa yafaqaadanyenate metzewaatocene basewere kasawoce 'eyulenye lamadabaqenaa bayefaa laleeloce sawoce yamalekaame szeraa tamesaaleete lamahone, gebeyete, beezaa maaqerabenaa ka'alaahe qethaate madaane yamaayecaalebate 'enedihume gwaadanyaa lagwaadanyaawe melejaa masethate yamiyaasecelawe wadaajenate yamaayenorebate (yatenesaa'ee) `elate kamamethaatu bafite lagesu.>>

samaayaatenaa mederene yaala qedema mesaalee yafatharawe (kaalamanore wada manore yaamathaacehu) 'alaahe nawe. kasamaayaate yazenaabe wehane 'awarada. yasawe lejoce hoye! baziyaa weha leyu leyu fereewocene la'enaaneta megebe 'enedihonu 'abaqala. baresu (ba'alaahe) wesaanee marekabe baweha laaye 'enedinesaafafenaa 'enedigwaaze qalaale 'adaragalaacehu

'enedazihume tzahhayenaa charaqaane yatagaru 'adaragalaacehu; zawatere yegwaazaalu; lalitenaa qane 'enedifaraaraqunaa lalite la'eneqelefenaa la'erafetaacehu, qanune la'eneqeseqaaseeyaacehunaa lategaataacehu yatagaru (yatamacu) 'adaragalaacehu.

('alaahe) yathayaqaacehutene hulu sathaacehu. yaalethayaqaacehuteneme sathaacehu. ya'alaahene tzagaawoce qotheraacehu 'atezalequteme ('atecharesuteme) 'ejege bezu naacawe. yatathaqasute kafile mesaaleewoce bezu naacawe. yasawe leje nafesune (raasune) badaayenaa ya'alaahene tzagaawoce babezu yamikede (fethure) nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lejune 'esemaa'eelene 'enaa ya'esemaa'eelene 'enaate haajarene bamakaa shalaqowoce baasafaraacawe waqete beraahime yatanaagarawene 'asetaawese - <<geetaayee hoye! beetasaboceene yaasafarekubate yehene mareete (makaane) dame yamaayefasebate, 'anedeme sawe yamaayebadalebate yasalaame hagare 'aderegawe. 'eneenaa lejoceene kathaa`otaate 'amelaakinate 'areqane.>>

<<geetaayee hoye! 'enazihe thaa'o`otaate bezu sawocene kaqathetanyaawe manegade 'athememewaale bezuwocu (thaa`otaatu) 'enedamiyaamaaledu bamagamate bathaa`otocu tafatanu. ka'alaahe weche 'amalakwaacawe. 'alaahene babecanyenate bamaamelakenaa 'eresune bamataazaze laaye yatakatalanye ya'enee takataaye nawe. 'alaahene babecanyenate bamaamelakenaa la'eresu taazaazhe bamahone laaye yaaletakatalanye geetaayee hoye! 'aneta lafaqadekawe sawe lahathi'ate meherate yametesathenaa 'azaanye nahe.>>

geetaayee hoye! 'enee kafile zereyaawoceene ('esemaa'eelenaa lejocune) 'ereshaa ('aze`erete)naa weha baleelabate shalaqo wesethe (bamakaa) batakabarawe beetehe 'athagabe, babeetehe wesethe salaatene 'enedifatzemu 'aseqamechaacawaalahu. geetaayee hoye! yasawoce lebe 'enaresunenaa yehene mareete (hagare) 'enedinaafeqe 'aderege. basathahacawe tzagaa yamiyaamasagenu 'enedihonu fereewocene lagesaacawe.

geetaacene hoye! 'aneta yamenedabeqaweme geletze yamenaadaregaweneme taaweqaalahe. bamedereme hona basamaaye ka'alaahe yamisaware 'anedeme nagare yalame. 'alaahe huluneme yaaweqaale. felaagotaacenenaa wadaresu yaalane dehenate ka'alaahe 'ayesawareme.

mesegaanaanaa wedaasee kebere laresu yatagabaa lahonawe 'alaahe yehune laziyaa kamalekaame sawoce yahona (leje) 'enedisathanye yaasamaahutene tamaatzeno lataqabalanye bashemegelenaa zamanee kahaajare 'esemaa'eelene, kasaaraa sehaqene lasathanye. geetaayee wada 'eresu tamaatzeno yamiyaasamaa sawe therine yesamaale.

geetaayee hoye! salaateene batamwalaa huneetaa yamefatzeme 'adereganye. zereyaawoceeme salaataacawene batamwalaa huneetaa yamifatzeme 'aderegaacawe. tamaatzenoyeene taqabalanye. 'aneta zanede qebulenate yaalawe 'aderegawe.

geetaayee hoye! lahathi'atee meheratene sethanye. yawalaajoceeneme hathi'ate maarelenye (beraahime ya'alaahe salaame baresu laaye yehune) yehene yatanaagarawe 'abaatu ya'alaahe thalaate mahonune kamaawaqu bafite nabare. yehe gudaaye geletze sihonelatenaa 'abaatu ya'alaahe thalaate mahonune siyaaweqe raasune ka'abaatu 'areqwaale yasawe lejoce batenesaa'ee `elate baszeraacawe simaramaru bageetaacawe fite bamiqomubate `elate la'amaanyoce hathi'ate meheratene sethe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe yabadalocene qethaate siyaazagayawe badalanyoce bamaasetabaabalenaa ya'alaahe manegade bamazegaate 'enedihume laleeloceme mathefo tagebaaraate yamifatzemutene deregite 'alaahe 'enedazanagaa 'ataasebe. 'alaahe deregitaacawene yaaweqaale. katagebaaraacawe karesu yamidabaqe 'anedeme nagare yalame. qethaataacawene yamiyaazagayawe `aayenoce bamimalakatute 'asedanegaache te`eyenete baferehaate wada laaye yamiyaanegaathethubate yatenesaa'ee `elate nawe.

yasawe lejoce kamaqaaberaacawe tanasetawe wada thaariyaacawe bafethenate sinagudu raasaacawene kafe 'aderegawe batasefaa maqurathe wada samaaye yemalakataalu. bamimalakatute 'asedanegaache ('asefari) te`eyenete laayenocaacawe (badenegaathee) 'enedafathatha yeqaraale; kaafathathabate 'ayenaqalame. bate`eyenetu denegaathee lebonaacawe maasetawaale yatasaanawe maganezabe yamaayecele baado yehonaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! batenesaa'ee `elate (kamikasatawe) ya'alaahe qethaate hhezebocene 'asethaneqeqe. baziyaane `elate (gizee) 'alaahene bamakaadenaa ba'eresu laaye ya'amelekote tagaari bamaaderage nafesocaacawene yabadalu sawoce 'enedihe yelaalu - <<geetaacene hoye! theqite gizeene sethane; qethaatene 'azageyelene; wada mederaawi heyewate lateneshe gizee malesane; ba'aneta 'enaamenaalane. wada 'enyaa yalaakaacawene male'eketanyoce 'enekatalaalene.>> bawaqasaa malese yesathaacawaale. <<bamederaawi hheyewate kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase manorune bamakaade kaqerebitu `aalame wada macharashaa `aalame 'enedamaateshagaagaru setemelu 'alenabaramene?!>>

ba'alaahe bamakaade badalanyaa yahonu ka'enaaneta bafite yaqadamu teweledoce (lamesaalee yahudenaa yaswalihe hhezeboce) yamanoriyaa seferaawocene safaraacehu. banaresu laaye yafatzamenawe yaqethaate thefaate geletze honalaacehu. ba'alaahe matsehhafe wesethe gesaatzeene 'enedetewasedu mesaaleewoce 'aseqamathenelaacehu. nagare gene gesaatzeewocene 'alewasadaacehume.

badalanyaa bahonu teweledoce yamanoriyaa seferaawoce (manedaroce) yasafaru 'enazihe sawoce rasulene lamagedalenaa theriyaacawene lamaathefaate seeraacawene thanasasu. 'alaahe seeraacawene yaaweqaale. kaszeraacawe qenethaate karesu yamisawarebate nagare yalame. ya'enaresu seeraa dakaamaa nawe. dakaamaa bamahonume taraarocene kabotaacawe maanesaate 'ayeceleme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! dele 'enedamisathaacawenenaa 'emenataacawene yabalaaye 'enedamiyaadaregawe lamale'eketanyocu qaale kidaane yasathawe 'alaahe yasathaacawene qaale kidaane yaafaresaale belahe bafetzume 'ataasebe. 'alaahe maaneme dele yamaayesaanawe 'ashanaafi nawe. lawadaajocu 'ashanaafinate yesathaale. thalaatocunenaa yaresu male'eketanyocene thalaatoce beretu tabaqaaye nawe.

yehe bakahadiyaane laaye yamifatzamawe beqalaa mareete baleelaa netzuhe mareete bamiqayarebate, samaayaate baleeloce samaayaate bamilawathubate, sawoce ba'akaalaacawenaa baszeraawocaacawe negeszenaanaa taalaaqenate laresu becaa bahonawenaa ba'ashanaafiwe 'alaahe fite lamaqome kamaqaaberaacawe bamiwathubate yatenesaa'ee `elate yekasataale; (yefatzamaale). 'alaahe 'ashanaafi yamaayeshanafe geetaa nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! mareete baleelaa mareete samaayaatenaa baleelaa samaayaate bamilawethubate `elate 'agaariyaane kafilu wada kafilu tasaaserawe temalakataalahe. 'ejocaacawenaa 'egerocaacawe basanesalate yethafaraalu.
ka"qetheraane" (kareenejenaa kafetanyaa taqathaathaaye nethera nagare) yatasaraa lebese yelabesaalu. yachafagaga fitaacawene 'esaate yeshafenawaale.
'alaahe huluneme nafese baszaraacewe malekaamenaa mathefo szeraa yemanadaale. 'alaahe yaszeraawoce meremaraa laaye fathaane nawe.

bamuhhamade laaye yawaradawe yehe qure'aane bawesethu kayaazawe maasefaraariyaanaa yaberetu qethaate qatharo 'enedithanaqaqu; ba'ewenate 'amelekote yamigabaawe 'amelaake 'alaahe becaa mahonune 'enediyaawequ 'enedihume 'eresune 'enediyaamalekunaa ba'eresu laaye 'anedeneme ya'amelekote tagaari 'enedaayaadaregu, yanetzuhe 'a`emero baalabeetoce tathaqaamiwoce selahonu gesaatzeenaa temeherete 'enediwasedubate lasawoce yatanagara 'awaaje nawe.

(lr) 'alife, laame, rwa (yehene selamasalu yaqure'aane 'aneqatzoce babaqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye galatzaa tasathetwale) 'enazihe 'aneqatzoce yalaaqa kebere yaalaacawenaa ka'alaahe zanede maweradaacawene yamithaqumu, 'enedihume 'amelekote babecanyenate la'alaahe becaa tagabi mahonunenaa hegegaatocene yamigaletzu yaqure'aane 'aneqatzoce naacawe.
batenesaa'ee `elate kahadiyaane gudaayu sigabaacawenaa bamederaawi heyewate yanabarubate kehedate hhasate 'enedanabara sigalatzelaacawe menawe muselime honane banabare belawe yemanyaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'asetabaabaayoce 'enesesaate (kabetoce) 'enedamimagabute 'enedibalu tawaacawe. 'achere 'alaaqi bahonacewe yaduneyaa tzagaa yefanethezu. ruqe menyote kamaanenaa kamalekaame szeraawoce baatalee yaadaregaacawe. batenesaa'ee `elate ba'alaahe fite siqarebu yamiganyubatene (yanabarutene) keserate yaaweqaalu.
ba'alaahe `eweqate yatawasana wadafiteme wada xwaalaame yamaayele yagizee wasane yaalawe bihone 'eneji badalanyaa kahonu katamoce makaakale thefaate yaawaradenebate 'anedeme katamaa yalame.

maanenyaaweme hhezebe yaqethaate qatharwacawe saayedarese thefaate 'ayedaresebaacawe. 'enedazihume yathefaate qatharwacaweme sidarese 'ayezagayeme. selahoname badalanyoce 'alaahe bamisathaacawe gizee litaalalu 'ayegabaame.
yamakaa kahadiyaane lamale'eketanyaawe 'enedihe 'alu - <<ba'aneta laaye gesaatzee ('enedametemogetawe) yawaradalehe sawe hoye! bazihe theri 'ebede nahe. ya'ebedocene tagebaare taakanaawenaalahe.
baregethe ka'alwahe lekohe kahoneenaa 'ewenatanyaa kahoneke 'enedihume qethaate 'enedamiwaredebene yamimasakerulehene maalaa'eketocene lamene 'ataamathaame?

malaa'eketoce 'enedimathu selasanazarute theyaaqee 'alaahe malese sisathaacawe 'enedihe 'ala - <<baqethaate yamathefiyaacehu gizee sidaresenaa bamiyaasefalegu mekeneyaataawi huneetaawoce 'eneji malaa'eketocene 'anaawaredeme. malaa'eketocu waredawe (mathetawe) 'emenatene kaaletaqabalu faataa (gizee) yamisathaacawe 'ayehonume. yelequnese bafethenate qethaate yefatzamebaacawaale.

yehene qure'aane lasawoce magalachaa 'enedihone bamuhhamade laaye yaawaradenawe 'enyaawe nane; meneme `aayenate machamarenaa maqanase, malawathenaa mazaabaate bafetzume 'enedaayekasatebate yehene qure'aane yamenethabeqaweme 'enyaawe nane.>>
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'aneta bafite wada kehedate budenoce male'eketanyaacenene lekane hhasatanyoce belawaacawaale. hhezebocu hhasatanyaa yaalute yamajamariyaa male'eketanyaa 'ayedalahe.
yaqadamu yakehedate budenoce yamathaalaacawene male'eketanyaa yalame hhasatanyaa nahe saayelutenaa saayaafeezubate 'ayeqareme.

ba'enaziyaa hhezeboce lebonaa wesethe maasetabaabalene 'enedaasegabaanawe, bageterenataacawenaa fitaacawene bamaazoraacawe mekeneyaate bamakaa thaa`otaawiyaane lebonaa wesetheme 'asetabaabaayenatene 'enaasegabaalane.

bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye bawaradawe bazihe qure'aane 'ayaamenume. male'eketanyocaacawe yaamathutene male'ekete hhasatanyaa yaalu hhezebocene yamaathefaate ya'alaahe qwaami hege kazihe bafite tafatzemwale 'anetane hhasatanyaa yaaluhe sawoce kazihe temeherete (gesaatzeene) yewesadu.
'enazihe 'asetabaabaayoce bageletze maaserajaawoce 'ewenate bigalatzelaacaweme yasamaayaate baraafocene benekafetelaacawenaa wada laaye biwathu 'enekwaa chefene geteroce naacawe.
'ewenate nawe belawe 'ayaamenume. yelequneme 'enedihe yelaalu - <<`aayenocaacene ka`eyetaa tagaaredo nawe; yehe yamenemalakatawe yadegemete tatze`eno nawe. degemete yatadaragabene sawoce nane.>>
bayabesenaa babaahere chalamaa guzwacawe laaye yemarubate zanede basamaayaate laaye gezufe kawaakebetocene 'adaragene. ya'alaahene celotaa 'enedimalakatubateme latamalekaacoce webe 'adaragenawe.
ka'alaahe 'ezenate katabaarara shayethwane hulu samaayene thabeqanawaale.
kalaaye yasamaaye nawaariwocene (baalamwalocene) basereqote yamisamaawene gene berehaanaamaa tawarewaari 'esaate yekatalawaale yaaqaathelawaale.

mederene sawoce taragaagetawe 'enedinorubaate zaragaanaate. basawoce laaye 'enedaatewaaleleme bareswa laaye tzenu taraarocene 'adaragene. yatamathanunaa yatawasanu ya'aze`erete (yatakele) `aayenatocene 'eneda 'asefalaaginataacawe bamareete laaye 'abaqalene.

yasawe lejoce hoye! bamederaawi `aalame 'esekameteqoyubate gizee derase lamanore yamiyaasefalegaacehune megebe, weha (yamasaasalutene nagaroce) bamareete laaye 'adaragenelaacehu. ka'enaaneta wechi lamiganyunaa 'enaaneta lamaatemagebwacawe fetherataate heyewataacawene yamiqathelubatene 'adaragenelaacawe.

sawoceme hona maanenyaawume nafese yaalawe nagare yamothaqamebeetene hulu maaseganyate 'enaa sawoce 'enedethaqamubate maaderage 'enecelaalane. yaminaaseganyawene nagare dagemo bamenefalegawenaa bamiyaasefalegawe leke 'enaaseganyaalane.

nefaasene damanaane tashakaami 'aderegane laakenawe. nafaase katashakamawe damanaa wehane 'awaradene. yazenaabe wehane 'athathaanaacehu. sawoce hoye! bamareete laaye 'enaaneta yaweha menechocene yametaakamaacu 'ayedalaacehume. yehene yamiyaadaregawe 'alaahe nawe.

'enyaa mutaanene heyaawe 'enaadaregaacawaalane. kaala manore bamaaseganyatenaa gizeeyaacawe sidarese kamote baxwaalaa bamaqaseqase heyaawaanene wada mote 'enewasedaacawaalane. mareetene 'enaa bareswa laaye miganyutene hulu yamenewarese qariwoce 'enyaa becaa nane.
ka'enaaneta makaakale qademo yamiwasedawene (yatawaladawene), qademo yamimotawene (yamotawene),wadaxwaalaa yazagayaweneme 'enaaweqaalane. kazihe wesethe ka'enyaa yamisaware 'anedeme nagare yalame.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe malekaame yaszaraawene bamalekaame szeraawe, mathefo yaszaraawene bamathefo szeraawe limanadaa batenesaa'ee `elate huluneme yesabasebaacawaale. 'eresu geetaahe ('alaahe) bamaasetanaabaru thebabanyaa nawe; meneme yamaayesawarebate `aawaaqi nawe.
sinakaa demetze kamiyaawathaa daraqe cheqaa 'adamene fatharenawe. 'adame yatafatharabate yehe cheqaa thequrenaa rajeme gizee bamaqoyatu tharanu yataqayara nabare.
'adame kamafatharu 'aseqademo ya'agaanetocene 'abaate thanekaaraa nedaade (gelate) kaalawe 'esaate fatharenawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe lamalaa'eketanyocenaa labelise (ka'enaresu gaare nabare) sinakaa demetze kamiyaasamaa daraqe, thequre, tharanu yataqayara cheqaa yasawe lejene 'efatheraalahu belo banagaraacawe gizee yahonawene 'asetaawese.
qeretzune kaasetakaakalekunaa 'afathaatharune saamwalaa (saathanaaqeqe) ya'eneene te`ezaaze lamafatzamenaa laresu yakebere salaametaa lamasethate segadulate. (sujude 'aderegulate.)
malaa'eketoce te`ezaazune fatza. 'alaahe 'enedaazazaacaweme hulume "sujude" waradu.
nagare gene belise (kanaresu baayehoneme, yanaresu 'amesaayaa) baayehoneme kamalaa'eketoce gaare nabare kamalaa'eketoce gaare la'adame sujude lamaaderage 'emebitanyaa hona.

la'adame "sujude" lamaaderage 'emebitanyaa kahona baxwaalaa 'alaahe labelise 'enedihe 'ala - <<te`ezaazeene lamafatzame kasagadute mala'eketoce gaare 'aberahe 'enedaatesagede yakalakalahe menedenawe?!>>
belise bakuraate 'enedihe 'ala - <<kadaraqe, thequrenaa, tharanu kataqayara cheqaa lafatharekawe sawe sujude maaderage la'enee tagabi 'ayedalame.>>
'alaahe belisene 'enedihe 'alawe - <<kajanate wethaa; 'aneta kaziyaa yatabaarareke nahe.
'eseka tenesaa'ee `elate 'eregemaane 'enaa ka'enee 'ezenate mabaarere ba'aneta laaye yehonaale.>>
belise 'enedihe 'ala - <<geetaayee hoye! 'aqoyanye; fetherataate 'esekamiqasaqasubate `elate derase motene 'ataamethaabenye.>>
'alaahe 'enedihe 'alawe - <<'aneta yamote fetzaameeyaacawe 'enedizagaye katadaragalaacawe nahe.
fetherataate hulu bamajamariyaawe theri 'esekamimotubate `elate derase.>>

belise 'enedihe 'ala - <<geetaayee hoye! 'enedethameme selaadarakanye bamederaawi heyewate hathi'atene malekaame 'asemaselaacawaalahu; huluneme kaqathetanyaawe fenotehe (manegadehe) 'athamemaacawaalahu.
ka'agalegaayocehe 'anetane 'enediyaamaleku yamarathekelaacawe baariyaawocehe siqaru.>>
'alaahe 'enedihe 'ala - <<yehe manegadee wada 'enee yamiyaadarese qanaa nawe.
qathetanyaawene manegade yasaatu 'anetane yatakataluhe sawocene becaa 'eneji netzuhe 'agalegaayoceene lamaathemame xaayeleme selethaaneme yalaheme.>>
jahaname labelisenaa 'eresune latakatalu yathemate manegade sawoce bamulu qatharo'acawe nawe.
jahaname sabaate magebiyaawoce 'alute; banaziyaa wada jahaname yegabaalu 'eyaanedaanedu yajahaname magebiyaa yataawaqa mathane yabelise takataayoce yegabubataale.
yaazazaacawene bamafatzamenaa kakalakalaacawe bamaqothabe 'alaahene yamifaru sawoce bajanatenaa bamenechocwa wesethe yehonaalu.
wada janate bamigabubate waqete 'enedihe yebaalaalu - <<kacegerenaa kathefaatenaa kaferehaate salaame honaacehu (wada janate) gebu.
balebonaawocaacawe wesethe yamiganyawene qenaatenaa yamathalaatene semeete 'asewagedane ba'alegaa laaye taqamethawe kafilocu kafilune yamimalakatu yamiwaadadu wanedemaamaacece 'adaragenaacawe.
bajanate wesethe dekaame 'ayaaganyaacaweme ('ayenakaacaweme). kaziyaame 'ayewathume. baziyaa wesethe lazala`aalame yeqoyaalu.>>
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enee batzatzate wada 'enee latamalasa 'agalegaayee meheratene yamesathenaa 'azaanye mahoneene labaariyaawocee negaraacawe.
('enedihume) qethaatee 'asaamaami qethaate 'enedahona negaraacawe. meherateene 'enediyaaganyu wada 'enee batzatzate yemalasu. kaqethaatee madehenene yaaganyaalu.
yaleje beseraatene lisathutenaa yaluthe hhezeboce 'enedamithafu linagerute selamathute yaberaahime malaa'ekete 'enegedoce tarekelaacawe.

(malaa'eketocu) baresu laaye sigabu "salaame" 'alute. kasathute salaametaa yatashaala malese sathaacawe. 'enedimagabu yatathabasa yathejaa segaa 'aqarabalaacawe. sawoce 'enedahonu gameto nabare. yaaqarabawene megebe 'enedamaayemagabu simalakate <<'enyaa faretanaacawaale>> sile tanaagara.
malaa'eketocu 'enedihe 'alute:: <<'ateferaa; yamiyaasedasetehene (beseraate) 'enenagerehalane; `eweqate yaalawe wanede leje yenorehaale.>>

leje 'enedaminorawe banagarute beseraate bamadanaqe beraahime 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<kadarasabenye kazihe 'erejenaanaa ya`edemee magefaate gaare leje 'enedamaaganye nagaraacehunye; beseraataacehume mene maleke (gatzetaa) yaalawe nawe?!>>
kamalaa'eketocu 'anedanyaawe male'eketanyaa laberaahime 'enedihe 'alu - <<ba'ewenate meneme therethere yaleelawe beseraatene nageranehaale. banagarenehe beseraate katasefaa qoraachoce 'atehune.>>
beraahime 'enedihe 'ala - <<kageetaawe (ka'alaahe) 'ezenate kaqathetanyaawe manegade yathamamu sawoce 'eneji leelaa tasefaa yamiqorethe 'alane?!>>
beraahime 'enedihe 'ala - <<'enaaneta (yamalaa'ekete) male'eketanyoce hoye! ka'alaahe yatalaakaacehubate mekeneyaate menedenawe!?>>
kamalaa'ekete male'eketanyoce 'anedanyaawe 'enedihe 'ala:- <<bathaame beleshu, bathaame kefu yahonu hhezebocene (yaluthe hhezebocene) 'enedenaathafaa 'alaahe lekone nawe.
yaluthe beetasabocenaa yaresu 'amaanye takataayoce siqaru 'enaresune thefaate 'ayaaganyaacaweme. huluneme salaame 'enaawathaacawaalane.
yaluthe misete seteqare. 'ereswa thefaatu kamiyaaganyaacawe qariwoce naate.>>
wada luthe hhezeboce yatalaakute yamalaa'ekete male'eketanyoce bawanedoce gatzetaa simathu.
luthe <<yamaatetaawaqu sawoce naacehu.>> 'alaacawe.
kamalaa'eketocu 'anedanyaawe laluthe 'enedihe 'ala:- <<luthe hoye! 'ateferaa; yelequneme hhezebocehene bamitharaatharute yamathefiyaacawe qethaate wada 'aneta mathetanaale.
feeze baleelabate 'ewenate wada 'aneta mathetanaale. banagarenehe nagare 'ewenatanyoce nane.

yalalitu kafile kefele siyaalefe beetasabocehene yezahe tagwaaze; kaxwaalaacawe hunahe hide. yahonawene lamamalekate 'anedaacehume wada xwaalaa 'enedaayemalakate. 'alaahe 'enedeteheedu wadaazazaacehu seferaa tagwaazu.>>
yawasanenawene te`ezaaze bamalakotaawi male'ekete laluthe 'asaawaqenawe. male'eketu gohe siqade hhezebocu kasere masarataacawe tamanegelawe 'eseka macharashaawe yethafaalu yamile nabare.
ya"sadome" nawaariwoce tzayaafe tagebaare lamafatzame bamamanyate baluthe 'enegedoce mamethaate 'eyafanathazu mathu.
luthe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<'enazihe sawoce 'enegedoce naacawe; banaresu laaye mafatsame bametefalegute deregite 'ataagaalethunye.
yehene tzayaafe deregite bamatawe 'alaahene feru. ba'asenawaari deregitaacehu 'ataawaaredunye.>>
hhezebocu 'enedihe 'alute - <<'anedeme 'enegedaa 'enedaateqabale 'alekalakaleneme nabarene!?>>

luthe ba'enegedocu fite lanafesu mekeneyaate lamasethate lahhezebocu 'enedihe 'ala - <<'enazihe seetoce lejocee naacawe; tzotaawi felaagotaacehune lamafatzame yametefalegu kahona batedaare wesadwacawe.>>
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! baheyewatehe 'emelaalahu yaluthe hhezeboce wasane baalafa seeranyenataacawe wesethe yewaazheqaalu.
tzahhaye kameseraaqe yametewathaabate yanegaate waqete sidarese yamiyaathafu beretu demetze yaazaacawe.
yalaayenyaawe wadataace bamazaqezaqe manedaraacawene galabathenawe; yadaraqe cheqaa denegaaye 'azanabenebaacawe.
baluthe hhezeboce laaye batakasatawe bazihe batathaqasawe (taarike) wesethe selamiyaasewelu sawoce meleketoce yeganyaalu.
yaluthe hhezeboce manedare baqwaami manegade 'athagabe yamiganye nawe. baziyaa yamiyaalefe manegadanyaa hulu limalakatawe yecelaale.
batakasatawe baziyaa (taarike) wesethe 'amaanyoce gesaatzeene yamiwasedubaacawe yamithaqume nagaroce yeganyaalu.
yathamazemaazaa zaafoce manedare nawaariwoce yahonute yashu`ayebe hhezeboce ba'alaahe laaye kehedatene bamafatzamaacawenaa male'eketanyaawene shu`ayebe hhasate bamaalataacawe badalanyoce nabaru.

(bamathefo szeraacawenaa kehedataacawe mekeneyaate) tabaqalenaacawe. qethaate mathaabaacawe. yaluthenaa yashu`ayebe hhezeboce katamoce manedare baziyaa lamiyaalefu manegadanyoce bageletze yetaawaqaalu.

samudoce wada 'enaresu yatalaakawene nabiye swalihene hhasatanyaa silu huluneme male'eketanyoce 'asetabaabalu.samudoce (bahijaazenaa bamakaa makaakale yamiganye) "hhijere" yatasanya seferaa nawaariwoce nabaru.
ka'alaahe yezote bamathaawe male`ekete 'ewenatanyaa selamahonu meleketocenaa maaserajaawocene sathanaacawe. ba'enazihe maaserajaawoce gesaatzeene 'alewasadume. tekurateme 'alesathwacaweme.
taraaroce bamaborebare (bamasanethaqe) kamiyaasebwacawe (kamifarwacawe) nagaroce yamithalalubaacawe manoriyaawocene yeszaru nabare.
gohe siqade yaqethaate maqesafete waradabaacawe.
yaafarute habetenaa yaganabute manoriyaa ya'alaahene qethaate 'alekalakalaacaweme ('alemalasalaacaweme)

samaayaatenaa mederene 'enedihume banaresu makaakale yamiganyu nagarocene yaalaqume nagarenaa thebabe 'enedihu bahhasate 'alefatharenaacaweme. huluneme yafatharenawe ba'ewenate nawe. yatenesaa'ee `elate yemathaale; therethere yalaweme; 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! hhasatanyaa kamiluhe sawoce fitehene 'azure. malekaame yeqeretaane 'aderegelaacawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe yahulume nagare fathaarinaa sela hulume nagare `aawaaqi nawe.
sabaate 'aneqatzoce yaalwatene yamakefaciyaatune me`eraafe ("'alefaatihane") sathetanehale.

kathafi `aalamaawi yamederaawi heyewate mafanethazheyaawoce yatalayaayu mathaqamiyaawocene wada sathanaacawe kahadiyaane `aayenocehene 'atezaregaa. 'asetabaabaaye bamahonaacaweme 'atezane. la'amaanyoce raasehene zeqe 'aderege.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale <<'enee ka'alaahe qethaate 'asethaneqaaqi nanye.>>

ya'alaahene matsehhafe male'eketoce bakefeloce nathaathelawe kafilune yamiyaamenu, kafilune dagemo bamikedu sawoce laaye 'alaahe yaawaradawene (qethaate) `aayenatenaa 'amesaayaa 'enedaayaaganyaacehu 'asethanaqeqaacewaalahu.
'enazihe qure'aanene yatanathaathaala yaadaragutenaa yehe (qure'aane) degemete wayeme theneqolaa wayeneme getheme nawe bamaalate yatanaagarute.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bageetaahe 'emelaalaahu. batenesaa'ee `elate (yehene qure'aane) yakafaafalutene hulu 'enethayeqaacawaalane.
ba`aalamaawi heyewate selafatzamute (selaszarute) kehedatenaa hathi'ate 'enethayeqaacawaalane.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! wada 'eresu theri 'enedetaadarege 'alaahe yaazazahene yefaa 'aderege; 'agaariyaane selaminaagarutenaa selamifatzemute nagare tekurate 'atesethe.
fetzume 'ateferaacawe; kaqurayeshe yamiyaafeezu yakehedate mariwoce seeraa 'enyaa 'enebaqaahalane.
'enaziyaa ka'alaahe gaare leelaa ya'amelekote tagaarine yamiyaadaregu ya'amelekote tagaari maaderage mathefo szeraacawe fetzaameewe mene ('enedamimasele) yaaweqaalu.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! hhasatanyaa nahe bamaalataacawenaa ba'aneta laaye bamaafeezaacawe lebehe 'enedamichanaqe baregethe 'enaaweqaalane.

la'alaahe kebere masethatenaa bamulu baaheriyaatu bamaawadase wada 'eresu tathagaa; 'alaahene kamiyaamalekutenaa laresu kamisagedute hune. bazihe manegade yalebehe cheneqate yewagadaale (hekemenaa yaaganyaale).
'alaahene zawatere bamaamelake laaye tzenu hune. baheyewate 'esekaalahe derase baziyaawe laaye 'eyaalahe mote 'esekamimathaa ('alaahene bamaamelake laaye) tzenu honahe qathele.

kahadiyaane hoye! 'enaanetane lamaqethaate 'alaahe yaasaalafawe wesaanee qarebwale. kamafatzamiyaawe gizeewe bafite 'enedifathene 'atethayequ. thaa`otaawiyaane ya'amelekote tagaari kamiyaadaregubate gudaaye 'alaahe laaqa.

'alaahe 'eresu bafaqadawe male'eketanyaa laaye kawesaaneewocu bamalakotaawi male'ekete malaa'eketocene yaawaredaale. male'eketanyoce hoye! sawoce ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaarine 'enedaayaadaregu 'asethaneqequ; ba'ewenate 'amelekote yamigabaawe ka'enee basetaqare leelaa yalame. yasawe lejoce hoye! yaazazekutene bamafatzamenaa kakalakalekute bamaqothabe (bamaraaqe) 'eneene feru.

'alaahe samaayaatenaa mederene yaala qedema mesaalee ba'ewenate fatherwale. bahhasate (yaalaqume nagare) 'alefatharaacaweme. yelequneme yataalaaqenatu maaserajaa 'enedihonu fatherwacawaale. 'alaahe ba'eresu laaye kamiyaadaragubate ya'amelekote tagaari yalaaqa nawe.

yasawe leje katzayaafe (yafetewate) thabetaa tafatharwale. ka'anede yafetherate me`eraafe wada leelaa yafetherate me`eraafe siyaadege, 'ewenatene lamadamesase (lamaathefaate) bahasate beretunaa geletze takaraakaari hona.

yasawe lejoce hoye! 'alaahe yabeete 'enesesocene 'eneda gemale, laame, bagenaa feyale yaalutene yafatharawe la'enaaneta theqeme nawe. kathaqameetaawocaacawe makaakale kasufocaacawenaa katzagurocaacawe (bamisaru 'alebaasaate) muqatene taaganyaalaacehu watataacawenaa kaqodaacawe 'enedihume bajarebaawocaacawe laaye (bamagwaagwaaze) leelocene theqemocene taaganyaalaacehu. kanaresume (segaacaweneme) temagabaalaacehu.
bameshete wada (maarafiyaacawe) sigabunaa banegaate lagethoshe sisamaaru la'enaaneta webate nawe.

la'enaaneta yafatharenelaacehu 'enazihene 'enesesaatoce bakabaade 'asecagaari huneetaa kaalehona basetaqare letedaresubate wadamaatecelubate hagare setegwaazu kabaade gwaazaacehune yeshakamaalu. yasawe lejoce hoye! geetaacehu (fathaariyaacehu) 'enazihene 'enesesaatoce la'enaaneta yatagaru bamaaderagu ba'enaaneta laaye bathaame 'azaanye nawe.

'alaahe la'enaaneta 'enedetesaafarubaacawe; neberataacehuneme chenaacehu 'enedetaagwaaguzubaacawenaa basawoce mahale 'enedetewaabubaacawe farasene; baqelonenaa 'aheyaane fatharalaacehu. wadafite yamaataawequtene (yamagwaagwaazhaa zadeewocene) yefatheraale.

wada 'eresu wedeetaa yamiyaadaresawene qathetanyaawene manegade magalatzene 'alaahe baraasu laaye wasana. yehe manegade yaselaame manegade nawe. kamanegadoce makaakale ka'ewenate yaazanabalu yashayethwane manegadoce yeganyaalu. kaselaame manegade weche yamiganye maanenyaaweme manegade. (ka'ewenate) yaazanabala nawe. ya'emenatene sekeete lahulaacehume lamasethate 'alaahe bifaqede hulaacehume ya'emenate sekeetene taaganyu nabare.

kadamanaawoce wehane yamiyaawaredelaacehu 'alaahe nawe. kaziyaa 'enaanetanaa 'enesesocaacehu yametethathutene weha taaganyaalaacehu. 'enedazihume baziyaawe weha kabetocaacehune lagethoshe yametaasamaarubate takelocenaa zaafoce yebaqelaalu.

yametemagabwacawene sabeloce 'alaahe baziyaa weha yaabaqelaale. baziyaawe weha wayeraane yatamere zaafocenenaa wayenocene 'enedihume huluneme `aayenate fereewocene yaabaqelaale. baziyaa wehanaa kaziyaa weha 'alaahe kamiyaabaqelaacawe nagaroce wesethe sela 'alaahe fetherataate batheleqate lamiyaasetawelu sawoce ya'alaahene celotaa thaqwaami nagaroce ya'alaahene taalaaqenatenaa kagudelate yatharaa mahonune yeradaalu.

lalitene 'enedeteragaagubatenaa 'erafete 'enedetaadaregubate, qanune dagemo lanuro yamiyaasefalegaacehune nagaroce 'enedetefalegubate 'alaahe yatagaru 'adaragalaacehu. 'enedihume tzahhayene maberaate bamaaderage yatagaraace 'adaragalaacehu; charaqaaneme berehaanaamaa 'adaragaate. bawesaaneeyaawi te`ezaazu kawaakebetocene lanaaneta yatagaru 'adaragaacawe. babaaherenaa bayabese chalamaawoce bakewaakebetoce (manegadocene) temaraalaacehu. gizeeyaatene 'enaa leeloceneme nagaroce taaweqaalaacehu. 'enazihene hulu nagaroce yatagaru bamadaragaacawe wesethe 'a`emero'acawene lamiyaasaru (lamithaqamu) sawoce ya'alaahene celotaa (xaayaalenate) thaqaami maaserajaawoce bageletze yeganyaalu. yazihene thebabe yamiganazabuteme 'enaresuwe naacawe.

'alaahe bamedere yafatharaacawene yatalayaayu 'ayenate maa`edenaatene, 'enesesaatene, takelocene, sabelocene yatagaru 'adaragalaacehu. bazihe batathaqasawe fatharaanaa magaraate wesethe genezaabee lamiwasedu 'enaa 'alaahe caayenaa tzagaa sache mahonune lamiyaawequ sawoce ya'alaahene xaayaalenate yamithaqumu geletze maaserajaawoce yeganyaalu.

baaherene yatagaraa yaadaragalaacehu kagudelatoce hulu theraate yatagabaawe 'alaahe nawe. babaahere laaye 'enedetegwaazunaa (katheleqe baahere) wesethe yamiganyu nagarocene 'enedetaawathu 'enedazihume (kabaahere) kaathamadaacehute 'asaa laselaasaanaa thaafaache segaane 'enedetemagabu 'asecaalaacehu. lulene yamasalu 'enaaneta baalabeetocaacehu yametelabeswacawene geethaageethoce kabaahere wesethe taawathaalaacehu. marekabe yabaaherune maa`ebale 'eyasanathaqa sigwaaze temalakataalahe. banegede sekeete yamiganyawene ya'alaahene cerotaa lamafalage 'enazihene marekaboce tesaafaraalaacehu. ba'enaaneta laaye selafatzamawe tzagaa 'alaahene 'enedametaamasagenu 'enedazihume babecanyenate 'eresune becaa 'enedetaamaleku ('enazihe nagaroce yatagaru honulaacehu).

ba'enaaneta laaye 'enedaatewaalelenaa 'enedaatezanabale ('alaahe) bamareete laaye yamaathanaakariyaa taraaraawocene 'adaraga. wehane 'enedetethathu 'enedihume sabelocaacehunenaa 'enesesaatocaacehune weha 'enedetaathathu bamareete laaye wanezocene 'afasasa. manegade saatesetu wadafalagaacehute 'aqethaachaa lamaderase yamiyaasecelwacehune yametegwaazubaacawene manegadoce (bamareete laaye 'adaraga).
baqane berehaane guzo yamimaraacehune geletze meleketoce bamareete laaye 'adaragalaacehu. 'enedazihume balalite 'enedetemarubaacawe kawaakebetocene basamaaye laaye 'adaraga.

'enazihene 'enaa leeloce nagaroce (fetherataatene) yamifathere 'anedaaceme nagare 'enedamaayefathere nawene!? ('anedaaceneme nagare mafethare kamaayecele gaare 'ekule nawene!?) yahulu nagare fathaari yahonawe 'alaahene taalaaqenate 'ateganazabumene!? babecanyenate 'eresune becaa bamaamelakenaa 'enedaaceme nagare mafethare yamaayecele ('akaale) ba'eresu laaye ya'amelekote tagaari kamaaderage 'ateqothabumene?!

yasawe lejoce hoye! 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye yafatzamaacawene bezu tzagaawoce lamaquthare betemokeru 'ejege bezunaa bezu `aayenate kamahonaacawe 'anetzaare yamicaalaacehu 'ayehoneme ('ateceluteme). 'alaahe (lalagasaacehu tzagaawoce) mesegaanaa kamaaqerabe bamazanegaataacehu baalamayaazu mahhari nawe. 'enedazihume 'enedamigabaawe mesegaanaa yaala maaqerabe gudelataacehunaa bahathi'ataacehu mekeneyaate (tzagaawocune) ba'enaaneta laaye baalamaaqwaarathu 'azaanye nawe.

yasawe lejoce hoye! 'alaahe yametedabeqwaacawene szeraawoce yaaweqaale. bayefaa yameteszarwacawene szeraawoceneme yaaweqaale. karesu yamisawarebate 'anedaaceme nagare yalame. yaszeraacehuneme waagaa yesathaacawaale.

thaa`otaawiyaane ('agaariyaane) ka'alaahe wechi yamiyaamalekwaacawe nagaroce theqite 'enekwaa bihone 'enedaaceme nagare 'ayefatherume; yamiyaamalekwaacawe raasaacawe yamiszarwacawe 'akaaloce naacawe. bagazaa 'ejocaacawe yaszarwacawene thaa`otaatene 'enedeete 'aderegawe ka'alaahe weche yamiyaamalekwaacawe?!
ba'amaalaakiwocaacawe yataszaru kamahonaacawe gaare heyewate 'alebaa ge'uzoce naacawe. ka'amaalaakiwocaacawe gaare batenesaa'ee `elate ba'esaate wesethe limaagadu mace 'enedamiqasaqasu 'ayaawequme.

'ewenatanyaa 'amelaakaacehu tagaari yaleelawe 'anede 'amelaake nawe. 'eresume 'alaahe nawe sawoce yaszeraacawene waagaa 'enediyaaganyu kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasaacawene yamaayaamenu sawoce lebonaawocaacawe ('alaahene) yamaayefaraa ya'alaahene 'anedenate yakaada nawe. (kamote baxwaalaa) yaszeraa meremaraanaa qethaate 'enedaala 'ayaamenume 'ewenatene yamaayeqabalu (la'ewenate) yamaayenebarakaku kuraatanyoce naacawe.

'enazihe sawoce badebeqe yamifatzemwacawene szeraawoce 'enaa bayefaa yamitagaberuteneme 'alaahe ba'ewenate yaaweqaale. ka'eresu yamisawarebate 'anedeme nagare yalame. baszeraacaweme yemanadaacawaale. 'alaahe 'eresune kamaamelakenaa la'eresu kamanebarekake bakuraate yamizorutene 'ayewademe. yelequneme 'ejege bathaame yethalaacawaale.

ya'alaahene (yafathaarine becanyaa tamalaakinate) yamikedunaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase hhasate nawe yamilu sawoce 'alaahe bamuhhamade laaye yaawaradawe menedenawe?! yamile theyaaqee siqarebebaacawe <<('alaahe) ba'eresu (bamuhhamade) laaye meneme 'alaawaradame; yezote yamathaawe yathenete teweledoce taarikenaa 'afa taarikaacawene nawe.>> bamaalate malese yesathaalu.

hathi'ataacawe saayegwaadale 'enedihume bamaayemenataacawenaa bachefene takataayocaacawe kaselaame yaathamamwacawene sawoce hathi'ate mashakame fetzaameeyaacawe yehonaale. yamishakamute yaraasaacawenaa yatakataayocaacawe hathi'ate tzayaafenate mene yaahele yabarataa nawe?! (bathaame yabarataa nawe).

ka'enazihe bafite kahadiyaane bamale'eketanyocaacawe laaye seeraawocene thanesesawaale. 'alaahe beetocaacawene kamaszaratu 'afarasawe. balaayaacawe laaye yabeetocaacawe thaariyaa wadaqabaacawe. kamaayegametute 'aqethaachaa ya'alaahe qethaate mathaabaacawe. yaganabute beete 'enedamikalaakalelaacawe yegametu nabare. mathefiyaacawe baziyaa hona.

kaziyaame batenesaa'ee `elate 'alaahe baqethaate weredatene yaalabesaacawaale. 'enediheme yelaacawaale <<ka'enee gaare ba'amelekote tagaari setaadaregwaacawe yanabarute tagaariwocee yate 'alu?! ba'enaresu mekeneyaate nabiyaatoceenenaa 'amaanyocene bathalaatenate tefareju nabare>> yathalaqa 'eweqatenaa malekaame szeraawocene 'athaamerawe yayaazu ya`eweqate sawoce 'enedihe tanaagaru <<batenesaa'ee 'elate weredatenaa qethaate bakahadiyaane laaye tafatzaami nawe.>>

'enaziyaa 'alaahene bamakaadenaa nafesocaacawene bamabadale yatazafaqu kahadiyaane yamote malaa'eketenaa ya'eresu radaate malaa'eketoce nafesocaacawene bamiyaawathubate gizee, mote ba'enaresu laaye siwarede 'eje sathetawe taazaazhoce yehonaalu. kehedate yamithaqemaacawe mahonune bamaasabe yanabarubatene kehedatenaa hathi'ate yekedaalu. 'enedihe yebaalaalu - <<hhasate tanaagaraacehu. hathi'atocene yametefatzemu kahadiyaane nabaraacehu. bamederaawi heyewate tefatzemu yanabarawene 'alaahe yaaweqaale. ka'eresu yamisawarebate qenethaate nagare yalame. baszeraacehume yemanadaacexwaale.>>

'enediheme yebaalaalu:- <<baziyaa lazala`aalame bameteqoyubate jahaname ('esaate) 'enedaszeraawocaacehu gebu>>; ba'alaahe kamaamanenaa 'eresune becaa kamaamelake kuraatanyaa yahonu sawoce yamacharashaa maarafiyaa bathaame yakafaa nawe.

('alaahe) yaazazaacawene bamafatzamenaa kakalakalaacawe bamaqothabe geetaacawene sifaru lanabaru sawoce 'enedihe yebaalaalu - <<banabiyaacehu muhhamade laaye geetaacehu yaawaradawe menedenawe?!>>; <<'ejege teleqe malekaamene nagare 'aweredwale.>> bamaalate malese yesathaalu. 'alaahene bamalekaame huneetaa yaamalakunaa kasawoce gaare yaalaacawene genenyunate yaasaamaru (sawoce) bazihu mederaawi `aalame safi sisaayenaa delene yamasaasalutene (malekaame menedaawocene) yaaganyaalu. ba`aalamaawi heyewate 'alaahe 'aseqademo bafethenate kasathaacawe menedaa bamacharashaawe `aalame yaazagaajalaacawe menedaa yatashaala nawe. yaazazawene bamafatzamenaa kakalakalawe bamaqothabe geetaacawene yamithanaqaqu sawoce hagare janate mene yaahele (bathaame) yaamaara nawe.

yamigabubaate yamanoriyaanaa yamaarafiyaa janate kazaafocwanaa kahenetzaawocwa sere wanezoce yefasaalu. bazihece janate wesethe nafesocaacawe (yamimanyawene) yamifalegawene hulu yaaganyaalu. kamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) hhezeboce 'alaahene yafaru sawoce yamiyaaganyutene yehene yamasala menedaa 'amesaayaa kaqadamu hhezeboce 'alaahene yefaru yanabaru sawoceneme yemanadaacawaale.

yamote malaa'eketenaa radaatocu 'alaahene yamifaru sawocene nafese siyaawathu lebocaacawe kakehedate netzuhe bahona huneetaa laaye nawe. malaa'eketoce 'enedihe yaanaagerwacawaale <<salaame ba'enaaneta laaye yehune; kahulume thefaate denaacexwaale. bamederaawi heyewate banabaraacehu tekekelanyaa 'emenatenaa baszaraacehute malekaame szeraa janate gebu.>>

'enaziyaa thaa`otaawiyaanenaa 'asetabaabaayoce yamithabequte yamote malaa'eketenaa radaatocu fitocaacawenaa jarebaawocaacawene 'esekimatwacawenaa nafesaacawene lamaawethaate 'esekimathu derase nawene wayenese bamederaawi heyewate baqethaate kasere maszarataacawe yamithafubate ya'alaahe wesaanee 'esekimathaa nawe yamithabequte?! bamakaa yamiganyu thaa`otaawiyaane yamifatzemute `aayenate tagebaare kanaresu bafite yanabarute qadamete thaa`otaawiyaane yefatzemute nabare. baziheme `aalame 'athefetwacawaale 'alaahe siyaathafaacawe 'alebadalaacaweme. nagare gene 'enaresu ba'alaahe laaye kehedatene bamafatzame raasaacawene bathefaate 'azaqete wesethe bamawareware nafesocaacawene badalu.
yefatzemu banabarawe szeraa qethaate waradabaacawe. sigasatzubate yaafeezubate yanabarawe qethaate kahulume 'aqethaachaa kababaacawe.

ba'alaahe laaye ka'eresu weche yamiganyu 'akaalaatene ba'amelekwaa'acawe wesethe tagaari yaadaragu (sawoce) 'enedazihe tanaagaru - <<'alaahe 'eresune becaa 'enedenaamalekenaa ba'eresu laaye 'enedaaceme tagaari 'enedaanaadarege yaresu feqaade bihone 'enyaame hona ka'enyaa bafite yanabarute 'abaatocaacene ka'eresu weche 'anedeme nagare 'anaamalekeme nabare. 'anedeneme nagare yatakalakala ('ereme) 'enedaanaadarege yaresu faqaade bihone yatakalakala 'anaadaregaweme nabare.>> yehene yamasalu hasatanyaa makaraakariyaawocene yaqadamu kahadiyaaneme tanaagerawaale. kamale'eketanyocu yamithabaqawe (xaalaafinate) 'enediyaadaresu yataazazutene male`ekete geletze bahona manegade maaderase becaa nawe. ba'eregetheme 'aderesawaale. 'alaahe (baraase yamawasane) felaagotenaa merechaa kaadaragalaacawe 'enaa wada 'enaresu male'eketanyocene kalaaka baxwaalaa kahadiyaane "baqadare" (ya'alaahe feqaade wesaanee) makaraakariyaa mekeneyaate yalaacaweme.

hhezebocu 'alaahene babecanyenate 'enediyaamalekunaa ka'alaahe weche yamiganyu thaa`otaatene, shayethwanocenenaa leeloce nagarocene kamaamelake 'enediqothabu yamiyaaze male'eketanyaane wada 'eyaanedaadu yaqadamu teweledoce lekanaale. (ka'enaziyaa teweledoce) makaakale 'alaahe sekeetene yasathawenaa 'emenatene yataqabala male'eketanyaawe yezote yamathaawene yatakatala yeganyaale. ('enedazihume kanaziyaa teweledoce) makaakale 'alaahene yakaadanaa male'eketanyaawene yaamatzu 'alaahe sekeetene yanafagawenaa themate yatatzaafabate yeganyaale. hasatanyoce qethaatenaa thefaate kadarasabaacawe baxwaalaa yahonawene macharashaacawene ba`aayenaacehu lamamalekate bamedere laaye tagwaazu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enazihe theri lamaaderage 'aqemehe bafaqadawe meneme yaahele therate betaadaregenaa qathetanyaawene manegade 'enedimaru gugute binorehe lazihe 'asefalaagi mekeneyaataawi nagarocene betefatzeme 'alaahe yaathamamawene sawe qathetanyaawene manegade yamamaraate sekeetene 'ayesatheme ka'alaahe weche qethaatene lamakalaakale yamiradaacawe 'anedeme yalame (yalaacaweme).

kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase hhasate nawe yaalu sawoce 'athanekerawe 'aragaagethawe <<'alaahe yamotane sawe 'ayeqasaqeseme>> bamaalate mahalaane fatzamu. bazihe laaye maaserajaa saayenoraacawe yelequneme mutaanene hulu 'alaahe yeqasaqesaale. yehene yamaaderage ba'eresu laaye 'ewenatanyaa qatharo 'ala. nagare gene bezu sawoce 'alaahe mutaanene 'enedamiqasaqese 'ayaawequme kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase manorune yeqaawamaalu (yekedaalu).

sela "tawehide" ('amelekote la'alaahe becaa yamigabaawe sela mahonu) kamote baxwaalaa selamaqaseqasenaa sela nabiyenate 'ewenataawene ligaletzelaacawe batenesaa'eewe 'elate 'alaahe huluneme yeqasaqesaacawaale.

mutaanene heyaawe maaderagenaa maqaseqase kafalagene yehene maaderage (yamikalakelane) nagare yalame. 'anedene nagare senefalege yamenelawe (kun) "hune" nawe. wadiyaaweme yaala meneme therethere yehonaale.

kahadiyaane seqaayene kaadarasulaacawenaa mafanaafanyaa kaasaathwacawe baxwaalaa ya'alaahene wedeetaa bamaasabe beetasabocaacawenenaa neberatocaacawene tetawe kakehedate medere wada selaame medere yatasadadutene bamederaawi heyewate yatakabaru bamihonebate medere (hagare) 'enaanoraacawaalane. yamacharashaawe `aalame menedaa daageme yajanate menedaa bamahonu yabalatha nawe kasedate wada xwaalaa yaqaru sawoce lasedatanyoce ('alaahe) yamisathaacawene menedaa biyaawequ kasedate wada xwaalaa 'ayeqarume nabare.

ba'alaahe manegade laaye yatasadadu 'enazihe sawoce hezebocaacawe kaadarasubaacawe seqaaye katewelede hagaraacawenaa kabeetasabocaacawe gaare malayaayataacawe kamifatherebaacawe cegere te`egesete yaadaragu naacawe 'alaahene bamataazaze laaye taagaashoce honu bahulume gudaayaacawe bageetaacawe laaye becaa yedagafaalu. 'alaaheme yehene teleqe menedaa sathaacawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! ka'aneta bafite yalaakenaacawe (male'eketanyoce) malakotaawi male`eketene yamenaawaredelaacawe "sawoce" becaa nabaru. yamalaa`eketene male'eketanyaane 'alelaakeneme yehe yatalamada qwaami kxidataacene nawe. yehene yametekedu kahonanaa male'eketanyoce sawe mahonaacawenaa kaalaawaqaacehu yaqadamete matsaahhefete baalabeetocene thayequ. male'eketanyoce "malaa`ekete" 'enedaalenabarunaa "sawoce" 'enedanabaru yenagerwacexwaale.

kasawe zare yahonu 'enaziyaane male'eketanyoce bageletze maaserajaawocenaa bawaradulaacawe matsaahhefetoce laakene. male'eketanyaacene hoye! lasawoce geletze 'enedihonu yamiyaasefalegu gudaayoce geletze 'enedihonu,'enedihume 'a`emero'acawene 'enediyaaszarunaa bawesethu bayaazawe male'ekete gesaatzeene 'enediwasedu wada 'aneta qure'aane 'awaradene.

ya'alaahene manegade lamazegaate seeraawocene yathanasasu sawoce baqaarune laaye ('enedatakasatawe) 'enedatathaqasawe ba'enaresume laaye mareetene 'enedamaayesanatheqebaacawenaa fetzume mamethaatune kamaayethabequte 'aqethaachaa qethaate 'enedamaayemathaabaacawe madehene (waasetenaa) 'agenyetawaalene!? tamaamenawaalene!?
wayeneme baguzo laaye bamizawaawarubatenaa habete lamaaferaate bamirwarwathubate waqete qethaate biyaaganyaacawese?! maamelathenaa makalaakale yamicelu 'ayedalume.

ya'alwahe qethaate 'eresune bafaru gizee 'enedaayedaresebaacawe yetamaamanaalune?! 'alwahe 'eko bamaanenyaawume waqete leqathaacawe yecelaale;geetaacehu 'azaanyeme; rexeruheme nawe. tawebate 'arego wadaresu yemalasu zanede baarocune lamaqethaate 'ayecakuleme.

wayeneme 'eyafarute yaalawene ya'alaahene qethaate 'enedamaayaaganyaacawe tamaamenawaalene?! bahulume huneetaawoce 'enaresune bamaqethaate laaye 'alaahe caaye nawe. ya'enaaneta geetaa ruheruhe 'enaa 'azaanye nawe. baneseha wada 'eresu limalasu selamicelu qethaatene 'ayaacaakulebaacaweme.

basamaayaatenaa bamareete wesethe yamiganyu taneqasaaqaashe nagaroce hulu la'alaahe becaa yesagedaalu. la'eresu (la'alaahe) becaa malaa'eketoce yesagedaalu. 'alaahene kamaamelakenaa la'eresu kamataazaze 'ayekorume.

malaa'eketoce meneme 'enekwaa yehene bamasala 'amelekotenaa taazaazhenate laaye bihonume ba'akaalu, ba'ashanaafinatunaa baselethaanu ka'enaresu balaaye yahonawene geetaacawene yefaraalu; yaazazaacawene te`ezaaze yefatzemaalu.

theraate (kebere) yatagabaawe 'alaahe labaariyaawocu hulu 'enedihe 'ala - <<hulate 'amelaakocene 'ateyaazu;'ewenatanyaa 'amelaake tagaarinaa hulatanyaa yaleelawe 'anede becaa nawe. 'eneene becaa feru; ka'enee weche yamiganyu nagarocene 'ateferu.>>

bamafethareme, banegesenaame, bamaasetanaabareme basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yamiganyu hulu la'eresu (la'alaahe) becaa nawe. taazaazhenate; fetzume raasene maanebarekakenaa yaszeraa hhasaabene ('alaamaane) therete maaderage la'eresu la'alaahe becaa yatzanaa (yatagabaa) nawe. ka'alaahe weche yametefarute nagare 'alane?! maferaate yalabaacehume. 'eresune ('alaahene) becaa feru.

yasawe lejoce hoye! yaaganyaacehute 'emenataawinaa `aalamaawi tzagaa kebere katagabaawe ka'alaahe yaaganyaacehute nawe. kaleelaa 'ayedalame. kaziyaame makaraa, bashetaa wayeneme dehenate siyaaganyaacehu yadarasabaacahune (fatanaa) 'enediyaasewagedelaacehu wada 'eresu becaa batamaatzeno tewaadaqaalaacehu. babecanyenate limalake yamigabaawe tzagaawocene yamilagesenaa cegerocene yamiyaasewagede ('amelaake) nawe.

kaziyaame tamaatzeno'acehune siqabalenaa ba'enaaneta laaye yamiganyawene makaraa siyaasewagede ka'enaaneta kafilocu ka'eresu gaare leelaane bamaamelake bageetaacawe laaye tagaarine yaadaregaalu. yehe bathaame kabaade wanejale (hathi'ate) nawe.

ba'alaahe laaye ya'ameleko tagaari yamiyaadaregu mahonaacawene 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye yafatzamawene tzagaa 'enedikedu 'adaragaacawe. katzagaawocu makaakale makaraacawene yaasewagadalaacawe yethaqasaale. selaziheme 'enedihe tabaalu - <<mederaawiwenaa yawadiyaanyaawe `aalame ya'alaahe qethaate 'esekimathaabaacehu derase bameteganyubate tzagaa wesethe tadasatu (tathaqamu) (fanethezu).>>

thaa`otaawiyaane (ge'uze 'enedihume yamaayethaqemenaa yamaayegodaa bamahonu) meneme lamaayaaweqawe thaa`otaacawe 'enyaa kalagasenaacawe sisaaye dereshaa yaadaregulataale. baziheme wada thaa`otu lamaqerabe yefalegaalu. thaa`otaawiyaane hoye! 'enazihene thaa`otaate 'amelaake 'enedahonunaa kaganezabaacehu dereshaa 'enedaalaacawe selametemogetute nagare batenesaa'ee `elate tethayaqaalaacehu.

thaa`otaawiyaane 'alaahe seete lejoce 'enedaalute yenaagaraalu. 'enaresume malaa'eketoce 'enedahonu yaamenaalu. wada 'eresu (wada 'alaahe) seete lejocene yaasethagaalu. laraasaacawe yamaayewadutene la'eresu yemarethaalu. laresu kamiyaadaregute nagare 'alaahe yataqadasanaa yatharaa nawe. laraasaacawe yanafesocaacawe (felaagote) zenebaalee yamimarethawene wanedoce lejoce yaadaregaalu. kazihe yakafaa mene hathi'ate yeganyaale?!

ka'enazihe thaa`otaawiyaane makaakale la'anedanyaawe seete leje 'enedatawaladabate binagerawe (yasamaawene) zeenaa bamathelaate fitu yethaquraale. lebu bahhazanenaa bacheneqate yemolaale. kaziyaame gene (yehe sawe) lanafesu yamaayewadawene wada 'alaahe yaasethagaale.

(seete 'enedatawaladalate) selatanagarawe zeenaa mathefonate kasawoce raasune yedabeqaale; yesaweraale. tawaaredonaa lebonaawe tasabero yehecene seete leje yaasaadegaate wayenese yegedalaatenaa ba'afare wesethe yeqebaraate!? kanafesu gaare yemwagataale. laraasaacawe yamithalutene lageetaacawe bamaaderagaacawe thaa`otaawiyaane yamisathute ferede menenyaa tzayaafe nawe!? (bathaame tzayaafe nawe.)

bamacharashaawe `aalame lamaayaamenu kahadiyaane la'alaahe leje yaasefalegawaale belawe maamanaacawe yamaayemenatenaa yakehedate mathefo magalachaa baaheri nawe. la'alaahe yaleqenaa, yamelu`enate, yamabeqaaqaatenaa ya`eweqate yalaaqa mesegune baaheriyaatoce 'alute. 'eresu theraate yatagabaawe 'alaahe banegeszenaawe maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi, ba'afathaatharu, bamaasetanaabarunaa badenegaageewe thebabanyaa nawe.

babadalaacawenaa bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe sawocene biqathaa bamedere laaye yamineqasaaqase sawenaa 'enesesaate 'ayenoreme nabare. nagare gene 'alaahe ba'eresu `eweqate latawasana yagizee 'ereqate (rezemate) yaaqoyaacawaale. ba`eweqatu yatawasanawe yaa gizee simathaa theqite yaahele gizeeneme bihone kaziyaa wadaxwaalaame hona wada fite 'ayelume

laraasaacawe yamithalutene (seete lejocene) la'alaahe yaadaregaalu. kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasaacaweme 'ewenate kahona 'alaahe zanede malekaame darajaa 'enedaalaacawe 'anedabataacawe hhasatene yenaagaraale. ba'ewenate lanaresu 'esaate 'alaacawe. baziyaa wesethe yetawaalu. zeneta `aalameme kaziyaa ('esaate) 'ayewathume.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! ba'alaahe 'emelaalahu ka'aneta bafite wadanabarute teweledoce male'eketanyocene lekanaale. ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekone tagaari yamaaderage, yakehedatenaa yahathi'ate mathefo tagebaaraacawene shayethwane malekaame 'aderego 'asaayaacawe. batenesaa'ee `elate (theqeme yamaayesathawe) radaataacawe 'eresu nawe. ka'eresu 'eredaataa yethayequ. batenesaa'eewe `elate 'asaamaami qethaate yaaganyaalu.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! ba'aneta laaye qure'aanene yaawaradenawe sela "tawehide" ('alaahene babecanyenate selamaamelake, karesu weche yamimalaku nagarocene selamakaade) kamote baxwaalaa selamaqaseqasenaa selahegegaate denegaageewoce lasawoce hulu selatalayaayubate gudaayoce 'enedetegaletzelaacawe nawe. 'enedihume ba'alaahe,bamale'eketanyaawenaa qure'aane yezote bamathaawe male'ekete lamiyaamenu sawoce qure'aane qathetanyaawene manegade mamariyaanaa 'ezenate 'enedihone nawe. ka'ewenate yamithaqamuteme 'enaresu naacawe.

'alaahe kasamaaye zenaabene 'awarada. baziyaa yazenaabe weha mareetene heyaawe 'adaragaate. thafenaa (yamaataabaqele) daraqe kahonace baxwaalaa kamareete wesethe takelocene 'abaqala. kasamaaye zenaabene bamaaweradenaa kamareete takelocene bamaabeqale wesethe ya'alaahene negegere lamiyaadaamethunaa batheleqate lamiganazabu sawoce thaqaami geletze (meleketoce) yeganyaale.

yasawe lejoce hoye! bagemaloce, balaamoce, babagocenaa bafeyaloce wesethe yametegasatzubate qume nagare 'ala. hode kamaayezawe tarafa nagarenaa basawenate 'akaale wesethe kamiganyawe dame makaakale kagaatwa yamiwathaane watate 'enaathathaacexwaalane. kazihe wesethe watatu netzuhenaa thaafaache sawocene yamiyaasedasete hono yewathaale.

bamenelagesaacehu yatamerenaa yawayene fereewoce wesethe la'enaaneta gesaatzee yeganyaale 'a`emerone yamisawere (yamiwasede) 'asekaari mathathe teszarubataalaacehu yehe malekaame 'ayedalame. ka'enazihe fereewoce tamere, zabibe 'enaa yamasaasalute yamithaqemaacehune malekaame megeboce tethaqamubataalaacehu. bazihe batathaqasawe wesethe lamiyaasetawelu sawoce ya'alaahene celotaanaa basawoce laaye yamifatzamawene tzagaa yamithaqume meleketoce yeganyaalu. gesaatzeeneme yamiwasedute 'enaresu naacawe.
male'eketanyaacene hoye! geetaahe nebene 'asaawaqaate. bataraaroce laaye, bazaafoce laaye, sawoce bamiganabubate thaariyaa (kafetaa) laaye beetocene yaazhi sile manegadene maraate.

kaziyaame yametefalegiwene fereewoce hulu tamagabi. geetaasheme (wada botaashe lamamalase) yaagaraaleshene (yaamacaacaleshene) 'enaa yaasaawaqeshene manegade yezashe tagwaazhi. kanebe hode wesethe leyu leyu qalamoce yaalute maare yewathaale. bamaare wesethe lasawe lejoce fawese 'ala. bashetaawocene yaakemubataale. nebene bamaasaawaqenaa bazihe kahodewaa bamiwathaawe maare wesethe sela'alaahe celotaanaa yafetherataatune gudaaye selamaasetanaabaru batheleqate lamiyaasebu sawoce meleketoce yeganyaalu. temeherete yamiwaseduteme 'enaresu naacawe.

'alaahe yaala qedema mesaalee fatharaacehu. gizeeyaacehu sifatzame (siyaaleqe) wadamote yewasedaacexwaale.ka'enaaneta makaakale wada mathefo ya`edemee 'erekane (majaajate) `edemeewe yamirazeme yenoraale. baqadama heyewatu kamiyaaweqawe nagare 'anedaaceme yamaayaaweqe yehonaale. 'alaahe `aawaaqi nawe; kabaariyaawocu tagebaare 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayesawarebateme. ('alaahe) xaayaale nawe. 'anedeme yamisaanawe nagare yalame.

'alaahe balagasaacehu sisaaye kafilaacehune kakafilu 'abalaalatha bamakaakalaacehu habetaamenaa deha, yabalaayenaa yabataace 'adaraga. 'alaahe basisaaye yaasebalathaacawene sawoce 'alaahe yasathaacawene habete la'agalegaayocu sathetawe ka'eresu gaare bahabete 'ekule 'enedihonu yamifalegu 'ayedalume. laraasaacawe tagaari 'enedaayenoraacawenaa ka'agalegaayocaacawe gaare 'ekule mahone yamaayewadu sihonu 'enedeete kabaariyaawaacu tagaarine ba'alaahe laaye maaderagene la'alaahe yewadaalu?! tagaari 'enedaayenoraacawenaa ka'agalegaayocaacawe gaare 'ekule mahone yamaayewadu sihonu 'enedeete kabaariyaawocu tagaarine ba'alaahe laaye maaderagene la'alaahe yewadaalu?! yehe mene `aayenate badale nawe?! kazihe yamigazefe mene `aayenate ya'alaahene tzagaa makaade yeganyaale?!

yasawe lejoce hoye! dasetaawocene yametaaganyubaacawe karaasaacehu zereyaa yahonu thenedoce (misetocene) 'alaahe 'adaragalaacehu. kamisetocaacehu lejocenenaa yaleje lejocene sathaacehu. kamegeboce (segaawocene, thereewocene, feraafereewocene) malekaamune lagasaacehu. bahhasate thaa`otoce yaamenaalu liqotherwacawe yamaayecelutene gadabe yalashe bezu ya'alaahene tzagaawoce yekedaalune?! ba'eresu becaa bamaamane 'alaahene 'ayaamasagenuteme?!

'enaziyaa thaa`otaawiyaane kasamaayaate wayeneme kamareete meneme `aayenate sisaayene lisathwacawe yamaayecelu thaa`otaatene ka'alaahe weche yaamalekaalu. (thaa`otaatu) heyewatenaa `eweqate yaleelaacawe ge'uzoce bamahonaacawe yehene maaderage yecelaalu tabelome 'ayetaasabeme ('ayethabaqeme).

yasawe lejoce hoye! theqeme kamaayesathunaa kamaayegodu ka'enazihe thaa`otaate la'alaahe 'amesaayaane 'ataaderegu.ka'eresu gaare ya'amelekote tagaarine yametaadaregulate 'alaahe 'amesaayaa yalaweme. 'alaahe 'eresu yaalawene fetzumaawi yaleqenaanaa yamelu`enate baaheriwocene yaaweqaale. 'enaaneta yehene 'ataawequ. selaziheme ba'eresu laaye tagaari bamaaderage 'enaa 'eresune kathaa`otocaacehu gaare lamaamasaasale (sehetate) wesethe tewadeqaalaacehu.

bathaa`otaawiyaane laaye malese lamasethate babaarenate qanebare wesethe yamiganye, yafaqadawene yamaaderagenaa laraasu wachi yamaawethaate 'aqeme yaleelawe baariyaanenaa, ka'enyaa zanede yatafaqada netzuhe ganezabene yasathanawe, baziyaame ganezabe 'enedafaqadawe yamiyaazebate bageletzenaa basewere yamilagesewe natzaa sawene 'alaahe mesaalee 'aseqamatha. 'enazihe hulate sawoce (huneetaa) 'ekule 'ayedalume. banegeszenaawe wesethe 'enedafaqadawe yamaazazenaa yabaalabeetenate mabete yaalawe 'alaahene 'enedeete 'aqeme kaleelaacawe thaa`otaacehu gaare 'ekule taadaregaalaacehu? wedaasee laresu tagabi lahonawe 'alaahe wedaasee yegabaawaale. 'enedazihume bezu thaa`otaawiyaane ba'amelekote 'alaahene becaa magazaatenaa 'eresu becaa limalake 'enedamigabaa 'ayaawequme.

'alaahe bathaa`otaawiyaane laaye malese lamasethate leelaa yahulate sawocene mesaalee 'aseqamatha. 'anedanyaawe masemaate yatasaanawe, manaagare yamaayecele 'enedihume yamaayeganazabe nawe. laraasunaa laleeloce sawoce theqeme ('agalegelote) masethate 'ayeceleme. babeetasabocunaa gudaayune bamiyaasetadaaderawe (bamiqothaatharawe) 'akaale laaye kabaade shakeme nawe. bayatenyaaweme 'aqethaachaa bisamaaraa malekaamenenaa yamifalegawene yezo mamethaate 'ayeceleme. yehe sawenaa masemaatenaa manaagare yamicele, yamisathawe theqeme tashaagaari yahona, sawocene bafetehe yamiyaazezenaa baraasu 'aqwaamu tzenu yahona, masanaakeloce baleelubatenaa bamaayaametaataa geletze manegade laaye yahona sawe 'ekule yehonaalune!? thaa`otaawiyaane hoye! bafetzumaawi yaleqenaanaa yamelu`enate baaheriyaate yamigalatzawene 'alaahene 'enaa manaagarenaa masemaate yamaayecelu, theqeme yamaayesathunaa cegerocene yamaayaasewagedu thaa`otaatocaacehune 'enedeete 'ekule taadaregaalaacehu?!

basamaayaatenaa bamedere yatasawaru ruqe mesethirocene `aawaaqi 'alaahe becaa nawe. yehene bamaawaqe kafetherataatu hulu 'alaahe babecanyenate yatalaya nawe. yatenesaa'ee `elate gudaaye 'alaahe becaa kamiyaaweqaacawe yaruqe mesethiroce makaakale yamimadabe nawe. 'alaahe sifaqede yamimathaabate fethenate 'eneda `aayene regebegebite qetzebate wayeneme kaziyaame yaqaraba nawe. 'alaahe hulune bamaaderage laaye caaye nawe. yamisaanawe 'anedeme nagare yalame. 'anedene gudaaye sifalege (kun) "hune" yelawaale. wadiyaaweme yehonaale.

yasawe lejoce hoye! ya'eregezenaa gizeeyaacehu sithanaaqaqe 'alaahe ka'enaatocaacehu maahetzane meneme yamaataawequ hetzaanaatoce honaacehu 'awathaacehu. ba'enaaneta laaye selaadaragawe tzagaa 'enedetaamasagenute yametaadamethubatene masemiyaa, yametaayubatene `aayene, yameteganazabubatene lebonaa 'adaragalaacehu.

'alaahe balagasaacawe kenefocenaa ba'ayare laaye baqalaalu lamaberare yatamacaacunaa kenefocaacawene mazaregaatenenaa maathafeneme 'alaahe yaasaawaqaacawene baraari 'a`ewaafaatene thaa`otaawiyaane 'ayemalakatumene? ba'ayaru wesethe 'enedaayewadequ yamiyaayezaacawe hulune caaye yahonawe 'alaahe becaa nawe. bazihe wesethe ba'alaahe lamiyaamenu sawoce meleketoce yeganyaalu. mekeneyaatume bameleketocenaa gesaatzeewoce yamithaqamu 'enaresu becaa naacawe.

badenegaayenaa baleeloce nagaroce bameteganabwacawe beetaacehu 'alaahe maarafiyaanaa maregiyaa 'adaragalaacehu. kagemale, kakabete, kabagenaa feyale qodaawoce bagatharoce wesethe 'enedaqwaami manoriyaa yamiyaagalagelu denekwaanoce 'adaragalaacehu. (yehe denekwaane) kabotaa wada botaa seteneqasaaqasu tashakemo lamaheede qalaale nawe. kaguzo setaarefume lamatekale qalaale nawe. 'enedazihume kabagoce sufe, kagemalenaa feyale tzagure yabeete wesethe magalegayaa `eqaawocene, latawasana yaahele gizee yamiqoyunaa yametethaqamubaacawene 'alebaasaatenaa mashafanyaawocene 'adaragalaacehu.

katzahhaye (hharure) yametethalalubaacawene zaafocenaa beetocene 'alaahe 'adaragalaacehu. 'enedihume kamuqate (kanedaade), kaqure (kaberede)naa ka'atheqi thalaate yametesawarubaacawe yataraaraa waashaawocene 'adaragalaacehu.'enedazihume kaberedenaa kamuqate yamigaaredwacehune 'alebaasaate kathethenaa kaleeloce nagaroce 'enedetaaganyu 'adaragalaacehu. bathorenate wesethe yamasaariyaa theqaate wada sawenataacene 'enedaayedarese theqaatene yametekalaakalubaacawene yathore makalaakayaa lebesocene 'adaragalaacehu. ('alaahe) 'enazihene tzagaawoce ba'enaaneta laaye 'enedafatzamawe 'enedazihume laresu becaa fetzume taazaazhe 'enedetehonunaa ba'eresu laaye 'anedeneme ya'amelekote tagaari 'enedaataadaregu tzagaawocune ba'enaaneta laaye yatamwalaa yaadaregaale.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'emenate kamaqabalenaa yezahe yamathaakxawene male'ekete 'ewenate kamaalate fitaacawene biyaazoru ba'aneta laaye yaalawe xaalaafinate 'enedetaadarese yataazazekawene male'ekete bageletze maaderase becaa nawe. qathetanyaawene manegade 'enedimaru yamaasegadade xaalaafinate yalabeheme.

thaa`otaawiyaane 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye yaadaragaacawene tzagaawoce yaaweqaalu (kazihe wesethe rasulene wada 'enaresu malaaku yethaqasaale). kaziyaame gene mesegaanaane baalamaaqerabe male'eketanyaawene hhasatanyaa bamaalate ya'alaahene tzagaa yekedaalu. bezuwocu ya'alaahene tzagaawoce yamiyaasetabaabelu naacawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! ka'eyaanedaanedu tewelede yatalaakalaacawene male'eketanyaa 'alaahe yamiqasaqesebatene ba'amaanyoce 'emenatenaa kahadiyaane kehedate laaye yamimasakerubatene `elate 'asetaawese. kaziyaame lakahadiyaane selanabarubate kehedate mekeneyaate maaqerabe yamifaqedelaacawe 'ayehoneme. geetaacawe kanaresu yamiwadawene 'enedifatzemu wada mederaawi `aalame yamimalasume 'ayehonume. yamacharashaawe `aalame yameremaraa 'eneji yaszeraa `aalame 'ayedalame.

badalanyaa thaa`otaawiyaane qethaatene 'enedimalakatu (yamifatzamebaacawe) qethaate kanaresu laaye 'ayeqalelaacaweme. 'enedihume (qethaatu) yamizagaajelaacawenaa faataa yamisathaacawe 'ayehonume. yelequneme zeneta `aalame baziyaa wesethe lamaqoyate yegabaalu.

thaa`otaawiyaane ka'alaahe weche siyaamalekwaacawe yanabarutene 'amaakeletocene bamacharashaawe `aalame simalakatwacawe <<geetaacene hoye! 'enazihe ka'aneta weche senaamalekaacawe yanabarute 'agaarocaacene naacawe>> bamaalate hathi'atocaacawene liyaashakemwacawe bamaasabe yenaagaraalu. 'alaaheme 'amaaleketocaacawe 'enedinaagaru yaadaregaale. 'enediheme silu malese yesathwacawaale - <<thaa`otaawiyaane hoye! ka'alaahe gaare ya'amelekote tagaari bamaaderage setefatzemu banabarawe 'amelekote hhasatanyaa naacehu. 'alaahe karesu gaare limalake yamigabaawe tagaari yalaweme.>>

batenesaa'eewe `elate thaa`otaawiyaane la'alaahe 'eje bamasethate taazaazhe yehonaalu. thaa`otocaacawe 'alaahe zanede 'enedamiyaamaaledu bahhasate yeqathefute yanabarawe mugete hulu yethafaabaacawaale.

'enaziyaa 'alaahene yakaadu 'enedazihume leelocene (sawoce) ka'alaahe manegade 'enedishashu yaadaragu (babeleshunataacawenaa leeloceneme bamaabalaashataacawenaa bamaathemamaacawe mekeneyaate) lakehedataacawe tagabi yamihonaacawene baqethaate laaye qethaatene 'enechamerelaacawaalane.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! selanabarubate kehedatenaa 'emenate mesekerenate yamisathebaacawene male'eketanyaa ba'eyaanedaanedu tewelede wesethe yameneqasaqesebatene `elate 'asetaawese. yeheme male'eketanyaa yaraasaacawe waganenaa lesaanaacawene (qwaaneqwaacawene) yaminaagare nawe. male'eketanyaacene hoye! bahulume teweledoce laaye mesekere 'enedetehone 'enaaqarebehalane. yatafaqadunaa yaaletafaqadu, menedaanaa qethaatene 'enedihume galatzaa yamiyaasefalegaacawene leeloce nagarocene hulu 'enedetaaberaaraa ba'aneta laaye qure'aanene 'awaradene. (qure'aanene) yaawaradenawe sawoce wada 'ewenate mamariyaa 'enediyaaganyu, laamanubatenaa (laszarubate) 'ezenate 'enedihone; ba'alaahe lamiyaamenu sawoce selamithabeqaacawe zala`aalamaawi tzagaa beseraatene 'enedisathe nawe.

'alaahe baariyaawocune ya'alaahenenaa yabaariyaawocune mabete batekekele bamaakebarenaa baferede kxidate wesethe tagabi bahona `eweqate kaalehona basetaqare 'anedune kaleelaawe saayaasebalethe fetehawi 'enedihone yaazezaale. 'enedihume baariyaawe babago feqaadanyenate bamamatzewate badale yafatzamutene yeqere bamaalatenaa yamasaasalutene gedeetaa yaalehonabatene malekaame tagebaare bamafatzame malekaame baalawelataa 'enedihone 'alaahe yaazezaale. yaqerebe zamadoce yamiyaasefalegwaacawene nagaroce 'enedisathaacawe yaazezaale 'enedihume kahulume 'ayenate tzayaafe nagaroce ('asetzayaafi qaalaatocene manaagareme yehune, zemutene yamasalu 'asetzayaafi deregitocene kamafatzame) yekalakelaale. badalene (gefene)naa basawoce laaye kuraatanyaa mahonene yekalakelaale. 'alaahe bazihe 'aneqatze baazazaacehunaa bakalakalaacehu nagaroce genezaabeene 'enedetaaganyu yegasetzaacexwaale.

la'alaahe wayeneme lasawoce yagabaacexwaacawene qaale kidaanoce batamwalaa huneetaa fatzemu. ba'alaahe seme bamamaale mahhalaacehune kaathanaakaraacehute (kaathabaqaacehute) 'enaa. yamaalaacehubatene gudaaye 'enedametefatzemu 'alaahene ba'enaaneta laaye mesekere kaadaragaacehu baxwaalaa mahhalaacehune 'ataaferesu. 'alaahe yametefatzemutene yaaweqaale. karesu yamisawarebate meneme nagare yalame. baziyaame laaye menedaacehune yesathaacexwaale.

sufe wayeneme thethe bamafetale 'enedalafaacenaa fatelewaa 'enedaamaaralaate kaziyaame gene fatelune 'enedaabalaashacawenaa kamafatalu bafite 'enedanabarabate huneetaa 'enedabataatanacewe belehenate yatanafagaate seete qaale kidaanaacehune bamaaferase talaalaa 'enaa baaladakaamaa 'a`emero baalabeetoce 'atehunu (yeheci seete) bafatelume dakamace; fatelune bamafetaateme dakamace. tafalaagiwene nagare 'alaaganyaceme. mahhalaawocaacehune kafilaacehu kafilune yamiyaataalelebate maataalayaa taadaregutaalaacehu. 'alaahe yamifatenaacehu qaale kidaanaacehune selamamulaataacehu nawe. qaale kidaanaacehune tefatzemaalaacehu wayenese taafaresaalaacehu!? bamederaawi `aalame selametelayaayubate gudaaye 'alaahe ba`elata tenesaa'ee yegaletzelaacexwaale. tekekelanyaawene katasaasaatawe, 'ewenatanyaawene kahhasatanyaawe yelayawaale.

'alaahe bifaqede ba'emenate laaye yagaaraa sememenate yaalaacehu (yatasemaamaacehu) 'anede tewelede yaadaregaacehu nabare. nagare gene 'ewenatenenaa qaale kidaane mamulaatene bamanefage bafetehawinatu yafalagawene yaathamemaale. lafaqadawe dagemo bacerotaawe wada 'enazihe nagaroce yamamaraate sekeetene yaagonaatzefaale. batenesaa'ee `elate bamederaawi heyewate tefatzemute selanabarawe szeraa tethayaqaalaacehu.

semeetaacehune bamakatale mahalaacehune bafalagaacehu gizee yametefatzemute, bafalagaacehu gizee dagemo yametaafaresute kafilaacehu kafilune yamiyaataalelebate maataalayaa 'ataaderegute. yehene kaadaragaacehu katzenaate baxwaalaa kaqathetanyaawe manegade 'egeraacehu yenesharaatataale. ka'alaahe manegade kamathemamaacehunaa leeloce sawoce bamaathemamaacehu qethaate teqamesaalaacehu. derebe qethaate yethabeqaacexwaale.

qaale kidaanaacehune bamaaferasenaa baalamafatzame ba'alaahe qaalekidaane theqite lewaache (meteke) 'atelawathu. qaale kidaanaacehune bamaaferase kametaaganyute theqite lewaache (meteke) 'alaahe zanede bamederaawi `aalame yamiganyawene delenaa habete ('enedihume) bamacharashaawe `aalame yamiganyawe zalaaqi tzagaa yametaawequ kahona la'enaaneta yatashaala nawe.

yasawe lejoce hoye! 'enaaneta zanede yamiganyawe ganezabe, dasetaanaa mecote meneme yaahele bezu bihone thafi nawe. 'alaahe zanede yamiganyawene menedaa gene zawetaari nawe. thafiwene kazawetaariwe 'enedeete temarethaalaacehu qaale kidaanaacawe laaye bamatzenaate te`egesete laadaragunaa qaale kidaanaacawene laalaafarasu menedaacawene yeszarute kanabarawe malekaame nagare batashaala 'enemanadaacawaalane.

ba'alaahe yamiyaamenenaa ka'alaahe denegaageewoce gaare yamisemaamu malekaame szeraawocene yaszaraa (wanedeme yehune seete ya'alaahene wesaaneewoce yamiwade), batasathawe (baalawe) yamidasatenaa yamibeqaaqaa, lamalekaame tagebaaroce sekeetene yatasatha bamaaderage bamederaawi `aalame malekaame heyewatene 'enaanorawaalane. bamacharashaawe `aalame bamederaawi `aalame yeszaru kanabarawe malekaame szeraa yatashaala menedaa 'enesathaacawaalene.
'aneta 'amaanye hoye! qure'aanene maanebabe setefalege ka'alaahe 'ezenate katabaararawe shayethwane gutegotaa 'enedithabeqehe 'alaahene thayeqe.
shayethwane ba'alaahe baamanu 'enedihume bahulume gudaayocaacawe ba'alaahe laaye becaa bamidagafute laaye selethaane yalaweme.

yamagotegote selethaane yaalawe ba'enaziyaa wadaaje 'aderegawe bayaazute, bamaataalalu taazaazhe bahonute laaye becaa nawe. 'enaresu shayethwane selaataalalaacawe (selaathamamaacawe) ba'alaahe laaye tagaarine yaadaregaalu; ka'alaahe gaare leelaane nagare yaamalekaalu.

'anedene yaqure'aane 'aneqatze baleelaa yaqure'aane 'aneqatze seneshere ('alaahe lathebabe yamishaarawene qure'aane yaaweqaale; 'enedihume; kaqure'aane selamaayeshaaraweme yaaweqaale) 'enedihe yelaalu - <<muhhamade hoye! 'aneta ba'alaahe laaye yameteqathefe hhasatanyaa nahe.>> bezuwocu sherate yamihonawe bathaame wasaanye lahona 'amelaakaawi thebabe mahonune 'enediyaaweme 'ayaawequme.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! yehe qure'aane meneme sehetate baleelabate baaletalawathanaa baaletazaabaa 'ewenate, 'adise 'aneqatze bawarada 'enaa kafile ('aneqatzocu) batashaaru gizee hulu 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe manegade yaamanute tzenaatene 'enediyaaganyu, wada 'ewenate mamariyaacawe 'enedihone, 'enedihume baresu laaye bamiyaaganyute yatakabara (yalaaqa) menedaa lamuselimoce beseraate 'enedisathu theraate katagabaawe 'alaahe zanede yezo yawaradawe jeberile nawe balaacawe.

thaa`otaawiyaane <<muhhamadene qure'aane yamiyaasetamerawe sawe nawe>> 'enedamilu 'enyaa 'enaaweqaalane. bazihe mugetaacawe hhasatanyoce naacawe (mahhamadene) qure'aane 'enedamiyaasetamere yamimogetute sawe lesaane (qwaaneqwaa) `aarabenyaa 'ayedalame. yehe qure'aane dagemo yatawaradawe geletzenaa methuqe 'agalaalatze baalawe ya`aarabenyaa lesaane nawe. 'enedeete `aarabenyaa qwaaneqwaawe kaalehona sawe (yehene qure'aane) tamerotaale belawe yemogetaalu?!

ya'alaahe ta'ameraatoce ka'alaahe zanede yamathu mahonaacawene yamiyaamenute (bazihe kehedataacawe) getere honawe 'esekaqathalu derase 'alaahe qathetanyaawene manegade yamamaraatene sekeete 'ayesathaacaweme. bamiganyubate ba'alaahe kehedataacawenaa 'aneqatzocu hhasate bamaalataacawe mekeneyaate 'asaamaami qethaate yethabeqaacawaale.

muhhamade kageetaawe zanede yezote bamathaawe nagare hhasatanyaa 'ayedalame. yelequneme hhasate yamidaresute ya'alaahene ta`aameraatoce ('aneqatzoce) 'ewenate yamaayelute naacawe. mekeneyaatume qethaataacenene 'ayefarume; lamenedaaceneme 'ayegwaagume. 'enazihe kehedate magalachaacawe yahona (sawoce) hhasatanyoce naacawe. hhasate batadagaagaami yamiyaadaregute lemaadaawi deregitaacawe nawe.

'emenatene kataqabala baxwaalaa 'alaahe yakaada (ba'asegadaace huneetaa kehedate yatachaanabatenaa yakehedatene qaale ba'anedabatu yatanaagara nagare gene lebu ba'emenate yatzanaanaa ba'emenatu tekekele 'enedahona yaamana siqare) nagare gene lebu lakehedate yatakafata, ka'emenate kehedatene yamaratha, bafeqaadanyenate (yakehedate qaalene yatanaagara) kaselaame yataqalabasa nawe. ba'enedazihe 'ayenate sawoce laaye ya'alaahe quthaa waredobaacawaale. teleqe qethaateme yethabeqaacawaale.

kaselaame yataqalabasubate yeheme mekeneyaate bamacharashaawe `aalame bamakaadaacawe bamelaashe yamiyaaganyutene mederaawi (theqeme) bamamerathaacawe nawe. 'alaahe lakahadiyaane hhezeboce ya'emenatene sekeete 'ayesatheme. 'enediyaaweme yenafegaacawaale (yaawaaredaacawaale).

ka'emenate baxwaalaa (wada kehedate) bamaqalebase yatagalatzute 'enazihe sawoce 'alaahe lebocaacawene dafenotaale. gesaatzeewocene (mekerocene) 'ayeradume. masemiyaacawene (dafenotaale) theqeme yamisathaacawene 'ayaadaamethume. `aayenocaacawene (gaaredotaale); 'emenatene yamithaqumu ta`aameraatocene 'ayemalakatume. yadasetaa mekeneyaatenaa ya`edela bisenate mekeneyaate kahonu nagaroce 'enedihume 'alaahe kaazagaajalaacawe qethaate zeneguwoce naacawe.

ka'emenate baxwaalaa wada kehedate bamaqalebasaacawe nafesocaacawene yakasarute 'enazihe (sawoce) batenesaa'ee `elate ya'ewenate kasaariwoce 'enaresu naacawe. ba'emenataacawe bitzanu janate yegabu nabare.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'enedihume thaa`otaawiyaane seqaaye kaadarasubaacawenaa lebaacawe ba'emenate yatzanaa bihoneme baseqaaye beretaate yakehedatene qaale 'esekinaagaru ba'emenataacawe kafatanwacawe baxwaalaa kamakaa wada madinaa latasadadu 'aqema dakaamoce, kaziyaame ya'alaahe qaale kafe yaala, yakahadiyaane qaale zeqe yaala 'enedihone ba'alaahe manegade laaye lataagalu, bategelu 'asecagaari huneetaawoce laayeme te`egesetene laadaragu, kazihe katamokarubate fatanaa, yakehedate qaale 'esekawathaacawe katasaqaayubate qethaate baxwaalaa geetaahe lanaresu meheratene sachi 'enaa 'azaanye nawe. yakehedate qaale ka'anedabataacawe yawathaawe tagadedawe nawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'eyaanedaanedu sawe laraasu takaraakaari hono yamimathaabatene, baziyaane `elate 'asefari te`eyenete mekeneyaate kanafesu weche selaleelaawe yamaayekaraakarebatene `elate 'asetaawese. hulume nafese selaszaraacewe malekaamenaa mathefo szeraa menedaawaa yefatzemelaataale. yamalekaame szeraa menedaacawe yamiqanese hono wayeneme mathefo tagebaaraacawe (kaszarute) chamero 'ayebadalume.
