'alaahe 'aneditene katamaa (makaane) mesaalee 'aseqamatha. nawaariwocwa segaate yaleelabaacawe salaamaawi katamaa nabarace. bazuriyaawaa yamiganyu sawoce sithalafu katamaawaa gene yataragaagaace nabarace. sisaayewaa baamaaranaa baqasala huneetaa kahulume seferaawoce yemathaalaataale. nawaariwocwa 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye yaadaragawene tzagaa kaadu. 'alaamasaganuteme. ferehaatenaa rahabe 'eneda lebese 'esekihonaacawe derase, barahabenaa basawenataacawe laaye (bagatzetaacawe) laaye geletze bamitaaye denegaathee, segaatenaa beretu ferehaate yaszeraacawene waagaa sathaacawe.

yamakaa nawaariwoce 'emenatene bamathabaqenaa ba'ewenatanyaanate yamiyaawequte kanaresu yahona male'eketanyaa -muhhamade mathaalaacawe. 'alaahe ba'eresu laaye baawaradawe male`ekete hhasatanyaa nahe 'alute. banaresu laaye yarahabenaa ferehaate ya'alaahe qethaate waradabaacawe. ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaari siyaadaregunaa male'eketanyaawene hhasatanyaa belawe sinaagaru nafesocaacawene wada thefaate 'azaqete bamaketate raasaacawene badalu.

yasawe lejoce hoye! 'alaahe kasathaacehu sisaaye lamegebenate theru yahonawene `aayenate yatafaqada megebe tamagabu. sela tzagaawocu `eweqenaa bamasethatenaa 'eresu bamiwadawe gudaaye theqeme laaye (tzagaawocune) bamaawaale 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye yafatzamawene tzagaa 'amasegenu (ba'eregethe 'eresune becaa yametaamalekunaa baresu laaye 'anedeme ya'amelekote tagaari yametaadaregu kahona.)

la'erede kamiqarebe nagare saayetaarade yamota, fasaashe dame, ya'asaamaa segaa mulu 'akaale, ka'alaahe weche wadamiganye 'akaale lamaqaarabe sawe yaaradawe 'erede 'enazihene megeboce 'alaahe 'ereme 'aderegobaacawaale. yehe kelekalaa 'amaaraache baminorebate huneetaa wesethe (tafatzaami) yamihone nawe. 'asegadaaje huneetaawoce yatathaqasutene nagaroce 'enedimagabe yaasegadadutene, kelekele yahonu megebocene mamagabe faqedo saayehone (ba'asegadaaje huneetaa) 'enazihene nagaroce kamiyaasefalegawe mathane saayaalefe yatamagaba hathi'ate yalabateme. 'alaahe meheratene 'aderaagi nawe. yatamagabawene yemerawaale. ba'asegadaaje huneetaa wesethe ('enazihene kelekeloce) 'enedimagabe selafaqadalate 'alaahe 'azaanye nawe.

thaa`otaawiyaane hoye! <<yehe yatafaqada nawe; yehe dagemo 'ereme nawe>> bamaalate 'alaahe yaalekalakalawene bamakalekale, 'alaahe yaalefaqadawene bamafeqade ba'alaahe laaye hhasatene lamaqethafe bamaasabe 'anedabataacehu ba'alaahe laaye bahhasate yamigaletzawene 'atenaagaru. ba'alaahe laaye hhasatene yamiqathefu sawoce yafelaagotaacawene 'ayaaganyume. kamifaruteme 'ayedenume.
ba`aalamaawi heyewate semeetocaacawene bamakatalaacawe theqite mathaqamiyaawocene yaaganyaalu. batenesaa'ee `elate 'asaamaami qethaate yethabeqaacawaale.

bazihe hhezebe laaye 'ereme yaadaragawune yamegebe `aayenatocene kazarazara baxwaalaa 'ayehudoce laaye 'ereme yaadaragawune 'enedihe bamaalate tanaagara::
(ba'ane'ame meheraafe 'aneqatze 146 laaye 'enedatathaqasawe) yatarakelehene (yathaqaselehene) nagaroce batalaye ba'ayehudaawiyaane laaye 'ereme 'adaragenawe. yehene bamakalekalaacene 'alebadalenaacaweme. nagare gene laqethaate mekeneyaate yahonu nagarocene bamafatzamaacawe raasaacawene badalu. bawasane 'alaafinataacawe waagaacawene sathanaacawe. qethaate 'enedihonaacawe yatathaqasawene kelekele 'adaragenebaacawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! kaziyaame geetaahe la'enaziyaa yamacharashaa fetzaameewene baalamaawaqe mathefo szeraawocene lafatzamu, kaziyaame mathefo tagebaarocene kafatzamu baxwaalaa wada 'alaahe batzatzate latamalasunaa mathefo nagare yaalabatene tagebaaraacawene laasetakaakalu geetaahe kanesehacawe baxwaalaa lahathi'ataacawe meheratene sachinaa 'azaanye nawe.

thaa`otaawiyaane baberaahime manegade laaye mahonaacawene yemogetu selanabare 'alaahe lamugetaacawe 'enedihe bamaalate malese satha.
beraahime malekaame baaheriyaatocene sabesebo yayaaza, zawatere lageetaawe taazaazhe yahona, ka'emenate manegadoce hulu wada selaame ya'emenate manegade raasune yaazanabala nabare. bafetzume kathaa`otaawiyaane wagane 'alenabarame.
'alaahe baresu laaye selaadaragawe tzagaa 'amasegaanye nabare. 'alaahe nabiye 'enedihone marathawe. wada qathetanyaawe yaselaame 'emenateme maraawe.

bamederaawi heyewate nabiyenatene, malekaame semene (bamalekaame beetasabe), malekaame lejene sathanawe. bamacharashaawe `aalame 'eresu bajanate wesethe kafetanyaa darajaawoce katazagaajalaacawe malekaame sawoce makaakale nawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! kaziyaame 'alaahene babecanyenate bamaamelake, kathaa`otaawiyaane raasene bamaaraaqe, wada 'alaahe manegade sawocene bamatheraatenaa ba'alaahe denegaageewoce bamaszeraate kahulume 'emenatoce wada selaame 'emenate bamazanebale yaberaahimene manegade takatale bamaalate malakotaawi male`ekete 'awaradenelehe. beraahime thaa`otaawiyaane 'enedamimogetute thaa`otaawi bafetzume 'alenabarame. yelequneme 'alaahene babecanyenate yamiyaamaleke (nabiye) nabare.

bamahakalaacawe leyunate yatafatharabatene yaqedaameene `elate kanuro wethaa werade la'amelekote natzaa gizee 'enediyaaganyu maakebare ba'ayehudaawiyaane laaye gedeetaa yatadaragawe ya'arebene `elate la'amelekote becaa natzaa 'enediyaadaregu sitaazazu 'emebi kaalu baxwaalaa nabare. male'eketanyaacene hoye! geetaahe batenesaa'ee `elate batalayaayubate nagare ferede yesathaale. huluneme tagabiwene waagaa yemanadaale.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'anetanaa takataayocehe 'amaanyoce wada selaame manegade theri yamidaragelete sawe huneetaa, genezaabeenaa 'aqabaabale 'enedamiyaasefalegawe malekaame beseraatenaa maasethaneqaqiyaa baazala mekere theri 'aderegu. sere'ate baalawe malekaame yanegegerenaa yahasaabe manegade (belehate) takaraakaru. sawocene wada qathetanyaawe manegade yamameraate gedeetaa yalabeheme. ya'aneta xaalaafinate (male`ekete) maaderase nawe. geetaahe kaselaame manegade yathamamutene yaaweqaale. 'enedazihume (wada selaame) yatamarutene yaaweqaale. (selaamene baalamaqabalaacawe) nafesehene quchete 'ataaseyezaate.

thalaataacehune maqethaate setefalegu 'eresu ba'enaaneteta laaye bafatzamawe tagebaare 'amesaayaa chemaari saataadaregu qethute. thalaataacehu laaye 'aqeme kaaganyaacehu baxwaalaa kamaqethaate te`egesete betaadaregu yaqethaate melaashe bamasethate 'ekule kamahone te`egesete yatashaala yehonaale.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! kanaresu selamidaresubehe cegeroce te`egesete 'aderege. te`egesete yamaaderage sekeetehe 'alaahe yalagasahe sekeete nawe. kahadiyaane ka'aneta fitocaacawene bamaazoraacawe 'atezane. bamifatzemute seeraanaa tanekoleme lebehe 'ayechanaqe.

'alaahe 'eresune bamaferaate hathi'atocene katawete 'enedihume yataazazutene bamafatzame malekaame tagebaaraatocene baamaara huneetaa kamifatzemute gaare nawe. delene bamasethatenaa ba'eredaataawe ka'enaresu gaare nawe.

karesu wechi yamiganyu 'akaalaate yamaayecelutene yamicele bamahonu 'alaahe theraatenaa teleqenate la'eresu yatagabaa hona. 'agalegaayune muhhamade ba'akaalenaa bamanefase bamulu helinaawi neqaatu balalitu kefele kamasejidale hharaame bafereewoce, ba'azere`etocenaa banabiyaate maarafiyaawoce zuriyaawene wadabaarakenawe bayetale maqedise masejide ya'alaahene celotaa (xaayaalenate) yamithaqumu kafile ta`aameraatoce 'enedimalakate yaasegwaaza 'eresu ('alaahe) nawe.

lamusaa 'oritene sathanawe. la'eseraa'eele lejoce mamariyaa 'adaragenawe. la'eseraa'eele lejoce 'enedihe 'alenaacawe - <<gudaayaacehune yametaasethagubate mamakiyaa ka'enee weche 'ateyaazu. yelequneme ba'enee laaye becaa tamaku.>>

baweha maa`ebale kamasemathe kanuhhe gaare 'eneditarefu bamaaderage tzagaa yaadaragenelaacawe sawoce zereyaawoce naacehu. yehene tzagaa 'asetaawesu. 'eresune becaa bamagazaatenaa 'eresune bamataazaze 'alaahene 'amasegenu. baziheme nuhene tamesaalitaacehu 'aderegu. nuhhe 'alaahene babezu 'amasegaanye nabare.

hathi'atene bamafatzamenaa bakuraate lahulate gizee bamedere laaye kanaresu beleshunate makasatu yamaayeqare bamahonunaa basawoce laaye badale bamafatzame 'enedihume wasane bamaalafe leke yaalafa shumataacawene yaanetzabaareqaalu bamaalate la'eseraa'eele lejoce nagarenaacawe. bataweraate wesetheme 'asaaweqanaacawaale.

yamajamariyaawe beleshunataacawe (thefaataacawe) sikasate yaxaayelenaa yagezufe 'aqeme baalabeete yahonu ya'enyaa baariyaawocene 'eneshomebaacawenaa yegadelwacawaale, yaafanaaqelwacawaale,yalafubatene hulu yaathafaalu. yeheme ya'alaahe qatharo tafatzaaminatu yamaayeqare mahonu yataawaqa nawe.

ya'eseraa'eele lejoce hoye! wada 'alaahe baneseha setemalasu ba'enaaneta laaye xaayele (selethaane) yasathanaacawe (xaayeloce) laaye delene sathanaacehu. hhagaraacehune malasenelaacehu. bazarafaa katawasadabaacehu baxwaalaa habetene 'agonaatzafenaacehu. bamereko katawasadubaacehu baxwaalaa lejocene sathanaacehu kathalaatocaacehu yamileqe yabazaa sebesebe (budene) 'adaragenaacehu.

ya'eseraa'eele lejoce hoye! szeraacehune malekaame (yaamaara) betaadaregu, bamifalagawe maleku betefatzemu malekaame wetheetu yamimalasawe wada 'enaanetawe nawe. 'alaahe ka'enaaneta szeraa yatabeqaaqaa nawe. mathefo tagebaare betefatzemume yaszeraacehu mazaze (kefaate) ba'enaanetawe laaye nawe. 'alaahe malekaame tagebaaraacehu 'ayethaqemaweme. mathefo tagebaaraacehume 'ayegodaaweme. hulatanyaawe beleshunate (thefaate) sikasate thalaatocaacehu 'enediyaawaaredwacehu ba'enaaneta laaye xaayele 'enesathaacawaalane. bamifatzemubaacehu yaweredate `aayenatoce bafitocaacehu (bagatzetaawocaacehu) laaye makafaate (gusequlenaa) geletze hono 'eneditaaye yaadaregaalu wada bayetale maqedise yegabaalu; baziyaame bamajamariyaawe gizee 'enedafatzamute thefaatene yefatzemaalu. 'ashanaafi yahonubatene hagare mulu bamulu yaawademaalu.

ya'eseraa'eele lejoce hoye! kazihe beretu qethaate baxwaalaa baneseha wada 'eresu katamalasaacehunaa szeraacehune malekaame kaadaragaacehu geetaacehu liyaazenelaacehu yefalegaale (yecelaale). laszosetanyaa wayeneme kaziyaa bamibalethe gizee wada thefaatenaa beleshunate katamalasaacehu 'enaanetane wada maqethaate 'enemalasaalane. jahanameneme 'alaahene lakaadu sawoce yamaayelayaacawe maarafiyaanaa menethaafe 'adereganaale.

yehe bamuhhamade laaye yawaradawene qure'aane kahulume yatashaalawene malekaame manegade (yasalaame manegade) yemaraale. malekaame tagebaare lamifatzemu ba'alaahe lamiyaamenu sawoce 'alaahe zanede 'ejege teleqe menedaa 'enedamiyaaganyu yamiyaasedasetaacawene beseraate yenageraale.
batenesaa'ee `elate lamiyaamenu sawoce bamacharashaawe qane 'asaamaami qethaate 'enedatazagaajalaacawe yamiyaasekafaa zeenaa yenageraacawaale.

yasawe leje bamalekaame nagaroce lanafesu du`aa'e (tsalote) 'enedamiyaadaregawe hulu baquthaawe waqete baalamaawaqe baraasu, balejocunaa baganezabu laaye bamathefo nagaroce du`aa yaadaregaale (yetsaleyaale) yethaaraale; yeraagamaale. bamathefo yamiyaadaregawene du`aa'e (tsalote) benesamaawenaa beneqabalawe yethafaa nabare. ganezabunaa lejocume yethafu nabare. yasawe leje cekule yamahone tafathero 'alawe. yeheme selahona bamigodaawe nagare laaye sithaadafe yesetawaalaale.

ya'alaahene becanyenatenaa xaayaalenate yamithaqumu meleketoce 'enedihonu (bamakaakalaacawe yarezematenaa ya'etherate, yamuqatenaa yaberede, yaqezeqaazee leyunate bamanoru) lalitenaa qanene fatharene. lalitene la'eneqelefenaa la'erafete chalamaa 'adaragenawe. sawoce maayate 'enedicelunaa lanurwacawe 'enedirwarwathu qanene berehaanaamaa 'adaragene. ('enedihume) bahulatu mafaraaraqe ya`aamataatene quthere, yamiyaasefalegaacehune yawarocene, yaqanaatenenaa yasa`aataatene hhisaabe 'enedetaawequ ('adaragene). nagaroce bageletze 'eneditharu, tekekelanyaawe kahhasatanyaawe 'enedilaye huluneme nagare bamigabaa 'aberaaraanawe.

(batenesaa'eewe `elate) hhabele ka'anegate 'enedamaayelayawe hulu 'eyaanedaanedu sawe karesu yataganyawe tagebaare (szeraawe) karesu yamaalaye 'enedihone 'enaadaregaalane. 'esekimaramare derase szeraawe karesu 'ayelayeme. batenesaa'eewe `elate yaszaraacawe malekaamenaa mathefo tagebaaraate hulu yatasabasabubatene mazegabe 'enaawathaalataalane ('enaaqarebelataalane). fite lafitu takafetonaa tazaregeto yaaganyawaale.

baziyaa gizeeme 'enedihe 'enelawaalane - <<'aneta sawe hoye! mazegabehene 'anebebe; baszeraahe laaye raasehene yamamaremare xaalaafinatene wesade. ba`elatume raasehene baraasehe mamaremarehe baqi nawe.>>

wada 'emenate yatamaraa theqemu laraasu nawe (tathaqaamiwe raasu nawe). kaqathetanyaawe manegade yathamama yathematu qethaate (tafatzaami) yamihonawe baraasu laaye nawe. 'anedite nafese yaleelaane nafese hathi'ate 'ateshakameme. male'eketanyocene wada 'enaresu bamalaake marajaa saayedaresaacawe hhezebocene 'aneqathaame.

'aneditene katamaa babadalewaa mekeneyaate lenaathafaate senefalege (kakatamaawaa nawaariwoce) batzagaawoce yaqebethate heyewatene yamimaru nawaariwocwane bamalekaame szeraawoce 'enaazezaacawaalane. yataazazutene 'ayefatzemume. yelequneme hathi'ate bamafatzame yaametzaalu. kate`ezaaze yaafanagethaalu. kasere maszarataacawe yamimanagelaacawene (yamiyaathafaacawe) thefaate wesaanee qaale yefatzamebaacawaale.

kanuhhe baxwaalaa (`aadenaa samudene yamasalu) yaathafaanaacawe 'asetabaabaaye teweledoce 'ejege bezu naacawe. (mene yaahele bezu honu) male'eketanyaacene hoye! yabaariyaawocune hathi'ate wesetha-mesethire maawaqenaa mamalekate bageetaahe baqaa. (kahathi'ataacawe) meneme yamidabaqebate yalame. baziyaame menedaacawene yesathaacawaale.

bamalekaame szeraawocu ya`aalamaawi heyewatene theqemoce yamifalegenaa bamacharashaawe `aalame yamaayaamene, 'enedihume lamacharashaawe `aalame gemete yamaayesathe (sawe) 'eresu yamifalegawene tzagaa saayehone 'enyaa yamenefaqedawene (`aalamaawi) theqeme bazihu `aalame 'enaadaregelataalane. kaziyaame `aalamaawi heyewatene bamamerathunaa bamacharashaawe `aalame bamakaadu yatawagazanaa ka'alaaheme 'ezenate yatabaarara hono batenesaa'eewe `elate baqaathalo lamasaqaayate yamigabaabatene jahaname ('esaate) 'enaazagaajelataalane.

bamalekaame szeraawocu yamacharashaawene `aalame yafalaga, 'alaahe 'eneditaamanubaacawe gedeetaa baadaragabaacawe nagaroce 'amaanye hono kayeyulenyenaa semulenye yatzadaa 'asefalaagiwene therate yaadaraga, ba'enazihe baaheriyaate yamigalatzu sawoce therataacawe 'alaahe zanede taqabaayenate yaalawe nawe. baziheme tagebaaraacawe yemanadaacawaale.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! la'enazihe hulate malekaame sarinaa hathi'atanyaa budenoce la'eyaanedaanedaacawe yageetaahene sethotaa yaalamaaqwaarathe 'enechamerelaacawaalane. ba`aalamaawi heyewate yageetaahe sethotaa kamalekaameme hona hathi'atanyaa sawe kamaaneme yamiqwaarathe (yamigaarade) 'ayedalame ('ayehoneme).

male'eketanyaacene hoye! ba`aalamaawi heyewate basisaayenaa badarajaa kafilune kakafilu 'enedeete 'enedaabalathenaacawe 'asetawele! yamacharashaawe `aalame mabalaalathenaa yatzagaawoce darajaa leyunate ka`aalamaawi heyewate bathaame yabalatha nawe. 'eyaanedaanedu 'amaanye bazihe therate yaaderege.

'aneta ya'alaahe 'agalegaaye hoye! ka'alaahe gaare yametaamalekawe leelaa 'amelaake 'ataaderege. 'alaahe zanedenaa ba'alaahe malekaame 'agalegaayoce zanede yatawaqaseke tehonaalahe. 'amasegaanye 'ayenoreheme radaate yaleelahe, 'alaahe yatawahe tehonaalahe.

'aneta ya'alaahe 'agalegaaye hoye! geetaahe karesu weche leelaa nagare 'enedaayemalake 'azezwale; gedeetaa 'aderegwaale. 'enedihume lawalaajoce malekaame maaderegene batalaye ba'erejenaa zamanaacawe 'azezwale. kawalaajoce makaakale 'anedanyaacawe wayeneme hulatume 'aneta zanede ba'erejenaacawe laaye kadarasu "'ufe " bamaalatenaa baleelaa tamasaasaaye nagare 'atesalaacaacawe. banegegerehe 'atethanekerebaacawe; 'ezenatenaa leselaasee yaalaacawe yatakabaru qaalaatocene tanaagaraacawe.
raasehene 'awaaredahe ba'ezenate zeqe balelaacawe; 'enediheme bale - <<geetaayee hoye! bahetzaanenatee selatanekabaakabunye 'ezanelaacawe.>>

yasawe lejoce hoye! geetaacehu balebonaacehu wesethe yaalawene ya'amelekote, yamalekaame tagebaaraatenaa lawalaajoce malekaame yamaaderage szeraacehune `aalaamaane la'eresu becaa netzuhe yamaaderage hhasaabene yaaweqaale. ya'amelekotaacehu, lawalaajocaacehu bago yamaaderagaacehunaa yaleeloceme tagebaaraatoce `aalaamaa hhasaabaacehu malekaame kahona 'eresu 'alaahe baneseha wada 'eresu lamimalasu meheratene sachi nawe. la'alaahe wayeneme labeetasabocu taazaazhe kamahone yaqadama caletanyenatu (senefenaawe) baneseha latamalasa 'alaahe meheratene yesathawaale.
'aneta 'amaanye hoye! yaqerebe zamadene yazemedenaawene haqe sethe. latacagara deha, guzowe latasanaakalabate manegadanyaa lagese. ganezabehene bahathi'atenaa babekenate tagebaare laaye 'ataawele.

ganezabaacawene bahathi'ate laaye yamiyaawelu babekenate yamiyaawathu yashayethwane wanedemoce naacawe. babekenate yamiyaazaacawene yefatzemaalu; shayethwane geetaawene ('alaahene) kahadi nawe. hathi'atene 'eneji leelaa 'ayeszaraame. 'alaahene bamiyaaseqothaa nagare 'eneji baleelaa 'ayaazezeme.

'alaahe yamikafetelehene sisaaye bamathabaabaqe yametesathaacawe nagare baalamanoru yatanasaa la'enazihe sawoce kamasethate kataqothabeke 'alaahe sisaayaacawene 'enediyaasafaalaacawe du`aa'e bamaaderage (bamamaatzane) wayeneme dagemo 'alaahe ganezabe kasathahe 'enedametesathaacawe tasefaa bamasethate qalaalenaa yalazabu qaalaatocene tanaagaraacawe.

kamalagase 'ateqothabe. 'enedihume (ganezabe) bamaawethaate (katagabiwe balaaye) 'ataabaakene. kamalagase kataqothabeke sela sesetehe sawoce yamiyaawagezuhe tawaqaashe tehonaalahe. 'enedihume bekune kahoneke yametesathawene (yametaawathaawene) taathaalahe.

'eresu bamiyaaweqawe yalaaqa thebabe geetaahe lafaqadawe sawe sisaayune yaasafaalataale; 'enedihume bafaqadawe sawe laaye sisaayune yaathabebataale. yabaariyaawocune wesethe 'awaaqinaa szeraacaweneme tamalekaace nawe. sela 'enaresu yamisawarebate 'anedeme nagare yalame. te`ezaazune banaresu laaye 'enedafaqadawe tafatzaami yaadaregaale.

lalejoce wachi bamaawethaataacehu yawadafite dehenatene faretaacehu lejocaacehune 'ategedalu. sisaayaacawene yamasethate xaalaafinate (tathayaaqinate) ya'enyaa nawe. ya'enaaneta sisaaye xaalaafinate ya'enyaa nawe. lejocene magedale teleqe hathi'ate nawe. gedeyaacawene tagabi yamiyaadarege mekeneyaatenaa hathi'ate yalabaacaweme.

zemutene tathaneqaqu, zemutene yamiyaabarataatu nagaroceme raaqu, zemute tzayaafinatu wadare yalashe nawe. bamiyaasekatelawe ya'alaahe qethaatenaa yazereyaa debeleqenate mekeneyaate yakafaa manegade nawe.

yagedeyaa qethaate yamiyaasefarede thefaate 'esekaalefatzamace derase. 'alaahe ba'emenatenaa baqaale kidaane yathabaqaatene nafese 'ategedalu. (ka'emenate maqalebase, katedaare baxwaalaa zemute mafatzame, sawene magedale) gedeyaawene hegaawi yamiyaadaregawe manashaa saayenore yaala mekeneyaate bagefe latagadala sawe labeetasabocu bagadalawe sawe laaye selethaane 'enedinoraacawe 'adereganaale. beetasabocu (waraashocu) gadaayu bamote 'enediqathaa lithayequ yecelaalu. 'enedihume banatzaa (babago faqaadaacawe) yeqeretaane maaderage yecelaalu. yakaasaa ganezabe taqabelaweme yeqeretaane masethate yecelaalu. yatagadaaye beetasabe 'alaahe yafaqadalatene wasane bamaalafe yagadaayene reesaa maqoraarathe, kagadalabate nagare weche baala nagare magedale, karesu weche (beetasabocuneme hona leelaa) maanenyaaweme sawe magedale 'ayefaqadelateme (yatagadaaye beetasabe) (ba'alaahe 'eredaataa) yataagazanaa yataradaa nawe.

mulu 'a`emerowe laayenaa la'akaala mathane 'esekidarese derase ganezabune bamiyaaraabunaa bamithabequ thaqaami gudaayoce laaye kaalehona basetaqare walaaju yamotabate hetzaane ganezabene 'ataaneqasaaqesu, ba'alaahenaa ba'enaaneta makaakale, ba'enaanetanaa basawoce makaakale yamiganye qaale kidaanaacehune saayefaresenaa saayegwaadale fatzemu. batenesaa'ee `elate 'alaahe qaale kidaane yagabaa sawe qaale kidaanune fatzemo kahona limanadaawe, qaale kidaanune yaalefatzama kahona dagemo liqathaawe yethayeqawaale.

lasawoce seferene setesaferu batamwalaa huneetaa fatzemu; 'ataagwaadelu. theqiteneme bihone bamaayeqanese bamaayaazaabaa fetehawi mizaane mazenu; seferenaa mizaane kamaagwaadalenaa kamaqanase yeleqe seferenenaa mizaanene maamwalaate bamederaawime hona bamacharashaawe `aalame la'enaaneta malekaamenaa fetzaameeweme yaamaara nawe.

ya'adame leje hoye! yamaataaweqawene 'atekatale gemetocenaa malaametocene yametekatale tehonaalahe. yasawe leje masemiyaawene, `aayenune, lebonaawene bamalekaame hona bamathefo 'enedeete 'enedatathaqamabaacawe tathayaaqi nawe. sela malekaamu menedaane yaaganyaale. sela mathefowe dagemo yeqathaale.
bamedere laaye bakuraate, bamajanane 'atehide. bakuraate beteheede ba'eremejaahe mareetene 'ateqadedeme;qumatehe taraaroce yadarasubate rezematenaa kafetaa 'ayedareseme. kuraatu sela menedenawe?!
yasawe lejoce hoye! kazihe balaaye yatathaqasute nagaroce mathefo tagebaaraatocu yatakalakalu naacawe. yamifatzemaacawene sawe 'alaahe 'ayewademe. yelequneme yethalaawaale.

'enazihene yazarazarenaacawe mamariyaawoce, kelekalaawocenaa denegaageewoce geetaahe wada 'aneta yaawaradawe malakotaawi male`ekete nawe. yasawe leje hoye! ka'alaahe gaare leelaane 'amaakelete 'ateyaaze. (yehene kaadarageke) batenesaa'eewe `elate nafesehenaa sawoce yamiwaqesuhe, kamalekaame nagaroce hulu nefuge (yatanafageke) honahe wada jahaname tewarawaraalahe.

malaa'ekete ya'alaahe seete lejoce naacawe bamaalate hhasate yametemogetute thaa`otaawiyaane hoye! 'alaahe 'enaanetane bawanedoce lejoce marathanaa laraasu malaa'eketene 'eneda seete lejoce 'adaragane!? yaazane?! 'alaahe 'enaaneta kametenaagarute yalaaqa nawe, leje 'alawe bamaalate theraate batagabaawe 'alaahe laaye kabaadenaa tzayaafe nagarene tenaagaraalaacehu. bakehedate wesethe bamazafaqe seetoce lejoce 'alute bamaalate temogetaalaacehu.

bazihe qure'aane sawoce mekerene 'enediganazabunaa yamithaqemaacawene manegade 'enediyezu 'enedihume yamigodaacawene manegade 'eneditawe hegegaatocene, gesaatzeewocene, mesaaleewocene geletze 'adaragene. yehune 'eneji netzuhe tafathero'acawe (tafathero'awi 'amalakaakataacawe) yataqalabasabaacawe kafile sawoce bazihe galatzaa ka'ewenate maraaqenenaa 'ewenatene mathelaatene 'eneji leelaane 'ayechamerume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enazihe thaa`otaawiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe bahhasate 'enedametenaagarute ka'alaahe gaare leeloce 'amaaleketoce binoru 'enazihe hhasatanyaa 'amaakeletoce ya`areshe baalabeete wada honawe 'alaahe selethaanune lamaashanafe (lamataagale) manegade yefalegu nabare.
thaa`otaawiyaane 'eresune kamigaletzute nagare 'alaahe yatharaanaa yataqadasa nawe. thaa`otaawiyaane kaminaagarute 'alaahe bathaame yalaaqa nawe.

samaayaatenaa medere 'enedihume basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yamiganyu fetherataate hulunaa maanenyaaweme fetherate 'alaahene kawedaasee gaare yaatharaalu. nagare gene yawedaaseeyaacawene huneetaa 'ateganazabuteme. yameteganazabute balesaanaacehu 'alaahene yamiyaatharaa sawe wedaaseene becaa nawe. 'alaahe taagaashe nawe. qethaatene 'ayaafatheneme. wada 'eresu baneseha latamalasame mahhari nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! qure'aanene setaanabenaa bawesethu yamiganyutene kelekalaawoce gesaatzeewoce siyaadamethu ba'afanegaachenataacawe mekeneyaate ba'anetanaa batenesaa'eewe `elate bamaayaamenu sawoce makaakale qure'aanene maganezabe yamikalakelaacawe geredoshe 'enaadaregaalane.

qure'aanene 'enedaayeganazabu ('enedaayeradu) balebonaawocaacawe laaye shefaane thaqameetaa yaalawe maademathene 'enedaayaadaamethu bajorowocaacawe laaye kebedatene 'adaragene. baqure'aane wesethe geetaahene becaa setaawasaanaa, hhasatanyaa 'amaaleketocaacawene saatethaqese seteqare jarebaacawene sathetawe yemalasaalu. 'amelekotene la'alaahe becaa netzuhe kamaaderage yereqaalu.

mariwocaacawe qure'aane yamisamubatene manegade 'enyaa 'enaaweqaalane. baresu (baqure'aane) yamamaraate felaagote yalaacaweme yelequneme bametaanabubate waqete maafeezenaa machaawate yefalegaalu. 'enaziyaa bakehedate nafesocaacawene yabadalu sawoce <<sawoce hoye! degemete yatadaragabatenaa 'a`emerowene yasaata sawe 'atekatalu>> bamaalate sela qure'aane yamiyaasetabaabelutenenaa manegadune lamazegaate yamiyaadaregutene yamiyaakaaheedutene misethere (waree) 'enaaweqaalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'asetawele. 'anetane yagalatzubate leyu leyu tawaqaashe baaheriyaatocene (setemalakate) tegaramaalahe. ya'ewenate manegade setawaale (ka'ewenate manegade 'afanegethawe wathetawaale) waalalu wada 'ewenate manegademe kaaletamarume (mamaraate 'alecaalume).

thaa`otaawiyaane kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase manorune hhasate nawe bamaalate 'enedihe tanaagaru - kamotenenaa 'athenete becaa honane sawenataacene kabasabasa (ba'afare katabalaa) baxwaalaa 'eneda 'adise (heyaawe honane) 'eneqasaqasaalane?! yehe fetzume yamihone (yamicaale) nagare 'ayedalame.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - <<thaa`otaawiyaane hoye! yametecelu kahona thanekaaraa 'enedahonawe denegaaye, xaayele 'enedaalawe berate hunu. yeheneneme fetzume mahone 'atecelume.

wayeneme kanazihe leelaa balebocaawocaacahu gezufe 'enedahona yametaasebutene leelaane fetherate hunu. 'alaahe 'enedajamaraacehu yemalesaacexwaale. bamajamariyaawe waqete 'enedafatharaacehu heyaawe yaadaregaacexwaale.>> 'enaziyaa geteroce <<kamotene baxwaalaa heyaawe 'aderego yamimalesane maanawe?!>> (bamaalate yethayeqaalu) 'enedihe balaacawe <<yaalaqedema mesaalee majamariyaa yafatharaacehu (kamote baxwaalaa heyaawe 'aderego) yemalesaacexwaale.>> bametesathaacawe malese bamaafeeze cheneqelaataacawene yaanaqaaneqaalu. fetzume makasatu yaraaqa gemete yaalawe mahonune bamaasabe <<yehe kamote baxwaalaa mamalase yamikasatawe macee nawe?!>> bamaalate yethayeqaalu. <<menaalebaateme qerebe nawe>> balaacawe. yamimathaa nagare hulu qerebe nawe.

yametemalasute 'alaahe wada masabesabiyaawe medere bamitharaacehu `elate nawe. fetzume taazaazhe honaacehu 'eyaamasaganaacehu te`ezaazune tefatzemaalaacehu. bamedere laaye theqitene yaahele gizee becaa 'enedaaqoyaacehu taasebaalaacehu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'enee laamanu baariyaawocee <<baminagaagarubate waqete malekaame qaalaatocene 'enedinaagaru sawocene yamiyaarequ mathefo qaalaatocene 'enedirequ ('enediqothabu)>> negaraacawe. shayethwane (mathefo qaalaatocene) `aalamaawinaa yawadiyaanyaawe `aalame gudaayaacawene bamiyaabalaashu gudaayoce laaye lamathaqame therate yaadaregaale. shayethwane lasawe lejoce geletze thalaate nawe. selahoname (sawoce) lithanaqaqute yegabaale.

yasawe lejoce hoye! geetaacehu sela'enaaneta`aawaaqi nawe. ka'enaaneta yamisawarebate meneme nagare yalame. liyaazenelaacehu kafaqada ya'emenatenaa yamalekaame szeraawocene sekeete bamasethate yaazenelaacexwaale. liqathaacehu kafalagame 'emenatene bamanefagenaa bakehedate laaye 'enedetemotu bamaaderage yeqathaacaxwaale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'emenatene 'enediqabalu yametaasegadedaacawenaa bakehedate (baxaayele) yametaagedaacawe szeraawocaacawene yameteqothaathare banaresu laaye wakile 'aderegane 'alelaakeneheme. 'aneta 'alaahe 'enedetaadarese yaazazahene male'ekete 'aderaashe becaa nahe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe selamiganyu gudaayoce (nagaroce) hulu yaaweqaale. sela huneetaacawonaa selamigabaacawe yaaweqaale. bezu takataayocene bamasethatenaa matsehhafene bamaawerade kafile nabiyaatocene kakafile nabiyaatoce 'enedibalethu 'adereganaale. ladaawedeme "zabure "yatasanya matsehhafe sathetanawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa thaa`otaawiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe. cegeroce siwaredebaacehu ka'alaahe weche 'amelaake 'enedahonu yametemogetwacawe 'akaalaatene tamaatzanu. 'enaresu ka'enaaneta laaye cegerocene maanesaate magafetare 'ayecelume. 'aqeme yaleelaacawe bamahonume wada leelaa cegerune mawesademe 'ayecelume. meneme maaderage yamaayecele 'akaale 'amelaake lihone 'ayeceleme.

'enaziyaa malaa'eketenaa yamasaasalu sawoce yamimaatzanwacawe 'akaalaatoce, 'enaresu 'eraasaacawe wada 'alaahe qerebe yamiyaadaregaacawene malekaame szeraa yefalegaalu. wada 'alaahe bataazaazhenate qerebe lamahone yesheqadaadamaalu. 'alaahe 'enediyaazenelaacawe yemanyaalu. 'enedaayeqathaacawe yefaraalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yageetaahe qethaate lithanaqaqute yamigabaa nawe.

maanenyaaweme katamaa wayeme manedare banawaariwocu kehedate mekeneyaate bamederaawiwe `aalame yathefaate qethaate saanaawaredebate yaqara yalame. wayeneme yakatamaawaa nawaariwoce bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate badame mafaasasenaa baleeloce kabaade qethaatoce 'enefatenaacawaalane. yehe thefaatenaa qethaate batathaqasawe saleedaa laaye yatatzaafa malakotaawi 'amelaakaawi ferede nawe.

thaa`otaawiyaane yathayaqutene mutaanene heyaawe maaderage yamasalu yamale'eketanyaawe 'ewenatanyenatene yamithaqumu yamidaasasu ta`aameraatocene maawerade yaalefaqadenawene bamajamariyaa teweledoce yasaalihe gemalene tadaasaashe ta`aameraatocene 'aweredane yaasetabaabalu bamahonaacawe nawe. yasamude hhezebocene geletzenaa teleqe ta`aamerene sathanaacawe. kehedatene fatzamu. qethaataacawene 'afathanenawe. bamale'eketanyoce 'ejoce ta`aameraatocene yamenaadaregawe hhezebocaacawe 'enedifarunaa ('enedithanaqaqunaa) la'alaahe fetzume taazaazhe 'enedihonu nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! "geetaahe baxaayaalenatu sawocene yaakaababa nawe" baquthetheru sere naacawe bamaalate yanagarenehene 'asetawele. 'alaahe ka'enaresu yethabeqehale. 'enedetaadarese yataazazekawene male`ekete 'aderese. ba"seraa'e" lalite batachabaache ba`aayenehe yatamalakatekawene yaasaayanehe sawocene lamafatane nawe. 'ewenate nawe belawe yeqabalutaale wayenese hhasate nawe yelutaale?! la'enaresu lasawoce fatanaa 'enedihone 'eneji baqure'aane yatathaqasacewene ya"zaqume" zaafene kajahhaname sere 'enedetebaqele 'alaadarageneme. ba'enazihe hulate ta`aameraatoce kaalaamanu baleeloce ta`aameraatoce liyaamenu 'ayecelume. ta`aameraatocene bamaawerade (bamaamethaate) senaasefaraaraacawe kehedataacawe yechameraale; bathemate wasane yaalefaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lamalaa'eketoce la'adame segadu bamaalate senenageraacawe yahonawene 'asetaawese. yehe segedate ya'akeberote salaametaa madafaate magonebase 'eneji ya'amelekote segedate 'ayedalame. hulume te`ezaazune bamafatzame la'adame sagadu nagare gene belise 'eneene ka'esaate fatherahe kacheqaa lafatharekawe 'esagedaalahune!? 'enee ka'eresu 'ebalethaalahu bamaalatenaa bamakuraate la'adame masegade 'emebi 'ala.

belise lageetaawe 'enedihe 'ala 'enedesagedelate bamaazaze ka'enee yaasebalathekawene yehene fetherate 'eseka `aalame fetzaamee kaaqoyakxanye 'aneta yathabaqekaacawe theqitoce siqaru 'amelekotene laaneta becaa netzuhe yamiyaadaregu lejocune kaqathetanyaawe manegade 'anesharaatetaacawaalahu, 'athamemaacawaalahu.
'alaahe 'enedihe 'alawe - hide 'eseka `aalame fetzaamee teqoyaalahe; 'esaate la'anetanaa 'anetane lataazazuhe yatamwalaa yaszeraacehu menedaa yehonaale.

wada hathi'ate bamithaaraa demetzehe, 'anetane wada mataazaze bamithaaru farasanyocehe 'egeranyocehe chukxate kanaresu letaataalele yametecelawene 'ataalele. yaselaamene marehoce yamiqaaranu nagarocene webe 'aderego bamaasaayate baganezabaacawe, bazemute lejocene bamaaferaate 'enaa bahhasate yalejoce baalabeetenatene bamamogate 'enedihume baseyaameeyaacawe ka'alaahe weche yamiganyu 'amaaleketocene 'amelaaki 'enedihonu bamaaderage balejocaacawe tagaaraacawe. hhasatanyaa qatharowocenenaa, yaweshate tasefaawocene (menyotocene) webe 'aderegelaacawe. shayethwane yamisathaacawe yatasefaa qaale (qatharo) yamaataalale hhasatanyaa qatharo nawe.

belise hoye! te`ezaazeene bamitagaberu 'amaanye 'agalegaayocee laaye selethaane yalaheme. 'alaahe tanekolehene yemaleselaacawaale. banagarocu laaye ba'alaahe laaye latadagafa sawe mamakiyaanate la'alaahe baqaa.

yasawe lejoce hoye! geetaacehu banegede terefenaa baleeloceme szeraawoce sisaayaacehune 'enedetefalegu marekabene babaahere laaye yaasegwaazalaacehu nawe. 'enazihene manegadoce qalaale bamaaderagu 'eresu la'enaaneta 'azaanye nawe.

thaa`otaawiyaane hoye! mathefaataacehune 'eseketefaru derase babaahere guzo laaye fatanaanaa 'asecagaari nagaroce sigathemwacehu ka'alaahe weche yametaamalekwaacawe nagaroce ka'a`emero'acehu (kahhasaabaacehu) yethafaalu. yametaasetaawesute 'esune becaa yehonaale. 'eredaataawene 'enedisathaacehu temaatzanutaalaacehume. 'eredaataawene sisathaacehu, kaferehataacehu salaame siyaadaregaacehunaa wada yabese setewathu 'eresune becaa kamaamelakenaa kamamaatzane tezoraalaacehu. wada thaa`otocaacehu temalasaalaacehu. yasawe leje ya'alaahene tzagaawoce kahadi nawe.

thaa`otaawiyaane hoye! wada yabese basalaame siyaasewathaacehu 'alaahe mederene 'enedamaayedaramesebaacehu tamaamanaacehune! baluthe hhezeboce laaye 'enedaadaragawe kasamaaye denegaaye 'enedamiyaazanebebaacehu tamaamanaacehune?! kaziyaame kathefaate yamithabeqaacehu yamikalaakalelaacawe radaate 'ayenoraacaweme.

wayenese bamajamariyaa siyaadenaacehu ya'alaahene tzagaawoce bamakaadaacehu mekeneyaate. wada baahere badegaami 'enedamaayemalesaacehu 'enaa beretu nefaasene 'enedamaayelekebaacehu 'enedihume 'enedamaayaasamethaacehu tamaamanaacehune?! kaziyaame 'enaanetane lamaredaate ba'enaaneta laaye selaadaragenawe yamithayeqane 'ataaganyume.

ya'adamene zereyaawoce 'a`emero bamasethatenaa malaa'eketocene la'abaataacawe 'enedisagedu bamaaderagenaa baleeloceme nagaroce kebere sathanaacawe. bayabese laaye yamigwaagwaazubatene magwaagwaazhaawoce babaahere laaye yamigwaazubaacawene marekaboce yatagaru 'adaragenelaacawe. yamimagabwacawene, yamithathwacawene tzotaawi felaagotaacawene yamifatzemubaacawene malekaame nagaroce lagasenaacawe. kabezu fetherataate bathaame 'asebalathenaacawe. ya'alaahene tzagaawoce liyaamasagenu yegabaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'eyaanedaanedu budene (sebesebe) bamederaawi `aalame batamesaaleetenate bamikatalawe mariwe yamenetharaabatene `elate 'asetawele. yaszeraacawene matsehhafe baqanye 'eje yatasathaacawe matsehhafaacawene badasetaa yaanabebaalu. katamere feree wesethe yamiganyawene kere yaahele 'anasetanyaa bihone 'enekwaa kamalekaame szeraacawe menedaacawe 'anedaaceme 'ayeqaneseme.

bazihe mederaawi `aalame 'ewenatene kamaqabalenaa la'ewenate taazaazhe kahona lebonaawe yataawara batenesaa'ee `elate kaziyaa yakafaa 'ewere yehonaale. yajanatene manegade 'ayemaraame. kaqenu manegade yathamama nawe. waagaa yamikafalawe 'enedayaszeraawe nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! thaa`otaawiyaane wada 'aneta kaawaradenawe qure'aane liyaazoruhe (liyaanesharaatetuhe) 'enaa kasemeete zenebaaleewoce gaare yamithaathaame ba'enyaa laaye leelaane 'enedetedarese liyaadaregehe qarebawe nabare. yafalagutene yehene betefatzeme wadaaje baadaraguhe nabare.

ba'ewenate laaye tzenaate 'enedinoruhe malekaame baanaadaregelehe 'emenatene 'enediqabalu yaalahe gugute bathaame kafetanyaa bamahonu 'enedihume seeraacawe 'ataalaayenataacawe thanekaaraa bamahonu yaaqarabulehene mekera hhasaabe leteqabalenaa kafile yaahelene wada 'enaresu letezanabale qarebahe nabare. nagare gene wada 'enaresu kamazanebale thabaqenehe.

baaqarabulehe hhasaabe wada 'enaresu betezanabale bamederaawi `aalamenaa bamacharashaawe `aalame derebe qethaatene 'enaaqamesehe nabare. kaziyaame ka'aneta qethaatene yamimaleselehe ba'enyaa laaye yamiradaahe 'ataaganyeme nabare.

kahaadiyaane ba'aneta laaye baalaacawe thalaatenate 'asechaneqawe kamakaa liyaasewathuhe qarebawe nabare. bageetaahe te`ezaaze 'eseketesadade derase kamakaa 'enedaayaasewathuhe 'alaahe kalakalaacawe. biyaasewathuhe 'aneta kawathaahe baxwaalaa yatheqite yaahele gizee 'eneji leelaane 'ayeqoyume nabare.

ka'aneta baxwaalaa theqitene becaa 'eneji yamaayeqoyu yamahonaacawe ferede ka'aneta baqadamu male'eketanyoce wesetheme yamiganye ya'alaahe qwaami hege nawe. yekxaweme maanenyaaweme male'eketanyaa hhezebocu kahagaraacawe (kamahakalaacawe) siyaasewathute 'alaahe qethaatune (bahhezebocu laaye) yaawaredebaacawaale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lazihe qwaami kxidate (hegaacene) talawaache 'ataaganyelateme. yelequneme qwaami yamaayeqayare hono taaganyawaalahe.

tzahaye ka'ekula samaaye kametezanabalebate gizee 'aneseto tzahhaye 'eseketethaleqe derase (yehe yazehurenaa ya`asere salaatene yaakaatetaale) balalite chalamaame (yehe yamageribenaa ya`ishaa waqetocene yaakaatetaale) batamwalaa huneetaa bataqamathalaacawe gizeeyaatoce bamafatzame salaatocene segade. yafajereneme salaate segade bafajere salaate wesethe nebaabehene razheme 'aderege. bafajere salaate waqete yalalitenaa yaqane malaa`eketoce yeganyaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kalalitu kefele bakafilu gizee basegedatehe tachamaari yakafetaa darajaawoce 'enedinorehe, batenesaa'ee `elate sawoce kamiganyubate 'asechanaaqi yatenesaa'ee `elate huneetaa lasawoce 'amaalaaje 'enedetehone 'aderego geetaahe 'enedaqasaqasahe bamaasabe tanasenaa segade. yamajamariyaawenaa yamacharashaawe teweledoce yamiyaamasagenute taalaaqe ya'amaalaajenate kebere (darajaa) la'aneta yehonaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale - geetaayee hoye! magebiyaayeenenaa mawechiyaayee bamulu 'anetane bamataazazenaa 'aneta bametewadawe nagare laaye 'aderegawe; ka'aneta zanede bathalaatocee laaye baresu delene yametesathanye geletze maaserajaane 'aderegelenye.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa thaa`otaawiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe - selaame mathetwale. 'alaahe yasathawe yadele qatharo 'ewene honwale. kehedatenaa ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekote tagaarine yamaaderage tagebaare tawagedwale hhasate thafinaa dabezaazhe nawe. ba'ewenate fite tzenu 'ayehoneme.

kaqure'aane lamaayemenate lakehedatenaa therethaaree yalebe bashetaawoce fawese yahonane sinababe la'akaale lasawenate fawese yamisathe yahonane, lamitagaberute 'amaanyoce 'ezenate yahonane 'enaawaredaalane. yehe qure'aane lakahadiyaane yamichamerawe thefaatene becaa nawe. mekeneyaatu qure'aanene maademathe yaaseqochaacawaale. hhasate nawe maalatenaa karesu maraaqene yechamerelaacawaale.

theenaanaa habetene yamasalu tzagaawocene lasawe leje senelagese 'alaahene kamaamaseganenaa kamataazaze (yasawe leje) yaafanagethaale. bakuraate yereqaale. bashetaanaa dehenate yamasaasalu nagaroce siyaaganyawe dagemo ka'alaahe 'ezenate beretu tasefaa qoraache yehonaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale. 'eyaanedaanedu sawe yaraasune huneetaa bamimasele yaraasu manegade (seletenaa 'akaaheede) yeszeraa. geetaacehu wada 'ewenate manegade yabalatha yatamaraawene yaaweqaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yamatsaahhefete baalabeetoce yahonu kahadiyaane sela "nafese" menenate yethayequhale. 'enedihe balaacawe - yanafesehene menenate ka'alaahe basetaqare yamiyaaweqe yalame. 'enaanetanaa thaqelaalaa fetherataate ka'eweqate yatasathaacehu ka'alaahe `eweqate gaare banetzetzere sitaaye bathaame theqite nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'alaahe 'emelaalahu. wada 'aneta yaawaradenawene malakotaawi male`ekete kalebonaawocenaa kamatsaahhefete laaye bamaanesaate (bamaathefaate) lenewasedawe benefalege 'enewasedawe nabare. kaziyaame yamiradaahenaa xaalaafinate wasedo yamimalesehe 'ataaganyeme.

nagare gene bageetaahe 'ezenate mekeneyaate (malakotaawi male`eketune) 'alewasadenaweme. yelequnese yatathabaqa 'aderegane 'aqoyanawe. geetaahe 'anetane male'eketanyaa bamaaderagu; yanabiyaate madamedamiyaa bamahonenaa qure'aaneneme ba'aneta laaye bamaaweradu yageetaahe cerotaa ba'aneta laaye bathaame teleqe nawe.

musherekoce yehee qure'aane sawoce yaminaagarute 'ayenate nawe belo leelaa qure'aane 'enedimathaalaacawe xasaabe baaqarabu gizee kacaalu 'eresune yamimasele 'enedeyaamathu thayaqaacawe.
thaa`otaawiyaane yehe qure'aane sawoce yaminaagarute 'ayenate nagare nawe bamaalate mekeneyaate yamiyaaqarebu bamahonaacawenaa 'enedilawathe ('enediqayare) hhasaabe bamaaqerabaacawe 'alaahe tamasaasaayune 'enediyaamathu bamathayaqe fataanye theyaaqee siyaaqarebelaacawe 'enedihe 'ala. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe - yasawe lejocenaa 'agaanenetoce bamulu yehene qure'aane lamaamethaate bisabaasabunaa kafilu yakafilu 'agaazhenaa radaate bihone 'enekwaa baretu`enatu bawebe qeneberunaa bametheqatu bafetzume 'eresune yamimasele 'ayaamathume.

bazihe qure'aane wesethe lasawe lejoce; 'emenate 'enediqabalu bamafalage bawesethu gesaatzeene kamisathu mekeroce, temeheretocenaa huluneme `aayenate kelekalaawoce, taarikoce leyu leyu nagarocene bamaaberaaraate galatzaa 'adaragene. nagare gene bezu sawoce yehenene qure'aane maqaawamene (kehedatene) marathu.

thaa'o`otaawiyaane yatathayaqutene yaqure'aane 'amesaayaa maamethaate sisaanaacawe lamafataatane yatalayaayu hasaabocene masanezare jamaru.
yamikatalawene hasaabe bamaaqerabe 'enedihe 'alu - bamakaa medere yamifasenaa yamaayenathefe meneche 'esekametaafaleqelene derase 'anaameneleheme.
wayeneme bezu zaafoce yaalute baseru baxaayele wanezoce yamifasubate ya'atekelete seferaa 'esekinorehe derase 'anaameneleheme.

wayeneme 'enedathaqasekawe samaayene yaqethaate quraache 'aderegahe 'awaredebene wayeneme yametemogetawe nagare tekekele mahonune 'enedimasakarulehe 'alaahenenaa malaa`eketocene batachabaache 'amethaa.

wayeneme bawareqenaa baleeloce nagaroce yatashaqothaqotha beete yenurehe. wayeneme wada samaaye wethaa. wada samaaye betewathaame 'aneta male'eketanyaa 'enedahoneke yamenaanabawe yatatzaafa matsehhafe ka'alaahe zanede yezahe kaalewaradeke male'eketanyaa mahonehene 'anaameneme. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe geetaayee theraate yegabaawe 'eneda leeloce male'eketanyocu sawenaa male'eketanyaa 'eneji leelaane nagare nanyene?! 'anedeme nagare yamaamethaate selethaane yalanyeme. 'enedeete yathayaqaacehutene maamethaate 'ecelaalahu?!

ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe kamaamane male'eketanyaawe yezote yamathaawene male`ekete kamatagebare yakalakalaacawe male'eketanyaawe kasawe zare mahonune makaadaacawe nawe. yehene bamaqaawame 'enedihe 'alu 'alaahe wada 'enyaa sawe yahona male'eketanyaa lekwaalene?!

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe maleselaacawe bamareete laaye yaminorutenaa 'enedanaanetawe taragaagetawe yamiheedu malaa`eketoce bamedere laaye binoru wada 'enaresu zeriyaacawene male'akene 'eneleke nabare. mekeneyaatume yatalaakabatene male`ekete liyaaseradaacawe liyaaseganazabebaacawe yamicelawe male'ake nawe. yasawe zeriyaane wada 'enaresu male'eketanyaa 'aderego yamalaake thebabe mekeneyaataawi 'ayedalame. 'enedazihume ya'enaaneta huneetaa yehene yemaselaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! "'enedihe bale 'enee wada 'enaaneta yatalaakunye male'eketanyaa selamahoneenaa wada 'enaaneta yatalaakubatene male`ekete selamaaderasee ba'eneenaa ba'enaaneta makaakale lamesekerenate ba'alaahe baqaa". 'alaahe yabaariyaawocune huneetaa yaakaababa hulune 'awaaqi nawe. kahuneetaacawe karesu 'enedaaceme nagare 'ayesawareme. yanafesocaacawene mesethiroce hulu tamalekaace nawe.

'alaahe qathetanyaawene manegade yamamaraate sekeetene yasathawe sawe ba'eregetheme qathetanyaawene manegade tamaretwale 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yatawaacawenaa yaathamamaacawene wada 'ewenate yamimarwacawe 'enaa mathefowene yamikalakalubaacawe theqeme yamiyaamathulaacawe radaatocene 'ataaganyelaacaweme. bafitaacawe 'eyatagotatu batenesaa'eewe `elate 'enesabasebaacawaalane. 'ayaayume; 'ayenaagarume; 'ayesamume. yamiyaarefubate manoriyaacawe jahaname nawe. yajahhaname walaafane babarada quthere maqathaathalune 'enechamerelaacawaalane.

yehe yamiyaaganyute yaqethaate menedaa bamale'eketanyaacene laaye yaawaradenaacawene 'aneqatzoce bamakaadaacawe mekeneyaate nawe. kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase ruqe 'enedahona bamaasabe 'enedihe yelu nabare. kamotenenaa yabasabasu 'athenetoce yatabataatanu 'akaalaatoce kahonene baxwaalaa 'eneda 'adise fethure kaziyaa baxwaalaa 'eneqasaqasaalane?

kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase manorune lamaqaawame 'athebeqawe yayaazutene makaraakariyaa sithaqese 'alaahe 'enedihe sile malese sathaacawe::
kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yamiyaasetabaabelu 'enazihe sawoce samaayaatenenaa mederene kanagezefataacawe yafatharawe 'alaahe 'enaresune yamimasele mafethare caaye mahonune 'ayaawequmene? gezufene nagare lamafethare yamicele kaziyaa yamiyaanesene nagare mafethare caaye nawe. bamederaawi `aalame heyewataacawe yamifatzamebatene yatawasana gizeene 'alaahe 'aderegolaacawaale. meneme therethaaree laleelabate maqaseqasaacaweme yagizee wasanene gadabene 'aderegwaale. kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase manorune yamithaqumu maaserajaawoce geletze kamahonaacawe gaare thaa`otaawiyaane kehedatene 'eneji leelaane 'emebi 'alu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enazihe thaa`otaawiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe. yamaayaaleqawenenaa yamaayenathefawene yageetaayeene ya'ezenate kemecete baalabeetoce betehonu 'enedaayaaleqebaacehu bamaferaatenaa deha 'enedaatehonu, kamalagase teqothabu nabare. 'emenate yataqabala kaalehona basetaqare yasawe leje batafathero sesetaame nawe. 'amaanye ya'alaahene menedaa falego yelagesaale.

nabiyu kathaa'o`otaawiyaane yaagaathamaacawe maasetabaabale katakasata baxwaalaa matzenaanyaa 'enedihonaacawe musaa kafire`owenenaa kahhezebocu gaare yaalawene taarike bamatheqase 'enedihe 'ala.
lamusaa maaserajaa yamihonutene zathanye geletze meleketoce sathanawe. 'enaresume bateru, 'eju, dereqe, rahabe, yamerete maqanase, yaweha maa`ebale, 'anebathaa, qemaale, 'enequraaritenaa dame naacawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! qadametoce 'enazihene ta`aameraatoce musaa yezo bamathaalaacawe waqete yatakasatawene 'ayehudaawiyaanene thayeqaacawe; fire`owene 'enedihe 'alawe musaa hoye! bametaamathaacawe 'enegedaa nagaroce mekeneyaate degemete yatadaragabehe 'enedahoneke 'egametaalahu.

musaa lafire`owene malese bamasethate 'enedihe 'ala fire`owene hoye! 'enazihene ta`aameraatoce yaawaradawe yasamaayaatenaa yamareete geetaa yahonawe 'alaahe mahonune 'eregethanyaa honahaale. xaayaalenatunenaa male'eketanyaawe 'ewenate mahonune yamithaqume 'aderego 'aweredwacawaale. nagare gene kehedatene fatzameke. fire`owene hoye! 'aneta thafinaa kasaari mahonehene 'aweqaalahu.
fire`owene musaanenaa takataayocune kagebetze bamaasewathaate liqathaacawe falaga. 'eresunenaa karesu gaare yanabarutene szaraawitocune bamaasemathe 'athafaanaacawe.

fire`owenenaa szaraawitu kathafu baxwaalaa la'eseraa'eele lejoce 'enedihe 'alenaacawe bashaame medere sefaru yatenesaa'eewe `elate sihone wada masabesabiyaawe lameremaraa hulaacehuneme 'enaamathaacexwaalane.

yehenene qure'aane ba'ewenate bamuhhamade laaye 'awaradenawe. saayelawathenaa saayezaanafe ba'ewenate ba'eresu laaye waredwale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahene lamifaru sawoce bajanate beseraatene yametesathe lakahadiyaane, lahathi'atanyocenaa lawasane 'alaafiwoce ka'esaate yametaasethanaqeqe 'aderegane 'eneji 'alelaakeneheme.
lamaganezabenaa lamaasetawaale yebalethe yamiradaa bamahonu ba'eregaataa basawoce laaye 'enedetaanabawe qure'aanene yataberaaraa 'aderegane 'aweredanawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe baresu betaamenume 'emenataacehu meneme 'ayechamerelateme; baresu baataamenume kehedataacehu meneme 'ayeqanesebateme. yaqadamu samaayaawi matsaahhefetene yaanababunaa malakotaawi male`eketenaa nabiyenatene yaawaqu qure'aane sinababelaacawe 'alaahene lamaamasegane bafitaacawe bamadafaate yesagedaalu.

basegedataacaweme wesethe 'enedihe yelaalu - qaalekidaanune kamaaferase geetaacene theraate yatagabaawe hona. muhhamadene male'eketanyaa 'aderego 'enedamileke yagabaawe qaale kidaane yefatzamaale bazihenaa baleeloce gudaayoce yageetaacene qatharo yekasataale therethaaree yalaweme.

bafitocaacawe la'alaahe yamisagedu honawe yewadeqaalu. 'alaahene bamaferaate yaalaqesaalu. qure'aanene maademathenaa male`eketocune maasetawaale la'alaahe manebarekakenaa 'alaahene maferaatene yechamerelaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe hoye! 'aleraahemaane hoye! bamaalate yametaadaregawe yatamaatzeno therine lataqaawamahe sawe 'enedihe bale 'alaahenaa 'aleraahemaane ya'alaahe semoce naacawe. 'alaahe malekaame semoce 'alute 'enazime hulate semoce ka'enaziyaa wesethe naacawe. ba'enaresunaa baleelocu malekaame semocu 'alaahene tamaatzanute. basalaatehe wesethe thaa`otaawiyaane 'esekisamuhe derase banebaabe demetzehene kafe 'ataaderege. 'enedihume 'amaanyoce masemaate 'esekamaayecelu deraseme demetzehene 'atesawere. bahulatu huneetaawoce makaakale maa'ekalaawi manegade falege.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale! la'alaahe mesegaanaa yatagabaa yehune; laziyaa yamesegaanaawoce `aayenate laresu tagabi lahonawe; laziyaa lejene kamayaaze theraate yatagabaawe. ka'amelekote tagaari yatharaa lahonawe. banegesenaa wesethe tagaari yalaweme. weredatenaa dekaame fetzume 'ayenakaaweme. yamiradaawenaa yamiyaathanaakerawe 'ayaasefalegaweme. bataalaaqenatume 'aleqawe. lejene, tagaarine banegesenaawe wesethe radaatenaa 'agaazhene 'ataaderegelate.

ba'agalegaayunaa bamale'eketanyaawe muhhaamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye qure'aanene laawaradawenaa yehenenu qure'aane yatazaanafanaa ka'ewenate yaazanabala laalaadaragawe geetaa la'alaahe becaa bamelu`enaa balaaqu baaheriyaatocu, bageletzenaa sewere tzagaawocu wedaasee yatagabaa nawe.

yelequneme kahaadiyaane 'alaahe zanede kamithabeqaacawe beretu qethaate yamiyaasefaraaraa yamiyaasethanaqeqe 'enedihone gechetocenaa leyunatoce yaleelubate qathetanyaa 'adaragenawe. malekaame szeraawocene lamifatzemu 'amaanyoce 'acaa yamaayeganyelate malekaame menedaa 'enediyaaganyu yamiyaasedasetaacawene yenageraacawaale.
baziyaa menedaa wesethe zala`aalame yenoraalu. 'ayeqwaarathebaacaweme.
'alaahe leje 'alawe bamaalate yatanaagarutene 'ayehudaawiyaanene, keresetiyaanocenenaa, kafile thaa`otaawiyaanene yaasethanaqeqaale.

la'enaziyaa hhasate tanaagaariwoce 'alaahe leje 'alawe bamaalate lamimogetute qethefate `eweqatenaa maaserajaa yalaacaweme. 'enedihume bachefene yatakatalwacawe 'abaatocaacaweme bazihe laaye `eweqate yalaacaweme. yaalamaasetawaale ka'anedabataacawe yametemathaawe yeheci qaale tzayaafenaa bathaame kabaade hona. maszaratenaa marajaa yaleelawe hhasatene 'eneji 'ayenaagarume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bazihe qure'aane baalamaamanaacawe bahhazanenaa baquchete raasehene letaathafaa tedaresaalahe. yehene 'ataaderege. qathetanyaawene manegade 'enedimaru yamaaderage gedeetaa yalabeheme. xaalaafinatehe (male'ekete) maaderase becaa nawe.

'enyaa yatenyocu 'alaahe yamiwadawene malekaame szeraa 'enedamiszarunaa yatenyocu dagemo mathefo 'enedamiszaru lamafatanenaa huluneme 'enedamigabaawe lamamanedaate sibaale bamareete gatzetaa laaye yamiganyu fetherataatene lamareete webate 'adereganaacawaale.

bamareete gatzetaa laaye yamiganyu fetherataatene takele yaleelabaacawe 'afare 'enaadaregaacawaalane. yehe yamihonawe bamareete laaye yamiganyu fetherataate heyewate siyaabaqaa nawe. baziheme ligasatzu yegabaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yawaashaawe sawoce taarikenaa semocaacawe yatatzaafabate saleedaacawe ka'asegaraami ta`aameraatocaacene 'enedahona 'ataasebe! yelequneme samaayaatenaa mederenenaa yamasalu leeloce nagaroce mafethare yebalethe yamiyaasedamemu naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'emenataacawe belawe shashetawe wada waashaawe bamagebaate. "geetaacene hoye! lahathi'ataacenene meheratene bamalagase kathalaatocaacene bamaaraaqe ka'aneta zanede yahona 'ezenatene sethane. kakehedate wada 'emenate yaadaragenawene sedate wada 'ewenatanyaawenaa qathetanyaawe manegade mamaraate 'enedihone 'aderegelene. bamaalate geetaacawene balemanaa yatamaatzanutene 'amaanye wathaatoce huneetaane 'asetaawese ('awesaa).
kaziyaame wadawaashaawe katagwaazunaa kagabu baxwaalaa demetzocene 'enedaayesamu bajorowocaacawe laaye geredoshene 'adaragenebaacawe. labezu 'amataate `eneqelefeme thaalenebaacawe.

kaziyaame karazheme 'eneqelefaacawe baxwaalaa bawaashaawe yaqoyetaacawe yagizee rezemate mathane mene yaahele 'enedahona kamikaraakaru hulate budenoce tekekelanyaawene yagizee rezemate yamiyaaweqawe yatenyaawe nawe yamilawene `eweqataacenene yefaa (geletze) lamaaderage (ka'eneqelefaacawe) qasaqasenaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! taarikaacawene therethere baleelabate 'ewenate 'enaasaaweqehaalane. bageetaacawe yaamanu wathaatoce nabaru. te`ezaazune fatzamu. yaqenune manegade sekeete ba'ewenate laaye tzenu mahonene chamarenelaacawe.

lebocaacawene ba'emenate laaye bamatzenaate 'enedihume la'emenate sibaale hagarene laqo masadadene yamitaagase thanekaaraa 'adaragenawe. kahadi bahonawe neguse fite qarebawe ba'alaahe becaa 'enedamiyaamenu 'emenataacawene yefaa siyaadaregu 'enedihe 'alute - "baresu yamenaamenebatenaa yamenaamalekawe geetaacene yasamaayaatenaa yamedere geetaa nawe. karesu weche yamiganyu hhasatanyaa 'amaaleketocene bafetzume 'anaamalekeme. karesu weche yamiganyu hhasatanyaa 'amaakeletocene kaamalakene ka'ewenate yaraaqa yabadale qaalene ba'eregethe tanaagara.

'erese ba'eresaacawe bamatayaayate 'enedihe 'alu - 'enaho hhezebocaacene ka'alaahe weche yamiyaamalekwaacawene 'amaaleketoce 'adaragu. sela 'amelekwaacawe geletze marajaa yalaacaweme. ba'alaahe laaye tagaarine bamaaderage ba'alaahe laaye hhasatene kamiqathefe yabalatha badalanyaa yalame.

kahhezebocaacehu setegalalu (raasaacehune setaagalelunaa) ka'alaahe weche yamiyaamalekwaacawene nagaroce setetawe 'enedihume 'alaahene babecanyenate setaamaleku ba'emenataacehu bamashashe wada waashaawe hidu. kebere yatagabaawe geetaacehu kathalaatocaacehu yamithabeqaacehune 'ezenatune yezaragaalaacexwaale. bahhezebocaacehu makaakale kamanore meteke yamihonwacehune yametethaqamubaacawene nagaroce geetaacehu qalaale yaadaregelaacaxwaale.

yataazazutene fatzamu. 'alaahe 'eneqelefe laqaqabaacawe. kathalaatocaacawe thabaqaacawe. tzahhaye kameseraaqe setewathaa (kawaashaacawe) wada qanye 'azanebelaa temalakataalahe. wada magebiyaawaa setethaleqe wada geraa taazanabelaalace. waashaawene tzahaye 'ayaaganyaweme. baqwaami thelaawoce wesethe nabaru. yatzahhaye nedaade 'ayaasecageraacaweme. bawaashaawe wesethe 'ayare (nefaase)naa yamiyaasefalegwaacawene nagaroce bamiyaaganyubate safi huneetaa wesethe nabaru. wada waashaawe magebaataacawe, `eneqelefe yatathaalabaacawe mahonu, tzahhaye ka'enaresu mazanebalewaa, seferaacawe safi mahonunaa kahhezebocaacawe natzaa mawethaataacawe 'enazihe lanaresu yatakasatu nagaroce ya'alaahene xaayaalenate yamithaqumu ya'alaahe 'asedamaami szeraawoce naacawe. 'alaahe qathetanyaawene manegade sekeete yasathawe sawe 'eresu ba'ewenate yatamaraa nawe. kaqathetanyaawe manegade ('alaahe) yatawawenaa yaathamamawe sawe wada qathetanyaawe manegade yamimaraawe yamiyaamalaaketawe radaate 'ataaganyelateme. mekeneyaatume qathetanyaawene manegade yamamaraate sekeetene masethate ba'alaahe 'eje yaala gudaaye nawe.

`aayenocaacawe kefete bamahonaacawe (bamahonu) yanaqu 'enedahona taasebaalahe. nagare gene ba'eneqelefe wesethe naacawe. ba'eneqelefaacawe wesethe mareete ('afare) sawenataacawene 'enedaayebalaawe ba'anede waqete wada qanye baleelaa gizee dagemo wada geraa 'enaagalaabethaacawaalane. kanaresu gaare 'abero yanabarawe weshaa bawaashaawe magebiyaa laaye kenedocune zaregetwale. betemalakataacawenaa huneetaacawene betaaye baferehaate jarebaahene sathetahe teshashaacawe nabare; nafeseheme badenegaathee yemolaa nabare.

ka'asedamaami xaayaalenataacene (celotaacene) kalaaye yatatarakawene banaresu laaye 'enedaadaragenawe 'enedazihume ba'eneqelefe yaasaalafute gizee mene yaahele 'enedahona kafilu kafilocune 'enedithayeqe karazheme gizee baxwaalaa ka'eneqelefaacawe qasaqasenaacawe. kafilocu malese sathu 'anede mulu qane wayeneme ya'anedene qane kafile gizeene ba'eneqelefe 'asaalefanaale kanaresu makaakale geetaacehu ba'eneqelefe wesethe yaqoyaacehubatene gizee yaaweqaale. yazihe gudaaye `eweqate la'eresu tawete. bamimalakataacehu gudaaye laaye tekurate 'aderegu. wada menaaweqawe katamaa yehene yabere maa`edene ganezabe 'aseyezaacehu 'anedaacehune laakute. kakatamaawe nawaariwoce makaakale theru megebe yaalawene sawe yemalekatenaa gazeto yemethaa. wada katamaawe sigabaanaa siwathaa 'enedihume sigabayaaye theneqaaqee yaaderege; belehe yehune; bathaame bezu gudaate selamiyaasekatele 'anedeme sawe yameteganyubatene botaa 'enedaayaaweqebate yaaderege.

hhezebocaacehu katamalakatwacuhenaa seferaacehune kaawaqu badenegaaye wagerawe yegadelwacexwaale. wayeneme 'alaahe wada 'ewenatanyaawe 'emenate yamamaraate tzagaawene saayesathaacehu bafite qadamete wadanabaraacehubate yatazaanafawe ya'emenate manegadaacawe yemaleswacexwaale. wadaziyaa (ya'emenate manegade) katamalasaacehu bamederaawi `aalame, bamacharashaaweme `aalame madehene 'ataaganyume. yelequneme 'alaahe yamaraacehune 'ewenatanyaa 'emenate bamatawaacehu 'enaa wadaziyaa yatazaanafa ya'emenate manegade bamamalasaacehu mekeneyaate kabaade keseratene tekaseraalaacehu.

'enedazihume razheme `aamataatene ba'eneqelefe wesethe 'enedihonu bamaaderagenaa kaziyaame ka'eneqelefaacawe maqaseqase xaayaalenataacenene yamithaqume 'asedanaaqi tagebaare 'enedaadaragenawe yakatamaawe nawaariwoce 'alaahe 'amaanyocene yamiradaa mahonu 'ewenate 'enedahona, tenesaa'ee yamimathaa therethaaree yaleelawe gudaaye selamahonu 'enediyaawequ (yawaashaawene sawoce) 'enedimalakatwacawe 'adaragene. yawaashaawe sawoce gudaaye bageletze yamitaawaqe sihonenaa yawaashaawe sawoce simotu yatamalakatwacawe sawoce 'enaresune batamalakata mene maaderage 'enedamigabaa bahhasaabe talayaayu. kafilocu "bawaashaacawe magebiyaa laaye yamigaaredaacawenaa yamithabeqaacawe genebaataa seru; geetaacawe sela huneetaacawe yaaweqaale. huneetaacawe 'alaahe zanede yatalaya kebere 'enedaalaacawe yethaqumaale" bamaalate tanaagaru. `eweqate 'enedihume tekekelanyaa yahona maaserajaa yaleelaacawe nagare gene tadamaachenate yanabarwacawe kafilocu (sawoce) "la'enaresu kebere masethatenaa darajaacawene lamaasetaawase bazihe botaacawe laaye 'amelekote yamidaragebatene masejede 'eneganabaalane" bamaalate tanaagaru.

taarikaacawene yamizabaarequ wesene sawoce sela qutheraacawe 'enedihe yelaalu. "szosete naaca; weshaacawe 'araatanyaacawe nawe" leeloce dagemo "'amesete naacawe; weshaacawe sedesetanyaacawe nawe" yelaalu. hulatume budenoce yaminaagarute yaala marajaa gemetene takatelawe nawe. leeloce dagemo "sabaate naacawe weshaacawe semenetanyaacawe nawe" bamaalate yenaagaraalu. male'eketanyaacene hoye! "geetaayee qutheraacawene (batekekele) yaaweqaale" balaacawe. qutheraacawene yamiyaawequte 'alaahe qutheraacawene yaasaawaqaacawe theqite sawoce becaa naacawe. basesu theleqate baleelawe huneetaa kalaaye becaa 'eneji yamatsaahhefetu baalabeetocenenaa leeloceneme sela qutheraacawenaa sela leelaa huneetaacawe 'atekaraakare. sela 'enaresu gudaaye bawaradalehe malakotaawi male'ekete tagadabe. yamaayaawequ bamahonaacawe selazerezere gudaayaacawe kanaresu 'anedaacaweneme 'atethayeqe.

'aneta nabeye hoye! naga maszeraate selametefalegawe gudaaye "yehene gudaaye naga 'eszaraawaalahu" 'atebale. mekeneyaatume gudaayune baregethe yameteszaraawe mahonune wayeneme bagudaayunaa ba'aneta makaakale yamiyaadanaaqefe nagare yaagaathemehe 'enedahona 'ataaweqeme. yehe lahulume muselimoce yatasatha mekere (marehe) nawe.

"ba'alaahe feqaade naga 'eszaraawaalahu" bamaalate deregitune ka'alaahe feqaade gaare 'asetasaasere. yehene maalate kazanagaahe "ba'alaahe feqaade" bamaalate geetaahene 'awesaa. 'enediheme bale "geetaayee qenune manegade bamamaraatenaa basekeete kazihe gudaaye yebalethe qerebe wada honawe 'enedimaraanye 'emanyaalahu".
yawaashaawe sawoce bawaashaacawe wesethe szosete mato zathanye `aamataate qoyu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bawaashaacawe wesethe yaqoyubatene gizee 'alaahe yaaweqaale bale. yaqoyetaawe rezemateme nageronaale. ka'alaahe negegere baxwaalaa yamaaneme negegere botaa 'ayesathaweme basamaayaatenaa bamedere bafetheratenaa ba`eweqate yatasawaru nagaroce (yaruqe mesethiroce `eweqate) hulu ya'eresu ya'alaahe becaa naacawe. ya'alaahe `eyetaa leyu nawe! huluneme yemalakataale. ya'alaahe masemaate 'ejege leyu nawe! huluneme nagare yesamaale. karesu weche sela gudaayaacawe yamiradaacawe yalaacaweme. baferedu maaneneme 'ayaagaaraame. 'eresu baferede becanyaa nawe.

'alaahe ferede la'eresu becaa 'enedahona sigaletze male'eketanyaawe kamamariyaawe (kaferedu) yawaradalaacawene malakotaawi male`ekete 'enediyaanabunaa 'enedikatalu 'azazaacawe. 'enediheme 'ala -
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe kaqure'aane wada 'aneta baawaradawe malakotaawi male'ekete szeraa. ya'alaahe qaale hulume 'ewenatenaa fetehawi bamahonu talawaache yalaweme. ka'alaahe weche yametethagaabate mathagiyaa, karesu weche kamiganyu 'akaalaate yametethabaqebate thabaaqine 'ataaganyeme.

'amelekotene la'alaahe becaa therete bamaaderage geetaacawene thwatenaa maataa ba'amelekotenaa balemanaa kamimaatzanute gaare gwaadanyaa bamahone raasehene 'asetaagese. kahabetaamocenaa baalatzagaawoce gaare maqamathe falegahe 'enaresune tetahe leelaa 'atemalekate. lebu laaye bamaashagaacene (bamadefanaacene) mekeneyaate 'enyaane kamaasetaawase lebonaawene zenegu yaadaragenawenaa kazuriyaaheme yaalu dehoceneme zore 'enedetaadarege yaazazahene, geetaaweneme kamataazaze yeleqe yanafesune felaagote yaasedamamawenaa szeraaweme bekenatenaa thefaate yahonabatene sawe 'enedaatetaazaze.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lebocaacawe zenegu bamahonu 'alaahene kamaasetaawase lamiyaafeezute 'enedihe balaacawe - wada 'enaaneta yezhee yamathaahute 'ewenatene nawe. ka'enee saayehone ka'alaahe zanede yamathaa nawe. 'amaanyocene 'enedaabaarere lametaadaregulenye theri malese yamesathe 'ayedalahume. ka'enaaneta makaakale bazihe 'ewenate maamane yafalaga 'emenatene yeqabale. bamiyaaganyawe menedaa yedasataale. bazihe 'ewenate makaadene yafalaga yekaade. yamithabeqawe qethaate yamikafaa yehonaale. kehedatene bamamerathe nafesocaacawene labadalu sawoce ba'atherocu yamikababubatene jahhanamene 'azagaajetanaale. kaziyaa maamelathe (mashashe) 'ayecelume. kamiyaaganyaacawe kabaade themaate yatanasaa 'eredaataane bithayequ kafetanyaa muqate baalawe, deferese zayete yamimasele weha yesathaacawaale. bathaame muqate yaalawe bamahonu fitaacawene yeqaqelawaale. yehe yamisathaacawe fasaashe yakafaa mathathe nawe themene 'ayeqoretheme. yelequneme themene yechameraale qodaacawene yamigashalethawene nabalebaale 'ayaathafaame. yamiyaarefubate 'esaate yakafaa manoriyaa nawe.

'alaahe labadalanyoce yaazagaajawene qethaate kathaqasa baxwaalaa la'amaanyoce yaazagaajawene kebure menedaa (yaszeraa waagaa) 'enedihe sile thaqasa.
'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru teleqe (menedaa) yaszeraa waagaa 'alaacawe. 'enyaa szeraawene malekaame yaadaraga sawene menedaa 'anaathafaame. yelequneme meneme saayeqanese menedaacawene batamwalaa huneetaa 'enesathaacawaalane.

ba'emenatenaa bamalekaame szeraawoce yamigalatzute 'enazihe sawoce zala'alame yamiqoyubate janatene yaaganyaalu. bamanoriyaawocaacawe sere yajanate thaafaache wanezoce yefasesaalu. bawareqe 'anebaaroce yewaabaalu. kasesenaa kawaferaame hhare yatasaru 'aranegwaadee lebesocene yelabesaalu. bawebe magaarajaawoce baageethu 'alegaawoce laaye yedagafaalu. yaseszeraacaweme waagaa bathaame malekaame nawe. yaminorubate janate yaamaara manoriyaa nawe.

'alaahe ya'amaanyocenenaa yabadalanyocene menedaa kagalatza baxwaalaa lahulatume mesaaleewocene 'aseqamatha.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'amaanyenaa kahadi yahonu yahulate sawoce mesaalee tarekelaacawe. lakahadiwe sawe hulate yawayene 'atekelete seferaawoce 'adaragenelate (sathanawe) ya'atekelete seferaawocune zuriyaa batamere zaafoce kababenawe. ba'atekeletocume mahale bamiganyawe kefete botaa laaye 'aze`eretocene 'abaqalene.

hulume ya'atekelete seferaawoce yatamere, yawayene, ya'aze`erete fereeyaacawene sathu. meneme 'alaagodalu. yelequneme babaqinaa batamwalaa huneetaa (fereeyaacawene) sathu. wehane baqalaalu 'enedithathu bamahakalaacawe yawaneze weha 'afasasene.

yahulatu ya'atekelete seferaawoce baalabeete leeloce hhabetocenaa fereewoce nabarute. baaledarabaawe yahonawene 'amaanye sawe tatze`eno liyaadaregebate siyaanaagerawe bakuraate 'enedihe 'ala. 'enee ka'aneta yabalatha ganezabe, ka'aneta yatashaala kebere 'alanye. zamadoceeme thanekaaroce naacawe.

(kahadiwe sawe) bakehedatenaa baraasu bamagarame nafesune yabadala hono 'amaanye baaledarabaawene bamayaaze wada 'atekelete seferaawe gabaa. kahadiwe 'enedihe 'ala qwaami 'enedihone yamiyaasefalegu nagarocene selaamwalaahu "yehe yametemalakatawe ya'atekelete seferaa yamithafaa 'ayemaselanyeme."

'enedazihume yatenesaa'ee `elate yamikasateme 'ayemaselanyeme heyewate 'enedihu yeqathelaale. tenesaa'ee takasata bibaale 'enaa kamote taqaseqeshee wada geetaayee bemalase 'enekwaa kamaqaseqasee baxwaalaa kazihe ya'atekelete seferaayee yatashaala mamalashaa 'aganyaalahu bamederaawi heyewatee habetaame mahonee kamaqaseqaseme baxwaalaa habetaame 'enedamehone yaaseganazebaale.

'amaanye baaledarabaawe 'eyatakaraakarawe 'enedihe 'alawe. "'abaatehene 'adamene ka'afare fathero kaziyaame 'anetane kafetewate thabetaa wanede 'aderego 'akaalehene bamaasetakaakale yatamwalaa sawe 'aderego yafatharahene geetaahene kaadekene?! yehene hulu maaderage yacaala (fathaari) kamote baxwaalaa liqasaqeseheme yecelaale."
nagare gene 'enee yehene negegerehene 'alenaagareme. 'enee yamelawe "'eresu theraate yatagabaawe 'alaahe geetaayee nawe. ba'amelekote ba'eresu laaye 'anedeneme 'alaagaaraame."

wada 'atekelete seferaahe setegabaa mene 'ala 'enedihe betele noro "ya'alaahe feqaade hona; 'anedeme sawe ba'alaahe bihone 'eneji belehaate yalaweme; yafaqadawene yamiyaadarege 'eresu 'alaahe nawe. beretuwe 'eresu nawe". 'enee ka'aneta yaanasekunye daha 'enaa yaanasu lejoce yaalunye mahoneene betemalakateme.

'enee 'alaahe ka'aneta ya'atekelete seferaa yatashaala 'enedamisathanye tasefaa 'adaregaalahu. ba'atekelete seferaahe laaye kasamaaye thefaatene (qethaatene) lekobate ya'atekelete seferaahe takele yaleelabate 'egerocene yamiyaadaalethe lemuthe mareete 'enedamihone ('egametaalahu).

wayeneme ya'atekelete seferaawe weha bamareete wesethe sathemo (sarego) 'enedithafaanaa bameneme `aayenate manegade letedaresebate yamaatecelawe 'enedamihone ('egametaalahu) ya'atekeletu seferaa weha wada mareete wesethe kasathama (kasaraga) ya'atekelete seferaawe liqathele 'ayeceleme.

'amaanyu sawe yagamatawe 'ewene hona. ya'atekelete seferaawene lamaasaamarenaa lamaasetakaakale baawathaawe wachinaa yawayene fereewe bamidaradarebate yadaase genede laaye 'atekeletu bamulu bamawedaqume 'ejege bamatzatzatunaa bamaqochatu bezaate ya'ejocune madaafoce maagalaabathune qathala. 'enediheme 'ala "waa" menyotee mene 'ala geetaayeene becaa baamene 'enaa ba'amelekoteme laaye ka'eresu (ka'alaahe) gaare 'anedeneme baalaagaaraa noro."

yehe kahadi sawe yawaradabatene qethaate likalaakalulate yamicelu budenoce 'alenabaruteme. 'eresu babudenocu yefokere nabare. 'alaahe ya'atekelete seferaawene 'enedaayaathafaabate makalaakaleme 'alecaalame.

bazihe huneetaa laaye ('enedihe `aayenate 'adagaa sidarese) 'eredaataa masethate ya'alaahe becaa nawe. 'eresu 'alaahe la'amaanye wadaajocu yatashaala menedaane sachi nawe. menedaacawene derebe yaadaregelaacawaale. yaamaara fetzaameeme la'enaresu nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba`aalamaawi heyewate lamitaalalu sawoce mesaaleene 'aseqamethe. ya`aalamaawi heyewate thafinatenaa bafethenate tafatzaami yamahonu mesaalee kasamaaye 'enedaawaradenawe yazenaabe weha nawe. bazihe weha yamedere takeloce baqalu; gomaru. 'enazihene takeloce kafilaacawene nefaase wada leelaa 'aqethaachaa yamiwasedaacawe yatasabaabarunaa yatabataatanu honu. mareete qademo wadanabaracebate tamalasace. 'alaahe huluneme nagare caaye nawe. yamisaanawe nagare yalame. yafalagawene heyaawe yaadaregaale; yafalagawene yaathafaale.

ganezabenaa lejoce ba`aalamaawi heyewate yamiwaabubaacawe nagaroce naacawe. 'alaahe bamiwadawe tagebaare laaye yatalagasa kaalehona basetaqare ganezabe bamacharashaawe `aalame thaqameetaa yalaweme. 'alaahe zanede tawadaaje yahonu szeraawocenaa negegeroce ba`aalamaawi heyewate wesethe kamiganyu geethoce hulu yatashaala menedaa 'alaacawe. yehe yasawe leje tasefaa yamiyaadaregawe yatashaala nagare nawe. mekeneyaatume yamederaawi `aalame webatoce thafi naacawe. yatawadadu (yamesegune) szeraawocenaa negegeroce menedaa gene 'alaahe zanede qari nawe.

taraarocene kaseferaacawe yamenaasewagedebatene `elate 'asetaawese. balaayewaa laaye yamiganyu taraaraawoce, zaafocenenaa genebaataawoce bamawagadaacawe mareete geletze honaa temalakataalahe. huluneme fetherataatene 'enesabasebaacawaalane. 'anedeme fethure saayeqasaqase 'ayeqareme.

sawoce bageetaahe (ba'alaahe) fite basalefe yeqarebaalu. yemarameraacawaale. 'enediheme yebaalaalu "becaacehune yaala machaamiyaa; yaaletaarazaacehunaa bamajamariyaa 'enedafatharenaacehu 'ereqaanaacehu honaacehu wada 'enyaa mathaacehu. yelequneme kamote baxwaalaa 'enedamaateqasaqasunaa 'enyaa baziyaa yaszeraacehune waagaa yametemanadubate gizeenaa botaa la'enaaneta bafetzume 'enedaalaadaragene mogetaacehune nabare.

(baziyaane gizee) yaszeraawoce mazegabe yeqamathaale kafilu matzehhafune baqanye 'eju yeqabalaale; kafilu matsehhafune bageraa 'eju yeqabalaale. yasawe leje hoye! kahadiyaane mazegabaacawe wesethe yamiganyawene yafaru honawe temalakataalahe. mekeneyaatume bawesethu yaaseqadamutene kehedatenaa hathi'ate yaaweqaalu. 'enediheme yelaalu - "waa! thefaataacene waa! makaraacene. yehe tenesheme yehune teleqene yamaayetawe yaszaraanawene hulu thabeqo yaasafara (yaqothara) mene `aayenate mazegabe nawe?" ba`aalamaawi heyewataacawe yaszarutene hathi'ate tatzefonaa taragaagetho 'aganyute. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe maaneneme 'ayebadeleme. 'anedeme sawe yaalahathi'atu 'ayeqathaame. la'eresu taazaazhe yanabarawene sawe yataazaazhenate waagaaweneme qenethaate 'ayeqaneseme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lamalaa'eketoce la'adame ya'akeberote segedatene 'aderegulate senelaacawe yahonawene 'asetaawese. shayethaane becaa siqare yageetaacawene te`ezaaze lamafatzame hulume bagenebaaraacawe la'adame tadafu. ka'agaanenetoce 'eneji kamalaa`eketoce 'alenabarame. bagenebaaru lamadafaate koraa 'emebitanyaa hona. kageetaawe te`ezaaze 'afanagatha. sawoce hoye! 'eresunenaa lejocune ka'enee weche yametewadaajute wadaaje 'aderegaacehu teyezuwaacawaalaacehune?! 'enaresu ya'enaaneta thalaatoce naacawe. 'enedeete thalaatocaacehune wadaaje 'aderegaacehu teyezaalaacehu?! 'alaahene wadaaje 'aderego bamayaaze meteke shayethwanene ya'enaresu wadaaje yaadaragu badalanyoce tagebaare bathaame yakafaa tzayaafe hona.

ka'enee weche (wadaajoce) radaatoce 'aderegaacehu yayaazaacexwaacawe 'enaziyaa 'enedanaanetawe baariyaawoce (fethuroce) naacawe. yasamaayaatenaa yamedere fetherate mesekeroce 'alaadaragekwaacaweme 'enediyaaweme (baziyaane waqete) yataganyume 'alenabarume. bakafilaacawe mafathare kafilaacawene 'alaasemasakarekume. bamafetharenaa sere`aata `aalamune bamaasetanaabare 'enee becanyaa nanye. kasawenaa ka'agaanenete shayethwanoce 'athemaamiwoce radaate 'aderegee yameyeze 'ayedalahume. 'enee karadaate yatabeqaaqaahu nanye.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe bamederaawi `aalame baresu laaye ya'amelekote tagaari laadaragu sawoce "tagaariwoceene 'enaziyaa ya'enee tagaari 'enedahonu yamogataacexwaacawene tagaariwocene yamiradwacehu kahona therwacawe" yamilebatene yatenesaa'ee `elate 'asetaawese. (tagaari yaadaragwaacawene hhasatanyaa 'amaaleketoce) yethaaraalu. latheriyaacawe malese 'ayesathwacaweme 'ayeradwacaweme. ba'amelaakiwocunaa batamalaakiwocu makaakale yamigaarute thefaate (wedematene -yajahaname 'esaatene) 'adaragene.
thaa`otaawiyaane 'esaatene batachabaache tamalakatu. baziyaa wesethe 'enedamigabume mulu 'eregethanyoce honu. ka'esaate yamishashubatene seferaa 'ayaaganyume.

bamuhhamade laaye bawaradawe bazihe qure'aane wesethe 'enediyaasetaawesunaa 'enedimasakeru bezu `aayenate mesaaleewocene ba'eregethe galetzanaale. nagare gene yasawe leje (batalaye kahadiyaane bezu yamisetawaalebaacawe nagare) bahhasate yaala 'ewenate takaraakaari mahone nawe.

bachefene getere kahadiyaane 'enaa muhhamade kageetaawe yezote bamathaawe male`ekete bamaamane makaakale, ba'enaresunaa bahathi'ataacawe ka'alaahe meheratene bamathayaqe makaakale geredoshe yafatharawe yagalatzaa 'etherate ('ayedalame) baqure'aane wesethe mesaaleewoce taqamethawelaacawaale. geletze maaserajaawoce mathetolaacawaale. yagaaradaacawe bageterenate baqadamu teweledoce laaye yawadaqawene (yatakasatawe) qethaate banaresu laaye 'enediwadeqe ('enedikasate) 'enaa yataqatharute qethaate tachabaache hono 'enediyaayute mathayaqaacawe nawe.

male'eketanyocaacenene yamenelekawenaa la'emenatenaa 'alaahene lamitaazazu sawoce beseraate 'enedisathu yakehedatenaa yahathi'ate sawocene 'enediyaasethanaqequ nawe (male'eketanyoce) lebonaawocene (baxaayele) 'emenate yamiyaashakemubate selethaane yalaacaweme. ba'alaahe yakaadu sawoce marajaawoce gelatze bihonulaacaweme bahhasataacawe bamuhhamade laaye yawaradawene 'ewenate lamaasewagade male'eketanyocene yekaraakaraalu. qure'aanene 'enaa 'enedithanaqaqu yatanagaraacawene gudaaye masaaqiyaanaa maafeezheyaa 'adaragu.

bageetaawe 'aneqatzoce gesaatzee 'enedatasathawenaa (ba'aneqatzocu) wesethe lamiganyu yaqethaate qatharowocene caletanyaa 'enedahona sawe badalanyaa yalame (ba'aneqatzocu) gesaatzeewocene kamawesade zora. bamederaawi heyewate yaaseqadamawene kehedatenaa hathi'ate rasaa. neseha 'alaadaragame. yehene `aayenate baaheri baalaacawe sawoce lebe laaye qure'aanene maganezabe (maradaate) yamikalakelaacawene geredoshe 'adaragene. joro'acawe qure'aanene maademathe yamaayecele 'adaragenawe. yamaqabale maademathene 'ayaadamethume. balebaacawe laaye shefaane (geredoshe), bajoro'acawe laaye denequrenaa (maademathe 'alamacaale) 'esekaala derase wada 'emenate betetharaacawe theri wada metaadaregelaacawe nagare bafetzume malese 'ayesathume.

nabiyu male'eketaacawene yaasetabaabalu sawoce fathaane qethaate 'enediyaaganyaacawe gugute 'enedaayenoraacawe. 'alaahe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - "'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! banesehaa lamimalasu baariyaawocu geetaahe hathi'atene mahhari nawe. huluneme nagare yasafaa 'ezenate (baalabeetenate) yaalawe nawe. sela 'ezenatume hathi'atanyoce baneseha wada 'eresu 'enedimalasu gizeene yesathaacawaale. 'eresu 'alaahe 'enazihene 'afanegaachoce yamiqathaa bihone bamederaawiwe `aalame qethaatene (yaafathenebaacawe) nabare. nagare gene 'alaahe taagaashenaa 'azaanye nawe. banesehha 'enedimalasu qethaatune 'azagayalaacawe. yelequneme baneseha kaaletamalasu bakehedataacawenaa ba'afanegaachenataacawe yamimanadubate yatawasana gizeenaa botaa 'alaacawe. ka'alaahe weche mathagiyaane 'ayaaganyume.

'eneda hude, swalihe, shu`ayebe, hhezeboce katamoce ka'enaaneta baqerebate yameteganyawene kahadi katamaane (nawaariwocwa) bakehedatenaa hathi'ate nafesocaacawene sibadelu 'athafaanaacawe. yamithafubateneme yatawasana yagizee qatharo 'adaragene.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! musaa la'agalegaayu yusha`e bene nune 'enedihe sile batanaagara gizee yahonawene 'asetaawese. yahulate baaheroce magaathamiyaa seferaa 'esekidarese derase magwaazeene 'alaaqwaaretheme. wayeneme malekaamune ya'alaahe baariyaa 'esekamenaaganyenaa karesu `eweqatene 'esekamenewasede derase razheme gizeene 'egwaazaalahu.

hulatume (musaanaa 'agalegaayu ) tagwaazu. yahulatu baaheroce maganaanyaa seferaa sidaresu laseneqe yayaazutene `aasaacawene zanagu. 'alaahe `aasaawene heyaawe 'adaragawe. wehawe ka'eresu gaare saayegaache 'eneda "siredaabe" babaaheru wesethe manegadune qadada.
yaane botaa 'alefawe sishaagaru musaa la'agaazhu 'enedihe 'ala:- yamesaa megebe 'aqerebelene. bazihe guzo'acene baregethe beretu dekaame 'agenyetonaale."

'agalegaayu 'enedihe 'ala:- wada qwaathenye denegaayu senethagaa yatakasatawene tamaleketahalene?! sela `aasaawe gudaaye 'anetane maasetaawase zanagaahu. 'enedaalaasetaawesehe yaasezanagaanye shayethwane nawe. `aasaawe heyaawe hono nabare. bamiyaasedameme huneetaa babaaheru wesethe manegadune qadada (yaaza).

musaa la'agalegaayu 'enedihe 'ala - "yamenefalegawene yehene nabare yehe yamalekaamu ya'alaahe baariyaa yamiganyebate melekete nawe. kamanegade 'enedaayethafu wada qwaathenyu denegaaye 'esekidaresu derase ya'egerocaacawene faanaa 'eyatakatalu wada xwaalaa tamalasu. kaziyaame wada `aasaawe magebiyaa botaa darasu.

`aasaawe yathafaabate seferaa sidaresu 'eziyaawe botaa kamalekaame baariyaawocaacene 'anedu yahonawene ka'enyaa yahona 'ezenatene yasathanawene, sawoce yamaayaawequtene ka'enyaa yahona `eweqate yaasaawaqenawene, baariyaa 'aganyu.
musaa raasune zeqe bamaaderagenaa basere`aate 'enedihe 'alawe. "'alaahe kaasetamaarahe `eweqate mari yahonawene 'enedetaasetamerane lekatalehene?"
kxadere "'aneta zanede kamiganyawe `eweqate gaare yamaayesemaamaa bamahonu sela `eweqatee bametemalakatawe nagare te`egesete 'ayenoreheme" 'ala.
tekekelanyaawene gatzetaa baalaawaqekebate huneetaa kametemalakataacawe tagebaaroce 'enedeetese te`egesete maaderage yecaalehale. mekeneyaatume ba`eweqatehe kafetaa mathane ferede tesathaalahe.
musaa 'enedihe 'ala "bametaamalekaacawe selameteszaraacawe szeraawoce ba'alaahe feqaade te`ezaazehene bamaakebarenaa baalamathaase baazazekanye te`egesetanyaa honyee taaganyanyaalahe.
kxadere lamusaa 'enedihe 'ala - katakatalekanye 'enee raasee (yatadaragabatene) gatzetaa (ya`eyetaa maa`ezane) 'esekaalegalatzekulehe derase seszaraa selametemalakatawe gudaaye 'enedaatethayeqanye."

bazihe sememenate laaye sidaresu 'aneditene marekabe 'esekamiyaaganyu derase wada baaheru daarecaa guzo'acawene qathalu. bamarekabwa laaye (baalabeetocu) lakxadere kebere lamasethate bamafeqadaacawe yaala kefeyaa tasaafaru. kxadere yamarekabitwane 'enechate ganethelo marekabitwane maqedade jamara. bazihene gizee musaa 'enedihe 'alawe - "baalabeetocu yaala kefeyaa yaasaafarunene marekabe katasaafaariwocwa 'enedetesamethe tenadelaataalane?! teqadedaataalahene?! kabaade deregitene fatzameke."
kxadere lamusaa 'enedihe 'ala:- ka'enee bametemalakatawe te`egesete maaderage 'ateceleme 'alaalekuhemene?!
musaa lakxadere 'enedihe 'ala - "yagabaahulehene qaale bamaresaatenaa bamatawee 'ateyaazanye. gwaadanyenatehene 'ataathebeqebenye; nagaroceneme kabaabaade 'ataaderegebenye."

kamarekabitwa kawaradu baxwaalaa wada baaheru daarecaa 'eyataraamadu tagwaazu. kalejoce gaare yamichaawate la'akaala mathane yaaledarasa lejene tamalakatu. kxadere gadalawe. musaa 'enedihe 'alawe:: "yaala 'anedaace thefaate la'akaala mathane yaaledarasa netzuhe nafesene tegadelaalahene?! weguze tagebaarene fatzameke.
kxadere lamusaa 'enedihe 'ala - "musaa hoye! selametefatzemawe nagare 'aneta te`egesete 'ayenoreheme beyeehe nabare."

musaa 'enedihe 'ala - "kazihe baxwaalaa sela 'anedeme gudaaye kathayaqeku talayanye. te`ezaazehene szosetee yathaaseku bamahonee 'aberonateene lamatawe mekeneyaate yamiyaasathe baqi me`eraafe laaye daresahale."

'anedite katamaa 'esekidaresu 'aberawe tagwaazu; kanawaariwocwa megebe thayaqu. yakatamaawaa nawaariwoce megebe bamasethate yaalabaacawene ya'enegedenate mabete liyaakaberu 'alefaqadume. bakatamaawe wesethe liwadeqenaa lifarese yadarasa. yatazanabala 'athere tamalakatu. kxadere 'atheru qathe 'esekile derase 'asetakaakalawe. musaa lakxadere 'enedihe 'ala - "betefaqede 'atherune bamaasetakaakalehe kefeyaa letethayeqenaa ba'enegedenate selaaletaqabalune selamiyaasefalegane (kefeyaawene) leteyezawe tecelaalaahe."

kxadere lamusaa 'enedihe 'ala - "'atherune 'asetakaakeyee kefeyaa baalamathayaqee yaasamaakxawe yehe taqaawemo ya'eneenaa ya'aneta yamalayaayaa botaa nawe. seferaawe selatamalakatekawenaa te`egesetene maaderage selaalecaalekebate yagudaayune mesethire 'enagerehalawe."

selaqadaadakute yataqaawamekanye marekabe gudaayene batamalakata marekabitwa babaahere laaye bareswa (baziyaace marekabe) yamiszaru dakaamoce (neberate) nabarace. marekabaacawene makalaakale 'ayecelume. theru marekabocene hulu baxaayele yamiwasedenaa nawere yaalabaacawene marekabocene yamitawe neguse selanabare marekabitwane 'enedaayewasedaate gudelate yaalaate marekabe 'enedetehone falageku.

lamene gadalekawe bamaalate yataqaawamekanye leje gudaayene batamalakata 'abaatenaa 'enaatu 'amaanyoce nabaru. 'eresu gene ba'alaahe 'eweqate kahadi nabare. la'akaala mathane kadarasa walaajocu kaleke baalafa wedeetaa selamiyaafaqerute wayeneme bathaame selamiyaasefalegaacawe 'alaahene wada makaade 'enedaayewasedaacawe faraahu.
karesu ba'emenatu, bamalekaamenatunaa kahathi'ate netzuhe bamahonu yatashaala leje 'enaa lawalaajocu yabalatha 'azaanye yahona 'alaahe 'eneditakaalaacawe falagekunye.

yaasetakaakalekutenaa selaasetakaakalekuteme yataqaawamekanye 'athere gudaayene batamalakata yaheedenebatene katamaa nawaari yahonu hulate hetzaanaate neberate nabare. 'abaataacawe motwale. ka'atheru sere la'enaresu yataqabara habete nabare. ya'enazihe hulate hetzaanaate 'abaate malekaame sawe nabare. musaahoye! geetaahe 'enediyaadegunaa la'akaala mathane 'enedidaresu kaziyaame ka'atheru sere yataqabara (habetaacawene) 'enediyaawathu falaga. 'atheru biwadeqe habetaacawe yefaa yehonenaa labekenate yegaalathaale. yehe szeraa geetaahe lanaresu baalawe 'ezenate (reheraahee) yahona nawe. baraasee therate 'aleszaraahuteme. te`egesete letaadaregebate yaalecaalekawe gudaaye mesethire yehe nawe.
