'alaahe yakxaderene taarike sithaqese bamakaakalaacawe tesesere yaala bamahonu yazuleqarenayenene taarikeme thaqasa. hulatume (kxaderene zuleqarenayene) dakaamocene lamathabaqe therate 'aderegawaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! thaa`otaawiyaanenaa 'ayehudaawiyaane lamafatane sela zuleqarenayene yethayequhale. 'enedihe bale:- " kataariku gesaatzeene yametewasedubatene kefele 'anabelaacexwaalawe."
bamareete laaye mecotene (selethaanene) sathanawe. lamifalegawe nagare hulu maganyate 'asefalaagi yahonu (madaarashaa nagarocenaa manegadocene) hulu 'amacaacanelate (sathanawe).
wada felaagotu lamaderase yasathanawene manegadocenaa (madaarashaawoce) yaaza 'aqethaachaawene wada me`eraabe 'adaraga.

batzahhaye mathelaqiyaa 'aqethaachaa kamareete macharashaa 'esekidarese bamareete laaye tagwaaza. tzahhayewaane basegaa `aayenu kathequre cheqaa yametefaleqe muqe meneche wusethe setethaleqe 'ayaate. bamathelaqiyaa botaa laayeme kahadiyaane yahonu hhezebocene 'aganya. bamerechaa maleke 'enedihe 'alenawe. "zuleqarenayene hoye! 'enazihene sawoce (sela thefaataacawe) bamagedaleme hona baleelaa nagare qethaacawe wayeneme malekaame 'aderegelaacawe."

zuleqarenayeneme 'enedihe 'ala:- "ba'alaahe laaye ya'amelekotene tagaari yaadaraganaa 'alaahene 'enediyaamaleke theri kaadaragenelate baxwaalaa baziyaawe laaye getere yahonane bamederaawi `aalame 'eneqathaawaalane. kaziyaame batenesaa'ee `elate wada geetaawe ('alaahe) yemalasaale. 'asedanegaache qethaateme yeqathaawaale.

kanaresu makaakale ba'alaahe yaamananaa malekaame szeraa yaszaraa janatene yaaganyaale. ba'emenatunaa bamalekaame szeraawe mekeneyaate kageetaawe yamisathawe menedaa nawe. sela gudaayaacene lazabetaanaa reheraahee yaalabatene 'enenagerawaalane.
kaziyaame kamajamariyaawe manegade bataqaaraani wada tzahhaye mawechaa 'aqethaachaa manegadene takatala.

tzahhaye wadametewathaabate ba`aayenaszegaawu lamaayate yamiyaasecelawune seferaa 'esekidarese derase tagwaaza. katzahhaye yamikalaakalenaa yamithabeqaacawe beete thelaanaa zaafoce kaleelaacawe hhezeboce zanede tzahhaye setewathaa (gohe siqade) darasa.
'enedazihume zuleqarenayene te`ezaaze satha. `eweqataacene (ya'alaahe `eweqate) 'eresu yaalawene xaayelenaa selethaane zerezere yaakabara nawe.
kaziyaame kamajamariyaawocu hulate manegadoce bameseraaqenaa bame`eraabe 'agedeme leelaa manegadene takatala.
bahulate taraaraawoce makaakale yamiganye kefete botaa 'esekiyaaganye derase tagwaaza. kataraarocu fite lafite yaleeloce sawocene negegere yamaayeganazabu hhezebocene 'aganya.

"zuleqarenayene hoye!" 'alute "ya'ejujenaa ma'ejuje (goge maagoge) (ya'adame zereyaa yahonu hulate teleqe hhezeboce maalataacawe nawe). bamifatzemwacawe gedeyaawocenaa baleeloce tagebaaraatoce bamedere laaye beleshunatenaa cegerocene 'abezetawaale. (mederene 'abalaashetawaale). ba'enyaanaa ba'eresu makaakale geredoshe 'enedetaadarege ganezabe 'enesethehene?!

zuleqarenayene 'enedihe 'ala "geetaayee yalagasanyene negesenaanaa selethaane kametesathunye ganezabe la'enee yatashaala nawe. basawe xaayelenaa bamasaariyaawoce 'agezunye. ba'enaanetanaa ba'eresu makaakale geredoshene 'adaregaalahu."

yaberate quraachocene 'amethu (yaberate quraachocene 'amathu). bataraaraawocu mahakale baberetu maganebaate jamara. bagenebaataawe 'ekule siyaadaregaacawe "banazihe yaberate quraachoce laaye 'esaate 'aqathaathalu" sile szaraatanyocune tanaagara. yaberate quraachocu qaye feme sihonu bazihe laaye yamifasawene nahase 'amethulenye 'ala.
ya'ejujenaa ma'ejuje kafe yaala bamahonu liwathute 'alecaalume. thanekaaraa bamahonume kasere libasute 'alecaalume.

zuleqarenayene 'enedihe 'ala - "yehe gadabe kageetaayee yahona 'ezenate nawe. baya'ejuje 'enaa bama'ejuje 'enedihume bamedere laaye bamifatzemwacawe beleshetoce cegeroce makaakale (cegeroce) yehonaale. yekalaakalaacawaale. katenesaa'ee bafite 'enedamiwathu 'alaahe yawasanawene waqete simathaa kamareete gaare 'ekule yaadaregawaale; yaafaresawaale. yehene maafaraarasunaa ya'ejujenaa ma'ejuje 'enedamiwathu 'alaahe yagabaawe qatharo tzenu nawe 'ayelawatheme.

(bamacharashaawe zamane) kafile sawoce bakafilocu yewaakabaalu. 'erese barese yedabalaalaqaalu. therunebaawe tanafaa. fetherataatene hulu lameszaraawenaa yaszeraacawene waagaa 'enediyaaganyu sabasabenaacawe.
jahanamene lakahadiyaane meneme baaletashafana huneetaa ba`aayenaacawe 'enediyaayute geletze 'adaragenawe.

bamederaawi heyewate ba`aayenocaacawe laaye yamishafenaacawe geredoshe bamanoru 'alaahene kamaasetaawase `ewere lanabaru kahadiyaane (jahanamene) geletze 'adaragenawe. ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce bataqabaayenate manefase masemaate 'ayecelume nabare.

'enaziyaa 'alaahene yakaadu sawoce yamalaa'ekete yamale'eketanyocenaa baariyaawoceene ka'enee weche yamimalaku liyaadareguwaacawe yaasebaalune?! 'enyaa jahhanamene lakahadiyaane manoriyaanate 'azagaajetanaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale - yasawe lejoce hoye! szeraawene bakafetanyaa huneetaa selakasara sawe 'anenageraacehumene?!

batenesaa'ee `elate bamederaawi heyewate yeszarute yanabarawe szeraa kanetu (bekune) honobaacawe yemalakataalu. baszeraacawe malekaame 'aderaagiwoce 'enedihonu 'enaa baszeraacawe 'enedithaqamu yaasebu (yegametu) nabare. tachabaachu huneetaa gene kazihe taqaaraani nawe.

'enazihe ya'alaahene becanyenate yamithaqumu yageetaacawene ta`aameraatoce yakaadu naacawe. kageetaacawe gaare maganaanyataacawene kedawaale. bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate szeraacawe (tagebaaraacawe) bekune hona. batenesaa'eewe `elate 'alaahe zanede kebere (botaa) 'ayenoraacawe.
'alaahene bamakaadaacawe yaawaradekwaacawene ta`aameraatocenaa male'eketanyoceene feeze 'aderegawe bamayaazaacawe yatazagaajalaacawe menedaa jahaname nawe.

'alaahe yakahadiyaanene menedaa sithaqese 'amaanyoce yamiyaaganyuteneme menedaa 'asekatelo thaqasa. 'enediheme 'ala::
'enaziyaa 'alaahene yaamanunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru kebere 'enediyaaganyu bakafetanyaa janatoce manoriyaacawe yehonaale.
baziyaa wesethe lazala'alame yeqoyaalu. (janate) yamiqarebawe 'acaa menedaa selaleela kaziyaa botaa maqayarene 'ayefalegume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! "yageetaayee qaalaatoce bezu naacawe" bale. baahere qaalaatocu yamitzaafebate qalame bihonenaa baziyaa bitzaafe ya'alaahene qaalaatoce kamaalaqaacawe bafite yabaaheru weha yaaleqe nabare. leeloce baaheroceme benaamathaa 'enedihu yaalequ nabare.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale - 'enee ba'ewenate yametaamalekubate 'amelaake (letaamalekute yamigabaawe 'amelaake) tagaari yaleelawe 'anede nawe; 'eresume 'alaahe nawe yamile malakotaawi male'ekete yamiwaredelenye ya'enaanetawe 'amesaayaa sawe nanye. geetaawene maganaanyate yamifaraa mamariyaawene yamisemaamu szeraawocenaa hhasaabune lageetaawe netzuhe 'aderego yeszeraa. bageetaawe 'ameleko maaneneme ya'amelekote tagaari 'ayaaderege.
(khy`S) kaafe, haa, yaa, `aayene, swade (yehene selamasalu yaqure'aane 'aneqatzoce babaqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye galatzaa tasathetwale.)
yehe temeherete (gesaatzee) 'enedihone ba'aneta laaye yamenetarekelehe tewesetaa (maasetaawashaa) ba'alaahe 'agalegaaye zakariyaa laaye yahonawene yageetaahene 'ezenate nawe.
kagudelate theraate yatagabaawe geetaawene ('alaahene) lemanaawe yatashaala qebulenate 'enediyaaganyenaa taqabaayenate 'enedinorawe. badebeqe (basewere) simaatzane yahonawene 'asetaawese.
'enediheme 'ala - "geetaayee hoye! 'athenetocee dakamu; yaraasee tzagure shebatoce bazu; 'anetane bamamaatzanee yaafareku 'alehoneme. yelequneme batamaatzanekuhe gizee hulu malese sathetakxanyaale.

zamadocee ba`aalamaawi heyewate baatalee bamahonaacawe ka'enee mote baxwaalaa ba'emenate gedeetaacawe laaye 'enedamaayetzanu sagaahu. misetee yamaatewalede mahane naate. ka'aneta zanede radaate yamihonanyene leje sethanye.
ka'eneenaa kayaa`eqube beetasaboce nabiyenatene yamiwarese. geetaayee hoye! ba'emenatume; basena megebaarume; ba`eweqatume yatawadada (leje) 'aderegawe.

'alaahe tamaatzenowene taqabalawenaa tharaawe. zakareyaa hoye! tamaatzenohene taqabelanehale. yamiyaasedasetehene 'enenagerehaalane. "yahheyaa yatasanya leje sathenehale. karesu bafite yehe seme yatasathawe sawe 'alaadarageneme (yalame)."

zakariyaa ba'alaahe ya'aderaaginate celotaa bamadanaqe 'enedihe 'ala - "misetee yamaatewalede mahane naate; ya`edemeenaa ya'athenete madekame macharashaa laaye dareshaalahu. 'enedeete leje yenoranyaale?!(linoranye yecelaale?)

wada 'eresu yatalaakawe male'aakete 'enedihe 'alawe:- "huneetaawe 'enedagalatzekawe ('enedatanaagarekawe nawe). misetehe 'atewaledeme. 'anetame ya`edemeenaa ya'athenete madekame macharashaa laaye daresahale. nagare gene geetaahe 'enedihe 'ala - "kamahane 'enaatenaa ba`edemeewe macharashaa laaye kadarasa 'abaate yaaheyaane mafethare qalaale nawe. zakariyaa hoye! 'anedeme yamitaawase nagare saatehone kazihe bafite fathereehalahu. yaalenabareke nabareke."

zakariyaame 'enedihe 'ala:- "geetaayee hoye! malaa'eketoce beseraate yaszathunye yehe nagare makasatune yamithaqume lebee yamiyaarefebatene melekete 'aderegelenye" yatasathahe beseraate yamakasatu melekete yaala meneme yatheenaa cegere (yelequneme mulu theenanyaa honahe) szosete lalitocene sawocene maanaagare 'alamacaale nawe" 'ala.
kasegedate botaawe wada hhezebocu wathaa. yaalanegegere bamelekete galatzalaacawe "baqane magebiyaanaa baqane macharashaa kagudelate theraate yatagabaawene 'alaahene 'awadesute."

yahheyaa tawaladalate. 'eresune maanaagare yamicaalebatene ya`edemee me`eraafe laaye sidarese 'enedihe 'alenawe - yaahheyaa hoye! 'oritene baqurethanyenatenaa bategaate yaaze. balejenate `edemeewe genezaabeene, `eweqatene, tegaatene, qurethanyenatene sathanawe.

ka'enyaa bahona "raahhemate" 'azanenelate; kahathi'ate netzuhe 'adaragenawe. ba'alaahe te`ezaazoce heyewatune yamimaraa, 'alaahe yakalakalaacawene nagaroce yamiqothabe (yamireqe) 'alaahene yamifaraa sawe nabare.

lawalaajocu malekaame 'aderaagi, ruheruhe (tehute), care nabare. 'alaahenenaa walaajocune kamataazaze yamikoraa 'alenabarame. 'enedihume 'alaahenenaa walaajocune yamiyaametze (te`ezaazaacawene yamithese) 'alenabarame.

batawaladabate `elate, bamote kazihe `aalame bamiwathaabate `elatenaa hheyaawe hono batenesaa'ee `elate bamiqasaqasebate waqete (`elate) ya'alaahe salaamenaa dahenenate baresu laaye hona. 'enazihene szosete `elatoce yasawe leje yamiyaalefebaacawe 'ejege 'asechanaaqi (me`eraafoce) `elatoce naacawe. (yasawe leje) ba'enazihe `elatoce salaame kahona kanaresu weche bamiganyu (`elatoce) ferehate yalabateme.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! bawaradalehe qure'aane wesethe kabeetasabocwa talayetaa 'enaresu bamiganyubate wada meseraaqe 'aqethaachaa labecaawaa galale setele yatakasatawene (yahonawene) yamareyamene taarike 'asetaawese.

'alaahene setaamaleke sawoce 'enedaayemalakatwate laraasewaa makalayaa magaarajaane 'adaragace. jiberilene wada 'ereswa laakenawe. mulu yatasetakaakala tafathero baalawe sawe mesele (qeretze) taayaate bamathefo tagebaare 'enedaayefalegaate faraace.
basawe qeretze 'amesaayaa 'enedahona wada 'ereswa siqarebe "'alaahene yametefaraa kahona ka'aneta mathefo nagare 'enedaayenakaanye "ba'aleraahemaane" (ba'azaanyu geetaayee 'ethabaqaalahu) 'alace.
jiberile 'enedihe 'ala - "'enee sawe 'ayedalahume. malekaamenaa netzuhe leje 'enedesatheshe wada 'aneci yatalaaku yageetaashe male'eketanyaa nanye."
mareyame bamadanaqe 'enedihe 'alace "baaleme hona leelaa wanede yaaleqarabanye sihone 'enedeete leje linoranye yecelaale? zemutanyaame 'ayedalahume"

jiberile 'enedihe 'alaate - "nagaru 'aneci 'enedatanaagareshewe nawe. baaleme hona leelaa wanede naketoshe 'ayaaweqeme. zemutanyaame 'ayedalasheme. nagare gene geetaashe 'enedihe 'ala - "yaala 'abaate lejene mafethare la'enee qalaale nawe. yehe yamihonawe yamisatheshe leje lasawoce ya'alaahene 'aderaaginate celotaa (xaayaalenate) yamiyaasaaye melekete 'enedihone 'enedihume la'anecinaa la'eresu (male'eketanyenate) lamiyaamenu sawoce 'ezenate 'enedihone nawe. yazihe lejeshe mafathare batathabaqawe saleedaa laaye yatatzaafa yatawasana ya'alaahe ferede (wesaanee) nawe.
malaa'eketu (batenefaashu) kanafaabaate baxwaalaa 'aragazace. kasawoce baraaqa botaa galale 'alace.
methe thanakarabaatenaa wada 'anede tamere zaafe sere tathagaace. mareyame 'enedihe 'alace - "menawe kazihe `elate bafite mocee bahonanaa sela 'enee mathefo 'enedaayegamate yamaaletaawase behone."
ka'egerocwawaa sere `isaa tharaate. "'atezanyi; geetaashe ('alaahe) yametethachiwene fasaashe weha 'aderegoleshaale."
yatamerune genede yaazhiwe; (ba'ejoceshe) wazewezhiwe; baziyaawe qetzebate yabasala tekuse yatamere 'eshate yeragefeleshaale.

yatamere 'eshatune tamagabi; kawehaweme thachi; kawaladeshewe leje nafeseshe 'erekaataa (dasetaa) yesamaate 'atezanyi. sawocene katamalakateshenaa selawaladeshewe leje kathayaqushe 'enedihe baye - "meneme 'enedaalenaagare baraasee laaye zemetaane gedeetaa 'aderegeeyaalahu. lageetaayee zaaree 'anedeme sawe 'alaanaagereme.
lejwane 'azelaa mareyame wada hhezebocwa heedace. hhezebocwa bataqaawemo "mareyame hoye! 'abaate yaleelawe leje yezashe bamamethaate kabaade hhasatanyaa deregitene fatzameshe" 'alwate.

'alaahene bamaamelake ya'arune ('arune malekaame sawe nabare) 'amesaayaa yahoneshewe hoye! 'abaateshe zemutanyaa 'alenabarame. 'enaatesheme zemutanyaa 'alenabaraceme. yatawaladeshewe bamalekaamenate kamitaawaqe netzuhe beetasabe nawe. 'enedeete 'abaate yaleelawe leje yezashe temachiyaalashe?!
wada lejwawaa (`isaa 'amalakatace. ba'aneqalebaa laaye nabare.) hhezebocwa bamagarame "ba'aneqalebaa laaye yamiganye hetzaane lejene 'enedeete maanaagare 'enecelaalane?!" 'alwate.
`isaa (ba'aneqalebaawe laaye 'enedaala) 'enedihe 'ala - "'enee ya'alaahe baariyaa nanye. nejelene sathetonyaale. nabiye 'aderegonyaale."
bayatenyaaweme seferaa behone lasawoce yamethaqeme yatabaarakunye 'aderegonyaale. bamulu heyewatee, salaatene 'enedesagede, metzewaatene 'enedesathe 'azezonyaale.
la'enaatee malekaame 'enedehone 'aderegonyaale. geetaayeene kamataazaze yamekoraanaa yamaametze 'alaadaraganyeme.

baweledatee `elate, bamemotebate `elate, batenesaa'ee `elate heyaawe honyee bameqasaqesebate `elate kashayethwanenaa karadaatocu salaame mahone ba'enee laaye nawe. ba'enazihe szosete 'asechanaaqi qetzebatoce shayethwane 'ayethagaanyeme.

yehe ba'enazihe baaheriyaatocu yatagalatzawe (`isaa) yamareyame leje nawe. sela'eresu yamitharaatharunaa yamilayaayu manegadene yathamamu (yasaatu) sawoce yaminaagarute qaale saayehone yehe qaale sela 'eresu 'ewenatanyaa qaale nawe.

ba`isaa gudaaye sawoce talayaayu (yatalayaayu budenoce honu). kahhezebocu makaakale kafilocu baresu bamaamane "'eresu male'eketanyaa nawe" 'alu. kafilocu lamesaalee 'ayehudaawiyaane ('eresune) kaadu. 'enedihume kafile budenoce 'eresune batamalakata wasane bamaalafe "'eresu 'alaahe nawe" 'alu. leeloce dagemo 'eresu "ya'alaahe leje nawe" bamaalate tanaagaru. 'alaahe kazihe yalaaqa hona. ba'eresu gudaaye lamilayaayute batenesaa'ee `elate te`eyenete (baziyaane `elate kaalawe 'asefari te`eyenete) meremaraanaa qethaate wayowelaacawe.

baziyaa `elate menanyaa yaadamethaalu?! menanyaa yesamaalu?! masemaate theqeme bamaayesathaacawe gizee samu. maayate theqeme bamaayesathaacawe gizee tamalakatu ('ayu). nagare gene bamederaawi heyewate badalanyaa yahonute kaqathetanyaawe manegade bageletze themate wesethe naacawe. babadalaacawe wesethe honawe badenegate 'esekimathaabaacawe derase lamacharashaa `aalame zegejete 'ayaadaregume.

fetherataate bamulu kathafu baxwaalaa 'enyaa becaa qariwoce nane. mederene 'enaa bamedere laaye yaalawene waraashoce nane. yafaqadenawene 'enaadaregaalane. baszeraacawe 'enedimaramarunaa yaszeraacawene waagaa 'enediyaaganyu batenesaa'ee `elate wada 'enyaa becaa yemalasaalu.

la'abaatu "'azare" 'enedihe bamaalate yatanaagarawene 'asetaawese "'abaatee hoye! betetharaawe tamaatzenohene yamaayesamaa 'amelekotehene yamaayemalakate cegerehene liyaasewagedelehe theqemeneme lisathehe yamaayecele thaa`otene ka'alaahe weche lamene taamalekaalahe?!"
'abaatee hoye! laresu taazaazhe bamahone shayethaanene 'ataameleke. la'adame 'enedisagede siyaazawe 'emebi bamaalate shayethwane "'aleraahemaanene" ('alaahene) 'ametswale.
'abaatee hoye! bakehedate laaye 'eyaalahe kamoteke ya'aleraahemaane (ya'alaahe) qethaate 'enedaayaaganyehe 'efaraalahu dagaafiwe bamahonehe yashayethaane gwaadanyaa tehonaalahe.

'azare laleju beraahime 'enedihe 'ala "beraahime hoye! kathaa`otocee 'afanegaache mahonehe nawene?! thaa`oteene kamaneqafe kaaletaqothabeke badenegaaye 'ewagerehaalawe. larazheme qoyetaa (gizee) ka'enee zore bale; bafetzume 'ataanaageranye. ka'enee gaare 'atehune."

beraahime la'abaatu 'enedihe 'ala:- "ka'enee laaneta salaame yederasehe; ba'enee bakule yamiyaasekafaahe nagare 'ayemathaame. kageetaayee meheratenaa qathetanyaawene manegade mamaraatene 'ethayeqelehalawe." 'eresu la'enee bathaame 'azaanye nawe."

'enaanetanenaa ka'alaahe weche yametaamalekwaacawe (thaa`otoce) talayecaalahu. (reqeeyaalahu) geetaayeene becaa 'emaatzanaalahu. baresu laaye 'anedeme nagare tagaarine 'alaadaregeme. katamaatzaneku (kaalaamaneku) 'enedamaayekalakelanyenaa 'eresune bamamaatzanee bamalamanee `edela nefuge 'enedamaayaadareganye tasefaa 'adaregaalahu.
'enaresunaa ka'alaahe weche yamiyaamalekwaacawene 'amaaleketoce sireqe beetasabune yaathaabatene meteke lejune sehhaqene, yaleje lejune yaa`eqobene sathanawe. hulatuneme nabiye 'adaragenaacawe.

nabiye kamahonaacaweme gaare ka'ezenataacene bezu malekaame nagarocene sathanaacawe. basawoce 'anedabate baqathaayenate (yamitaawase) yazalaqa malekaame wedaasee 'adaragenelaacawe. (malekaame seme 'adaragenelaacawe).
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bawaradalehe qure'aane wesethe yamusaane taarike 'asetaawese. 'eresu musaa yatamaratha leyu (sawe) nabare. nabiyenaa male'eketanyaa nabare.
kataraaraawe qanye bakule tharaanawe. 'aqerebane 'anaagarenawe. 'alaahe (baziyaa seferaa) lamusaa negegerune 'asamaawe.
ka'ezenataacene ba'eresu laaye bafatzamenawe tzagaa wanedemune 'arunene sathanawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! ba'aneta laaye bawaradawe qure'aane wesethe yasemaa'eelene taarike 'asetaawese. baqaale kidaanu 'ewenatanyaa (sawe) nabare. yasathanawene qaale kidaane yefatzeme nabare. nabiyenaa male'eketanyaa nabare.
salaatene batamwalaa huneetaa bamafatzame, metzewaatocene bamasethate, beetasabocune yaageze nabare. bageetaawe zanede yatawadada nabare.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! ba'aneta laaye batawaradawe qure'aane wesethe yaderisene taarike 'asetaawese. bathaame 'ewenatanyaanaa ya'alaahene ta`aameraatoce 'ewenate yamile ('ameno yamiqabale) nabiye nabare.
basathanawe nabiyenate tewesetaawene kafe 'adaragenawe darajaawe kafe yaala nabare.

kazakariyaa 'eseka derise derase bazihe me`eraafe yatathaqasute ka'adame 'enaa bamarekabe kanabiyu nuhhe gaare kaasaafarenaacawe sawoce kaberaahimenaa kayaa`eqobe lejoce 'alaahe yanabiyenatene tzagaane yalagasenaacawe naacawe. wada selaame qathetanyaawe manegade 'enedimaru sekeete yasathanaacawe naacawe. marethanaacawe; nabiyaate 'adaragenaacawe. ya'alaahe 'aneqatzoce sinababunaa sisamu ba'alaahe ferehaate 'eyaalaqasu yesagedu nabare.

ka'enazihe yatamarathu nabiyaatoce baxwaalaa yamathefonaa yathemate manegade takataayoce takatalu. salaatene 'abalaashu. bamifalagawe maleku salaatene 'ayefatzemume. zemutene yamasalu yanafese semeetaacawe yamifalegawene hathi'ate fatzamu. bajahaname wesethe mathefo nagarenaa weredatene yaaganyaalu.

kagudelatunaa kawasane xaalaafinatu baneseha yatamalasanaa ba'alaahe yaamana 'enedihume malekaame szeraa yaszaraa (bazihe baaheri yamigalatzu sawoce) janate yegabaalu. kaszeraawocaacawe menedaa yaanasame bihone qenethaate 'ayeqanaseme.

'aleraahemaane malekaame 'agalegaayocune 'enedamiyaasegabaacawe baruqe qaale kidaane yagabaalaacawe yamanoriyaanaa yamaarafiyaa janate. janatene yaaletamalakatu bihoneme bajanate 'amenawe nabare. ya'alaahe yajanate qaale kidaane qatharo (yaruqe mesethire bihoneme) therethere yalaweme; yemathaale.

terefe 'enaa tzayaafe qaalaatocene bajanate wesethe 'ayesamume. yelequme kafilocaacawe kafilocu yamisathutene salaametaa malaa`eketoce selanaresu yamisathwacawene salaametaa yesamaalu. yamifaqedute megebe thawaatenaa maataa yeqarebelaacawaale.
ka'agalegaayocaacene te`ezaazaacene lamifatzemunaa kakalakalenaacawe lamiqothabu sawoce yamenaawaresawe banazihe gatzetaawoce yatagalatzacewene yehecine janate nawe.

'alaahe 'eresune yamithanaqaqu sawocene menedaa sithaqese 'alaahene maferaate maalate ka'eresu te`ezaaze gaare maqome maalate mahonune siyaaseradaa 'enedihe 'ala.
jiberile hoye! lamuhhamade 'enedihe bale. malaa'eketoce 'enedihu baraasaacawe feqaade 'ayewaredume. ba'alaahe te`ezaaze nawe yamiwaredute. wadafite yamimathaawe yamacharashaawe `aalame gudaaye wayeneme yaasaalafenawe yamederaawi `aalame gudaaye, 'enedihume bamederaawi `aalamenaa bamacharashaawe `aalame makaakale yamiganyu gudaayoce hulu la'alaahe nawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe 'anedeme nagare yamirasaa 'ayedalame.

yasamaayaatenaa yamedere fathaari, baalabeetenaa yagudaayaacawe 'asetanaabaari, 'enedihume ba'enaresu makaakale yamiganyu nagarocene fathaari, baalabeetenaa yagudaayaacawe 'asetanaabaari 'eresune becaa 'ameleke. 'eresu limalake tagabi nawe. 'eresune bamaamelake laaye tzenu hune. 'amelekotene yamigaaraawe 'amesaayaanaa bethee yalaweme.
kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase manorune hhasate yamile kahadi sawe bamafeeze 'enedihe yelaale - "kamoteku baxwaalaa kaqaberee hulatanyaa heyewatene heyaawe honyee 'ewathaalahune?! yehe ruqe nagare nawe.

kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase manorune hhasate yamilawe yehe sawe kazihe bafite meneme yaalenabara hono yafatharenawe yelequneme hulatanyaawe mafathare kamajamariyaawe mafathare bathaame yaqalala mahonune 'ayaasetaaweseneme?! yamajamariyaawene mafathare lahulatanyaawe mafathare maaserajaa maaderage yecaalaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bageetaahe 'emelaalahu kaasaasaatwacawe shayethwanoce gaare 'agodaanyetane wada masabesabiyaawe seferaa kaqaberaacawe 'enaawathaacawaalane. kaziyaame bagulebataacawe tanebarekekawe wada jahaname magebiyaawoce tawaaredawe yenadaalu.
kaziyaame ka'eyaanedaanedu yathemate budene mariwocaacawene (bakabaade 'amatzanyaa yanabarutene) baxaayele 'enegotetaacawaalane.
'enedazihume jahaname lamagebaatenaa qaathalowenenaa seqaayune lamaqemase tagabi yahonutene 'enyaa 'enaaweqaacewaalane.

yasawe lejoce hoye! ka'enaaneta wesethe bajahhaname wagabe laaye yatazaragaawene qachene deledeye (siraathe) yamaayeshaagare yalame. yehe mahonu 'alaahe yawasanawe yatafatzama wesaanee nawe. ya'alaahene wesaanee yamishere (yamimalese) yalame.

kaziyaame kazihe ya"siraathe" mashaagare baxwaalaa te`ezaazocune bamafatzamenaa kelekelocune bamaraaqe geetaacawene yefaru yanabarutene salaame 'enaadaregaacawaalane. badalanyocene bagulebataacawe 'enedatanebarakaku 'enetawaacawaalane. kaziyaa maamelathe 'ayecelume.

basawoce laaye bamale'eketanyocaacene laaye yawaradu geletze 'aneqatzoce sinababu kahadiyaane la'amaanyoce 'enedihe yelaalu. "kahulataacene sebesebe theru manoriyaanaa theru maahebaraawi darajaa yaalawe yanyaa sebesebe (budene) wayenese ya'enaaneta?!"

'enazihe kahhadiyaane 'aseqademo banabaraacawe qusaawi yabalaayenate bakuraate (batemekehete) yatawatharu yaathafaanaacawe teweledoce bezu naacawe. kanazihe yatashaala habete nabaraacawe. lebesocaacawe wedenaa sawenataacawe bamecote wesethe yeganye selanabare gatzetaacawe yaamere nabare.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'enedihe bale bathemate wesethe yamiwaanye sawe 'aleraahemaane thematune 'esekichamere derase gizee yesathawaale. 'ezihu bamederaawi `aalame wayeneme batenesaa'ee `elate yataqatharutene qethaate batachabaache ba`aayenaacawe 'esekimalakatu derase; baziyaane gizee mathefo manoriyaanaa 'anasetanyaa radaate yaalawe ya'enaresu sebesebe wayenese ya'amaanyu sebesebe maane 'enedahona yaaweqaalu.

themataacawene 'esekichameru derase 'enazihe cale batabaalubate taqaaraani qathetanyaawene manegade latamaru 'alaahe 'emenatenaa malekaame taazaazhenatene yechamerelaacawaale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! wada zala`aalamaawi dasetaa yamiyaadaresu malekaame szeraawoce geetaahe zanede menedaacawe yabalatha thaqaami 'enaa macharashaacawe yatashaala nawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! bamaaserajaawocaacene kahedatene yafatzamawene 'enaa qatharo'acenene hhasate yaalawene sawe tamalakatekene!? kamote baxwaalaa kataqasaqaseku bezu habetenaa lejoce yesathanyaale 'ala.

yaruqene mesethire selaawaqa yatanaagarawene bamarajaa laaye tamasereto tanaagarane!? wayenese janate 'enediyaasegabaawenaa habetenaa lejoce 'enedamisathawe geetaawe ('alaahe) zanede qaale kidaanene 'adaraga?!
gudaayu (huneetaawe) 'eresu 'enedamogatawe 'ayedalame. yaminaagarawenenaa yamiszaraawene 'enetzefaalane. selamimogetawe hhasate qethaatu laaye leelaa qethaatene 'enechamerebataalane.
kaathafaanawe baxwaalaa yatawaacawene habetenaa lejoce 'enewaresawaalane. sifanathezebaacawe yanabarute keberunaa habetu tagafawe batenesaa'ee `elate becaawene wada 'enyaa yemathaale.
thaa`otaawiyaane dagaafinaa jarebaacawene yamithabequ 'enedahonu banaresu yamiradubaacawene ka'alaahe weche yamiyaamalekwaacawene (nagaroce) yaazu.

huneetaawe 'enedagamatute 'ayedalame. ka'alaahe weche yamiyaamalekwaacawe 'enazihene 'amaaleketoce batenesaa'ee `elate yathaa`otaawiyaanene 'ameleko yekedaalu. kathaa`otaawiyaane yereqaalu; (raasaacawene yaareqaalu) yathaa`otaawiyaane thalaatoce yehonaalu.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! shayethwanocene 'enedaasenasaanaa bakahadiyaanoce laaye xaayele 'enedasathanaacawe ('enedashomenebaacawe) 'atemalakatemene?! hathi'atene 'enedifatzemunaa ya'alaahene 'emenate 'enedizagu yaanaswaswacawaale.
male'eketanyaacene hoye! 'alaahe bafethenate 'enediyaathafaacawe 'atecakule. `edemeeyaacawene 'eneqotheraalane. gizeeyaacawe sifatzame yamigabaacawene qethaate 'enefatzemebaacawaalane.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! yaazazaacawene bamafatzamenaa yakalakalaacawene bamaqothabe geetaacawene yamifaru sawocene yatakabarunaa yalaaqu honawe babudene yamenesabasebebatene yatenesaa'ee `elate 'asetaawese.
kahadiyaanene wada jahaname bawehaa theme yataqaathalu honawe 'enenadaacawaalane.
bamederaawi heyewate ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyocu bamaamane 'alaahe zanede qaale kidaanene yayaaza siqare 'enazihe kahadiyaane kafilu lakafilocu melejaane masethate 'ayecelume.
'ayehudaawiyaane, naswaraawocenaa kafile thaa`otaawiyaane 'aleraahemaane leje 'alawe (yaaza) 'alu.
yehene yametenaagaru sawoce hoye! 'ejege kabaadene nagare (qaale) tanaagaraacehu ('amathaacehu).
bazihe hhasatanyaa wegeze qaale mekeneyaate samaayaatoce lisanathaathaqu medere letefaraarese, taraaroce lidaramasu yedaresaalu.
yehe hulu 'aleraahemaane leje 'alawe bamaalataacawe nawe. kazihe (nagare) 'alaahe bathaame yalaaqa hona.
kazihe yatharaa (yalaaqa) bamahonu 'alaahe lejene mayaazu yatagabaa 'ayedalame.
basamaayaate wesethe yamiganyu hulu malaa'eketoce, sawoce, 'agaanenetoce, batenesaa'ee `elate la'eresu 'alaahe becaa tanaanesawe saayemathu 'ayeqarume.
ba`eweqatu kabwacawaale. bamigabaa qotherwacawaale. kanaresume 'anedaaceme yamisawarebate nagare yalame.
'eyaanedaanedu fethure batenesaa'ee `elate becaawene hono yemathaale. habetenaa radaate yalaweme ('ayenoraweme).
'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanunaa 'alaahe zanede yamiwadadu malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru sawocene ba'eresu wedeetaa 'alaahe tawadaaje yaadaregaacawaale. sawoce 'enediwadwacawe yaadaregaale.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! balesaanehe (qwaaneqwaahe) bamaawerade yehene qure'aane qalaale yaadaragenawe te`ezaazeene kelekalaawoceene yamithanaqaqu fariha-'alaahe sawoce beseraate 'enedetasathaacawenaa 'ewenatene kamaqabale beretu, bahhasate yamikaraakarunaa kuraatanyaa yahonu sawocene 'enedetaasethanaqeqebate nawe.

ka'aneta hhezeboce (teweledoce) bafite yaathafaanaacawe hhezeboce bezu naacawe; zaaree selanaziyaa hhezeboce yamisamaahe nagare 'alane?! yaalahosaase demetzene tesamaahelaacawaalahene?! 'enaresune yaaganyaacawe (qethaate) 'alaahe sifaqede leeloceneme liyaaganyaacawe yecelaale.
(Th) thaha; (yehene selamasalu ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehene qure'aane ba'aneta laaye yaawaradenawe bamale'eketanyaanatehe (ba'aneta) hhezebocehe kamaamane bamaafanegathaacawe mekeneyaate baquchete nafesehene 'enedetaadakeme 'ayedalame.
yehene qure'aane yaawaradenawe 'eresune ('alaahene) yamaferaate sekeetene 'alaahe yasathaacawene sawoce 'enedetegaletzebate nawe.
mederene kafe yaalu samaayaatocene yafatharawe 'alaahe qure'aanene 'aweredwale. kataalaaqu fathaari yatawarada bamahonu qure'aane taalaaqe nawe.
'aleraahemaane ('alaahe) la'eresu keberenaa xaayaalenate tagabi bahona huneetaa ka`areshe balaaye hona; (kafe 'ala).
basamaayaate, bamedere wesethenaa ka'afare bataace yamiganyu fetherataatoce fetherate, negesenaanaa maasetanaabare yaresu ya'alaahe becaa nawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! negegerehene geletze betaadaregeme hona betedabeqe 'eresu 'alaahe huluneme yaaweqaale. debeqeneme yaaweqaale. kadebeqeme 'alefo yanafese fenethaaqi hasaabocene yaaweqaale. kazihe wesethe ka'alaahe yamisaware 'anedeme nagare yalame.
'alaahe; ba'ewenate ka'eresu weche yamimalake yalame. yalaaqunaa melu`e yahonu malekaame semoce 'alute. (ya'eresu naacawe).

yahhezebune 'emebetanyenate banabeyu (sawa) laaye sibarataa matzenaanyaa yehunawe zanede yamusaane taareke 'alwahe(suwa) 'enedihe bamaalate tanaagara::
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yamusaa ya`imeraane leje taarike zeenaa daresohale (wada 'aneta mathetwale)?

baguzo laaye 'esaate simalakate labeetasabocu 'enedihe 'ala:- "'ezihe seferaa 'erafete 'aderegu; 'esaate tamalekecaalahu; kaziyaa 'esaate yamiqathaathale nagare laamathaalaacehu wayeneme manegade yamimaraanyene laaganye 'ecelaalahu.
wada 'esaate simathaa "musaa hoye!" bamaalate 'alaahe tharaawe.
'enee geetaahe nanye; ka'enee gaare lamanagaagare zegeju 'enedetehone machaamiyaahene 'aweleqe; "thuwaa" batasanyawe yataqadasa shalaqo wesethe teganyaalahe.
musaa hoye! male'eketeene 'enedetaadarese marecheehalawe. wada 'aneta yamaawaredawene malakotaawi male'ekete 'ademethe.
'enee 'alaahe nanye; ka'enee basetaqare ba'ewenate yamimalake ('amelaake) yalame. 'eneene becaa 'ameleke. 'eneene lamaasetaawase batamwalaa huneetaa segedatene fatzeme.

tenesaa'ee yemathaale; selamakasatu therethere yalaweme. (gizeewene) lesawerawe 'eqarebaalahu; fetherataate (yatenesaa'ee `elate yamikasatebatene) waqete 'ayaawequme. nagare gene nabiyaatoce selanagarwacawe meleketoce yaaweqaalu. (yatenesaa'ee `elate yamimathaabate mekeneyaate) nafese hulu baszaraacewe szeraa malekaameme yehune mathefo menedaawaane 'enedetaaganye nawe.

'eresune (yatenesaa'ee `elate) 'ewenate kamaalate laziyaa `elate bamalekaame szeraawoce kamazagaajate, baziyaane `elate yamaayaamene yaaletafaqadu yanafese semeetocune yamikatale kahadi 'ayaazuruhe. bazihe mekeneyaate tethafaalahe.
musaa hoye! baqanye 'ejehe yayaazekawe nagare menedenawe?
musaame 'enedihe 'ala - bateree nawe bameraamadebate waqete 'edagafawaalahu; labagocee kazaafe laaye qethalocene 'araagefebataalahu. kaziheme leelaa bezu 'ethaqamebataalahu.
'alaaheme 'enedihe 'alawe "musaa hoye! (baterehene) thaalawe"
musaa (baterune) thaalawe. bafethenate (wadamineqasaaqase) wadamiheede 'ebaabenate talawatha.
'alaahe lamusaa 'enedihe 'ala:- "baterehene yaaze; wada 'ebaabenate bamaqayaru 'ateferaa; seteyezawe wada nabarabate yaqademo huneetaa 'enemalesawaalane."
'ejehene wada gonehe 'asethagaa. nache (berehaanaamaa) hono yewathaale. yehe hulatanyaawe meleketehe nawe.
musaa hoye! 'enazihene hulate meleketoce yaasaayanehe xaayaalenataacenene yamiyaaseradu teleqe ta`aameraatocene lenaasaayehe 'enedihume ka'alaahe zanede (yatalaake) male'eketanyaa bamahonehe nawe.
musaa hoye! wada fire`owene hide. 'eresu bakehedatenaa 'alaahene bamaamatze wasane 'alefwale.
musaa 'enedihe 'ala - "geetaayee hoye! cegerocene mashakame 'enedecele lebeene 'asefaalenye."
gudaayeene 'aqelelelenye.
baretu`e 'anedabate 'enedenaagare 'asecelanye.
male'eketehene saadarese negegereene 'enediganazabu.
bagudaayee laaye yamiyaagezanye kabeetasabocee radaate 'aderegelenye.
wanedemee haarune ya`imeraane lejene.
baresu 'athanekeranye.
male'eketune bamaaderase ya'enee 'agaare 'aderegawe.
bezu 'enedenaawadesehe.
bezu 'enedenaasetaawesehe.
'aneta ba'enyaa laaye tamalekaace nahe. kagudaayaacene 'anedeme nagare 'ayesawarebeheme.
'alaahe 'enedihe 'ala - "musaa hoye! yathayaqekawene sathetanehale."
badegaami ba'aneta laaye tzagaacenene fatzemanaale.
kafire`owene szeraa 'alaahe 'enedathabaqahe 'enaatehene yaaseganazabenaate (yaasaawaqenaate) baasaawaqenaate gizee yahonawene 'asetawele.

senaaseganazebaate (senaasaaweqaate) te`ezaaze sathanaate. kaweledatu baxwaalaa basaathene 'aderegashe wada baahere wareweriwe. ba'enyaa te`ezaaze baaheru wada daarecaa yegafaawaale. (yethelawaale, yetafaawaale, kaziyaame) ya'eneeme ya'eresume thalaate (yahonawe sawe) fire`owene yewasedawaale. (musaa hoye!) wedeetaayeene ba'aneta laaye 'adaragekunye. selaziheme sawoce wadaduhe. ba`aayenee; bathebaqaayeenaa ba'enekebekaabeeyee sere taqaretzehe 'enedetewathaa ('enedetaadege).

'ehetehe (bawesethu yanabarekebatene saathene) takatelaa wada heedabate 'aqethaachaa seteheede 'asetaawese. saathenune lawasadute sawoce 'enedihe 'alace "(yehene hetzaane) yamithabeqawene, thute yamiyaathabaawenenaa yamiyaasaadegawene sawe lethaqumaacehune\?" wada 'enaatehe 'enedetemalase bamaaderage 'ereswame wada 'ereswa bamamalasehe 'enedetedasatenaa sela 'aneta hhazane 'enedaayesamaate (bamaaderage) tzagaawocene lagasenehe. babuthi bamametaate gebetzaawiwene gadalekawe. kaqethaate 'enedetedene tzagaane 'adaragenelehe. kaagaathamuhe fatanaawoce hulu ba'anedenaa baleelaa gizee natzaa 'awathaanehe. kaziyaame wathetahe ya"madeyane" sawoce gaare `aamataatene 'asaalafeke. kaziyaame musaa hoye! 'enedetemathaanaa 'enedaanaagerehe yatawasanalehe gizee sidarese mathaahe.
ya'enee male'eketanyaanaa wada 'aneta yaawaradekutene malakotaawi male'ekete lasawoce 'enedetaadarese marathekuhe.
musaa hoye! ya'alaahene xaayaalenatenaa becanyenate bamithaqumu ta`aameraatocaacene 'anetanaa wanedemehe haarune hidu. wada 'enee theri kamaaderagenaa 'eneene kamaasetaawase 'atedekamu.
wada fire`owene hidu bakehedatenaa 'alaahene bamaamatze wasane 'alefwale.
'enedigasatzenaa 'alaahene fareto baneseha 'enedimalase xaayela qaale yaleelabaacawene laselaasaa qaalaatocene tanaagarute.

musaanaa haarune 'enedihe 'alu - "theriwene batamwalaa huneetaa saayaadaamethe laqethaate 'enedaayefathene wayeneme bagedeyaanaa baleeloce manegadoce 'enyaane bamagedale wasane 'enedaayaalefe 'enefaraalane."
'alaahe 'enedihe 'alaacawe "'ateferu ba'eredaataayeenaa badegaafee 'enee ka'enaaneta gaare nanye. ba'enaanetanaa ba'eresu makaakale yamihonawene 'emalakataalahu."

wada 'eresu hidu. 'enediheme balute. fire`owene hoye! yageetaahe male'eketanyoce nane. ya'eseraa'eelene lejoce ka'enyaa gaare laakaacawe. lejocaacawene bamagedale 'enaa seetocaacawene bamatawe 'ateqethaacawe. ('ataasaqaayaacawe). sela 'ewenatanyaanataacene kageetaahe zanede marajaawocene yezanelehe mathetanaale. ya'alaahene madehene yamiyaaganyawe yaamananaa ya'alaahene qathetanyaa manegade yatakatala sawe nawe.

bamederaawi `aalamenaa bamacharashaawe `aalame qethaate yamihonawe ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce (ta`aameraatoce) baasetabaabala 'enedihume male'eketanyoce yezawete kamathute male'ekete baafanagatha sawe laaye mahonune malakotaawi male'ekete daresonaale.
yezawete yamathutene bamaawegaze fire`owene 'enedihe 'ala - "musaa hoye! wada 'enee 'enedalaakaacehu yametemogetute geetaacehu maanawe?"
musaame 'enedihe 'ala - "geetaacene 'eresu lahulume nagare yamigabaawene malekenaa qeretzenaa yasatha nawe. kaziyaame fetherataatene lafatharaacawe nagare maraa ('amalakata)."
fire`owene 'enedihe 'ala - "bakehedate laaye yanabaru yaqadamu teweledoce taarike mene yemaselaale?"

musaa lafire`owene 'enedihe 'ala - 'enaziyaa teweledoce (hhezeboce) yanabarubate huneetaa `eweqate geetaayee zanede nawe. batathaqasawe saleedaa laaye tatzefwale (saferwale) selanaresu `eweqate geetaayee 'ayesaasaateme. selanaresu yaawaqaweneme 'ayerasaame.

('enaziyaa teweledoce yanabarubate huneetaa `eweqate) mareetene bareswa laaye lamanore yatamacaaca yaadaragalaacehu geetaayee zanede nawe ('alaahe) bamareete laaye yametegwaazubaacawene yatamacu manegadoce 'adaragalaacehu. kasamaaye yazenaabe wehane 'awarada. baziyaame weha leyu leyu takelocene 'abaqalane.

sawoce hoye! kamedere kaabaqalenelaacehu malekaame nagaroce tamagabu. 'enesesaatocaacehume thabequ. bazihe batathaqasawe tzagaa wesethe la'a`emero baalabeetoce ya'alaahene xaayaalenatenaa becanyenate thaqwaami nagaroce yeganyaalu.
'abaataacehune 'adame kamareete 'afare fatharenawe, setemotu wadaziyaawe baqabere 'enemalesaacexwaalane. batenesaa'ee `elate kaziyaawe (kamareete) bamaqaseqase tewathaalaacehu.
zathanye ta`aameraatocaacene bamulu lafire`owene geletze 'adaragenelate. tamalakataacawe; kaziyaame hhasate 'alaacawe. ba'alaahe lamaamane yatadaragalatene theri kamaqabale 'emebitanyaa hona.
fire`owene 'enedihe 'ala - "musaa hoye! yezahe bamathaahewe degemete negesenaawe la'aneta 'enedihone kagebetze letaasewathaane mathaahene?!"

musaa hoye! ya'anetane `aayenate 'amesaayaa degemete yezane wada 'aneta 'enemathaalane. ba'anetanaa ba'enyaa makaakale bagizee yataawaqanaa botaa yatawasana qatharone 'aderege. 'enyaa kaziyaa 'aneqareme, 'anetame kaziyaa 'ateqareme. (yaqatharowe) botaa (bahulataacene) mahale yamiganye 'amaakaaye botaa yehune.
musaa lafire`owene 'enedihe 'ala - "ba'enyaanaa ba'enaaneta makaakale qatharowe sawoce ba`aalaacawene lamaakebare bamisabaasabubate yaba`aale `elate rafaade laaye yehune."
fire`owene jarebaawene satheto heeda. seeraawenenaa tanekolocune maasabaasabe jamara. kaziyaame bataqatharawe gizeenaa botaa lafukekeru qaraba.

musaa yafire`owene degemetanyocene simakere 'enedihe 'ala - "tathaneqaqu! sawocene bametaataalelubatenaa bametefatzemute degemete 'alaahe laaye hhasatene 'ateqethafu. ('alaahe) ka'eresu bahona qethaate yemanagelaacawaale (kamaszarataacawe yenaqelaacawaale). ba'alaahe laaye hhasatene yaqathafa ba'eregethe kasara.
yamusaane negegere sisamu degemetanyocu 'erese ba'erese tayaayu; bamesethire taneshokaashoku.

kafile degemetanyoce leelocune bamesethire 'enedihe 'alu - musaanaa haarune degemetanyoce naacawe; yezawe bamathute degemete kagebetze liyaasewathwacehu, yalaaqawene yaheyewate marehacehunenaa methuqe kahonawe manegadaacehu liyaasewagedwacehu yefalegaalu.

nagaraacehune thabaqe 'aderegu; 'atelayaayu. kaziyaame batadaraaja huneetaa (basalefe) wada fite beqe balu. yayaazaacehutene ba'anede qetzebate bagaaraa wareweru. zaaree 'ashanaafi yahona sawe yamifalegawene yaaganyaale.
degemetanyocu lamusaa 'enedihe 'alute - "musaa hoye! kahulate 'anedune merathe "yayaazekawene degemete majamariyaa yametethelawe 'aneta hune, wayeneme 'enyaa jamaariwoce 'enehune."

musaa 'enedihe 'ala - "baqedemiyaa yayaazaacehutene 'enaaneta thaalu; yayaazutene warawaru. yawarawarwacawe kerocenaa bateroce badegemetaacawe mekeneyaate bafethenate yamineqasaaqasu 'ebaaboce honawe lamusaa tamasalubate"
musaa yafatzamute tagebaare yafatharabatene ferehate bawesethu dabeqo 'ameqo yaaza.
'alaahe lamusaa bamaatzenaanaate 'enedihe 'alawe - yatamasaasalabehene nagare 'ateferaa. musaa hoye! ba'ashanaafinatenaa badele ka'enaresu balaaye yametehonawe 'aneta nahe.

baqanye 'ejehe yayaazekawene batere warewerawe, wada 'ebaabenate talawetho yasarwacawene degemetoce bamulu yebalaacawaale. (yewethaacawaale). 'enaresu yasarute tanekolenaa degemete 'eneji leelaane 'ayedalame. degemetanyaa bayatenyaaweme seferaa sekeetene 'ayaaganyeme.

musaa baterune warawara. (bateru) wada 'ebaabenate talawatha. yasarutene degemetoce bamulu waathaacawe. musaa yaadaragawe (musaazanede yaalawe nagare) degemete 'alamahonunaa ka'alaahe zanede yahona gudaaye mahonune bamaawaqaacawe degemetanyocu lasegedate bagenebaaraacawe wada mareete la'alaahe tadafu. 'enediheme 'alu:- "lamusaanaa lahaarune 'enedihume bahulume fetherataate geetaa 'amenanaale."

fire`owene degemetanyocu 'emenatene maqabalaacawene bamaawegazenaa bazaacaa 'enedihe 'ala - "'enee saalefaqedelaacehu bamusaa (male'ekete) 'amanaacehune?! 'enaaneta degemetanyoce! musaa degemete yaasetamaaraacehu waanaa mariyaacehu nawe. ya'eyaanedaanedaacehune 'ejenaa 'egere 'eqorethaalahu. 'eseketemotu derase batamere zaafe genede laaye 'esaqelaacexwaalahu. yaane gizee 'enee wayenese yamusaa geetaa bataqaaraani 'aqethaachaawoce maane thanekaaraa qethaate yaalawe mahonune taaweqaalaacehu.

degemetanyocu lafire`owene 'enedihe 'alute - "fire`owene hoye! " yamathaalenene geletze ta`aameraate kamakatale 'anetane makatale, kafatharane 'alaahe 'anetane, bafetzume 'anaasebaletheme. ba'enyaa laaye maaderage yametefalegawene fatzeme. selethaane yaalahe thafi bahonawe bazihe mederaawi`aalame laaye becaa nawe. selethaaneheme yethafaale.

yaqadama yakehedatenaa leelaa hathi'atocene 'enedihume 'enedenemaarawe, 'enedenefatzemawenaa kamusaa gaare 'enedenefokaakarebate yaasegadadekanene yadegemete hathi'ate 'enedisarazelene bamamanyate 'enyaa bageetaacene 'amenanaale. 'aneta kasathahene qatharo ya'alaahe menedaa yatashaala nawe. 'aneta kaasefaraaraahene qethaate yageetaacene qethaate zala`aalamaawi nawe.

gudaatunaa yamihonawe nagare batenesaa'ee `elate 'eresu kahadi hono geetaawe yamimathaabate sawe jahaname yethabeqawaale. baresu wesethe zala`aalame lamaqoyate wada jahaname yegabaale. bamote kajahaname qethaate 'erafete 'ayaaganyeme. malekaame heyewateneme 'ayenoreme.
batenesaa'ee `elate baresu 'amaanye hono baregethe malekaame tagebaaraatocene szareto geetaawene yamimathaa sawe, bazihe taalaaqe baaheri yamigalatzu sawoce kafe yaalu darajaawoce 'alwacawe.

'enazihe darajaawoce kahenetzaawocwa sere wanezoce yamifasubaacawe yamanoriyaa janatoce naacawe. baziyaa wesethe zala`aalame yeqoyaalu. yehe yatathaqasawe menedaa kakehedatenaa hathi'ate netzuhe yahona sawe hulu menedaa nawe.

'anedeme sawe saayaaweqe 'agalegaayoceene kagebetze balalite yezahe tagwaaze bamaalate lamusaa malakotaawi male'eketene 'awaradenelate. baaherune babaterehe kamataahe baxwaalaa baaheru yamisanatheqe yayabese manegadene 'aderegelaacawe; fire`owenenaa szaraawitu yedaresubenyaale, yekatalunyaale belahe 'ateferaa, 'enedihume babaaheru wesethe masematheneme 'atesegaa.

fire`owene szaraawitune 'asekatelo takatalaacawe. 'ewenatune (gezefatune) 'alaahe becaa yamiyaaweqawe nagare kabaaheru fire`owenenaa szaraawitune shafanaacawe. hulume sathemawe thafu. musaanaa takataayocu daanu.
baasaamaralaacawe (webe 'aderego) baasaayaacawe kehedatenaa baataalalaacawe hhasate mekeneyaate fire`owene hhezebocune 'athamama. wada qathetanyaawe manegade 'alemaraacaweme.

kafire`owenenaa kaszaraawitu kaatarafenaacawe baxwaalaa la'eseraa'eele lejoce 'enedihe 'alenaacawe - ya'eseraa'eele lejoce hoye! (bamedera badaa) bathafaacehubate (bawaalalaacehubate) waqete ka'enyaa tzagaa thaafaache fasaashene wehane sathanaacehu, kathalaatocaacehu 'adaanenaacehu. ba"thure" taraaraa 'athagabe bamiganyawe shalaqo qanye kefele musaane 'enedamenaanaagerawe qaale kidaanene sathanaacehu. maare, derechete yamimasele thaafaache segaa yaalawene teneshe baraari (wafene) yamasaasalutene sathanaacehu.

kalagasenaacehu yatafaqadu megeboce thaafaachoce tamagabu. kafaqadenelaacehu wada kalakalenaacehu nagaroce wasane 'atelafu. quthaayee yewaredebaacexwaale. ya'enee quthaa yawaradabate sawe bamederaawinaa bamacharashaawe `aalame yethafaale; `edela biseme yehonaale.
wada 'enee batzatzate lamimalasenaa 'emenatene lataqabala 'enedihume malekaame szeraawocene laszaraanaa ba'ewenate laaye tzenu sihone 'enee babezu mahhari nanye.
musaa hoye! 'enaresune wada xwaalaa bamatawe
musaa 'enedihe 'ala - "'enaresu kabasetaxwaalaayee naacawe; yekatalunyaale." (geetaayee hoye!) wada 'aneta bamafethane 'aneta 'enedetewade hhezeboceene wada 'aneta 'aseqadamekunye.
'alaahe 'enedihe 'alawe - wada xwaalaa yatawekaacawe hhezebocehene thejaane bamaamelake fatanenaacawe. (wada thejaa) 'ameleko saamiriye theri 'adaragalaacawe. baziheme 'athamamaacawe.

thejaa bamaamelakaacawe 'ejege taqotheto 'enedihume ba'enaresu laaye 'azeno musaa wada hhezebocu tamalasa. musaame 'enedihe 'alaacawe - "hhezebocee hoye! 'oritene 'enedamiyaaweredelaacehu 'enedihume janate 'enedamiyaasegabaacehu geetaacehu malekaame qatharone 'alesathaacehumene?! gizeewe razamabaacehu zanagaacehune?! wayenese bazihe tagebaaraacehu yageetaacehu quthaa ba'enaaneta laaye 'enedisaferenaa qethaatu 'enediwarede falagaacehu?! selaziheme wada 'enaaneta 'esekamemalase derase geetaacehune bamataazaze laaye tzenu tehonu zanede yasathaacehunyene qaale kidaane 'afarasaacehu.

yamusaa hhezeboce 'enedihe 'alu - "musaa hoye! baraasaacene merechaa qaale kidaanehene 'alaafaraseneme. yelequneme ba'asegadaaje huneetaa nawe. kafire`owene hhezeboce geethaa geethoce kabaade shakemocene tashakemane karesu lamagalaagale wada gudegwaade warawarenawe. 'enyaa (geethaageethocune) wada gudegwaade 'enedawarawarenawe 'enedazihume 'eresu gaare yanabarawene yajiberile yafarase kotee yaqofarenawene 'afare saamiriyu warawara.

ka'enaziyaa geethaa geethoce saamiriye la'eseraa'eele lejoce nafese yaleelawene 'eneda laame yamichohe yathejaa takela sawenate ('akaale) qaratzalaacawe. basaamiriye tagebaare yatafatanute 'enedihe 'alu - yehe 'enaanetanaa musaa yametaamalekute nawe. 'ezihe rasetote hido nawe.

baziyaa thejaa yatafatanute 'enaa thejaawene yaamalakute 'enaziyaa sawoce, thejaawe yamaayaanaageraacawenaa malese yamaayesathaacawe 'enedihume ka'enaresume hona kaleelaa gudaatene mamalase yamaayecele la'enaresume hona laleelaa theqemene maamethaate yamaayecele mahonune 'ayaasetawelumene?!

musaa wada 'enaresu kamamalasu bafite ba'eregethe 'arune 'enedihe belwacawe nabare. "bathejaawe qeretze wesethe yamiganyawe wareqenaa demetze 'amaanye kakahadiwe 'enedilaye la'enaaneta yatadaraga fatanaa nawe." hhezebocee hoye! geetaacehu ya'ezenate baalabeete nawe ('ezenate yaalawe nawe). la'enaaneta magudaateneme hona mathemamene (lisathaacehu) linafegaacehu yamiyecele ('akaale) 'ayedalame. (geetaacehune) becaa bamaamelake takatalunye. ka'eresu weche yamiganyu nagarocene maamelake bamatawe te`ezaazeene takatalu.
thejaawene bamaamelake yatafatanute 'enedihe 'alu - "musaa 'esekimalase derase (thejaawene) maamelakaacenene 'anetaweme."
musaa lawanedemu haarune 'enedihe 'ala - "ka'alaahe weche thejaane bamaamelake sithamemu setemalakate yakalakalahe nagare menedenawe?"
tetahaacawe wada 'enee kamamethaate? ba'enaresume laaye metekee saadaregehe te`ezaazeene 'amatzekene?!

yafatzamawene tagebaare lamaqaawame musaa yawanedemune tzimenaa raase bamayaaze sigotete 'arune musaa hazaneetaa 'enediyaadaregelate 'enedihe 'ala -"ya'enaatee leje hoye! tzimeenenaa yaraase tzagureene 'ateyaaze. ka'enaresu gaare yaqoyahubate mekeneyaate 'alanye. becaacawene betawaacawe 'enedaayelayaayu faraahunaa 'aneta (haarune hoye!) bamakaakalaacawe malayaayatene 'adarageke banaresu laaye yasathahukene 'adaraa 'alethabaqekeme 'enedaatelanye faraahu.
musaa lasaamiriyu 'enedihe 'ala - "saamiriye hoye! gudaayehe menedenawe!? yaadaragekawene 'enedetefatzeme yaadaragahe (yagafaahe) menedenawe?"

saamiriyu lamusaa 'enedihe 'ala - "'enaresu yaalaayutene 'enee tamalakateku; jiberilene bafarase laaye 'ayahu. kafarasu yakotee faanaa 'afare zaganekunye." kaziyaame qaletho bathejaa qeretze batasaraawe geethe laaye warawarekute. demetze yamiyaasamaa bathejaa qeretze yatasaraa 'akaale taganya. 'enedazihume yasaraahutene nafesee webe 'adaragacelenye.

musaa lasaamiriyu 'enedihe 'ala - "hide; baheyewate 'esekaalahe derase "'alenakaame 'alenakaame" 'eyaaleke nure yatathaaleke honahe tenoraalahe. batenesaa'ee `elateme baszeraahe temaramaraalahe; teqathaalahe. 'alaahe yehene qatharo 'ayaafarese. yametaamalekawe 'aderegahe yayaazekawene ka'alaahe weche 'eresune bamaamelake yaqoyahebatene thejaa tamalekate. 'esekiqalethe derase 'esaate 'enaanadebataalane. kaziyaame meneme 'ayenate faanaa 'enedaayenorawe babaahere wesethe 'enebatenawaalane.

sawoce hoye! ba'ewenate letaamalekute yamigabaawe ka'eresu weche ba'ewenate limalake yamaayegabaawe 'eresu 'alaahe nawe. huluneme nagaroce ba`eweqatu kabebwale. ya'anedeme nagare `eweqate 'ayefalegeme.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! yamusaane yafire`owenene 'enaa yahhezebocaacawene taarike 'enedatarakenelehe 'enedazihume yaqadamuhene nabiyaatocenaa hhezeboce zeenaa matzenaanyaa 'enedihonehe 'enetarekelehaalane. temeherete yamiwasede sawe yamigaletzebatene qure'aane ka'enyaa zanede sathetanehale.

ba'aneta laaye kawaradawe yehe qure'aane yaafanagathanaa ba'eresu yaalaamana 'enedihume bawesethu bamiganyu 'aneqatzoce (mamariyaawoce) yaaleszaraa batenesaa'ee `elate 'asaamaami qethaate yatagabaawe hono teleqe hathi'atene tashakemo yemathaale.
baziyaa qethaate wesethe lazala`aalame yeqoyaale. batenesaa'ee `elate yamishakamawe shakeme yakafaa hona.

male'aku sawocene kaqabere lamaqaseqase hulatanyaawene theri baqanedu sinafaa baziyaane `elate bamiyaagaathemaacawe yamacharashaawe `aalame 'asefari te`eyenete mekeneyaate kahadiyaane yagatzetaacawe qalamenaa `aayenocaacawe bamaqayaru samaayaawi honawe (gatzetaa yezawe) 'enesabasebaacawaalane.
'enedihe bamaalate yeneshokaashokaalu kamote baxwaalaa ba"bazarakxe `aalame" 'asere ma`aaletocene yaahele becaa 'eneji 'aleqoyaneme.

yamimasatherutene 'enyaa 'enaaweqaalane. kaziyaa 'anedeme nagare 'ayaalefaneme. ka'enaresu makaakale yatashaala 'a`emero (genezaabee) yaalawe 'enedihe yelaale:- "bazarakxe `aalame" yaqoyaacehute 'anede qane becaa nawe; kaziyaa 'ayebaletheme.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! batenesaa'ee `elate taraaroce mene 'enedamihonu yethayequhale. 'enedihe balaacawe - geetaayee taraarocene kaseraacawe yenaqelaacawaale. kaziyaame yebatenaacawaale. baado yehonaalu.
(taraarocene) yatashakamacewe medere takelenaa yataganabaa nagare yaleelabaate lathe yaala medera badaa tehonaalace.
medere fetzume lathe yaala medera badaa bamahonwa mazanebale, kafetaanaa, zeqe yaala seferaa 'atemalakateme.

baziyaane `elate sawoce wada masabesabiyaawe yamithaaraawene demetze yekatalaalu. 'eresune kamakatale leelaa 'amaaraache 'ayenoraacaweme. demetzoce ba'araahemaane ferehaate tzathe yelaalu. baziyaane `elate bathaame debeqe demetzene 'eneji leelaa 'atesamaame.
'alaahe 'enediyaamaalede lafaqadalate 'enaa yamelejaa negegerune lawadadalate kaalehona basetaqare baziyaane taalaaqe `elate kamaanenyaaweme 'amaalaaje melejaa yamithaqeme 'ayehoneme 'ayethaqememe.

sela tenesaa'ee gudaaye sawoce yamithabeqaacawene 'alaahe yaaweqaale. 'enedihume jarebaacawene kaxwaalaa tetawete sathetawete selamiheedu yamederaawi heyewate yaaweqaale. fetherataate hulu sela 'alaahe 'akaalenaa baaheriyaate ba`eweqate likaababu 'ayecelume.

yasawe lejoce fitoce (gatzetaawoce) ya'agalegaayocune (yasawocene) gudaayoce lamiyaasetanaaberawenaa lamifatzemawe lamaayemotawe heyaawe ('amelaake) ('alaahe) tawaarada; sakana. hathi'atene yatashakama sawe nafesune yathefaate zeqethate wesethe bamaawerade ba'eregethe kasara.

ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe 'ameno malekaame szeraawocene yaszaraa menedaawene batamwalaa huneetaa yaaganyaale. baalefatzamawe hathi'ate taqatheto badale 'enedaayefatzamebate wayeneme yamalekaame szeraawe menedaa 'enedaayeqanasebate 'ayefaraame.

yaqadamete (hhezebocene) taarike 'enedaawaradenawe 'enedazihume yehe qure'aane bageletze ya`aarabenyaa lesaane 'awaradenawe. 'alaahene 'enedifaru wayeneme qure'aane gesaatzeenaa maganezabene 'enedifatherelaacawe bawesethu yaqatharonaa yamaasethaneqaqiyaa `aayenatocene galatzene.

yahulu nagare negesenaa la'eresu yahonawe neguse, 'eresu 'ewenate yahonawenaa negegerume 'ewenate yahonawe 'alaahe kafe yaala yataqadasanaa yalaaqa hona. thaa`otaawiyaane ('eresune) kamigaletzubate laaqa (tharaa). 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! jiberile (malakotaawi male'eketune) maaderasune saayaathanaaqeqe karesu gaare qure'aanene bamaanebabe 'atefethane. 'enedihe bale - geetaayee hoye! kaasetamaarekanye `eweqatene chamerelenye.

bamusaa taarike wusethe fere`one 'enedate jarebaawune 'enedasatha 'enaa ya'eseraa'eele lejoce zenegunatene kagalatze baxwaalaa ya'adamene taarike magelatzu 'anede yarasaa sawu wada geetaawu te`ezaaze mamalase 'enedaalabate lamaasaawaqe nawe.
kazihe qadame kazaafitwa 'enedaayemagabe 'adamene 'adaraa sathanawe. kaziyaa tagebaare kalakalenawe. yamiyaasekatelaweneme fetzaamee galatzenelate. ya'adaraawene qaale raseto kazaafitwa balaa. te`egesete 'alaadaragame. yasathanawene 'adaraa bamathabaqe laaye thenekaareenaa qurethanyenatene 'alaaganyalateme (yaluteme).

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! malaa'eketocene lasalaametaa la'adame segadu baalene gizee yahonawene 'asetaawese. ka'enaresu gaare yanabarawene nagare gene kanaresu zereyaa yaalehonawe "belise" becaa siqare hulume sagadu. (belise) lamasegade bakuraate 'emebitanyaa hona.

'enedihe 'alene:- 'adame hoye! belise ya'aneta thalaate nawe. yamiseteheme thalaate nawe. yamigotagutawene nagare bamataazaze 'anetanaa misetehene kajanate 'enedaayaasewathaacehu. cegerenaa mathefo nagarocene (dase yamiyaasanyu) teshakamaalahenaa.
bajanate wesethe rahaabe bafetzume 'enedaayenakaahe limagebehe 'enedaatetaaraze liyaalabesehe 'alaahe laaye qaale kidaane 'alahe.
fetzume 'enedaatethamaa liyaathathaahe yatzahhaye harure fetzume 'enedaayenakaahe liyaasethalelehe 'alaahe laaye qaale kidaane 'alahe.

shayethwane 'adamene gotagotawe. 'enediheme 'alawe - kareswa yatamagaba bafetzume yamaayemote yelequneme zala`aalamaawi heyaawe yamihonebaatene 'enedihume macharashaa yaleelawe yamaayeqwaarathe negesenaa yamiyaaganyebaatene zaafe laamalaaketehene?

kareswa 'enedaayemagabu katakalakalubaate zaafe 'adamenaa hhawaa balu. debeqe yanabarawene haferataacawe tagalatzalaacawe. haferataacawene lamashafane bafethenate yajanate qethaloce maqanethase jamaru. kazaafitwa kamabelaate bamaqothabe yageetaawene te`ezaaze baalamafatzamu 'adame yageetaawene te`ezaaze thaasa. wadaaletafaqadalate nagare wasane 'alafa.
kaziyaame 'alaahe marathahe (tzatzatune) nesehawene taqabalawe wada malekaame manegademe maraawe.

la'adamenaa lahhawaa 'alaahe 'enedihe 'alaacawe - 'enaanetanaa belise kajanate weradu; 'eresu thalaataacehu nawe; 'enaanetame ya'eresu thalaatoce naacehu. yamanegadee mamariyaa simathaalaacehu ka'enaaneta makaakale yamanegadeene mamariyaa yatakatalanaa 'eresune yatagabara kaziyaame yaalaafanagatha ka'ewenate yamithame 'ayehoneme; bamacharashaawe `aalame bamaqathaate `edela bise 'ayehoneme yelequneme 'alaahe janatene yaasegabaawaale.

kagesaatzeeyee yazoranaa gesaatzeeyeene yaaletaqabala ba`aalamaawi heyewatenaa baqabere wesethe yacheneqate heyewate yenorawaale. batenesaa'ee `elate wada masabesabiyaawe medere ('akaalaawi) `aayenunaa makaraakariyaawe (yamikaraakarebate hhasaabe) yathafaa hono 'enaaganyawaalane.
kagesaatzeeyee yazorawe yehe sawe 'enedihe yelaale. geetaayee hoye! zaaree lamene `ewere 'aderegahe qasaqasekanye, bamederaawi heyewate yamemalakate nabarekunye.

'alaahe la'eresu malese sisathe 'enedihe 'ala - "bamederaawi heyewate yehene yamasala nagare fatzemahale." 'aneqatzocaacene ba'eregethe daresawehe nabare. tetahacawe 'afanagatheke. 'enedihume zaaree baqethaate wesethe tetawaalahe.

yehene bamasala qethaate batakalakalu semeetaawi hathi'atoce wesethe yatazafaqanenaa kageetaawe bahonu geletze maaserajaawoce kamaamane yazorane (sawe) 'eneqathaalane. ka`aalamaawi heyewatenaa kaqabere heyewate yacheneqate nuro bamacharashaawe `aalame yaminorawe ya'alaahe qethaate 'asedanegaachenaa yabalatha beretu nawe.

lathaa`otaawiyaane ka'eresu bafite yaathafaanaacawe hhezeboce bezaate 'aletagalatzalaacaweneme?! banaziyaa bathafu hhezeboce manoriyaawoce (katamoce) bakule yaalefaalu. yawaradabaacawene qethaate qari meleketoce yemalakataalu. 'enaziyaane bezu hezeboce yaagaathamaacawene thefaatenaa wedemate la'a`emero baalabeetoce temeherete nawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! maaserajaa saayedaresawe maaneneme sawe yamaayeqathaa mahonu 'enedihume 'eresu zanede yagizee qatharo yamawasanu yageetaahe qaale yaqadama baayehone noro yamigabaacawe bamahonu qethaatene yaafathenebaacawe nabare.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! ba'aneta hhasate yaalu sawoce selaminaagarwacawe bezu hhasatoce te`egesete 'aderege. gohe kamaqedadu bafite banegaate segedatenenaa tzahhaye kamathelaqwaa bafite ba"`asere" segedate wesethe, 'enedihume kalalite sa`aatoce ba"mageribe" 'enaa ba"`ishaa" salaatoce wesethe, tzahhaye setezanabalenaa yaqanu yamajamariyaa gemaashe sithanaaqaqe ba"zuhere" salaate wesethe, yaqanu hulatanyaa gemaashe sithanaaqaqe ba"mageribe" salaate wesethe ka'alaahe zanede yametewadadawene menedaa lamaagenyate bamaasabe geetaahene 'awadese.

la'enaziyaa 'asetabaabaayoce lafatanaa yaadaragenelaacawene ya`aalamaawi heyewate 'ababaawocenaa mafanethazhiyaawocene 'atemalekate. yaadaragenelaacawe nagare thafi nawe. 'esekametewade derase geetaahe 'enedamisathehe qaale kidaane yasathahe qatharo kathafi ya`aalamaawi heyewate dasetaa (fanethazeyaa) yatashaalanaa zala`aalamaawi nawe.

male'eketanyaacene hoye! salaatene 'enedisagedu beetasabocehene 'ezaze; salaatene bamafatzame laayeme taagase. laraasehenaa laleeloceme ka'aneta sisaayene 'anethayeqeme. yasisaayehe xaalaafinate ba'enyaa laaye nawe. bamederaawi `aalamenaa bamacharashaawe `aalame mesegune fetzaamee yamihonawe yaazazawene bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamaqothabe 'alaahene lamifarute nawe.

banabiyu hhasate yaalu 'enaziyaa kahadiyaane 'enedihe 'alu - "muhhamade 'ewenatanyaa male'eketanyaa selamahonu kageetaawe meleketocene yezo 'ayemathaamene?" 'enazihene 'asetabaabaayoce kamuhhamade bafite yanabarutene malakotaawi matsaahhefete 'ewenatanyaanate yamiyaaragaagethawe qure'aane 'aledarasaacawemene?!

'enazihe banabiyu yaasetabaabalu (kahadiyaane) male`eketanyaacenene wada 'enaresu saanelekenaa matsehhafene banaresu laaye saanaawarede bathemataacawenaa bachefene gazhinataacawe mekeneyaate qethaatocene bamaawerade benaathafaacawe batenesaa'ee `elate lakehedataacawe mekeneyaate lamaaqerabe 'enedihe yelu nabare. geetaacene hoye! bamederaawi `aalame male`eketanyocene 'atelekeme nabarene?. baqethaatehe mekeneyaate weredate saayesaferebene bafite 'enaamenebatenaa yezwacawe yamathaacawene 'aneqatzoce 'enekatale nabare.

male'etanyaacene hoye! la'enazihe 'asetabaabaayoce 'enedihe balaacawe 'enyaame 'enaanetame hulaaceneme 'alaahe yamiyaadaregawene 'enethabeqaalane. 'enaanetame thabequ. yatekekelanyaawe manegade baalabeete qathetanyaawene manegade yatamaraawe 'enyaa wayenese 'enaaneta maane 'enedahona therethere baleelawe huneetaa wadafite taaweqaalaacehu.
sawoce batenesaa'ee `elate baszeraacawe yamigamagamubate `elate qaraba; baqerebu hheyewate wetherate wesethe bamahonaacawe yatenesaa'eewene qane zanegetawaale.

kageetaacawe zanede baqerebu yawarada 'adise qure'aane bamathaalaacawe quthere thaqameetaa yaalawe maademathe 'ayaadaamethume; yelequnese yaqaledenaa bawesethu selaalawe male'ekete bagedeyalashenate nawe yamiyaadaamethute.

lebaacawe yazanagaa hono nawe yamisamute; bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate badalanyaa yahonuteme:: yehe male'eketanyaa nanye yamilawe sawe ka'enaaneta yamaayelaye 'enedanaanetawe yaala sawe 'ayedalamene?! yezote yamathaaweme degemete nawe; lamahonuse 'enedanaanetawe sawe mahonune 'enaa yezote yamathaawe degemete mahonune 'eyaawaqaacehu tekatalutaalaacexwaalene?! belawe yamimasaatharutene yedabeqaalu.

male'eketanyaaweme (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'enedihe 'ala:: yametedabequtene waree geetaayee yaaweqaale. bamedereme hona basamaayaate katanaagaariwe yamimanachawene negegere yaaweqaale; yabaarocune negegere sami; tagebaaraacawene 'awaaqi nawe; baszeraacaweme yemanadaacawaale.

yelequnese muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yezote selamathaawe mamariyaa batamalakata walaawaayoce honawe; 'anedaanedee fece yaleelawe qezhate nawe yelaalu. leelaa gizee dagemo 'ayedalame! meneme manashaa saayenorawe raasu yafatharawe naweme yelaalu. leelaa gizeeme dagaami nawe yelaalu. 'ewenatanyaame kahona yamajamariyaawocu male'eketanyoce, musaa betere, saalihhe dagemo gemale 'enedaamathute hulu 'enasu yaamathutene `aayenate ta`aamere yaamethaalene 'alu.

ka'enaziheme bafite ta`aameraatoce 'enedimathaalaacawe theyaaqee 'aqerebawe tasathetwacawe yaamanu manedaroce yalume; yelequnese 'asetabaabalu; 'athafaanaacaweme. lamahonu 'enazihenyocu yaamenu yehone?!

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta bafite yalaakenaacawe male'eketanyoce malakotaawi raa`eye yamenaasetalaalefelaacawe sawoce 'eneji leelaa 'alenabarume; malaa'eketene 'alaakeneme. yehenene yamaataawequ kahoname yamatsaahhefetune baalabeetoce thayequ.

yamenelekaacawe male'eketanyoceneme yamaayemagabu 'akaalaate 'alaadaregenaacaweme; yelequnese maaneme 'enedamimagabawe yemagabaalu; yamaayemotunaa bazihe `aalame lazala`aalame yaminorume 'alaadaragenaacaweme.

kaziyaame male'eketanyocaacene 'enaa me'emanaane kathefaate bamaadaane lamale'eketanyocaacene yagabaanawene qaale kidaane 'aragaagathenelaacawe. 'alaahene bamakaadaacawenaa hathi'atene bamafatsamaacawe yatanasaame wasane yaalafuteneme 'athafaanaacawe.

kaamanaacehubatenaa bawesethu yaalaweneme katagabaraacehu kebere yametaaganyubatenaa yametekorubatene qure'aane 'awaradenelaacehu; yehenene 'asetawelaacehu ba'eresu lamaamanenaa bawesethu yaazalawene male'ekete lamatagebare 'atefathenumene?!
bafatsamute badalenaa kehedate saabiyaa nawaariwocwane yaathafaanaacawe katamoce barekaataa naacawe. ka'enasume baxwaalaa leeloce hhezebocene fatharene.
yathefaate 'eremejaa yamiwasadebaacawe sawoceme sere-naqale yahonawene qethaataacenene 'enedatamalakatu; kathefaatu (kaqethaatu) bamashashe manedaraacawene bafethenate laqawe yewathaalu.
bafeeze malekume 'enedihe yebaabaalaalu:: 'atesheshu; sela heyewataacehu tethayaqu zanede wada manoriyaacehunaa wada nabaraacehubate qenethote tamalasu.
'enanyehe badalanyoceme hathi'ataacawene bamaamane 'enedihe 'alu:: waye thefaataacenenaa keserataacene; 'alaahene bamakaadaacene saabiyaa badalanyoce nane.
'eneda taachada takele bamahone meneme yamaayeneqasaaqasu reesaawoce 'esekaadaragenaacawe gizee deraseme sela thefaataacawe kamanaazazenaa raasaacawene kamaraagame 'aletawagadume nabare.
samaaye, medere 'enaa bamakaakalaacawe yaalawene lachawaataanaa laqalede 'alefatharenaacaweme; yelequnese xaayaalenataacenene lamaasaayate nawe yafatharenaacawe.
baalabeeteme hona leje mayaaze benefalege noro 'enyaa zanede kaalute 'eneyeze nabare; kazihe yalaaqene bamahonaaceneme yehenene yamenaadarege 'ayedalaneme.

ba'eregetheme wada male'eketanyaacene yamenaasetalaalefawene malakotaawi raa`eye bakahaadiyaane kanetu 'emenate laaye 'enethelawaalane; yedamasesawaale. yatasaasaatawe 'aqwaamaacaweme tawagaajenaa thafi nawe. 'enaaneta misetenaa leje 'alawe yametelu; 'alaahene bamaayegabaawe baaheriye bamagelatsaacehu thefaate yegabaacexwaale.

misetenaa lejene mayaaze macagarene yamiyaaseradaa bamahonu; 'alaahe yazihe `aalame baalaneberate 'enedahona sigaletse 'enedihe yelaale::
yasamaayenaa yamedere selethaane ya'eresu becaa nawe. 'eresu zanede yamiganyute malaa'ekete 'eresune magazaate 'emebi bamaalate 'ayekorume; 'ayedakemumeme.
meneme saayesalacu zawatere 'alaahene yaawadesaalu.
yelequnese 'agaariwoce ka'alaahe wechi; mutaanene heyaawe maaderage yamaayecelu 'amaaleketene yaazu; lamahonu yehene maaderage yamaayecelene 'enedeete yegazaalu?!

basamaayaatenaa bamedere barekaataa 'amaaleketoce binoru noro bamakaakalaacawe bamifatharawe yaselethaane shekucaa bathafu nabare; tachabaachu gene kazihe bataqaaraani nawe. 'agaariwoce baweshate 'alaahe tagaari 'alawe belawe kamigaletsute yazufaanu geetaa laaqa.

'alaahe baselethaanume hona bawesaaneewe becanyaa nawe; sela wesaaneeweme hona sela fatsamawe maaneme 'ayethayeqaweme; yelequnese 'eresu baarocene selaszeraacawe yethayeqaacawaale; ba'eresume yemanadaacawaale.

ba'eregetheme ka'alaahe leelaa 'amelaakene tagazu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyihe 'agaariwoce 'enedihe balaacawe:: 'enazihe 'akaalaate 'amelekote 'enedamigabaacawe maaragaagachaa maaserajaa 'amethu. 'enaho ba'enee 'enaa ka'enee bafite banabarute male'eketanyoce laaye yawaradawe matsehhafe yeganyaale la'enaaneta yamihone maaserajaa yalaacehume. yelequnese 'abezaanyaawocu 'agaariwoce madagafiyaacawe maayemenatenaa chefene takataayenate nawe; bamahonume 'ewenatene maqabale celaa belawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta bafite maanenyaaweneme male'eketanyaa seneleke; ka'enee baqare 'ewenatanyaa tamalaaki yalame; 'eneene becaa 'ameleku; ba'enee laaye maaneneme tagaari 'enedaataadaregu yamile malakotaawi raa`eye saanaasetalaalefe 'alelaakenaacaweme.

'agaariwoceme:: 'alaahe malaa'eketene seete lejocu 'aderegwaacawaale 'alu. 'enasu kamiqathefute weshate 'alaahe laaqa yataqadasame nawe. yelequnese malaa'eketoce 'eresu zanede yatakabaru ya'alaahe baaroce naacawe; wada 'eresume 'ejege yaqarabu baalamwale naacawe.
banegegereme geetaacawene 'ayeqademume; saayaazaacawe 'anedeme qaale 'ayenaagarume. te'ezaazuneme fatsaamiwoce naacawe; fetsumeme 'ayeqaaranuteme.

yaalafaweneme hona yawadafite szeraacaweneme yaaweqaale; kaala faqaadunaa lawadadawe kaalehona baqare melejaane lamaaneme 'ayethayequme; yelequnese 'enaresu 'alaahene kamaferaataacawe yatanasaa 'ejege thenequqe naacawe. bate'ezaazeme hona bakelekalaa 'ayetsaararuteme.

kamalaa'eketoceme 'anedaacawe:: 'enee ka'alaahe wechi lemalake yamigabaanye 'amelaaka nanye bile 'enekwaa; la'ezihe negegeru batenesaa'eewe 'elateme lazala`aalame yamiqathaabate ya'esaate qethaate 'eneqathaawe nabare. bakehedatenaa ba'alaahe laaye tagaari bamaaderage yabadalutene ba'enedazihe `aayenate qethaate 'eneqathaacawaalane.

lamahonuse 'enanyihe 'alaahene yakaadu sawoce samaayaatenaa medere yatathaabaqunaa meneme kefetate yaalenabaraacawe 'enedanabarunaa zenaabeme ka'enasu yezanebe 'enedanabara; 'eneda layanaacawe; kasamaayeme wada medere bamiwaredaweme zenaabe saabiyaa 'enesesaateneme hona 'atekeletocene 'enedafatharene 'ayaawequmene?! yehenenu bamaasetawaalese ba'alaahe becanyaa 'amelaakenate 'ayaamenumene?!

medere nawaariwocwa laaye 'enedaataaragaregetsenu yahonu taraarocene fatharene; baguzwacaweme wada falagute 'aqethaachaa magwaazeme yecelu zanedeme safaafinaa yatalayaayu manegadocene zaragaanelaacawe.

samaayeneme mesaso saayenorawe 'enedaayewadeqe yatathabaqa thaaraa 'adereganawaale; wareene kamiwaseduteme thabeqanawaale. 'agaariwoceme 'eneda tzahaaye 'enaa charaqaa yaalutene basamaaye laaye yamiganyu ta`aameraatocene celaa bamaalate 'ayaasetawelume.

'alaaheme leelitene la'erafete, qanene dagemo laszeraa yafathara; tzahaayene laqane; charaqaaneme lameshete magalachaanate babecanyenate yafathara 'enaa tzahaayenaa charaqaame wada qanyeme hona wada geraa saayezaanafu baqathetaa yamigwaazubate mehhewaare 'alaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta bafite kanabarute yasawe lejoce la'anedaacaweme bazihe hheyewate lazala`aalame maqoyatene 'alewasaneme; lamahonu bazihe `aalame yaalahe yamanoriyaa gizee bithanaaqaqenaa betemote 'enanyihe kaaneta baxwaalaa lazala`aalame yeqoyaalune?! bafetsume.

maanenyaawaame nafese 'amaanyeme tehune kahaadi ba'ezihe `aalame motene qamaashenaate. 'enaaneta yasawe lejoce hoye! bazihenyaawe `aalameme wesethe bahaalaafinate, batsagaa 'enaa baqethaate 'enefatenaacexwaalane; kaziyaame setemotu wada 'enyaa becaanaa becaa nawe yametemalasute; 'eneda szeraacehume 'enemanadaacexwaalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyihe 'agaariwoce baayuhe gizee masaalaqiyaa 'aderegawe nawe yamiyezuhe; takataayocaacaweneme kaaneta lamaaraaqe:: lamahonu yametaamalekwaacawe 'amaaleketocene yamitacawe yehe sawe nawe?! 'eyaalu yesaalaqaalu. 'enediheme baaneta laaye kamasaalaqaacaweme gaare 'alaahe yaawaradalaacaweneme qure'aane 'enaa yalagasaacaweneme tzagaa yekedaalu. kefu yatabaala nagarene hulu yasabasabu bamahonaacawe litacu 'enaa linawaru yamigabute 'enasu naacawe.

yasawe leje mathaadafe baahheriwe nawe; selahoname nagaroce kamakasataacawe bafite yethaadafaale. ka'ezihe gatsetaa 'anedu kahadiyaane qethaatu yate'ala bamaalate mathaadafaacawe nawe. qethaateene yametaathaadefu sawoce hoye! yametethaadafubatene qethaate 'asaayaacexwaalahu; 'enedifaathaneme 'atethayequ.

kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yaasetabaabalu kahadiwoce bamathaadafe:: 'enaaneta muselimoce hoye! lamahonu teqasaqesaalaacehu belaacehu yametezabaabatubene sela makasatu 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu macee nawe yamikasatawe?! bamaalate yethayeqaalu.

'enanyehe maqaseqasene yaasetabaabalu kahadiyaane kafitaacawe 'enaa kajarebaacawe laaye 'esaatene mamakate 'enedamaayecelu 'enedihume 'esaatene yamimaketelaacawe radaate 'enedamaayenoraacawe biyaawequ 'enaa biyaaragaagethu noro qethaate tolo 'enedimathaa baaletamanyu nabare.

yamiqathubate ya'esaate qethaateme 'enasu 'aweqawete 'ayedalame yamimathaabaacawe; yelequnese badenegate nawe yamimathaabaacawe; raasaacawene makalaakale 'ayecelume; tatzatzetawe 'ezenate yaaganyume zanede 'ayethabaqume.

ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yahhezebocaacawe masaalaqenaa maasetabaabale sirabeshaacawe; 'alaahe 'enedihe bamaalate 'atsenaanaacawe::
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! hhezebocehe bisaalaqubeheme 'aneta yamajamariyaawe 'ayedalaheme; yelequnese kaaneta bafite baqadamute male'eketanyoce laaye tasaaleqawebaacawaale. 'enanyaa bamale'eketanyoce laaye yesaalaqu yanabaru kahadiyaane bazihe `aalame laaye male'eketanyocaacawe siyaasefaraarwacawe yesaalaqubate yanabarawe qethaate kababaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! qethaate yamiyaathaadefutene 'enedihe balaacawe:: lamahonu 'arahhemaane 'enaaneta laaye maawerade kamifalegawe qethaatenaa yamaathefaate 'eremejaa bamesheteme hona baqane yamithabeqaacehu maanawe?! nagaru yageetaacawene gesaatsee 'enedihume maaserajaawocune kamaasetaawase yatagalalu naacawe. bamaayemenatenaa bamonyenateme yatanasaa meneme 'ayaasetanatenume.

wayenese qethaataacenene yamikalaakalelaacawe 'amelaake 'alaacawene?! yamigathemaacawene cegere karaasaacawe bamamakate raasaacawene maredaate 'ayecelume; laraasaacaweme theqeme maamethaate 'ayecelume; raasune 'enekwaa maredaate yamaayecele 'enedeete nawe leelaawene liradaa yamicelawe?! 'enasu raasaacawe ka'enyaa qethaate maamelachaa yalaacaweme.

yelequnese 'enazihene sawocenaa walaajocaacawene lamaamacaacate 'enaa lamaazanaagaate bazaragaanelaacawe tsagaacene 'athaqaaqamenaacawe; gizeeweme razamabaacawenaa tashanagalu; bakehedataacaweme laaye qathalubate. lamahonu 'enanyihe batsagaacene yatashanagalutenaa qethaataacenene yamiyaathaadefute sawoce nawaariwocwane shenefate 'enedigathemaacawe bamaaderage 'enaa bamaawaarade mederene zureyaawaane 'enedameneqanesaate 'ayemalakatumene?! bazihu tamakerawe siyaabaqu baleelocu laaye yaarafawe `aayenate 'adagaa 'enedaayaaganyaacawe 'ayegasatsumene?! 'enanyihe 'ashanaafiwoce saayehonu tashanaafiwoce naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale:: 'enaaneta sawoce hoye! ya'alaahe qethaatene yamaasethanaqeqaacehu geetaayee wada 'enee yaawaradawene malakotaawi raa`eye maszarate bamaaderage nawe.'ewenatene laalamasemaate denequrenaa yaalabaacawe ka'alaahe qethaate bamaasefaraaraate wada 'ewenate theri sidaragelaacawe maqabalenaa maademathe 'ayaadaamethume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa qethaate 'enedifathene yamifalegu sawoce kageetaahe zanede qethaate siyaaganyaacawe 'enedihe yelaalu:: waye thefaataacene 'enaa keserataacene! 'alaahene bamaagaaraatenaa muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yezote yamathaawene bamaasetabaabale badalanyoce nabarene.

latenesaa'eewe sawoceme szeraacawe yemazanebate zanedeme mizaanaawi yahonawene mizaane 'enaaseqamethaalane. ba`elatume malekaame szeraawaane bamaagudale 'aliyaame bawanejale laaye leelaa wanejale bamachamare maanenyaawaame nafese 'atebadaleme.yamimazanawe kebedatu yasanaafeche kebedate yaahele bihoneme maamethaataacene 'ayeqareme; yabaarocaacenene szeraa maqothaathareme ba'enyaa baqaa.

ba'ewenatenaa bahasate 'enedihume yatafaqadawenenaa yatakalakalawene yamilaye;laamanubateme mamariyaa 'enedihone 'enaa geetaacaweneme lamifarute maasetaawashaa yehone zanede taweraatene lamusaanaa lahaarune (`alayehimaa 'asalaame) ba'eregetheme sathetanaale.
'enanyaa saayemalakatute yamiyaamenubate yahonawene geetaacawene qethaate yamifarutenaa yatenesaa'eewene `elate yamifaru naacawe.

yehe bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye yatawaradawene qure'aane maasetaawase lamifalege maasetaawashaanaa tagesaatse nawe. barekaataa theqemenaa malekaamenate yaalabate nawe; 'enedihe kamahonume gaare taasetabaabelutaalaacexwaalene?! bawesethu yaalawene 'ataaragaagethume; 'ateszarubatememe?!
la'abaatu 'azare 'enaa lahhezebocu:: 'enazihe ba'ejocaacehu yaszaraacexwaacawe 'enaa baqwaaminate yametaamalekwaacawe thaa`otaate menedenaacawe?! silaacawe::
hhezebocume:: walaajocaacene siyaamalekwaacawe yaaganyanaacawe bamahonu 'enasune 'are'ayaa bamaaderage nawe yaamalakenaacawe 'alute.
beraahime 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: 'enaaneta takataayoce hoye! 'enaanetame honaacehu 'asekataaye walaajocaacehu ka'ewenatanyaawe manegade geletse yahona themate laaye naacehu.
hhezebocume 'enedihe 'alute:: lamahonu yehenene setele 'ewenatehene nawe wayenese 'eyaqaladeke nawe?!

beraahimeme 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: ba'eregetheme yezheelaacehu yamathaahute qume nagare 'eneji qalede 'ayedalame. geetaacehu kaala qedema-mesaalee lafatharaacawe samaayaatenaa medere baalabeete nawe; ya'enaaneta 'enaa yasamaayaate 'enedihume yamedere geetaa mahonune kamimasekerute 'anedu nanye; lathaa`otocaacehu 'anedaaceme dereshaa yalaacaweme.
beraahime hhezebocu saayesamute 'enedihe 'ala:: kathaa`otocaacehu reqaacehu laba`aale seteheedu sela thaa`otaacehu yamiyaaseqayemaacehune nagare 'aseeraalahu.

beraahime thaa`otocaacawene tenaaneshe quretheraache 'esekihonu deraseme 'anekotaakotaacawe; wada 'eresume tamalesawe maane 'enedasabaabaraacawe yethayequteme zanede taalaaqaacawe yahonawene thaa`ote 'aseqara.
wesunocu 'enedihe 'alu:: beraahime yamibaale gobaze wathaate bakefu semaacawene siyaanasaanaa sitacaacawe sametanaale; mene 'alebaateme yaawadamaacawe 'eresu saayehone 'ayeqareme.

mariwocaacaweme 'enedihe 'alu:: yaszaraawene nagare siyaamene sawoce 'enedimalakatunaa maamanume ba'eresu laaye la'enaaneta yamithaqeme marajaa yehonelaacehu zanede sawe hulu taganyeto mamalekatenaa masemaate wada micelebate botaa yezaacehu 'aqerebute.

beraahime ba'adabaabaaye yathaa`otocaacawene dakaamaanate bageletse lamaasaayate bamasaalaqeme 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: yehenene yafatsamekute 'enee saalehone yathaa`otaatu taalaaqe nawe yehenene yafatsamawe; yaminaagaru kahoname thaa`otocaacehune thayeqwaacawe.

bamaasetanetanenaa bamaasetawaale wada raasaacawe tamalasu; thaa`otocaacawe yamaayethaqemu 'enedihume yamaayegodu mahonaacawe tagalatsalaacawe; ka'alaahe wechime 'enasune bamagazaataacawe badalanyoce mahonaacaweneme taganazabu.

kaziyaame wada te`ebitaacawenaa wada maasetabaabalaacawe tamalasunaa 'enedihe 'alu:: 'aneta beraahime hoye! 'enanyihe thaa`otaate 'enedamaayenaagaru ba'eregethe taaweqaalahe; 'enedeetese nawe 'enedenethayeqaacawe yametaazezane?! yehene silu ba'eresu laaye maaserajaa maaqerabaacawe nabare genaa ba'enasu laaye marajaa honabaacawe.

beraahime bamaawegazeme 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: yamaayethaqemwacehune 'enedihume yamaayegodwacehune thaa`otaate taamalekaalaacehu 'enedee? karaasaacawe 'adagaane makalaakale 'aliyaame theqeme maamethaate 'ayecelume.

menenyaa 'aseqayaami naacehu; meneme yamaayethaqemunaa yamaayegodu honawe saala ka'alaahe wechi yametaamalekwaacawe thaa`otaateme 'aseqayaami naacawe; lamahonu yehenenu 'asetawelaacehu 'enasune maamelake 'atetawemene?!

bamaaserajaa 'eresune magaafathe sisaanaacawe wada gulebate tashagaagarunaa 'enedihe 'alu:: yasabaabaraacawenenaa yaafaraarasaacawene thaa`otocaacehune lamaredaate sibaale 'enaa lamaqathaachaanateme 'eremejaa mawesade yametecelu kahona beraahimene ba'esaate 'aqaathelute.
'esaate 'aqathaathalunaa bawesethu warawaruteme; 'enyaame:: 'esaate hoye! laberaahime salaamenaa qazeqaazaa hunelate; 'alenawe; 'enedaziyaame honalate; meneme seqaaye 'alaaganyaweme.
yaberaahime hhezeboce 'eresune lamaaqaathale 'aseeru; seeraacawene 'akashafenebaacawe; yelequnese 'enasune thafiwocenaa tashanaafiwoce 'adaragenaacawe.
'eresune 'enaa lutheneme 'adaanenaacawe. nabiyaatene bamalaakenaa lafetherataate baasaraachanawe malekaame nagare yatanasaa barakate wada 'adaragenaabaateme yashaame medere 'asewathaanaacawe.

geetaawe leje 'enedisathawe batamaatzana gizeeme sehhaaqene sathanawe. batachamaarinateme yaa`equbene sathanawe; 'eyaanedaanedaacawene beraahimene 'enedihume lejocune sehhaaqenenaa yaa`equbeneme 'alaahene taazaazhe dagaagoce 'adaragenaacawe.

sawoce bamalekaame 'are`aayaanate yemarubaacawe zanedeme mariwoce 'adaragenaacawe. ba'alaahe faqaademe sawocene 'alaahene babecanyenate 'enediyaamaleku theri yaadaregaalu. malekaame szeru; salaateneme batamwalaa maleku fatsemu 'enedihume zakaatene sethu yamile malekete 'asetalaalafenelaacawe; 'enaresume lanyaa taazaazhoce nabaru.

lalutheme batathaalu sawoce makaakale yamaferade thebabene sathanawe; sela haayemaanotume 'eweqate sathanawe. nawaariwocwa tsayaafe tagebaare yefatzemu yanabarutene yasadome manedare laaye kaawaradenawe qethaate natsaa 'awathaanawe; hhezebocu kageetaacawe te'ezaaze yaafanagathu kefu sawoce nabaru.

hhezebocu laaye kadarasawe qethaate 'eresune bamaadaanaacene bacerotaacene wesethe 'asegabaanawe; te'ezaazaacene bamaakebarenaa yakalakalenawene bamaraaqe te'ezaazaacene kamiyaakaberute bago sawoce nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaberaahimenaa kaluthe bafite wada 'alaahe theri yaadaragawenenaa yathayaqawene bamasethate melaashe yasathanawene; 'eresunenaa 'amaanye beetasabocune kataalaaqu cheneqe seladaanawe yanuhhe taarike 'awesaa.

'ewenatanyaa mahonune bamiyaaseradu ta`aameraate 'agazenawe. kaasetabaabalute hhezebocu tanekoleme 'adaanenawe; 'enasu yathefaatenaa yatanekole hhezeboce nabaru; hulaacaweneme bamaasethame 'athafaanaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! daawedenaa lejume sulayemaane hulate sawoce takaasawe ya'anedaanyaacawe bagoce baleelite bahulatanyaawe saweyee 'ereshaa tasamaaretawe 'ereshaawene bamaabalaashataacawe tathaaletawe sela mathubate gudaaye laaye sifaredu yahonawene taarike 'awesaa; yadaawedeneme hona yasulayemaanene ferede tamaleketanaale; feredaacaweme meneme 'aletasawarabeneme.

gudaayuneme ka'abaateyawe daawede yeleqe lasulayemaane 'asaawaqenawe; yehunenaa ladaawedeme hona lasulayemaane nabiyenatene 'enaa yahaayemaanotune denegaagee `eweqate sathetanaacawaale; sulayemaanene bazihe 'alelayanaweme. ladaawedeme ya'eresune wedaasee takatelawe 'alaahene 'enediyaawadesu bamaaderage taraarocene 'agaraanelate; baraari 'a`ewaafaateneme 'agaraanelate. yehenene maaseganezabune, `eweqate 'enaa thebabe masethatune 'enedihume nagarocene maamacaacatune lamafatsame wesaanee 'asaalefane nabare.

sawenataacehuneme yathore masaariyaa 'enedaayebathaathasaacehu makalaakayaa yehone zanede yaberate yathore lebese 'aszaraarene ladaawede 'asaawaqenawe. 'enaaneta yasawe lejoce hoye! lamahonu 'alaahe la'enaaneta selawaalalaacehu welataa taamasagenaalaacehu?

lasulayemaaneme nabiyaatocene yalaakenebate 'enaa barekaataa malekaame nagarocene yaasaraachanebate medere bamahonu yatabaaraka wada honawe yashaame medere bate'ezaazu 'enedetegwaaze 'ejege nafaashaa yahonacewene nefaase 'agaraanelate. huluneme nagare 'enaaweqaalane; meneme nagareme ka'enyaa yamisaware yalame.

lasulayemaaneme `enequ 'enaa yamasaasalutene baahhere wesethe bamathelaqe yaawathu zanede shayethwanocene 'agaraanelate. kaziheme leelaagenebaataanaa yamasaasalutene szeraawocene yeszarulataale. qutheraacaweneme hona bezaataacawene ba'eregetheme 'enaaweqaalane; meneme 'ayaamalethaneme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'ayube (`alayehi 'asalaame) cegere bagathamawe gizee geetaawene:: geetaayee hoye! babashetaanaa beetasabe yamaathaate cegere gathamanye; 'aneta dagemo ka'azaanyoce hulu balaache 'azaanye nahe; yagathamanyene cegere 'anesaalenye; belo batamaatsana gizee yahonawene taarike 'awesaa.

latheriweme melaashe sathanawe; yadarasabateneme gudaate 'asewagadenelate; 'athetwacawe yanabarutene beetasabocunenaa lejocuneme sathanawe; ka'enasume gaare tamasaasaayuneme sathanawe; yehenene hulu yaadaragenawe ka'enyaa bahona 'ezenate 'enaa ba'amelekote la'alaahe taazaazhe lahonuteme 'ayube 'enedataagasawe yetaagasu zanede lamaasetaawase chemere nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! semaa`ilene, derisene 'enedihume zulekifeleneme (ya'alaahe salaame bahulume laaye yehunenaa) 'awesaa; 'eyaanedaanedaacawe bacegere gizee taagaashocenaa 'alaahe gedeetaa yaadaragabaacawene xaalaafinataacawene ba'agebaabu yatawathu naacawe.
