ba'ezenataacene bamaakaatate nabiyaatoce 'adaragenaacawe; janateme 'asegabaanaacawe; yageetaacawene te'ezaaze bamatagebarenaa wechaacaweme hona wesethaacawe yaamaara malekaame kahonute ya'alaahe baaroce naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya`aasaa gwaade yahonawe yunuse (`alayehi 'asalaame) hhezebocu bawanejalenaa hathi'ate laaye wasane bamaalafaacawe saabiyaa tanaado kaala geetaawe faqaade thelo heedo; sela maheedu maqathaachaa yehone zanede yamenaachanaaneqawe 'alemasalaweme nabare. `aasaawe wethote 'ejege bamachanaanaqe 'enaa hodu wesethe bamaasare fatanawe; thefaatune bamaamanenaa kathefaatume wada 'alaahe bamatsatsate batanabaabarawe ya`aasaa hode, yabaahherenaa yameshete chalamaa wesethe bamahone:: kaaneta leelaa ba'ewenate limalake yamigabaawe yalame; yataqadasekenaa yalaaqeke nahe; 'enee kabadalanyoce nanye; bamaalate batathaaraa gizee yahonawene taarike 'awesaa.

latheriweme melaashe sathanawe; katanabaabarawe chalamaanaa ka`aasaawe hodeme bamaasewathaate kachenequ cegereme 'adaanawe. yunusene kazihe `aayenate cheneqe 'enedaadaanenawe hulu 'amaanyoceme cheneqe laaye wadeqawe 'alaahene kalamanu 'enasuneme 'enaadenaacawaalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! zakariyaa:: geetaayee! leje yaleelanye becanyaa 'ataadereganye; 'aneta kaqariwoce hulu balaache nahe; ka'enee mamote baxwaalaa yamitakaanye leje sethanye; bamaalate geetaawene silamene yahonawene taarike 'awesaa.

latheriweme melaashe sathanawe; yaahheyaa yamibaale lejeneme sathanawe; baalabeetuneme 'abajanelate; makaane nabarace genaa 'enedetewalede 'adaragenaate. zakariyaa, baalabeetunaa leju malekaame lamaszeraate yamishaqadaadamu 'enedihume 'enyaa zanede yaalawene malekaame nagare bamakajalenaa 'enyaa zanede yaalawene qethaate bamasegaateme yemaatsanune 'enaa la'enyaame taanaanaashoce nabaru.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! beletwane kazemute selathabaqacewe mareyame taarike 'awesaa; 'alaahe jiberilene (`alayehi 'asalaame) wada 'eswa bamalaake nafaabaatenaa `isaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) tsanasace; 'ereswanaa lejwane `isaaneme lasawoce ya'alaahe xaayaalenatenaa 'enaa kaala 'abaateme 'eresune bamafetharume 'alaahe meneme 'enedamaayesaanawe maasaayaa nabaru.
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! yehe haayemaanotaacehu 'anede haayemaanote nawe; 'eresume yaselaame haayemaanote yahonawe tawehhide nawe; 'eneeme geetaacehu nanye 'amelekoteneme la'enee becaa fatsemu.

sawoce 'alaahene babecanyenate yamiyaamaleku 'ahadaawiyaane, 'agaariwoce, kahadinaa 'amaanyeme bamahone takafaafalu. batenesaa'eeweme `elate 'enanyihe yatakafaafalute hulu wada 'enyaa becaanaa becaa yemalasalu; 'enedayaszeraacaweme 'enemanadaacawaalane.

ka'enasume makaakale ba'alaahe: bamale'eketanyaawenaa bamacharashaawe qane 'ameno malekaame szeraawocene yaszaraa malekaame szeraawene 'ayekaademe; yelequnese 'alaahe menedaawene yaamasagenelatenaa 'ethefe derebe yaadaregelataale; bamiqasaqesebate `elateme baszeraawe mazegabe laaye safero yaaganyawenaa yedasataaleme.

yamaanenyaawaame manedare sawocene bakehedataacawe saabiyaa kaathafaanaacawe baxwaalaa 'eneditzatzatunaa tzatzataacaweme taqabaayenate yaaganye zanede wada 'ezihenyaawe `aalame 'enasune mamalasaacene fetzume yamaayetaasabe nawe.
fetsume 'ayemalasume. yaya'ejuje 'enaa maa'ejuje gedebe sikafateme bafethenate kamedere kafetaa 'eyatamamu yewathaalu.

'enasume bamawethaataacawe yatenesaa'eewe `elate yeqarebaale. yatenesaa'eewe `elate 'asefari kesetatocenaa cheneqatoce geletse yehonaalu; ka'asedanegaachenatu yatanasaa yakahaadiyaane `ayene fathetho 'enedihe yelaalu:: waa thefaataacene! baduneyaa hheyewate 'eyaalane lazihe taalaaqe qane mazagaajate tazanaagetanaale; belome kehedatenaa hathi'atene bamafatsameme badalanyoce nabarene.

'enaaneta 'agaariyaane hoye! 'enaanetame honaacehu ka'alaahe leelaa setaamalekwaacawe yanabarute thaa`otaate 'enedihume setaamalekwaacawe dase yesanyu yanabarute sawoceme honu 'agaanenetoce ya'esaate maqathaathayaa naacehu. 'enaaneta 'enaa 'amaaleketocaacehume 'esaate gabiwoce naacehu.

'enanyihe ka'alaahe leelaa yamimalakute 'akaalaate ba'ewenate 'amelekote yamigabaacawe bihone noro kamiyaamalekwaacawe sawoce gaare 'esaate baalegabu nabare. 'eyaanedaanedu tamalaakime hona 'amelaaki fetsume yamaayewathu sihonu lazala`aalame 'esaate wesethe nawaariwoce naacawe.

wesethu kamigathemaacawe thanekaaraa seqaaye yatanasaa kabaade 'esetenefaase 'eyaawathu yenesaqasaqaalu; 'esaate wesethe kamigathemaacaweme 'asedanegaache kesetate yatanasaa demetsocene masemaate yesaanaacawaale.

'agaariwoce `isaame hona malaa'eketoce bamamalakaacawe yatanasaa 'esaate yegabaalu maalate nawe silu; 'alaahe 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: `isaanaa masalocu 'enedihume 'alaahe baqadama `eweqatu yadasetaa sawoce 'enedihonu yaasaalafaacawe sawoce ka'esaate yereqaalu.
ya'esaate demetseneme 'ayesamume; yelequnese 'enasu nafesaacawe bametefalegawe tzagaanaa 'erekaataa wesethe qwaamiwoce honawe zawatere 'ayeqwaarathebaacaweme.

'esaate bagwaadocwa laaye tathareqemaa bametezagaa waqete yaalawe 'asedanegaache taalaaqe kesetate 'ayaasefaraacaweme; yelequnese malaa'eketoce ba'enekwaane dasetaa male'ekete 'aqabaabale 'eyaadaragulaacawe:: baduneyaawe `aalame taqathero yanabarawe qanaacehu nawe; bawesethu bametaaganyute tsagaa tadasatu; yelwacawaale.

mazegabe bawesethu yaazalawe tzehufe 'eyaalabate 'enedamithaqalale samaayene bamenethaqalele gizee; fetherataateneme majamariyaa batafatharubate 'akwaaxwaane honawe 'eneqasaqesaacawaalane; yeheme tafatsaami 'enedamihone qaale gabetane nabare; qaale yagabaanaweneme fatsamene.

bathebequ saleedaa laaye kaasafarenawe baxwaalaa bamale'eketanyoce laaye baawaradenawe matsehhafe wesethe:: ya'alaahe malekaame baaroce te'ezaazune 'akebaari yahonute maalateme yamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) hhezeboce mederene yewaresaalu belane tzefane 'aseferanaale.
baawaradenawe gesaatsee wesetheme 'alaahe badanagagalaacawe mamariyaa maszarate lamiyaamalekute hhezeboce taalaaqe male`ekete 'alawe; ba'ewenatu ba'ezihe male`ekete tathaqaamiwocu 'enaresu naacawe.
'aneta muhhamade hoye! sawocene lamameraatenaa ka'alaahe qethaate lamaadaane kaalahe leyu felaagote yatanasaa lafetherataate bamulu 'azaanye 'aderegane lekanehale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale:: kageetaayee yatalaalafalenye malakotaawi raa`eye 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaakaacehu 'anede 'amelaake nawe; meneme tagaari yaleelawe nawe; 'eresume 'alaahe nawe. 'eresune lamaamanenaa te'ezaazuneme tagebaaraawi lamaaderage taazaazhe hunu.

yaamathaahelaacawene mamariyaa celaa yaalu 'enedahona; 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe:: 'enee 'enaa 'enaaneta ba'ekule leyunate wesethe 'enedaalane 'asaaweqeeyaacexwaalahu; 'alaahe 'enedamiqathaacehu yagabaawe qaale macee 'enedamiwaredebaacehu 'alaaweqeme.
kanegegere geletze yametaadareguteneme hona yametedabequtene 'alaahe yaaweqaale; meneme nagare 'ayesawarebateme; ba'esume yemanadaacexwaale.

qethaataacehune maazageyatu mene 'alebaate 'enaanetane lamafatane, lamaazanaagaate 'enaa ba'alaahe `eweqate 'esekatawasanawe `elate derase 'enaaneta 'enedetezenaanu belome bakehedataacehunaa bathememataacehu laaye 'enedetegafubate lihone yecelaale; 'enee gene 'alaaweqeme.

ya'alaahe male'eketanyaame (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'alaahene 'eyatamaatsanu 'enedihe 'alu:: geetaayee! ba'ewenate bamaferade ba'enyaa 'enaa bakehedate laaye ceke baalute hhezebocee makaakale laye. 'enaaneta kametenaagarute kehedatenaa qethefate bageetaacene ba'alerahhemaane 'enetaagazaalane.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! yaazazaacehune bamatagebarenaa kakalakalaacehume bamataaqabe geetaacehune feru. katenesaa'eewe `elate gaare tathaamerawe yamimathu 'asedanegaache nagaroce 'ejege taalaaqe naacawe. ya'alaahene wedeetaa bamiyaaseganye szeraa lenezagaajelate yamigabaa nawe.

kaferehaateme bezaate maanenyaawaame 'athebi 'enaate yametaathabaawene lejwane setezanagaa; yaaragazacewaame 'eregezenaawaa sichanaagafe; kesetatume 'ejege 'asedanegaache bamahonume sawoce 'a`emerwacawene kamasaataacawe yatanasaa 'enedasakaaraame sihonu temalakataacawaalahe. masekaraacawe 'asekaari mathathe kamathathaate saayehone ya'alaahe qethaate beretaate nawe 'a`emerwacawene yaasaataacawe.

'alaahe katenesaa'eewe makasate gaare tathaamerawe yamimathu 'asedanegaache nagarocene kathaqasa baxwaalaa tenesaa'ee 'enaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce melaashe sisathe 'enedihe yelaale::
kasawoce mahaleme yamidagafebate `eweqate saayenorawe sela 'alaahe celotaanaa kamote baxwaalaa sela maqaseqase yamikaraakare 'enaa ba'emenatume hona banegegeru bageetaawe laaye yaamatsane shayethaanenaa yathemate mariwocene yamikatalu 'alu.

'amatsanyaa yahonawene yasaweme hona ya'agaanenete shayethwanene yatakatala 'enaa 'ewenateme belo yaamana; katekekelanyaawe manegade 'enedamiyaathamawe tawasenwale; wada kehedatenaa hathi'aateme selamimaraaweme wada 'esaate yenadaawaale.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! kamote baxwaalaa 'enaanetane selamaqaseqase celotaacene therethaaree kaalaacehu; 'afathaatharaacehune 'asetawelu. 'abaataacehune 'aadamene ka'afare nawe yafatharenawe; bamaqathaleme zereyaawene kawanedu wada seetwa maahetzane bamifanaatharawe yazare fasaashe fatharenaacawe. kaziyaame yazare fasaashu wada ragaa damenate yeqayaraale; yaragaawe dameme yataanyaka wada mimasele quraache segaanate yelawathaale; qathelome quraache segaawe wayeme wada tamwalaa fethurenate taqayero maahetsane wesethe bamaregaate heyewate yaalawe leje hono 'esekamiwalade yeqoyaale; 'aliyaame yaaletasetakaakala fethure yehonenaa maahetzane yaasewaredaawaale. yeheme yahonawe 'enaanetane batalayaaya ya'afathaathare 'erekane bamaasaalafe yamafethare celotaacenene lenegaletselaacehu nawe. katatsanasaweme yafalagenawene 'eseka tawasanawe qana-gadabe maalateme zathanye ware moletote 'esekiwalade derase bamaahetzane wesethe 'enaaragaagaawaalane; kaziyaame kanaataacehu maahetzane hetsaane leje 'aderegane 'enaasewathaacexwaalane; kaziyaame baxaayeleme hona ba'asetasaasabe yatamwalaa darajaa laaye tedaresaalaacehu. ka'enaaneta makaakaleme qademo yamimote 'ala; yatawasanaacehute dagemo xaayelenaa 'asetasaasabe yamidakemebate ya'erejenaa gizee dareso kahetzaane leje yakafaa darajaa laaye bamaderase yaaweqe yanabarawe hulume yamithafaabate darajaa laaye yamidareseme 'ala. mederene meneme 'atekelete yaleelabaate daraqe mareete honaa temalakataalahe; yazenaabe weha senaazanebebaate ba'atekelete tekafaafataalace; 'atekeletocwame bamaadagaacaweme tenafaafaalace; kahulume ya'azere`erete `aayenateme webe gatsetaa yaalawene taabaqelaalace.

yehe ya'afathaatharaacehu 'ajamaamare; yametaalefute 'erekane 'enedihume yamiwaladawe yaalawe huneetaane yagalatsenelaacehu kametaamalekute thaa`ote yeleqe yafatharaacehu geetaa 'alaahe meneme therethaaree yaleelawe 'ewenatanyaa mahonune 'enedetaamenu nawe; batachamaarime mutaanene 'enedamiqasaqesenaa meneme yamaayesaanawe hulune nagare maaderage yamicele mahonuneme 'enedetaamenu nawe.
tenesaa'eewe yamimathaa mahonunaa selamamethaatu meneme therethaaree yaleelawe mahonu 'enedihume 'alaahe mutaanene baszeraacawe lamamanedaate kaqaberaacawe 'enedamiqasaqesaacawe 'enedetaamenume nawe.

'alaahe baszosetanyaawe 'aneqatse laaye bachefene takataayenate sababe yaalawene yathemate huneetaa kagalatsa baxwaalaa baqathaaye 'aneqatze dagemo yathemate qunecho selahonute baaheri sigaletse 'enedihe 'ala::
kakahadiyaaneme makaakale wada 'ewenate yamiyaadarese `eweqate saayenoraacawe, wadatekekelanyaa 'aqwaame yamiyaadaresaacawe mari saayenoraacawe 'enaa yamilutene nagare yamiyaaseradaa ka'alaahe zanede yawarada 'aberi matsehhafe saayenoraacawe sela 'alaahe 'ahhadenate yamikaraakaru 'alu.

sawocene ka'emenatenaa wada 'alaahe haayemaanote 'enedaayegabu lamaagade bakuraate 'anegatune yaazoraale. ba'ezihe `aayenate baaheri yatagalatsa bamigathemawe qethaate baqerebitu `aalame yamiwaarade sihone bamacharashaawe `aalameme yamiyaaqaathele 'esaate 'enaaqamesawaalane.
'enediheme yebaalaale:: yehe yameteqamesawe qethaate bafatsamekawe kehedatenaa wanejale sababe nawe; 'alaahe kafetherataatu maaneneme yaala wanejalu 'ayeqathaame.

kasawoce makaakaleme yatametaataanaa batherethaaree laaye hono 'alaahene yamigazaa 'ala; taadiyaa theenenate 'enaa haabete kaaganya ba'amaanyenatenaa la'alaahe baalawe taazaazhenate laaye yeqathelaale; yabashetaame hona yadehenate cegere sigathemawe sela haayemaanotu kefu yaasebenaa yeqalabasaale. duneyaawene kasara; kehedatume katawasanalate weche kazihece `aalame meneme `edele 'ayechamerelate. bamacharashaawe `aalame kamigathemawe ya'alaahe qethaate kasaari nawe; yeheme geletse keserate nawe.

biyaametzebaacawe yamaayegodutene bitaazazaacaweme yamaayethaqemutene thaa`otaate ka'alaahe weche yegazaale. yehe lithaqemunaa ligodu yamaayecelutene thaa`otaate mamaatsanu ka'ewenate yaraaqa themate nawe.

yehe kahadi kamiyaaganyawe theqeme yeleqe gojenatu ba'eregethe yahonawene thaa`otene yemaatsanaale; katheqemu yeleqe lagudaate 'ejege yaqaraba 'amelaake menenyaa yakafaa 'amelaake nawe. 'eredaataa lamithayeqaweme hona gwaadanyenate falego latagodaanyaweme menenyaa yakafaa radaatenaa gwaadanyaa nawe.

'enanyaa yaamanutene 'enaa malekaame yahonu szeraawoce yamiszarutene 'alaahe kahenetsaawocwa sere wanezoce yamifasesubaate wada honacewe janate yaasegabaacawaale. 'alaahe lamiyaazenawe bamaazane; yamiqathaaweneme siqathaa yafalagawene yaadaregaale; yamiyaasegadedawe yalame.

'alaahe male'eketanyaawene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) baqerebitu `aalameme hona bamacharashaawe `aalame 'ayeradaame belo yaasaba; babeetu thaaraa laaye gamade yeseqalenaa 'esetenefaasune kamedere lamaathanaaqaqe yetaanaqe; kaziyaame yehe deregitu bawesethu yaalawene quchetenaa nedeete yaathafaalate 'enedahona yemalekate. 'amatsanyaawe falagame 'alefalagame 'alaahe nabiyune yeradaale.

kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase 'enedaala geletse bahona maaserajaa 'eneda galatsenelaacehu hulu; bamuhhamademe (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye qure'aaneneme geletse yahonu 'aneqatzoce 'aderegane 'aweredanaale. laqenunaa latasetakaakalawe manegade 'alaahe baterufaatu yafalagawene lasekeete yaabaqaale.

kazihe tewelede, ka'ayehudoce, kasaabi'oce ('anedaanede nabiyaatocene yamikatalu budene naacawe), kanasaaraawoce, kathaa`otaawiyaane 'enaa ka'esaate 'amelaakiwoce ba'alaahe yaamanutene; batenesaa'eewe qane 'alaahe bamakaakalaacawe bamaferade 'amaanyocene janate siyaasegabaa yataqarutene dagemo 'esaate yaasegabaacawaale. 'alaahe 'eyaanedaanedune yabaariwocune negegerenaa tagebaare yemalakataale; meneme 'ayesawarebateme; baresu yemanadaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! samaaye laaye yaalu malaa'eketoce, bamedere laaye yamiganyuteme 'amaanye sawocenaa 'agaanenetoceme yataazaazhenate masegade la'alaahe 'enedamisagedu; tzahaaye, charaqaa, samaayaate laaye yaalu kawaakebetoce, gaaraawoce, zaafoce 'enaa bamedere laaye yaalu taneqasaaqaashe 'enesesoce yataazaazhenate masegadene 'enedamisagedulateme; barekaataa sawoceme la'alaahe 'eje 'enedaminasu taaweqaalahene?! barekaataawoceme la'alaahe masegade faqaadanyaa 'ayedalume; kahadi bamahonaacaweme ya'alaahe quthaa tzanaabaacawe. sela kehedatume 'alaahe weredatenaa yabataacenate yawasanabate sawe yamiyaakaberawe maaneme yalame. 'alaaheme yaashaawene yaadaregaale; yamiyaasegadedawe yalame.

'alaahe bataazaazhenate la'esu yamisagedutenenaa 'emebitanyocene kagalatza baxwaalaa; ya'eyaanedaanedaacawene macharashaa sigaletse 'enedihe yelaale::
'enanyihe hulate budenoce maalateme yamaanenaa yakehedate budenoce sela geetaacawe baalaacawe 'emenate maane tekekele 'enedahona yekaraakaraalu. yakehedate budenocu lebese sawenatene kabo 'enedamishafenawe hulu 'esaate zuriyaacawene yekabebaacawaale; 'ejege yafalaa weha cheneqelaataacawe laaye yedafaale.
kawehawe 'ejege mafelaate yatanasaame yahode 'eqaacawenaa qodaacawe yeqalethaale.
malaa'eketoce cheneqelaataacawene yamimatubateme yaberate madoshaame 'esaate wesethe tazagaajetolaacawaale.
bawesethu kamigathemaacawe cegerenaa makaraa beretaate yatanasaame lamawethaate bamokaru quthere wada 'eziyaawe 'enedimalasu yedaragaalu. ya'aqaathaayune 'esaate qethaate qemasume; yebaalaalu.

yamaane budenocemaa 'enanyaa ba'alaahe yaamanutenaa malekaame szeraane yaszarute kazaafocwanaa kahenetsaawocwa sere wanezoce yamifasubaate janate wesethe 'alaahe yaasegabaacawaale. balule geetheme yaasegeethaacawaale; lebesaacaweme hhare nawe.

baduneyaa heyewateme laaye "laalaaha lalaahu" 'enedamilawe yamesekerenate qaale, 'alaahu 'akebare, 'alehhamedulilaahe 'enaa wada masaasalute malekaame qaalaate 'alaahe maraacawe; yatamasaganaweneme yaselaame manegadeneme 'asaawaqaacawe.

'enanyaa 'alaahene yakaadu, leeloceme wada 'eselemenaa 'enedaayegabu 'aqethaachaa yamiyaaseqayeru, 'agaariwoceme bahhudayebiyaa `aamate laaye 'enedafatsamute sawocene katakabarawe hharame yamiyaagedu sawoce 'asaamaamiwene qethaate saanaaqamesaacawe 'aneqareme. yaa masejide lasawoce lasegedataacawe 'aqethaachaa, ya`umeraanaa yahhaje tagebaaraate 'anedu kefele yahonawe; ya'ezaa 'agare nawaariwoceme hono kamakaa weche yaalu manegadanyoce 'ekule yamihonubate botaa nawe. 'aweqo wanejale wesethe bamazafaqe ka'ewenate maazanebale yamiyaasebe kaala 'asaamaami qethaate 'enaaqamesawaalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! katarasaa baxwaalaa yahharamene kelele laberaahime (`alayehi 'asalaame) botaawene bagalatsenelate; 'eneene bamaamelake laaye meneneme 'ataagaaraa: yelequnese babecanyenate tagazaanye beeteeneme bazuriyaawe lamizorutenaa bawesethu lamisageduteme kamidaasasenaa manefasaawi kahona rekusate 'atsedaawe yamile malakotaawi raa`eye baasetalaalafenelate gizee yahonawene 'awesaa.

'enedeteganabaawe wadaazazeneheme beete hhaje yaadaregu (yegobanyu) zanede sawocene tathaaraa; kaya'aqethaachaaweme 'egeranyoce honawe 'aliyaame karuqe botaa tachenawebate baguzo reqate yatanasaa 'ejege yakasaanaa yadakama gemale laaye tasaaferawe 'eyatamamu yemathaalu.

yawanejale meheratene, menedaa maagenyatene, ya'aqwaame 'anedenate 'enaa masale theqemoce laaye 'enediganyu 'enedihume 'alaahe balagasaacawe yagemale, yakabetenaa yafeyale tzagaa 'alaahene lamaamasegane bataawaqu qanaatoce maalateme zulehhijaa 'aseranyaawe qanenaa ka'eresu qathelo yaalutene szosete qanaate chamero yezawete yamathutene ya'erede sethotaa siyaaredu 'alaahene yaamasagenu zanede theri 'aderegelaacawe. yeheneneme 'erede tamagabu; 'ejege yatacagaraneme deha magebu.

qathelome yataqarawene yahhaje tagebaaraate yaathanaaqaqu; tzaguraacawene bamalaachate, theferaacaweneme bamaqurathe 'enaa hheraame (yahhaje tagebaare) laaye bamahonaacawe yaaganyaacawene qoshaashaa bamaasewagade yefatu (yamajamariyaa yahhaje tagebaaraacawene yaathanaaqequ). raasaacawe laaye gedeetaa yaadaragutene hhaje, `umeraahe 'enaa ya'erede tagebaare yaamwalu; 'alaahe ka'amebaagananoce 'agazaaze natsaa yaawathaawene beete yahhaje thawaafe yaaderegu.

yeheme maalate tzagurene bamalaachate, theferene bamaqurathe, qoshaashaaneme bamaasewagade 'enedetefatu 'enedihume selataacehune 'enedetemolu 'enaa beetune 'enedetegobanyu yataazazaacehute tagebaare 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye gedeetaa yaadaragawe nawe. 'alaahe gedeetaa yaadaragabaacehune kebere sethute. `umeraahe 'aliyaame hhajene lamaaderage bawasanabate waqete ya'alaahene wasane laalamadaafare kebere bamasethatenaa yakalakalaweneme laalamafatsame 'alaahe 'enedireqe yaazazawene yaraaqa baqerebume heyewate hona bamacharashaawe `aalame bageetaawe zanede la'eresu malekaame nawe. 'enaaneta sawoce hoye! ka'enesesaatoceme 'eneda gemale, kabetenaa feyale yaalute tafaqadalaacehu; ka'enasu makaakaleme "hhaame", "bahhiraahe" 'enaa "wasilaahe" ('enanyehe seyaameewoce 'agaariwoce batalayaayu mekeneyaatoce lamegebenateme hona latalayaayu 'agalegelotoce mathaqame 'ereme lamaaderage yatathaqamwacawe seyaameewoce naacawe) yamasaasalute 'ereme 'aletadaragabaacehume; yelequnese 'ereme yatadaragabaacehu baqure'aane wesethe tathaqesawe yametaaganywacawe 'eneda bakete, damenaa yamasaasalutene nawe. 'erekuse yahonawene hhawelete raaqu; ba'alaaheme hona bafetherataatu laaye kamiqathafuteme hasate raaqu.

kahulume bamaraaqe 'alaahene batamalaakinatu laaye meneme tagaari saataadaregubate 'esu zanede tawadaaje wada honawe 'emenate becaa zuru; ba'alaahe laaye tagaari yaadaraga sawe mesaaleewe kasamaaye wadeqo baraari 'a`ewaafaate segaawenenaa 'athenetune 'enedaminathequte 'enedamibathaathesute 'aliyaame nafaasewada maayetaawaqe ruqe botaa 'enedamiwarawarawe sawe nawe.

yehe 'alaahene babecanyenate maamelake, 'emenatene batheraate la'esu becaa maaderage 'enedihume thaa`otenenaa yahasate qaalene maraaqe ya'alaahe te'ezaaze nawe. yahaayemaanote magalachaawocene yahhaje tagebaaraatenenaa 'eredeneme chemere kebere masethate; lebe geetaawaane lamaferaatwa 'anedu magalachaa nawe.

bahharame kelele lamaarade yaamathaacexwaacawe yamataarajiyaa yagizee gadabaacawe 'esekidaresenaa bahharame kelele 'eseketaaredute deraseme bamagwaagwaazhaanate, sufaacawene, zaraacawene 'enaa watataacawene mathaqame tafaqedolaacexwaale.

'alaahe sela sathaacawe gemale, kabetenaa feyale lamaamasegane qurebaanocene bamiyaaredu waqete ba'enasu laaye ya'alaahene seme yaawasu zanede; 'alaahe laalafute hhezeboce la'eyaanedaanedaacawe damene bamaafesase masewaa`etene la'alaahe yaaqarebu zanede 'eredune yamifatsemubatene hege 'adereganaale. 'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaakaacehu meneme tagaari yaleelawe 'anede 'amelaake nawe; bamataazazenaa bamatanaanase la'eresu becaa 'eje sethu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! taanaanaashocenaa szeraacawene batheraate la'alaahe yamifatsemutene bamiyaasedasetaacawe nagare 'abeseraacawe.

'enanyaa 'alaahe siwasaa qethaatune sagetawe te`ezaazune kamaqaarane yaraaqutene; salaateneme 'asaamerawe 'amwaletawe yamisagedutene; cegere sigathemaacawe te'egesete yamiyaadaregutene; 'alaahe kasathaacaweme nagare bamalekaame nagare laaye wachi yamiyaadaregutene 'abesere.

bamakaa lamaarade yametenadwacawe gemalocenenaa kabetocene yahaayemaanote magalachaa 'adereganelaacexwaale; ba'enasume haayemaanotaawime hona duneyaawi theqeme taaganyaalaacehu. 'enedaataamalethebaacehu 'anede 'egerwane wada laaye bamaasare baszosete 'egerwa kaaqomaacexwaate baxwaalaa setaaredwate "bisemilaahe" balu; kaaradaacexwaate baxwaalaame bagonwa setewadeqeme ('enaaneta 'enesesaawocene nadetaacehu yamathaacehute) kasegaawaa tamagabu, kalemanaa yataqothabaweneme deha magebu; kasegaaweme lamaagenyate yamineqasaaqasaweneme 'enedihu magebute. 'eqaacehune lamaagwaagwaazenaa lamagaalabe 'enedaagaraanelaacehu hulu wada 'alaahe lamaqaarabe wada maarajaa seferaame baqalaalu nadetaacehu mawesade tecelume zanede 'ageretanelaacexwaale; selaagaraalaacehume 'alaahene 'enedetaamasaganuteme nawe.

yametaaqarebwacawe sethotaawoce segaacawe wayeneme damaacawe la'alaahe 'ayedareseme; wada 'esume 'ayeheedeme. nagare gene wada 'eresu yamiheedawe 'ereswane bamaaradaacehu wada 'alaahe lamaqaarabe te`ezaazune la'eresu becaa belaacehu yametefatsemutenaa la'alaahe yaalaacehu feraacaa nawe. 'alaahe 'enedihe 'aderego yaagaraalaacehu la'ewenate lasekeete selaabaqaacehu 'alaahene bamaamasegane 'enedetaalequte nawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaacawene sigazume hona kafethuraanu gaare baalaacawe genenyunate bago szariwocene yamisedasetaacawene nagare 'abeseraacawe.

ba'alaahe yaamanutene yathalaataacawene tanekole 'alaahe yemaketelaacawaale; 'alaahe maanenyaaweme kadaatanyaa, ya'alaahene tzagaa yamikede, 'alaahene yamaayaamasagene 'ayewadaweme yelequneme yethalaawaale.

'alaahe la'amaanyocu 'enedamikalaakalelaacawe kagalatza 'enaa wesethaacawe kataragaagaa baxwaalaa kahadiyaanene mawaagaatene bamafeqade 'enedihe 'ala::
thalaatocaacawe badale selafatsamubaacawe; yamiwaagwaacawene 'agaariwocene 'amaanyoce 'enediwaagwaacawe 'alaahe faqadalaacawe. 'alaahe 'amaanyocene yaala thorenate bathalaatocaacawe laaye dele 'enediyaadaregu maaderage yecelaale; nagare gene bathebabu baasaalafawe wesaanee maszarate kahaadiyaanene bamawaagaate 'amaanyocene mafatane falego nawe.

la'enanyaa meneme thefaate saayenoraacawe <<geetaacene 'alaahe nawe; ka'eresu wechi leelaa geetaa yalaneme>> bamaalataacawe kahadiyaane kahagaraacawe bagefe laasewathwacawe. 'alaahe lanabiyaatocenaa la'amaanyoce kahaadiyaanene mawaagaate baayedanagege noro ya'amelekote seferaa laaye wasane bamaalafe yabaahetaawiyaanene gadaamaate, yanasaaraawocene beetakehenatene, mekuraabocene, lasalaate masegajaanate 'enaa muselimoce 'alaahene babezaate 'enediyaawasubate yatazagaaju yamuselimoce masejidene yaafaraaresu nabare. haayemaanotunenaa male'eketanyaawene yamiradu sawocene 'alaahe yeradaale; haayemaanotune yaradaawene lamaredaate 'alaahe xaayele yaalawe geetaa nawe; maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi nawe.

'enanyaa dele qaale yatagabaalaacawe bathalaatocaacawe laaye dele bamaaderage medere laaye kaamacaacanaacawe salaatene batamwalaa maleku yamisagedu; kaganezabaacawe zakaa yamisathu 'enedihume haayemaanotu yaazazawene yamiyaazezu 'enaa yatakalakalaweneme yamikalakelu naacawe. banagaroce laaye yamamanedaateme hona yamaqethaate wesaanee mamalashaawe wada 'alaahe becaa nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! waganocehe biyaasetabaabeluhe taagase; waganocu yaasetabaabaalute yamajamariyaa male'eketanyaa 'ayedalaheme. kaaneta bafiteme yanuhhe waganoce nuhhene, `aadoce dagemo hudene 'enaa samudoce dagemo saalihhene 'asetabaabelawaale.
yaberaahime waganoceme beraahimene; yaluthe waganoceme luthene 'asetabaabelawaale.

yamadeyane hhezeboceme shu`aayebene 'asetabaabelawaale. fire`aawenenaa waganocu musaane 'asetabaabelawaale. 'enasuneme lamaazanaagaateme bawaganocaacawe laaye qethaataacawene 'azagayahunye; kaziyaame 'eremejaa wasadekubaacawe. wegezatee 'enedeete 'enedahona 'asetawele. bakehedataacawe yatanasaanawe yaathafaaxwaacawe.

bakehedataacawe saabiyaa basere naqale qethaate yaathafaanaacawe yakatamaa hhezeboce senetenaa senete naacawe! manedaraacawe.nawaariwocwa thafetawe baado honawe yafaraarasu honawe qaru. bamathefaataacaweme yagudegwaade wehacawe yamiqadaa thafeto baado yahonute senetenaa senete naacawe. nawaariwocune kaqethaate makalaakalenaa mamashage yaalecaalu senetenaa senete yaashabaraqunaa telaaleqe yahonu beetamanegesetaate mene 'abazaacawe.

male'eketanyaawe (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yezoyamathaawene yaasetabaabalu sawoce lamahonu yathafu manedarocene qerite 'enaa 'ashaaraa lamamalekatenaa 'a`emerwacawene bamaaszaraate limakaru 'enedihume lamagasatse bamithaqeme maleku taarikaacaweneme lamasemaate bamedere laaye 'ayegwaazumene?! mataaware yamibaalawe ya`aayene mataaware 'ayedalame; nagare gene lathefaatenaa lawedeqate yamidaaregawe `ewerenate labaalabeetu lamagasatseme hona lamamakare `edele yamaayesathawe yalebe mataaware nawe.

'aneta maleketanyaa hoye! waganocehe qethaatene 'enedithanaqaqu sinagaraacawe baqerebu `aalame tolo yamiqathubatenaa lamacharashaaweme `aalame 'enedizagaye yatawasanawene qethaate yate 'ala 'eyaalu yaathaadefuhaale; nagaru 'alaahe 'enedamiqathu yaasaalafawene qaale 'ayaathefeme. babadere yagathamaacawe ka'asecakwaaye qethaate 'anedu nawe. kaalawe yaqethaate kebedate yatanasaa batenesaa'eewe `elate yaalawe ya'anede qane qethaate ba'ezihenyaawe `aalame 'aqothaatharaacehu maszarate 'eneda 'anede shihe `aamate nawe.

bakehedataacawe yatanasaa badalanyaa honawe saalu qethaatene yaazagayahulaacawenaa lamaazanaagaateme yaalaathaadafekwaacawe katamoce 'ejege bezu naacawe. kaziyaame sere naqale bahona qethaate 'athafaaxwaacawe. batenesaa'eewe `elate mamalashaacawe wada 'enee becaa nawe; sela kehedataacaweme qwaami bahona qethaate 'emanadaacawaalahu.
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'enee yatalaakubatene yamaadareselaacehu 'asethaneqaaqiyaacehu nanye; selamaasethaneqeqaacehume geletse nanye balaacawe.
'enanyaa ba'alaahe yaamanutenaa malekaame szeraa yaszarute kageetaacawe zanede lahathi'aataacawe meherate 'enaa bajanate wesetheme fetsume yamaayeqwaarathe yatakabara sisaaye tazagaajetolaacawaale.

'enanyaa ka'alaahe yamiyaamalethu 'enaa yamaayeqathaacawe maselwacawe 'aneqatsocaacenene lamaasetabaabale yamirwarwathute; 'enasu gwaadanyaa kagwaadanyaawe gaare zawatere 'enedamaayelaaqaqe hulu ya'esaate gwaadoce honawe baqwaaminate nawaariwoce naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta basetafite yalaakenawe nabiyeme hona male'eketanyaa ya'alaahene matsehhafe siyaanabe; shayethwane banebaabu laaye sawocene yamiyaadanaagerebatene chemaari malakotaawi raa`eye 'asemaselo yaalesanazarabateyalame.'alaaheme shayethwane karaasu yamichamerawene wedeqe bamaaderage (yaasewagedawenaa) 'aneqatzocune yaatzanaale. 'alaahe hulune nagare `aawaaqi nawe; meneme nagare 'ayesawarebateme; bamafetharu, bawesaaneewenaa bamaasetanaabarume thebabanyaa nawe.

shayethwane banabiyu nebaabe laaye yamisanazerawe; 'eresu yamisanazerawene 'alaahe lamanaafeqaane, lebaacawe ladaraqabaacawe 'agaariwoce fatanaa 'enedihone falego nawe. badalanyaa yahonuteme manaafeqaanenaa 'agaariwoce ya'alaahenaa yamale'eketanyaawe thalaatoce 'enaa ka'ewenatenaa kaqenu manegademe yaraaqu naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa 'alaahe `eweqatene yasathaacawe sawoce bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye yatawaradawe qure'aane 'alaahe wadaaneta yaawaradawe 'ewenatanyaa malakotaawi raa`eye mahonune 'eregethanyaa bamahone sela 'eresu yaalaacawe 'emenate 'enedichamerenaa lebocaacaweme la'alaahe 'eneditanaanase nawe. 'alaaheme 'enanyaa ba'eresu yaamanutene la'eresu lamatanaanasaacawe waagaa themate wada leelabate qathetanyaa manegade yemaraacawaale.

'enanyaa 'alaahene yakaadunaa male'eketanyaawene yaasetabaabalu sawoce; 'alaahe baaneta laaye baawaradawe qure'aane kamatharaathare 'ayewagadume; ba'enedihe `aayenatu 'aqwaamaacawe laaye honawe yatenesaa'eewe qane badenegate 'esekimathaabaacawe wayeme 'ezenateme hona malekaame yaleelabate qane qethaate 'esekimathaabaacawe derase yeqathelaalu.

'enanyihe yatazaatabaacawe sawoce qethaatu bamidaresebaacawe yatenesaa'ee `elate selethaane hulu ya'alaahe becaa nawe; selethaanune maaneme yamigaafaawe yalame. 'eresu yalaaqawe geetaa ba'amaanyocenaa bakahaadiyaane makaakale ferede yamisathenawe; la'eyaanedaanedu yamigabaawene yefaredelataale. 'enanyaa ba'alaahe yaamanutenaa malekaame szeraawoce yaszarute taalaaqe menedaa 'eresume yamaayeqwaarathe 'enaa qwaami yahona yajanate tsagaa tazagaajetolaacawaale.
'enanyaa 'alaahene yakaadunaa bamale'eketanyaacene laaye yawaradawene 'aneqatsoce yaasetabaabalu; bajahaname wesethe yamiyaawaaredaacawene 'awaaraaje qethaate 'azagaajetolaacawaale.

'enanyaa ya'alaahene wedeetaa bamafalagenaa haayemaanotuneme lamadagafe 'agaraacawenenaa beetaacawene thelawe yawathute; kaziyaame ba'alaahe manegade laaye 'eyataagalu yatagadalu wayeme yamotutene; 'alaahe bajanate wesethe qwaaminaa yamaayeqwaarathe malekaame sisaayene yelagesaacawaale; 'alaahe kalagaashoce hulu balaache nawe.
yamidasatubatene botaa 'alaahe yaasegabaacawaale; yeheme janate nawe. 'alaaheme haasaabaacawenenaa tagebaaraacawene 'awaaqi; wasane bamaalafaacaweme bafethenate baalamaqethaatu caaye nawe.

yehe yatathaqasawe ba'alaahe manegade laaye yatasadadute janate yamagebaataacawe gudaaye; 'enedihume theqaate yaadarasawe laaye tamasaasaaye theqaate maaderase mafaqadunaa baziheme hathi'aatanyaa 'alamahonu; 'atheqiwe theqaate maaderasune kaqathala 'alaahe tathaqiwene yeradaale.'alaahe ya'amaanyocune hathi'aataacawene yeqere baayenaa wanejalaacawene yamisarezelaacawe nawe.

yeheme 'alaahe theqaate yadarasabatene yamiyaagezawe 'alaahe hulune nagare caaye bamahonu nawe. kacelotaaweme makaakale 'anedune bamaasaathare leelaanyaawene dagemo bamaaserazame leelitene baqane wesethe; qaneneme baleelite wesethe maasegabaatu 'anedu nawe. 'alaahe yabaariyaawocune negegere sami, tagebaaraacawene 'awaaqi bamahonu ka'ezihe meneme nagare 'ayesawarebateme; baszeraacaweme yemanadaacawaale.

yehe yatathaqasawe leelitene baqane; qanene dagemo baleelite wesethe maasegabaatu 'alaahe 'ewenatanyaa bamahonu nawe. haayemaanotu 'ewenate; qaalume 'ewenate; 'amaanyoceneme maredaatu 'ewenate bamahonunaa 'agaariwoce ka'alaahe leelaa yamigazwacawe thaa`otaate maszarate yaleelawe hasate bamahonu nawe. 'alaahe ba'akaalu, bacelotaawenaa ba'ashanaafinatu kafethuraanu balaaye nawe; leqenaa taalaaqenate 'enaa kuraate yamigabaawe taalaaqe geetaa nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe bamedere laaye kasamaaye zenaabene 'aweredo; zenaabe kawaradabaate baxwaalaa bametaabaqelawe takele setelamaleme 'atemalakatemene! 'alaahe labaariyaawocu zenaabe bamaazenabu; takeleneme kamedere bamaabeqalu labaariyaawocu 'ejege ruxeruxe; yamibajaacawene batheleqate 'awaaqi; meneme yamaayesawarebate geetaa nawe.

basamaaye wesethe yaalaweme hona bamedere wesethe yaalawe hulu neberatenataacawe ya'eresu becaanaa becaa naacawe. 'alaahe kamaanenyaaweme fethuraanu meneme yamaayefalege 'enaa yatabeqaaqaa geetaa nawe; bamaanenyaaweme huneetaa tamasegaanye nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe laaneta 'enaa lasawoce bamedere wesethe yamiganyutene 'enesesaawocene 'enaa ge`uze nagarocene latheqemaacehunaa la'agalegelotaacehu maamacaacatune 'atemalakatemene?! ba'eresu te`ezaazenaa maageraateme kahagare wada hagare baahherene sanetheqo yamigwaazaweneme marekabe 'amacaacalaacehu. ba'eresu faqaade kaalehona basetaqa medere laaye 'enedaatewadeqe samaayene yezolaacexwaale; medere laaye 'enedetewadeqe biyaazaate noro tewadeqe nabare. sawoce meneme badale binorebaacawe 'enekwaa 'alaahe 'enanyihene nagaroce bamaamacaacatu lasawe leje 'ejege ruxeruxe 'azaanye nawe.

kaalamanore wada manore yaamathaacehu bamahonu hheyaawe yaadaragaacehu 'alaahe nawe; kaziyaame 'edemeeyaacehu sithanaaqaqe yegadelaacexwaale; kaziyaame baszeraacehu yemarameraacehunaa yemanadaacehu zanedeme kamote baxwaalaame daageme hheyaawe yaadaregaacexwaale. yehunenaa yasawe leje ka'alaahe weche yaalane 'akaale bamaamelaku ya'alaahene tsagaa geletse hono 'eyaala'abezeto kahaadi nawe.

la'eyaanedaanedu maaxebarasabe sere`aata haayemaanote 'adereganaale; hulume 'enedayasere`aatu yeszaraale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'agaariwocenaa yaleelaa 'emenate takataayoce sela sere`aata-haayemaanotehe likaraakaruhe 'ayegabaame; 'enasu yahasate gwaadoce bamahonaacawe ka'enasu yeleqe la'ewenate yatagabaahe 'aneta nahe. thememate yaleelabate 'enaa qene manegade laaye bamahonehe sawocene 'ahhadenatene la'alaahe becaa 'enedifatsemu theri 'aderegelaacawe.

maaserajaawe geletse kahona baxwaalaa kamakaraakare basetaqare 'emebi kaalu; bamaasefaraaraateme maleku:: yameteszarutene szeraa 'alaahe yaaweqaale; kaszeraacehu meneme 'ayesawarebateme; baszeraacehume yemanadaacexwaale; bamaalate gudaayaacawene wada 'alaahe 'asethagaa.
'alaahe bazihenyaawe `aalame sela haayemaanotu gudaaye bamakaakalaacawe selanabarawe wezegebe; ba'amaanyocenaa bakahaadi baaroce makaakale baferede yelayaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lamahonu 'alaahe basamaaye wesethe yaalawene 'enedihume bamedere wesethe yaalawene 'enedamiyaaweqenaa bawesethaacawe kaalawe meneme 'enedamaayesawarebate 'ataaweqemene. ya'enazihe nagaroce `eweqate bathebequ saleedaa laaye saferwale; sela'enazihe nagaroce hulu maawaqe la'alaahe 'ejege qalaale nawe.

'agaariwoce 'alaahe matsaahhefetocu laaye sela mamalakaacawe maaserajaa yaalaawaradalaacawene thaa`otaate ka'alaahe weche yaamalekaalu; ba`eweqate laaye yatamasarata maaserajaa yalaacaweme; yelequnese becanyaawe marajaacawe walaajocaacawene bachefene makatalaacawe nawe. labadalanyoce ka'alaahe lamiyaarefebaacawe qethaate yamimaketelaacawe radaate yalaacaweme.

yaqure'aane 'aneqatzoce taberaareto sinababelaacawe 'alaahene yakaadu sawoce yehenene sisamu fitaacawene bamaakomaataraacawe yatanasaa maasetabaabalaacawene bafitaacawe laaye taanabaalahe; 'ejege kamanaadadaacaweme yatanasaa 'aneqatzaacenene yamiyaanabulaacawene sawoce 'eremejaa liwasedubaacawe yeqaathaacawaale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe:: kamakosaataraacehunaa kanedeetaacehu yakafaa nagare lenegaraacehune?! 'alaahe kahaadiyaanocene 'enedamiyaasegabaabate qaale yagabaawe 'esaate nawe yamithabeqaacehu. mamalashaacaweme mene yakafaa mamalashaa nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'asedanaaqi mesaalee tagaletswalenaa 'ademethute; tagasatsubateme; ka'alaahe wechi yametegazwacawe thaa`otaatenaa leeloceme 'aqeme yaleelaacawe bamahonu teneshe bihoneme zenebe 'enekwaa mafethare 'ayecelume. lifatheru bisabaasabu 'enekwaa 'ayefatherume. ba'enasu laaye yamiganyawene shetome hona leelaa nagare biwasede ka'eresu maadaane (maqamaate) 'ayecelume. zenebe mafethare 'enaa neberataacawene kazenebe maqabale baalamacaalaacawe; kazihe yatalaqa nagare laaye meneme 'aqeme 'enedaleelaacawe tagalatsa; lamahonu 'enedihe 'aqeme saayenoraacawe 'enedeete ka'alaahe weche tegazwacawaalaacehu?! yehe zenebe yaqamaawene maasemalase yatasaanawe falaagi thaa`oteme hona tafalaagiwe zenebeme dakaamaa naacawe.

'anedaanede fethuraanune ka'alaahe gaare bamaamelakaacaweme yatanasaa 'alaahene tagabiwene kebere 'alaakabaruteme. 'alaahe xaayaale nawe; kaxaayaalenatenaa kacelotaawe 'anedu samaayaate,mederenaa bawesethaacawe yamiganyutene mafetharu nawe. ka'agaariwoce thaa`otaateme bataqaaraani maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi nawe. nagare gene thaa`otaatu dakaamaa yatawaaradu 'enaa meneme mafethare yamaayecelu naacawe.

'alaahe kamalaa'eketocenaa kasawoceme ma`e'eketanyaane yemarethaale; wesene malaa'eketocene wada sawe yelekaale; lamesaaleeme jiberilene wada 'anedaanede sawoce lekwaale. sawe yahonutene male'eketanyoceneme wada sawoce yelekaale. 'agaariwoce sela male'eketanyaawe yaminaagarutene 'alaahe sami nawe; lamale`eketume yamimarethaweneme `aawaaqi nawe.

'alaahe yamalaa'ekete honu yasawe male'eketanyocu kamafatharaacaweme bafite hona kamotaacawe baxwaalaa yaalubatene yaaweqaale. batenesaa'eewe qane nagaraatoce hulu mamalashaacawe wada 'alaahe becaa nawe. baariyaawocune 'asenaseto selaasaalafute szeraame yemanadaacawaale.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa yatadanagagalaacehune tagebaaraawi yametaadaregu 'amaanyoce hoye! yafalagaacehutene taaganyunaa kafaraacehute tedenu zanede basalaataacehu laaye la'alaahe becaa ruku`enaa sujude 'aderegu; metsewaatenenaa zemedenaane maqathalene yamasaasalutene malekaame tagebaaraatene szeru.

la'alaahe therete baala maleku ba'alaahe manegade laaye tagabiwene tegele taagalu; 'eresu nawe yamarathaacehunaa haayemaanotaacehuneme garenaa cheneqeme hona cegere yaleelawe yaadaragalaacehu. yehe gare haayemaanote ya'abaataacehu yaberaahime (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'emenate nawe. baalafute matsaahhefetocenaa baqure'aaneme 'alaahe nawe muselimoce belo yasayamaacehu. yeheme yahonawe male'eketanyaawe 'enediyaasetalaalefe yataazazawene 'enedaadarasalaacehu 'enedimasakerebaacehunaa 'enaanetame male'eketanyoce laqadamute hhezeboce male`eketaacawene 'enedaadarasulaacawe 'enedetemasakeru nawe. selazihe salaatene batamwalaa maleku bamasegade 'enaa zakaaneme bamasethate 'alaahene 'amasegenu. ba'alaaheme tathabaqu; bagudaayaacehume hulu ba'eresu laaye tamaku; 'eresu 'alaahe lamiwadute 'amaanyoce malekaame thabaaqi; 'egazaane lathayaquteme malekaame 'agaazhe nawe. wedadute yethabeqaacexwaale; 'eredaataa thayequte yeradaacexwaale.
'alaahene yaamanunaa yahaayemaanotune denegaagee tagebaaraawi yaadaragute me'emanaane yamifalegutene bamaagenyatenaa kamisagute bamadaane lasekeete baqu.
'enanyaa 'akaalaacawe taragaageto; lebaacawe kaleelaa wetherate natsaa hono basalaataacawe wesethe yamitanaanasu;
'enanyaa ka'alubaaletaa 'enaa kazaazaataa wesethu kaazalaweme yanegegerenaa yatagebaare wanejale yaraaqute;
'enanyaa nafesaacawene kamathefo tagebaare 'enedihume ganezabaacawene zakaatene bamaawethaate yamaatsedaate tagebaarene fatsaamiwoce yahonute;
'enanyaame beletaacawene kazemute, kagebera-sadome 'enaa katsayaafe tagebaare bamaaraaqe yamithabequ; bamahonume chawaanaa netsuhe yahonute.
nagare gene kabaalabeetocaacawe wayeme baquthetheraacawe sere kaalu baariyaawocaacawe gaare bagenenyunate 'enaa bamasaasalute biraku 'ayewaqasume.
kamisetocenaa baseru kaalute baariyaawoce wechi semeetune maarekaate yafalaga; 'alaahe yafaqadawene 'erekaataa talaalefo bakalakalawe bamarekaatu ya'alaahene wasane talaalefwale.
'enanyaame 'alaahe 'enedihume sawoce yasathwacawene 'adaraa 'enaa qaalaacawene yamithabequnaa yamiyaamwalu naacawe.
'enanyaame baqwaaminate bamasegade, waqetune, maa`ezanaatune, gedeetaawene 'enedihume yatawadadu kefelocune bamaamwalaate salaataacawene yamithabequ;
ba'enazihe baaheri yatagalatsute waraashoce naacawe;
lazala`aalame nawaariwoce 'enaa bawesethwa yaalawe tzagaa yamaayeqwaarathe sihone taalaaqune janate waraashoce naacawe.
yasawe lejocene 'abaate 'adamene kamedere 'afare gaare katabokaa weha nethere kahonawe kacheqaa fatharenawe.
qathelome zereyaawocune 'esekamiwaladebate qane deraseme bamaahetzane wesethe rageto kamiqoye yazare fesaashe yamiraabu honawe fatharenaacawe.

maahetzane wesethe rageto kamiqamathawe yazare fasaashe qathelo yaragaa qaye dame 'aderegane fatharenawe; yehenene qaye yaragaa dameme 'eneda taanyaka quraache segaa 'adaragenawe; yehenenu quraache segaame thanekaaraa 'athenete 'aderegane fatharenawe; yehenene 'athenete dagemo segaa 'alabasenawe; 'esetenefaaseneme ba'eresu laaye bamanefaate 'enaa hheyewateme bamaasewathaate leelaa fethure 'aderegane fatharenawe. kafathaariwoce hulu yabalatha yahonawe fathaari laaqa.
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'enazihene 'erekanoce kaalafaacehu baxwaalaame gizeeyaacehu sithanaaqaqe temotaalaacehu.
kamotaacehume baxwaalaa batenesaa'eewe `elate selaasaalafaacehute szeraa temaramaru zanedeme kaqaberaacehu teqasaqasaalaacehu.
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! kabalaayaacehume tadaraaraabi sabaate samaayene fatharene. fetherataacenene yamenezanagaa 'ayedalaneme; 'anerasaacawememe.

bezu hono 'enedaayaathafaa tenesheme hono 'enedaayaanese bamiyaasefalegaweme mathane kasamaaye yazenaabene weha 'awaradene; sawocenaa 'enesesaatoceme yethaqamubate zanedeme bamedere laaye 'enediragaa 'adaragenawe. lenaathafaaweme 'enecelaalane; meneme 'atethaqamubateme.

bazihe wehame yazanebaabaa 'enaa yawayene 'atekeletocene 'aseganyanelaacehu; bamalekeme hona ba`aayenate yatalayaayu feraafereewocene 'eneda tine, rumaane 'enaa tufaahhene bawesethwa 'adaragenelaacehu; ka'ereswame temagabaalaacehu.
basinaa taraaraa 'akaabaabi yametebaqelawene 'enaa lamaqabaatenaa lamaabaayaanateme yamiyaagalagelawe zayete kafereewaa yamiwathaabaatene yazayetune (yawayeraa) zaafeneme 'aseganyanelaacehu.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! yabeete 'enesesocene 'eneda gemale, kabetenaa feyale yaalutene 'enedetemakarubate 'enaa sela 'alaahe xaayaalenate 'enedihume sela 'azaanyenatume maaserajaa yehonaacehu zanede fatharenelaacehu. ka'enazihu 'enesesaatoce hodeme therete yaalanaa lathachiwoce yamiwaathe watate 'adaragenelaacehu; lamagwaagwaazhaanate, basufaacawe, batsaguraacawe 'enaa bamasaasalute barekaataa gudaayeme tegalagalubaacawaalaacehu; segaacaweneme temagabaalaacehu.
bayabese laaye ka'enesesoce bagemale; babaahhere dagemo bamarekabe laaye nawe yametesaafarute (yametegwaagwaazute).

ba'eregetheme nuhhene (`alayehi 'asalaame) wada 'alaahe yetharaacawe zanedeme wada hhezebocu laakenawe. 'enediheme 'alaacawe:: hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene becaawene tagazute; ka'eresu wechi 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaake yalaacehume. lamahonu te'ezaazaatune bamaakebare 'enaa kelekalaawocune bamaraaqe 'alaahene 'atefarutemene?!

'enanyaa kahhezebocu 'alaahene yakaadute mariwocaacawenaa taalaalaaqocaacawe latakataayocaacawenaa lataraawe hhezebe 'enedihe 'alwacawe:: yehe 'enee male'eketanyaa nanye 'eyaala yamimogetawe saweyee 'enedanaaneta yaala sawe nawe; ba'enaaneta laaye mashomenaa selethaane falego nawe. 'alaahe ba'ewenate male'eketanyaa malaake bifalege noro kamalaa'eketoce nabare yamilekawe; kasawe 'ayelekeme. baqadamuteme teweledoce 'eresu yamilawene `aayenate 'anaaweqeme.
yaminaagarawene yamaayaaweqe 'ebede nawe; maanenatu 'esekilayeme derase thabequ.
nuhhe (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enedihe 'ala:: geetaayee 'eneene bamaasetabaabalaacawe yatanasaa la'enee bamabaqale ba'enasu laaye 'eredaanye.

ba'enyaa `eyetaanaa marekabwaneme 'enedeete maszeraate 'enedaalabehe baasetamaarehene maszarate marekabe szeraa yamile malakotaawi raa`eyene 'asetalaalafenelate; yamaathefaate wesaaneecene simathaa; kamedejaa sere xaayele yaalawe weha simanache; zare maraabaatu 'enediqathele bahheyewate kaalute wanede 'enaa seete 'asegabaa(chaane). 'eneda baalabeetehenaa leje yaalutenaa 'alaahe yaqethaate qaalune yaasaalafabaacawe siqaru beetasabocehene chaane; bakehedate sela badaluteme kaqethaatu 'enedidenunaa maathefaataacawene 'enedetaweweme lamathayaqe 'enedaataanaageranye. bamithelaqalawe weha wesethe bamasethame thafi mahonaacawe yamaayeqare nawe.
'aneta 'enaa 'aberawehe yamiganyute yadaanu 'amaanyoce marekabu laaye setewathu; kakahaadiyaane hhezeboce 'adenone 'enasune yaathafaacawe 'alaahe mesegaanaa yegabaawe; balu.
'enediheme bale:: geetaayee bamedere laaye malekaame maasaarafiyaane 'asaarafanye. 'aneta malekaame 'asaaraafi nahe.

yehe nuhhenenaa 'aberawete yaalu 'amaanyocene maadaanenaa kahadiyaanene maathefaate; male'eketanyocaacenene maredaatenaa 'enasune yaasetabaabalutene maathefaate celotaa 'enedaalane maaserajaa nawe. nuhhene wada hhezebocu bamalaake 'amaanyu kakahaadiwe, taazaazhu ka'amatsanyaawe talayeto 'enediwathaa yanuhhe hhezebocene 'enefatenaalane.
yanuhhe hhezebocene kaathafaane baxwaalaa leelaa hhezebocene 'aseganyane.

karaasaacawe hono wada 'alaahe yamitharaacawene male'eketanyaa laakenelaacawe; 'enediheme 'alaacawe:: 'alaahene babecanyenate 'amelekute; ka'eresu wechi 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaake yalaacehume; yakalakalaacehune bamaraaqenaa yaazazaacehune bamatagebare 'alaahene 'atefarumene?!

'enanyaa 'alaahene yakaadutenaa yamacharashaawe `aalamenaa bawesethu yaalaweneme menedaame hona qethaate yaasetabaabalute; ba'ezihenyaawe heyewateme yatamacaacalaacawe wasane 'enediyaalefu yaadaragaacawe; yahhezebocu mariwocenaa taalaalaaqoce latakataayocaacawenaa lataraawe hhezebe 'enedihe 'alu:: yehe 'enedanaanetawe sawe nawe; yametemagabutene nawe yamimagabawe; yametethathuteneme nawe yamithathaawe; wada 'enaaneta male'eketanyaa hono lamalaake yamiyaabaqaawe ka'enaaneta yamilayebate nagare yalame.

'enedanaanetawe sawe yahonane 'akaale yametetaazazu kahona; 'eresune bamataazazaacehunaa 'amaaleketocaacehune bamatawaacehu tathaqaamiwoce baalamahonaacehunaa bameneme yamaayebalethaacehune bamakatalaacehu kasaariwoce naacehu.

lamahonu yehe male'eketanyaa nanye belo yamimogetawe sawe motaacehu yabasabasa 'athenete 'enaa 'afare kahonaacehu baxwaalaa heyaawe honaacehu kaqabere 'enedametewathu qaale yegabaalaacexwaalene?! yehe yamitaasabe nagare nawene?!
kamotaacehunaa yabasabasa 'athenete 'enaa 'afare kahonaacehu baxwaalaa heyaawe honaacehu kaqaberaacehu teqasaqasaalaacehu yamilawe qaala-qatharo 'ejege ruqe 'enaa yamaayemasele nawe.

heyewate maalate ya'ezihe `aalame heyewate becaa nawe. yamacharashaawe `aalame heyewate 'ayedalame. baheyewate yaalanawe 'enemotaalane daageme heyaawe 'anehoneme; leeloce dagemo yewaladunaa baheyewate yenoraalu; kamoteneme baxwaalaa batenesaa'eewe `elate lameremaraa daageme 'anewathaame.
yehe wada 'enaaneta yatalaakunye male'eketanyaa nanye belo yamilawe sawe 'enedihe sile ba'alaahe laaye weshate yamiqathefe sawe nawe; 'anaamenelatememe.
male'eketanyaaweme 'enedihe 'ala:: geetaayee 'eneene bamaasetabaabalaacawe yatanasaa la'enee bamabaqaleme ba'enasu laaye 'eredaanye.
'alaaheme 'enedihe sile malese sathawe:: 'enanyihe 'aneta yaamathaahelaacawene bamaasetabaabalaacawe yatanasaa katheqite gizee baxwaalaa ka'enasu selamanachawe maasetabaabale yamitsatsatu yehonaalu.

getere bamahonaacawe yatanasaa qethaate selamigabaacawe 'athefi yahonane xaayelanyaa demetse laqanebaacawe 'athafaanaacawe; 'eneda gorefe gebesebaaseme honawe 'enedithafu honu; badalanyaa hhezeboce thefaate yegabaacawaale.
'enasune kaathafaane baxwaalaa qathelo 'eneda luthe hhezeboce, yashu`ayebe hhezeboce 'enaa yayunuse hhezeboce yaalutene leelaa hhezebocene 'aseganyane.
ka'enanyihe 'asetabaabaaye hhezeboce mahale meneme `aayenate zadee bithaqamu yamathefiyaacawe yagizee gadabene yamiqademe 'aliyaame yamizagaye maaneme yalame.

kaziyaame male'eketanyocaacenene 'akataatelane malaakune qathalene. maanenyaaweme male'eketanyaa yatalaakabaacawe hhezeboce male'eketanyocaacawe simathulaacawe yaalaasetabaabala yalame; taraa bataraame 'akataatelane 'athafaanaacawe. sewoce sela 'enasu yamiyaawarute taarike kaalehona basetaqare 'anedaacaweme yaqara yalame. male'eketanyocaacawe kageetaacawe zanede yezawete yamathutene yamaayaamenu sawoce thefaate yegabaacawaale.

bamaqathaleme musaanenaa wanedemune harunene zathanyune ta`aameraatocaacenene (betere, ya'eje madaafe, 'anebathaa, qemaale, 'enequraarite, dame, yamiyaathelaqaleqe weha, dereqe 'enaa 'azere`etocene maagudale.) 'enedihume gulehe marajaane bamaaseyaaze laakenaacawe.
wada fire`owenenaa wada cheferocu laakenaacawe; koru; ba'enasu lamaamaneme 'alefaqadume. bacheqonaanaa bagefe sawoce laaye yaminethabaararu nabaru.

'enedihe 'alu:: lamahonu ka'enyaa meneme malayaa yaleelaacawenaa 'enedanyaa sawe lahonute belome hhezebocaacawe (yaseraa'eele lejoce) 'enyaane yamiyaagalagelunaa yamitaazazu honawe 'eyaalu ba'enasu 'enaamenaalane?!
ka'alaahe yezawe yamathutene malekete 'asetabaabalwacawe. bamaasetabaabalaacaweme saabiyaa bamasethame kamithafute honu.
lamusaame hhezebocu la'ewenate yemarunaa yetagaberuteme zanede taweraatene sathanawe.

`isaa yamareyamene leje 'enaa 'enaatune mareyamene kaala 'abaate bamatzenaswa sela celotaacene 'aseraji 'adaragenaacawe. hulatuneme kamedere kafe yaala, yatadalaadala lamanoriyaanate yatamacaaca 'enaa zawatere yamifaleqe meneche yamiganyebate botaa laaye 'asaarafenaacawe.

'enaaneta male'eketanyoce hoye! mabelaate dase yamiyaasanyaacehune 'enaa yafaqadekulaacehune tamagabu; kahaayemaanotu mamariyaa gaare tasemaami yahonawene malekaame szeraa szeru; yameteszarutene szeraa 'aweqaalahu; kaszeraacehume 'anedaaceme ka'enee yamisaware yalame.

'enaaneta male'eketanyoce hoye! haayemaanotaacehume 'anede nawe: 'eresume selaame nawe. 'eneeme geetaacehu nanye; ka'enee weche leelaa geetaa yalaacehume. bamahonume te'ezaazaateene bamaakebarenaa yakalakalekwaacehune bamaraaqe ferunye.

ka'enasu helefate baxwaalaame takataayocaacawe bahaayemaanote takafaafalu; babudenenaa ba'anejaa takafaafalu; 'eyaanedaanedume 'anejaa yaleelaawene zore belo yamaayemalakatenaa 'eresu yaalabate 'aqwaame 'alaahe zanede tawadaaju nawe belo bamiyaamenebate becaa yatamaaraka yehonaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! qethaatu 'esekiyaarefebaacawe derase baalubate maayemenatenaa madanaagare 'enedaalu tawaacawe.

lamahonuse 'enanyihe bayaazute 'aqwaame dasetanyaa yahonute 'anejaawoce baqerebitu `aalame yamenesathaacawe lejeme hona ganezabe yamigabaacawene malekaame nagare yamenaaseqademelaacawe yemaselaacawaalene?! nagaru 'enedaasabute 'ayedalame. yehenene yamenesathaacawe 'enasune lamaazanaagaate nawe; honome yehe 'ayetaawaqaacaweme.

lamahonuse 'enanyihe bayaazute 'aqwaame dasetanyaa yahonute 'anejaawoce baqerebitu `aalame yamenesathaacawe lejeme hona ganezabe yamigabaacawene malekaame nagare yamenaaseqademelaacawe yemaselaacawaalene?! nagaru 'enedaasabute 'ayedalame. yehenene yamenesathaacawe 'enasune lamaazanaagaate nawe; honome yehe 'ayetaawaqaacaweme.
'enanyaa kamaamanaacawenaa malekaame kamaszeraataacawe gaare geetaacawene yamifarute;
'enanyaame bamatsehhafu 'aneqatzoce yamiyaamenute;
'enanyaame geetaacawene babecanyenate yamiyaamalekunaa ba'eresu laaye yamaayaagaarute;

'enanyaame lamalekaame tagebaare yamitagu yahonute; yatenesaa'eewe qaneme wada 'alaahe simalasu yamiyaadaregutene wachi 'enedihume yamiszarutene malekaame szeraa saayeqabalaacawe 'enedayeqare 'eyasagu bamalekaame szeraacawe wada 'alaahe yamiqaarabu yahonute.
'enanyihe ba'ezihe taalaaqe baaheriye yamigalatsute sawoce lamalekaame szeraa tasheqadaadaamiwoce naacawe; lazaame qadaamiwoce naacawe; bamahonume nawe leelocene yaqadamute.

maanenyaawaaneme nafese kametecelawe yaszeraa mathane balaaye 'anaasegadedaateme; ya'eyaanedaanedune szari szeraa yamenaasaferebate matsehhafe 'enyaa zanede yeganyaale; meneme therethaaree yaleelabate 'ewenatene yenaagaraale. malekaame menedaacawene bamaqanaseme hona wanejalaacawe laaye bamachamare 'ayebadalume.

nagare gene yakahaadiyaane lebe yehe 'ewenate selaminaagarawe matsehhafe 'enedihume ba'enasu laaye sela waradaweme bamazanaagaate wesethe naacawe. kakehedataacaweme leelaa yamiszarwacawe barekaataa szeraawoce 'alwacawe.
baduneyaa wesethe badelote laaye yamiganyutene batenesaa'eewe `elate baqathaanaacawe gizee bayederasulenye theri demetsaacawene kafe 'aderegawe yechohaalu.
ka'alaahe 'ezenate 'enasune tasefaa bamaaseqoratheme maleku 'enedihe yebaalaalu:: ba'ezihe qane 'atechukxu 'eredaataaneme 'ateshu; ya'alaahene qethaate yamikalakelelaacehu radaate yalaacehume.
ya'alaahe matsehhafe 'aneqatzoce yenababelaacehu nabare; basamaacehute gizee kamathelaataacehu yatanasaame jarebaa bamasethate temalasaalaacehu.

yehene yametaadaregute ya'enyaa yahharame nawaariwoce nane bamaalate basawe laaye selametenethabaararu nawe. 'enaaneta yahharame sawoce 'ayedalaacehume yelequnese yahharame baalabeetoce 'alaahene fariwocu naacawe. bazuriyaawe kefu qaalene 'eyataqabaabalaacehu bamaameshate meneme `aayenate kebere 'atesathuteme.

lamahonuse 'enanyihe 'agaariwoce liyaamenubate 'enaa bawesethu yaalawene yetagaberu zanede 'alaahe ba'enasu laaye yaawaradawene qure'aane 'ayaasetanatenumene?! wayenese kanasu bafite yaalafute qadametocaacawe yaalemathaalaacawe mamariyaa selamathaabaacawe nawe yaasetabaabalutenaa celaa yaalute.

wayenese 'alaahe wada 'enasu yalaakawene male'eketanyaacawene muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) saayaawequte qaretawe thafetwacawe nawe. 'esunatune, 'ewenatanyenatunenaa taamaanyenatune ba'eregetheme yaaweqaalu.

yelequnese 'ebede nawe yelaalu; weshataamoce naacawe. nagaru ka'alaahe zanede lamahonu meneme therethaaree yaleelabatene 'ewenate nawe yaamathaalaacawe. 'abezaanyaawocu dagemo 'ewenatene yamithalu; bawesethaacawe baala meqanyenateme 'ejege yamithalu 'enaa lahasatanyaa 'aqwaamaacawe yamiwagenu naacawe.

'alaahe nagaraatocene 'eneda 'enasu zenebaalee biyaasekeede noro yanagarocene macharashaa yamaayaawequnaa tekekelanyaawene 'aliyaame tekekele yaalehonawene yamaasetadaadare danebe yamaayaawequ bamahonaacawe samaayaate, medere 'enedihume bawesethaacawe yaalute hulu bathafu nabare. nagare gene bawusethu keberaacawe 'enaa leqenaacawune bayaaza qure'aane 'amathaanelaacawe 'enaresu gene jarebaacawune sathute.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lamahonu yezakxawe selamathaakxawe male`ekete waagaa thayeqahacawe selahona nawe theriwene 'aneqabaleme yaalute?! fetsume yehe nagare kaaneta 'aletaganyame. bamahonume ka'enanyihenaa kaleelocume menedaa yeleqe yageetaahe menedaanaa waagaa yebalethaale; 'eresume sisaaye kamisathute hulu balaache nawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'eregetheme 'enanyiheneme hona leelocene sawoce meneme thememate wada leelabate qathetanyaa wada honawe ya'eselemenaa manegade nawe theri yametaadaregelaacawe.

'enanyaa bamacharashaawe `aalame; wesethu selaalaweme meremaraa, qethaatenaa menedaa yamaayaamenute kaqathetanyaawe yaselaame manegade bamaafanegathe ka'eswa weche wada honawe thamaamaa 'enaa wada 'esaate yamiyaamaraa wada honawe manegade 'azanebalawaale.
benaazenelaacawenaa yaagaathamaacawene dereqeme hona rahaabe benaanasaalaacawe; 'ewenatene setawe bamawaalalenaa bamadanebare laaye yezawateru nabare.
batalayaayu yacegere `aayenate benefatenaacaweme; lageetaacawe 'ayetanaanasume, la'eresume 'eje 'ayeszathume, 'adagaame bagathamaacawe waqeteme yaanasaalaacaweme zanede 'ayemaatsanuteme.
yaberetu qethaate barene yakafatenebaacawe gizee; 'enasu bawaqetu kamaanenyaaweme therunaa mafetehee tasefaa yeqorethaalu.

maqaseqasene maasetabaabale bamasemiyaawe, bamamalekacaawenaa balebonaawe ba'agebaabu tathaqaami kahona sawe yamaayemanache bamahonu; 'alaahe 'enazihe nagarocene bamasethatu yawaalalaacawene tsagaa 'eyaasetaawasaacawe 'enedihe 'ala::
'enaaneta maqaseqasene 'asetabaabaayoce hoye! masemiyaane 'enedetesamubate, `aayeneneme 'enedetemalakatubate, lebene 'enedeteganazabubate yafatharalaacehu 'alaahe nawe. honome selanazihe tsagaawocu theqitene 'eneji 'ataamasagenuteme.
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! bamedere laaye yafatharaacehu 'eresu nawe; batenesaa'eewe `elate lameremaraanaa lamenedaa wada 'eresu becaa nawe yametesabasabute.

'eresu becaa nawe hheyaawe 'aderaagi maaneme hheyaawe yamiyaadarege yalame; 'eresu becaa nawe magedale yamicele maaneme magedale 'ayeceleme. bachalamaame hona baberehaane 'enedihume bamaarezamenaa bamaasaathare meshetenaa qane yamalawaawathe mathane 'enaa leke ya'eresu becaa nawe. xaayaalenatune 'enaa bamafethareme hona bamaasetanaabare becanyaa mahonune 'ataasetawelumene?!
yelequnese bakehedate yaqadamwacawenenaa 'abaatocaacawe yamilutene `aayenate nawe yamilute.
nagarune bamaaraaqenaa bamaasetabaabale 'enedihe 'alu:: lamahonu motane 'afarenaa yabasabasa 'athenete kahonene baxwaalaa lameremaraa baheyewate daageme 'eneqasaqasaalane?!
yehenenu nagare 'enyaame honene walaajocaaceneme kazihe qadame qatharo tasathetonaale; yehunenaa yehe qatharo sifatsame 'alaayaneme; yehe yaqadametocu taratenaa weshate nawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyihe maqaseqasene lamiyaasetabaabelute kahaadiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe:: yametaawequ kahona; lamahonu yehece medere yamaanenaate?!

mederenaa balaayuwaa laaye yaalawe hulu ya'alaahe nawe; yeluhaale. 'enedihe balaacawe:: yamedere bawesethwa yaalawe baalabeete yahonawe geetaa 'enaanetane kamotaacehu baxwaalaa maqaseqase yamicele mahonune 'ataasetawelumene?!
'enedihe balaacawe:: yasabaatu samaayaate geetaa maanawe? 'enedihume kafethuraanoce bamathane 'eresune yamiyaakele yamaayeganyelate yahonawe yataalaaqu `aareshe (zufaane) geetaase maanawe?

'enedihe bamaalate malese yesathuhaale:: sabaatu samaayaatenaa taalaaqu `areshe (zufaane) ya'alaahe neberatoce naacawe. 'enedihe balaacawe:: taadiyaa kaqethaatu salaame tehonu zanede te'ezaazaatune bamaakebarenaa kelekalaawocune bamaraaqe lamene 'alaahene 'atefarume?

'enediheme balaacawe:: `eweqate kaalaacehu lamahonu yahulu nagare selethaane ba'eju yahonawe 'enaa kaselethaanu meneme maafanegathe yamaayecaalebate; kabaariyaawocu yaashaawene yamiradaa; 'eresu bakefu yafalagawene sawe maaneme takalaakelo qethaatune mamakate yamaayecelawe maanawe?

yahulu nagare selethaane ba'alaahe 'eje nawe; yelaalu. 'enedihe balaacawe:: yehenene yametaaragaagethu honaacehu 'eyaala; lamahonu 'a`emerwacehu yate heedo nawe ka'eresu wechi yaalutene 'akaalaate yametegazute?

nagaru 'enasu 'enedamiyaasebute 'ayedalame. yelequnese meneme therethere yaleelabatene 'ewenate nawe yaamathaanelaacawe. la'alaahe tagaarinaa leje 'alawe belawe selamiluteme weshataamoce naacawe; 'alaahe kamilute nagare hulu 'ejege yalaaqa geetaa nawe.

kahadiyaaneme 'enedamilute 'alaahe leje 'aleyaazame; ka'eresume gaare mamalake yamigabaawe 'akaaleme yalame. 'enedawe 'aberote yamimalake 'akaale 'ala bibaale 'enekwaa 'eyaanedaanedu 'amelaake 'eresu yafatharawene layeto yewasede nabare; 'anedu leelaanyaaweneme lamaashanafe tegele yegathemenaa ya`aalame sere`aate yewademe nabare; batachabaache katabaalawe nagare 'anedeme 'aletafatharame. yehe selahoname 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaake 'anede 'enedahona 'eresume 'alaahe mahonune tachabaachu yaaseradaale. tagaarinaa leje 'alawe belawe kamigaletsute laaqa.
kafethuraanu yatasawarawene hulu `aawaaqi; yamitaayenaa basemeete hhewaase yamidaasasuteneneme `aawaaqi nawe. ka'enazihe meneme nagare 'ayesawarebateme. kamagaaraateme laaqa.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale:: geetaayee 'enanyihene 'agaariwoce yaqatharekaacawene qethaate betaasaayanye.
geetaayee 'enee 'eyaalahu yameteqathaacawe kahona; ka'enasu 'enedaataadareganye; yadarasabaacawe qethaate 'enee laayeme 'enedaayedarasebenye.
'enyaa 'enasune 'enedameneqathaacawe qaale yagabaanawene qethaate lenaasaayehe 'enecelaalane; yeheneneme yehune leelaa nagare 'ayesaananeme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kefu yamiszaraabehene batashaala malekaame baaheriye yeqere bamaalatenaa yamiyaadaresebehene cegere bate`egesete takalaakale; 'enasu selamigaletsute tagaari 'alawe yamilutenaa yamiqathefutene; 'anetaneme dagemo laaneta bamaayegabaa baaheriye 'enedamigaletsuhenaa degemetanyaa 'enaa 'ebede 'enedamiluheme 'enaaweqaalane.
'enedihe bale:: <<geetaayee kashayethaane wetewataanaa gutegotaa baaneta 'ethabaqaalahu.
geetaayee bamaanenyaaweme gudaayee laaye 'enedaayemathubenyeme ba'aneta 'ethabaqaalahu.>>

ka'enanyihe 'agaariwoce 'anedaacawe mote simathaabatenaa yamidaresebatene ba`aayenu simalakate; selaalafawe 'edemeewenaa ya'alaahene mamariyaa baalamaakebare selaagwaadalawe 'eyatatzatzata 'enedihe yelaale:: <<geetaayee wada duneyaa heyewate malesanye.

wada 'ereswa betemalesanye malekaame szeraane 'eszaraalahu.>> bafetsume! nagaru 'enedafalagekawe 'ayedalame. zeme belo yaminaagarawe qaale nawe. wada duneyaa hheyewate bimalaseme qelu yagabaawene qaale 'ayemolaame. 'enanyihe mutaane 'eseka maqaseqashaawenaa masabesabiyaawe qane derase bahulatu hheyewate makaakale baala geredoshe wesethe yeqoyaalu. yaalafaacawene lamaakaakaaseme hona yaabalaashutene lamaarame kaalubate `aalame wada xwaalaa yamamalase `edele yalaacaweme.
kawanejalu yeleqe malekaame szeraawe bamabelathu mizaanu yakabadalate; 'enanyaa yafalagutene bamaagenyatenaa kamifarute nagare bamaraaqe sekeetaamaa yahonute 'enasu naacawe.

kamalekaame szeraacawe yeleqeme wanejalaacawe bamabelathu mizaanaacawe yaqalalabaacawe. nafesaacawene yamigodaawene bamaszeraataacawe 'enaa yamithaqemaacawene 'emenatenaa malekaame szeraa bamatawaacawe raasaacawene labekenate bamadaarage; bajahaname wesethe yamaayewathu sihonu yamiqoyu naacawe.
'esaate fitaacawene yelabalebaacawaale; ba'esaate wesetheme fitaacawe 'ejege kamachafegagu yatanasaa yalaayenyaawe 'enaa yataacenyaawe kanaaferaacawe wada theresaacawe yeshabashabaale.
batecete malekume 'enedihe yebaalaalu:: <<ba'ezihenyaawe `aalame yaqure'aane 'aneqatzoce 'eyatanababalaacehu; taasetabaabelu 'alenabaramene?!>>
'enedihe yelaalu:: <<geetaacene baqadama `eweqatehe baasaalafekawe `edala bise yamahonaacene wesaanee 'ashanafanenaa ka'ewenate yaraaqene hhezeboceme honene.
geetaacene ka'esaate 'asewathaane. wada nabarenebate kehedatenaa themate benemalase; meneme maasetabaabayaa yaleelane raasaacenene badaayoce nane maalate nawe.>>
'alaahe 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<ba'esaate wesethe yatawaaradaacehunaa yabataace honaacehu 'eregu; 'enedaataanagerunyeme.

'enanyaa ba'enee yaamanu wesene baariyaawocee 'enedihe yelu nabare:: geetaacene baaneta 'amenanaale; hathi'aataacenene sarezelene; ba'azaanyenateheme 'ezanelene 'aneta ka'azaanyoce hulu balaache nahe.

'enanyaane 'alaahene yamimaatzanutene masaalaqiyaanaa maafeezhaa 'adaragaacexwaacawe; ba'enasu laayeme masaalaqaacehu 'alaahene maawesaate 'aserasaacehu; bamaalaagathenaa bamasaalaqeme tesequbaacaweme nabaraacehu.
'enanyihene 'amaanyoce ya'alaahene te'ezaaze bamaakebarenaa ka'enaanetame bamisanazarebaacawe selataagasume yatenesaa'eewe `elate lajanate bamaabeqaate 'emanadaacawaalahu.
'enedihe bamaalateme malese yesathaalu:: <<'anede qane wayeneme gemaashe qane nawe yaqoyanawe; sela qanenaa waraate tekurate yamisathutene thayeqe.>>
'enedihe yelaacawaale:: <<yaqoyaacehubatene gizee betaawequ; ya'alaahene te'ezaaze tagebaaraawi bamaaderage te`egesete maaderage yamiyaasecelaacehu 'achere gizee becaa nawe yaqoyaacehute.>>

baalaselethaanu; fethuraanu 'enedafalagawe yamiyaadaregawe; 'ewenatanyaa yahonawe; qaalume 'ewenate; negegerume 'ewenate; ka'eresu weche 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaake yalame. kafethuraanoce hulu taalaaqe yahonawe 'enaa yatakabarawe `areshe (zufaane) baalabeete yahonawe laaqa. 'alaahe kafethuraanoce hulu lagazafawe nagare geetaa kahona; yahulume nagare geetaa nawe.

'amelekote 'enedamigabaacawe marajaa saayenorawe ka'alaahe gaare leelaane 'amelaake yamitharaa; yakefu szeraawe menedaa geetaawe zanede nawe. sela thefaatume baqethaate yamimanadaawe 'eresu nawe. kahadiyaane yamifalegutene bamaagenyatenaa kamithalute bamaraaqe lasekeete 'ayebaqume.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale:: <<geetaayee hathi'aateene sarezelenye; ba'ezenateheme 'ezanelenye; tzatzatune bamaqabale lahathi'aatanyaa kamiyaazenute hulu balaache nahe.>>

yehene me`eraafe: hegegaatune 'enedetetagaberu gedeetaa yaadaragenebate; bawesethume yamiganyutene hegegaatoce taasetaawesunaa tetagaberuteme zanede bawesethu yataberaaru 'aneqatzocene yaawaradenebate me`eraafe nawe.

yaalaagabu wanede zemutanyaa 'enaa seete zemutanyaane 'eyaanedaanedaacawene mato jeraafe gerafwacawe. ba'alaahe 'enaa bamacharashaawe qane yametaamenu 'enedahonaacehu; qethaatune ba'enaresu laaye baalamafatsame 'aliyaame bamaaqaalale 'ezenatenaa reheraahee 'ayeyaazaacehu. 'enaresune lamaagaalathe lanaresume laleeloceme magasachaa yehone zanede: qethaataacawe laaye kame`emanaane yatawasanu kefeloce yeganyu.

yazemutene tzayaafenate lamagelatse: zemutene lemaadu yaadaraga tamasaasaayune zemutanyaa seetene 'aliyaame 'ereswane maagebaate yatakalakala kamahonume gaare 'agaari seetene 'eneji 'enedamaayaagabaa; zemutene lemaadwa yaadaragaceme yaraaswane `aayenate zemutanyaane 'aliyaame 'agaari wanedene 'eneji leelaa 'enedamaataagabaa; zemutanyaa seetene maagebaatenaa lazemutanyaa wanedeme madaare bame'emanaane laaye 'ereme madaragune: 'alaahe galatsa.

'enaaneta mariwoce hoye! 'enanyaa chawaa seetocene 'enaa chawaa wanedocene batzayaafe (bazemute) yamizalefu 'enaa thebeqocene bazemute lazalafubate 'araate mesekerocene yamaayaamathutene: samaaniyaa jeraafe gerafwacawe; 'eseka maceeme mesekerenataacaweneme 'ateqabalu. 'enanyaa chawaawocene bazemute yamizalefute ka'alaahe te'ezaaze yaafanagathu naacawe.

'enanyaa yatatzatzatu 'enaa wada 'alaaheme yatamalasute kaziyaame szeraawocaacawene yaasaamarute siqaru; 'enaresune 'alaahe tzatzataacawene mahari 'enaa mesekerenataacawene yeqabalaacawaale. 'alaaheme kabaarocu latatzatzatu mahari; lanaresume 'azaanye nawe.

'enanyaa baalabeetocaacawene bazemute yamikasesu wanedoce; 'enaresuneme lakasasubate wanejale tekekelanyaanate karaasaacawe baashaagare leeloce mesekeroce yaleelaacawe; kanaresu 'anedaacawe misetune bazemute sela makesasu ka'ewenatanyocu lamahonu mesekerenatu ba'alaahe seme 'araate gizee melo mamasekare nawe.
kaziyaame ba'amesetanyaawe mesekerenate; 'eresu 'ereswane sela kasasaate nagare kaweshataamocu kahona ya'alaahe 'eregemaane 'enediwaredebate mathayaqene yechameraale.

baziheme maszarate 'ereswa yazemute qethaatene leteqathaa tagabi tehonaalace. 'eresu 'ereswane bakasasaate nagare kaweshataamocu 'enedahona 'araate gizee ba'alaahe seme melaa mamasekarwa yazemute qethaatune yekalaakalelaataale.
ba'amesetanyaaweme mesekerenate: 'eresu 'ereswane selakasasaate wanejale ka'ewenatanyocu 'enedahona ya'alaahe qethaate bareswa laaye 'enediwarede malamane techameraalace.

sawoce hoye! ya'alaahe cerotaa 'enaa 'ezenatu ba'enaaneta laaye baalenabara; kabaarocu latatzatzatute mahari; bamaasetadaadarunaa bahegegaatume thebabanyaa baalenabare bawanejalocaacehu 'athaadefo yeqathaacehunaa yaawaaredaacehume nabare.

me'emanaane hoye! 'enanyaa 'ebelatene (yame'emanaane 'enaate yahonacewene `aashaane (radeyalaahu `anehaa; bazemute seme yamaathefaate tagebaarene) yafatsamu; ba'enaaneta seme yamitharu budenoce naacawe. 'enaresu yafabarakute yahasate waree; la'enaaneta kefu 'enedahona 'aderegaacehu 'enedaataasebute; bawesethu menedaane maagenyate; me`emanaanene ka'asemasaayoce malayate 'enaa yame`emanaane 'enaatene kawanejale natsaa mahonwane maaragaagachaanate yaalabate bamahonu ba'eregethe la'enaaneta malekaame nawe. la'eyaanedaanedu 'ereswane batzayaafe bamaaneqwaashashe negegere latasaatafa: laszaraawe hathi'ate waagaa 'alawe. yehene tzayaafe negegere qademo bamanaagare telequne hathi'ate laszaraawe yamanaafeqaanu mari `abedalaahe bine 'ubaye bine salule taalaaqe qethaate tazagaajetolataale.
'enanyaa wanede 'amaanyoce 'enaa seete 'amaanyoce yehenene taalaaqe qethefate basamu gizee: ya'amaanye wanedemocaacawene salaamaawinate bamaasabe yehe geletse weshate nawe 'ayelume nabare?!

'enanyaa bame'emanaane 'enaate `aashaahe (radeya 'alaahu `anehaa) laaye yaqathafute sawoce wada 'ereswa laasethagute taalaaqe qethefate tekekelanyenate: 'araate mesekerocene 'ayaamathume nabarene?! baziheme maszarate mesekerocene yamaayaamathu kahona (lamaceeme 'ayaamathume) 'alaahe zanede weshataamoce naacawe.

me'emanaane hoye! 'enaanetane baqethaate baalamaathaadafe 'enaa kamakaakalaacehu latatzatzatuteme meheratene bamaaderage ya'alaahe cerotaanaa 'ezenate bazihenyaawenaa bamachiwe `aalame banaaneta laaye baalenabara; bame`emanaane 'enaate laaye bamawaashate 'enaa bamaqethafe thaleqaacehu bagabaacehubate hhameete taalaaqe qethaate baaganyaacehume nabare.

weshate hono saala 'anedaacehu kaleelaacehu wareewene seteqabaabalunaa ba'anedabataacehu setenagaagaru; sela 'eresume `eweqate 'alenabaraacehume. qethefate belome yanetsuhhene sawe seme maathefaate yaalabate bamahonu 'alaahe zanede taalaaqe wanejale hono saala: 'enaaneta qalaale 'aderegaacehu taasebutaalaacehu.

yehenene qethefate basamaacehu gizeeme:: yehenene 'asaafaari nagare lenenaagare 'ayegabaaneme. geetaacene hoye! yalaaqeke nahe! yehe bame`emanaane 'enaate laaye yatasanazarawe nagare taalaaqe weshate nawe 'atelume nabarene?!
'ewenate 'amaanyoce yahonaacehu 'enedahona: wadazihe `aayenatu netsuhhe sawene batzayaafe seme wada maathefaate qethefate bafetsume 'enedaatemalasu yemakeraacexwaale, yegasetzaacexwaaleme.

'alaaheme hegegaatune 'enaa mekerocune yaaqafa 'aneqatzocune yaaberaaraalaacexwaale. 'alaaheme meneme yamaayesawarebate; szeraawocaacehune `aawaaqi; bamaasetanaabarunaa bahegegaatume thebabanyaa nawe.

'enanyaa bazemute masaadabene chamero tsayaafe nagaroce bame`emanaane wesethe 'enedisefaafaa yamifaqedu: la'enaresu bazihece `aalame basedebe(seme bamaathefaate) wanejale 'asaamaami qethaate; bamacharashaawe `aalame dagemo ya'esaate qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale. 'alaahe weshataacawene; yabaaroce gudaayene yamiyaamaraabatene 'enedihume yamibajaacawene `aawaaqi nawe. 'enaaneta gene yehenene 'ataawequme.

'enaaneta baseme maathefaatu laaye yatazafaqaacehu hoye! 'alaahe cerotaawene baayelagesaacehunaa baayaazenelaacehu noro; 'alaaheme la'enaaneta ruxeruxe 'enaa 'ejege yamiyaazene baalenabare: qethaatune yaafaathenebaacehu nabare.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa hegegaatune yametefatsemu sawoce hoye! shayethwane weshatene bamaasaamare bamiraamadawe faanaawe 'atekatalute. yashayethwaneneme 'eremejaa yamikatale kaala 'eresu katagebaarocenaa kanegegeroce tzayaafe yahonawene 'enaa ya'alaaheneme hege yamiyaawagezawene nagare yaazezaale. me`emanaane hoye! ba'enaaneta laaye ya'alaahe 'ezenate baalenabare: ka'enaaneta maaneme baaletharaa nabare. genaa 'alaahe tzatzatune bamaqabale yafalagawene yaatharaale. 'alaaheme negegerocaacehune sami; szeraawocaacehune `aawaaqi nawe; ka'eresume meneme 'ayesawarebateme; sela szeraacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

'enanyaa ba'emenatu belechaa yaalaacawe 'enaa baneberateme yatzagaa baalabeetoce yahonute: dehocenaa ba'alaahe manegade latasadadu yatacagaru zamadocaacawe seme maathefaatu laaye bamasaatafaacawe mekeneyaate lanaresu mamatzewate lamatawe 'ayemaalu. yeqere yebalwacawe; yelafwacaweme. yeqere yaalaacexwaacawenaa yaalafaacexwaacawe 'enedahona: 'alaahe wanejalocaacehune 'enedimerelaacehu 'atewadumene?! 'alaahe kabaarocu latatzatzata mahari; la'enaresume 'azaanye nawe. yehe 'aneqatze 'abubakere (radeya 'alaahu `anehu) zamadu misethahhe seme bamaathefaatu laaye bamasaatafu yatanasaa la'eresu yaadaregawe yanabarawene malekaame nagare lamaaqwaarathe bamamaalu mekeneyaate yawarada nawe.

'enanyaa chawaa belome 'amaanye yahonute seetoce cheraashe yamaayaasebutenenaa yazanagute bahonawe tzayaafe tagebaare semaacawene yamiyaathafu; baqerebume hona bamacharashaawe `aalame ka'alaahe 'ezenate yatabaararunaa yataragamu naacawe. la'enaresume taalaaqe qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale.
yeheme qethaate melaasocaacawe batanaagarubate weshate; 'egerocaacaweme yeszarute banabarubate nagare bamimasakerubaacawe yaferedu `elate yetzanaabaacawaale.

baziyaane `elate 'alaahe menedaacawene bafetehe yekafelaacawaale. 'alaaheme 'ewenate mahonune; la'alaahe yahona malekaame nagare; qaale kidaane; maasefaraariyaame hulu therethaaree yaleelabate geletse 'ewenate mahonune yaaweqaalu.

kawanedoceme, kaseetoceme, kanegegereme, katagebaareme mathefowocu lamathefowoce yatagabu naacawe. ka'enanyiheme theruwocu latheruwocu yatagabu naacawe. 'enanyaa kawanedocenaa kaseetoce theruwocu mathefo wanedocenaa seetoce kamilute nagare netsuhe naacawe. lanaresume 'alaahe zanede wanejalocaacawene yamimerebate meherate tazagaajetolaacawaale. la'enaresume yaamaara sisaaye janate tazagaajetolaacawaale.

haferatagalaane mamalekate semeetene qaseqeso zenaa(zemute) wada maseraate 'enedamigafaafaa yame`eraafu magebiyaa laaye sela tagalatza `aayenoce yaaletafaqadalaacawene galaa 'enedaayemalakatu 'enaa sawoce 'aseqademo theneqaaqee yaaderegu zanede wada beete sigabu maasefaqadene 'azaza.
'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa hegegaatune yametetagaberute sawoce hoye! ya'enaaneta wadaalehonu beetoce nawaariwocwane saataasefaqedu 'enaa la'enaresume salaametaa saataaqarebu <<'asalaamu `alayekume; magebaate yefaqadaale?>> belaacehu faqaade saatethayequ 'ategebu. yehe yataazazaacehubate maasefaqade badenegate kamagebaate 'enaa yataazazaacehuteneme letaasetaawesu belome letetagaberu zanede yatashaala nawe.

babeetocu wesethe maaneneme baataaganyu: mafeqade kamicele 'akaale faqaade 'eseketaaganyu deraseme 'ategebu. baalabeetocume tamalasu kaalwacehu 'ategebu; tamalasume. yeheme 'alaahe zanede la'enaaneta netzehenaa nawe. 'alaaheme yameteszarutene nagare tamalekaace nawe; meneme 'ayesawarebateme; ba'eresume yemanadaacexwaale.

lathaqelaalaa 'agalegelote yatazagaaju; yatawasana gelasabe neberate yaalehonu 'eneda beetamatsaahhefete 'enaa bagabayaawoce wesethe 'enedaalu maarafiyaawoce; sawoce yaminorubaacawe 'enaa 'eqaawocaacehume wada yamiganyubaacawe beetoce yaalafaqaade betegabu cegere yalabaacehume; 'alaahe kaszeraawocecehunaa kahuneetaacehume geletse yametaadareguteneme hona yametedabequteneme yaaweqaale; baziheme yemanadaacexwaale.

wadaaletafaqada taqaaraani tsotaane mamalekate yazemute deledeye bamahonu 'alaahe `eyetaane zeqe maaderagene 'azaza; 'enediheme 'ala::
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! wanede 'amaanyocene: seetocenenaa haferata-galaane kamamalekate `eyetaacawene 'enediqothebunaa beletaacaweneme kamagelathenaa katsayaafe tagebaare (kazemute) 'enedithabequ negaraacawe. yehe 'ereme wada hona 'akaale kamamalekate `aayenene maqothabe: 'alaahe zanede la'eresu netsehenaa nawe. 'alaaheme selamiszarute wesethe `aawaaqi nawe; meneme 'ayesawarebateme; sela'eresume yemanadaacawaale.

laseete 'amaanyoceme: mamalekate kaaletafaqadalaacawe nagare 'enaa kahaferata-galaa `eyetaacawene 'enediqothebu 'enedihume kazemute bamaraaqenaa bamashafaneme beletaacawene 'enedithabequ negaraacawe. balebese madabaqu yamaayemace; ka'eresume geletse yahonawene siqare geethocaacawene labaa`ede wanedoce `eyetaa 'ayegelathu. tzagurocaacawene; fitocaacawene 'enaa 'anegatocaacaweneme lamashafane: gufetaawocaacawene ba'anegategeewocaacawe laaye yaathaafu. labaalocaacawe; la'abaatocaacawe; labaalocaacawe 'abaatoce; lawanedoce lejocaacawe; labaalocaacawe wanede lejoce; lawanedemocaacawe; lawanedemocaacawe wanede lejoce; la'ehetocaacawe wanede lejoce; 'amaanyeme honu kahadiyaane lahonu taamaanye seetocaacawe; baquthetheraacawe sere laalu wanedeme honu seete baariyaawocaacawe; kawanedoceme laseete gudaaye yaleelaacawe lakxonute takataayoce wayeme la'enanyaame hetzaane bamahonaacawe selaseetoce haferata-galaa lamaayaawequ hhetsaanaate kaalehona baqare yawesethe geethocaacawene 'ayegelathu. kageethocaacaweme ya'egere 'alebone yemasele yamidabequte yetaawaqe zanedeme 'egerocaacawene 'ayemetu. me`emanaane hoye! yametefalegutene bamaagenyate; kametefaruteme natsaa bamahone tedenu zanede hulaacehume wada 'alaahe bamatzatzate tamalasu.

batedaare thelaa sere 'alamahone kazemute masefaafiyaa manegadoce 'anedu bamahonu 'alaahe yaalaagabu sawocene wada tedaare 'enedigabu 'egazaa lidaragelaacawe 'enedamigabaa bamaazaze 'enedihe 'ala::
me'emanaane hoye! misetoce yaleelaacawene wanedoce 'enedihume baale yaleelaacawene chawaa seetocene 'agaabu. kawanedoce baarocaacehunaa kaseetoce baarocaacehume 'amaanye yahonutene 'agaabu; dehoceme bihonu 'alaahe kasafiwe terufaatu yaabeqaaqaacawaale. 'alaaheme maaneneme maabaletsage kasisaayu yamaayeqanesebate; sisaaya safi; yabaarocune huneetaa `aawaaqi nawe.

'alaahe yaalaagabu wanedocenaa seetocene maagaabaatene kaazaza baxwaalaa: tedaare yaalemaszarata yamiyaagabaabatene yaalaaganya 'enedahona raasune mathabaqe 'enaa mataagase 'enedaalabate siyaazeze 'enedihe yelaale::
'enanyaame yagaabecaa wachi yamaayaaganyu 'alaahe kasafiwe cerotaawe 'esekayaabeqaaqaacawe derase yethabequ. 'enaziyaaneme kaszeraacehu yaalute baaroce 'agalegaayocaacehu: ganezabene sathetawe natzaa lamawethaate ka'alaqocaacawe gaare matzaatzaafene yamifalegutene: 'enasu yamakefale 'aqeme 'enaa ba'emenataacawe theru 'enedahonu betaawequ: wele tatzaatzaafwacawe. katatzaatzaafaacexwaacawe kafilune `edaa bamatawe 'alaaheme kasathaacehu ganezabe sethwacawe. seetoce baarocaacehuneme yaqerebune hheyewate theqeme ganezabene bamafalage: yamanaafeqaanu mari yahonawe `abedalaahe bine 'ubaye hulate seete baarocene 'enedaasegadedadawe `aayenate: kazemute tzayaafenate maraaqene 'eyafalagu: zemute 'enedifatsemu 'ataasegadedwacawe. ka'enaanetame yamiyaasegadedaacawe kaala: 'alaahe kamagadadaacawe baxwaalaa wanejalocaacawene mahari 'enaa la'enaresume 'azaanye nawe. 'enaresume yatagadadu bamahonaacawe hathi'ate yalabaacaweme; hathi'atu baasegadadaacawe sawe laaye nawe.

sawoce hoye! ba'eregethe wada 'enaaneta mamasaasale yaleelabaacawene 'enedihume 'ewunatenenaa hhasatene layetawe yamiyaaberaaru 'aneqatzocene 'aweradanaale. ka'enaaneta bafite kaalafute 'amaanyoce 'enaa kahadiyaane mesaaleewoceme 'awaradene. yageetaacawune te`ezaazetene bamafatzame 'enaa kakelekalaawu bamaraaqe 'alwahene lamifarute tagesaatse yamihone mekere 'awuredanaale.

'alaahe yasamaayaatenaa yamedere berehaane nawe. bawesethwa yaaluteneme mari sihone ba'amaanyu lebonaa yamiganyawe yaberehaanu mesaalee dagemo leke meneme 'ayenate qadaadaa baleelawe 'athere wayeme kalalaa wesethe 'enedamiganye berehaane nawe. yaziyaa berehaane mesaalee leke baberecheqo wesethe 'enedaala berehaane sihone 'eneda lule kokabeme boge belo yaabaraale. yehe berehaane yamiqathaathalawe beruke kahonacwa zaafe zayete nawe. zaafwame yawayeraa maalateme yazayetune zaafe tebaalaalace. yehecene yatabaarakace zaafe banegaateme yehune bameshete katzahaaye yamigaaredaate nagare yalamenaa zayetwa kanethaatu yatanasaa yabaraa 'esekimasele boge yelaale. yeheme 'esaate saayenakaakaawe yamitaayebate berehaane sihone biqathaathale dageme mene yaahele yebaraa yehone?! baberecheqowe berehaane laaye ya'aberiwaa berehaane sitaakalebate dagemo yebesaale. ya'amaanyu lebonaame qenu godaanaa laaye yamiyaasekeedawene berehaane siyaaganye leke 'enedazihu nawe yamiyaabaraawe. 'alaahe kabaarocu makaakaleme lamishaawe qure'aanene takatelawe lamimarubate yehenene 'edele yaagonaatzefaacawaale. hayaalu 'alaahe bahulume nagare laaye thelequne `aawaaqi, meneme nagare yamaayeshashagawe 'amelaake nawenaa nagarocene ka'amesaayaawocaacawe gaare bamaayaayaaze mesaalee bamatheqase yaaberaaraale.

yeheme maberaate 'alaahe darajaawocaacawe 'enaa genebaataawocaacawe yalaaqa 'enedihone baazazabate: ba'azaane; bawedaaseenaa basalaateme semu 'enediwasaa bafaqadabate masejidoce wesethe yaabaraale. ya'alaahene wedeetaa bamafalageme bathwatenaa bamaataa bawesethaacawe yesagadaale.

'enanyaa 'alaahene kamaawesaate; salaateneme batagabiwe maleku kamasegade; zakaaneme lamigabaawe kamasethate: magezaatenaa mashathe yamaayaazanaagaacawe: wanedoce ('alaahene thwatenaa maataa yaawadesaalu). kaqethaate natsaa mahonene bamakajale 'enaa wesethu mathaalene bamaferaate: leboce baferehaate yamigalabaabathubatene 'enedihume `aayenoceme wada talayaayu 'aqethaachaa yamiqaabezubatene: yaferedune qane yefaraalu.

yehenene yaadaragute: 'alaaheme baszeraawocaacawe: kaszarute batashaala maleku limanadaacawe; katerufaatume lichamerelaacawe zanede nawe. 'alaaheme lamifalagawe 'eneda szeraawe yaala gadabe sisaayene yesathaale; belome kaszarute 'ethefe derebe bahona maleku yelagesaacawaale.
