'enanyaa 'alaahene yakaadu sawoce: szeraawocaacawe menedaa yaleelaacawe sihonu: yatathamaa sawe 'awelaalaa meedaa laaye 'enedamiyaayawe 'enaa weha nawe belo 'enedamiyaasebawe welebelebite (sarebido) `aayenate nawe. wadaresume batagwaazanaa badarasa gizee weha hono 'ayaaganyaweme. kahadime 'enedihu nawe: szeraawocu yamithaqemute yemaselawaale; moto siqasaqaseme bakehedatu sababe menedaawene 'ayaaganyeme. geetaaweneme kafite lafitu yaaganyawaale; yaszeraaweneme menedaa yatamwalaa 'aderego yesathawaale. ya'alaaheme meremaraa fathaane nawe.

wayeme szeraawocaacawe maa`ebale bamishafenawe, kamaa`ebalume balaaye damanaa 'enedashafanawe theleqe baahhere wesethe 'enedaalu kafilaacawe bakafilaacawe laaye 'enedatadaraarabu chelamaawoce `aayenate nawe. bazihe wesethe yawadaqa sawe bachelamaawocu wesethe 'ejune biyaawathaa kachelamaawe beretaate yatanasaa maayate 'ayeceleme. kahadime 'enedihu nawe: yadenequrenaa; yatherethaaree; yawalaawaayenate 'enaa balebe laaye yamagaarade chelamaawoce yatadarabubate nawe. 'alaaheme kathememate qenaacaane; yamatsehhafuneme `eweqate yaalesathawe: yamiqaanaabate mamariyaa; yamimaraabate matsehhafeme yalaweme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaho 'alaahe basamaayaate yaalu; bamedereme yaalu fetherataatu 'a`ewaafeme bahewaa kenefocaacawene yaanesaafafu honawe: 'eresune 'enedamiyaawadesu 'ataaweqemene?! ka'enyaa fetherataate 'eyaanedaanedaacawene ka'enaresu 'eneda sawoce salaatene yamisagedawene segedatune; 'eneda 'a`ewaafeme yamiyaawadesawene dagemo wedaaseewene yaaweqaale. 'alaaheme yamiszarutene hulu `aawaaqi nawe.
yasamaayaatunaa yamederu negeszenaa la'alaahe becaa nawe. baferedume `elate lameremaraa 'enaa lamenedaa mamalase wada 'eresu becaa nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaho 'alaahe damanaa yaminadaa mahonune; kafilune kakafilu yamiqalaaqele; kaziyaame kafilune bakafilu laaye yamidaraarebawe mahonune 'ataaweqemene?! kadamanaawoce makaakaleme zenaabe siwathaa temalakataalahe. kasamaayeme 'aqethaachaa taraarocene kamimaselu yatadaraarabu damanaawoce 'eneda thathare yaala yaweha barado yewaredaale; baziyaame barado kabaarocu makaakale yamifalegawene yaaganyaale; kamishaaweme laaye yemalesawaale. yadamanaaweme natzaberaaqe berehaane kamaanetzabaaraqu beretaate `aayenocene linatheqe yeqarebaale.

'alaahe leelitene 'enaa qanene bamaarezamenaa bamaasaathare; bamaasekeedenaa bamaamethaateme yaagalaabethaale. ba'enanyihe ya'alaahene geetenate thaqwaami bahonute meleketoce wesethe ya'alaahene celotaa 'enaa 'anedenate maganezabe lamicelu sawoce mekere 'ala.

'alaahe bamedere laaye taneqasaaqaashe yahonutene hulu kazare fasaashe fathara; ka'enaresume makaakale 'eneda 'ebaabe 'enaa zanedo yaalute badarataacawe yamisaabu; 'eneda sawe 'enaa baraariwoce yaalute dagemo bahulate 'egerocaacawe yamigwaazu; 'eneda 'enesesaate yaaluteme ba'araate 'egerocaacawe yamiraamadume 'alu. 'alaahe 'ezihe kathaqasawenaa kaalethaqasaweme yamishaawene yefatheraale. 'enaho 'alaaheme 'anedaaceme nagare yamaayaaqetawe; nagarocune hulu caaye nawe.

bamuhhamade laaye mamasaasale yaleelabaacawenaa wada 'ewenatanyaa manegade yamimaru geletse 'aneqatsotzocene 'aweredanaale. 'alaaheme yamishaawene sawe thememate wadaleelabate qathetanyaa manegade yemaraale; yaame manegade wada janate yaadaresaale.

'asemasaayocu: ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe 'amanene; 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaaweneme taazazene yelaalu. 'enedihe kaalu baxwaalaame ka'enaresu yatawasanute yaafagafegaalu. ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe maamanaacawene; 'enaresuneme yamitaazazu mahonaacawene kaawaju baxwaalaame 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene 'ayetaazazume. 'enanyaa meneme 'enekwaa 'amenanaale bilume: ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyaawe yamiyaamenu 'ayedalume.
'enanyaame 'asemasaayoce: wada 'alaahe 'enaa bamimasakerubateme gudaaye male'eketanyaawe bamahakalaacawe yefarede zanede wada 'eresu sitharu: yaane gizee 'enaresu ka'alaahe ferede yaafagafegaalu.
'ewenatu ya'enaresu mahonune 'enedihume la'enaresu bamithaqeme maleku yamifaradelaacawe mahonune kaawaqu gene: taazaazhocenaa taanaanaashoce honawe yemathaalu.

balebocaacawe wesethe yamaayelaqaacawe bashetaa 'alabaacawene?! wayenese muhhamade male'eketanyaa mahonune tatharaatharune?! wayese 'alaahenaa male'eketanyaawe 'enedaayebadelwacawe farune?! bafetsume! yelequneme 'enanyaa kaferedu yamirequnaa yamikedu badaayoce naacawe.

'alaahe ya'eresune 'enaa yamale'eketanyaawene ferede yamiqaawamutene 'enaa kaziyaame yamirequtene 'asemasaayoce huneetaa katanaagara baxwaalaa: feredune yamiqabalutene me`emanaanene gudaaye bamatheqase 'enedihe 'ala::
'amaanyoceme bamahakalaacawe yefarede zanede wada 'alaahenaa wada male'eketanyaawe sitharu:: qaalune samaane; te`ezaazuneme taqabalene: kamaalate wechi meneme 'ayelume. 'enanyaa bazihe baaheri yatagalatsute bazihenyaaweme `aalame hona bamacharashaawe `aalame sekeetaamaawoce naacawe.

'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yamitaazaze; laferedaacaweme 'eje yamisathe; 'alaaheneme yamifaraanaa te'ezaazune bamafatsamenaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe yamithanaqaqe: 'enanyaa yazihenyaawenenaa yamacharashaawene `aalame dasetaa yamiyaaganyute 'enasu naacawe.

'enanyaa 'asemasaayoce: wada tegele mawethaate betaazezaacawe: 'enedamiwathu yamicelutene yaakele wasane yadarasa mahalaawocaacawene yemelaalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe:: 'atemaalu! weshataacehu yetaawaqaale: taazaazhe nane yameteluteme yetaawaqaale; 'alaahe yameteszarutene nagare `aawaaqi nawe; meneme betedabequme ka'eresu yamisaware nagare yalame.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa 'asemasaayoce 'enedihe balaacawe:: 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene bayefaame badebeqeme taazazu; 'enasune kamataazaze betaafagafegu: 'enaho ya'eresu xaalaafinate yataazazawene maaderase nawe; ba'enaanetame laaye yamataazazenaa yaamathaawene male`ekete yamaszeraate gedeetaa 'alabaacehu. yaazazaacehune bamatagebare: kakalakalaacehume bamaraaqe te`ezaazune betefatsemu: wada 'ewenate temaraalaacehu. male'eketanyaawe male`ekete maaderase 'eneji: 'enaanetane yamaaqenaateme hona yamaasegadade xaalaafinate yalabateme.

'alaahe ka'enaaneta makaakale 'enanyaa yaamanutene 'enaa malekaame szeraawocene yamiszarutene; 'enanyaane kanaresu bafite yanabarutene 'amaanyoce bamedere laaye metekoce 'enedaadaragaacawe hulu metekoce liyaadaregaacawe; bathalaatocaacawe laaye delene liyaaqadaajaacawe; yawadadalaacaweneme 'emenate yatamacaaca 'enaa yatadalaadala liyaadaregelaacawe; kasegaataacaweme baxwaalaa tzathetaane litakaalaacawe: qaale gabaalaacawe. kaziyaame 'eneene babecanyenate yaamalekunyaale. ba'eneeme maaneneme tagaari 'ayaadaragume: sile qaale gabaalaacawe. ka'enaziheme tzagaawoce baxwaalaa yamikede kaala: 'enanyaa 'enaresu ka'alaahe te'ezaaze yaafanagathu naacawe.
salaatene batagabiwe maleku segadu; yaganezabocaacehuneme zakaa sethu; yetaazanelaacehu zanedeme te'ezaazune bamafatzame 'enaa kakalakalawe bamataaqabe male'eketanyaawene taazazu.

'aneta male'e'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaane yakaadu sawocene 'alaahe banaresu laaye qethaatene maawerade bifalege bamedere wesethe kaqethaatu yaamalethaalu belahe 'ataasebe. baferedume `elate manoriyaacawe yajahaaname 'esaate naate. 'ereswa mamalashaawe yahonacebate sawe: mamalashaawe menenyaa kafaa.

'alaahe la'akaala-mathane yadarasa maanenyaaweme sawe wada beete kamagebaatu bafite maasefaqade 'enedaalabate thaqeso 'asaalefo nabare: bazihe botaa dagemo 'enanyaa la'akaala-mathane yaaledarasu seete 'enaa wanede baaroce, baariyaa yaalehonu hetsaanaate 'enedihume la'akaala-mathane yadarasu lejoce yamaasefaqade sere`aatenenaa hhegegaatene bamatheqase: 'enedihe 'ala::
'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa bahegegaatume yameteszaru hoye! 'enanyaa baszeraacehu yamiganyu wanedenaa seete 'agalegaayoce; la'akaala mathane yaaledarasu lejoceme: baszosete gizeewoce wesethe wada 'enaaneta lamagebaate yaasefaqedwacehu: kasubihhe salaate bafite ka'eneqelefe 'enedanaqu yamanyetaa lebese siqayare, kaqatere baxwaalaame 'erafete lamaaderage lebesaacehune bametaawalequbate waqete, 'enedihume ka`ishaa'e salaate baxwaalaa lamatanyaate yamanyetaa lebese bameteqayeru waqete: 'enanyihe szosete haferata galaa yamigalathebate waqetoce bamahonaacawe: banazihe waqetoceme saayaasefaqedwacehu wada 'enaaneta kefele 'ayegebu. kanazihe wechi baalu waqetoce saayaasefaqedwacehu bigabu: ba'enaanetame hona banaresume laaye cegere yalame. 'enaresu 'enaaneta gaare 'ejege yamimalaalasunaa yamineqasaaqasu naacawe. 'anedaacehu leelaanyaawe gaare yegabaale; yewathaaleme; yemalaalasaaleme. bamahonume hulegizee lamagebaate maasefaqade yecageraale. 'alaahe yamaasefaqadene hegegaate 'enedaaberaaraaweme hulu: yadanagagaacawene hegegaate yamiyaaseradu 'aneqatzocene yaaberaaraalaacexwaale. 'alaaheme labaarocu yamibajaacawene nagare `awaaqi; bamidanagegaacaweme hegegaatu thebabanyaa nawe.

ya'enaaneta hetsaanaatoce la'akaala-mathane kadarasu: kazihe bafite batathaqasawe maleku telaalaaqocu 'enedamiyaasefaqedute lamagebaate bafalagu gizee hulu yaasefaqedu. 'alaaheme yamaasefaqadene hegegaate 'enedaaberaaraawe hulu: 'aneqatzocuneme yaaberaaraale. 'alaaheme labaarocu yamibajawene hulu `aawaaqi; selamidanagelaacaweme hegegaatu thebabanyaa nawe.

kaseetoceme 'enanyaa gaabecaane yamaayefalegu belome yaware 'ababaane kamaayatenaa ka'eregezenaa yataqwaarathu baaleteetoce:: 'enedaayegalethu yatakalakalutene yawesethe geethocaacawene saayegalethu kalaaye yamiyaathaafutene lebese 'enaa ya`aayena 'eregebene baayelabesu hathi'ate yalabaacaweme; yehunenaa lamashafanenaa lamathabaqe 'ejege wasaanye bamahonu malebasune kamatawe yeleqe bilabesu la'enasu malekaame nawe. 'alaaheme negegeraacehune yamisamaa; tagebaaraacehune yamiyaaweqe; ka'eziheme meneme 'ayesawarebateme; selaszeraacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

`aayena-sewere; 'anekaasaa 'enaa hhemametanyaa bahona laayeme ba'alaahe manegade mataagalene yemasele: 'alaahe babaarocu laaye gedeetaa yaadaragawene baayewathu hathi'ate yalabaacaweme. 'enaaneta me`emanaane hoye! beetaacehu; lejocaacehu beete; wayeme 'abaatocaacehu beete; wayeme 'enaatocaacehu beete; wayeme wanedemocaacehu beete; 'ehetocaacehu beete; wayeme 'agotocaacehu beete; 'akesetocaacehu beete; yashumocaacehu beete; wayeme yashumeewocaacehu; wayeme 'enedetethabequ halaafinate yatasathaacehu, 'eneda mesaaleeme:: ya'ereshaa zabanyaa; wayeme gwaadanyocaacehu beete: baheberateme hona tanathaathelaacehu betegabu: ba'enaaneta laaye hathi'ate yalabaacehume. wadatathaqasute beeteme hona wada leelocume bametegabu gizee <<'asalaamu `alayekume>> bamaalate: wesethwa bamiganyu nawaariwoce laaye salaametaane 'aweredu. babeete wesethe maaneme kaleelame <<'asalaamu `alayenaa wa`alaa `ibaadi 'alaahi 'asaalihhane>> bamaalate laraasaacehu salaametaa 'aqerebu. 'alaahe la'enaaneta yadanagagalaacehu bamakaakalaacehu wedeetaanenaa teseserene yamiyaasefaafaa 'enaa batherunatume yasamiwene lebe yamimaareke; ka'alaahe zanede yahona yatabaaraka salaametaa nawe. bazihe me`eraafe wesethe baasaalafenawe maaberaariyaa maszarateme: teradunaa bawesethu yaalawene mamariyaa tetagaberume zanede 'alaahe 'aneqatzocene yaaberaaraale.

'alaahe sigabu yamaasefaqadene danebe kathaqasa baxwaalaame siwathume selamaasefaqade thaqasa: 'enediheme 'ala::
'enaho ba'emenataacawe 'ewenatanyaa yahonute 'amaanyoce: ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanute; kamale'eketanyaaweme gaare lamuselimoce theqeme wasaanye 'enaa sabesaabi yahona sebesabaa laaye sihonu male'eketanyaawene saayaasefaqedu yamaayeheedute becaa naacawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa lamaheede yamiyaasefaqeduhe: 'enasu ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanute naacawe. la'anedaanede 'asaasaabi gudaayaacawe kaasefaqaduheme: ka'enaresu mahakaleme lafalagekawe feqadelate. lanaresu ka'alaaheme mehheratene thayeqelaacawe. 'alaaheme kabaarocu wadaresu yatamalasane sawe mahari; la'enaresume 'azaanye nawe.

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! male'eketanyaawene setetharute 'erese ba'eresaacehu 'enedametetharaarute `aayenate banathalaa semu muhhamade hoye! 'aliyaame ya`abedalaahe leje hoye! belaacehu 'atetherute; yelequnese ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'alaahe nabiye hoye! belaacehu therute. wasaanye lahona gudaayeme sitharaacehu, 'erese ba'eresaacehu lataraa gudaaye 'enedametetharaarute `aayenate theri 'atequtharute: yelequnese theriwene bafethenate taqabalu. 'enanyaa badebeqe sholekawe yamiheedutene 'alaahe ba'eregetheme yaaweqaacawaale. 'enanyaame yamale'eketanyaacawene te'ezaaze yamitzaararu: 'alaahe fatanaa 'enaa makaraa 'enedaayaadaresebaacawe wayeme mataagase yamaayecelute 'asaamaami qethaate 'enedaayaaganyaacawe yethaneqaqu.

nequ! 'ewaqu! basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalane nagare hulu mafethare; baalabeetenateme maasetanaabareme ya'alaahe becaa nawe. 'enaaneta yaalaacehubatene huneetaa hulu ba'eregethe yaaweqaale. kamote taqaseqesawe wada 'eresu bamimalasubate `elateme: ba'ezihenyaawe `aalame yaszarutene yenageraacawaale. 'alaahe basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalu nagaroce hulu yamaayesawarebate; sela hulume nagare `aawaaqi nawe.

babaareyaawe 'enaa bamale'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye: lamedere nawaari sawocenaa 'agaanenetoce ka'alaahe qethaate 'asefaraarinaa 'asethaneqaaqi yehone zanede ba'ewenatenaa bahasate makaakale yamilaye yahonawene matsehhafe yaawaradawe ('alaahe) laaqa barakatume bazaa.

yaa! yasamaayaatenaa yamedere negeszenaa ba'eju yahonawe; lejeme yaleelawe; banegeszenaaweme tagaari yaleelawe; nagaraatoceneme hulu yafatharanaa `eweqatunaa thebabume bafaqadawe maleke yamathananaa batekekele yaazagaaja nawe.

'enanyaa 'agaariwoce: ka'alaahe baashaagare teleqeme hona teneshene nagare mafethare yamaayecelu: yelequneme 'alaahe kaalenabarubate yaaseganyaacawene: 'eraasaacawe fethure yahonutene; karaasaacawe gudaatene maaseqarate; theqemeneme maamethaate yamaayecelutene; heyaawene magedale,muteneme maqaseqase yamaayecelutene mutaaneneme kaqaberocaacawe maqaseqase yamaayecelutene 'akaalaate tamalaaki 'aderegawe yaazu.

'alaahe 'agaariwocene ba'alaahe laaye tagaari maaderagaacawene kaasetaawasaacawe baxwaalaa: selaresu matsehhafe (qure'aane) 'enedihume sela male'eketanyaawe yaalaacawene 'aqwaame galatza; 'enediheme 'ala -
'enanyaa 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yakaadute: <> 'alu. 'enanyaa kahadiyaane 'enedihe bamaalataacawe ba'eregethe badalene 'enaa hasate qaalene tanaagaru. qure'aane ya'alaahe qaale nawe; saweme hona gaaneene 'amesaayaawene liyaamathu 'ayecelume.

'enanyaame qure'aanene yaasetabaabalute 'enedihe 'alu:: <<yehe qure'aane yaqadametocu wareenaa yamiqathaathefute hasate thereqeme nawe; muhhamademe yaanene galebetho nawe; thwate 'enaa maataa yenababelataale.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa 'asetabaabaayoce 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<nagaru 'enaaneta 'enedaalaacehute saayehone:qure'anune yaawaradawe yaa basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalutene debeqe nagarocene hulu `aawaaqi yahonawe 'alaahe nawe. 'eresume kathefaatu tatzatzeto latamalasa mahari; labaarocume 'azaanye nawe.>>

'enanyaame male'eketanyaawene yaasetabaabaalu 'agaariwoce 'enedihe 'alu:: <<yehe ka'alaahe zanede 'enedatalaaka yaminaagarawe male'eketanyaa mene hono nawe? maanenyaaweme sawe yamimagabawene megebe yamimagabe; nuroweneme lamaashanafe bayagabayaawe yamizawaaware?! lamahonuse 'aberote yamigodaanyawe; yamiyaamenebatenaa yamiradaawe male'ake kaala ka'eresu gaare 'ayewaredeme norwale?

wayenese baresu laaye delebe 'ayewaredelatemene?! wayeme bagabayaa wesethe kamazawaaware 'enaa sisaayene kamafalage yamiyaabeqaaqaawe sihone: fereewocune yamibalaacawe ya'atekelete seferaa lamene 'alenoraweme?>> 'alu. badaayocume 'enedihe 'alu:: <<'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! 'enaho 'enaaneta yametekatalute degemete 'a`emerowene yaashanafawene sawe 'eneji male'eketanyaa 'ayedalame.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'anetane bamene `aayenate baaheri 'enedagalatzuhe tamalekate; tadanaqeme: degemetanyaa, yatadagamabate; 'ebede belawe 'enedeete mesaaleewocene 'enedaadaragulehe tamalekate. baziheme mekeneyaate 'ewenatene saatu; basekeete godaanaa laayeme magwaaze 'alecaalume; sela 'ewenatanyenatehenaa sela taamaanyenateheme naqafaa yamiyaaqarebubate manegademe maagenyate 'ayecelume.

yaa! 'enaresu laaneta kaasabulehe nagare yatashaalane: karesu tebalaa zanede kahhenetzaawocu 'enaa zaafocu sere jeratoce yamifasebatene ya'atekelete seferaa; yadalaaheme kxonahe tenorebate zanede hhenetzaawocene liyaadaregelehe yamicelawe geetaahe leqenaa tagabaawe.

yatanaagarutene sinaagaru 'ewenatene 'enaa maaserajaane falegawe 'ayedalame; yelequnese yatenesaa'eewene qane maasetabaabalaacawe nawe; yatenesaa'eeweneme `elate laasetabaabala sawe: 'ejege yagaamanaa yamiqathaathale taalaaqe qethaate 'azagaajetanaale.
jahanameme kahadiyaane wadareswa sinadu karuqe seferaa batamalakatacaacawe gizee: kanedeetwa yatanasaa; 'ejege maganefalwane 'enaa maanaafaatwane yesamaalu.

'enanyaame kahadiyaane: 'ejocaacawe ka'anegatocaacawe gaare baberate sanesalate yataasaru honawe, bajahaname wesethe yathababa wada hona seferaa siwarawaru; kaziyaa natzaa mahonene bamamanyate mathefaatene yelamenaalu.

'enaaneta kahadiyaane hoye! baraasaacehu laaye 'anede thefaatene 'atetheru; yelequneme bezu thefaatene tathaaru; gene yametefalegutene 'ataaganyume. ba'asaamaamiweme qethaate wesethe tezawateraalaacehu; yebaalaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<lamahonu yehe yatathaqasalaacehu qethaate nawe yamishaalawe wayese tzagaawocwa; zawetaari 'enaa yamaayeqwaarathe 'enaa qwaami yahonace janate?! 'alaahe 'eresune lamifarute 'amaanye baarocu menedaa 'enaa baferedume `elate mamalashaa 'aderego yaazagaajaate?!>>

lanaresume ba'ereswa wesethe yamifalegute tzagaa 'alalaacawe; yeheme thenequqe baarocu 'alaahene yamithayequte qaale kidaanu nawe. ya'alaahe qaale kidaane tafatsaami nawe; 'eresu qaalune 'ayaathefemenaa.

'alaaheme 'asetabaabaayoce 'agaariwoce 'enaa 'enaresume ka'alaahe baashaagare tagaariwocene: yamiqasaqesebate `elate 'enaa 'amaaleketocaacawene lamaathaathaale tamalaakiwocaacawene:: <<baaroceene 'enediyaamalekwaacehu bamaazaze yaathamamwacexwaacawe 'enaaneta naacehune?! wayenese baraasaacawe nawe yathamamute?!>> bamilebate gizee yamihonawene 'awesaa.

tamalaakiwoceme 'enedihe yelaalu:: <<geetaacene hoye! laaneta tagaari yaleelahe yalaaqeke nahe; kaaneta leelaa yamenewadaajaacawe radaatoce linoraneme 'ayegabaame; baarocehene kaaneta bataace yaamalekune zanede 'aletharaacaweme; 'aneta gene 'agaariwocene ba`aalamaawi theqeme 'athaaqamekaacawe; 'abaatocaacaweneme tagesaatzene 'esekizanagu derase 'aqamaathalekaacawe; kaaneta gaareme leelaane 'amalaku; bathamaamaanataacaweme yatanasaa yathafu hhezeboce honu.>>

'alaaheme 'enedihe yelaacawaale:: <<'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! ka'alaahe wechi setaamalekwaacawe yanabaraacehute tamalaakiwocaacehu ba'enaresu laaye teqathefute yanabarawene nagare 'asetabaabaalubaacehu; dakaamaa bamahonaacehu yatanasaa karaasaacehu gudaatene maasewagade 'aliyaame raasaacehune maredaate 'atecelume. 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! ba'alaahe laaye tagaari bamaaderage: ka'enaaneta makaakale badale yamifatseme kaala: kalaaye yatathaqasutene yaaqamasenawene `aayenate kabaade qethaate 'enaaqamesawaalane.>>

'agaariwocu male'eketanyaawe (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) megebe mabelaataacawene 'enaa bagabayaa wesethe mazawaawaraacawene: lanabiyenataacawe maathaathaayaa selamathaqamaacawe 'alaahe 'enedihe sile malese satha::
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta bafite kaalute male'eketanyoce 'anedaacaweneme: 'enaresu megebene yamibalu, bagabayaa wesetheme yamizawaawaru bihonu 'eneji 'alelaakenaacaweme. 'anetame kamale'eketanyoce yatalayahe mathee (yamajamariyaa) 'ayedalaheme. sawoce hoye! bahabete, badehenate, batheenenate, bahhemame banazihe leyunate; batafatanaacehubate nagare mataagasaacehune lamafatane: bamataagasaacehume lenemanadaacehu: kafilaacehune lakafilaacehu mafatanyaa 'adaragene. geetaaheme maane 'enedamitaagase; maanese 'enedamitaazazawe; yatenyaawese 'enedamiyaametzawe hulune tamalekaace nawe.

'enanyaa 'enyaane maagenyatene tasefaa yamaayaadaregu; qethaataaceneneme yamaayefarute kahadiyaane: 'alaahe sela muhhamade 'ewenatanyenate yenagerune zanede malaa'eketene lamene 'alaawaradame wayeme 'eresune geetaacenene bageletze lamene fite lafite 'eyaayanawe 'ayenageraneme?! 'alu. kuraate balebonaacawe wesethe 'ayelo ka'emenate kalekelwacawaale; bazihe negegeraacaweme bakehedate 'enaa 'amebaagananenate wasanene 'alefawaale.

kahadiyaanu: bamotaacawe gizee, baqaberocaacawe wesethe, bamaqaseqashaacawe, lameremaraame sinadu, 'esaate wesetheme bamigabubate gizee, kamalaa'ekete gaare siganaanyu: malaa'eketu ka'alaahe yahonawe yabeseraate qaale ba'enaaneta laaye yatakalakala 'ereme nawe yelwacawaale.

kahadiyaanume bamederaawiwe `aalame wadaszarute malekaame szeraa 'enaamaraanaa, kaziyaame bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate yamaayethaqemaacawe yamaayeqwaathare sihone yatabatana tebiyaa 'enaadaregawaalane.

'enanyaa yaamanute sawoce baziyaa qane bamanoriyaa yatashaalu, bamaarafiyaa bakuleme baduneyaa kamiwasedute 'erafete yabalatha 'erafete laaye naacawe. yeheme ba'alaahe bamaamanaacawe 'enaa bamalekaame szeraacawe mekeneyaate nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! samaayaate banache daamanaawoce bamisanathaathaqubate `elate 'enaa malaa'eketeme wadamasabasabiyaacawe medere kasamaaye babezaate bamiwaredubate `elate yamihonawene 'awesaa.

yaa! 'ewenatanyaanaa yatzanaa yahonawe negeszenaa baferedu `elate la'alaahe yeragaagathaale. yaame `elate bakahadiyaane laaye kabaade yehonaale. bataqaaraaniwe dagemo lame'emanaane 'ejege qalaale nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'anetane male'eketanyaawene makatalene bamatawe raasune yabadala kahadi: katzatzatu kebedate yatanasaa 'enedihe yelaale:: male'eketanyaawe kageetaawe yezo yamathaawene nagare yanatzaa mawechaa manegadene takateyee banabare waa menyotee! 'eyaala thaatocune baminakesebate gizee yamihonawene 'awesaa.
kahazane beretaateme yatanasaa: 'enediheme yelaale:: <<waa thefaatee! menaala kahadiwene wadaaje 'aderegee baaleyaazeku.

yeheme kahadi gwaadanyaa bamale'eketanyaawe bakule qure'aane kadarasanye baxwaalaa 'athamamanye>>; shayethwane yasawe leje cegere sigathemawe galale yamile; yasawene leje 'ejege yamikede 'achebarebaari nawe.
male'eketanyaaweme baziyaane `elate lageetaawe semotaane yamiyaaqarebe hono: geetaayee hoye! hhezebocee yehenene qure'aane tawewete; karesume 'afagafagu; yelaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! leke 'aneta kahhezebocehe 'enedagathamahe maasecagare 'enaa ka'anetame godaanaa sawocene maagade 'enedagathamahe hulu; kaaneta bafite lalaakenaacawe male'eketanyoce la'eyaanedaanedaacawe kaafanagathu hhezebocaacawe thalaate 'adereganaale. wada 'ewenate bamameraate ragade ya'alaahe marinate baqaa (baqi nawe); bathalaatocehe laaye bamaagaze ragademe geetaahe baqaa! (baqi nawe).

'enanyaame 'alaahene yakaadute: yehe qure'aane bamale'eketanyaawe laaye ba'anede theqele 'ayewaredeme norwale? lamene tanathaathelo warada?! 'alu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'eresu lebonaahene 'enaaragaagaabate zanede: yezatune maradaate 'enaa balebe mayaazu yeqale zanedeme baqasetaa bamaawerade 'awaradenawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa 'agaariwoce baaneta laaye lamisanazerute hasaabe: 'ewenatanyaa 'enaa tzenu yahona malese 'enedihume 'ejege yatashaala galatzaa nawe yamenaamathaalehe.

'enanyaa baferedu `elate wada jahaname bafitocaacawe 'eyatagotatu yamiheedute; maarafiyaacawe 'esaate bamahonu: yakafaa maarafiyaa; manegadaacaweme yathematenaa yakehedate manegademe bamahonu 'ejege ka'ewenate yaraaqa nawe.
musaane matsehhafune (taweraatene) ba'eregethe sathanawe; wanedemuneme harunene laresu 'agaazhe yehone zanede male'eketanyaa 'adaragenawe.

'enediheme 'alenaacawe:: <<'enanyaa 'aneqatzocaacenene wada 'asetabaabalute fire`aawenenaa hhezebocu hidu.>> te'ezaazaaceneneme fatsamu. wada 'enasume bamaheede wada 'alaahe becanyaa 'amelaakenate tharwacawe. nagare gene 'asetabaabalwacawe: beretu bahoname 'athafaafe 'athafaanaacawe.

yanuhhe hhezeboceneme: nuhhene bamakaade male'eketanyaacenene baasetabaabalu gizee; baweha bamaathelaqelaqe 'athafaanaacawe. mathefaataacaweneme badaayocene fatzemo yamenaathafaa lamahonu: lacelotaacene magalachaa 'adaregenawe. labadaayoceme baferedu `elate 'asaamaami qethaatene 'azagaajetanaale.
yahude hhezeboce `aadocene, yasaalihhe hhezebocene samudoceneme, yagudegwaaditu baaledaraboceneme; ba'enanyihe szosete mahhakale yanabaru bezu kahadi teweledocene 'athefetanaale.

yaathafaanaacawene 'eyaanedaanedaacawene hhezeboce yemakarubate zanedeme: ka'enaresu bafite yanabarutene 'asetabaabaaye hhezeboce maathefaataacenene 'enaa yathefaataacaweneme mekeneyaate nageranaacawaale. bakehedate 'enaa bakuraataacaweme mekeneyaate huluneme 'athafaanaacawe.

kaaneta hhezeboce 'asetabaabaayoceme wada shaame lanegede bamiheedubate gizee: tzayaafe szeraa bamaszeraataacawe mekeneyaate yakafaa yadenegaaye zenaabene baazanabenebaacawe baluthe hhezeboce manedare bakule yaalefaalu. lamahonu yehenene manedare kamamalekate taawerawaalene?! 'ayedalame: nagaru mamaremare yamikatalawe maqaseqase 'ala belawe 'ayegametume nabare.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa 'asetabaabaayoce: 'anetane bamiyaayubate gizee bamasaalaqe 'enaa bakehedate: 'alaahe male'eketanyaa 'ederego wadanyaa yalaakawe yehenene nawe?! yelaalu.

ba'amaaleketocaacene laaye baanetaagase noro: bamiyaaqarebawe maaserajaa ka'amaaleketocaacene ba'eregethe 'athememone nabare; 'alu. baqaberocaacawe 'enaa baferedume `elate qethaatene bamimalakatubate gizee: ka'enasunaa kaaneta maane thamaamaa manegade laaye 'enedaala maawaqaacawe 'ayeqaree nawe. maanese 'ejege yathamama 'enedahoname yaaweqaalu.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yaanene kanetu felaagotene 'amelaake 'aderego yamitaazazawene 'ayakxawene? 'aneta wada 'emenate yametemalesawe 'enaa kakehedate yametekalakelawe thabaaqiwe tehonaalahene?!

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'enanyaa 'alaahene wadamaamelake 'enaa mataazaze kametetharaacawe 'abezaanyocu yamiqabalu, yamisamu 'enaa maaserajaawocene yamiganazabu 'aderegahe taasebaalahene?! 'enasu bamasemaate, bamaasetawaale 'enaa bamaradaate 'eneda 'enesesaa 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalume; yelequnese manegadene bamasaate ragade ka'enesesaa yabaasu naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe yamifatherawe nagare thelaawene bamedere gatzetaa laaye 'enedeete 'enedamizaragaa 'alaayahemene? yaragaa 'enedihone bifalege nuro babotaawe yamitzanaa yaadaregawe nabare. kaziyaame bamarezamu 'enaa bamaatharu tzahayene la'eresu magalachaa melekete 'adaragenaate.
qathelome 'eneda tzahayu kafetaa mathaneme qase baqase 'eyaalene thelaawene sabesebane 'eneyezawaalane.

'alaahe 'eresu yaa lalitene la'enaaneta 'eneda lebese yamishafenaacehu; 'eneqelefeneme kaszeraawocaacehu dekaame yametaarefubate maarafeyaa; qaneneme wada szeraawocaacehu yameteheedubate masamaariyaa: yaadaragalaacehu nawe.
'eresume yaa labaaroce kaalawe 'ezenate: yazenaabe maweradene 'abesaari yahonu qazeqaazaa nefaasocene yamileke nawe; kasamaayeme fethuraane yamitzadubatene netzuhe yazenaabe wehane 'enaawaredaalane.

baziheme kasamaaye bawaradawe wehame: yatalayaayu baqaaye 'enaa 'aranegwaadee takelocene bamaabeqale daraqe 'enaa meneme yamaayaabaqele yahonawene medere heyewate bamazeraate heyaawe lenaadaregebate 'enedihume bazihu weha kafatharenaacawe 'enesesocenaa barekaataa sawoceneme lamaathathaate nawe.

yegasatzunaa yemakarubateme zanede: bazihe qure'aane wesethe maaserajaawocene batalayaaya maleku galetsanaale 'enedihume 'aberaaretanaale; yehunenaa 'abezaanyocu sawoce 'ewenatene makaadenaa maasetabaabale 'eneji maqabale 'alefalagume.

benefalege noro bayaanedaanedu manedare yamiyaasethanaqeqaacawene 'enaa ka'alaahe qethaate yamiyaasefaraaraacawene 'asethaneqaaqi 'eneleke nabare; gene yaane 'alefalageneme. 'enaho muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) wada sawoce hulu lekanawaale.

kahadiyaane 'atelasaalaselaacawe bamithayequhe 'enaa bamiyaaqarebulehe hasaabe laayeme 'atetaazazaacawe. yelequnese 'enasune wada 'alaahe bametethaaraabate gizee yamigathemehene cegere bamaqwaaqwaamenaa bamiyaadaresubehe cegere bamataagase, 'aneta laaye bawaradawe qure'aane taalaaqe tegele taagalaacawe.
'alaahe 'eresu yahulatune thaafaache 'enaa chawaamaa thaa`eme yaalaacawene baahheroce 'anede laaye 'enedigwaazu yaadaraganaa; hulatume 'enedaayeqalaaqalu kalekaaye geredoshene yaadaraga geetaa nawe.

'eresu yaa kawanede 'enaa kaseete fasaashe yafetewate thabetaa sawene yafathara; badame yatasaasara zamade 'enaa bagaabecaa yatasaasara 'amaace yaadaraga nawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lageetaahe 'anedaace nagare yamaayaadaagetawe sihone banagaroce hulu caaye nawe. kacelotaaweme sawene kawanede 'enaa seete yafetewate weha mafetharu nawe.

'enanyaa kahadiyaane bigazwacawe yamaayethaqemwacawene; bitawaacaweme yamaayegodwacawene; ka'alaahe bataace 'amaaleketene yaamalekaalu. kahadi shayethwanene bamakatale 'alaahene bamiyaaseqothaa nagare shayethwane radaate hona.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe ba'emenate 'enaa bamalekaame szeraa yataazazane 'abesaari; bakehedate 'enaa bawanejale yaamatzaweneme 'asethaneqaaqi: 'aderegane 'eneji 'alelaakeneheme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<male'eketune bamaaderasee meneme warotaa 'alethayeqaacehume. nagare gene ka'enaaneta ganezabune wachi bamaaderage wada 'alaahe wedeetaa yamiyaaqaarebawe manegade yaafalaga yaaderege.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! banagarocehe hulu baziyaa mote bamaayenakaawe; hheyaawe 'enaa becaawene qari bahonawe 'alaahe laaye tamakaa. 'eresuneme kamaamasegane gaare 'aleqawe; 'amogesawe. yabaarocune hathi'ate batheleqate lamaawaqe 'alaahe baqi nawe. meneme nagare 'ayeshashagebateme.

yaa samaayaatene 'enaa mederene bamakaakalaacawe yaalutene nagaroceneme basedesete qanaate yafathara; kaziyaame baxwaalaa karesu kebere 'enaa leqenaa gaare bamigatheme ka`areshe balaaye kafe baalawe laaye tamakaa; 'eresume 'are-rahemaane nawe. 'anedaaceme nagare yamaayedabaqebatene wesethe `aawaaqi yahonawene 'alaahene thayeqe.

kahadiyaanume la'are-rahemaane segadu: batabaalu gizee: "la'are-rahemaane 'anesagedeme; 'are-rahemaane maane nawe?! 'anaaweqaweme; 'anesagedelateme; lamaanaaweqawe 'enaa 'aneta laazazekane hulu 'enesagedaalane?" 'alu. laresu 'enedisagedu mataazazaacawe ba'alaahe kamaamane reqatene chamaralaacawe.
yaa basamaaye yakawaakebetene mazoriyaa 'enaa maarafiyaa yaadaraga; bawesethwame 'aberi tzahayene; lamedereme katzahaye berehaane 'anetsabaaraaqi charaqaane yaadaragawe 'alaahe leqenaa tagabaawe.
'alaahe: 'eresu yaa yaresune ta`aameraate 'asetawelo lasekeete mabeqaatene lafalaga; sela tzagaawocume liyaamasagenawe lafalaga: leelitene 'enaa qanene tatakaakiwoce yaadaraga nawe.

'alaahe bazihe me`eraafe wesethe ya'enanyaane ba'eresu kamaamane 'enaa la'eresu kamataazaze selaafanagathute:kahadiyaane magalachaa kathaqasa baxwaalaa; 'eresune wadamataazaze yamizorutene ya'amaanye baarocune baaheriyaate galatza; 'enediheme 'ala::
'amaanye yahonute ya'alaahe qene 'agalegaaye baaroce; 'enanyaa bamedere laaye bamatanaanase ba'eregaataa yamiraamadu naacawe. 'alaawaaqiwoce bamiyaasekafaa nagare siyaanaagerwacawe: ba'amesaayaawe saayehone salaame yamilu; malekaame manaagarene yamaayezanagu naacawe.
'enanyaa lageetaacawe bamasegade genebaarocaacawene dafetawe 'enaa ba'egerocaacawe bamaqome 'alaahene sigazu yamiyaaderute naacawe.
'enanyaame geetaacawene 'eyalamanu:: <<geetaacene hoye! bakehedate laalafa sawe yajahaname 'esaate zawetaarinaa qwaami yamaayelaqe bamahonu: yajahanamene qethaate 'areqelene>>; yamilu naacawe.
ba'eregethe 'esaate bawesethu lamiragaa yakafaa maregiyaa; lanawaariweme yakafaa manoriyaa nawe.

'enanyaame kaganezabocaacawe bamimatzawetu gizee: bamaabaakane wasanene yamaayaalefu; lamigabaawe kamasethate yamaayenafegu; 'asathaathaacawe bamaabaakane 'enaa bamanefage mahakale mizaanaawi yahonu naacawe.

'enanyaame: ka'alaahe gaare leelaane yamaayaamaleku; yagadalane bamagedale, wayeme ka'emenatu bamaqalebase; wayeme baalatedaare hono zemute bafatsama 'alaahe 'enedigadale kafaqadawe wechi: 'alaahe 'ereme yaadaragawene nafese yamaayaathafu; zemute yamaayefatzemu naacawe. 'enanyihene telaaleqe hathi'atocene yafatzama batenesaa'eewe `elate selafatsamawe hathi'ate yaqethaate waagaawene yaaganyaale.
baferedu `elate qethaate yedaraarabelataale; bawesethume yatawaarada 'enaa yaanasa hono yezawateraale.

genaa tatzatzeto wada 'alaahe yatamalasa 'enaa yaamana; latzatzatume maaragaagachaa malekaame szeraa yaszaraa; 'enanyaane 'alaahe hathi'ate yaszarutene yeqere belwacawe babotaawe malekaame menedaane yetakaalaacawaale. 'alaahe kabaarocu batsatsate wada 'eresu latamalasa mahari; lanaresume 'azaanye nawe.
wada 'alaahe batzatzate yatamalasa; tzatzatuneme malekaamene bamaszeraate 'enaa kamathefo bamaraaqe yaaragaagatha; 'enaho yatamalasawe wada 'alaahe nawenaa tzatzatu taqabaayenatene yaaganyaale.

'enanyaa wanejale bamifatsamebaacawe 'enaa 'ereme bahonu botaawoce laaye yamaayeganyu; bahasate yamaayemasakeru;kanegegeroceme katagebaaroceme wedeqe bahonu zaazaataawoce 'athagabe siyaalefu: nafesaacawene baziyaa kamaqoshashe yaakabarwate honawe tetawe yamiyaalefu naacawe.
'enanyaame bamisamu ya'alaahe 'aneqatzoce sigasatzu 'enedaalesamu daneqorowoce; bamitaayu ya'alaahe ta`aameraateme sigasatzu 'enedaalaayu 'eweroce honawe yamaayaalefu naacawe.

'enanyaame lageetaacawe bamiyaadaregute tsalotaacaweme laaye: geetaacene hoye! kabaalabeetocaacene 'enaa kalejocaacene 'anetane bamaferaataacawe 'enaa ba'ewenate laaye bamaqomaacawe; ya`aayene maarafiyaawocene sethane. 'anetane lamifaru sawoce 'are'ayaa yamihonu mariwoce 'aderegane; yamilu naacawe.

'enanyaa banazihe baahheriyaate yatagalatzute; 'alaahene bamataazaze laaye bamataagasaacawe: bajanate balaaqawe firedawese kafe yaalu saganatocene yemanadaalu. bawesethwame malaa'ekete bamaakebare 'enaa basalaametaa 'aqabaabale yaadaregulaacawaale; kacegereme salaame yehonaalu.
bawesethwame lamaceeme zawetaariwoce honawe yenoraalu; 'ereswame (janate) lamiyaarefubaate bamaarafiyaanatwa; lamiqamathubaateme bamaqamachaanatwa 'ejege yaamaarace naate.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa bakehedate laaye getere lahonu kahadiyaane 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<geetaayee 'eresune bamataazazaacehu kanaaneta theqeme yaaganye zanede gede yalaweme. la'amelekote 'enaa yakejaalote lemanaane yamilamenute baarocu baalenabaru; lanaaneta gede yalaweme.>> male'eketanyaawe kageetaacehu yezo yamathaalaacehune nagare baregethe 'asetabaabelaacexwaale; maasetabaabalume yahathi'atu wetheete (qethaatu) 'athebeqo yamiyezaacehu yehonaale.
(Tsm) (thaa...si...ne mi...me) (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)
'enanyihe 'ewenatene kahasate layeto yamiberaaraawe qure'aane 'aneqatzoce naacawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'enaresune maqaanaate 'ejege kamagwaagwaate yatanasaa; bahhazane raasehene 'enedaataathafaa yesagaalehale.

ba'enaresu laaye kasamaaye ta`aamerene maawerade benefalege 'enaawarede nabare; kaziyaaneme 'anegatocaacawe lareswa yatawaaradu 'enaa yatanaanasu honawe yeqoyu nabare. nagare gene yehenene yaalaadaragenawe; baruqe tenebite yaamenu 'enedahone lamafatane falegane nawe.

'enanyihe 'asetabaabaayoce ya'alaahene 'anedenatenaa yamale'eketanyaawene 'ewenatanyenate yamiyaaragaagethe ka'alaahe zanede yahona 'adise (tekuse) maaserajaa bimathaalaacaweme; 'eresune laalamasemaatenaa ba'eresume laalamaamane jarebaa yamisathu naacawe.

male'eketanyaacawe yezo yamathaalaacawene nagare ba'eregethe 'asetabaabalu; 'enaresu sisaalaqubate yanabarubate zeenaa maaragaagachaawe baregethe yemathaalaacawaale; qethaatume yeragaagathebaacawaale.

'enanyihe bakehedataacawe laaye yazawataru 'asetabaabaayoce; bamedere wesethe ka'eyaanedaanedu baqaaye yatalayaaya `aayenatene, `eyetaawe yamiyaamere 'enaa barekaataa theqemoce yaalutene yaabaqalene mahonaacenene 'alaayumene?!
'enaho bamedere wesethe yatalayaaya 'atekeletene yaabaqalawe 'alaahe mutaanene bamaqaseqase laaye caaye mahonune thaqwaami melekete 'ala; 'abezaanyocaacawe gene 'amaanyoce 'alehonume.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaho geetaahe 'eresu 'ashanaafi yaleelawe 'ashanaafi; labaarocume 'azaanye nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe baareyaawene musaane 'alaahene bamakaade 'enaa ya'eseraa'eele lejocene babaarenate bamayaaze badaaye wadahonu hhezeboce 'enediheede yamiyaazezawe sihone batharaawe gizee yahonawene 'awesaa.
wada fire`aawene hhezeboce, ba'ezenate 'enaa baleselaasee 'alaahene 'enedifaru; yaazazaacawene 'enedifatzemu 'enaa kakalakalaacaweme 'enedirequ yamiyaazezaacawe sihone;
musaame (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enedihe 'ala - <<'enee kaaneta wada 'enaresu bamaadaresawe male'ekete yaasetabaabelunyaale beyee 'efaraalahu.
'eneeneme lamaasetabaabalaacawe lebee yechanaqaale; 'anedabateeme kamanaagare yetasaasaraale; selahoname wanedemee harune la'enee radaate yehonanye zanede jiberilene wada harune laakelenye.
ka'enaresu gosaa yahonane qibethayene bamagedaleeme; ba'enee laaye yamiqotherute wanejale 'alaacawe; 'enedaayegadelunye 'efaraalahu.>>

'alaaheme lamusaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enedihe 'alawe:: <<bafetzume 'ayegadeluheme; 'aneta 'enaa wanedemehe harune la'ewenatanyaanataacehu thaqwaami bahonace ta`aameraate hidu; 'enyaa badelenaa ba'egazaa ka'enaaneta gaare nane.yametelutenenaa yametebaaluteneme samiwoce nane; 'anedaaceme nagare 'ayeshashagebeneme.
wada fire`aaweneme hidunaa 'enyaa ka`aalamaatu fathaari wadaaneta yatalaakene male'eketanyoce nane>>; balute.
<<ya'eseraa'eelene lejoce telaqelene zanede 'enefalegaalane.>>

fire`aawene lamusaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enedihe 'alawe:: <<bamakaakalaacene teneshe leje honahe 'alaasaadagenehemene?! ka`edemeeheme bezu `aamataatene ka'enyaa gaare qoyahe; nabiyenatene 'enedetaaweje yaadaragahe menedene nawe?
kagosaahe yahonane sawe lamaagaze qibethiyune bamagedale taalaaqe wanejalene szaraahe 'enyaa lawaalenelehe bago welataa kahadi nahe.>>
musaame (`alayehi 'asalaame) bamaamane lafire`owene 'enedihe 'alawe:: <<'awone: 'enee malakotaawiwe raa`eye wada 'enee saayemathaa bafite; kaalaawaaqiwoce banabarekubate gizee 'aderegeewaalahu.
ba'eresu dame 'eneene tegadelunyaalaacehu beyee farecee wada madeyane shashahu; geetaayeeme `eweqatene sathanye; wada sawoce kamilekaacawe male'eketanyaaweme 'adaraganye.
yaseraa'eelene lejoce babaarenate yezahe; 'eneene yaalabaarenate banatzaa yaasaadagekanye bamahonehe; yametematzaadaqebenye welataahe nace; gene yehe laaneta theri kamaaderage 'ayaagedanyeme.>>
fire`oweneme 'enedihe 'ala:: <<'aneta male'eketanyaawe 'enedahoneke yametenaagarelate ya`aalamaatu geetaa 'eresu maanawe?!>>

musaame lafire`aawene malese sisathe - <<ya`aalamaatu geetaa 'eresu yasamaayaatu; yamedere 'enaa bamahakalaacawe yaalu fetherataate hulu geetaa nawe. ka'aragaagachoceme 'enedahonaacehu (babecanyenate 'amelekute)>>'alawe.
fire`oweneme kahhezebocu bazuriyaawe laalute shumaamenete:- <<musaa yamisathawene malese 'enaa yaweshate mugetune 'eyaadaamathaacehu nawene?!>> 'ala.
musaame 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<'alaahe ya'enaanetanaa yaqadamete 'abaatocaacehume geetaa nawe.>>
fire`oweneme 'enedihe 'ala:: <<yaa wadanaaneta 'enedatalaaka yaminaagarawe male'eketanyaa mene 'enedamimalese yamaayaaweqe `ebede; yamilaweneme yamaayeradaa nawe.>>
musaame 'ala - <<yameteganazabubate 'a`emero yaalaacehu 'enedahona: 'enee wadaresu yametharaacehu 'alaahe - yameseraaqu; yame`eraabu 'enaa bamahakalaacawe yaalute fetherataate hulu geetaa nawe.>>
fire`oweneme maaserajaawene magaafathe kaaqaatawe baxwaalaa lamusaa 'enedihe 'ala - <<ka'enee baashaagare leelaa betaamaleke ba'esere katathaalute makaakale 'adaregehalawe>> 'alawe.

musaame (`alayehi 'asalaame) lafire`aawene - <<'enee ka'alaahe wadaaneta batalaakubate nagare la'ewenatanyaanatee masekaari yahonane geletze maaserajaaneme baamathaalehe; ka'eseranyoce taadareganyaalahene?!>> 'alawe.
fire`aaweneme <<selametelawe ka'ewenatanyoce kahoneke; 'ewenatanyaanateene yaaseradaale yaalekawene 'amethaa>>; 'ala.
musaame zanegune wada medere warawara; wadiyaaweneme wada geletse 'ebaabenate talawatha.
'ejuneme wada bebetu 'asegabaa; wadiyaawenu lamimalakatu sawoce kalametze saayehone kaberehaane nache honaa taayace.
fire`oweneme bazuriyaawe laalute makwaanenete:: <<'enaho yehe sawe badegemete yamathaqa `aawaaqi degemetanyaa nawe>>; 'alaacawe.
<<bazihe degemetume kahagaraacehu liyaawathaacehu yefalegaale; 'eremejaa 'enewasedebate zanede hhasaabaacehu menedene nawe?>> 'ala.
'enediheme 'alute:: <<'eresune 'enaa wanedemune 'aqoyaacawe; lamaqethaate 'atecaakole; degemetanyocene yamisabasabu sawocene wada gebetze katamoce laake;
degemete thaneqeqo yamiyaaweqe `aawaaqi degemetanyaane hulu yaamathulehale>> 'alute.
fire`owene musaane yewadaadarute zanede; batawasana qane 'enaa botaa degemetanyocene sabasaba.
lasawoceme <<'ashanaafiwe musaa yehune degemetanyocu temalakatu zanede tasabesebaacexwaalene?>> tabaalu.
'enaresu bamusaa laaye delene yamiqadaaju 'ashanaafiwoce yahonu 'enedahona; ba'emenataacawe degemetanyocune 'enekatale zanede.

degemetanyocume musaane liwadaadaru wada fire`aawene 'enedamathume 'enedihe 'alute:: <<lamahonu 'enyaa bamusaa laaye dele beneqadaaje 'enaa 'ashanaafi benehone: qusaawi theqeme menedaa yenorane yehone?!>>
fire`oweneme 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<'awone! menedaa yenoraacexwaale; baaladele kahonaacehu: 'enee lanaaneta yalaaqane selethaane bamasethatee 'enee zanede kaqarabute tehonaalaacehu.>>

musaame ba'alaahe 'egazaa bamatamaamane 'enaa 'eresu zanede yaalaweme degemete 'enedaalehona bamaaberaaraate: <<kagamadocaacehu 'enaa zanegocaacehu 'enaaneta yametethelutene 'eseki wada mareete thaalu>>; 'alaacawe.
gamadocaacawene 'enaa zanegocaacawene wada mareete warawaru; bamithelubate gizeeme <<bafire`aawene kebere yehunebene; 'ashanaafiwocu 'enyaa nane; musaame tashanaafi nawe>>; 'alu.
musaame zanegune warawara; wada zanedonateme talawathace; 'enaresu badegemete sawocene lamaataalale yaqathaathafutene 'eyalaqamace tewethe jamare.
degemetanyocume: yamusaa zanege zanedo honaa badegemete yaqathaathafutene yametewethe mahonwane simalakatu: bagenebaaraacawe wada medere wadaqu.
<<ba`aalamaatu geetaa 'amanene>>; 'alume.
<<bamusaa 'enaa baharune geetaa ('amanene).>>

fire`oweneme yadegemetanyocune 'emenate bamaqaawame - <<'enee saalefaqedelaacehu laresu 'amanaacehulatene?! musaa degemetene yaasetamaaraacehu taalaaqaacehu nawe; hulaacehuneme yagebetze sawocene kahagaraacawe lamaabaarare 'asiraacexwaale; yamaawaredebaacehune qethaate baqerebu taaweqaalaacehu. 'ejocaacehune 'enaa 'egerocaacehune 'eyaanaagaahu 'eqorethaacexwaalahu; kanaanetame maaneneme saalaaseqare batamere zaafe genedoce laaye 'eseqelaacexwaalahu>>; 'ala.

degemetanyocume lafire`aawene 'enedihe 'alute:: <<'aneta bazihece `aalame 'eje 'egerene kamaqurathe 'enaa kamaseqale 'enyaane bametaasefaraaraabate wesethe cegere yalame; qethaatehe yaalefaale; 'enyaame wada geetaacene 'alaahe tamalaashoce nane; bazala`aalamaawi 'ezenatu wesethe yaasegabaanaale.
'enyaame kasawoce: bamusaa bamaamane 'enaa bamaaragaagathe yamajamariyaawocu bamahonaacene mekeneyaate geetaacene qademo yaszaraanawene wanejalocaacenene yemerelene zanede 'enekajelaalane>>; 'alute.
lamusaame yaseraa'eelene lejoce yezo baleelite 'enedigwaaze bamaazaze; fire`aawene 'enaa gebera 'abarocu limaleswacawe 'enedamikatalwacawe bamanegare; malakotaawi raa`eye 'asetalaalafanaale.
fire`oweneme: yaseraa'eele lejoce balalite magwaazaacawene bamaawaqu limalesaacawe bagebetze katamoce szaraawitoce yamisabasebulate sawoce laaka.
fire`oweneme: yaseraa'eele lejocene darajaa bamaaqaalale maleku 'enedihe 'ala:: <<'enanyihe theqite cheferoce naacawe.
'enaresume: 'enyaane ba'enaresu laaye yamiyaaseqothaanene szeraa 'eyaszaru nawe.
'enyaame: baneqaate 'enasune lamagaafathe zegeju nane.>>
fire`owene 'enaa hhezebocune: yaamaara 'atekelete seferaa 'enaa yamifasu menechoce kaalaate yagebetze medere 'asewathaanaacawe.
yaganezabe deleboce 'enaa yaamaaru manoriyaawoce baalabeete kahonacewe.
fire`owene 'enaa gebera 'abarocune kananyihe tzagaawoce 'enedaasewathaanaacawe hulu; kanaresu baxwaalaa laseraa'eele lejoce 'awarasenaate.
fire`owene 'enaa hhezebocume tzahhaye bametewathaabate gizee yaseraa'eele lejocene takatalwacawe.

fire`owene 'enaa hhezebocu: kamusaa 'enaa kahhezebocu gaare; fite lafite 'enedatafaathathume: yamusaa baaledaraboce: <<fire`aawene 'enaa hhezebocu darasubene; 'enyaa 'enasune yamagaafathe 'aqeme yalaneme>>; 'alu.

musaame lahhezebocu 'enedihe 'alaacawe - <<gudaayu 'enaaneta 'enedaasabaacehute 'ayedalame; geetaayee ba'egazaawe 'enaa badelu ka'enee gaare nawe; yamenedenebatene manegade yethaqumanyaale; yemaraanyaale.>>

lamusaame baahherune babateru 'enedimataawe bamaazaze malakotaawi raa`eyene 'asetalaalafene. musaame baahherune bamataawe gizee: baseraa'eele lejoce nagade quthere: 'aseraa hulate botaa takafala; 'eyaanedaanedume kefelefaaye weha yamaayefase daraqe 'eneda taalaaqe goraa hona.
kaziyaame fire`aawenene 'enaa hhezebocune 'aqarabenaacawe; manegade yaala maselwacawe wada baahheru gabu.
musaane 'enaa karesu gaare yanabarutene yaseraa'eele lejocene hulu natzaa 'awathaane; maaneme 'alethafaame.
kaziyaame fire`aawenene 'enaa 'aberawete yanabarutene hulu babaahheru bamaasethame 'athafaanaacawe.

'enaho babaahheru makafaafale, bamusaa 'enaa hhezebocu madaane 'enedihume bafire`aawene 'enaa hhezebocu mathefaate: lamusaame 'ewenatanyenate thaqwaami melekete 'alabate. kafire`aawene gaare yaalute 'abezaanyocu 'amaanyoce 'alenabarume.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaho geetaahe thalaatocene yamibaqale 'ashanaafi, kabaarocume wadaresu latamalasa mahhari nawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yaberaahimene taarike 'awesaalaacawe.
la'abaatu 'azare 'enaa lahhezebocu, <<ka'alaahe baashaagare menedene nawe yametaamalekute baalaacawe gizee yahonawene 'awesaa.>>
<<hhezebocume: yamenaamalekawe thaa`otaatene nawe; lanaresume 'amelekote yameneqome senehone 'eneqoyaalane>> 'alu.
beraahimeme 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<thaa`otaatu 'enaaneta setelamenwacawe lemanaacehune yesamaalune?
yataazazaacexwaacawe 'enedahona yethaqemwacexwaalene? yaamatzaacexwaacawe 'enedahonase yegodwacexwaalene?>>

<<benelamenaacawe 'ayesamuneme; yaamalakenaacawe 'enedahoname 'ayethaqemuneme; benaametzebaacaweme 'ayegoduneme; nagare gene walaajocaacene 'enedihe siyaadaregu selaaganyanaacawe; ya'enaresune 'are'ayaa takatelane nawe:>> 'alu.
beraahimeme:: <<'enaaneta ka'alaahe baashaagare yametaamalekwaacawene 'ayaacehu; 'asetawaalaacehune?!
<<qadamete 'abaatocaacehu yaamaleku yanabarubateneme nagare >>
hasate bamahonaacawe 'enaresu hulaacaweme lanee thalaatocee naacawe; ya`aalamaatu geetaa 'alaahe siqare >> 'alaacawe.
yaa yafatharanye; bahulatume `aalame malekaame nagaroce kamimaraanye basetaqare;
yaa 'eresu yataraabeku gizee yamimagebanye; yatathamaahume gizee yamiyaathathaanye nawe.
yataamamaku gizee kahhemamee yaadenanyaale; karesu basetaqare 'adaanye yalanyeme.
yamote qatharoyeeme sidarese yamigadelanye; kaziyaame yamiqaseqesanye nawe.
yaame bameremaraawe `elate wanejaleene 'enedimerelenye yamekajelawe nawe.>>

beraahimeme geetaawene 'eyalamana:: <<geetaayee hoye! ba'emenatee theleqe `eweqatene sethanye; 'eneeme 'enaresuneme janatene bamaasegabaate kaqadamete nabiyaate, kadagaagocu baarocehe gaare qalaaqelanye>> 'ala.
<<ka'enee baxwaalaa bamimathu teweledoce wesethe malekaame zenaane 'aderegelenye.
'amaanye baarocehe yamidasatubaatene yajanatene darajaawoce kamiwaresute 'adereganye, 'eziyaame 'anuranye.

la'abaateeme mehheratene 'aderegelate; 'eresu baaneta laaye bamaagaaraate mekeneyaate kathamaamocu honwale.>> beraahime (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'abaataacawe ka'esaate sawoce mahonu saayegalatzelaacawe bafite nawe yalamanute. ya'alaahe thalaate bamahonu ka'esaate sawoce mamadabu katagalatzalaacawe baxwaalaa la'eresu meherate 'alethayaqulateme.
<<sawoceme lagemegamaa bamiqasaqasubate `elate 'ataawaaredanye.>>
'anede sawe bamedere `aalame yasabasabawe ganezabu yamaayethaqemawe; lejocume yamaayaagezute bahonawe `elate.

nagare gene kamaagaaraate; kamanaafeqenate; kataayetaa 'enaa baraase kamadanaqe yatharaa szalaamaawi lebe yezo yamathaa: 'eresu ba'alaahe manegade yaawathaawe ganezabu 'enaa 'alaahene yalamanulate lejocu yethaqemutaale.
janateme te'ezaazune bamafatzame 'enaa kakalakalawe bamaraaqe 'alaahene lamifarute teqarebaalace.
'esaateme katekekelanyaawe 'emenate lathamamu sawoce bamasabesabiyaawe botaa laaye saalu tegalatzelaacawaalace.
'enaresuneme bamaathaathaale:: <<'enanyaa taamalekwaacawe yanabarute thaa`otaate yate naacawe?!>> yebaalaale.
'enanyaa ka'alaahe wadiyaa taamalekwaacawe yanabarute?! 'enaanetane ka'alaahe qethaate bamakalekale yeradwacexwaalene?! wayenese 'enaresu raasaacawene maredaate yecelaalune?
'erese ba'eresaacawe laaye yatadaraarabu sihone 'enaresuneme bamaamelake yathamamute wada 'esaate yewarawaraalu.
kashayethwanaateme yabelise szaraawitoce hulu saayenathaathalu 'esaate wesethe yewarawaraalu.
'enyaame ka'alaahe leelaa yaalutene yamigazu 'enaa tagaari yaadaragu 'agaariwoce: ka'alaahe wechi siyaamalekwaacawe kanabarute gaare 'eyatakaraakaru 'enedihe yelaalu::
<<ba'alaahe yehunebene! geletze bahona themate wesethe nabarene.
'enaanetane ka`aalamaatu geetaa gaare 'ekule 'aderegane 'eresune 'enedamenaamalekawe baamalakenaacehu gizee; (bageletze themate wesethe nabarene).
ka'alaahe leelaa yaalutene 'enedenaamaleke batharune gizee yaathamamune; 'enanyaa 'amatzanyocu 'eneji leeloce 'ayedalume.
kaqethaatume natzaa yaawathaane zanede: 'alaahe fite qarebo yamishamagelane 'amaalaaje yalaneme.
ka'enyaame qethaatene yamiyaasewagedelene yaqerebe wadaaje 'ayenoraneme.
ba'alaahe 'amaanyoce 'enehone zanede wada medere `aalame yamenemalasebate `edele binorane; menenyaa malekaame nabare>> (yelaalu).
bazihe batathaqasawe baberaahime taarike 'enaa ba'asetabaabaayoce macharashaa wesethe lamiyaasetawelu taalaaqe mekere 'alabate; 'abezaanyocaacaweme 'amaanyoce 'alenabarume.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaho geetaahe thalaatocune tabaqaaye; 'ashanaafi; tatzatzetawe latamalasute 'azaanye nawe.
yaszegaa zemedenaa yamiyaaganaanyaacawe wanedemaacawe nuhheme 'eresune sagetaacehu; <<ka'alaahe bataace yaalutene kamaamelake bamaraaqe: 'alaahene 'atefarumene?!>> baalaacawe gizee;
<<'enee 'alaahe wadanaaneta yalaakanye male'eketanyaa nanye; 'alaahe balaakanye laaye taamaanye nanye; kamale'eketu 'alechamereme; 'alaagodelememe.
'enee kageetaayee wadanaaneta bamaadaresawe nagare: ka'enaaneta menedaane 'alethayeqaacehume; 'enaho menedaayee ba`aalamaatu geetaa ba'alaahe laaye 'eneji bamaaneme laaye 'ayedalame.
te`ezaazune bamafatzame yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru; bamaazezaacehu 'enaa bamekalakelaacehu 'eneeneme taazazunye.>>
hhezebocume 'enedihe 'alute:: <<nuhhe hoye! yatakataluhe sawoce: kamahalaacawe 'alaqoce 'enaa shumoce yaleelubaacawe wedaaqi sawoce honawe saala; lamahonu baaneta 'enaamenaalane?!>>
nuhheme (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<'enanyihe 'amaanyoce yeszarute selanabarute mene 'asaawaqanye? 'enee szeraacawene lamaqothaathare yatamadabeku 'ayedalahume.
gemegamaacawe, misetheraacawene 'enaa geletzaacawene bamiyaaweqawe ba'alaahe laaye 'eneji baleelaa laaye 'ayedalame. betaawequ noro yaalaacehutene baalaalaacehu nabare.
ya'enaanetane maamane bamakajale; lafelaagotaacehu malese lamasethate; 'amaanyocene bacelotaayee yamaabaarere 'ayedalahume.
'enee ka'alaahe qethaate yamaasethanaqeqaacehu geletse 'asethaneqaaqi 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalahume.>>
hhezebocume 'enedihe 'alute:: <<'aneta 'enyaane kametetharaabate nagare yamaateqothabe kahona: kamiwagazute 'enaa badenegaaye tawagerawe kamigadalute tehonaalahe.>>
nuhheme geetaawene bamalamane 'enedihe 'ala:: <<geetaayee hoye! hhezebocee 'asetabaabalunye; yezhee yamathaahutene nagareneme 'aletaqabalunyeme.

baweshate laaye bamazawetaraacawe yamiyaathafaacawene ferede ba'enee 'enaa banaresu makaakale ferade; kahhezebocee kahadiyaanune kametaathafaabate thefaate: 'eneene 'enaa ka'enee gaare yaamanutene 'adenane.>>
latheriweme malese sathanawe: 'eresune 'enaa basawoce 'enedihume ba'enesesaate batamolaacewe marekabe wesethe karesu gaare yanabarutene 'amaanyocene: 'adaanenaacawe.
kanaresume baxwaalaa qariwocene: kahadiwocune yanuhhe hhezebocene 'athafaanaacawe.

bazihe banuhhe 'enaa bahhezebocu taarike; nuhhene 'enaa karesu gaare yaamanutene natzaa bamaawethaate, kahhezeboceme yakaadutene bamaathefaate wesethe lamimakaru sawoce mamakariyaa melekete 'ala; 'abezaanyocaacawe 'amaanyoce 'alenabarume.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaho geetaahe thalaatocune tabaqaaye; 'ashanaafi; labaarocume 'azaanye nawe.
`aadoceme male'eketanyaacawene hudene bamaasetabaabalaacawe: male'eketanyocune hulu 'asetabaabalu.
yaszegaa zemedenaa yamiyaaganaanyaacawe wanedemaacawe hudeme:: <<'eresune bamaferaate leelocene maamelakene bamatawe: 'alaahene 'atethanaqaqumene>>: baalaacawe gizee yahonawene 'awesaa.
<<'enaho 'enee 'alaahe wadanaaneta yalaakanye male'eketanyaacehu nanye; ka'alaahe bataqabalekute male`ekete yamaalechamerebateme yamaaleqaneseme taamaanye nanye>>; yaalawene.
<<te`ezaazune bamafatzame yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru; bamaazezaacehu 'enaa bamekalakelaacehu 'eneeneme taazazunye.
'enee kageetaayee wadanaaneta bamaadaresawe male`ekete, kanaaneta menedaane 'alethayeqaacehume; 'enaho menedaayee ba`aalamaatu geetaa ba'alaahe laaye 'eneji bamaaneme laaye 'ayedalame.
baziheceme hona bamachiwe `aalame theqeme yamaayaaseganyulaacehune; yametechaawatu honaacehu bakafetaa botaawoce laaye kafe yaalu genebocene teganabaalaacehune?
leke 'enaaneta bazihe `aalame lazala`aalame 'enedametenoru 'enaa 'enedamaatemotu bamaasabe: meshegocene 'enaa hhenetzaawocene teganabaalaacehu?
sawoceneme lamametaate 'enaa lamagedale bamaasabe: yaala 'ezenate 'enaa rexeraahee bachekaanee 'eremejaa tewasedaalaacehu?
te'ezaazune bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru; baazazekwaacehu 'enaa bakalakalekwaacehu nagare taazazunye>>; 'alaacawe.
<<katzagaawocume bametaawequte nagare yaabalatzagaacehune 'alaahene quthaawene feru.
'enesesaatene 'enaa lejocene sathaacehu.
ba'atekelete seferaawoce 'enaa bamifasesu menechoce 'abalatzagaacehu.
hhezebocee hoye! 'enee ba'enaaneta laaye yataalaaqune yaferedune `elate qethaate 'efaraalaacexwaalahu.>>
hhezebocume 'enedihe 'alute:: <<'aneta: 'enyaane mamekareheme 'alamamekareheme la'enyaa 'ekule nawe; 'anaameneleheme; kaalanebateme nagare 'anemalaseme.>>
yehe yaqadamete sawoce 'emenate, lemaade 'enaa baaheri 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame.
'enyaame yameneqathaa 'ayedalaneme.

nabiyaacawene hudene bamaasetabaabale laaye qathalu; bamaasetabaabalaacaweme mekeneyaate: bathefaate nefaase 'athafaanaacawe. bazihe maathefaate wesetheme la'asetawaayoce mekere 'ala; 'abezaanyocaacaweme 'amaanyoce 'alenabarume.
'enaho geetaahe thalaatocune tabaqaaye; 'ashanaafi; labaarocume 'azaanye nawe.
samudoceme: nabiyaacawene saalihhene bamaasetabaabalaacawe male'eketanyocene hulu 'asetabaabalu.
yagosaa wanedemaacawe saalihheme:: <<'eresune bamaferaate; leelocene maamelakene bamatawe: 'alaahene 'atethanaqaqumene>>; baala gizee yahonawene 'awesaa.
<<'enee 'alaahe wadanaaneta yalaakanye male'eketanyaacehu nanye; ka'alaahe wadanaaneta bamaadaresawe nagare yamaalechamere 'enaa yamaaleqanese taamaanye male'eketanyaa nanye.
te`ezaazune bamafatzame yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru; bamaazezaacehu 'enaa bamekalakelaacehu 'eneeneme taazazunye.
'enee kageetaayee wadanaaneta bamaadaresawe male`ekete, kanaaneta menedaane 'alethayeqaacehume; 'enaho menedaayee ba`aalamaatu geetaa ba'alaahe laaye 'eneji bamaaneme laaye 'ayedalame.
'enaaneta 'ahune baalaacehubate malekaame nagaroce; tzagaawoce wesethe yamaatefaru dasetanyoce honaacehu: tetawaalaacehune?!
ba'atekelete seferaawoce 'enaa bamifasu menechoce wesethe.
ba'azemaraawoce 'enaa yabasalu 'enaa yalasalasu fereewoce baalute yatamere zaafoce wesethe?!
belehoce bamahonaacehu; taraarocene sanetheqaacehu yametenorubatene beete tetharebaalaacehu.
te`ezaazune bamafatzame yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru; bamaazezaacehu 'enaa bamekalakelaacehu 'eneeneme taazazunye.
wanejale bamaszeraate denebare yathaasu sawocene te`ezaaze 'atekatalu.
ya'enanyaane bamiyaasaraachute wanejale: bamedere wesethe yamiyaabalaashutene; ya'alaaheneme te`ezaaze bamafatzame raasaacawene yamaayaasetakaakelutene.>>
hhezebocume 'enedihe 'alute:: <<'enaho; 'aneta degemete batadagaagaami tadagemobaacawe: 'a`emerwacawene kanathaqaacawe sawoce nahe.

'aneta 'enedanyaawe sawe 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaheme; ka'enyaa 'asebaletho male'eketanyaa liyaadaregehe yamiyaasecelehe nagare yalaheme; selametenaagarawe ka'ewenatanyocu kahoneke: male'eketanyaanatehene yamithaqume melekete 'amethaa.>>

'alaahe lamelekete: kaqwaathenye yaawathaatene gemale yasathawe sihone saalihheme 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<yehece yametetaaye 'enaa yametedaasase gemale nace; kawehaweme lareswa dereshaa 'alaate; lanaanetame yataawaqa `elate dereshaa 'alaacehu; 'ereswa bametethathaa `elate 'atethathume, 'enaanetame bametethathu `elate 'ereswa 'atethathaame.

bameteme hona bamawegaate yamigodaatene kefu nagare 'enedaataadaresubaate; yehene yaadaragaacehu 'enedahona: ba'enaaneta laaye yamiwaredawe kabaade qethaate bamahonu: taalaaqe bahonawe qane yamiyaathafaacehu ya'alaahe qethaate yaaganyaacexwaale.>>

'ereswane lamawegaate tasemaamu; kanaresume manaathi yahonawe wagaate; bafatsamuteme qethaate banaresu laaye yamifatsame mahonune 'enedaawaqu: selaszarute wanejale tatzatzatu; genaa qethaatene simalakatu matzatzate 'ayethaqememe.

yataqatharute qethaate: yamareete maneqatheqathe 'enaa yamale'ake chukxate yaazaacawe; bazihe basaalihhe 'enaa bahhezebocu taarike wesethe lamimakaru taalaaqe mekere 'ala; 'abezaanyocaacawe 'amaanyoce 'alenabarume.
'enaho geetaahe thalaatocune tabaqaaye; 'ashanaafi; labaarocume 'azaanye nawe.
yaluthe hhezeboceme: male'eketanyaacawene luthene (`alayehi 'asalaame) bamaasetabaabalaacawe: male'eketanyocene hulu 'asetabaabaalu.
yazemedenaa wanedemaacawe lutheme:: <<'eresune bamaferaate; baresu maagaaraatene bamatawe; 'alaahene 'atethanaqaqumene?>> baalaacawe gizee yahonawene 'awesaa.
<<'enaho 'enee ka'alaahe wada'enaaneta yatalaaku: balaakanye male`ekete yamaalechamere 'enaa yamaaleqanese taamaanye male'eketanyaa nanye>>: 'alaacawe.
<<te'ezaazune bamafatzame yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru; bamaazezaacehu 'enaa bamekalakelaacehu 'eneeneme taazazunye.
'enee kageetaayee wadanaaneta bamaadaresawe male'ekete, kanaaneta menedaane 'alethayeqaacehume; 'enaho menedaayee ba`aalamaatu geetaa ba'alaahe laaye 'eneji bamaaneme laaye 'ayedalame.
kasawoce makaakale kawanedoce gaare tzotaawi genenyunate tefatsemaalaacehu?!
'alaahe kamisetocaacehu gaare semeetocaacehune taaraku zanede yafatharalaacehune 'akaale tetawaalaacehu?! baregethe bazihe 'ejege tzayaafe tagebaaraacehu ya'alaahene wasane 'alefaacexwaale.>>

hhezebocume 'enedihe 'alute:: <<luthe hoye! kazihe 'enyaa kameneszaraawe nagare makalekalehene 'enaa maaneqwaashashehene yamaataaqome kahona: 'anetanaa kaaneta gaare yaalute hulu kamanedaraacene tebaararaalaacehu.>>
lutheme 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<'enee 'enaaneta yameteszarutene szeraacehune 'ejege kamithalute nanye.>>
geetaaweneme bamamaatsane 'enedihe 'ala:: <<geetaayee hoye! 'eneene 'enaa beetasaboceene 'enanyihe hhezeboce bamiszarute wanejale mekeneyaate kamiyaaganyaacawe qethaate 'adenane.>>
mamaatzanuneme samaane; 'eresune 'enaa beetasabocuneme bamulu 'adaanenaacawe.
nagare gene baalabeetu: kakahadiwocu nabarace 'enaa 'ereswa bathefaate kamiyaalefute honace.
kaziyaame luthe 'enaa beetasabocu kasadume manedare kawathu baxwaalaa: qariwocune bakabaade qethaate 'athafaanaacawe.

leke zenaabe 'enedamizanebaweme, yadanegiyaa zenaabene 'azanabenebaacawe; 'enanyaa bawanejalaacawe laaye yamiqathelubate kahona 'enedamiqathu: luthe 'asethaneqeqwaacawe yanabaru hhezeboce zenaabe menenyaa kafaa.
bazihe baluthe hhezeboce baszarute tzayaafe tagebaare mekeneyaate batafatsamabaacawe qethaate: lamiyaasetawelu sawoce mamakariyaa nawe; 'abezaanyocaacawe 'amaanyoce 'alenabarume.
'enaho geetaahe thalaatocene tabaqaaye; 'ashanaafi; labaarocume 'azaanye nawe.
bamadeyane katamaa 'aqeraabiyaa yameteganyawe yatathalaalafa zaafe yaalabaate chaakaa manedare baalabeetoce: nabiyaacawene shu`aayebene bamaasetabaabalaacawe: male'eketanyocune hulu 'asetabaabalu.
nabeyaacawe shu`aayebeme:: <<'eresune faretaacehu; baresu maagaaraatene bamatawe; 'alaahene 'atethanaqaqumene?!>> yaalaacawe gizee yahonawene 'awesaa.
<<'enaho 'enee 'alaahe wada'enaaneta yalaakanye; bamale`eketu laaye yamaalechamere 'enaa yamaaleqanese taamaanye male'eketanyaa nanye>>; 'alaacawe.
<<te'ezaazune bamafatzame yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru; bamaazezaacehu 'enaa bamekalakelaacehu 'eneeneme taazazunye.
'enee kageetaayee wadanaaneta bamaadaresawe male`ekete, kanaaneta menedaane 'alethayeqaacehume; 'enaho menedaayee ba`aalamaatu geetaa ba'alaahe laaye 'eneji bamaaneme laaye 'ayedalame.
lasawoceme bameteshathu gizee seferene mululaacawe; basheyaache gizee seferene kamiyaagwaadeluteme 'atehunu.
setemazenume batekekelanyaa mizaane mazenu.
yasawoceneme neberate 'ataagudelu; wanejale 'athefiwoce bamahoneme mederene 'ataabalaashu>>; 'alaacawe.
yaanene 'enaanetane 'enaa qadamete teweledocene yafatharawe: 'alaahe qethaatune 'enedaayaawaredebaacehu ferute.
yashu`ayebeme hhezeboce lashu`ayebe 'enedihe 'alute:: <<'enaho! 'aneta degemete batadagaagaami tadagemobaacawe: 'a`emerwacawene kanathaqaacawe sawoce nahe.

'aneta 'enedanyaa sawe 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaheme; ka'enyaa belechaa yalaheme; 'enedeete male'eketanyaa honeke?! male'eketanyaa nanye selametelawe nagare kaweshataamocu 'aderegane 'eneji 'anaasebeheme.
selametelawe ka'ewenatanyocu betehone: kasamaaye yahonane quraache 'aweredebene.>>
shu`ayebeme 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<'enaho geetaayee 'enaaneta yameteszarutene yamaagaaraatenaa yawanejale szeraacehune yaaweqaale; kaszeraacehu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.>>

'eresune bamaasetabaabale gafubate; yathelaayetwa qane qethaate darasabaacawe; kabarataa yatzahhaye muqate qane baxwaalaa damanaa 'athalalabaacawe: zenaabe 'aderegawe gamatute; damanaaweme 'esaatene 'azanababaacawenaa taqaathalu. yaa 'enaresu yathafubate qethaate: ba'asefarinatu taalaaqe yahona yaqethaate `elate nabare.
bazihe bashu`ayebe hhezeboce mathefaate; lamimakaru sawoce mamakariyaa nawe; 'abezaanyocaacaweme 'amaanyoce 'alenabarume.
'enaho geetaahe thalaatocune tabaqaaye; 'ashanaafi; labaarocume 'azaanye nawe.
'enaho yehe qure'aane: ya`aalamaatu fathaari bamuhhamade laaye yaawaradawe nawe.
yezote yawaradawe taamaanyu manefase jiberile (`alayehi 'asalaame) nawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! sawocene kamiyaasethanaqequ 'enaa ba'alaahe qethaate kamiyaasefaraarwacawe male'eketanyoce makaakale tehone zanede: taamaanyune manefase balebehe laaye 'awaradawe.
geletze bahona ba`aarabenyaa qwaaneqwaa nawe yaawaradawe.
'enaho yehe qure'aane baqadamete matsaahhefete wesethe yatathaqasa nawe; qadamete malakotaawi matsaahhefete yaabasarute nawe.

ka'eseraa'eele lejoce liqaawenete makaakale `abedalaahe bine salaamene yemasele: baaneta laaye yawaradawene 'ewenatanyenate maawaqaacawe: la'enanyaa baaneta laasetabaabalute maaserajaa 'ayehonaacawemene?
yehenene qure'aane ya`aarabenyaa qwaaneqwaa bamaayenaagaru 'anedaanede baa`ede sawoce laaye benaawaredawe;
yawaradalateme sawe matsehhafune biyaanabelaacawe: baresu 'ayaamenume; 'enyaa 'aneradaaweme yelu nabare; baqwaaneqwaacawe selatawarada 'alaahene yaamasegenu.
bazihu maleke maasetabaabalene 'enaa kehedatene ba'amatzanyoce leboce wesethe 'enaasegabaalane.
'asaamaami yahonawene qethaate 'esekiyaayu derase kaalubate kehedate 'ayelawathume.
yeheme qethaate badenegate yemathaabaacawaale; badenegateme 'esekamiyaarefebaacawe deraseme mamethaatune 'ayaawequme.
qethaatume badenegate siwaredebaacawe: 'ejege kamaqochataacawe yatanasaa:: <<wada 'alaahe 'enemalase zanede gizee yesathane yehone?!>> yelaalu.
'enanyihe kahadiyaane:: <<'enedaalekawe kasamaaye werejebenye (ma`aate) 'esekataawaredebene derase 'anaameneleheme>>; bamaalate qethaataacenene yethaadafaalune?!
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'eseki tanaagare: lamahonu 'enanyihene ka'emenate yaafanagathu kahadiyaanene batzagaawoce rajeme zamane benaathaaqemaacawe;
kaziyaa batzagaawoce kaqoyubate zamane baxwaalaa: yeqatharute yanabarawe qethaate bimathaabaacawe;
bazice `aalame yanabarute tzagaawoce mene yethaqemaacawaale?! tzagaawocu yeqwaarathaalu; meneme 'ayethaqemaacaweme.
maanenyaaweneme hhezebe: male'eketanyaane bamalaake 'enaa matsaahhefete bamaawerade: saanaasethanaqeqaacawe yaathafaanaacawe hhezeboce yalume.
lanaresu mamakariyaanaa magasachaa yehone zanede male'eketanyaane saaneleke, matsaahhefeteneme saanaawarede 'enaa saanaasethanaqeqe yameneqathaa badaayoce 'alehoneme.
shayethwanaateme yehenene qure'aane yezawe bamale'eketanyaawe lebe laaye 'alewaradume.
balebu laaye liwaredu 'ayegabaame; mawerademe 'ayecelumeme.
'ayecelume: mekeneyaatume samaaye laaye kamiganyawe seferaa taagedawaale; 'enedeetese yedaresubataale?! 'enedeetese yezawete yewaredaalu?!
ka'alaahe gaare tagaari bamaaderage leelaane 'amelaake 'enedaategazaa: baziheme sababe kamiqathute tehonaalahe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! zamadocehene 'eneda qerebataacawe: bamaagaaraate tagebaaraacawe laaye yamizawateru kahona, ya'alaahe qethaate 'enedaayaaganyaacawe 'asethaneqeqaacawe.
latakataluhe 'amaanyoce bamaazanenaa bamaraaraate: negegereheneme hona tagebaarehene 'alaseleselaacawe; tanaanaselaacawe.

kaamatzunaa; 'alaahene babecanyenate 'enediyaamaleku 'enaa taazaazhe 'enedihonu setaazezaacawe taazaazhe baayehonu: 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<'enaaneta kametefatzemute yamaagaaraatenaa yahathi'ate tagebaare yatharaahu nanye.>>
banagaroce hulu: thalaatocune bamabaqale 'ashanaafi; wada 'esu tatzatzetawe lamimalasute mahari bahonawe geetaahe laaye tamakaa.
baziyaa lasalaate bameteqomebate gizee yamiyaayehe bahonawe;
kasagaajoceme gaare honahe ka'anedu yasalaate kefele wada leelaanyaawe kefele mashagaagarehene bamimalakatawe geetaahe; 'anetame honeke leelocu yameteszarute szeraa meneme 'ayesawarebateme.
'eresume salaate laaye yametaanabawene qure'aane 'enaa yametelawene wedaasee yamisamaa; bawesethehe yaalaweneme 'esaabee `aawaaqi nawe.

qure'aanene yezawe yawaradute shayethwanaate naacawe; muhhamademe baala qenee nawe, belawe laqathafute: 'alaahe malese sisathe 'enedihe 'ala::
<
yamiwaredute: bamaanenyaaweme weshataame, wanejala-bezu, qathaafi thaneqwaaye lebe laaye nawe.

shayethwanaatume: jorwacawene thaale bamaaderage kalaayenyaawe hhezeboce (malaa'ekete) negegerene yesarequnaa; lathaneqwaaye wadaajocaacawe yaasetalaalefutaale; 'abezaanyaawocu thaneqwaayoce weshataamoce naacawe: 'anede qaale 'ewenate binaagarume qelu: 'ayaayezawe mato weshate yewaashaalu.
muhhamade ka'enaresu 'anedaacawe 'enedahona yametenaagarulaacawe baalaqeneewoce; kaqathetanyaa manegade yaafanagathu sawoce naacawe; yamikatalwacawe yamiluteneme qenee yaasetagaabulaacawaale.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kathemataacawe gatzetaa 'anedu: bayashalaqowe yamiwaalelu; 'anedee bamaawadase; leelaa gizee dagemo tecetenaa zalafaa; leelaa gizee dagemo yatalayaayu gudaayoce wesethe 'eyagabu sizalaabedu: 'atemalakatemene?!
'enedamiwaashunaa; yaalaadaragute 'adereganaale belawe sinaagaruse: 'aletamalakatekemene?!

nagare gene 'enanyaa: yaamanute 'enaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszarute; 'alaaheneme babezaate yaawasute;kathalaatocaacawe bakule badale daresobaacawe yatabaqalute: 'eneda hhasaane bine saabite yaalute: baalaqeneewoce ka'enasu 'ayedalume. 'enanyaame: 'alaahene bamakaade 'enaa babaarocu laaye wasanene bamaalafe: yabadalu sawoce; 'enedeete wadaala mamalashaa 'enedamimalasu saayaawequ 'ayeqarume; taalaaqe wada hona celotenaa raqiqe wadahona meremaraa yeqarebaalu.

(Ts) thaa. sine. mime (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata: ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.) 'enanyihe baaneta laaye yawaradute 'aneqatzoce: yaqure'aane 'aneqatzoce naacawe; meneme therethaaree yaleelabate matsehhafe nawe; yaasetanatanaweme ka'alaahe zanede mahonune yaaweqaale.
'enanyihe 'aneqatzoce: wada 'ewenate mariwoce naacawe; ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyocu laamanuteme beseraatoce naacawe.

'enanyaa salaatene batamwalaa maleku ba'agebaabu lamisagedu: yaganezabaacaweneme zakaahe lamigabaawe 'akaale ba'agebaabu lamisathute 'enaa bamacharashaawe `aalame selaalawe menedaame hona qethaate 'aragaagaache lahonute;

'enanyaa bamacharashaawe `aalame 'enaa bawesethu selaalawe menedaame hona qethaate yamaayaamenu kahadiyaane: kefu szeraawocaacawene 'asaamarenelaacawe: baderegitume gafubate: lamalekaame nagareme hona laqanaawe godaanaa mamaraate yamaayecelu yatadanaagaru naacawe.

'enanyihe bazihe baaheri yatagalatzute: bazihenyaawe `aalame bagedeyaanaa ba'esere yakafaa qethaate yatamadabalaacawe, batenesaa'eewe qaneme 'enasume hona beetasabocaacawe 'esaate wesethe zawetaari bamahonaacawe raasaacawe 'enaa beetasabocaacawe 'ejege yakasaru naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yamiwaredelehe qure'aane: bamafethare, bamaasetanaabare 'enaa badenegaageewe thebabanyaa 'enedihume labaariyaawocu yamibajaacawene `aawaaqi kahonawe geetaa yawarada qure'aane nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! musaa labeetasabocu: <<'esaate tamalekecaalahu: yaaqathaathalawe sawe manegade yethaqumane zanede male`ekete yezhee 'aliyaame laberedu mamoqiyaa yehone zanede ka'esaatu cebo lakushee lemethaa>>: yaalaacawe gizee yahonawene 'awesaa.

'esaate yaayabate botaa 'enedadarasame: <<ba'esaatu wesethe yamiganyawenaa bazuriyaawe yaalu malaa'ekete yatabaaraku naacawe: ya`aalamaatume geetaa: thamaamoce kamisathute seyaamee hulu yalaaqa 'enaa yatakabara nawe>>: bamaalate 'alaahe tharaawe.
'alaaheme: <<'aneta musaa hoye! 'enaho maaneme yamaayaashanefanye: 'ashanaafi; bamafetharee, bawesaaneeyee hona badenegaageeyee thebabanyaa yahonekute 'alaahe nanye>>: 'alawe.

<<beterehene thaale>>: musaame te'ezaazune 'akabara; musaame: beteru 'eneda 'ebaabe sineqasaaqasenaa siselakalake 'enedatamalakatame: laalamamalase jarebaawene satheto shasha; 'alaaheme: <<'ateferaate! 'enee zanede male'eketanyocee 'ebaabeneme hona leelaa nagarene 'ayefarume>>: 'alawe.
<<honome: hathi'ate bamafatsame raasune yabadala: kaziyaame yatatzatzata: 'enee yeqere baayenaa la'eresu 'ejege 'azaanye nanye.

'ejeheneme ba'anegategeehe wesethe 'asegabaanaa malesahe 'awethaawe: kaalameneme lametheme 'ejehe kabarado yanathaa hono yewathaale; yeheme: 'ewenatanyenatehene 'aragaagaache kahonute 'enaa wada fire`aawene 'enaa hhezebocu katalaakute zathanye leyu ta'ameraatoce: (batere, yadereqe zamane, yaferaaferee gudelate, 'athelaqelaaqi gorefe, 'anebathaa, qemaale, 'enequraarite 'enaa dame:) 'anedu nawe. 'enaresume bakehedate ka'alaahe te'ezaaze yaafanagathu naacawe.>>
'enanyihe musaane yaradaanebaacawe ta`aameraate geletze 'enaa gulehe hono simathaalaacaweme: <<yehe musaa yezote yamathaawe ta`aamere: geletze degemete nawe>>: 'alu.

'enanyihe ta`aameraatoce: ba'eregethe ka'alaahe mahonune wesethaacawe 'eyaaragaagatha: badalanyaanaa hhaqene laalamaqabale bamakuraataacawe saabiyaame kaadu: 'alaaragaagathume; 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bahathi'ataacawe 'enaa bakehedataacawe bamedere laaye thefaate yamifatsemu sawoce macharashaacawe 'enedeete 'enedahona 'asetawele! hulaacaweneme 'athafaanaacawe: 'awadamenaacaweme.

daawedene 'enaa lejune sulayemaanene: ya'a`ewaafene qwaaneqwaa chamero: `eweqatene sathanaacawe; daawedenaa sulayemaaneme (`alayehimaa 'asalaame) 'alaahe: banabiyenate 'enedihume shayethwanaatene 'enaa 'agaanenetocene la'enyaa bamaageraatu: kabezu 'amaanye baariyaawocu 'enyaane bamamerathu: la'alaahe mesegaanaa yegabaawe: 'alu.

sulayemaaneme nabiyenatene, `eweqatene 'enaa selethaanene: ka'abaatu kadaawede warasa; 'alaahe la'eresunaa lawalaaju yawaalalaacawene welataa bamaawesaate:: <<sawoce hoye! 'alaahe ya'a`ewaafene demetze yamaradaate `eweqate sathetonaale; lanabiyaateme hona labaalaszelethaanaate yasathawene hulu sathetonaale; yehe 'alaahe yasathane sethotaa: geletze 'enaa gulehe terufaate nawe.>>
lasulayemaane: yasawe, ya'agaanenetenaa ya'a'ewaafe szaraawitocu tasabaasebawe: baszere`aate yegwaazaalu.

'eyatagwaazu 'eyaalu bashaame 'akaabaabi bamiganye yagunedaanoce shalaqo 'enedadarasume: kagunedaanocu 'anedwa:: <<gunedaanoce hoye! sulayemaanenaa szaraawitocu ya'enaaneta manore saayetaawaqaacawe 'enedaayechafaleqwaacehu tathaneqaqu! manoraacehune biyaawequ: 'ayeragethwacehume>>, 'alace.

sulayemaaneme negegerwane sisamaa fagage 'ala: <<geetaayee hoye! ba'enee 'enaa bawalaajocee laaye yawaalekelenene tsagaa 'amasagene zanede lasekeete 'abeqaanye, 'aseganezebanyeme; yametefaqedaweneme malekaame szeraa lamaszeraateme 'abeqaanye; ba'ezenateheme kabago baariyaawocehe goraame 'asegabaanye>>: bamaalate geetaawene 'alaahene tamaatzana.

sulayemaaneme 'a`ewaafaatene siqaanye: hude hudene (baqaqane yamimasele ya'a`ewaafe zereyaa nawe.) 'alaaganyaweme: <<lamenedenawe hude hudune yaalaayahute: lamahonu 'enedaalaayawe yaagadanye nagare 'alane?! wayenese kaaletaganyute hono nawe?!>> 'ala.

'enedaaletaganya siyaaweqeme: <<beretu qethaate 'eqathaawaalahu, wayeneme baalamaganyatu qethaate yehonawe zanede 'aredawaalahu: 'aliyaame yathafaabatene mekeneyaate yamiyaaseradaa geletze marajaa yaamethaalenye>>: 'ala.

hudehudu latawasana gizee zagaya: 'enedamathaame lasulayemaane (`alayehi 'asalaame):: <<yaalaayakxawene nagare 'ayecee nawe yamathaahute: sela sabaa'e hhezeboceme meneme therethere yaleelawene 'ewenatanyaa zeenaa yezheelehe matheceeyaalahu>>: 'alawe.

<<yametaasetadaaderaacawe seete honaa nawe yaaganyaxwaacawe: yehece seeteme yaselethaaneme hona yaxaayele manegadoce hulu tasathetwataale; yahhezebocwane gudaaye yametaasetadaaderebate teleqe zufaaneme 'alaate.

yehece seete 'enaa hhezebocwa: ka'alaahe wechi latzahaye sisagedu nawe yaaganyaxwaacawe: shayethwaneme yaalubatene yahathi'atenaa yamaagaaraate wanejalene 'asaamerolaacawe: ka'ewenatu manegade 'azoraacawe: wada 'ewenateme mamaraate 'ayecelume.

yaa basamaaye wesethe yadabaqawene zenaabe lamiyaawaredawe, kamedereme 'azere`etene lamiyaawathaawe, kaszeraawocaacehume yametedabequteneme hona bageletse yameteszarutene lamiyaaweqawe 'enaa meneme yamaayeszawarebate lahonawe: la'alaahe becaa 'enedaayesagedu: shayethwane yaalubatene yahathi'atenaa yamaagaaraate wanejalene 'asaamaralaacawe.
'alaahe: becanyaa tamalaaki nawe: yataalaaqu `aresheme baalabeete nawe.>>
sulayemaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) lahudehudu:: <<yametenaagarawe nagare 'ewenatehene yehune wayeneme dagemo kaweshatanyoce tehone 'enemalakataalane>>: 'alawe.

sulayemaane dabedaabee tsaafa: lahudehudume sathawe 'enaa <<yehene dabedaabeeyeene wada saabaa hhezeboce yezahe hidenaa kalaaye bamathaale 'aserakebaacawenaa zore belahe sela dabedaabeewe yamiwayaayutene 'ademethe>>: 'alawe.
negeszetitwame dabedaabeewene tarakabace: <<keburaanoce hoye! taalaaqenaa yatakabara dabedaabee daresonyaale>>: 'alace.
yadabedaabeeweme chebethe: kasulayemaane yatalaaka sihone <<bisemilaahi 'are-rahhemaani 'are-rahhime>> (ba'alaahe 'ejege ruxeruxe 'ejege 'azaanye bahonawe seme) bamile qaale yatajamara nawe.

<<'enedaatekoru! ka'alaahe gaare tzahayene 'eyaamalakaacehu bamahonaacehu: wada 'alaahe becanyaa tamalaakinate 'enaa ba'alaahe tagaari maaderagene selamatawe lamaadaregelaacehu theri: taazaazhenaa faqaadanyaa honaacehu wada 'enee nu!>> yamile nawe.

negeszetitwame:: <<mamaakeretocenaa keburaanoce hoye! sela gudaayee tekekelanyaawene 'aqethaachaa thaqumunye: 'enee gaare taganyetaacehu yaalaacehune hasaabe saataakaafelunye meneme nagare 'alewaseneme>>: 'alace.
mamaakeretocume:: <<'enyaa taalaaqe xaayele 'alane, bathorenateme thanekaaraa sawoce nane: wesaaneewe yaaneci nawe: yafalageshewene 'ezazhine: 'enyaa lamafatsame zegeju nane>>: 'alwate.

negeszetitwame:: <<nagaszetaate: yatenyaaweme katamaa bathore kagabu: bamifatsemute gedeyaa, qemiyaa 'enaa zerefiyaa saabiyaa manedarune yaabalaashaalu, taalaalaaqe sawoceneme yatakabarunaa zenanyaa yanabarutene: yaawaaredwacawaale, nagaszetaate bamaanenyaaweme yakatamaa hhezebe laaye dele kaadaragu: sawoce lebe wesethe ferehatene 'enaa makabarene lamafethare hulegizee yehenenu nawe yamiyaadaregute>>: 'alace.
<<bamahonume: 'eseti ladabedaabeewe baalabeetenaa lahhezebocu sethotaa lelaakenaa kasethotaawe baxwaalaa male'eketanyocu mene yezawe 'enedamimathu 'ayaalahu.>>

yatalaakawe male'eketanyaa 'enaa radaatocu wada sulayemaane 'enedamathu: <<lamahonu ganezabe yameteradunye: ka'enaaneta leteqalabesunye nawene?! 'alaahe yasathanye nabiyenate, selethaane 'enaa ganezabe: la'enaaneta kasathaacehu yabalatha nawe; yelequnese bamisathaacehu yaduneyaa shaqathe sethotaa yametedasatute 'enaanetawe naacehu>>: bamaalate sethotaawe malaakune taca.

sulayemaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) lamale'eketanyaawe:: <<yaamathaakxawene sethotaa yezahe wada 'enasu tamalase: taazaazhe 'enaa bafaqaadanyenate yamaayemathu kahona: 'ereswa 'enaa hhezebocwa magaafathe yamaayecelutene szaraawite yezane 'enemathaanaa bakebere yenorubate kanabarawe yasaabaa katamaa yatawaaradunaa yabataace honawe 'enaasewathaacawaalane>>: bamaalate maleso laakawe.

sulayemaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) ba'asetadaadaru szere lamiganyu wasaanye sawoce:: <<makwaanenetoce hoye! lamahonu taazaazhe honawe kamamethaataacawe bafite zufaanwane yamiyaamathaalenye maanawe?>> 'alaacawe.

kagaaneenoce xaayelanyaawe:: <<'ahune kaalahebate maqamachaa saatenasaa: zufaanwane 'amathaalehalahu: kanamulu 'eqaaweme tashakemee yamaamethaate 'aqemu 'alanye, bawesethu selaalaweme taamaanye nanye>>: bamaalate malese sathawe.

sulayemaane zanede yamiganye 'anede bago yamatsehhaafu `eweqate belome 'alaahe katathayaqabate melaashe yamisathawe taalaaqune ya'alaahene seme chemere yamiyaaweqe `aawaaqi sawe:: 'alaahene bamamaatzane: `aayenehene kamaaneqasaaqasehe bafite 'asemathaalehalahu; 'alaahene tamaatzaname: metzaaneeweneme 'alaahe taqabalawe; sulayemaaneme zufaanune 'eresu zanede siyaaganyawe:: <<yehe yageetaayee terufaate nawe, tzagaawene 'amasegaanye 'aliyaame 'asetabaabaaye mahoneene lifatenanye nawe! 'alaahene yaamasagana: yamesegaanaawe theqeme wada raasu nawe yamimalasawe; ya'alaahene tzagaawocene yaasetabaabala 'enaa yaalaamasegana dagemo: 'alaahe ka'eresu mesegaanaa yatabeqaaqaa, care 'enaa yatakabara geetaa nawe: sela carenatume tzagaawene lamiyaasetabaabeluteme macaru nawe>>: 'ala.
sulayemaaneme (`alayehi 'asalaame):: <<zufaanwane kaalabate yezate qayerute: lamahonu zufaanwane 'enedametaaweqe 'aliyaame neberataacawene kamaayaawequte 'enedametehone 'enemalakataalane!>> 'ala.

yasaabaa negeszete sulayemaane zanede 'enedadarasaceme: 'ereswane lamafataneme:: <<yehe zufaaneshene yemaselaalene?>> tabaalace; 'eneda theyaaqeeweme yezate:: <<leke 'eresune yemaselaale!>> bamaalate 'enedamalasaceme: sulayemaane:: <<'alaahe 'enedazihe `aayenate nagarocene maaderage yamicele bamahonu: ka'ereswa bafite `eweqate sathetonaale; 'aseqademaneme la'alaahe te'ezaaze tagazhiwocenaa tamariwoceme nabarene>>: 'ala.

'ereswa dagemo: yahhezebocwane felaagote lamaarekaatenaa 'enaa bachefene bamakatale: ka'alaahe wechi taamalekawe yanabarawe thaa`ote: 'alaahene babecanyenate kamaamelake 'agadaate; bamahonume 'alaahene kakaadute hhezeboce nabarace; 'enedanasume kahadi honace.

hhenetsaawe wesethe gebi tabaalace: 'aszaraarume yaweha gatzetaa maleke nabaranaa: setaayawe weha masalaatenaa lamagebaate yemacaate zanede baatwane galatzace; sulayemaaneme (`alayehi 'asalaame):: <<yehe bamasetaawate yataszaraa hhenetsaa nawe>>: 'alaate; wada selaameme theri 'adaragalaate: <<geetaayee hoye! kaaneta gaare leelaane bamaamelakee: baraasee laaye badale fatsemeeyaalahu; kasulayemaane gaare bamahoneme lafetherataatu thaqelaalaa geetaa lahonawe: la'alaahe taazaazhe honyaalahu>>: bamaalate theriwene taqabalace.

wada samudeme yazemedenaa wanedemaacawene saalihhene (`alayehi 'asalaame) <<'alaahene babecanyenate tagazute>>: bamaalate laakenawe; 'eresu theri kaadaragalaacawe baxwaalaa lahulate budene takafalu: 'anedanyaawe budene 'amaanyoce sihonu leelaanyaawe dagemo kahadiyaane naacawe: maanenyaacawe 'ewenate laaye 'enedaalume tanataaraku.

saalihhe (`alayehi 'asalaame):: <<lamene ka'ezenate 'aseqademaacehu qethaate 'enedifaathane tethayeqaalaacehu?! yaazenelaacehu zanede lahathi'ataacehu sereyate 'alaahene 'atethayequmene?!>> 'alaacawe.

hhezebocu sela 'ewenate 'eyaamaararu:: <<baaneta 'enaa 'aberawehe baalute 'amaanyoce saabiyaa: gada bisoce honene>>: 'alute; saalihheme (`alayehi 'asalaame):: <<lamiyaagaathemaacehu cegere baraariwocene yametelaqute: `eweqatu 'alaahe zanede nawe: meneme nagare 'ayesawarebateme; yelequnese bamizaragaalaacehu malekaame sisaayenaa bamigathemaacehu cegere yametefatanu hhezeboce naacehu>>: 'alaacawe.
