bahhijere katamaa bamaaneme hona bamalekaame szeraa mederene kamaasaamare yeleqe: bahathi'atenaa bakehedate bamedere laaye 'athefi yahonu zathanye sawoce nabaru.

'erese ba'eresaacaweme:: <<manoriyaawe derase balalite heedane: 'eresunenaa bitasabune gadelane senaabaqaa: lawaraashocu:: yasaalihhenenaa yabeetasabune magadale 'alaayaneme: selamenelaweme 'ewenatanyoce nane: 'enedamenele: yehenene deregite lamafatsame 'erese ba'eresaacene ba'alaahe seme 'enemaamaale>>, tabaabaalu.

saalihhene 'enaa beetasabocune lamagedale: debeqe seeraa 'adaraaju; 'enaresu meneme bamaayaawequbate huneetaa 'enaa 'eresune ka'enasu tanekole lamaadaanenaa 'eresune lamaredaate: belome kahadi hhezebocune lamaathefaate: mekere makarene (zadeene zayadene).
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yaseeraacawenaa yatanekolaacawene macharashaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara 'asetawele! ka'enyaa bahona qethaate deraashaacawene 'athafaanaacawe.

'enaho babadalaacaweme saabiyaa: yabeetaacawe gedegedaanaa thaariyaawe wadeqo: sawoceme yaleelubate baado hono qaretwale. babadalaacawe saabiyaa yadarasabaacawe yaqethaate 'adagaa: la'amaanye hhezeboce gesaatzee nawe: tagasaachoce 'enaresu naacawe.
kasaalihhe hhezeboceme ba'alaahe yaamanutene 'adaanaacawe; te`ezaazune bamaakebarenaa kelekalaawene bamaraaqe taazaazhoce nabaru.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! luthe 'eyatacaacawenaa 'eyaawagazaacawe:: <<ba'adabaabaaye sawe 'eyaayaacehu: tzayaafe tagebaarene gebera sadomaawinatene tefatsemaalaacehune?!>> yaalaacawe gizee yahonawene 'asetaawese.

<<seetocene tetaacehu segaawi felaagotaacehune lamaarekaate kawanede gaare genenyunate tefatsemaalaacehune?! yeheneneme setefatzemu lachawaanatenaa zare lamaabezaate saayehone: 'enesesaawi 'enaa segaawi semeetaacehune lamaarekaate nawe; ba'ewenatume ya'emenate, yanetsehenaa 'enaa kahathi'ate yamaraaqe gedeetaacehune yamaataawequ maayemaane naacehu.>>

yahhezebocume malese <<yaluthene beetasaboce kakatamaacehu 'asewathu. 'enasu kaqoshaashaawocenaa ka'edefoce raasaacawene yamiyaatheraaru (yamiyaarequ) naacawe>> maalate 'eneji leelaa 'alenabarame. yehenene yaalute bamifatzemute tzayaafe tagebaare yaluthe hhezeboce selaaletagaarwacawenaa yelequnese yehenene tagebaare bamafatsamaacawe selamiyaawagezwacawe 'enasu laaye lamaashofe nawe.
'eresunenaa beetasabocuneme 'adaanenaacawe baalabeetu becaa seteqare. bathefaatu wesethe kamiqarute 'enedetehone wasanenebaate.
ba'enaresume laaye yadenegaaye zenaabene kasamaaye 'azanabenebaacawe. baqethaate tasefaraaretawe laaletagasatzu sawoce 'asekafi 'enaa 'athefi zenaabe nabare.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale:: <<latzagaawe hulu mesegaanaa la'alaahe yegabaawe. yaluthe 'enaa yasaalihe hhezebocene kaqathaabate qethaateme yanabiyune (salalaahu `alayehi wasalamene) baaledarabocene salaame 'aderegwaacawaale. lamahonu yanagaru hulu selethaane ba'ejunaa 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaake yahonawe 'alaahe yebalethaalene wayenese 'agaariwoce yamiyaamalekwaacawe meneme yamatheqameme hona yamagudaate selethaane yaleelaacawe thaa`otaate?!

wayese yaa samaayaatenenaa mederene yaala qadaami mesaalee yafatharanaa kasamaaye la'enaaneta yasawe lejoce yazenaabene weha yaawaradawe; bawehaweme baalawebatenaa qonejo yahonutene 'atekeletocene 'abaqalene. 'aqema dakaamaa bamahonaacehu ka'atekeletocu zaafwane letaabaqelu 'atecelume. yamiyaabaqelaate 'alaahe nawe. ka'alaahe gaare yehenene yaadaraga leelaa 'amelaake 'alane? yalame. gene 'enaresu ka'ewenate yamiyaazanabelu hhezeboce naacawe. bagefeme fathaarine kafethure gaare 'ekule yamiyaadaregu naacawe.>>

wayeme yaa mederene nawaariwocwa laaye yamaatewaalele yatzanaace 'enaa yaragaace, bawesethwame yamifasu wanezocene, la'ereswame yatzanu taraarocene, bahulatu baahheroceme maalateme:: bachawaamaawenaa bathaafaachu baahhere makaakale chawaamaawe kathaafaachu gaare bamaqalaaqale lamathathe kamahone 'enedaayaabalaashawe malayaayaa geredoshene yaadaraga nawe. 'enazihene hulu yamiyaadarege ka'alaahe gaare ba'ewenate leelaa 'amelaake 'alane? yalame. genaa 'abezaanyaawocaacawe 'ayaawequme. yamiyaawequ bihonu noro kafethuraanu 'anedeneme ba'alaahe laaye 'ayaagaarume nabare.

wayeme yaa yatacagarane sawe kacegeru 'enediyaalaaqeqawe balamanawe gizee lemanaawene yamiqabale, yasawe lejene yamiyaasekafaa bashetaanenaa dehenatene yamiyaasewagede, bamedereme laaye katewelede wada tewelede 'anedu leelaawene yamitakaa yamedere tatakiwoce yaadaragaacehu. 'enazihene hulu yamiyaadarege ka'alaahe gaare ba'ewenate leelaa 'amelaake 'alane?! yalame; theqiteme 'ategasatzume 'atemakarumeme.

wayeme yaa bayabesenaa babaahhere chalamaawoce wesethe meleketocenenaa kawaakebetocene bamaaderage yamimaraacehu, nafaasoceneme zenaabe kamamethaatu bafite 'abesaari honawe labaarocu wadafalagawe ba'ezenatu yamileke nawe. yehene yamiyaadarege ka'alaahe gaare ba'ewenate leelaa 'amelaake 'alane?! 'alaahe 'agaariwoce kafethuraanu ka'eresu gaare kamiyaagaarwacawe hulu yatharaa 'enaa yataqadasa nawe.

wayeme yaa bamaahetzane wesethe ka'anede kxidate wada leelaa kxidate bamaashagaagare mafetharene yamijamere kaziyaame kamota baxwaalaa hheyaawe bamaaderage yamimalesawe; kasamaaye zenaabene bamaaweradenaa kamedereme 'azere`etocene bamaabeqale sisaayene yamisathaacehu nawe. yehene ka'alaahe gaare ba'ewenate yamiyaadarege leelaa 'amelaake 'alane?! 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce <<baalaacehubate shereke laaye 'ewenatanyoce 'enedahonaacehu maaserajaacehune 'amethu>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<basamaayaate yaalu malaa'ekete bamedereme yaalu sawoce hulu ruqene misetherene 'ayaawequme. nagare gene 'alaahe becaa nawe yamiyaaweqawe. basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalu hulu lamenedaa macee 'enedamiqasaqasume 'ayaawequme>> balaacawe.

yamacharashaawene `aalame batamalakata yaalaacawe `eweqate tadaraarebo sela 'eresu 'eregethanyoce honawe nawene? bafetzume! yelequneme 'enaresu selamachiwe `aalame batherethaaree 'enaa bamawaalale wesethe naacawe. ba'eregetheme `eyetaawocaacaweme kareswa yataawara nawe.
'enaziyaa kahadiyaane bamaasetabaabaleme 'enedihe 'alu:: <<lamahonu 'enyaame 'abaatocaaceneme motane 'afare kahonene baxwaalaa hheyaawe honane 'eneqasaqasaalane?>>

'enyaanaa 'abaatocaacene kazihe bafite ba'eregethe ba'athaqaalaaye 'enedameneqasaqase qaale tagabetolene nabare. honome qaalu batagebaare sifatsame 'alaayanaweme. yehe yatagabaalene yamaqaseqase qaale qadametocu bamatsaahhefetocaacawe yaasafarute weshate 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame 'alu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<bamedere laaye bayatenyaaweme 'aqethaachaa tagwaazu. 'enaziyaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yaasetabaabalute wanejalanyoce macharashaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara tamalekatu. yehenenu bamaasetabaabalaacawe yatanasaa ba'eregethe 'athafaanaacawe.>>
'agaariwoce therihene kamaqabale bamaafanegathaacawe 'atezane. sela tanekolaacaweme lebehe 'ayethababe. ba'enaresu laaye 'alaahe yeradaahale.
kahhezebocehe kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yamiyaasetabaabelu kahadiwoceme 'anetanaa me'emanaane yaqatharaacehune yaqethaate qatharo 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu macee nawe yamiragaagathawe yelaalu.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<yametaathaadefute qethaate wesenu wada 'enaaneta qerebe mahonu 'eregethe nawe.>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! meneme 'enekwaa bakehedatenaa bahathi'aate wesethe bihonume geetaahe sawocene baqethaate yamaayaathaadefaacawe bamahonu lasawe lejoce baalawelataa nawe. honome 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce bamiwaalelaacawe welataa 'alaahene 'ayaamasagenume.
geetaaheme baarocu balebocaacawe wesethe yamidabequtenaane geletze yamiyaadaregutene yaaweqaale. ka'enasu meneme 'ayeszawarebateme. ba'eresume yemanadaacawaale.
basamaayeme hona bamedere wesethe hono kasawoce yatasawara maanenyaaweme nagare geletse bahona matsaahhefete wesethe saferwale. yeheme matsehhafe lawehhale maahefuze (yatathabaqawe mazegabe) nawe.
yehe bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye yawaradawe qure'aane la'eseraa'eele lejoce yamiwazaagabubatene 'abezaanyaawene nagare yetarekelaacawaale; sehetataacaweneme yaagaalethaale.
qure'aane yaseraa'eele lejoce mazaanafene 'enaa yabarazutene matsehhafaacawene 'eremaate yamisathe mahonu tagaletswale. 'eresume (qure'aane) ba'esu lamisaru me'emanaane mamariyaanaa 'ezenate nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe baferedu `elate fetehawi bahona feredu baamanutenaa bakahadiwoce mahakale yefaredaale. la'amaanyu siyaazene kahadiwene dagemo yeqathaale. thalaatocune yamibaqale 'ashanaafi nawe. maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi nawe. 'ewenatanyaawenaa weshataamu yamaayeqalaaqalebate `aawaaqi nawe.
ba'alaaheme tamakaa; bagudaayeheme hulu ba'esu tadagafe. 'aneta geletze bahonawe 'ewenate laaye nahe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'aneta 'alaahene bamakaadaacawe mekeneyaate lebocaacawe yamotacebaacawe mutaanene 'ataasamaame. 'ewenatene 'enedaayesamu yatatzaafabaacawenaa 'alwahe masemiyaa yaasaathaacawene daneqorowoceneme 'emebi belawe sizoru therine 'ataasamaame.

'anetame ka'ewenate yataawarutene yametaaqanaa 'ayedalaheme. bamahonume ba'enasu laaye letaazenenaa raasehene letaadakeme 'ayegabaame. ba'aneqatzocaacene yamiyaamenutenenaa late'ezaazocu fetsume tagazhi yahonutene 'eneji therihene 'ataasamaame.

bakehedataacawene bahathiyaataacawe laaye bamazawetaraacawe ya'alaahe qethaate siragaagathebaacawe 'enaa kefuwocu sawoce siqaru; tenesaa'eeweme siqarebe kataalaalaaqe meleketocu 'anedu yahonawene 'enesesaa kamedere 'enaawathaalaacawaalane. yehece 'enesesaame bamale'eketanyaacene laaye baawaradenaacawe 'aneqatzocaacene yamaayaaragaagethu 'enedanabaru bamigabaacawe qwaaneqwaa yametaanaageraacawe tehonaalace.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kahhezeboceme hulu 'aneqatzocaacenene yamiyaasetabaabelutene yashumaamenete sebeseboce yamenesabasabebatene qane 'asetaawese. <<yamajamariyaawocu wada macharashaawocu yemalasaalu kaziyaame wada gemegamaa yenadaalu.

manadaataacaweme yaqathala hono yamagamegamiyaa botaacawe zanede sidaresu 'alaahe 'enasune bamatacate 'enedihe yelaacawaale:: ba`eweqate yaalaadaarasaacehu setehonu ya'eneene 'anedenatene yamiyaamalaketawenenaa denegaageeyeeneme yaaqafawene 'aneqatzoceene 'asetabaabalaacehune?! wayese bamaamanenaa bamaasetabaabale ragade mene teszaru nabaraacehu?!>>

ba'alaahe bamakaadaacawenaa 'aneqatzocune bamaasetabaabalaacawe bafatsamute badale saabiyaa ba'enaresu laaye yaqethaate qaalu tafatzamabaacawe. 'aqeme selaleelaacawe 'enaa maaserajaacaweme wedeqe bamahonu karaasaacawe lamakalaakale 'enekwaa manaagare 'ayecelume.

kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yaasetabaabelu selanabare 'alaahe bahheyewataacawe yaalawene tachabaache kesetate bamaamalaakate 'enedamiqasaqasu bamagelatse 'asaasabaacawe. yeheme 'eneqelefene 'eneda mote, ka'eneqelefe maneqaatene dagemo kamote baxwaalaa 'enedamaqaseqase mahonune sigaletze 'enedihe 'ala::
lamahonu 'enazihe kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene 'asetabaabaayoce 'enyaa bamatanyaate 'erafete yaaganyu zanede lalitene mafetharaacenene 'enedihume mamalekate celawe wada szeraa maneqasaaqase yecelu zanede qanene berehaanaamaa maaderagaacenene 'ayemalakatumene?! yehe batadagaagaami mamotenaa manasaate (matanyaatenaa maneqaate) la'amaanye hhezeboce geletse yahona maaserajaa nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! baqanede 'enedinafaa yatamadabawe male'ake baqanedume hulatanyaawaane nefi baminafaabate gizee 'alaahe bacarenatu 'enedaayedanagethu yawasanawe baqare basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yaalute hulu bamidanagethu gizee yamihonawene 'asetaawese. ba'ezihe `elateme 'eyaanedaanedu ya'alaahe fetherataate la'eresu yatanaanasu 'enaa taazaazhe honawe yemathaalu.

taraaraawoceme yatzanu 'enaa yamaayeneqasaaqasu maselawe taayaacawaalahe. baziyaane qane gene 'enasu 'eneda damanaa guzo bafethenate yeheedaalu. yeheme ya'alaahe deneqe seraa nawe. yamiyaaneqasaaqesaweme 'esu nawe. 'eresu bameteszarute hulu bazerezere `aawaaqi nawe. kaszeraawocaacehu meneme 'ayesawarebateme. ba'esume yemanadaacawaale.

batenesaa'eewe qane 'emenatenenaa malekaame szeraane yezo yamathaa janate tazagaajetolataale. 'enasume batenesaa'eewe qane 'alaahe ka'elatu denegaathee salaame selaadaragaacawe yataragaagaa tsathetaa wesethe naacawe.

kehedatenenaa hathi'aatene yezawe yaqarabutemaa ba'afe thimaacawe 'esaate wesethe yethaalaalu. 'enasune bamakonane 'enaa bamaawaarade 'enedihe yebaalaalu:: <<yametemanadute baduneyaawe `aalame tefatsemute banabarawe kehedatenaa hathi'aate saabiyaa 'eneji baleelaa nawene?!>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<'enee ba'eregetheme yataazazekute bawesethwa dame mafaasase yamaayefaqadebaate; bawesethwame maaneme yamaayebadalebaate; taadaanye 'enesesaawocwame yamaayegadalubaate; zaafocwame yamaayeqorathubaate yahonacewene yataqadasacewene yamakaane katamaa geetaa 'enedegazaa nawe. yanagarume hulu selethaane ya'eresu becaa nawe. la'alaahe 'eje 'enedesathenaa late'ezaazu fetsume taazaazhe 'enedehone taazezheeyaalahu.

basawoce laayeme qure'aanene 'enedaanabe taazezhaalahu.>> ba'esu mamariyaa yatamaraa ba'esu wesethe yaalawene yaszaraame theqemu laraasu becaa nawe. yatasaasaatame, ya'eresuneme mamariyaanate yataqaawama 'esu wesethe baalawe yaaleszaraame sawe <<'enee ka'alaahe qethaate yamaasethanaqeqe 'asethaneqaaqi 'eneji wada qathetanyaa manegade mameraatu ba'ejee 'ayedalame>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale:: <<lamaayeqotharawe tzagaawe mesegaanaa hulu la'alaahe nawe. 'alaahe wadafite ta`aameraatune banafesaacehu basamaaye 'enaa bamedere 'enedihume basisaayaacawe wesethe yaasaayaacexwaale. 'ewenatene lamaqabale yamiyaasecelaacehune 'eweqate taasechabethaacexwaalace. geetaaheme yameteszarutene hulu zenegu 'ayedalame. yelequnese 'eyaanedaanedune yaaweqaale. ka'esu meneme 'ayesawarebateme. ba'esu yemanadaacaxwaale.>>
(Tsm) <<thwa sine mime>> (ba`arabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)
'enazihe geletze yahonu yaqure'aane 'aneqatzoce naacawe.
sela musaa 'enaa fire`aawene therethere yaleelawene 'ewenatanyaa taarike 'amaanye hhezeboce yethaqamubate zanede 'enaanabelehalane. taariku baazalawe temeherete tathaqaamiwocu 'enaresu naacawe.

fire`aawene bagebetze medere laaye wasane 'alafa. ba'enasume laaye tashoma. nawaariwocwaneme babudene kafaafelo wesenune budene maalateme ya'eseraa'eele lejocene yaawaaredaale. wanede lejocaacawene bamagedale 'ejege 'enasune lamaawaarade bamaasabe dagemo seete lejocaacawene la'agalegaayenate baheyewate yaaseqaraacawaale. 'eresu bagefe, wasane bamaalafe 'enaa bakuraate medere laaye thefaate kamifatzemute 'anedu nabare.

la'enaziyaa bagebetze medere fire`aawene lachaqonaacawe ya'eseraa'eele lejoce thalaataacawene bamaathefaate, cheqonaawene ka'enasu laaye bamaasewagade, ba'ewenate manegade laaye sawocene yamimaru mariwoce bamaaderage, 'enedihume kafe yaalawe geetaa 'enedihe baalawe maszarate:: (wa'awrathna 'lqawma 'lWadhiyna kanuw yustaD`afuwna mashariqa 'l'arDi wamaGaribaha 'lWatiy barakna fiyha) <<'enaziyaa yechaqonu yanabarutene hhezeboce bameszeraaqunaa bame`eraabu yabaarakenaatene medere 'awarasenaacawe.>> baalawe maszarateme kafire`owene mathefaate baxwaalaa yatabaarakacewene yashaame mederene waraashoceme bamaaderage taalaaqe welataane lenewelelaacawe 'eneshaalane.

'enedihume 'enasune bamedere laaye baalaselethaane bamaaderage bamedere laaye lenaamacaacelaacawenaa fire`owenene banegeszenaawe laaye taalaaqe radaatu yanabarawene haamaaneneme 'enaa baselethaanaacawe laaye radaatoce yanabaru szaraawitocaacaweneme yefarute yanabarutene yaselethaane mawagade 'enaa ka'eseraa'eele lejoce batawaladawe leje 'eje yaselethaanaacawene mathanaaqaqe lenaasaayaacawe 'enefalegaalane.

'alaahe yafire`owene negeszenaa wadeete 'enedamiyaamaraa 'enaa musaanenaa hhezebocune 'enedamiyaaleqaacawe kagalatza baxwaalaa yamusaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) taarike kaweledate male'eketanyaa hono 'esekilaake derase yaalawene sigaletse 'enedihe 'ala -
yamusaaneme 'enaate <<'athebiwe. baresume laaye fire`owene 'enaa hhezebocu yegadelutaale yamile feraacaa kaadarabeshe saathene wesethe 'aseqamethashe banaayele waneze wesethe thaayewe, sela masemathume hona sela fire`aawene ba'esu laaye segaate 'ayegebaashe; ka'eresu bamalayatesheme 'atezanyi, baheyewate 'enemaleseleshaalane; wada fetherataatume katalaaku ya'alaahe male'eketanyoce 'anedu 'enedaregawaalane.>> bamaalate 'asaawaqenaate.

'esune basaathene wesethe 'aderegashe baahhere wesethe thaayewe belane yaasaawaqenaatene fatzamace. musaane yafire`aawene thalaate bamaaderage ba'eju laselethaanune mathefiyaa 'enaa tekaazeeme 'enediwaraacawe 'enaa 'alaahe yashaawe tafatsaami yehone zanedeme yafire`aawene beetasaboceme 'agenyetawe wasadute. fire`aawene, miniseteru haamaaneme 'enaa radaatocaacaweme bakehedataacawe, denebare bamaalafaacawenaa medere laaye thefaatene bamaasefaafaataacawe mekeneyaate hathi'aatanyoce nabaru.

fire`oweneme musaane magedalene bafalaga gizee yafire`aawene baalabeete:: <<la'eneeme laanetame yadasetaa meneche nawe. menaalebaateme ba'agalegaayenate 'aliyaame bamaadago lejenate 'eneda leje bamahone lithaqemane yecelaalenaa 'ategedalute>> 'alace. 'enaresume yaselethaanaacawe fetzaamee ba'esu 'eje mahonune fetsume 'ayaawequme nabare.

yamusaame 'enaate kaleeloce yaduneyaa hasaaboce hulu lebwa baado bamahone yamusaane gudaaye becaa bamaasabe mataagase 'alecaalaceme. bageetaacawe kamimakunaa laferedume kamitaagasu me'emanaane tehone zanede lebwane baalaathanaakarene noro lebwa balejwa laaye bathaame kamanethalethalu yatanasaa lejee nawe belaa letenaagare 'ejege qarebaa nabare.

lejwane wanezu wesethe kathaalacewe baxwaalaa la'ehetu <<ba'esu laaye mene 'enedamifatsemu faanaawene takataye>> 'alacaate. fire`aawenenaa hhezebocu 'ehetu mahonwane 'enaa wareeweneme 'enedametekataatale 'enedaayaawequbaate karuqe honaa 'ayacewe.

musaame ba'alaahe yamaasetanaabare thebabe yaseetocene thute kamathebaate taaqaba. 'ehetu lejune lamaasethabaate yaalaacawene gugute baayaceme gizee <<'esune bamaathebaatenaa bamanekabaakabe leyu taqoreqwaari yahonune beetasaboce laamalaaketaacehune?>> 'alace.

'alaahe yamusaane 'ajamaamare kagalatza baxwaalaa yawathaatenate gizeewene 'asekatelo bamagelatse 'enedihe 'ala -
'akaale badanebe beretaatenaa thenekaaree yamiyaaganyebate ya`edemee kelele 'enedadarasanaa gulebatume bathanakara gizee kanabiyenatume 'aseqademane sela 'eseraa'eele lejoce yahaayemaanote mamariyaa 'eweqatenenaa genezaabeene sathanawe. musaane bamataazazu 'enedamanadaanawe hulu bayatenyaaweme gizeenaa botaa yaalu malekaame szariwocene 'enemanadaalane.

musaame sawoce beetaacawe 'erafete bamiyaadaregubate waqete wada katamaawaa gabaa. bakatamaawaame wesethe yamithaalunaa yamidabaadabu hulate sawocene 'aganya. 'anedanyaawe ka'eseraa'eele lejoce yamusaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) wagane nawe. leelaanyaawe dagemo yamusaa thalaate kahonute yafire`aawene wagane gebetzaawi nabare. waganume thalaatu bahonawe gebetzaawi laaye 'enediradaawe thayaqawe. musaame gebetzaawiwene bathuchaa mataawe. metume thanekaaraa selanabare gadalawe. musaame (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enedihe 'ala:: <<yehe kashayethwane tanekolenaa maataalale nawe. shayethwane latakatalute 'asaasaace 'enaa geletze thalaate nawe. yeheme kanee yatakasatawe bathalaatenatu 'enedihume 'eneene lamaasaasaate yamishaa 'athemaamime bamahonu mekeneyaate nawe.>>

musaame thefaatune bamaamane geetaawene 'eyatamaatzana 'enedihe 'ala:: <<geetaayee hoye! 'enee yehenene gebetzaawi bamagedalee nafeseene badeyaalahunaa hathi'aateene maaranye.>> 'alaaheme maarawe. 'eresu kabaarocu wada 'eresu yamimalasutene mahari la'enasume 'azaanye nawe.
mamaatsanuneme bamaqathale 'enedihe 'ala:: <<geetaayee hoye! 'aneta la'enee sela lagasekanye gulebate, 'eweqatenaa thebabe la'amatzanyoce fatsemo radaate 'alehoneme>> 'ala.

gebetzaawiwene bamagedalume mekeneyaate yamikasatawene nagare bamathabaqenaa baferehaate wesethe hono bakatamaawaa wesethe qoya badenegateme yaa telaanetenaa bagebetzaawiwe thalaatu laaye 'eredaataane yathayaqawe sawe baleelaa gebetzaawi laaye 'enediradaawe bamachohe 'eredaataane yethayeqawaale. musaa la'eresu <<ba'eregetheme 'aneta geletze thamaamaa 'enaa 'amatzanyaa nahe>> 'alawe.

musaame yaanene laresu 'enaa la'eseraa'eelaawiwe sawe thalaate yahonawene gebetzaawi 'eremejaa liwasedebate sile 'eseraa'eelaawiwe musaa (inWaka laGawiyW mWubiyn) <<'aneta 'eko geletze thamaamaa nahe>> belote sela nabara ligadelanye nawe belo bamaasabe <<musaa hoye! tenaanetenaa nafesene 'enedaathafaakxawe hulu letegadelanye tefalegaalahene?! bamedere laaye sawocene bamagedalenaa bamabadale xaayelanyaa mahonene 'eneji bahulate sawoce mahhakale bamaasetaaraqe kamalekaame szariwoceme mahone 'atefalegeme>> 'alawe.

yagedeyaa wareeweme batasaraacha gizee kakatamaayetume raaqe kaalawe botaa 'anede sawe bamusaa laaye 'enedaayedaresubate bamaferaate 'enaa la'eresume bamaazane 'eyarotha mathaa. <<musaa hoye! yafire`aawene wagane shumaamenetoce 'anetane ligadeluhe 'eyatamakaakaru nawenaa kahagare wethaa. 'anetane 'agenyetawe 'enedaayegadeluhe 'enee laaneta bamaazane bataamaanyenate makaarihe nanye.>> 'alawe.

musaa yamakaariwene te'ezaaze bamafatzame mene lifathare yecelaale bamile segaate 'enaa theneqaaqee bamaaderage kahagare wathaa. geetaaweneme bamamaatzane 'enedihe 'ala:: <<geetaayee hoye! kefu nagare 'enedaayaadaresubenye kabadalanyocu hhezeboce 'adenanye.>>
wada madeyane 'aqethaachaa fitune baazora gizeeme 'enedihe 'ala:: <<geetaayee qathetanyaawene manegade 'enedaalesete wada malekaamune manegade 'enedamimaraanye ba'eregetheme 'amenaalahu.>>

yamadeyane sawoce kabetocaacawene weha yamiyaathathubate botaa 'enedadarasame kabetocaacawene yamiyaathathu sawoce 'aganya. ka'enaresu zeqe belome sawoce kabetocaacawene 'esekiyaathathu derase feyalocaacawene wehawene 'enedaayethathu siyaagedu hulate seetocene 'aganya. musaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) <<lamahonu kasawoce gaare yamaataathathubate mekeneyaate menedene nawe?>> 'alaacawe. <<'enyaa huleeme 'enemathaalane gene 'eranyocu hulu 'esekimalasu derase ka'enasu gaare laalamaqalaaqale bamaferaate 'anaathathaame. 'abaataaceneme 'edemeewe yagafaa teleqe shemaagelee nawe maathathaate 'ayeceleme. mamethaataaceneme feyalocaacenene maathathaate yagede selahona nawe>> 'alute.

la'enasu bamaazaneme manegaawocaacawene 'athathaalaacawe. kaziyaame wada thelaawe 'erafete lamaaderage zaware 'alanaa, wada geetaawe gudaayune bamaaqerabe, <<geetaayee hoye! ba'ahune sa`aate 'aneta wada 'enee lametaawaredawe malekaame nagare hulu 'ejege falaaginaa kajaaye nanye>> 'ala.

hulatume seetoce wadabeetaacawe baheedu gizee la'abaataacawe nagarutenaa 'abaateyaweme kahulatu 'anedwane 'enedetetharaawe laakaate. `aayenaafaarenatene talaabesaa wada 'esu bamamethaate 'enedihe 'alacewe:: <<'abaatee lanyaa yaathathaahelenene waagaa likafelehe bamaasabe yetharaahale.>> musaame yahulatu seetoce 'abaate zanede 'enedamathaa taarikune sinagerawe 'esune bamaaragaagaateme 'enedihe 'alawe:: <<'ateferaa kabadalanyocu hhezeboce denahale. kafire`aawenenaa kashumaamenetu denahale. bamadeyane laaye meneme `aayenate selethaane yalaacaweme. 'anetane ligoduheme 'ayecelume.>>

kaseete lejocu 'anedanyaawaa 'enedihe 'alace:: <<'abaatee hoye! feyalocene 'enedithabeqelene qetharawe. gulebate 'enaa taamaanyenate baaherine ba'anede laaye talaabeswale. gulebate yatasathawene gedeetaa lamawathaate yamiradaawe sihone taamaanyenate dagemo yatasathawene 'adaraa lamathabaqe yeradaawaale. bamahonume leteqatherawe yegabaale.>>

walaaje 'abaataacaweme musaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'enedihe 'alawe:: <<ka'enazihe hulate seete lejocee 'anedanyaawaane lederehe 'efalegaalahu. theloshwame yamihonawe feyalocaacenene lasemenete `aamataate ba'eranyenate mathabaqe nawe. 'asere `aamate 'edafenaalahu kaalekeme yehe yaaneta welataa sihone 'alaasegadedeheme. mekeneyaatume welaacene semenete `aamate bamahonu 'anetane yamiyaasecagere nagare 'alaasegadedeheme. ba'alaahe faqaademe qaalaacawene kamithabequ 'enaa kamaayaafaresu dagaagoce honyee taaganyanyaalahe.>>

musaame (`aalayehi 'asalaame) <<yehe wele ba'eneenaa baaneta mahakale yaala qaale kidaane nawe. kahulatu gizeeyaate maanenyaaweneme, semenete `aamataatene wayeme 'asere `aamataatene bemolaa yaalabenyene gedeetaa tawathecaalahu. chemaari 'enedaatethayeqanye. 'alaaheme batawaawaalenawe gudaaye laaye wakilenaa tathabaabaaqi mesekere nawe>> 'ala.

musaame yatasemaamubatene yatashaalanaa yatamwalaawene 'aserune `aamataate 'enedacharasanaa kabeetasabocu gaare kamadeyane wada gebetze baheeda gizee kathure taraaraa gone 'esaatene 'aya. labeetasabu 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<'ezihe thabequnye! 'esaatene 'ayecaalahu. mene'alebaateme ka'ereswa 'akaabaabi yahona waree 'aliyaame 'esaate 'enedetaaqathaathelunaa kaberedume temoqu zanede ka'esaatu cebo yezheelaacehu>> 'emathaalahunye.

musaame yaayaate 'esaate gaare bamathaame gizee geetaawe (subehaanahu wata`aalaa) kamusaa basetaqanye kaalawe zaafe bakule kamiganyawe shalaqo 'enaa katakabarawe botaa, <<musaa hoye! 'enee yafethuraanu hulu geetaa, 'alaahe nanye>> bamaalate tharaawe.

<<betereheneme thaale>> tabaala. musaa yageetaawene te`ezaaze bamafatzameme thaalaate. 'eneda 'ebaabe seteneqasaaqasenaa seteselakalake baayaateme gizee baferehaate wada xwaalaa zoro shasha. kasheshetume 'aletamalasame. <<musaa hoye! tamalase 'ateferaame. ka'ereswame hona kamifaru leeloceme nagaroce hulu yatathabaqeke nahe.>> bamaalate geetaaweme tharaawe.

<<qanye 'ejehene ba'anegatehe sere wada bebetehe wesethe 'asegabaa yaala lametze nache honaa tewathaalace.>> musaame 'ejune 'asegabeto siyaawathaa 'eneda barado nache honaa wathaace. <<ferehaatehe sakane 'enedile 'ejeheneme wadaaneta sabesabe 'aderege.>> musaame 'ejune sabesabe siyaadaregawe ferehaatu laqaqawe. 'enazihe yatathaqasute betere 'enaa 'eje kageetaahe lafire`aawene 'enaa lashumaamenete waganocu yatalaaku maaserajaawoce naacawe. 'enasu ba'alaahe bamakaadenaa hathi'aatocene bamafatzame ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yawathu 'amatzanyoce hhezeboce bamahonaacawe nawe.

musaa geetaawene bamamaatsane 'enedihe 'ala:: <<geetaayee hoye! 'enee ka'enaresu yahonane gelasabe gadeyaalahu. selaziheme yatalaakubatene male'ekete lamaaderase 'enasu gaa heejee 'enedaayegadelunye 'efaraalahu.

wanedemeeme haarune 'eresu ka'enee yatashaala yamanaagare celotaa yaalawe bamahonu fire`owenenaa waganocu biyaasetabaabelunye 'enekwaa radaate yehonelenyaalenaa kanee gaare laakawe. ka'enee bafite 'enedanabarute kahadi hhezeboce male'eketanyoce talekawelaacawe male'eketanyocene 'enedaasetabaabalute hulu fire`aawene 'enaa hhezebocu yaasetabaabelunyaale beyee 'efaraalahu.>>

'alaaheme lamusaa metsaanee melaashe bamasethate:: <<musaa hoye! wanedemehene kaaneta gaare male'eketanyaa 'enaa radaate 'aderegane bamalaake 'enaabarataahalane. lahulataacehume bathalaatocaacehu laaye maaserajaane 'enaa 'eredaataane 'enaadaregaalane. yametethalutene kefu nagare ba'enaaneta 'ayaadaresubaacehume. 'aneqatzocaacenene bamayaaze hidu. 'enaanetanaa kame'emanaane yatakatalaacehume hulu 'ashanaafiwoce naacehu. thalaatocaacehu fire`aawene 'enaa waganocu tashanaafiwoce naacawe.>> 'alaacawe.

musaame (`alayehi 'asalaame) geletze yahonu ta`aameraatocaacenene 'enaa 'aneqatzocaacenene yezo simathaalaacawe <<yehe musaa yaqathafawe degemete 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame. yeheneneme gude baqadametocu walaajocaacene sametane yamaanaaweqawe nawe>> 'alu.

musaame fire`owenene malese sisathawe 'enedihe 'alawe:: <<geetaayee maane 'ewenatanyaa hono ka'eresu zanede qathetanyaawene manegade yezo yamathaawene 'enedihume bamacharashaawe hagare yaamaara fetsaamee lamaane 'enedahona yaaweqaale. 'enaho badalanyoce yafelaagotaacawe tasaaketolaacawe; kamisagute bamadaane lasekeete 'ayebaqume.>>

fire`oweneme babakulu lashumaamenete waganocu 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<'enaaneta hhezeboce hoye! la'enaaneta ka'enee weche leelaa tamalaaki 'alaaweqelaacehume. haamaane hoye! cheqaawene thube 'esekihone derase ba'esaate 'aqaathelawenaa yamusaane 'amelaake lamaagenyate 'enaa lamaayate 'ecele zanede samaaye thaqase genebe ganebaalenye. musaa wada 'enee 'enaa wada waganocee ka'alaahe talekeeyaalahu selamilawe nagare weshataame nawe beyee 'egametaalahu.>>

fire`owene 'enaa szaraawitocu kuraataacawe barataa; yaala 'agebaabeme bagebetze medere laaye yabalaaye honu; kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene 'asetabaabalu; batenesaa'eeweme qane lameremaraanaa laqethaate wada 'enyaa yamaayemalasu masalaacawe.

'eresune 'enaa szaraawitune yaazenaacawenaa 'enedisathemume baahhere wesethe thaalenaacawe hulume motu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yabadalanyoce macharashaanaa fetzaamee 'enedeete 'enedanabara 'asetawele! macharashaacawe 'enaa fetzaameeyaacawe thefaate hono qara.

bamiyaasaraachute kehedatenaa themate saabiyaa la'amatzanyocenaa lathamaamoce wada 'esaate yamithaaru mariwoce 'adaragenaacawe. baqiyaamaaheme (batenesaa'eeweme) 'elate 'enasune ka'esaate bamaadaane yamiradaacawe radaate 'ayenoraacaweme. yelequnese badanagagute yawanejale 'enaa yathefaate falage 'enaa wada themate baadaragute sabakaame yatanasaa qethaatu 'ethefe yedaragabaacawaale. baziheme deregitaacawe yaraasaacawenaa 'enasune yatakatalwacawe sawoce hathi'aate yetzaafebaacawaale.

bazihece baqerebitu `aalame kaqethaataacawe batachamaari weredatenenaa 'eregemaanene 'asekatalenebaacawe. baqimaaheme (tenesaa'eeweme) qane 'enasu ka'alaahe 'ezenate kamibaararute 'enaa kamiwaqasute naacawe.

yaalafute yakefela zamanaate hhezeboceme male'eketanyocene lekane bamaasetabaabalaacawe mekeneyaate kaathafaane baxwaalaa lasawoce yamithaqemaacawene bamaayate lisarubate yamigodaacaweneme litawe, wada malekaame nagareme yamimaraacawe, bawesethume baduneyaanaa bamacharashaawe `aalame yamithaqemaacawene yamithaqume 'ezenateme sihone ya'alaaheneme tzagaa bamaamaseganenaa ba'esu bamaamane yegasatzu zanedeme lamusaa taweraatene baregethe sathanawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! wada fire`owenenaa shumaamenetu bamalaake wada musaa te'ezaazene baawaradenelate gizee kamusaa bakule kataraaraawe me'eraabaawiwe gone 'alenabarekeme. lasawoce bamaawaqehe tetarekelaacaweme zanede 'eziyaa botaa laaye kataganyuteme 'alenabarekeme. yametetarekelaacawe nagare 'eresu 'alaahe wadaaneta yaawaradalehe raa`eye nawe.

genaa 'enyaa kamusaa baxwaalaa hhezebocenenaa fethuraanene 'aseganyane. ya'alaahene qaale kidaane 'esekirasu deraseme gizeewe razamabaacawe. nagaru yamadeyane hhezeboce gaare nawaari honahe 'aneqatzocaacenene yametaanabelaacawe 'alenabarekeme. nagare gene 'enyaa lekanehe yamusaane taarikenaa madeyaneme yenore 'enedanabare raa`eye 'awaradenelehe bamahonume 'alaahe yaawaradalehene raa`eye maszarate bamaaderage lasawoce taarikune tarekelaacawe.

musaane senetharaawe 'enaa yaawaradenelatene male'ekete senaawaredelate yatakasatawene lasawoce tenageraacawe zanede bataraaraawe gone 'alenabarekeme. nagare gene kageetaahe bahona 'ezenate lasawoce laakenehe. bamahonume ka'aneta bafite yamiyaasethanaqecaacawe 'asethaneqaaqi yaalemathaalaacawene hhezeboce yegasatzu zanede 'enedetaasethanaqeqaacawe ka'alaahe zanede yezahe yamathaahelaacawene yaamenume zanede yehenene taarike raa`eye 'awaradenelehe.

bagazaa 'ejaacawe bafatsamute kehedatenaa hathi'aatoce mekeneyaate ya'amelaake qethaate bamiyaaganyaacawe gizeenaa male'eketanyaa 'alamalaakune bamaamakaanyate <<geetaacene hoye! 'aneqatzocehene 'enedenekatalenaa 'enedeneszaraabate yageetaacaweneme te'ezaaze kamifatsemute me'emanaaneme 'enedenehone male'eketanyaane lamene 'atelekeleneme nabare?>> yamilu baayehonu noro baqethaate 'enaathaadefaacawe nabare. nagare gene 'enyaa yaalehona maasetabaabayaa 'enedaayaaqarebu male'eketanyaane wadanaresu bamalaake qethaatune 'azagayanawe.

muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) kageetaacawe zanede laqurayeshoce male'eketene yezo simathaalaacawe 'ayehudocene sela 'esu thayeqawe basathwacawe maaserajaa masarate <<lamusaa kageetaawe malaakune yamiyaaseradu ta`aameraate 'eneda betere 'enaa 'eje `aayenate lamuhhamade 'ayesathaweme nabarene?!>> 'alu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! melaashe bamasethateme 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<lamahonu 'ayehudoce kazihe bafite musaa batasathawe 'alekaadumene?>> 'enediheme 'alu:: <<qure'aane 'enaa taweraate 'anedu leelaawene yamidagefe hulatume degemetoce naacawe 'enyaa taweraateneme hona qure'aanene kedanaale.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lanazihe sawoce <<ka'alaahe zanede yawarada 'enaa kataweraatenaa kaqure'aane yebalethe qene yahonawene 'eseti 'amethu. qure'aane 'enaa taweraate degemetoce naacawe bametelute 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu 'amethulenyenaa lekatalawe. balaacawe.>>

kaqure'aane 'enaa kataweraate yabalatha qene yahonane matsehhafe 'enediyaamathu bagaabazekaacawe maszarate melaashe yamaayesathuhe kahona, maasetabaabalaacawe ka'ewenatanyaa maaserajaa 'enedaalehona 'eregethanyaa hune. yamikatalute zenebaaleewocaacawene becaa mahonune 'ewaqe. ka'alaaheme yahona mamariyaa saayenorawe zenebaaleewene katakatala sawe yebalethe yathamama 'anedeme yalame. 'alaahene bamakaade nafesocaacawene yabadalu hhezebocene 'alaahe tekekelanyaawene manegade 'ayemaraacaweme; sekeetaamaame 'ayaadaregaacaweme.

la'agaariwoce 'enaa ka'eseraa'eele lejoce lahonute 'ayehudoce yaalafutene hhezeboce taarike 'enedihume male'eketanyocene bamaasetabaabalaacawe mekeneyaate yaawaradenebaacawe qethaate `aayenate 'enedaayaagaathemaacawe yegasatzu 'enaa yaamenu zanede qaalene baregethe 'akataatalene.

'enaziyaa qure'aane kamawaradu bafite taweraatene yasathanaacawe ba'emenataacawe yatzanu matsehhafaacawe wesethe sela 'esu bamanagarunaa batagalatzawe maszarate selamiyaaganyute baqure'aane yaamenaalu.

baminababelaacaweme gizee <<ba'esu 'amenanaale. 'eresu kageetaacene yawarada yahona meneme therethere yaleelawe 'ewenate nawe. 'enyaa kaqure'aane bafite muselimoce nabarene. ka'esu bafite bamathuteme male'eketanyoce 'amaanyoce nabarene>> yelaalu.

'enaziyaa kalaaye yatagalatsute bamatsehhafaacawe bamaamane bamataagasaacawenaa muhhamademe (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) silaaku bamaamanaacawe yaszeraacawene waagaa hulate gizee yesathaalu. yasarutene hathi'aateme bamiszarute malekaame szeraawoceme yegafateraalu. kasathanaacaweme sisaaye bamalekaame nagaroce laaye yelagesaalu.

'enaziyaa 'amaanye yamatsaahhefete baalabeetoce ka'agaariwoce yahonane wedeqe yahonane negegere basamu gizee meneme botaa saayesathute ka'eresu yereqaalu. deregitune fatsaamiwoceneme 'enedihe yelwacawaale:: <<'enyaa yaszeraawocaacenene wetheete 'enaaganyaalane. la'enenaatame yaszeraawocaacehu wetheetene 'alalaacehu. ka'enyaa sedebe 'enaa maasecagare salaame naacehu. 'enyaa maayemocene magodaanyate 'anefalegeme. mekeneyaatume baduneyaa 'enaa ba'emenate laaye gudaatenaa cegere selaalawe nawe>> yelaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'abuthaalibenenaa yamasaasalutene 'aneta yawadadekawene lasekeete maabeqaate 'ateceleme. yelequnese 'alaahe becaa nawe yaashaawene lasekeete yamiyaabaqaawe. laqathetanyaawe manegade sekeete maane 'enedamibaqaa baasaalafawe 'eweqatu yebalethe `aawaaqi nawe.

kamakaa sawoce 'agaariwocu selaamene baalamakatalaacawe maasetabaabayaa bamaaqerabe 'enedihe 'alu:: <<'aneta yezahe yamathaakxawene 'eselemenaa benekatale thalaatocaacene bafethenate kamederaacene yaabaarerunaale (ba'agaaraacene laaye 'eyaalane fathaane 'eremejaa yewasedubenaale).>> lamahonu la'enazihe 'agaariwoce dame mafesaseme hona badale mafatsame kelekele bahonabate yahharamene (makaane) kelele; thalaatoce 'enasu laaye wararaa 'enedaayefatsemubaacaweme salaame yamiyaaganyubate 'enaa 'enyaame la'enasu sisaaye yehoneme zanede kahulume yaferaaferee `aayenatoceme wada 'enasu yamimathu bamaaderage la'enasu 'alaamacaacanelaacawemene?! yehunenaa 'abezaanyaawocaacawe 'alaahene yaamasagenu zanede yawaalalaacawene welataa 'ayaawequme.

senetenaa senete katamaa nawe 'alaahe ba'enasu laaye yalagasaacawene tzagaa bamakaadaacawe bawanejale 'enaa bahathi'aate wasane yaalafu bamahonume qethaate lekane yaathafaanawe. 'enaho kanawaariwocu baxwaalaa teneshe gizee 'eneji yaaletanorabaacawe theqite sawoce yamiyaalefubaacawe yathafu manoriyaawocaacawe naacawe. samaayaatene, mederene 'enaa bawesethaacawe yamiganyutene hulu waraashocu 'enyaa nane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaaheme 'anetane bakatamoce 'enaate (makaa) 'enedalaakahe hulu, bamanedarocu waanaa katamaa wesethe 'aneqatzocune ba'enasu laaye yamiyaanabe male'eketanyaane 'esekamileke derase yamiyaathafaa 'ayedalame; katamoceneme nawaariwocwa 'ewenate laaye qathe 'esekaalu derase yamenaathafaa 'ayedalaneme. yamenaathafaawe bakehedate 'enaa wanejalene bamafatzame badaayoce yahonutene nawe.

'agaariwoce yamiyaagaathemaacawene yathorenate cegerenaa yanegede maqwaarathe 'ewenatene laalamakatale laaqarabute maasetabaabayaa 'alaahe melaashene bamasethate 'enedihe 'ala -
geetaacehume yasathaacehu maanenyaaweme nagare baqerebitu `aalame 'enaa heyewate 'enedetethaqaaqamubatenaa 'enedetaageethubate nawe. kaziyaame yethafaale. 'alaahe zanede batenesaa'eewe qane yaalawe teleqe menedaa duneyaa wesethe kaalawe theqemenaa geethe balaachenaa zawetaari nawe. taadiyaa yehenene 'asetawelaacehu kathafiwe `aalame yeleqe zawetaarinaa qwaami yahonawene 'atemarethumene?!

lamahonu janatene 'enaa bawesethwa yaalawene zawetaari tzagaa qaale yagabaanelate sawe baqerebitu hheyewate yamithaqaaqamebatene kaganezabe 'enaa geethe sathetanawe kaziyaame 'eresu batenesaa'eewe qane lajahaname 'esaate kamiqarebu 'enedahonawe sawe nawene?!

geetaacawe (subehaanahu wata`aalaa) 'enaresune yamitharaabatene 'enaa <<'enaziyaa ka'enee wechi setaamalekwaacawe 'enaa 'agaarocee 'enedahonu tenaagarulaacawe yanabaraacehute yate naacawe?>> yamilebatene qane 'asetaawese.

'enaziyaa wada kehedate tathaari yahonutenaa qethaate yataragaagathabaacawe 'enedihe yelaalu:: <<'enazihe 'enyaa 'enedathamamenawe hulu yaathamamenaacawe sawoce wada 'aneta bamathagaate ka'enasu natzaa nane; yaamalekuteme yanabarawe shayethwanaatene 'eneji 'enyaane 'alenabarame.>>

'enediheme yebaalaalu:: <<kaalaacehubate weredate yaadenwacehume zanede tagaariwocaacehune 'eseti therwacawe.>> yetharwacawaaleme latheriyaacaweme melaashene 'ayesathwacaweme; yatazagaajalaacaweneme qethaate yemalakataalu; bazihene gizee baduneyaawe heyewate la'ewenate batamaraane noro belawe yemanyaalu.
geetaacaweme <<wada 'enaaneta yalaakexwaacawene male'eketanyoceene mene melaashe sathaacehu>> belo yamitharaacawene qane 'asetaawese.

baziyaane qaneme lamakaraakariyaanate yamiyaaqarebute maaserajaa yesawarebaacawenaa meneme maasetaawase 'ayecelume. wada qethaateme maameraataacawene 'eregethanyaa bamahonaacawe baagaathamaacawe kafetanyaa denegaathee yatanasaa 'erese ba'eresaacaweme 'ayethayaayaqume.

ka'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce kakehedatu yatatzatzatanaa ba'alaahe 'enaa bamale'eketanyoce yaamana; malekaameneme szeraa yaszaraa; 'enaresu yamifalegutene bamaagenyate 'enaa kamifarute nagare natzaa bamawethaate kamidenute ba'eregetheme yehonaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaaheme mafethare yamifalegawene yefatheraale. lanabiyenate 'enaa 'eresune lamataazaze yamifalegawene yemarethaaleme. la'agaariwoceme 'alaahene yamaqaawame merechaa yalaacaweme. 'alaahe kamaayegabaawe yataqadasanaa ka'eresu gaare ba'amelekote kamigaaruteme yalaaqa geetaa nawe.
geetaaheme lebocaacawe yamidabequtenenaa geletze yamiyaadaregutene hulu yaaweqaale. ka'esu meneme yamisawarebate nagare yalame. baziheme yemanadaacawaale.

'eresume 'alaahe nawe. ka'eresu leelaa ba'ewenate yamimalake yalame. baduneyaame hona ba'akxiraawe `aalame mesegaanaa la'eresu becaa nawe. meneme mamalaashaa yaleelawe tafatzaami feredenaa wesaanee ya'eresu becaa nawe. baqiyaamaahe qaneme lagemegamaanaa lamenedaame wada 'eresu becaa nawe yametemalasute.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enazihe 'agaariwoce:: <<'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye leelitene 'eseka tenesaa'eewe qane derase zawetaari 'enaa yamaayeqwaarathe biyaadaregebaacehu; lamahonu ka'alaahe leelaa 'eneda qanu berehaane berehaanene yamiyaamathaalaacehu 'amelaake maanawe? 'enazihene maaserajaawoce sametaacehu ka'alaahe leelaa yamiyaamathaalaacehu 'amelaake 'enedaleela 'ataawequmene? 'eseti negarunye>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enazihe 'agaariwoce, <<'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye qanene 'eseka tenesaa'eewe qane derase zawetaari 'enaa yamaayeqwaarathe biyaadaregebaacehu lamahonu ka'alaahe leelaa kaqane szeraa lefaataacehu yametaarefubatene leelite yamiyaamathaalaacehu 'amelaake maanawe? 'eseti negarunye. 'enazihene ta`aameraatoce bamamalekate yehenene hulu ka'alaahe leelaa yaala 'amelaake liyaamathaalaacehu 'enedamaayecele 'ateganazabumene?!>>

'enaaneta yasawe lejoce hoye! ka'ezenatume leelitune chalamaa bamaaderage qanune baszeraa setelafu kawaalaacehu baxwaalaa 'enedetaarefubate; qanene dagemo berehaanemaa bamaaderage sisaayene felagaa 'enedeteneqasaaqasubatenaa sela sathaacehume tzagaa 'enedetaamasagenutenaa fetsume 'enedaatekedute sile yehenene 'adaragalaacehu.
geetaacawe, <<'enaziyaa kanee wechi setegazwacawe 'enaa 'agaarocee setaadaregwaacawe yanabaraacehute yate naacawe?>> bamaalate yamithaaraabatene qane 'asetaawese.

ka'eyaanedaanedu hhezebeme yanabarubatene kehedatenaa maasetabaabale yamimasakerubaacawe nabiyaatocaacawene 'enaamathaanaa ka'enazihe hhezeboceme 'asetabaabaayocene yanabaraacehubatene kehedatenaa maasetabaabale 'aserajiyaacehune 'amethu 'enelaacawaalane. marajaacawe yethafaabaacawaale; meneme kerekere yaleelawe 'ewenate la'alaahe becaa mahonune yaaragaagethaalu. la'alaahe baweshate tagaari yaadaregwaacawe yanabarute 'akaaloceme yesawarubaacawaale.

'alaahe fire`owene medere laaye baselethaanu denebare maalafune kagalatza baxwaalaa qaarune dagemo baganezabe denebare 'enedaalafa sigaletse -
qaarune kamusaa waganoce nabare. ba'enaresume laaye koraa. yasathanaweme yaganezabe delebe (kemecete) mathaneme yakaazenaawocu qulefe kebedate gulebate yaalaacawe wesune sawoce mashakame yamisaanaacawe nawe. waganocume:: <> 'alute.

'alaaheme yasathahene ganezabe malekaame nagare laaye bamaawaale yamacharashaawene 'agare menedaa falege. baqerebitume `aalame yamegebe, yamathathe, yalebese 'enaa leeloceneme tzagaawoce yaala maabaakanenaa yaala kuraate yamathaqame dereshaahene 'ateresaa. 'alaaheme laaneta malekaame 'enedawaalalehe kageetaahe 'enaa kabaarocu gaare malekaamene 'aderege. wanejalene bamafatzame 'enaa te'ezaazene bamatawe bamedere wesethe thefaatene 'atefalege. 'alaahe medere wesethe 'athefiwocene 'ayewademe yelequnese yethalaacawaale 'alute.

qaaruneme yehenene ganezabe yatasathahute 'enee zanede baalawe 'eweqatenaa celotaa nawe. laziheme tagabi nanye'ala. 'alaahe ka'eresu bafite baxaayele ka'eresu yebalethe yabaratutene bahabetenaa qusene bamasabesabe yebalethe yabazutene yaathafaa mahonune qaarune 'ayaaweqemene? xaayelaacaweme hona ganezabaacawe 'alethaqamaacaweme. 'alaaheme selamiyaaweqawe 'amatzanyoce batenesaa'eewe qane sela hathi'aatocaacawe 'ayethayaqume. bithayaqume yatecete 'enaa yawaqasaa theyaaqee nawe.

qaaruneme 'agitho 'eyatanethabaarara wada hhezebocu wathaa. yaqaarune gwaade kahonute laqerebitu heyewate geethe leyu gugute yaalaacawe 'enedihe 'alu:: <<mene 'ala qaarune yatasathawe yaduneyaa geethe la'enyaame batasathane. qaarune yataalaaqe 'edele baalabeete nawe.>>

'enaziyaa 'eweqatene yatasathute, qaarunene 'agitho 'enedaayute 'enaa gwaadanyocu yatamanyutene basamu gizee <<wayolaacehu! ba'alaahe laamanunaa malekaame szeraane laszaru 'alaahe bamacharashaayetu `aalame yaazagaajawe tzagaanaa menedaa qaarune katasathawe yaqerebitu `aalame geethe balaache nawe. lazihece malekaame negegerenaa 'ereswa yametaasekatelawene malekaame szeraa lamaszeraate 'enaziyaa 'alaahe zanede yaalawene menedaa thafi kahonacewe yaduneyaa `aalame yamiyaasebalethu taagaashoce 'eneji leelaawe 'ayetaadaleme.>> 'alu.
wasane bamaalafu lamabaqale sibaale 'eresune, beetune 'enaa bawesethu yaalutene mederene 'asathamenebaacawe. ka'alaahe wechi yamiradute waganoce 'alenabaruteme. raasuneme maredaate 'alecaalame.

'enaziyaame kamasethamu 'aseqademo yanabarabatene ganezabenaa geethe tamanyetawe yanabarute sawoce bamagasatze 'enaa bamaqochate 'enedihe 'alu:: <<lakaase 'alaahe kabaarocu lafalagawe sisaayune yamiyaasafaa; lafalagawe yamiyaathabe mahonune 'alaawaqeneme. 'alaahe malekaame welolene sela tanaagarenawe saayeqathaane qareto nawe 'eneji qaarunene mederene 'enedaasathamabate 'enyaaneme yaasathemebene nabare.>> 'enaho kahadiwoce baqerebitume hona bamacharashaayetu `aalame 'ayedenume. yelequnese mamalashaacawenaa fetzaameeyaacawe keserate nawe.

yehecene yamacharashaa hagare 'enaziyaa bamedere ba'ewenate laaye makuraatene lamaayefalegunaa thefaateneme lamaayeshu 'amaanyoce yatzagaanaa yakebere 'agare 'enaadaregaataalane. bajanate wesethe yaalawene tzagaa 'enaa bawesethwame yamisafenawene ya'alaahene wedeetaa bamaagenyate yatamasaganacewe macharashaa yageetaacawene te'ezaaze lamifatsemunaa yakalakalawene lamirequ thenequqocu naate.

batenesaa'eewe qane 'eneda salaate, zakaahe, tzomenaa yamasaasalutene malekaame szeraa yezo yamathaa 'anedu malekaame szeraa ba'asere 'ethefe derebe bamaabaazaate kazihu malekaame szeraa yatashaala menedaa 'alawe. kehedate, walade mabelaate, zemutenaa masale yahathi'aate szeraawocene yezo yamathaa dagemo 'enaziyaa hathi'aatene fatsaamiwoce meneme chemaari saayedarage baszeraacawe `aayenate yemanadaalu.

yaa qure'aanene baaneta laaye yaawaradawe, maaderasene 'enaa ba'esu maszeraatene gedeetaa yaadaragabehe dele bamaaderage wada makaa yemalesehale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! - <<'enaho geetaayee qenune manegade yezo yamathaawenenaa ka'ewenate 'enaa kaqenu manegade geletse yahona sehetate laaye yaalawene yaaweqaale.>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kamalaakehe bafite qure'aane wadaaneta ka'alaahe mawaradune tasefaa yametaadarege 'alenabarekeme. nagare gene yageetaahe 'ezenate honanaa wada 'aneta maaweradune wasana. baalubate themate laaye lakahadiyaane radaate 'enedaatehone.

'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce 'alaahe wada'aneta 'aneqatzocune kaawarada baxwaalaa maanebabune 'enaa maaderasune 'enedetetawe 'ayaadereguhe. sawocene wada 'alaahe 'emenate, wada becanyenatu 'enaa bahegume 'enediszaru theraa. ka'alaahe gaare leelaane bamagazaate ka'agaariwocume 'atehune. yelequnese 'alaahene becaa babecanyenate kamigazute hune.

ka'alaaheme gaare leelaane 'amelaake 'ategazaa, ka'eresu baqare 'ewenatenyaa 'amelaake yalame. ka'alaahe fite basetaqare hulume nagare thafi nawe. feredu ya'esu becaa nawe yafalagawene yefaredaale. wada 'eresume batenesaa'eewe qane lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa temalasaalaacehu.
(lm) <<'alife laame mime>> (ba`arabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)
lamahonu sawoce ba'alaahe 'amenanaale bamaalataacawe becaa batekekele selamaamanaacawe saayefatanu yamitawe masalaacawene? nagaru 'enedagamatute 'ayedalame.

'enaziyaane ka'enasu bafite yanabarutene ba'eregethe fatenanaale; 'alaaheme ba'emenataacawe 'ewenatanyaa yahonutene 'enaa weshataamocuneme lanaaneta geletze bamaaderage yamagelatzene 'eweqate yaaweqaale.

wayenese 'enaziyaa sherekene 'enaa leeloce hathi'atocene yamitagaberu, yamiyaaqetune 'enaa kaqethaataacene yamidenu yemaselaacawaalene? yamifaredute ferede yakafaa nawe; 'enasu ka'alaahe 'ayaamalethume bakehedataacawe laaye honawe kamotume kaqethaatu 'ayedenume.

batenesaa'ee qane menedaawene limanadaawe 'alaahe fite maqomene tasefaa yamiyaadarege sawe 'alaahe laziyaa qane yaqatharawe qatharo ba'eregethe baqerebe qane machi 'enedahona yewaqe! 'eresume yabaarocune negegere sami; szeraacawene `aawaaqi nawe; meneme yamiyaamalethawe nagare yalame; yemanadaacawaale.

'alaahene bamataazazenaa kahathi'aate bamaraaqe nafesune yataagala 'enedihume ba'alaahe manegademe yataagala yamitaagalawe laraasu nawe; mekeneyaatume theqemu wadaresu tamalaashe nawenaa; 'alaahe kafethuraane hulu ba'eregethe yatabeqaaqaa nawe; ya'enasu mataazaze selethaanune 'ayechamerelateme; maamatzaacaweme kaselethaanu 'ayeqanesebateme.

'enaziyaa yaamanu, senefatenaacaweme yataagasu 'enaa malekaame szeraawoceneme yaszaru, baszarute malekaame szeraawocaacawe yatanasaa hathi'aatocaacawene 'enesarezelaacawaalane. baqerebitu `aalame yeszarute kanabarute batashaala batenesaa'eewe qane 'enemanadaacawaalane.

yasawene leje lawalaajocu malekaamene 'enediyaadaregenaa 'eneditaazazaacawe 'azazenawe; 'aneta yasawe leje hoye! sa`ede bine 'abi waqaase ka'enaatu 'enedadarasabate `aayenate walaajocehe ba'enee laaye 'enedetaagaaraa bitaagaluhe 'atetaazazaacawe; mekeneyaatume fathaarine bamaamatze fethurene mataazaze kelekele nawenaa. batenesaa'eewe qane mamalashaacehu wadanee becaa nawe; baduneyaa teszarute yanabaraacehuteneme hulu 'enageraacaxwaalahu; baszeraacehume 'emanadaacexwaalahu.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanu, malekaame szeraawoceneme yaszaru, batenesaa'eewe qane kadagaagocu gaare 'enaasegabaacawaalane; ka'enasu gaare 'enesabasebaacawaalane; 'eneda 'enasume menedaa 'enemanadaacawaalane.

kasawoceme ba'alaahe 'amenyaalahu kaala baxwaalaa: bamaamanu yatanasaame kahadiyaanoce siyaasaqaayute ya'enasune maasaqaayate leke 'eneda 'alaahe qethaate 'aderego bamaasabe kakahadiyaanoce gaare bamagethame ka'emenatu yeqalabasaale; 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'alaaheme zanede 'eredaataa 'enaa 'egazaame setaaganye; 'enedihe yelaale:: <<me'emanaane hoye! ba'ewenate ka'enaaneta gaare nabarene; lamahonu 'alaahe basawoce lebe wesethe yaalawene `aawaaqi 'ayedalamene?! bawesethu yaalawe kehedatenaa 'emenate 'ayesawarebateme; lamahonuse 'alaahe balebaacawe wesethe yaalawene ka'enaresu yabalatha yamiyaaweqe hono saala: balebaacawe wesethe yaalawene 'enedeete 'aderegawe linagerute yecelaalune?!
'alaaheme 'enaziyaane ba'ewenate ba'esu yaamanutene yaaweqaale. 'enaziyaane 'emenatene geletze bamaaderage kehedate bawesethaacawe yamidabequtene manaafeqaaneneme yaaweqaale.

'enaziyaa kahadiyaanoceme ba'alaahe 'anedenate laamanute me'emanaane 'enedihe yelwacawaale:: <<haayemaanotaacenenaa yaalanebatene manegade takatalu; 'enyaa ya'enaanetane hathi'aate 'eneshakamenaa ba'enaanetame faanetaa ba'ezihu 'enemanadaalane.>> lanagaru 'enasume kahathi'aatocaacawe meneneme 'ayeshakamume; yeheneneme silu weshataamoce naacawe.

'enasu yaleelaawene hathi'ate 'ayeshakamume yamilawe wada themataacawe yamitharu kahaadiyaanoce bazihe mekeneyaate tachamaari hathi'aate 'ayenorebaacaweme yamile genezaabee liyaasekatele selamicele; yehenene genezaabee lamaasetakaakale 'enedihe yelaale::
wada themataacawe yamithaarute 'agaariwoce yafatsamutene wanejale mazaze yeshakamaalu. ya'enasune theri yatakatalaweneme sawe wanejale meneme saayeqanase yeshakamaalu. batenesaa'eewe qaneme baduneyaa yeqathefute sela nabarawe weshate ba'eregethe yethayaqaalu.

nuhheneme wada hhezebocu male'eketanyaa 'aderegane laakenawe. ba'enasu wesethe zathanye mato hamesaa 'amate wada 'alaahe 'anedenate (tawehhide) 'eyatharaacawe taqamatha. bakehedataacawe bamazawetare 'asetabaabalute. 'enasu 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyocene bamakaade badaayoce honawe yawehawe maathelaqelaqe yaazaacawe. bamasethame thafu.
nuhhene 'enaa bamarekabwa wesethe ka'eresu gaare yanabarutene me'emanaane bamasethame kamathefaate 'adaanenaacawe. marekabwaneme sawoce yamigasatzubate magasachaa 'adaragenaate.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! beraahime lahhezebocu <<'alaahene becaa tagazu. yasune te'ezaaze bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe qethaatune tathaneqaqu. yehe yataazazawe nagare malekaame mahonune yametaawequ betehonu la'enaaneta balaache nawe.>> baala gizee taarikune 'awesaa.

'enaaneta 'agaariwoce yametaamalekute yamaayethaqemunaa yamaayegodu thaa`otaatene nawe. 'amelekote yegabaacawaale setelu weshatene teqathefaalaacehu. 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe leelaa yametegazwacawe la'enaaneta sisaaye ba'ejaacawe sere hono sisaayene lisathwacehu 'ayecelume. bamahonume sisaayene ka'alaahe zanede becaa falegu. babecanyenate 'eresune becaa tagazu. sela sathaacehume sisaaye 'amasegenute. batenesaa'eewe qane lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa wada thaa`otocaacehu saayehone wada 'eresu becaa nawe yametemalasute.

'enaaneta 'agaariwoce muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yezote yamathaawene betaasetabaabelume kafitaacehu yanabarute hhezeboce 'eneda nuhhe hhezeboce, `aadoce, samudoce 'enaa yamasaasalute ba'eregethe 'asetabaabelawaale. bamale'eketanyaaweme laaye geletze yahona maaderase 'eneji leelaa yalabateme. geetaawe 'enediyaadarese yaazazawene wadanaaneta 'adereswale.

lamahonu 'enazihe 'agaariwoce 'alaahe fethuraanene bamajamariyaa 'enedeete 'enedafathara; kathafume baxwaalaa daageme 'enedeete 'enedamimalesaacaweme 'ayemalakatumene?! yehe nagare la'alaahe qalaale nawe. meneme yamaayesaanawe hulune nagare caaye nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<bamedere laaye tagwaazu 'alaahe fethuraanene 'enedeete bamajamariyaa 'enedafathara tamalekatu. kaziyaame 'alaahe sawocene kamotu baxwaalaa lagemegamaa daageme hheyaawe 'aderego yeqasaqesaacawaale. 'alaahe hulune nagare caaye nawe. meneme 'ayesaanaweme. sawocene bamajamariyaa mafethare 'enedaaletasaanawe hulu kamote baxwaalaame maqaseqase 'ayesaanaweme.

kafethuru bafetehu yaashaawene yeqathaale. kafethurume bacerotaawe laashaawe yaazenaale. kamaqaaberaacehu hheyaawe bamaaderage batenesaa'ee qane bamiqasaqesaacehu gizee lagemegamaa wada 'eresu becaa temalasaalaacehu.

kageetaacehume 'ataamalethume. bamedereme hona basamaaye kaqethaatume maafatelake 'atecelume. ka'alaaheme gudaayaacehune bamayaaze yamiradaacehu wadaaje, qethaatuneme yamiyaanasaalaacehu radaate yalaacehume.>>

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe 'aneqatzoce 'enaa batenesaa'eewe qane 'alaahe fite maqomene yaasetabaabalu sawoce ka'ezenatu tasefaa yaqorathu naacawe. bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate janate bafetzume 'ayegabume. batenesaa'eeme qane yamithabeqaacawe 'asaamaami qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale.

beraahime hhezebocune 'alaahene babecanyenate 'enedigazunaa kathaa`ote 'ameleko 'enedirequ kaazazaacawe baxwaalaa yahhezebocume malese <<'amaaleketocaacehune lamaredaate gedalute wayeme 'esaate wesethe bamathaale 'aqaathelute.>> maalate 'eneji leelaa 'alenabarame. ka'esaateme 'alaahe 'adaanawe. beraahimene 'esaate wesethe kathaalute baxwaalaa bamaadaanu wesethe lamiyaamenu hhezeboce ta`aameraate 'alabate. bata`aameraatu tathaqaamiwocu 'enaresu naacawe.

beraahimeme lahhezebocu <<ka'alaahe leelaa thaa`otaatene 'amaalekete 'aderegaacehu yayaazaacehute baqerebitu hheyewate 'erese ba'eresaacehu lamatawaawaqe 'enaa lamawaadade becaa nawe. kaziyaame baxwaalaa batenesaa'ee qane bamahakalaacehu yanabarawe wedeetaa yeqwaarathaale. qethaatune bametaayubate qaneme kafilaacehu kafilune yekedaale. kafilaacehume kafilune yeragemaale. yametenorubaate manoriyaacehume 'esaate naate. la'enaanetame ka'alaahe leelaa yametegazwacawe thaa`otaateme hona leeloce ka'alaahe qethaate yamiyaagedwacehu radaatoce meneme yalaacehume.>>

lutheme baberaahime 'amana. <<'enee wada geetaayee wada tabaarakacewe yashaame medere tasadaaje nanye. 'enaho 'alaahe maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi; wada 'eresu yatasadadawene yamaayaawaarede, bamiwasenawe 'enaa bamiyaasetanaaberawe thebabanyaa nawe.>>

laberaahimeme sehhaaqene 'enaa yasehhaaqene leje yaa`equbene sathanawe. balejocume wesethe nabiyenatene 'enaa ka'alaahe yawaradu matsaahhefetene 'adaragene. 'ewenate laaye bamatzenaatu 'enaa taagaashe bamahonu theru lejocenenaa malekaame zenaane baqerebitu `aalame bamasethate manadaanawe. 'eresume bamacharashaayetu `aalame yadagaagocune menedaa yemanadaale. baduneyaa yatasathaweme menedaa bamacharashaayetu `aalame kamisathawe taalaaqe menedaa laaye 'ayeqanesebateme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! luthe hhezebocune <<'enaaneta tzayaafe tagebaarene teszaraalaacehune?! yehenene bamafatzame ka'enaaneta bafite ka`aalamaate maaneme 'aleqadamaacehume. 'enaaneta yehenene theenanyaa yahona 'a'emero yamaayeqabalawene tagebaare bamafatzame yamajamariyaawocu naacehu.>> yaalaacawene 'asetaawese.

<<'enaaneta ba'eregethe yafetewate semeetaacehune lamaarekaate wanedocene teganaanyaalaacehune?! ya'enaaneta 'atzayaafi deregite 'enedaayefatzamebaacawe bamasegaate yamiyaalefu manegadanyocene manegade teqorethaalaacehune? bamasabesabiyaacehume 'eyataraaqotaacehu ba'enaaneta bakule yamiyaalefene sawe banegegerenaa batagebaare magudaatene `aayenate mathefo tagebaaraatene teszaraalaacehune?>> 'alaacawe. kazihe 'atzayaafi deregite sikalakelaacawe; hhezebocu yasathute melaashe <<selametenaagarawe 'ewenatanyaa kahoneke yametezetebenene ya'alaahene qethaate 'eseti 'amethaabene>> yamile nabare.

hhezebocu getere bamaalate ya'alaahene qethaate bamaaqaalale 'enediyaawaredebaacawe kathayaqu baxwaalaa; luthe geetaawene bamamaatzane <<geetaayee hoye! medere laaye kehedatene 'enaa 'atzayaafi deregitene bamafatzame thefaatene bamiyaasefaafute 'amatzanyaa hhezeboce laaye 'eredaanye>> 'ala.

beraahimeneme basehhaaqe 'enaa baleje lejume yaa`eqube lamaabasare malaa'eketene balaakene gizee <<'enyaa yaluthe hhezeboce yasadome katamaa nawaariwocene bamisarute 'atzayaafi tagebaare badaayoce bamahonaacawe lenaathafaacawe nawe.>> 'alute.

beraahimeme (`aalayehi salaame) lamalaa'eketu 'enedihe 'alaacawe:: <<nawaariwocwane lamaathefaate yafalagaacehute katamaa wesethe luthe yeganyaale; 'eresume kabadaayoce 'ayedalame.>> malaa'eketume <<'enyaa bawesethwa yaalawene yebalethe 'awaaqiwoce nane; bakatamaawaa nawaariwoce laaye kamiwaredaweme qethaate kabaalabeetu basetaqare 'eresunenaa beetasabune 'enaadenaacawaalane;>> 'alute.

yaluthe hhezebocene lamaathefaate yalaakenaacawe malaa'eketocaaceneme wada luthe simathu hhezebocu mathefowoce bamahonaacawe mekeneyaate ba'enasu mamethaate 'azana. lebume tachanaqa. yeheme yahonawe malaa'eketu bawanedoce maleke tamaselawe bamamethaataacawe 'enaa 'enazihe sawoce dagemo seetocene tetawe wanedocene basemeete yeganaanyu selanabare nawe. malaa'eketume <<'ateferaa, hhezebocehe bakefu 'ayedaresubeheme. 'enasune bamaathefaataaceneme 'atezane. 'enyaa kabaalabeetehe basetaqare 'anetanenaa beetasaboceheneme 'enaadenaalane. 'ereswa gene bathefaate wesethe kamiqarute bamahonwa ka'enasu gaare 'enaathafaataalane.>> 'alute.

'enyaa bazihece katamaa nawaariwoce laaye yefatzemute banabarute 'asetzayaafi tagebaare mekeneyaate kasamaaye qethaate 'enaawaredaalane. yeheme qethaate bajahaname 'esaate katathabasawe denegaaye sihone yeheme yahonawe seetocene bamatawe wanedocene basemeete tzotaawi genenyunate bamaaderagaacawe ka'alaahe te'ezaaze weche bamahone 'asetzayaafi deregitene bamafatzamaacawe 'enasune lamaqethaate yaawaradenawe qethaate nawe.
yamiyaasetawelu sawoce tathaqaamiwoce yehonu zanede ba'eregetheme bazihece baathafaanaate katamaa wesethe geletze meleketene tetanaale ('aseqamethanaale).

wada madeyaneme yazare hharage wanedemaacawe yahonawene shu`ayebene (`aalayehi salaame) laakene. <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene becaa tagazu. 'esune bamagazaataacehume menedaawene bamacharashaawe qane ka'eresu thabequ. hathi'aatene bamaszeraatenaa bamaasaraachate medereneme 'ataabalaashu>> 'alaacawe.
hhezebocume 'asetabaabalute. yamedere maneqatheqathe darasabaacawe. bamanedaraacaweme wesethe fitocaacawe ka'afare gaare yatalathafu sihone yatadafu 'enaa yamaayeneqasaaqasu honu, 'alaqu.

'enedihume yahude hhezebocene, `aadocene 'enaa yaswalihhe hhezebocene samudoceneme 'athafaane. 'enaaneta yamakaa sawoce, kamanoriyaawocaacaweme <<hhaderamote>> ba<<hhijere>>naa <<shihhere>> botaawoce mathefaataacawene yamiyaamalaakete la'enaaneta baregethe tagalatsalaacehu; yafaraarasawe manoriyaacawe yehenene yemasakeraale. sayethaaneme yanabarubatene kehedate 'enaa leeloce hathi'aatocene la'enaresu 'ageethalaacawe; kaqathetanyaaweme manegade 'agadaacawe; male'eketanyocaacawe selaasetamaarwacaweme 'ewenatune 'enaa yatasaasaatawene manegade yamaasetawaale baalabeetoce nabaru; gene yaasetamaarwacawene manegade kamakatale yeleqe semeetene makatale marathu.

qaarune bamusaa hhezeboce laaye wasane baalafa gizee 'eresune 'enaa manoriyaawene mareete wesethe bamaasemathe 'athafaanawe. fire`aawenenenaa radaatune haamaaneneme baahhere wesethe bamaasethame 'athafaanaacawe. musaame 'ewenatanyaa mahonune yamiyaamalaaketu geletze yahonu ta`aameraatocene ba'eregethe yezolaacawe mathaa. bagebetze medereme laaye ba'esu kamaamane yeleqe koru. ka'enyaa bamaamelathe kaqethaataaceneme madaane 'ayecelume.

kalaaye yatathaqasutene hulu bawanejalaacawe mekeneyaate 'athefi bahonawe qethaataacene yaazenaacawe. ka'enasume yatathabasa denegaaye yalaqaqenebaacawe yaluthe hhezeboce yeganyubataale; bachukxate 'eremejaa yawasadanebaacaweme yasaalihhe 'enaa yashu`aayebe hhezeboceme yeganyubataale; 'eresune 'enaa beetuneme mederene yaasamathenebate qaarune; bamasethame yaathafaanaacaweme yanuhhe hhezeboce, fire`aawene 'enaa haamaaneme yeganyubataale; 'alaaheme kaala hathi'aate 'enaresune bamaathefaate yamibadelaacawe geetaa 'ayedalame; nagare gene wanejale 'enaa hathi'aatene bamafatsame raasaacawene badaayoce nabaru bamahonume qethaate yamigabaacawe honu.

ya'enaziyaa ka'alaahe leelaa theqemaacawene wayeme 'amaalaajenataacawene kajelawe thaa`otaatene yayaazu sawoce mesaalee katheqaate lamakalaakale beetene 'eneda yaazace shararite `aayenate nawe. kabeetoce hulu bathaame dakaamaawe yashararite beete nawe. thalaatene 'ayekalaakalelaateme. thaa`otocaacaweme leke 'enedazihu 'ayethaqemume, 'ayegodume 'ayaamaaledumeme. 'agaariwocu yehenene biyaawequ noro thaa`otaatene ka'alaahe leelaa 'amaalekete 'aderegawe 'ayegazwacaweme nabare.

'alaahe yaanene ka'eresu leelaa yamigazutene yaaweqaale. kaziheme meneme nagare 'ayesawarebateme. 'eresume yaa maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi, bamafethare, bamawasanenaa bamaasetanaabare thebabanyaa nawe.

sawocene lamaaneqaate, 'ewenatune lamaaseradaate 'enaa la'ewenatume yemaru zanede yamenethaqesaacawene mesaaleewoce batafalaagiwe maleke yamiganazabute ya'alaahe hegegaatenenaa thebabune `aawaaqiwoce becaa naacawe.

'alaahe samaayaatenenaa mederene ba'ewenate fathara. lakanetume hona lachawaataame 'alefatharaacaweme. bazihe mafethare wesethe lame'emanaane ya'alaahene caayenate yamiyaaseradaa geletze melekete 'alabate. mekeneyaatume me'emanaane ba'alaahe fethuraane maaserajaanate fathaari manorune yamiyaaragaagethute 'enaresu naacawe. kahadeyaane gene basamaayaatenaa banafesaacawe laaye yaalutene ya'alaahene ta`aameraate 'enedaalaayu honawe yafathaarine taalaaqenatenaa celotaa saayaasetawelu yaalefaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe wada 'aneta baraa`eye yaawaradalehene qure'aane lasawoce 'anebebe. salaateneme danebune thabeqahenaa 'amwaletahe segade. batamwalaa maleku yamisagade salaate sagaajune kawanejale 'enaa kamithalaa hulu yekalakelaalenaa nawe. yeheme wanejale 'enedaayeszaraa yamiyaagedenaa wada malekaame szeraa yamimaraa lebe wesethe bamifatherawe berehaane mekeneyaate nawe. 'alaahene maawadase kahulume nagare yalaaqa 'enaa taalaaqe nawe. 'alaaheme yameteszarutene hulu yaaweqaale. kaszeraawocaacehu meneme 'ayesawarebateme. baszeraawocaacehume malekaamune bamalekaame mathefowene dagemo bamathefo yemanadaacexwaale.

<<'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! 'ayehudoce 'enaa keresetiyaanocene batashaalanaa malekaame bahonawe manegade bagesaatzeenaa bageletze maaserajaawoce 'eneji 'atekaraakaru! 'atewayaayume! nagare gene ka'enasu bakuraatenaa bate`ebite nafesaacawene yabadalute, ba'enaaneta laaye thorenatene yaawajubaacehu siqaru: 'enasuneme 'eje 'esekisathu ('esekisalemu) derase wayeme tawaaredawe ba'ejaacawe geberene 'esekikafelu derase tawaagwaacawe. la'ayehudocenaa lakeresetiyaanoceme 'alaahe wada 'enyaa baawaradawe qure'aanenaa wadanaanetame bawaradute taweraatenaa nejile 'amenanaale. 'amelaakaaceneme 'amelaakaacehume 'anede nawe. ba'amelaakenatu, bageetenatunaa melu`enatu 'agaare yaleelawe 'anede nawe. 'enyaame la'eresu tanaanaashenaa taazaazhoce nane.>> balwacawe.

kaaneta bafite banabarute laaye matsaahhefetene 'enedaawaradene hulu baaneta laayeme qure'aanene 'awaradene. ka'enaresume taweraatene kamiyaanabute kafilocu 'enada `abedulaahe bine salaame yaalute bamatsehhafaacawe wesethe maanenatu tatsefo selamiyaaganyute ba'esu yaamenaalu; kanazihe 'agaariwoceme ba'esu yamiyaamenu 'alu. lemedaacawe kehedatenaa 'ewenate geletse kahona baxwaalaa maasetabaabale kahonute kahadiyaane basetaqare 'aneqatzocaacenene maaneme 'ayekedeme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaqure'aane bafite meneme matsehhafe yametaanabe, baqanyeheme yametetzefe 'alenabarekeme. mekeneyaatume yamaataanabenaa yamaatetzefe yaaletamaareke nabarekenaa. yametaanabenaa yametetzefe betehone noro yaane gizee maayemocu ba'aneta nabiyenate ba'eregethe yetharaatharu nabare. kaalafute matsaahhefete wasedo nawe yatzaafawe wadamile demedaamee yedaresume nabare.

yelequnese baaneta laaye yawaradawe qure'aane ba'enazihe `eweqate batasathute me'emanaane leboce wesethe geletse yahonu 'aneqatzoce nawe; 'aneqatzocaacenene nafesocaacawene ba'alaahe bamaagaaraatenaa bamakaade yabadalute 'eneji leeloce sawoce 'ayekedume.

'agaariwoceme <<bamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) laayeme ka'esu bafite banabarute male'eketanyoce laaye 'enedawaradu hulu kageetaawe zanede ta'aameraate lamene 'alewaradulateme?>> 'alu; 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehenene hasaabe laaqarabuteme <<ta`aameraate ba'alaahe 'eje becaa naacawe; bafalagaweme gizee yaawaradaacawaale; maaweradu banee 'eje 'ayedalame. 'eneeme ka'alaahe qethaate yamaasethanaqaqaacehu geletze 'asethaneqaaqi becaa nanye>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enyaa qure'aanene ba'enasu laaye yaminababe hono baaneta laaye maaweradaacene la'enaziyaa ta`aameraate 'enediwaredelehe hasaabe laaqarabute 'ayebaqaacawemene?! ba'enasu laaye bawaradawe qure'aane wesethe lamiyaamenu hhezeboce 'ezenatenaa gesaatzee 'alabate. ba'esu yamithaqamuteme 'enasu naacawe. baalafute male'eketanyoce laaye 'enedawaradawe ta`aamere `aayenate 'enedimathaalaacawe hasaabe kamaaqerabe yeleqe yehe yawaradalaacawe qure'aane balaache nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale:: <<yezhee yamathaahutene male'ekete 'ewenatanyenatenenaa ya'enaanetaneme ba'eresu maasetabaabale bamesekerenate 'alaahe (subehhaanahu wata`aalaa) baqi nawe. basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawene hulu yaaweqaale. ba'enasu wesethe yaalawe meneme 'ayesawarebateme.>> 'enaziyaame ka'alaahe wechi bamimalaku wedeqe nagaroce yaamanu, babecanyenate 'ameleko yamigabaawene 'alaahene yakaadu; 'emenatene bakehedate bamalawathaacaweme 'enasu kasaariwoce naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce 'aneta yaasethanaqaqekaacawene qethaate tolo 'enedetaamathaalaacawe yaathaadefuhale. 'alaahe 'enasune lamaqethaate wadafiteme wadaxwaalaame yamaayele yatawasana gizee baayenore noro yathayaqute qethaate yemathaabaacawe nabare. saayaasebute badenegate ba'eregethe yemathaabaacawaale.

'aneta sela qatharekaacaweme qethaate yaathaadefuhale. yaaci 'alaahe lakahadeyaane qaale yagabaate (yaqatharaate) yajahaname 'esaate 'enasune ba'eregethe kabaabi naate. kaqethaatwame maamelathe 'ayecelume.

qethaatu kabalaayaacawe bamishafenaacawe, ka'egerocaacaweme sere menethaafe bamihonelaacawe qane; 'alaaheme 'enasune bamakonane teszarute yanabaraacehutene yashereke 'enaa yawanejale waagaa qemasu yelaacawaale.
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu baarocee hoye! 'eneene lamagazaate kamaatecelubate medere tasadadu. mederee ba'eregethe safi naate. 'eneeneme becaa tagazunye banee 'anedeneme 'ataagaarubenye.
motene maferaataacehu kamasadade 'ayekalakelaacehu. nafese hulu motene qamaashe naate. kaziyaame lagemegamaanaa lamamanedaate wada 'enyaa becaa temalasaalaacehu.

'enaziyaame ba'alaahe yaamanu 'enaa wada 'eresu yamiyaaqaarebutene malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru kajanate baserocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene saganatoce bawesethaacawe lazalaalame zawetaariwoce sihonu ba'eregethe 'enaasaferaacawaalane. moteme 'ayaaganyaacaweme. yehe menedaa ba'alaahe te'ezaaze lamiszaru sawoce menenyaa yaamaara menedaa nawe!!
'enaziyaa 'alaahene bamataazazenaa 'esune kamaamatze yataagasu sawoce menedaa menenyaa 'amaara. bagudaayaacaweme hulu bageetaacawe becaa laaye yamimaku naacawe.

taneqasaaqaashe 'enesesaate hulu meneme baquthere bezu bihonume megebaacawene masabesabeme hona mashakame yamaayecelu sihone 'alaahe yemagebaacawaale. 'enaanetaneme yemagebaale. bamahonume rahabene bamaferaate masadadene bamatawaacehu meneme mekeneyaate yalaacehume. 'eresu negegeraacehune sami; hasaabaacehunenaa seraacehune `aawaaqi nawe. ka'esu meneme nagare 'ayesawarebateme. baszeraacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa 'agaariwocene <<samaayaatene yafatharawe maanawe? mederenese yafatharawe maanawe? tzahhayene 'enaa charaqaane yamitakaaku sihonu yaagaraacawe maanawe?>> belahe betethayeqaacawe <<ba'eregethe samaayaatenenaa mederene yafatharawe tzahhayenenaa charaqaane zawatere 'enedineqasaaqasu yaagaraawe 'alaahe nawe.>> yeluhale. taadiyaa ba'alaahe kamaamane yamizorute lamenedene nawe? ka'esume wechi yamaayethaqemu 'enaa yamaayegodu yahonu 'amaaleketenese lamene yegazaalu?

'alaahe kabaarocu lamishaawe sisaayene yaasafaale; bamishaaweme laaye yaathabebaale. yeheme 'esu lamiyaaweqawe thebabe nawe. 'alaahe sela nagaru hulu `aawaaqi nawe. meneme nagare 'ayesawarebateme. labaarocu yamithaqemaacawene nagare kamaasetanaabare yamisawarebateme nagare yalame.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa 'agaariwocene kasamaayeme wehane yaawaradanaa ba'esume mederene kadaraqace baxwaalaa hheyaawe yaadaragaate maane 'enedahona betethayeqaacawe kasamaaye wehane 'aweredo mederene hheyaawe yaadaragawe 'alaahe nawe; yeluhale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale:: <<maaserajaawene geletze laadaragawe 'alaahe mesegaanaa yegabaawe; honome tachabaachu 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaasetawelume; biyaasetawelu noro ka'alaahe gaare yamaayethaqemu 'enaa yamaayegodu thaa`otaatene 'ayaagaarume nabare.>>

yeheceme qerebe hheyewate wesethwa yaalawe mathaqaaqamiyaanaa semeetene chamero lebaacawe ba'ereswa laaye latanethalathalu sawoce bezu saayeqoye bafethenate yamiyaaleqe maataalayaa 'enaa chawaataa 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaceme. yamacharashaawe 'agare zalaalamaawi selahonace 'ewenatanyaa hagare naate. yehenenu yamiyaawequ bihonu noro kazawetaaritu hheyewate yeleqe thafiwene hheyewate baalemarathu nabare.

'alaahe 'agaariwoce samaayaatene 'enaa mederene maane 'enedafatharaacawe sithayaqu ba'alaahe fathaarinate kamaamanaacawe gaare leelaane maamelakaacawe 'erese baraasu yamigaache 'emenate 'enedaalaacawe kamazagababaacawe baxwaalaa qathelome baahhere wesethe masemathene bamasegaate 'alaahene babecanyenate 'enedamigazu 'enaa basalaame siwathu dagemo wada maagaaraate 'enedamimalasu sigaletze 'enedihe yelaale::
'agaariwoce baahhere wesethe bamarekabe sigwaazu kamasethame yaadenaacaweme zanede tsalotene la'eresu becaa bamaaderage 'alaahene yemaatzanutaale. kamasethameme 'enedaadaanaacaweme ka'eresu gaare 'amaaleketocaacawene 'abero bamamaatzane wada maagaaraatu yeqalabasaalu.
basathanaacawe tzagaa likedunaa baduneyaa geethaageetheme lithaqaaqamu 'agaariwoce honawe yemalasaalu. bamimotubateme gizee mathefo fetzaameeyaacawene saayaawequ 'ayeqareme.

'enaziyaane ba'alaahe tzagaa yamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce 'enasune kamasethame kaadaanenaacaweme batachamaari leelaa tzagaa 'enedasathanaacawe 'ayaayumene? 'esume leeloce bazuriyaacawe yaalu sawoce theqaate 'eyatasanazarabaacawe, gedeyaa 'eyatafatzamabaacawe, 'eyataasaru, seetocaacawenenaa lejocaacaweneme 'eyamaarakubaacawe, ganezabocaacaweme 'eyatazarafa baalabate huneetaa 'enyaa hharamene (makaane) la'enasu tzathetanyaa bamaaderage kaganezabaacawe mazarafe 'enaa kadamaacawe mafesase yatamaamanu tzathetanyoce 'adaragenaacawe. lamahonu 'amaalekete bamibaalu wedeqe nagaroce yaamenaalune? 'alaaheme basathaacawe tzagaa 'eresune kamaamasegane yeleqe 'eresune yekedaalune?

ba'alaaheme laaye 'agaarene bamaaderage weshatene kaqathaathafa wayeme male'eketanyaawe yezote yamathaawene 'ewenate kaasetabaabala sawe yebalethe badaaye yalame. lakahadiyaane 'enaa masalocaacawe bajahaname wesethe manoriyaa yaalaacawe mahonu therethere yalaweme.

'enaziyaa ya'enyaane wedeetaa falegawe raasaacawene yataagalutene latekekelanyaawe manegade sekeete 'enaabaqaacawaalane. 'alaaheme ba'eregethe ba'egazaa, ba'eredaataanaa basekeete kabago sariwoce gaare nawe.
(lm) <<'alife laame mime>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)
faarese rumene 'ashanafa.
kafaarese hagare wada rume bathaame qerebe bahonacewe medere rumoce bafaaresoce katashanafu baxwaalaa ba'eregethe yaashanefaalu.

kaszosete `aamataate baalaanasa ka'asereme `aamataate baalebalatha gizee wesethe yaashanefaalu. rumoce kamashanafaacawe bafiteme baxwaalaame te'ezaazu hulu ya'alaahe nawe. rumoce faaresocene bamiyaashanefume gizee me'emanaane yedasataalu.

yamatsehhafe baalabeetoce bamahonaacaweme 'alaahe rumocene bamaredaatu yedasataalu. 'alaahe yamishaawene bamishaawe laaye yeradaale; 'eresume maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi lame'emanaane baarocume 'azaanye nawe.

yehe 'eredaataa ka'alaahe yahona qaale kidaane nabare. delume bamaragaagathu me'emanaane ba'alaahe qaale kidaane 'eregethanyenataacawe yechameraale. gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce kahadiwoce bamahonaacawe 'ayaawequme.

kaqerebitu hheyewate manoriyaane 'enaa qusaawi selethaaneene maganebaate kanurwacawe gaare tayaayaazhenate yaalawene gudaaye becaa nawe bageletze yamiyaawequte. 'emenatene 'enaa ya'alaahene hegegaate gene 'ayaawequme. 'enasume ka'ewenatanyaayetu yamacharashaawaa `aalame zanegiwoce naacawe. meneme tekurate 'ayesathwateme.

lamahonu 'enaziyaa 'asetabaabaaye 'agaariwoce sela nafesocaacawe 'alaahe 'enedeete 'enedafatharaacawenaa 'enedaasetakaakalaacaweme 'ayaasetawelumene? samaayaatenenaa mederene bamahakalaacaweme yaalawene hulu 'alaahe ba'ewenate fatharaacawe. lachawaataa 'alefatharaacaweme. baduneyaa yamiqoyubatene gizee yatawasana 'adaragawe. kasawoceme bezuwocu yaqiyaamaahe 'elate ka'alaahe gaare sela maganaanyate 'asetabaabaayoce naacawe. selahoname geetaacawe zanede wedeetaa yamiyaaseganyelaacawe malekaame szeraane bamaszeraate latenesaa'eewe `elate 'ayezagaajume.

'enazihe sawoce bamedere laaye bamagwaaze ya'enaziyaane kabafitaacawe yanabarutene 'asetabaabaaye sawoce fetzaamee 'enedeete 'enedanabara 'ayemalakatumene? baxaayele ka'enaresu yebalethe yathanakaru nabaru. mederene lagenebaataanaa la'azere`ete 'arasu; 'enazihe mederene kaasaamarute balaaye 'enaziyaa qadametocu 'asaamerawetaale. male'eketanyocaacaweme ba'alaahe 'anedenate laaye geletze yahonu ta`aameraatocene 'enaa maaserajaawocene siyaamathulaacawe 'asetabaabalume. 'alaahe 'enasune siyaathafaa 'alebadalaacaweme; gene 'enasu bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate nafesocaacawene thefaate laaye bamathaalaacawe raasaacawene yebadelu nabare.

kaziyaame ba'alaahe bamaagaaraatenaa mathefo szeraawocene bamaszeraate yaathafute sawoce fetzaamee 'ejege yakafaa fetzaamee hona. yeheme ya'alaahene 'aneqatzocene yamisetabaabelu 'enaa yamisaalaqu bamahonaacawe nawe.

'alaahe fethurene yaala qadaami 'amesaayaa bamajamariyaa yefatheraale; kaziyaame yaathafaawaale; kaziyaame daageme yemalesawaale; kaziyaame batenesaa'eewe qane lagemegamaa 'enaa lamamanedaate wada 'eresu becaa temalasaalaacehu.
tenesaa'eeme bametekasatebate qane 'amatzanyoce ba'alaahe lamakaadaacawe maaserajaa yaleelaacawe bamahonu ka'alaahe 'ezenate tasefaa yeqorethaalu. menyotaacaweme yeqwaarathaale.

la'enaresume baduneyaa ka'alaahe weche bamagazaate siyaagaarwacawe yanabarute thaa`otaate ka'alaahe qethaate bamaadaane 'amaalaajoce 'ayehonwacaweme. yamiyaagaarwacaweneme sawoce yekedwacawaale. hulume 'anede `aayenate qethaatenaa thefaate wesethe bamahonaacaweme 'enasune bamifalegwaacawe sa`aate laaye yaawaaredwacawaale.

sa`aatitu bametekasatebate gizeeme sawoce baduneyaa yeszarute banabarawe szeraa `aayenate wada kafetanyaawe maa`erage yamiwathu sihonu leeloce dagemo wada zeqetanyaawe 'azaqeteme yamiwaredu bamahone yelayaayaalu.
'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanu 'enaa 'esu zanede tawadaaje yahonu malekaame szeraawocene yaszarute 'enasu bajanate wesethe bamiyaaganyute yamaayeqwaarathe zalaalamaawi tzagaa yedasataalu.

'enaziyaame ba'alaahe yakaadute 'enaa bamale'eketanyocaaceneme laaye bawaradute 'aneqatzoce 'enedihume kamote baxwaalaa bamaqaseqase 'enaa bagemegamaa yaasetabaabalute baqethaatu laaye yamithaadu 'enaa kaqethaateme yamaayelaaqaqu naacawe.
masheto yamageribe 'enaa ya`ishaa'e salaate waqete sigabaa 'enedihume nageto yafajere salaate waqete sigabaame 'alaahene 'awadesute.

mesegaanaame la'eresu becaa nawe. basamaayaate malaa'eketu siyaamasagenute bamedere dagemo fetherataatu yaamasagenutaale. basareke maalateme ya'asere salaate waqetenaa barafaadume yazehure salaate waqete laaye 'awadesute.

yasawe lejene kazare fasaashe, chaachuteneme ka'enequlaale 'enedamiyaawathaa heyaawene kamute yaawathaale. yazare fasaashene kasawe leje 'enequlaaleneme kadoro 'enedamiyaawathaame mutene kaheyaawe yaawathaale. medereneme kadaraqace baxwaalaa zenaabene bamaaweradenaa bamaabeqale heyaawe yaadaregaataale. mederene 'azere`etene bamaabeqale hheyaawe 'enedaadaragaate hulu kamaqaaberaacehu lagemegamaanaa lamamanedaate tewathaalaacehu.

ya'alaahene caayenate 'enaa becanyenate kamiyaaseradu taalaalaaqe ta`aameraatoce makaakale 'abaataacehu 'adamene kacheqaa bamafethare 'enaanetane yasawe lejocene ka'afare mafetharu kaziyaame bamaraabaate tabaazetaacehu bameseraaqe 'enaa bame`eraabe yamedere kefeloce masaraachataacehu nawe.

wanedoce hoye! ya'alaahene celotaanaa becanyenatune kamiyaaseradu taalaalaaqe ta`aameraatoceme makaakale 'anede `aayenate bamahonaacehu nafesaacehu wada 'enaresu teragaa zanede la'enaaneta kanafesaacehu thenedocene mafetharunaa ba'enaanetanaa ba'enasu makaakaleme mafaaqarene 'enaa matazaazanene maaderagu nawe. ba'ezihe batathaqasaweme wesethe 'a`emerwacawene bamaaszaraate yamithaqamu bamahonaacawe lamiyaasetawelu hhezeboce geletze yahona maaserajaa 'enaa meleketoce yeganyaale.

badegaamime ya'alaahene celotaanaa becanyenatune kamiyaaseradu taalaalaaqe ta`aameraatoceme makaakale samaayaatenenaa mederene mafetharu nawe. kaziheme wesethe yaqwaaneqwaawocaacehunaa yamalekocaacehume malayaayate 'anedu nawe. batathaqasaweme wesethe la`aawaaqiwoce geletze maaserajaawocenaa meleketoce 'alu.

ya'alaahene celotaanaa becanyenatune kamiyaaseradu taalaalaaqe ta`aameraatoceme makaakale kaszeraacehu lefaate taarefu zanede balalite 'enedihume baqaneme matanyaataacehu nawe. kata`aameraatume baqanu kefela gizee kageetaacehu sisaayene felagaa masamaaraataacehu nawe. bazihe batathaqasaweme wesethe yamaasetanetate 'enaa yamaqabale masemaatene lamisamu hhezeboce maaserajaawoce 'enaa meleketoce 'alubate.

ya'alaahene celotaanaa becanyenatune kamiyaaseradu taalaalaaqe ta`aameraatoceme makaakale maberaqene samaaye laaye 'enaanetane maasaayatu 'enaa kamaqesafete maferaatene 'enaa zenaabe makajalene ba'anede laaye masabesabu nawe. kasamaayeme yazenaabene weha yaawaredelaacexwaale. ba'eresume mederene kadaraqace baxwaalaa 'azere`etene bamaabeqale heyaawe yaadaregaataale. bazihe wesethe lamiyaasebu hhezeboce geletze maaserajaawoce 'enaa meleketoce 'alubate. baziheme kamote baxwaalaa lagemegamaa 'enaa lamamanedaate maqaseqase 'enedaala 'enedamaaserajaanate yethaqamubataale.

ya'alaahene celotaanaa becanyenatune kamiyaaseradu taalaalaaqe ta`aameraatoceme makaakale samaaye yamaatewadeqenaa medereme yamaayefarese honawe bate`ezaazu maqomaacawe nawe. kaziyaame male'aku baqanedu baminafaabate gizee 'eresu yataqadasawe geetaa kamedere tewathume zanede sitharaacehu wadiyaawenu lagemegamaanaa lamamanedaate kamaqaaberaacehu tewathaalaacehu.

basamaayaateme hona bamedere wesethe yaalute bamulu baselethaaneme, bamafethareme hona bamawasane ya'eresu becaa naacawe. basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalute hulume la'esu taazaazhocenaa late`ezaazu 'eje yasathu naacawe.

'eresu yataqadasawe geetaa kaala qedema mesaalee bamajamariyaa fetherataatene yafatharawe 'eresu nawe. kaathafaacaweme baxwaalaa daageme yemalesaacawaale. majamariyaa kamafethareme yeleqe daageme mamalasu yaqalala nawe. yehunenaa 'anedaacene nagare kafalaga <<kune>> (hune) silawe yamihone bamahonume hulatume la'eresu qalaale naacawe. bamigalatzebaacaweme yaleqenaanaa yale`ulenate baaheriyaate hulu yalaaqawe baaheri ya'eresu becaa nawe. 'eresume maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi; ba'afathaatharume hona ba'asetanaabaarinatu thebabanyaa nawe.

'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! 'alaahe la'enaanetawe karaasaacehu yatawasadane mesaalee thaqasalaacehu. lamahonu natzaa yaszeraa 'agaaraacehune ganezabaacehune 'ekule bagaaraa 'enedaayekaafale 'enedametesagute `aayenate segaate baarocaacehune 'enaa ba'ejocaacehu quthethere sere yaalutene 'agalegaayocaacehune tesagaalaacexwaalene?
