'enedihe `aayenate yabaariyaa 'aseginate 'enaa baalaagaaraanatene laraasaacehu tefaqedaalaacehune (teqabalaalaacehune)? kaalameneme therethere yehenene 'atefaqedume ('ateqabalume)! bamahonume 'alaahe banegeszenaawe laaye kafethuraanume yehune kabaariyaawocu la'eresu tagaari linorawe cheraashe 'ayegabaame; mesaaleewocene bamatheqasenaa baleeloce manegadoce tathaqaamiwoce bamahonaacawe lamiyaasetawelu hhezeboce maaserajaawocene 'enaa 'aneqatzocene 'enegaletsaalane.

yathememataacawe manese'ee yamaaserajaa 'etherate 'enaa maaserajaawe saayeberaaraa qareto saayehone yelequnese 'enasu zenebaaleeyaacawene 'enaa 'abaatocaacawene yaala `eweqate bachefene makatalaacawe nawe. lamahonu 'alaahe yaathamamawene sawe yamiyaaqanaawe maanawe?! maaneme liyaaqanaawe 'ayeceleme. la'enaresume ka'alaahe qethaate yamikalaakalulaacawe radaatoce yalaacaweme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'anetanaa kaaneta gaare yaalute leelaane 'emenate tetaacehu 'alaahe wada marathalehe 'enaa yasawe lejocene wada fatharabate tafatherwawi ya'eselemenaa haayemaanote fitaacehune 'azuru. ya'alaahene fetherate 'atelawethu. yehe meneme mazaanafe yaleelabate qathetanyaawe haayemaanote nawe. nagare gene 'abezaanyocu sawoce 'ewenatanyaawe haayemaanote maalate yehe haayemaanote mahonune 'ayaawequme.

kawanejalocaacehume nesehha bamaaderage wada 'esu tamalasu. ya'esune te`ezaaze bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe ferute. batamwalaa malekume salaatene segadu. tekekelanyaawene tafatherwawi haayemaanotene bamatzaarare ba'amelekote laaye ka'alaahe gaare leelaawene 'enedamiyaagaarute 'agaariwoce 'atehunu.

ka'enaziyaa haayemaanotaacawene 'enedaqayarute bakafilume 'amenawe bakafilu 'enedakaadute, babudenenaa ba'anejaame 'enedatakafaafalute 'agaariwoce 'atehunu. 'eyaanedaanedu 'anejaame 'eresu zanede baalawe wedeqe nagare dasetanyaa bamahone 'eresu becaa 'ewenate laaye 'enedaalanaa leeloce dagemo weshate laaye 'enedahonu yesamaawaale.

'agaariwoce yabashetaa, yadehenate wayeme yadereqe cegere siyaagaathemaacawe; yaagaathamaacawene cegere yaasewagedelaacawe zanede la'eresu (la'alaahe) bamatanaanase 'enaa bamamaatzane wada 'eresu bamamalase yataqadasawene geetaacawene babecanyenate yelamenutaale. kaziyaame ba'ezenatu yaagaathamaacawene cegere sigalethelaacawe (siyaanasaalaacawe) ka'enasu kafilocu wadiyaawenu ka'alaahe gaare leelaane bamalamane wada maagaaraatu yemalasaalu.

meneme 'enekwaa ya'alaahene tzagaawoce cegere maasewagadune chamero bikedunaa bazihece `aalame heyewate ba'ejaacawe bamiganyawe bithaqaaqamume qelu batenesaa'eewe qane geletze themate laaye 'enedanabaru ba`aayenaacawe mamalekataacawe 'ayeqareme.

lamahonu maaserajaa saayenoraacawe ba'alaahe wada maagaaraate mene 'anasaasaacawe? bamaagaaraataacawe laaye la'enasu kamatsehhafe 'aseraje 'alaawaradeneme. selamiyaagaaruteme hona selaalubateme kehedate tekekelanyaanate yamiyaaragaagethelaacawe matsehhafe yalaacaweme.

sawoceneme katzagaacene 'eneda theenenatenaa habete yaalawene tzagaa baaqamasenaacawe gizee yakuraatene dasetaa yedasataalu. 'ejocaacaweme baszarwacawe wanejale mekeneyaate bashetaa, dehenate 'enaa leelaa cegere sigathemaacawe wadeyaawenu ka'alaahe 'ezenate tasefaa yeqorethaalu. yaasekafaacaweme nagare 'enedamaayewagade tasefaacawene yaachalemaalu.

lamahonuse 'alaahe lamishaawe sawe yaamasagenaale wayese yekedaale yamilawene lamafatane sisaayene yamiyaasafaa; baagaathamawe fatanaa yetaagasaale wayese yethalaale yamilawene lamafataneme sisaayene yamiyaathabe mahonune 'ayaayumene? sisaayene ba'anedaanedu laaye bamaasefaateme baleelaawe laaye bamaathebabeme lamiyaamenu hhezeboce ya'alaahene 'ezenatenaa reheraaheene yamiyaamalaketu meleketoce yeganyubataale.

'aneta muselime hoye! yazemedenaane baalabeete yamigabaawene malekaame welataane 'enaa yazemedenaa mabetune tawathaa. ladehame gudaayune mafatsame yamicelebatene sethe. 'enegedaame hono wada hagaru magwaagwaazhaa lataqwaarathabateme manegadanyaa sethe. yehe batalayaayu 'aqethaachaawoce yamilagase sethotaa la'enaziyaa ya'alaahene fite lamishu malekaame nawe. 'enazihene 'eredaataanaa mabetocene yamiyaabaraketu yafalagutene janatene bamaagenyate 'enaa kamifarute qethaate bamadaane sekeetaamaawoce (`edelanyoce) naacawe.

wada 'alaahe yamiyaaqaarebu szeraawocene kagalatza baxwaalaa la'alaahe tabelo saayehone rekaashe yahonacewe duneyaa tafalegobate yamiszaru szeraawoce 'enedaalu sigaletze 'enedihe yelaale::
'ethefe 'aderego 'enedimaleselaacehu lamaanenyaaweme sawe yametesathute ganezabe 'alaahe zanede menedaawe 'ayechamereme; ganezabaacehuneme gudaayune lamifatseme sawe ya'alaahene fite bamakajaleme 'enaa kasaweyeewe meneme darajaa 'enedihume menedaa saatefalegu yasathaacehute 'enazihe 'alaahe zanede menedaawe yamitaathafelaacawe naacawe.

'alaahe 'enaanetane bamafethare, sisaayene bamasethate 'enedihume bamagedale 'enaa heyaawe 'aderego bamaqaseqase becanyaa 'amelaake nawe; ka'esu wechi kametaagaarwacawe thaa`otaate wesethe kanazihe nagaroce 'anedune nagare maaderage yamicele 'alane? 'agaariwoce kamilutenaa kamiyaamenute: 'alaahe yataqadasa nawe.

yasawe lejoce baszarute wanejale saabiyaa banurwacawe laaye gudelate; baheyewataacawe laaye dereqe; bashetaa 'enaa warareshenye 'enedikasate bamaaderage babaahherenaa bayabese laaye makaraa geletze hona; yeheme yahonawe 'alaahe baduneyaa hheyewate wesethe bakefu szeraacawe mekeneyaate liqathaacawe 'enaa bamatzatzate wada 'eresu yemalasu zanede nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<medere laaye tagwaazunaa ka'enaaneta bafite male'eketanyaacawene yaasetabaabelu yanabarute sawoce macharashaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara tamalekatu. ba'eregetheme yakafaa macharashaa nabare. 'abezaanyocaacawe ka'alaahe gaare leelaane bamagazaate 'agaariwoce nabaru. ba'alaahe laaye tagaari bamaaderagaacawe mekeneyaate thafu.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'eresu malaashe yaleelawe yatenesaa'eewe qane kamamethaatu bafite fitehene yaa mazaanafe yaleelabate wada honawe qathetanyaawe haayemaanote qathe 'aderege. baziyaane qane sawoce yelayaayaalu. kafilu bajanate wesethe yedasataale. leelaawe ba'esaate wesethe yesaqaayaale.

ba'alaahe yakaada sawe yakehedatu wetheete 'esaate wesethe mazawetare sihone gudaatu baraasu laaye nawe. ya'alaahene fite bamafalage malekaame szeraane yaszaru janate wesethe lamagebaatenaa 'ereswa wesethe yaalawene tzagaa lazalaalame bamathaqaaqame lanafesocaacawe maarafiyaawocene yaazagaajaalu.

'enaziyaane ba'alaahe yaamanutene 'enaa geetaacawene lamaasewadade malekaame szeraawocene yaszarutene yemanadaa zanede 'alaahe sawocene lahulate bamakefale yelayaayaale. ba'esunaa bamale'eketanyocu yamikedutene 'ayewademe. yelequnese bathaame yethalaacawaale. batenesaa'eeme qane yeqathaacawaale.

ya'alaahene caayenatene 'enaa becanyaanatene kamiyaamalaketu taalaalaaqe ta`aameraate makaakale nefaasocene yazenaabene mamethaate 'abesaari 'aderego malaaku; zenaabe kazanabame baxwaalaa fereewocene 'enaa dasetaane kacerotaawe liyaaqamesaacehu, marekaboceme ba'esu faqaade 'enedineqasaaqasu, baahhere laaye bamaneshaalale kacerotaaweme 'enedetefalegunaa 'alaahe basathaacehu tzagaa 'enedichamerelaacehu taamasagenute zanede maazagaajatu nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'aneta bafite male'eketanyocene wada hhezebocaacawe ba'eregethe lekanaale; 'ewenatanyaanataacawene yamiyaasaayu geletze ta`aameraatene 'amathulaacawe; kaziyaame yaamathulaacawene male`ekete 'asetabaabaalwacawe; 'enaziyaa wanejalene yaszaruteneme tabaqalenaacawe; baqethaataacene 'athafaanaacawe; male'eketanyocene 'enaa takataaye me'emanaanene kathefaate natzaa 'awathaane; 'amaanyocene maadaanenaa maredaatene baraasaacene laaye gedeetaa 'adaragene.

'alaahe 'eresu yaa nafaasocene yamilekenaa yamiqasaqese nawe; nafaasoceme damanaane yeqasaqesaalu; basamaaye laayeme batenesheme babezaateme yafalagawene yezaragaawaale. quretheraachoceme yaadaregawaale. 'aneta tamalekaace hoye! zenaabume kadamanaawe mahakale siwathaa taayaalahe. ka'ezenatume kabaarocu yamishaawene zenaabe siyaazanebelaacawe zenaabene bamaawerade laraasaacawe 'enaa la'enesesocaacawe 'azere`ete 'enaa 'atekeletocene bamaagenyataacawe yedasataalu.
'alaahe zenaabe ba'enasu laaye kamaaweradu bafite ba'eregethe tasefaa qoraachoce nabaru.

'alaahe medereneme kamotace baxwaalaa yatalayaayu 'azere`etocene bamaabeqale 'enedeete hheyaawe 'enedamiyaadaregaate, labaarocu wadamiyaawaredawe yazenaabe wetheetoce tamalekate; yehecene medere kadaraqace baxwaalaa heyaawe yaadaragaate 'alaahe mutaaneneme heyaawe 'aderaagi nawe; 'eresume hulune nagare caaye nawe; meneme 'ayesaanaweme.

nafaasene ba'azemaraawocaacawenaa ba'atekeletocaacawe laaye yaathafaabaacawe zanede benelekenaa 'azemaraawocaacawene kalamelamenate baxwaalaame taqayero garetheto bimalakatute ya'alaahe tzagaa barekaataa hono 'eyaala yaalafawene tzagaa kamaasetabaabale 'ayewagadume.

'aneta mutaanene 'enedamaataasamaa hulu daneqorowoceneme ka'aneta reqawe bashashu gizee maasamaate 'ateceleme. leke 'enedazihu yaraaqutene 'enaa yamaayethaqamutene wada qanaawe manegade mameraateme 'ateceleme.

'aneta katekekelanyaawe manegade yathamamutene wada qathetanyaawe manegade yametaaqaanaa 'ayedalaheme. ba'aneqatzocaacene yamiyaamenutene sawoce 'eneji leelaawe yamithaqamebate yahonane maasamaatene 'ataasemaame. mekeneyaatume bametenaagarawe yamithaqamute 'enasu naacawe. 'enasume late`ezaazaacene taazaazhoce laresume tanaanaashe naacawe.

'alaahe yaa 'enaanetane (yasawe lejocene) kadakaamaa fasaashe nawe yafatharaacehu. kaziyaame kadakaamaa hhetzaanenate baxwaalaa wada thanekaaraa wathaatenate; kaziyaame kathanekaaraa wathaatenate baxwaalaa dakaamaa shemegelenaane 'enaa 'erejenaane 'adaraga. 'alaahe kadakaamaa 'enaa kathanekaaraa yafalagawene yefatheraale. 'eresume meneme yamaayesawarebate sela nagaru hulu `aawaaqi; meneme yamaayesaanaweme caaye nawe.

tenesaa'ee bametekasatebate qane wanejalanyoce ka'anedite sa`aate basetaqare bamaqaabere 'aleqoyaneme belawe yemelaalu. bamaqaabere wesethe yaalawene qoyetaa 'enedazanaguteme hulu baduneyaawe heyewateme 'ewenatene zanegetawe nabare.

'enaziyaa 'alaahe `eweqatene 'enaa 'emenatene yasathaacawe malaa'ekete 'enaa nabiyaate lakahadiyaanu <<'alaahe baqademo `eweqatu katafatharaacehu gizee 'aneseto 'eseka 'asetabaabalaacehute yamaqaseqashaacehu `elate qoyaacehu. genaa 'enaaneta kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase 'enedaala yamaataawaqu nabaraacehunaa basume kaadaacehu>> yelwacawaale.

'alaahe fethuraanene lagemegamaa 'enaa lamamanedaate bamiqasaqesaacawe gizee 'enaziyaa badalanyoce yamiqathefute mekeneyaate 'ayethaqemaacaweme. waqetu bamaalafume yatanasaa wada 'alaahe bamamalasenaa bamatzatzate ya'alaahene wedeetaa maagenyate 'ayethabaqebaacaweme.

lasawe leje tekurate kamasethate 'anetzaarenaa 'ewenatu kaweshate yegalatzelaacaweme zanede bazihe qure'aane wesethe 'eyaanedaanedune mesaalee galatzene. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! sela 'ewenatanyaanatehe maaserajaa betaamathaalaacaweme 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yakaadute <<yaamathaacehute kanetune 'eneji leelaane 'ayedalame>> yelaalu.
maaserajaa 'amethetahelaacawe baalaamanute sawoce lebe laaye 'enedataatamawe hulu; 'aneta 'ewenatene yaamathaahelaacawe mahonune `eweqenaa bamaayesathu sawoce leboce laayeme 'alaahe yaatemaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe laaneta qaale yagabaawe dele 'enaa madalaadale yataragaagatha 'enaa meneme therethere yaleelawe 'ewenate nawe. bamahonume hhezebocehe 'anetane sela maasetabaabalaacawe taagase. 'enaziyaame batenesaa'ee maqaseqasene yamaayaaragaagethu sawoce lamacaakolenaa te`egesete lamaathaate 'ayedaareguhe.

la'enaziyaa salaatene batamwalaa maleku 'asetakaakelawe lamiyaaqwaaqumu, yaganezabocaacaweneme yagedeetaa metzewaate yamisathu, 'enasume bamacharashaayetu `aalame maqaseqase, gemegamaa 'enaa qethaate 'enedaala menedaa yamiyaaragaagethu lahonute mamariyaa 'enaa 'ezenate nawe.

'enaziyaa bazihe baaheri yatagalatzu bamacharashaawe `aalame 'awaaraaje qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale.

'aneqatzocaaceneme ba'esu laaye batanababu gizee kamasemaate yeleqe 'enedaalesamaa hono bakuraate jarebaa yesathaale. demetzene laalamasemaate jorowe laaye denequrenaa 'enedaalabate sawe yehonaale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lawadafite bamiyaagaathemawe 'asaamaami qethaate 'abeserawe.
'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanu 'enaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru, la'enasu yamadasacaa janatoce tazagaatolaacawaale. 'alaahe baazagaajalaacaweme tzagaa yedasataalu.

ba'eswa wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe. 'alaaheme yehene meneme therethaaree yaleelawene 'ewenatanyaa yatasefaa qaalene gabetolaacawe nabare. 'eresume maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi, bamafethare 'enaa bawesaaneewe 'enedihume badenegaageewe thebabanyaawe nawe.

'alaahe samaayaatene kafe yaalu sihonu yaala mesasowoce fatharaacawe. medereme ba'enaaneta laaye 'enedaatewaalele 'enaa 'enedaataaragarege yatzanu taraarocene takalabaate. bamedere laaye yatalayaayu taneqasaaqaashe 'enesesocene hulu 'asaraacha. kasamaayeme yazenaabe wehane 'awaradene. bamedereme laaye `eyetaane kamisebe malekaame `aayenate hulu sawoce 'enaa 'enesesoce 'enedithaqamubate 'abaqalene.

yehe yatathaqasawe ya'alaahe fethure nawe. 'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! <<'enaziyaa ka'alaahe leelaa yametegazwacawe menene 'enedafatharu 'eseki 'asaayunye?! yelequnese badaayoce ka'ewenate yaraaqa bahona geletze thememate wesethe naacawe. meneme yamaayefatheru raasaacaweme fethuraane yahonu 'akaalaatene kageetaacawe gaare yaagaaraalu.

laluqemaaneme yahaayemaanote `eweqatene 'enaa bagudaayoce laaye sekeetene ba'eregethe sathanawe. 'enediheme 'alenawe:: <<'aneta luqemaane hoye! 'eresune 'enedetegazaawe sekeetaamaa yaadaragahene geetaahene lawaalalehe welataa 'amasegenawe.>> geetaawene yaamasagana yamesegaanaawe theqemu laraasu becaa nawe. 'alaahe ka'esu mesegaanaa yatabeqaaqaa nawe. yageetaawene tzagaa yakaada sawe yakehedatu gudaate baraasu laaye nawe. ya'esu makaade 'alaahene meneme 'ayegodaame. 'alaahe kafethuraanu hulu yatabeqaaqaa bahuneetaawoce hulu mesegune nawenaa.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! luqemaaneme laleju, bamalekaame nagare yamiyaanasaasaawe 'enaa kamathefo nagareme yamiyaasethanaqeqawe sihone <<lejee hoye! ka'alaahe gaare leelaane fethure 'ategazaa. ka'alaahe gaare leelaane nagare magazaate lanafese taalaaqe badale nawe. kabaade wanejalene mafatzame nafesene wada zalaalamaawi qethaate yaadaresaataale>> yaalawene 'asetaawese.

saweneme 'alaahene maamatze baleelabate maleku lawalaajocu malekaame 'enediwelelaacawe 'enaa 'eneditaazazaacawe bathebeqe 'azazenawe. 'enaatu bahodwa wesethe badekaame laaye bahona dekaame 'aragazacewe. thute mathaayaaweme bahulate `aamate wesethe nawe. bawaalalehe welataa 'alaahene 'amasegene. kaziyaame 'anetane bamaasaadagenaa bamanekabaakabe laaye yaalutene walaajoceheneme 'amasegene. bamaalate 'azazenawe. mamalashaaweme wada 'enee becaa nawe. huluneme yamigabaacawene 'emanadaacawaalahu.

ba'alaahe laaye leelaane 'enedetaagaaraa walaajocehe kafetanyaa chaanaa bamaaderage bitaagaluheme bazihe laaye 'atetaazazaacawe mekeneyaatume fathaarine bamaamatze fethurene mataazaze 'ayecaalemenaa. baqerebitume `aalame bamalekaame nagare, zemedenaane bamaqathalenaa malekaame welataane bamawaale tagodaanyaacawe. ba'enee 'anedenate bamaamanenaa bamataazaze wadaneeme yatamalasane sawe manegade takatale. kaziyaame batenesaa'ee qane hulaacehume mamalashaacehu wada 'enee becaa nawe. baqerebitume `aalame teszarute yanabaraacehuteneme szeraa hulu 'enageraacexwaalahu. ba'esume 'emanadaacexwaalahu.

lejee hoye! mathefo wayeme malekaame szeraa yagomane zare qenethaate kebedate yaahele honaa yafalagawene yaahele betaanesenaa baqwaathenye wesethe maaneme bamaayaayaate wayeme basamaayaatenaa bamedere bayatenyaaweme botaa betehone 'alaahe batenesaa'eewe qane ba'eregethe yaamathaataale. baariyaaweneme ba'ereswa laaye yemanadaawaale. 'alaahe 'ejege yaanasu nagaroce 'enekwaane yamaayesawarubate theleqe `aawaaqi nawe. 'ewenataacawene 'enaa botaacaweneme chemere theleqe `aawaaqi nawe.

lejee hoye! salaatene batamwalaa maleku 'asetakaakelahe 'aqwaaqume. bamalekaame nagareme 'ezaze. kamathefome hulu kalekele. bamiyaaganyeheme cegere laaye taagase. yehe yataazazekawe nagare 'alaahe 'enedeteszaraawe yawasanabehe nagare nawe basu laaye leelaa merechaa yalaheme.

fiteheneme bakuraate kasawoce 'ataazure. bamedereme laaye baraasehe yametedanaqe 'enaa yakoraahe honahe 'atehide. 'alaahe ba'akaaheedu yaminethabaararene; ka'alaaheme batasathawe tzagaa basawe lejoce laaye yamikofasene; guranyaa yahonane, ya'alaaheneme tzagaa yamaayaamasagenene 'ayewademe.

ba'akaaheedeheme bamafethane 'enaa bamaneqaraafafe mahakale 'eregaataa yaalabatene 'akaaheede hide ('eremejaa taraamade); demetzeheneme zeqe 'aderege! sawocene bamirabeshe maleku kafe 'ataaderege! kademetzoceme hulu kafetanyaa bamahonu 'aseqayaamiwe demetze ya'aheyoce nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'alaahe basamaayaate yaalutene tzahhaye, charaqaane 'enaa kawaakebetene, bamedereme yaaluteneme taneqasaaqaashe 'enesesaate, zaafocene 'enaa 'azere`etene 'enedetethaqamubate yaagaraalaacehu mahonune 'ataayumene? 'enedaamaara maleke 'enaa takela-sawenate yaalu geletze yahonu, 'enedihume 'eneda 'a`emero 'enaa `eweqate yaalu debeqe tzagaawocune hulu 'amwalaalaacehu. 'enazihe tzagaawoce kamanoraacaweme gaare, kasawe lejoce makaakale ka'alaahe bahona malakotaawi male`ekete laaye saayemarakoze, beruhe 'a`emeroneme saayethaqame ka'alaahe yawaradaneme geletze yahonane matsehhafe saayeze sela 'alaahe 'anedenate yamikaraakare 'ala.

la'enazihe ba'alaahe 'anedenate laaye lamikaraakarute 'alaahe bamale'eketanyaawe laaye yaawaradawene takatalu batabaalu gizee, 'anekataleme. yelequneme 'enyaa yaalafute 'abaatocaacenene yaaganyanebatene yathaa`ote 'amelekote manegadene nawe yamenekatalawe yelaalu. lamahonu shayethwane 'enasune bamiyaasaasetebate yathaa`ote 'ameleko kaziyaame batenesaa'ee wada tagaagaamace, 'esaate qethaate yamitharaacawe bihoneme 'enekwaa qadametocaacawene yekatalaalune?!

'eresu 'amelekotune la'alaahe becaa yaadaraga; szeraaweneme 'asaamero wada 'alaahe fitune yaazora sawe; madehenene lamifalege hulu 'ejege 'asetamaamaanye 'enaa sela maqorathu fetzume segaate yamaayegabaawe yahonane nagare chabethwale;yanagarume hulu mamalashaa wada 'alaahe becaa nawe. huluneme yamigabaacawene yemanadaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'alaahe yakaada sawe kehedatu 'ayaasaazenehe. batenesaa'eewe qane mamalashaacawe wada 'enyaa nawe. baduneyaa yaszaruteneme mathefo szeraa hulu 'enenageraacawaalane. bareswame laaye 'enemanadaacawaalane. 'alaahe baleboce wesethe yaalane hulu yaaweqaale. ba'eswa wesethe yaalawe meneme 'ayesawarebateme.

baqerebitume hheyewate bamenesathaacawe thaafaache nagaroce theqitene gizee 'enedidasatu 'enaadaregaacawaalane. kaziyaame batenesaa'eewe qane beretu qethaate (ya'esaate qethaate) wesethe 'enechameraacawaalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaane 'agaariwocene samaayaatene 'enaa mederene maane 'enedafatharaacawe betethayeqaacawe; <<ba'eregethe 'alaahe nawe>> yelaalu. 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<maaserajaawene banaaneta laaye geletze bamaaderagu mesegaanaa la'alaahe yegabaawe. yelequneme 'abezaanyaawocu maayemaane bamahonaacawe lamesegaanaa tagabiwe maane 'enedahona 'ayaawequme.>>

basamaayaate 'enaa bamedere yaalawene hulu mafethare baselethaanu sere maaderage 'enaa maasetanaabare ya'alaahe becaa nawe. 'alaahe 'esu kafethuraanu hulu yatabeqaaqaa baduneyaame bamacharashaayetu `aalameme mesegune nawe.

kazaafeme bamedere laaye yaalawe hulu taqorethonaa taqaretzo be'eroce bihone; baahherume laaye leeloce sabaate baahheroce bichamaru 'enaa qalame bihonu ya'alaahe qaalaate yamaayaalequ bamahonaacawe tatzefawe 'ayaalequme. 'alaahe maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi; bamafethareme bamaasetanaabareme thebabanyaa nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'enaanetane mafethare 'enaanetane batenesaa'ee qane lagemegamaa 'enaa lamenedaa maqaseqase kaqelatu yatanasaa 'anedite nafesene 'eneda mafethare 'enaa maqaseqase 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame. 'alaahe ya'anedune demetze kamasemaate leelaa demetze yamaayaazanaagaawe sami; 'anedene nagare kamaayate leelaa nagare yamaayaagedawe tamalekaace nawe. 'enedazihume 'aneditene nafese mafethare wayeme maqaseqase leelaawene kamafethareme kamaqaseqaseme 'ayaazanaagaaweme.

lamahonu 'alaahe qanune lamaarezame kalalitu siqanese 'enedihume lalitu 'enedirazeme dagemo kaqanu siqanese; yatzahhayenenaa yacharaqaaneme magwaazhaa yawasana 'enaa 'esekatawasana `elate deraseme batawasanalaacawe mehewaare 'enedigwaazume maaderagune; 'alaaheme yameteszarutene hulu bazerezere `aawaaqinaa kaszeraawocaacehu meneme yamaayesawarebate 'enedihume baszeraacehume 'enedamimanadaacehume 'atemalakatumene.

yehe maasetanaabare 'enaa mawasane yahonawe 'alaahe ba'akaalu, babaaheriwe 'enaa batagebaaru 'ewenate mahonune yaaseradaale. 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce ka'esu wechi yamigazute 'esu meneme maszarate yaleelawe weshate nawe. 'alaaheme ba'akaalu, bacelotaawe 'enaa baxaayaalenatu kafethuraanu hulu yabalaaye, ka'esu balaaye maaneme yaleela, kahulume nagaroce 'esu taalaaqe geetaa bamahonu nawe.

'enaaneta yasawe lejoce hoye! ya'alaahene celotaa 'enaa 'ezenatene kamiyaaseradu 'asedanaaqi meleketocu liyaasaayaacehu zanede marekaboce ba'alaahe 'ezenate 'enaa maageraate baahhere laaye yamineqasaaqasu mahonaacawene 'ataayumene? bazihe wesethe bamiyaagaathemawe cegere bathaame taagaashenaa bamiyaagaathemawe tzagaa 'amasegaanye lahona hulu lacaayenatu meleketoce 'alubate.

'eneda taraaroce 'enaa damanaawoce yahona maa`ebale kaya'aqethaachaawe baakaababaacawenaa bashafanaacawe gizee lemanaane 'enaa 'amelekotene la'eresu becaa yaatharu honawe 'alaahene yemaatzanutaale. 'alaaheme latheriyaacawe melaashe basathaacawenaa wada yabeseme bamaasewathaate siyaadenaacawe; kamasethameme sithabeqaacawe; ka'enasume gedeetaa yahonabatene mesegaanaa batamwalaa maleku yamaayetagabere quthebe 'ala; ka'enasume ya'alaahene tzagaa yamikede 'ala; ya'enyaane ta`aameraate yamikedawe ka'adagaa yamiyaadenawe kahona 'eresune kamiyaamasegenute 'enedamihone la'alaahe qaale gabeto siyaabaqaa qaalune yaathafa 'ataalaaye kadaatanyaa 'enaa 'alaahe yawaalalatene tzagaa kahadi 'enedihume batasathawe tzagaa fathaariwene yamaayaamasagene sawe nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! te`ezaazune bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe geetaacehune feru. walaajeme laleju yamaayethaqemebatene lejeme lawalaaju meneme thaqaami yamaayehonebatene qane qethaate feru. 'alaahe batenesaa'eewe qane mamanedaate qaale yagabaawe makasatu yamaayeqare yataragaagatha nawenaa. qerebitume heyewate bawesethwa baalu semeetoce 'enaa maazanaagiyaawoce 'ateshanegelaacehu. 'alaaheme taageswacehu qethaataacehune bamaazageyatu shayethwane 'ayaataalelaacehu.

yasa`aatitu (tenesaa'ee yamikasatebate qane) `eweqate 'alaahe zanede becaa nawe. macee 'enedametekasate yaaweqaale; zenaabeneme bafalagawe gizee yaawaredaale; bamaahetzaneme wesethe yaalawene wanede yehune seete, `edelanyaa yehune manaathi; yamiyaaweqawe 'alaahe becaa nawe. maanenyaayetume nafese naga yameteszaraawene malekaame wayeme mathefo 'ataaweqeme. maanenyaayetume nafese bayatenyaawe medere 'enedametemote 'ataaweqeme. ba'ewenate 'alaahe 'enazihene hulu yaaweqaale. 'alaahe nagarocene hulu bazerezere `aawaaqi nawe. meneme yamiwasawarebate nagare yalame.

yehe muhhamade (salalaa `aalayehi wasalame) yezote yamathaawe qure'aane yatawaradawe ka`aalamaatu geetaa nawe. bazihe laaye meneme therethere yalaweme.

'enaziyaa kahadiwoce muhhamade bageetaawe laaye qathafa yelaalune? 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! nagaru 'enasu 'enedaalute 'ayedalame. yelequne 'esu kageetaahe zanede yawarada meneme therethere yaleelawe 'ewenate nawe. kaaneta bafite ka'alaahe qethaate yamiyaasefaraaraacawe male'eketanyaa yaalemathaalaacawene hhezeboce letaasefaraaraabate yatawarada nawe. 'enaresu 'ewenatene bamakatalenaa ba'esume bamaszeraate limarubate yekajalaalenaa.

'alaahe yaa samaayaatene 'enaa mederene bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawene hulu basedesete qanaate wesethe yafathara nawe.'esume 'enazihene ka`aayene belechetaa bafathana gizee wesethe mafethare yecelaale. kaziyaame ka`areshu balaaye laleqenaawe bamigabaawe maleku kafe 'ala. 'enaaneta sawoce hoye! ka'eresu leelaa lagudaayaacehu xaalaafinatene yamiwasede thabaaqi yalaacehume geetaacehu zanede yamiyaamaalede 'amaalaajeme yalaacehume. 'ataasetanatenumene? ka'esu gaare leelaane saataagaaru yafatharaacehune 'alaahene becaa 'ategazumene?!

yehene hulu yaasetanaabarawe ruquneme qerebuneme hulu `aawaaqiwe nawe. ka'esu meneme nagare 'ayesawareme. 'eresu maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi; kathalaatu yamibaqale 'enaa lame'emanaane baarocume 'azaanye nawe.
yaa yafatharawene nagare hulu yaasaamara 'enaa yasaweneme (ya'adaamene) fetherate yaala qadaami 'amesaayaa kacheqaa yajamara nawe.
kaziyaame baxwaalaa zereyaawocune kadakaamaa weha (yazare fasaashe) yafathara nawe.

kaziyaame qeretzune bamaasetakaakale 'amwaleto sawene fathara. kaziyaame 'esetenefaasene bamanefaate batamadabaweme male'ake 'amaakaayenate 'esetenefaasune nafaabate. 'enaaneta sawoce hoye! la'enaanetame yametesamubatene jorowocene, yametaayubate `aayenocene 'enaa yametaasebubatene lebocene 'adaragalaacehu. 'alaahe kasathaacehunaa banaaneta laaye kawaalalaacehu tzagaawoce theqitene becaa taamasagenaalaacehu?!

kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yamiyaasetabaabelu 'agaariwoceme bamedereme wesethe motane bathafaane gizeenaa 'akaalaacene 'afare kahona baxwaalaa 'enyaa 'eneda 'adise fetherate hheyaawe honane 'eneqasaqasaalane? yamitaasabe 'ayedalame 'alu. yelequne batachabaache huneetaacawe kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene kahadiwoce naacawe ba'esume 'ayaamenume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene lamiyaasetabaabelu 'agaariwoce - <<ba'enaaneta laaye nafesaacehune lamawesade 'alaahe yamadabawe male'aaka mote yegadelaacexwaale. kaziyaame batenesaa'eewe qane lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa wada 'enyaa becaa temalasaalaacehu>> balaacawe.

'amatzanyoceme batenesaa'eewe qane maqaseqasene bamakaadaacawe mekeneyaate tawaaredawe 'anegataacawene yaaqaraqaru honawe baweredate semeete <<geetaacene hoye! senaasetabaabelawe yanabarawene maqaseqasene tamalakatene. male'eketanyoce kaaneta zanede yezawete yamathutene 'ewenatene samaane 'anetane yamenaasewadedebate malekaame szeraane 'eneszaraalanenaa wada duneyaa hheyewate malesane 'enyaa maqaseqasene 'enaa male'eketanyoce yezawete yamathutene nagaroce 'aragaagethanaale>> yamilu sihonu betaaye noro teleqe nagare taaye nabare.

lanafese hulu qenenatene 'enaa lamalekaame nagare sekeetene masethate benefalege noro lazihe 'enegaabezaate nabare. nagare gene ka'emenate manegadenaa katzenaate yeleqe yakehedatenenaa yathematene manegade bamamerathaacawe yatanasaa batenesaa'eewe `elate bakahadi sawocenaa 'agaanenetoce 'esaatene 'emolaataalahu yamilawe thebabenaa fetehe yaazalawe qaalee taragaagethwale.

'enasune bamaweqase 'enaa bamaawaarade maleku batenesaa'eewe qane ka'alaahe gaare lagemegamaa maganaanyatene baduneyaa hheyewate bamazanegaataacehu mekeneyaate qethaatune qemasu. baqethaate wesethe lametesaqaayubate gede yaleelane sihone 'enetawaacexwaalane baduneyaa laaye teszarute banabaraacehuteme wanejale mekeneyaate: zawetaarine qethaate qemasu yebaalaalu.

'alaahe ya'amatzanyocene huneetaa kaawasaa baxwaalaa ya'amaanyocene huneetaa qathelo sigaletze 'enedihe 'ala -
male'eketanyaacene laaye yatawaradu 'aneqatzocaacene yamiyaamenute ba'eswa batamakaru gizee 'alaahene kamesegaanaa gaare yamiyaatharu sihonu sagaajoce naacawe. 'enasume 'alaahene lamagazaatenaa la'eresu bayatenyaaweme huneetaa lamasegade 'ayekorume.

gonocaacawe tanyetawebaacawe kanabarute feraashaacawe bamaraaqe wada geetaacawe fitaacawene bamaazore basegedataacawe wesethe ya'esune qethaate bamaferaatenaa 'ezenatune bamakajale yelamenutaale. kasathanaacaweme ganezabe ba'alaahe manegade laaye yelagesaalu.

baduneyaame yeszarute kanabarute malekaame szeraawoce 'enasune lamamanedaate la`aayenocaacawe maregiyaa (maarafiyaa): 'alaahe yaazagaajalaacawene tzagaa maanenyaawaame nafese 'ataaweqeme. yehenene menedaa ka'alaahe basetaqare maaneme 'ayaaweqaweme.

ba'alaahe 'amaanye yahona 'enaa bate`ezaazu maszarate yamiszaraa 'enedihume yakalakalawene yamireqe sawe ka'alaahe te'ezaaze 'enedawathaa sawe 'ayedalame. hulatu 'alaahe zanede bamenedaa bakule 'ayesetakaakalume.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru, 'alaahe 'enasune bamaakebare duneyaa wesethe yeszarute banabarute malekaame szeraawoce mekeneyaate menedaa yehone zanede bajanatoce manoriyaane 'azagaajetolaacawaale.

ba'alaaheme 'aneqatzoce tamakero kamaayegasatze kaziyaame bagede yalashenate ka'eresu kaafanagatha sawe yebalethe badalanyaa yalame. 'enyaa kehedatene 'enaa wanejalene bamafatzame ka'alaahe 'aneqatzoce yaraaqu 'amatzanyocene tabaqaayoce nane. yaame yamaayeqare gudaaye nawe.

musaaneme matsehhafene ba'eregethe sathanawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! balalite guzohenaa wada samaaye baaragekebate gizee musaane maagenyatehene 'atetharaathare. bamusaa laaye yawaradawene matsehhafe laseraa'eele lejoce kathememate wada qathetanyaa manegade mari 'adaragenawe.

ya'alaahene te'ezaaze bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe sawocene wada 'ewenate manegade sithaaru bamiyaagaathemwacaweme cegeroce bataagasu 'enaa bamale'eketanyaacawe laaye bawaradulaacawe ta`aamerocaacenene yamiyaaragaagethu bahonume gizee ka'eseraa'eele lejoce ba'ewenate laaye sawoce yamikatalwacawe wada 'ewenate yamimaru mariwoce 'adaragene.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe 'enaresu baduneyaa siwazaagabubate yanabarutene gudaaye 'ewenatanyaawene katasaasaatawe bamagelatze batenesaa'eewe qane bamahakalaacawe yefaredaale. huluneme yamigabaacawene yemanadaale.

yaalafutene hhezeboce bezuwocene yaathafaane mahonaacene 'aletagalatzalaacawemene? mamalekate tasaanaacawene? 'enasu kamathefaataacawe bafite yenorubaacawe banabarute bamanoriyaawocaacawe yamiheedu sihonu bahuneetaacawe gene 'aletagasatzume. 'enaziyaane hhezeboce bakehedataacawe 'enaa bawanejalaacawe mekeneyaate maathefaataacene male'eketanyocaacawe ka'alaahe zanede yaamathute male`ekete tekekele lamahonu thaqwaami mamaariyaa nawe. 'enazihe ba'alaahe 'aneqatzoce yamiyaasetabaabelute yamamakarenaa yamaqabale masemaatene 'ayesamumene?

'enaziyaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yamiyaasetabaabelute sawoce 'enyaa wehane yamaataabaqele wada honacewe daraqe medere yamenaawarede mahonaacenene kaziheme weha gemalocaacawe, kabetocaacawe bagenaa feyalocaacawe 'enaa nafesocaacawe yamimagabutene 'azere`etocene maabeqalaacenene 'ayemalakatumene? yeheneneme bamamalekate daraqe yahonacewene medere heyaawe yaadaraga mutaanene hheyaawe yamiyaadarege mahonune 'ayaasetawelume 'enaa 'ayeradumene?

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehe qatharo yamiragaagathawe yatenesaa'ee qane nawe balaacawe. babaaroce makaakale yamilayebate yamalayaa qane sihone 'enaziyaa baduneyaa 'eyaalu ba'alaahe yakaadute sawoce batenesaa'eewe qane qethaatune katamalakatu baxwaalaa 'emenataacawe 'ayethaqemaacaweme. wada geetaacaweme tatzatzatawe 'enedimalasu yaqoyetaa gizee 'ayesathaacaweme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enazihene bathememataacawe laaye getere yahonutene tawaacawe. ba'enasu laaye yamiwaredebaacawene qethaate tathabaabaqe. 'enasume yaqatharekaacawene qethaate tathabaabaaqiwoce naacawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! ya'alaahene te'ezaaze bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahene becaa bamaferaate tzenaa. kahadiwocene 'enaa manaafeqaaneneme zenebaaleeyaacawene bamakatale 'atetaazaze. 'alaahe kahadiwoce 'enaa manaafeqaane yamiyaaseerutene hulu `aawaaqi, bamafethare 'enaa bamaasetanaabare thebabanyaa nawe.
geetaaheme wada 'aneta yaawaradawene male`ekete takatale. 'alaahe yameteszarutene hulu zerezere `aawaaqi nawenaa. meneme yamiyaamalethawe nagare yalame. baszeraawocaacehume yemanadaacexwaale.
bagudaayeheme hulu ba'alaahe laaye becaa tamakaa. kabaarocu ba'esu yamimakutene bathebaqaa bakule 'alaahe baqi nawe.

'anedaanedocu 'enedamiyaasebute 'alaahe ba'anede sawe darate wesethe hulate lebe 'alaadaragame. 'enedazihume misetocaacehune 'eneda 'enaatocaacehu ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme (kelekele) 'alaadaragame. 'enedihume leje bamaaderage yaasethagaacexwaacawene yamaadago lejene 'eneda 'aberaake lejaacehu 'alaadaragame. zihaare (misetene 'eneda 'enaatee jarebaa nashe maalate) 'anede baale misetune baraasu laaye 'ereme maaderage sihone 'enedazihume yamaadagone leje 'eneda 'aberaake leju 'aderego mayaaze yamaayemace lemede hono selaame wedeqe yaadaragaacawe naacawe. yehe zihare 'enaa ya'aberaake leje yaalehonane ba'asaadaagi seme yamitharaa leje maaderage ba'afocaacehu yametelutenaa yametaamalaalesute 'ewenataanate yaleelawe nawe. misete 'enaatu 'ayedalaceme; 'asaadaagime lamaadago leje walaaje 'abaatu 'ayedalame. 'alaaheme baarocu 'enedisarubate 'ewenatune yenaagaraale. 'esume wada tekekelanyaawe manegade yemaraale.

lejocaacene naacawe yametelwacawene batekekelanyaa 'abaataacawe seme therwacawe. bawalaaje seme matheraatu 'esu 'alaahe zanede mizaanaawinate nawe. 'enasune yametetharubate 'abaatocaacaweneme baataawequ kahaayemaanotenaa kabaarenate natsaa yaasewathaacexwaacawe wanedemocaacehu naacawe. wanedemee hoye! ya'agotee leje hoye! 'eyaalaacehu therwacawe. ba'asaadaagiwe bamatheraate 'anedaacehu bisaasaate ba'enaaneta laaye hathi'aate yalabaacehume. gene 'aweqaacehu bametenaagarute hathi'aate 'alabaacehu. 'alaaheme kabaarocu wada'esu bamamalase latatzatzata mahari la'enasume 'azaanye nawe. basehetate baszarute 'ayezaacaweme.

me'emanaane meneme 'enekwaa nafesaacawe wada leelaa betaazanabeleme yaraasaacawene zenebaalee kamakatale yeleqe nabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yaadaragulaacawene theri litaazazu yegabaacawaale. baalabeetocume lame'emanaane hulu 'enaatocaacawe naacawe. bamahonume nabiyu kamotu baxwaalaa maaneme 'amaanye 'enasune maagebaate ba'eresu laaye 'ereme nawe. yazemedenaa baalabeetoceme kafilaacawe lakafilu bamawaraarase ba'alaahe hege kame'emanaane 'enaa ba'alaahe manegade laaye katasadadute sedatanyoce yeleqe tagabi naacawe. (ba'eselemenaa majamariyaa gizee laaye me'emanaane sedatanyoce kaleeloce gaare yewaraarasu nabare. kaziyaa baxwaalaa gene yamawaraarase hegu tashaara.) nagare gene 'enaaneta me'emanaane kawaraashe wechi lahonu wadaajocaacehu malekaamene nagare betenaazazu yefaqadaale. yehe denegaagee batathabaqawe mazegabe (lawehhale maahhefuze) wesethe yatamazagaba nawe. yeheneneme tagebaaraawi maaderage yagede nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kanabiyaatoceme 'alaahene becaa 'enedigazu, ba'esume meneneme maaneneme 'enedaayaagaaru, yawaradalaacawene male`ekete 'enediyaadaresu yathabaqa qaale kidaanene batalayeme ka'aneta, kanuhheme, kaberaahimeme, kamusaame, kamareyame leje `isaame bawasadene gizee 'asetaawese. ka'enasume ya'alaahene male`ekete 'enediyaadaresu yatasathaacawene 'adaraa 'enediyaamwalu yakabadane qaale kidaane taqabalene.

'alaahe yehenene thanekaaraa qaale kidaane kanabiyaatocu yataqabalawe 'ewenatanyaa male'eketanyocene sela'ewenatanyaa male'eketaacawe bamathayaqe kahadiyaanene lamaashamaaqaqe nawe. 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyocune lakaaduteme batenesaa'eewe 'elate 'asaamaami yahonawene yajahaname 'esaate qethaate 'azagaajetolaacawaale.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa bate'ezaazu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! 'enaanetane lamawaagaate bezu szaraawitene bamasabesabe 'enasuneme yamiyaagezu manaafeqaanene 'enaa 'ayehudocene chamerawe thalaatoce wada madinaa bamathubaacehu gizee ba'enasu laaye nafaasene laakene (yanefaasu seme "sobaa" yamibaale sihone nabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) dele yaaganyubate nefaase nawe) yaalaayaacexwaacawene yamalaa'ekete szaraawiteneme laakene. kahadiyaaneme meneme yamaayecelu sihonu jarebaacawene sathetawe shashu. 'alaahe la'enaaneta yawaalalalaacehune tzagaawene 'asetaawesu. 'alaahe yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe meneme nagare 'ayesawarebateme. baszeraawocaacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

yeheme yahonawe kahadiwoce kashalaqowe balaayeme, bataaceme, bameseraaqume, bame`eraabume 'aqethaachaa bamathubaacehu gizee, `aayenoceme wada thalaate kamamalekate weche wada leelaa mamalekate bamaayecelubate gizee,kaferehateme yatanasaa leboce laaneqaawoce laaye badarasu 'enaa dele bamaagenyate 'enaa tasefaa bamaquratheme mahale bahona semeete wesethe honaacehu ba'alaahe laaye yatalayaayu therethaareewoce batharatharaacehu gizee yahonawene 'asetaawesu.

bazihe bakxanedaqe zamacaa thalaatoce kaya'aqethaachaawe bamasabaasabaacawe mekeneyaate me'emanaane tafatanu. kakabaade ferehateme yatanasaa kabaade maneqatheqathene taneqathaqathu. baziheme fatanaa manaafeqaane kame'emanaane talayu.

baziyaanu qane manaafeqaane 'enaa 'enaziyaa balebocaacawe wesethe therethaaree yaalabaacawe; ba'emenataacawe dakaamaa yahonute <<'alaahenaa male'eketanyaawe bathalaatoce laaye dele sela maqadaajatene 'enaa bamedere laaye tamacaacetane selamanore yagabulene qaale maszarate yaleelawe kanetu nagare 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame>> 'alu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kamanaafeqaaneme yahonu kefeloce lamadinaa sawoce, <<yayaseribe (yamadinaa yaqademo semwa nabare) sawoce hoye! lakxanedaqe qerebe kahonawe yasale`e taraaraa sanesalate maqomiyaa seferaa yalaacehumenaa wadayabeetaacehu tamalasu>> baalu gizee yahonawene 'asetaawese! ka'enaresume makaakale kafilocu <<beetaacene lathalaate yatagaalatha nawenaa wada beetaacene 'enedenemalase yefeqadulene>> bamaalate nabiyune (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame)ne feqaade yethayeqaalu; 'ewenataawe gene 'enasu 'enedaalute beetaacawe lathalaate yatagaalatha 'ayedalame. baziheme weshate mekeneyaate kathalaate mashashene 'eneji leelaane 'ayefalegume.

bamadinaa zureyaa yaalu thalaatoce kaya'aqethaachaawe bigabubaacawenaa wada kehedatenaa shereke (la'alaahe tagaari wada maaderage) 'enedimalasu bithayeqwaacawe: yegabubate nabare; wada kehedateme kamamalase: qaaleneme kamaathafe teneshene gizee 'eneji 'ayeqoyume.

'enaziyaa manaafeqaane ka'uhude zamacaa kashashu baxwaalaa 'alaahe leelaa wegiyaa laaye biganyume: thalaatene 'enewaagaalane thalaatene faretane 'aneshasheme: bamaalate qaale gabetawe nabare; genaa qaalaacawene 'afarasu; baariyaaweme la'alaahe bagabaawe qaale kidaane tathayaaqi nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lanazihe manaafeqaane <<motene wayeme magadalene faretaacehu beteshashu kawegiyaa mashashaacehu 'ayethaqemaacehume; mekeneyaatume `edemee yatawasana nawenaa wegiyaa motene 'ayaaqarebeme mashasheme kamote 'ayaareqeme; beteshashunaa gizeeyaacehume baayedarese yaane gizeeme bazihe hheyewate theqitene gizee 'eneji 'atethaqaaqamume.>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye yametethalutene mote wayeme gedeyaane bifalege ka'alaahe yamithabeqaacehu maanawe? wayeme yametemanyutene salaame mahonene 'enaa malekaame nagarene bishaa kazihe maaneme 'ayaagedaacehume>> balaacawe. 'enazihe manaafeqaane ka'alaahe leelaa yamithabeqaacawe thabaaqime; ka'alaahe qethaate yamikalaakalelaacawe radaateme 'ayaaganyume.

ka'enaaneta wesethe leelocene kamale'eketanyaawe gaare honawe 'enedaayewaagu wadaxwaalaa yamiyaaseqarutenenaa lawanedemocaacaweme <<wadanyaa nu ka'esu gaare 'enedaatewaagu tegadalaalaacehunaa>> yamilutene 'alaahe ba'eregethe yaaweqaacawaale. 'enazihe leelocene wadaxwaalaa yamiyaaseqaru sawoce wegiyaaneme theqitene gizee 'eneji 'ayemathume 'ayesaatafumeme. yeheme wesene tasaatefo 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene lamaredaate saayehone raasaacawene kawaqasaa 'enaa kaweredate lamakalaakale nawe.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! 'enazihe manaafeqaane ganezabaacawene kamalagase; 'enaanetane kamaredaate raasaacawene wegiyaa laaye kamaasaatafe 'enaa 'enaanetane kamawudade nefugoce naacawe. 'ayeradwacehumeme, ka'enaaneta gaare honaweme 'ayewaagume. kathalaate gaare magaathame 'enaa ferehaahate bamathaa gizee mote ba'eresu laaye 'enedatathaadabate sawe `aayenocaacawe kaferehate yatanasaa wadiyaanaa wadihe yamiqaabezu honawe wada 'aneta simalakatu taayaacawaalahe. ferehaatume heedo bataragaagume gizee baganezabe laaye yamisaasu honawe basalu melaasoce bamathefo negegere yewagwaacexwaale. bamereko laaye segebegeboce bamahonaacawe 'ejege yefalegwaataale. banazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatzute ba'ewenate 'alaamanume. bamahonume 'alaahe yaszeraawocaacawene menedaa 'athafaabaacawe. yeheme maathefaate ba'alaahe laaye qalaale nawe.

'enanyaa fariwoce ya'alaahe male'eketanyaane 'enaa me'emanaanene lamawaagaate yatasabasabute 'ahhezaabe me'emanaanene dabezaacawene saayaathafu 'ayeheedume belawe yaasebaalu; 'ahhezaabocume lahulatanyaa gizee bimathu 'enanyaa fari manaafeqaane madinaa baayehonunaa kamadinaa reqawe kazalaanoce gaare mahonene yemanyaalu. kathalaatoce gaare batadaragawe wegiyaa mene 'enedaagaathamaacehu sela wareewocaacehu yethayeqaalu. 'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! ka'enaaneta gaare bihonu noro theqitene 'eneji 'ayewaagume nabare. tekurate 'atesethwacawe, ba'enasume gudaaye hhazane 'ayesamaacehu.

ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa batanaagarawenaa baszaraawe hulu la'enaaneta malekaame 'are'ayaa 'alalaacehu. batakabarawe 'akaalu taganyetwale wagiyaaweneme tasaatefwale. kazihe baxwaalaa 'enedeete banafesaacehu laaye tesasetaalaacehu? ya'alaahene male'eketanyaa 'eresu yaa yamacharashaawene qane yamikajelenaa laziyaame qane yamiszaraa, 'alaaheneme babezu yamiyaawasaa 'eneji 'ayekataleme. yaa yamacharashaawene qane yamaayekajelawenaa 'alaahene babezu yamaayaawasaa gene ya'alaahe male'eketanyaane 'ayekataleme.

'amaanyocume 'ahhezaabe 'enasune lamawaagaate tasabesabawe baayu gizee <<yehe 'alaahenaa male'eketanyaawe yaqatharune fatanaa, makaraanaa dele nawe.>> 'alaahenaa male'eketanyaaweme bazihe laaye 'ewenatene tanaagaru; tagebaaraawime hona 'alu. 'ahhezaabene maayataacawe ba'alaahe maamanenenaa mataazazeneme 'eneji leelaane 'alechamaralaacaweme.

ka'amaanyoce makaakale ba'alaahe manegade batzenaate 'enaa bate`egesete bamataagale laaye la'alaahe yagabutene qaale kidaane ba'ewenate yafatzamu wanedoce 'alu. ka'enaresume yamota wayeme ba'alaahe manegade yatagadala 'ala. ka'enasume ba'esu manegade laaye samaa`etenatene yamithabaabaqe 'ala. manaafeqaane qaalaacawene 'enedaathafu me'emanaane la'alaahe yagabutene qaale 'alelawathume.

'alaahe laresu yagabutene qaale bamaamwalaate 'ewenatanyocene ba'ewenatanyaanataacawenaa qaalaacawene bamaamwalaataacawe limanadaa; qaalaacawene yaathafu manaafeqaaneneme kafalaga neseha saayegathemaacawe bakehedataacawe 'enedimotu bamaaderage liqathaa wayeme laneseha gathemwacawe tzatzataacawene liqabale yehene 'adaraga. 'alaahe kathefaatu latamalasa mahari la'esume 'azaanye nawe.

'enaziyaane 'amaanyocene lamawaagaate yatasabasabutene qurayeshenaa ka'enaresu gaare yaaluteme kahadiyaane yaalamute saayesaakaalaacawe baquchetenaa bacheneqate yatamolu honawe 'alaahe malasaacawe; 'amaanyocene kaszere maszarataacawe lamaathefaate yaalelamute 'aletasaakaalaacaweme. 'amaanyocuneme 'enasune kamagaadale nefaasene bamalaake 'enaa malaa'eketene bamaawerade 'alaahe baqaacawe. 'alaaheme beretu 'enaa maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi nawe.

'enaziyaaneme ka'ayehudoce yahonu 'ahhezaabocene thalaatocaacawe mashegawebaacawe kanabarute meshegocaacawe 'alaahe 'awaradaacawe. balebocaacaweme wesethe ferehatene thaalabaacawe. 'enaaneta me'emanaane kafilune tegadelaalaacehu. kafiluneme temaarekaalaacehu.

'alaahe 'enasune kaathafaa baxwaalaa mederaacaweneme bawesethwa kayaazacewe 'azere`etenaa zamebaabaa gaare beetocaacaweneme, ganezabocaacaweneme ganaa yaaleragathaacexwaateneme lawadafitu yameteragethwatene yakxayebarene medere 'awarasaacehu; yeheme la'amaanyoce yatagabaa qaalenaa beseraate nawe. 'alaaheme nagarune hulu caaye nawe. meneme 'ayaaqetaweme.

'aneta nabiye hoye! lamisetocehe wachine 'enedetaasafaalaacawe bathayaquhe gizeenaa 'aneta gaare letaasafaalaacawe baalecaaleke gizee <<qerebitune hheyewatenaa bawesethwa yaalawene geethwane yametefalegu kahonaacehu nu yamifatu seetoce yamithaqaaqamubatene 'athaqaaqemaacexwaalahu (yamisathaacawene ganezabe 'esathaacexwaalahu). magudaate 'enaa maasecagare yaleelabatene fece 'efataacexwaalahu>> balaacawe.

<<ya'alaahene 'enaa yamale'eketanyaawene wedeetaa 'enedihume bamacharashaayetume hagare janatene yametefalegu kahona baalaacehubate huneetaa taagasu. 'enaho 'alaahe ka'enaaneta bate`egesete malekaamene laszarunaa bamalekaame latadaadaru teleqene menedaa 'azagaajetwale>> balaacawe.

yanabiyu baalabeetoce hoye! ka'enaaneta wesethe geletze yahonane tzayaafe tagebaare yameteszaraa yaalacebatene botaanaa darajaa 'enedihume yanabiyune kebere lamathabaqe sibaale batenesaa'eewe qane qethaatu hulate 'ethefe hono yenabaabarebaataale. yeheme qethaatene maanabaabaru 'alaahe zanede qalaale nawe.

ka'enaaneta makaakale 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene yametetaazaze 'enaa 'alaahe zanede tawadaaje yahonawene malekaame szeraaneme yameteszaraa menedaawaane laleeloce seetoce kamenesathawe hulate 'ethefe bamaaderage 'enesathaataalane. la'ereswame batenesaa'eewe qane malekaamene menedaa 'azagaajetanelaataale. 'esume janate nawe.

yanabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) baalabeetoce hoye! badarajaanaa bakebere 'enedaleeloce seetoce 'ayedalaacehume. yelequne 'enaaneta ya'alaahene te'ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene betefaru ka'enaaneta weche maaneme yaaledarasabate darajaanaa kebere 'alalaacehu. banegegere 'atelasaalasu baa`ede yahonutene wanedoce setaanaageru demetzaacehune bamaaqethane 'ateqelaselasu. baziheme mekeneyaate lebu wesethe nefeqenaanaa yatzayaafe tagebaare felaagote bashetaa yaalabate sawe yekajelaalenaa. katherethaaree yaraaqane 'enaa qalede yaalehonane bagudaayaacehu mathane yamere negegerene tanaagaru.

babeetocaacehume wesethe 'eregu. lagudaaye kaalehona basetaqare 'atewethu. kaselaame bafite seetoce yaadaregute 'enedanabaruteme 'enedamajamariyaawe maayemenate gizee bamaageethe 'ategalathu. wanedocene lamaamaalale silu yegalaalathu nabarenaa. salaateneme batamwalaa maleku 'aqwaaqumu. yaganezabaacehune gedeetaawi metzewaateneme sethu. 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaaweneme taazazu. yanabiyu baalabeetocenaa beetasaboce hoye! 'alaahe ka'enaaneta laaye qoshaashaanenaa mathefone nagare liyaasewagede yeshaale. nafesocaacehuneme bamalekaame senamegebaare bamaasewaabenaa mathefo baaheriyaatene bamaasewagade qoshaashaane yamaayaaseqare mulu maatheraatene liyaatharaacehu yefalegaale.

bamale'eketanyaawe laaye ka'alaahe yatawaradutene 'aneqatzocenenaa netzuhe yahonawene yamale'eketanyaawe falageneme babeetocaacehu yaminababawene 'asetaawesu. 'alaahe 'enaanetane ba'eresu banabiyu beete wesethe bamaaderagu 'azaanye, wesethe `aawaaqime bamahonume 'enaanetane yamale'eketanyaawe baalabeetoce 'enaa yame'emanaane hulu 'enaatoce 'aderego marathaacehu.

la'alaahe raasaacawene yaasegazu wanedocenaa seetoce, ba'alaahe yaamanu wanedocenaa seetoceme, 'alaahene yamitaazazu wanedocenaa seetoceme ba'emenataacawenaa banegegerocaacawe 'ewenatanyaa yahonu wanedocenaa seetoceme, bamataazaze, kawanejale bamaraaqe 'enaa bafatanaame gizee taagaashe yahonu wanedocenaa seetoceme, 'alaahene fari wanedocenaa seetoceme gedeetaawi yahonanenaa gedeetaawi yaalehonaneme metzewaatene matzewaace wanedocenaa seetoceme, gedeetaawinaa gedeetaawi yaalehona tsomene tswami wanedocenaa seetoceme, beletocaacawene 'enediyaayu kaaletafaqadalaacawe sawoce `eyetaa baalamagelathenaa ka'atzayaafiwe zemutenaa maqedemu bamaraaqe yathabaqu wanedocenaa seetoceme, balebaacawenaa bamelaasaacawe bageletsenaa bamisethere 'alaahene babezu 'aweshiwoce wanedocenaa seetoceme, 'alaahe la'enasu lawanejalocaacawe ka'esu yahona meheratenenaa batenesaa'eewe qane taalaaqe menedaane (janatene) 'azagaajetolaacawaale.

'alaahenaa male'eketanyaaweme 'anede nagarene bafaradu gizee me'emanaane 'enaa me'emanaate bagudaayaacawe laaye lamaqabale wayeme laalamaqabale merechaa linoraacawe 'ayegabaame. ya'alaahenenaa yamale'eketanyaaweneme te`ezaaze yathaasa sawe katekekelanyaawe manegade geletze yahonane masaasaate ba'eregethe tasaasaata.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! laziyaa 'alaahe yaselaamene tzagaa yalagasawe, 'anetame kabaarenate qanebare natzaa yaawathaakxawe 'enaa yalagasekawe (zayede bine hhaarisaahe) baalabeetune (zayenabe bineta jahheshene) bamafetaate gudaaye laaye liyaamaakerehe bamathaa gizee <<baalabeetehene 'enedaatefataate, yaazaate>> baaleke gizee 'asetaawese. 'alaahene feraa! zayedeme baalabeetune fateto 'alaahe 'ereswane 'enedetaagabaate baazazahe gizee yasawocene 'alubaaletaa faretahe yaawaqekawene nagare geletze kamaaderage tedabeqaalahene? 'alaaheme yazayedene mafetaate 'enaa yaanetaneme 'ereswane maagebaate geletze yaadaregaale. baziheme gudaaye 'alaahene nawe letefaraawe yamigabaawe. zayedeme kareswa gudaayune bacharasanaa faqedo bafataate gizee 'anetane 'agaabaanehe. yeheme ba'amaanyoce laaye, yamaadago lejocaacawe kamisetocaacawe gudaayene bacharasu 'enaa bafatwacawe 'enedihume `idaacawe (maahetsanaacawe ka'eregezenaa natsaa mahonu yamiragaagathebate yaqoyetaa yagizee gadabaacawe) baabaqaa gizee maagebaatu wanejale 'enedamaayehone lamagelatze nawe. ya'alaaheme te`ezaaze kalekaaye 'enaa 'agaaje yaleelawe sihone tafatzaami hona.

banabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) laaye 'alaahe la'eresu yamaadago leju yafataatene seete 'enediyaagabaa bafaqadawe nagare meneme wanejaleme hona cegere linorebate 'ayegabaame. mekeneyaatume 'esu yamikatalawe kasu bafite yaalafutene nabiyaate falage nawenaa. 'esu bazihe gudaaye laaye kamale'eketanyoce yamajamariyaa 'ayedalame; 'alaaheme yafaradawe (gaabecaawene 'enedifatzeme maaderage 'enaa yamaadago leje 'enedawaladute leje 'alamahonune maferade sihone baziheme wesaanee laaye lanabiyu 'asetayaayateme hona merechaa yalaweme) feredu tafatzaami nawe. malaashe yalaweme.

'enaziyaa 'alaahe yaawaradalaacawene male'eketoce lahhezebocaacawe yamiyaadaresunaa ka'alaahe basetaqareme 'anedeneme yamaayefarute nabiyaate 'alaahe yafaqadalaacawene sifatzemu leeloce yamiyaawarutene nagare zore belawe 'ayemalakatume. 'alaahe yabaarocune szeraa kamathabaqe kamagamegame bakule baqi nawe. malekaamune bamalekaame, mathefowene bamathefo yemanadaacawaale.

muhhamade kawanedocaacehu ya'anedeneme 'abaate 'ayedalame! yazayede walaajeme 'ayedalame! zayede baalabeetune kafataa baxwaalaa yazayedene baalabeete biyaagabaa 'ereme 'ayehonebateme! yelequnese 'esu wada sawoce yatalaaka ya'alaahe male'eketanyaanaa yanabiyaatoce madamedameyaa nawe. ka'esu baxwaalaa leelaa nabiye yalame! 'alaaheme hulune nagaru `aawaaqi nawe; yabaarocu gudaayeme meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.
'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa yadanagagalaacehuneme yametetegaberu me'emanaane hoye! 'alaahene balebocaacehu, bamelaasaacehunaa ba'akaalaacehu bezu maawesaatene 'awesute.

baqanu majamariyaa macharashaame (ba'enazihe gizeeyaate maasetaawase qalaalenaa balaache bamahonu) 'alaahene ka'esu basetaqare 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaake 'enedaleelanaa kamaayegabu baahheriyaateme (batahelilenaa batasebihhe) 'atherute.

'eresume la'enaaneta yaazenelaacexwaale yaawadesaacexwaaleme. malaa'eketume meheratene yelamenulaacexwaale. yeheme kakehedate chalamaawoce wada 'emenate berehaane yaawathaacehu zanede nawe. la'amaanyoceme bathaame 'azaanye nawe. te`ezaazune kafatzamunaa yakalakalawene karaaqu 'ayeqathaacaweme.

me'emanaane kageetaacawe fite bamiqomubate `elate salaametaacawe kacegeroce hulu salaame mahone 'enaa tzathetaane maagenyate nawe. la'enasume 'esune bamataazazaacawenaa kawanejale bamaraaqaacawe mekeneyaate malekaamene menedaa (janatene) 'azagaajetolaacawaale.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'enyaa wada sawoce la'enasu yatalaakebatene male'ekete maaderasehene ba'enasu laaye masekaari, lame'emanaane 'alaahe yaazagaajalaacawene janate 'abesaarinaa lakahadiyaane yaazagaajalaacawene qethaate 'asefaraarime 'adereganehe lekanehale.
ba'alaaheme te'ezaaze wada 'anedenatu 'enaa 'eresuneme wada mataazaze tathaari, qathetanyaa manegade mamaraatene lafalagu hulu 'aberi berehaane 'aderegane laakenehe.

ba'alaahe yaamanutene 'enaa badanagagawe te'ezaaze maszarate malekaamene yamiszaru me'emanaanene ka'alaahe zanede cerotaa yaalaacawe mahonune 'abeseraacawe. yeheme baduneyaa 'eredaataa maagenyatenenaa bamacharashaame dele bamaagenyate janate magebaatene yaathaqaalelaale.

kahadiwocenenaa manaafeqaanene ka'alaahe haayemaanote bamaagade laaye yamithaarutene tawaacawe. yehene maaderagehe yamathaahebatene nagare 'enediyaamenu yegaabezaacawaale. bathalaatocehe laaye delene 'enediyaaqadaajehe mathayaqene chamero bagudaayoceheme hulu ba'alaahe laaye tamakaa. labaaroceme baduneyaanaa ba'akxeeraa gudaayocaacawe laaye yamitamaamanubate mathagiyaa 'alaahe baqi nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa badenegaageewe yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! kame'emanaate gaare yagaabecaa teseserene kafatzamaacehu 'enaa kaziyaame saateganaanywacawe bafite kafataacexwaacawe 'enasune baalamaganaanyate maahetzanaacawe yatharaa mahonune lamaawaqe ba'enasu laaye yameteqotherwate `idedaahe (kaware 'ababaa bamatheraate yehune baware maquthare) meneme yalaacehume (yamaasethabaqe mabete yalaacehume). bamafataataacawe mekeneyaate yatagodaawene semeetaacawene lamathagane kaganezabaacehu ya'aqemaacehune yaahele sethwacawe. saategodwacaweme wadabeetasabocaacawe malekaame maasanaabatene 'asanaabetwacawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'enyaa 'enaziyaane theloshaacawene yasathahacawene misetocehene faqadenelehe! 'alaahe laaneta kamalasaleheme 'enaziyaane baquthetherehe sere yaalutene seete merekonyoce 'enaziyaaneme kaaneta gaare kamakaa wada madinaa yatasadadutene ya'agote (ya'abaate wanedeme) seete lejoce, ya'akesetoceheneme (ya'abaate 'ehetoce) seete lejoce, ya'agote (ya'enaate wanedeme) seete lejocenaa ya'akesete (ya'enaate 'ehete) seete lejocene maagebaate la'aneta faqedanelehale. yaamanaceme seete nafeswane yaala theloshe lanabiyu betesathenaa nabiyu liyaagabaate yafalaga 'enedahona (raaswane 'asaalefaa bamasethate madaare) lanabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) becaa yatafaqada laleeloce me'emanaane gene yaaletafaqada nawe. bame'emanaane laaye babaalabeetocaacawe gudaaye ka'araate seetoce balaaye maagebaate yamaayefaqadelaacawe mahonune 'enedawasanene baregethe 'enaaweqaalane. 'enedihume baquthetheraacawe sere baalute baaroce gudaaye laaye yaala gadabe yafalagutene quthere bamayaaze lithaqaaqamubaacawe faqedanelaacawaale. baaneta laaye cegerenaa thebate 'enedaayenore laleelaa yaalefaqadenawene laaneta yaalafutene faqadenelehe. 'alaahe kabaarocu wada 'esu bamatzatzate yamimalasutene mahhari la'enasu 'azaanye nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kamisetocehe yameteshaatene ka'eswa gaare saataadere taraawaane bamaaqoyate yametefalegawene taazagayaalahe. yameteshaaweneme ka'eswa gaare bamaadare taasethagaalahe. kaaraaqekaateme yafalagekaatene bamamalase betaasethagaa baaneta laaye meneme hathi'ate yalabeheme. yehe yatasathahe merechaanaa delote yabaalabeetocehe `aayenoce 'enediragunaa hulaacaweme yasathahacawene bamulu 'enediwadu yaqaraba nawe. mekeneyaatume gedeetaa yatadaragabehene yamaatetawenaa mabetaacawene kamafatzame sesetaame 'enedaalehoneke selamiyaawequ 'alaaheme ('enaaneta wanedoce) ka'anedwa misetaacehu wada leelaanyaawaa misetaacehu balebocaacehu wesethe yaalawene mazanebale yaaweqaale. 'alaaheme yabaarocune szeraa yaaweqaale. ka'esu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. wada 'esu yetzatzatume zanede baqethaate yamaayaathaadefe taagaashe caaye nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'aneta sere kaalute baalabeetocehe wechi leelaa seete maagebaate 'ayefaqadeleheme. ka'enasu weche letaagabaate yafalagekaate seete meneme 'enekwaa malekwaa biyaasedaneqeheme hulaacaweneme wayeme kafilaacawene bamafetaate ba'enasu faanetaa leelaane maagebaate 'ayefaqadeleheme. gene baquthetherehe sere kaalute yamereko seetocene yaala gadabe beteyeze yefaqadelehale. 'alaaheme hulune nagare tathabaabaaqi nawe. yehe ferede yame'emanaane 'enaatoce darajaane yaasaayaale. 'enasune mafetaatenaa ba'enasu laaye leelaa maagebaatene 'alaahe kalakala.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa badenegaageewe yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! lagebezhaa kaalehona basetaqare kanabiyu beetoce 'ategebu. yamegebe mabesalene bamathabaabaqeme bezu 'ateqamathu. nagare gene lagebezhaa katatharaacehu gebu. baletaacehume wadiyaawe tabatanu. 'erese baresaacehu lamaaweraate setelu 'ateqoyu. ya'enaaneta maqoyate nabiyune yaasecageraale. 'enaanetane wethu belo mathayaqeneme yaaferaale. nagare gene 'alaahe 'ewenatene maazaze 'ayaafereme. bamaqoyataacehu 'esune 'enedaataasecagerute 'enedetebatanu 'azazaacehu. yanabiyune (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) baalabeetoceme maanenyaaweneme 'eqaa mathayaqe kafalagaacehu kamagaarajaa xwaalaa honaacehu thayeqwaacawe. yanabiyune darajaa 'enaa yabaalabeetocaacaweneme keberaacaweneme lamathabaqe sibaale 'enaa fite lafite 'enedaataayuwaacawe 'eyatafaathathaacehu 'atethayeqwaacawe. 'enasune kamagaarajaa xwaalaa mathayaqaacehu lalebocaacehunaa lalebocaacaweme tzedaate 'enedihume bagutegotaanaa mathefone nagare bamaasegeethe shayethwane lebocaacehunaa lebocaacawe wesethe magebiyaa 'enedaayenorawe lamaaderagenawe. 'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! wareene lamaaweraate bamaqamathe ya'alaahene male'eketanyaa letaasecagerunaa misetocuneme kamota baxwaalaa menegizeeme letaagabu 'ayegabaacehume. mekeneyaatume yame'emanaane 'enaatoce bamahonaacawe. maaneme sawe 'enaatune maagebaate 'ayefaqadelateme. yehe male'eketanyaawene maasecagaraacehu (kagatsetaaweme 'anedu kamota baxwaalaa misetocune maagebaataacehu) kelekele nawe. 'alaahe zanedeme kakabaade hathi'aate yeqotharaale.

kaszeraawocaacehu maanenyaaweneme nagare geletze betaadaregu wayeme banafesaacehu wesethe betedabequte ka'alaahe meneme 'ayedabaqebateme! 'alaahe hulune nagare `aawaaqi nawenaa! kaszeraawocaacehume hona kaleelaa meneme 'ayedabaqebateme! baszeraawocaacehume malekaamune bamalekaame mathefowene dagemo bamathefo yemanadaacexwaale.

'abaatocaacawe, wanedoce lejocaacaweme, wanedemocaacaweme, yawanedemocaacawe wanedoce lejoceme, ya'ehetocaacawe wanedoce lejoceme bazareme hona bathebi yamizaamadwacawe wanedemocaacawe hulu biyaayewaacawenaa yaala magaarajaa biyaanaagerwacawe meneme hathi'aate yalabaacaweme. 'enedihume yame'emanaane misetocaacaweme, baquthetheraacawe sere yaalu baaroce yaala magaarajaa biyaanaagerwacawe hathi'aate yalabaacaweme. 'enaaneta me'emanaate hoye! 'alaahe yaazazawene bamafatzamenaa yakalakalaweneme bamakalekale 'alaahene feru. 'alaahe bageletze yamiszaraawenenaa yaminagarawene hulu tamalekaace nawenaa.

'alaahe malaa'ekete zanede male'eketanyaawe muhhamadene (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yaawadesaale. malaa'eketume la'esu 'ezenatene yelamenulataale. 'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa badenegaageewe yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! bamale'eketanyaawe laaye ya'akeberote 'ezenatene 'aweredu. yamaakebareneme salaametaa salaame balu.

'alaahe male'eketanyaawene maakebarene 'enaa baresaacawe laaye ya'akeberote 'ezenatene 'enedenaawarede kaazaza baxwaalaa 'esaacawene 'enedaanaasecagere sikalakele 'enedihe 'ala -
'enaziyaa 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene banegegerenaa batagebaare yamiyaasecageru baqerebitunaa bamacharashaayetume `aalame 'alaahe ka'ezenatu 'abaararaacawe; 'araaqaacaweme. la'enaresume bamacharashaayetu qane ya'alaahene male'eketanyaa bamaasecagaraacawe mekeneyaate 'awaaraaje yahonane qethaate 'azagaajetolaacawaale.
'enaziyaame me'emanaanene 'enaa me'emanaatene banegegerenaa batagebaare baaleszarute wanejale bamazelafe yamiyaasecageru weshatenenaa geletze hathi'aatene tashakamu.

'aneta nabiye hoye! lamisetocehe, laseete lejoceheme, lame'emanaane misetoceme baa`ede kahonu wanedoce fite galaacawe 'enedaayegalaalathe yamilabesutene makanaanabiyaawocaacawene balaayaacawe laaye 'enedilaqequ negaraacawe. yehe 'enasu chawaa 'enedahonu 'eneditaawaqunaa 'enaziyaa seete baaroce babaalageewoce 'enedamidafarute 'enaziheme 'enedaayedafaru bathaame yaqaraba nawe. 'alaahe kabaarocu bamatzatzate wada 'esu yamimalasutene mahari; la'enasume 'azaanye nawe.

'enaziyaa kehedatene bamadabaqenaa selaamene geletse bamaaderage 'asemasaaye yahonu manaafeqaane kanefeqenaacawe, 'enaziyaame balebocaacawe wesethe baalawe yasemeete bashetaa 'enaa 'amatze laaye yatanethalathalu, bamadinaa wesethe yaweshate wareene bamaamethaate me'emanaane lamalayaayate yamirwarwathu kazihe tagebaaraacawe yamaayetaaqabu kahona 'aneta- ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enasune 'enedeteqathaa 'enaazezehalane ba'enasu laaye 'eneshomehalane. kaziyaame bazihe tagebaaraacaweme 'alaahe selamiyaathafaacawe wayeme medere laaye bamaabalaashataacawe selamiyaabaareraacawe bamadinaa wesethe theqite gizee 'eneji 'ayenwanwaruheme.
ka'alaahe 'ezenate yatabaararu naacawe. yateme botaa biganyu yeyaazu 'enaa yegadalu. yeheme munaafiqoce bamahonaacawenaa medere laaye beleshunatene bamaasaraachataacawe nawe.
yehe bamanaafeqaane laaye nefeqenaacawene geletze baadaragu gizee yamifatzame ya'alaahe qwaami denegaagee nawe; ya'alaaheme denegaagee fatzemo talawaache 'ataaganyelateme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'agaariwocenaa 'ayehudoce bamaqaawame 'enaa bamaasetabaabale maleku tenesaa'ee macee naate belawe yethayequhale. <<yatenesaa'ee `eweqate 'alaahe zanede becaa nawe; 'enee zanede meneme yalame>> balaacawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! tenesaa'ee qerebe selamahonwa mene 'asaawaqahe.
'alaahe kahadiwocene ba'eregetheme ka'ezenatu 'abaarerwacawaale. la'enaresume batenesaa'eewe qane yametethabeqaacawene yatagaagaamacene 'esaate 'azagaajetolaacawaale.
batazagaajacelaacawe 'esaate wesethe zalaalame zawetaariwoce naacawe. 'eswa wesethe yamithaqemaacawe wadaajeme, kaqethaateme yamikalaakalelaacawe radaateme 'ayaaganyume.

fitocaacawe bajahaname 'esaate wesethe bamigalaabathebate gizee bathaame bamatzatzatenaa bamaqochate <<waa! menyotaacene baduneyaa hheyewataacene ya'alaahene te'ezaazune bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe batagazaane male'eketanyaaweneme kageetaawe yaamathaawene nagare bataazazene noro>> yelaalu.
dakaamaanaa wedeqe yahonane maaserajaa bamaamethaateme <<geetaacene hoye! mariwocaacenene 'enaa yawaganocaacene taalaalaaqocene taazazene kaqathetanyaaweme manegade 'asaasaatune.>> yelaalu

<<geetaacene hoye! la'enaziyaa kaqathetanyaawe manegade laasaasaatune mariwocenaa taalaalaaqoce 'enyaane bamaasaasaataacawe mekeneyaate ka'enyaa qethaate 'ethefene sethaacawe. ka'ezenateheme 'ejege maabaararene 'abaareraacawe>> yelaalu.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa badenegaageewe yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! male'eketanyaacehune 'eneda 'enaziyaa musaane (beletu laaye 'ebethate 'alabate bamaalate) 'enedaasecagarute sawoce 'atehunu. kaaluteme nagare hulu 'alaahe 'atharaawe. kaaluteme nagare salaame mahonu tagalatzalaacawe. 'alaaheme zanede kebure nawe. lemanaawe taqabaayenate yaalawenaa szeraaweme yaalekaszara nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa badenegaageewe yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! yaazazawene bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalaweneme bamaraaqe 'alaahene feru. tekekelanyaa 'enaa 'ewenate yahonane negegereme tanaagaru.

'enaaneta 'alaahene yametefarunaa tekekelanyaa yahonane negegere yametenaagaru kahonu szeraawocaacehune la'enaaneta yaasaamerelaacexwaale yeqabalaacexwaaleme. hathi'atocaacehuneme yesareyelaacexwaale. basume 'ayezaacehume. 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene yamitaazazeme sawe meneme liwadaadarawe yamaayecelene taalaaqe delene tagonaatsafa. 'eresume ya'alaahene wedeetaa maagenyate 'enaa janate magebaate nawe.

'enyaa yashari`aane te'ezaazocene; ganezabocene 'enaa misetherocene bamathabaqe laaye 'adaraane lasamaayaate, lamederenaa lataraaroce 'aqarabene; kaaletaazazu yamimathaawene mazazeneme faru. kamashakame taqothabu. yasaweme leje nafesune bathaame badaaye baalamataazazu yamimathaawene mazaze yamaayaaweqe maayeme bamahonume tashakamaate.

ya'alaahe fetherata-wesaanee honanaa yasawe leje tashakamaate. 'alaahe manaafeqaane wanedocenenaa manaafeqaane seetocene, wanedoce 'agaariwocene 'enaa seetoce 'agaariwoceneme banefeqenaacawenaa bamaagaaraataacawe mekeneyaate liqathaacawe ba'enaziyaa yate'ezaazocune 'adaraa yatashakamu me'emanaanene 'enaa me'emanaateneme tzatzataacawene liqabale yehene 'adaraga. 'alaaheme wada 'esu bamatzatzate yatamalasutene mahari la'enasume 'azaanye nawe.

mesegaanaa laziyaa basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalu hulu fetherataate, negeszenaanaa maasetanaabare ya'eresu lahonawe la'alaahe yegabaawe. bamacharashaayetume `aalame mesegaanaanaa wedaasee la'eresu becaa nawe. 'eresume bamafetharenaa bamaasetanaabare thebabanyaa yabaarocune huneetaa bazerezere `aawaaqinaa ka'eresu meneme yamaayesawarebate geetaa nawe.

bamedere wesethe yamigabaawene weha, 'azere`etenaa maa`edenaate hulu ka'ereswame yamiwathaawene 'azere`etenaa leelocune hulu yaaweqaale; kasamaayeme yamiweredawene zenaabe, malaa'eketenaa sisaayene hulu; wada samaaye yamiyaaregawene malaa'ekete, yabaariyaawocune szeraawocenaa manefasocene hulu yaaweqaale! 'eresu lame'emanaane baarocu 'azaanye wada 'eresu bamatzatzate yamimalasutene mahari nawe.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yakaaduteme <<sa`aatitu (tenesaa'ee) bafetsume 'atemathaabeneme>> 'alu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bafetsume; ba'alaahe 'emelaalahu 'enaaneta yametaasetabaabelwate tenesaa'ee ba'eregethe temathaabaacexwaalace. gene gizeewe macee 'enedahona ka'alaahe basetaqare maaneme 'ayaaweqeme. 'esu ruqenaa yatadabaqane sela sa`aatitume hona sela leeloce `aawaaqi nawe. basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yaquchaache kebedate yaahele yaalaate 'enekwaa betehone ka'eresu 'atesawareme. kazihe katathaqasawe yaanasame hona yabalatha bihoneme bageletzu matsehhafe wesethe kamatzaafe 'ayeqareme. 'esume lawehhale maahhefuze (thebequ mazegabe) sihone 'eseka 'elata-tenesaa'ee derase yamikasatute nagaroce hulu yatatzaafabate mazegabe nawe.

'alaahe bathebequ mazegabe wesethe yaalawene wesaanee yaatzanaawe 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanutenenaa malekaame szeraa yaszarutene lamamanedaate nawe. la'enaziyaa ba'ezihe baaheri latagalatsute lahathi'atocaacawe meherate ka'alaahe zanede talagesawaale. bamahonume bahathi'aataacawe 'ayeyaazume. yatakabara tzagaa tazagaajetolaacawaale; yeheme tzagaa batenesaa'ee qane janate magebaate nawe.

'enaziyaa 'alaahe yaawaradaacawene 'aneqatzoce wedeqe lamaaderage bategaate yamirwarwathute 'enaa 'aneqatzocene degemete; male'eketanyaacenene dagemo thaneqwaaye, degemetanyaa 'enaa baala qenee yamilute; yehenene baaheri yatalaabasute dagemo batenesaa'eewe 'elate 'ejege yakafaanaa beretu qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale.

ya`eweqate baalabeete yahonute baaledarabocehenaa kamatsaahhefete baalabeetoce 'amaanye liqaawenetoceme 'alaahe wada 'aneta yaawaradawe raa'eye therethaaree yaleelawe 'ewenate mahonunenaa maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi baduneyaame ba'akxiraame mesegune wadahonawe 'alaahe manegade yamimaraa mahonune yemasakeraalu.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yakaaduteme 'erese baresaacawe ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa baamathute nagare bamagaramenaa bamasaalaqe 'enedihe yebaabaalaalu:: <<lamahonu 'enaaneta mutaacehunaa 'akaalaacehu hulu mabathaathasene batabathaathasa gizee kamotaacehu baxwaalaa heyaawe honaacehu teqasaqasaalaacehu belo yaminageraacehune sawe 'enaasaayaacehune?!>>

'enediheme yelaalu:: <<lamahonu yehe sawe kamotene baxwaalaa teqasaqasaalaacehu sile ba'alaahe laaye weshatene qathefo nawene? wayenese yaleelane nagare yamiqaazhe 'ebede nawe?>> nagaru 'enasu 'enedamilute 'ayedalame. yelequnese yahonawe nagare 'enaziyaa bamacharashaawe qane yamiyaamenute batenesaa'eewe 'elate baberetu qethaate wesethe sihonu baduneyaa heyewataacawe dagemo ka'ewenate 'ejege yaraaqa sehetate wesethe mahonaacawe nawe 'enedihe yamiyaasebelaacawe.

'enaziyaa kamote baxwaalaa maqasaqasene yamiyaasetabaabalu sawoce kafitaacawe yaalacewene mederenaa kaxwaalaacawe yaalawene samaaye 'ayemalakatumene? 'enyaa mederene ka'egeraacawe sere maasemathene benefalege 'enaasamethaacawaalane. wayeme kasamaaye quraachene ba'enasu laaye mathaale benefalege 'enethelebaacawaalane. bazihe wesethe wada geetaawe tamalaashe lahona baariyaa hulu yageetaawene celotaa lamaawaqiyaa geletze yahona melekete 'alabate. yehenene maaderage yacaala geetaa mutaacehu 'akaalaacehu katabathaathasa baxwaalaa lamaqaseqase caaye nawe.

ladaawedeme (`alayehi 'asalaame) ka'enyaa yahonane nabiyenatenenaa selethaanene ba'eregethe sathanawe. lagaaraawoceme 'enedihe 'alenaacawe:: <<gaaraawoce hoye! kadaawede gaare tasebihhene ('alaahene kamaayegabu nagarocene maatheraate) malaalesu. labaraariwoceme 'enedazihu 'alene. berateneme yafalagawene nagare 'enediszaraabate la'eresu 'alazabenelate.

'aneta daawede hoye! yaanetane tawaagiwoce yathalaatocaacawene thore yamikalaakale safaafi yathore lebesocene szeraa. misemaarocune dagemo laqadaadaawocu yamigathemu qachaachene honawe botaawe laaye yamaayetzanunaa waferaame honawe dagemo qadaadaawocu wesethe yamaayegabu 'enedaayehonu mathenahe szeraa. malekaameneme szeru 'enee yameteszarutene nagare hulu tamalekaace nanye. kaszeraawocaacehu meneme 'ayedabaqebenyeme 'emanadaacexwaalahume.>>

lasulayemaane bine daawede (`alayehi 'asalaame) yathwate guzowaa yaware manegade 'enedihume yameshete guzowaa yaware manegade yahonacewaane nefaasene 'agaraanelate. kanahaseme yafalagawene maszeraate yeceleme zanede yanahaseneme meneche 'afasasenelate. kagaaneenoceme bageetaawe faqaade kafitu yamiszarune bamaaderage 'agaraanelate. kagaaneenoceme wesethe 'enediszaru kaazazenaacawe te'ezaaze zenefe yamilutene yamiqathaathalene ya'esaate qethaate 'enaaqamesaacawaalane.

'enazihe gaaneenoce lasulayemaane yafalagawene masegidoce, beeta-manegesete, meseloce, sefaataacawe 'eneda ganedaa yahonutene gabataawocene, telaaleqe bamahonaacawe maaneme liyaaneqasaaqesaacawe yamaayecelu desetoceneme yeszarulataale. la'enasume 'enedihe 'alenaacawe:: <<yadaawede beetasaboce hoye! 'alaahe yawaalalaacehune tzagaa 'amasegaanyoce bamahone szeru>> kabaariyaawoceeme yawaalekulaacawene tzagaa yamiyaamasagenute theqitocu naacawe.

ba'eresume laaye motene bafaradenebate gizee tadagefobate yanabarawe betere bamesethe tabaleto 'esekiwadeqe deraseme lagaaneenocu mamotune yanagaraacawe maaneme 'alenabarame. bawadaqa gizeeme gaaneenoce ruqe misetherene yamaayaawequ mahonu tagalatzalaacawe. yamiyaawequ bihone noromaa sulayemaane baheyewate yaalanaa yamiqothaatharaacawe maselwacawe yeszarute yanabarutene kabaabaade szeraa bamaszeraate 'awaaraaje seqaaye wesethe 'ayeqoyume nabare.

'alaahe ladaawedenaa laleju sulayemaanene yawaalawene tzagaa kagalatza baxwaalaa: lasaba'e hhezeboce yawaalawene tzagaa galatza. yehune 'eneji daawedenaa lasulayemaane (`alayehimaa 'asalaame) 'alaahene siyaamasagenu yasaba'e hhezeboce gene makaadaacawene sigaletse 'enedihe 'ala::
yasaba'e gosaawoceme yenorubate banabarawe manoriyaacawe wesethe ya'alaahene celotaa 'enedihume yawaalalaacawene tzagaa yamiyaaseradu geletze meleketoce nabaru. 'enaziheme meleketoce hulate ya'atekelete seferaawoce sihonu 'anedanyaawe basetaqanyaacawe leelaanyaawe dagemo basetageraacawe nabaru. 'enediheme belanaacaweme nabare:: <>

'alaahene maamaseganenaa bamale'eketanyoce maamanene celaa 'alu. tzagaacawene wada quthaa bamaqayareme qathaanaacawe. bamahonume kabaade gorefe laqaqenebaacawenaa gedebaacawene 'afarasabaacawe; 'ereshaacaweneme baweha 'athelaqalaqabaacawe. ba'atekeletocaacaweme meteke leeloce hulate maraaraa fereewocene bamiyaabaqelu, bamaayaafaraa ya''asale' zaafe 'enaa kaqureqeraa zaafe theqitene 'eneji bamaayaabaqelu 'atekeletoce lawathenebaacawe.

yehe kanabarubate malekaame tzagaa yatalawathawe bamakaadaacawenaa tzagaawene kamaamasegane yeleqe celaa bamaalataacawe yehenene manadaanaacawe. 'enedihe yaalawene kabaade qethaate ya'alaahe tzagaane yaasetabaabalanaa 'ejege yakaadane 'eneji leelaawene 'aneqathaame.

yamane wesethe yaalute ya'saba'e' hhezebocenaa baziyaace bawesethwa barakatene baadaragenebaate shaame katamaa makaakale yataqaraarabu katamocene 'adaragene. guzwacaweneme ka'anede katamaa wada leelaawe katamaa yaala meneme cegere shaame 'esekidaresu derase wasanene. 'enediheme 'alenaacawe:: <<kathalaate, karahabenaa themaate segaate salaamaawi honaacehu bafalagaacehute gizee baleeliteme baqaneme tagwaazu.>>

guzowene bamaaqaraarabu ya'alaahene tzagaa baalamaqabaleme 'enaa bamanethabaarare <<geetaacene hoye! baguzowocaacene yaacine katamaa bamaasewagade yaguzowene lefaate 'enedeneqamesenaa yagemalocaacene thanekaaraanate 'enedenaasaaye 'araareqelene!>> 'alu; ya'alaahene tzagaa bamakaadaacawe 'alaahe maamaseganene celaa bamaalataacawe 'enaa dehoce laaye bamamaqenyataacawe nafesaacawene badalu; ka'enasu baxwaalaa laalu sawoce managaagariyaa 'adaragenaacawe; 'erese baresaacaweme 'enedaayeganaanyu bayakatamaawe mabataataneneme bataatanenaacawe; bazihe batathaqasawe yasaba'e (yasaabaa) hhezeboce tzagaanaa beqalaa wesethe 'alaahene bamataazaze laaye, 'esune kamaamatzenaa bamakaraa gizee bathaame taagaashenaa ya'alaahene tzagaa bathaame 'amasegaanye lahona hulu magasachaawoce 'alu.

beliseme 'enasune ka'ewenate maasaasaatenaa maathemamene 'ecelaalahu yaalawene menyotune ba'eregethe fatzamabaacawe. katawasanu 'amaanyoce basetaqare leelocu bakehedatenaa bathememate manegade laaye takatalute. me'emanaane gene tasefaawene bamaachalame saayekatalute qaru.

beliseme 'enasune 'asegadedo maasaasaate yamicelebate selethaane 'alenabaraweme. yelequnese wanejalene 'eyaasaamaralaacawe yaasaasetaacawaale. yehunenaa 'enyaa 'enasune 'enediyaasaasete mafeqadaacene sela 'akxiraanaa bawesethu selaalawe menedaa yamiyaamenutenenaa ba'aakxiraawe gudaaye therethaaree laaye yaalutene layetane lamaasaawaqe nawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe hulune nagare tathabaabaaqi nawe. yabaariyaawocuneme szeraa yethabeqaale ba'eresume yemanadaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<'enaziyaane ka'alaahe leelaa 'amaalekete belaacehu yametaasebwacawene theqemene 'enediyaaseganyulaacehu 'enedihume gudaatene 'enedimaketulaacehu therwacawe. basamaayaateme bamedereme wesethe yaquchaache kebedate yaahele selethaane yalaacaweme. bahulatume wesethe ka'alaahe gaare tagaarinate yalaacaweme. 'alaahene yamiradaawe radaate yalame. 'eresu ka'agaarenaa karadaate yatabeqaaqaa geetaa nawe.>>

melejaame 'esu lafaqadalate sawe becaa bihone 'eneji 'ayethaqememe! 'alaaheme yalaaqa taalaaqe geetaa bamahonu 'esu lawadadalate 'eneji melejaane 'ayefaqedeme! kataalaaqenatume yatanasaa samaaye laaye hono sinaagare la'esu negegere bamatanaanase malaa'eketoce kenefocaacawene yaagaachaalu; kalebocaacawe laaye denegaatheewe batagalatsame gizee lajiberile <<geetaacehu mene 'ala?>> yelaalu; jiberileme <<'ewenatene tanaagara; 'eresume ba'akaalume bamaashanafeme yabalaayenaa taalaaqu geetaa nawe>>; yelaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<kasamaayaate zenaabene bamaawerade kamedere 'azere`ete, feraafereewocenaa theraathereewocene bamaabeqale sisaayene yamilagesaacehu maane nawe?>> 'enediheme balaacawe:: <<sisaayune yamilagesaacehu 'alaahe nawe. 'agaariwoce hoye! 'enyaa wayeme 'enaaneta batekekelanyaawe godaanaa laaye wayeme bageletsetze masaasaate wesethe nane. kahulate 'anedaacene ka'anedanyaawe mahonaacene 'ayeqaree nawe. batekekelanyaawe godaanaa laaye yaalute me'emanaane mahonaacawenaa batasaasaata manegade laaye dagemo 'agaariwoce mahonaacawe therethere yalaweme>>
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<'enaaneta batenesaa'eewe qane 'enyaa selafatzamenawe hathi'aate 'atethayaqume. 'enyaame dagemo 'enaaneta selameteszaruteme szeraa 'anethayaqeme.>>

'enediheme balaacawe:: <<'alaahe batenesaa'eewe qane 'enyaanaa 'enaanetane yesabasabaale. kaziyaame bamakaakalaacene bafetehe yefaredaale. 'ewenatanyaawene 'ewenatanyaa kaalehonawe bamalayate 'eresu bafetehe faraaju bamifaredaweme `aawaaqiwe nawe.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enediheme balaacaweme:: <<'enaziyaane la'alaahe ba'ameleko tagaariwoce 'aderegaacehu wada 'esu yaasethagaacexwaacawene 'asaayunye. bafetsume; 'enaaneta 'enedaasabaacehute 'alaahe 'agaare yalaweme. yelequnese 'esu maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafiwe bamafethare, bamawasanenaa bamaasetanaabare thebabanyaawe 'esu 'alaahe nawe.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'anetane yalaakenehe malaawene yasawe leje fariha 'alaahe yahonutene bajanate 'enedetaabaserenaa yakehedatenaa yathememate baalabeetocene ba'esaate 'enedetaasefaraaraa nawe. yehune 'eneji bezuxaanu sawoce yehenene 'ewenataa 'ayaawequme; biyaawequ noro baalaasetabaabaluhe nabare.

'agaariwoce yaa yatasefaraarutene qethaate 'enedimathaabaacawe bamathaadafe 'enediheme yelaalu:: <<'eregethe yekasataale belaacehu yametaamenute qethaate 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu qana qatharowe macee nawe?!>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa qethaatene lamiyaathaadefute sawoce 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<la'anedaafetaame bihone 'enekwaa wada xwaalaame yamaateqoyubate wada fiteme yamaatelubate qana qatharo tazagaajetolaacexwaale. yeheme qane yaqiyaamaahe (yatenesaa'eewe) qane nawe.>>

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yakaaduteme 'enedihe 'alu:: <<'enyaa bazihe muhhamade waradalenye bamilawe qure'aane bacheraashe 'anaameneme. 'enedihume ka'esu bafite baalafute matsaahhefeteme 'anaameneme.>> 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! badaayoce lameremaraa geetaacawe zanede qomawe 'erese ba'eresaacawe malese sisathaathu; 'eyaanedaanedaacawe siwaqaaqasunaa 'anedu leelaanyaawene tathayaaqi siyaadarege; tachaqunawe yanabaru takataayoceme baduneyaawe `aalame neqawe chaqunawe yegazwacawe lanabarute 'alaqocaacawe <<'enaaneta baataasaasetune noro ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyocu baamanene nabare>> silwacawe yaalawene huneetaa betemalakate 'ejege yamidaneqe nawe.

'enaziyaa 'ewenatene kamakatale yakorute 'asekataayoce la'enaziyaa latachaqonute takataayoce:: <<lamahonu muhhamade kaamathaalaacehu meraacaa 'enyaa kalekelanaacexwaalene?! bafetsume. nagaru raasaacehu badaayoce, 'athefinaa yathefaate baalabeetoce nabaraacehu.>> yelwacawaale.

'enaziyaa 'alaqocaacawe yachaqonwacawe takataayoce 'ewenatene laalamakatale yamikorutene 'asekataayocaacawene 'enedihe yelwacawaale:: <<yelequnese 'ewenatene 'enedaanekatale yakalakalane ba'alaahe 'enedenekedenaa ka'eresu wechi leeloce fetherataatene 'enedenaamaleke maazazaacehunaa baqanenaa baleelite 'enyaa laaye yametaaseerute seeraa nawe.>> yehunenaa leke qethaatune 'enedatamalakatu baduneyaa wesethe yaalu baasaalafute kehedate yaadarabaacawene quchetenaa tzatzate yedabeqaalu. maqathaataacaweneme 'eregethanyoce yehonaalu. bakahadiyaane 'anegateme laaye sanesalate 'enaadaregaalane. yehenene menedaa yamimanadute baduneyaa heyewate laaye yeszarute banabarawe ka'alaahe wechi 'amelekone mafatzamaacawenaa bahathi'aataacawe yatanasaa nawe.

yanabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) hhezeboce baasetabaabalwacawe gizee 'esaacawene lamaatzenaanaate sile yehe nagare kazihe bafite yanabarute hhezeboce tagebaare 'enedanabare sigaletze 'enedihe yelaale::
'enyaa bamaanenyaaweme katamaa nawaariwoce zanede ya'alaahene qethaate yamiyaasefaraaraacawe male'eketanyaane balaakene quthere baalaselethaanaate, baalahabetocenaa baalamaa`eragoce delotanyaa nawaariwoce <<'enaaneta male'eketanyoce hoye! 'enyaa yatalaakaacehubatene male'ekete kedanaale>> kamaalate 'aletawagadume.

'enazihu baalaselethaanaate baguraanaa bakuraate 'enediheme yelaalu:: <<'enyaa baala bezu ganezabe 'enaa baala bezu lejoce nane. teqathaalaacehu yametelune nagare weshate nawe. 'enyaa baqerebitu heyewateme hona bamacharashaayetume `aalame 'aneqathaame.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lanaziyaa batasathaacawe tzagaa latashanagalute 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<geetaayee maamaseganune 'aliyaame makaadune lamafatane lamishaawe sawe sisaayene yaasafaale; yashaaweneme yetaagase 'enedahona wayenese yaamaarere 'enedahona lamafataneme sisaayene yaathabebataale. nagare gene 'abezaanyocu sawoce 'alaahe thebabanyaa mahonunenaa 'eyaanedaanedune nagare siwasene bataalaaqe thebabe mahonune 'ayaawequme. yehenenu thebabe yamiyaaweqe yaaweqawaale; yamaayaaweqe dagemo 'ayaaweqaweme.>>

yehe yametefokerubate ganezabocaacehunaa lejocaacehume wada 'alaahe wedeetaa yamiyaaqaarebwacehu 'ayedalume. yelequnese ba'alaahe yaamananaa malekaame szeraane yaszaraa 'ethefe menedaane yaaganyaale. ganezabune ba'alaahe manegade laaye bamaawethaatu wada 'alaahe yaaqaarebawaale. lejocume la'esu 'alaahene bamamaatzanaacawe malekaame nagarene yaaganyaale. 'enaziyaa yaamanutenaa malekaame yaszarute baszarute malekaame szeraa 'ethefe menedaa tazagaajetolaacawaale. 'enasume kafe baalu baganate manoriyaawoce wesethe bamahonaacawe kamisagute qethaate, motenaa, yatzagaa maqwaarathe salaamenaa tzathetaa wesethe naacawe.

'enaziyaa sawocene ka'enyaa 'aneqatzoce lamaazore kafetanyaa therate bamaaderagenaa gebaacawene lamaasaakaate yamitherute kahadiyaane baduneyaa kasaariwocenaa bamacharashaaweme qane yamiqathu naacawe.
