'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<geetaayee kabaarocu lamishaawe sawe sisaayene yaasafaale. ka'enasu bashaaweme laaye yaathabebaale. kamaanenyaaweme nagare ba'alaahe manegade laaye yametelagesutene 'alaahe baduneyaa yatashaalawene bamasethate bamacharashaaweme teleqe menedaa bamamanedaate 'eresu yetakaalaacexwaale. 'alaaheme kasisaaye sachiwoce hulu balaache nawe. bamahonume sisaayene yamifalege wada 'esu yethagaa>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe huluneme bamisabasebaacawenaa kaziyaame 'agaariyaanene bamaneqafenaa bamaawegaze lamalaa'eketocu <<'enazihe ka'alaahe wechi 'enaanetane yegazu nabarune?!>> belo yamilawene gizee 'asetaawese.

malaa'eketocume tharaahe <<laaqeke taqadasekeme!! ka'enaresu wuche radaataacene 'aneta becaa nahe. ba'enyaanaa ba'enasu makaakale wadaajenate yalame. yelequnese 'enazihe 'agaariwoce shayethwanaate bamalaa'ekete yemasalubaacawenaa yegazwacawe nabare. 'abezaanyocaacawe ba'enasu 'amaanyoce naacawe>> yelaalu.

bamasabesabiyaanaa bameremaraawe qaneme tamalaakiwoce baduneyaa ka'alaahe wechi laamalakwaacawe matheqameneme hona magudaatene 'ayecelume. la'enaziyaa nafesaacawene bakehedate bahathi'aate labadaluteme. <<yaacene baduneyaa taasetabaabelwate yanabaraacehutene ya'esaate qethaate qemasu>> 'enelaacawaalane.

ba'enaziyaa 'asetabaabaaye 'agaariwoceme laaye geletze yahonutenaa yaaletadebasabasute 'aneqatzocaacene batanababulaacawe gizee 'enedihe yelaalu:: <<yehenene yezo yamathaawe sawe 'abaatocaacehu yegazute kanabarute nagare ligataacehu yamifalege sawe nawe.>> 'enedihe yelaalu:: <<yeheme qure'aane ba'alaahe laaye yataqathaathafa weshate 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame.>> 'enaziyaame ba'alaahe yakaadute qure'aane ka'alaahe zanede simathaalaacawe 'enedihe 'alu:: <<yehe baalabeetene kamisetu; lejene ka'abaatu yamilayaaye geletze degemete 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame.>>

yehe qure'aane muhhamade karaasu yaqathafawe weshate mahonune yamithaqumaacawe yahonu yamiyaanabwacawe matsaahhefetocene 'alesathanaacaweme. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'anetane kamalaakaacene 'aseqademane ka'alaahe qethaate yamiyaasefaraaraacawene male'eketanyaa wada 'enaresu 'alelaakeneme nabare.

yaalafute 'eneda `aade, samudenaa yaluthe hhezeboce yaalute 'asetabaabelawaale. yaaneta hhezeboce ('agaariwoce) ya'enaziyaane yaalafutene hhezeboce bagulebateme, bamaqwaaqwaameme, baganezabeme, babezaateme 'anede 'aseranyaawene 'aledarasume. hulume yatalaakulaacawene male'eketanyoce 'asetabaabalu. yatasathaacaweme ganezabe, gulebatenaa yaquthere bezaate meneme 'alethaqamaacaweme; qethaateeme 'arafabaacawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! wegezatee 'enedihume qethaatee 'enedeete 'enedanabare tamalekate.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<'enee lethaqumaacehunaa lemakeraacehu yamefalegawe 'anede nagarene becaa nawe. 'eresume kasemeete natzaa honaacehu; hulate hulate; 'aliyaame layabecaacehu honaacehu la'alaahe belaacehu 'enedeteqomu); kaziyaame bagwaadanyaacehu yaheyewate taarikenaa sela 'esu 'ewenatanyenate, taamaanyenatenaa theenenatune bamaathenaate ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) meneme 'ebedate yaleelabate mahonune maremeraacehu 'enedeteradu nawe. 'eresu 'enaaneta kaalaacehubate maagaaraate wada 'alaahe bamatzatzate yamaatemalasu kahona beretu qethaate kamamethaatu bafite yamiyaasethanaqeqaacehu nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa 'asetabaabaaye 'agaariwoce 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<yezheelaacehu bamathaahute 'ewenatenaa malekaame nagare waagaa wayeneme damoze 'alethayaqekwaacehume binoreme 'enekwaa laraasaacehu tathaqamubate. menedaayee ba'alaahe laaye becaa nawe. 'eresu 'alaahe hulune nagare tamalekaacenaa masekaari nawe. 'eresume 'enee la'enaaneta selamaaderasee yemasakeraale. baszeraacehume laaye yemasakeraale waagaacehuneme yekafelaacexwaale.>>

ba'enaziyaa 'agaariwocenaa thamaamoce laaye maaserajaawene kagalatza baxwaalaa:yehe ya'eresu fetherata-wesaanee mahonune sigaletze 'enedihe 'ala::
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enedihe bale:: <>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa 'asetabaabaaye 'agaariwoce 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<'ewenate mathaa 'esume selaame nawe. weshate dagemo meneme faanaame hona xaayele yaleelawe 'enedihume maleso maanesaraaraate yamaayecele hono tawagada.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa 'asetabaabaaye 'agaariwoce 'enediheme balaacawe:: <<la'enaaneta kamaasetalaalefawe 'ewenate besaasaate yasehetatee gudaate baraasee laaye becaa yatagadaba nawe. 'enaanetane meneme 'ayaaganyaacehume. wada 'ewenatu bemaraame geetaayee wadanee bamiyaawaredawe mamariyaa nawe. 'eresu yabaarocune negegere sami, 'enee yamelawene hulu masemaate yamaayesaanawe qerebe geetaa nawe.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enazihe 'asetabaabaayoce yaqimaahe (yatenesaa'eewe qane) qethaatune ba`aayenaacawe 'enedatamalakatu sidanagethunaa ka'eresu maamelachaa sithafaabaacawe; yamithagubateme mathagiyaa siyaathu; kaqerebe seferaame baqalaalu ba'anede gizee siwasadu yamihonutene betaaye noro 'asedanaaqi nagare temalakataalahe.

yamacharashaa maarafiyaacawene baayume gizee 'enedihe yelaalu:: <<'enyaa baqiyaamaahe (batenesaa'eewe qane) 'amenanaale.>> lamahonu 'emenate taqabaayenate kamiyaaganyebate yaszeraa hagare yahonawene duneyaane laqawe wada zalaalamaawiwe yamenedaa hagare bamashaagaraacawe 'emenate ka'enasu reqo 'eyaala kayate 'agenyetawe nawe 'emenatene yamiyezute?!

lamahonuse baduneyaawe heyewate 'ewenatene kedawe 'eyaala 'enedeetese hono nawe liyaamenunaa 'emenataacawe taqabaayenate liyaaganye yamicelawe?! ka'ewenate reqaweme bagemete sela male'eketanyaawe (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) degemetanyaa, thaneqwaaye baalaqenee 'eyaalu qaalaatocene 'eyasanazaruse 'enedeete yaamenaalu?!

'enazihe 'asetabaabaayoce ka'enaresu bafite male'eketanyocaacawene yaasetabaabaalute teweledocene kamifalegute yaduneyaa 'erekaataa, kakehedataacawe bamamalase ka'esaate lamadaane yaalaacawene felaagote 'enedihume wada duneyaa yamamalase menyotaacawene 'enedanafagenaacawe hulu 'enaziheme laaye yehenenu 'adaragenebaacawe. mekeneyaatume 'enazihu sawoce male'eketanyoce yezawete bamathute ya'alaahe 'anedenate 'enedihume kamote baxwaalaa yamaqaseqase 'emenate laaye lakehedate yamiyaabaqaacawe therethaaree wesethe nabaru.

mesegaanaa samaayaatenenaa mederene yaala qedema-mesaalee fathaari lahonawe 'alaahe yegabaawe. kamalaa'eketeme ya'esune fetherata-wesaanee te'ezaazene fatsaami 'adaraga. ka'enasume lanabiyaatoce male'ekete yamiyaadarese; yasathaacaweneme 'adaraa 'enediwathu yaabarataacawe naacawe. ka'enasume wesethe baala hulate, baalaszosetenaa baala 'araate kenefoce yahonu wada taazazubate yamibaru sihonu bafetheratu laaye ba'akaaleme, bawebateme, bademetzeme yamishaawene yechameraale. 'alaahe hulune nagare caaye nawenaa. meneme 'ayesaanaweme.

yahulume nagaroce makefacaa qulefe ba'alaahe 'eje nawe. bamahonume lasawoce sisaayene, meraacaanenaa `edelanyenatene yamikafetawene maaneme 'agaaje yalaweme. ka'eresu yamikalakelawene kakalakalawe baxwaalaa maaneme yamikafetawe yalame. 'eresume maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi. bamafethare, bamawasanenaa bamaasetanaabare thebabanyaa nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! ba'enaaneta laaye yaalawene ya'alaahene tzagaa balebaacehu, bamelaasaacehunaa ba'akaalaacehu batagebaare 'asetaawesu. lamahonu ka'alaahe wechi kasamaaye zenaabene bamaawerade, kamedereme 'azere`etenenaa feraafereene bamaabeqale sisaaye yamisathaacehu leelaa fathaari 'alane? ka'eresu basetaqare ba'ewenate 'amelaake yalame. 'esu 'enaanetane fatherwacehunaa sisaaye 'eyasathaacehu lamahonu 'enedeete hono nawe kazihe ka'ewenataa zoraacehu 'enedihume la'alaahe 'agaare 'alawe bamaalate ba'alaahe laaye yameteqathefute?

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! hhezebocehe biyaasetabaabeluheme taagase. 'aneta hhezebocu kaasetabaabalute yamajamariyaawe 'ayedalaheme. ka'aneta bafite yanabaru 'eneda `aade, samude, yaluthe hhezeboce male'eketanyocaacawene 'asetabaabelawaale. nagaroce hulu wada 'alaaheme yemalasaalu. baziheme gizee 'asetabaabaayocene yaathafaale. male'eketanyocenaa me`emanaanene dele yaagonaatzefaacawaale.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'alaahe batenesaa'eewe qane sela maqaseqasenaa sela mamanedaate yagabaawe qaale 'ewenate nawe. meneme therethere yalaweme. yaduneyaa thefethenaanaa semeete laziyaa qane malekaame szeraane bamaszeraate kamazagaajate 'ataataalelaacehu. 'ataalaayume shayethwane weshatene bamaasegeethenaa wada duneyaa bamaazanebale 'ayaataalelaacehu.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! shayethwane la'enaaneta yazalaalame thalaataacehu nawe. selazihe 'esune bamawaagaate thalaate 'aderegaacehu yaazute. takataayocune yamitharaawe ba'alaahe kedawe batenesaa'eewe qane macharashaacawe yatagaagaamace 'esaate 'enedigabu nawe.

'enaziyaa shayethwanene bamakatale yakaadute la'enasu beretu qethaate 'alalaacawe. 'enaziyaame ba'alaahe yaamanutenaa bago szeraawocene yaszaru la'enasu ka'alaahe lahathi'ataacawe meheratenaa taalaaqe menedaame 'alaacawe. 'esume janate nawe.

shayethwane mathefo szeraawene 'agitholate yehenu szeraa malekaame 'aderego yataqabala sawe 'alaahe 'ewenatene shalemolate 'ewenate 'aderego 'enedataqabalawe sawe nawene? 'alaaheme yamishaawene sawe yaathamaale. yamishaawene yaaqanaale. maaneme 'asegadaaje yalaweme selazihe 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bathamaamoce mathemame bamaazane nafesehene 'ataathefaa. 'alaahe yamiszarutene hulu `aawaaqi nawe. kaszeraawocaacawe meneme 'ayesawarebateme.

'alaaheme 'esu nafaasocene yalaaka nawe. nafaasume damanaane yeqasaqesaale. yeheneneme damanaa takele wada leelabate 'agare 'enenadaawaalane. bawehaweme baabaqalenawe 'azere`ete medereneme kadaraqace baxwaalaa hheyaawe 'enaadaregaalane. yehecene medere kamotace baxwaalaa heyaawe 'enedaadaragenaate hulu mutaaneneme batenesaa'eewe qane 'enedazihu 'eneqasaqesaacawaalane.

baduneyaanaa ba'akxeeraa 'ashanaafinatene yamifalege ka'alaahe 'eneji kamaaneme 'ayethayeqe. bahulatume hagaroce 'ashanaafinate la'alaahe becaa nawe. malekaame wedaaseewe wada 'eresu yewathaale. malekaame szeraaneme wada 'eresu kafe yaadaregawaale. 'enaziyaame mathefo seeraane yamiyaaseeru (ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa magedalene yamasala) la'enasu beretu qethaate 'alalaacawe. ya'enaziyaa kahadiyaane tanekole yethafaale. yamifalegute 'ayesaakaalaacaweme.

'alaahe 'abaataacehune 'adamene ka`afare, kaziyaame 'enaanetane kafetewate thabetaa fatharaacehu. kaziyaame wanedenaa seete bamaaderage 'enedetegaabu 'adaragaacehu. ka'alaahe `eweqate weche maanenyaawaame 'enesete tzenese matzanaseme hona leje mawelade 'ateceleme. ka'eresu yamisaware nagare yalame. yamaanenyaaweme fethure `edemee machamareme hona maqanase lawehhalemaahefuze (bathebequ matsehhafe) laaye saferwale. yehe yatagalatsawe 'enaanetane ka'afare mafetharu, bakxidate mafatharaacehume, `edemeeyaacehune bathebequ matsehhafe laaye maasefare la'alaahe gare nawe.

hulatume baaheroce 'ekule 'ayedalume. 'anedanyaawe bathaame thaafaache nawe, thaa`emu selamithaafethe baqalaalu yamithathaa nawe. hulatanyaawe chawaamaa yamimarere nawe. bathaame chawaamaa bamahonu lithathaa 'ayeceleme. katagalatzute hulate baaheroceme tekuse segaane tebalaalaacehu 'esume ya`aaszaa segaa nawe. kahulatu baaheroceme yametelabesutene (lulenaa marejaane) geethe taawathaalaacehu. 'aneta tamalekaace hoye! negedene bamanagade ya'alaahene cerotaa 'enedetefalegunaa yalagasaacehune barekaataa tzagaawene taamasagenute zanede baaherene wadafitenaa wada xwaalaa sanetheqawe yamigwaazu marekabocene mafetharune temalakataalahe.

'alaahe lalitene baqane wesethe yaasegabaanaa qanume yerazemaale; qaneneme balalite wesethe yaasegabaale; lalitume yerazemaale; tzahayenenaa charaqaaneme 'agaraa; hulume ba'alaahe yamitaawaqe yatawasana yaqatharo gizee derase yegwaazaalu; 'esume tenesaa'ee nawe; yehenene hulu yawasanawe geetaacehu 'alaahe nawe; negeszenaawe ya'esu becaa nawe. 'enaziyaame ka'alaahe wechi yametegazwacawe thaa`otaate yatamere feree shefaane yaahele 'enekwaa selethaane yalaacaweme. ka'enee wechi 'enedeete tegazwacawaalaacehu?!

yametaamalekwaacawene betetharwacawe theriyaacehune 'ayesamume. mekeneyaatume heyewate yaleelaacawe masemiyaame yaleelaacawe ge`uzoce naacawe. theriyaacehune bisamume noro ('enediyaawe bisamu) 'ayemalesulaacehume. batenesaa'eeweme qane 'enaresune ba'alaahe maagaaraataacehunenaa maamelakaacehune yekedaalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'alaahe yabalatha theleqe `aawaaqi hono 'ewenatene yaminagerehe maaneme yalame.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! bagudaayaacehunaa huneetaacehu hulu hulegizee ka'alaahe kajaayoce naacehu. 'alaaheme 'eresu yatabeqaaqaawe ka'enaaneta meneme yamaayekajele; labaarocu bamiwasenaacawe hulu baqerebitume bamacharashaayetume `aalame mesegune nawe.
'alaahe 'enaanetane maathefaate bifalege yaasewagedaacexwaale. ba'enaanetame meteke 'esune yamigazu meneme yamaayaagaarubate 'adise fethure yaamathaale.
'enaanetane bamaathefaate maasewagade bametekaacehume 'adise fethurene maamethaatu ba'alaahe laaye meneme 'asecagaari 'ayedalame.

hathi'aatene tashakaamime nafese yaleelaawene shakeme 'ateshakameme. yelequnese hulume nafese yaraaswane hathi'aate becaa teshakamaalace. hathi'atwane bamashakamwa yakabadaateme nafese hathi'atwane 'enedishakamulaate betethaaraame tathariwe la'eswa yaqerebe zamade bihoneme 'enekwaa ka'eswa 'anedeme yamishakamelaate 'ataaganyeme. 'aneta male`e'eketanyaa hoye! ka'alaahe qethaate yametaasethanaqeqawe 'enaziyaane geetaacawene baruqe yamifarutene, salaateneme bamigabaa 'amwaletawe yaaqwaaqwaamutene nawe. ba'aneta maasefaraariyaa tathaqaamiwoce 'enasu naacawe. kahathi'ateme (telequme hathi'ate ba'alaahe maagaaraate nawe) yatharaa sawe yamitharaawe laraasu becaa nawe. mekeneyaatume theqemu wada 'esu yemalasaalenaa. 'alaahe kaszeraawe yatabeqaaqaa nawe. batenesaa'eewe qane lagemegamaame lamenedaame mamalashaa wada 'alaahe becaa nawe.
`aayena-sewerenaa yamiyaaye 'ekule 'enedaalehonute hulu kahadinaa 'amaanyeme badarajaa 'ekule 'ayedalume.
chalamaawocenaa berehaane 'ekule 'enedaalehonuteme hulu kehedatenaa 'emenateme 'ekule 'ayehonume.
thelaanaa moqaate nafaase 'ekule 'enedaalehonute hulu janatenaa 'esaate badarajaacawe 'ekule 'ayedalume.

heyaawaanenaa mutaane 'ekule 'enedaalehonute hulu me'emanenaa kahadiyaaneme 'ekule 'ayedalume. 'alaahe qanaawene manegade limaraawe yafalagawene sawe yaasamaawaale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kahadiyaane maqaabere wesethe 'enedaalu mutaane naacawenaa letaasamaacawe 'ateceleme.
'aneta ka'alaahe qethaate 'asethaneqaaqi 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaheme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enyaa me'emanaanene 'alaahe malekaame menedaa yaazagaajalaacawe mahonune 'abesaarinaa kahadiyaanene 'asaamaami qethaate yaazagaajalaacawe mahonune 'asethaneqaaqi bamaaderage; therethaaree baleelawe ba'ewenate lekanehaale. kaalafuteme hhezeboce maanenyaaweme hhezebe ka'alaahe zanede kaqethaatu yamiyaasefaraacawe male'eketanyaa yaalaalafabate hhezebe yalame.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! hhezebocehe biyaasetabaabaluheme taagase. 'aneta hhezebocu kaasetabaabalute yamajamariyaawe 'ayedalaheme. yaalafute hhezeboce 'eneda `ade, samude 'enaa yaluthe yaalute hhezeboce male'eketanyocaacawene 'asetabaabelawaale. male'eketanyocaacaweme sela 'ewenatanyenataacawe ka'alaahe zanede geletze maaserajaawocene, 'asedanaaqi ta`aameraatocene, matsaahhefetenenaa lamiyaasetawelaacawe 'aberi yahonu matsaahhefete 'amethetawelaacawe nabare.

kaziheme gaare 'alaahene kaadu male'eketanyocu ka'esu zanede yaamathutene mamariyaa 'alaamanume. kaziyaame 'enaziyaane yakaadutene 'athafaaxwaacawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enasune bamaathefaate maawegazee 'enedeete nabare? 'asetawele.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe kasamaaye yazenaabe wehane maaweradunenaa bawehaweme malekaacawe yatalayaayu yaferaaferee `aayenatocene qaye, 'aranegwaadee, bichaa 'enaa leeloce zaafocaacawene kaathathaane baxwaalaa maawethaataacenene. kataraaroceme yatalayaayu nachoce, qayoceme bathaame thequroceme yahonu manegadoce manoraacawene 'atemalakatemene?!

kasawoceme, kataneqasaaqaashe fethuraaneme, kabeete 'enesasoceme (gemale, kabete, feyalenaa bage) 'enedazihu malekocaacawe yatalayaayu 'alu. ya'alaahene darajaa yamiyaakaberunaa yamifarute `aawaaqiwocu naacawe. mekeneyaatume baaheriyaatu, denegaageewenaa caayenatune 'aweqawaalenaa. 'alaahe maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi kabaarocu kahathi'aatu tatzatzeto yatamalasawene mahari nawe.

'enaziyaa wada male'eketanyaawe yawaradawene ya'alaahene matsehhafe yamiyaanabunaa mamariyaawene yamitagaberuteme, salaateneme bamigabaa 'asaamerawe yamisagedu, kasathanaacaweme sisaaye zakaanaa leelocene bamisethereme hona bageletse yalagasu; bafetsume yamaatekaserene yanegede szeraane ka'alaahe tasefaa yaadaregaalu.

yeheneneme yamiyaadaregute 'alaahe yaszeraawocaacawene menedaa mulu 'aderego 'enedisathaacawenaa kacerotaaweme yechamerelaacawe zanede nawe. 'alaaheme yazihe baalabeete nawenaa 'esu ba'enazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatsutene bathaame mahari malekaame szeraacaweneme 'amasegaanye nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kamatsehhafu wadaaneta yaawaradenelehe meneme therethaaree yaleelawe 'ewenate nawe. ka'esu bafite yaalafutene matsaahhefete 'aragaache nawe. 'alaahe sela baariyaawocu theleqe `aawaaqinaa szeraacawene tamalekaace nawe. 'esu la'eyaanedaanedu hhezebe male'eketanyoce bagizeeyaacawe yamiyaasefalegaacawene raa`eye yaawaredaale.

kaziyaame kaleeloce hhezeboce yaasebalathenaacawene yamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) hhezebocene qure'aanene sathanaacawe; 'anedaanedu kelekele yahonu szeraawocene bamaszeraatenaa gedeetaane bamatawe nafesune yamibadele 'ala.leelaawe dagemo gedeetaawocane bamaszeraatenaa yatakalakalutene bamatawe kaziheme gaare 'anedaanede tawadaaje nagarocene bamatawenaa yatathalu 'anedaanede nagarocene bamaszeraate bazihu yatabeqaaqaame 'ala. wesenocu dagemo gedeetaawinaa tawadaaje szeraawocene bamaszeraate 'enaa kelekelocenenaa yatathalu tagebaaraatene bamatawe ba'alaahe faqaade bamalekaame szeraawoce qadaamiwoceme 'alu. yaa yatathaqasawe (lazihe hhezebe qure'aanene maretho masethatu) meneme cerotaa yamaayewadaadarawe taalaaqe cerotaa nawe!
'enazihe merethocu yamanoriyaa ganatocene yegabaalu. bawesethwame yawareqenaa yalule 'anebaarocene yaathaleqaalu. ba'ereswa wesethe 'alebaasaataacaweme hhare nawe.

janate kagabume baxwaalaa <<'esaate 'enedaayaasegabaane 'esune bamaferaataacene mekeneyaate ka'enyaa laaye hhazanene laasewagadalene la'alaahe mesegaanaa yegabaawe. geetaacene kabaarocu bamatzatzate wada 'esu yamimalasutene bathaame mahari bamataazazaacaweme 'amasegaanye nawenaa.>> yelaalu.

'eresume yaa kacerotaawe yazalaalame manoriyaane hagare (kaswa baxwaalaa wada leelaa mashagaagare yaleelabaatene) yaasaarafa nawe. banyaa zadeeme xaayeleme 'ayedalame. ba'eswa wesethe makaraame dekaameme 'ayenakaaneme.

yamerethoce baarocune menedaa kagalatza baxwaalaa: yatawaaradu kahadiyaanene menedaa sigaletze 'enedihe 'ala::
'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yakaaduteme la'enaresu yajahaname 'esaate 'alalaacawe. yemotume kaqethaate yegalaagalume zanede ba'enasu laaye mote 'ayefarademe. kajahaname qethaateme la'enaresu meneme 'ayeqalalelaacaweme. 'enedazihe `aayenate qethaatene yageetaawene tzagaa kahadine hulu batenesaa'eewe qane 'enemanadaalane.

'enasume ba'eswa wesethe demetzaacawene kafe bamaaderage 'eredaataane felagaa 'enedihe 'eyaalu yechohalu. <<geetaacene hoye! duneyaa banabarenebate gizee 'eneszaraawe kanabarenawe leelaa malekaame szeraane bamaszeraate ya'anetane wedeetaa bamaagenyate kaqethaatehe 'enedene zanede ka'esaate 'asewathaane.>> 'alaaheme malese bamasethate ba'esu wesethe magasatzenenaa wada 'alaahe tatzatzeto mamalasene 'enedihume malekaame szeraane maszeraate lafalaga sawe yamigasatzebatene `edemee 'alaadaragenelaacehumene? ka'alaahe qethaate 'asethaneqaaqiweme male'eketanyaa mathetolaacexwaale; kazihe hulu baxwaalaa mekeneyaate yalaacehume selazihe ya'esaate qethaate qemasu; nafesaacawene bakehedatenaa bahathi'aate yabadaluteme ya'alaahene qethaate bamaadaanenaa bamaaqelale meneme radaate yalaacaweme yebaalaale.
'alaahe yasamaayaatenenaa yamederene misethere baregethe `aa'awaaqi nawe. meneme 'ayaamalethaweme. 'esu baarocu balebocaacawe wesethe yamidabequtene malekaameme mathefome `aawaaqi nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'alaahe 'enaanetane mene 'enedametaadaregu lamafatane bamedere laaye kafilocaacehu kafilune 'enediwarese (tataki 'enedihone) 'aderegwaale. ya'alaaheme male'eketanyoceme yaamathutene yakaada sawe yakehedatu wanejalenaa mazazu wada raasu tamalaashe nawe. bamakaadume geetaawene 'ayegodaame. kahadiwoceneme kehedataacawe kageetaacawe zanede mathalaatene 'eneji leelaa 'ayechamerelaacaweme. kahadiwoceneme kehedataacawe kiszaaraane 'eneji leelaa 'ayechamerelaacaweme biyaamenu noro: yamiyaazagaajelaacawene janate yaathaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce <<'enaziyaane ka'alaahe wechi yametegazwacawene tagaariwocaacehu 'ayaacehune? kamedere menene 'enedafatharu 'asaayunye? taraarocwane fatharune?! wanezocwane fatharune? 'enesesaawocwane fatharune? wayese la'enaresu samaayaatene bamafethare sherekenaa 'alaacawene? wayese matsehhafune sathanaacawenaa 'enasu tagaariwocaacawene magazaataacawe tekekele 'enedahonu geletze maaserajaa 'alaacawene? 'ayedalame meneme yalaacaweme yelequnese nafesaacawene bakehedate bahathi'aate yabadalu badalanyoce kafilaacawe kafilune maataalalene 'eneji tasefaa 'ayesathume.>>

'alaahe samaayaatenenaa medere 'enedaayewagadu yeyezaacawaale. biwagadume ka'eresu wechi 'anedeme yamiyezaacawe yalame. 'enaho 'esu baarocune baqethaate kamaathaadafe taagaashe; kabaarocu wada 'esu bamatzatzate yatamalasutene wanejale mahari nawe.

'enaziyaa 'asetabaabaaye kahadiyaane kabaade yahonane mahalaa bamamaaleme ka'alaahe kaqethaatu yamiyaasefaraaraacawe male'eketanyaa bimathaalaacawe kayehudoce; kakeresetiyaanocenaa kaleeloce hhezeboce yebalethe wada 'ewenate yatamarunaa yatasetakaakalu 'enedamihonu tanaagaru. muhhamademe (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) kageetaacawe qethaate yamiyaasethanaqeqaacawe bamahone male'eketanyaa hono yamathaalaacawe gizee mamethaatu ka'ewenate maraaqenenaa baweshate laaye manethalethalene 'eneji leelaa 'alechamaralaacaweme. kaalafute hhezeboce hulu wada 'ewenate yatamaraane 'enehonaalane belawe 'athebeqawe yamaalutene mahalaa saayaamwalu qaru.

bamaalubate nagare laaye ba'alaahe yamaalute theenanyaanaa theru yahona hasaabenaa `aalaamaa norwacawe saayehone yelequne medere laaye lamakuraatenaa sawocene lamaataalale nawe. mathefo seeraame baaseerawe sawe laaye 'eneji baleelaawe laaye 'ayesafereme. lamahonu seeranyaa kuraatanyoce ka'enasu bafite yanabarute sawoce 'enedathafute mathefaatene 'eneji leelaa yethabaabaqaalune? 'alaahe kuraatanyocene bamaathefaate kxidate laaye yaalawe qwaami wesaaneene bamaqayare qethaatune ba'enasu laaye baalamaasaalafeme hona wayeme dagemo wada leelaa 'akaale bamaazoreme lawethe 'ataaganyelateme (meneme 'ayeqayareme). mekeneyaatume yatzanaa ya'amelaake qwaami wesaanee nawe.

'enazihe 'anetane 'asetabaabaayoce bamedere laaye 'eyatagwaazu ka'enasu bafite yanabarutene hhezeboce fetzaamee 'enedeete 'enedanabare bamaasetawaale 'ayemalakatumene?! 'enasune bamaathefaate fetzaameeyaacaweme mathefo fe`emee 'alenabaramene! ka'enaresume baxaayele yabaratu nabaru; 'alaaheme basamaayaateme hona bamedere wesethe meneme nagare yamisaanawe 'ayedalame. 'enazihe 'asetabaabaayoce yamisarutene `aawaaqi nawe; kaszeraawocaacawe meneme 'ayesawarebatememe; 'ayaamalethawememe; bafalagabateme gizee 'enasune lamaathefaate caaye nawe!

'alaaheme sawocene baszarute hathi'aate, bafatzamute wanejale qethaatune biyaafaathene noro bamedere laaye yaalu nawaariwocenenaa baseraacawe yaalu 'enesesocenenaa ganezabaacawene bamulu wadiyaawene yaathafaacawe nabare; gene 'esu theraate yegegabaawenaa 'esekatawasana (tenesaa'ee) gizee derase yaaqoyaacawaale. tenesaa'eeweme bamathaa gizee 'alaahe yabaarocune huneetaa tamalekaace nawenaa; ka'enasu meneme 'ayesawarebateme; baszeraacaweme malekaamune bamalekaame, mathefone bamathefo yemanadaacawaale.
ys <<yaasine>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)
'aneqatzocu tzenu 'enaa kafitume hona kaxwaalaawe yamiyaabalaashe nagare yamaayemathaabate bahonawe qure'aane 'alaahe yemelaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'aneta baregethe 'alaahe wada baarocu kalaakaacawe wada 'esu 'anedenatenaa 'ameleko kamitharu male'eketanyocu nahe.

qathe baala falagenaa batasetakaakala hege laaye nahe. yehe qathe yaala falagenaa yatasetakaakala hege maaneme kamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi; la'amaanye baarocu 'azaanye kahonawe geetaa: yatawarada nawe.

qathe baala falagenaa batasetakaakala hege laaye nahe. yehe qathe yaala falagenaa yatasetakaakala hege maaneme kamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi; la'amaanye baarocu 'azaanye kahonawe geetaa: yatawarada nawe.

yehenene yaawaradenelehe: kazihe bafite 'asethaneqaaqi yaalemathaalaacawene ya`aarabe hhezebocene letaasefaraaraabatenaa letaasethanaqeqebate nawe; 'enasu 'emenatenenaa ya'alaahene 'anedenate yazanagu naacawe; maasethaneqaqiyaa yataqwaarathabaacaweme hhezeboce hulu 'enedihe naacawe. kamale'eketanyoce, ka`aawaaqiwocenaa wada 'alaahe tathaariwoce yamiyaasetaaweswacawe yaasefalegaacawaale.

ba'abezaanyocaacawe laaye ya'alaahe qethaate ba'eregethe taragaagathabaacawe. 'ewenatu ka'alaahe bamale'eketanyocu 'anedabate kadarasaacawe baxwaalaa 'enasu 'ayaamenume yelequne bakehedataacawe laaye zawataru; ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe 'ayaamenume; bamathaalaacawe 'ewenateme 'ayeszarume.

'enazihe yamiyaamenume yamimarume 'ayedalume; mesaaleeyaacaweme: 'anegatocaacawe laaye qanebare (gamade) 'enedatadaragabate 'enaa 'ejocaacawe ka'anegatocaacawe gaare 'agachocaacawe sere 'enedatasabasabu naacawe. raasaacawene (cheneqelaate) wada samaaye yaanegaathathu honawe wadataace maagonebase 'ayecelume. 'enaziheme ba'alaahe kamaamane yataasaru naacawe la'esu 'eje 'ayesathume raasaacaweneme la'esu 'ayaasetanaanesume.

kafitaacaweme ka'ewenate yamigaarede geredone: kaxwaalaacaweme geredone 'adaragene. `aayenocaacawene ka'ewenate shafanenaacaweme selazihe 'enasu yamithaqemaacawene nagare 'ayaayume. yehe nagare yatakasatawe 'enasu kehedataacawe laaye yazawatarunaa geteroce mahonaacawe geletze kahona baxwaalaa nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enazihe 'ewenatene maqabalene 'emebi yaalu kahadiyaane betaasethanaqeqaacaweme baataasethanaqeqaacaweme la'enasu 'ekule nawe. 'aneta ka'alaahe zanede yaamathaakxawene 'ewenate 'ayaamenume.

bamaasethaneqaqiyaahe ba'ewenate yamithaqamawe bazihe qure'aane yaamana, bawesethu yaalawene mamariyaa yatakatalanaa maaneme bamaayaayawe botaa labecaawe sihone geetaawene yamifaraa sawe becaa nawe. 'enanyihene baaheriyaate yatalaabasutene yamiyaasedasetawene meheratenaa bamacharashaawe `aalame yamithabeqawene taalaaqe menedaane 'abeserawe 'esume janate magebaate nawe.

'enyaa mutaanene lagemegamaa batenesaa'eewe qane heyaawe 'enaadaregaalane. baqerebitume heyewate yaaseqadamuteneme malekaamenaa mathefo seraa 'enetzefaalane. kaheyewataacawe maalafe baxwaalaa yaaseqarutene 'ashaaraacawene qwaami metzewaatene yamasala malekaame szeraacawene 'enedihume 'eneda kehedate yaalu mathefo szeraacawene 'enetzefaalane. nagaruneme hulu geletze bahonawe matsehhafe (thebeqe mazegabe) wesethe 'athaqaalalenawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa takaraakaari 'asetabaabaayoce temeherete yehonaacawe zanede yakatamaayetune sawoce male'eketanyoce bamathaa gizee yahonawene mesaalee 'aderegelaacawe.

bamajamariyaa wada 'alaahe 'anedenatenaa 'ameleko yamitharwacawe hulate male'eketanyocene balaakene gizee hulatuneme 'asetabaabalu. szosetanyaa male'eketanyaane bamalaake 'athanakarenaacawe. szosetume male'eketanyoce lakatamaayetu sawoce 'enyaa (szosetaacene) 'enaanetane wada 'alaahe 'anedenatenaa hhegune 'enedetekatalu lamatheraate wada 'enaaneta yatalaakene nane 'alwacawe.

yakatamaayetume sawoce lamale'eketanyocu <<'enedanyaa sawoce 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaacehume. kanyaa yamilayaacehu nagare yalame. 'are-raahhemaaneme meneme raa`eye 'alaawaradame. 'enaaneta bazihe 'abaabaalaacehu ba'alaahe laaye yametewaashu 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaacehume>> 'alu.

male'eketanyocume lakatamaayetu sawoce weshate melaashe bamasethate <<'enaaneta yakatamaayetu sawoce geetaacene 'enyaa wada 'enaaneta yatalaakene mahonaacenene yaaweqaale. yehe lanyaa baqi maaserajaa nawe>> 'alu.
<<ba'enyaa laayeme 'enedenaadarese yataazazenawene bageletze maaderase 'eneji leelaa yalabeneme. 'enyaa 'enaanetane lasekeete maabeqaate 'aneceleme.>>

yakatamaayetume sawoce lamale'eketanyoce <<'enyaa ba'enaaneta gada-bisoce honene. 'enyaane wada 'alaahe 'anedenate (tawehhide) kamatheraate yamaatetaaqabu kahona 'eseketemotu derase badenegaaye bamawegare 'eneqathaacexwaalane. ka'enyaame 'asaamaami qethaate baregethe yaaganyaacexwaale>> 'alu.

male'eketanyocume la'enasu malese bamasethate <<gadabisenataacehu ba'alaahe bamakaadaacehunaa male'eketanyocene baalamakatalaacehu mekeneyaate ka'enaanetawe gaare nawe; 'ayelaqaacehume. sela 'alaahe selaasetaawasanaacehu 'enyaa gada-bisoce hone?! ba'ewenatu 'enaaneta kehedatenaa hathi'atene bamafatzamaacehu wasane 'alaafi hhezeboce naacehu>>; 'alwacawe.

kakatamaayetume ruqe botaa bahhezebu laaye male'eketanyocene bamaasetabaabalaacawenaa bamagedale 'enedihume bamaasaqaayate bamazaataacawe mekeneyaate faretolaacawe 'anede saweyee 'eyarotha mathaa. <<waganocee hoye! 'enazihe male'eketanyoce yaamathulaacehune takatalu>> 'ala.

<<waganocee 'enasu ka'alaahe yawaradalaacawene bamaaderase laaye qenune manegade yatamaru sihonu bamiyaadaresute male'ekete ka'enaaneta waagaane yamaayethayeqwaacehune sawoce takatalu 'enedihe `aayenatu sawe likatalute yamigabaa nawe>> 'alaacawe.

yehe makaarime sawe <<yafatharanyene 'alaahene kamagazaate yamiyaagedanye menedene nawe?! 'enaanetame yafatharaacehune geetaacehune kamagazaate yamikalakelaacehu (yamiyaagedaacehu) menedene nawe?! wada 'eresume becaa bamaqaseqase lamamanedaate temalasaalaacehu>> 'ala.

lamahonu yaala'agebaabe 'eneene kafatharanye leelaa 'amaaleketene 'egazaalahunyene? 'are-raahhemaane 'eneene bagudaate bifaleganye ya'enazihe 'amaalekete melejaa meneme 'ayethaqemanyeme. lithaqemunyeme ligodunyeme 'ayecelume. bakehedate laaye bemote 'alaahe banee laaye yashaawene gudaate 'ayaadenunyeme.
ka'alaahe wechi 'amaaleketene yameyeze kahona 'enee yaane gizee 'ameleko yamaayegabaawene bamagazaateenaa 'ameleko yamigabaawene 'amelaake bamatawee mekeneyaate bageletze sehetate wesethe nanye.

<<waganocee 'enee bageetaayeenaa bageetaacehu 'amenyaalahunaa 'anedee semunye. letegadelunye bametezetubenye nagare laaye gede yalanyeme>> 'ala. waganocume gadalute. wadeyaaweme 'alaahe janate 'asegabaawe.

samaa'ete kahona baxwaalaa bakebere janate gebaa tabaala. janateme gabeto bawesethwa yaalawene tzagaa 'enedatamalakata bamenyote 'enedihe 'ala <<yaasetabaabalunyenaa yagadalunye waganocee geetaayee lanee yaadaragalenye meheratenaa geetaayee yasathanyene kebere biyaawequ noro 'enee 'enedaamanekute baamanunaa yaaganyahutene menedaa baaganyu nabare.>>

samaa'ete kahona baxwaalaa bakebere janate gebaa tabaala. janateme gabeto bawesethwa yaalawene tzagaa 'enedatamalakata bamenyote 'enedihe 'ala <<yaasetabaabalunyenaa yagadalunye waganocee geetaayee lanee yaadaragalenye meheratenaa geetaayee yasathanyene kebere biyaawequ noro 'enee 'enedaamanekute baamanunaa yaaganyahutene menedaa baaganyu nabare.>>

'enaziyaane yaasetabaabalutenaa yagadalute waganocune lamaathefaate kasamaaye yamiwaredu yamale'ake szaraawite 'alaasefalaganeme. hezeboce baathafaane gizee male'aketene yamenaawarede 'alehoname. gudaayaacawe kazihe yaqalala nawe. mathefiyaacawe yaqethaate malaa'eketene bamaawerade saayehone kasamaaye bamathaa chukxate 'enedihone wasanene.

yawaganocu mathefaate taarike ba'anede chukxate 'eneji leelaa 'alenabarame. chukxatune senelekabaacawe wadiyaawe tarafarafu maaneme yaqara yalame. mesaaleeyaacawe leke yataqathaathala 'esaate laaye weha sichamarebate 'enedamithafaa thafu meneme qerite 'aletaganyalaacaweme.

'asetabaabaaye lahonu baaroce qethaatene batenesaa'eewe qane baayu gizee waa quchetaacawe! 'enasu duneyaa banabarubate gizee 'anedeme ka'alaahe yahona male'eketanyaa 'ayemathaalaacaweme. bamale'eketanyaawe laaye yaalaagathunaa yatasaalaqu bihone 'eneji baziheme mekeneyaate batenesaa'eewe qane fetsaameewe quchete hona.

'enanyaa male'eketanyocene yaasetabaabalunaa ba'enasu laaye yatasaalaqu sawoce ka'enasu bafite baalafute hhezeboce 'ayegasatzumene? 'enasu motu wadazice `aalameme tamalesawe 'ayemathume yelequne kaszarute szeraa gaare taganaanyu; baszeraawocaacaweme 'alaahe yemanadaacawaale.
'eyaanedaanedu hhezebe batenesaa'eewe qane kamote kataqasaqasu baxwaalaa lamamanedaate 'enyaa zanede maqerabaacawe yamaayeqare nawe.

la'enanyaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce meleketu daraqenaa yamaataabaqele mareete laaye kasamaaye zenaabe bamaawerade ya'azere`ete `aayenatoce 'enaa yatalayaayu yatheraatheree `aayenatocene bamaabeqale sawoce yemagabute zanede 'awathaane. yehecene medere zenaabe bamaawerade 'enaa 'azere`etene bamaawethaate heyaawe 'enedaadaragaate hulu mutaanene heyaawe bamaaderage maqaseqasene caaye nawe.
kasamaaye zenaabe yaawaradenelaate medere wesethe kazanebaabaanaa kawayene yahonu ya'atekelete botaawoce 'adaragene. ka'eswame yamiyaathathubaatene menechoce 'afalaqene.

'alaahe kawaalalaacawe welataa ka'enazihe ya'atekelete botaawoce meneme ba'ejocaacawe yaaleszarute fereewocene yemagabu zanede yehenene 'adaragene. 'enazihene hulu ka'esu terufaatenaa 'ezenate 'esune babecanyenate bamagazaataacawenaa bamale'eketanyocu bamaamanaacawe mekeneyaate yasathaacawene 'alaahene 'ayaamasagenumene?

kazaafocenaa 'azere`ete 'enedihume kasawoce nafese thenede bamaaderage wanedenaa seete 'alaahe kafatharaacawe medere laaye baahere wesethe 'enaa leeloce sawoce kamaayaawequte hulu yafathara 'amelaake theraate yegabaawe.

ya'alaahe becanyaa 'amelaakenatene kamiyaamalaaketu melekete: qane bamaheedu berehaane yewagadaale. laliteneme kaqanu gafefane 'enaawathaalane. qanu kaheeda baxwaalaa chalamaane bamaamethaate sawoce bachalamaa wesethe yegabaalu.

ka'alaahe 'anedenate ('ahadenate) meleketoce tzahaye naate 'eswa wada maarafiyaawaa tegwaazaalace. yaaneneme 'alaahe wasanune yaaweqawaale ka'esu wasane 'ataalefeme. yehe wesaanee maaneme yamaayaashanefawe ya'ashanaafiwe bafethuraanu gudaaye laaye meneme yamaayedabaqebate `aawaaqi kahonawe 'amelaake nawe.

ka'alaahe 'anedenate meleketoce leelaawaa charaqaa naate; bayalalitu yametaarefebatene maarafiyaa 'adaragalaate; teneshe honaa tewathaalace, kaziyaa baxwaalaa taadegaalace kaziyaame 'eyaanasace bamaheede leke 'eneda tamere zaafe qerenechaafe yatathaamama, sese, qachene, daalacaanaa yaarajace 'enedetehone wasana.

tzahaye, charaqaa, lalitenaa qane ba'alaahe wesaanee yatawasanu meleketoce naacawe; 'alaahe kawasanalaacawe wasane 'ayaalefume! tzahaye charaqaane 'aqethaachaawaane bamaaselawatheme hona wayeme berehaanwane lamaasewagade letedaresebaate 'ayegabaame. laliteme gizeewe saayedarese baqane botaa laaye bamagebaate qadaami 'ayehoneme. hulume fethuraane 'alaahe yawasanalaacawe mehewaare laaye ba'esu wesaaneenaa thebaqaa yegwaazaalu.

ya'alaahene 'anedenatenaa 'alaahe babaarocu laaye yawaalawene tzagaa kamiyaamalaaketu meleketoce: ka'adame zereyaa yahonu banuhhe zamane yanabarutene bafethuraane yatamolaace marekabe laaye bamachaane kagorefe mathelaqelaqe 'adaanaacawe. 'alaahe kahulume `aayenate fethuraane thenede thenede bamaaderage chaanaacawe.
ya'alaahene 'anedenatenaa 'alaahe babaarocu laaye yawaalawene tzagaa kamiyaamalaaketu meleketoce makaakale 'eneda nuhhe `aayenate marekabe mafetharaacene nawe.

'enasune maasemathe benefalege 'enaasamethaacawaalane; 'enasune senaasamethe maaneme yamiradaacawe raji yalaacaweme; ba'enyaa te`ezaazenaa wesaanee senaasamethaacawe yamiyaadenaacawe 'adaanye yalaacaweme.
nagare gene ba'ezenataacene 'enasune kamaasemathe bamaadaane 'enaa 'eseka tawasana gizee lamaathaaqame bamaaqoyate yegasatzunaa yaamenu zanede 'adaanenaacawe.

la'enaziyaa ka'emenate lazoru 'agaariwoce 'alaahe tzagaawene yelagesaacehu zanede kafite lafitaacehu yaalawene yamacharashaawene qane kabaadenatenaa kaxwaalaacehu yaalacewene duneyaa tathaneqaqu batabaalu gizee 'alefatzamume. yelequnese celaa bamaalate 'emebi 'alu.
la'enanyaa 'asetabaabaaye 'agaariwoce: ya'alaahene 'anedenatenaa 'esune babecanyenate tamalaaki mahonune yamiyaasaayu meleketoce bamathaalaacawe quthere gemete saayesathu fitaacawene yaazoraalu.

la'enanyaa 'asetabaabaayoce dehocenenaa yatacagarutene 'alaahe kasathaacehu ganezabe 'agezu batabaalu gizee bamakuraate lame'emanaane 'alaahe mamagabene bifalege yamimagebawene sawe 'enyaa 'enemagebaalane? 'enyaa ya'esune felaagote 'anetzaarareme. 'enaaneta (me'emenaane hoye!) geletze bahona sehetatenaa ka'ewenate yaraaqa manegade laaye 'eneji baleelaa laaye 'ayedalaacehume yelaalu.

kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene bamaasetabaabale yamiyaawagezute kahadeyaane 'enaaneta (me'emanaane hoye!) kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase yamikasate mahonu 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu yehe qatharo macee nawe? yelaalu.

'enanyaa yatenesaa'eene qane yamiyaasetabaabelu baqanede yaminafaawe yamajamariyaawene nefi 'esekinafaa derase 'eneji leelaa 'ayethabequme. yehece nefi baduneyaa szeraawocaacawe bamashathe, bamagezaate, wehane bamaathathaate 'enaa leeloce baduneyaa szeraa wetherate laaye 'eyaalu denegate teyezaacawaalace.

yehece nefi denegate bametemathaabaacawe gizee 'anedu laleelaawe nuzaazee maasetalaalafe 'ayecelume. wada beetasabocaacawenaa beetaacaweme mamalaalase 'ayecelume. yelequnese baszeraawocaacawe laaye 'eyaalu yemotaalu.
hulatanyaawe nefi latenesaa'ee yenafaale! 'enasu wadiyaawe kamaqaaberocaacawe bamawethaate lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa wada geetaacawe bafethenate yeheedaalu.

'enaziyaa tenesaa'eewene yakaadunaa yaasetabaabalu sawoce bamatzatzate waa thefaataacene! kamaqaaberocaacene maane qasaqasene? yelaalu; latheyaaqeeyaacawe melaashe sisathaacawe yehe 'alaahe qaale yagabaawe nawe 'esume yekasataale. male'eketanyoceme sela geetaacawe yatanaagarute 'ewenatanyoce naacawe.
kamaqaabere yamaqaseqase gudaaye kahulatanyaawe nefi takatelo yamimathaa 'anede nefi 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame. wadiyaaweme fethuroce ba'athaqaalaaye 'enyaa zanede lagemegamaa yeqarebaalu.

feredu bazaane qane bafetehe yehonaale. 'enaaneta baaroce yaaleszaraacehutene hathi'aate bamachamarenaa yaszaraacehutene malekaame szeraane bamaqanase meneme 'atebadalume. baduneyaa seteszarute yanabarawene menedaa tamwaleto yekafalaacexwaale.
yajanate baaledaraboce batenesaa'eewe qane kamiyaayute zalaalamaawi tzagaanaa teleqe dele dasetanyoce naacawe. selaleelaawe kamaasabe yeleqe baraasaacawe gudaaye laaye wetherate wesethe naacawe.
'enasunaa baalabeetocaacawe bajanate thelaa sere bamahone ba'alegaawocaacawe laaye bamadasate yedagafaalu.
bajanate wesethe 'eneda wayene, tine balase, rumaanenaa yamasaasalute yatalayaayu thaafaache feraafereewoce 'enaa 'ezaa wesethe yamifalegute yatalayaayu tzagaawoce hulu 'alaacawe.

kazihe tzagaa balaayeme 'azaanye kahonawe geetaa salaametaa 'alaacawe; la'enasu salaametaa baaqarabalaacaweme gizee kahulume nagare salaamene yaaganyaalu. ka'alaahe salaametaa yabalatha taalaaqe salaame yalame.
batenesaa'eewe qane la'agaariwoce ka'amaanyoce talayu yebaalaalu la'agaariwoce ka'amaanyoce gaare mahone 'ayegabaacaweme mekeneyaatume menedaacawenaa baaheriyaacawe yatalayaaya bamahonu.

lamahonu bamale'eketanyocee 'enedabate 'enaaneta ya'adame lejoce hoye! shayethwanene yatalayaayu yakehedatenaa hathi'aate bamafatsame 'atetaazazu. shayethwane thalaatenatu la'enaaneta geletze yahona thalaate nawe 'alaalekwaacehumene? 'ewene tekekelanyaa 'a`emero yaalawe sawe thalaatenatu geletze yahonane thalaate 'enedeete yetaazazaale?!

'enaaneta ya'adame lejoce ba'enee meneme saataagaaru 'eneene becaa tagazunye beyee 'azazekwaacehu. 'eneene becaa magazaatenaa mataazaze qathe yaala 'enaa wada wedeetaayeenaa janatee yamiyaadarese manegade nawe. nagare gene 'enee yaazazekwaacehune te'e`ezaaze 'alefatzamaacehume.

baregetheme shayethwane ka'enaaneta bezu fethuraanene 'asaasaata. lamahonu geetaacehune yametetaazazubatenaa 'esune becaa yametegazubatene 'enaa yaa la'enaaneta thalaatenatu geletze yahonane `eyethwane kamataazaze yamiyaasethanaqeqaacehu 'a`emero 'alenabaraacehumene?!
yehece jahaname duneyaa banabaraacehu gizee bakehedataacehu mekeneyaate qaale yatagabaacelaacehu naate ka'enaaneta `eyetaa wechi nabarace. bazaareewemaa qane ba`aayenaacehu 'eyaayaacexwaate nawe.
bazaareewe qane gebwate. baduneyaa heyewataacehu 'alaahene bamakaadaacehu mekeneyaate bawesethwa lazalaalame nawaariwoce setehonu taqaathalu.

bazaareewe qane 'afocaacawene 'enezagaalane; dudaawoce yehonaalu; yanabarubatene kehedatenaa hathi'aate 'ayaasetabaabelume; 'ejocaacawe duneyaa wesethe yeszarute yanabarutene yenaagaraalu; 'egerocaacaweme yefatsemute yanabarutene hathi'aatenaa siheedubaacawe yanabarutene hulu yemasakeraalu.

`aayenocaacawene maasewagade benefalege 'asewagedane 'enedaayaayu 'enaadarege nabare. bazihene gizee yajanatene manegade deledeyene lamashaagare yesheqadaadamaalu. nagare gene `aayenocaacawe thafeto 'enedeete mashaagare yecelaalune?

'afathaatharaacawene maqayarenaa baalubate botaa maaseqamathene benefalege 'afathaatharaacawene qayerane 'egerocaacawe laaye 'enediqamethu 'enaadaregaalane. baziheme gizee kabotaacawe saayeneqasaaqasu wadafite maheedeme wadaxwaalaa mamalaseme 'ayecelume.

kasawoce makaakale `edemeewene bamaarezame yaaqoyanawe wada dakaamaanate darajaa 'enemalesawaalane. yehece `aalame yazalaalame manoriyaa hagare 'enedaalehonace yamacharashaayetu `aalame yazalaalame manoriyaa hagare 'enedahonace ba'a`emerwacawe 'ayaasetanatenumene?

muhhamadene (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) qenee (getheme) 'alaasetamaarenaweme; 'ayegabaawememe! mekeneyaatume baaheriweme 'ayedalame. tafatheroweme lazihe yatamacaaca 'ayedalame. 'enyaa yaasetamaarenawe laasetanatanawe sawe maasetaawashaanaa geletze yahonane qure'aanene 'eneji leelaane 'ayedalame.

lebu heyaawenaa berehaane yahonane sawe liyaasethanaqeqebate nawe. mekeneyaatume yamithaqamawe 'esu nawenaa; 'enedihume bakahadeyaane laaye maaserajaawe bamawaradunaa male'eketu yadarasaacawe bamahonu meneme `aayenate mekeneyaate yamiyaaqarebubate huneetaa yalame 'enaa ba'enasu laaye qethaatene yaaragaagethebaacawaale.
'enyaa 'ejocaacene kaszarute 'enesasocene yafatharenelaacawe mahonune 'ayaayumene? 'enasume ya'enazihe 'enesesoce baalabeetoce bamahone yamithaqemaacawene gudaayoce yaakanaawenaalu.
la'enasu yatagarunaa taazaazhoce 'adaragenaacawe. yegaalebwacawaale; 'eqaawocaacaweneme yechenubaacawaale; segaacaweneme yemagabaalu.

la'enasume kamagaalabenaa segaawaane kamabelaate wechi leeloce theqemoce:: qodaawaane, leetho, bamashathe yamiyaaganyute theqeme 'alalaacawe. ka'esume menethaafenaa lebese yeszarubataale. lamathathenateme watatwaneme yethathaalu. taadiyaa 'enazihenenaa leeloce tzagaawocene yalagasalaacawene 'alaahene 'ayaamasagenumene?!
'agaariwoce ka'alaahe qethaate maradaatenenaa madaanene bamakajale ka'alaahe wechi yamigazwacawene 'amaaleketene yaazu.

'enaziyaa 'enasu yayaazwacawe 'amaalekete: nafesaacaweneme hona yamigazwacaweneme sawocene maredaate 'ayecelume. 'enasunaa thaa`otocaacawe bamulu laqethaate yeqarebunaa 'anedu kaleelaawe natzaa mahonune yegaletzaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'enasu negegere 'anetane male'eketanyaa 'ayedalaheme:: 'anedee gathaami 'enaa leeloce qethefataacawe 'ayaasaazenehe. 'enyaa yamidabequteneme yamigaletzuteneme 'enaaweqaalane. ka'enasu meneme 'ayedabaqebeneme baszeraawocaacaweme 'enemanadaacawaalane.

lamahonu yaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yamiyaasetabaabelawe saweyee: kafetewate thabetaa (maneye) yafatharenawe mahonaacenene 'ayaasetanatenemene? kaziyaa baxwaalaa yatalayaayu 'erekanocene 'alefo tawaladanaa 'adaga. wadiyaaweme 'athebeqo takaraakaarinaa tachaqaachaaqi hona. yatafatharabatene huneetaa bamaayate kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase 'enedaala 'ayaasetanatenemene?!

yeheme kahadi yabasabasa 'athenetene bamaamethaate kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase 'enedaleela baalamaawaqenaa bamazanegaate yehenene yabasabasa 'athenete wada nabarabate maane yemalesawaalene?! 'ala; kaalenabarabate mafatharune zanagaa.

'aneta muhhamade hoye! la'esu melaashe bamasethate yehenene yabasabasa 'athenete majamariyaa yafatharawe heyaawe yaadaregawaale balaacawe. majamariyaa yafatharawe 'enedaganaa heyewate satheto mamalase 'ayekabedaweme. 'eresu sela fethuru hulu yaaweqaale; meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! la'enaaneta ka'erethebe 'aranegwaadee zaafe 'esaatene 'awathaalaacehu; wadiyaaweme ka'esaatu taaqathaathelaalaacehu; 'enazihe taqaaraani nagarocene 'erethebe 'aranegwaadee yahonawene zaafenaa yameteqathaathale 'esaatene 'anede laaye 'enedihone yaadaraga geetaa: yamotutene hheyaawe maaderage caaye nawe.

yaa samaayaatenenaa mederene taalaalaaqe kamahonaacaweme gaare yafathara mutaanene heyaawe maaderage caaye 'ayedalamene? caaye nawe. 'athaqaalaaye fethuraanene babezu fathaari, sela fethuraanu hulu `aawaaqi nawe. meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.
'anedene nagare mafethare sifalege hune yelawaale wadiyaaweme yaa yafalagawe nagare yehonaale. kanaziheme heyaawe maaderage, magedale maqaseqasanaa leeloce yamasaasalute yeganyubataale.

'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce la'alaahe yamaayegabaawene nagare kamiyaasethagute dekemate laaqa; yanagaroce hulu baalabeete 'enaa yahulume nagaroce qulefe ba'eju nawe. batenesaa'eeweme qane wada 'esu becaa temalasaalaacehu. laszeraawocaacehume menedaa yesathaacexwaale.
geetaacawene sigazu tasetakaakalawe bamisalafu malaa'ekete 'emelaalahu.
daamanaane 'alaahe zenaabe maawarade bafalagabate botaa manedaatene baminadu malaa'eketeme 'emelaalahu.
ya'alaahe negegere qure'aanene bamiyaanabu malaa'eketeme 'emelaalahu.
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaakaacehu 'anede nawe meneme 'agaare yalaweme. 'esume 'alaahe nawe.
yasamaayaate, yamedere, basamaayenaa bamedere mahakale yaalu hulu geetaa nawe. `aamatune mulu yatzahhaye mawechaanaa magebiyaa yahonaweme 'aqethaachaa geetaa nawe.
'enyaa wada medere yaqarabacewene samaaye qonejonaa sitaayu 'eneda lule yamiyaaberaqarequ bahonu kawaakebete 'ageethenaate.
yaqerebitune samaaye bakawaakebete ka'alaahe te'ezaaze kaafanagathu manaathi shayethwanaate thabaqenaate. kakawaakebetoce 'eyatafanaatharu yematwacawaale.
'enaziyaa shayethwanaate 'alaahe wada malaa'ekete yamiyaawaredawene shari`aawinaa `aalamaawi te'ezaazene maadaamathe 'ayecelume kaya'aqethaachaawe hulu yakawaakebetu cebo yewarawarebaacawaale.
'enedaayaadaamethu 'enasune lamaabaararenaa lamaaraaqe yewarawarebaacawaale. bamacharashaayetume qane zawatere yamaayaaqwaarethe 'asaamaami qethaate 'alalaacawe.

malaa'eketoceme bamakaakalaacawe yamiqabaabalwacawene male'eketenaa wada medere yaalewaradawene yathalafu shayethwanocene wadiyaaweme yamiyaabaraanaa 'aqaathaaye yahona cebo yekatalaacawaale. 'anedaanedee cebowe saayaaqaathelaacawe wada thaneqwaayoce wanedemocaacawe wareewene yaadaresaalu. 'enasume taqabelawe mato weshate chamerawe yaawaraalu.

'aneta muhhamade hoye! 'enaziyaane: kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yamiyaasetabaabelu kahadiyaanene thayeqaacawe lamahonu 'enasu basawenate thenekaareenaa ba'akaale gezefate kafatharenaacawe samaayaate, mederenaa malaa'ekete yabaratu naacawene?! 'enyaa kamithaabaqe cheqaa fatharenaacawe. bamaszaratu yatafatharute kamithaabaqe dakaamaa kahona cheqaa hono 'eyaala taadiyaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene lamene yaawagezaalu?

yelequnese 'aneta muhhamade hoye! ba'alaahe celotaanaa yafethuraanune gudaaye bamaasetanaabaru tadanaqekene? 'enedihume yakahadiyaane kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase maasetabaabale danaqahe. 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene bathaame kamaasetabaabalaacawe yatanasaa 'aneta sela tenesaa'eewe setaawaraacawe yaafeezaalu.
'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce lebaacawe bamaderaqu yatanasaa maanenyaawemene mekere simakaru meneme 'ayegasatzume; 'ayethaqamumeme.
lanabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) sela 'ewenatanyenataacawe kamigaletsu ta`aameraatoce 'anedune ta`aamere baayu gizee bamagaramenaa bamaashofe wasane yaalefaalu.
baziheme gizee: yehe muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yaamathaawe nagare geletze yahona degemete 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame yelaalu.
motane, 'afare 'enaa yabasabasa 'athenetekahonene baxwaalaa heyaawe honane 'eneqasaqasaalane? yehe nagare yamaayecaale nawe yelaalu.
qadametocu ka'enyaa bafite yamotute 'abaatocaaceneme yeqasaqasaalune? yelaalu.

'aneta muhhamade hoye! la'enasu melaashe bamasethate <<'awone 'afare honaacehu 'athenetaacehu kabasabasaba baxwaalaa 'enaanetanaa yaqadamu 'abaatocaacehu chemere teqasaqasaalaacehu; ba'athaqaalaaye hulaacehume waraadoce honaacehu teqasaqasaalaacehu>> balaacawe.
'esume baqanedu (hulatanyaa nefi) 'enedatanafaa 'alaahe ba'enasu laaye mene 'enedamifatzemebaacawe bamathabaabaqe yatenesaa'eewene kabaade huneetaane yaayaalu.
'enanyaa tenesaa'eewene yamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce waa thefaataacene! yehe 'alaahe baarocune baduneyaa heyewate yeszarute yanabarutene szeraa yamimanadaabate yamenedaa qane nawe yelaalu.
yehe yaa ba'eresu setaasetabaabelutenaa setaawagezute yanabaraacehute babaaroce makaakale yamifaredebate qane nawe yebaalaalu.

lamalaa'eketoceme bazaane qane 'enaziyaane nafesocaacawene bashereke yabadalu sawoce 'enaa basherekenaa bamaasetabaabale 'amesaayaawocaacaweneme ka'alaahe wechi yegazwacawe yanabaruteneme thaa`otaate sabesabu; wada 'esaate manegademe merwacawe; nedwacaweme: mekeneyaatume mamalashaacawe naatenaa.

lamalaa'eketoceme bazaane qane 'enaziyaane nafesocaacawene bashereke yabadalu sawoce 'enaa basherekenaa bamaasetabaabale 'amesaayaawocaacaweneme ka'alaahe wechi yegazwacawe yanabaruteneme thaa`otaate sabesabu; wada 'esaate manegademe merwacawe; nedwacaweme: mekeneyaatume mamalashaacawe naatenaa.
wada 'esaate kamagebaataacawe bafite lagemegamaa 'aqumwacawe 'enasu tathayaaqiwoce naacawenaa kaziyaa baxwaalaa wada 'esaate nedwacawe yebaalaale.
'enasune bamaweqase <<baduneyaa 'erese baraasaacehu seteradaadu 'enedanabarawe hulu 'ahune mene honaacehu nawe yamaateradaadute?>> yebaalaalu.
baregethe 'enasu zaaree la'alaahe te`ezaaze 'ejaacawene yasathu waraadaawoce naacawe. dakaamoce bamahonaacawenaa belehataacaweme 'anaasaa bamahonu maradaadaate 'ayecelume.
mawaqaaqasenaa makaraakare bamaayethaqemebate gizee 'erese ba'eresaacawe yamiwaqaaqasunaa yamikaraakaru honawe yemathaalu.

takataayoce la'asekataayoce:: 'enaaneta kabareteewoce bahaayemaanotenaa ba'ewenate bakule bamamethaate kehedatene, sherekenenaa kabaade wanejalocene 'enedenefatseme bamaasegeethe male'eketanyoce ka'alaahe yezawete yamathutene 'ewenate 'enedeneshashe taadaregune nabare yelaalu.

'asekataayoceme latakataayoce:: <<'enaaneta 'enedaalaacehute 'ayedalame yelequnese 'enaaneta bakehedate laaye nabaraacehu. yametaamenu 'alenabaraacehume; yelequnese taasetabaabelu nabare>> yelwacawaale.

'enaaneta takataayoce hoye! 'enyaa ba'enaaneta laaye selethaane norone wada kehedate, sherekenaa kabaade wanejalocene 'enedetefatsemu 'asegadaajoce 'alenabareneme. yelequnese 'enaaneta bakehedatenaa wanejale laaye wasane 'alaafiwoce nabaraacehu; 'enyaa 'alaasaasaatenaacehume.

ba'enyaanaa ba'enaaneta laaye: lashayethwa << (la'amla'anWa jahanWama minka wamimWan tabi`aka minhum 'ajma`iyna) baanetanaa 'anetane batakatalu hulu jahanamene 'emolaataalahu>> yatabaalawe ya'alaahe yazaacaa qaale taragaagathabene: bamahonume geetaacene qaale yagabaawene qethaate qamaashoce nane.

'enyaa wada thematenaa kehedate tharaanaacehu 'enyaa katekekelanyaawe manegade yathamamene nabarene. 'enyaa wadazihe batharaanaacehume gizee kehedatene lamaqabalenaa lamathemame zegejuwoce nabaraacehu.
selazihe takataayocenaa 'asekataayoce yatenesaa'eewene qane qethaate tagaariwoce naacawe. baduneyaa `aalame bakehedatenaa themate laaye tagaariwoce 'enedanabaru hulu 'anedu leelaawene 'ayethaqememe.
'enazihene sawoce 'enedaaqamasenaacawe hulu baleeloce 'amatzanyoce laaye 'enedazihu 'enaadaregaalane. huluneme takataayocenaa 'asekataayoce yamigabaacawene qethaate bamasethate 'enaagaaraacawaalane.

'enaziyaane 'agaariwoce duneyaa banabarubate gizee: <<ka'alaahe basetaqare ba'ewenate yamimalake leelaa 'amelaake yalame>> yehe qaale yamiyaazawene bamafatzame 'enaa yamikalakelawene bamakalekale tageberu: batabaalu gizee: 'ewenatene baalamaqabalenaa bamakuraate malekaame melaashene masethate 'emebi 'alu.

bakehedataacawe bamaamakaanyateme <<'enyaa la'ebede baalaqenee belane 'amaaleketocaacenene 'enetawaalane?!>> yelu nabare. yehenene lamaalate yafalagute ya'alaahene male'eketanyaa muhhamadene (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) nawe.

baregetheme teleqe qethefate qathafu! ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa 'ebedeme baalaqeneeme 'ayedalume. yelequne yaa wada 'alaahe 'anedenatenaa male'eketanyaane wada makatale yamithaaraawe qure'aanene 'amathaa. male'eketanyoce ka'alaahe yezawete yamathutene tawehhidenaa tenesaa'eene bamaa`edaqe 'ewenatanyenataacawene 'aragaagatha. bameneme 'aletaqaaranaacaweme.
'enaaneta 'agaariwoce bakehedataacehunaa male'eketanyocene bamaasetabaabalaacehu mekeneyaate 'asaamaamiwene qethaate baregethe qamaashoce naacehu.
'enaaneta 'agaariwoce baduneyaa heyewate ba'alaahe bamakaadenaa wanejalocene bamafatsame teszarute yanabaraacehutene 'eneji leelaa 'atemanadume.
nagare gene ba'alaahe yaamanu 'enaziyaane 'alaahene becaa 'enedigazu yamarathaacawenaa 'esune becaa yamigazu ya'alaahe baaroce kazihe qethaate yedenaalu.
la'enaziyaa 'alaahe yaatharaacawe (yamarathaacawe) baaroce bathaafaachenatu, therunatunaa zawetaarinatu yataawaqa sisaaye tazagaajetolaacawaale.

kasisaayocu makaakale yamimagabwacawenaa yamifalegwaacawe 'ejege thaafaache yahonu feraafereewoce 'alwacawe. kaziheme balaaye kafe baalu darajaawocenaa ya'alaahene yatakabara fite bamaayate yatakabaru naacawe.
'enazihene hulu bamaayeqwaarathenaa bamaayewagade zawateraawi yahonu tzagaawocenaa yazalaalame manoriyaa janate wesethe yaaganyutaale.
ba'alegaawocaacawe laaye bamadagafe fite lafite yamitayaayu yehonaalu. wanedeme kawanedemu gaare bamaganaanyatu yedasataale.
bathaje yatamolu berecheqowoce yezorelaacawaale. 'enaziyaa katheraataacawe yatanasaa fasaashe meneche weha yemaselaalu.
nache maleke yaalaacawe yamithathaawe sawe mulu thefethenaa yaaganyaale.

'eneda duneyaa 'asekaari mathathe 'ayedalame. 'a`emerone yamaayegaarede sekaare yaleelabate 'enedihume bamathathaatu mekeneyaate raase metaate 'ayaagaathemaweme. 'akaalume hona 'a`emerowe kanazihe salaame yaaganyaale.
bajanate wesethe la'enasu thebeqe yahonu seetoce kabaalocaacawe wechi `aayenocaacawe wada leelaa yamaayeshaagare qonejo `aayene yaalaacawe naacawe.
yamalekaacawe nethaate kadaalacaa gaare yataqalaaqala nache leke 'eneda sagone 'enequlaale balaabaa yatashafana, kanefaasenaa 'abwaraa yatathabaqa 'enedihume 'eje yaalenakaawe yemaselaalu.
kajanate sawoce makaakale fite lafite bamaqamathe baduneyaa sela 'asaalafute kesetate yaawaraalu.
kame'emanaane makaakale 'enee baduneyaa wesethe kamote baxwaalaa maqasaqasene yamiyaasetabaabele 'anede gwaadanyaa nabaranye yelaale.
bamaafeezenaa bamaasetabaabale <<lamahonu 'aneta gwaadanyaayee kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase 'enedaala kamiyaamenute sawoce nahene?>> yelanye nabare.
'enyaa motane, 'afare honane, yabasabasa 'athenete kahonene baxwaalaa taqaseqesane baduneyaa seneszaraawe yanabarawene menedaa 'enemanadaalane?!
'amaanyu bajanate wesethe laalu gwaadanyocu <<kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene siyaasetabaabele yanabarane sawe macharashaa mene 'enedahona heedane 'eneye>> yelaacawaale.
'esu gwaadanyaawene mahale jahaname wesethe 'ayawe.

<<ba'alaahe yehunebenye 'aneta gwaadanyaayee 'eneene wada kehedatenaa kamote baxwaalaa yaalawene heyewate 'enedaasetabaabele bamatheraate 'esaate wesethe bamaasegabaate letaathafaanye taqaarebahe nabare.

'alaahe batzagaawe wada tekekelanyaa 'emenate bamameraate welataa baayewelelenye noro wada qethaate kamiqarebu sawoce 'ehone nabare.>> ya'esaate kahonawe gwaadanyaawe gaare weyeyetune kaathanaaqaqa baxwaalaa janate wesethe wada miganyute gwaadanyocu bamazore 'enedihe 'alaacawe::

'esaate kagabaa gwaadanyaawu gaare negegerune kaabaqaa baxwaalaa janate wusethe yaalu gwaadanyocune 'enedihe bamaalate 'anagaagaraacawe.
<<'enyaa yajanate gwaadoce 'anemoteme.
yaaci baduneyaa kamotenaate mote leelaa motene 'anemoteme. 'enyaa yelequne bajanate lazalaalame nwariwoce nane. kahadiyaane 'enedamiqathute 'aneqathaame.
yehe geetaacene yamanadaane (janate wesethe 'asegabeto zalaalame 'enedenenorenaa ka'esaate 'enedenedene yaadaragane) leelaa meneme dele linatzaatzarawe yamaayecele teleqe dele nawe.>>
yehene lamasala taalaaqe menedaa szariwoce liszaru yegabaacawaale mekeneyaatume terefaamaa negede nawenaa.

yehe yatathaqasawe 'alaahe 'esune lamataazaze yamarathaacawenaa yaatharaacawe baarocu yaazagaajawe tzagaa yebalethaalene? wayenese baqure'aane yataragamacewe yamaataawaferenaa rahabene yamaataasetaagase yakahadiyaane megebe yahonacewe yazaqume zaafe.

'enyaa yehecene zaafe 'enaziyaa bakehedatenaa bahathi'ate labadalu badaayoce mafatanyaa fatanaa 'adaragenaate. baziheme mekeneyaate 'enasu zaafe 'esaate wesethe kagabaa yeqaathalaale 'eneji 'esaate wesethe zaafe 'ayebaqeleme 'alu.
ya<<zaqume>> zaafe mathefo 'asetadaadage yaalaate zaafe naate; 'eswa ka'esaate mahale ('azaqete) yametebaqele zaafe naate.

ka'eswa yamiwathaawe feree siyaayute yamiyaasethalaa yashayethwane raase yemaselaale. siyaayute yaalaamaara yawesethu mathefonatene yaaseradaale (siyaayute yaalaamaara sibalute yaaqeraale 'enedamibaalawe nawe). fereeweme yamiyaasethalaa thaa`eme 'enedaalawe yaasaayaale.
kahadiyaane maraaraanaa 'asethaye yahonawene fereewaane yemagabaalu. baado yahonawe hodaacaweneme ba'esu yemolaalu.
kaziyaame 'enasu yehenene kabalu baxwaalaa tekuse qoshaashaa yahona yataqalaaqala mathathe 'alaacawe.
kaziyaame mamalashaacawe wada jahaname 'esaate nawe kaqethaate wada qethaate yezawaawaraalu.
'enazihe kahadiyaane 'abaatocaacawe katekekelanyaa manegade yatasaasaatu honawe 'agenyetawaacawaalenaa. yaala tekekelanyaa maaserajaame takatalwacawe.
'enasu 'abaatocaacawene bathemate bamakatale laaye bagede 'enedikatalu yatagadadu yemasele bafethenate yekatalaalu.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yaaneta hhezeboce bamathemame yamajamariyaawoce 'ayedalume. ka'enasu bafite yaqadamwacawe hhezeboce 'abezaanyaawocu baregethe tasaasetawaale.
baqadametocu hhezeboce wesethe bezu ka'alaahe qethaate yamiyaasethanaqequ male'eketanyocene baregethe lekanaale. nagare gene male'eketanyocene kaadu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'enaziyaane male'eketanyocaacawe 'asethaneqeqwaacawe malekaame melaashe yaalesathu hhezeboce macharashaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara tamalekate bamakaadaacawenaa male'eketanyocene bamaasetabaabalaacawe mekeneyaate macharashaacawe zalaalamaawi 'esaate magebaate hona.
'enaziyaa 'alaahe yamarathaacawenaa ba'esu 'amenawe babecanyenate yamigazu baarocu siqaru 'enasu ya'enaziyaa kahadiwoce macharashaa kahonacewe qethaate natzaa wachiwoce naacawe.

male'eketanyaacene nuhheme ba'eregethe yaasetabaabalute hhezebocune siraagame batharaane gizee latheriwe fathaane melaashe 'asathaathaacene 'enedeete yaamaara nabare!! ba'enasu laaye laadaragawe du`aa fathaane malese sathanawe.
'esune, beetasabunenaa ka'esu gaare yaamanute me'emanaanene bakahadiyaane hhezebocu laaye katalaqaqawe teleqe gorefe kamasethame 'adaanenaacawe.
beetasabunenaa 'amaanye takataayocune becaa 'adaanene. ka'enasu wechi yaalutene kahadiyaane hhezebocune 'asathamene.
kaxwaalaawe lamimathu teweledoceme 'eresune bamalekaame yamiyaawadesubatene taalaaqe zenaane 'aseqamathenelate.
nuhhe kaxwaalaawe yamimathute teweledoce bakefu nagare 'enedaayaawasute salaamenaa 'amaane yehune. yelequnese wedaaseenaa malekaame zenaa baqwaaminate yehonelataale.
'enyaa nuhhene bamanadaanawe malekaame menedaa 'enedazihu malekaame szariwocene 'alaahene becaa bamagazaataacawe 'enaa bamataazazaacawe mekeneyaate bamalekaame 'enemanadaacawaale.
nuhhe 'alaahene bamataazaze laaye kamiszaru 'amaanye baariyaawocaacene nawe.
kaziyaame leelocune ba'enasu laaye balaqaqenawe gorefe 'asamathenaacawe. ka'enasu 'anedeme 'aleqarame.
beraahimeme ya'esune wada 'alaahe 'anedenate bamatheraate laaye katakatalute yahaayemaanotu takataayoce nawe.
wada geetaawe kamaagaaraate yatharaa salaamaawi lebene yezonaa bafethuraanu gudaayeme la'alaahe taamaanye hono baqaraba gizee yanabarawene 'asetaawese.
'abaatunenaa hhezebocune bamaweqase <<ka'alaahe wechi menene tegazaalaacehu?>> baala gizee;
<<'enaaneta hhezeboce baweshate ka'alaahe wechi yaalane 'amelaake taamalekaalaacehune?
'enaaneta hhezeboce hoye! ka'eresu leelaa 'eyatagazaacehu ya`aalamaatune geetaa setaaganyute sela 'eresu mene taasebaalaacehu?! menese yamiyaadaregaacehu yemaselaacexwaale?!>>
beraahime kahhezebocu gaare 'abero laalamawethaate zadee lamafethare bamaasabe wada kawaakebete mamalekatene tamalakata.
kahhezebocu gaare wada ba`aalaacawe laalamawethaate mekeneyaate bamaaqerabe <<'amonyaale>> 'ala.
'esune wada xwaalaa tetaweteme heedu.
wada 'enasu 'amaaleketocaacaweme zora. ba'amaaleketocaacaweme laaye bamaashofe <<'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce yamiyaaqarebulaacehune megebe 'atebalumene?>> 'ala.
<<mene naketwacehu nawe yamaataawarute, yamithayeqaacehune melaashe yamaatesathute? 'enedihe `aayenatu ka'alaahe wechi limalake yegabaawaalene?>>
beraahime 'enasune lamasabaabare baqanye 'eju mametaatene tayaayaaza.
thaa`ote 'amelaakiyaane wada 'esu 'eyarothu mathu.
beraahimeme batzenaate fite lafite bamagaafathenaa 'enasune bamaweqase <<ka'alaahe wechi 'enaaneta ba'ejaacehu yametetharebwacawene taamalekaalaacehune?>> 'alaacawe.
<<'alaahe 'enaanetane fathara szeraawocaacehuneme fathara, kaszeraawocaacehume 'enazihe thaa`otaate naacawe. la'ameleko 'alaahe becaa tagabi nawe. ba'esu 'ameleko laaye meneme tagaari yalaweme.>>

'esune bamaaserajaa malese masethate sela tasaanaacawe xaayele wada mathaqame bamaheede baberaahime laaye mene 'enedamifatsemu tamakaakarunaa <<genebene ganebunaa 'enechate moletaacehu ba'esaate 'aqathaathelu. kaziyaame 'esaate wesethe thaalute>> tabaabaalu.
yaberaahime hhezeboce baberaahime laaye 'esune 'athefetawe 'enedigalaagalu tanekolene 'asabu. 'esaatene baberaahime laaye salaamenaa qazeqaazaa bamaaderage kasaariwoce 'adaragenaacawe.

beraahimeme <<'enee yahhezeboceene 'agare laqeqee geetaayeene lamagazaate 'enedimacanye wada geetaayee tagwaazhe nanye. geetaayeeme baregethe lanee baduneyaanaa ba'akxiraa malekaame wadahonawe yemaraanyaale>> 'ala.
<<kahhezebocee tanatheyee ba'enegedaanatee metekenaa 'agaazhe yehonanye zanede geetaayee hoye! dage yahonane leje sethanye.>>
lemanaawene bamamalase yamiyaasedasetawene nagare lejeme 'abasarenawe. 'adegome taagaashe 'enedamihone nagarenawe. yeheme leje semaa`ile (`aalayehi 'asalaame) nawe.

semaa`ile wathaate hono ka'esu gaare lamaneqasaaqase badarasa gizee 'abaatu beraahime heleme 'aya. yanabiyaatoceme heleme raa`eye nawenaa. beraameme yaayawene heleme bamanegare <<lejee hoye! 'enee bahelemee saaredehe 'ayahunye. mene yemaselehale 'eseki tamalekate!>> 'alawe. semaa`ile la'abaatu melaashe bamasethate <<'abaatee hoye! 'alaahe yaazazahene fatseme; 'eradanye 'alaahe bishaa 'eneene kataagaashocenaa ya'alaahene wesaanee kawadadu sawoce honyee taaganyanyaalahe>> 'alawe.
hulatume la'alaahe batanaanasunaa la'esu 'eje basathu gizee: beraahime lejune bagenebaaru bakule 'enediyaaredawe bataazazawe maszarate 'aseqamathawe.
beraahime lejune bamaarade ya'alaahene te'ezaaze lamafatsame 'eyatazagaaja 'eyaala: <<beraahime hoye!>> belane tharaanawe.

<<baregetheme yaayakxawene heleme ba'ewenate 'aragaagatheke! kazihe taalaaqe fatanaa natzaa bamaawethaate 'enedamanadaanehe hulu 'enedazihu malekaame szariwocene kamakaraanaa fatanaa natzaa bamaawethaate 'enemanadaalane.
yehe ba'ewenate geletse yahona fatanaa nawe; beraahimeme yehenene fatanaa 'alefwale.
basemaa`ile botaame taalaaqe ya'erede bagene beezaa sathanawe.
laberaahimeme baxwaalaanyocu hhezeboce wesethe malekaame zenaane 'aseqaranelate.
ka'alaahe salaametaa 'enedihume kacegerenaa gudaate hulu salaame baberaahime laaye yehune.
beraahimene yehenene menedaa 'enedamanadaanawe hulu: malekaame szariwocene hulu 'enemanadaalane.
beraahime kanaziyaa 'alaahene bamagazaate laaye batamwalaa maleku kaamanute baarocaacene nawe.
lawadafitu nabiyenaa ka'alaahe dagaage baaroce yamihonawene leelaa leje 'abasarenawe. 'esume sehhaqe nawe. yeheme becanyaa yanabarawe lejune semaa`ilene lamaarade 'alaahene bamataazazu nawe.

ba'esunaa baleju sehhaqe laayeme ka'enyaa yahonane barakate 'awaradene; tzagaaceneneme 'abezetane sathanaacawe; lejocaacaweneme 'abazaanelaacawe; kahulatume zaroce geetaawene bamataazaze bago szari yeganyaale; ka'enasume nafesune bakehedatenaa wanejalene bamafatsame geletze badaayeme 'ala.
lamusaanaa lawanedemu harune ba'eregethe nabiyenatene lagasene.
'enasunenaa hhezebocaacawene ya'eseraa'eele lejene kafare`one 'agazaazenaa kamasemathe 'adaanene.
bafare`onenaa szaraawitu laaye radaanaacaweme. bathalaatoce laaye maashanafeme la'enasu hona.
lamusaanaa lawanedemu harune ka'alaahe yahonawene matsehhafe taweraatene bageletze yataberaaraa sihone sathanaacawe.
meneme gobaathaanate yaleelabatene qathetanyaawene manegade maraanaacawe 'esume wada fathaari wedeetaa yamiyaadarese ya'eselemenaa manegade nawe.
lahulatume laxwaalanyocu teweledoce malekaame zenaane 'enaa bamalekaame mawasaatene 'atarafenelaacawe.
malekaame yahonace ka'alaahe salaametaa 'enaa kacegeroce hulu salaame bamusaanaa baharune laaye yehune.
'enyaa musaanenaa harunene bamalekaame menedaa 'enedamanadaanaacawe 'enedazihu bago szariwocene hulu geetaacawene bamataazazaacawe mekeneyaate bamalekaame 'enemanadaacawaalane.
musaanaa harune baregethe kaamanutenaa hegaacenene yetagaberu yanabaru baarocaacene naacawe.>>
leyaaseme kageetaacawe katalaakute male'eketanyoce nawe. 'alaahe nabiyenatenenaa male'eketanyenatene lagasawe.

male'eketanyaa hono latalaakabaacawe ya'eseraa'eele lejoce hhezebocee hoye! te`ezaazune bamafatsame ka'enaziheme 'alaahene babecanyenate bamaamelake 'enaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe kaziheme kashereke reqaacehu 'alaahene 'atefarumene? baalaacawe gizee;
ka'alaahe wechi thaa`otaacehune <<baa`elene>> tegazaalaacehune? kafathaariwocu hulu yebalethe bathaame 'asaamaari yahonawene 'alaahene maamelakene tetawaalaacehune?

'alaahe 'esu yafatharaacehu geetaacehu nawe; kazihe bafite 'abaatocaacehuneme fathara; la'ameleko tagabiwe nawe; 'enaziyaa meneme yamaayethaqemunaa yamaayegodu thaa`otoce la'ameleko yamigabu 'ayedalume.
kahhezebocume maasetabaabale 'eneji leelaa 'aletaganyame; bamaasetabaabalaacaweme mekeneyaate laqethaate yeqarebaalu (yethaadaalu).
nagare gene kahhezebocu 'amenawenaa ba'amelekwaacawe 'alaahene becaa yatagazu laqethaate kamaqerabe denawaale.
ba'esu laaye baxwaalanyocu teweledoce wesethe malekaame zenaanenaa bamalekaame mawasaatene 'atarafenelate.
ya'alaahe salaametaanaa wedaasee baleyaase laaye yehune.
'enyaa leyaasene bamalekaame 'enedamanadaanawe hulu 'enedazihu kabaarocaacene 'amaanye bago szariwocene 'enemanadaalane.
leyaase ba'ewenate kaamanu baarocaacenenaa bageetaawe bamaamane laaye 'eregethanyaa 'amaanye nawe.
luthe: 'alaahe hhezebune 'abesaarinaa 'asethaneqaaqi bamaaderage kalaakaacawe male'eketanyoce 'anedu male'eketanyaa nawe.
'esunenaa beetasabune hulu bahhezebu laaye katalaakawe qethaate yaadaanenawe gizee yahonawene 'asetaawese.
baalabeetu seteqare: 'eswa yahhezebwa qethaate 'eneda 'enasu kahadi bamahonwa 'athaqaalwataale.
kaziyaame ba'esu yaasetabaabalunaa yezote yamathaawene male'ekete baalamaamanaacawe mekeneyaate 'athafaanaacawe.
'enaaneta yamakaa sawoce wada shaame setegwaagwaazu bamanoriyaacawe 'akaabaabi baqanu kefela gizee taalefaalaacehu.

'enadazihume baleeliteme taalefaalaacehu ba'a`emerwacehu 'ataasetanatenumene?! bamaasetabaabalaacawe, bakehedataacawenaa kazihe bafite yehenene 'asetzayaafi tagebaare bamafatsame maaneme yaaleqadamaacawene wanejale bamaszeraataacawe mekeneyaate yagudaayaacawe macharashaa mene 'enedanabare 'atemakarumene?!
yunuseme 'alaahe hhezebune 'abesaarinaa 'asethaneqaaqi bamaaderage kalaakaacawe male'eketanyoce 'anedu male'eketanyaa nawe.
bahhezebu laaye taqotheto batasaafaariwocenaa ba`eqaa yatamolaace marekabe laaye bamasaafare tetwacawe yaheeda gizee yahonawene 'asetaawese!

marekabwa mulu bamahonwa lamasemathe taqaarabace. tasaafaariwoceme tasaafaari bamabezaatu mekeneyaate 'enedaatesamethe kafilune lamathaale `ethaa tathaathaalu. yunuseme `ethaawe daresobate katashanaafiwoce hona. baziheme mekeneyaate baahere laaye thaalute.
baahere laaye bathaaluteme gizee `aasaawe yaazawenaa waathawe. 'esu kageetaawe faqaade wechi wada baaheru bamaheedu yamiyaasewaqesawe tagebaare fatzama.
yunuse kazihe bafite 'alaahene babezaate kamiyaawasu sawoce 'enaa ba`aaszaawe hode wesethe hono 'alaahene baayaatharaa (baayaaleqe) noro;
tenesaa'eewe qane derase ba`aaszaawe hode wesethe baqoya nabare. la'esu maqabariyaawe hono qareto nabare.
ka`aaszaawe hode bamaawethaate yamibaqele zaafenaa genebe baleelawe baado mareete laaye thaalenawe. `aaszaawe hode wesethe latawasana gizee sela qoya sawenatu yadakama hona.
bazaace baado medere laaye yamithalalebatene yadubaa zaafene 'abaqalene.
qutheraacawe mato shihe katoweneme yamibalethu wada honu hhezebocu dagemo laakenawe.
'esu yaamathaawene male'eketeme 'amanu taqabalume. 'esekatawasana gizee derase baduneyaa heyewataacawe 'alaahe 'athaaqamaacawe.

'aneta muhhamade hoye! 'enaziyaane 'agaariwocene bamaawegaze thayeqaacawe. 'enaziyaane yametethalwacawe seetocene la'alaahe bamaaderage la'enaaneta gene yametewadwacawene wanede lejoce taadaregaalaacehune? mene `aayenate kefefele nawe?
lamahonuse 'enedeete malaa'eketocene seetoce naacawe 'alu?! 'enasu sifatharu 'aletaganyu 'alaayu!
nequ! 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce kaweshataacawenaa qethefataacawe bezaate 'enedihe yelaalu.la'alaahe leje 'adaragulate 'enasu baminaagaru baregethe weshataamoce naacawe.
nequ! 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce kaweshataacawenaa qethefataacawe bezaate 'enedihe yelaalu.la'alaahe leje 'adaragulate 'enasu baminaagaru baregethe weshataamoce naacawe.
lamahonu 'alaahe laraasu kametewadwacawe wanedoce yeleqe yametethalwacawene seetoce 'asebaletho marathane? bafetsume.
'enaaneta 'agaariwoce mene honaacehu yehenene fetehawi yaalehona ferede bamaferade la'alaahe seete lejene la'enaaneta dagemo wanede lejene taadaregaalaacehu?!
yehenene yaalaacehubatene yatabalaasha 'emenate 'ateganazabumene? beteganazabu noro yehenene 'atelume nabare.
lamahonu geletze yahona kamatsehhafe yehune kamale'eketanyaa yehenene gudaaye yamigaletze maaserajaa 'alaacehune?
selametelute nagare 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu yehenene 'ewenataa yaaqafawene matsehhafaacehune 'amethu.

'agaariwoce malaa'eke: ya'alaahe seete lejoce naacawe silu; ba'alaahenaa bamale'ake makaakale yazemedenaa tesesere fatharu; male'akeme 'agaariwocene 'alaahe lameremaraa 'enedamiyaaqarebaacawe ba'eregetheme yaaweqaalu.
'alaahe 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce la'esu yamaayegabaawene leje, 'agaare 'enaa kamigaletzute nagare hulu yatharaa nawe.
nagare gene ya'alaahe netzuhe baaroce 'alaahene sigaletzu la'eresu bamigabaa yaleqenaanaa yakebere baaheri nawe yamigaletzute.
'enaaneta 'agaariwoce 'enaanetame ka'alaahe wechi yametegazwacaweme hulu.
ka'ewenatanyaa haayemaanote maaneneme yametaasaasetu 'ayedalaacehume.

nagare gene 'alaahe ka'esaate baaledaraboce naacawe belo yawasanabaacawene 'alaahe ba'eresu laaye wesaaneewene bamafatzame yehe sawe kahadi yehonenaa 'esaate yegabaale. 'enaanetanaa ka'alaahe wechi yametegazwacawe 'akaalaate gene bazihe laaye meneme 'aqeme yalaacehume.

malaa'eketeme 'alaahene becaa 'enedamigazunaa 'agaariwoce kamilute nagare yatharu mahonaacawene bamagelatze <<ka'enyaame makaakale 'anedeme yalame. 'alaahene bamaamelakenaa bamataazaze ragade 'eyaanedaanedu yataawaqa botaanaa darajaa 'alawe.
'enyaa malaa'eketoce 'alaahene bamagazaatenaa bamataazaze laaye basalefe 'eneqomaalane. 'enyaame 'alaahene kamaayegabute baaheriyaate 'atheriwoce nane.>>
'enyaa malaa'eketoce 'alaahene bamagazaatenaa bamataazaze laaye basalefe 'eneqomaalane. 'enyaame 'alaahene kamaayegabute baaheriyaate 'atheriwoce nane.>>

yamakaa 'agaariwoce nabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) kamalaakaacawe bafite kaqademowocu matsaahhefete ('enedataweraate) 'enyaa zanede binorane noro 'amelekotaacawene la'alaahe kamiyaatharu sawoce bahonene nabare. 'enasu gene weshataamoce naacawe. mekeneyaatume nabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) qure'aanune yezolaacawe bamathaa gizee kaadu. batenesaa'eeweme qane yamithabeqaacawene kabaade qethaate baregethe saayaawequ 'ayeqarume.

yamakaa 'agaariwoce nabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) kamalaakaacawe bafite kaqademowocu matsaahhefete ('enedataweraate) 'enyaa zanede binorane noro 'amelekotaacawene la'alaahe kamiyaatharu sawoce bahonene nabare. 'enasu gene weshataamoce naacawe. mekeneyaatume nabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) qure'aanune yezolaacawe bamathaa gizee kaadu. batenesaa'eeweme qane yamithabeqaacawene kabaade qethaate baregethe saayaawequ 'ayeqarume.

yamakaa 'agaariwoce nabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) kamalaakaacawe bafite kaqademowocu matsaahhefete ('enedataweraate) 'enyaa zanede binorane noro 'amelekotaacawene la'alaahe kamiyaatharu sawoce bahonene nabare. 'enasu gene weshataamoce naacawe. mekeneyaatume nabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) qure'aanune yezolaacawe bamathaa gizee kaadu. batenesaa'eeweme qane yamithabeqaacawene kabaade qethaate baregethe saayaawequ 'ayeqarume.

yamakaa 'agaariwoce nabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) kamalaakaacawe bafite kaqademowocu matsaahhefete ('enedataweraate) 'enyaa zanede binorane noro 'amelekotaacawene la'alaahe kamiyaatharu sawoce bahonene nabare. 'enasu gene weshataamoce naacawe. mekeneyaatume nabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) qure'aanune yezolaacawe bamathaa gizee kaadu. batenesaa'eeweme qane yamithabeqaacawene kabaade qethaate baregethe saayaawequ 'ayeqarume.

malaashenaa taqaawaami yamaayeganyelate ya`eredaataa qaalaaceneme: <<male'eketanyocaacene bathalaatocaacawe laaye 'alaahe basathaacawe maaserajaanaa xaayele 'enedamiyaashanefu>> ba'eregethe 'alefaalace! 'enaziyaa ya'alaahene negegere yabalaaye 'enedetehone ba'alaahe manegade laaye yamiwaagute szaraawitocaacene ba'eregethe 'ashanaafiwocu 'enaresu naacawe.

malaashenaa taqaawaami yamaayeganyelate ya`eredaataa qaalaaceneme: <<male'eketanyocaacene bathalaatocaacawe laaye 'alaahe basathaacawe maaserajaanaa xaayele 'enedamiyaashanefu>> ba'eregethe 'alefaalace! 'enaziyaa ya'alaahene negegere yabalaaye 'enedetehone ba'alaahe manegade laaye yamiwaagute szaraawitocaacene ba'eregethe 'ashanaafiwocu 'enaresu naacawe.

malaashenaa taqaawaami yamaayeganyelate ya`eredaataa qaalaaceneme: <<male'eketanyocaacene bathalaatocaacawe laaye 'alaahe basathaacawe maaserajaanaa xaayele 'enedamiyaashanefu>> ba'eregethe 'alefaalace! 'enaziyaa ya'alaahene negegere yabalaaye 'enedetehone ba'alaahe manegade laaye yamiwaagute szaraawitocaacene ba'eregethe 'ashanaafiwocu 'enaresu naacawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa yamakaa 'agaariwoce 'alaahe yamiyaaweqawene yaqerebe gizee qethaate 'esekimathaa derase celaa balaacawe.
ba'enaresu laaye qethaate 'esekimathaa derase thabeqaacawe. 'enaresume maayate yamaayethaqemaacawe gizee yamidaresebaacawene yaayaalu.
lamahonu 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce ya'alaahe qethaate 'enedifathene yefalegaalune?
ya'alaahe qethaate ba'enasu laaye bawarada gizee negaataacawe menenyaa yakafaa negaate hona.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe 'enasune maqethaatene 'esekiwasene theqite gizee derase tawaacawe.
tamalekate! 'enasume ba'enaresu laaye yamiwaredawene ya'alaahene qethaate baregetheme yemalakataalu.
'aneta muhhamade hoye! 'ashanaafiwe geetaahe 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce 'esune kamigaletzute yagodolo baaheri hulu tharaa (laaqa).
batakabarute male'eketanyoceme laaye ya'alaahe salaametaanaa wedaasee yehune.
mesegaanaa bamulu la'esu nawe; mesegaanaame yegabaawaale. ya`aalamaatu hulu geetaa nawe; ka'eresu wechi leelaa geetaa yalaacaweme.

(S) <<swade>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe magebiyaa laaye taberaaretwale.) sawocene baduneyaacawenaa ba'akxeeraacawe yamithaqemaacawene maasetaawashaa yaakaatata bahonawe qure'aane 'emelaalahu. 'enaziyaa yamakaa 'agaariwoce ka'alaahe gaare tagaariwoce 'alu 'enedamilute 'ayedalame.

nagare gene 'enaziyaa kahadiwoce ba'alaahe 'anedenate baalamaamanaacawe bate`ebitenaa bakuraate wesethe naacawe. 'enedihume kamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) gaare leyunatenaa bathalaatenate wesethe naacawe.

ka'enaresu bafite male'eketanyocene yaasetabaabalu kakefela zamanaate hhezeboce bezune 'athefetanaale. qethaatu bawaradabaacaweme gizee gizeewe kaqethaate mawechiyaanaa maamelachaa gizee saayehoneme la'eredaataa tathaaru.

bakehedataacawe kazawataru ya'alaahene qethaate yamiyaasefaraaraa karaasaacawe yahona male'eketanyaa bamathaalaacawe gizee tadanaqu. muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yezote yamathaawene nagare 'ewenatanyenate maaserajaa baayu gizee kahadiwoce yehe degemetanyaa (thaneqwaaye) sawoce laaye yamidageme, ka'alaahe raa`eye yamiwaredelate male'eketanyaa nanye yamilawe weshataame nawe 'alu.
yehe sawe bezu yahonu 'amaaleketocene 'anede 'amelaake 'adaragaacawene? yehe tagebaaru bathaame 'asegaraami nagare nawe 'alu.

taalaalaaqenaa kabareteewocu latakataayocaacawe <<hidu ba'amaaleketocaacehu 'amelekote laaye taagasu! bamuhhamade haayemaanote wesethe 'ategebu. muhhamade 'anede 'amelaakene becaa 'enedetegazu yatharaacehu nagare 'esu yabalaaye bamahone 'enyaa ya'esu takataayoce 'enedenehone yamafalage seeraa nawe>> 'alu.

<<yehenene: muhhamade wada 'alaahe 'anedenate yamitharaawe nagare: ba'abaatocaacene zanede yaalaaganyanawenaa ba`isaa (`aalayehi 'asalaame) haayemaanote wesetheme sametane yamaanaaweqawe nagare nawe. ka'esu yasamaanawe weshatenaa qethefate 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame>> 'alu.

<<kamakaakalaacene 'alaqocenaa taalaalaaqoce 'eyaalu la'esu becaa talayeto ba'esu laaye qure'aane waradalatene?>> yelequnese 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce selamiwaredawe raa`eye (qure'aane) batherethaaree wesethe naacawe. ya'alaahene qethaate ganaa 'aleqamasume; bamaaqoyatume tataalalu. qethaatune biqamesu noro kehedatenenaa ba'alaahe maagaaraatene 'enedihume wada 'aneta yamiwaredelehene raa`eye matharaatharene 'ayedaferume nabare.

lamahonu maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafinaa lagaashu geetaahe yacerotaawe magaazanoce: yaa! yafalagawene lafalagawe sawe yamisathe yahonawe 'agaariwocenaa 'asetabaabaayoce zanede naacawene? kacerotaaweme nabiyenate yeganyebataale. 'esuneme lafalagawe yesathaale. lafalagute masethatenaa yafalagutene makalekale ba'enasu 'eje 'ayedalame.

wayenese yasamaayaate; yamederenaa bamakaakalaacawe yamiganyu nagaroce hulu negeszenaa yanasu nawene? selahoname makalekaleme hona masethate yegabaacawaalene? yehenenu kahona yamilute lamasethateme yehune lamakalekale yalebaacawene maferade yecelu zanede wada samaaye lamaderase yamiradaacawene nagare yethaqamunaa yewethu. fetsume yehenene maaderage 'ayecelume.

'enaziyaa bamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yaasetabaabalute ka'enasu bafite yanabarute hhezeboce male'eketanyocaacawene bamaasetabaabalaacawe 'enedaathafaanaacawe hhezeboce hulu tashanaafi szaraawite naacawe. leke ba'enaziyaa szaraawite laaye 'enedatafatzamawe ba'enaziheme laaye yefatzamaale.

'enazihe 'asetabaabaayoce yamajamariyaa 'asetabaabaayoce 'ayedalume. ka'enasu bafite yanuhhe hhezeboce, `aadoce 'enaa sawocene yaasaqaayebate yanabara cekaale baalabeete yanabarawe fire`one 'asetabaabelawaale.
samudeme, yaluthe hhezeboceme, yashu`aayebe hhezeboceme 'asetabaabalu. 'enazihe bamale'eketanyocaacawe bamasabaasabe yaasetabaabalunaa yezawete yamathutene mamariyaa: yakaadu 'ahhezaaboce naacawe.
hulume male'eketanyocaacawene yaasetabaabalu hhezeboce 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalume. teneshe gizee biqoyeme ya'alaahe qethaate ba'enasu laaye taragaagathabaacawe.

'enazihe bamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) la'eswa mamalase yaleelaatene hulatanyaayetu 'aneditene yatherunebaa nefi 'eneji leelaa 'ayethabaabaqume. bamaasetabaabale laaye 'eyaalu kamotu qethaatu yaarefebaacawaale.
bamaashofeme <<geetaacene hoye! katenesaa'ee qane bafite yaqethaataacene dereshaa baduneyaa heyewataacene 'afaathenelene>> 'alu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce kaminaagarute yamaayaasedasetehe nagare laaye taagase. thalaatocene bamaqwaaqwaamenaa 'alaahene bamataazaze laaye taagaashe, yaxaayele baalabeete yahonawene baariyaacenene daawedene 'awesaalaacawe. 'esu baneseha wada 'alaahe 'ejege tamalaashenaa 'alaahe yamiwadawene malekaame szeraa yamiszaraa nawe.
