daawede kaqatere baxwaalaanaa rafaade laaye 'alaahene siyaawadesenaa siyaatharaa (siyaaleqe): taraaraawoceme 'esune takatelawe 'aberawe 'alaahene 'enediyaawadesunaa 'enediyaatharu ('enediyaalequ) 'adaragenelate.
baraariwoceneme bahewaa laaye yamaqoyate celotaa 'adaragenelaacawe; 'eyaanedaanedume 'eresune ('alaahene) bamaatheraate (bamaalaaqe) taazaazhe nawe.

basathanawe geremaa mogase, xaayelenaa bathalaatu laaye `eredaataa negeszenaawene 'abarataanelate; nabiyenatene, bagudaayu laaye sekeetene bahulume hasaabu laaye geletzenatene, yamanaagare celotaane, yaferede beselatenaa celotaane sathanawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! hulatu yaaletagebaabu sawoce wada daawede ya'ameleko botaa zalawe yamagebaataacawe zeenaa daresohalene?!

denegate wada daawede baaletalamada maleku bamagebaataacawe: yadanagatha gizeenaa 'enasume madanegathune siradu hulatume <<'ateferaa!>> 'alute; <<'anedanyaacene 'anedanyaacenene selabadala tathaaletane nawe; bafetehe ferade! setefaredeme 'enedaataadaalaa! wada tekekelanyaawe manegade meraane!>> 'alute.

'anedu takaraakaari ladaawede <<yehe sawe wanedemee nawe zathanaa zathanye seete bagoce 'alute; laneeme 'anedite seete bage 'alacenye; 'anedwane la'esu 'enedesathawe falaga; bakerekereme rataanye;>> 'alawe.

daawedeme ferede bamasethate kasaashune 'eyaanaagara <<wanedemehe yaanetane seete bage wada bagocu lamaqalaaqale bamathayaqu baregetheme badelohale.>> bagaaraa yamiszaru bezuwocu yaleelaawene mabete bamawesadenaa bamaadaalaate baleelaawe laaye denebare yaalefaalu. 'enaziyaa yaamanutenaa malekaame szeraane yaszarute siqaru 'enasu ka'agaarocaacawe gaare yaala 'adelowonaa yaala badale yenwanwaraalu. bazihe baaheri yamigalatsutzuteme theqitoce naacawe. daawedeme bazihe kerekere wesethe bamaasegabaate yafatanenawe mahonune 'aragaagatha. meheratene kageetaawe lamana. wada 'alaaheme lamaqaarabe bamawedaqe sagada bamatzatzateme wada 'esu tamalasa.
melaashe bamasethateme maarenawe. 'esu 'enyaa zanede kaqerebe baalamwaloce nawe. bamacharashaaweme gizee malekaame mamalashaa 'alawe.

daawede hoye! 'enyaa yahaayemaanotenaa yaduneyaa gudaayoce wesaaneewoce lamaasefatzame medere laaye meteke 'adereganehalenaa basawoce mahakale bafetehe ferade. basawoce makaakale setefarede 'anedu bazemedenaawe; bagwaadanyenate wayeme thalaate bamahonu mekeneyaate bamaadaalaate zenebaaleehene 'atekatale! kaqathetanyaawe ya'alaahe manegade yaasaasetehalenaa. 'enaziyaa qathe kaalawe ya'alaahe manegade yamisaasaatu yameremaraawene qane bamaresaataacawe mekeneyaatenaa beretu yahona qethaate 'alaacawe. mekeneyaatume 'alaahene biyaasetaawesunaa 'esune bifaru semeetaacawene bamakatale 'ayaazanabelume nabare.

samaayenenaa mederene bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawene hulu lakanetu 'alefathareneme. yelequnese yafatharenaacawe lateleqe `aalaamaanaa thebabe nawe. 'enedihume ya'alaahene celotaa yamiyaamalaaketu meleketoce sihonu ba'enasu wesethe 'alaahene 'enedenetaazaze nawe. lakanetu 'enedatafatharu yamitharaatharute 'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce naacawe. yehenene therethaaree yamitharaatharute kahadiyaane batenesaa'eewe qane bakehedataacawenaa bamathefo therethaariyaacawe wesethe 'enedaalu yamimotu kahona: ka'esaate qethaate wayolaacawe.

'enaziyaane ba'alaahe yaamanutenenaa male'eketanyaawene yatakatalunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru, medere laaye bakehedatenaa bahathi'aate 'enedamiyaathafu sawoce 'anaadaregaacaweme. 'enedihume yageetaacawene te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale geetaacawene yamifaru, bawanejale wesethe 'enedatazafaqu kahadiyaanenaa manaafeqaane 'anaadaregeme. 'enazihene 'ekule maaderage gefenaa badale bamahonu la'alaahe 'ayegabaame. yelequnese 'alaahe 'esune yamifarutene baarocune janate bamaasegabaate yemanadaale. kahadiyaanene dagemo 'esaate wesethe bamaasegabaate yeqathaale. mekeneyaatume hulatume 'alaahe zanede 'ekule baalamahonaacawe menedaacaweme 'ekule 'ayedalame.

'aneta nabiye hoye! yehe wadaaneta yaawaradenawe qure'aane bezu malekaame nagarenaa theqeme yaalawe beruke matsehahhafe nawe. 'aneqatsotzocune sawoce 'enediyaasetanatenute teregumune 'enediyaasetawelutenaa yaberuhe 'a`emero baalabeetoceme 'enedigasatzubate 'awaradenawe.

ladaawede ka'enyaa yahona tzagaanaa terufaate la`aayenu maarafiyaa yehone zanede lejune sulayemaanene sathanawe.sulayemaaneme merethe baariyaa nawe. 'esu neseha bamaaderage babezaate wada 'alaahe tamalaashe nawe.

lasulayemaaneme kaqatere baxwaalaa baszosete 'egeroce bamaqome 'araatanyaa 'egeraacawene kafe yamiyaadaregu cholee fathaane farasoce baqarabulate gizee yahonawene 'asetaawese! tzahaye 'eseketethaleqe deraseme te`eyenetu qathala.
sulayemaaneme <<geetaayeene kamaasetaawase yeleqe ganezabe farasocene chamero (mawedadene) maratheku tzahaye 'eseketethaleqenaa ya`asere salaateme 'esekiyaamalethanyeme derase darasekunye?>> 'ala.
farasoceneme maleswacawe. 'amathwacaweme. baatocaacawenenaa 'anegatocaacawene basayefe mametaatune tayaayaazawe.

bamanebara selethaanume laaye shayethwanene bamaaseqamathe sulayemaanene fatanenawe. saweme maselo la'achere gizee selethaanune yezo 'asetadaadaranaa kaziyaame selethaanu wada sulayemaane daageme tamalasalatenaa bashayethwanoceme laaye shomenawe.
sulayemaaneme <<geetaayee hoye! hathi'aateene maaranye ka'enee baxwaalaa lamaaneme yamaatesathawe yahonane negeszenaa la'enee sathanye. 'aneta sethotaahe yabazaanaa lagaasenatehe yalaaqa nawe>> 'ala.
melaasheme sathanawe; nefaaseneme baqalaalu late`ezaazu yametemaraa; xaayelanyaanaa fathaane honaa saala yamaaterabesha yezaawe 'enedetegwaaze bamaaderage 'agaraanelate.
shayethwanaateneme ba'esu te`ezaaze yamitaazazu sihonu 'agaraanelate. kashayethwanaateme genebanyocenaa baahere wesethe bamasemathe 'enequwocenaa lule yamiyaawathu yeganyubataale.
kashayethwanaateme 'amatzanyoce honawe saala lasu yatagaru baberate tathaferawe yamaayeneqasaaqasume 'alu.

'aneta sulayemaane hoye! yehe 'aneta bathayaqekawe maszarate yasathanehe sethotaacene nawe; lafalagekawe sethe laalefalagekaweme kalekele! bametesathaweme hona bametekalakelawe meneme gemegamaa yalabeheme.
sulayemaane 'enyaa zanede yaqerebe baalamwale nawe. malekaame mamalashaame baregethe 'alawe. 'esume janate nawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! baariyaacene 'ayube geetaawene 'alaahene bamamaatzane <<shayethwane 'eneene gudaatenaa seqaaye 'adarasabenye>> 'ala.
la'esume <<ba'egerehe mederene metaa>> 'alenawe. ba'egerume mederene mataa yamithathaawenaa yamitaathabebateweha falaqalate. sithathaanaa sitaathabe yadarasabate gudaatenaa cegere yewagadelataale.

melaasheneme sathanawe. yanabarabateneme cegere 'anasaanelate. bamataagasume 'azenanelate beetasabune malesane sathanawe. ka'enasu gaare batamasaasaaye lejocenenaa yaleje lejocene chamerane sathanawe. baziheme laaye beruhe 'a`emero baalabeetoce yate`egesete macharashaa kacegere magalaagalenaa malekaame menedaa mahonune yegasatzubataale.

'ayube babaalabeetu laaye taqotheto mato jeraafe 'egarefaataalahu bamaalate melo selanabare. <<'aneta 'ayube mahalaahene lamafatzame ba'ejehe 'arechumee yaazenaa baalabeetehene metaa. yamaalekawe mahalaa 'ayebalaasheme.>> 'esume chebethe 'arechumeene yezo mataate. 'enyaa bafatanenawe fatanaa taagaashe hono 'aganyanawe. 'eresu leyu baariyaa nawe.'ejege wada 'alaahe tamalaashenaa tatzatzaace nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yamarathenaacawe baarocaacenenaa yalaakenaacawene male'eketanyocaacenene beraahime, sehhaqenaa yaa`eqube 'alaahene bamataazazenaa wedeetaawene bamafalage laaye yaxaayele baalabeetoce yahonu 'enedihume ya'ewenatanyaa maasetawaale baalabeetoce yahonutene 'awesaalaacawe.

'enyaa 'enasu becaa yamilayubatene leyu malayaa lagasenaacawe. lebocaacawene yamacharashaayetune hagare bamaasetaawase, la'eswa malekaame szeraane bamaszeraate mazagaajatenaa sawocene laswa 'enedizagaaju theri maaderagene nawe.
'enasu 'enyaa zanede 'enyaane bamataazazenaa ba'ameleko merethoce male'eketaacenene 'enedishakamunaa lasawoceme 'enediyaadarasu marathenaacawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! semaa`ile yaberaahime lejene, yasa`enenaa zalekifelene 'asetaawese. 'enasune baamaara maleku 'awadesaacawe, mekeneyaatume lazihe tagabi naacawenaa. 'enazihe hulu 'alaahe yamarathaacawe merethoce naacawe.
yehe la'enazihe baqure'aane yatagalatza malekaame zenaa nawe; ya'alaahene te'ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahene lamifaru bamacharashaawe qane malekaame mamalashaa 'alaacawe.
yehe malekaame mamalashaa 'esu batenesaa'ee qane yamigabwate yamanoriyaa janatoce naacawe. barocaacaweme la'enasu 'aqabaabale bamazagaajate yatakafatu naacawe.
yatashalamu 'alegaawocaacawe laaye yedagafaalu. 'agalegaayocaacaweneme yamifalegutene bezu yaferaaferee `aayenatocenenaa yamifalegutene yatalayaayu mathathocene yaazwacawaale.
'enasu zanedeme `aayenocaacawene babaalabeetocaacawe laaye 'asaathaariwoce; 'enasune 'alefawe wada leelaa yamaayemalakatunaa ba`edemeeme 'ekuyaawoce yahonu seetoce 'alwacawe.

'enaaneta 'alaahene yametefaru sawoce hoye! yehe malekaame menedaa duneyaa wesethe seteszarute banabarawe malekaame szeraawocaacehu mekeneyaate latenesaa'eewe qane yatagabaalaacehu yatasefaa qaale nawe.
yehe yathaqasenawe menedaa batenesaa'eewe qane 'alaahene lamifarute yamenesathawe sisaayaacene nawe. 'esume yamaayeqwaarathenaa yamaayaaleqe qwaami nawe.

yehe yathaqasenawe menedaa 'alaahene lamifarute nawe. bakehedatenaa bahathi'aate ya'alaahene denebare lamiyaalefute 'alaahene lamifarute katasathawe menedaa bataqaaraani sihone 'esume batenesaa'eewe qane bathaame yakafaa mamalashaa 'alaacawe.
yeheme menedaa 'enasune yametaathaqaalele jahaname naate; qaathalowaanenaa nabalebaalewaane yeqamesaalu; ya'enasu menethaafe naate. menethaafitume menenyaa yakafaace menethaafe naate.
yehe qethaate 'ejege yafalaa wehanaa ba'esaate kamiqaathalute ya'esaate gwaadoce 'akaale yamifase 'ezhe nawe. yamithathuteme 'esu kathemaate yamaayaarakaa mathathaacawe nawe.
leelaame 'esune yamimasele qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale. batenesaa'eewe qane yamiqathubaacawe yatalayaayu yaqethaate `aayenatoce tazagaajetolaacawaale.

ya'esaate sawoce 'esaate bagabu gizee bahulate takaraakaariwoce thele gizee yamikasate yasedebe `aayenate yesadaadabaalu. 'anedu kaleelaawe netzuhenatune yegaletsaale. kafilocume 'enazihe ka'enaaneta gaare yamigabu kefeloce naacawe yelaalu. melaashe bamasethateme la'enasu 'ayesafaalaacawe 'enyaa ya'esaatene qethaate 'enedameneqamesawe hulu 'enasume qamaashoce naacawenaa yelaalu.

'enaziyaa takataayoce la'asekataayoce <<yelequne 'enaaneta 'asekataayoce 'ayesefaacehu. lanyaa mathemamenaa masaasaate mekeneyaatocu 'enaaneta naacehu. yehe maarafiyaa menenyaa yakafaa maarafiyaa nawe. yahulume maarafiyaa yajahaname 'esaate naate.>>
takataayocu geetaacene hoye! tekekelanyaa manegadu mathetolene 'eyaala katekekelanyaawe manegade yaasaasaatunene: ya'esaate 'ethefe qethaate chamerelate>> yelaalu.
thamaamaanaa kuraatanyoce <<'enyaa baduneyaa thamaamaanaa ya'esaate naacawe belane senaasebaacawe yanabarute sawoce menawe 'esaate wesethe ka'enyaa gaare 'anaayaacawemesaa?>> yelaalu.

ba'enasu laaye maashofaacenenaa masaalaqaacene yatasaasaata hono la'esaate yatagabu saayehonu qaru wayese maashofaacene tekekele hono 'esaate wesethe gabetawaale. nagare gene `aayenocaacene 'alaayaacaweme?
yehe batenesaa'eewe qane bakahadiyaane makaakale yamidaragawe kerekere therethaaree yaleelawe 'ewenate nawe.

'aneta muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) hoye! lahhezebocehe <<'enee la'enaaneta bakehedataacehunaa male'eketanyocene bamaasetabaabalaacehu mekeneyaate qethaate 'enedaayaawaredebaacehu ya'alaahe qethaate 'asethaneqaaqi nanye. la'ameleko tagabi yahona ka'alaahe basetaqare maaneme yalame. 'esu bataalaaqenatu, babaaheriyaatunaa basemocu becanyaa nawe. huluneme yaashanafa 'ashanaafi hulume nagaroce la'esu tanaanaashe naacawe>> balaacawe.
yasamaayaate, yamederenaa bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawe hulu geetaa nawe. banegeszenaawe laaye maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi; kabaarocu wada 'esu baneseha yamimalasutene mahari nawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enazihe 'asetabaabaayoce <<yehe qure'aane taalaaqe zeenaa nawe>> balaacawe.
'enaaneta kazihe yataalaaqe gudaaye zeenaa meneme zore saatelu zanegiwoce naacehu.
ba'adame mafethare gudaaye laaye bamalaa'eketoce makaakale batadaragawe weyeyete zuriyaa 'alaahe raa`eyune wadanee bamaawerade baayaasaaweqanye noro meneme `eweqate 'alenabaranyeme.
'alaahe wadanee raa`eye yamiyaawaredawe 'enee la'enaaneta kaqethaatu geletze yahonekunye 'asethaneqaaqi bamahonee 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame.
geetaahe lamalaa'eketoce 'enee sawene ('adamene `aalayehi salaame) kacheqaa fathaari nanye yaalawene 'asetaawese.
fetheratunenaa qeretsune baasetakaakalekunaa kamanefasee banafaahubate gizee la'eresu sagadu; 'aleku.
malaa'eketoceme yageetaacawene te'ezaaze bamafatzame bamulu yasalaametaanaa yakebere segedatene sagadu. ka'enasu makaakale la'adame saayesagade yaqara 'anedeme male'ake yalame.
nagare gene belise becaa bakuraate segedatene 'emebi 'ala; bageetaawe te'ezaaze laaye bamakuraatume kakahadiwoce hona.
'alaaheme <<'aneta belise hoye! 'enee ba'ejee lafatharekute la'adame masegade mene kalakalahe? kasegedate yakalakalahe kuraate nawe wayese kazihe bafiteme kate`ebitanyoce nabareke?>> 'alawe.
beliseme <<'enee ka'adame balaache nanye. 'eneene ka'esaate fatharekanye 'esune dagemo kacheqaa fatharekawe>>; 'ala. 'enedasu 'abaabaaleme 'esaate dagemo kacheqaa yebalethaale.
'alaahe labelise <<kajanate wethaa 'aneta yataragameke nahenaa>> 'alawe.
<<'eregemaaneeme 'eseka feredu qane (tenesaa'ee) derase baaneta laaye yehune.>>
belise <<geetaayee hoye! 'eseka tenesaa'ee derase saategadelanye 'aqoyanye>>; 'ala.
'alaaheme <<'aneta kamiqoyute nahe>>; 'alawe.
<<'esekataawaqawe yatawasana qane derase (kaziyaa temotaalahe).>>
belise <<baxaayelehenaa 'ashanaafinatehe 'emelaalahu! ya'adamene lejoce bamulu 'asaasetaacawaalahu>> 'ala.
<<'aneta kanee maasaasaate yathabaqekawenaa 'anetane becaa bamagazaate yaatharaahacawenaa yamarathekaacawe baarocehe siqaru:>>
'alaahe 'enedihe 'ala - <<'ewenatu kanee nawe. 'ewenatene dagemo 'enaagaraalahu. ka'esu leelaa 'alenaagareme.
batenesaa'eewe qane baaneta; bazereyaahenaa 'anetane bakehedatehe batakataluhe ya'adame lejoce hulu jahanamene ba'eregethe 'emolaataalahu.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enazihe 'agaariwoce <<lamaasetalaalefelaacehu mekere meneme waagaa (menedaa) 'alethayeqaacehume. 'eneeme kataazazekute wechi 'anedeneme nagare yamechamereme 'ayedalahume>> balaacawe.
<<qure'aane te'ezaaze lamafatsame ladarasu sawocenaa gaaneenoce tagesaatze 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame.
yazihene qure'aane 'ewenatanyenate kaqerebe gizee baxwaalaa setemotu ba'eregethe taaweqaataalaacehu.>>
yaqure'aane mawerade maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafiwe bamafethare, bamaasetanaabarenaa bamadanegage thebabanyaa kahonawe 'alaahe nawe. ka'eresu becaa 'eneji kaleelaa 'akaale 'alewaradame.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enyaa wada 'aneta qure'aanune ba'ewenate yatamolaa sihone 'awaradenawe. wareewe hulu 'ewenate, feredu hulu fetehawi nawe. 'alaahene becaawene haayemaanotene la'eresu becaa kamaagaaraate (kashereke) yaatharaahe honahe tagazaawe.

'eseti nequ! kashereke 'edefe yatharaa yahona haayemaanote la'alaahe becaa nawe! 'enaziyaame ka'alaahe leelaa thaa`otaatene 'enedigazwacawe yayaazwacawene bamaamakaanyate wada 'alaahe maaqaarabene 'enediyaaqaarebune, gudaayaacenene 'enediyaaqarebulenenaa 'alaahe zanede 'enediyaamaaledune 'eneji laleelaa 'anegazaacaweme yelaalu. 'alaahe 'esune babecanyenate bamiyaamalekute me'emanaanenaa ba'esu bamiyaagaaru kahadiyaane makaakale batenesaa'eewe qane siwazaagabubaacawe banabarute ya'alaahene 'anedenate (tawehhide) gudaaye laaye yefaredaale. 'alaahe la'eresu 'agaare bamaaderage weshataamenaa ya'esune tzagaa kahadi yahonutene sawoce sekeetaamaa 'ayaadaregaacaweme.

'alaahe lejene mayaaze bifalege noro kafetheratu yamifalegawene yemarethenaa 'eneda leju yaadaregawe nabare. 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce kamilute hulu theraate yegabaawe. 'esu ba'akaalu, babaaheriwenaa batagebaaru 'anede nawe. meneme tagaari yalaweme. fethuraanocune hulu 'ashanaafi nawe.

samaayaatenaa mederene lataalaaqe thebabe fatharaacawe; 'enaziyaa badaayoce 'enedamilute lachawaataa 'ayedalame! lalitene baqane wesethe yaasegabaale; qaneneme balalite wesethe yaasegabaale; 'anedu simathaa leelaawene yeshafenaale; tzahhayenenaa charaqaane 'agaraa; hulume latawasana gizee (`aalame fetsaamee) derase yegwaazaalu; nequ! 'esu thalaatocune bamabaqale maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi; kabaarocu baneseha wada 'esu yamimalasutene mahari nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! geetaacehu ka'anedite nafese ('adame) fatharaacehu. kaziyaame ka'adame baalabeetune hhawaa'ene fathara. kagemale, kakabete, kabagenaa feyale semenete 'ayenatocene ka'eyaanedaanedu wanedenaa seete fathara. ba'enaatocaacehu hode wesethe ka'anede kxidate wada leelaa kxidate baszosete chalamaawoce yahode, maahetzanenaa kamaahetzane qathelo bameteganye sese shefaane wesethe fatharaacehu. 'enazihene hulu yafathara geetaacene 'alaahe nawe. selethaanu ya'esu becaa nawe. ka'eresu leelaa ba'ewenate 'amelaake yalame taadiyaa 'esune magazaate tetaacehu meneme yamaayefatherawene raasu fethure yahonawene 'enedeete wada magazaate tezoraalaacehu?!

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! geetaacehune betekedu: 'alaahe ka'emenataacehu yatabeqaaqaa nawe. ya'enaaneta kehedate 'ayegodaaweme. yakehedataacehu gudaate wada 'enaaneta tamalaashe nawe. labaarocu kehedatene 'ayewademe. bakehedateme 'ayaazeme. mekeneyaatume 'alaahe baarocune 'asetzayaafinaa mathefo nagare 'ayaazeme. 'alaahe yasathaacehune tzagaa betaamasagenutenaa ba'esu betaamenu mesegaanaacehune yewadaale. ba'esume yemanadaacaxwaale. 'anedite nafese yaleelaayetune nafese hathi'aate 'ateshakameme. yelequnese 'eyaanedaanedwa nafese baszeraawaa tayaazhe naate. kaziyaame batenesaa'ee qane mamalashaacehu wada geetaacehu becaa nawe. baduneyaa teszarute yanabaraacehuteneme yenageraacexwaale. baszeraawocaacehume yemanadaacexwaale. 'esu babaarocu leboce wesethe yaalawene `aawaaqi nawe. 'eswa wesethe yaalawe meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.

'anede kahadi bashetaa, ganezabe maathaatenenaa yamasemathe segaatenaa gudaate baaganyawe gizee gudaatunenaa cegerune 'enediyaanasaalate wada 'esu tamalaashe bamahone geetaawene yetharaale. kaziyaame tzagaane bamasethate yagathamawene cegere baanasaalate gizee kazihe bafite sitharaawe yanabarawene 'alaahene yerasaale. kamanegadu lamaasaasaateme la'alaahe ka'esu wechi yamigazaacawene 'agaaroce yaadaregaale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bazihe maleku yaalane sawe <<bakehedatehe baqariwe `edemeehe theqite gizeene tathaqame; 'aneta baregethe batenesaa'eewe qane zawetaari bamahone 'esaate kamigabu ya'esaate gwaadoce nahe>>; balawe.

lamahonu yaa 'alaahene bamataazaze yalalite gizeewene lageetaawe bamasegade bamaqome yamiyaasaalefe sawe, 'esume yamacharashaayetune `aalame qethaate yamifaraa yageetaawene cerotaa yamikajele yeshaalaale wayese yaa geetaawene yakaada? 'alaahene bacegere gizee yamigazaa badelote gizee bamakaade ka'alaahe gaare 'agaare yamiyaadarege? 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'enaziyaa 'alaahene bamaawaqaacawe mekeneyaate gedeetaa yaadaragabaacawene yamiyaawequ 'enaa 'enaziyaa selazihe gudaaye meneme yamaayaawequ sawoce 'ekule naacawene?>> balaacawe. ya'enazihene leyunate yamiyaawequte 'enaziyaa yaberuhe 'a`emero baalabeetoce becaa naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa ba'eneenaa bamale'eketanyocee yaamanu baaroceene te`ezaazune bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe geetaacehune feru la'enaziyaa bazihece qerebitu `aalame malekaame laszarute baduneyaa malekaame menedaa dele, theenenatenaa ganezabe 'alalaacawe. bamacharashaaweme qane janatene yemanadaacawaale. ya'alaahe medere safi naatenaa 'alaahene yametegazubaate botaa lamaagenyate katacagaraacehu tasadadu. meneme 'ayaagedaacehu. taagaashocene batenesaa'eewe qane menedaacawe kabezaatunaa `aayenatu yatanasaa yaala qutherenaa sefere yesathaacawaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'alaahe 'eneene 'esune becaa 'amelekoyeene 'atherecee 'enedegazaawe 'azezonyaale>> balaacawe.
kazihe hhezebeme la'esu yamajamariyaawe 'eje kasathu (kasalamu) 'enaa kataazazu 'enedehoneme 'azonyaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'enee 'esune kaamatzekunyenaa kaaletaazazekunye yataalaaqune qane (tenesaa'eewene) qethaate 'efaraalahu>> balaacawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'enee 'alaahene becaa 'amelekoyeene 'atherecee 'egazaalahu. ka'esu gaare leelaane 'alegazaame>> bale.

<<'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! ka'esu wechi kathaa`otaate yafalagaacehutene tagazu ('abaabaalu zaacaa nawe). 'aneta male`e'eketanyaa hoye! ba'ewenate kasaariwoce maalate batenesaa'eewe `elate nafesocaacawenenaa beetasabocaacawene yaathute naacawe. ka'enasu talayetawe janate labecaacawe bamagebaataacawe wayeme 'esaate 'aberawe bamagebaataacawe mekeneyaate bafetzume 'ayeganaanyumeme. nequ! yehe meneme malabaabase yaleelabate 'ewenatanyaa geletze keserate nawe>> balaacawe.

batenesaa'eewe 'elate la'enasu kalaayaacawe chese, nabalebaalenaa muqate, kabataacaacawe chese, nabalebaalenaa muqate 'alaacawe. bazihe batathaqasawe qethaate 'alaahe baarocune yaasefaraaraale. baarocee hoye! te'e`ezaazeene bamafatsamenaa yakalakalekutene bamaraaqe 'eneene ferunye.

'alaahe yawanejalanyocene huneetaa kagalatza baxwaalaa yadagaage baarocune huneetaa bamagelatze 'enedihe yelaale::
'enaziyaa thaa`otaatenenaa ka'alaahe weche yamimalaku nagarocene kamagazaate yaraaqu wada 'alaaheme baneseha yatamalasu 'enasu simotu, qabere wesethenaa batenesaa'eewe qane yajanate beseraate 'alalaacawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! baaroceene 'abesere.

'enaziyaa negegere 'adaamethawe malekaamune kamathefowe bamalayate malekaamune (wesethu bayaazawe theqeme) yamikatalutene 'abesere. bazihe baaheri yatagalatsute sawoce 'alaahe wada qathetanyaa manegade yamaraacawe naacawe. 'enaziyaame yaberuhe 'a`emero baalabeetoce naacawe.

bakehedatunaa bathemeetu laaye bamaqathalu ba'eresu laaye yaqethaate qaale yataragaagathabatene sawe 'esune wada meraacaa manegade lamamaraatenaa lamaaqaanaate meneme malaa yalaheme. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lamahonu yehene baaheriwe yahonane sawe ka'esaate maadaane tecelaalahene?

nagare gene 'enaziyaa te`ezaazune bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe geetaacawene yafaru 'anedu baleelaawe laaye yatadaraarabu; kafe yaalunaa kaserocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawe yahonu manoriyaawoce 'alwacawe. 'alaahe ba'eregethe yehenenu qaale gabetolaacawaale. 'alaaheme qaalune 'ayaafareseme.

'alaahe kasamaaye (damanaa) yazenaabene weha 'awaarada. wada medereme 'asegabaa. kaziyaa baxwaalaa menechocenaa wanezoce bamaaderage 'awathaa. kaziyaa baxwaalaame bazihe weha yatalayaayu ya'azere`ete `aayenatocene 'awathaa. kaziyaame 'azemaraawe yedareqaale. kanabarabate 'aranegwaadeeyaamaa maleke bamaqayare garethetome temalakataalahe. kadaraqa baxwaalaame yatasabaabara yaadaregawaale. bazihe batagalatzawe wesethe heyaawe lebe laalacawe gesaatzee 'alabate.

'alaahe lebune la'eselemenaa yaasefaalatenenaa wada 'esume kageetaawe berehaane laaye hono yatamaraa sawe 'alaahene baalamaawesaate lebu 'enedadaraqa sawe nawene? bafetsume 'ekule 'ayedalame! natzaa mawethaate lame'emanaane sihone keserate dagemo 'alaahene baalamaawesaate lebocaacawe ladaraqu sawoce nawe. 'enaziyaa ka'ewenate bamaraaqe bageletze masaasaate wesethe naacawe.

'alaahe bamale'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) laaye merethe negegere (qaale) yahonawene qure'aanene 'awarada. ba'ewenatanyenatu, banegegeru, wathe hono yamaayefaalase bamahonu, taarikocunaa denegaageewocu bamadagaagamu, bazaacaanaa batasefaa qaalu, ya'ewenatanyocenaa 'ewenatanyaa yaalehonu sawocene baaheriyaate 'enaa yamasaasalutene bamazarezaru tamasaasaaye 'aderego 'awaradawe. 'enaziyaa geetaacawene yamifarute yazaacaa qaalunenaa maasefaraariyaawene basamu gizee qodaawocaacawe yekomaataraale. kaziyaame beseraatocenaa yatasefaa qaalune sisamu dagemo lebocaacawenaa qodaawocaacawe yelazebaalu. yehe qure'aanenaa tatze'enowe ya'alaahe meraacaa nawe. yafalagawene wada mamariyaawe yemaraabataale. lasekeete yaalaabaqaawene sawe ka'alaahe weche yamimaraawe yalame.

lamahonu yehenene 'alaahe yaaqanaawene, baduneyaa sekeetaamaa yaadaragawenenaa bamacharashaawe janate yaasegabaawene sawe, ba'alaahe yakaada bakehedatume laaye hono yamotanaa 'esaate wesethe 'ejocunenaa 'egerocu taaserawe yagabu 'enaa kafitu ya'esaatene qethaate mamakate yamaayecele sawe gaare 'ekule naacawene? nafesaacawene bakehedatenaa bahathi'aate labadaluteme bawaqasaa maleku <<teszarute yanabaraacehutene kehedatenaa hathi'aate qethaatune qemasu. yehe waagaacehu nawe>> yebaalaalu.
ka'enazihe yamakaa 'agaariwoce bafite yanabarute hhezeboce 'asetabaabalu. qethaatume laneseha saayezagaajunaa bamaayaawequte bakule mathaabaacawe.
'alaaheme bazihe qethaate baqerebitu heyewate weredatenenaa haferatene 'aqamasaacawe. yamiyaawequ bihonu noro yamithabeqaacawe yamacharashaayetume `aalame qethaate teleqenaa kabaade nawe.

bamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) batawaradawe qure'aane wesethe lasawoce yatalayaayu kamalekaamenaa mathefo, 'ewenatenaa weshate, kehedatenaa 'emenate 'enaa leeloce mesaaleewocene 'adaragene. yeheneneme yaaseqamathenawene mesaaleewene bamaganezabe 'ewenatune 'aweqawe 'enedisarubatenaa weshatuneme 'aweqawe yetawete zanede nawe.

ba`aarabenyaa qwaaneqwaa yaminababe 'adaragenawe. bawesethume meneme mazaabaatenaa mawalaagade yaleelabate sikxone ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahene yefaru zanede yekajalaalenaa.

'alaahe ya'agaariwocenenaa 'eresune babecanyenate yamigazutene sawoce yaalaacawene leyunate yamiyaamalakete mesaalee 'aseqamatha. yeheme mesaalee 'anedu hulate yamaayegebaabu 'alaqoce 'agalegaaye nawe. 'anedanyaawene siyaasedasete leelaanyaawene yaasekafaale. bamahonume yehe sawe tametaatetonaa tadanaagero nawe yaminorawe. leelaanyaawe dagemo la'anede 'alaqaa becaa nawe tagazhinatu. 'eresune yaagalagelaale; felaagotune yaaweqaale. bamahonume wesethu (manefasu) yataragaagaanaa 'erafete yaalawe nawe. hulatu ('agalegaayoce) 'ekule 'ayedalume. mesegaanaa la'alaahe yatagabaa nawe. 'abezaanyocu 'ayaawequmenaa ka'alaahe gaare leelaane tagaari yaadaregaalu.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'aneta mwace nahe; 'enasume mwacoce naacawe meneme 'ayeqarelaacawe.
kaziyaame ('enaaneta sawoce) batenesaa'eewe qane geetaacehu zanede baaletagebaabaacehubaacawe nagare laaye tekaraakaraalaacehu. 'ewenatanyaaweme kaweshatanyaawe yelayaale.

la'alaahe yamaayegabaawene 'agaare, misetenaa leje kamiyaasethagaa; baqure'aane kamiyaasetabaabele 'enedihume ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa yezote yamathaawene 'ewenate kamiyaasetabaabele yabalatha badalanyaa maane nawe?! lamahonu la'enaziyaa ba'alaahe lakaadunaa male'eketanyaa yaamathaawene male'ekete lakaadu 'esaate maqamachaacawenaa manoriyaacawe 'ayedalacemene? manoriyaacawenaa maqamachaacawe naate.

'alaahe 'enaziyaa weshataamocenenaa yamiyaasetabaabelu sawocene kagalatza baxwaalaa 'ewenatanyaanaa yamiyaamenene sigaletze::
yaa banegegerume batagebaarume 'ewenate yezo yamathaawe (nabiyaatenaa leeloce) 'enaa basu bamaamane 'ewenate nawe yaalanaa ba'ewenate maszarate szeraane yaszaraa 'enaziyaa 'ewenatanyaa yageetaacawene te`ezaaze yamifatsemunaa yakalakalawene yamirequ thaneqaaqoce (geetaacawene yamifaru) naacawe.
geetaacawe zanede yamifalegute zalaalamaawi thaafaache nagaroce 'alalaacawe; kalaaye yatagalatzawe la'enaziyaa kageetaacawenaa kabaarocu gaare bago szariwoce menedaa nawe.

'alaahe 'enasu baduneyaa yaszarwacawene mathefo szeraawoce neseha bamaaderage wada geetaacawe bamamalasaacawe yesarezelaacawaale. 'enedihume baszeraacawe malekaame szeraawoce batashaala menedaa yemanadaacawaale.

lamahonu 'alaahe baariyaawene muhhamadene (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) bahaayemaanotume baduneyaame 'enedihume yathalaatune tanekole bamakalaakale baqiwe 'ayedalamene? nawe. 'esu baqiwe nawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enasu kamaayemenataacawenaa qilenataacawe yatanasaa 'anetane ka'alaahe wechi yamiyaamalekwaacawe thaa`otaate kefu nagare 'enedaayaadaresubehe yaasefaraaruhaale. 'alaahe 'esune bamaawaarade wada qanaawe manegade yaalemaraawene wada qathetanyaa manegade yamimaraawe yalaweme.

'alaahe qathetanyaa manegadene yamaraawe maaneme liyaasaasetawe 'ayeceleme. lamahonu 'alaahe maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi ba'esu yakaadutenaa yaamatzutene yamabaqale baalabeete 'ayedalamene? nawe. 'esu 'ashanaafi yabaqale baalabeete nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaane 'agaariwoce <<samaayaatenenaa mederene yafatharawe maanawe;>> belahe betethayeqaacawe <<'alaahe nawe yafatharaacawe>> yeluhale. 'amaaleketocaacawe dakaamaa mahonaacawene geletze bamaaderage <<'enaziyaa ka'alaahe wechi yametaamalekwaacawene thaa`otaate huneetaa 'eseki negarunye lamahonu 'alaahe 'eneene gudaate biyaadaresebenye gudaatune liyaasewagadulenye yecelaalune? 'enedihume geetaayee 'eneene ba'ezenatu malekaame nagare bicaranye lamahonu yehenene yacaranyene 'ezenate kanee likalakelu yecelaalune? geetaayee 'alaahe becaa baqiyee nawe. ba'esu becaa bagudaayocee hulu 'emakaalahu. tamakiwoce hulu ba'esu becaa yemaku.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa <<hhezebocee hoye! 'enaaneta bawadadaacehute shireke (maagaaraate) huneetaa laaye honaacehu szeraacehune szeru; 'eneeme geetaayee baazazanye maszarate wada 'esu becanyaa tamalaakinate (tawehhide) 'enaa 'amelekone la'esu becaa 'enedidarage bamathaaraate 'eszaraalahu; yametegwaazubatene manegade macharashaawene saataawequte 'ateqarume>> balaacawe.

baduneyaa yamiyaawaaredawenaa zeqe yamiyaadaregawe qethaate bamaane laaye 'enedamimathaa 'enaa zawetaari yazalaalame, yamaayaaqwaarethenaa yamaayewagade qethaate bamacharashaawe qane (tenesaa'ee) bamaane laaye 'enedamiwarede saataawequte 'ateqarume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! sawocene taasethanaqeqe zanede baaneta laaye qure'aanene ba'ewenate 'awaradene. wada 'ewenate yatamaraa theqemu laraasu nawe. 'alaahe ba'esu mamaraate 'ayethaqameme. mekeneyaatume yatabeqaaqaa nawenaa. yathamamame sawe yathemematu gudaate baraasu laaye nawe. 'alaahe ya'esu mathemame 'ayegodaaweme. 'aneta ba'enasu laaye tawakelahe wada qanaawe manegade yametaasegadede 'ayedalaheme. halaafinatehe 'alaahe 'enedetaadarese yaazazahene maaderase becaa nawe.

'alaahe 'aneditene nafese gizeewaa badarasa gizee yamigadelaate 'esu nawe. yaaci gizeewaa yaaledarasacene nafese ba'eneqelefe gizee yewasedaataale. mote yafaradabaatene 'ezaawe yaaseqaraataale. mote baswa laaye yaalefaradabaatene 'eseka tawasana gizeewaa darase yelaqaataale. nafesene maleqaqe, magedalenaa heyaawe maaderagene yacaala geetaa sawocene kamote baxwaa lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa maqaseqase caaye mahonune la'enaziyaa lamiyaasetanatenu sawoce maaserajaa yehonaacawaale.

'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce ka'alaahe wechi thaa`otaacawene ba'amaalaajenate yethaqemanaale bamile yaazwacawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<lamahonu 'enaziyaane laraasaacaweme laleelaaweme meneneme yamaayecelunaa meneme yamaayaawequ bihonume 'enekwaa 'amaalaaje 'aderegaacehu teyezwacawaalaacehune?>> balaacawe. 'enasu ge`uze honawe meneme yamaayenaagaru, yamaayesamu, yamaayaayu, yamaayethaqemunaa yamaayegodu naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce <<melejaa baathaqaalaaye ya'alaahe becaa nawe. maaneme 'esu zanede faqaade kaalesathawe basetaqare 'ayaamaaledeme; 'enedihume 'esu lawadadalaacawe 'eneji 'ayaamaaledume yasamaayaatenaa yamedere hulu negeszenaa la'esu becaa nawe kaziyaa baxwaalaa batenesaa'eewe qane lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa wada 'esu becaa bamamalase 'enedayaszeraacehu yemanadaacexwaale>> balaacawe.

'alaahe becaawene batawasaa gizee ya'enaziyaa bamacharashaawe qane gemegamaanenaa menedaane chamero yamaayaamenu sawoce leboce yedanaberaalu (yeshashaalu). 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe wechi yamimalaku thaa`otaate batawasu gizee 'enaresu dasetanyoce yehonaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'alaahe hoye! samaayaatenaa mederene yafathareke, ruquneme qerebuneme `aawaaqi yahoneke, ka'aneta meneme yamidabaqe yalame. 'aneta becaa batenesaa'eewe qane babaarocehe makaakale yaaletagebaabubaacawenenaa yewazaagabubate yanabarutene bamalayate 'ewenatanyaanenaa weshataamene, `edelanyaanaa `edela bise geletze yehonaalu.

la'enaziyaa nafesaacawene bamaagaaraatenaa bawanejale yabadalu sawoce medere laaye yaalawe wede yahonu nagarocenaa ganezabe binoraacawe noro kataqasaqasu baxwaalaa kamiyaaganyaacawe kabaade qethaate lamadaane beezaa yekafelu nabare. nagare gene yalaacaweme. binoraacaweme 'enekwaa meneme taqabaayenate yalaweme. 'enasu fetzume yaalethabaqute yaqethaate `aayenate yefaanaa geletze honalaacawe.
yasarute yasherekenaa yawanejale kefaate yegalatzelaacawaale; duneyaa wesethe banabarubate gizee siyaalaagethubate yanabarute qethaate safarabaacawe.

kahadi yahonawe sawe bashetaa wayeme dehenate wazata. siyaagaathemawe yaagaathamawene 'enedenaanasaalate yemaatzatsananaale; kaziyaa baxwaalaa katzagaawe theenenatene wayeme ganezabene basathanawe gizee yehenene yaaganyahute 'alaahe 'enee lasu tagabi mahoneene selamiyaaweqe nawe yasathanye yelaale. yelequnese mafatanyaanaa mazanaagiyaa nawe; nagare gene 'abezaanyaawocu kahadiyaane 'ayaawequme. 'alaahe basathaacaweme tzagaa yeshanagalaalu.
ka'enasu bafite yanabaru kahadiyaane baregethe yehenenu belawaale; yaaganyute yanabaruteme ganezabenaa darajaa 'alethaqamaacaweme.

yaszarwacawe yasherekenaa yawanejale kefu qethaate 'aganyaacawe; ka'enaziheme 'enaziyaa basherekenaa bawanejale nafesaacawene yabadalute 'enedaalafute hhezeboce yaszarwacawe kefu szeraa waagaa ba'eregethe yaaganyaacawaale; 'enasume 'alaahene yamiyaamalethu 'ayedalume.

lamahonu 'enazihe 'agaariwoce yafalagute tanaagarune? 'alaahe baariyaawene yaamaszagenaale wayenese yekedaale belo lamafatane lashaawe sisaayune 'enedamiyaasafaalatenaa lashaaweme dagemo taagaashenatune wayeme ba'alaahe wesaanee laaye maamaararune lamafatane sisaayune 'enedamiyaathabebateme 'alaawaqumene?! batathaqasawe yasisaaye masefaatenaa mathebabe wesethe la'amaanyoce sela 'alaahe 'asetanaabaarinate taalaaqe maaserajaa nawe. ba'eziheme tathaqaamiwocu 'enaresu becaa naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa ba'alaahe bamaagaaraatene wanejalocene bamafatzame denebare yaalafaacehu baarocee hoye! ka'alaahe 'ezenatenaa lahathi'ataacehu meheratene tasefaa 'atequrathu. 'alaahe hathi'atocene bamulu wada 'esu latamalasu yemeraalenaa. 'enaho 'esu wada 'alaahe latamalasute mahari la'enasu 'azaanye nawenaa balaacawe.

batenesaa'eewe qane qethaate wada 'enaaneta kamamethaatu bafite wadageetaacehu neseha bamaaderagenaa malekaame szeraawocene bamaszeraate tamalasu la'esume 'eje bamasethate taazazu. yaa qethaate kamathaa baxwaalaa thaa`otaateme yehune beetasabocaacehu maaneme liradaacehu yamicele yalame.

qethaate badenegate saataawequnaa bamatzatzate saatezagaaju kamamethaatu bafite ka'alaahe zanede wada male'eketanyaawe yawaradawene malekaamune qure'aane takatalu; te`ezaazaatune tageberu; kelekalaaweneme raaqu.

nafeseme kamatzatzate yatanasaa batenesaa'eewe qane waa! tzatzatee bakehedatenaa bawanejale wesethe bamazafaqe ba'alaahe bakule yaalawene te'ezaaze baalamafatzame baagwaadalekute 'enaa bame'emanaane laaye kamiyaashofute nabarekunye kamaalatwa bafite yataazazacawene tefatzeme.

ba'alaahe wesaanee (qadare) bamaamakaanyateme 'alaahe malekaamune nagare bigathemanye ya'esune te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'esune kamifarute 'ehone nabare kamaalatwa bafite yataazazacewene tefatzeme.

qethaatene bametaayebate gizee bamamanyate wada duneyaa mamalasene `edele baaganye noro wada 'alaahe baneseha bamamalase szeraawocaacawene kamiyaasaameru bago szariwoce 'ehone nabare kamaalatwa bafite yataazazacewene tefatzeme.

'aneta wada qanaawe manegade mamaraatene yatamanyakxawe: nagaru 'aneta 'enedametelawe 'ayedalame! 'aneqatzocee baregethe mathetawelehale. 'esuneme 'asetabaabaleke. koraaheme. ba'alaahe, ba'aneqatzocunaa bamale'eketanyocu kakahadiwoceme honahale yebaalaale.

batenesaa'eewe qaneme la'alaahe 'agaarenaa leje yaadaragute ka`edela-bisenate yatanasaa fitocaacawe yathaqoru honawe taayaacawaalahe. lamahonu gahaname ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe maamane laaye lakoru sawoce manoriyaa 'ayedalacemene? naate 'eswa la'enasu manoriyaa naate.

'alaahe 'enaziyaane ya'esune te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale geetaacawene lafaru dele yamiyaaganyubate botaa janate bamaasegabaate kaqethaate 'adaanaacawe. qethaate 'ayenakaacaweme. baduneyaa gudaayoce baamalathaacawe nagare 'ayaazenume.
'alaahe huluneme nagaroce fathaari nawe. ka'esu wechi leelaa fathaari yalame. 'esu nagarune hulu thabaaqi, 'asetanaabaarinaa nagaraatocene bafalagabate maleku yamiyaaneqasaaqese nawe.

yasamaayaatenaa yamedere yamalekaame nagaroce delebe makefacaawoce ya'esu becaa nawe. lafalagawe yesathaale. yaalefalagawene yekalakelaale. 'enaziyaa ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce yakaadute kasaariwoce naacawe. mekeneyaatume baduneyaa heyewataacawe baalamaamanaacawenaa ba'akxiraa dagemo lazalaalame 'esaate wesethe bamagebaataacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa 'amaaleketocaacawene 'enedetegazaa lamiwatawetuhe 'agaariyaane <<'enaaneta sela geetaacehu yamaataawequ yahonaacehu hoye! lamahonu ka'alaahe wechi leelaane 'enedegazaa taazezunyaalaacehune? ka'alaahe weche 'ameleko yamigabaawe yalame. bamahonume ka'esu wechi leelaane 'alegazaame>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe wada 'aneta te'ezaaze 'aweredwale. 'enedihume kaaneta bafite wada nabarute male'eketanyoceme te`ezaaze 'aweredwale. 'esume ka'alaahe gaare leelaane bamaagaaraate yametaamaleke kahona yamalekaame szeraahe menedaa yetaabasaale. 'enedihume baduneyaa haayemaanotehene bamaathaate bamacharashaa qane dagemo seqaayenaa qethaate wesethe bamagebaate kakasaariwoce tehonaalahe.
yeleqese ba'esu laaye meneme saataagaaraa 'esune becaa tagazaa. bawaalaleheme malekaame welataa ka'amasegaanyoceme hune.

ka'alaahe gaare leelaane dakaamaanaa 'aqeme yaleelaacawe fethuraanene bamaagaaraataacawe mekeneyaate la'esu yamigabaawene maakebare 'alaakabaruteme. batachamaari ya'alaahene celotaa kamiyaamalaaketu nagaroce 'alaahe batenesaa'ee qane mederenenaa bawesethwa yaalutene chemere taraarocene, zaafocene, baaherocenenaa wanezocene bachebethu wesethe sabaatu samaayaatene baqanyu thaqelelo yeyezaacawaale. 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce kamilutenaa kamiyaamenute nagare tharaa laaqame.

baqanede 'enedinafaa yatawakalawe male'ake baminafaabate gizee basamaayaatenaa bamedere laaye yaalute hulu: yemotaalu; kaziyaame baxwaalaa male'aku leelaa hulatanyaa nefi mutaanene lamaqaseqase yenafaale; wadiyaaweme 'athaqaalaaye heyaawe honawe bamaqome 'alaahe ba'enasu laaye yamifatsemawene yethabaabaqaalu.

yaleqenaa baalabeete yahonawe geetaa babaarocu makaakale lamaferade bamimathaabate gizee medere taabaraalace; yasawoce yaszeraa mazegaboceme batagalathu gizee nabiyaatoce lahhezebocaacawe male'ekete 'enedaadarasu lamamasekare nabiyaatocenaa hhezebocaacawe 'enedimathu yedaragaale. 'alaaheme ba'athaqaalaaye bafethurocu makaakale bafetehe yefaredaale. 'enasu baziyaane qane yaaleszarute mathefo szeraa laaye bamachamare 'enaa kaszarute malekaame szeraa laaye bamaqanase 'ayebadelume.

'eyaanedaanedwa nafese yaszaraacewene mathefome yehune malekaame szeraa 'alaahe batamwalaa maleku yemanadaataale. 'alaahe yamiszarutene hulu yaaweqaale; 'alaahe kaszeraawocaacawe malekaamume mathefoweme meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. baziyaane qane 'enedayaszeraacawe yemanadaacawaale.

malaa'eketoce ba'alaahe yakaadutene sawoce yatakafaafalu sebeseboce honawe: wada gahaname yenadwacawaale; gahanameme 'enedadarasu lagahaname thebaqaa yatamadabute malaa'eketeme barwane yekafetulaacawaale. 'enasune bamatacateme <<yageetaacehune 'aneqatzoce yamiyaanabulaacehunaa yaziheneme qane (tenesaa'ee) maganaanyate bawesethume beretu qethaate manorune yamiyaasethanaqeqwaacehu yaraasaacehu wagane yahonu male'eketanyoce 'alemathulaacehumene?>> yelwacawaale. 'enaziyaa kahadiyaane yehenene bamaaragaagatheme <<yalame mathetathawelenaale>> yelaalu; <<yehunenaa yaqethaatu qaale bakahadiwoce laaye taragaagatha; 'enyaame kahadiwoce nabarene>> yelaalu.

'enasune lamaawaarade, ka'alaahe 'ezenate 'enaa ka'esaate 'enedamaayewathu tasefaa lamaaseqorathe lazalaalame nawaariwoce setehonu 'esaate wesethe gebu. ya'enaziyaa ka'ewenate yaraaqunaa kuraatanyoce menenyaa yakafaace manoriyaa naate yebaalaalu.

malaa'eketoceme 'enaziyaane yageetaacawene te'ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe geetaacawene yamifarute kebere yaalaacawe sebeseboce honawe wada janate qase belawe yenadwacawaale; janate 'enedadarasume wadiyaaweme barocwa yekafatulaacawaale; yatamadabuteme malaa'eketeme:: <<kagudaate 'enaa kametethalute hulu salaame yesefanebaacehu; lebocaacehunaa szeraawocaacehu 'amaaru! zalaalaame nawaariwoce setehonume janate gebu!>> yelwacawaale.

me'emanaane janate bagabu gizeeme <<bamale'eketanyoce 'anedabate janate lamaasegabaate qaale yagabaalenene lamolaalene yajanatene medere bamenefalegawe botaa 'enedenenore laawarasane 'alaahe: meseganaa yegabaawe>> yelaalu; 'enaziyaa malekaame szeraawocene bamaszeraate yageetaacawene fite yamifalegu yaszeraawocaacawe menedaa menenyaa yaamaara nawe.

malaa'eketoce batenesaa'eewe qane ba`aareshe zuriyaa yaakaababu yehonaalu. kahadiyaane 'alaahene kamigaletsute kamaayegabaawe baaheri yaatharutaale (yaalequtaale). 'alaahe baathaqaalaaye baarocu makaakale yamiyaakaberawene bamaakebare yamiqathaawene bamaqethaate bafetehenaa ba'ewenate yefaredaale. 'amaanye lahonu baarocu bamaazanenaa 'enaa kahadi yahonute baarocune qethaatene bamaqethaate lafaradawe la`aalamaatu geetaa 'alaahe mesegaanaa yegabaawe yebaalaale.
(Hm) <<hha mime>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe majamariyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)
bamale'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) laaye yawaradawene qure'aane maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi; labaarocu yamithaqemawene `aawaaqi kahonawe 'alaahe nawe yawaradawe.

yahathi'atanyocene hathi'ate mahari, kabaarocu neseha bamagebaate yamimalasutene neseha taqabaaye, kahathi'atu neseha yamaayegabaawene qethaata beretu, malekaame welataane yamiwele yaterufaate baalabeete nawe. ka'eresu basetaqare ba'ewenate yamimalake 'amelaake yalame. batenesaa'eewe qane yabaarocu mamalashaa wada 'eresu becaa nawe. huluneme yamigabaacawene yemanadaacawaale.

ya'alaahene becanyaa tamalaakinatenenaa yamale'eketanyocene 'ewenatanyenate yamiyaamalaaketu meleketocenaa ta`aameraatocene batamalakata yamikaraakaru 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yakaadute 'eneji maaneme 'ayekaraakareme. yeheme yahonawe 'a`emerwacawe beleshu bamahonu nawe. bamahonume 'atezanebaacawe. ba'enasu sisaaye masefaatenaa mathaqaaqame 'enedihume 'enasune darajaa badarajaa bamafatane lamayaaze maaqoyataacene 'ayeshanegelehe.

ka'enazihe 'agaariwoce bafite: yanuhhe hhezeboce 'asetabaabalu; kanuhhe hhezeboce baxwaalaa yamathuteme 'ahhezaaboce 'asetabaabalu;`aadoce,samudoce yaluthe hhezeboce, yamadeyane hhezebocenaa fire`one bamaasetabaabale 'eyaanedaanedu hhezebe male'eketanyaawene lamagedale 'asaba. 'enasu zanede kaalawe weshate 'ewenatene lamaabalaashate takaraakaru. 'enaziyaane hulu hhezeboce yaazekwaacawe;qethaatee 'enedeete 'enedanabara 'asetawele! baregetheme qethaatee beretu nabare.

'alaahe:'enaziyaane male'eketanyocene yaasetabaabalu hhezebocene lamaathefaate 'enedawasanawe hulu;'enedazihume 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yageetaahe qaale ba'enazihe kahadiyaane laaye 'enasu ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe bamaalate taragaagatha.

'enaziyaa yageetaacenene `areshe yamishakamute malaa'eketocenaa 'enaziyaame bazuriyaawe yaalute geetaacawene kamaayegabu baaheriyaate yaatharaalu (yaaleqaalu);ba'esume yaamenaalu;la'enaziyaa ba'alaahe laamanu sawoce:maaretaane bamalamane batamaatzenwacawe geetaacene hoye! nagarune hulu ba`eweqatehenaa ba`ezenate kabebahale. la'enaziyaa kahathi'atocaacawe bamatzatzate wada 'aneta yatamalasute 'enaa manegadehene yatakatalutene maaraacawe! ka'esaate qethaateme thabeqaacawe; yelaalu.

malaa'eketoceme <<geetaacene hoye! 'amaanyocene 'enedametaasegabaacawe qaale yagabaahelaacawene janate 'asegabaacawe. 'enedihume szeraacawene yaasaamarutene ka'abaatocaacawe; kabaalabeetocaacawenaa kalejocaacaweme 'asegabaacawe. 'aneta maaneme yamaayaashanefehe 'ashanaafi; bawesaaneehenaa bamaasetanaabarehe thebabanyaa nahe>>:yelaalu.

kamathefo szeraawocaacaweme kefaate thabeqaacawe; 'ateqethaacaweme. batenesaa'eewe qane bamathefo szeraawe baalamaqethaate yathabaqekawene sawe baregethe 'azanekelate;kaqethaate bamathabaqenaa janatene bamaasegabaate yaazanalate meneme yamaayewadaadarawe teleqe dele nawe.

'enaziyaa 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyocune yakaadute sawoce batenesaa'eewe qane 'esaate bamigabubate gizee 'enaa raasaacawene sithalunaa siragemu:<<duneyaa wesethe banabaraacehubate gizee ba'alaahe 'enedetaamenu setetharu bamakaadaacehunaa ka'esu wechi leelaane 'amelaake bamayaazaacehu zaaree nafesaacehune kametethalwate yabalatha:'alaahe la'enaaneta yaalawe thelaacaa yabarataa nawe>> tabelawe yetharaalu.

'enaziyaa kahadiyaane maamane bamaayethaqemebatenaa neseha taqabaayenate baleelabate qane hathi'ataacawene bamaamane <<geetaacene hoye! hulate gizee gadalekane;'esume kaalenabarenebate 'aseganyahane qathelo katafatharene baxwaalaa gadalekane; hulate gizeeme heyaawe 'adaragekane;yaame kaalenabarenebate 'aseganyakxanenaa latenesaa'eewe bamaqaseqase heyaawe 'adaragekane;yaszaraanaacawenehathi'atocaaceneme 'amenanaale;lamahonu ka'esaate bamawethaate wada duneyaa tamalesane szeraawocaacene 'asetakaakelane wedeetaahene 'enaaganye zanede yamenemalasebate manegade 'alane?!>> yelaalu.

yehe yataqathaacehute qethaate mekeneyaatu:duneyaa banabaraacehu gizee 'alaahe meneme tagaari saayenorawe babecanyenate batatharaa gizee:la'esu 'agaare bamaaderage bamakaadaacehu nawe. ka'alaahe gaare leelaa tagaari sidarage gene taamenaalaacehu;feredu ba'akaalume, bacelotaaweme bamaashanafeme yalaaqanaa taalaaqe lakxonawe 'alaahe becaa nawe.

'alaahe ba'ademaasenaa banafesaacehu ya'esune caayenatenaa 'amelaakenate yamigaletzu meleketocene yamiyaasaayaacehu 'esu nawe. kasamaaye yazenaabene weha yaawaredaale;bazihe zenaabe la'enaaneta sisaaye yamihonutene 'azere`etocenaa 'atekeletocene wazata. taaganyaalaacehu. ba'enazihe meleketoce wada 'alaahe baqenenate neseha bamagebaate yamimalasute 'eneji 'ayegasatzume.
'enaaneta me'emanaane szeraawocaacehunenaa lemanaacehune la'alaahe 'atheretaacehu meneme saataagaaru kahadiyaane 'enekwaa bithalu: 'esune becaa tamaatzanu.

szeraawocenenaa lemanaane 'atheretawe lifatsemulate yamigabaa nawe. 'esume yakafetanyaa darajaawoce kafethuraanu yataraaraaqa yataalaaqu `areshe baalabeete nawe. kabaarocu bafalagawe laaye raasaacawenenaa leelaawene heyaawe yamiyaadaregene raa`eye yamiyaawarede, yamajamariyaawocunaa yamacharashaawocu yamiganaanyubate yatenesaa'eene qane sawocene lamaasethaneqaqe 'aweredwale.

'enasu ba'anede meedaa laaye tasabesebawe geletze bamihonubate qane ba'alaahe laaye ka'akaalaacawe, kaszeraawocaacawenaa kamenedaawocaacawe meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. negeszenaawe yamaane nawe?! bamaalate yethayeqaale. bazaane qane 'anede melaashe becaa nawe. 'esume negeszenaa ba'akaalu, babaaheriwenaa batagebaaru 'anede lahonawe 'alaahe becaa nawe. huluneme baquthetheru sere yaadaraganaa la'esu hulume yatanaanasulate 'ashanaafiwe nawe.

bazaareewe qane nafese yaszaraacewene hulu theru yaszaraace bamalekaame,mathefo yaszaraaceme bamathefo temanadaalace. bazaareewe qane badale yalame. mekeneyaatume bafetehe faraaju 'alaahe nawenaa. 'alaahe huluneme ba`eweqatu yaakaababa bamahonu babaarocu mahakale gemegamaawe fathaane nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yatenesaa'eewene qane 'asethaneqeqaacawe; yehece tenesaa'ee machenaa qerebe naate mekeneyaatume wadafite yamimathaa hulu qerebe nawenaa. leboce kaqanu kebedate yatanasaa guroro laaye yamidaresubate gizee, 'are-raahhemaane yafaqadalate kaalehona basetaqare zeme yaalu sihonu 'ayenaagarume. lanaziyaa nafesaacawene basherekenaa bawanejale yabadalu wadaajeme zamademe yalaacaweme; 'amaalaaje bifaqadelaacaweme tasami 'amaalaaje yalaacaweme.
'eyasaraqace badebeqe yametemalakatene `aayene yaaweqaale; 'enedihume leboce yamidabequtene yaaweqaale; kazihe meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.

'alaaheme ba'ewenatenaa bafetehe yefaredaale. kamalekaame szeraawe bamaqanasenaa yaaleszaraawene hathi'aate bamachamare maaneneme 'ayebadeleme. 'enaziyaame 'agaariwoce ka'alaahe wechi yamiyaamalekwaacawe bameneme 'ayefaredume, mekeneyaatume meneme nagare yalaacawemenaa. 'alaahe 'eresu yabaarocune negegere sami; bahasaabaacawenaa szeraawocaacawene tamalekaace nawe. baziheme yemanadaacawaale.

'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce ka'enaresu bafite yanabarutene hhezeboce fetzaamee bamaasetawaale yemalakatu zanede bamedere laaye 'ayegwaazumene? macharashaacawe yakafaa nabare. 'enaziyaa hhezeboce baxaayele ka'enazihe yabaratu nabaru; bamedere laayeme bagenebaataa 'enazihenyocu yaalaasaarafutene 'ashaaraa 'asaarefawe heedu. 'alaaheme bahathi'atocaacawe mekeneyaate 'athafaacawe la'enasume ka'alaahe qethaate yamikalaakalelaacawe 'alenabaraacaweme.

yehe yaagaathamaacawe qethaate male'eketanyocaacawe geletze yahonu maaserajaawocenaa 'asedanaaqi ta`aameraatocene ka'alaahe yezawelaacawe bamimathu gizee 'alaahene bamakaade male'eketanyocene 'asetabaabalu. kanabaraacawe gulebatenaa xaayele 'alaahe yaazaacawenaa 'athafaacawe. 'alaahe 'esune yakaadutenaa male'eketanyocene yaasetabaabalu laaye thanekaaraanaa qethaata beretu nawe.

'enaziyaa yanabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) hhezeboce ba'asetabaabalwacawe gizee: 'alaahe yanabiyu musaa (`aalayehi salaame) kafire`one gaare yanabarawene taarike bamagelatse macharashaawe dele 'enedamihone bamaabesare 'edihe bamaalate galatza.
musaane geletze bahonu ta`aameraatocenaa maaserajaawoce baregetheme laakenawe.
wada fire`onenaa wada miniseteru hamaane 'enedihume qaarune laakenawe. 'enasume musaa male'eketanyaa nanye bamilawe nagare dagaami weshataame nawe 'alu.

musaa 'ewenatanyaa mahonune maaserajaa baamathaalaacaweme gizee fire`one ya'enaziyaa 'amaanyocene wanede lejocene gedalu seetocaacawene lamaawaarade sibaale 'aseqarwacawe 'alaacawe. ya'amaanyocene qutheraacawene lamaasaanase kahadiyaane yamiyaaseerute seeraa meneme tatze'eno saayefathere thafi tawagaaje bihone 'eneji 'enedihu 'ayeqareme.

fire`oneme:<<musaane 'esune lamaqethaate legedalawe tawenye! kanee yaadenawe 'enedahona geetaawene yelamene. 'enee geetaawene bamatheraatu gede yalanyeme;nagare gene yaalaacehubatene haayemaanote 'enedaayeqayerebaacehu wayeme medere laaye bagedeyaanaa bathefaate beleshunatene maasaraachatune nawe yamefaraawe>> 'ala.

musaame:fire`one mazaatune baawaqa gizee:<<'enee bageetaayeenaa bageetaacehu 'ewenatene laalamaqabalenaa ba'esu baalamaamane 'enedihume gemegamaanaa qethaate yaalabatene batenesaa'eewe qane kamaayaamenu kuraatanyoce hulu 'ethabaqaalahu>> 'ala.

kafire`oneme beetasabe hono ba'alaahe bamaamane 'emenatune kahhezebu yadabaqawe sawe:musaane lamagedale maasabaacawene bamaqaawamenaa bamaawegaze 'anedene sawe yaala meneme wanejale <<geetaayee 'alaahe nawe bamaalatu becaa tegadelaalaacehune? saweyeewe kageetaawe selamalaaku 'enaa 'ewenatanyaa selamahonu ta`aameraatocenenaa maaserajaawocene baregetheme 'amathaalaacehu. 'esu weshatune kahona gudaatu ba'esu laaye nawe;'ewenatanyaa kahona gene yamiyaasefaraaraacehu qethaate ba'asecakwaaye yaaganyaacexwaale. 'alaahe ya'esune denebare yamiyaalefutenenaa bamale'eketanyoce laaye yamiqathefutene wada 'ewenate manegade 'ayemaraame>>:'ala.

'enaaneta hhezebocee hoye! ba'ahunu gizee bagebetze medere laaye yaalaacehu negeszenaa geletze nawe. taadeyaa musaane bamagedale mekeneyaate ka'alaahe qethaate bimathaabene maane yeradaanaale? fire`one 'enedihe 'ala:: <<tanekolenenaa beleshunatene lamakalaakale sibaale musaa magadale 'enedaalabate wasenyaalahu. selahoname bazihe gudaaye laaye leelaa wesaanee yalame. bamahonume 'enee qanaanaa qathetanyaa wada honawe manegade 'eneji wada leelaa 'alemaraacehume.>>

yaame yaamanawe sawe hhezebune bamamekare 'enedihe 'ala:: <<musaane bagefe yametegadelute kahona ka'enaaneta bafite yanabarute 'ahhezaaboce male'eketanyocaacawene bamatanaakole ba'enasu laaye yatasabaasabu sawoce laaye qethaate 'enedaawaradawe hulu ba'enaaneta laaye qethaatene 'enedaayewaredebaacehu 'efaraalaacexwaalahu.>>

'enaziyaa yakaadunaa male'eketanyocene yaasetabaabalute lemaade `aayenate 'eneda nuhhe hhezeboce, `aadoce, samudocenaa ka'enasu baxwaalaa yamathuteme 'enazihene ba'alaahe bamakaadaacawenaa male'eketanyocene bamaasetabaabalaacawe mekeneyaate 'athafaacawe. 'alaahe labaarocu mabadalane yamishaa 'ayedalame;yamiqathaacaweme bahathi'ataacawe becaa nawe; tasemaami qethaatene yeqathaale.

hhezebocee hoye! 'enee tenesaa'eene 'efaraalaacaxwaalahu. yaame qane sawoce 'erese ba'eresaacawe yamitharaarubate qane nawe. zamade zamadune wayeme baalaselethaanune kazihe 'asedanegaache qane yamithaqemwacawe maselwacawe yamitharaarubate qane nawe.

ka'esaate bamaferaate wadaxwaalaa zoraacehu yameteshashubate qane ka'alaahe qethaate yamithabeqaacehu thabaaqi yalaacehume. 'alaahe yaawaaradawene wada 'emenate 'ayemaraaweme. wada qanaawe manegade yamimaraawe mari yalaweme. mekeneyaatume sekeetaamaa maaderage ba'alaahe 'eje selahona nawe.

kamusaa (`aalayehi salaame) bafite ba'eregetheme yusufe (`aalayehi salaame) ya'alaahene becanyaa 'amelaakenate yamigaletzu geletze maaserajaawocene 'amethetolaacehu nabare. kaziyaame 'esu yaamathaalaacehune nagare matharaatharenenaa maasetabaabalene 'aletawaacehume. bamotame gizee therethaareeyaacehu chamara. ka'esu baxwaalaa 'alaahe male'eketanyaane bacheraashe 'ayelekeme 'alaacehu. 'enaaneta ka'ewenate reqaacehu 'enedathamamaacehu hulu 'alaahe wasane 'alaafiwocenenaa ba'esu 'anedenate tatharaathaarine hulu yaathamemaale.

'enaziyaa ya'alaahene ta`aameraatoce meneme maaserajaa saayenoraacawe wedeqe lamaaderage yamikaraakarute kerekeraacawe 'alaahe zanedenaa 'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce yaamanute zanede 'ejege yatathalaa nawe. 'alaahe 'enaziyaane ta`aameraatocune wedeqe lamaaderage yamikaraakarutene lebocaacawe laaye 'enedaatamabaacawe hulu: 'enedazihu ba'enaziyaa 'ewenatene laalamaqabale yakoru leboce hulu laaye yaatemaale. bamahonume wada tekekelanyaawe manegade 'ayeqanume; wada malekaame nagareme 'ayemarume.
fire`one laminiseterume <<haamaane hoye! wada laaye mawethaate 'ecele zanede kafe yaala genebene ganebaalenye>> 'alawe.

baziheme genebaataa wada samaayaate lamaderasenaa musaame 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaake nawe belo yamilawene 'amelaakune lamaayate 'emokeraalahu;musaa yaminaagarawe weshate yemaselanyaale;bazihe malekume lahaamaane yehenene te`ezaaze bamaazazu kefu szeraawe tageethalate. baziheme yatanasaa ka'ewenate manegade wada themeete manegade zora. yafire`oneme tanekole weshatune yabalaaye lamaaderagenaa musaa yaamathaawene ya'ewenate manegade wedeqe lamaaderage bakisaaraa wesethe 'eneji 'ayedalame. mekeneyaatume yaszeraawe macharashaawe wedeqatenaa yamaayeqwaarathe weredate nawenaa.

kafire`one beetasabe yaamanawe:hhezebune bamamekarenaa wada 'ewenate manegade bamameraate:<<'enaaneta waganocee hoye! 'eneene takatalunye qathetanyaawenenaa 'ewenatanyaawene manegade 'emaraacexwaalahunaa>> 'ala.

waganocee hoye! yeheci qerebitu heyewate (duneyaa) mathaqaaqamiyaawaa theqite honaa yameteqwaarathe becaa naate. 'eswa zanede yaalawe thafi nagare 'ayaataalelaacehu. macharashaayetume `aalame wesethe baalawe zalaalamaawinaa yamaayeqwaarathe tzagaa maragaagiyaanaa yazawatere manoriyaa hagare naate. bamahonume 'alaahene bamataazazenaa ka'eswa yamiyaazanaagaacehuneme nagaroce bamathaneqaqe raaqu.

mathefo szeraane yaszaraa:'eneda szeraawe 'eneji 'ayemanadaame;basu laaye qethaate 'ayechamarebateme. wanedeme yehune seete ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce 'ameno malekaame szeraane yaszaraa sawe:'enaziyaa batamasagana baaheri yatagalatzute:batenesaa'eewe qane janatene yegabaalu. 'alaahe ba'eswa wesethe zalaalamaawinaa yamaayeqwaarathu yahonu yatalayaayu tzagaawocene yaala quthethere yesathaacawaale.

waganocee hoye! 'enee kaduneyaanaa ka'akxeeraa keserate ba'alaahe 'amenaacehunaa malekaame szeraane szaretaacehu wada madaane yametharaacehu sehone: 'enaaneta gene 'eneene 'alaahene bamakaadenaa bamaamatze 'esaate 'enedegabaa tesabekunyaalaacehu.

ba'alaahe 'enedekede 'enaa ka'esu gaare leelaa 'amelaake selamanoru maaragaagachaa saayenoranye ba'esu 'enedaagaaraa taazezunyaalaacehu;'eneeme maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi, labaarocu mahari bahonawe 'alaahe 'enedetaamenu 'etharaacexwaalahu.

ba'eregethe 'enaaneta 'enedaamenebatenaa 'enedetaazazawe yametesabekunye thaa`ote la'eresu baqerebitume kxona bamacharashaayetu `aalame ba'ewenate yamitharaabate theri yalaweme. 'enyaa ba'athaqaalaaye baregethe mamalashaacene wada 'alaahe becaa nawe. 'enaziyaa bakehedatenaa bawanejale wasane 'alaafiwoceme 'enasu batenesaa'eewe qane 'esaate bamagebaate yamaayelaaqaqu ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe.

mekerune 'aletaqabalumenaa 'enee yaaqarabekulaacehune mekere baalamaqabalaacehu bamatzatzate lawadafitu taasetaawesaalaacehu. gudaayeene bamulu wada 'alaahe becaa 'asethagaalahu 'ala. 'alaahe baarocune tamalekaace nawe;kaszeraawocaacawe meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.

'esune lamagedale baasabume gizee: 'alaahe ka'enasu tanekole 'enaa seeraa thabaqawe. bafire`one takataayoceme laaye baduneyaa yaweha masemathe qethaate 'akaababaacawe. 'esunenaa szaraawitune weha wesethe 'asathamaacawe.

kamotu baxwaalaame baqaberocaacawe wesethe 'esaate laaye thawaatenaa maataa yeqarebaalu. batenesaa'eeme qane yafire`one takataayocene beretunaa kabaade qethaatene 'asegabwacawe:yebaalaale. mekeneyaatume 'enasu bakehedate, bamaasetabaabalenaa ka'alaahe manegade sawocene yaagedu nabarenaa.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa ka'esaate gwaadoce yahonu 'asekataayocenaa takataayoce bamikaraakarute gizee 'asetaawese. takataayoceme dakaamoce kuraatanyaa 'asekataayocene <<'enyaa baduneyaa `aalame 'enaanetane bathememate manegade takataayoce nabarene. lamahonuse ka'alaahe yatawasanawene qethaate kanyaa laaye bamashakame taawaathunaalaacehune?>> yelaalu.

'enaziyaa guranyaa mariwoceme <<'enyaame hone 'enaaneta ('asekataayocenaa takataayoce) hulaaceneme 'esaate wesethe nane. 'anedu yaleelaawene qethaate 'ayeshakameme. 'alaahe huluneme yamigabaawene qethaate bamasethate babaarocu makaakale ferede sathetwale>> yelaalu.

'enaziyaame 'esaate wesethe yamiqathute takataayocenaa 'asekataayoce ka'esaate mawethaatenenaa wada duneyaa bamamalase neseha 'enedamaayaaganyu tasefaa baqorathu gizee:la'esaate zabanyoce <<geetaacehune zalaalamaawi kahonawe qethaate 'anede qane 'enediyaaqalelene lamenulene>> yelaalu.

yajahaname 'esaate thabaaqiwoce: lakahadiyaane melaashe bamasethate lamahonu male'eketanyocaacehu geletze yahonu maaserajaawoce 'alaamathulaacehumene?! yelwacawaale. kahadiyaaneme:'awone! geletze yahonu maaserajaawoce yezawelene mathetawaale:yelaalu. zabanyocume bamaashofe 'enaaneta raasaacehu lamenu 'enyaa lakahadiyaane 'amaalaajoce 'anehoneme. yakahadiyaane lemanaa wedeqenaa thefaate 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame. mekeneyaatume kahadi bamahonaacawe taqabaayenate yalaweme.

'alaahe yafire`owenene taarike, yafire`aawenenaa takataayocu baduneyaanaa ba'akxeeraa macharashaacawe mene 'enedahona kagalatza baxwaalaa male'eketanyocenaa 'amaanyoce baduneyaanaa ba'akxeeraa yamiyaagaathemaacawene dele bamagelatze:
'enyaa male'eketanyocaacenenaa ba'alaahenenaa bamale'eketanyoce yaamanutene baduneyaa maaserajaacawene geletze bamaaderagenaa 'enasune bathalaatoce laaye dele bamaaqadaajate, batenesaa'eewe qane dagemo 'enasune bamaredaate janate 'enaasegabaacawaalane. thalaatocaacawene baduneyaa bamaqethaate ba'akxeeraa 'ewenatanyaa nabiyaatocenaa malaa'ekete male'ekete maaderasaacawenenaa hhezeboce maasetabaabalaacawene kamasakaru baxwaalaa 'esaate wesethe yaasegabaacawaale.

'enaziyaa bakehedatenaa bawanejale nafesaacawene yabadalu mekeneyaataacawe yamaayethaqemaacawe qane nawe. la'enaresu bazaane qane ka'alaahe 'ezenate bamabaarare bamacharashaawe qane bamiyaagaathemaacawe 'asaamaami qethaate mathefo hagare 'alalaacawe.

musaane (`aalayehi salaame) ta`aameraatenenaa ya'eseraa'eele lejoce wada 'ewenate yamimarubatene `eweqate sathanawe. ya'eseraa'eele lejoce 'erese baraasaacawe katewelede tewelede yamiwaraarasute yataweraatene matsehhafe 'asewarasenaacawe.
wada 'ewenate manegade yamimaraanaa beruhe 'a`emero laalaacawe tagesaatzenaa mekere 'adaragenawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kawaganocehe bamiyaagaathemehe maasetabaabale taagase. 'alaahe laaneta qaale yagabaalehe delenaa 'eredaataa 'ewenate nawe therethaaree yalaweme. lahathi'ateheme maaretaane thayeqe. geetaahene kamesegaanaa gaare bamaatheraate (bamaalaaqe) yaqanu macharashaanaa majamariyaa laaye 'awadese.

'enaziyaa ya'alaahene 'aneqatzocenenaa meleketocene yaala maaserajaa wedeqe lamaaderage bamaneqasaaqase yamikaraakaru yehenene lamaaderage yamiyaanasaabaacawe nagare binore yabalaayenatene lamagonaatzafe 'enaa 'ewenatene laalamaqabale bamakuraate 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame;wada 'eziyaa yabalaayenate lamaderaseme 'ayecelume. bamahonume 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'alaahe tathabaqe. 'enaho 'esu yabaarocune negegere sami; szeraawocaacawene tamalekaace meneme 'ayaamalethaweme; baszeraawocaacaweme yemanadaacawaale.

samaayaatenaa mederene kataalaaqenataacawenaa sefaataacaweme gaare mafethare yasawe lejene kamafethare yeleqe taalaaqe nawe. 'enazihene taalaalaaqe kamahonaacaweme gaare yafathara mutaanene kamaqaaberocaacawe lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa heyaawe maaderage caaye nawe. nagare gene 'abezaanyaawoce sawoce 'ayaawequme. baziheme 'ayegasatzume. yehenene kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase 'enedaala 'enedamaaserajaa 'ayethaqamubateme.

yamiyaaye sawenaa yamaayaaye sawe 'ekule 'ayedalume. 'enedihume 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanunaa bamale'eketanyoce yaamanunaa malekaame szeraane yaszaru ka'enaziyaa kamathefo 'emenataacawenaa hathi'ataacawe gaare mathefone szeraane kaszaru gaare 'ekule 'ayedalume theqiteneme 'ateganazabume. beteganazabumaa noro bahulatu makaakale yaalawene leyunate 'aweqaacehu ka'enaziyaa ya'alaahene wedeetaa falegawe ba'alaahe 'amenawe malekaame szeraane kamiszaru sawoce tehonu nabare.

sa`aatitu (tenesaa'eewe) yaaci mutaanene lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa yamiqasaqasebaate qane yaalameneme therethaaree machi naate. nagare gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce mamethaatwane 'ayaamenume. baziheme mekeneyaate ba'emenatenaa bamalekaame szeraa 'ayezagaajume.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! geetaacehu 'eneene becaa lamenunye; 'eneene becaa tagazunye. lalemanaacehu melaashe 'esathaacexwaalahu; yeqereme 'elaacexwaalahu; meherateneme 'elagesaacexwaalahu. 'enaziyaa 'eneene babecanyenate kamagazaate yamikoru batenesaa'eewe qane jahaname tawaaredawe yegabaalu.

'alaahe lalitene tesakenubatenaa taarefubate zanede chalamaa 'adaragalaacehu;qanene dage szeraa teszarubate zanede berehaane 'adaragalaacehu. 'alaahe babaarocu laaye tzagaawene bageletzeme badebeqeme bamaamwalaate yataalaaqe terufaate baalabeete nawe. nagare gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce selawaalalaacawe welataa 'alaahene 'ayaamasagenume.

yehenene tzagaa yawaalalaacehu 'alaahe nawe;yahulume nagaroce fathaari nawe. ka'esu wechi leelaa fathaari yalame;ba'ewenate yamigazute ka'esu wechi leelaa yalame. yehe hono saala 'enaaneta 'enedeete 'esune kamagazaate meneme yamaayethaqemunaa yamaayegodu yahonutene wada magazaate tezoraalaacehune?

'enaziyaa sawoce 'alaahene kamaamanenaa 'esune babecanyenate kamagegazaate 'enedazoru hulu:'enaziyaane ya'alaahene becanyaa tamalaakinatene kamiyaasaayu meleketoce bamaanenyaaweme gizeenaa bayatenyaaweme botaa yamiyaasetabaabelu hulu wada 'ewenate 'ayemarume, wada qathetanyaawe manegademe 'ayeqanume.

'enaaneta sawoce 'alaahe la'enaaneta mederene 'enedetenorubaate yataragaagaace 'adaragalaacehu. samaayene dagemo kabalaayaacehu yathanakarace genebe bamaaderage ba'enaaneta laaye kamawedaqe yatathabaqace, ba'enaatocaacehu maahetzane 'asaamero qaratzaacehu, therunaa thaafaache sisaayene sathaacehu. 'enazihene hulu tzagaawoce yasathaacehu geetaacehu 'alaahe nawe. yafethuraane hulu geetaa yahonawe 'alaahe laaqa; ka'eresu wechi leelaa geetaa yalaacehume.

'esu yamaayemote heyaawe nawe;ka'esu wechi ba'ewenate leelaa 'amelaake yalame. ya'esune fite falegaacehu 'esune lamenute 'esuneme tagazu. ka'esu gaare leelaane 'ataagaaru;mesegaanaa yafethuraanu hulu geetaa lahonawe 'alaahe yatagabaa nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe 'eneene 'enaziyaane ka'alaahe wechi yametegazwacawene meneme yamaayethaqemunaa kagudaate yamaayekalaakalu 'amelekotaacawe wedeqe mahonu geletze yahonu maaserajaawoce kamathulenye baxwaalaa thaa`otaatene 'enedaalegazaa ('enedaalaamaleke) takalekeyaalahu balaacawe. 'alaahe la'esu 'eje bamasethate 'enedegazaawe 'azezonyaale;'esu yafethuraane hulu geetaa nawe;ka'esu wechi leelaa geetaa yalaacaweme.

'alaahe 'abaataacehune 'adamene ka'afare fathara;kaziyaa baxwaalaa ya'enaanetane 'afathaathare kafetewate thabetaa, kafetewate thabetaa baxwaalaa:karagaa dame kaziyaame baxwaalaa ka'enaataacehu hode teneshe hetzaane 'aderego 'asewathaacehu. kaziyaame latamwalaa ya'akaale thenekaaree darajaa laaye tedaresaalaacehu, kaziyaame 'adegaacehu shemaageleewoce tehonaalaacehu. kanaanetame wesethe 'ezihe kamaderasu bafite yamimote 'ala;yaa ba'alaahe yatawasanawene gizee bamaderase ka'esu meneme 'ayeqanasebaacehume;'enedihume 'ayechamarelaacehume. ba'enaziheme meleketocunaa maaserajaawocu ya'alaahene caayenatenaa becanyenate 'enedeteradu yehenene yegaletsaale.
hheyaawe maaderage 'enaa magedale ba'alaahe 'eje becaa nawe. 'esu 'anedene nagare kawasana la'eresu <<hune>> yelawenaa wadiyaawe yehonaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enanyaa ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce geletze kamahonaacawe gaare bamaasetabaabale yamikaraakarutene 'ayetahalene? 'ewenatu geletze kamahonu gaare ka'ewenate 'enedeete yezoraalu? huneetaacawe 'ayegarememe?!
'enaziyaa baqure'aanenaa male'eketanyocaacenene balaakenawe 'ewenate yamiyaasetabaabelu yamaasetabaabalaacawene macharashaa saayaawequte 'ayeqarume. yamacharashaacawe kefunateneme yaayaalu.
yamacharashaacawene huneetaa 'anegatocaacawe laaye gamadoce, 'egerocaacaweme laaye sanesalatoce bamaaderage yaqethaate zabanyoce bamigotetwacawe gizee yaaweqaalu.
'ejege yafalaa weha wesethe yegotataalu;kaziyaame 'esaate wesethe yeqaathalaalu.
'enasune bamaweqaseme <<'enaziyaa ba'alaahe 'ameleko laaye setaagaarwacawe yanabarute 'amaalekete tabeyeewoce yate 'alu?>> yebaalaalu.

<<ka'alaahe wechi meneme yamaayethaqemunaa kagudaate yamaayekalaakalu thaa`otocaacehu yate 'alu?>> kahadiyaaneme <<ka'enyaa reqawaale 'anaayaacaweme. yelequne baduneyaa wesethe 'ameleko yamigabaawene meneme 'aletagazaaneme>> yelaalu. 'enazihene 'enedaathamamawe hulu bamaanenyaaweme gizeenaa bayatenyaaweme botaa yaalutene kahadiyaane ka'ewenate yaathamaale (yaasaasetaale).
'enediheme yebaalaalu:: yehe yameteqathute qethaate mekeneyaatu ba'alaahe maagaaraate laaye honaacehu tedasatu nabare. 'enedihume tenebathaararunaa tekoru nabaraacehu.
jahaname wesethe lazalaalame nawaariwoce setehonu babarocwa gebu;kuraatanyoce yaminorubaate manoriyaa menenyaa kafaace!

male'eketanyaawe kawaganocaacawe yamiyaagaathemaacawene cegere 'alaahe 'eneditaagasu bamaazaze kaziyaame 'esaacawene bamaatzenaanaate yamiradaacawe mahonune qaale bamagebaate:
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! waganocehe yamiyaadaresubehene cegere 'enaa maasetabaabale taagase. 'anetane lamaredaate 'alaahe laaneta yagabaalehe qaale meneme therethaaree yaleelabate 'ewenate nawe. 'aneta baheyewate 'eyaalahe la'enaziyaa kahadiyaane yazaatenebaacawene 'anedaanedune qethaate (badere zamacaa laaye 'enedatakasatawe) benaasaayehe wayeme 'anetane yehenene saanaasaayehe benegadelehe batenesaa'eewe qane wada 'enyaa becaa selamimalasu waagaacawene 'enesathaacawaalane wadiyaaweme jahaname wesethe bamaasegabaate lazalaalame 'enediqathu 'enaadaregaalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'aneta bafite bezu male'eketanyoce wada hhezebocaacawe baregetheme lekanaale. hhezebocu male'eketanyocaacawene 'asecagarwacawe, 'enedihume 'asetabaabalwacawe. nagare gene cegerunenaa masetabaabalune bate`egesete tawathute. ka'enaziheme male'eketanyoce makaakale taarikaacawene yatarakenelehe 'alu. ka'enaresume taarikaacaweneme yaaletarakenelehe 'alu. maanenyaaweme male'eketanyaa ba'alaahe kalehona basetaqare ta`aamere liyaamathaa 'ayegabaaweme. kahadiyaane male'eketanyocaacawene ta`aamere 'enediyaamathu mathayaqaacawe tagabi 'ayedalame. dele magonaatzafe 'aliyaame bamale'eketanyocenaa bahhezebocaacawe makaakale yefarede zanede ya'alaahe wesaanee simathaa bafetehe yefaredaale. kahadiyaaneme yethafaalu. male'eketanyoce yedenaalu. 'alaahe babaarocu makaakale bamifaredebate `elateme yawedeqe manegade baalabeetoce nafesaacawene bakehedate mekeneyaate thefaate laaye yathaalu sawoce yekaseraalu.
'alaahe la'enaaneta gemalene, kabetene, feyalenenaa bagene yatawasanutene lamagwaagwaazhaa, leelocene dagemo lamamagabe fatharalaacehu.

la'enaanetame banazihe fethuroce wesethe bayagizeewe 'adaadise yahonu yatalayaayu theqemoce 'alalaacehu. bawesethaacehu yametaasebutene gudaaye lamaasaakaate tethaqamubaacawaalaacehu. katheqemocume makaakale bayabeseme babaahhereme magwaagwaazaacehu nawe.

ya'esune caayenatenenaa becanyaa tamalaakinatene yamiyaamalaaketu ta`aameraatuneme yaasaayaacexwaale. 'enaaneta zanede ta`aameraatocu kataragaagathu baxwaalaa taadiyaa ka'alaahe ta`aameraate yatenyaawene yametekedute?

'enaziyaa ka'enasu bafite yanabarute yaasetabaabalute hhezeboce fetzaamee 'enedeete 'enedanabara yemalakatu zanede bamedere laaye 'ayegwaazumene? 'enaziyaa hhezeboce ka'enaresu yebalethe baalahabete, baxaayele bakule thanekaaroce, medere laaye tatze'eno bamaasaadarenaa 'ashaaraa bamathaale beretuwoce nabaru. bihoneme gene 'athefi yahonawe ya'alaahe qethaate bamathaabaacawe gizee yeszarute yanabarute meneme 'alethaqamaacaweme.

male'eketanyocaacaweme geletze yahonu maaserajaawocenaa ta`aameraatocene baamathulaacawe gizee 'asetabaabalu. male'eketanyocaacawe kaamathulaacaweme bataqaaraani 'enasu zanede yaalawene `eweqate bamayaaze koru. siyaashofubate 'enaa male'eketanyocaacawe siyaathanaqeqwaacawe yanabarute qethaateme ba'enasu laaye waradabaacawe.

qethaataaceneneme baayu gizee maamane bamaayethaqemebate gizee bamaamane ba'alaahe becaa 'amenanaale; ka'alaahe weche bamaagaaraate senegazaacawe yanabarutene thaa`otaatenaa 'agaarocune kedanaale 'alu.

qethaataacenene baayu gizee maamanaacawe yamithaqemaacawe 'alenabarame. ya'alaahene qethaate baayu gizee 'enedamaayethaqemaacawe kazihe bafite 'alaahe babaarocu laaye yaasaalafawe wesaanee nawe. kahadiyaane ba'alaahe bamakaadaacawenaa 'esaatene kamamalekataacawe bafite neseha baalamagebaataacawe yatanasaa:ya'alaahe qethaate simathaabaacawe raasaacawene thefaate laaye bamathaale nafesaacawene 'akasaru ('athu).
(Hm) <<hha mime>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe majamariyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)
yehe qure'aane yawaradawe 'azaanyenaa reheruhe kahonawe 'alaahe nawe.

mulunaa batamwalaa maleku 'aneqatzocu yatagalatzubate matsehhafe nawe. ba`aarabenyaa qwaaneqwaa yaminababe sihone lamiyaawequ sawoce yatagalatza nawe. bamale`eketunaa wesethu baaqafawe wada 'ewenate bamimaraawe mamariyaa tathaqaamiwocu 'enaresu naacawe.

lame'emanaane 'alaahe yaazagaajalaacawene malekaame menedaane yamiyaabasere, kahadiyaanene ka'asaamaamiwe ya'alaahe qethaate yamiyaasefaraaraa nawe;honome 'abezaanyaawocu celaa 'alute. 'eresu yayaazawene meraacaa yamaqabalene masemaate 'ayesamume.

'aneta theri yametaadaregelenene nagare lamaradaate lebocaacene bashefaane taqolefwalenaa 'ayegabaaneme; bajorowocaaceneme laaye denequrenaa 'alanaa 'anesamaame; ba'enyaanaa baanetame makaakale geredoshe 'alanaa yametenaagarawe 'enyaa zanede meneme 'ayedareseme;'aneta baraasehe manegade szeraa; 'enyaame baraasaacene manegade 'eneszaraalane;'anetane 'anekataleme:'alu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye!'enaziyaa getere yahonutene kahadiyaane: <<'enee 'eneda 'enaaneta sawe nanye; 'ewenatanyaa 'amelaakaacehu 'anede 'amelaake becaa nawe yamile te`ezaaze talaalefolenyaale. bamahonume 'amelekotaacehune la'esu becaa 'aderegu. ka'esume lahathi'ataacehu maaretaane thayequ. la'enaziyaa ba'alaahe bamaagaaraate leelaane yamigazu 'agaariwoce geletse yahona keserate taragaagathabaacawe wayolaacawe.>>
'enaziyaa yaganezabaacawene metzewaate yamaayesathu 'enasume bamacharashaawe qane bawesethu bayaazawe zalaalamaawi tzagaanenaa 'asaamaami qethaate kahadi naacawe.
'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce yaamanunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru yamaayeqwaarathe zalaalamaawi menedaa bajanate wesethe 'alalaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'agaariwocene bamakonane <<'enaaneta baziyaa mederene bahulate qane ('ehudenaa sanyo) wesethe yafatharawene'alaahene lamene tekedaalaacehu? la'eresume ka'esu wechi leelocu baalaanethaawocene taadaregulataalaacehune? yaa yafethuraane hulu geetaa nawe.>>

bamedere laayeme yatzanu taraarocene bamaaderage 'enedaatewaazheqe 'adaragaate. mathayaqe lamifalegu thayaaqiwoceme bawesethwame lasawocenaa la'enesesoce yamihonu megebocene barakate bamaaderage kaalafute hulate qanaate gaare (maakesanyonaa rabu`ene chamero) ba'araate 'ekule qanaatoce wesethe fathara.

kaziyaame samaayene wada mafethare 'amaraa. baziyaane gizee 'eswa chese nabarace. samaayaatenenaa medereneme meneme 'amaaraache yalaacehumenaa faqedaacehume hona saatefaqedu te`ezaazeene takatalu 'alaacawe. 'enasume faqedane taazaazhoce nane;'aneta kafalagawe wechi leelaa felaagote yalaneme 'alu.

'alaahe samaayaatene bahulate qanaate (hhamusenaa jume`aa) fathero charasa;baziheme maszarate samaayaatenaa mederene basedesete qanaate fathero 'athanaaqaqa;'eyaanedaanedume samaayeme yamiwasenawene 'enaa yamiyaazaacawene 'amelekonaa te`ezaazocene 'awarada. yaduneyaa (qerebitwane) samaayeneme bakawaakebete 'asegeethenaate; shayethwanoce wada samaaye bamawethaate 'enedaayesamu thabaqenaate. 'enazihe kalaaye yatagalatzute hulu maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi; sela fethuraanu hulu `aawaaqi yahonawe geetaa wesaanee nawe.

'enazihe 'aneta yaamathaakxawene maamane celaa yamilu kahona:'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bahude hhezeboce `aade 'enaa baswalihe hhezeboce 'enedihume samude laaye baasetabaabalute hulu qethaate 'enedaawaradawe ba'enaanetame laaye qethaate 'enedaayewaredebaacehu 'asethanaqeqaacexwaalahu balaacawe.

ka'alaahe basetaqare leelaane 'ategazu bamile ba'anede `aayenate qaale male'eketanyoce bamathulaacawe gizee:ka'enanyaa kahadiyaane makaakale 'alaahe male'eketanyaane maawerade bifalege noro malaa'eketocene wada 'enyaa yaawarede nabare. 'enyaa 'enaaneta yatalaakaacehubatene nagare kedanaale;mekeneyaatume 'enaaneta 'enedanyaa sawoce naacehunaa 'alu.

yahude hhezeboce `aademe:'alaahene kamakaadaacawe gaare yaala 'agebaabe bamedere wesethe koru; bazuriyaacawe yaalutene badalu; bagulebataacaweme bamataalale ka'enyaa balaaye xaayele yaalawe beretu maane 'ala? ba'enasu 'abaabaale ka'enasu balaaye xaayele yaalawe yalame. 'alaahe la'enasu melaashe sisathe 'enaziyaa sawoce 'enasune yafatharaacawenenaa denebare 'enediyaalefu yaadaragaacawene xaayele yasathaacawe 'alaahe ka'enasu balaaye xaayele yaalawe beretu mahonune 'ayaawequmene? 'enasume hude yaamathaalaacawene ta`aameraatoceneme yekedu nabare.

ba'enasu laaye yamirabeshe demetzene yaaqafa nefaase kefu bahonu qanaate wesethe laakenebaacawe. yehene yaadaragenawe yaweredate qethaate lenaaqamesaacawe nawe. yaa yamithabeqaacawe yamacharashaawe `aalame qethaate bathaame 'enasune 'awaaraaje nawe. 'enasune kaqethaate bamaadaane yamiradaacawe maaneme 'ayaaganyume.

yaswalihhe hhezeboce samadocemaa ya'ewenatune manegade bamagelatze maraanaacawe. wada 'ewenate kamamaraate yeleqe themeetene 'asebalathunaa marathu. yeszaruteme banabarute kehedatenaa wanejale 'awaaraaje bahona qethaate yaazenaacawe.
'enanyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce yaamanutene: te'e`ezaazune bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene yefaru yanabarutene bahhezebocaacawe laaye kadarasawe qethaate 'adaanenaacawe.
ya'alaaheme thalaatoce wada 'esaate bamisabasabubate qane malaa'eketoce yamacharashaawocu 'esekimathu derase yamajamariyaawocune yaagetwacawaale;ka'esaateme maamelathe 'ayecelume.

'eyatanadu wada 'esaate simathu baduneyaa yeszarute yanabarutene szeraawoce baasetabaabalume gizee jorowocaacawe, `aayenocaacawenaa qodaawocaacaweme baduneyaa yeszarute yanabarutene kehedatenaa wanejale ba'enaresu laaye yemasakerubaacawaale.

kahadiyaaneme laqodaawocaacawe: <<baduneyaa seneszaraa yanabarenawene lamene temasakerubenaalaacehu?!>> yelaalu. qodaawoceme labaalabeetocu malese bamasethate <<huluneme nagaroce maanaagare yamicelawe 'alaahe 'enedenenaagare 'adaragane. duneyaa laaye banabaraacehubate gizee bamajamariyaa yafatharaacehu 'esu nawe. bamacharashaayetume qane lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa wada 'esu becaa temalasaalaacehu>> yelwacawaale.

hathi'atene bameteszarubate gizee jorowocaacehu, `aayenocaacehunaa qodaawocaacehu 'enedaayemasakerubaacehu yametedabaqu 'alenabaraacehume. mekeneyaatume kamote baxwaalaa bagemegamaa, baqethaatenaa bamenedaa 'ataamenumenaa. nagare gene 'enaaneta 'alaahe yameteszarutene bezuwene 'ayaaweqeme yelequne yesawarebataale bamaalate tatharaatharaacehu; bamahonume tashanagalaacehu.
yehe sela geetaacehu yatatharaatharaacehute mathefo therethaaree 'athafaacehu. baziheme mekeneyaate baduneyaanaa ba'akxeeraa kamikaserute honaacehu.

'enaziyaa jorowocaacawe, `aayenocaacawenaa qodaawocaacawe yamasakarubaacawe sawoce bitaagasume:'esaate la'enaresu yaminorubaate manoriyaacawe naate. ya'alaahene wedeetaa lamaagenyatenaa janate lamagebaate bithayequme ya'alaahene wedeetaame hona janate magebaatene bafetsume 'ayaaganyume.

ba'enazihe kahadiyaane laaye kashayethwanoce yamaayelayewaacawe quraanyaawocene 'azagaajanelaacawe;'enasume kehedatene, hathi'atocene, kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasenenaa mamanedaatene maasetabaabalene shalamulaacawe ('ageethulaacawe). kagaaneenenaa saweme ka'enasu bafite baregethe kaalafute hhezeboce gaare honawe yaqethaate qaala-wesaanee taragaagathabaacawe. 'enasu batenesaa'eewe qane 'esaate bamagebaate nafesaacawenenaa beetasabocaacawene yaathu kasaariwoce honu.

'enanyaa kahadiyaaneme 'ewenatanyaa maaserajaane lamaqwaaqwaame baalamacaalaacawe 'erese baraasaacawe bamamakaakare (muhhamade ba'enaaneta laaye yamiyaanabawene qure'aane 'ataadaamethu; 'esu wesethe baalawe te`ezaazeme 'atetaazazu; siyaanabelaacehume demetzaacehune kafe 'aderegaacehu tanechaachu (chukxu) bazihe maleku teratutaalaacehu. maanebabunenaa masebakune yetawawenaa baziheme maleku 'erafete 'enaaganyaalane>>:'alu.

'enanyaane ba'alaahe yakaadutenenaa male'eketanyocene yaasetabaabalutene yatenesaa'eewe qane beretu yahona qethaate 'enaaqamesaacawaalane. 'enaziyaaneme yeszarute yanabarutene maagaaraatenenaa hathi'atene 'enasune lamaqethaate bamathefo menedaa 'enemanadaacawaalane.

yehe yatathaqasawe menedaa ya'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yakaadunaa male'eketanyocene yaasetabaabalu ya'alaahe thalaatoce menedaa 'esaate naate. fetsume yamaayeqwaarathe yazalaalame manoriyaa 'agare naate. ya'alaahe 'aneqatzoce geletzenaa thanekaaraa maaserajaa kamahonaacaweme gaare yekedunaa yaasetabaabelu selanabaru 'esaatene manadaanaacawe.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yakaadunaa male'eketanyocene yaasetabaabalu:geetaacene 'enaziyaane kagaaneenenaa kasawe honawe yaasaasaatunene, kehedatenenaa wada kehedate mathaaraatene yaasetamaarawene shayethwanene 'enaa gedeyaa yajamarawene ya'adaame lejene 'esaate wesethe ka'egerocaacene szere bamaaderage kataacenyocu kabaade qethaate kamiqathu ya'esaate sawoce yehonu zanede 'asaayane yelaalu.

'alaahe yathalaatocune menedaa kagalatza baxwaalaa: yawadaajocune menedaa sigaletse:
'enanyaa geetaacene 'alaahe nawe; ka'esu wechi leelaa geetaa yalaneme bamaalate te`ezaazune bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale qathe yaalute mote 'afaafe laaye sihonu malaa'eketoce bamawerade kamote 'enaa kamote baxwaalaa yaalawene 'ateferu, baduneyaa sela tawaacehute nagare 'atezanu! ba'alaahe bamaamanenaa malekaame szeraane bamaszeraataacehu baduneyaa qaale yatagabaalaacehu janate dase yebalaacehu yelwacawaale.

'enyaa baduneyaa heyewate radaatocaacehu nane; wada tekekelanyaa manegade 'enemaraacehunaa 'enethabeqaacehu nabare. ba'akxeeraame radaatocaacehu nane; radaatenataacene qathaaye nawe. bajanate wesethe nafesaacehu yameteshaawene hulu thaafaachocenaa semeetoce tazagaajetolaacexwaale. ba'eswa wesetheme yametefalegute hulu 'alaacehu.
wada 'esu neseha bamaaderage yamimalasu baarocune mahari: la'enasu 'azaanye kahonawe yatazagaaja sisaaye nawe.
