wada 'alaahe 'anedenatenaa badenegaageewe 'enediszaru kamithaaraa, geetaawene lamaasewadade malekaame szeraane kaszaraa; <<'enee la'alaahe te`ezaaze 'eje kasathute nanye>> kaala sawe yebalethe qaalu yaamaara maane 'ala? 'enazihene hulu yaszaraa kasawoce hulu negegeru yaamaara nawe.

'alaahene yamiyaasewadedu malekaame szeraawocene maszeraate 'enaa 'esune yamiyaaseqothu mathefo szeraawocene maszeraate 'ekule 'ayedalume. kasawoce baaneta laaye kefu nagarene bifatzemabehe bamalekaame tzabaaye mathefone takalaakale. yaane gizee baaneta 'enaa ba'esu makaakale yanabarawe yaalafa thalaatenate mathefowene bamalekaame katakalaakaleke 'esu leke 'eneda 'azaanye zamade yehonaale.

lazihece mesegune lahonace tzabaaye 'enaziyaa bamiyaagaathemaacawe cegerenaa kasawoce bamigathemaacawe kefu nagare taagaashoce 'eneji leelaawe 'ayaaganyaateme. 'enedihume yateleqe `edele baalabeete yahonu 'eneji maaneme 'ayegathemaateme. mekeneyaatume bawesethwa yaalawe bezu malekaamenaa thaqaami nagaroce yayaazace bamahonwa.
`eshayethwane bayatenyaaweme gizee bamathefo nagare bigotagutehe ba'alaahe tathabaqe tathagaame. 'esu yametenaagarawene sami huneetaahene `aawaaqi nawenaa.

ya'alaahene taalaaqenatenaa 'anedenatene kamiyaamalaaketu meleketoce makaakale yalalitenaa qane mafaraaraqe, tzahhayenaa charaqaa naacawe. 'enaaneta sawoce latzahhayeme lacharaqaame 'atesegadu. 'enasune lafatharaacawe 'alaahe becaa segadu 'eresune ba'ewenate yametegazu kahona laleelaa 'atesegadu.
bikorunaa bitawe lafathaari 'alaahe kaalesagadu 'enaziyaa 'alaahe zanede yaalute malaa'ekete balalitenaa baqane yaatharutaale, yaamasagenutaale; 'enasume magazaatene 'ayesalacume.

ya'alaahe taalaaqenate, 'anedenatenaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase 'enedamicele kamiyaamalaketu meleketocu 'aneta mederene meneme yamaataabaqele daraqe honaa taayaataalahe. kasamaaye yazenaabe weha baawaradenebaate gizee bawesethwa baalawe debeqe zare mabeqale mekeneyaate teneqasaaqasaalace; tefaafaalaceme. yehecene medere 'azere`ete bamaabeqale heyaawe 'enedaadaragaate hulu mutaanene heyaawe bamaadarage lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa yeqasaqesaacawaale. 'esu huluneme nagaroce caaye nawe. yamotaceweneme medere heyaawe maaderagenenaa mutaanene heyaawe bamaaderage kamaqaaberocaacawe maqaseqase 'ayesaanaweme.

'enanyaa 'aneqatzocaacenene katekekelanyaawe maaberaariyaa bamaasetabaabale, bamaawegazenaa bamaqayare yamiyaathaamemu ya'enasu huneetaa 'ayedabaqebeneme; 'enaaweqaacawaalane. lamahonu ba'esaate wesethe yamiwarawarawe yebalethaalene; wayese batenesaa'ee qane salaamaawi hono yamimathaawe sawe?! 'enaaneta sawoce hoye! yafalagaacehutene malekaameme mathefome szeraa szeru ba'ewenatu malekaamunenaa mathefowene galetzanelaacexwaale. 'alaahe 'enaaneta yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe. kaszeraawocaacehu meneme 'ayesawarebateme.

'enaziyaa ka'alaahe zanede qure'aane bamathaalaacawe gizee yakaadute batenesaa'ee qane yeqathaalu. 'eresume 'ashanaafi thanekaaraa matsehhafe nawe. maaneme yamiyaazaabaa liyaazaabaawenaa maaneme qayaari liqayerawe 'ayeceleme.

kaxwaalaaweme kafitume bamaqanase, bamachamare, bamalawatheme hona bamaqayare kanetu nagare 'ayemathaabateme. bamafethare, bamawasanenaa bamadanegage thebabanyaa, bahulume huneetaawoce mesegune kahonawe geetaa yatawarada nawe.

'alaahe baqure'aane yaasetabaabalu sawocene huneetaa kagalatza baxwaalaa: male'eketanyaawene ka'esu bafite yanabarute male'eketanyoce kahhezebaacawe yaagaathamaacawene maasetabaabale, maashofenaa qethefatene bamagelatze siyaatzenaanaacawe 'enedihe yelaale::
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta bafite lanabarute male'eketanyoce yatabaalawe `aayenate 'eneji laaneta leelaa 'ayebaalemenaa taagase. geetaahe kabaarocu wada 'esu yamimalasutene yameherate baalabeetenaa bawanejalu laaye yazawataranenaa neseha yaalegabaane ya'asaamaami qethaate baalabeete nawe.

yehenene qure'aane ka`aarabenyaa qwaaneqwaa wechi benaawaredawe noro:kakahadiwoce makaakale 'anedaanedocu 'aneqatzocu 'enedigabaane yeberaarulene yelu nabare. lamahonu qure'aane ka`aarabenyaa qwaaneqwaa wechi, yehenene qure'aane yaamathaawe male'eketanyaa `aarabaawi yehonaalene? yelu nabare. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enazihe sawoce <<yehe qure'aane la'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyocu laamanute kathemeete wada qathetanyaa manegade yamimaraa, lebe wesethe laalawe yamaayemenatenaa masale bashetaawoce madehanite nawe>> balaacawe. 'enaziyaame ba'alaahe yamaayaamenute jorowocawe laaye denequrenaa 'ala. 'esu (qure'aane) ba'enasu laaye taawerobaacawaale 'ayegabaacaweme. ba'enazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatzute karuqe botaa 'enedamitharu naacawe. 'enasu yatathaariwene demetze 'enedeete yesamaalu?

lamusaa baregetheme taweraatene sathanawe. ba'esume hhezebu talayaayu ka'enasu yaamana 'ala;yakaadame 'ala. 'alaahe ba'enasu makaakale bataweraate gudaaye laaye batafatharawe 'alamagebaabaate batenesaa'ee qane wesaanee yesathaale yamile qaale baayetalaalafe noro:bamakaakalaacawe batafarada nabare. 'ewenatanyaawene kaweshatanyaawe bamalayate 'ewenatanyaawene bamaakebare weshatanyaawene yaawaaredaale. kahadiyaane baqure'aane gudaaye laaye therethaaree wesethe naacawe.

malekaame szeraane yaszaraa sawe:yamalekaame szeraawe theqeme lanafesu nawe. 'alaahe yamaaneme szeraa 'ayethaqemaweme. mathefo szeraane yaszaraa sawe gudaatu baraasu laaye nawe. 'alaahe yabaarocu hathi'ate 'ayegodaaweme. huluneme yamigabaacawene yemanadaacawaale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaaheme baarocune badaaye 'ayedalame. yaszarutene malekaame menedaa 'ayeqanesebaacaweme; mathefo menedaame 'ayechamerebaacaweme.

yasa`aatitune (yatenesaa'ee) qane macee 'enedametekasate `eweqatu wada 'alaahe becaa yemalasaale. ka'esu wechi maaneme 'ayaaweqeme. maanenyaaweme feree kashefaanu siwathaa 'enedihume maanenyaawaame 'enesete setetzaneseme hona setewalede saayaaweqawe yamihone nagare yalame;ka'alaahe meneme nagare 'ayesawareme. ka'alaahe gaare thaa`otaatene siyaamaleku yanabaru 'agaariwocene 'enasune bamaweqasenaa bamatacate <<'enaziyaa ka'enee wechi setaamalekwaacawe yanabarute tagaariwoce yate 'alu?>> belo bamitharaacawe qane; 'agaariwocume <<bafite lafitehe sehetataacenene 'amenanaale! bazaareewe `elate 'agaare 'enedaalahe maanaaceneme 'ayemasakareme.>> yelaalu.
kazihe bafite sigazwacawe yanabarute thaa`otaate yesawarubaacawaale. ka'alaahe qethaate mashashenaa mathagiyaa 'enedaleelaacawe yaaragaagethaalu.
yasawe leje theenenatene, ganezabene, lejocene 'enaa leeloce tzagaawocene kamathayaqe 'ayesalaceme. dehenatene, bashetaanenaa leeloce kefu yahonu nagaroce siyaagaathemawe tasefaa qoraache yehonaale.

cegerenaa bashetaa kaagaathamawe baxwaalaa ka'enyaa yahona theenenate, habetenaa, 'ezenate senaaqamesawe yehene yaaganyahute 'enee lazihe tagabinaa baalabeete selahonekunye nawe; sa`aatitume (tenesaa'ee) machi naate beyee 'alaasebeme. 'ewenate tenesaa'ee kaalaceme kageetaayee zanede malekaame nagare 'alanye yelaale. baduneyaa lamalekaame nagare tagabi bamahonee malekaame welataa 'enedawaalalenye hulu bamacharashaawe qaneme malekaame welataa yewelelenyaale. la'enaziyaa sela sarwacawe kehedatenaa hathi'ate ba'alaahe yakaadu baregetheme szeraawocaacawene 'enenageraacawaalane. 'ejege kabaadenaa beretu kahonawe qethaate 'enaaqamesaacawaalane.

lasawoce malekaame tzagaawoce ('eneda theenenatenaa leeloce balagasenaacawe gizee 'alaahene kamaasetaawasenaa kamataazaze yezanagaalu;bakuraateme jarebaa yesathaalu. makaraa, bashetaanaa dehenate banakaacawe gizee lemanaa yaabazaalu. la'esu semotaawene bamaaqerabe cegerune 'enediyaanasaalate yemaatzanaale. geetaawe malekaame nagare silagesaweme 'ayaamasageneme; cegerenaa makaraa siyaagaathemaweme 'ayetaagaseme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lanaziyaa 'agaariwocenaa 'asetabaabaayoce yehe qure'aane ka'alaahe zanede yamathaa bihonenaa 'enaaneta ba'esu betekedunaa betaasetabaabelu huneetaacehu 'enedeete yehonaale? lamahonu 'ewenatu geletze kamahonu gaare maaserajaawe thanekaaraanaa yatasetakaakala hono saala yehenene teto leelaane kamikatale sawe yabalatha yatasaasaata sawe 'alane?

yehe qure'aane therethaaree yaleelawe 'ewenate mahonu 'esekigalatzelaacawe derase basamaayaate, bamederenaa banafesocaacawe laaye ta`aamerocaacenene 'enaasaayaacawaalane. yehe qure'aane ba'ewenate ka'alaahe selamamethaatu ya'alaahe mesekerenate lanaziyaa 'agaariwoce 'ayebaqaamene? ka'alaahe mesekerenate yabalatha maane 'ala? 'ewenatune falaagi bihonu noro ba'alaahe mesekerenate batabeqaaqu nabare.

kamote baxwaalaa batenesaa'ee qane maqaseqasene bamaawegazaacawe mekeneyaate kageetaacawe gaare maganaanyatene batamalakata batherethaaree laaye naacawe. bamacharashaawe qane 'ayaamenume laziyaa qane yamihonaacawene malekaame szeraane bamaszeraate 'ayezagaajume. nequ! 'alaahe huluneme nagare bacelotaawenaa ba`eweqatu yaakaababa nawe.
(Hm) `sq <<hhaa mime>>, <<`aayene sine qaafe>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe majamariyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)
(Hm) `sq <<hhaa mime>>, <<`aayene sine qaafe>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe majamariyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)

'alaahe kaaneta bafite banabarute nabiyaate laaye raa`eye 'enedaasetalaalafawe hulu:ba'anetame laaye yehenene qure'aane raa`eye 'asetalaalefolehaale. 'aneta yamajamariyaawe raa`eye yamiwaredelate sawe 'ayedalaheme. 'alaahe bawesaaneewe 'ashanaafinaa baferedume thebabanyaa nawe.
basamaayaatenaa bamedere laaye yaalawene hulune mafethare, negeszenaanaa maasetanaabare la'alaahe becaa nawe. 'esu ba'akaaleme, badarajaame, bamaashanafeme yalaaqa; ba'akaalume taalaaqe nawe.

samaayaate bataalaaqenataacawenaa bakafetaacawe gezufe kamahonaacawe gaare ba'alaahe taalaaqenate mekeneyaate lamasanethaqe yeqarebaalu. malaa'ekete geetaacawene bamaalaaqenaa la'esu bamatanaanase 'eyaamasaganu yaawadesutaale. 'alaaheneme medere laaye laalute 'amaanyoce maaretaane yethayeqaalu. nequ! 'alaahe kahathi'ataacawe tatzatzetawe yamimalasutene mahari, labaarocu 'azaanye nawe.

'enaziyaa ka'alaahe baashaagare thaa`otaatene bamawadaajatenaa ka'alaahe wechi bamaamelake yayaazu:'alaahe ya'enasune szeraawoce bamakataatale yeqothaatharaacawaale. 'enedihume waagaacawene yesathaacawaale. 'aneta ba'enasu laaye wakile 'ayedalaheme 'aneta ya'alaahene male`ekete 'aderaashe nahe. sela 'enasu szeraa 'atethayaqeme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta bafite lanabiyaatoce raa`eye 'enedaasetalaalafenawe hulu:yamakaa sawocenenaa bazuriyaawaa laalu `aaraboce 'enedihume leelocene sawoce taasethanaqeqaacawe zanede ba'aneta laaye ba`aarabenyaa yaminababe yahonane qure'aane 'awaradene. yamajamariyaawocenenaa yamacharashaawocene lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa 'anede 'adabaabaaye laaye yamisabasabubatene yatenesaa'eewene qane sawocene 'asethaneqeqene. yaa qane lamakasatu meneme therethaaree yalaweme. baziyaa qane sawoce lahulate bamakafale kafilu yajanate 'enasume 'amaanyoce sihonu kafilu dagemo ya'esaate 'enasume kahadiyaane naacawe.

'alaahe bifalege noro:baselaame 'anede hhezebe yaadaregaacawe nabare; baziheme mekeneyaate huluneme janate yaasegabaacawaale. nagare gene ya'esu wesaaneenaa ferede honanaa yafalagawene selaame wesethe bamaasegabaate janatene yaasegabaawaale. bakehedatenaa bahathi'aate nafesocaacawene yabadalute yamithabeqaacawe thabaaqi 'enedihume ka'alaahe qethaate yamiradaacawe radaate yalaacaweme.

yelequnese 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce ka'alaahe baashaagare yamithabeqaacawene thabaaqi yaazu. 'ewenatanyaa thabaaqi 'esu 'alaahe nawe. ka'esu wechi yaalu meneme 'ayethaqemumeme, 'ayegodumeme. 'esu mutaanene lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa heyaawe yaadaregaale. 'esu huluneme nagaroce caaye nawe meneme nagare 'ayesaanaweme.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! bamaanenyaaweme maszarataawime hona tagebaaraawi yahaayemaanote gudaaye laaye kaaletagebaabaacehu wasaaneewe wada 'alaahe nawe yamimalasawe. bagudaayume wada qure'aanenaa wada hadise mamalase nawe; 'eresu 'eko 'alaahe geetaayee nawe. bagudaayoceeme hulu ba'eresu laaye 'emakaalahu. banesehame wada 'eresu 'emalasaalahu.

'alaahe samaayaatenenaa mederene yaala qedema-mesaalee fatharaacawe. kanafesocaacehu thenede 'adaragalaacehu. 'enedihume kagemale, kabete, bagenaa feyale thenede thenede (wanedenaa seete) bamaaderage la'enaaneta 'enedibazaalaacehu 'adaraga. 'erese baraasaacehu bamagaabaate 'enedetebaazu yaadaregaale. 'enedihume ka'enesesoce segaanaa watate bamasethate lamanore mekeneyaate 'adaragalaacehu. 'esune ('alaahene) yamimasele meneme nagare yalame. 'eresume yabaarocune negegere sami szeraacawene tamalekaace nawe. meneme yamiyaamalethawe nagare yalame. baszeraawocaacewe malekaame kahona bamalekaame mathefo kahona bamathefo yemanadaacawaale.

yasamaayaatenaa yamedere kaazenaa qulefoce ya'esu becaa nawe. batasathawe nagare yaamasagenaale wayese yekedaale yamilawene lamafatane kabaarocu lafalagawe sisaayune yaasafaale;bafalagawe laayeme 'alaahe bawasanawe nagare yetaagasaale wayese yaamaareraale bamile 'esune lamafatane sisaayune yaathabebataale. 'esu huluneme nagare `aawaaqi nawe. labaarocu theqeme yaalawe maanenyaaweme nagare 'ayesawarebateme.

la'enaaneta kahaayemaanote nuhene male'ekete 'enediyaadaresenaa ba'esu 'enediszaraabate baazazenawe maszarate wada 'aneta raa`eye yaawaradenaweneme danagagalaacehu. 'enedihume laberaahime, musaanaa `isaa male'ekete 'enediyaadaresunaa ba'esu 'enediszarubate yataazazubatene `aayenate te`ezaaze danagagenelaacehu. chebethuneme haayemaanotene qathe 'aderegaacehu yaazu; ba'eresu laaye malayaayatene tawe yamile nawe. 'agaariwoce wada 'alaahe 'anedenate matheraataacehunaa ka'alaahe wechi magazaatene 'eneditawe mathaaraataacehu kabadaacawe. 'alaahe kabaarocu yafalagawene yemarethaale. 'enedihume 'esune 'enedigazunaa 'eneditaazazu lasekeete yaabaqaacawaale. kabaarocu wada 'esu bamatzatzate yamimalasutene wada 'esu yemaraale.

kahadiyaanenaa 'agaariwoce leyunate wesethe yagabute muhhaamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) wada 'enaresu bamalaakaacawe maaserajaawe kataragaagathabaacawe baxwaalaa nawe. malayaayataacaweme denebare bamaalafenaa babadale mekeneyaate 'eneji baleelaa 'alenabarame. ba'alaahe `eweqate maszarate qethaatu 'eseka tawasana gizee (tenesaa'ee) yeqoyaale yamile wesaanee baayaalefe noro: 'alaahe bamakaakalaacawe 'esune bamakaadaacawenaa male'eketanyocene bamaasetabaabalaacawe mekeneyaate yewasenebaacawe nabare. 'enaziyaa kaalafute hhezebocaacawe baxwaalaa taweraatene yawarasu yehudocenaa nejilene yawarasu naswaraawoce 'enedihume ka'enazihe 'agaariwoce baxwaalaa yawarasu sawoce muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yezolaacawe selamathaawe qure'aane batherethaaree wesethe naacawe.

wada 'ezihe haayemaanote tathaaraa; 'esu baazazaheme maszarate tzenaa, wedeqe yahonawe semeetaacawene 'atekatale; 'enasune setekaraakare 'enee ba'alaahe 'amenyaalahu 'enedihume bamale'eketanyoce laaye baawaradaacaweme matsaahhefetoce 'amenyaalahu; 'alaaheme ba'enaaneta makaakale bafetehe 'enedefarede 'azonyaale balaacawe. 'enee yanyaane 'enaa ya'enaanetane hulu geetaa yahonawene 'alaahene nawe yamegazaaweme balaacawe. therume yehune mathefo yaszaraanawe lanyaa, lanaanetame yaszaraacehute therume yehune mathefo 'alalaacehu. 'ewenatunaa maaserajaawe katagalatza baxwaalaa ba'enyaanaa ba'enaaneta makaakale meneme kerekere yalame. 'alaahe hulaaceneneme yesabasebanaale. batenesaa'eewe qane wada 'esume 'enemalasaalane. hulaaceneneme yamigabaanene yemanadaanaale. bazaaneme qane 'ewenatanyaawe kaweshataamu 'enedihume la'ewenatu tagabiwenaa tagabi yaalehonawe yelayaale.

'enaziyaa bamale'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salaalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) sawoce latheriwe 'ewenatenatune bamaaserajaa 'aragaagethawe theru melaashe sathetawe katakatalu baxwaalaa 'enaziyaa wedeqe bahona maaserajaa bahaayemaanotu gudaaye laaye yamikaraakaru 'alaahe zanedenaa me'emanaane zanede maaserajaacawe tawagaajenaa wedeqe nawe;meneme maszarate yalaweme. 'ewenatene wedeqe bamaaderagaacawenaa 'alaahene bamakaadaacaweme mekeneyaate ya'alaahe quthaa ba'enasu laaye 'alabaacawe. 'enedihume batenesaa'eewe qane kabaade 'enaa beretu yahona qethaate 'alalaacawe.

yakahadiyaane maaserajaa wedeqe mahonune kagalatza baxwaalaa muselime 'enedamaaserajaa yamithaqamebatene 'ewenatanyaa maaserajaa qure'aanene bamagelatze: 'enedihe 'ala::
'alaahe qure'aanene meneme therethaaree yaleelawe sihone ba'ewenate 'awarada. basawoce makaakaleme bafetehe 'enedifaredume mizaanaawinatene 'awarada. 'enaziyaa yamiyaasetabaabelute yatenesaa'eewe qane qerebe lihone yecelaale. 'enedamitaawaqawe machi yahona nagare hulu qerebe nawe.

'enaziyaa baswa yamaayaamenu sawoce 'enedifathene yefalegaalu;mekeneyaatume bagemegamaa, bamalekaame mamanedaatenaa baqethaate selamaayaamenu 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanu sawoce macharashaacawene selamiyaawequ 'eswane yefaraalu. 'eswa bamamethaatwa gudaaye laaye meneme therethaaree yaleelawe 'eregethanyaa 'emenate 'alaacawe. nequ! 'enaziyaa sela tenesaa'eewe yamikaraakarunaa sela makasatume gudaaye laaye tatharaathaariwoce: ka'ewenate yaraaqa sehetate wesethe naacawe.

'alaahe labaarocu rexeruxe nawe. lafalagawe sisaaye bamasethate yaasafaalataale. bafalagawe laaye dagemo labaariyaawe bamaazane yaathabebataale. 'esu maaneme yamaayaashanefawe thanekaaraa; thalaatocune bamabaqale 'ashanaafi nawe.

yamacharashaawene qane bamafalage la'eswa qane malekaame szeraane yaszaraa menedaawene 'ethefe derebe 'enaadaregelataalane. mekeneyaatume 'anede malekaame szeraa ba'asere 'eseka sabaate mato kaziyaame balaaye 'ethefe derebe yemanadaalenaa. qerebitune heyewate (duneyaane) becaa yafalaga yatawasanalatene dereshaa 'enesathawaalane. bamacharashaawe qane ('akxiraa) duneyaane bamamerathu mekeneyaate meneme dereshaa yalaweme.

lamahonu la'enazihe 'agaariwoce ka'alaahe baashaagare 'alaahe yaalefaqadawene ba'esu maagaaraatene, yafaqadawene bamakalekale, yakalakalawene bamafeqade haayemaanotene danagagulaacawene?! 'alaahe bafethuraanu makaakale yamifaredebate yatawasana qane bamaaderage 'esekamalayaawe qane yaaqoyaacawaale yamile qaala-wesaanee baayaasaalefe noro yeqathaacawe nabare. 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe bamaagaaraatenaa bahathi'ate nafesocaacawene yabadalu sawoce:batenesaa'eewe qane 'asaamaami qethaate 'alalaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! nafesocaacawene bamaagaaraatenaa bahathi'ate yabadalu: baszarute hathi'ate mekeneyaate ya'alaahene qethaate yasagu honawe taayaacawaalahe. qethaatume ba'enasu laaye makasatu yamaayeqare nawe. neseha yaleelabate ferehate meneme 'ayethaqemaacaweme. 'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce yaamanu ka'enaziyaa bataqaaraani malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru bajanate chafeewoce yedasataalu. geetaacaweme zanede yafalagutene lazalaalame yamaayeqwaarathe yahonu yatalayaayu tzagaawoce 'alwacawe. yeheme meneme yamaayewadaadarawe taalaaqe terufaate nawe.

yehene beseraate 'enaziyaane ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyocu 'amenawe malekaame szeraane yaszaru baarocune: 'alaahe bamale'eketanyocu 'amaakaanyenate yaabaseraale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enee 'ewenatene bamaaderasee mekeneyaate ka'enaaneta meneme menedaa 'alefalegeme. ka'enaaneta yamefalegawe nagare binore yaame theqemu wada'enaaneta yemalasaale. 'esume lazemedenaa setelu 'enedetewadunye becaa nawe. malekaame szeraane yaszaraa menedaawene 'ethefe derabe 'enaadaregelataalane. bateneshu 'anedene malekaame szeraa ba'asere 'enaabaazaalane. 'alaahe kahathi'ataacawe bamatzatzate yamimalasutene mahari; ya'alaahene fite falegawe lamiszaru malekaame szeraa 'amasegaanye nawe.

ka'agaariwoce qethefate 'anedu <<muhhamade yehenene qure'aane baraasu qathefo kageetaayee nawe yelaale.>> yamilawe sihone; 'alaahe la'enasu malese sisathe 'enedihe 'ala:: bawesethehe weshate maqethafe betaasebe lebehe laaye 'ashegaalahu; yaqathafekaweneme 'edamasesawenaa 'ewenatene becaa 'aseqaraalahu. yeheme saayehone bamaqeratu yanabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) 'ewenatanyenatenaa raa`eyume kageetaacawe zanede 'enedamimathaalaacawe taragaagatha maalate nawe. 'esu babaarocu lebe wesethe yaalawene `aawaaqi nawe. meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.

'esu ('alaahe) kabaarocu kakehedataacawenaa kawanejalaacawe wada 'alaahe bamatzatzate neseha kaadaragunaa katamalasu nesehacawene bamaqabale yaszarwacaweneme hathi'atoceme yaalefaacawaale. 'alaahe yameteszarwacawene nagaroce hulu yaaweqaale. szeraawocaacehu meneme 'ayesawarebateme; baszeraawocaacehume yemanadaacaxwaale.

ya'enaziyaane ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce yaamanutene me'emanaane tamaatzeno yeqabalaacawaale. batachamaarime yaalethayaqutene katerufaatu yechamerelaacawaale. la'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce yakaadu batenesaa'eewe qane yamithabeqaacawe beretu qethaate 'alaacawe.

'alaahe labaarocu hulu sisaayune biyaasafaalaacawe noro medere laaye bagefenaa babadale wasane yaalefu nabare. nagare gene 'alaahe kasisaayu baleke matheno lafalagawe bamaasefaatenaa bamaathebabe yaawaredaale. 'esu yabaarocune huneetaa bazerezere `aawaaqinaa tamalekaace nawe; sisathe hona sikalakele lathebabe nawe.

'alaahe sawocene yazenaabe mamethaatene tasefaa kaqorathu baxwaalaa zenaabene yamiyaawaredenaa mederene 'azere`ete 'enedetaabaqele bamaaderage 'ezenatune yamizaragaa nawe. 'esu yabaarocune gudaaye bamakataatale yamithabeqe bamaanenyaaweme huneetaa mesegune nawe.

ya'alaahene caayenatenaa becanyaa tamalaakinatene kamiyaasaayu meleketoce makaakale: samaayaatenaa mederene mafetharunaa ba'enasu wesethe 'asedanaaqi yahonu fethuraane maasaraachatu nawe. 'esu 'enasune lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa masabesabene bafalaga gizee bamasabesabe caaye nawe. 'enasune majamariyaame mafethare 'enedaaletasaanawe hulu yeheme 'ayesaanaweme.

'enaaneta sawoce banafesaacehume hona baganezabocaacehu yamiyaagaathemaacehu maanenyaaweme nagare 'ejocaacehu baszaraacewe hathi'ate nawe. 'enediyaaweme 'alaahe kawanejalaacehu bezune yaalefaacexwaale ba'eresume 'ayezaacehume.

'alaahe 'enaanetane maqethaate bifalege ka'esu bamashashe kaqethaatu madaane 'atecelume. ka'alaahe wechi gudaayaacehune bamakataatale thabaaqi yalaacehume. 'enedihume 'enaanetane maqethaate bifalege qethaatune liyaanasaalaacehu yamicele radaate 'ataaganyume.
ya'alaahene celotaanaa becanyaa tamalaakinatene kamiyaasaayu meleketoce makaakale bakafetaacawenaa bataalaaqenataacawe 'eneda taraaroce yahonu baahere laaye yaminesaafafu marekaboce yeganyaalu.

'alaahe marekabocene 'enedinesaafafu yamiyaadaregute nefaasocene maaseqome bifalege bamaaseqome baahere laaye 'enedaayeneqasaaqasu bamaaderage qathe 'enedilu yaadaregaacawe nabare. marekabocene bamafetharenaa baahere laaye baqalaalu banefaase 'enedinesaafafu bamaaderage bafatanaanaa bacegere gizee bathaame taagaashe lahonunaa ya'alaahene tzagaa 'amasegaanye lahonu hulu ya'alaahene celotaa bageletze yamiyaasaayu meleketoce naacawe.

wayeme 'alaahe sawoce baszarute hathi'atenaa wanejale mekeneyaate marekabocene maathefaate kafalaga 'awelo nefaase bamalaake yaathafaacawaale. 'esu yabaarocune hathi'ate bezuwene yaalefaale; ba'esume 'ayeqathaacaweme.

marekabocene 'awelo nefaase lekane bamenaathafaabate gizee 'enaziyaa ya'alaahene meleketoce wedeqe lamaaderage yamikaraakarute sawoce kaqethaatu meneme `aayenate maamelachaa 'enedaleelaacawe 'enediyaawequme chemere nawe. bamahonume leelaane 'akaale mamaatzane tetawe 'alaahene becaa yemaatzanaalu.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! maanenyaaweme kaganezabe, kaselethaanenaa kalejoce yatasathaacehute thafinaa tawagaaje kahonawe yaduneyaa mathaqaaqamene nawe ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce yaamanunaa bamaanenyaaweme gudaayocaacawe laaye ba'alaahe lamimaku yazalaalame tzagaa bajanate 'azagaajetolaacawaale.

'enaziyaa kabaadenaa 'atzayaafi yahonu wanejalocene yamirequ; banegegereme hona batagebaare yaasekafaacawe sawe laaye biqothume yeqeretaa yamiyaadaregunaa sela thefaatume yamaayeqathu naacawe. yehenene yeqeretaa yamiyaadaregute malekaame nagarenaa theqeme kaalawe nawe.

'enaziyaa yageetaacawene theri te`ezaazune bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale malekaame melaashe yamisathu, segedataacawene batamwalaa maleku yamiyaakanaawenu, 'anegabegaabinaa 'asaasaabi bahonu gudaayocaacawe laaye yamimakaakarunaa kasathanaacawe sisaaye ya'alaahene fite falegawe yamisathu naacawe.

'enaziyaa badale baagaathamaacawe gizee yanafesaacawene kebere lamathabaqe silu yamiratu naacawe. yehenene yamiyaadaregute yaa badaaye sawe layeqeretaa tagabi kaalehona batalaye dagemo yeqeretaa maaderagu theqemenaa 'asefalaagi kaalehona tekekelanyaa 'eremejaa nawe.

yehenene yafalaga maaderage yecelaale. nagare gene meneme saayechamerenaa wasane saayaalefe batamasaasaaye maleku 'atzafaa mamalase yecelaale. ba'esu laaye gefe yaszaraabatene yeqeretaa yaadaraganaa baszaraawe thefaate yaaleyaaza 'enedihume ba'esu 'enaa thefaate baathafaabate wanedemu makaakale yaalawene huneetaa yaasetakaakala menedaawe 'alaahe zanede nawe. 'alaahe 'enaziyaane sawoce banafesaacawe wayeme baganezabaacawe wayeme bakeberaacawe laaye badale yamifatzemutene 'ayewadaacaweme; yelequnese yethalaacawaale.
katabadalume baxwaalaa batamasaasaaye maleku lanafesaacawe 'atzafaa yamimalesu yamiwaqasubate manegade yalabaacaweme.

bathefaataacawe yamiyeyaazute 'enaa qethaate yaalabaacawe ba'enaziyaa sawocene bamibadelu 'enaa medere laaye hathi'atene bamifatzemu laaye nawe. bamacharashaawe qane ba'enaziyaa sawoce laaye 'asaamaami qethaate 'alabaacawe.

leeloce bamiyaadaresubate badale laaye yamitaagase 'enaa yeqere yamile; yehe te`egesete bataagaashunaa baheberatasabu laaye malekaame theqemene yamiyaaseganye yatamasagana tagebaare nawe. yeheneneme tagebaare yataalaaqe `edele baalabeete yahonu sawoce 'eneji maaneme 'ayetaadaleme.

'alaahe qanaawene manegade yaalemaraawenaa ka'ewenatu yaaraaqawe ka'alaahe baxwaalaa maaneme gudaayune bamakataatale yamimaraawe yalaweme. nafesocaacawene bakehedatenaa bahathi'ate yabalathu sawoce batenesaa'eewe qane qethaatene baayu gizee waa menyotaacene wada duneyaa tamalesane wada 'alaahe neseha yamenaadaregebatene manegade baaganyane belawe yemanyaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa badaayoce waraadoce honawe 'esaate zanede bamiqarebubate gizee 'eswane kamaferaataacawe yatanasaa saraqe 'eyaadaragu sawocene simalakatu taayaalahe. 'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce yaamanute ya'ewenate kasaariwoce maalate baagaathamaacawe qethaate mekeneyaate raasaacawenenaa beetasabocaacawene yakasarute naacawe yelaalu. nequ 'enaziyaa bakehedatenaa bahathi'ate raasaacawene yabadalu lazalaalame yamaayeqwaarathe zawetaari yahona qethaate wesethe naacawe.

'enasune batenesaa'ee qane ka'alaahe qethaate yamiyaadenaacawe thabaaqi yalaacaweme. 'alaahe 'ewenatene 'enedaayekatalu yaadaregaacawenaa yaathamamaacawene wada 'ewenate manegade yamimaraacawe maaneme yalaacaweme.

'enaaneta sawoce lageetaacehu theri yasune te'ezaaze bamafatsame, yakalakalawene bamaraaqenaa lawadafite 'eszaraawaalahu yamilene nagare bamatawe tenesaa'ee kamamethaatwa bafite malekaame melaashe sethu. 'eswa kamathaace baxwaalaa malaashe yalaateme. yametethagubate mathagiyaame yalaacehume 'enedihume baduneyaa yaszaraacehutene hathi'ate yametaasetabaabelume 'ayedalaacehume.

'aneta yaazazakaacawene nagare 'emebi kaalu 'anetane ya'enaresune szeraa thabaaqi 'aderagane 'alelaakeneheme. 'aneta 'enedetaadarese yaazazenehene male`ekete maaderase 'eneji leelaa meneme yalabeheme. hisaabaacawe 'alaahe zanede nawe. 'enyaa yasawe lejene ka'enyaa zanede yahonawene 'ezenatene kahabete, theenenatenenaa leelocene balagasenawe gizee yekoraale. bahathi'ataacaweme mekeneyaate yasawe leje yamithalaawe kefu nagare siyaagaathemawe yatalamadawe baaheriyaacawe ya'alaahene tzagaa makaade, 'alamaamaseganenaa 'alaahe bathebabu yamiwasenawene nagare maamaarare nawe.

yasamaayaatenaa yamedere baalabeetenatenaa negeszenaa ya'alaahe nawe. yafalagawene wanede, seetenaa leelaawene yefatheraale. lafalagawe seetene becaa bamasethate wanedene yekalakelawaale. lafalagawe dagemo wanedene becaa bamasethate seetene yekalakelawaale. laleelaawe dagemo wanedenaa seete bamaaderage yesathaale. yafalagawene dagemo mahane yamaayewalede yaadaregawaale. 'alaahe yasawe lejene raa`eye bamaawerade baraa`eye wayeme baqathetaa wayeme baleelaa maleku kamagaarajaa basetajarebaa 'esune saayaaye bamaanaagare wayeme dagemo 'eneda jiberile yaalu male'eketanyaa malaa'eketene wada sawe leje male'eketanyaa bafaqaadu maasetalaalafe yamifalegawene male'ekete bamalaake 'eneji bagahade liyaanaagerawe 'ayegabaame. 'esu bamaanenatume babaaheriweme yalaaqa, bamafethare, bamawasanenaa bamadanegageme thebabanyaa nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta bafite banabarute nabiyaatoce laaye raa`eye 'enedaasetalaalafene hulu wada 'anetame kanyaa zanede yahonawene qure'aane 'awaradene. kazihe bafite bamale'eketanyoce laaye yatawaradu matsaahhefetenaa 'emenate mene 'enedahona 'ataaweqeme. nagare gene yehenene qure'aane berehaane bamaaderage kabaarocaacene yafalagenawene ba'esu qanaawene manegade 'enemaraalane. 'aneta baregetheme sawocene wada qanaawene yaselaame manegade temaraalahe.
yaa yasamaayaatenaa yamedere babaalabeetenate, bamafetharenaa bamaasetanaabare la'esu yahonawene ya'alaahene manegade temaraalahe. 'eseki nequ nagaraatoce hulu wada 'alaahe becaa yemalasaalu.
(Hm) <<hha mime>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe majamariyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)
'alaahe bamuhhamade (salalaahu `aayelahi wasalame) laaye batawaradawe laasetanatanawe sawe geletzenaa ya'alaahene denegaagee galaache bahonawe qure'aane yemelaale.
'enyaa ba`aarabenyaa qwaaneqwaa yaminababe sihone teregumune teganazabunaa teradu zanede 'enedihume laleeloce hhezeboce taasetalaalefu zanede 'awaradenawe.

yehe qure'aane 'enyaa zanede yamiganyawe yatathabaqawe matsehhafe wesethe kafe yaala darajaa, keberenaa botaa yaalawe nawe. bate`ezaazaatocunaa kelekalaawoce kathebabe yaalewathaa thebabanyaa 'enedihume baferedu gechete 'enaa leyunate yaleelawe nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe maagaaraatenaa kelekele yahonu nagaroce laaye bamazafaqaacehu mekeneyaate 'enaanetane wada 'alaahe 'ameleko matheraatenenaa qure'aanene maawerade 'anetaweme; yehenene 'anaadaregaweme; yelequnese 'enaanetane kamaazane 'akwaayaa 'enemakeraacexwaalane.
baalafute hhezeboce laaye bezu nabiyaatocene lekanaale.
yaalafute hhezeboce ka'alaahe zanede male'eketanyaa wada 'enasu matheto saayaashofubate yaalafa yalame.

ka'enasu baxaayelenaa gulebate yabalathu sawocene 'athefetanaale. 'enazihene dakaamaa hhezebocene maathefaate 'ayesaananeme. bazihe qure'aane wesethe sela 'alafute hhezeboce 'athafaafe baaheri tagaletzo 'alefwale. 'eneda `adoce, samudoce, yaluthe hhezebocenaa yamadeyane sawoce wazata...

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaane 'agaari 'asetabaabaayocene <<samaayaatenenaa mederene maane fatharaacawe;>> belahe betethayeqaacawe. latheyaaqeewe melaashe bamasethate <<'ashanaafiwe meneme yamaayaashanefawe; huluneme nagaroce `aawaaqi yahonawe nawe yafatharaacawe>> yeluhale.
'alaahe 'esu mederene yatzanaace maragaagiyaa 'adaragalaacehu bataraaraaroce 'enaa shalaqowoce 'akaabaabi manegadocene bamaaderage baguzwacehu wadametefalegubate manegade temarubataalaacehu.

yaame kasamaaye la'enaaneta, la'enesasocaacehunaa la'azere`etocaacehu baleke baqi yahonane weha yaawaradalaacehu nawe. ba'eresume daraqe yamotacene hagare heyaawe 'adaragene. yehecene daraqe yamotacene hagare hheyaawe 'enedaadaragene hulu mutaanene hheyaawe bamaaderage 'eneqasaqesaalane.

qanenaa laleetene, wanedenaa seetene 'enaa yamasaasalutene thenedoce hulu yafathara. marekabenenaa 'enesesoceneme laguzwacehu magwaagwaazhaanate babaahere guzwacehu bamarekabe; bayabese guzwacehu dagemo ba'enesesaa 'enedetegwaazu 'adaragaacehu.

yehenene hulu yaadaragalaacehu baguzwacehu laaye bamagwaagwaazhaawe jarebaa laaye taragaagetaacehu kataqamathaacehu baxwaalaa tamacaacetaacehu bamaqamathaacehunaa 'enaziheneme magwaagwaazhaawoce la'enaaneta bamaageraatu ya'alaahene tzagaa 'enedetaasetaawesunaa ba'anedabataacehume 'enedafalagene maqothaathare 'enaa maazaze 'enedenecele yehenene magwaagwaazhaa bamaamacaacate yaagaraalene geetaa laaqa! theraateme yegabaawe. 'alaahe yehenene baayaagaraalene noro 'anecelaweme nabare 'enedetelume chemere nawe.
'enyaa kamotene baxwaalaa lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa wada geetaacene becaa tamalaashoce nane 'enedetelu nawe.

'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce 'anedaanede fethuroce kafathaari 'enedatawaladu bamamogate malaa'ekete ya'alaahe seete lejoce naacawe 'alu. 'enedihe `aayenate negegere yaminaagare sawe kehedatunaa thematu geletze yahona 'eleme yaala kahadi nawe.

lamahonu 'enaaneta 'agaariwoce 'alaahe kafetherataatu seete lejocene lalejenate laraasu 'aderegwaacawe; wanede lejocene dagemo la'enaaneta becaa marathalene nawe yametelute?! yehe yameteqathefute 'amadaadabe mene `aayenate yakafaa 'amadaadabe nawe?!

lageetaawe leju naate belo yamiyaamenebaate seete lejene siyaabaserute bakabaade hhazanenaa tekaazee yatanasaa fitu thequre 'enaa keseme yelaale; banedeeteme yewatharaale. lamahonu siyaabaserute 'enedihe `aayenate cheneqate wesethe yamiyaasegabaawene gudaaye 'enedeete 'aderego nawe lageetaawe yamilathefawe?!
bageethaageethe tashalemaa yametaadegawene? bakerekereme gizee seete bamahonwa negegerene bageletze yamaataaberaaraawene seete leje la'alaahe yaadaregaalune?!

'enaziyaane ya'alaahene baaroce malaa'eketene seete lejoce 'alwacawe. lamahonu 'alaahe sifatheraacawe babotaawe laaye tagenyetawe seete mahonaacawene 'aragaagethawaalene? malaa'eketoce yehenene qaalaacawene yemazagebutaale. selaziheme gudaaye batenesaa'eewe qane yethayaqaalu; kaziyaame selazihe weshataacawe yeqathaalu.

'alaahe malaa'eketocene 'enedaanaamaleke biyaashaa noro: 'anaamalekaacaweme nabare. yehenene tagebaaraacenene mashaatu (mawasanu) mafeqadenaa mawedadune yaasaayaale. bamaalate ya'alaahene fetherataawi wesaaneene (qaala-wesaaneewene) lamakaraakariyaanate yethaqesaalu. nagare gene lazihe negegeraacawe meneme `eweqatenaa maaserajaa yalaacaweme yelequnese weshataamoce naacawe.
lamahonu la'agaariwoce kazihe qure'aane bafite ka'alaahe wechi 'enediyaamaleku matsehhafe sathetanaacawaalene? yeheneneme matsehhafe 'athebeqawe yezawe lamakaraakariyaanate 'eyatathaqamubate nawene?!

bafetsume 'aletasathaacaweme. yelequnese qadametoce 'abaatocaacawene bachefene makatalaacawene 'eneda maaserajaa bamatheqase <<'enyaa qadamete 'abaatocaacenene bahona bahaayemaanote laaye honawe 'agenyetanaacawaale ('enaziyaa 'abaatocaacawe thaa`ote 'amelaakiyaane nabaru) bamahonume yehenenu bamagazaate faanaacawene 'enekatalaalane.>> 'alu.

'enanyaa walaajocaacawene makatalene maaserajaa bamaaderage 'eneda 'asetabaabalute hulu: bamaanenyaawaame katamaa maanenyaaweneme male'eketanyaa seneleke: bahabete yataterafarafute baalaabaatoce: 'enyaa qadamete 'abaatocaacenene yahona 'emenate laaye yaaganyanaacawe bamahonu: ya'enasune ya'emenate faanaa takataayoce nane: saayelu yaqaru hhezeboce yalume; bamahonume hhezebocehe 'anetane bamaasetabaabale yamajamariyaawoce 'ayedalume.

male'eketanyaacaweme: <<'enee 'abaatocaacehune kaaganyaacehubate manegade yatashaala baamathaalaacehume 'enasune tekatalaalaacehune? 'alaacawe. 'enasume 'anetanaa kaaneta bafite yanabarute yatalaakaacehubatene male'ekete 'aneqabaleme kedanaale>> 'alu.

male'eketanyocaacawene yaasetabaabalu hhezebocene bamabaqale 'athafaanaacawe. bamahonume male'eketanyocaacawene yaasetabaabalu sawoce macharashaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara 'asetawele macharashaacawe 'asaamaami qethaate nabare.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! beraahime la'abaatunaa lahhezebu ka'alaahe wechi kametegazwacawe nagaroce hulu netzuhe nanye.
kaziyaa kafatharanye 'alaahe basetaqare: 'esu wadamithaqemanye qathe wadaalawe haayemaanote yemaraanyaalenaa 'esune becaa nawe yamegazaawe. yaalawene 'asetaawuse!

beraahime yehecene yatawehide negegere (ka'alaahe basetaqare ba'ewenate yamimalake yalame yametelawaane negegere) kasu baxwaalaa bamimathu zereyaawocu laaye 'aseqaraate. bamahonume kazereyaawocu 'alaahene babecanyenate meneme tagaari saayaadaregu yamiyaamaleku 'alu. kazereyaawocume ba'alaahe kamaagaaraatenaa hathi'ate kamaszeraate tetawe 'alaahene becaa bamagazaate wada 'ewenatanyaawaa manegade yemalasu zanede.

bathefaataacaweme mekeneyaate 'enazihene 'agaariwoce baqethaate 'alaathaadafekwaacaweme. yelequnese baduneyaa 'enasunenaa yaalafute 'abaatocaacawene yehe 'ewenatanyaa qure'aanenaa geletze yahonawe male'eketanyaa muhhamade 'esekamathaalaacawe derase 'athaaqamekwaacawe.
meneme therethaaree yaleelawe 'ewenatanyaa qure'aane bamathaalaacawe gizee yehe muhhamade yadagamabene degemete nawe. 'enyaa ba'esu kahadiwoce nane 'anaameneme 'alu.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe bamakaade tagaari yaadaragu 'agaariwoce: yeheme qure'aane kahulatu katamoce (makaanaa thwafe) bataalaaqe sawe laaye lamene 'alewaradame? dehanaa yatime yahonawe muhhamade laaye qure'aane kamiwarede ba'walide benu `uqebaahe' 'enaa '`urewaahe bine mase`ude 'alesaqafi laaye biwarede' 'alu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lamahonu yageetaahene 'ezenate lafalagute bamasethatenaa kafalagute bamakalekale 'enasu yaakafaafelaalune?! 'anedu laleelaawe yatagaraa yehone zanede kafilune habetaame leelaawene dagemo deha bamaaderage bamakaakalaacawe sisaayaacawene kafaafalene. batenesaa'eewe qane geetaahe labaarocu yamisathawe tzagaa thafi kahonacewe duneyaanaa 'enasu kamisabasebute yebalethaale.

sawoceme bakehedate 'anede hhezebe yamihonu baalenabaru noro ba'alaahe ('are-raahhemaane) lamikedu sawoce labeetocaacehu kabere yatasaru thaariyaawoce; ba'eresume laaye yamiwathubaacawene yabere masalaaloce 'enaadaregelaacawe nabare.
'enasune lamafatane labeetocaacaweme barocene: yamidagafubaacaweneme 'alegaawoce 'enaadaregelaacawe nabare.

wareqene 'enaadaregelaacawe nabare. yeheme hulu yaduneyaa mathaqaaqamiyaa 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame. theqemume gizeeyaawi hono yamaayezawatere nawe. bamacharashaayetu hagare yaalawe tzagaa yageetaacawene te`ezaaze bamatzomenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene lamifaru balaache nawe.

bamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) laaye yawaradawene qure'aane celaa yamile ba'eresu laaye shayethwanene bamashome yamiyaathamawenaa wada tabalaasha manegade yamiyaanasaasaawe 'enaadaregelataalane. yateme botaa bihone ya'esu quraanyaa yehonaale.

'enaziyaa kaqure'aane baraaqu sawoce laaye yatashomu quraanyaawoce ka'alaahe manegade yaagedwacawaale. ya'alaahene te'ezaaze 'ayefatzemume yakalakalaweneme 'ayerequme. wada qanaawe manegade yatamaru yemaselaacawenaa kasehetataacawe tatzatzetawe wada 'alaahe 'ayemalasume.

batenesaa'eewe qane ka'alaahe qure'aane yaraaqawe sawe bamathaa gizee bamamanyate waa menyotee! ba'eneenaa baaneta ('aneta quraanyaayee) makaakale bameseraaqenaa bame`eraabe makaakale 'enedaalawe reqate banora noro: menenyaa yakafaahe quraanyaa nahe yelaale.

'alaahe lakahadiyaane batenesaa'ee qane nafesaacehune bakehedatenaa bahathi'ate badelaacexwaalenaa bazaareewe qane meneme 'ayethaqemaacehume. mekeneyaatume baduneyaa bakehedatenaa bahathi'ate 'enedatagaaraacehute hulu bazaareeweme qane baqethaate tegaaraalaacehu yelaacawaale.

'enazihe sawoce 'ewenatene kamasemaate daneqorowocenaa 'ewenatene kamaayate `eweroce bamahonaacawe lamahonu ('aneta male'eketanyaa hoye!) daneqorone maasamaate wayeme `ewerocene mameraate wayeme geletze kahonawe yatasetakaakala manegade yatasaasaatutene wada qathetanyaawe manegade mameraate tecelaalahene?
'enasune saaneqathaa 'anetane bamote benewasedehe 'enyaa ka'enasu baduneyaanaa ba'akxiraa tabaqaayoce nane.
wayeme yaanene yazaatenebaacawene qethaate benaasaayehe 'enyaa 'enasune maqethaate 'enecelaalane 'enyaane meneme liyaashanefune 'ayecelume.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kageetaahe yatawaradalehene 'athebeqahe yaaze. ba'esume szeraabate. 'aneta baqathetanyaawe manegade laaye nahenaa. ba'esu laaye meneme yatadebasabasa nagare yalabateme.
yehe qure'aane laaneta 'enaa lahhezebocehe kebere nawe. batenesaa'eewe qane sela 'esu bamaamane, manegadune bamakatale wada 'esu theri bamaaderage laaye tethayaqaalaacehu.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'aneta bafite yalaakenaacawene male'eketanyoce thayeqe lamahonu ka'are-rahhemaane wechi yamimalaku 'amaalekete 'adereganaalene?
musaane bata`aamerocaacene wada fire`onenaa wada shumaamenetocu ba'eregethe laakene 'enee yafethuraane hulu geetaa male'eketanyaa nanye 'alaacawe.
ta`aamerocaaceneme simathaalaacawe ba'eresu wadiyaawenu bamaashofenaa bamaalaagathe yeseqaalu.

nabiyu musaa (`aalayehi salaame) yamathaabatene manegade 'ewenatanyenate bamagelatze fire`onenaa shumaamenetocene kata`aamereme 'anediteneme 'anaasaayaacaweme 'eswa ka'eswa bafite yaalacewene yabalathace betehone 'eneji: baduneyaame kaalubate kehedate yemalasu zanede baqethaate yaazenaacawe; nagare gene limalasu 'alecaalume.

kaqethaatume yatawasanawe baaganyaacawe gizee: 'aneta dagaami hoye! geetaahe kaamanene qethaatune 'enedamiyaanasaa qaale bagabaalehe maszarate lamenelene qethaatune kaanasaalene wada 'ewenatu tamariwoce nane 'alu.
qethaatune baanasaanelaacaweme gizee yagabutene qaale yaafaresaalu; qaalaacawene 'ayemolume.

fire`oneme bakuraate hhezebocune bamathaaraate hhezebocee hoye! yagebetze gezaate negeszenaa yanee 'ayedalamene? ka'abaayeme waneze bafoqocee sere yamifasawe negeszenaayeenenaa taalaaqenateene 'ataayumene?
'enee: kazihe waraadaa (tabaaraari)naa negegeruneme kamaayaasaamerawe (kamusaa) yatashaalekunyenaa balaache nanye.

'esu 'ewenatanyaa male'eketanyaa selamahonu yamigaletze: lamene 'alaahe yawareqe 'amebaare 'ayaawaredelateme wayeme takataataaye yahonu malaa'ekete ka'eresu gaare taqoraanyetawe lamenese 'ayemathume?!
hhezebocuneme 'amonyaacawe, bathemeetume takatalute, 'enasume ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yawathu honu.
kehedataacawene bamaqathalaacawe baaseqothuneme gizee tabaqalenaacawe. huluneme weha wesethe 'asamathenaacawe.

fire`onenenaa shumaamenetocu 'enedathafu 'enedaayethafu qadaamiwoce 'enaa ya'enasune `aayenate szeraa bamaszeraate yaagaathamaacawene 'enedaayaagaathemawe mamakarene lafalaga mamakariyaanaa mesaalee 'adaragenaacawe.

'enanyaa 'agaariwoce (inWakum wama ta`buduwna min duwni 'llWahi HaSabu jahanWama 'antum laha wariduwna ) <<'enaanetanaa ka'alaahe baashaagare yametegazwacawe: yajahaname (ya'esaate) maagado (maaqathaathayaa) bamahone 'esaate tegabaalaacehu>> bamilawe ya'aneqatze 'athaqaalaaye male'ekete wesethe: keresetiyaanoce yamiyaamalekute `isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) yekaatataale (yegabaale); mekeneyaatume 'alaahe thaa`otaatene maamelake 'enedakalakalawe hulu: 'eresune maamelakeneme kalekelwale: bamahonume yekaatataale: belawe 'asabu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! hhezebocehe bakerekere 'eyatanechaachu 'enaa 'eyarabashu: nagaru 'enediyaa kahona: 'amaaleketocaacene `isaa yahonawene 'enedihonu faqedanaale: yelaalu; bamahonume 'alaahe la'enasu melaashe bamasethate: (inWa 'lWadhiyna sabaqat lahum mWinWa 'lHusna~ 'uwlay'ika `anha mub`aduwna) <<'enanyaa: ka'enyaa zanede malekaame qaale yaasaalafenelaacawe: 'enaresu ka'ereswa (ka'esaate) yaraaqu naacawe>> yamilawene 'aneqatze 'awarada.

yanyaa 'amaaleketoce yebalethaalu wayese `isaa? yelaalu. benu zibe`aaraanaa 'amesaayaawe yehenene mesaalee yaamathute 'ewenate felagaa saayehone makaraakarene bamafalage nawe. 'enasu lakerekere yatafatharu takaraakaariwoce naacawe.

`isaa yamareyame leje kabaarocaacene makaakale 'anedu hono yanabiyenatenaa yamale'eketanyenate tzagaa yasathanawe nawe. laseraa'eele lejoce taalaaqe mesaalee 'adaragenawe. yaame 'alaahe 'adamene yaala 'abaatenaa 'enaate 'enedafatharawe hulu `isaane yaala 'abaate bamafethare ya'alaahene caayenate 'enedamaaserajaa yamithaqamubate 'adaragene.
'enaaneta ya'adame lejoce! 'enaanetane maathefaate benefalege 'athefetane ba'enaaneta meteke medere yamitaku malaa'eketoce metekocene 'enaadaregaalane.

`isaa (`aalayehi salaame) macharashaa zamane laaye bamiwaredebate gizee katenesaa'ee taalaalaaqe meleketoce 'anedu melekete nawe. tenesaa'ee mamethaatune 'atetharaatharu. 'enee ka'alaahe yaamathaahulaacehune male'ekete takatalu. mekeneyaatume 'enee yezheelaacehu yamathaahute mawalaagade yaleelabate qathetanyaa manegade nawe balaacawe.
shayethwaneme kaqathetanyaawe manegade bamaathemamenaa bamaataalale 'ayaagedaacehu 'eresu la'enaaneta thalaatenatu geletze yahona thalaate nawe.

`isaa (`aalayehi salaame) ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa selamahonu geletze ta`aameraatocene yezo bamathaa gizee: <<'enee ka'alaahe zanede thebabene yezhee bamamethaate bahaayemaanotaacehu gudaaye 'anedaanede yamaategebaabubaacawene nagaroce geletze laadaregelaacehu nawe. ya'esune te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene feru! 'eneeneme bamaazezaacehunaa bamekalakelaacehu nagare taazazunye>> 'alaacawe.

<<'alaahe yaneeme yanaanetame geetaa nawe; ka'eresu leelaa geetaa yalaneme. 'amelekotaacehuneme la'alaahe becaa 'aderegu. yehe 'enee theri yaadaragekulaacehu tawehhidenaa 'amelekone la'alaahe becaa maaderage mawalaagade yaleelabate qathetanyaa manegade nawe>> 'alaacawe.

ba`isaa gudaaye laaye yatalayaayu budene honu: ka'enasu makaakale 'amelaake nawe yamilu, ya'alaahe leje nawe yamilunaa 'esunaa 'enaatu 'amelaake naacawe yamilu 'alu. `isaa 'amelaake nawe bamaalate, leje nawe, szosetanyaawe nawe bamaalate nafesaacawene yabadalute 'asaamaamine qethaate wayolaacawe.

'enazihe ba`isaa gudaaye laaye babudene yatakafaafalu sawoce: tenesaa'eewe saayaasebu badenegate mamethaatene 'eneji leelaa yethabaabaqaalune? 'enasu bakehedataacawe laaye honawe tenesaa'eewaa kamathaace guzwacawe wada 'asaamaami qethaate nawe.

bakehedatenaa bathememate laaye yatawadaaju batenesaa'eewe qane kafilu lakafilu thalaate yehonaale. 'enaziyaa ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene yamifaru siqaru 'enasu yamaayeqwaarathe zawatere yahona wadaajenate 'alaacawe.

'alaaheme labaarocu: <<'enaaneta baarocee hoye! bazaareewe qane selawadafitu meneme segaate 'ayegebaacehu. 'enedihume kaduneyaa baamalathaacehu yaduneyaa gudaayoce meneme tekaazee yalabaacehume>> yelaacawaale.
'enaziyaa bamale'eketanyaawe laaye batawaradawe qure'aane yaamanu: baqure'aane bamamaraate te`ezaazune yamifatzemunaa yakalakalawene yamikalakalu naacawe.
bamiyaaganyute qwaami yamaayeqwaarathenaa yamaayethafaa tzagaa tadasaacoce setehonu 'enaanetanaa 'enaanetane ba'emenate yamimaselwacehu janate gebu yebaalaalu.

safaafi yahonu zerege saahenocenaa mayaazhaa joro yaleelaacawe kubaayaawoce bamayaaze 'agalegaayocaacawe ba'enasu laaye yezoraalu. bajanate wesethe nafesoce yamikajalute, `aayenoceme bamaayate yamidasatubate hulu 'ala. 'enaanetame bawesethwa zalaalame nawaariwoce naacehu. ka'eswa lazalaalame 'atewathume.
yaaci yatagalatzacelaacehu janate teszarute banabaraacehute szeraa ka'esu (ka'alaahe) terufaate yatasathaacexwaate naate.
la'enaaneta ba'eswa wesethe yamaayeqwaarathu bezu feraafereewoce 'alalaacehu ka'eswame temagabaalaacehu.

'alaahene lamifaru sawoce yaazagaajalaacawene menedaa kagalatza baxwaalaa: bataqaaraani yaalu 'amatzanyocene yaazagaajalaacawene sigaletze:
bakehedatenaa bahathi'ate 'amatzanyoce yahonute batenesaa'eewe qane bajahaname wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe
kaqethaatu 'ayeqalelaacaweme; 'enasu baqethaate wesethe ka'alaahe 'ezenate tasefaa qoraachoce naacawe.
'enyaa 'enasune 'esaate wesethe bamaasegabaataacene 'alebadalenaacaweme. nagare gene raasaacawene bakehedate badalu.

ya'esaate thabaaqi yahonawene "maalikene" bamathaaraate: <<'aneta maalike hoye! kaqethaatu lamagalaagale geetaahe mote yewasenebene (yegedalane)>>; maalikeme melaashe bamasethate: <<'enaaneta baqethaate wesethe lazalaalame zawetaariwoce naacehu, 'atemotume, qethaatume 'ayeqalelaacehume>>: yelaacawaale.
duneyaa wesethe meneme therethaaree yaleelawene 'ewenatanyaawene manegade 'amathaanelaacehu. gene 'abezaanyaawocaacehu 'ewenatune tethalu nabaraacehu.
banabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) bamaadame biyaaseeru 'enyaame tanekolaacawene bamibalethe maleku bamamalase 'enaathanaakerebaacawaalane.

lamahonu 'enasu balebocaacawe wesethe yaqwaatharutenenaa bamakaakalaacawe bamisethere yamiwayaayutene yamaanesamaa yemaselaacawaalene?! bafetsume! 'enyaa huluneme 'enesamaalane, batachamaarime malaa'eketocaacene yamiszarutene hulu 'enasu zanede yemazagebaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa seete lejocene wada 'alaahe yamiyaasethagutene sawoce 'alaahe ka'enasu 'abaabaale yalaaqanaa yatharaa nawenaa 'enee'enaaneta kamitelute nagare 'eresune kamitharutenaa kamigazute yamajamariyaa nanye balaacawe.
yasamaayaate, yamederenaa ya`areshe geetaa 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce ba'alaahe laaye kamiyaagaarute 'agaare, misetenaa lejoce hulu yatharaa (yalaaqa) geetaa nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enasune wedaaqi bahonawe manegadaacawe laaye yaanene yesefaraarubate yanabarutene qanaacawene 'esekiganaanyu derase yechaawatume tawaacawe. baziyaane gizee yanabarubatene macharashaa yaaweqaalu yetzatzataalu.

'esu yaa basamaaye wesethe ba'ewenate ligazute yamigabaawe bamedereme wesethe ba'ewenate ligazute yamigabaawe 'amelaake nawe. 'esu bamafethare, bamawasanenaa bamaasetanaabare thebabanyaa yabaarocune gudaayoce `aawaaqi nawe. meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.

yasamaayaatenaa yamedere bamakaakalume yaalawe hulu negeszenaa laresu becaa yahonawe welataawenaa barakatu yabazaa 'amelaake laaqa. yatenesaa'eewe qane (sa`aatitu) `eweqate macee 'enedahonace ka'esu basetaqare maaneme 'ayaaweqeme. `eweqatu 'esu zanede becaa nawe. bamacharashaaweme qane lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa wada 'esu becaa temalasaalacehu.

'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce ka'alaahe wechi yamiyaamalekwaacawe 'akaalaate melejaane liyaamaaledwacawe 'ayecelume. 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe wechi ba'ewenate limalake yamigabaawe 'amelaake 'enedaleela ba'ewenate yamasakaru siqaru 'eneda `isaa, `uzayerenaa malaa'eketoce.
maanawe yafatharaacehu? belahe betethayeqaacawe 'enasume <<'alaahe nawe>> yeluhale. yehenene kaaragaagathu baxwaalaa 'esune kamagazaate 'enedeete wada leelaa yezoraalu?!
'alaahe male'eketanyaawe bahhezebocu masetabaabale yaaqarabawe semotaane yaaweqaale. 'esume geetaayee hoye! 'enaziyaa sawoce 'aneta balaakanye male'ekete 'ayaamenume.
celaa balaacawe ya'enasune tanekole yametemalesebatene negegere tanaagaraacawe (yehe bamakaa yanabara huneetaa nawe) lawadafitu yamiyaagathemaacawene qethaate saayaawequte 'ayeqarume.
(Hm) <<hha mime>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe majamariyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)
'alaahe: qathetanyaawene manegade yamigaletze bahonawe qure'aane yemelaale.
'enyaa qure'aanene bamawasanyaayetu barakatwa yabazaa bahonace lalite 'awaradene. 'enyaa bazihe qure'aane 'asefaraariwoce nane.
bazice lalite ba`aamatu 'enedikasate yatawasanawe sisaaye, `edemeenaa leeloce nagaroce hulu yewasanaale.
ka'enyaa zanede yakxona te'ezaaze 'enelayaalane; 'enyaa male'eketanyocene laakiwoce nane.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kageetaahe bahona 'ezenate male'eketanyocene laakene. 'enaho 'esu yabaarocune negegere samiwe yabaarocune szeraanaa hasaabe `aawaaqi nawe. meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.
yasamaayaate, yamederenaa bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawe nagare hulu geetaa nawe. 'eregethanyaa 'emenate kaalaacehume bamale'eketanyocee 'emanu.

ka'eresu leelaa ba'ewenate yamimalake yalame. heyaawe yaadaregaale; yegadelaaleme. ka'esu wechi heyaawe maaderageme magedaleme yamicele yalame. ya'enaanetame yamajamariyaawocume 'abaatocaacehu geetaa nawe.
'enanyaa 'agaariwoce bazihe 'eregethanyaa 'emenate yalaacaweme. yelequnese 'enasu yamichaawatu sihonu bamatharaathare wesethe naacawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! samaayeme geletse bahona chese yametemathaabatene karahaabe bezaate ba`aayenaacawe wada samaaye sethabaabaqu yametemathaabaacawene yaqerebe qane qethaate tathabaabaqe.
sawocene hulu bamishafene bahona chese la'enasume yehe 'asaamaami yahona qethaate nawe yebaalaalu.
geetaacawene bamamaatzane geetaacene hoye! wada 'enyaa yalaqaqekawene qethaatene 'anesaalene. yehenene qethaate yametaanasaalene kahona ba'anetanaa bamale'eketanyaahe 'enaamenaalane: 'alu.
male'eketanyaawe geletze yahonane male'ekete 'amethetolaacawe 'eyaalanaa 'ewenatanyaanatune 'eyaawaqu 'enedeete qethaatu bawarada gizee bamagasatze wada geetaacawe yemalasaalu?!
kaziyaame ba'esu kamaamane zoru. sela'esume 'esu leelaa sawe yamiyaasetamerawe 'eneji male'eketanyaa 'ayedalame bamaalate 'ebede nawe 'alu.
'enyaa ka'enaaneta qethaatune latheqite gizee senaanasaa 'enaaneta wada kehedataacehunaa maasetabaabalaacehu temalasaalaacehu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! batenesaa'eewe qane 'enasune 'esaate wesethe bamaasegabaate beretu 'ayaayaazene bameneyaazaacawe gizee tathabaabaqaacawe 'enyaa 'enasune ba'alaahe bamakaadaacawe, male'eketanyaawene bamaasetabaabalaacawe 'enebaqalaacawaalane.
ka'enasume bafite yafire`one hhezebocene fatenanaale. wada 'enasume wada 'alaahe 'anedenatenaa 'ameleko yamitharaacawe yatakabarawe male'eketanyaa musaa (`aalayehi salaame) mathaalaacawe.

musaame lafire`onenaa lahhezebu ya'eseraa'eele lejocene ya'alaahe baaroce bamahonaacawe 'enasune baariyaa 'aderegaacehu leteyezu 'ayegabaacehume. 'enee wada 'enaaneta yatalaakunye ya'alaahe male'e`eketanyaa nanye. wada 'enaaneta 'enedaadarese yaazazanyene bataamaanyenate meneme saalechamere 'enedihume meneme saaleqanese 'adaresaalahu 'alaacawe.
<<'alaahene magazaatene bamatawe 'atekuru; babaarocume laaye yabalaaye bamahone wasane 'atelafu; 'enee geletze yahonane maaserajaa 'amathaalaacexwaalahu 'alaacawe.
'eneeneme badenegaaye bamawegare 'enedaategadelunye bageetaayeenaa bageetaacehu tathabeqeeyaalahu.
'enee yamathaahubatene kaalaamanaacehu bamathefo nagare 'ateqerabunye raaqunye>> 'alaacawe.
musaa geetaawene bamamaatzane <<'enazihe (fire`onenaa shumaamenetu) 'amatzanyoce bamahonaacawe lafathaane qethaate tagabiwoce naacawe>> 'ala.
'alaahe musaane hhezebocune yezo bamaataa 'enediwathaa 'azazawe, fire`onenaa hhezebocu 'enedamikataluteme nagarawe.
'alaahe 'esunaa yaseraa'eele lejoce baaherune katashaagaru baxwaalaa: kefetenaa yasakana 'enedahona 'eneditawawe 'azaza. fare`onenaa hhezebocu baahere wesethe bamasemathe thafiwoce naacawe.
fire`onenaa hhezebocu senetenaa senete (barekaataa) 'atekeletocenaa fasaashe menechocene tetawe heedu.
wada xwaalaacawe senetenaa senete 'azemaraawocenaa malekaame maqamachaawocene thelawe heedu.
tadasaacoce honawe sithaqaaqamubate yanabarawene nuro bezune nagaroce tawe.
nagaru 'enedatagalatzalaacehu hona. 'atekeletocu, menechocaacawene, 'azemaraacawenenaa manoriyaacawene bamulu leelocune hhezeboce (ya'eseraa'eele lejocene) 'awarasenaacawe.
samaayenaa medereme fire`onenaa hhezebocu bamasemathaacawe mekeneyaate 'alaalaaqasume. neseha 'enediyaadaregume yamiqoyu 'alehonume.
baregetheme ya'eseraa'eelene lejoce wanedocene bamagedalenaa seetocene bamaaseqaratu fire`onenaa hhezebocu yefatzemu kanabarute 'awaaraaje seqaaye 'adaanenaacawe.
kafire`one seqaaye 'adaanenaacawe. mekeneyaatume fire`one ka'alaahe te`ezaazenaa haayemaanote wasane yaalafa kuraatanyaa nabare.
ya'eseraa'eeleneme lejoce kamaawaqaacene gaare bazamanu kanabarute hhezeboce marathenaacawe; mekeneyaatume nabiyaatocaacawe bezu selanabaru.
musaane (`aalayehi salaame) yaagazenebaacawe ta`aameraatoce bawesethu geletze yahonu tzagaawoce yaalabatene ('eneda maare, 'eshatenaa yasabaa segaane yamasaasalutene) sathanaacawe.
'enazihe yamakaa 'agaariwocenaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yamiyaasetabaabelu baregetheme 'enedihe yelaalu.
'eswa yamajamariyaawaa motaacene kaziyaa baxwaalaa manasaate yaleelabaate mote 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaceme. 'enyaa kamotene baxwaalaa 'aneqasaqaseme.

'aneta muhhamade hoye! 'anetanaa takataayocehe 'alaahe yamotutene hheyaawe bamaaderage lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa yeqasaqesaale selametelute 'ewenatanyaa kahonaacehu: yamotutene 'abaatocaacenene 'amethulene yeluhale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lamahonu 'enaziyaa 'agaariwocenaa 'anetane yaasetabaabalu sawoce bagulebatenaa bamakalaakale bakule katuba`e hhezebocenaa kazaa bafite kanabarute `aadocenaa samudoce yeshaalaalune? huluneme 'athafaanaacawe mekeneyaatume 'amatzanyoce nabarunaa.
samaayaate, mederenaa bamakaakalaacaweme yaalutene hulu lachawaataa 'alefatharenaacaweme.
samaayaatenaa mederene lateleqe thebabe 'eneji 'alefatharenaacaweme. nagare gene 'abezaanyaawocu 'agaariwoce yehenene 'ayaawequme.
yatenesaa'eewe qane 'alaahe babaaroce makaakale yamifaradebate yafethuraane 'athaqaalaaye masabesabeyaa qana-qatharo nawe.

zamade zamadune 'enaa gwaadanyaa gwaadanyaawene yamaayethaqemebate 'enedihume ka'alaahe qethaate yamaayekalaakalubate qane nawe. mekeneyaatume negeszenaawe bazaane qane la'alaahe becaa nawe. maaneme negeszenaa 'alanye yamile yalame.
nagare gene 'alaahe yaazanalate sawe malekaame szeraane bamaaseqadamu yethaqamaale. 'alaahe maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi labaarocu 'azaanye nawe.

'alaahe tenesaa'eene kathaqasa baxwaalaa sawoce 'eneda menedaacawe yamilayaayu mahonune sigaletze -
ba'esaate sere 'alaahe yaabaqalaate ya <> zaafe;
hathi'atene yamiyaabazu megebe naate. mathefo fereewaaneme yemagabaalu.
yeheme feree 'eneda thequre defedefe zayete yaala nawe. 'ejege kamafelaatu yatanasaa hodaacawe wesethe yaminetakatake nawe.
'afalaalume bathaame kamafelaatu yatanasaa 'ejege 'enedaminetakatake weha nawe.
la'esaate zabanyoceme <<yaazute! yaala meneme reheraahee baxaayele wada jahaname 'esaate mahale gotetute;
kaziyaa baxwaalaa 'ejege kafalaawe weha cheneqelaatu laaye 'afesubate; seqaayeme 'enedaayelayawe>> yebaalaalu.
bamaashemwathatheme <<'aneta 'ashanaafinaa bahhezebocehe zanedeme yatakabarake yahonekawe yehenene 'asaamaami qethaate qemase>> yebaalaale.
yehe qethaate batenesaa'eewe qane makasatune tetharaatharute yanabarawe sihone 'ahune gene 'esune bamaayate therethaareewe tawagadalaacehu.
ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale geetaacawene yamifaru kamisagaa kefu nagare hulu salaame yamiyaaganyubate manoriyaa wesethe naacawe.
ba'atekeletocenaa waraaje menechoce wesethe naacawe.
janate wesetheme sese 'enaa waferaame hhare yelabesaalu. fite lafiteme yataqethaachu bamahone 'anedu yaleelaawene jarebaa 'ayaayeme.
kalaaye batathaqasawe 'enedaakabarenaacawe hulu bajanate wesethe qonejonaa kawebataacawe yatanasaa `aayenocaacawe telaaleqe yahonu seetocene 'agaabaanaacawe.
bajanate wesetheme yeqwaarathaale 'enedihume yegodaanaale yamile segaate saayegabaacawe 'agalegaayocene yamifalegwaacawene yaferaaferee `aayenate 'enediyaamathulaacawe lamaazaze yetharwacawaale.
'eziyaawe wesethe zawetaariwoce yehonaalu. baduneyaa kamotute mote basetaqare: leelaa motene 'ayeqamesume. geetaacaweme ka'esaate qethaate thabaqaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe terufaatenaa malekaame welataane yawaalalaacawe naacawe. yehe kalaaye yatathaqasawe (janate magebaatenaa ka'esaate mathabaqe) teleqe dele nawe. meneme dele 'ayewadaadaraweme.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehenene qure'aane baqwaaneqwaahe ba`aarabenyaa bamaawerade qalaale nagare yaadaragenawe hhezebocehe yeganazabu zanede nawe.
ya'anetane delenaa ya'enasune mathefaate tathabaabaqe. 'enaresu yaanetane mathefaate tathabaabaaqiwoce naacawenaa.
(Hm) <<hha mime>> (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe majamariyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)
qure'aane yawaradawe maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi, bamafethare, bamawasanenaa bamaasetanaabare thebabanyaa kahonawe 'alaahe nawe.
basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe ya'alaahene celotaanaa becanyaa tamalaakinatune la'amaanyoce yamiyaaseradu ta`aameraatoce yeganyaalu. ba'ezihe maaserajaa tathaqaamiwocu 'enaresu naacawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'enaanetane kafetewate thabetaa kaziyaame karagaa dame kaziyaame yataanyaka kamimasele szegaa bamafethare, medere laaye yamineqasaaqasutene hulu mafetharu 'alaahe fathaari lamahonu 'eregethanyaa 'emenate laalaacawe hulu becanyenatune yamiyaaseradu meleketoce bawesethaacawe yeganyaale.

yalalitenaa qane mafaraaraqenaa matakaakaate, kasamaaye zenaabene bamaawerade mute yanabaracewene medere 'atekeletocene bamaabeqale heyaawe maaderage, nefaasene katalayaayu 'aqethaachaawoce 'enedinafese maagalaabathenaa maazawaaware ya'alaahene 'anedenate, mutaanene maqaseqase 'enedihume huluneme nagaroce yamaaderage celotaa 'enedaalawe bamaaserajaanate lamithaqamu `aawaaqiwoce hulu yamiyaaseradu meleketoce 'alu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enazihe meleketocenenaa maaserajaawocene yamenetarekelehe ba'ewenate nawe. 'alaahe babaariyaawe laaye yaawaradawene yanegegere maaserajaawoce yamaayaamenu kahona; lamahonu bayatenyaawe negegerenaa bayatenyaawe maaserajaa nawe liyaamenu yamicelute?!
weshataame bathaame hathi'atanyaa lahonu hulu ya'alaahe qethaatenaa thefaate banasu laaye yehune.

yehe kahadi baqure'aane wesethe ya'alaahe 'aneqatzoce sinababe yesamaale. kaziyaa baxwaalaa bakehedatunaa bahathi'atu laaye yezawateraale. 'ewenatene kamakatale bamakuraate yaminababulatene 'aneqatzoce sameto 'enedaalesamaa yehonaale. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehenene sawe bamacharashaawe qane kefu yahona seqaaye 'enedaalawe negarawe. yaame yamiyaasaameme qethaate yethabeqawaale.

kaqure'aaneme 'anedaace male'ekete badarasawe gizeeme yamiyaashofebate maashofiyaa 'aderego yeyezawaale. 'enazihe qure'aanene maashofiyaa 'aderegawe yayaazu sawoce batenesaa'eewe qane 'awaaraaje qethaate 'alalaacawe.

kafite lafitaacawe bamacharashaawe qane yajahaname 'esaate yethabeqaacawaale. yaaganyuteme ganezabe meneme 'ayethaqemaacaweme. 'enedihume 'enaziyaane ka'alaahe baashaagare yayaazwacawe thaa`otaateme ka'alaahe qethaate meneme 'ayekalaakalulaacaweme. la'enasu taalaaqe seqaayenaa qethaate 'alalaacawe.

bamale'eketanyaacene muhhamade laaye yaawaradenawe matsehhafe wada 'ewenate manegade yamimaraa nawe. 'enaziyaa 'alaahe bamale'eketanyaawe laaye yaawaradaacawene 'aneqatzoce yamikedu la'enaresu kefu 'asaamaami qethaate 'alalaacawe.

'enaaneta sawoce 'alaahe baaherene bamaageraate ba'esu te'ezaaze marekaboce 'enedineqasaaqasunaa yatafaqadu yahonu sisaayene katerufaatu 'enedetefalegu basathaacehume tzagaa 'alaahene taamasagenu zanede yaagaraalaacehu 'esu becaa nawe.

basamaayaate yaalutene tzahhaye, charaqaanenaa kawaakebetene 'agaraalaacehu. bamedereme laaye wanezocene, zaafoce, taraarocenaa leelocene 'agaraalaacehu. 'enazihe hulu tzagaa baresu cerotaa 'enaa maalekaamenatenawe.'enazihene la'enaaneta bamaageraate ya'alaahene caayenatenenaa becanyaa tamalaakinatene ba'aneqatzocu lamiyaasetanatenu sawoce yamiyaaseradaa meleketoce nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanu me'emanaanene 'enaziyaa la'alaahe tzagaame yehune laqethaatu gede yaleelaacawe kahadiyaane lamiyaathafubaacehu thefaate yeqere balwacawe. 'alaahe 'eyaanedaanedune taagaashe 'amaanyeneme hona wasane 'alaafi kahadiyaanene baduneyaa yeszarute banabarawe szeraa waagaacawene yesathaacawaale: balaacawe.

malekaame szeraane yaszaraa yaszeraawe wetheete laraasu nawe. 'alaahe kaszeraawe meneme 'ayethaqameme. mathefo szeraane yaszaraa yamathefo szeraawe wetheete qethaate baraasu laaye nawe. mathefo bamaszeraatu 'alaahene meneme 'ayegodaame. kaziyaa baxwaalaa batenesaa'ee qane wada 'alaahe becaa temalasaalacehu. yaszeraawocaacehune wetheete 'enedayaszeraacehu yemanadaacexwaale.

la'eseraa'eele lejoce taweraatenenaa basawoce makaakale bahegu masarate yamifaredubatene mamariyaa sathanaacawe. 'abezaanyaawocune nabiyaatocaacaweneme kaberaahime (`aalayehi salaame) zereyaa 'adaragene. katalayaayu malekaame sisaayoceme lagasenaacawe. bazamanaacawe kanabarute hhezeboce hulu 'asebalathenaacawe.

'ewenatene weshatene yamigaletzu (yamilayu) maaserajaawocene sathanaacawe; male'eketanyaawe muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame)ne bamalaake geletze maaserajaa kamathaalaacawe baxwaalaa 'eneji: 'aletalayaayume nabare. wada 'ezihe malayaayateme yamaraacawe yabalaayenatenenaa selethaanene bamafalage 'anedu baleelaawe laaye wasane bamaalafu nawe. ('aneta male'eketanyaa hoye!) geetaahe batenesaa'eewe qane baduneyaa bamakaakalaacawe yaaletagebaabubaacawene gudaayoce geletze bamaaderage 'ewenate laaye yanabarawenenaa yaalenabarawene yaasaayaale.

ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa hoye! bamaqathaleme 'anetane sawocene wada 'emenatenaa malekaame szeraa yametethaaraa setehone baselaame hege laaye 'adaragenehe. bamahonume yehenene hege takatale. ka'ewenate yamiyaasaasetu selahonume ya'enaziyaane 'ewenatene yamaayaawequnaa semeetaacawene yamikatalu sawocene 'atekatale.

'enaziyaa 'ewenatene yamaayaawequtene sawoce zenebaalee yametekatale kahona: ya'alaahene qethaate qenethaate taakele likalaakalulehe 'ayecelume. bahulume manegadocenaa haayemaanotoce laaye yaalu badaayoce kafilu leelaawene yeradaale. 'alaahe me'emanaanenaa ya'esune te'ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene yamifarutene thabaaqinaa radaate nawe.

yehe bamale'eketanyaacene laaye yaawaradenawe qure'aane sawoce 'ewenatene kaweshate bamalayate yamimalakatubate berehanoce, wada 'ewenate yamimaraanaa ba'eregethanyenate lamiyaamenu 'ezenate nawe. mekeneyaatume geetaacawe 'enediwadelaacawe, janate 'enediyaasegabaacawenaa ka'esaate 'enediyaareqaacawe wada qathetanyaa manegade yamimarubate bamahonu nawe.

'enaziyaane kehedatenaa hathi'atene ba'akaalaacawe yamisaru sawoce bamenedaa bakule ka'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanunaa malekaame szeraane yaszaru sawoce gaare baduneyaanaa ba'akxeeraa 'ekule yamenaadaregaacawe yemaselaacawaalene?! 'enedihe yamiyaasebu kahona menenyaa 'aseqayaami wesaanee nawe!

'alaahe samaayaatenaa mederene lachawaataa saayehone: lataalaaqe thebabe nawe yafatharaacawe. 'eyaanedaanedwane nafese baszaraacewe malekaameme hona mathefo szeraa yemanadaacawaale. 'alaahe yaszarutene malekaame szeraa bamaagwaadalenaa yaalesarutene hathi'ate bamachamare 'ayebadelaacaweme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! zenebaaleewene fetsume saayetsaarare 'amelaaku 'aderego yayaazawene sawe tamalakatekene? 'alaaheme 'esu lamathemame yatagabaa mahonune bamaawaqu wada 'ewenate 'alemaraaweme. lebu laaye maahetame bamaatame yamithaqemawene 'enedaayesamaa 'adaragawe. batachamaarime `aayenu laaye geredoshe bamaaderage 'ewenatene 'enedaayemalakate 'agadawe. bamahonume 'alaahe yaasaasaatawene wada 'ewenate manegade yamimaraawe maane nawe? lamahonu semeetene makatale yaalawene gudaate naa ya'alaahene hege makatale yaalawene theqeme 'ateganazabumene?!

'enaziyaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yamiyaawagezu sawoce heyewate maalate yaduneyaa heyewate 'eneji leelaa heyewate yalame. tewelede yemotaale 'ayemalaseme. leelaa tewelede yetakaale, 'enyaane yamigadelane yalalitenaa yaqane matakaakaatenaa mafaraaraqe becaa nawe yelaalu. kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene bamaasetabaabalaacawe kagemetenaa kataraa therethaaree wechi meneme `eweqate yalaacaweme. gemetenaa taraa therethaaree dagemo ka'ewenate meneme 'ayaabeqaaqaame.

'enaziyaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene bamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce laaye geletze yahonu 'aneqatzocaacene baminababelaacawe gizee lamale'eketanyaawenaa labaaledarabocu kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasaacenene batamalakata 'ewenatanyoce nane yametelu kahona yamotute 'abaatocaacenene 'esekiqasaqesunaa 'amethulene. kamilawe makaraakariyaa nathebe wechi leelaa meneme maaserajaa yalaacaweme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe 'enaanetane kafetewate thabetaa bamafethare heyaawe yaadaregaacexwaale. kaziyaame baxwaalaa yegadelaacexwaale. kamotaacehu baxwaalaa batenesaa'eewe qane lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa yesabasabaacexwaale. yaa qane yaala meneme therethaare machi nawe. nagare gene 'abezaanyaawe sawe 'ayaaweqeme. baziheme mekeneyaate malekaame szeraane bamaszeraate 'ayezagaajume.

yasamaayaatenaa yamedere baalabeetenatenaa negeszenaa ya'alaahe becaa nawe. ba'enaziheme wesethe ka'esu basetaqare yamimalake leelaa 'amelaake yalame. yaaci mutaanene lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa yamiqasaqasubaate yahonace sa`aatitu (yatenesaa'eewe qane) bametekasatebate gizee 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe wechi siyaamaleku yanabaru 'ewenatene wedeqe lamaaderagenaa weshatene lamaanegase sineqasaaqasu yanabaru yaweshate sawoce yekaseraalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bazaane qane hulume hhezeboce bagulebataacawe bamanebarekake yamifatsamebaacawene sithabaabaqu temalakataalahe. hulume hhezeboce 'enaziyaa thabaaqi malaa'eketoce wada tzaafwacawe mazegabe yetharaalu. 'enaaneta sawoce hoye! baduneyaa seteszarute yanabarawe mathefoneme yehune malekaaneme nagare bazaareewe qane temanadaalaacehu.

yehe mazegabaacene (malaa'eketoce szeraawocaacehune simazagebubate yanabarawe mazegabe sihone) ba'ewenate yefaredebaacexwaalenaa 'anebebute. 'enyaa thabaaqi malaa'eketocene szeraawocaacehune baduneyaa 'enedimazagebu 'enaazezaacawe nabare.
'enaziyaa yaamanunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru geetaacawe ba'ezenatu janate wesethe yaasegabaacawaale. yehe 'alaahe yasathaacawe menedaa meneme yamaayewadaadarawe geletze yahona dele nawe.

'enaziyaa 'alaahene yakaadutene bamaneqafe <<lamahonu 'aneqatzocee sinababelaacehu 'anaameneme bamaalate 'alekoraacehumene? kehedatenenaa wanejalene yametefatsemu wanejalanyoce 'alenabaraacehumene?>> yebaalaalu.

yaa 'alaahe baarocune lamaqaseqase qana qatharo yasathawe yaqatharo qane meneme therethaaree yaleelawe 'ewenate nawe. yatenesaa'eewe mamethaateme therethere yaleelawe 'ewenate nawe. la'eswa qane yamithaqemaacehune malekaame szeraane szeru batabaala gizee <<tenesaa'ee mene 'enedahona 'anaaweqeme. 'enyaa mamethaatwane tatharaathaariwoce nane. makasatwaneme 'eregethanyaa 'ayedalaneme>> 'alaacehu.
baduneyaa yaszarute mathefo szeraa kehedatenaa hathi'ate geletze honalaacawe. bamiyaasethanaqeqaacaweme gizee siyaashofubate yanabarawe qethaate waradabaacawe.

'alaahe yazaareewene qane maganaanyate ba'emenatenaa bamalekaame szeraa saatezagaaju bamaresaataacehu mekeneyaate bazaareewe qane 'esaate wesethe 'enetawaacexwaalane: yelaacawaale. yametenorubaate maqamachaacehu 'esaate naate. ya'alaahene qethaate bamakalaakale yamiradaacehu maaneme yalame.

yehe yataqathaacehute qethaate ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce masaalaqiyaa 'aderegaacehu bamayaazaacehu mekeneyaate nawe. yaduneyaa heyewate bageethaageethocwanaa bathaafaachenatwa 'ataalalacaacehu. bazaareewe qane 'enazaa ba'alaahe 'aneqatzoce yamiyaashofu ka'esaate 'ayewathume yelequnese lazalaalame nawaariwoce naacawe. malekaame szeraane yeszarume zanede wada duneyaa 'ayemalasume 'enedihume geetaacawe 'enasune bawedeetaa 'ayeqabalaacaweme.
mesegaanaa yasamaayaate, yamederenaa ya'athaqaalaaye fethuraane geetaa lahonawe la'alaahe becaa nawe.
basamaayaatenaa bamedere kuraatenaa leqenaa la'esu nawe. 'esu 'ashanaafi maaneme yamaayaashanefawe bamafethare, bamawasanenaa bamaasetanaabare thebabanyaa nawe.
(Hm) <<hha mime>>: (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe majamariyaa laaye taberaaretwale.)
qure'aane 'ashanaafiwe maaneme yamaayaashanefawe, bamafetharenaa bamawasane thebabanyaa kahonawe 'alaahe waredwale.

samaayaatenenaa mederene 'enedihume ba'enazihe makaakale yaalawene hulu lachawaataa 'alefatharenaacaweme. yelequnese 'enazihene hulu ba'ewenatenaa lataalaaqe thebabe nawe yafatharenaacawe. kathebabocu makaakale baaroce ba'enazihe meleketoce 'amaakaanyenate geetaacawene 'aweqawe 'eresune becaa 'enedigazu 'enaa ba'esu meneme saayaagaaru yatafatharulatene `aalaamaa maasaakaate nawe. bazihe medere laaye 'alaahe yawasanawe yatawasana gizee derase yeqoyaalu. 'enazaa kahadiyaane 'alaahe kaawaradalaacawe mamariyaa yaraaqunaa gede yalashoce naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enanyaa kahhaqe yaraaqu 'agaariyaane: 'eseki 'enaziyaane ka'alaahe wechi yametegazwacawe thaa`otaate kamedere mene fatharu? negarunye balaacawe. lamahonu taraarocene fatherawaalene? wanezocenese fatherawaalene? wayese samaayaatene bamafethare tagaaretawe dereshaa 'alaacawene? kaqure'aane bafite ka'alaahe yawarada matsehhafe kaala 'eseki 'amethu wayeme yamajamariyaawocu yataweraate ya`eweqate qerite kaalanaa thaa`otocaacene la'ameleko tagabi naacawe sela metelute nagare 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu 'amethu balaacawe.

ka'alaahe wechi 'eseka tenesaa'eewe derase latheriwe melaashe yamaayesathutene thaa`otaatene kamigazu yabalatha thamaamaa (yatasaasaata) maaneme yalame. 'enazihene ka'alaahe wechi yamigazwacawe thaa`otaate kamigazwacawe sawoce theri yazanagu naacawe. mekeneyaatume ge`uze nagaroce yamaayesamu, yamaayaayunaa yamaayaasebu naacawe.

ka'alaahe wechi yamigazwacawe nagaroce baduneyaa 'enedamaayethaqemwacawe hulu: batenesaa'eewe qane siqasaqasunaa sisabasabu ka'enasu (tagazhiwoce) 'ameleko natzaanataacawene bamagelatse yaawagezwacawaale. 'enyaane magazaataacawene 'anaaweqememe yelaalu.
bamale'eketanyaacene laaye yaawaradenawe 'aneqatzoce sinababelaacawe 'enaziyaa qure'aanene yakaadu sawoce yehe ka'alaahe yamathaa saayehone geletze yahona degemete nawe yelaalu.

lamahonu 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce muhhamade yehenene qure'aane baraasu yafatharawenaa yaqathafawe 'eneji ka'alaahe yaamathaawe 'ayedalame yelaalune? 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'enee karaasee yafatharekute kahona yehenene bamaaderagee yamidaresebenyene qethaate letekalaakalulenye 'atecelume. bamahonume yehenene bamaqethafe 'enedeete raaseene laqethaate 'agaalethaalahunye?>> balaacawe. <<'alaahe 'enaaneta qure'aanene bamaaneqwaashashenaa 'eneene bamaathelaalaate wesethe setewaanyu yaaweqaale. ba'eneenaa banaaneta makaakale bamamalekatenaa bamamasekare 'alaahe becaa baqi nawe. 'alaahe wada 'esu yamimalasutene mahari labaarocume 'azaanye nawe.>>

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enazihe nabiyenatehene yaasetabaabalutene 'agaariwocene: <<'enee 'alaahe kalaakaacawe male'eketanyoce yamajamariyaa 'ayedalahume. kanee bafite bezu male'eketanyoce 'alefawaale. 'enee 'alaahe banee laaye 'enaa ba'enaaneta laaye yamifatsemawene nagare 'alaaweqeme. 'enee 'alaahe yaawaradalenyene raa`eye 'eneji leelaane 'alekataleme. yamenaagaraweme yameszaraaweme 'esu yaazazanyene 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame. 'enee geletze yahonekunye 'asethaneqaaqi 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalahume>> balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'agaariwoce: <<yehe qure'aane ka'alaahe zanede yamathaa bihonenaa 'enaaneta betekedute; ka'alaahe selamamethaatume ka'eseraa'eele lejoce (yayaa`eqube lejoce) 'enasu zanede yaalawene taweraate maszarate bamaaderage bimasakerunaa baqure'aane biyaamenu; nagare gene 'enaaneta kamaamane yeleqe betekorunaa baataamenu lamahonu 'enaaneta badaayoce 'ayedalaacehumene? 'alaahe badaayocene wada 'ewenate 'ayemaraame>> balaacawe.

'enaziyaa qure'aanenaa male'eketanyaawe yezote yamathaawene nagare yaasetabaabalu sawoce yehe muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yezote yamathaawe nagare 'ewenate bihone noro 'enazihe dakaamoce, dehocenaa baaroce wada 'ezihe 'emenate 'ayeqademuneme nabare yelaalu. male'eketanyaacawe yezote bamathaawe nagare baalamamaraataacaweme yatanasaa yehe yezote yamathaawe nagare yadero weshate nawenaa yehenene weshate 'anekataleme yelaalu.

kazihe qure'aane bafite banabiyulaahe musaa (`aalayehi salaame) yawaradawe taweraate wada 'ewenate yamimaraanaa ba'esu laamanute 'enaa lamikatalute 'ezenate nawe. yehe bamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yawaradawe qure'aane dagemo kazihe bafite yanabarutene matsaahhefetoce ka'alaahe selamamethaataacawe yamiyaaragaagethe; 'enaziyaane nafesaacawene basherekenaa bahathi'ate yabadalu sawocene yamiyaasethanaqeqe 'enaa kafathaariyaacawe 'enaa kabaarocu gaare malekaame genenyunate yaalaacawene bago szariwocene 'abesaari; bageletze `aarabenyaa qwaaneqwaa yawarada mamariyaa nawe.

'enaziyaa <<'alaahe geetaacene nawe, ka'esu wechi leelaa geetaa yalaneme>> bamaalate kaamanu baxwaalaa ba'emenatenaa bamalekaame szeraa laaye yatzanu lawadafitu bamacharashaawe qane ferehate yalabaacaweme. baduneyaa selaamalathaacawe yaduneyaa gudaayoce 'enaa wada xwaalaacawe tetawe yamathute 'ayaasaasebaacaweme.

'enaziyaa ba'enazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatzute: yajanate baaledaraboce naacawe. 'ezaa wesetheme lazalaalame nawaariwoce naacawe. yeheneneme menedaa yaaganyute duneyaa banabarubate gizee malekaame szeraawocene bamaszeraataacawe mekeneyaate nawe.

yasawe lejene: lawalaajocu malekaame welataa 'enediwele thabaqe yaala te'e`ezaazene 'asetalaalafenelate. lawalaajocu baheyewate kaalu 'enasune bamaagalegale kamotu baxwaalaame shari`aawene bamaayetzaarare maleku mataazaze 'enedaalabate 'azazenawe. batalaye 'enaatu setetzanesawe bacegere 'enedihume setewaledawe bacegere; ya'eregezenaawenaa thute mathebaate yamiyaaqomebate gizee salaasaa ware nawe. ba'a`emerowenaa ba'akaalu yatamwalaa darajaa badarasa gizee 'enaa 'arebaa `aamate simolaawe geetaayee hoye! baneenaa bawalaajocee laaye selawaalekelene welataa 'anetane 'enedaamasagene 'adereganye. 'enedihume 'aneta yametewadawene malekaame szeraane 'enedeszaraa 'adereganye. szeraayeeneme taqabalanye. lejoceeneme dagaage 'aderegelenye. 'enee kahathi'atee wada 'aneta tamaleshaalahu. 'enee late`ezaazocehe hulu 'eje satheceeyaalahu yelaale.

'enazihe sawoce yaszarwacawene malekaame szeraawocene batashaala maleku 'eneqabalaacawaalane. hathi'atocaacaweneme 'enaalefaacawaalane. baszarwacaweme hathi'atoce 'ayeyaazume. 'enazihe sawoce yajanate sawoce naacawe. yehe 'ewenatanyaa yahona qaale kidaane nawe. yaalameneme therethere yeragaagathaale.

'alaahe walaajocune yamitaazaze lejene bamesaalee bamagelatze sawocene walaajocaacawene 'eneditaazazu kaanasaasaa baxwaalaa bataqaaraaniwe walaajocaacawene yamaayetaazazutene bamesaalee bamagelatze 'eneda 'enasu kamahone 'enedenethanaqaqe bamaasaasabe 'enedihe yelaale::
yaa walaajocune thefaate banaaneta laaye yehune! kamotekunye baxwaalaa heyaawe honahe teqasaqasaalahe bamaalate tezetubenyaalaacehune? bezu teweledoce 'alefawaale. bezu sawoceme motawebaacawaale. nagare gene ka'enaresu 'anedeme yatanasaa yalame. walaajocu 'alaahe lejaacawene wada tekekelanyaa 'emenate 'enedimaraawe 'alaahene yemaatzanaalu. lalejaacaweme batenesaa'eewe yamaataamene kahona wayolehe. ba'esu 'emane ya'alaahe qaale kidaane therethaaree yaleelawe 'ewenate nawe: yelutaale. nagare gene leju kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene daageme bamaasetabaabale <> bamaalate tanaagara.

'enaziyaa sawoce kanasu bafite banabarute qethaate kataragaagaathabaacawe yasawocenaa yagaaneenoce hhezeboce sebesebe wesethe naacawe. 'esaate bamagebaataacaweme raasaacawenenaa beetasabocaacawene bamaathaataacawe yatanasaa 'enaresu ba'eregetheme kasaariwoce naacawe.

lahulatume budenoce (yajanate sebesebocenaa ya'esaate sebeseboce) 'enedayaszeraacawe darajaa 'alaacawe. yajanate sawoce kafe yaalu darajaawoce sinoraacawe ya'esaate sawoce dagemo kazeqetanyaa hulu zeqetanyaa 'azaqete wesethe naacawe. batenesaa'eewe qane hulume tamwaleto yekafalaacawaale. maaneme yaszaraawene malekaame szeraa bamaqanase, yaaleszaraawe hathi'ate tachenobate 'ayebadaleme.

'alaahene yamikedu, male'eketanyaawene yamiyaasetabaabelu 'esaate zanede bamiqarebubate gizee bawaqasaanaa batecete maleku duneyaa banabaraacehute gizee malekaame malekaamunenaa thaafaachune heyewate 'athaathemaacehu 'asaalefaacexwaale. bazaareewe qane gene medere laaye yaala'agebaabe bakuraate wesethe selanabaracehu 'enaa bakehedatenaa bahathi'ate wesethe bamazafaqe ka'alaahe te'ezaaze bamaafanegathaacehu mekeneyaate 'awaaraajenaa 'asaafaari yahonawene qethaate temanadaalaacehu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yahude yaszegaa zamanede yahonute `aadoce: badabube `aarabe baahera salaathee 'ahheqaafe bamibaale botaacawe banabarubate gizee ba'enasu laaye ya'alaahe qethaate 'enedaayewaredebaacawe baasethanaqaqaacawe gizee yahonawene 'asetaawese. kahude bafite hhezebocaacawene yamiyaasethanaqequ male'eketanyoce 'alaahene 'eneji 'enedaategazu. <<ka'esu gaare leelaane nagare 'ategazu. 'enee banaaneta laaye yataalaaqune qane qethaate 'efaraalaacexwaalahu>> yamile sihone baregetheme lekanaale.
hhezebocume <<'amaaleketocaacenene 'enedaanegazaa letaagedane nawe yamathaakxawene? letaadarege 'ateceleme. 'ewenatanyaa kahoneke yametezetebenene qethaate 'amethaabene bamaalate>> malasulate.

hudeme <<qethaatu macee 'enedamimathaa 'alaahe becaa nawe yamiyaaweqawe. 'enee sela'esu meneme `eweqate yalanyeme. 'enee wada 'enaaneta yatalaakubatene male'ekete 'aderaashe male'eketanyaa nanye. yamithaqemaacehune nagare yametetawu, 'enedihume yamigodaacehune nagare yametefatsemu maayemaane naacehu>> 'alaacawe.

yaa siyaathaadefute yanabarawe qethaate bamathaabaacawe gizee kasamaaye 'aqethaachaa wada shalaqocaacawe geletze daamanaa hono qarebo siyaayute yehe daamanaa yaqarabawe zenaabe lizanebalene nawe 'alu. bazihene gizee hude <<'enaaneta 'enedaasabaacehute zenaabe yayaaza daamanaa saayehone setaathaadefute yanabarawe qethaate nawe bawesethu 'asaamaami yahona qethaate yaazala nefaase nawe>> 'alaacawe.

'alaahe 'enedetaathafaacawe yaazazaatene yaaganyacewene hulu yametaathafaa setehone 'enasume thafu. kazihe bafite yenorubate yanabarawe manoriyaa beetocaacawe 'eneji meneme yamaayetaaye hona. 'enedazihe `aayenate 'asaamaami qethaate bakehedataacawenaa bahathi'atocaacawe laaye yazawataru wanejalanyocene 'eneqathaalane.
