la'enaaneta yaalesathanawene yatalayaayu yamecote sababocene lahude hhezeboce sathanaacawe. yamisamubatene joro, yamiyaayubatene `aayene, yamiyaasetanatenubatene 'a`emero 'adaragenelaacawe. bihoneme gene jorowocaacawe, `aayenocaacawenaa 'a`emerwacawe meneme 'alethaqamaacaweme. qethaate bamathaabaacawe gizee 'aletakalaakalulaacaweme; mekeneyaatume ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce kahadiwoce nabarunaa, bamahonume nabiyaacawe hude (`aalayehi salaame) siyaasethanaqeqaacawe yanabarawe qethaate bamaashofaacawe mekeneyaate waradabaacawe.

'enaaneta yamakaa sawoce hoye! bazuriyaacehu yanabarutene yakatamaa hhezebocene 'athefetanaale. `aadocene, samadocene, yaluthe hhezebocenenaa yamadeyane sawocene baregetheme 'athefetanaale. kakehedataacaweme yemalasu zanede yatalayaayu maaserajaawocene 'awaradenelaacawe.

ba'amelekonaa ba'erede yaaqaarebunaale belawe ka'alaahe wechi yayaazwacawe 'amaaleketoce lamene 'aleradwacaweme, bafetsume 'ayeradwacaweme. 'enediyaaweme 'enasu bamifalegwaacawe wasaanye sa`aate laaye thafubaacawe. 'enazihe thaa`otaate yethaqemunaale 'enedihume 'alaahe zanede yaamaaledunaale belawe tasefaa yaadaragubate nagare weshataacawenaa qethefataacawe nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kagaaneenoce yatawasanu qure'aanene 'enediyaadaamethu wada 'aneta baazorenaacawe gizee yahonawene 'asetaawese. 'enazihe gaaneenoce lamaadaamatheme baqarabu gizee 'erese baraasaacawe bathemonaa 'enedenaadaamethe zeme balu tabaabaalu. ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) qure'aanene 'anebebawe sicharesu waganocaacawene bazihe qure'aane yamaayaamenu kahona ka'alaahe qethaate lamaasethaneqaqe tamalasu.

waganocaacene hoye! <<'enyaa kamusaa (`aalayehi salaame) baxwaalaa yawaradutene matsaahhefete ka'alaahe maweradaacawene yamiyaaragaagethe yahona 'alaahe yaawaradawene matsehhafe samaane. yehe matsehhafe wada 'ewenatenaa wada qathetanyaawe manegade (wada selaame) yemaraale>> 'alwacawe.

waganocaacene hoye! muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) theri yamiyaadaregelaacehune 'ewenate taqabalute. 'esu kageetaawe yatalaaka male'eketanyaa mahonune 'emanu. baziheme mekeneyaate 'alaahe hathi'ataacehune yemerelaacexwaale. theri yamiyaadaregelaacehune 'ewenate bamaqabalaacehunaa bamuhhamade male'eketanyenate bamaamanaacehu mekeneyaate kamiyaagaathemaacehu 'asaamaami qethaate natzaa yaawathaacexwaale.

muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) theri yamiyaadaregawene 'ewenate yamaayeqabale kahona medere laaye ka'alaahe 'ayaamaletheme. ka'alaahe wechi kaqethaatu yamithabeqaweme maaneme yalaweme. 'enasume geletze kahonawe 'ewenate yatasaasaatu naacawe.

lamahonu 'enaziyaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yamiyaasetabaabelu kahadiyaane samaayaatenenaa mederene yafatharawe 'alaahe; gezufenaa safaafi kamahonaacaweme gaare sifatheraacawe yaalekabadawe geetaa mutaanene lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa maqaseqase caaye mahonune 'ayaawequmene? 'enasune hheyaawe maaderagene caaye nawe. 'esu nagarocene hulume caaye nawe. mutaanene hheyaawe maaderage 'ayesaanaweme.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce yakaadute wada 'esaate liqathu bamiqarebubate gizee 'enasune bamatacate <<lamahonu yehenene yametemalakatute 'esaate 'ewenate 'ayedalamene? wayese baduneyaa wesethe setaasetabaabelute 'enedanabarawe weshate nawe?>> yebaalaalu. 'enasume <<bageetaacene yehunebene 'ewenate nawe>> yelaalu. honome bakehedataacehu mekeneyaate ya'esaatene qethaate qemasu yebaalaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa yate`egesete baalabeete yahonute male'eketanyoce 'enedataagasute hulu hhezebocehe bamiyaasetabaabeluhe nagare laaye taagase. 'enazihe yate`egesete baalabeetoce nabiyu muhhamadene chamero nuhhe, beraahime, musaa 'enaa `isaa (`aalayehimu 'asalaame) naacawe. bafethenate 'enediqathu 'atefalege. 'anetane yaasetabaabalu sawoce qaale yatagabaawene yamacharashaawene `aalame qethaate baayu gizee kaqethaatu kebedatenaa rezemate yatanasaa; baduneyaa 'anede sa`aate yaahele yanoru yemaselaacawaale. yehe bamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yawaradawe qure'aane lasawocenaa lagaaneenoce hulu baqi gesaatzee nawe. bakehedatenaa bahathi'ate ka'alaahe te`ezaaze kaafanagathute baqare baqethaate yamithafaa yalame.
'enaziyaa 'alaahene yakaadunaa sawocene ka'alaahe manegade yakalakalu 'alaahe szeraawocaacawene 'athafaabaacawe.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanu, malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru 'enaa ba'alaahe bamale'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) laaye yaawaradawe kageetaacawe 'ewenate sihone yaamanu hathi'atocaacawene sarazalaacawe. ba'esume 'ayeyaazubateme. yaduneyaacawenenaa ya'akxiraacawene gudaayoce 'asetakaakalalaacaweme.

yehe kalaaye yatathaqasawe yahulatu budenoce menedaa mekeneyaatu kahadiyaane wedeqe yahonawene manegade bamakatalaacawe. ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanute dagemo kageetaacawe yamathaalaacawene 'ewenate bamakatalaacawe sihone yeheme szeraawocaacawe bamalayaayatu mekeneyaate menedaawocaacaweme talayaaya. 'alaahe bame'emanaane 'enaa bakahadiyaane bazihe maleku wesaaneewene 'enedagalatzawe hulu lasawoce yatalayaayu mesaaleewocene yaadaregaale. 'eyaanedaanedune katamasaasaayu gaare yaaqoraanyaale.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! 'enaziyaa kahadi tawaagiyaanene kaaganyaacexwaacawe 'anegataacawene basayefe metwacawe. xaayelaacawene mulu 'eseketaadaakemunaa bamagedale bezuwocune 'eseketecharesu derase wegiyaawene qathelu. bezuwocune kagadalaacehu baxwaalaa merekonyocune thabaqe 'aderegaacehu 'esarwacawe. merekonyocune 'eneda huneetaawenaa 'asefalaaginatu merechaa 'alaacehu. kafalagaacehu yaalameneme kefeyaa banatzaa bamaleqaqe welataa maquthare wayeme yaganezabe kefeyaa wayeneme baleelaa nagare beezaa maasekafale tecelaalaacehu. wegiyaawe kahadiyaane wada selaame bamagebaate wayeme basememenate 'esekiyaabaqaa derase mamaarakenaa mawaagaate qathelu. yehe yatathaqasawe me'emanaanene bakahadiyaane mafatane 'enaa yadele maqayaayare 'enedihume 'anedune baleelaawe laaye dele maqadaajatu ya'alaahe wesaanee nawe. 'alaahe bifalege noro yaala wegiyaa bakahadiyaane laaye dele yesathaacehu nabare. nagare gene tegelene yadanagagawe kafilaacehune bakafilu lamafatane nawe. kame'emanaane ba'ewenate ba'alaahe manegade laaye yamiwaagaawenenaa yamaayewaagaawene lamalayate, 'enedihume 'amaanyene bakahadi lamafatane sihone baziheme mekeneyaate 'amaanye katagadala wada janate, kahadi katagadala dagemo wada 'esaate 'enedigabu nawe. ba'alaahe manegade laaye yatagadalu 'alaahe szeraawocaacawene 'ayaathafaabaacaweme.
baduneyaa heyewataacawe 'ewenate 'enedikatalu bamaaderage gudaayocaacawene yaasetakaakelelaacawaale.
batenesaa'eewe qane janate yaasegabaacawaale. duneyaa wesethe banabarubate gizee mene 'enedametemasele yagalatzalaacawe sihone ya'akxiraa beetaacawene 'asaawaqaacawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa badenegaageewe yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! nabiyune, haayemaanotune bamaredaate 'enedihume kahadiyaanene bamawaagaate ka 'alaahe gone qumu. 'alaaheme ba'enasu laaye 'ashanaafi 'enedetehonu yeradaacexwaale. ka'enasu gaare thore meedaa laaye seteganaanyume 'egerocaacehune yaatzanaale.
'enaziyaa 'alaahenaa male'eketanyaawene yakaadu keseratenaa thefaate 'alalaacawe. yaszeraawocaacawene menedaa 'athafaabaacawe.

yeheme yahonabate 'enasu 'alaahe bamale'eketanyaawe laaye yaawaradawene ya'alaahene 'anedenate yaakaatata yahonawene qure'aanene bamathelaataacawe mekeneyaate nawe. bamahonume 'alaahe szeraawocaacawene 'abalaashabaacawe. duneyaanaa yamacharashaawene `aalame kasaru.

lamahonu 'enaziyaa 'asetabaabaayoce medere laaye bamagwaaze kanasu bafite yanabarutene 'asetabaabaayoce macharashaacawe 'enedeete 'enedanabara 'ayaasetawelumene? macharashaacawe 'asaamaami nabare. 'alaahe manoriyaacawene 'awadamabaacawe. 'enasune, lejocaacawenaa ganezabaacawene 'athafaabaacawe. batamasaasaayeme maleku bayatenyaaweme gizeenaa botaa yaalutene kahadiyaane 'enedazihu yeqathaacawaale.
yehe lahulatu budenoce yatathaqasawe menedaa nawe. 'alaahe yame'emanaane radaate sihone nagare gene kahadiyaane radaate yalaacaweme.

'alaahe 'enaziyaa ba'esunaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanutenenaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszarutene kafoqocaacawenenaa kazaafoce szere yatalayaayu wanezoce yamifasubaatene janatoce yaasegabaacawaale. 'enaziyaa 'alaahene 'enaa male'eketanyaawene yakaadu baduneyaa semeetocaacawenenaa zenebaaleeyaacawene bamakatale yamithaqaaqamunaa sibalu 'eneda kabetoce yamibalu hodaacawenaa beletocaacawe 'eneji leelaa hasaabe yaleelaacawe; batenesaa'eewe qane yamithalalubate manoriyaacawe 'esaate nawe.

'anetane kaasewathu kamakaa katamaa sawoce bafite senetenaa senete yakatamaa sawoce bagulebataacawe, baganezabaacawenaa balejocaacawe bezaate yanabaraacawe male'eketanyocaacawene bakaadu gizee 'athafaanaacawe. ya'alaahe qethaate bamathaabaacawe gizee radaate 'alenabaraacaweme. 'enyaa kafalagene yamakaa sawoceneme maathefaate 'enecelaalane.

lamahonu kageetaawe zanede geletzenaa gulehe yahona maaserajaa laaye hono 'esune ba`eweqate yamigazaa sawe; shayethwane mathefo szeraawocaacawene yashalamalaacawe 'enedihume thaa`otaatene bamagazaate, wanejalene bamafatsamenaa male'eketanyocene bamaasetabaabale semeetocaacawene zenebaaleeyaacawene yamikatalu 'ekule naacawene?

ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'esune yamifaru baarocune lamaasegabaate qaale yagabaalaacawe janate baaheri bawesethwa bezu gizee kamaqoyatu yatanasaa thaa'emume hona shetaawe yaaletaqayara weha, thaa`emu yaaletalawatha watate, lathachiwoce thaafaache yahonu thajocenaa kasafafe yatathaaraa netzuhe maare 'alalaacawe. 'enedihume yamifalegute yatalayaayu feraafereewoce sinoraacawe kazihe hulu balaaye 'alaahe hathi'atocaacawene yemeraale. bameneme hathi'ate 'ayeyaazume. lamahonu bazihe `aayenate menedaa yamimanadaa 'enaa 'esaate wesethe zawatere bamaqamathe ka'eswa lazalaalame yamaayewathaa; 'ejege yafalaa weha yamithathaanaa 'ejege kamafelaatu yatanasaa 'anejataacawene yamiqoraarethe kahonawe gaare 'ekule naacawene?

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kamanaafeqaane makaakale kamaqabale yeleqe 'alamaqabalene maszarate bamaaderage 'anetane yamiyaadaamethu 'alu; 'enaame kaaneta zanede kawathu baxwaalaa la'enaziyaa `eweqatene latasathute sawoce qedeme mene nabare yatanaagarawe belawe bamaanaanaaqenaa bacaletanyenate yethayeqaalu. 'enazihe `aayenate sawocene 'alaahe lebocaacawe laaye 'atamabaacawe. meneme malekaame nagare 'ayedaresebateme. semeetocaacawene bamakatalaacaweme `aayenocaacawe ka'ewenate 'asaawaracaacawe.

'enaziyaa wada 'ewenatu manegade yatamarunaa male'eketanyaawe yaamathaawene yatakatalu geetaacawe wada 'ewenate mamaraatenenaa malekaame nagare laaye 'enediszamaaru bamaaderage 'enedihume ka'esaate yamikalaakalelaacawene szeraa 'asaawaqaacawe.

lamahonu 'enaziyaa kahadiyaane denegate saayaawequnaa meneme zegejete saayaadaregu sa`aatitu (tenesaa'ee) 'eseketemathaabaacawe yethabeqaalune? yatenesaa'ee melekete baregetheme mathetwale. kanaziheme meleketoce yanabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) male'eketanyaa hono malaake 'enaa yacharaqaa masanethaqe yeganyebataale. bazihe `aayenate huneetaa honawe tenesaa'eewe simathaa 'enedeete baswa ligasatzunaa limakaru yecelaalu? lithaqamu fetzume 'ayecelume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ka'alaahe basetaqare ba'ewenate ligazute yamigabaa 'amelaake 'enedaleela 'eregethanyaa hune. lahathi'ateheme ka'alaahe maaretaane thayeqe. 'enedihume lawanede 'amaanyocenaa laseete 'amaanyoce maaretaane thayeqelaacawe. 'alaahe yanaanetane baqanu kefela gizee 'eneqeseqaaseeyaacehune 'enaa yalalite maarafiyaacehune yaaweqaale. meneme yamidabaqebate nagare yalame.

me'emanaane 'alaahe bamale'eketanyaawe laaye yawegiyaane denegaagee batamalakata me`eraafe 'enediyaawarede bamamanyate 'alaahe sela wegiyaa denegaagee (wesaanee) yametegaletze me`eraafe biyaawarede noro 'alu. wegiyaane batamalakata wasaanye yahona yamaayeshaare hege siyaawarede 'enaziyaa lebocaacawe wesethe therethaaree yaalabaacawe manaafeqaane kaferehatenaa shebere yatanasaa mote yamathaabate sawe 'asetayaayate yaayuhale. thorenatene faretawe bamaafagefagaacawe yatanasaa ya'esaate qethaate wada 'enasu yaqaraba 'enaa 'enedamiqothaatharaacawe 'alaahe yazaacaa qaalune 'asaalafabaacawe.

ya'alaahene te`ezaaze biyaakaberunaa malekaame nagarene binaagaru lanasu malekaame yehonelaacawe nabare. wegiyaa gedeetaa tadarego nagaru yamere bahona gizee 'asemasaaye kamahonenaa ba'alaahe laaye kamaamatze yeleqe ba'emenataacawenaa geetaacawene bamataazaze laaye 'ewenatanyoce mahonaacawe yeshaalaacawe nabare.

ba'alaahe maamanenenaa mataazazene 'emebi yametelu kahona huneetaacehu yamiyaamazenawe bakehedataacehunaa bawanejalaacehu mekeneyaate kazihe bafite bamaayemenate gizee huneetaacehu 'enedanabarawe mederene bahathi'atenaa bakehedate maabalaashatenaa zemedenaane yameteqorethu yemaselaale.

'enazihe mederene bamaabalaashatenaa zemedenaane bamaqurathe yatagalatzu sawoce 'alaahe ka'ezenatu yaaraaqaacawe naacawe. 'enedihume jorowocaacawene 'ewenatene lamaqabale masemaatene 'enedaayesamu 'adanaqorabaacawe. `aayenocaacaweme yamaasetawaale `eyetaane 'enedaayaayu 'asaawaraacawe.

'enazihe 'asetabaabaayoce lamene qure'aanene 'ayaasetanatenume? 'ewenatanyaa yahona maasetanetanene biyaasetanatenute noro: malekaame nagarene hulu yaasaayaacawenaa kamathefo nagareme hulu yaareqaacawe nabare. yelequnese lebocaacawe laaye mekere 'enedaayedaresenaa bamaasetaawashaawe 'enedaayethaqamu baxaayele taqolefobaacawaalene?

'enaziyaa maaserajaawe kamathaalaacawenaa yamale'eketanyaawe (muhhamade salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) huneetaa katagalatzalaacawe baxwaalaa wada kehedatenaa nefeqenaa yatamalasu shayethwane kehedatenenaa nefeqenaane shalamalaacawe. 'enedihume razheme `edemee bamanore shanagalaacawe.

yehe themeete yaaganyaacawe mekeneyaatu la'enaziyaa 'alaahe bamale'eketanyaawe laaye yaawaradawene raa`eye yathalu 'agaariwocene 'enyaa ba'anedaanede gudaayoce laaye me'emanaanene kathore wagiyaa bamaasetagwaagwaale 'enetaazazaacexwaalane bamaalataacawe nawe. 'alaahe misetheraacawene yaaweqaale 'enedihume geletze yamiyaadaregutene yaaweqaale. ka'esu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. geletze maaderage yafalagawene lamale'eketanyaawe geletze yaadaregaale.

heyewatene bamawesade yatawakalu malaa'ekete: heyewataacawene siwasedunaa yaberate madoshaa bamayaaze fitocaacawenenaa maqamachaacawene simatu betaaye noro 'ejege 'asedanegaachenaa 'aseqayaami yahona qethaate taaye nabare.

heyewataacawe setewathaa yaagaathamaacawe kabaade qethaate mekeneyaatu 'alaahene yamiyaaseqothaane kehedate, nefeqenaanaa 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene bamatzaararaacawe; 'enedihume wada geetaacawe yamiyaaqaarebaacawene 'enaa ya'esune wadeetaa yamiyaaganyubatene ba'alaahe maamanenaa male'eketanyaawene makatalene bamathelaataacawe szeraawocaacawene 'abalaashabaacawe.

lamahonu 'enaziyaa balebocaacawe wesethe therethaareene yayaazu manaafeqaane 'alaahe balebocaacawe wesethe yaalawene thelaacaacawene 'ayaawathaame belowe yaasebaalune? 'ayaasebu, 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyene kaweshataame lamalayatenaa 'amaanye geletze 'enediwathaa 'enedihume 'asemasaaye munaafiqe yegaalathe zanede 'alaahe bafatanaa yaasewathaataale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enyaa manaafeqaanene maasaawaqene benefalege 'enaasaaweqehalane. bameleketocaacawe 'enaa ba'anagaagaraacawe taaweqaacawaalahe. 'alaahe szeraawocaacehune yaaweqaale. ka'enaaneta meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. baszeraawocaacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! kanaaneta ba'alaahe manegade laaye taagaayocenenaa thalaatocene bamawaagaate laaye taagaashocene bayefaa 'esekamenaasaaweqe derase bategele, thalaatocene bamawaagaate 'enaa bamagaadale 'enefatenaacexwaalane. ka'enaaneta mahale 'ewenatanyaawenenaa weshataamune bageletze lamaawaqe 'enefatenaacexwaalane.

'enaziyaa 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene yakaadunaa ka'alaahe haayemaanote raasaacawenenaa leelaawene yaagadu; 'ewenatu katagalatzalaacawe baxwaalaa male'eketanyaawene yatatzaararunaa yatawaagu raasaacawene 'eneji 'alaahene meneme 'ayegoduteme. szeraawocaacawene 'alaahe yaabalaashebaacawaale.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa badenegaageewe yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! 'alaahenenaamale'eketanyaaweneme yaazazwacehune bamaseraate 'enaa kakalakalwacehu bamakalekale taazazwacawe. szeraawocaacehune bakehedate; bayeyulenye 'enaa bamasale nagare 'ataabalaashu.

'enaziyaa 'alaahene yakaadu raasaacawenenaa leelaawene ka'alaahe haayemaanote yaagadu; kazaa baxwaalaa baneseha wada 'alaahe saayemalasu bakehedataacawe kamotu hathi'atocaacawene 'ayemeraacaweme. yelequnese bawanejalaacawe yeyezaacawaale. lazalaalameme 'esaate wesethe yezawateraalu.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! thalaatocaacehune kamawaagaate 'atesenafu ('atedekamu). 'enedihume la'ereqe saayegaabezwacehu qademaacehu 'enedaategaabezwacawe. 'enaaneta yabalaayenaa 'ashanaafi naacehunaa. 'alaaheme 'enaanetane bamaredaatenaa bamaagaze kagonaacehu nawe. yamalekaame szeraawocaacehune menedaame 'ayaagodelebaacehume yelequnese kasu terufaatenaa legesenaa yechamerelaacaxwaale.

qerebitu heyewate (duneyaa) chawaataanaa zaazaataa naate. baswa yamithamadenaa la'akxiraawe kamaszeraate yamizanaagaawe 'a'emero yaleelawe nawe. ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe betaamenunaa yasune te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene betefaru yaszeraawocaacehune menedaa meneme saayaagwaadele mulu 'aderego yesathaacexwaale. kanaaneta mulu ganezabaacehune 'ayethayeqaacehume. kanaaneta yamifalegawe gedeetaa yatadaragabaacehune metzewaate (zakaa) nawe.

mulu ganezabaacehune 'athebeqo bithayeqaacehu noro nefuge tehonaalaacehu. baziheme mekeneyaate balebaacehu wesethe yaalawe sesetaamenatenaa segebegebenatene bageletze yaawathaabaacehu nabare. nagare gene selaazanalaacehu yehenene 'alaadaragame.

'enaaneta kaganezabaacehu hulume saayehone yatawasanawene ba'alaahe manegade laaye 'enedetaawathu setethayaqu kanaaneta makaakale bamasasate yamikalakele 'ala. ba'alaahe manegade laaye kaganezabu yatawasanawene kamaawethaate yasasata ba'ewenatu yamisasetawe banafesu laaye nawe. mekeneyaatume yametzewaatene menedaa kamaagenyate selaagadaate. 'alaahe baraasu yatabeqaaqaa kanaaneta metzewaate meneme 'ayefalegeme. 'enaaneta gene ka'esu kajaayoce naacehu. kaselaame wada kehedate beteqalabasu yaathafaacehunaa leeloceneme yaamathaale. 'eneda 'enaanetame 'ayehonume, yelequnese 'alaahene yamitaazazu taazaazhoce yehonaalu.
bahhudayebiyaa batadaragawe 'ereqenaa sememenate maszarate 'enyaa geletze yahona makefatene kafatenelehe.

kazihe dele bafitenaa baxwaalaa yaszaraahacawene hathi'atoce limerehe, haayemaanotehene bamaredaate tzagaawene limolaalehenaa yatasetakaakalawenenaa qathe yaalawene gobaathaa yaalehonawene ya'eselemenaane manegade yemaraahale.
'alaahe 'anetane bathalaatocehe laaye dele 'enedetaadarege thanekaaraanaa maaneme limaketawe bamaayecele 'eredaataa yeradaahale.

'alaahe bame'emanaane lebe wesethe ba'emenataacawe laaye 'emenate 'enedichameru tzenaatenenaa maragaagaatene yaawaradawe 'esu nawe. basamaayaatenaa bamedere laaye yaalu szaraawitoce ya'alaahe becaa naacawe. ba'enasume kabaarocu yafalagawene yeradaale. 'alaahe labaarocu yamithaqemaacawene hulu `aawaaqi 'eredaataawenenaa 'egazaawene bamasethate thebabanyaa nawe.

'alaahe haayemaanotune 'ayeradaame 'enedihume qaalune yabalaaye 'ayaadaregeme bamaalate ba'alaahe laaye mathefo therethaareene yatatharaatharu manaafeqaane, manaafeqaate 'enaa 'agaariwocene yeqathaale. yaqethaatu mazaze wada 'enasu zora. bakehedataacawenaa ba'alaahe laaye mathefo therethaareene bamatharaatharaacawe mekeneyaate ka'ezenatu 'abaararaacawe. batachamaarime batenesaa'eewe qane yajahaname 'esaate 'azagaajetolaacawaale. 'eswa wesethe bamagebaate lazalaalame zawetaariwoce naacawe. jahaname menenyaa yakafaace mamalashaacawe naate.

basamaayaatenaa bamedere laaye yaalu hulu ya'alaahe szaraawite bamahonaacawe kabaarocu yafalagawene yeradaale. 'alaahe maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi nawe. bamafethare, bamawasanenaa bamaasetanaabare thebabanyaa nawe.

ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enyaa 'anetane batenesaa'ee qane bahhezebocehe laaye masekaari, me'emanaanene baduneyaa wesethe yaazagaajalaacawene dele 'enaa maamacaacatene 'enedihume ba'akxiraa yaazagaajalaacawene tzagaa yametaabasere 'enaa lakahadiyaane baduneyaa wesethe yaazagaajalaacawene weredatenaa bame'emanaane 'eje shenefatenenaa ba'akxiraa yaazagaajalaacawenenaa yamithabeqaacawene 'asaamaami qethaate 'asefaraarinaa 'asethaneqaaqi 'aderegane laakenehe.

yehene yaadaragenawe ba'alaahe 'enedetaamenu, bamale'eketanyaaweme 'enedetaamenu, male'eketanyaawene 'enedetaakaberutenaa 'enedetaawequte 'alaahene qanenaa maataa kamaayegabu baaheriyaate 'enedetaatharute lamaaderage nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa yamakaa 'agaariyaanene lamawaagaate baye`atu ridewaane (bawedeetaawe qaala-mahalaa) laaye kaaneta gaare qaala-mahalaa sifatzemu ba'eregetheme qaala-mahalaawene yamifatzemute ka'alaahe gaare nawe. mekeneyaatume 'agaariyaanene lamawaagaate yaazazawe 'esu nawe. 'eresume malekaame menedaa yemanadaacawaale. qaala-mahalaaweneme sifatsemu ya'alaahe 'eje kanasu 'eje balaaye nawe. 'alaahe yemalakataacawaale ka'enasu meneme nagare 'ayedabaqebateme. haayemaanotune lamaredaate la'alaahe qaale bagabaawe maszarate qaala-mahalaawene yamiyaafarese qaale kidaanunenaa qaala-mahalaawene bamaaferase yamigodaawe raasu nawe. 'alaahene meneme 'ayegodaame. haayemaanotune lamaredaate qaale bagabaawe maszarate qaalune yamimolaawe 'alaahe taalaaqe menedaane (janatene) yesathawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa 'alaahe kaaneta gaare baguzohe laaye 'enedaayeheedu wadaxwaalaa yaaseqaraacawene baalaagaroce bamaqerataacawe setewaqesaacawe kaaneta gaare 'enedaanewathaa balejocaacenenaa baganezabaacene thebaqaa laaye wetherate gabetane nawe, bamahonume lahathi'ataacene maaretaa ka'alaahe thayeqelene yeluhale. daaru gene yehene maaretaane ka'alaahe 'enedithayeqelaacawe yamithayequte bamelaasaacawe 'eneji kalebaacawe tatzatzetawe 'ayedalame. selaziheme 'alaahe lanaaneta malekaame nagare wayeme mathefo nagare liyaadarege kafalaga ka'alaahe maaneme limaketelaacehu 'ayeceleme balaacawe. yelequnese 'alaahe 'enaaneta yameteszarutene nagare hulu bazerezere `aawaaqi nawe. szeraawocaacehune meneme lamadabaqe betemokerume ka'esu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.

kamale'eketanyaawe gaare guzo 'enedaatewathu yaagadaacehu balejocaacehunaa baganezabaacehu wetherate gabetaacehu saayehone yelequnese 'enaaneta ya'alaahe male'eketanyaanaa baaledarabocu ba'athaqaalaaye yethafaalu; wada madinaa, wada beetasabocaacawe 'ayemalasume belaacehu sela 'asabaacehu nawe. yehenene nagare shayethwane balebocaacehu wesethe shalamalaacehu. 'enedihume bageetaacehu laaye haayemaanotune 'ayeradaame belaacehu mathefo therethaareene tatharaatharaacehu. ba'alaahe laaye mathefo therethaareene bamatharaatharaacehunaa kamale'eketanyaawe wadaxwaalaa bamaqerataacehu mekeneyaate thafiwoce honaacehu.
ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe yamaayaamene kahadi nawe. ba'alaahe lakaadu sawoceme batenesaa'eewe qane yamiqathubaatene baxaayele yameteqathaathale 'esaatene 'azagaajetanaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaaneta gaare wada makaa baalamaheede wadaxwaalaa yaqarutene sawoce <<'enasune bamafatane baqerebu bathorenate xaayelanyaa kahonu sawoce gaare 'enedetewaagu tetheraalaacehu. ba'alaahe manegade laaye tewaagwaacawaalaacehu wayeme yaalawegiyaa wada selaame yegabaalu. bamahonume 'alaahe latharaacehu wegiyaa 'eshi belaacehu yametetaazazu kahonaacehu malekaame menedaa (janatene) yesathaacaxwaale. kazihe bafite wada makaa kamale'eketanyaawe gaare mawethaatene 'emebi 'enedaalaacehute hulu 'emebi kaalaacehu 'asaamaami yahona qethaate yeqathaacexwaale>> balaacawe.

ba`aayena seweraane, 'akaala senekulaanenaa bashetanyaa yahonu sawoce: ba'alaahe manegade laaye kamawaagaate wada xwaalaa biqaru: meneme hathi'ate yalabaacaweme. 'alaahenenaa ya'alaahene male'eketanyaa yamitaazazu kahenetzaawocaacawenaa kazaafoce sere yatalayaayu wanezoce yamifasubaacawe janatoce wesethe yaasegabaacawaale. 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene mataazazene 'emebi yamilutene 'asaamaami yahonawene qethaate yeqathaacawaale.

'enaziyaa kazaafwa sere bamahone kaaneta gaare qaala mahalaa yamifatsemu sawocene baregetheme 'alaahe wado taqabalaacawe. lebocaacawe wesethe yaalawene ya'emenate qenenatenaa 'ewenatanyenateme 'awaqa. bamahonume lebocaacawe laaye 'eregaataane 'awarada. baziheme mekeneyaate makaa bamagebaate faanetaa yaamalathaacawene nagare bamatakaate qerebe yahonawene yakxayebare makafatene dele manadaacawe.
kakxayebare sawoce yamiyaaganyutene bezu mereko sathaacawe. 'alaahe maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi bamafethare, bamawasanenaa bamaasetanaabare thebabanyaa nawe.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! lawadafiteme yatalayaayu katamocene ba'eselaamaawi dele bamakefate bezu mereko 'enedametaaganyu qaale yegabaalaacexwaale. 'ahune gene yakxayebarene mereko 'afathanalaacehu. 'enedihume ba'enaanetanaa lejocaacehu laaye 'adagaa liyaadaresu yanabarutene yayehudoce 'ejoce sabasabalaacehu. yehene fathaane yamereko neberate 'alaahe baarocune 'enedamiradaanaa 'enedamiyaageze yamiyaaseradaa melekete 'adaragalaacehu. 'enaanetaneme qathe wadaalawe (meneme yaaletawalaagadawene) manegade yemaraacexwaale.

'enanyaa 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene yakaadu kahadiyaane 'enaanetane (me'emanaane) biwaagwaacehu ka'enaaneta tashanaafinaa wada xwaalaa zorawe yeshashaalu. kazaa baxwaalaame gudaayaacawene yamikataatale thabaaqi 'enaa bawegiyaacawe laaye yamiradaacawene radaateme 'ayaaganyume.

ya'amaanyoce maashanafenaa yakahadiyaane mashanafe hulee bamaanenyaaweme gizeenaa botaa yataragaagatha nawe. 'anetane kaasetabaabalu sawoce bafite banabarute hhezeboce laaye yanabara ya'alaahe wesaaneeyaawi kxidate nawe. bamahonume me'emanaanene 'ashanaafi bamaaderagenaa kahadiyaanene 'enedishanafu bamaaderage yahonawene ya'alaahe qwaami yawesaanee kxidate yamiqayare 'ayedalame.

bahhudayebiyaahe zamacaa laaye ka'agaariwoce samaaneyaa tawaagiwoce 'enaaneta laaye 'adagaa lamaaderase falegawe simathu ba'ejaacawe 'adagaa 'enedaayaadaresubaacehu yakalakalaacawe 'alaahe nawe. 'enaanetaneme 'enasune bamagedalenaa bamaaseqaayate 'ejaacehune 'enedaatesanazerume kalakalaacehu. yelequneme 'enasune mamaarake kaasecaalaacehu baxwaalaa 'enedetelaqwaacawe 'adaragaacehu. 'alaahe yameteszarutene tamalekaace nawe; kaszeraacehu meneme 'ayesawarebateme.

'alaahenaa male'eketanyaawene yakaadute, kataqadasawe masejide 'enaa masewaa'etu bamitaaradebate yamasejidu kelele 'enedaayedarese yaagadute 'enasu naacawe. 'enaaneta yamaataaweqwaacawe ba'alaahe yaamanu wanedocenaa seetoce baayenoru 'enaa saataawequ kakahadiyaanoce gaare 'enedaategadelwacawenaa 'enasune bamagedalaacehume lahathi'ate 'enaa yadame kaasaa bamakefale cegere wesethe yamaategabu bihone noro: makaane dele 'enedetaadaregu bafaqadalaacehu nabare. yehenene yaadaragawe bamakaa 'enedamiganyute 'amaanyoce 'alaahe yaashaawene wada 'ezenatu lamaasegabaate falego nawe. makaa wesethe yaalute kahadiyaane kame'emanaane talayetawe bihone noro: 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene yakaadutene 'asaamaami qethaate 'eneqathaacawe nabare.

'enaziyaa 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene yakaadute balebocaacawe wesethe kuraatenaa te`ebite 'alabaacawe. yehe yamaayemenate kuraatenaa te`ebite 'ewenatene ba'ewenatanyenatu kamaaragaagathe gaare saayehone kagela-semeete gaare yataqoraanya nawe. bahhudayebiyaahe `aamate laaye ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) makaa bamagebaataacawe tashanefaacexwaale tabelawe 'enedaayenaqafu bamaalate 'elehe wesethe gabu. 'alaaheme ka'eresu zanede yahonane 'eregaataane bamale'eketanyaawe 'enaa ba'amaanyoce laaye 'awaradalaacawe. bamahonume quthaacawe 'agaariwoce laszarubaacawe szeraa 'atzafaa lamamase 'aledaaragaacaweme. 'alaaheme 'ewenatanyaawene ya<<laalaaha lalaahene>> qaale 'amaanyocene 'asechabathaacawe. gedeetaawaaneme ba'agebaabume 'enediwathu 'azazaacaweme; tawathume. yehecene qaale bamachabathe ragade 'amaanyocu kamaaneme yeleqe 'enaresu yatagabu naacawe. 'alaahe lebaacawe wesethe yaalawene malekaamenateme selamiyaaweqe 'enaresu la'ezihe nagare baalabeetenate yamigabu honawaale. 'alaahe hulune nagare `aawaaqi nawe; ka'eresu meneme nagare 'ayesawareme.

'alaahe male'eketanyaawene yaasaayaacawene hheleme 'enaa labaaledarabocaacawe yanagarutene 'ewenate 'adaragalaacawe. yeheme hheleme ya'alaahe male'eketanyaanaa baaledarabocaacawe wadataqadasawe ya'alaahe masejide thalaatene saayefaru; yahhaje tagebaaraatene maathanaaqaqaacawene yamiyaaseradaawene tagebaare wesenu tzagurune talaacheto leelaawe dagemo 'asaathero 'enedamigabu yaayute hheleme nabare. 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye 'enaaneta yamaataawequtene yamibajaacehune nagare 'alaahe yaaweqaale. bamahonume bazihenyaawe `aamate makaa bamagebaate hhelemu 'enedaayefatzame 'aderego baqerebu 'enedifatzame 'adaraga. yeheme dele 'alaahe yahhudayebiyaawe sememenate 'enedifatzame maaderagunaa yehenenu sememenate takatalo babotaawe taganyetawe banabarute 'amaanyoce 'ejeme kxayebare dele 'enedihone maaderagu nawe.

'alaahe 'eresu male'eketanyaawene muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) geletze yahonane maaserajaanaa ya'eselemenaa haayemaanote yahonawene 'ewenatanyaawene haayemaanote maszarate 'aderego nawe yalaakaacawe. yeheme yahonawe ya'eresune 'emenate kamitzaararute 'emenatoce hulu yabalaaye 'enedihone nawe. ba'ezihe laayeme 'alaahe masekerwale. lamesekerenate 'alaahe baqi nawe.

muhhamade ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa nawe; ka'esu gaare yaalute baaledarabocu batawaagi kahadiyaane laaye beretu, bamakaakalaacawe yamitazaazanunaa yamiwaadadu naacawe. 'aneta tamalekaace hoye! setemalakataacawe la'alaahe siyaagonabesunaa sisagedu taaganyaacawaalahe. ka'alaahe maaretaanenaa malekaame menedaane yekajelaalu. 'enedihume ya'alaahene wedeetaa yethayeqaalu. yamagalachaacawe meleketeme yasegedate wetheete yahonawe bafitaacawe laaye yamisetawaalawe maragaagaate, yaamaara gatzetaa 'enaa yasalaate berehaane nawe. yehe yatagalatzawe baaheriyaacawe bamusaa (`aalayehi salaame) laaye batawaradawe matsehhafe taweraate laaye tagaletswale. ba`isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) laaye bawaradaweme nejile (wanegeele) laaye tebeberaacawenaa madagaagafaacawene bamesaalee sigaletze, qanezalu 'eneda baqala 'azemaraa nawe; 'azemaraaweme baqanezalu mekeneyaate thanekero bagenedu laaye tasetakaakelo yaqoma yehonaale. ba'azemaraawe thenekaareenaa mamwalaate gabareewoce yedanaqaalu. yeheneme mesaalee 'alaahe yagalatzawe bame'emanaane thenekaaree, 'erese ba'erese matasaasarenaa madagaagafe kahadiyaane 'enediqochunaa 'enedinaadadu lamaaderage nawe. ba'alaahe yaamanutenenaa malekaame yaszarutene sahaabaawocene (ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa baaledarabocene) 'alaahe wanejalaacawene 'enedamisarezelaacawenaa ka'eresume zanede taaleqe menedaanaa janate 'enedamiyaasegabaacawe qaale gabetolaacawaale.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa yadanagagawene yametekatalu me'emanaane hoye! banegegereme yehune batagebaare ka'alaahenaa kamale'eketanyaawe fite 'ateqedamu. ya'esune te'ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene feru. 'alaahe negegerocaacehune yesamaale. szeraacehuneme yaaweqaale. meneme 'ayaamalethaweme baszeraawocaacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa yadanagagawene yametekatalu me'emanaane hoye! kamale'eketanyaawe gaare szena szere`aate yenuraacehu. ka'eresu gaare setehonu demetzaacehune kafe 'ataaderegu. 'erese baraasaacehu setaawaru 'enedametechohute male'eketanyaawene setaanaageru 'esune bamaakebare 'atechuhubate. setetharuteme 'erese ba'eresaacehu setetharaaru baseme 'enedametetharaarute 'enedaatetharute. yelequnese balazaba 'anedabate <<nabiyu hoye! ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa hoye!>> bamaalate ba'akeberote therute. bazihe mekeneyaate yaszeraawocaacehu menedaa mabalaashatune saataawequ szeraawocaacehu 'enedaayebalaashebaacehu letethanaqaqu yegabaale.

'enaziyaa demetzocaacawene ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa zanede zeqe yamiyaadaregu sawoce: 'enasu 'alaahe lebocaacawene 'esune lamaferaate bamafatane yaatharaacawe naacawe. lahathi'atocaacawe meherate basu 'ayezaacaweme. batenesaa'eewe qane taalaaqe menedaa 'alalaacawe. 'esume 'alaahe janate yaasegabaacawaale.
'enaziyaa kabaalabeetocehe beete jarebaa bamahone demetzaacawene kafe 'aderegawe yamitharuhe 'abezaanyaawocu 'ayaasetawelume ('asetawaaye 'ayedalume).

'enaziyaa kabaalabeetocehe beetoce jarebaa honawe yamitharuhe: 'eseketewathaa derase bitaagasunaa 'anetane kabeetocu jarebaa honawe kamiyaanaageruhe yeleqe deme`ecawene zeqe 'aderegawe biyaanaageruhe malekaame yehonelaacawe nabare. mekeneyaatume demetzene zeqe 'aderego batehetenaa maanaagare 'esaacawene kamaakebare yeqotharaalenaa. 'alaahe yanasuneme yehune yaleelocene wanejale wada 'esu baneseha yamimalasutene mahari; baalamaawaqaacaweme yeqere yelaacawaale.la'enasume 'azaanye nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa yadanagagawene yametekatalu me'emanaane hoye! 'anede faasiqe (ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yawathaa) selahonu sawoce waree yezolaacehu bimathaa: wadeyaawe 'atemanute 'ewenatanyenatune 'aragaagethu. 'ewenatanyenatune saataaragaagethu kataqabalaacehu sawocene baalamaawaqe tegodaalaacehunaa. baziheme mekeneyaate 'ewenatu katagalatzalaacehunaa sawocene kagodaacehu baxwaalaa nagaru weshate mahonune setaawequ tetzatzataalaacehu.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! raa`eye yamiwaredelate ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa ka'enaaneta gaare 'enedaala 'ewaqu. bamahonume weshatene tathaneqaqu. mekeneyaatume setewaashu mawaashataacehune 'alaahe raa`eye bamaawerade yenagerawaalenaa. ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa 'enaanetane yamithaqemaacehune nagare yaaweqaale. 'enaaneta yametaaqarebwacawene hasaaboce hulu biqabalaacehu noro 'esu lanaaneta bamaayewadawe cegere wesethe tewadeqaalaacehu. nagare gene 'alaahe katerufaatu 'emenatene 'enaaneta gaare tawadaaje 'adaragawe. 'enedihume lebaacehu wesethe 'asaamarawe selahoname 'amanaacehu. kehedatene, ka'esu te'ezaaze mawethaatene, 'enedihume hathi'atene 'enedetethalu 'adaraga. ba'enazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatzute qathetanyaawenenaa yatasetakaakalawene manegade yatamaru naacawe.

malekaame szeraawocene 'enediwadunaa mathefo nagarene 'enedithalu bamaaderage yaaganyute ya'alaahe terufaate 'enaa 'alaahe banasu laaye yawaalawe tzagaa nawe. 'alaahe 'esune yamiyaamasagenunaa malekaame yamigathemaacawene `aawaaqi nagarocene babotaacawe bamaaseqamathe thebabanyaa nawe.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! kame'emanaane: hulate budenoce bithaalu: batathaalubate nagare laaye wada 'alaahe hege bamatheraate bamakaakalaacawe 'asetaarequ. 'anedu 'erequne 'emebi bamaalate baleelaanyaawe laaye wasane kaalafa: wasane yaalafawene budene wada 'alaahe wesaaneenaa hege 'esekimalase derase tagaadalwate; wada 'alaahe hegenaa wesaanee katamasu gene bamakaakalaacawe yaala 'adelo bafetehe 'asetaarequ; bawesaaneeyaacehume (baferedaacehume) fetehawi hunu. 'alaahe baferedaacawe fetehawiyaanene yewadaalenaa.

me'emanaane baselaame wanedemaamaacoce naacawe. selaameme yamifaredawe bame'emanaane makaakale lamifatharawe 'alamagebaabaate maasemaamaatenenaa maasetaaraqene yaazezaale. yetaazanelaacehu zanedeme ya'esune te`ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene feru.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa yadanagagawene denegaagee yametekatalu me'emanaane hoye! wanedoce bawanedoce laaye 'ayaashufu ('ayeqaledu) mekeneyaatume ka'ashwafiwoce yeleqe yamishofebaacawe 'alaahe zanede yabalathu lihonu yecelaalunaa. therunatume yamitaayawe 'alaahe zanede baalawe nawe. seetoceme baseetoce laaye 'ayaashufu 'enaziyaa ka'ashwafiwoce yeleqe yamishofebaacawe yatashaalu lihonu yecelaalunaa. yawanedemocaacehune nafesoce ('enedaraase nafese selahonace) 'ataanaweru. 'anedu leelaawene bamithalaawe qetzele seme 'ayetheraa. nabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) kamalaakaacawe bafite ba'anedaanede yamadinaa sawoce zanede 'enedanabarawe ka'enaaneta makaakale yehenene yafatzama faasiqe (ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yawathaa) nawe. ka'emenate baxwaalaa <<faasiqe>> bamile baaheri matharaatu kafaa; kanazihe hathi'atoce yaaletamalasu hathi'atene bamaseraate nafesaacawene thefaate laaye yathaalu badaayoce naacawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe 'amenaacehunaa badanagagawe denegaagee yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! tayaayaazhe yahonu mekeneyaatocenaa maaserajaawoce yaleelaacawene bezu therethaareewoce raaqu. wechaawi huneetaawe theru yahonane sawe bamathefo matharetharene yamasaasalu 'anedaanede therethaaree hathi'ate nawenaa. yame'emanaanene naweroceneme kajarebaacawe 'atekataatalu. 'anedaacehu leelaawene bamithalaawe nagare 'ataanesu ('atemute) sawene bamithalaawe nagare semune maanesaate kamota baxwaalaa segaawene 'enedamabelaate nawe. lamahonu maanaacehume yamota wanedemune segaa mabelaate yamiwade 'alane?! bamahonume hameetene letethalute yegabaale mekeneyaatume segaawene 'enedamabelaate nawenaa. te`ezaazune bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene feru. 'alaahe wada 'esu tatzatzetawe yatamalasutene taqabaaye labaarocume 'azaanye nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'enyaa ka'anede wanede ('abaataacehu 'adame) 'enaa ka'anedite seete ('enaataacehu hhawaa) fatharenaacehu. zaraacehu 'anede bamahonu 'anedu baleelaawe laaye bazare 'ayefokere. kazihe baxwaalaame bezu hhezebocenenaa yatasaraachu gosaawocene bamaaderage 'erese baraasaacehu 'enedetetawaawaqu 'eneji 'anedu baleelaawe laaye 'enedifokere 'ayedalame. mekeneyaatume belechaa yaalawe 'alaahene bamaferaate becaa nawe. bamahonume 'alaahe zanede balaachaacehu yabalatha 'alaahene fariyaacehu nawe. 'alaahe huneetaacehune hulu `aawaaqi; yaalaacehubatene melu`enatenaa godalonatene bazerezere `aawaaqi nawe. meneme nagare 'ayedabaqebateme.

'anedaanede zalaanoce wada male'eketanyaawe (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) zanede bamamethaate <<'enyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe 'amenanaale>> 'alu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<'alaamanaacehume>> balaacawe. nagare gene <<la'alaahe te`ezaazaate 'eje sathetanaale salemanaale>> balu. mekeneyaate ganaa 'emenate balebocaacehu wesethe saretzo 'alegabaame. lawadafitu yegabaale tabelo yethabaqaale. 'enaaneta zalaanoce ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe bamaamanenaa malekaame szeraane bamaszeraatenaa yakalakalawene bamaraaqe 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene betetaazazu 'alaahe kaszeraawocaacehu menedaa meneme 'ayeqanesebaacehume. 'alaahe wada 'esu yatatzatzutene mahari la'enasu 'azaanye nawe.

'ewenatanyaa me'emanaane maalate 'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanu kazaa baxwaalaa ba'emenataacawe therethaaree yaalegabaabate ba'alaaheme manegade baganezabocaacawenaa banafesocaacawe bamataagale bameneme yaalesasatu becaa naacawe. ba'enazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatzute 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyocu naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lazalaanocu <<lamahonu 'alaahene sela 'emenataacehu letaasaawequtenaa letaasetamerute nawene?>> balaacawe. 'alaahe basamaayaatenaa bamedere laaye yaalawene yaaweqaale. 'alaahe huluneme nagaroce `aawaaqi nawe. meneme 'ayedabaqebateme bamahonume 'enaaneta bahaayemaanotaacehu gudaaye letaasaawequte 'ayeshaame.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enazihe zalaanoce bamaselamaacawe yematzaadaqubehaale. 'enedihe balaacawe:: <<bamaselamaacehu banee laaye 'atematzaadaqu. bamaselamaacehu yametethaqamute 'enaaneta raasaacehu naacehu. yelequnese wada 'emenatu magebaataacehu 'ewenate kahona wada 'emenate 'enedetegabu selamaraacehu 'alaahe yematzaadaqebaacaxwaale.

'alaahe yasamaayaatenenaa yamederene yaruqe misethere yaaweqaale meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. 'alaahe 'enaaneta yameteszarutene tamalekaace nawe. kaszeraawocaacehu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. baszeraawocaacehume malekaameme yehune mathefo yemanadaacexwaale.>>

(q) <<qaafe>>: (ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe majamariyaa laaye taberaaretwale.) 'alaahe batakabarawe qure'aane yemelaale. ba'esu wesethe yatalayaayu teregwaameewoce bezu malekaame nagarocenaa barakate 'alawe; bamahonume 'enaaneta sawoce batenesaa'eewe qane lagemegamaanaa lamamanedaate ba'ewenate teqasaqasaalaacehu.

ya'emebitanyenataacawe manese'ee 'aneta tewaashaalahe belawe magamataacawe 'ayedalame. 'ewenatanyaa mahonehene yaaweqaalu. nagare gene yagaramaacawe kamalaa'ekete zare saayehone kasawe zare yahona 'asethaneqaaqi male'eketanyaa malaaku nawe. kamagaramaacaweme yatanasaa kasawe zare male'eketanyaa malaaku yamidaneqe nagare nawe 'alu.

motane 'afare kahonene baxwaalaa 'eneqasaqasaalane? yehe sawenataacene kabasabasa baxwaalaa nafesaacene daageme wada 'akaalaacene tamaleso wada heyewate mamalase 'enaa yamaqaseqase gudaaye fetsume yamaayemasele nagare nawe; likasateme 'ayeceleme ('alu).

kamotu baxwaalaa medere 'akaalaacawene yametebalaawene baregetheme 'enaaweqaalane. ka'esu meneme 'ayedabaqebeneme 'enyaa zanede baheyewataacaweme yehune kamotu baxwaalaa yamenewasenawene wesaanee hulu thabeqo yamiyeze mazegabe 'alane.
yelequnese 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce male'eketanyaawe yezolaacawe yamathaawene qure'aane 'asetabaabalu. 'enasu batametaataa nagare wesethe naacawe. ba'eresu gudaaye laaye 'anedeme 'aqwaame yalaacaweme.

'agaariwoce kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase maasetabaabalaacawene kathaqasa baxwaalaa yamikasate mahonune bamaaserajaa sigaletze:
lamahonu 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce kabalaayaacawe yaalawene samaayene 'enedeete 'enedafatharenaate, 'enedeete 'enedaganabaanaatenaa 'eswa laaye kawaakebetene bamaaderage la'ereswa yamiyaanaweraate meneme qadaadaawoce yaleelwate 'enedetehone 'enedeete 'enedaasegeethenaate batekurate 'ayemalakatumene? yehecene samaayene yafathara mutaanene heyaawe 'aderego maqaseqase 'ayesaanaweme.

mederene lamanoriyaa yametemace bamaaderage zaragaanaate. ba'ereswa laaye 'enedaatewaalele thanekaaraanaa yatzanu taraarocene 'aseqamathebaate. bawesethwame la`eyetaa dase yamilu ya'azere`etenaa yazaafe `aayenatocene 'abaqalene.
geetaawe bamamalase ya'esune te`ezaaze lamiyaakaberu baaroce hulu maasaayaa temeheretenaa tagesaatze yehone zanede 'enazihene nagaroce hulu fatharene.
kasamaayeme bezu theqemenaa malekaame yahonane weha 'awaradene. baziheme weha 'azere`etocene 'abaqalene. yamitaachadu theraathereewocene 'eneda gabesenaa leelocene 'abaqalene.
basume 'anedu baleelaawe laaye yatadaraaraba 'enebuthe yaalaate setehone razhaazhemenaa kafe yaalu zanebaabaawocene 'abaqalene.

yamibaqelutene yaabaqalenawe labaarocu sisaaye yehone zanede nawe. 'azere`ete yaleelaatene 'agare bawehawe heyaawe 'adaragene. yehecene 'azere`ete yaleelaatene 'agare bazenaabe heyaawe 'enedaadaragenaate hulu mutaanene heyaawe 'enaadaregaalane. heyaawe honaweme yewathaalu.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'anetane kaasetabaabalute sawoce bafite leeloce hhezeboceme nabiyaatocaacawene 'asetabaabelawaale. yanuhhe hhezeboce, yagudegwaadu baaledarabocenaa samudoce 'asetabaabalu.
`aadoceme, fire`oneme yaluthe hhezeboceme 'asetabaabalu.

yatheqetheqe zaafe baalabeetoce yahonute yasha`aayebe hhezebocenaa tuba`e yayamene 'asetadaadare hhezeboceme 'alwahe wada 'enaresu yalaakalaacawune male'eketanyoce 'asetabaabalu. 'alaahe yazaatabaacawe qethaateme taragaagathabaacawe.
lamahonu 'enaanetane majamariyaa mafethare yaalekabadane daageme maqaseqase yekabedanaalene? yelequnese badegaami 'eneda 'adise bamafatharaacawe gudaaye laaye geraa 'enedatagaabu nawe yaalute.

baregetheme yasawe lejene fatharene. nafesu bawesethwa yametegotagutawene hasaabenaa leeloceneme nagaroce 'enaaweqaalane. kalebu gaare tayaayezo 'anegatu laaye kamiganyawe yadame gaane yabalatha 'enyaa wada 'esu yaqarabene nane.
'anedanyaawe baqanyu leelaanyaawe dagemo bageraawe bakule taqamethawe szeraawene yamiqabaabalute malaa'eketoce siganaanyu;
maanenyaaweneme negegere sinaagare: baminaagarawe negegere laaye taqothaathaarinaa 'aberote yaala male'ake yaala bihone 'eneji 'ayeqareme.
meneme mashashaa yaleelawe yamote makaraa (sekaare) ba'ewenatu mathaa. 'aneta yazanagaahe yasawe leje hoye! yaa seteshashawenaa wada xwaalaa setaafagafegebate yanabarekawe nawe yebaalaale.
baqanedu 'enedinafaa yatawakalawe male'ake hulatanyaawene nefi baqanedu banafaa gizee yaa qane yatenesaa'eewe 'elate sihone kahadiyaanenaa hathi'atanyoce yamiqathubate yazaacaawe qane nawe.
hulume nafese yaminadaate 'enaa baszeraawaa laaye yamimasakerebaate male'ake tamadebobaate temathaalace.

latanajiweme basemeetenaa baduneyaa thaafaachenate wesethe bamahone kazihe qane bazenegaatee wesethe nabareke.bamiyaagathemehe qethaatenaa makaraa saabiyaa mazanaagaatehene 'enegaletzelehalane. bamahonume zaaree `aayenehe yasalaa hono kazenegaateehe talaaqeqahe nagarocene hulu teganazabaalahe yebaalaale.
ba'eresu laaye yatamadabawenaa ka'esu gaare yataqoraanyaweme male'ake yehe ka'enee gaare yaalawe szeraawe meneme saayeqanaseme saayechamareme 'aqerebeeyaalahu yelaale.
'alaahe lanaziyaa lamanedaatenaa lamamasekare yatamadabutene malaa'eketocene: 'ewenatene yaaletaqabalunaa getere 'asetabaabaaye yahonutene jahaname wesethe warewerwacawe yelaacawaale.
'alaahe gedeetaa yaadaragabatene malekaame szeraane kalekaaye, ya'alaahene wasane 'alaafinaa 'alaahe yaminaagarawene yatasefaame hona yazaacaa qaale yamitharaatharawene.
yaanene ka'alaahe gaare leelaane tamalaaki 'amelaake yaadaragaweneme kabaadenaa beretu yahona qethaate wesethe warewerute.
yashayethwane quraanyaaweme raasune bamaagelale 'enedihe yelaale:: <<geetaacene hoye! 'enee 'alaasaasaatekuteme. nagare gene 'esu ka'ewenate fetsume yaraaqa sehetate wesethe nabare.>>

'alaaheme <<'enee zanede 'atechaqaachaqu. machaqaachaqaacehu meneme theqeme yalaweme. duneyaa wesethe banabaraacehubate gizee bamale'eketanyocee 'amaakaanyenate 'alaahene lakaadunaa laamatsutzu kabaade zaacaane wada 'enaaneta 'asetalaalefeelaacehu nabare:>> yelaacawaale.

qaalu 'enee zanede 'ayelawatheme! qaaleeneme 'alaathefeme! baaroceene malekaame szeraawocaacawene bamaqanasenaa yaaleszarutene hathi'ate bamachamare 'alebadeleme. yelequnese baszarute szeraa 'emanadaacawaalahu.

lajahanameme 'aneci zanede batawarawarute kahadiyaanenaa hathi'atanyoce moletashaalene? 'enelaataalane. 'eswame lageetaawaa malese bamasethate tachamaari 'alane? telaalace. yeheneneme yametelawe chemaarine bamafalage 'enaa lageetaawaa setele bamaqothaate nawe.

'alaahe lakahadiyaane yatazagaajawene thanekaaraa zaacaa kathaqasa baxwaalaa la'amaanye baariyaawocu yaazagaajawene bamaawesaate 'enedihe yelaale::
janate ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene lamifaru baqarabace gizee baswa wesethe yaalawene tzagaa baqerebate yemalakataalu.
yehene menedaa baneseha wada geetaawe tamalaashe 'enaa ya'esune te`ezaaze thabaaqi lahonu hulu 'alaahe qaale yagabaalaacehu nawe yebaalaalu.
'alaahe 'eneji maaneme bamaayemalakatawe waqete laaye 'alaahene bamisethere yafaraa; wada 'alaahe fetsume yazora 'enaa banetzuhe lebu 'alaahene yaaganya zawatere tatzatzaace.
janatene yaalameneme cegere basalaame gebwate. yehe theri yamazawetariyaa qane nawe: yebaalaalu.

bawesethwame yafalagutenaa maalaqiyaa yaleelawe tzagaa 'alalaacawe. batachamaarime `aayene 'ayetote yamaayaaweqe, jorome sametote yamaayaaweqe 'enedihume yamaanenyaaweme sawe lebe teze belote yamaayaaweqe yatzagaa `aayenatoce 'enyaa zanede yeganyaale. kaziheme 'anedu 'alaahene (subehaanahu wata`aalaa)ne mamalekate nawe.

ka'enazihe yamakaa 'asetabaabaaye 'agaariwoce bafite bagulebate ka'enasu beretu yanabarutene senetenaa senete hhezeboce 'athefetanaale. kaqethaatu lamaamelatheme falegawe bayahagaru maamelachaa 'afalaalagu liyaaganyu 'alecaalume.
kalaaye yaalafutene hhezeboce maathefaate batagalatzawe laaye lebe laalawenaa saayezanagaa lebune bamaaqerabe jorowene lasatha hulu tagesaatzenaa mekere 'alabate.
samaayaatene, mederenenaa bamakaakalaacawe yaalawene hulu ba'afetaa yaahele gizee mafethare 'eyacaalene basedesete qanaate fatharenaacawe. yehudoce 'enedaaluteme meneme dekaame 'alaaganyaneme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehudocenaa leeloce selaminaagarute nagare taagaashe hune. geetaahene bamaamasegane tzahhaye kamawathaatwa subehhi salaatene 'enedihume tzahhaye kamathelaqwaa bafite `asere salaatene segade.
baleeloce kefela gizee la'esu segade. kasegedatoce baxwaalaame 'atheraawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yaa baqanedu 'enedinafaa yatawakalawe male'ake hulatanyaawene nefi kaqerebe botaa hono baminafaabate gizee semaa.

fethuraane yamaqaseqashaa chukxatene meneme bamaayaatharaathere maleku ba'eregethanyenate yasamu gizee; yaa yehene yasamu qane mutaanoce kamaqaaberocaacawe lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa yamawechiyaa qane nawe.

'enyaawe nane heyaawe yamenaadaregawenaa yamenegadelawe. ka'enyaa wechi heyaawe yamiyaadaregenaa yamigadeleme yalame. batenesaa'eewe qane lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa baaroce mamalashaacawe wada 'enyaa becaa nawe.
mareeteme ka'enasu setesanathaqelaacawe bafethenate yewathaalu. huluneme masabesabe lanyaa qalaale nawe.

'enyaa 'asetabaabaayoce yamilutene hulu 'enaaweqaalane. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'enasu laaye yatashomeke ba'emenate 'asegadaaje 'ayedalaheme. 'aneta 'eko 'alaahe 'enedetaadarese yaazazahene male`ekete 'aderaashe nahe. bamahonume bakahadiyaanenaa bahathi'atanyoce laaye yazaatekutene zaacaayeene yamifarutene sawoce baqure'aane 'asetaawese. mekeneyaatume yamimakarawe 'enedihume sigasetzute yamigasatzawe yamifaraa sawe nawe.
'alaahe 'abwaraa mabatanene yamibatenu bahonu nafaasoce yemelaale.
bezunaa kabaade zenaabene tashakaami bahonute damanaawoceme yemelaale.
garenaa qalaale bahona maleku baahere laaye maneqasaaqasene bamineqasaaqasu marekaboce yemelaale.
'alaahe yafethuraanene gudaaye 'enediyaakafaafelu yaazazaacawe bahonu malaa'ekete yemelaale.
geetaacehu qaale yagabaalaacehu gemegamaanaa mamanedaate therethaaree yaleelawe 'ewenate nawe.
batenesaa'eewe qane yabaaroce gemegamaa yamaayeqarenaa yamikasate nawe.
'alaahe webenaa magwaagwaazhaa masemare baalaate samaaye yemelaale.

'enaaneta yamakaa sawoce hoye! 'erese baraasu yamigaachenaa yatametaataa 'aqwaame laaye naacehu. 'anedaanedee qure'aanene degemete, leelaa gizee dagemo getheme; 'anedee dagemo muhhamadene dagaami, leelaa gizeeme dagemo baala qenee telaalaacehu.

'alaahe 'enedamaayaamene selamiyaaweqe bawesaaneewenaa ba`eweqatu 'alamaamanune yaaragaagathawene gelasabe baqure'aanenaa banabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'enedaayaamene yehonaale, lasekeete 'ayebaqaame.
'enaziyaa weshataamoce baqure'aanenaa banabiyu laaye yalebaacawene yatanaagarute taragamu.
'enaziyaa `elamacharashaawe hagare maayemenaa zenegu gedeelashe yahonute;
yamenedaa qane macee nawe? bamaalateme yethayeqaalu. laziyaa qane yamihonaacawene szeraa 'ayeszarume.
'enasu ba'esaate bamiqaathalubate qane nawe: bamaalate 'alaahe melaashe yesathaacawaale.
qethaataacehune qemasu. siyaasethanaqeqwaacehu bamaashofe yate 'ala belaacehu setethaadafubate yanabarawe qethaate nawe yebaalaalu.
ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale geetaacawene yafaru sawoce ya'atekelete botaawocenaa fasaashe menechoce wesethe yenoraalu.
geetaacawe yasathaacawene malekaame menedaa yataqabalu naacawe. yehenene menedaa kamaagenyataacawe bafite baduneyaa malekaame szariwoce nabaru.
balalite segedate yaakanaawenaalu; teneshe gizee 'eneji 'ayetanyume.
banegaate gizee lahathi'ataacawe ka'alaahe maaretaane yethayeqaalu.
kaganezabaacaweme bameneme mekeneyaate yehune tacagerawe lamithayeqwaacaweme hona lamaayethayeqwaacawe cegeranyoce bafaqaadanyenate yamadabute dereshaa 'ala.

bamedere laayeme 'alaahe baaseqamathaacawe baaheroce, taraaroce, wanezoce, zaafoce, 'azere`ete, 'enesesocenaa masale fetherataate; ya'alaahene fathaarinatenaa yafetherataatene qeretze 'asaamaari mahonune lamiyaamenu sawoce celotaawene yamiyaaseradu ta`aameraatoce naacawe.
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! baraasaacehu laaye ya'alaahene celotaa yamiyaasaayu meleketoce 'alunaa teganazabume zanede 'atemalakatumene?
yaduneyaame yahaayemaanoteme sisaayaacehu kasamaaye nawe. 'enedihume baduneyaanaa ba'akxeeraa qaale yatagabaalaacehu menedaa kasamaaye nawe.
basamaayenaa bamedere geetaa 'emelaalahunye. 'enaaneta setenaagaru bamanaagaraacehu laaye meneme therethaaree 'enedaleelaacehu hulu kamote baxwaalaame maqaseqase therethaaree yaleelawe 'ewenate nawe.
lamahonu 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'enaziyaa beraahime (`aalayehi salaame) ba'akeberote yataqabalaacawene malaa'akete 'enegedoce zeenaa daresohalene?!
'esu zanede bagabu gizee salaametaa 'aqerebawe gabu. beraahimeme melaashe bamasethate salaame 'alaacawe. bawesethu yamaanaaweqaacawe sawoce naacawe 'ala.
qase belo wada beetasabu gabaa. sawoce selamasaluteme mulu yasabaace thejaane yezolaacawe mathaa.
thejaawaaneme 'aqarabalaacawe. qase belome <<yaqarabalaacehune megebe 'atebalumene?>> 'alaacawe.

megebune saayebalu siqaru balebu wesethe ferehate tachaarabate. baziheme gizee 'enegedocu 'enedafaraa gamatunaa bataragaagaa maleku <<'ateferaa 'enyaa ka'alaahe zanede yamathaane male'eketanyoce nane>> 'alute. bezu `eweqate yaalawe lejeme 'enedamiyaaganye malekaame zeenaa nagarute: yeheme leje sehhaqe (`alayehi 'asalaame) nawe.
baalabeetu yehenene malekaame zeenaa basamaace gizee kadasetaa bezaate chokxace, fitwaneme 'eyamataace bamagarameme <<'arogite bamaszaratu mahane yahonace seete tewaledaalacene?!>> 'alace.

malaa'eketoceme <<'enyaa yanagareneshe geetaashe yaalawene nawe. 'esu yaalawe malaashe yalaweme. 'esu bamafetharenaa bamawasane thebabanyaa, lafethuraanu yamithaqemaacawene bamaaderage `aawaaqi nawe 'alwate.>>
beraahime (`aalayehi salaame) malaa'eketoceneme <<menedene nawe gudaayaacehu? mene falegaacehu nawe yamathaacehute?>> 'alaacawe.
'enasume <<'enyaa 'alaahe 'asetsayaafi szeraane wadamiszaru wanejalanyoce lekone nawe yamathaanawe.>> bamaalate malasulate.
<<ba'enasu laaye daraqe denegaayene lenelaqebaacawe naweme yalaakane.>>
'aneta beraahime hoye! ya'alaahene wasane batalaalafunaa bakehedateme hona bahathi'aate leke yaalafu sawoce laaye melekete tadaragobaate yametewaraware denegaaye naate.
wanejalanyoce laaye yadarasawe qethaate 'enedaayaaganyaacawe kaluthe hhezeboce 'amaanye yahonutene kakatamaawaa 'asewathaanaacawe.
bakatamaawaa la'alaahe 'eje kasathu (kasalamu) muselimoce wechi leelaa beete 'alaaganyaneme; 'enasume yaluthe beetasabe naacawe.

baluthe hhezeboce katamaa yadarasawene qethaate 'enazaa 'asaamaami yahonawene qethaate yamifarute sawoce yemakarubate zanede 'enasune maathefaataacenene yamiyaasaayu meleketocene tetanaale. kaqethaatu lamadaaneme 'enasu yaszarutene `aayenate szeraame 'enedaayeszarunaa 'enedimakarubate nawe.
musaane (`aalayehi salaame) geletze yahonu maaserajaawocenenaa ta`aameraatocene bamasethate wada fire`one balaakenawe gizee 'asaamaami yahonawene qethaate lamifarute melekete 'ala.
fire`one 'ewenatene laalamaqabale jarebaa satha. musaane (`aalayehi salaame) sawocene yamidageme dagaami wayeme 'a'emerowene yasaata 'ebede naweme 'ala.
'esunenaa szaraawitune bamulu baahere wesethe warawarenaacawe sathamunaa thafume. fire`one bamaasetabaabalunaa 'amelaake nanye bamaalatu tawaqaashe hona.

bahude (`aalayehi salaame) hhezeboce (`aadoce) zenaabene yamaateshakame, `etzewaatene yamaataadaaqelenaa barakaa yaleelaate yahonacene nefaase balaakene gizee 'asaamaami yahonawene qethaate lamifaru melekete 'ala.
yaalafacebate nafeseme hona ganezabeme maanenyaaweneme nagare saataawademenaa 'eneda basabasa 'athenete saataadareqe 'ateqareme (huluneme nagare taathafaalace).
yaswalihhe (`aalayehi salaame) hhezeboce (samudoce) baheyewataacehu gizeewe kamaderasu bafite tathaqamubate batabaalu gizee 'asaamaami yahonawene qethaate lamifaru melekete 'ala.

kageetaacaweme te`ezaaze koru kamaamaneme wasane 'alafu. baziheme gizee bamathabaabaqe laaye 'eyaalu (mekeneyaatume qethaatu ka3 qane baxwaalaa yewaredaale yamile qaale tagabeto selanabara) yaqethaate maqesafete waradabaacawe.
banasu laaye yawaradawene qethaate makalaakale 'alecaalume. yehenene qethaate lamamakate 'aqememe 'alenabaraacaweme.
baregetheme kalaaye katathaqasute hhezeboce bafite yanuhhene hhezeboce bagorefe bamaathelaqelaqe 'athefetanaale. mekeneyaatume ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yawathu laqethaate tagabi bamahonaacawe nawe.
samaayene 'asetakaakelane baxaayele ganabaanaate. 'enyaa 'ademaaswane 'enaasafaalane labaarocaaceneme sisaayaacawene 'enaasafaalane.
mederene lanawaariwoce 'eneda feraashe yatamacaacace 'adaragenaate. 'enedihe batamacaaca huneetaa mazaregaataacene mene yaamaarene zaregiwoce nane.

kahulume nagare thenede 'aderegane fatharene. wanede 'enaa seete, samaaye 'enaa medere, yabesenaa baahere wazata...yeheneme yaadaragenawe ya'alaahene becanyaa 'amelaakenatenaa celotaa 'enedeteganazabu nawe.
'alaahene saataametzu bamataazaze wada 'alaahe, kaqethaatu wada menedaawe sheshu. 'enee kaqethaatu geletze bahona maleku 'asethanaqeqaacexwaalahu.
ka'alaaheme gaare leelaane yamimalake 'amelaake 'ataaderegu 'enee ka'esu geletze bahona maleku 'asethanaqeqaacexwaalahu.

yamakaa sawoce 'enedaasetabaabalute hulu: yaalafuteme hhezeboce 'asetabaabalu. 'anedeme (maaneme) ka'alaahe zanede male'eketanyaa 'ayemathaalaacaweme 'enasu yaanene male'eketanyaa dagaami wayeme 'ebede yaalute bihone 'eneji.

lamahonu male'eketanyocene bamaasetabaabale yaalafute kahadiyaane qathelawe yamathute kahadiyaane gaare 'adaraa tabaabelawaalene? 'adaraa yatabaabaalute nagare yalame nagare gene yaamasaasalaacawe denebare maalafenaa thamaamoce mahonaacawe nawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enazihene kahadiyaane celaa balaacawe. 'aderese yatabaalekawene hulu bamaaderasehe 'atewaqaseme.
'enasune celaa maalatehe mekerenaa maasetaawasene 'ayekalekelehe. mekaraacawe gasetzaacawe. yaaneta maasetaawase ya'emenate sawocene yethaqemaalenaa.
gaaneenocenaa yasawe lejocene 'eneene becaa ligazunye 'eneji laleelaa 'alefatharekwaacaweme. banee 'ameleko laaye tagaari 'enediyaadaregubenye 'alefatharekwaacaweme.
kanasu sisaaye 'alefalegeme; 'enedimagebunyeme 'alefalegeme.

'athaqaalaaye fethuraane yasune sisaaye falaagiwoce naacawe; 'alaahe baarocune sisaaye sachi nawe. 'alaahe yathanekaaraa xaayele baalabeete bamahonu maaneme 'ayaashanefaweme. 'athaqaalaaye gaaneenocenaa sawoce basu xaayele sere naacawe.
'anetane bamaasetabaabale nafesaacawene yabadalu sawoce 'eneda 'alafu gwaadanyocaacawe qethaate la'enasume yaqethaate dereshaa selaalaacawe gizeewe kamaderasu bafite qethaatune 'ayaathaadefu.
ba'alaahe bakaadunaa male'eketanyaawene baasetabaabalu sawoce laaye qethaatu yewaredebaacawaale tabelawe yatagabaalaacawene yazaacaa qaale yatenesaa'eewe qane thefaatenaa keserate wayolaacawe.
'alaahe musaane (`alayehi salaame) baanaagarabate yathure taraaraa yemelaale.
batatzaafawe matsehhafe baqure'aane maala.
bafite 'enedawaraduteme matsaahhefetoce hulu zeregenaa safi bahonawe beraanaa (qodaa) yamitzaafe nawe.
samaaye laaye bamiganyawenaa 'alaahene bamagazaate malaa'eketoce bamiyaadamequte beete yemelaale.
lamedere thaaraa honaa kafe batadaragacewe samaaye 'emelaalahu.
baweha batamolaawe baahere 'emelaalahu.
yageetaahe qethaate bakahadiyaane laaye tafatsaami mahonu yamaayeqare nawe.
ka'enasu makalaakalenaa maagade yamicele maaneme yalame.
samaaye maneqasaaqasene bataneqasaaqasace gizee: tenesaa'ee maderasune lamaasaawaqe baxaayele teneqasaaqasaalace.
taraaroce kabotaacawe manasaatene batanasu gizee.
bazaane qane 'alaahe lakahadeyaane yazaatawene qethaate bamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce laaye thefaatenaa keserate wayolaacawe.
'enanyaa bachawaataanaa zaazaataa laaye yamiwaanyute sela tenesaa'eewenaa sela maqaseqase gede yalashe yahonute.
wada jahaname bachekaaneenaa baxaayele magafaatene batagafu gizee,
bakunanaa malekume: <<male'eketanyocaacehu siyaasefarwarwacehunaa setaasetabaabelwate yanabaraacexwaate 'esaate naate>> yebaalaalu.
yehenene ba`aayenaacehu yaayaacehute qethaate ('esaate) degemete nawene? wayese 'enaaneta 'atemalakatume?

ya'esaatwane muqatenaa qaathalone qemasu. qaathalwane bamaqamase laaye betetaagasume baatetaagasume 'ekule nawe. bazaareewe qane bakehedataacehunaa bahathi'ataacehu mekeneyaate seteszarute yanabarawene 'eneji leelaa 'atemanadume.

'alaahe ya'asetabaabaayocenaa yakahadiwocene menedaa kagalatza baxwaalaa ya'ewenatanyocenaa fariha-'alaahe yahonu baarocune menedaa sigaletze:
ya'esune te`ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale geetaacawene yamifaru; yamaayeqwaarathenaa taalaaqe tzagaa yaalabaate janatoce wesethe naacawe.

geetaacawe basathaacawe thaafaache nagaroce 'eneda megeboce mathathoce 'enaa misetoce wazata...tadasaacoce naacawe. geetaacawe kajahaname qethaate thabaqaacawe. yamifalegutene nagaroce bamaagenyatenaa kamithalute mathefo tathabaqu.

lanafesaacehu dase yaalaacehune belu, thathu bametebaluteme, bametethathuteme gudaatenaa cegere yaagaathemanaale belaacehu 'atesegu. yehe baduneyaa seteszarute lanabarawe malekaame szeraacehu menedaa nawe yebaalaalu.
yatawaabunaa yaageethu 'enedihume yatadaradaru bahonu 'alegaawoce laaye yedagafaalu. nachenaa kaqunejenaacawe `aayenocaacawe safaafi yahonu seetocene 'enaagaabaacawaalane.

'enazaa yaamanu 'enaa lejocaacawe ba'emenate yatakatalwacawe ba'enaresu dase 'enedilaacawe lejocaacawene (baszeraa 'enasune baayedaresubaacaweme) wada 'enasu 'enaasethagaacawaalane. kaszeraawocaacawe meneme 'aneqanesebaacaweme. hulume sawe baszaraawe mathefo szeraa tayaazhe nawe. leelaa sawe hathi'atune 'ayeshakamelateme.
ya'eshatenaa feraaferee `aayenatocene 'enechamerelaacawaalane. 'enedihume yamifalegutene segaa 'enechamerelaacawaalane.

bajanate wesethe mathathene yeqabaabalaalu. yehe gene thachiwoce baduneyaa sithathu bamathathaataacawe mekeneyaate takatelawe yamimathutene nagaroce terefenaa wedeqe yahonu negegeroce 'enedihume wanejalene yamiyaasekatelu 'ayedalume.
kasawenataacawe qelaatenaa theraate yatanasaa zaagole wesethe batheneqaaqee yataqamatha lule yamimaselu taadaagi 'agalegaayoce te`ezaazaacawene lamaqabalenaa 'enasune lamaagalegale yeneqasaaqasaalu.
yajanate sawoce 'erese baresaacawe fite lafite bamaqamathe selaalafawe yaduneyaa heyewataacawe yethayaayaqaalu.
'enyaa duneyaa wesethe kabeetasabocaacene gaare banabarenebate gizee ya'alaahene qethaate 'enefaraa nabare. bamaalate yemalesaalu.
'alaahe wada selaame bamameraate malekaamune lagasane. 'ejege 'aqaathaaye kahonaweme qethaate thabaqane.

baduneyaa heyewate banabarenebate gizee 'enegazaawe nabare. ka'esaate qethaateme 'enedithabeqane 'enelamenawe nabare. 'esu malekaame welataane yamiwele 'azaanye nawe. kamalekaame welataaweme wada 'emenate mameraatu 'enaa janate 'asegabeto ka'esaate 'adaanane.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! baqure'aane 'asetaawesaacawe 'alaahe bawaalalehe ya'emenatenaa 'a`emero welataa thaneqwaayeme 'ebedeme 'ayedalaheme.

'enazihe kahadiyaane 'asetabaabaayoce muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa 'ayedalame, yelequnese baalaqenee (gathaami) 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame, 'enyaa 'esune denegate moto magalaagalene 'enethabeqaalane yelaalune?
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! <<yaneene mote thabequ 'eneeme 'eneene bamaasetabaabalaacehu mekeneyaate banaaneta laaye yamiwaredawene qethaate 'ethabeqaalahu>> balaacawe.

lamahonu 'a`emerwacawe: <<thaneqwaayenaa 'ebede nawe">> yamilawene 'abaabaale 'enedilu 'azezwacawe nawene yehenene yamilute? yehene bamaalataacawe ba'anede sawe laaye lisabaasabu yamaayecelutene nagaroce sabasabu. yelequnese 'enasu wada shari`aaweme hona wada helinaa limalasu yamaayecelu wasane 'alaafiwoce naacawe.

lamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) raa`eye 'alewaradalateme, yelequnese karaasu yafatharawe nawe yelaalune? karaasu yafatharawe 'ayedalame. 'enasu fatharaa nawe bamaalataacawe yamaayaamenu kuraatanyoce naacawe.
'esu baraasu yafatharawe nawe yamilu kahonanaa 'ewenatanyoce kahonu: 'esune yamasala yaminababe qure'aane yaamethu.

lamahonu yaala fathaari tafatharune? wayese raasaacawene baraasaacawe fatharu? bamaszaratu 'anede fethure yaala fathaari lifathare 'ayeceleme; 'enedihume raasune mafethareme 'ayeceleme. bamahonume lamene fathaariyaacawene 'ayegazume?!

lamahonuse samaayaatenaa mederene fatherawaalene? bafetsume! 'alefatharume; yelequnese sela fathaariyaacawe 'eregethanyaa 'emenate yalaacaweme; 'eregethanyaa 'emenate binoraacawe noro 'esune becaa batagazunaa male'eketanyaawene baamanu nabare.

lamahonu yageetaahe yasisaaye kaazenaa 'enedihume nabiyenate ba'ejaacawe hono lafalagute bamasethate yafalaguteneme yamakalekale selethaane 'alaacawene? wayese 'enyaa yabalaaye taqothaathaarinaa 'enedafalagene nagaraatocene 'enaaneqasaaqesaalane yelaalune?

lamahonuse wada samaaye yamiwathubate mawathaachaa masalaale norwacawe 'alaahe yamiyaasetalaalefawene raa`eye yaadaamethaalune? kaadaamathume maadaamathaacawene yamiyaaragaagethe geletze yahona maaserajaa 'ewenatanyoce kahonu yaamethu.
lamahonuse yametethalwatene seete leje lasu; yametewadutene wanede leje lanaaneta taadaregaalaacehune?
lamahonuse 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'alaahe male`eketene bamaasetalaalafehe kefeyaa tethayeqaacawaalahene? yeheme bamahonu yamaayecelutene shakeme tashakamune?
lamahonuse yaruqe (yawadafite)`eweqate norwacawe baziheme mekeneyaate kazihu yamitzefute 'enaa selawadafitu yafalagutene yaminagerwacawe 'alwacawene?
lamahonuse 'enazihe kahadiyaane ba'anetanaa bahaayemaanotehe seeraane yaaseeraalune? baaneta laaye saayehone ba'enasu laaye nawe yamiseerebaacawe bamahonume ba'alaahe tamaamane.

lamahonuse ba'ewenate yamimalake ka'alaahe wechi 'amelaake 'alaacawene? 'alaahe 'enasu ba'alaahe laaye kamiyaagaarute yatharaa nawe kalaaye yatagalatzute nagaroce hulu bafetzume lihone yamaayecele gudaaye nawe.
kasamaaye yahona quraachene baayu gizee yehe yatadaraaraba damanaa nawe yelaalu. bamiyaayute nagare 'ayemakarume, 'ayaamenumeme.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! batenesaa'eewe qane kamiqathubate qethaate gaare 'esekiganaanyu derase bakehedataacawenaa bathememataacawe laaye tawaacawe.
seeraacawe teleqeme yehune teneshe yamaayethaqemaacawe qane nawe. 'enedihume kaqethaate yamiyaadenaacawe radaateme yalaacaweme.

la'enaziyaa nafesaacawene bakehedatenaa bashereke yabadalu sawoce katenesaa'ee qethaate bafite baqerebitu `aalame (duneyaa) bamamaarake, bagedeyaa; baqabere wesethe dagemo qethaate 'alalaacawe. nagare gene 'abezaanyaawocu yehene 'ayaawequme selahoname bakehedataacawe laaye yezawateraalu.

'alaahe 'agaariwoce yaalubatene yawadaqa 'emenate kagalatsa baxwaalaa: male'eketanyaawene la'enasu gede 'enedaayenoraacawenaa bamaasetabaabalaacawe te'egesete 'enediyaadaregu siyaazezaacawe 'enedihe yelaale::
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lageetaahe feredenaa lashari`aawiwe denegaagee taagase. mekeneyaatume ba'enyaa `eyetaanaa thebaqaa sere nahenaa. ka'eneqelefe setenaqaame geetaahene bamaamasegane kamaayegabu nagaroce 'atheraawe.
balaliteme geetaahene 'atheraa. 'enedihume kokoboce thaleqawe gohe berehaanune yezo simathaa yasubehhi salaatene segade.
'alaahe kawaakebete bamithaleqebate gizee yemelaale.
muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) qathe yaalawene manegade 'alesaatame 'enedihume thamaamaame 'alehoname; yelequnese wada qathetanyaa manegade yatamaraa nawe.
semeetunenaa lebewaladune takatelo yehenene qure'aane 'ayenaagareme.
yehe qure'aane bajiberile (`aalayehi salaame) 'amaakaanyenate ka'alaahe yawarada raa`eye 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame.
yehenene qure'aane beretu xaayele yaalawe jiberile (`aalayehi salaame) 'asetamaarawe.
yaamaara gatsetaa yaalawe jiberile 'alaahe bafatharawe qeretse kalaaye geletze hono lanabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) taaya.
jiberile kasamaaye laayenyaawe 'aqethaachaa laaye hono.
kazaa baxwaalaa jiberile (`aalayehi salaame) wada nabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) qaraba. qerebatune yabalatha chamara.
qerebatume yahulate dagaane reqate yaahele wayeme kazihe yabalatha yaqaraba nawe.
'alaahe lajiberile yaasetalaalafawene male'ekete jiberile lamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) 'asetalaalafa.
yamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) lebe ba`aayenu yatamalakatawene 'alewaashame.
'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! wada samaaye baaragabate gizee 'alaahe selaasaayawe nagare tekaraakarutaalaacehune?
baregetheme muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) wada samaaye baaraga gizee jiberilene batafatharabate 'akwaaxwaane badegaami lahulatanyaa gizee 'ayetotaale.
"sidaratule munetahaa" kametebaale zaafe 'athagabe nawe yaayawe. zaafwame sabaatanyaawe samaaye laaye yameteganye gezufe zaafe naate.
'ezice zaafe zanede yazalaalame maarafiyaa janate yeganyaale.
yaqurequraa zaafwane ka'alaahe leyu yahona teleqe nagare bashafanaate gizee yaanene nagare menenatune ka'alaahe basetaqare maaneme 'ayaaweqaweme.
yamuhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) `aayenu wada qanyeme wada geraame 'alewaalalame. maayate kaalabate gadabeme 'alaalafame.
baregetheme muhhamade (salaalahu `aalayehi wasalame) wada samaaye baaragabate gizee ya'alaahene taalaaqenate yamiyaasaayu taalaalaaqe meleketoce 'ayetwale. janatenaa jahanamene wazata...'ayetwale.
'enaaneta 'agaariwoce hoye! 'enazihene ka'alaahe wechi yametegazwacawene 'ale-laatenaa `uze-zaane tamalakataacehune?!
kathaa`otocaacehu sela leelaanyaawenaa szosetanyaayetu manaate 'eseti negarunye lamahonu yethaqemaacexwaalene? kagudaatese yekalaakalelwacexwaalene?!
lamahonu la'enaaneta yametewadutene wanede la'alaahe dagemo yametethalwatene seete leje taadaregaalaacehune?!
yehece bazenebaaleeyaacehu yaakafaafalaacexwaate kefefele fetehawinate yagodalaate fereda gamedele ferede naate.

'enazihe thaa`otaate taraa yahonu kaseme yazalala teregume yalashe yahonu ya'ameleko baaheri yaleelaacawe 'enaanetanaa 'abaatocaacehu karaasaacehu yasayamaacexwaate naate. 'alaahe meneme maaserajaa yaalaawaradalaate 'agaariwoce ba'emenataacawe gudaaye shayethwane yashalamalaacawene therethaareenenaa zenebaaleeyaacawene 'eneji 'ayekatalume. baregetheme kageetaacawe bamale'eketanyaawe 'anedabate qanaa mamariyaa mathetolaacawaale bihoneme 'aletakataluteme.
lamahonu yasawe leje thaa`otaate 'alaahe zanede yaamaaledunyaale yamile menyote 'alawene?!
yalaweme! yatamanyawene 'ayaaganyeme. yamacharashaawenaa yamajamariyaawe `aalame ya'alaahe becaa naacawe. kanasu yafalagawene lafalagawe yesathaale, laalefalagawe dagemo 'ayesatheme.

senetenaa senete basamaayaate yamiganyu malaa'ekete maamaaladene bifalegu melejaacawe yamaayethaqeme 'alaahe 'enediyaamaaledu lafalagalaacawe sawoce faqaade sisathenaa melejaa latathayaqalate 'akaale 'alaahe yawadadalate sihone becaa nawe. 'alaahe basu laaye lamiyaagaarute faqaade 'ayesatheme 'enedihume ka'alaahe wechi yamiyaamalekutene 'ayewademe.

bamacharashaawe qane maqaseqasene yamaayaamenu sawoce malaa'eketocene baseete seyaamee yetharwacawaale. mekeneyaatume ba'enasu 'emenate seetoce naacawe belawe selamiyaamenu 'enasu kamilute nagare 'alaahe yatharaanaa yalaaqa geetaa nawe.
malaa'aketocene baseete seyaamee matheraataacawe meneme maaserajaa yalaacaweme. therethaareene 'eneji leelaane 'ayekatalume. therethaaree (gemete) ba'ewenate botaa laaye liqome 'ayeceleme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahene maasetaawasene celaa bamaalate yazanagu sawocene raaqaacawe. 'enasu yaqerebitu heyewatene 'eneji leelaa felaagote yaleelaacawene (raaqaacawe). batachamaarime 'enasu lamacharashaawe qane yamithaqemaacawene 'ayeszarume. mekeneyaatume bazaa qane 'emenate selaleelaacawe.

malaa'eketocene baseete yamitharu 'agaariyaane: ya`eweqataacawe macharashaa yehe nawe. mekeneyaatume maayemoce selahonu. bazihe laaye 'eregethanyaa 'eweqate yalaacaweme. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe ka'ewenate manegade yaraaqutene yaaweqaale. la'ewenate manegade yatamaruteneme yaaweqaale, meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.

basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalute hulu baalabeetenate, mafetharenaa maasetanaabare yasu becaa nawe. 'enazaane mathefo szeraa yasarutene yamigabaacawene qethaate bamasethate yemanadaale 'enedihume malekaame szeraane yaszaru me'emanaane batashaala menedaa (janate) yemanadaale.

'enaziyaa kataalaalaaqe wanejalocenaa ka'atzayaafi hathi'ate teneneshu hathi'ate siqare yamirequ naacawe. 'enazihe teneneshe hathi'atoce taalaalaaqe wanejalocene bamaraaqenaa malekaame szeraawocene bamaabezaate yesarazaalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe yasafi maaretaa baalabeete nawe. bamahonume baaroce kahathi'atocaacawe tatzatzetawe katamalasu yemeraacawaale. 'esu 'alaahe 'abaataacehune 'adamene ka'afare sifatherawe huneetaacehune yaaweqaale 'enedihume ba'enaatocaacehu hode wesethe honaacehu ka'anede darajaa wada leelaanyaawe darajaa seteshagaagaru yaaweqaale meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. bamahonume nafesaacehune 'eswane bamaawadase, 'alaahene yamifaraa mahonune bamaamasegane 'ataatheraaru (yamaayegabaatene darajaa 'atesethu) mekeneyaatume ya'esune te`ezaaze bamafatsame yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene yamifaru baarocune yaaweqaale.
lamahonu yazaa wada selaame kaqaraba baxwaalaa yazorawene sawe mathefo huneetaa 'ayetahalene?!
teneshe ganezabe kasatha baxwaalaa yekalakelaale. mekeneyaatume nefugenate baaheriwe selahona baziheme laaye raasune makaabu.
lamahonu yaruqe misethere `eweqate norote yamitaayawe hono nawene sela tenebite yamiyaawaraawe?!
wayenese ba'alaahe laaye 'eyaqathafa nawe?! yehe ba'alaahe laaye yamiqathefawe sawe banabiyulaahe musaa matsehhafe wesethe yaalawe 'aletanagarawemene?
yageetaawene te`ezaaze hulu yaamwalaa yahonawe beraahime matsehhafe wesethe yaalawese 'aletanagarawemene?
'anede sawe yaleelaawene hathi'ate yamaayeshakame mahonune.
yasawe leje yaszaraawene szeraa menedaa 'eneji yaleelawe mahonune.
batenesaa'eewe qane szeraawe bageletze yamitaaye mahonune.
kazaa baxwaalaa yaszeraawe wetheete yatamwalaa hono saayegwaadale yesathawaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kamote baxwaalaa baaroce wada geetaahe yemalasaalu.
'alaahe yafalagawene 'asedaseto 'enediseqe yaadaregaale. yafalagawene dagemo 'asaazeno yaaselaqesawaale.
'esu yafalagawene yegadelaale, yafalagawene bamaqaseqase heyaawe yaadaregaale.
'esu hulate `aayenate tzotaane wanedenaa seetene fathara.
yeheme yamihonawe yafetewate thabetaa maahetzane wesethe bamifasebate waqete nawe.
kamote baxwaalaa 'enedaganaa fathero bamaqaseqase wada hheyewate yemalesawaale.
kabaarocu yafalagawene habete bamasethate habetaame 'adaraga. batachamaarime batherite maleku qwaami neberate 'enediyeze neberate sathawe.
'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce ka'alaahe gaare siyaamalekwaate yanabaracewe kokabe "shi`eraa" 'alaahe ya'eswa geetaa nawe.
yanabiyulaahe swalihe hhezeboce samadoceneme meneme saayaaseqare 'athafaacawe.

yanuhhe hhezeboceneme ka`aadocenaa samudoce bafite 'athafaacawe. yanuhhe hhezeboce ka'enasu yabaasu badaayocenaa 'ejege yathamamu nabaru. mekeneyaatume nabiyulaahe nuhhe 'enasu gaare zathanye mato hamesaa `aamate wada tawehhide ('alaahene babecanyenate 'enedigazu) sitharaacawe 'aletaqabaluteme.
yaluthe hhezeboce katamaaneme wada samaaye kafe 'aderego wada medere galabathaate.
wada samaaye kafe 'aderego wada medere kagalabathaate baxwaalaa yadenegaaye werejebenye shafanaate.
'aneta sawe ya'alaahe celotaane kamiyaasaayute meleketoce bayatenyaawe nawe yametekaraakarawenaa yamaategasatzawe?
yehe yatalaakalaacehu male'eketanyaa 'eneda qadametocu male'eketanyoce nawe.
qerebitu tenesaa'ee qarabace.
'eswane yamimalese wayeme yamimakete 'akaale yalame. 'eswaneme mamalekatenaa salaswame maawaqe yamicelawe 'alaahe becaa nawe.
yaminababelaacehu qure'aane ka'alaahe selamamethaatu tegaramaalaacehune?!
bamaashofeme basu laaye teseqaalaacehu. mekerocune setesamume 'ataalaqesumene?
la'alaahe becaa segadu 'amelekoteneme baqenenate lasu becaa 'aderegu.

yasa`aatitu (tenesaa'eewe) mamechaa gizee qaraba. charaqaame banabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) gizee lahulate takafalace. yacharaqaane lahulate makafale batachabaache kataayu yanabiyu ta`aameraatoce 'anedu nabare.

'agaariwoce yanabiyune (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) 'ewenatanyenate yamiyaasaayu maaserajaawocene siyaayu maqabalene 'emebi 'alu. 'enediheme yelaalu:: 'enyaa yaayanaacawe maaserajaawoce wedeqe yahonu degemetoce naacawe.
yamathaaweneme 'ewenate 'asetabaabalu. semeetocaacaweneme takatalu. batenesaa'eewe `elate hulume nagare therume yehune mathefo bamigabaawe botaa laaye yaarefaale.
ba'eregetheme 'alaahe bakehedataacawenaa babadalaacawe yaathafaacawe hhezeboce taarike kaalubate kehedatenaa badale 'eneditaaqabu baqi yahona mekere mathetolaacawaale.

yaa yamathaalaacawe mekere 'enasu meneme `aayenate mekeneyaate 'enedaayaaqarebu yatamwalaa thebabene yayaaza nawe. daaru gene ba'alaahe 'enaa bamacharashaawe qane yamaayaamenu sawoce meneme maasethaneqaqiyaa 'ayethaqemaacaweme.

bazihe yamaayemaru kahona tawaacawe. yaa batherunebaa 'enedinafaa yatawakalawe male'ake fethuraane kazihe bafite 'ayetawete yamaayaawequte 'asedanegaache wadahonawe theri 'esekitharaa derase celaa balaacawe (tawaacawe).
`aayenocaacawe yatawaaradu yehonaalu. kamaqaaberocaacaweme wathetawe wada gemegamaa botaa siheedu yatabatanu 'anebathaawoce yemaselaalu.
bafethenate wada tathaariwe maqomiyaa botaa yeheedaalu. kaqanu kebedatenaa 'asedanegaachenate yatanasaa zaaree bathaame kabaade qane nawe yelaalu.

kufaaroce lanabiyaacene jarebaa masethataacawene kaawasaa baxwaalaa nabiyune lamaatzenaanaate kazihe bafite yanabaru hhezeboceme male'etanyocaacawune maasetabaabalaacawene nagaraacawe.
kanazihe 'anetane kaasetabaabaluhe sawoce bafite yanuhhe hhezeboce baariyaacenene nuhhene (`aalayehi salaame) wada hhezebocu balaakenawe gizee 'asetabaabalu. 'ebede naweme 'alu. 'enasune wada tekekelanyaawe manegade matheraatene kaaletaweke bamaalate basedebenaa bazaacaa 'asefaraarute 'enedihume 'awagazute.
geetaayee hhezebocee 'ashanafunye. latheriyee malekaame melaashe 'alesathunyeme. ba'enasu laaye qethaate bamaawerade 'eredaanye bamaalate tamaatzana.
yasamaayene baroce bamakefate takataataayenaa baxaayele yamifase weha laqaqenebaacawe.

medere wehane bamaafelaqe menechoce 'enedifatharu 'adaragene. 'alaahe qadame belo bawasanawe maszarate kasamaaye yawaradawe medere laaye kafalaqawe gaare taganaanyu. 'alaahe natzaa yaawathaawe siqare 'enedaalu ba'athaqaalaaye baweha 'asathamaacawe.
'enyaa nuhhene ba'enechatenaa bamisemaare yatasaraace bahonace marekabe laaye bamachaane 'esunenaa 'aberawete yaalutene natzaa 'awathaanaacawe.

yehece marekabe kabaade maa`ebale laaye banyaa `eyetaanaa thebaqaa 'enedetegwaaze bamaaderage nuhhene baasetabaabalute hhezebocu 'enaa ka'alaahe yaamathaalaacawene male`ekete bakaadu sawoce laaye radaanawe.
baregetheme 'enazihene sawoce yaqathaanebate qethaate temeheretenaa tagesaatze 'enedihone 'adaragenawe. lamahonu bazihe tagesaatze yamigasatze 'alane?
yaasetabaabalu sawoce laaye qethaatee 'enedeete nabare? 'enasune bamaathefaatee maasethaneqaqiyaayee 'enedeete nabare?!
ba'eregetheme qure'aanene lamekerenaa tagesaatze 'agaraanawe. lamahonu batagesaatzu yamigasatze 'alane?

`aadoce nabiyulaahe hudene (`aalayehi salaame) 'asetabaabalu. 'enaaneta yamakaa sawoce hoye! qethaatee 'enedeete 'enedanabara 'eseti 'asetawelu leelocene bamaqethaate maasethaneqaqiyaayee 'enedeete nabare?
'enyaa kabaadenaa bathaame qazeqaazaa yahonacene nefaase; mathefonaa barakate baleelaawe qane jahaname 'esekigabu derase qathaaye yahonane qethaate 'awaradenebaacawe.
sawocene kamareete naqelaa bamaanesaate ba'afe thimaacawe yametewarawere naate. 'awadaadaqaacaweme kaszeru yatanaqala yatamere zaafe (zanebaabaa) genede yemaselaalu.
'enaaneta yamakaa sawoce qethaatee 'enedeete 'enedanabara 'eseki 'asetawelu! leelocune bamaqethaate maasethaneqaqiyaayeese 'enedeete nabare?
ba'eregetheme qure'aanene lamekerenaa tagesaatze 'agaraanawe. lamahonu batagesaatzu yamigasatze 'alane?
samudoce male'eketanyaacawe swalihhe (`aalayehi salaame) yaasethanaqaqaacawene nagare 'asetabaabalu.
'enyaa 'eneda 'enyaa yahonane sawe 'enekatalaalane? 'enyaa 'esune yamenekatale kahona ka'ewenate raaqene 'enedihume cegere wesethe gabaane maalate nawaa bamaalate 'awagazute.
ka'enyaa 'athaqaalaaye talayeto la'esu becaa raa`eye waradalatene?! 'alewaradalateme yelequnese 'esu weshataamenaa 'amebaaganane nawe.
naga batenesaa'eewe qane weshataame 'amebaaganane maane 'enedahona saayaawequte 'ayeqarume. 'enasu naacawe wayese swalihhe?

'enasune lamafatane senele kateleqe qwaathenye (denegaaye) gemalene 'enaawathaalaacawaalane. 'aneta swalihhe hoye! baswa laaye 'enaa ba'enasu laaye yamihonawene tathabaabaqe. selamiyaadaresubeheme cegere taagase.
yagudegwaadu weha ba'enasu 'enaa bagemalwa makaakale yatakafaafala; 'anedu qane laswa leelaawe dagemo la'enasu hulume 'eyaanedaanedu batamadabalate qane heedo 'enedamisetanaagade negaraacawe.
hhezebocu gadaayu gemalwane 'enedigadele tharute. yawaganocune te`ezaaze lamafatzame sayefune 'aqabalutenaa gemalwane wageto gadalaate.
'enaaneta yamakaa sawoce qethaatee 'enedeete 'enedanabare 'eseki 'asetawelu? leelocune bamaqethaate maasethaneqaqiyaayeese 'enedeete nabare?
'enyaa 'anedene chukxate bamalaake 'athafaanaacawe. baziheme maszarate leke lakabetoce 'athere yamithaqamubatene daraqe zaafe maselawe qaru.
ba'eregetheme qure'aanene lamekerenaa tagesaatze 'agaraanawe. lamahonu batagesaatzu yamigasatze 'alane?
yaluthe hhezeboce nabiyulaahe luthe yaamathaalaacawene male'ekete 'asetabaabalu.
