'enyaa ba'enasu laaye denegaayene yametethelene nefaase laqaqanebaacawe. nabiyulaahi luthenenaa yaamanute beetasabune qethaatu kamamethaatu bafite balalite laqawe 'enediwathu bamaaderage kaqethaate 'adaanenaacawe.

ba'enyaa tzagaa mekeneyaate kaqethaate 'adaanenaacawe. bamahonume nabiyulaahe luthene bamanadaanebate menedaa maszarate ya'alaahene tzagaa 'amasegaanye yahonu baarocaacenene bamalekaame 'enemanadaalane.
qethaatu kamamethaatu bafite luthe hhezebocune ka'alaahe qethaate 'asethaneqeqwaacawe nabare. bihoneme gene maasethaneqaqiyaawene celaa bamaalate takaraakarute, 'enedihume 'asetabaabalute.

ba'enasunaa ba'enegedocu malaa'eketoce makaakale 'asetzayaafi deregitene lamafatzame bamafalage luthene 'eneditawaacawe thayaqute. baziyaaweme qetzebate `aayenocaacawene 'athafaanebaacawe. qethaateene qemasu. yehe qethaate yamaasetabaabalaacehu wetheete nawe 'alenaacawe.
zawetaarinaa qathaaye yahona qethaate bamaaladaawe sa`aate baregetheme mathaabaacawe. yehe qethaate yazalaalame kahonawe ya'akxiraa qethaate 'esekigabu derase gizeeyaawi nawe.
yehene yaawaradekubaacehune qethaate luthe 'asethaneqeqwaacehu maasethaneqaqiyaawene baalamaqabalaacehu mekeneyaate nawenaa qemasute 'alenaacawe.
ba'eregetheme qure'aanene lamekerenaa tagesaa`e 'agaraanawe. lamahonu batagesaatzu yamigasatze 'alane?
baregetheme bamusaanaa harune (`aalayehi salaame) 'anedabate maasethaneqaqiyaacene lafire`one mathaalate.

ka'enyaa zanede yamathaalaacawene yatalayaayu ta`aameraatoceneme 'asetabaabalu. bamaasetabaabalaacaweme mekeneyaate maaneme liyaashanefawe yamaayecelawene ya'ashanaafinaa huluneme nagare caaye yahonawe geetaa qethaate qathanaacawe.

lamahonu 'enaaneta yamakaa kahadiyaane kanaziyaa kaalafute yanuhhe, hude, samude, yaluthenaa yafire`one hhezeboce teshaalaalaacehune wayese 'enaaneta ka'alaahe qethaate 'enedametedenu yamigaletze mamariyaa kasamaaye waredolaacehu nawe?!
lamahonu 'enazihe yamakaa kahadiyaane ba'enyaa laaye kefu yamiyaasebenenaa 'anedenataacenene yamikafaafelene hulu laaye 'ashanaafi nane yelaalune?
'enazihe yamakaa kahadiyaane sebeseboce ba'amaanyoce fite bamashanafe wadaxwaalaa yeshashaalu. (batachabaache babadere zamacaa laaye taayetwale)
yelequnese yamiyaasetabaabelwate tenesaa'ee yaqethaate qana qatharwacawe naate. yatenesaa'eewe qane qethaate duneyaa laaye babadere zamacaa kaagaathamaacawe qethaate yabaasanaa yakafaa nawe.
'enazihe thamaamaa wanejalanyoce ka'ewenate yaraaqa bahona yakehedate hathi'ate 'enedihume baqethaatenaa lefaate wesethe naacawe.
bafitocaacawe 'esaate wesethe bamigotatubate gizee; batecete maleku <<ya'esaatene qethaate qemasu>> yebaalaalu.
'enyaa huluneme nagare bawasanenawe, ba`eweqataacenenaa bamazegabaacene (lawehhale maahhefuze) laaye baasafarenawe maszarate nawe yafatharenawe.
'anedene nagare senefalege te`ezaazaacene 'anedite qaale becaa naate 'eswame <<hune>> bamile yafalagenawe nagare bafethenate 'eneda `aayene belechetaa yehonaale.
kaalafute hhezeboce bakehedataacawe 'enedanaaneta yahonutene baregetheme 'athefetanaale. lamahonu kakehedatu bamaraaqe yamigasatzenaa yamimakare 'alane?
baaroce yaszarutene maanenyaaweme szeraa thabaaqi malaa'eketoce zanede tamazegebo yeganyaale. meneme nagare ka'enasu 'ayaamalethaacaweme.
maanenyaaweme negegerenaa szeraa tenesheme yehune teleqe baszeraa mazegabe 'enaa balawehhale maahefuze (thebeqe bahonawe mazegabe) wesethe tatzefwale. baziheme maszarate yemanadaalu.
yageetaacawene te`ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene yamifarute bajanatocenaa bawanezoce wesethe yedasataalu.

zaazaataanaa hathi'ate baleelabate 'ewenatanyaa bahonu maqamachaa, yahulume nagare baalabeetenaa negusze 'enedihume meneme nagare yamaayesaanawe caaye yahona 'alaahe zanede yehonaalu. 'enasu zawaterenaa zalaalamaawi bahona tzagaa laaye mahonaacawe yamiyaathayaayeqe 'ayedalame.

mederene lafethuraane lamanoriyaa zegejunaa yataragaagaace 'adaragaate.
'eswa wesethe feraafereene yamiyaafarunaa kamakaakalu tafaleqeqo yatamere feree yamiwathaabaacawe yatamere zaafoce 'alu.

yehenene menedaa yaaganyute duneyaa banabarubate gizee malekaame szeraane bamaszeraataacawe mekeneyaate nawe.
janate wesethe 'atzayaafi negegerene 'ayesamume 'enedihume hathi'ate wesethe yamiyaasegabaane szeraame 'ayeszarume.
janate wesethe yamalaa'eketenenaa ya'erese baraasaacawe salaametaane 'eneji leelaa 'ayesamume.
yaqanye gwaadoce yaszeraa mazegabaacawe baqanye 'ejaacawe yamisathaacawe naacawe; 'alaahe zanede yaalaacawe darajaanaa maa`erage menenyaa yalaaqa nawe!!
'eshohaacawe yataqorathunaa yamaayegodu yahonu yaqurequraa zaafe gaare naacawe.
fereewe yatadaraarabanaa yatadaradara yamuze zaafeme wesethe naacawe.
qwaaminaa zawetaari yahona zerege thelaa sere naacawe.
yamaayaaqomu waraaje wehawoceme 'athagabe naacawe.
baquthere yaaletagadabu bezu feraafereewoceme.
fetzume yamaayeqwaarathe, waqetaawi yaalehona 'enaa bafalagubateme gizee meneme yamiyaagedaacawe yalame.
ba'alegaawocaacawe laaye yataqamathu kafe yaalu feraashoce 'alwacawe.
yatathaqasutene yajanate seetocene baaletalamada maleku 'ezaawe janate wesethe ba'eregetheme fatharenaacawe.
kazihe bafite maaneme yaaledarasabaacawe (yaalenakaacawe) lejaagaradoceme 'adereganaacawaale.
baalocaacawe gaare tawaadaajenaa ba`edemeeme 'ekuyaa naacawe.
la`edelanyenataacawe melekete yehone zanede yaszeraa mazegabaacawene baqanye 'ejaacawe lataqabalute sawoce 'enazihene seetoce fatharenelaacawe.
'enasume kaalafute yanabiyaate hhezeboce sebesebe naacawe.
kanabiyu muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yamacharashaa hhezeboce sebeseme naacawe.
yageraa gwaadoce yaszeraa mazegabaacawe bageraa 'ejaacawe yamisathaacawe naacawe. macharashaacawenaa huneetaacawe menenyaa yakafaa nawe.
kabaadenaa xaayelanyaa bahonace nefaase wesethe 'enedihume kabaadenaa 'asechanaaqi bahonawe muqate wesethe naacawe.
bathelaashate thelaa sere naacawe.
malekaamenaa theru baalehona nafaashaamaa 'ayare 'enaa dase yamaayele gatzetaa (`eyetaa) laaye naacawe.
'enasu wadazihe qethaate kamamethaacawe bafite baduneyaa wesethe yataqamaathalunaa semeetaacawe 'eneji leelaa hasaabe 'alenabaraacaweme.
'alaahene bamakaadenaa thaa`otaatene bamagazaate laaye yazawataru nabaru.
motane 'afare honane 'enaa yabasabasa 'athenete kahonene baxwaalaa 'eneqasaqasaalane? bamaalate bamaashofenaa bamaawegaze yaasetabaabelu nabare.
lamahonu kanyaa bafite yanabaru 'abaatocaacene yeqasaqasaalune?
la'enazihe maqaseqasene lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce 'enedihe balaacawe yamajamariyaawocume yamacharashaawocume hhezeboce;
yaala meneme therethere batenesaa'eewe qane lamagamegamenaa lamamanedaate yesabaasabaalu.
'enaaneta kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yaasetabaabalaacehu ka'ewenate manegade yatasaasaataacehu hoye! mathefonaa qoshaashaa kahonawe yazaqume fereene batenesaa'eewe temagabaalaacehu.
'enaaneta kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene yaasetabaabalaacehu ka'ewenate manegade yatasaasaataacehu hoye! mathefonaa qoshaashaa kahonawe yazaqume fereene batenesaa'eewe temagabaalaacehu.
bazihu zaafe feree baado yahonawene hodaacehune yemolulaacexwaale.
'ejege bathaame yafalaa weha yethathaalu.
babashetaa mekeneyaate yatathamaace gemale 'enedametethathaawe hulu bathaame yethathaalu.
yehe yatagalatzawe megebenaa yafalaa weha bamenedaawe qane masetanegedwacawe nawe.
'enaaneta sawoce 'enyaa 'enaanetane kaalenabaraacehubate botaa fatharenaacehu. baxwaalaa heyaawe 'aderegane 'enedamenemalesaacehu 'ataamenumene?
lamahonu ('enaaneta sawoce) babaalabeetocaacehu maahetzane wesethe yametaafasutene yazare fasaashe tamalakataacehune?!
lamahonu yehenene yazare fasaashe 'enaaneta naacehu yametefatherute wayenese 'enyaa?
motene banaaneta laaye wasanene, bamahonume la'eyaanedaanedaacehu wadafiteme wadaxwaalaame yamaataalefubatene yatawasana gizee 'adereganaale. 'enyaa meneme yamiyaaqetane nagare yalame.
kaalaacehubate 'afathaathare qeretze maqayare 'enedihume 'enaanetane bamaataawequte qeretzenaa 'afathaathare mafethare 'ayaaqetaneme ('ayesaananeme).

ba'eregetheme 'enaanetane bamajamariyaa 'enedeete 'enedafatharenaacehu taawequtaalaacehu. bamahonume majamariyaa 'enedafatharaacehu hulu 'enedaganaa heyaawe 'aderego maqaseqase 'enedamicele 'ateganazabumene?!
lamahonu mareete laaye yametezarutene zare 'ayetaacexwaalene?
lamahonu yehenene zare yametaabaqelute 'enaaneta naacehu wayese 'enyaa?
yehene yabaqalawene 'azere`ete kabasalanaa kadarasa baxwaalaa masabaabarene kafalagene yatasabaabara 'azemaraa 'enaadaregawaalane. baziheme gizee 'enaaneta bahuneetaawe tegaramaalaacehu.
yaawathaanawene bamaathaate taqachiwoceme naneme telaalaacehu.
yelequnese 'enyaa sisaaye 'enedaanaaganye takalekelanaale.
lamahonu setethamu yametethathutene weha 'ayaacehune?
lamahonu kasamaaye damanaa yaawaradaacehute 'enaaneta naacehu wayese 'enyaa?

'enyaa yehenene weha sawoce lamathathe lamaathathaate 'enedaayethaqamubate chawaamaa maaderagene benefalege chawaamaa 'enaadaregawaalane. bamahonume ba'ezenate thaafaache yahonane weha bamaaweradu 'alaahene 'ataamasagenumene?
lamahonu lamathaqaaqamiyaa yametaaqathaathelwatene 'esaate 'ayaacehune?
lamahonu yametaaqathaathelubaatene zaafe yafatharaacexwaate 'enaaneta naacehu wayese 'enyaa?
'enyaa yehecene 'esaate ya'akxiraane 'esaate yametaasetaawesaacehu 'enaa lamanegadanyoce mathaqaaqamiyaa 'adaragenaate.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yataalaaqune geetaahene seme bamaanesaate kamaayegabu baaheriyaate 'atheraawe ('aleqawe).
'alaahe bawaakebetoce maarafiyaa botaa yemelaale.
bawesethu kaalawe gadabe yalashe ya'alaahe meleketocenaa mekere 'akwaayaa yanazihene yakawaakebetoce maarafiyaa taalaaqenate betaawequ noro limaalebate yamigabaa teleqe botaa mahonune taawequ nabare.
ba'enaaneta laaye yaminababawe qure'aane bawesethu bezu thaqaami yahonu male'eketoce yaaqafa bamahonu yatakabara qure'aane nawe.
kasawoce `aayene yatathabaqa matsehhafe wesethe nawe. 'eresume lawehhale maafuze (thebeqe matsehhafe) nawe.
kahathi'atenaa kagudelate yatharu malaa'ekete 'eneji maaneme 'ayenakaaweme.
ka`aalamaatu yafethuraane hulu geetaa kahonawe bamale'eketanyaawe muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) laaye yawarada nawe.
lamahonu 'enaaneta 'agaariwoce bazihe qure'aane 'ataamenume taasetabaabelaalaacehune?

'alaahe yasathaacehune tzagaa bamaamasegane fanetaa taasetabaabelaalaacehu? zenaabene wada kawaakebete taasethagaalaacehu?! 'enyaa 'ekalite kokabe bamawathaatwa mekeneyaate zenaabe 'aganyane telaalaacehu?!

kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase manorune yamiyaaseradu wesene maaserajaawocene kathaqasa baxwaalaa motene makalaakale 'aqeme 'enedaleelaacawe bamatheqase daageme maqaseqase 'enedamicele siyaaseganazebe: yagadala 'akaale maleso heyaawe maaderage 'enedamaayesaanawe siyaaragaagethe:
lamahonu nafeseme guroro laaye setedarese.
'enaaneta bazaane gizee mote 'afaafe yadarasawene sawe kafite lafitaacehu taayutaalaacehu.
nagare gene 'enyaa ba`eweqataacene, bacelotaacenenaa bamalaa'eketocaacene ka'enaaneta yebalethe wada mwacu yaqarabene nane. yehune 'eneji 'enaaneta 'enazihene malaa'eketoce maayate 'atecelume.
'enyaa kamotene baxwaalaa 'aneqasaqaseme, 'enedihume baszeraawocaaceneme 'anemanadaame yametelu kahona;
'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu kamwacu yametewathaawene nafese wada nabaracebate maleswate! honome gene 'atecelume.
mwacu bamalekaame szeraawocenaa ba'emenate kaqadametocu kahona (yaqerebe baalamwale kahona):
la'esu meneme dekaame yaleelabate 'erafete, malekaame sisaayenaa 'ezenate yaalabatenaa yafalagutene tzagaa hulu yamiyaaganyubate janate 'alalaacawe.
mwace kanaziyaa yaszeraa mazegabaacawe baqanye kamisathaacawe yaqanye gwaadoce kahona banasu gudaaye laaye 'atechanaqe 'enasu kaqethaate salaame yamihonunaa maragaagaatene yamiyaaganyu naacawe.
mwacu male'eketanyaawe (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yaamathutene yaasetabaabalanaa katekekelanyaawe manegade yathamama sawe kahona;
'aqabaabale yamidaragelate masetanegedo 'ejege yafalaa weha nawe.
bajahaname 'esaate yeqaathalaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehe yatarakenelehe hulu meneme therethere yaleelawe 'eregethanyaa yahona 'ewenate nawe.
yataalaaqune geetaahene seme 'atheraa, 'enedihume kagodalo baaheriyaate 'atsedaawe.
basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalu fethuraane hulu 'alaahene kamaayegabu baaheriyaate 'atharu ('alaaqu). 'esu 'ashanaafi hono maaneme 'ayaashanefaweme, bamafetharenaa bamawasane thebabanyaa nawe.

yasamaayaatenaa yamedere negeszenaanaa selethaane yasu becaa nawe. hheyaawe maaderage yafalagawene hheyaawe yaadaregaale. 'enedihume magedale yafalagawene yegadelaale. 'esu huluneme nagare caaye nawe. meneme 'ayaaqetaweme.

'esu yamajamariyaawe nawe; ka'esu bafite meneme nagare yalame. 'esu yamacharashaa nawe; kasu baxwaalaa meneme nagare 'ayenoreme. 'esu geletze nawe; kasu balaaye meneme nagare yalame. 'esu sewere nawe; ka'esu weche meneme nagare yalame. 'esu huluneme nagare `aawaaqi nawe. meneme 'ayaamalethaweme.

'esu samaayaatenaa mederene ka'ehude bamajamare jume`aa laaye bamacharase basedesete qanaate fatharaacawe. 'esu kazihe baanasa gizee wesethe mafethare yecelaale. kazaa baxwaalaa la'esu 'enedamigabaawe ka`areshe balaaye hona, kafe 'ala wada medere yamigabaawene hulu 'enedazenaabe, feree, wazata, kaswa yamiwathaawene hulu ('azere'ete, maa`edenaate wazata., kasamaaye yamiwaradawene) 'eneda zenaabe, raa`eye wazata., wada samaaye yamiyaaregawene ('eneda malaa'ekete, manefase, szeraawoce wazata.) bamulu yaaweqaale. batachamaarime yateme botaa betehonu ba`eweqatu kanaaneta gaare nawe. meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. 'alaahe 'enaaneta yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe. kaszeraawocaacehu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. 'enedayaszeraawocaacehume yemanadaacexwaale.
yasamaayaatenaa yamedere negeszenaanaa selethaane yasu becaa nawe. nagaroce hulu wada 'esu yemalasaalu. fethuraanene hulu bamagamegame 'enedayaszeraawocaacawe yemanadaacawaale.

lalitene baqane wesethe bamaasegabaate chalamaane yaamathaale sawoceme yetanyaalu. 'enedihume qanene balalite wesethe bamaasegabaate berehaanene bamaawethaate sawoce wada yaszeraawocaacawe yeneqasaaqasaalu. 'esu babaarocu lebe wesethe yaalawene hulu yaaweqaale. meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.

ba'alaahe 'emanu, bamale'eketanyaaweme 'emanu 'alaahe meteke kaadaragaacehume ganezabe laaye 'awethu. 'enedihume 'esu bafaqadalaacehu laaye 'awethu. ka'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanu ganezabocaacawene ba'alaahe manegade yaawathu taalaaqe menedaa 'alaahe zanede 'alaacawe. yaame janate nawe.

bageetaacehu 'alaahe 'enedetaamenu male'eketanyaawe 'eyatharaacehu ba'alaahe 'enedaataamenu yaagadaacehu menedene nawe? 'abaataacehu 'adame jarebaa banabaraacehu gizee baregetheme qaale-kidaane yezobaacexwaale 'ewenatanyaa 'amaanyoce kahonaacehu 'emanu.

'esu babaariyaawe (muhhamade /salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) laaye geletze yahonu 'aneqatzocene kakehedatenaa maayemenate wada 'emenatenaa `eweqate berehaane yaawathaacehu zanede 'aweredwale. 'alaahe la'enaaneta wada qanaawe manegade yamimaraacehu male'eketanyaa malaaku rexeruxe 'azaanye nawe.

samaayaatenaa medere ya'alaahe honawe saala ba'esu manegade laaye ganezabe 'enedaataawathu mene 'agadaacehu?! 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! makaa kamakafatu bafite ganezabocaacawene ba'alaahe manegade laaye ya'alaahene wedeetaa bamafalage yaawathunaa selaamene lamaredaate silu kahadiyaanene yatawaagu 'ekule 'ayedalume. yelequnese 'enazihe kamakaa makafate bafite wachi kaawathunaa ba'alaahe manegade laaye yatawaagute: kanaziyaa kamakaa makafate baxwaalaa yamathute, ganezabocaacawene ba'alaahe manegade laaye yaawathu 'enaa kahadiyaanene katawaagute yeleqe 'alaahe zanede teleqe botaanaa teleqe darajaa yabalatha 'alaacawe. hulatume 'ekule 'ayedalume. yehunenaa 'alaahe hulatuneme janate 'enedamiyaasegabaacawe qaale gabetwale. 'alaahe 'enaaneta yameteszarutene szeraa hulu bazerezere yaaweqawaale meneme 'ayedabaqebateme 'enedayaszeraawocaacehu yemanadaacaxwaale.

maane nawe 'esu ganezabune dase 'eyaalawenaa ya'alaahene fite falego yamiyaawathaa? bamaawethaatume mekeneyaate 'alaahe 'ethefe derebe bamaaderage batenesaa'eewe qane malekaame menedaa yamikafelawe?! 'esume janate nawe.

'alaahe yame'emanaanene huneetaa kagalatza baxwaalaa bazaanu qane yamanaafeqaane huneetaa mene 'enedamimasele sigaletze:
wanede manaafeqaanenaa seete manaafeqaate ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanutene sawoce siraathune (deledeyune) lamashaagare yeradaane zanede kaberehaanaacehu 'enedenewasede thabequne yelwacawaale. lamanaafeqaaneme bamaashofenaa bamasaalaqe wadaxwaalaacehu tamalesaacehu yametaabarubatene berehaanaacehune falegu yebaalaalu. baziheme gizee bamakaakalaacawe 'athere yedaragaale; 'atherume bare yaalawe nawe; wesethu ba'amaanyoce bakule 'ezenate sihone wechu bamanaafeqaane bakule yaalawe dagemo qethaate nawe.

'enyaa baselaamenaa 'alaahene bamataazaze laaye kanaaneta gaare 'alenabarenemene? bamaalate manaafeqaane me'emanaanene yetharaalu. 'awo kanyaa gaare nabaraacehu. nagare gene raasaacehune bamafatane nefeqenaa wesethe gabetaacehu nafesaacehune 'athafaacehu. batachamaarime bame'emanaane laaye 'ashanaafinaa yabalaaye 'enehonaalane belaacehu setethabaabaqu nabare. 'enedihume me'emanaane dele 'enedamaayaaganyunaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene batamalakata batherethaaree laaye nabaraacehu. yaweshate menyoteme 'ataalalaacehu. baziheme huneetaa laaye honaacehu mote mathaabaacehu shayethwaneme 'ataalalaacehu.

lamahonu ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanu me'emanaane 'alaahene bamaawesaatenaa bamaasetaawaseme 'eregaataane lamaagenyate 'enedihume baqure'aane wesethe bawaradawe beseraateme hona zaacaa lebocaacawe lamalaselase (lamalazabe) 'aleqarabamene? bamakaakalaacawe nabiyaate baalamamethaate sirazemebaacawe lebocaacawe bazihe mekeneyaate 'enedadaraqabaacawe yehudoce (taweraate yatasathaacawe) 'enaa keresetiyaanoce (nejile yatasathaacawe) 'enedaayehonu yethaneqaqu. ka'enasu bezuwocu ka'alaahe te'ezaaze yawathu 'amaatziyaane naacawe.

'alaahe mederene kadaraqace baxwaalaa ba'azere`ete hheyaawe 'enedamiyaadarege 'ewaqu. ya'alaahene caayenatenenaa becanyaa tamalaakinatene taawequ zanede yatalayaayu meleketocenenaa maaserajaawocene bamaamethaate galatzenelaacehu. batachamaarime mederene kamotace baxwaalaa hheyaawe yaadaragaate geetaa; 'enaanetane kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase caaye nawe. yadaraqawene lebocaacehuneme maalaselase yecelaale.

kaganezabocaacawe metzewaatene yamiyaawathu wanedocenaa seetoce siyaawathume nafesocaacawe dase 'eyaalaacawe saayematzaadaqunaa sawene saayegodu yamiyaawathu menedaacawe 'ethefe sihone yeheme 'anedene malekaame szeraa ba'asere 'eseka sabaate matonaa kazaa balaaye bamaaderage yemanadaacawaale. kaziheme gaare malekaamenaa barekaataa menedaa 'alaahe zanede 'alalaacawe: 'eresume janate nawe.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanunaa bamakaakalaacawe saayelayaayu ('anedaacaweneme saayelayu) bamale'eketanyoce yaamanu: 'enasu ba'eregethe ba'ewenate yaamanunaa geetaacawe zanede ba'ewenate yamasakaru naacawe. bamahonume yatazagaaja malekaame menedaa 'alaacawe. batenesaa'eewe qane kafite lafitaacawenaa baqanyocaacawe yamigwaaze berehaane 'alalaacawe. ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce yakaadu 'enedihume male'eketanyocene laaye yaawaradenawene 'aneqatzoce yaasetabaabaalu 'enasu ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe. batenesaa'eewe qane lazalaalame nawaariwoce sihonu 'esaate wesethe gabiwoce naacawe, ka'esume 'ayewathume.

yazicene yaqerebitune hheyewate nuro chawaataa, lebene yamiyaazanaagaa, yameteshalaalamubaate geethaageethe, bamakaakalaacehu bahabetenaa baneberate 'enedihume baselethaane mafokaakariyaa, baganezabenaa lejoce bezaate makuraariyaa yahonace heyewate naate. yaduneyaa mesaaleeme kasamaaye zenaabe waredo 'aze`eretu gabareewocene 'enedaasegarama 'azemaraa nawe. yehe 'aranegwaadeeyaamaa 'azere`ete bezume saayeqoye yedareqaale. ka'aranegwaadeenate wada daalacaa maleke qathelome dareqonaa tasabaabero taayaalahe ('aneta tamalekaace hoye!) bamahonume batenesaa'eeweme qane lakahadiyaanenaa lamanaafeqaane kabaade qethaate 'enaa ka'alaahe yahona meheratenaa ya'alaahe wedeetaa lame'emanaane tazagaajetwale. yaqerebitu heyewate tzenaate yaleelaate thafi heyewate 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaceme. bamahonwame thafinaa tawagaaje yahonacewene hheyewate kamacharashaayetu hheyewate tzagaa yaaseqadama (yaasebalatha) kakasaariwoce nawe.

yageetaacehune maaretaanaa malekaame menedaa wada metaaganyubate malekaame szeraanaa sefaatwa yasamaayenaa yamedere yaahele sefaate wadaalaate janate tashaqadaadamu. yehece janate ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce lamiyaamenu me'emanaane yatazagaajace naate. yehe menedaa ya'alaahe terufaate sihone kabaarocu lafalagawe yesathaale. mekeneyaatume 'alaahe yateleqe terufaate baalabeete nawenaa.

maanenyaaweme nagare medere laayeme yehune banafesocaacehu laaye yamiyaagaamaathecehu cegere (dereqe, rahabe wazata.) lawehhale maahefuze (batathabaqawe mazegabe) wesethe fetherataatene kamafetharaacene bafite saferwale. yehe nagare 'alaahe zanede qalaale nawe.

yeheme yahonawe 'enaaneta sawoce hoye! selaamalathaacehu nagare 'enedaataazenunaa basathaacehume nagare yakuraatene dasetaa 'enedaatedasatu nawe. 'alaahe 'eresu basathawe tzagaa basawe laaye yamikoraanaa yaminethabaararene 'ayewademe.

maawethaate gedeetaa yahonabaacawene metzewaate yamaayaawathu nefugoce kaziheme 'alefawe leelaawene nefuge 'enedihone yamiyaazu kasaariwoce naacawe. 'enaho ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yamiwathaa nafesune 'eneji 'alaahene 'ayegodaame. 'alaahe kabaarocu yatabeqaaqaa (habetaame) yabaarocu taazaazhenate yamaayaasefalegawe nawe. bayatenyaaweme huneetaa mesegune nawe.

male'eketanyocaacene baregetheme geletze bahonu maaserajaawoce lekanaacawaale. ka'enasu gaareme matsaahhefetenenaa mizaanene (mizaanaawinatene) bamaawerade sawoce bafetehe 'enediqomu 'azazenaacawe. berateneme thanekaaraa sihone 'awaradene. kazihe berateme yatalayaayu masaariyaawocenaa yatalayaayu yamagalegayaa masaariyaawocene 'enedithaqamubate. baziheme mekeneyaate kabaarocu haayemaanotunenaa male'eketanyocene baruqe yamiradaane labaarocu 'eweqatune geletze bamaaderage 'enediyaawequ selafalaga nawe. 'alaahe thanekaaraanaa 'ashanaafi nawe. maaneme 'ayaashanefaweme meneme 'ayaaqetaweme.

baregetheme nuhhenenaa beraahimene (`aalayehi salaame) male'eketanyoce 'aderegane laakene. ka'enasu zaroceme nabiyenatene 'adaragene. kitaabeme 'awaradene, ka'enasu (kaberaahimenaa nuhhe) bihone 'eneji; 'anedeme nabiye 'aletalaakame. 'enedihume banasu lejoce laaye yaawarada bihone 'eneji; 'anedeme matsehhafe 'alaawaradame. kazereyaawocaacawe makaakale qathetanyaawe manegade yatamaraa 'ala. ka'enasume bezuwocu ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yawathu (yaafanagathu) naacawe.

kazaa baxwaalaa male'eketanyocaacenene 'asekatalene wada hhezebocaacaweme 'akataatelane laakene. `isaa yamareyamene leje 'asekatelane bamalaake nejilene sathanawe. ba'esu yaamanutenaa yatakatalute lebe wesethe reheraaheenaa 'ezenatene 'adaragene. bamakaakalaacaweme yamiwaadadunaa yamitaazazu nabaru. ba'emenataacawe laaye wasane bamaalafe 'adise fatharaane bamafatzame 'alaahe yafaqadalaacawene 'anedaanede 'eneda gaabecaanenaa thaafaache nagaroce tawe. 'enyaa 'enasu yehenene 'enediyaadaregu 'alaazazeneme. yelequnese raasaacawe baraasaacawe laaye gedeetaa bamaaderage ba'emenataacawe laaye yaleelane nagare fatharu. 'enyaa yaazazenaacawe nagare binore ya'alaahene wedeetaa 'enedifalegu nabare. nagare gene 'aleszarubateme. ka'enasu yaamanutene sawoce menedaacawene sathanaacawe. bezuwocu ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yaamathaalaacawene male`ekete bamaasetabaabale ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yawathu naacawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe 'amenaacehunaa badenegaageewe yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! yasune te`ezaaze bamafatsame yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene feru. banabiyu muhhamadenaa baalafute male'eketanyoce bamaamanaacehu hulate menedaa yesathaacaxwaale. 'enedihume baduneyaa heyewataacehu yametemarubatene batenesaa'eewe qane siraathene (deledeye) yameteshagaagarubate berehaane bamaaderagenaa hathi'ataacehune yemeraacaxwaale. 'alaahe labaarocu yateleqe terufaate baalabeete nawe. bamahonume yasune terufaate magadabeme, maquthareme 'ayecaaleme.

teleqe terufaataacenene bamagelatze taalaaqenaa 'ethefe menedaa yamenesathaacehu yamatsehhafe sawoce (yehudocenaa naswaraawoce) ka'alaahe terufaate 'enasu yafalagutene masethatenaa yamaayefalegutene makalekale yamaayecelu mahonune 'enaa terefaatune kabaarocu lafalagawe bamasethate ba'alaahe 'eje mahonune 'enediyaawequ nawe. 'alaahe yateleqe tzagaa baalabeete nawe.

'enaziyaa baalabeetocaacawene 'aneci 'eneda 'enaatee jarebaa hunyebenye (nashe) bamaalate yaminaagaru sawoce 'enedihe maalataacawe weshataamoce naacawe. mekeneyaatume baalabeetocaacawe 'enaatocaacawe 'ayedalumenaa. 'enaatocaacawe yawaladwacawe naacawe. yehenene negegere baminaagarubate gizee 'aseqayaaminaa weshate tanaagaru. 'alaahe yeqere baayenaa mahari nawe. kahathi'atocaacawe yamitharubatene maakaakaashaa kaasaa danagagalaacawe.

yehenene 'aseqayaami negegere yaminaagaru sawoce kazihe baxwaalaa kabaalabeetocaacawe gaare yagebera segaa genenyunate maaderagene kafalagu kamaaderagaacawe bafite lathefaataacawe qethaatenaa kaasaa gebera-segaa genenyunate kamaaderagaacawe bafite 'aneditene baariyaa natzaa maawethaate 'alabaacawe. yehe 'enedetefatzemute yatawasanawe ya'alaahe wesaanee ('eneda 'enaateenashe) wada milawe qaale daageme 'enedaatemalasu maasethaneqaqiyaa 'enedihone nawe. 'alaahe yameteszarutene theleqe `aawaaqinaa ka'eresume meneme 'ayedabaqeme.

natzaa yamiyaawathaate baariyaa kaalaaganya ('eneda 'enaatee jarebaa nashe (hunyebinye belo)kaalaate)baalabeetu gaare yagebera segaa genenyunate kamafatzamu bafite; hulate ware batakataataaye tzome yetsume. yehenene kaalecaala sedesaa dehocene yemagebe. yehenene denegaagee yadanagagenawe ba'alaahe 'amenaacehu te'ezaazune 'enedetefatsemu naa male'etanyaawune 'enedetekatalu zanede nawe. 'enazihe hegoce ya'alaahe wasane sihonu labaarocu yadanagagaacawe naacawenaa wasane 'enedaataalefu. ya'alaahene hegegaatenaa wesaanee lakaadu hulu 'asaamaami yahona qethaate 'alalaacawe.

'enaziyaa 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene yamitzaararu kazihe bafite yanabaru hhezeboce 'enedatawaaradute hulu 'enaziheme tawaaradu baregetheme geletze yahona 'aneqatzocene 'awaradene. 'alaahene, 'aneqatzocunenaa male'eketanyocune yakaadute 'awaaraaje qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! me'emanaanene baayu gizee yamimasaatharutene yehudoce 'atemalakatemene? 'alaahe mamasaatharene kalakalaacawe. honome gene 'enasu 'alaahe wada kalakaalaacawe bamamalase muselimocene maamaatenenaa maatheqaatene 'enedihume male'eketanyaawe laaye maamatzene yamasaasalu wanejale 'azale misetherocene yemasaatharaalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! wada 'anetane bamamethaateme 'alaahe 'aneta salaame belohe bamaayaaweqawe salaametaa "'asaamu `alayeke" maalateme mote baaneta laaye yehune bamaalate szalaametaa yaaqarebulehale. nabiyeneme (salalaahu `alayehi wasalameneme) bamaasetabaabale "banegegeraacene 'alaahe 'ayeqathaaneme nabare. 'enediyaawe nabiye nanye sile 'ewenatanyaa bihone noro batanaagarenawe negegere saabiyaa 'alaahe yeqathaane nabare" yelaalu. selatanaagaruteme negegere yajahaname 'esaate qethaate baqiyaacawe naate. qaathalowaaneme yeqamesaalu. mamalashaacaweme menenyaa yakafaa mamalashaa nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa bahegegaate yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! bamakaakalaacehu bahathi'ate, wasane bamaalafenaa male'eketanyaawene bamaamatze laaye 'enedaatemasaatharunaa leke 'enedayehudoce 'enedaatehonu. ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamaakebarenaa ba'eresu laaye kamaamatze bamataaqabe gudaaye laaye tamakaakaru. yasune te`ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene feru. batenesaa'eewe qane lamagamegamenaa lamamanedaate wada 'esu becaa tesabaasabaalaacehu.

'alaahe (subehahhanahu wata`aalaa) yanegegere szena-szere`aatocene kagalatza baxwaalaa basawoce masabesabiyaa botaawoce laaye linore yamigabaawene szena-szere`aate sigaletze:
'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa ba`e!hegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! bamaqamaamachaa botaawoce laaye bamathagaagaate tasefaafu katabaalaacehu 'asefaafu, 'alaahe baduneyaanaa ba'akxiraa yaasafaalaacexwaale. 'anedaanede taalaalaaqe sawoce 'enediqamathubate tanasu batabaalaacehume gizee tanasu. 'alaahe kanaaneta 'amaanye yahonutenenaa ya`eweqate baalabeetocene yalaaqa darajaawoce laaye kafe yaadaregaacawaalenaa. 'alaahe 'enaaneta yameteszarutene hulu bazerezere `aawaaqi nawe. kaszeraawocaacehu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. baszeraacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

sahhaaboce ka male'eketanyaawe gaare mamasaathare baabazu gizee 'alwahe 'enedihe 'alaacawe; 'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa bahegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! kamale'eketanyaawe gaare bamisethere maaweraate kafalagaacehu kamaaweraataacehu bafite metzetsewaatene sethu. metzewaate masethataacehu lanaaneta malekaamenaa lahathi'ataacehu maatheriyaa nawe. 'alaahene bamataazazaacehu lebaacehu yetharaalenaa. yametaawathute metzewaate kaleelaacehu meneme cegere yalaweme. 'alaahe yabaariyaawocune wanejale mahari 'enaa lafethuraanume 'azaanye bamahonu yamicelutene yaahele 'eneji 'ayaasegadedeme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! manaafeqaane 'enaziyaane 'alaahe bakehedataacenaa bahathi'ataacawe mekeneyaate yataqothaabaacawene yehudoce wadaaje 'aderegawe siyezu 'ataayemene? manaafeqaane kanaanetame ka'amaanyoceme kayehudoceme 'ayedalume. kanaziheme kanaziyaame saayehonu walaawaaye naacawe. 'enazihe manaafeqaane weshate mahonune 'eyaawaqu 'enyaa yamuselimocene misethere wada yehudoce 'alaasetalaalafeneme bamaalate baweshate yemelaalu.

yataacenyaawe ('azaqete) ya'esaate kefele bamaasegabaate kabaade yahona qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale. 'enasu baduneyaa `aalame wesethe banabarubate gizee yeszarute yanabarawe szeraa menenyaa yakafaa nawe.

bakehedate mekeneyaate 'enedaayegadalu mahalaawocaacawene makalaakayaa 'aderegawe yaazu; ganezabocaacawenaa damaacawe 'enedithabaqe 'eselemenaane geletze 'adaragu. muselimocene bamaadaakamenaa 'enedizanaagu bamaaderage bamifatzemwacawe deregitoce sawoce 'ewenatene 'enedaayeqabalu 'agadu. baziheme mekeneyaate 'awaaraaje yahona qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale.
ganezabaacawenaa lejocaacawe meneme 'ayethaqemwacaweme. 'enaziyaa sawoce ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe. 'esaate wesetheme yaalamaaqwaarathe lazalaalame 'ezaawe bamaqoyate yeqathaalu.

'athaqaalaaye huluneme 'anedeme saayaaseqare lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa yeqaseqesaacawaale. 'enyaa bakehedatenaa banefeqenaa laaye 'alenabareneme 'amaanyoce honane 'alaahene yamiyaasewadede szeraa 'eneszaraa nabare bamaalate la'alaahe yemelulataale. la'enaaneta la'amaanyoce baduneyaa `aalame 'enyaa muselimoce nane bamaalate simelulaacehu 'enedanabaru hulu la'alaaheme yemelulataale. bazihe mahalaacawe theqemene bamaagenyatenaa kagudaate yamidenu yemaselaacawaale. 'enasu baduneyaame ba'akxiraame bamimelute nagare weshataamoce naacawe.

shayethwane bagutegotaawe 'alaahene 'enedirasu bamaaderage balaayaacawe laaye tashomabaacawe. 'alaahene yamiyaaseqothaa 'eneji 'alaahene yamiyaasewadede (yamiyaasedasete) nagare 'aleszarume. bazihe maleku yatagalatzute 'akaalaate hulu yashayethwane wadaajocenaa takataayoce naacawe. nequ! yashayethwane wadaajocenaa takataayoce yaqenaacaa (yaqathetanyaa) manegadene tetawe yathemeetene manegade 'enedihume yajanatene manegade tetawe ya'esaate manegadene bamakatalaacawe baduneyaame ba'akxeeraame kasaariwoce naacawe.
'enaziyaa ya'alaahe 'enaa yamale'eketanyaawe thalaatoce 'alaahe baduneyaanaa ba'akxiraa kaawaaradaacawe kahadiyaane sebesebe wesethe naacawe.

'alaahe ba`eweqatu 'eneenaa male'eketanyocee bathalaatocaacene laaye bamaaserajaanaa baxaayele 'ashanaafiwoce nane yamile wesaanee 'asaalefwale. 'alaahe male'eketanyocene bamaredaate thanekaaraa 'enaa thalaatocune bamabaqale 'ashanaafi nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ba'alaahenaa batenesaa'eewe qane yamiyaamenu honawe ya'alaahenaa yamale'eketanyaawene thalaate siwadaaju fetsume 'ataaganyeme. 'enazihe ya'alaahenaa yamale'eketanyaawe thalaatoce meneme 'enekwaa walaajocaacawe, wayeme lejocaacawe wayeme wanedemocaacawe wayeme yamitharubaacawe gosaawocaacawe bihonume wadaaje 'aderegawe 'ayezwacaweme. yeheme yahonabate ya'emenate tesesere kamaanenyaaweme tesesere yabalathanaa yalaaqa bamahonu nawe. bamahonume ya'emenatenaa yaleelaawe tesesere kaaletathaathaamu ya'emenate tesesere qedemiyaa yesathawaale. 'enaziyaa ya'alaahenaa yamale'eketanyaawene thalaatocene meneme 'enekwaa zamadocaacawe bihonume 'enekwaa yamaayewadaajute 'alaahe balebaacawe wesethe yamaayeqayare 'emenatene yaatzanaalaacawenaa ka'eresu bahona berehaanenaa maaserajaa bathalaatocaacawe laaye yaabarataacawe naacawe. batenesaa'eeweme qane lazalaalame yaminorubatenaa tzagaawe yamaayeqwaarathebate, mote yamaayaaganyaacawe, kahenetzaawocunaa kazaafocu sere wanezoce yamifasubate yazalaalame janatene yaasegabaacawaale. fetsume thelaacaa yaleelabatene wedeetaa 'alaahe wadadaacawe. 'alaahene maayatene chamero yamaayaaleqene tzagaa selalagasaacaweme dasetanyoce naacawe. 'enazihe bazihe baaheri yatagalatzute 'amaanyoce ya'alaahene te'ezaazaate fatzaamiwoce 'enaa yakalakalaacaweneme yamirequ ya'alaahe szaraawitoce naacawe. nequ! ya'alaahe szaraawitoce baduneyaanaa ba'aakxiraa yamifalegutene bamaagenyatenaa kamifarute nagare bamathabaqe dele 'aderaagiwoce naacawe.

basamaayaatenaa bamedere laaye yaalu hulu la'alaahe kamaayegabute godalonaa nawere baaheriyaate 'alaahene 'atharu ('alaaqute). 'esu maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi 'enaa bamafethare, bahegegaatunaa bawesaaneewe hulu thebabanyaa nawe.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yakaadu yasune male'eketanyaa muhhamadene (salalaahu 'alayehi wasalame) yaasetabaabalute bani 'anenadirene kamanoriyaa hagaraacawe kamadinaa wada shaame lamajamariyaa gizee yaasewathaacawe 'esu nawe. 'enasume taweraate yatasathaacawe 'ayehudoce sihonu qaale kidaanaacawene baafarasunaa ka'agaariwoce gaare bahonu gizee 'asewathaacawe. 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! 'enazihe sawoce kaalaacawe thenekaareenaa xaayele yatanasaa kahagaraacawe yewathaalu yamile gemete 'alenabaraacehume. 'enasume yaganabute meshegaacawe ka'alaahe qethaate yamithabeqaacawe maselwacawe nabare. honome gene 'enasu baalethabaqutenaa baalaasabute manegade male'eketanyaawene 'enediwaagaacawenaa kahagare 'enediyaasewathaacawe bamaaderage 'alaahe qethaatune 'awaradabaacawe. kabaade ferehateneme lebocaacawe wesethe katatabaacawe. beetocaacawene muselimoce 'enedaayegalagalubate kawesethe bagazaa 'ejaacawe siyaawademu kaweche dagemo me'emanaane 'afaraarasute. bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate yawaradabaacawene qethaate 'asetawaaye lebonaa yaalaacehu tamakarubate. 'enaanetame 'enedanasu honaacehu yanasune `aayenate qethaate 'enedaateqathu tathaneqaqu.
kahagaraacawe mawethaatene baayewasanebaacawe noro; baduneyaa laaye, bagedeyaa 'enaa bamamaarake yeqathaacawe nabare. ba'akxiraa dagemo zalaalamaawi ya'esaate qethaate yethabeqaacawaale.

yehe nagare yahonawe bakehedataacawenaa qaale kidaane bamaaferase 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene bamatzaararaacawe nawe. bamahonume 'alaahene yamitzaarare ya'alaahe qethaate kabaade bamahonu qethaatune yaawaredebaataale.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! ba'bani nadire' zamacaa yaqorathaacehuteme hona lamathaqame falegaacehu saateqorethwacawe kanagenedaacawe yatawaacexwaacawe yatamere zaafoce ba'alaahe te`ezaaze nawe. yehudocu 'enedaasabute mederene kamaabalaashate 'ayeqothareme. yehene yaadaragawe 'enaziyaane qaale kidaane yaafarasu 'enedihume 'adaraane kamathabaqe yeleqe kehedatene yamarathu yehudocene lamaawaarade falego nawe.

yaa ka'bani nadire' tawasedo 'alaahe wada male'eketanyaawe yamalasawe neberate 'enaaneta 'esune lamaagenyate bafethenate faraseme hona gemaleme 'alegaalabaacehume. cegereme 'alaagaathamaacehume, nagare gene 'alaahe male'eketanyocene bafalagawe laaye yeshomaale. bamahonume 'alaahe male'eketanyaawene babani nadire laaye shomabaacawenaa kaalameneme thorenate hagarune badele kafata. 'alaahe huluneme nagare caaye nawe. meneme nagare 'ayesaanaweme.

'alaahe kakatamaa sawoce meneme saayewaagu lamale'eketanyaawe yasathawe neberate (ganezabe); ganezabu bamaszaratu ya'alaahe nawe. bamale'eketanyaaweme quthethere sere 'adaragawe. male'eketanyaaweme 'asefalaagi bahona botaa 'enediyaawathaame wakelotaale. bamahonume kabani hashimenaa banilemuthalibe lahonute zamadocu metzewaate 'enedaayeqabalu yatakalakalu bamahonu bazihe meteke kazihe 'alaahe kasathaacawe faye'e (yaalathorenate yatamaaraka neberate) yesathaacawaale, layatimoce ('abaataacawe bahetzaanenate gizee yamotubaacawe), ladehoce, ganezabaacawe laalaqabaacawe 'enegedaa manegadanyoce nawe. yeheme yatadaragawe dehoce tatetawe habetaamoce 'enedaayekafufalute nawe. 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! male'eketanyaawe kafaye'e (yaalathorenate yatamaaraka neberate) ganezabe yasathaacehune taqabalu, yakalakalaacehune nagare takalekalu; ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamaakebarenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene feru; 'alaahe qethaatu beretu nawe, qethaatuneme tathaneqaqu.

kaziheme ganezabe la'alaahe silu ba'alaahe manegade laaye ganezabaacawenaa lejocaacawene tetawe 'enediwathu yatagadadu dehoce sedatanyoce, 'alaahe malekaame sisaaye baduneyaa 'enaa ya'esune wedeetaa ba'akxeeraa 'enedisathaacawe tasefaa yamiyaadaregu, 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene ba'alaahe manegade laaye bamataagale yamiradu naacawe. banazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatzu ba'ewenate 'emenate laaye yatzanu sawoce naacawe.

'alaahe sedatanyocene kagalatzanaa kaawadasa baxwaalaa 'aneswaroceneme siyaawadese:
'enaziyaa kasedatanyocu bafite madinaa yasafaru 'aneswaroce, ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanu kamakaa wada 'enasu yatasadadutene yewadaalu. ba'alaahe manegade laaye yatasadadu sedatanyoce kafaye'e (kamereko ganezabe) batasathu gizee meqenyenateme hona thelaacaa ba'anesaaroce lebe laaye meneme nagare 'ayechaareme. meneme raasaacawe dehocenaa falaagiwoce bihonume 'enekwaa baduneyaa gudaaye karaasaacawe yeleqe sedatanyocene yaaseqademaalu. 'alaahe yanafesune segebegebenatene thabeqote ba'alaahe manegade laaye ganezabune yaawathaa 'enasu yafalagutene nagare bamaagenyatenaa kamifarute nagare yatathabaqu 'ashanaafiwocenaa `edelanyoce naacawe.

ka'enasu baxwaalaa yamathu 'eseka tenesaa'ee derase bamalekaame yatakatalwacawe geetaacene hoye maarane, ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe 'amenawe kanyaa bafite yaalafu wanedemocaaceneme maaraacawe, balebocaaceneme bamaaneme 'amaanye laaye thelaacaanenaa meqanyenatene 'ataaderege, 'aneta labaarocehe rexeruxe 'enaa 'azaanye nahe yelaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa lebaacawe wesethe kehedatene yadabaqu 'enaa bawechaawi gatzetaacawe 'emenatene geletze yaadaragu manaafeqaane yakehedate wanedemocaacawenenaa yatabarazawe taweraate takataaye yahonutene 'ayehudoce 'enyaa 'anaawaaredaacehume lathalaateme 'asaalefane 'anesathaacehumenaa kahagaraacehu 'enedaatewathu; muselimoceme yamiyaasewathwacehu kahona 'enyaa kanaaneta gaare bamasalafe 'aberane 'enewathaalane. kanaaneta gaare 'enedaanewathaa yamiyaagedanene maaneneme 'anetaazazeme. katawaagwaacehume 'eneradaacexwaalane. manaafeqaane kayehudoce gaare 'aberane 'enewathaalane, 'enedihume yamiwaagwaacehu kahona kanaaneta gaare honane 'enewaagaalane yaalute weshate mahonune 'alaahe yemasakeraale.

muselimoce biyaasewathwacawe ka'enasu gaare 'ayewathume. kamuselimoce gaare biwaagume 'ayeradwacawememe 'ayaagezwacawememe. biradwacaweme muselimocene faretawe yeshashaalu. bazihe gizeeme manaafeqaane radaate 'ayenoraacaweme. yelequnese 'alaahe yaawaaredaacawaale.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! 'ayehudocenaa manaafeqaane ka'alaahe yabalatha 'enaanetane bathaame yefaraalu. yeheme -'enaanetane bathaame maferaataacawenaa 'alaahene 'alamaferaataacawe yamaayeradunaa yamaayegabaacawe selahonu nawe. ba'ewenate yamigabaacawe bihone noro maferaate yamigabaacawe 'alaahene nabare. mekeneyaatume 'enaanetane ba'enasu laaye yashomaacehu 'esu bamahonu nawe.

'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! yehudocenaa manaafeqaane ba'anede laaye honawe 'ayewaagwaacehume; ba'athere yatakababace meshege wesethe wayeme dagemo kagedegedaa basetajarebaa kaalehona basetaqare 'ayewaagwaacehume. bathaame fari selahonu fite lafite liwaagwaacehu 'ayecelume. 'erese ba'eresaacawe baalabaacawe thalaatenate yatanasaa bawesethaacawe yaalawe thabe beretu nawe. hasaabaacawe wathe 'enedihume yathanakara 'anedenate yaalaacawe yemaseluhale. 'ewenataawe gene lebocaacawe yatalayaayu naacawe. yeheme malayaayatenaa thabaacawe yamaayaasebu selahonu nawe. yamiyaasebu bihonu noro 'ewenatene 'aweqawe yekatalu nabare. 'ewenatune 'ayeqaaranume nabare.

yayehudoce kehedatenaa ba'enasu laaye yadarasawe qethaate mesaaleewe ba'agaariwoce baqerebe gizee yadarasabaacawe qethaate `aayenate nawe. yeheme bamakaadaacawe mekeneyaate mathefonaa kefu yahona qethaate nawe yataqathute. babadere thorenate gizee yatagadalawe tagadala, yatamaarakawe tamaaraka. kazihe batachamaari bamacharashaawe `aalameme 'asaamaami yahona qethaate 'alabaacawe.

yehudoce munaafiqocene mataazazaacawe mesaaleewe shayethwane lasawe leje kehedatene theru 'aderego yeshalemelataalenaa baziheme gizee saweyeewe geetaawene yekedaale. shayethwaneme bamakaadehe mekeneyaate 'enee kaaneta yatharaahu nanye. 'enee ya`aalamaatune geetaa 'efaraalahu 'enedaalawe nawe.

yashayethwanenaa shayethwanene yataazazu ('azaazhu shayethwane taazaazhu dagemo yasawe leje) batenesaa'eewe qane macharashaacawe 'esaate naate. 'esaate wesetheme lazalaalame zawetaari naacawe. yehe menedaa raasaacawene ya'alaahene wasane bamatalaalafe yabadalu sawoce yamithabeqaacawe menedaa nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu 'enaa bahegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! ya'esune te`ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene feru. maanenyaawaame nafese lanagawe yatenesaa'ee qane yaasaalafacewene malekaame szeraane bamaasetawaale temalekate. 'alaahene feru! 'alaahe 'enaaneta yameteszarutene hulu bazerezere `aawaaqi nawe. kaszeraawocaacehu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. baszeraacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

'eneda 'enaziyaa ya'alaahene te`ezaaze kamafatzamenaa kelekelune kamakalekale 'alaahene 'enedarasute sawoce 'atehunu. 'alaahene bamaresaataacaweme mekeneyaate nafesaacawene 'aserasaacawe. bamahonume ka'alaahe quthaa 'enaa qethaate yamiyaadenaacawene szeraa 'aleszarume. 'enaziyaa 'alaahene yarasunaa te`ezaazune yamaayefatzemu 'enedihume yakalakalawene yamaayekalakalu ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yawathu (faasiqoce) naacawe.

ya'esaate gwaadocenaa yajanate gwaadoce 'ekule 'ayedalume; yelequnese baduneyaa szeraacawe yatalayaaya 'enedahona hulu ba'akxiraame bamenedaacawe yatalayaayu naacawe. yajanate gwaadoce (baalabeetoce) yamifalegutene bamaagenyatenaa kamifarute nagare bamathabaqe `edelanyoce naacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehenene qure'aane bataraaraa laaye benaawaredawe noro thanekaaraanaa daraqe kamahonu gaare 'alaahene 'ejege kamaferaatu yatanasaa 'enedihume bawesethu kayaazawe mekerenaa kabaade zaacaa 'akwaayaa sisanathaathaqe taayawe nabare. yasawe lejoce bamekeru yegasatzubatenaa yemakarubate zanede 'enazihene mesaaleewoce 'adaragenelaacawe.

'alaahe ba'ewenate ka'eresu basetaqare 'amelekote yamigabaawe yalame. yaruquneme yaqerebuneme `aawaaqi ka'esu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. baduneyaanaa ba'akxiraa reheruhenaa 'azaanye; 'ezenatu la`aalamaatu hulu yadarasanaa yasafaa, taalaaqe geetaa nawe.

'alaahe ba'ewenate ka'eresu basetaqare 'amelekote yamigabaawe yalame. kahulume `aayenate gudelatoce yatharaa (gudelate wada 'eresu yamaayeqarebe yahona), kahulu `aayenate nawere yaraaqa male'eketanyocune ba'asedamaami ta'ameraatoce 'ewenatanyaanataacawene yaaragaagatha, yasawe lejocene tagebaare yamimalakate yataqadasa negusze nawe. 'alaahe 'anedeme yamiyaashanefawe yaleela 'ashanaafi nawe; huluneme baxaayaalenatu yaanebarakaka xaayaale nawe. thaa`otaawiyaane bathaa`otaate 'amelekotenaa baleeloce tagebaaraatoce ba'eresu laaye kamiyaadaregute ya'amelekote maagaaraate yatharaa, yalaaqa, yataqadasa nawe.

'alaahe yahulume fethuraane fathaari, nagaraatocene yaaseganya, fethuraanene bamifalegawe yamiqaretsetze malekaamenaa webe yahonu yalaaqu baaheriyaatoce 'alute. basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu 'alaahene kamaayegabu godalo baaheriyaate yaatharutaale. 'ashanaafi maaneme liyaashanefawe yamaayecele, bamafethare, bamadanegagenaa bamawasane thebabanyaa nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa bahegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! yaneene 'enaa ya'enaanetane thalaatoce yametewadwacawenaa yameteradwacawe wadaaje 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazwacawe. bamale'eketanyaawe 'eje yamathaalaacehune haayemaanote baregetheme kedawaale. 'enaanetanenaa ya'alaahe male'eketanyaane kahagaraacehu makaa yaasewathwacexwaale. zemedenaacehune 'ayethabequme. yehene yamiyaadaregute laleelaa saayehone 'enaaneta ba'alaahe bageetaacehu bamaamanaacehu becaa nawe. bamahonume banee manegade laaye lamataagalenaa yaneene wedeetaa falegaacehu kahona yawathaacehute 'enasune wadaaje 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazu. 'enasune bamawedade yamuselimocene misethere 'atenegarwacawe. 'enee 'enaaneta yadabaqaacehuteneme yehune bageletze yaawathaacehutene hulu 'aweqaalahu. yeheme hona leeloce gudaayoce ka'enee meneme 'ayedabaqebenyeme. kahadiyaanene wadaajenaa radaate 'aderego yayaaza ba'eregetheme kaqanaawe manegade 'azanebelwale. 'ewenatene setwale. yatasetakaakalawene manegade reqwaale.

baquthetheraacawe sere biyaadaregwaacehu balebocaacawe yayaazutene thelaacaanaa thalaatenate geletze yaadaregaalu. 'enaanetane lamaasaqaayatenaa lamadabedabe 'ejocaacawene yesanazeraalu. melaasocaacaweneme basedebenaa bamwaneqwaashashe leqe yaadaregaalu. 'eneda 'enasu ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe betekedume yemanyaalu.

zemedenaacehu 'ayethaqemaacehume. lalejocaacehu setelu kahadiyaanene kawadadaacehu meneme 'ayethaqemwacehume. yatenesaa'eewe qane yelayaayaacexwaale. janate yamigabaawe janate yegabaale, 'esaate yamigabaawe 'esaate yegabaale. 'aneducehu laleelaa 'ayethaqememe. 'alaahe 'enaaneta yameteszarutene nagare tamalekaace nawe. ka'enaaneta meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. baszeraacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! beraahimenaa 'esune yatakatalute me'emanaane kahadi lahonu hhezebocaacawe 'enyaa kanaaneta 'enaa ka'alaahe wechi kametegazwacawe nagaroce yatharaane natzaa nane; 'enaaneta yaalaacehubatene 'emenateme kedanaale; ba'enyaanaa banaaneta makaakale thalaatenataacenenaa thelaacaacene ba'alaahe becaa 'eseketaamenunaa basu meneneme saataagaaru 'esune becaa 'eseketegazu derase geletze hona baalu gizee la'enaaneta malekaame falagenaa 'are'ayaa naacawe. bamahonume 'enaaneta me'emanaane hoye! leke 'enedanasu hunu. nagare gene beraahime la'abaatu 'enee ka'alaahe maaretaane 'ethayeqelehalahu yaalawene 'atekatalute. mekeneyaatume yehenene nagare yatanaagarawe ba'abaatu maamane tasefaa kamaqurathu bafite bamahonu nawe. 'amaanyoceme la'agaariwoce maaretaane lithayequlaacawe 'ayegabaame. 'enee ka'alaahe qethaate meneme lekalaakalelehe 'aleceleme. geetaacene hoye bagudaayocaacene laaye hulu ba'aneta 'enemakaalane, banesehhaame wada 'aneta tamalesanaale, naga batenesaa'eewe qane mamalashaawe wada 'aneta nawe.

geetaacene hoye! kahadiyaanene banyaa laaye bamashome <<'amaanyoce 'ewenate laaye bihonu noro 'aneshomebaacaweme nabare>> bamaalate sawocene 'ewenatene 'enedaayekatalu 'enyaane mafatanyaa 'ataaderegane. geetaacene hathi'ataacenene maarane; 'aneta 'ashanaafi yamaateshanafe, bamafethare, bamadanegagenaa bamawasane laaye thebabanyaa nahe yelaalu.

yehecene malekaame 'are'ayaane yamikatalute ba'alaahe laaye baduneyaanaa ba'aakxiraa malekaame nagare tasefaa yamiyaadaregu becaa naacawe. kazihece malekaame 'are'ayaane kamakatale yaraaqa: 'alaahe ka'esu yatabeqaaqaa nawe. ka'enasu meneme 'ayefalegeme. bahulume nagare yatamasagana nawe.

'alaahe baregetheme ba'enaaneta 'enaa bakahadiyaane makaakale 'enasune wada selaame bamameraate wadaajenatene bamafethare wanedemaamaacoce maaderage yecelaale. 'alaahe ya'enasune lebe wada 'emenate magalebathe yecelaale. 'alaahe wada 'esu lamimalasu mahari la'enasume 'azaanye nawe.

'alaahe 'enaaneta muselimoce bamahonaacehu mekeneyaate yamaayewaagwaacehune 'enedihume kahagaraacehu yaalaasewathwacehune sawoce malekaame welataa betewelulaacawenaa bafetehawinate yamigabaacawenenaa ba'enaaneta laaye yaalaacawene mabetaacawene betesathwacawe 'ayekalakalaacehume. 'alaahe banafesaacawe, babeetasabocaacawenaa baleeloce laaye fetehawiyaanene yewadaale.

'alaahe 'enaziyaane bamaamanaacehu mekeneyaate yamiwaagwaacehune, kahagaraacehu yamiyaasewathwacehunenaa 'enaanetane kahagare bamaasewathaate yamitabaabarutene, wadaaje 'aderegaacehu mayaazene yekalakelaacexwaale. 'enazihene wadaaje 'aderego yamiyeze sawe ya'alaahene te'ezaaze bamaqaarane 'eraasune thefaate laaye yathaala 'enaa badaaye nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa bahegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! me'emanaate seetoce kakehedate hagare wada selaame hagare tasadawe wada 'enaaneta kamathu 'ewenatanyaa selamahonaacawe fatenwacawe. sela'ewenatanyaa 'emenataacawe 'alaahe yaaweqaale. lebocaacawe wesethe yadabaqute hulu ka'esu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. kafatanaa baxwaalaa 'ewenatanyenataacawe batalayaayu mekeneyaatoce katagalatzalaacehu wada kahadi baalabeetocaacawe 'atemaleswacawe. 'amaanye seetoce kahadi wanedocene, 'enedihume kahadi wanedoce seete 'amaanyocene maagebaate 'ayefaqademenaa. labaalocaacawe yaawathutene theloshe malesulaacawe. 'enaaneta 'amaanyoce hoye! seetoce `idaacawe (maahetzanaacawe ka'eregezenaa natzaa mahonu yamiragaagathebate yaqoyetaa yagizee gadabaacawe) katathanaaqaqa baxwaalaa theloshaacawene bamasethate betaagabwacawe meneme hathi'ate yalabaacehume. baalabeetu kahadi kahonace wayeme kaselaame wada kehedate kataqalabasacenaa kaheedace baalabeete 'aderego 'ayeyaazaate. mekeneyaatume bakehedate mekeneyaate gaabecaawe selataqwaaratha. 'enaziyaa kahadiyaanene yaawathaacehutene theloshe thayeqwaacawe. 'enasume lasalamute misetocaacawe yaawathutene yethayequ. yehe bahulatume bakule yaawathutene theloshe yamamalaalasu wesaanee 'alaahe bamakaakalaacehu yawasanawe wesaanee nawe. yafalagawene wesaaneeme yewasenaale. 'alaahe yabaarocune huneetaanaa szeraane yaaweqaale. meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. labaarocu bamiwasenawe nagare thebabanyaa nawe.

kanaaneta seetoce kedawe wada kahadiwoce biheedunaa kakahadiwoce theloshaacehune thayeqaacehu kaaletasathwacehunaa kakahadiyaane mereko kaaganyaacehu la'enaziyaa baalabeetocaacawe wada kahadiwoce laheedubaacawe kaaganyaacehute mereko (ganimaa) yaawathutene yaahele theloshe sethwacawe. yaamanaacehubate geetaane yaazazaacehune te`ezaaze bamafatzame 'enaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene feru.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! seete me'emanaate qaale kidaane lamagebaate wada 'aneta kamathu (makaa sikafate 'enedatakasatawe) ba'alaahe laaye meneme laayaagaaru 'esune becaa lamagazaate, laayesarequ, zemute laayefatzemu, yamaayemocene tagebaare bamakatale lejocaacawene laayegadelu, kaleelaa yatzanasutene wada baalocaacawe laayaasethagunaa demetzene kafe 'aderego kamaaleqase, bahhazane mekeneyaate tzaguraacawene kamalaachatenaa lebesocaacawene kamaqedade bamataaqabenaa bamasaasalute nagaroce laaye 'aneta bametaazaacawe nagare laayaametzu qaale kidaanaacawene taqabalaacawe. qaale kidaane kataqabalume baxwaalaa ka'alaahe maaretaane thayeqelaacawe. 'alaahe wada 'esu baneseha yatamalasutene mahari; la'enasu 'azaanye nawe.

me`eraafu kahadiyaanene wadaaje 'aderego mayaazene bamakalekale 'enedajamara hulu 'ahuneme lagudaayu kebedate bamasethate yaalafaweneme hasaabe bamaathanaakare 'alaahe 'enedihe yelaale -
'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa bahegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! 'enaziyaa 'alaahe yataqothaabaacawene hhezeboce 'atewadaaju. mekeneyaatume 'enasu bamacharashaawe qane 'ayaamenume. yelequnese kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasene baalamaamanaacawe yatanasaa leke yamotu sawocaacawe wada heyewate yamamalasaacawe gudaaye laaye tasefaa 'enedaqorathute hulu katenesaa'eewe `elate menedaame tasefaa yaqorathu naacawe.

basamaayaatenaa bamedere laaye yaalu hulu 'alaahene kamaayegabu godalonaa nawere baahereyaate bamaawadase 'atharu ('alaaqute). 'esu maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi bamafethare, bamawasanenaa bamadanegage thebabanyaa nawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehu bahegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! lamene batachabaache yamaateszarutene nagare 'eneszaraalane belaacehu tenaagaraalaacehu?! 'eneda mesaaleeme 'anedaacehu basayefee taageyaalahu thalaateneme mateceebataalahu yelaale. batachabaache gene yehenene 'alaadaragame.

yamaateszarune nagare 'eneszaraalane bamaalataacehu 'alaahe zanede quthaawe barataa, kabada. 'anede 'amaanye ka'alaahe gaare 'ewenatanyaa mahone yegabaawaale. tagebaaru kanegegeru gaare magethame 'alabate.
'alaahe ba'esu manegade laaye yasune wedeetaa bamafalage basalefe gone lagone gathemawe leke 'enedatayaayaaza genebe maselawe yamiwaagutene me'emanaane yewadaale.

'alaahe: sela wegiyaa 'enedihume ba'eresu manegade laaye siwaagu basalefe tayaayezawe yamiwaagutene kaamokaasha baxwaalaa: me'emanaane nabiyaatocaacawene 'enedaayaasetabaabelu maasethaneqaqiyaa yehone zanede yamusaa 'enaa ya`isaa (`alayehimaa 'asalaame) hhezeboce yanabarubatene 'amatzanyenate 'awasaa:
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! musaa lahhezebu 'enaaneta hhezebocee hoye! 'enee wada 'enaaneta yatalaakunye mahonune 'eyaawaqaacehu 'eneene bamaqaarane lamene taasaqaayunyaalaacehu?! musaa yezote yamathaawene 'ewenate 'aneqabaleme bamaalate ka'ewenate 'azanabalu. bamahonume 'alaahe lebocaacawene ka'ewenate 'enedireqenaa ba'ewenate laaye 'enedaayetzanaa 'adaragaacawe. 'enaziyaa kasu te`ezaaze yawathutene wada tekekelanyaa manegade 'ayemaraacaweme (lasekeete 'ayaabaqaacaweme).

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! `isaa yamareyame leje (`aalayehi salaame) ya'eseraa'eele (yaa`eqube) lejoce hoye! 'enee ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa sehone 'alaahe wada 'enaaneta lekonyaale. ka'enee bafite yanabarawe taweraate ('orite) ka'alaahe mamethaatune yamaaragaagethe 'enaa ka'enee baxwaalaa 'ahhemade yamibaale male'eketanyaa yamimathaa mahonune 'abesaari nanye. `isaa (`aalayehi salaame) 'ewenatanyaa mahonune yamiyaasaayu ta`aameraatocene yezolaacawe bamathaa gizee yehe geletze degemete nawe bafetsume 'anekatalaweme yaalutene 'asetaawese.

'esu wada selaame 'alaahene babecanyenate wada maamelake 'eyatathaaraa ka'alaahe gaare leelaa 'agaare bamaaderage yamigazaanaa ba'alaahe laaye weshatene kamiqathefe sawe yabalatha badalanyaa yalame. nafesaacawene basherekenaa bahathi'ate wesethe bamathaale badaaye yahonutene sawoce 'alaahe wada qathetanyaawenaa yatasetakaakalawe manegade 'ayemaraacaweme.

'enazihene 'asetabaabaayoce beleshu bahona negegeraacawe 'ewenatene bamaathaleshate ya'alaahene berehaane lamaathefaate yefalegaalu. 'alaahe 'enasu bithalume haayemaanotune bameseraaqenaa bame`eraabe bamaasaraachatenaa qaalune kafe bamaaderage berehaanune yemolaale.

'alaahe male'eketanyaawene muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalamene) baselaame haayemaanote yalaakawe 'eresu nawe. selaame wada malekaame nagare yamimaraa; yathaqaami `eweqatenaa yamalekaame szeraa haayemaanote nawe. bahaayemaanotoce laaye yabalaayenaa 'ashanaafi 'enedihone lekotaale. 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce selaame yabalaaye mahonune bithalume 'enekwaa yabalaaye yaadaregawaale.
'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa bahegegaatu yametesaru me'emanaane hoye! lamahonu 'asaamaami kahonawe qethaate yametaadenaacehu 'ateraafi negedene laamalaaketaacehunaa lemeraacehune?

yehece 'ateraafi negede maalate ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe maamane, ganezabaacehune bamaawethaate ya'alaahene wedeetaa lamaagenyate nafesaacehune zegeju 'aderegaacehu ba'esu manegade laaye mataagale naacawe. yeheme kalaaye yatathaqasawene yametaawequ kahona lanaaneta malekaame nawenaa tasheqadaadamu.

yazihe negede terefu 'alaahe hathi'ataacehune mamaaru. kahenetzaawoce 'enaa kazaafoce szere yatalayaayu wanezoce yamifasubaate janatoce maasegabaatu. mashagaagariyaa yaleelabate qwaami yahonawe janate wesethe wadaalawe malekaame manoriyaa maasegabaatu nawe. yehe yatagalatsawe menedaa meneme yamaayewadaadarawe yahona teleqe dele nawe.

kazihe negede leelaawe terefe dagemo 'enaaneta yametewadutenaa baqerebitu heyewate yamikasate nagare nawe. 'esume 'alaahe 'enaanetane bathalaatocaacehu laaye maredaatunaa la'enaaneta makaanaa 'enaa leeloce 'agarocene baqerebu makefatu naacawe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! me'emanaane yamiyaasedasetaacawene baduneyaa dele bamaaderagenenaa ba'aakxiraa dagemo janate bamaagenyate `edelanyaa 'enedamihonu 'abesaraacawe.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa bahegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! male'eketanyaawe yaamathaalaacehune haayemaanotaacehune bamaredaate ya'alaahe radaatoce hunu. leke `isaa (`aalayehi salaame) lahhawaareyaatu (radaatocu) ba'alaahe manegade laaye yamiradaanye maanawe? baala gizee wadiyaawe hhawaareyaatu 'enyaa ya'alaahe radaatoce nane 'enedaalute ('eneda 'enasu ya'alaahe radaatoce hunu). ka'eseraa'eele lejoce kafilu ba`isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) siyaamenu kafilocu dagemo kaadu. 'enaziyaane ba`isaa (`aalayehi salaame) yaamanutene bakahadiyaane laaye radaanaacawe. bamahonume 'ashanafwacawe.

basamaayaatenaa bamedere laaye yaalu hulu fethuraane 'alaahene kamaayegabu godalonaa nawere kahonu baaheriyaate 'esune bamaawadase yaatharaalu. banegeszenaawenaa selethaanu becanyaa yahona negusze nawe. kagudelatoce hulu yatharaa. 'esune maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi bamafethare, bamawasanenaa bamadanegage thebabanyaa nawe.

'esu 'alaahe yamaayaanabunaa yamaayetzefu lahonute `aaraboce kanasu yahonane ya'alaahene 'aneqatzoce yamiyaanabelaacawe, kakehedatenaa mathefo baaheriyaate yamiyaatharaacawe, qure'aanene yamiyaasetameraacawe, yamale'eketanyaawene sunaa (falage) yamiyaasetameraacawe male'eketanyaa laaka. 'enasu male'eketanyaawe kamalaaku bafite geletze bahona ka'ewenate yaraaqa themeete laaye honawe thaa`otaatene yamigazu, damene yamiyaafasunaa zemedenaane yamiqorethu nabaru.

yekxeewe male'eketanyaa ganaa yaaletafatharunaa wada fite lamimathu `aarabocenaa leeloceme hhezeboce talekwaale. 'esu ('alwahe) maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi bamafethare, bamadanegagenaa bamawasane thebabanyaa nawe.

yehe kalaaye yatathaqasawe yamale'eketanyaawe wada `aarabocenaa leeloce hhezeboce malaake 'alaahe lafalagawe yamisathawe ya'alaahe terufaate nawe. 'alaahe yataalaaqe terufaate baalabeete nawe. kataalaaqe terefaatu 'anedu yazihe tewelede male'eketanyaa yahonutene male'eketanyaawene lasawe leje hulu malaaku nawe.

'alaahe male'eketanyaa bamalaakunaa qure'aanene bamaawaradu yawaalawene leyu welataa kagalatza baxwaalaa: yamale'eketanyaawe musaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) hhezeboce 'anedaanedocu taweraate wesethe baalawe mamariyaa yamaayeszaru 'enedaalu bamatheqase yehe hhezebe 'enasune 'enedaayekatale siyaasethanaqeqe 'enedihe yelaale::
'enaziyaa bataweraate ('orite) 'enediszaru yataazazute nagare gene maszeraatene yatawe yehudoce mesaaleeyaacawe teleqe matsehhafe 'enedatashakamace 'aheyaa nawe. 'aheyaawaa yatachaanabaatene nagare matsehhafe yehune leelaa 'ataaweqeme. ba'alaahe mamariyaanaa 'aneqatzoce yamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce mesaalee menenyaa kafaa! 'alaahe 'enaziyaa raasaacawene yabadalu sawocene wada tekekelanyaa manegade 'ayemaraame.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yataweraate hege kataqayara baxwaalaa bayehudenate yaqaraacehu yehudoce hoye! 'enyaa kaleeloce sawoce yatamarathu ya'alaahe wadaajoce nane yametelu kahona 'enaa yaa kaleeloce sawoce yabalatha teleqe darajaane taaganyu zanedenaa bametelute nagare 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu motene tamanyu balaacawe.

motene bafetzume 'ayemanyume. yelequnese bafatzamute kehedateme wanejale, badale, taweraatene bamaqayaraacawe mekeneyaate bazice `aalame mazawetarene yemanyaalu. 'alaahe badaayocene yaaweqaale. ka'esu szeraacawe meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. baszeraacaweme yemanadaacawaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lanazihe yehudoce yaa seteshashute yanabarawe mote qerebe gizee wayeme qoyeto yaaganyaacexwaale; meneme 'ayeqarelaacehume. kaziyaa baxwaalaa batenesaa'eewe qane yaruqunenaa yaqerebune `aawaaqi wada honawe 'alaahe temalasaalaacehu. ka'esu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. baduneyaa seteszarute yanabarawene hulu bazerezere yenageraacexwaale. baszeraacehume yemanadaacexwaale balaacawe.

'enaaneta 'alaahene yaamanaacehunaa bahegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! bajume`aa qane kxuthebaa (negegere) 'aderaagiwe minebare laaye watheto lasalaate theri baadaraga gizee kxuthebaa lamaadaamathenaa salaate lamasegade wada masegide hidu. 'alaahene kamaasetaawase 'enedaayaazanagaacehu lajume`aa salaate 'azaane (theri) katadaraga baxwaalaa mashathenaa magezaate 'aqumu. yeheme (lajume`aa solaate theri katadaraga baxwaalaa mashathe maaqomenaa wada masegide maheedu) betaawequte lanaaneta lame'emanaane merethe nawe. bamahonume 'alaahe yamiyaazaacehune szeru.

yajume`aa salaatene bacharasaacehu gizee yatafaqada yahonawene sisaaye felagaanaa leeloce gudaayocaacehune lamafatsame medere laaye tabatanu. ka'alaahe terufaate yatafaqadawene terefenaa sisaaye falegu. sisaayaacehune bametefalegubate gizee 'alaahene babezaate 'awesute. sisaayene mafalage 'alaahene kamaawesaate 'enedaayaaserasaacehu. yehene kaadaragaacehu yametefalegutene bamaagenyate 'enaa kametefarute nagare bamathabaqe natzaa tewathaalaacehu.

'anedaanede muselimoce negedene wayeme chawaataane baayu gizee 'anetane minebare laaye tetawehe wadazaa bamaheede yebatanaalu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe zanede yaalawe yamalekaame szeraa menedaa kawathaacehubate negedenaa chawaataa yebalethaale balaacawe. 'alaahe kasachiwoce hulu balaache nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa selaamene geletze bamaaderage bawesethaacawe kehedate yaqwaatharu manaafeqaane 'aneta zanede simathu 'aneta 'ewenatanyaa ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa mahonehene 'enemasakeraalane yelaalu. 'alaahe ya'esu 'ewenatanyaa male'eketanyaa mahonehene yaaweqaale. nagare gene 'alaahe 'enaziyaa kalebaacene ya'alaahe 'ewenatanyaa male'eketanyaa mahonehene 'enemasakeraalane yamilu manaafeqaane 'enasu selamilute nagare weshataamoce mahonaacawene yemasakeraale.

me'emanaane nane bamaalate yamimelute mahalaacawene kagedeyaanaa kamamaarake makalaakayaa gaashaa 'aderegawe tathaqamubate. batachamaarime sawoce laaye therethaareene bamafetharenaa bamaasaraachate sawocene ka'emenate 'agadu. 'enasu yamiszarute szeraa menenyaa kafaa.

mekeneyaatume 'enasu yaamanute yanefeqenaa 'emenate sihone lebaacawe wesethe 'alegabaame. qathelome bawesethaacawe 'alaahene kaadu. bakehedataacaweme mekeneyaate lebocaacawe laaye 'atamabaacawe. lebocaacawe laaye bamataatamu mekeneyaateme yamithaqemaacawenaa yamibajaacawe nagare 'ayegabaacaweme.

'aneta tamalekaace hoye! 'enasune baayahe gizee fitaacawe laaye kamitaayawe webatenaa tzagaa bamanasaate huneetaacawenaa qeretzaacawe yegaremehale. sinaagarume bathaame batheraate kamaaweraataacawe yatanasaa bathemonaa taadaamethaacawaalahe. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'aneta baalahebate botaa laaye sihonu gedegedaa tadagefo yaqoma 'enechate yemaselaalu. meneme nagare 'ayegabaacaweme, 'ayeganazabumeme. fariwoce bamahonaacaweme yasamute demetze hulu 'enasune yamiyaagaalethe yemaselaacawaale. 'enasu 'ewenatanyaa thalaate naacawenaa yaanetane misethere 'enedaayaabaakenu wayeme seeraane 'enedaayaaseeru tathaneqaqaacawe. 'alaahe ka'ezenatu bamaawethaate ragamaacawe. lamahonu 'ewenatu geletsetze kamahonu gaare 'enedeete belawe nawe ka'emenate yamizorute?!

'enazihe manaafeqaane ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa ka'alaahe maaretaa 'enedithayeqelaacehu nu tolo batabaalu gizee bamaashofenaa bamaalaagathe fitaacawene yaazoraalu. 'enedihume yataazazute nagare 'ewenatene maqabalene 'emebi bamaalate kuraatanyaa honawe sirequ taayaacawaalahe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! meherate betethayeqelaacaweme baatethayeqelaacaweme 'ekule nawe. 'alaahe bafetsume 'ayemeraacaweme. 'alaahe ka'esu te`ezaazaate yawathutenenaa bahathi'ate laaye yamizawaterune qanaawene manegade 'ayemaraacaweme.

male'eketanyaawe zanede laalu dehocenaa kamadinaa zuriyaa lamathu gathareewoce (zalaanoce) 'enedibataatanu ganezabaacehune la'enasu wachi 'ataaderegu yamilute 'enasu naacawe. yasamaayaatenaa yamedere kaazenaa ba'alaahe 'eje nawe. bamahonume 'alaahe kabaarocu lafalagawe sisaaye yesathaale. nagare gene manaafeqaane sisaaye ba'alaahe 'eje mahonune 'ayaawequme.

yamanaafeqaanu mari yahonawe `aabedalaahe bine 'ubaye wada madinaa katamalasene yabalaayocu (raasunenaa zamadocune maalatu nawe) yatawaaradutene (muhhamadenaa baaledarabocune maalatu nawe) yaasewathaale yelaale. nagare gene leqenaanaa yabalaayenate la`aabedalaahe bene 'ubayenaa gwaadanyocu saayehone la'alaahe becaa 'enedihume lamale'eketanyaawenaa lame'emanaane nawe. nagare gene leqenaa ya'alaahe, yamale'eketanyaawenaa yame'emanaane 'enedahona 'ayaawequme.

'alaahe munaafiqoce laganezabe yaalaacawene gugutenaa nefugenataacawene 'enedihume ka'alaahe manegade sawocene lamakalekale therate yamiyaadaregu mahonune kagalatza baxwaalaa: 'amaanyoce nefuge mahone 'enedaleelabaacawe bamaasethaneqaqe ba'esu manegade laaye 'enediyaawathu siyaazeze 'enedihe yelaale::
'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa hegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! ganezabaacehunaa lejocaacehu kasalaatenaa kaleeloce yaselaame denegaageewoce 'ayaazanaagwaacehu. ganezabunaa lejocu 'alaahe gedeetaa kaadaragaacawe nagaroce yaazanaagute 'enasu nafesocaacawenenaa beetasabocaacawene bamaathaate ba'ewenate yakasaru sawoce naacawe.

'anedaacehu zanede mote mathetobate lageetaawe:: "geetaayee hoye! ba'alaahe manegade laaye ganezabeene wachi bamaaderage szeraacawe kamaaralaacawe dagaage ya'alaahe baariyaawoce 'enedehone latawasana gizee 'aqoyanye" kamaalataacehu bafite kalagasenaacehu ganezabe 'awethu (sethu).

'alaahe maanenyaawaaneme nafese gizeewaa kadarasanaa `edemeewaa katathanaaqaqa baxwaalaa bafetsume 'ayaaqoyaateme. 'alaahe 'enaaneta yameteszarutene szeraa hulu bazerezere `aawaaqi nawe. malekaame kaszaraacehu bamalekaame, mathefo kaszaraacehu dagemo bamathefo yemanadaacexwaale.

basamaayaatenaa bamedere laaye yaalu hulu fethuraane 'alaahene kamaayegabu godalonaa nawere kahonu baaheriyaate 'esune bamaawadase yaatharaalu (yaaleqaalu). banegeszenaawenaa selethaanu becanyaa yahona negusze nawe. kasu leelaa 'ewenatanyaa yahona negusze yalame mesegaanaa lasu nawe 'esu huluneme nagaroce caaye nawe. meneme nagare 'ayekabedaweme.

'esu 'enaanetane (yasawe lejocene) fathara. kanaaneta makaakaleme kahadi hono macharashaawe 'esaate 'enedihume 'amaanye hono macharashaawe janate yahonu 'alu. 'alaahe 'enaaneta yameteszarutene nagare hulu tamalekaace nawe. kaszeraawocaacehu meneme 'ayedabeqebateme. baszeraacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

samaayaatenenaa mederene lachawaataa saayehone laqume nagare nawe yafatharaacawe. 'enaaneta yasawe lejoce hoye! bacerotaaweme 'enaanetane baamaara qeretze qaratzaacehu. bifalege yamiyaasethalaa yaadaregaacehu nabare. batenesaa'eewe qane wada 'esu temalasaalaacehu. baszeraacehume malekaame yaszaraawene bamalekaame, mathefo yaszaraawene dagemo bamathefo yemanadaacexwaale.

basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalutene hulu yaaweqaale. badebeqeme yehune bayefaa yameteszarutene hulu yaaweqaale. lebe yaqwaatharaweneme therume hona mathefo huluneme yaaweqaale. meneme yamidabaqebate nagare yalame.

'enaaneta 'agaariwoce lamahonu ka'enaaneta bafite 'asetabaabaaye yanabarute yanuhhe, ya`aadoce, yasamudocenaa leeloce hhezeboce taarike 'aledarasaacehumene? bakehedataacaweme mekeneyaate baduneyaa qethaate 'aqamasenaacawe. bamacharashaawe `aalame dagemo 'asaamaami yahona qethaate 'alalaacawe. 'awo baregetheme wareewe dareswacexwaale. ba'enasu laaye qethaate 'enedadarasawe hulu ba'enaanetame laaye 'enedaayedarese temeherete bamawesade wada 'alaahe nesehha gebu.

yehe qethaate yaagaathamaacawe male'eketanyocaacawe geletze yahonu ta`aamerocene yezawe bamathu gizee yaanene bamaasetabaabale 'enedeete yasawe leje male'eketanyaa hono taleko qathetanyaawene manegade yemaraanaale 'alu. banasu maamaneneme 'emebi 'alu. baalamaamanaacaweme 'alaahene qenethaate taakele 'ayegoduteme. 'alaahe ka'enasu 'emenatenaa taazaazhenate yatabeqaaqaa nawe. mekeneyaatume ya'enasu mataazaze 'alaahene meneme 'ayechamerelatemenaa. 'alaahe baraasu yatabeqaaqaa; kamaaneme meneme yamaayefalege; banegegeru batagebaaru yatamasagana nawe.

'enaziyaa kahadiyaane kamote baxwaalaa heyaawe honane 'aneqasaqaseme 'alu. 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'enazihe 'asetabaabaayoce bageetaayee yehunebenye! batenesaa'eewe qane teqasaqasaalaacehu! kaziyaa baxwaalaa baduneyaa yaszaraacehute szeraa yenagaraacexwaale balaacawe. mutaanene maqaseqase ba'alaahe laaye qalaalenaa gare nawe. majamariyaa 'enedafatharaacehu hulu kamotaacehu baxwaalaa 'enaanetane maqaseqase caaye nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! ba'alaahe 'emanu bamale'eketanyaaweme 'emanu. yaa bamale'eketanyaacene laaye baawaradenawe qure'aaneme 'emanu. 'alaahe 'enaaneta yameteszarutene szeraa hulu bazerezere yaaweqaale. kaszeraawocaacehu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. baszeraacehume yemanadaacexwaale.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe batenesaa'eewe qane menedaacehune limanadaacehu yesabasebaacexwaale. baziyaa qane yakahadiyaane keseratenaa gudelate geletze yamiwathaabate yaquchete qane nawe. me'emanaane ya'esaate sawoce bajanate wesethe yaalaacawene botaa yewaresaalu. ya'esaate sawoce dagemo yajanate sawoce 'esaate wesethe yamiganyawene botaacawene yewaresaalu. ba'alaahe 'ameno malekaame szeraane yaszaraa 'alaahe hathi'atune yesarezelataale. kahenetzaawocaacawenaa kazaafoce szere yatalayaayu wanezoce yamifasubaate lazalaalame yaminorubaate yahonacehune janate yaasegabaacawaale. kajanate 'ayewathume. katzagaawocwame meneme 'ayeqwaarathebaacaweme. yehe yaaganyute nagare teleqe yahona 'enaa meneme yamaayewadaadarawe dele nawe.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yakaadunaa bamale'eketanyoce laaye yaawaradenawene 'aneqatzoce yaasetabaabalu ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe. lazalaalame 'esaate wesethe nawaariwoce naacawe. mamalashaacawe menenyaa yakafaace mamalashaa naate.

ba'alaahe wesaaneenaa ferede bihone 'eneji: maaneme sawe banafesu, baganezabunaa balejocu laaye meneme nagare 'ayaagaathemaweme. 'enaho 'esu ba'alaahenaa 'alaahe bawasanawe wesaaneenaa ferede yamiyaamene 'alaahe lebune cegere baagaathamawe gizee wada qathetanyaa manegade yemaraawaale. 'alaahe huluneme nagare `aawaaqi nawe. meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.

'alaahene taazazu, male'eketanyaaweneme taazazu, male'eketanyaawe yaamathaalaacehune nagare 'aneqabaleme betelu hathi'atu ba'enaaneta laaye nawe. bamale'eketanyaawe laaye geletze bahona maleku male'eketune maaderase 'eneji leelaa yalabateme. baregetheme 'enediyaadarese yataazazawene hulu 'adereswale.
'ewenatanyaa 'amelaake 'alaahe nawe. ka'esu wechi ba'ewenate limalake yamigabaa 'amelaake yalame. me'emanaanoce bagudaayaacawe hulu ba'alaahe becaa yemaku.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa bahegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! kabaalabeetocaacehunaa kalejocaacehu makaakale 'alaahene kamaasetaawase bamaazanaagaate lanaaneta thalaate yahonu 'alu. bamahonume 'enedaayaazanaagwaacehu tathaneqaqwaacawe. yamiyaathafwacaweneme thefaatoce yeqere betelu, betaalefwacawenaa betemeru 'alaahe yanaanetane hathi'ate yemeraacexwaale, 'enedihume yaazenelaacexwaale. mekeneyaatume 'anede malekaame szeraa batamasaasaaye maleku selamimanadaa 'enaaneta setemeru 'alaahe yemeraacexwaale.

ganezabaacehunaa lejocaacehu 'enaanetane kelekele yahonu nagarocene 'enedeteszaru bamaanasaasaate ya'alaahene te`ezaaze 'enedetethesu bamaaderage banaaneta laaye fatanaa naacawe. 'alaahe zanede ya'esune te`ezaaze bamamerathe yamitaazazu 'enaa baganezabocaacawenaa balejocaacawe kamazanaagaate yaraaqu teleqe menedaanaa janatene yesathaacawaale.

ya'esune te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene ya'aqemaacehune yaahele feru. 'alaahenaa male'eketanyaawe yamilwacehune nagare semu, 'enedihume taazazu. 'alaahe kasathaacehu ganezabe bamalekaame nagaroce laaye 'awethu. 'alaahe kanafese segebegebenate yathabaqaacawe sawoce yamifalegutene nagare bamaagenyatenaa kamifarute nagare yathabaqaacawe `edelanyoce naacawe.

'alaahene malekaame yahonane bedere basu manegade laaye kaganezabaacehu bamalagase betaabaderute; menedaacehune 'ethefenaa derebe bamaaderage 'anedune ba'asere 'eseka sabaate mato 'enedihume 'ethefe derebe 'aderego yemanadaacexwaale. batachamaarime hathi'ataacehune bamaalafe yemeraacexwaale. 'alaahe baarocu baszarwate teneshe nagare bezu menedaa yamisathe 'amasegaanye, baarocune baqethaate yamaayaathaadefe caaye geetaa nawe.
'alaahe yawadafitune 'enedihume yaahunune `aawaaqi nawe. ka'esu meneme 'ayedabaqebateme. maaneme yamaayaashanefawe 'ashanaafi, bamafethare, bamadanegagenaa bamawasane thebabanyaa nawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'anetame honeke kahhezocehe leelaame sawe baalabeetune mafetaate kafalaga bamajamariyaa `idedaawaa yefetaate; yehe feci yamihonawe kaware 'ababaa katzadaace baxwaalaa hono gebera-segaa genenyunate kamafatsatzame bafite lihone yegabaawaale. yehenene ya`idaahe gizee (maahetzanaacawe ka'eregezenaa natzaa mahonu yamiragaagathebate yaqoyetaa yagizee gadabaacawe) baalabeetocaacehune mamalase kafalagaacehu yethaqemaacexwaalenaa badanebe mazegebaacehu yaazute. ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene feru. yatafatu baalabeetocaacehune kaminorubate beete 'ataasewathu. 'enasume baraasaacawe gizee yatawasanawe gizee saayaaleqe 'atzayaafi nagare (zemute) fatzemawe kaalehona basetaqare kabeete 'enedaayewathu. yehece wesaanee 'alaahe yadanagagaate ya'alaahe denebare (wasane) labaarocu yawasanaate nace. ya'alaahene denebare yamithese baregetheme nafesune geetaawaane 'enedetaametze bamaaderage thefaate laaye bamathaale badalaate. 'aneta fece fatsaamiwe baale hoye! kafeci baxwaalaa kabeete saatewathaa bamaqoyatwa 'alaahe babaale lebe wesethe baalabeetune yamamalase felaagote 'asaaderobate limalesaate 'enedamicele mene 'asaawaqahe?!

yatawasanawe yagizee gadabe liyaaleqe sile batheru huneetaa lamaasetadaadare 'enaa lamanwanware taasaabi 'aderegaacehu kafeci baxwaalaa maleswacawe. nagare gene maqathale kaalefalagaacehu gizeewe yelaqenaa selaraasaacawe yamawasane mabete yenuraacawe. yamigabaacaweneme haqaacawene sathetaacehu bamalekaame shanywacawe. mamalaseme yehune malayaayate setefalegu gudaayune lamaqwaachate hulate fetehawi yahonu mesekerocene 'asemasekeru. 'enaanetame mesekeroce hoye! la'alaahe setelu bafetehe masekeru. yaa kalaaye yatathaqasawene hegenaa wesaanee ba'alaahe yamiyaamenunaa bamacharashaa qane yamiyaamenu sawoce yemakerubatenaa yetagaberutaale. mekeneyaatume bamekerenaa batagesaatze tathaqaamiwoce selahonu. ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene yamifaru hulu kamiyaagaathemaacawe cegerenaa makaraa mawechaa yaadaregelaacawaale.

kaalaasabawenaa kaalegamatawe botaanaa huneetaa sisaaye yesathawaale. bagudaayocu hulu ba'alaahe laaye yatamakaa 'alaahe baqiwe nawe. 'alaahe gudaayune hulu fatzaami nawe. meneme yamiyaaqetaweme, yamiyaamalethaweme nagare yalame. 'alaahe lahulume nagare fetzaameenaa wasane 'aderegolataale. lacegere gadabe 'alawe. lamecotenaa deloteme gadabe 'alawe.'anedaacawe basawe laaye yefaraaraqaale 'eneji qwaami 'ayehoneme.

`edemeeyaacawe bamagefaatu mekeneyaate yaware 'ababaane maayate yaaqomu fate seetocene yagadabe hege laaye katatharaatharaacehu szosete ware nawe. 'enedihume 'enaziyaa lejoce bamahonaacaweme mekeneyaate la'aqema heewaane yaaledarasuteme 'enedihu: szosete ware nawe. nafesa-thure yahonute seetoce bafeci wayeme baalabeetocaacawe yamotabaacawe `idaacawe (maahetzanaacawe ka'eregezenaa natsaa mahonu yamiragaagathebate yaqoyetaa yagizee gadabaacawe) siwaledu nawe. ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene yamifaru sawoce gudaayaacawene gare, cegerocene hulu qalaale yaadaregelaacawaale.

yaa kalaaye yatathaqasawe yafeci, kafeci mamalasenenaa yafeci gizee gadabe yamiyaabaqaabatene hulu 'alaahe 'enedeteszarubate banaaneta laaye yaawaradawe hege nawe. ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene yamifaru sawoce yaszarwacawene hathi'atoce yesarezelaacawaale. ba'akxiraame teleqe menedaane yesathaacawaale. 'esume janate magebaatenaa yamaayaaleqe tzagaawaane maagenyate nawe.

'alaahe sela fecinaa kafeci mamalasene batamalakata yaalawene hegegaate kagalatza baxwaalaa qalabenenaa manoriyaane batamalakata sigaletze:
'enaaneta baaloce hoye! baalabeetocaacehune 'eneda 'aqemaacehu 'anurwacawe. 'alaahe ka'aqemaacehu balaaye 'ayaasegadedaacehume. 'enasune maachanaanaqe falegaacehu baqalabenaa bamanoriyaa gudaaye laaye cegere 'atefetharubaacawe. yatafatu seetoce nafesa thure kahonu 'esekiwaledu derase wachi sethwacawe. lejocaacehune kaathabulaacehume yaathabubatene kefeyaa damoze kefalwacawe. bakefeyaa gudaaye bamakaakalaacehu tawayaayu. 'eswa yametefalegawene kefeyaa baale masethate kaaletasemaamaanaa 'eswa baalacewe kaalehona basetaqare kasasatace; baale leelaane 'athebi qathero lejune yaasethabaa.

sisaayu yasafaalate (habetaame yahona) 'alaahe kasathawe ganezabe lafataate baalabeetunaa laleju yesethe. sisaayu yathababate (deha yahona) dagemo 'alaahe kasathawe sisaaye yesethe. mekeneyaatume 'alaahe nafesene ya'aqemwa yaahele 'enedetaawathaa 'eneji ka'aqemwa balaaye 'enedetaawathaa 'ayaasegadedaateme. 'alaahe kacegere baxwaalaa nagarocene garenaa qalaale bamaaderage yaasafaalaacawaale.

'alaahe yatalayaayu te`ezaazocene kaazaza baxwaalaa 'enazihene te`ezaazoce yamaayefatsemutene bamaasethaneqaqe macharashaacawe yakafaa mahonune sigaletse:
senetenaa senete sawoce yageetaacawene te'ezaaze 'enaa yamale'eketanyocene te`ezaaze bamatsaararaacawe mekeneyaate baszarute mathefo szeraa kabaade yahona gemegamaane gamagamenaacawe. baduneyaame 'aseqayaami bahona qethaate barahaabe, raaqutaacawene bamaaseqaratenaa baleeloce qathaanaacawe, ba'aakxiraa dageme ya'esaate qethaate 'eneqathaacawaalane.
bamathefo szeraacaweme mekeneyaate qethaatene qamasu, baduneyaame ba'akxiraame macharashaacawe kisaaraa hona.

beretu yahona qethaateme 'azagaajetolaacawaale. 'enaaneta ya'a`emero baalabeetoce ya'alaahene te'ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale bakahaadiyaanu laaye yadarasawe 'enedaayedaresebaacehu 'alaahene feru. 'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanu baregetheme banaaneta laaye maasetaawashaa 'awaradenelaacehu. yaa maasetaawashaa yahathi'atene mathefonate 'enaa 'esune mataazazene yaamaara macharashaa yamigaletse nawe.

yehe maasetaawashaa ya'alaahene geletse yahonu meneme gechete yaleelabaacawe 'aneqatsocene yamiyaanabelaacehu ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa nawe. ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanutene sawoce kakehedate chalamaawoce wada qanaa manegade yamiyaawathu naacawe. ba'alaahe yaamanunaa malekaame szeraane yaszaru kahenetzaawocaacawenaa kazaafoce sere yatalayaayu wanezoce yamifasubaacawe janatoce wesethe yaasegabaacawaale. lazalaalameme taqamaachoce naacawe. janate wesethe yamaayeqwaarathe tzagaane bamasethate 'alaahe sisaayune baregetheme 'asaamaralate.

'esu 'alaahe sabaate samaayaatene leke 'eneda sabaatu samaayaateme sabaate mederocene fathara. shari`aawinaa `aalamaawi ya'alaahe te`ezaazocene yaawaredaale. 'alaahe huluneme nagaroce caaye, meneme nagare yamaayekabedawe mahonune 'enedetaawequ 'enaa huluneme nagaroce ba`eweqatu yaadaarasanaa yaakaababa basamaayaatenaa bamedere laaye yaalu hulu meneme yamaayedabaqubate mahonune 'enedetaawequ nawe.

'aneta nabiye hoye! 'alaahe ba'agalegaaye baariyaahe maariyaa 'enedetethaqaaqame yafaqadalehene baalabeetocehe baswa laaye qanetawe batanasu gizee 'enasune lamaasedasate setele baraasehe laaye lamene 'ereme taadaregaalahe?! 'alaahe mahari nawe. bamahonume merohale laanetame 'azaanye nawe.

mahalaacehune bamaaferasaacehu mekeneyaate yamahalaacehune maakaakaashaa 'enedetaawathu 'alaahe baregetheme danagagalaacehu. 'alaahe radaataacehu nawe. 'esu huneetaawocaacehunenaa yamithaqemaacehune nagare hulu `aawaaqi nawe. badenegaageewenaa bawesaaneewe thebabanyaa nawe.

nabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) kabaalabeetocaacawe makaakale lahhafeswa baariyaacawene maariyaane 'enedamaayeqarebwate bamesethere nagarwate. 'eswame yehenene waree la`aashaa tanaagarace. nabiyu (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) 'alaahe 'enedatanaagarace kanagaraacawe baxwaalaa yatawasanawene nagarwatenaa yatawasanawene tawete, lamene tanaagareshe belaweme waqaswate. baziheme gizee 'eswa maane nagarahe?! 'alacaacawe. debeqe nagaraatocene hulu bazerezere `aawaaqi yahonawe nagaranye 'alwate.

'alaahe yanabiyune baalabeetoce 'esu kabaalabeeteme 'alefo ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa mahonune maganezabe 'enedaalabaacawe yaasaasebaacawaale. yamale'eketanyaawe baalabeetoce bamale'eketanyaawe laaye 'enedamaanenyaaweme sawe liqanu 'enaa wada 'esu hulee maqerabe mabetaacawenaa yatafaqada bihoneme bamale'eketanyaawe laaye yamaayegabunaa basu mabete laaye wasane maalafe tagabi 'ayedalame. yamaayegabu nagarocene bamafatzamaacaweme wada 'alaahe neseha liyaadaregu yegabaale.
