'alaahe kamale'eketanyaawe gone nawe. 'enedihume male'eketocenaa dagaage baarocume kasu gone naacawe.

male'eketanyaawe 'enaanetane yamifataa kahona geetaawe kanaaneta yatashaalu baalabeetoce la'alaahe 'eje yasathu, ba'esunaa bamale'eketanyaawe yaamanu, 'alaahene yamitaazazu, kahathi'atocaacawe yamimalasu, lageetaacawe tagazhi yahonu, tswamiwoce, lejaagarade yaalehonunaa lejaagaradocene yetakaalate nabare. nagare gene 'alefataacaweme.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa bahegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! lanafesaacehunaa labeetasabocaacehume kabaadenaa taalaaqe yahonane basawocenaa badenegaaye yameteqathaathale kahonace 'esaate makalaakayaa yaazu. 'ezihece 'esaate wesethe bamigabute laaye chakaanyenaa xaayelanyaa yahonu 'enedihume 'alaahe baazazaacawe nagare laaye yamaayaametzunaa yataazazutene yaalameneme maaqemaamaate yamifatzemu malaa'eketoce 'alu.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yakaadaacehu kahadiyaane hoye! seteszarute banabaraacehute hathi'atenaa kehedate laaye meneme `aayenate mekeneyaate 'ataaqerebu. mekeneyaataacehu taqabaayenate yalawemenaa. bazaareewe qane baduneyaa seteszarute yanabarawene hathi'ate 'enedihume kehedate 'eneji leelaa 'atemanadume.

'enaaneta ba'alaahe yaamanaacehunaa bahegegaatu yameteszaru me'emanaane hoye! 'ewenatanyaa neseha la'alaahe gebu. geetaacehu hathi'ataacehune lisarezelaacehu 'enaa kafoqocaacawe sere yatalayaayu wanezoce yamifasubaacawe yahonu janate wesethe yaasegabaacexwaale. 'alaahe nabiyunenaa 'amaanyocene 'esaate wesethe bamaasegabaate yamaayaawaaredebate qane; berehaanocaacawe kafite lafitocaacawenaa kaqanyocaacawe siraathe (jahaname deledeye laaye yatazaragaa katzagure yaqathana kasayefe yasalaa yahona deledeye) bamigwaazubate qane geetaacene hoye berehaanocaacenene janate 'esekenegabaa derase yatamwalaa 'aderegelene, siraathe laaye berehaane 'enedathafaabaacawe manaafeqaane 'enedaanehone hathi'atocaacenene maarane, 'aneta hulume nagarocene caaye nahe; berehaanaacenene mulu kamaaderagenaa hathi'atocaacene mamaare 'ayesaaneheme.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kahadiyaanene basayefe, manaafeqaanene dagemo ba'anedabatehenaa ya'alaahene wesaanee bamaasefatzame laaye 'anetane yefaruhe zanedeme thanekerebaacawe. batenesaa'eewe qane yamiqamathubate maqamachaa 'esaate naate; menenyaa yakafaace mamalashaa naate.

'alaahe ba'esu 'enaa bamale'eketanyocu lakaadu sawoce mesaalee 'adaraga. 'enazihe kahadiyaane ka'amaanyoce gaare genenyunate manoraacawe yamaayethaqemaacawe 'enedahona lamaasaayate yahulate nabiyaate yanuhhenenaa yaluthene baalabeetoce mesaalee 'adaraga. 'enazihe hulate seetoce dagaage lahonu hulate baarocaacene misetoce nabaru. sawocene ka'alaahe manegade bamakalekale (bamaagade) 'enaa kahadiyaanene bamaredaate baalabeetocaacawene kadu. yanazihe dagaage baaroce baalabeetoce mahonaacawe 'alethaqamaacaweme. 'enasume 'esaate kamigabu kahadiyaanenaa ka'alaahe te`ezaaze kaafanagathu 'afanegaachoce gaare 'aberaacehu gebu tabaalu.

'alaahe ba'esunaa bamale'eketanyocu laamanu me'emanaane kakahadiyaane gaare genenyunate binoraacaweme me'emanaane 'ewenate laaye qathe 'esekaalu derase genenyunatu yamaayegodaacawe mahonune lamagelatze yafire`onene baalabeete mesaalee 'adaraga. <<geetaayee hoye 'aneta zanede bajanate beete ganebaalenye. kafire`one mathefo tanekolenaa szeraawe thabeqanye. ka'enazaa 'esune babadalenaa bagefe katakatalwacawe badaayoceme tanekole thabeqanye>> 'alace.

'alaahe ba'esunaa bamale'eketanyocu laamanu me'emanaane ya`imeraane leje yahonacewene mareyamene mesaalee 'adaraga. beletwane kazemute yathabaqace, 'alaahe jiberilene baswa laaye tenefaashune 'enedinafaabaate 'adaraga. baziheme gizee ba'alaahe wesaanee yaala 'abaate `isaane tzanasace. ba'alaahe denegaageewocenaa lamale'eketanyoce bawaradu matsaahhefeteme 'amanace.ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamatagebarenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale fetzume 'alaahene kamitaazazu baaroce nabarace.
selethaane ba'esu 'eje becaa yahonawe 'alaahe laaqa; malekaame nagarume bazaa. 'esu hulume nagaroce meneme yamaayekabedawe caaye nawe.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'eresu kanaaneta makaakale maanenyaacehu szeraawene 'enedamiyaasaamere lifatenaacehu motenenaa heyewatene yafathara nawe. maaneme liyaashanefawe yamaayecele 'ashanaafi; wada 'esu neseha lagabu mahari nawe.

sabaate samaayaatene 'anedu samaaye kaleelaanyaawe samaaye gaare saayenakaaku yatadaraarabu 'aderego fatharaacawe. 'aneta tamalekaace hoye! 'alaahe bafatharawe nagare laaye meneme mazaanafenenaa 'alamathaathaamene 'atemalakateme. `aayenehene wada samaaye 'anegaathahe tamalekate lamahonu kefetatenaa senetheqe taayaalahene? meneme 'ataaganyeme. nagare gene yametaayawe yaraqaqa 'enaa bathebabe yatakaana 'afathaathare nawe yametemalakatawe.
'ahuneme dagaagemahe tamalekate `aayenehe meneme nawereme kefetateme saayaaye tanaaneso, dakemonaa taaketote maayate tasenote yemalasaale.

wada medere yaqarabacewe samaayene 'aberi bahonu kawaakebete 'ageethenaate. 'enazihene kawaakebetoce wada samaaye wareene lamaadaamathe lamiwathu shayethwanoce mamecaa honawe 'enediyaaqaathelwacawe 'adaragene. taqathaathaaye yahonane ya'esaate qethaateme bamachiwe `aalame 'azagaajetanelaacawaale.
batenesaa'eewe qane bageetaacawe lakaadu yajahaname qethaate 'azagaajetanaale. menenyaa yakafaa 'amalaalasene yemalasaalu.
'esaate laaye batathaalume gizee kefunaa beretu demetze yesamaalu. 'eswa ('esaate) leke 'eneda desete tenetakatakaalace.

bawesethwa bamigabute laaye kamaqothaatwa bezaate yatanasaa kafilwa kakafilwa lamalayaayate yeqarebaale. bawesethwame yatalayaayu sebeseboce batathaalume gizee ba'esaate laaye yatamadabu malaa'eketoce 'enasune bamawanejale <<duneyaa wesethe banabaraacehu gizee ka'alaahe qethaate yamiyaasethanaqeqwaacehu 'asethaneqaaqi male'eketanyoce 'alemathulaacehume 'enedee?>> belawe yethayeqwaacawaale.

kufaaroceme 'alu <<'awo ka'alaahe qethaate yamiyaasethanaqeqe male'eketanyaa mathetolene nabare. nagare gene 'enyaa 'alaahe meneme raa`eye 'alaawaradame; 'enaaneta ka'ewenate yaraaqa themeete laaye yaalaacehu 'eneji male'eketanyoce 'ayedalaacehume bamaalate 'asetabaabalenaacawe.

'ewenatene sametane bataqabalene 'enaa 'ewenatene kaweshate yamenelayebate 'a`emero binorane noro ka'esaate baaledaraboce baalehone. yelequnese bamale'eketanyoce 'amenane, yezawete yamathutene mamariyaa taqabelane janate kamigabu yajanate baaledaraboce 'enehone nabare.>>
kahadiwocenaa weshataamoce 'enedanabarunaa la'esaate yamigabu thefaatanyoce mahonaacawene 'amanu. ya'esaate gwaadoce ka'alaahe 'ezenate maraaqe taragaagathabaacawe.

'alaahe ya'esaate sawocene baaheriyaacawenenaa menedaacawene kagalatza baxwaalaa yamaane sawocene baaherinaa menedaacawene bamaasekatale sigaletze:
'enaziyaa 'alaahene saayaayu yamifarute lahathi'atocaacawe maaretaanaa taalaaqe yahona menedaa janate 'alalaacawe.
'enaaneta yasawe lejoce hoye! bamisethereme yehune bageletze tanaagaru! 'alaahe yaaweqawaale. 'alaahe babaarocu lebe wesethe yaalawene yaaweqaale meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.

lamahonu fethuraanene bamulu yafathara misetherenenaa kasu yabalatha yatadabaqane nagare 'ayaaweqemene?! 'esu labaarocu 'azaanye, wesetha misethiraacawene yamiyaaweqe, meneme yamaayedabaqebate yahona geetaa nawe.

'esu mederene tenorubaate zanede lanaaneta qalaalenaa gare 'adaragalaacehu. baya'aqethaachaawe taneqasaaqasunaa yaazagaajalaacehune sisaayeneme tamagabu. lagemegamaanaa lamamanedaate wada 'esu becaa tamalaashoce naacehu.
samaaye laaye yaalawe 'alaahe mederene qalaalenaa gare kaadaraga baxwaalaa yametewaalele bamaaderage qaarunene 'enedaasamathawe hulu 'ayaasemathebeneme belaacehu tetamaamanaalaacehune?!

samaaye laaye yaalawe 'alaahe baluthe hhezeboce laaye 'enedafatzamawe kasamaaye denegaaye 'ayaazanebebeneme belaacehu tetamaamanaalaacehune? yaneene qethaate bametemalakatubate gizee maasethaneqaqiyeene saataawequte 'ateqarume. daaru gene yaneene qethaate kaayaacehu baxwaalaa yametethaqamute nagare yalaacehume.

kanazihe 'agaariwoce bafite yanabaru hhezeboce male'eketanyocaacawene 'asetabaabalu. bakehedataacawenaa maasetabaabalaacawe selazawatarume ya'alaahe qethaate waradabaacawe. ba'enasu laaye yaarafawe wegezatee 'enedeete nabare? 'ejege kabaade nabare.

'enazihe kahadiyaane baraariwoce basalefe honawe kenefocaacawene 'eyazaragunaa 'eyaathafu sibaru 'ayemalakatumene? medere laaye 'enedaayewadequ ka'alaahe basetaqare maaneme 'ayeyezaacaweme. 'esu huluneme nagaroce tamalekaace nawe.meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.

'enaaneta kahadiyaane hoye! 'alaahe 'enaanetane maqethaate bifalege yasune qethaate yamikalaakalelaacehu yatenyaawe szaraawite nawe? 'enazihe kahadiyaane bashayethwane yatataalalu 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalume.
'alaahe sisaaye masethatene bikalakelaacehu maaneme sisaaye 'ayesathaacehume. tachabaachu gene kahadiyaane bakuraataacawenaa bageterenataacawe 'enedihume 'ewenatene baalamaqabale laayegafubate.
lamahonu bafitu tadafeto bacheneqelaatu yamiheede ('agaari) nawe wada 'ewenate yatamaraawe wayenese qomo qathe belo ba'egeru qathetanyaa manegade laaye yamiheedawe?!

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lanazihe kahadiyaanenaa 'agaariwoce 'enaanetane 'alaahe nawe yafatharaacehu yametesamubatene joro, yametaayubatene `aayene 'enaa yametaasebubatene lebe fatharalaacehu. yehenene welataa yawaalalaacehune teneshe 'eneji 'ataamasagenuteme balaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lanazihe kahadiyaanenaa 'agaariwoce bamedere laaye 'enedetesaraachunaa 'enedetebaazu yaadaragaacehu 'alaahe 'eneji 'enaziyaa meneme mafethare yamaayecelu thaa`otaate 'ayedalume. lagemegamaanaa lamamanedaateme wada thaa`otocaacehu saayehone wada 'alaahe nawe yametemalasute. 'esune babecanyenate ferutenaa 'amelekute.

batenesaa'eewe qane yamiyaasetabaabelu 'asetabaabaayoce bamaafeezenaa nagaru meneme likasate 'enedamaayecele bamaasabe muhhamade hoye! 'aneta 'enaa baaledarabocehe yemathaale belaacehu yametaasefaraarune qana qatharo bamamethaatu 'ewenatanyoce kahonaacehu macee nawe?! yelaalu.
yatenesaa'eewe qane `eweqate 'alaahe zanede nawe balaacawe. macee 'enedamikasate 'esu becaa nawe yamiyaaweqawe. 'enee geletze yahonakunye 'asethaneqaaqi 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalahume.

qana qatharowe dareso qethaatu qerebe hono batenesaa'eewe qane 'enedatamalakatu 'alaahene yakaadu sawoce fite yeqayarenaa yethaquraale. yehe baduneyaa wesethe banabaraacehu gizee setethayequtenaa setaathaadefute yanabarawe qethaate nawe yebaalaalu.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lanazihe kahadiyaanenaa 'agaariwoce 'alaahe 'eneenenaa kanee gaare yaalutene biyaathafaane wayeme bimerane kahadiwocene ka'asaamaami qethaate maane yaadenaacawaale? balaacawe. kasu qethaate maaneme 'ayaadenaacehume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lanazihe kahadiyaanenaa 'agaariwoce babecanyenate 'enedetegazu yamitharaacehu 'eresu 'arahhemaane nawe. 'enyaame basu 'amenanaale. bagudaayocaaceneme basu laaye becaa nawe yamenemakaawe. geletze bahona themeete laaye yaalawene 'esu qathetanyaawe manegade laaye kaalawe saataawequte 'ateqarume. maane geletze yahona thememeete laaye yaala mahonune 'enaa maane qathetanyaawe manegadene yayaaza 'enedahona maawaqaacehu yamaayeqare nawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lanazihe kahadiyaanenaa 'agaariwoce yaa yametethathute weha maaneme bamaayedaresawe botaa wesethe bisamethe; yamifaleqe 'enaa bezu yahona weha maane yaamathaalaacexwaale?! balaacawe. ka'alaahe wechi maaneme 'ayaamathaalaacehume.

(n) <<nune>> ba`aarabenyaa fidalaate (mehetzaara-qaalaate) yamijameru me`eraafocene batamalakata ba'ale-baqaraahe me`eraafe majamariyaa laaye taberaaretwale. 'alaahe babe`ere 'enaa sawoce babe`eraacawe bamitzefute nagare yemelaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe bawaalalahe yanabiyenate welataa 'ebede 'ayedalaheme. yelequnese 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce 'ebede nawe belawe kamisanazeruteme sedebe natzaa nahe.
batashakamekawe xaalaafinate 'enaa bamiyaagaathemehe cegere mekeneyaate 'alaahe yamaayeqwaarathe menedaa yekafelahaale. maaneme basu tzagaa ba'aneta laaye 'ayematzaadaqeme.
qure'aane yaamathaawene maszarate yaadaraga taalaaqe sena megebaare laaye nahe. 'aneta qure'aane wesethe yatagalatzawene baaheri bamigabaa yatalaabaseke nahe.
'anetame saataaye 'ateqareme 'enaziyaa kahadiyaaneme saayaayu 'ayeqarume.
'ewenatu sigalathe maanenyaacehu 'ebede 'enedahona yegalatzaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe maane batasaasaata manegade laaye 'enedaala, maane bataqaanaa manegade laaye 'enedaala yaaweqaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yezahe yamathaakxawene nagare yaasetabaabalutene sawoce 'atetaazazaacawe.
bahaayemaanotehe hisaabe betelazebelaacawenaa betelasaalaselaacawe 'enasume bilazebunaa bilasaalasu yemanyaalu.
baweshate bathaame yamimelutenenaa waraadocene 'atetaazaze.
sibazaa hameetanyaanaa sawocene lamaalayaayate nagare yamiyaasaabeqe yahonawene.
malekaame nagarene bathaame kalekaaye, basawoce ganezabe, keberenaa nafese denebare yamiyaalefenaa bathaame hathi'atanyaanaa wanejalanyaa yahonawene.
leba daraqe, baleeloce laaye yatalathafa kanasu yaalehona zara- bise yahonawene.
habetaamenaa yabezu lejoce 'abaate bamahonu ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyaawe kamaamane koraa.
yanyaa 'aneqatzoce batanababalateme gizee yehe kaderowocu 'afa - taarike yatatzaafa nawe yelaale.
'aberote yamiqoyenaa 'aseqayaami yamiyaadaregawene melekete 'afenechaawe laaye 'enaadaregelataalane.

'enyaa 'enazihene 'agaariwocene badereqe 'enaa barahabe fatanenaacawe. kazihe bafite yanabaru ya'atekelete baalabeetoce 'azere`etune dehoce 'enedaayemagabu lamakalaakale bafethenate 'enaachedaalane belawe baheedu gizee 'enedafatanenaacawe.
bamahalaacawe laaye <<ya'alaahe faqaade kahona>> saayelu heedu.
'enasu batanyubaate leelite 'alaahe ba'atekelete botaawe laaye 'esaate laqaqabate. 'enasume 'esaatune makalaakale 'alecaalume.
'eneda leelite chalamaa thequre belaa qarace.
'erese ba'eresaacaweme bathwatu tatharaaru.
'azere`etune yametaachedu kahona dehocu saayemathu tolo bamaaladaa wadazaawe 'enehide tabaabaalu.
'eyataneshokwaashoku bafethenate wada 'atekelete botaawe heedu.
bamisethereme 'erese ba'eresaacawe bazaareewe `elate deha 'enedaayegabaa tabaabaalu.
fereewene lamakalekalenaa lamaagade wasenawe maaledawe heedu.
taqaathelaa siyaaganywateme 'enyaa manegadune tasaasetanaale tabaabaalu.
yelequnese dehocene kafereewe lamakalekale 'asebane 'enaa wasenane bamamethaataacene maachade 'enedaanecele tadaregane (taqathetane) nawe 'alu.
kamakaakalaacaweme shaale yaalawe sawe <<'enee bamajamariyaa dehocene lamakalekale bawasanaacehu gizee 'alaahene 'ataatharume ('ataalequme)neseha 'ategabume beyaacehu 'alenabaramene?>> 'alaacawe.
dehocene ka'azere`etaacene feree bamakalekalaacene badalanyoce nane: geetaacene theraate (leqenaa) yegabaawe 'alu.
'erese ba'eresaacaweme mawaqaaqasune tayaayaazute.
bamatzatzateme waa thefaataacene 'enyaa dehocene bamakalekalaacene mekeneyaate wasane 'alaafiwoce nane 'alu.
ka'azere`ete botaacene yatashaalace 'alaahe yetakaalene zanede tasefaa 'enaadaregaalane. ka'esu becaa 'enekajelaalane. malekaame nagarenaa yeqeretaane tasefaa 'enaadaregaalane.
'enyaane yaaletaazazunene sisaayaacenene bamakalekale qathaanaacawe. kebedatunenaa zawetaarinatune biyaawequ noro: ya'akxiraa (yamacharashaawe `aalame) qethaate kazihe yakafaanawe.
te`ezaazune bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'alaahene lamifaru sawoce 'alaahe zanede tzagaawe yamaayeqwaarathebate yahona janate tazagaajetolaacawaale.
yamakaa 'agaariwoce 'enedamiyaasebute muselimocenenaa kahadiwocene bamenedaa bakule 'ekule 'enaadaregaacawaalane?!
'enaaneta 'agaariwoce 'enedeete yaala fereda-gamedelenaa yatathaamama ferede nawe yametefaredute?!
lamahonu taazaazhenaa 'amatzanyaa 'ekule naacawe yamile yametaanabute matsehhafe 'alaacehune?
bazihe matsehhafeme wesethe latenesaa'eewe qane yafalagaacehutene yametemarethubate.
lamahonu 'enyaa zanede yawasanaacehutene 'enedametaaganyu bamahalaa yataragaagatha qaale kidaane 'alaacehune?
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'eseti yehenene negegere yaminaagarutene bazihe gudaaye laaye 'eseti waasu maane nawe? belahe thayeqaacawe.
bamenedaa bakule kame'emanaane gaare 'ekule yamiyaadaregwaacawe 'agaaroce 'alwacawene? 'ewenatanyoce kahonu 'enaziyaane 'agaaroce yaamethwacawe.
yatenesaa'eewe qane kebedate geletze yehonaale. geetaaceneme baatune yegaletzaale. baziheme gizee lasegedate yetharaalu me'emanaane sisagedu kahadiyaanenaa manaafeqaane gene masegade 'ayecelume.
`aayenocaacawe yafaru honawe weredatenaa tzatzate yeshafenaacawaale. baduneyaa theenanyoce 'eyaalu la'alaahe 'enedisagedu taazawe nabare.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enazihene baqure'aane yamiyaasetabaabelu sawocene lanee tawaacawe. maazanaagiyaanaa 'enasu laaye yamiwasade kxidataawi 'eremejaa mahonune saayaawequ darajaa badarajaa wada 'esaate 'enenadaacawaalane.
bahathi'ataacawe laaye 'enedigafubate lateneshe gizee tawaacawe. bakahadiyaanenaa ba'asetabaabaayoce laaye 'ayaayaazee beretu nawe. liyaamalethunyeme kanee qethaateme lidenu 'ayecelume.

lamahonu 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! daa`ewaa (theri) bamaaderagehe damawaze tethayeqaacawaalahene? yehene bamaaderageheme kabaade nagare 'enedatashakamu tasametwacawe ka'ewenate 'enedirequ 'adaragaacawene?! tachabaachu bataqaaraaniwe nawe. 'aneta daa`ewaa (theri) bamaaderagehe kanasu damawaze 'atethayeqeme. yehe kaalehona taadiyaa 'anetane 'enedaayekatalu yaagadaacawe menedenawe?!

wayenese ba'lawehhale maahhefuze' (bathebequ matsehhafe) wesethe selamiganyawe yawadafite `eweqate norwacawe ka'esume 'anetane lamakaraakare yamimacaacawene maaserajaa 'enedafalagu yamitzefute 'alaacawene?

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe 'enasune bakxidate liqathaacawe maaqoyate bamawasanu taagase. bahhezebocu laaye mataagase 'enedaaqaatawe ya'asaa nabaari gwaadanyaa yunuse; babaaherenaa ba'asaa nabaariwe chalamaawoce wesethe hono tachaneqo geetaawene batathaaraa gizee 'enedahonawe 'atehune.
ya'alaahe 'ezenate baayaaganyawe noro `aasaa nabaariwe medera badaa laaye yatawaqasa sihone yethelawe nabare. nagare gene ya'alaahe 'ezenate darasalatenaa saayethelawe qara.
geetaaweme marathawe nabiyenateme sathawe kadagaage baarocume 'adaragawe.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yakaadunaa male'eketanyaaweneme yaasetabaabalu 'anetane ba`aayenocaacawe 'ejege 'afethawe bamaayate litheluhe qarabu. yehenene baaneta laaye yawaradawene qure'aane semeetaacawene bamakatalenaa ka'ewenate yaraaqa bamahonaacawe yehenene male`ekete yezo yamathaawe male'eketanyaa 'ebede nawe 'alu.
yehe baaneta laaye yawaradawe qure'aane lasawocenaa lagaaneenoce mekerenaa tagesaatze 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame.
'alaahe bahulume laaye makasatwa selamaayeqarawe yatenesaa'eewe qane maawesaatu.
<<'ale-hhaaqe-qaahe>> takasaacwa menedenaate? bamilawe theyaaqee yazicene qane taalaaqenate yegaletzaale.
sela 'ale-hhaaqeqaahe (takasaacwa) yatenesaa'ee qane kebedatene mene 'asaawaqahe?!
yaswalihhe hhezeboce samudoce 'enaa yahude hhezeboce, `aadoce kakebedatwa yatanasaa yasawocene lebe yameteqoraqurawene tenesaa'eene 'asetabaabalu.
samudocene yamacharashaa (kafetanyaa darajaa) laaye badarasace kabaadenaa 'asedanegaache demetze 'athafaanaacawe.
`aadoceneme 'ejege bathaame qazeqaazaanaa daraqe bahonace nefaase 'athafaanaacawe.

lasabaate leelitenaa samenete qanaate kasere maszarataacawe 'athafaacaacawe. reesaacawe bamanedaraacawe wesethe wadeqonaa takamero setemalakataacawe kathafu baxwaalaa basebeso kaseru tanaqelo yawadaqa yatamere zaafe yemaselaalu.
yehene yamasala qethaate kawaradabaacawe baxwaalaa yamiqare nafese yaminore yemaselehalene?!
fire`owenenaa kasu bafite yaalafute hhezeboce 'enedihume manedaraacawene bamagalebathe yaqathaanaacawe yaluthe hhezeboce sherekenaa leeloce hathi'atocene fatzamu.
'eyaanedaanedu hhezeboce batalaakalaacawe male'eketanyaa laaye 'amatzu, bamahonume 'alaahe kabaade bahona qethaate 'athafaacawe.

wehaweme kamathane balaaye moleto wasanune siyaalefe bajarebaacawe wesethe yanabaraacehubaacawe (walaajocaacehune) nuhhe (`alayehi 'asalaame) ba'enyaa feqaade basaraawe taneqasaaqaashe jalebaa laaye bamachaane 'adaanenaacawe. 'enasune machaane maalate 'enaanetane machaane nawe.

yeheneneme yaadaragenawe yehece jalebaanaa taarikwaa lakehedate sawoce mathefaate 'enaa la'emenate sawoce madaane bamaaserajaanate yamithaqase magasachaa 'enedihonenaa bamisamaawe nagare mathaqame yamicele joro sameto 'enedithaqame nawe.
qanedune 'enedinafaa yatawakalawe male'ake baqanedu hulatanyaawaane nefi 'anede gizee banafaa gizee;
mederenaa taraaroce kabotaacawe tanasetawe baanedee madeqaqene badaqaqu gizeenaa medereme yahona yataraaraa 'akaale takafaafelawe yebataatanaalu.
yehe bamikasatebate gizee tenesaa'ee tekasataalace.
samaaye tasanathaatheqaa lamalaa'eketoce mawurajaa setehone; kazihe bafite thanekaaraanaa tayaayaazhe yanabaracewe samaaye dakaamaa tehonaalace.
malaa'eketoce bayatharafu chaafoce laaye yehonaalu. baziyaane taalaaqe qane yageetaahene `aareshe semenete ya'alaahe baalamwale yahonu malaa'eketoce yeshakamutaale.
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! baziyaane qane 'alaahe zanede teqarebaalacehu. kanaaneta la'alaahe meneme bihone 'ayedabaqebateme. yelequnese 'alaahe sela 'eyaanedaanedune nagare `aawaaqinaa tamalekaace nawe.
yaszeraa mazegabu baqanye 'eju yatasathawe sawe; bamadasate yaszeraa mazegabeene yaazunaa 'anebebu yelaale.
duneyaa banabarekubate gizee 'enedameqasaqasenaa 'enedamemanadaa 'eregethanyaa nabareku.
bamiyaaganyawe qwaami tzagaa tawadaaje yadasetaa nuro wesethe nawe.
fereewocwa lafalaagiwaa yaqarabace naate.
'enasune bamaakebareme yaalameneme macagare belu thathu yehenene yaaganyaacehute qadame belo baasaalafaacehute yaduneyaa heyewate malekaame szeraa nawe yebaalaalu.
yaszeraa mazegabu bageraa 'eju yatasathawe sawemaa 'ejege bamatzatzateme waa menyotee! menawe laqethaate yamidaareganye kefu szeraayee yatamazagababate yaszeraa mazegabee baaletasathanye yelaale.
waa menyotee! gemegamaayee mene 'enedahoname baalaawaqekunye.
waa menyotee! yaaci yamotekwaate mote yamacharashaanaa maqaseqase yaleelabaate bahonace.
ganezabeeme bihone ka'alaahe qethaate meneme 'alaadaananyeme.
'etamaamanebate yanabara selethaanee, gulebatee 'enaa maaserajaayee kanee thafubenye raaqubenye!
'enaaneta malaa'eketoce hoye! yehene sawe yaazute 'ejune ka'anegatu gaare 'esarute yebaalaale.
kaziyaa baxwaalaa qaathalowaane 'enediqameseme 'esaate wesethe chamerute.
qathelome rezematu sabaa kenede bahonawe sanesalate wesethe 'asegabute.
batenesaa'eewe qane ka'alaahe qethaate likalaakalelate yamicele zamademe yalaweme.
ya'esaate sawoce magelenaa dame 'eneji yamimagabawe thaqaami megebe yalaweme.
yehenene megebe hathi'atanyocenaa wanejalanyoce 'eneji 'ayemagabwateme.
bametaayute 'emelaalahu.
bamaataayuteme 'emelaalahu.
yatakabarawe male'eketanyaa lasawoce yamiyaanabawe qure'aane ya'alaahe negegere nawe.
yagathaami (yabaalaqenee) negegere 'ayedalame tenesheme 'ataamenume?
yathaneqwaaye negegereme 'ayedalame teneshe 'ateganazabumene? beteganazabu noro yathaneqwaaye negegere 'alamahonune taawequ nabare. mekeneyaatume yathaneqwaaye negegere kaqure'aane weche nawe.
nagare gene qure'aane yawaradawe ka`aalamaatu geetaa nawe.
muhhamade 'enyaa yaalaalenawene nagare theqiteme bihone bamanaagare biqafethebene.
lamabaqaleme baxaayelenaa bacelotaacene 'athebeqane 'eneyezawe ('enebaqalawe) nabare.
kaziyaa baxwaalaa kalebu gaare yatasaasarawene dameserune 'eneqorethelateme nabare.
kanaaneta maaneme liyaagedane 'ayeceleme. lanaaneta sile banyaa laaye fetsume liqathefe 'ayeceleme.
yageetaacawene te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalaacawene bamakalekale geetaacawene lamifaru tagesaatzenaa mekere nawe.
'enyaa kanaaneta makaakale bazihe qure'aane yamiyaasetabaabele 'enedaala 'enaaweqaalane.
bazihe qure'aane maasetabaabale batenesaa'eewe qane teleqe tzatzatenawe.
yehe qure'aane yataragaagatha 'ewenate yahona ka'alaahe selamamethaatu therethaaree yalaweme.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yataalaaqu geetaahene seme bamaawesaate kamaayegabu baaheriyaate 'atheraawe.
ka'agaariwoce 'anedu bamaafeeze baraasunaa bahhezebocu laaye yamibaalawe qethaate makasatu yamaayeqare kahona 'eseti yekasate belo du`aa 'adaraga (tathaaraa).
yaa qethaate bamathaame gizee lakahadiyaane maaneme 'ayekalaakalelaacaweme.
yale`elenaa, yaleqenaanaa yatzagaa baalabeete kahonawe 'alaahe.
badarajaawoceme laaye jiberilenaa malaa'eketoce wada 'alaahe yewathaalu. yehe qethaate yaqanu rezemate 50 shihe `aamate bahonawe qane yekasataale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! semotaanaa waqasaa yaleelabatene te`egesete taagasa.
'enasu yehenene qethaate ruqenaa fetzume yamaayehone 'aderegawe yaasebute nabare.
'enyaa dagemo qerebenaa yaalatherethere yamikasate 'enedahona 'enaaweqaalane.
samaaye 'eneda qalatha nahhasenaa wareqe bametehonebate gizee;
taraaroce 'eneda thethe qalaale bamihonubate gizee,
hulume baraasu gudaaye bamawatharu zamade zamadune bamaayethayeqebate gizee;
zamade zamadune biyaayeme qanu kabaade kamahonu yatanasaa 'anedu leelaawene 'ayethayeqeme. 'esaate yatawasanabate sawe lejocu beezaa 'enedihonulate yemanyaale.
baalabeetunaa wanedemume beezaa bihonulateme yemanyaale.
'enedihume bacegeru gizee kagonu yamiqomu yaqerebe gosaawocu beezaa 'enedihonulate.
medere wesethe yaalu 'athaqaalaaye gaaneenoce, sawocenaa leeloceneme chamero 'asaalefo beezaa bamaaderage raasune ka'esaate maadaane yefalegaale.
yehe thamaamaa sawe 'enedaasabawe 'ayeladame. yelequnese yameteqathaathalenaa yametenade yatenesaa'eewe qane 'esaate naate.
kamaqathaathalwa 'enaa kamuqatwa thenekaaree yatanasaa yacheneqelaatune qodaa baxaayelanyaawe yametegashalethe naate.
ka'ewenate yaraaqutene 'enaa maamane 'emebi yaalutene tethaaraalace.
'enedihume ganezabene sabesebo ba'alaahe manegade laaye maawethaate yasasatane chemere;
yasawe leje bathaame yamisaasaanaa qetha-bise hono tafathara.
bashetaa wayeme dehenate siyaagaathemawe te`egeseta-bise yehonaale.
yamiyaasedasete nagare 'eneda delote, mecotenaa habetaamenatene siyaagaathemawe ba'alaahe manegade laaye maawethaate bathaame kalekaaye yehonaale.
nagare gene sagaajoce kanazihe mathefo baaheriyaate yatharu naacawe.
'enaziyaa basegedataacawe laaye zawetaari, yamaayezanaagu bawaqetu yamisagedu.
baganezabaacawe laaye yatawasana gedeetaa 'enedaalabaacawe yamiyaamenu.
bayatenyaaweme mekeneyaate bihoneme tacagerawe lamithayeqwaacawenaa lamaayethayeqwaacawe dehoce.
batenesaa'eewe qane huluneme 'enedayaszeraawe bamimanadaabate qane yamiyaamenu naacawe.
yageetaacawene qethaate yamifarunaa wada malekaame szeraawocaacawe teleqenate yamaayemalakatu.
yageetaacawene qethaate 'asefari bamahonu 'a`emero yaalawe sawe 'ayetamaamaneme.
beletocaacawene katalayaayu 'atzayaafi tagebaaraate yamiyaarequnaa yamithabequ;
kabaalabeetocaacawenaa ba'alaahe manegade laaye sitaagalu kamaarakwaacawe merekonyoce basetaqare: genenyunate bamafatsame 'enaa bamasaasalute marekaataacawe yamiwaqasu 'ayedalume.
kabaalabeetocaacawenaa kamereko seetoce weche baala nagare semeetune maarekaate yafalaga 'esu ka'alaahe mamariyaa kaafanagathute sawoce nawe.
yatasathaacawene ganezabenaa misethere 'enedithabaqu 'enaa yaleelocene 'adaraanaa yagabutene qaale yamithabequ 'adaraacawene yamaayekedu 'enaa qaalaacawene yamaayaathefu naacawe.
bamifalagawe maleku bamesekerenate laaye yaqomu zemedenaa 'enaa thalaatenate ta`e'eno yamaayefatherebaacawe.
salaatene gizeewaane, ne`ehenaawaanaa 'eregaataawaane meneme saayaazanaagaacawe bamathabaqe yamisagedu.
banazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatzu hulu bajanate wesethe bamiyaaganyute qwaami tzagaanaa yatakabarawene ya'alaahene fite bamaayate yatakabaru naacawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enazihe bazuriyaahe yaalu kahadiyaane hhezebocehe bafethenate 'anetane wada makaade 'enediyaamaru yaadaragaacawe menedenawe?
babudene babudene honawe kaqanyehenaa kageraahe tabataatenawe 'enediqamathu yaadaragaacawe menedene nawe?
bakehedatu laaye zawetari hono yaala 'eyaanedaanedu sawe yazawatere yatzagaa baalabeete yahonacewene janate magebaate yefalegaalune?

'enasu 'enedamiyaasebute 'ayedalame. 'enasu kamiyaawequte dakaamaanaa waraadaa kahona fasaashe nawe yafatharenaacawe. laraasaacawe theqeme maamethaatenaa gudaate makalaakalene yamaayecelu dakaamoce naacawe. 'enedeete yekoraalu?
'alaahe yatzahhaaye;yacharaqaa 'enedihume yaleeloce kaawaakebete yahonute meseraaqocenaa yame`eraaboceme geetaa bahonawe baraasu bamamaale 'enyaa caayoce nane;yelaale.
'enyaa 'enasune 'athefetane ba'alaahe bamiyaamenu sawoce malawathe (matakaate) yamiyaaqetane 'enaa yameneshanafe 'ayedalaneme. 'enyaa 'enasune maathefaatenaa maqayarene senefalege 'enaadaregawaalane.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enasune baalubate themeetenaa weshate laaye tawaacawe. baqure'aane wesethe yatagabaalaacawe yaqethaate qaalene batenesaa'eewe qane 'esekiyaaganyu derase baduneyaa heyewataacawe yechaawatu.
wada qoma melekete fatheno lamaderase 'enedamisheqadaadame sawe honawe kamaqaaberocaacawe bafethenate bamiwathubate qane;
`aayenocaacawe yaafaranaa weredate yatakanaanabu honawe; yaa qane duneyaa wesethe banabarubate gizee qaale yatagabaalaacawe nawe. 'enasu gene meneme tekurate 'ayesathuteme nabare.

nuhhene: hhezebocu kaalubate ba'alaahe laaye yamaagaaraate 'emenate saabiyaa 'asaamaami yahonawe qethaate saayemathaabaacawe 'aseqademo bamaasethaneqaqe wada 'alaahe theri 'enediyaadaregelaacawe laakenawe.
nuhheme lahhezebu 'enee wada 'alaahe yamaatemalasu kahona kamithabeqaacehu qethaate bageletze yamaasethanaqeqaacehu 'asethaneqaaqi nanye 'alaacawe.
'alaahene becaa tagazu. basu laaye meneme 'ataagaaru, ya'esune te`ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'esune ferute 'enee yamaazaacehuneme nagare taazazunye.

yehene yametaadaregu kahona kasawoce mabete gaare yaaletayaayaazawene hathi'ate yemerelaacexwaale. yawaganocaacehuneme `edemee ba'alaahe `eweqate 'esekatawasanawe `elate derase yaarazemaale. bazihe 'aqwaame laaye 'esekaalaacehume derase bamedere laaye nawaariwoce bamahone mederene taganabaalaacehu. yehunenaa mote kamathaa maazageyate yalame. yehenene 'ewenataa betaawequ noro yaalaacehubatene yamaagaaraatenaa yathemate tagebaare tetaacehu ba'alaahe wada maamanenaa wada neseha tethaadafu nabare.
nuhheme geetaayee hoye! <<'enee hhezeboceene wada 'aneta 'anedenatenaa 'amelekote leete taqane yaalamaaqwaarathe tharaaxwaacawe>> 'ala.
theriyee ka'ewenate mashashenenaa maraaqene 'eneji meneme 'alechamaralaacaweme.

'enee 'anetane becaa bamaamelake, bamataazazenaa male'eketanyaahene bamataazaze maaretaane wada miyaaganyubate batharaaxwaacawe gizee 'ewenatune laalamaadaamathe jorowocaacawene dafanu, 'eneeneme laalamaayate balebese tashafaafanu yaalubateneme kehedateme gafubate. 'ewenatune laalamaqabaleme koru.
geetaayee hoye! kazaa baxwaalaame bayefaanaa bageletzeme tharaaxwaacawe.
demetzeeneme kafe 'aderegee, bamisethereme demetzeeneme zeqe 'aderegee 'enedihume yatalayaayu seletocene bamathaqame tharaaxwaacawe.
'enediheme 'alekwaacawe geetaacehune wada 'esu nesehha bamaaderage maaretaane thayequte. 'esu wada 'esu yamimalasutene baaroce mahari nawenaa.
yehenene kaadaragaacehu bafalagaacehute gizee takataataaye yahona zenaabe yaawaredelaacexwaale. dereqeme 'ayaagaathemaacehume.

barekaataa ganezabenaa lejocene yesathaacexwaale. yametemagabute yahonane ya'azere`ete botaa yaadaregelaacexwaale. yametethathubatene 'enaa kabetocaacehune 'enedihume 'azere`etocaacehune yametaathathubate wanezoce yaadaregelaacexwaale.
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! mene naketwacehu nawe ya'alaahene taalaaqenate yamaatefarute! 'esune bagedeyalashenate yametaametzute.
'esu baregetheme batalayaayu kxidatoce (kazare fasaashe, karagaa dame, yataanyaka kamimasele segaa wazata.) fatherwacehu 'eyaala.
lamahonu 'alaahe sabaate samaayaatene 'anedu ba'anedu laaye yatadaraaraba sihonu yafathara mahonune 'ataawequmene?!
charaqaane samaaye laaye 'aderego lamedere nawaariwoce 'enedetaabaraa 'enedihume yatzahhayene berehaane wagage yaala xaayelanyaa maberaate 'enedinorawe 'adaraga.
'abaataacehu 'adamene ka'afare bamafethare 'enaanetane kamedere fatharaacehu. kaziyaame yehece medere kametaabaqelawe temagabaalaacehu.
kamotaacehu baxwaalaa wada medere yemalesaacexwaale. qathelome batenesaa'eewe qane ka'ereswa maleso yaasewathaacexwaale.
'alaahe mederene lamanoriyaa yatamacaacacenaa yatazagaajace 'aderego zaragaalaacehu.
yeheneneme yaadaragawe safiwene yamedere magwaagwaazhaa manegadocene tathaqemaacehu yatafaqadalaacehune sisaayaacehune lamaafalaalage yemacaacehu zanede nawe.

nuhheme geetaayee 'anetane becaa 'enediyaamalekunaa 'enedigazu baazazekwaacawe gizee 'amatzubenye. taraa yamibaalu sawoceme 'enaziyaane ganezabenaa leje bamasethate malekaame tzagaahene yacarekaacawene mariwocaacawene takatalu. yehe yalagasekaacawe tzagaa keseratene 'eneji 'alechamaralaacaweme. baduneyaa themeetene 'enedihume ba'akxiraame qethaatene chamaralaacawe.
kabareteewoceme zeqetanyaa darajaa yaalaacawene sawoce banuhhe laaye bamaanasaasaate taalaaqe yahonane seeraa 'aseeru.
latakataayocaacaweme 'amaaleketocaacehune maamelake 'enedaatetawe. thaa`otocaacehune 'eneda "wade", "suwaa`e", "yagusze", "ya`uqe" 'enedihume "nasere"yaalutene magazaate 'enedaatetawu 'alwacawe.
banazihe thaa`otocaacawe bezu sawocene 'asaasaatu ('athamamu). geetaayee hoye! 'enazihene bakehedatenaa bathemeete laaye yaalutene badaayoce themeete 'eneji leelaa 'atechamerelaacawe.

baszarute mathefo szeraawocaacaweme mekeneyaate bazihe `aalame bagorefe 'enedisathemu tadaragu. kamotu baxwaalaame wadiyaawe 'esaate 'enedigabu tadaraga. kamasethamenaa ka'esaatu 'adagaa ka'alaahe wechi liyaadenaacawe yamicele radaate 'alaaganyume.

'alaahe lanuhhe: kaamanute hhezebocehe wechi maaneme kazihe baxwaalaa yamiyaamene yalame belo sinageraacawe. nuhheme geetaa hoye! kakahadiwoce bamedere laaye 'enedalebu yamineqasaaqasenaa yamizawaaware 'anedeme 'enedaataaseqare belo tamaatzana.

'aneta geetaayee hoye! betaaseqaraacawenaa betaaqoyaacawe me`emanaane baarocehene yaathamemaalu. 'enazihe sawoca 'anetane yamaayetaazazu thamaamoce 'enaa 'anetane yamaayaamasagenu kahadine nawe yamiwaledute.

geetaayee hoye! maaranye, walaajoceeneme maaraacawe, 'amaanye hono 'enee beete yagabaanenaa me'emanaanenaa me'emanaaneteneme hulu maaraacawe. nafesaacawene bakehedatenaa bahathi'ate yabadalutene sawoce thefaatenenaa keseratene 'eneji 'atechamerelaacawe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lahhezebocehe <<geetaayee yagaaneenoce sebesebe qure'aanene maadaamathaacawene raa`eye 'awaradalenye>> balaacawe. yehe yahonawe 'nakxelaa' shalaqo sihone wada hhezebocaacaweme batamalasu gizee 'enyaa ba'agalaalatzunaa batheraatu yamidaneqe yahona qure'aane 'adaamathene 'alwacawe.
yehe yaadamathenawe negegere ba'emenate, banegegerenaa batagebaare sitaaye 'ewenate bamahonu 'amenane taqabelanaale. bageetaaceneme 'ameleko laaye maaneneme 'anaagaaraame.
yageetaacene leqenaanaa taalaaqenate kafe yaala nawe ba'esume 'amenanaale. geetaacene miseteme, lejeme 'aleyaazame. kazihe yalaaqanaa yatharaa geetaa nawe.
belise (shayethwane) 'alaahe (theraate yatagabaawe geetaa) misetenaa leje 'alawe bamaalate 'ejege yatasaasaata negegere yenaagare nabare.
yasawenaa ya'agaanenete 'agaariwoce 'alaahe lejenaa misete 'alawe belawe simogetu 'ayewaashume belane bamaasabe negegeraacawene 'amenane taqabelane bachefene takatelanaacawe nabare.

bamaayemenate zamane kasawoce yamiyaasefaraa botaa bamigabubate gizee kagaaneenoce thebaqaane bamathayaqe 'anedaacawe <<bazihe shalaqo wesethe kaalu tanekolanyoce, kajinoce 'alaqaa 'ethabaqaalahu>> yelaale. baziheme gizee gaaneenocu basawoce laaye yabalatha ferehatenenaa sheberene chamarubaacawe.
'enaaneta gaaneenoce hoye! 'enaaneta 'alaahe kamote baxwaalaa lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa maaneneme 'ayeqasaqeseme belaacehu 'enedatatharaatharaacehu hulu sawoceme 'enedanaanetawe tatharaatharu.

yasamaayene waree lamaadaamathe falagene daaru gene samaaye laaye wathetane 'enesareqe yanabarawene waree maseraqe 'enedaanecele bamalaa'eketoce thanekaaraa thebaqaa yatamolaace honaa 'aganyanaate. 'enedazihume wada samaaye bamiqarebe hulu laaye yamitakose tafanaathaari 'esaate (cebo) yatamolaace honaalace.

kazihe bafite samaaye laaye botaa yezane malaa'eketoce yamiqabaabalutene waree 'enaadaamethenaa medere laaye lamiganyute thaneqwaayoce 'enenagere nabare. 'ahune gene nagaru taqayero ka'ahune baxwaalaa lamaadaamathe yamiheedutene lamametaate yatazagaaja taqathaathaaye 'esaate bamanoru wada 'ezaa yaqaraba hulu yelaqaqebatenaa yaaqathelawaale.

'enyaa yazihe beretu thebaqaa mekeneyaate mene 'enedahona 'anaaweqame. medere laaye baalu fethuraane laaye mathefo nagare taasebo yehune wayese geetaacawe 'alaahe malekaame nagare shetolaacawe 'enedahona 'enyaa 'anaaweqeme yasamaayu waree taqwaarethobenaale.

'enyaa gaaneenoce yehenene kamakaakalaacene 'alaahene yamifaraanaa 'esune yamitaazaze yaala sihone kahadinaa ka'alaahe te`ezaaze yaafanagathame yeganyaale. 'enyaa yatalayaayu `aayenatocenaa batalayaayu 'asetasaasaboce laaye 'eneganyaalane.
'enyaa 'alaahe banyaa laaye 'anedene nagare kafalaga yamaanaamalethawe mahonune 'eregethanyaa honene. basu quthethere sere bamahonaacene shashetane 'anaamalethaweme.

'enyaa wada qathetanyaa manegade yamimaraawene qure'aanene basamaane gizee 'amenanaale. bageetaawe yaamana 'enaho 'esu kamalekaame szeraawe yeqanasebenyaale 'enedihume yaaleszaraawe hathi'ate yechamarebenyaale belo segaate 'ayegabaaweme.

kanyaa makaakale la'alaahe 'eje bamasethate yasalamunaa te`ezaazune yamiyaakaberu sinoru leelocu dagemo kaqathetanyaawe ya'alaahe manegade yaazanabalu naacawe. la'alaahe te'ezaaze yatanaanasunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru 'enasu qathetanyaa 'ewenatanyaa manegadene 'aganyu.
kaqathetanyaawenaa 'ewenatanyaawe manegade yaazanabalu 'agaanenetoce: 'eneda 'enasu yahonute kahadi sawoce lajahaname maaqathaathayaa maagado honu.

yatawasanu 'agaanenetoce mathetawe qure'aane maadaamathaacawene batamalakata raa`eye 'enedatalaalafalenye hulu sawocenaa 'agaanenetoce baselaame laaye bitzanunaa bamamariyaawe batekekele biszaru noro 'alaahe kasamaaye laaye barekaataa wehanaa yatalayaayu tzagaawocene yelagesaacawe 'enedanabare raa`eye waredolenyaale.

ya'alaahene tzagaa ba'ewene bamesegaanaa yeqabalaalu wayese bakehedate? yamilawene lifatenaacawe falego nawe. qure'aanenaa mekerocune yaraaqa sawe: geetaawe lishakamawe yamaayecelawe qethaate wesethe yaasegabaawaale.

masegidoce ya'alaahe becaa naacawenaa ka'alaahe gaare maaneneme 'enedaatetharu ('enedaatemaatzanu) mekeneyaatume yehudocenaa naswaraawoce ya'ameleko botaacawene ka'alaahe wechi laala 'akaalaate 'enedaadaragute tehonaalaacehu.

ya'alaahe baariyaa muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) geetaawene lamagazaate 'nakxelaa' shalaqo laaye baqoma gizee: gaaneenoce qure'aanene lamaadaamathe bamagaafaate balaayu laaye liwathubate (linabaabarubate) qarebawe nabare.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! la'agaariwocu <<'enee geetaayeene becaa nawe yamegazaawe basu 'ameleko laaye maaneneme 'alechamereme>> balaacawe.
<<'enee 'alaahe lanaaneta yawasanabaacehune gudaate lekalaakalelaacehu 'enedihume 'alaahe 'enedaatethaqamubate yakalakalaacehune theqeme laamathaalaacehu 'aleceleme>> balaacawe.
<<'enee 'alaahe laaye baametze kasu maaneme 'ayaadenanyeme. kasu wecheme yamethagaabate mathagiyaa 'alaaganyeme>> balaacawe.

nagare gene 'enee laadaregawe yamecelawe nagare binore 'enedaadarese yaazazanyene male'ekete maaderase becaa nawe. 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene yamiyaametze hulu mamalashaawe wada jahaname 'esaate sihone 'esaate wesethe lazalaalame kaswa saayewathaa yezawateraale.

yaa baduneyaa honawe qaale yatagabaawene ya'akxiraa qethaate 'esekiyaayu derase: kahadiyaane kakehedataacawe 'ayewagadume. baziheme gizee radaatu dakaamaanaa baquthere 'anaasaa yahonawe maane 'enedahona saayaawequte 'ayeqarume.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lanazihe 'agaariwocenaa batenesaa'ee lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce <<qaale yatagabaawe qethaate qerebe yehune wayeme 'alaahe 'eneji maaneme yamaayaaweqawe yagizee gadabe yenurawe 'alaaweqeme>> balaacawe.
'alaahe yawadafitune `eweqate `aawaaqi meneme yamaayedabaqebate nawe. yehenene maaneneme 'ayaasaaweqeme baraasu laaye becaa yatagadaba nawe.

nagare gene 'esu lawadadawe male'eketanyaa becaa maasaawaqe yafalagawene yaasaaweqawaale. yehenene siyaasaaweqawe maaneme 'enedaayaaweqawe kafite lafitume kaxwaalaawume thabaaqi malaa'eketocene yelekelataale.

male'eketanyaawe kasu bafite yanabarute male'eketanyoce yageetaacawene te'ezaaze bamigabaa maaderasaacawene 'enedihume 'alaahe ba`eweqatu huluneme yaakaababanaa meneme yamaayedabaqebate mahonune 'enaa 'eyaanedaanedu nagare baquthere yaathaqaalala 'enedahona 'enediyaaweqe nawe.
'aneta balebese yatakanaanabekawe sawe hoye! (nabiyu muhhamadene /salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) lamaalate nawe.
kameshetu yatawasana sa`aate baqare lalitune basegedate 'asaalefe.
kafalageke gemaashune wayeme kagemaashu teneshe qanesahe 'anede szosetanyaawene segade.
wayeme hulate szosetanyaa 'esekihone chamerebate; qure'aaneneme setaanabe geletze 'aderegahenaa ragaa belahe 'anebebe.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enyaa bawesethu gedeetaawoce denegaageewoce sere`aatene 'enaa yamasaasalu mamariyaawocene yayaaza bamahonu kabaade yahonawene negegerene qure'aanene baaneta laaye 'enaawaredaalane.
yalalite waqete qure'aanene bamulu lebe batamasetho lamaanebabenaa tekekelanyaa du`aame lamaaderage 'ejege tasemaami waqete nawe.
yaqanu kefela-gizee laszeraa maneqasaaqashaahe waqete nawe. bamahonume qure'aanene (kamaanebabe) yamiyaazanagaa selahona lalite segade.
'alaahene batalayaayu yawedaasee `aayenatoce 'awesaa. wada 'esume 'amelekotene la'eresu becaa bamaaderageme mulu bamulu bataamaanyenatenaa baqenenate 'amelekawe.
yameseraaqunaa yame`eraabu geetaa; kasu weche ba'ewenate yamilake 'amelaake yalame. bagudaayocehe laaye hulu ba'esu laaye tamakaa.
kahadiyaane yamisanazerubehene sedebenenaa maashofene taagase. gudaate yaleelabatene mataweneme tawaacawe.
baduneyaa bataterafarafute sawoce gudaaye 'atechanaqe. yanasune gudaaye lanee tawawe. gizeeyaacawe 'esekidareseme teneshe gizee thabeqaacawe.
'enyaa zanede batenesaa'eewe qane kabaade maasariyaa gamade 'enaa baxaayele yameteqathaathale 'esaate tazagaajetwale.
maraaraa kamahonu yatanasaa kaguroro yamaayewarede yahona megebe 'enaa 'asaamaami yahona qethaate kaalafawe batachamaari 'ala.
yehe qethaate mederenaa taraaroce baxaayele bamineqathaqathubate gizee yekasataale. taraaroce kaqanu kebedate yatanasaa lasalaasaa yamifase 'ashawaa yehonaalu.
'enyaa musaane wada fire`owene 'enedalaakenawe hulu batenesaa'eewe qane banaaneta szeraawoce laaye yamimasakere yahonane male'eketanyaa lekanaale.

fire`owene ka'alaahe yatalaakalatene male'eketanyaane 'asetabaabala. bamaasetabaabalume bamaasemathe kabaade qethaatene qathanaawe. ba'akxiraame ba'esaate 'eneqathaawaalane. 'enaanetame male'eketanyaacehu laaye 'ataametzu ba'enasu laaye yadarasawe `aayenate qethaate yedaresebaacexwaale.

ba'alaahe yametekedunaa bamale'eketanyaawe yamaataamenu kahona 'enedeete kabaadenaa razheme 'enedihume qanu kabaade kamahonu yatanasaa lejoce shebataame bamihonubate qane raasaacehune maadaane tecelaalaacehune?!
samaaye kaqanu kebedate yatanasaa tesanathaathaqaalace. ya'esu qaale tafatsaami kamahone qerote yalaweme.

yehece tenesaa'eenenaa kaswa gaare tayaayaazhe yahonute kabaade huneetaawocene yametegaletze 'amaanyoce yamimakarubaate tagesaatze naate. wada geetaawe maderasene yafalaga yageetaawene manegade yezo yegwaaze.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe 'aneta kalalite 'anedaanedee kahulate szosetanyaa yaanasa, 'anedaanedee gemaashune, leelaa gizee dagemo 'anede szosetanyaawene 'enedameteqome; ka'amaanyoceme yatawasanu 'enedamiqomu yaaweqaale. lalitunenaa qanune yamiwasanawenaa yamimathenawe 'esu nawe. 'alaahe 'enaaneta qanunenaa lalitune batekekele 'enedamaatemathenutenaa 'enedamaatelakute yaaweqaale. bamahonume kamifalagawe balaaye bamaqome 'enedaatecagaru bamaasabe nesehacehune taqabalaacehu. selazihe kalalite yagaraalaacehune segadu. batachamaarime kanaaneta makaakale yamitaamamu, sisaayene felagaa yamigwaazu, ba'alaahe manegade laaye thalaatocene bamataagale ya'alaahene wedeetaa lamaagenyatenaa ya'alaahene qaale kafe lamaaderage yamilafu bamanoraacawe mekeneyaate kalalite yacaalaacehutene segadu. gedeetaawi salaatene gene batamwalaa maleku segadu. gedeetaawi metzewaateneme sethu. kaganezabaacehu ba'alaahe manegade laayeme 'awethu. lanafesaacehu yametaaseqademute malekaame nagare hulu 'alaahe zanede malekaamenaa yatashaala hono taaganyutaalaacehu. ka'alaahe maaretaane thayequ 'esu wada 'esu lamimalasu hulu maharinaa 'azaanye nawe.
'aneta balebese yatashafaafanekawe hoye! (nabiyu muhhamadene /salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame nawe)
tanasenaa ya'alaahene qethaate 'asefaraaraa.
geetaaheneme 'aleqe.
lebehene kawanejale, lebesehene dagemo kanajaasaa 'atheraa.
kathaa`ote 'amelekome raaqe.
yameteszaraawene malekaame szeraa 'eneda bezu 'aderegahe bamaquthare bageetaahe laaye 'atematsaadaqe.
yamiyaagaathemehene cegere hulu la'alaahe setele taagase.
baqanedume yahulatanyaawe nefi batanafaa gizee;
yaa qane kabaade qane nawe.
'alaahenenaa male'eketanyocene bakaadute laaye qalaale 'ayedalame.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! kaala ganezabenaa leje becaawene yafatharekutene walide benule mugiraane gudaaye 'eseti lanee tawawe.
bezu ganezabe yaadaragekulatene.
barekaataa ganezabe selaalawe baguzoweme waqete 'enekwaa saayeqare: bayabotaawe 'ajebawete kasu yamaayelayu lejoceneme 'adaragekulate.
batalayaayu nagaroce nurowene, sisaayenenaa lejocene badanebe 'amacaacanelate.
'eneene kamakaadu batachamaari yaane hulu kasathahute baxwaalaa chemaarine yefalegaale.
'esu 'enedamiyaasebawe 'ayedalame! bamale'eketanyaacene laaye yaawaradenawe 'aneqatzocaacene takaraakaarinaa 'asetabaabaaye nawe.
lishakamawe yamaayecelawe kabaade qethaate 'ashakemawaalahu.
'enazihene tzagaa yawaalekulate kahadi qure'aanene wedeqe lamaaderage yaminaagarawene maabesalesale tayaayaaza. maalate yaalabateneme bawesethu wasana.
taragama 'enedihume taqathaa 'enedeete wasana;
'ahuneme taragama 'enedihume taqathaa 'enedeete wasana.
lamilawe nagare 'ahuneme 'awathaa 'awarada.
qure'aanene yamitacebate nagare baalamaagenyatu yatanasaa fitune 'achafagaga, 'akosaatarame.
kazaa baxwaalaa ka'emenate zore 'ala. male'eketanyaawene kamakataleme koraa.
qathelome yehe muhhamade (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yezote yamathaawe negegere ya'alaahe negegere 'ayedalame yelequnese 'esu kaleelaa yamiyaamathaawe degemete nawe 'ala.
yehe ya'alaahe negegere saayehone yasawe negegere nawe: 'ala.
yehenene kahadi ka'esaate 'erekane 'anedu yahonawene "saqare" qaathalowene 'enediqamese 'asegabaawaalahu.
'aneta muhhamade hoye! "saqare" mene 'enedahona mene 'asaawaqahe?!

bawesethwa yamiqathaawene sawe meneme nagarune saataaseqare hulamanaawene bamaaqaathaleme meneme yametaaseqarawe nagare yalame. kaziyaame wada nabarabate yemalasaale. malesaa badegaamime taaqaathelawaalace. baziheme maleku qethaatu yeqathelaale.
'ejege 'aqaathaayenaa qodaane yameteqayere naate.
baswa laaye 'aseraa zathanye malaa'eketoce tamadebawaale. 'enaziheme ya'esaate zaboce naacawe.

ya'esaate thabaaqiwocene malaa'eketoce 'eneji leelaa 'alaadarageneme. sawoce banasu laaye meneme xaayele yalaacaweme. qutheraacawene 'enedihe yaadaragenawe kahadiyaanene lamafatane 'enaa yaalutene belawe qethaatu yedaraarabebaacawe zanede nawe. taweraate yatasathaacawe yehudocenaa nejile yatasathaacawe nasaaraawoceme qure'aane wesethe yatagalatzawe kamatsehhafaacawe gaare kaalawe yamigatheme bamahonu 'enediyaamenu; me'emanaaneme male`eketu kamatsaahhefete baalabeetoce gaare selamisemaamaa 'emenataacawe babalatha 'enedichamere lebocaacawe wesethe bashetaa yaalabaacawe manaafeqaanenaa kahadiyaane 'alaahe bazihe 'asegaaraami quthere mene falego nawe? 'enedilu. bazihe gudaaye yathamamute 'enedathamamunaa yaamanaweme 'enedaamana hulu 'alaahe maasaasaate yafalagawene yaasaasetaale. qanaawene manegade mameraatene yafalagawene yemaraale. yageetaahene szaraawite kabezaataacawe yatanasaa qutheraacawene kasu basetaqare maaneme 'ayaaweqaweme: yehece 'esaate 'eko ya'alaahene taalaaqenate lamiyaawequbaate mamakariyaa tagesaatzeme 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaceme.
nagaru 'anedaanede 'agaariwoce 'eneenaa waganocee 'enazihene ya'esaate thabaaqiwocene ka'esaate zore bamaaderage 'ebaqaacexwaalahu 'enedaalawe 'ayedalame. bacharaqaa 'emelaalahu.
laliteme bamiheedebate gizee 'emelaalahu.
negaateme wagage belo bamaaberaatu kxidateme 'emelaalahu.
yajahaname 'esaateme kataalaalaaqe 'adagaawoce 'anedwa naate.
lasawoce maasethaneqaqiyaanaa maasefaraariyaame naate.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! yehe maasefaraariyaanaa maasethaneqaqiyaa ba'alaahe 'amenonaa malekaamene bamaszeraate maqedame lamifalegenaa bakehedatenaa hathi'atene bamaszeraate wada xwaalaa maqerate lamifalege chemere nawe.
'eyaanedaanedwa nafese baszeraawaa tathayaaqi naate. yehe szeraawaa lathefaate yedaaregaataale 'aliyaame kathefaatenaa ka'adagaa madaanyaanaa makalaakayaa yehonaale.
nagare gene 'amaanyoce bahathi'ataacawe 'ayeyaazume. yelequnese yaasaalafute malekaame szeraa selaalaacawe hathi'ataacawe yetaalafelaacawaale (yeqere yebaalaalu).
me'emanaane batenesaa'eewe qane bajanate wesethe honawe 'erese baresaacawe yethayaayaqaalu.
nafesaacawene bahathi'ate yaathafu selahonute kahadiyaane;
me'emanaane lakahadiyaane jahaname yamagebiyaacehu mekeneyaate menedene nawe? belawe yethayeqwaacawaale.
kahadiyaaneme duneyaa banabarenebate gizee gedeetaa yahonacewene salaate bamigabaa maleku 'anesagedeme nabara bamaalate yemalesulaacawaale.
'alaahe kasathane sisaaye dehocene 'anemagebeme nabare.
'enyaa thamaamaa kahonu sawoce gaare bagabubate hulu 'enegabaa 'enedihume kathamaamaawocenaa 'amatzanyoceme gaare yalebaacenene 'enaawaraame nabare.
yamenedaaweneme qane 'enaasetabaabele nabare.
bazihe thememate laaye 'eyaalane mote mathaabene. neseha lamagebaate `edele 'alaaganyaneme.

batenesaa'eewe qane yamalaa'ekete, yamale'eketanyoce 'enaa yadagaage baaroce melejaa 'ayethaqemaacaweme. mekeneyaatume kamelejaa masefaretoce 'anedu melejaa yatathayaqalatene 'akaale 'alaahe liwadelate yegabaalenaa.
'enazihe 'agaariwoce kaqure'aane gesaatzee lamene yereqaalu?!
yasheshetaacawe (yaalamaqabalaacawe) huneetaa bathaame yadanabarace yameedaa 'aheyaane yemaselaalu;
ka'anebasaa faretaa 'eneda danabarace.

yelequnese 'enazihe 'agaariwoce 'eneyaanedaanedaacawe muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa mahonaacawene yaminageraacawe baraasegeeyaacawe laaye yamiqamathe geletze matsehhafe yefalegaalu. yeheneneme silu yamaaserajaa maanase wayeme yamaasaamanyaa dekemate noro saayehone yelequnese kuraatenaa geteretanyenate nawe.
nagaru 'enedihe 'ayedalame! yelequnese 'enasu bathemeetaacawe laaye getere bamahonaacawe 'enaa bamacharashaawe qane baalamaamane kehedataacawe laaye bamaqerataacawe nawe.
maasaasabiyaa! nequ! yehe qure'aane tagesaatzenaa mekere nawe.
qure'aanene 'anebebo mamakarenaa magasatze lafalaga yemakarebataale.

baziheme mamakare wayeme limakaru yamicelute 'alaahe 'enedimaru yafalagalaacawe becaa naacawe. 'esu ya'esune te`ezaaze bamaakebarenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale lifarute yamigabaa 'enaa wada 'esu latamalasu (nesehha lagabu) yameherate baalabeete nawe yemeraacawaale.
sawoce la`aalamaate geetaa bamiqomubate batenesaa'eewe qane 'alaahe yemelaale.

malekaame szeraa baalamaszeraatwanaa mathefo szeraa bamaszeraatwa mekeneyaate raaswane bametewaqese theru bahonace nafese 'emelaalahu. banazihe hulate nagaroce yamaalawe kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasenaa hulume baszaraawe szeraa yamimanadaa mahonune lamagelatze nawe.
lamahonu yasawe leje kamota baxwaalaa yatabataatanawe 'athenetune yamaanesabasebe 'aderego yaasebaalene?
'ayedalame 'enyaa 'enecelaalane. kamasabesabaaceneme batachamaari yathaatocaacawene chaafe 'enedanabara 'asetakaakalane 'enemalesawaalane.
yelequnese yasawe leje bathemeetu laaye wadafite maqaseqasene bamaasetabaabale maqathalene yefalegaale.
sela tenesaa'eewe 'enedamaayehone bamaasabe tenesaa'eewe macee nawe yametekasatawe bamaalate yethayeqaale?
kazihe bafite siyaasetabaabelawe yanabarawene batachabaache simalakatenaa `aayenoce yawaalalunaa yadanagathu gizee.
yacharaqaa berehaane bathafaa gizee,
yacharaqaa 'akaale baanede laaye sichafalaqu;
thamaamaa yahona sawe bazaane qane wadeete nawe yamishashawe?! yelaale.
baziyaane qane mashashaa yalame! thamaamaawe sawe yamithagaabate mathagiyaa 'enaa yamithabaqebateme mathabaqiyaame yalaweme.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! bazaane qane lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa mamalashaawe wada geetaahe nawe.
yasawe leje baziyaane qane yaaseqadamawenenaa wadaxwaalaa yaazagayawe nagare yenagarawaale.
yelequnese yasawe leje baraasu laaye masekaari nawe. 'eyaanedaanedu yasawenate kefele sela szaraawe hathi'ate yemasakeraale.
lanafesu mathefo szeraane 'enedaaleszaraa bamakaraakare mekeneyaatoce biyaaqarebeme 'ayethaqemaweme.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! qure'aane lithafaabenye yecelaale belahe bamaasabe melaasehene 'ataaneqasaaqese.
balebehe wesetheme 'enedisabasabe ('enedisafere) 'enaa nebaabume melaasehe laaye 'eneditzanaa maaderagu ya'enyaa xaalaafinate nawe.
jiberile 'anebebo 'esekicharese derase bathemonaa nebaabune 'ademethe.
kazaa baxwaalaa maaberaaraatunaa magelatzu banyaa laaye nawe.

takalekalu! kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase yamaayetaasabe nagare nawe yametelute tekekele 'ayedalame! 'enaanetane bamajamariyaa maaseganyate yacaala kamotaacehu baxwaalaa maqaseqase 'enedamaayaaqetawe taaweqaalaacehu. nagare gene batenesaa'ee lamaasetabaabale telequ mekeneyaataacehu lebaacehu bazihece qerebitu `aalame bawedeetaa yatanethalathala bamahonu nawe.
yamacharashaayetuneme hagare celaa bamaalataacawe nawe. yamacharashaayetume hagare yameteganyawe ya'alaahene te'ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale nawe.
yame'emanaanenaa ya'edelanyoce fitoce bazaane qane bathaame yaabaru yehonaalu.
geetaacaweneme yemalakataalu. baziheme yedasataalu.
yakahadiyaanenaa ya`edela bise fitoce yaachafagagu yehonaalu.
kabaadenaa 'asaamaami qethaate yewaredebenyaale belawe 'eregethanyaa yehonaalu.
nagaru 'agaariwoce kamotene baxwaalaa 'aneqathaame 'enedamilute 'ayedalame! nafese kadarate 'alefaa guroro laaye badarasace gizee;
'erese ba'eresaacaweme yehe sawe yedene zanede maanenawe yamiyaakemawe yebaabaalaalu.
baziheme gizee tzaa`era mote laaye yaalawe sawe yehecene `aalame bamote 'enedamilayaate 'eregethanyaa yehonaale.
baduneyaa fetsaameenaa ba'akxiraa jemaaree laaye makaraawoce 'enaa cegeroce ba'anede laaye yehonebataale.
yehe batafatzama gizee mwacu wada geetaawe yemalasaale.
yehe kahadi male'eketanyaawe baamathaawe 'alaamana lageetaaweme 'alesagada!
yelequnese male'eketanyaawe yaamathaawene nagare 'asetabaabala celaame 'ala.
kaziyaame yehe kahadi 'eyatanethabaarara wada beetasabu heeda.
'alaaheme yehenene kahadi qethaatu 'enedaqaraba 'enaa 'enedamidaresebate yazaacaa qaale gabaalate.
lamahonu yasawe lejene 'alaahe yaala haayemaanotaawi denegaageenaa mamariyaa 'enedihu yamitawawe yemaselawaalene?
yehe sawe ka`elataate 'anede qane maahetsane wesethe yamifase yazare fasaashe 'alenabaramene?
kazaa baxwaalaa yaragaa quraache dame 'adaragawe, qathelome 'alaahe fatharawe, sifatheraweme 'asetakaakalo fatharawe.
karaasume gosaa hulate `aayenate tzotaawocene wanedenenaa seetene fathara.
lamahonu yehenene sawe kazare fasaashenaa karagaa dame yafatharane geetaa mutaanene 'enedagadala lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa maqaseqase 'ayecelemene? yecelaale.
yasawe leje saayefatharenaa saayetaawase bezu zamanaate 'alefwale.

bamale'eketanyocaacene 'anedabate qathetanyaawene manegade galatzenelate. baziheme maszarate yathemeete manegademe tagalatzalate. kazihe baxwaalaa qathetanyaawene manegade bamakatale 'amasegaanyenaa 'amaanye wayeme yatasaasaatawene manegade bamakatale 'asetabaabaaye kahadi yehonaale.

'alaahe qathetanyaawe manegade laaye yamigwaazutenenaa yathamamutene kagalatza baxwaalaa menedaacaweneme sigaletze 'enedihe yelaale::
lanaziyaa 'alaahenaa male'eketanyocene lakaadu sawoce yamigotatubaacawene sanesalatoce, 'anegataacawe laaye yamithaleqe maaszariyaanaa yatagaagaamace 'esaatene 'azagaajetanaale.
'alaahene yamitaazazu me'emanaane batenesaa'eewe qane theru ma'aazaa yaalawe "kaafure" bamibaale mathathe yatabaraza wayene thaje yethathaalu.
yehe 'alaahene lamifarute sawoce yatazagaajawe mathathe baqalaalu lamathaathaate mecu, barekaataanaa yamaayaaqwaarethe meneche nawe.
yehecene mathathe yamithathwate baaroce baaheriyaacawe baraasaacawe laaye gedeetaa yaadaragutene nagare yamiyaamwalunaa kefu nagaru yamisaraachebatene yatenesaa'eewene qane yamifaru naacawe.
dehocene, walaajocaacawe balejenate gizee yamotubaacawene (yatimocene) 'enaa merekonyocene laraasaacawe 'eyafalagutenaa 'eyawadadute megebene yamimagebu naacawe.
bathaame 'asedanegaachenaa kabaade kamahonu yatanasaa thamaamaawoce fitaacawe chefegege yamilebate qane 'enedaayaawaaredane geetaacenene 'enefaraalane.
'alaahe baterufaatu kaziyaa taalaaqenaa kefu qane thabaqaacawe. batachamaarime 'enasune bamaakebareme fitaacawene geremaa mogasenaa berehaane, lebaacawene dagemo yawesethe dasetaane lagasaacawe.
ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatzame, kamaamatze bamaraaqe 'enedihume 'alaahe bawasanawe nagare laaye bamataagasaacawe mekeneyaate yamidasatubaate janatene 'enaa yamilabesutene hhare manadaacawe.

webenaa yaageethu bahonu 'alegaawoce laaye tadagagefawe. bajanate wesethe yamigodaacawe yahona yatzahhaye charare 'enaa kabaade qezeqaazee 'ayaayume. yelequnese qwaami thelaa hono muqate 'enaa qezeqaazee yaleelawe thelaa sere naacawe.
thelaawaame wada 'enasu yaqaraba nawe. qathefo mabelaate lafalaga sawe baqalaalu maqethafe yecele zanede fereewocwa yatamacaacu naacawe. yataqamathame hona yaqoma sawe mabelaate yecelaale.
mathathe kaasanyaacaweme 'agalegaayocaacawe yabere serite yahonu `eqaawocene 'enaa theraate yaalawe mathachiyaawocene yezawe ba'enasu laaye yezawaawaraalu.
kubaayaawocu seritaacawe yabere hono saala katheraataacawe yatanasaa masetaawate yemaselaalu. bamifaleguteme leke tamatheno saayechamerenaa saayeqanese yemathaalaacawaale.
'enazihe yatakabaru sawoce ba"zenejebele" yatabaraza yawayene thaje yethathaalu.
janate wesethe kamiganye "salesabile" kamibaale meneche yegonachaalu.

wathaatenate yamaayelayaacawe lejoceme 'enasune lamaagalegale bamakaakalaacawe yezawaawaraalu. kamalekaacawe maamaare, kafitaacawe theraatenaa kabezaataacawe 'enedihume bayabotaawe tabataatenawe setaayaacawe yatabatana lule yemaseluhale.
janateme wesethe yaalawene nagare setaaye letegaletzawe yamaatecelawene yatzagaa `aayenate taaganyaalahe. meneme yamaayewadaadarawe teleqe gezaateneme temalakataalahe.
kalaaye sawenataacawe laaye yaarafawe lebesaacawe wede, sesenaa waferaame yahhare lebese nawe. yabere 'amebaareme ba'ejaacawe laaye yaathaleqaalu. netzuhe mathatheneme 'alaahe yaathathaacawaale.
yehe yatasathaacehu laszaraacehute malekaame szeraa menedaa sihone szeraacehu 'alaahe zanede taqabaayenate selaalawe nawe yebaalaalu.
ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enyaa baaneta laaye qure'aanene ba'anede gizee muluwene saayehone kafaafelane 'awaradenawe.
'alaahe lamifaredawe shari`aawinaa `aalamaawi wesaaneewoce taagase. wada hathi'ate yamithaaraawene hathi'atanyaa 'enedihume wada kehedate yamitharaawe kahadine 'enedaatesamaacawe.
geetaahene baqane majamariyaa laaye baalawe ya "subehhi" salaate 'enaa yaqanu macharashaa laaye zuherenenaa `aaserene bamasegade 'asetaawese.
yalalite salaatene mageribe, `ishaa'ene 'enaa tahajudene bamasegade geetaahene 'asetaawese.

'enazihe 'agaariwoce yaqerebitune heyewate yewadaalu la'ereswame yegwaagwaalu. teneszaa'eeweneme celaa bamaalate wada xwaalaa yetawetaale. bawesethu cegerenaa fatanaa yaalabate bamahonu kabaade qane nawe.

'enyaa nane 'enasune yafatharenaacawe. 'enyaawe nane yasawenate magathaathamiyaacawene 'enaa 'akaalaacawene bamaathanekare thanekaaraa yaadaragenaacawe. 'enasune maathefaatenaa bamasalocaacawe matakaate benefalege 'athefetanaacawe baleeloce 'enetakaacawaalane.
yehe me`eraafe tagesaatzenaa mekere nawe. wada geetaawe wedeetaa yamiwasedawene manegade lafalaga yehenene manegade yeyaaze.

'alaahe kalefalagawe basetaqare: yageetaacehu yawedeetaa manegade laaye magwaaze 'atecelume. wesaaneewe hulu ya'eresu becaa nawe. 'alaahe labaarocu yamithaqemaacawene yamaayethaqemaacawene hona hulu `aawaaqi 'enaa bamifatheraacawe, bamiwasenaacawenaa badenegaageewe thebabanyaa nawe.

kabaarocu yafalagawene ba'ezenatu wesethe bamaasegabaate la'emenatenaa malekaame szeraa sekeetaamaa yaadaregaacawaale. bakehedatenaa bahathi'ate nafesaacawene yabadalutene batenesaa'eewe qane 'asaamaami ya'esaate qethaate 'azagaajetolaacawaale.
'alaahe takataatelaa bametenafese nefaase yemelaale.
baxaayele bametenafese 'awelo nefaase yemelaale.
zenaabeneme bamabatane bametenafese nefaaseme yemelaale.
'ewenatene kaweshate yamilayene male'ekete yezawe bamiwaredu malaa'eketoce yemelaale.
te'ezaazene (raa`eye) yezawe bamiwaredu malaa'eketoce yemelaale.
lasawe lejoce ka'alaahe zanede yahona mekeneyaate maqurachaa 'enaa ka'alaahe qethaate maasethaneqaqiyaa yayaazawene raa`eye nawe yezawe yamiwaredute.
yaa qaale yatagabaalaacehu gemegamaanaa menedaa yamaayeqare 'ewenate takasaace nawe.
kawaakebetoce berehaanaacawe batagafafanaa batawagada gizee;
samaayeme lamalaa'eketoce mawerajaa tehone zanede batasanathaqace gizee;
taraaraawoce kabotaacawe tanasetawe 'eneda 'abwaraa hewaa laaye batabatanu gizee;
male'eketanyoceme batawasanawe gizee batasabasabu gizee;
bahhezebaacawe laaye mesekere lamahone lataalaaqu qane 'enediqoyu batadaraga gizee;
babaaroce makaakale bamawasanyaawe qane 'ewenatanyaawe kaweshatanyaawe 'enedihume `edelanyoce ka`edela bisoce bageletze yetaawaqaalu.
lamahonu 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yamalayaa qane mene 'enedahona mene 'asaawaqahe?!
male'eketanyoce ka'alaahe zanede yezawete yamathutene nagare lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce bazaane qane qethaate, thefaatenaa keserate 'alalaacawe.
yaalafutene hhezeboce 'alaahene bakaadunaa male'eketanyocene baasetabaabalume gizee 'alaathafaanaacawemene?!
kaziyaa baxwaalaa yamathutene 'asetabaabaayoceneme bamaasekatale 'enaziyaane 'enedaathafaanaacawe hulu 'enaathafaacawaalane.
'enaziyaane yaalafutene hhezeboce 'enedaathafaanaacawe hulu muhhamadene (salalaahu `aalayehi wasalame) yamiyaasetabaabeluteneme 'enaathafaacawaalane.
'alaahe 'amatzanyocene 'enedamiqathaa yagabaawene yazaacaa qaale yamiyaasetabaabelute sawoce baziyaane qane qethaate, thefaatenaa keserate yaaganyaacawaale.
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! lamahonu 'enaanetane dakaamaanaa teneshe kahona yazare fasaashe 'alefatharenaacehumene?
yehene dakaamaa fasaashe thebeqe bahonawe yatamacaaca yaseete maahetzane wesethe 'adaragenawe.
'eseka tawasana gizee derase yekxaweme ya'eregezenaa gizee nawe.
yahulune baaheri, mathanune, malekune 'enaa wazata mathenane fatharene. 'enyaa menenyaa dase yamenele mathane wasaanyoce nane.
ya'alaahene celotaanaa caayenatune yamiyaasetabaabelute sawoce baziyaane qane qethaate, thefaatenaa keserate yaaganyaacawaale.
lamahonu mederene huluneme yasawe lejoce 'akaataa yametaaqefe 'alaadaragenaatemene?
baheyewate yaalutene 'eswa laaye ganebetawe bamanore, mutaanene dagemo wesethwa bamaaqafe 'akaatetaalace.

bamedere laaye 'enedaatewaalele yamiyaagedunaa kafe yaalu yatzanu gaaraawocene 'adaragene. 'enaaneta yasawe lejoce hoye! thaafaache yahonane weha 'athathaanaacehu. yehenene yafathara 'enaanetane maqaseqase 'ayekabedaweme.
'alaahe ba'enasu laaye yawaalalaacawene welataa yamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce baziyaane qane qethaate, thefaatenaa keserate yaaganyaacawaale.
male'eketanyoce yezawete yamathutene nagare laasetabaabalute sawoce 'enaaneta 'asetabaabaayoce hoye! tenaanetenaa setaasetabaabelute wada nabarawe qethaate hidu yebaalaalu.
laszosete wada takafaafalawe ya'esaate chese thelaa (thelaashate) hidu.
yathelaa qezeqaazee yaleelawe; ya'esaate nabalebaaleme hona qaathalo 'enedaayaaganyaacehu yamikalaakaleme 'ayedalame.
'esaatwa fenethaariwocene tetafaalace. ya'eyaanedaanedu fenethaari gezefateme teleqe henetzaane yamiyaakele nawe.
yametewaraweraacawe fenethaariwoce thequrate 'enaa teleqenate theqwaaqure gemalocene yemaselaale.
ya'alaahene qethaate lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce baziyaane qane qethaate, thefaatenaa keserate tazagaajetolaacawaale.
yehe qane meneme yamaayenaagarubate qane nawe.
lakehedataacawenaa hathi'ataacawe lageetaacawe yeqeretaane 'enediyaaqarebu 'ayefaqadelaacaweme.
yazihene qane zeenaa lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce baziyaane qane qethaate, thefaatenaa keserate tazagaajetolaacawaale.
yehe qane bafethuraane makaakale mawasanyaa qane nawe. 'enaanetanenaa yaalafutene hhezebocene baanede meedaa laaye 'enesabasebaacexwaalane.
ka'alaahe qethaate lamadaane yametaaseerute seeraa kaala ba'enee laaye 'asiru.
yaferedune qane lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce baziyaane qane qethaate, thefaatenaa keserate tazagaajetolaacawaale.
ya'alaahene te`ezaaze bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'esune yamifaru baaroce bajanate zaafoce safi thelaanaa yamifasu thaafaache wanezoce mahale naacawe.
mamagabe yamifalegute yaferaaferee `aayenatoceneme yaaganyaalu.
duneyaa wesethe teszarute banabarawe malekaame szeraa saabiyaa dase 'eyaalaacehu malekaamune tamagabu, mathathaate yafalagaacehuteme ba'erekaataa thathu yebaalaalu.
leke 'enaanetane bamanadaanaacehu maszarate szeraawocaacawene yamiyaasaamerutene hulu 'enemanadaalane.
'alaahe 'eresune lamifarute yaazagaajalaacawene menedaa lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce baziyaane qane qethaate, thefaatenaa keserate tazagaajetolaacawaale.

la'asetabaabaayoceme:: teneshe gizee baduneyaa heyewate zanaa balu; 'enedafalagaacehu belume. 'enaaneta 'alaahene bamakaadaacehunaa male'eketanyocene bamaasetabaabalaacehu wanejalanyaa thamaamoce naacehu yebaalaalu.
bamenedaawe qane yamithabeqaacawene qethaate lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce baziyaane qane qethaate, thefaatenaa keserate tazagaajetolaacawaale.
'enazihe 'asetabaabaayoce la'alaahe segadu sibaalu 'ayesagedume.
ya'alaahe male'eketanyoce ka'alaahe zanede yaamathutene lamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce baziyaane qane qethaate, thefaatenaa keserate tazagaajetolaacawaale.
bazihe kageetaacawe bawaradawe qure'aane kaalaamanu kasu wechi baalawe bayatenyaawe negegere nawe yamiyaamenute?!
'erese ba'eresaacawe sela taalaaqu waree (zeenaa) yethayaayaqaalu
kamote baxwaalaa sela maqaseqase yaminaagarawenaa bamale'eketanyaacawe laaye sela waradawe qure'aane nawe yamithayaayaqute.
yehe batalayaayu 'agalaalatzoce degemete, getheme, theneqolaanaa 'afa- taarike nawe belawe bamagelatze yatawazaagabubate qure'aane nawe.
nagaru 'enasu 'enedamilute 'ayedalame! 'enaziyaa baqure'aanene yamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce yamaasetabaabalaacawene mathefo wetheete saayaawequ 'ayeqarume.
'ahuneme yamaasetabaabalaacawe mathefo wetheete saayeragaagathelaacawe 'ayeqareme.
lamahonu mederene yatamacaacace 'enaa linorubaate yatasetakaakalace 'alaadaragenelaacawemene?
gaaraawoceneme medere 'enedaatewaalelebaacawe 'eneda cekaale 'adaragene.
'enaaneta yasawe lejoce! yatalayaaya medebe wesenune wanede leelaawene dagemo seete 'aderegane fatharenaacehu.
'eneqeseqaaseeyaacehune lamagetaatenaa 'erafete taaganyu zanede 'eneqelefeneme fatharenelaacehu.
haferata galaacehune balebese 'enedameteshafenuteme hulu lalitene bachalamaawe shefaane 'adaragenelaacehu.
qanene dagemo sisaaye felagaanaa yaszeraa masamaariyaa waqete 'adaragenelaacehu.
kabalaayaacehume laaye genebaataacawe thanekaaraa 'enaa 'aszaraaraacawe raqiqe yahonu sabaate samaayaatocene fatheranaale.
tzahhayene baxaayele yametaabaraanaa yameteqathaathale maberaate 'aderego fatharalaacehu.
lamazenabe kaqarabaweme (zenaabene) kaaragazaweme damanaame yaminebwabwa wehane 'awaradene.
ba'esu yatalayaayu theraathereewocenenaa 'azere`etocene lamaabeqale nawe.
bazenaabume yazaafocu qerenechaafoce kamabezaataacawe yatanasaa 'erese ba'eresaacawe yatathalaalafu 'atekeletocene lamaabeqale falegane nawe.

'alaahu (subehhanahu wata`aalaa) 'enazihene yasune taalaaqenate yamiyaamalaaketu tzagaawocene kagalatza baxwaalaa kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqasenenaa tenesaa'eene bamaasekatale yethaqesaale mekeneyaatume 'enazihene tzagaawoce yaaseganya mutaanene 'enedamiqasaqesenaa yamigamageme 'enedahona bamagelatze 'enedihe yelaale:
bafethuraanoce makaakale yamifaradebate qane bafetzume yamaayeqare bagizee yatawasana qana-qatharo yaalawe qane nawe.
male'akume baqanede hulatanyaawene nefi sinafaa 'enaaneta yasawe lejoce hoye! babudene yatakafaafalaacehu honaacehu wada 'enyaa temathaalaacehu.
samaayeme tasanathaatheqaa; takafaafeto 'enedaqaru baroce honaa tekafataalace.
gaaraawoceme tawagedawe wada tabatana tebiyaanate taqayerawe 'eneda siribedu bahonu gizee;
jahanameme lamaadane 'adefethaa tethabaabaqaalace.
badaayoce yamiyaarefubaate maarafiyaacawe naate.
maabeqiyaa yaleelawe rajeme zamanaatene yeqamathaalu.
bawesethwame ya'esaatwane qaathalo yamiyaabaredelaacawe qazeqaazaa 'ayareme hona themaacawene yamiyaarakubate weha 'ayeqamesume.
bathaame yafalaa weha 'enaa ka'esaate sawoce yamifase 'ezhe (magelenaa dame) 'eneji leelaa yamiqamesute nagare yalame.
lanabarubate kehedataacawenaa thememataacawe tasemaami yahona menedaa nawe.
batenesaa'eewe selamaayaamenu baqerebitu `aalame wesethe sinoru gemegamaane 'ayefarume nabare tenesaa'eene bifaru noro ba'alaahe 'amenawe malekaame szeraane yeszaru nabare.
bamale'eketanyaacene laaye yaawaradenawene 'aneqatzocaacenene maasetabaabalene 'asetabaabalu.
'eyaanedaanedune szeraawocaacawene qotherane yezanawaale baszeraawocaacawe mazegabe laayeme 'aseferanawaale.
'enaaneta 'amatzanyoce hoye! yehenene zawetaari qethaate qemasu baqethaataacehume laaye qethaatene 'eneji leelaa 'anechamerelaacehume.
yageetaacawene te'ezaaze bamafatzamenaa yakalakalaacawene bamakalekale latathanaqaqute thenequqoce yasekeetenaa yafelaagotaacawene yamiyaaganyubate yajanate maa`ekale tazagaajetolaacawaale.
ya'azere'ete botaawocenaa wayenoce;
tamasaasaaye `edemee laaye yamiganyu thutaacawe guce guce yaalu koradoceme;
bawayene thaje yatamolu berecheqowoceme tazagaajetolaacawaale.
janate wesethe 'alaasefalaagi negegerocenenaa weshatene 'ayesamume 'erese ba'eresaacaweme 'ayewashaashume.
yehe hulu 'alaahe yasathaacawe baqi yahona sethotaa 'enaa taalaaqe tzagaa nawe.

yasamaayaate, yamederenaa bamakaakalaacawe yaalu hulu geetaa, baqerebitume hona bamachiwe `aalame 'azaanye yahonawe; basamaayeme bamedereme yaalu bamulu 'eresu yafaqadalate kaalehona basetaqare lithayequte 'ayecelume.
jiberilenaa malaa'eketoce tasalefawe bamiqomubate gizee 'are-raahhemaane 'enediyaamaaledu yafaqadalaacawe 'ewenatenaa qaala tawehhidene yatanaagaru kaalehonu basetaqare maaneme 'ayenaagareme.

yehe yatagalatzalaacehu therethaaree yaleelawe ya'ewenate qane yemathaale (yekasataale) kazaa qane qethaate madaanene yafalaga wadazaa qane yamiyaadaresawenaa geetaawene yamiyaasewadedebate malekaame szeraane yeszeraa.

yasawe lejoce hoye! 'enyaa qerebe takasaace yahonawene qethaate 'asethaneqeqanaacexwaale 'eyaanedaanedu gelasabeme bazihe baqerebitu `aalame yaasaalafawene szeraa yamiyaayebate qane bazihe qane; kahadi yahona sawe kaqethaate lamadaanenaa lamaamelathe 'enesesoce 'afare hunu sibaalu 'enedanasu 'afare bahonekunye belo yemanyaale.
'alaahe yakahadiyaanene nafese baxaayelenaa bachekaanee manecheqawe bamiyaawathu malaa'eketoce yemelaale.
yame'emanaaneneme nafese baqalaalu 'enaa gare bahona maleku mazawe bamiyaawathu malaa'eketoceme yemelaale.
ya'alaahene te'ezaaze yezawe kasamaaye wada medere ba'ayare wesethe bafethenate 'eyawaanyu bamigwaazu malaa'eketoceme yemelaale.
ya'alaahene te'ezaazaate lamatagebare 'erese ba'eresaacawe bamisheqadaadamu malaa'eketeme yemelaale.

'alaahe 'enedifatzemu yaazazaacawene wesaaneewocene bamifatzemu: lamesaalee yasawocene szeraa 'enediqothaatharunaa 'enedimazagebu batamadabu malaa'eketoce yemelaale 'alaahe ba'enazihe hulu yamaalawe lameremaraanaa lamamanedaate sawocene 'enedamiqasaqesaacawe 'aseragetho lamanaagare nawe.
medere bamajamariyaawe nefi bameteneqathaqathebate gizee;
yehenene nefi hulatanyaawe nefi sikatalawe;
baziyaane qaneme yakahaadiwoce 'enaa yawanejalanyoce leboce baferehate yatamolu yehonaalu.
ba`aayenocaacaweme laaye yaweredate gatzetaa bageletze yenababaale.
lamahonu kamotene baxwaalaa daageme wada heyewate 'enemalasaalane? yelume nabare.
yabasabasene baado 'athenete kahonene baxwaalaa 'enemalasaalane 'enedee?!
'enedihe yelaalu:: 'ewenate hono katamalaseneme kabaade keseratenaa weredate nawe
yamaqaseqasu gudaaye qalaale nawe yeheme baqanede lamanefaate katamadabawe male'ake 'anede yanefi chukxate becaa nawe yamiyaasefalegawe.
wadiyaaweme bamedere hode wesethe mutaane honawe kaqoyu baxwaalaa hulume heyaawe honawe bamedere jarebaa laaye yehonaalu.
lamahonu 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! musaa kageetaawe 'enedihume kathalaatu fire`aawene gaare yanabarawe taarike daresohalene?
kagudelate yatharaawe (yalaaqawe) geetaawe bataqadasawe "thuwaa" batasanyawe shalaqo batharaawe gizee.
kaanaagarawe male'ekete 'anedu wada fire`owene hide 'enaho 'esu bakuraatenaa babadale wasane 'alefwalenaa.
'enediheme balawe:: <<'aneta fire`owene hoye! kakehedatenaa kahathi'ate yametetharaabatene (yametetzadaabatene) manegade tefalegaalahene?!

wada fathaarihenaa tanekabaakaabihe tefaraawenaa 'esu yamiwadawene lamaszeraatenaa yamithalaawene lamaraaqe yeradaahalenaa lemeraahene?>> musaame (`alayehi 'asalaame) ka'alaahe selamalaaku yamiyaaseradu.
taalaalaaqe ta`aameraatocene beterunenaa 'ejune bageletze 'asaayawe.
yafire`oweneme melaashe 'enazihene ta`aameraatocene maasetabaabalenaa.
musaa baamathaawe male'ekete kamaamane yeleqe bamaamatze 'enaa hhaqene bamagaafathe laaye barataa.
kamusaa gaare thore lamagethame 'athaqaalaaye szaraawitunenaa takataayocune sabesebo 'enedihe belo tathaaraa::
<<'enee taalaaqu geetaacehu nanye kanee weche maaneme taazaze 'ayecaaleme>>
'alaahe bazihece `aalame baahhere wesethe bamaasethame 'enedihume bamachiwe `aalame dagemo kabaade bahona qethaate wesethe bamaasegabaate kabaade 'ayaayaazene yaazawe.
fire`aawenene baduneyaanaa ba'akxiraa maqethaataacene 'alaahene lamifaru bamekeru lamithaqamu hulu tagesaatze nawe.
'enaaneta batenesaa'eewe yaasetabaabalaacehu sawoce hoye! lamahonu 'enaanetane mafethare nawe la'alaahe yamikabedawe wayese yaganabaatene samaaye mafethare?!
yathaariyaawaane reqate kafe yaala, yatasetakaakalace, kefetatenaa senetheqe 'enedihume meneme nawere yaleelabaate 'aderego fatharaate.
tzahaye bamathelaqwaa meshetwane yaachalamanaa tzahaye setewathaa dagemo qanwane baberehaane yaabaraa nawe.
samaayeneme kafathara baxwaalaa mederene zaragaate thaqaami yahonu nagaroceneme 'aseqamathalaate.
kamedere wehawaane fasaashe yahonu menechocene 'aderego 'awathaa. la'enesesoceme gethoshene 'abaqala.
gaaraawocene medere laaye 'atzanaa.

'enaaneta yasawe lejoce hoye! yehe hulu lanaaneta 'enaa lakabetocaacehu mathaqaaqamiyaa yehone zanede fatharalaacehu. yehunenaa yehenene hulu yafathara 'enedaganaa 'eneda 'adise mafethare 'ayesaanaweme.
ba'asedanegaachenatu huluneme yamiwethawe hulatanyaawe zure nefi sinafaanaa tenesaa'eeweme sikasate.
yehe nagareme sikasate 'enaa yasawe leje yaaseqadamawene malekaame wayeme mathefo szeraawene yaasetaawasa gizee.
jahaname bametemathaanaa latamalekaacoce yefaa bametehonebateme gizee;
bathememate wasane yaalafa;
thafi yahonacewene duneyaane yazalaalamenaa qari kahonacewe yamacharashaayetu heyewate yaasebalatha;
'esaate maqamachaawenaa masefariyaawe naate.
'alaahe fite maqomene yafaraa 'enaa nafesune 'alaahe yakalakalawene nagare kamakatale semeetu 'enaa zenebaaleewene yaaqabaate masefariyaawenaa maqamachaawe janate nawe.
'alaahe fite maqomene yafaraa 'enaa nafesune 'alaahe yakalakalawene nagare kamakatale semeetu 'enaa zenebaaleewene yaaqabaate masefariyaawenaa maqamachaawe janate nawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa maqaseqasene yamiyaasetabaabelu sawoce tenesaa'eewe macee nawe yamikasatawe? belawe yethayequhale.
'eswa macee 'enedahonace tenageraacawe zanede `eweqate yalaheme yeheme yaaneta gudaaye 'ayedalame. yelequnese gudaayehe laswa zegejete maaderage becaa nawe.
yatenesaa'eewe qane `eweqate mamalashaa wada 'alaahe becaa nawe.
'aneta tenesaa'eewene yamifaru sawocene 'asethaneqaaqi 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaheme. mekeneyaatume bamaasethaneqaqiyaawe yamithaqamute 'enasu selahonu.
tenesaa'eewene ba`aayenaacawe bageletze siyaayu baduneyaa hheyewate wesethe yathawaate kefela gizeene wayeme kasa`aate baxwaalaa yaalawene gizee becaa yanoru yemaselaacawaale.
ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa fitune 'achafagaganaa zorame.

`aabedalaahe benu 'umi maketume `aayena-sewere nabarenaa lamathayaqe bamamethaatu; ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa baziyaane gizee musherikocene theri bamaaderage 'eyaalunaa yaamenulenyaale belowe tasefaa baadaragubate sa`aate laaye nabare yamathaawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehe `aayena-sewere kahathi'aatu litzadaa 'enedahona mene 'asaawaqahe!!
kaaneta bamiyaadaamethawe tagesaatze mekeneyaate tamakero yethaqame yehonaale.
baganezabu tamaameno laaneta yamathaalehene male'ekete kamaamane yatabeqaaqaawenemaa;
'aneta lasu fitehenenaa lebehene mulu tesathaalahe.
kahathi'atu baayetzadaa baaneta laaye meneme gudaate yalabeheme.
malekaamene felagaa bafethenate yamathaawenemaa;
geetaawene yamifaraawene;
bakabaretee 'agaariwoce mekeneyaate 'eresune celaa telawaalahe.
nagaru 'enedihe mahone yalabateme. lamiqabalu hulu mekerenaa tagesaatze nawe.
qure'aane wesethe baalawe mekere mamakarenaa magasatze lafalagu hulu yemakarubate.
yehe qure'aane batakabarawe malaa'eketoce zanede kamiganyawe matsehhafe wesethe yeganyaale.
kafe yaala yakebere seferaa yatasathawenaa tzedu hono meneme qoshaashaa hona rekesate yamaayaaganyawe mazegabe wesethe yeganyaale.
'eresume bamalaa'ekete 'eje laaye yeganyaale.
geetaacawe zanede yatakabaru, 'ejege taazaazhenaa malekaamene yamitagaberu naacawe.
kahadi yahona sawe taragama. ba'alaahe laaye yaalawe kehedate menenyaa kabaade 'adaragawe!
lamahonu 'enedihe bamedere laaye yamikoraawenaa yamikedawe 'alaahe kamene yafatharawe maselote nawe?!
kadakaamaa fasaashe (kazare fasaashe) nawe yafatharawe. 'afathaatharuneme batalayaaya ya'afathaathare 'erekane 'enedihone 'adaragawe.
ka'enazihe 'erekanoce baxwaalaame ka'enaatu hode 'enediwathaa manegadune 'amacaacalate.
baheyewate yatawasana `edemee kaaqoyawe baxwaalaame 'enedimote 'adaragawe. 'eseka `elata-tenesaa'ee derase yamiqoyebatene maqaaberene 'adaragalate.
'alaahe bafalagame gizee lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa yeqasaqesawaale.
yehe kahadi sawe geetaawe gedeetaa yaadaragabatene mamariyaa tawathecaalahu belo 'enedamiyaasebawe 'ayedalame! 'alaahe gedeetaa yaadaragabatene mamariyaa 'aletawathaame.
yehe ba'alaahe yakaadawe sawe 'eseti yamimagabawe megebe 'enedeete 'enedataganya yaasetawele.
yazihe megebe maganyaa maszaratu 'enyaa kasamaaye baxaayele 'enaa babezaate baawaradenawe zenaabe nawe.
kaziyaa baxwaalaa mederene la'azere`ete maszanethaqene sanathaqene.
theraathereewocene (senedee, gabesenaa leelocene) 'abaqalene.
wayenene, 'erethebenaa 'eshatene la'enesesoce qalabe 'enedihone 'abaqalene.
yabalase feree (zayetune) 'enaa yatamere zanebaabaa 'abaqalene.
yatalayaayunaa bezu zaafoce yaalawene 'atekeleteneme 'abaqalene.
feraafereewocenenaa 'enesesocaacehune yamimagabwacawene gethoshe 'abaqalene.
yehenene hulu yafatharenawe la'enaaneta 'enaa lakabetocaacehu mathaqaaqamiyaa yehone zanede nawe.
jorone yamiyaadanaqurawe taalaaqunaa hulatanyaawe nefi simathaa;
wanedeme kawanedemu yamishashebate qane yehonaale.
'enedihume ka'enaatenaa ka'abaatume chemere yeshashaale.
kabaalabeetunaa kalejocume yeshashaale.
kaqanu kebedate yatanasaa 'anedu kaleelaawe baraasu gudaaye tawathero yamichanaqebate `elate nawe.
ya`edelanyoce fite baziyaane qane yamiyaabaraa yehonaale.
'alaahe ka'ezenatu baazagaajalaacawe nagare yatanasaa bafagagetaanaa badasetaa yatamolaa yehonaale.
ya`edela bisoce fiteme baziyaane 'elate 'abwaraamaa ('amadaame) yehonaale.
tzelemate yeshafenaacawaale.
bazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatzute 'enaziyaa kehedatenenaa thematene bagaaraa yatagabaru sawoce naacawe.
yatzahhaye 'akaalwa bametethaqalalebate 'enaa berehaanwaneme bametaathaabate gizee;
kawaakebeteme baragafunaa berehaanaacawe bataabasa gizee;
gaaraawoceme taneqatheqethawe kabotaacawe tawagedawe 'abwaraa bahonu gizee;
'ereguzenaa babaalabeetocwa zanede wede kamahonwa yatanasaa sisheqadaadamubaate yanabaracewe gemale kaala thabaaqi batatawace gizee;
'awereewoceme kasawoce gaare 'anede laaye ba'anede meedaa laaye batasabasabu gizee,
baaheroceme taqathaathelawe 'esaate bahonu gizee,
thamaamaa kathamaamaa, 'enedihume fariha 'alaahe 'alaahene kamifaraa gaare bamahone nafese ka'amesaayaawaa gaare bataqoraanyace gizee;
kanaheyewatwa yataqabaraceweneme hetzaane 'alaahe bamithayeqaate gizee,
lamahonu gadaayeshe bamene wanejale nawe yagadalashe?! (tabelaa setethayaqe);
'eyaanedaanedu sawe yaraasune yaszeraa mazegabe yaanabebe zanede yabaariyaawoce yaszeraa mazaagebete batagalatzame gizee;
samaayeme 'eneda bage qodaa batagafaface gizee;
'esaateme bataqathaathalace gizee;
janateme lathenequqocu baqarabace gizee;
yehe hulu sikasate maanenyaawaame nafese latenesaa'eewe qane yaasaalafacewene szeraa taaweqaalace.
