'alaahe: maataa meshete laaye beqe kamaalataacawe 'aseqademo qane laaye bamidabaqute kawaakebete yemolaale.
('enazihu kawaakebetoce) bamasemaraacawe laaye 'eyatagwaazu 'eyaala 'agaazane (waaleyaa) sinagaa meshegaacawe wesethe bamagebaate 'enedamidabaqute gohe siqade bamisawarute kawaakebetoce (yemelaale).
laliteme chalamaawene yezo bamimathaanaa bamigwaazebate gizee 'emelaalahu;
banegaateme berehaanu wagage baala gizee 'emelaalahu;

ya'alaahe qaale yahonawenaa bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye yawaradawe qure'aane 'alaahe xaalaafinate basathawe taamaanyu male'ake jiberile (`alayehi 'asalaame) 'amaakaayenate yadarasa nawe.
yaxaayele baalabeetenaa ya`areshu geetaa zanede teleqe darajaa yaalawe nawe.
yasamaaye malaa'ekete yetaazazutaale. bataamaanyenate raa`eye yamiyaadarese nawe.

yaa 'aberwacehu yanorawenaa ya'a`emerowene beselate, taamaanyenatenaa 'ewenatenyenatune thaneqeqaacehu yametaawequte muhhamade (salalaahu 'alayehi wasalame) 'enaaneta 'enedameteqathefute 'ebede 'ayedalame.
gwaadanyaacehu ba'eregetheme jiberilene batafatharabate 'akwaaxwaane geletze bahonawe 'ademaase laaye 'ayetotaale.
gwaadanyaacehu 'enediyaadarese yataazazawene te`ezaaze la'enaaneta maaderase yaminafegaacehu 'ayedalame. thaneqwaayoce ganezabe 'enedamiqabalute 'ayeqabaleme.
yehe qure'aane ka'alaahe 'ezenate yatabaararawe shayethwane negegere 'ayedalame.
ka'enazihe maaserajaawoce baxwaalaa ka'alaahe zanede mahonune lamaasetabaabale yatenyaawene selete nawe yametethaqamute?!
qure'aane lasawocenaa la'agaanenetoce tagesaatzenaa mekere 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame.
ka'enaaneta ba'ewenate manegade laaye qathe maalatene yafalaga qathe yebale.
ya`aalamaatu geetaa 'alaahe kaalashe (kaalefalaga) basetaqare masetakaakalenenaa qathe maalatene 'ateshume.
lamalaa'eketoce mawerajaa yehone zanede samaaye setesanathaathaqe;
kawaakebetoceme tabataatenawe siragefu;
baaheroceme takafaafetawe 'anedu kaleelaawe sidabalaalaqu;
qaberoceme mutaane kataqabarubate 'enediwathu kataace wadalaaye sigalabathu;
bazihe gizee 'eyaanedaanedwa nafese szaretaa yaaseqadamacewene (yaasetalaalafacewene) 'enaa saateszaraa wadaxwaalaa yaaseqaracewene taaweqaalace.
'aneta bageetaahe yakaadekawe yasawe leje hoye! lamahonu bacerotaawe baqethaate saayaathaadefehe yaaqoyahene yageetaahene te'e`ezaaze 'enedeteqaarane yaadaragahenaa yashanagalahe menedene nawe?!
kaalenabarekebate yaaseganyahenaa 'akaaleheneme yatasetakaakalanaa yaamaara 'aderego fatharahe.
bafalagawe qeretze qaretzo fatharahe. 'aheyaane, zenejarone, weshaane wayeneme leelaa nagarene 'asemaselo 'anetane baalamafetharu malekaame welataa waalaleheme.
'enaaneta yatashanagalaacehu sawoce hoye! nagaru 'enedihe 'ayedalame yelequnese 'enaaneta yamenedaawene qane bamaasetabaabale laziyaa qane yamihonaacehune nagare yamaatetagaberu sawoce naacehu.
szeraacehune yamiqothaatharu malaa'eketoce ba'enaaneta laaye tamadebawaale.
'alaahe zanede yatakabaru 'enaa szeraawocaacehune yamimazagebu tzahafiwoce sihonu;
yameteszarutene szeraa 'aweqawe yemazagebaalu.
'ejege taazaazhocenaa malekaame szeraa 'abezetawe yamiszaru sawoce yaqiyaamaa qane qwaami bahona tzagaa wesethe naacawe.
yathememeete gwaadoce ba'enasu laaye bameteqathaathale 'esaate wesethe naacawe.
bamenedaawe qane wesethwa bamagebaate qaathalowaane yeqamesaalu.
'esaate magebaate bameneme maleku 'ayeqarelaacaweme. yelequneme 'eziyaa wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lamahonu sela menedaawe qane mene yametaaweqawe nagare 'ala?!
badegaamime sela menedaawe mene yametaaweqawe nagare 'ala?!
maaneme sawe maaneneme yamaayethaqemebate qane sihone ba`elatume wesaaneewe hulu lamaaneme saayehone la'alaahe becaa yehonaale; yaashaawene yaadaregaale.
thefaatenaa keserate mizaanene bamiyaagwaadelu sawoce laaye yehune.
'enaziyaa sawene sefere sisaferu meneme saayaagwaadelu dereshaacawene mulu 'aderegawe yamiwasedu.

nagare gene lasawoce sisaferu wayeme simazenu seferenenaa mizaanene yamiyaagodelu naacawe. nabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) wada madinaa tasadawe sigabu yamadinaa maahebarasabe 'aszaraaraacawe 'enedihe nabare.
lamahonu yehenene tzayaafe tagebaare yamitageberu sawoce 'alaahe fite 'enedamiqasaqasu 'ayaawequmene?!
bawesethu baalawe fatanaanaa makaraa yatanasaa taalaaqe bahonawe qane lameremaraanaa lamamanedaate yamiqasaqasu mahonaacawene 'ayaawequmene?!
lagemegamaanaa lameremaraa la`aalamaatu geetaa sawoce hulu bamiqomubate qane.

nagaru kamote baxwaalaa maqaseqase yalame belaacehu 'enedaasabaacehute 'ayedalame. yelequnese 'enaziyaa yathememeete baalabeete yahonute kahadiyaanenenaa manaafeqaane mazegabe "sijine" (kamacharashaawe medere bataace yamiganye mazegabe nawe.)
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! "sijine" mene 'enedahona mene 'asaawaqahe?!
mazegabaacawe sihonemeneme nagare yamaayechamarebatenaa yamaayeqanasebate matsehhafe nawe.
baziyaane qane thefaatenaa keserate ba'asetabaabaayoce laaye yeragaagathaale.
'enasume 'alaahe baariyaawocune baduneyaa wesethe baszarute szeraa yamimanadaabatene yamenedaawene qane yaasetabaabalute naacawe.
yehenene qane yamiyaasetabaabelewe ba'alaahe wasane laaye denebare yamiyaalefenaa bathaame hathi'atanyaa kaalehona basetaqare maaneme yalame.
bamale'eketanyaacene laaye yawaradute 'aneqatzoce sinababelateme yehe yaqadametoce 'eneqoqeleshe 'eneji ka'alaahe yamathaa 'ayedalame yelaale.
nagaru 'enazihe 'asetabaabaayoce 'enedagamatute 'ayedalame. yelequnese yaa yesarute yanabarawe hathi'ate helinaacawene shafenwacawe 'ewenatune balebocaacawe mamalekate 'alecaalume.
ba'eregetheme 'enasu batenesaa'eewe qane geetaacawene kamaayate yatagaaradu naacawe.
qathelome 'esaate gabiwoce naacawe; bamuqatwame yesaqaayaalu.
batenesaa'eewe qane batecete maleku 'enedihe yebaalaalu:: yehe yagathamaacehu qethaate baduneyaawe `aalame wesethe male'eketanyocaacehu sela'esu sinagerwacehu setaasetabaabelute yanabarawe nawe.
nagaru 'enaaneta gemegamaanaa menedaa yalame belaacehu 'enedagamataacehute 'ayedalame. yelequnese yanaziyaa taazaazhoce mazegabe ba"`iliyine" nawe yaalawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! "`iliyune" mene 'enedahona mene 'asaawaqahe?!
szeraacawe yasafarabate mazegabaacawe sihone yamaayesaraze 'enedihume meneme nagare yamaayechamarebatenaa yamaayeqanasebateme nawe.
yehenene mazegabe baqerebate yamimalakatute ba'eyaanedaanedu samaaye laaye yamiganyu yaqerebe baalamwale malaa'eketoce naacawe.
'ejege taazaazhoce batenesaa'eewe qane zalaalamaawinaa qwaami tzagaa wesethe naacawe.
baageetha 'enaa batanethaalala 'alegaa laaye honawe geetaacawene 'enedihume wesethaacawene dase yamiyaasanyaacawenenaa yamiyaarakaacawene yemalakataalu.
setemalakataacaweme fitaacawe laaye yadelotenaa yamecote natzaberaaqe taasetawelaalahe.
'agalegaayocaacawe yataashagu yawayene thajocene yaathathwacawaale.

'eseka macharashaaweme ba''miseke' shetaa yataawada nawe. laziheme taalaaqe menedaa ya'alaahene wedeetaa maagenyate yamicaalebatene malekaame szeraa bamaszeraatenaa yamiyaaseqothaawene bamaraaqe tasheqadaadaamiwoce lisheqadaadamu yegabaale.
yehe yataashagawe mathathe katasenime meneche yatabaraza nawe.

yehe meneche yajanate kafetanyaa darajaa laaye yamiganye 'enaa yaqerebe baalamwaloce meneme saayechamarebate labecaawe yamithathute meneche nawe. yataqarute 'amaanyoce ka'ezihe meneche becaawene saayehone kaleelaa gaare tabarezo nawe yamithathute.
'enaziyaa baalubate yakehedate 'emenate yatanasaa 'amatzanyaa yahonutemaa ba'amaanyoce laaye 'eyatasaalaqu yesequ nabare.
bame'emanaane 'akaabaabi siyaalefu bamaashofenaa bamaalaagathe yethaqaaqasunaa yethaqwaaqomaalu.
wada beetasabocaacaweme simalasu bayaazute kehedatenaa ba'amaanyoce laaye bamasaalaqaacawe dase tasanyetawe nabare yamimalasute.
muselimoceneme baayu gizee: 'enazihe 'eko ya'abaatocaacawene haayemaanote 'anekataleme bamaalataacawe yatanasaa 'ewenatene yasaatu sawoce naacawe yelaalu.
yehenene yenaagaru zanedeme 'alaahe yanasune szeraa taqothaathaari 'aderego 'alemadabaacaweme.
kahadiyaane baduneyaa wesethe bame'emanaane laaye yaashofu 'enaa yesequ 'enedanabarawe hulu me'emanaane batenesaa'eewe qane bakahadiyaane laaye yeseqaalu.
yaageethace 'alegaa laaye honawe 'alaahe yaazagaajalaacawene zalaalamaawi tzagaane yemalakataalu.
ba'eregetheme kahadiyaane baduneyaa yeszarute banabarawe yaszeraacawe wetheete 'awaaraaje bahona qethaate bamaqathaate waagaacawene 'agenyetawaale.
lamalaa'eketoce mawerajaa yehone zanede samaaye batasanathaqace gizee;
lageetaawaa te`ezaaze baadarace gizee; letaadereme yegabaataale;
'alaahe mareetene leke 'eneda qodaa bazaragaate gizee;
wesethwa yaalawene delebocenaa mutaanene bamaaraagafe baado bahonace gizee;
lageetaawaa te`ezaazeme baadarace gizee; letaadereme yegabaataale;
'aneta yasawe leje hoye! wetheetune batenesaa'eewe qane 'alaahe yemanadaahe zanedeme: malekaame hona mathefo szeraane teszaraalahe.

'alaahe yasawene leje tagebaarene thaqelale 'aderego kagalatza baxwaalaa: batenesaa'eewe qane yaszariwocene huneetaacawene bazerezere sigaletze 'enedihe yelaale::
'enaho yaszeraa mazegabu baqanye 'eju yatasathawe;
'alaahe szeraawene 'asaayetote saayeqothaawe bamaalafe qalaale yahona gemegamaa yegamagemawaale.
dasetanyaame hono wada beetasabu yemalasaale.
ba'anetzaarume yaszeraa mazegabu kajarebaawe bageraa 'eju yatasathawemaa;
laraasu mathefaatene (motene) yemanyaale.
gahaname yegabaale baqaathalowaame yesaqaayaale.
'eresu baduneyaa wesethe 'eyaala banabarabate kehedatenaa hathi'ate dasetanyaa hono babeetasabocu mahale yenore nabare.
kamota baxwaalaa daageme wada heyewate yamimalase 'ayemaselaweme nabare.
'ayedalame! 'alaahe majamariyaa 'enedafatharawe hulu wada heyewate yemalesawaale. geetaawe nagara szeraawene tamalekaacenaa meneme yamaayesawarebate geetaa nawe. 'eneda szeraaweme yemanadaawaale.
'alaahe tzahhaye kathalaqace baxwaalaa basamaaye 'ademaase laaye bamitaayawe qaye wagaagane yemelaale.
balalitenaa bawesethu batakaatataweme fetherataate yemelaale.
charaqaa melu`e bametehonebate gizeeme yemelaale.

'enaaneta yasawe lejoce hoye! ka'anede ya'afathaathare 'erekane wada leelaa 'erekane teshagaagaraalaacehu. yeheme kazare fasaashenate wada ragaa damenate kazaa baxwaalaa yataanyaka wadamimasele szegaanate, qathelo baheyewate wada manore kazaa baxwaalaa mote, bamacharashaame maqaseqase.
lamahonu 'enazihe kahadiyaane lamenede nawe ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yamaayaamenute?!
lamenese nawe qure'aane sinababelaacawe lageetaacawe yamaayesagedute?!
yelequnese kahadiyaane male'eketanyaawe yaamathaalaacawene nagare 'asetabaabaayoce naacawe.
'alaahe lebocaacawe yaqwaatharawene nagare `aawaaqi nawe. kaszeraawocaacaweme meneme 'ayedabaqebateme.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! selamithabeqaacawe 'asaamaami qethaate negaraacawe.
nagare gene ba'alaahe yaamanutenaa malekaame szeraane yaszarute yamaayeqwaarathe menedaa maalateme janate tazagaajetolaacawaale.
yatzahhaye, yacharaqaanaa yaleeloce kawaakebetoce maarafiyaa baalabeete bahonace samaaye 'alaahe yemelaale.
fethuraanene hulu lamasabesabe qatharo bayaazabate batenesaa'eewe qaneme yemelaale.
'eneda nabiyu bahhezebocaacawe laaye yamesekere qaale bamisathu masekaariwoce 'enaa bamimasakarebaacawe hhezeboce hulume maala.
'enaziyaa teleqe gudegwaade yaqofarute sawoce taragamu.
ba'esu laaye 'esaate yaanadadu (yaaqathaathalu) 'enaa me'emanaanene kanaheyewataacawe bawesethu yathaalu sawoce (taragamu).
ba'esaate yatamolaace gudegwaade laaye bataqamathu gizee;
bame'emanaane laaye yamifatzemutene qethaate lamamalekate babotaawe yataqamathute sawoce;
'enazihe kahadiyaane me'emanaanene yathalubate becanyaa mekeneyaate maaneme liyaashenefawe bamaayecelawe 'ashanaafi 'enedihume bahulume nagare mesegune bahonawe geetaa bamaamanaacawe nawe.
yaa yaamanubate geetaa yasamaayaatenaa yamedere selethaane ya'eresu becaa nawe. huluneme nagare tamalekaace nawe. kabaariyaawocume tagebaare 'anedume 'ayesawarebateme.

'enaziyaa me'emanaanenaa me'emanaatene ba'alaahe becanyenate kamaamane lamaqalebase 'asebawe ba'esaate yaqathu sawoce kahathi'ataacawe neseha yamaayaadaregu kahona batenesaa'eewe qane yajahaname qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale. me'emanaanene ba'esaate bamaaqaathalaacawe mekeneyaate yamiyaaqaathele ya'esaate qethaate tazagaajetolaacawaale.

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanu 'enaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru kahenetzaawocenaa zaafoce szere yatalayaayu wanezoce yamifasubaacawe janatoce tazagaajetolaacawaale. yehe 'alaahe yaazagaajalaacawe taalaaqenaa meneme yamaayewadaadarawe dele nawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! badaayocene lagizeewe biyaaqoyaacaweme yageetaahe 'ayaayaaze beretu nawe.
'esu fetheratenenaa qethaatene yamijamere 'enaa 'enedaganaa yamimalese nawe.
wadasu kahathi'ataacawe neseha lamigabu mahari 'enaa thenequqe wadaajocune yamiwade nawe.
yatakabarawe `areshe baalabeete nawe.
yafalagawene yeqere yamilenaa yafalagawene dagemo yamiqathaa 'enedihume yaala maaneme 'asegadaajenate yafalagawene yamiszaraa geetaa nawe.
lamahonu 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'ewenatene lamawaagaate 'enaa sawocene ka'ewenate lamaagade yataathaqu szaraawitoce waree daresohalene?!
yafire`owene 'enaa samude, yaswalihhe (`alayehi 'asalaame) hhezeboce taarike;

'enazihene sawoce kamaamane yaagadaacawe yaalafute hhezebocenaa yadarasabaacawe yathefaate 'adagaa taarike saayedaresaacawe qareto saayehone kawadihu yaraasaacawene yagele semeetenaa zenebaaleeyaacawene bamakatale male'eketanyaacawe yezo yamathaawene nagare maasetabaabaalaacawe nawe yaagadaacawe.
'alaahe szeraacawene tamalekaacenaa huluneme yamiyaaweqe meneme yamaayaamalethawe nawe. baszeraacaweme maszarate yemanadaacawaale.
'asetabaabaayoce qure'aanene getheme nawe 'enedamilute 'ayedalame. yelequnese 'eresu yatakabara qure'aane nawe.
kamalawathenaa kamaqayare 'enedihume kachemaarinaa gudelate yatathabaqa saleedaa wesethe nawe yamiganyawe.
'alaahe basamaaye 'enaa lalite bamitaaye kokobe yemelaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! ya'ezihe taalaaqe kokobe menenatene mene 'asaawaqahe?!
yehe batagaagaama choraawe samaayene yamisanatheqe kokobe nawe.
batenesaa'eewe qane lagemegamaa yeradaa zanede 'alaahe ba'eyaanedaanedu nafese laaye szeraawaane mazegebo yamithabeqe malaa'ekete saayemadebebaate yaaseqarawe yalame.
ya'alaahene celotaa 'enedihume yaraasu dakaamaanate yegalatzelate zanede yasawe leje 'alaahe kamene 'enedafatharawe yemalekate (yaasetawele).
'alaahe yehenene sawe baxaayele tasefanethero maahetzane wesethe kamigabaa weha (yazare fasaashe) nawe yafatharawe.
yehe yazare fasaashe kawanede jarebaa 'enaa kaseetwa yadarate 'athenete mahakale yamiwathaa nawe.
'eresu 'alaahe yehenene yasawe leje kazihe dakaamaa fasaashe yafatharawe bamahonu kamota baxwaalaa hheyaawe 'aderego lagemegamaanaa lamenedaa maqaseqase caaye nawe.
misetheroce yamifatanubate 'enaa leboce yaqwaatharute hasaabe, 'emenatenaa leeloce geletze honawe tekekelanyaa kabeleshuwe yamilayebate qane nawe.
baziyaa qaneme yasawe leje ka'alaahe qethaate yamikalaakalebate xaayeleme hona yamiradaawe radaate 'ayenoraweme.
zenaabe bayagizeewe kasamaaye selamiwarede 'alaahe bazenaabaamaawe samaaye yemelaale.
ba'azere`ete, batheraatheree 'enaa bazaafoce mabeqale yametesanathaqe bahonacewe medereme yemelaale.
yehe bamuhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye yawaradawe qure'aane 'ewenatene kaweshate 'enedihume hhaqene kahasate 'aqwaame yamilaye qaalenawe.
yaaqafawe qume nagare 'enaa hhaqene 'eneji qaledenaa chawaataane 'ayedalame.
male'eketanyaacawe yezote yamathaawene 'asetabaabaayoce theriwene lamaasanaakalenaa kanetu lamaaseqarate 'ejege bezu seeraa yaawethanathenaalu.
'eneeme 'ewenatune haayemaanote yefaanaa yabalaaye lamaaderage 'enedihume weshatene wedeqe lamaaderage zadeene (ya'atzafaa) seeraane 'ezayedaalahu.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaane kahadiyaane teneshe gizee thabeqaacawe, thefaataacawenaa qethaataacawe laaye 'atecakule.
kafethuraanu balaaye le`ule 'enaa ba'ejegu kafe yaalawene geetaahene setaawasaa basemu 'awadesawenaa 'aleqawe.
yasawe lejene 'asetakaakelonaa qumanaawene 'asaamero yafatharawene geetaahene seme 'atheraa ('aleqawe).
fethuraanene gosaacawene, baaheriyaacawenenaa tzotaacawene layeto yafatharanaa qathelome 'eyaanedaanedune fethure la'eresu tasemaaminaa 'amaci wada honawe yamaraawene geetaahene seme 'atheraa.
geetaahe kamedere lakabetocaacehu saarenaa gethoshene yaabaqala nawe.
yaa saarenaa gethoshene 'erethebenaa 'aranegwaadee kanabara baxwaalaa thequrenaa dareqo yatasabaabara 'enedihone yaadaragawene geetaahene 'awadese.

'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! qure'aanene 'enaasetamerehalane; lebehe wesethe 'enesabasebawaalane, 'aterasaawememe. selahoname kazihe bafite 'enedaayerasaahe bamasegaate jiberile siyaasetamerehe ka'eresu gaare setaanabe 'enedanabarawe 'ataanebebe.
nagare gene 'alaahe bathebabu 'enedeterasaawe yaashaawene terasaalahe. 'esu geletzenaa debeqe yahonawene nagare yaaweqaale. meneme yamidabaqebate nagare yalame.
'alaahene yamiyaasewadedenaa janatene yamiyaasegabaahe yahonawe malekaame szeraane 'enaamacaacelehalane.
wada 'aneta bamenaasetalaalafawe qure'aane sawocene gase`e. mekerwa tadamaachenate 'esekaalaate derase mekaraacawe.
bagesaatzeehe tathaqaamiwoce 'alaahene yamifaru sawoce naacawe. mekeneyaatume tathaqaamiwoce 'enasu becaa naacawe.
kahaadi kamekere yeshashaale yethalaaleme; mekeneyaatume batenesaa'ee qane 'esaate wusethe bamagebaate 'edelabese kamihonute selahona.
qaathalowaa beretu yahona yatanesaa'eewaane qane 'esaate bamagebaate zalaalame bawusethwa 'eyataszaqaaya yenoraale.
dagemo 'esetwa wusethe zawetaari sihone waye muto kamiyaaganyawe cheneqe 'ayegalaagaleme waye dagemo 'erafete yaalawe nuro 'ayenoreme.
kashereke 'enaa kawanejale yatsadaa baregetheme yamefalagawene bamaagenyate taadala.
batadanagagulate zekeroce 'alwahene 'eyaawasaa swalaatune ba'agebaabu yasagada.
bamakaakalaacawe safi leyunate yaalawe kamahonume gaare 'enaaneta yaqerebitwane `aalame kamacharashaayetu taasebalethaalaacehu.
ya'akxeeraawe `aalame bawusethu yamaayeqwaarathe zaawetaari 'enaa thaafaache tzagaawoce selaalute kaduneyaa tzagaa hulu balaache nawe.
'enazihe yanagarenaacehu te`ezaazaate 'enaa zeenaawoce qure'aane kamaweradu bafite bawaradu matzehhaafete wusethe tathaqeswale.
'enasume baberaahime 'enaa musaa laaye yawaradu matzehhafete naacawe.
'aneta ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa hoye! lamahonu badenegaatheenaa bacheneqate sawocene selameteshafenawe yatenesaa'ee waree daresohalene?!
sawoce batenesaa'ee qane `edelanyaa wayeme `edela-bise yehonaalu. ya`edela-bisoce fite weredate yatakanaanabanaa yaaqaraqara yehonaale.
bamigotatabate szaneszalatenaa bamithafarubate maasariyaa gamade yatanasaa yadakamunaa yataakatu naacawe.
'enazihe fitoce 'ejege yamiyaaqaathele 'esaate wesethe yamigabunaa baqaathaloweme yamisaqaayu naacawe.
'ejege yafalaa 'enaa yamiyaaqaathele kahonawe yameneche weha yegaataalu.
"shiberiqe" wayeme "dari`e" kamibaale 'eshohamaanaa sidareqe marezaame, mathefonaa yathanabaa takele baqare yamimagabute megebe 'ayaaganyume.
tamagaabiwene yamaayaawafere 'enaa rahabuneme yamaayaasewagede nawe.
ya`edelanyoce fitoce baziyaa `elate baaganyute tzagaa mekeneyaate fitocaacawe yaabaraanaa badasetaa yamolaa yehonaale.
yamalekaame szeraawaa wetheete takamaacetonaa 'ethefe derebe hono bamaagenyatwa yatanasaa bamalekaame szeraawaa dasetanyaa tehonaalace.
badarajaawenaa babotaawe kafetanyaa bahonawe janate wesethe yehonaalu.
janate wesethe yatakalakala qaale lisamu yeqerenaa terefenaa wedeqe yahonu negegerocene 'ayesamume.
ba'ezihe janate wesetheme 'enedafalagu yamiyaazorutenaa wadafalagute 'aqethaachaa yamifaselaacawe menechoce tazagaajetolaacawaale.
bawesethwa kafe yaalu yakebere 'alegaawoceme tazagaajetolaacawaale.
yethathubaacaweme zanede tadarederawe yatazagaaju kubaayaawoceme 'alu.
ba'anede laaye yatadaradaru makadaawoceme;
'eziheme 'ezaame yatanathafu menethaafoceme yeganyubaataale.

'alaahu (subehhanahu wata`aalaa) ya`edelanyocenenaa ya`edela-bisocene leyunate kagalatza baxwaalaa yafathaarine celotaa 'enaa malekaame 'afathaatharene bamaawesaate yakahadiyaanene tekurate bamasaabenaa la'emenate maaserajaanate tathaqemawebate janate bamagebaate ka`edelanyoce yehonu zanede sigaabezaacawe 'enedihe yelaale::
lamahonu 'alaahe gemalene 'enedeete 'enedafatharaatenaa lasawe lejoce 'enedaagaraate bamaasetawaale 'ayemalakatumene?!
samaayeneme 'enedeete kafe 'aderego fatherote kabalaayaacawe yatathabaqanaa ba'enasu laaye yamaayewadeqe thaariyaa 'enedaadaragawe 'ayemalakatumene?!
gaaraawoceneme 'enedeete 'enedatakalaacawenaa medere basawoce laaye 'enedaatewaalele 'enedeete 'enedaatzanaate 'ayemalakatumene?!
mederene lasawoce maragaagiyaanaa lahulume nagare zegeju 'aderego 'enedeete 'enedazaragaatese 'ayemalakatumene?!

yasune (ya'alaahene) taalaaqenatene yamiyaasaayu meleketocene yemalakatu zanede tekurataacawene kasaaba baxwaalaa: male'eketanyaawe dagemo mene maaderage 'enedaalabaacawe 'aqethaachaa siyaasaayaacawe 'enedihe yelaale::
'aneta ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enazihene sawoce gasetzaacawe, ka'alaahe qethaateme 'asethaneqeqaacawe. 'aneta 'asetaawaashe nahe. kaaneta yamithabaqawe 'enasune maaseganezabe (maasetaawase) becaa nawe. wada qanaawe manegade mameraate (sekeetaamaa) maaderage ba'alaahe 'eje nawe.
ba'emenate letaasegadedaacawe zanede ba'enasu laaye 'aletashomekeme.
nagare gene ka'enasu 'emenatene 'emebi yaalanaa 'alaahenenaa male'eketanyaawene yakaadawene sawe;
'alaahe taalaaqu yajahaname 'esaate wesethe bamaasegabaate lazala`aalame zawetaari sihone yeqathaawaale.
kamotu baxwaalaa mamalashaacawe wada 'enyaa becaa nawe.
kazihe baxwaalaame yaszeraacawe meremaraanaa gemegamaa ya'anetame hona yaleelaa sawe szeraa saayehone yanyaa tagebaare nawe.
'alaahe bagohe (negaate) yemelaale.
ba'aserocu yazulehhijaa yamajamariyaa leelitoce yemelaale.
thenedenaa nathalaa bahonu nagaroceme hulu 'emelaalahu.
leeliteme bamathaa: baqathalanaa baheeda gizee 'emelaalahu. ya'enazihe hulu mahalaawoce maqwaachaa hasaabe: ba'eregetheme baszeraacehu temanadaalaacehu yamilawe nawe.
banazihe nagaroce mamaale la'a`emero baalabeetoce 'asaamaanye 'ayedalamene!
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lamahonu geetaahe ba`aade, bahude hhezeboce laaye male'eketanyaawene baasetabaabalu gizee mene 'enedaadaraga 'alaawaqekemene?!
razhaazheme 'enaa xaayelanyaa honawe "rame" bamibaalawe qedema-'ayaate yamitharute ya`aade gosaawoce yahonute.
'alaahe bazamanaacaweme bayatenyaaweme hagare laaye 'enasune masale yaalefatharalaacawe yahonute sawoce laaye yawasadawene 'eremejaa.

lamahonuse geetaahe yaswalihe hhezeboce yahonutene 'enaziyaa gaaraa laaye yaalutene qwaathenyoce sanetheqawe lamanoriyaanate badenegaaye beete yeszaru yanabarutene samudocene mene 'enedaadaraga 'alaawaqekemene?!
lamahonu sawocene yamiyaasaqaayebate cekaale yanabarawene fire`aawenene geetaahe mene 'enedaadaragawe 'alaawaqekemene?!
'enazihe hulu bayahagaraacawe baxaayaalenataacawenaa bagefaacawe wasanene 'alafu.
kehedatenaa hathi'atene bamaasaraachate beleshunatene 'asefaafu.
'alaahe beretu yahonawene qethaatune 'aqamasaacawe. kamedera gatzeme 'athafaacawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe yasawocene szeraa hulu tathabaabaaqinaa taqothaathaari sihone malekaame yaszaraawene janatene; mathefo yaszaraawene dagemo 'esaate yemanadaale.

'alaahe yaathafaacawe hhezeboce yaxaayelenaa yamakalaakale beqaate tzagaa yatawaalalaacawe selanabare. 'enasune batalayaaya tzagaa maathaaqamu yamawedade melekete 'enedaalehona sigaletze:
yasawe leje batalamedowe geetaawe bafatanawe 'enaa baakabarawe gizee, lejoce ganezabenaa selethaane bamasethate baathaaqamaweme gizee, yehenene yaadaragalate geetaawe zanede leyu kebere selaalanye nawe belo yegametaale. geetaayee yaakabaranye lazihu tagabi selahonekunye naweme yelaale.
sisaayune bamaathebabeme bafatanawe gizee geetaawe zanede waraadaa 'enedahona bamaasabe geetaayee 'awaaradanye yelaale.

bafetsume! nagaru yehe sawe tzagaane malagasu 'alaahe baariyaawene lamawedadu 'enedihume 'alamasethatu baariyaawe 'alaahe zanede yawarada lamahonu melekete nawe belo 'enedamiyaasebawe 'ayedalame. yelequnese 'enaaneta 'alaahe basathaacehu sisaaye 'abaatu yamotabatene (yatime) 'ataakaberume.
'erese ba'eresaacehu yamibalaawe yaleelawene dehane bamamagabe laaye 'ataanasaasume.
yadakaamaa seetocenenaa hetsaanaatene hhaqe hhalaalenatune gemete wesethe saataasegabu yaala 'agebaabe 'agebasebesaacehu tebalaalaacehu.
ganezabe 'alaqethe tewadaalaacehu. laganezabaacehu kamasaasaataacehume yatanasaa ba'alaahe manegade laaye maawethaate tesasetaalaacehu.
tagebaaraacehu 'enedihe mahone 'ayegabaaweme! medere baxaayele maneqatheqathene bataneqathaqathace gizee yaalawene huneetaa 'asetaawesu.
'aneta ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe babaarocu makaakale lamaferade simathaa; malaa'eketoceme baradefe tasalefawe bamathu gizee;

jahanameme basabaa shihe zalabate yatalagomacenaa ba'eyaanedaanedu zalabateme laaye sabaa shihe malaa'eketoce honawe 'eyagotatwate bametemathaabateme waqete: ba`elatume yasawe leje ya'alaahene mamariyaa batamalakata basenefenaa yaasaalafawe nagare teze yelawaale. `elatume yaszeraa saayehone yamenedaa qane bamahonu bazihe sa`aate maasetaawasu mene yethaqemawaale?!
'ejege kamaqochateme yatanasaa mene 'ala 'ewenatanyaa lahonawe yamacharashaawe `aalame heyewatee malekaame szeraa baasaalefekunye noro yelaale.
baziyaane qane ya'alaahene 'ayenate qethaate yamiqathaa maaneme yalame. mekeneyaatume ya'alaahe qethaate beretunaa qwaami nawe.
ba`elatume kahadiyaanene basanesalate thafero 'enedamiyaaserawe `aayenate 'asetasaasare maaneme 'ayaasereme.

'alaahe yakahadiyaanene menedaa kagalatza baxwaalaa ya'amaanyocene menedaa sigaletze 'enedihe yelaale::
ya'amaanyune nafese mote siyaaganyaateme hona batenesaa'eewe `elate ba'emenatenaa bamalekaame szeraa 'erekaataa wesethe yaalashewe nafese hoye!
wada geetaashe bamisatheshe malekaame menedaa yatadasateshe 'enaa banabarashe malekaame szeraa yatanasaa 'eresu zanede tawadaaje honashe tamalashi;
kadagaage baarocee gaare taqalaaqaye;
la'enaresume wada 'azagaajaxwaateme janate 'aberashaacawe gebi tebaalaalace.
'alaahe bataqadasacewe katamaa maalateme bamakaa yemelaale.
'aneta ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa hoye! magadale yaalabatene bamagedalenaa mamaarake yaalabatene bamamaarake 'ezihe hagare wesethe yameteszaraawe szeraa laaneta tafaqedwale.
'alaahe basawe lejoce 'abaate 'enaa ya'eresu zare bahonuteme lejocu yemelaale.
yasawene leje baduneyaa wesethe bamigathemawe cegere saabiyaa bacegerenaa makaraa wesethe yamiyaalefe 'aderegane fatharenawe.
yasawe leje hathi'atene sifatzeme yafatharawe geetaame bihone 'enekwaa maaneme yamaayezawenaa yamaayebaqalawe yemaselawaalene?!
bezunaa tadaraaraabi yahona ganezabene 'awathaahunye yelaale.
yehe baganezabu yamikuraaraawe sawe 'alaahe 'ayemalakatanyeme belo yaasebaalene? ganezabune kayate 'enedaamathaawe 'enaa mene laaye 'enedaawaalawe 'ayegamagemanyeme belo yaasebaalene?!
lamahonu yamimalakatebatene hulate `aayenoce 'alaadaragenelatemene?!
manaagare yamicelebatene melaase 'enaa hulate kanaaferocenese 'alaadaragenelateme?!
yamalekaamenaa yamathefo manegadocenese 'alaasaawaqenawemene?!
kajanate yamilayawene 'aqabate tashaagero maalafe nawe yamithabaqebate.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lamahonu yehe janate lamagebaate lishaagarawe yegabaale sela tabaalawe 'aqabate mene 'asaawaqahe?!
yehe 'aqabate wanedeme hona seete baariyaane kabaarenate maalaaqaqe nawe.
wayeme megebe 'ejege bamithafaabate yarahabe waqete laaye mamagabe nawe.
yaqerebe zemedenaa norote 'abaatu yamotabatene (yatimene) mamagabe nawe.
'aliyaame meneme neberate yaleelawene dehane maredaate (mamagabe) nawe.

qathelome ba'alaahe kaamanute, 'erese ba'eresaacaweme 'alaahene bamataazaze, yakalakalawene bamatawe 'enaa ba'adagaa waqete te`egesetene 'adaraa kamibaabaalute 'enedihume la'alaahe baariyaawoce bamaazane laaye kamimakaakarute mahone 'alabate.
banazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatzute yaszeraa mazegabaacawe baqanye 'ejaacawe yamisathaacawe yaqanye gwaadoce naacawe.
bamale'eketanyaacene laaye yawaradawene 'aneqatzocaacenene yaasetabaabalu 'enaa yakaadu yaszeraa mazegabaacawe bageraa 'ejaacawe yamisathaacawe yageraa gwaadoce naacawe.
batenesaa'eewe qane wesethu taqolefobaacawe yamiqathubate 'esaate tazagaajetolaacawaale.
'alaahe batzahhaye 'enaa kameseraaqe kawathaace baxwaalaa kafe bametelebate yarafaade waqete yemelaale.
tzahhaye kathalaqace baxwaalaa yaswane faanaa takatelaa bametemathaawaa charaqaame yemelaale.
baqane kefela gizee berehaanu medere laaye yaalawene hulu geletze bamiyaadaregebateme gizee yemelaale.
balaliteme mederene baathaqaalaaye bamiyaachalemebate gizee yemelaale.
basamaaye 'enaa baraqiqe 'aganabaabume yemelaale.
bamedere 'enaa sawoce bataragaagaa huneetaa 'enedinorubaate batheru huneetaa batazaragaacewe 'emelaalahu yelaale.
bahulume nafesenaa 'asetakaakelo bafatharaateme 'emelaalahu.
yaala temeherete nafesene malekaamunenaa mathefowene 'aseganazabaate.
nafesune bamalekaame nagare yaasewaabaate 'enaa kamathefo nagare yaatharaate baregetheme sekeetaamaa hona.
nafesune bawanejalenaa bahathi'ate wesethe yazafaqaateme baregetheme kasara.

'alaahe nafesune bawanejalenaa bahathi'ate yazafaqaatene sawe makesarune kagalatza baxwaalaa bamesaalee maleku samudocene bamatheqase siyaaberaaraa 'enedihe yelaale::
samude bawanejalenaa bahathi'ate wasane yaalafu bamahonaacawe nabiyaacawe saalihhene 'asetabaabalu.
gemalwane lamawegaate kahhezebu wekelenaa bamawesade thamaamaawe baqoma gizee;
ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa swalihhe (`alayehi 'asalaame`e ya'alaahene gemale 'enaa yamathathe qanwaneme tawaate 'atetanaakolwate 'alaacawe.

bagemalwa gudaaye male'eketanyaacawene 'asetabaabalu 'enaa thamaamaawe saweyee hhezebocume yasune 'aqwaame bamawedade gemalwane wagwaate. bawanejalume tagaaru 'alaahe qethaatune (ma`aatune) 'awaradabaacawe; bahathi'ataacaweme mekeneyaate bachukxate 'athafaacawe; baqethaatume huluneme ba'ekule 'athafaacawe.
'alaahe bazihe qethaate siyaathafaacawe yamikatalawene nagare meneme saayefaraa nawe.
'alaahe leelite batzelematu basamaayenaa medere makaakale yaalawene bamishafenebate gizee yemelaale.
baqane bamigalatzebate yefaa gizeeme yemelaale.
bahulatume yawanedenaa yaseete fetherataateme yemelaale.

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! tagebaaraacehu 'ejegune la'eyaqele nawe. yatawasanawe janate lamagebaate mekeneyaate yamihone malekaame tagebaare sihone wesenu dagemo 'esaate lamagebaate mekeneyaate yamihone mathefo tagebaare nawe.
zakaa, yabeete wachi 'enaa yamaakaakaashaa kefeyaa yamasaasalutene masethate yaalabatene yasathanaa 'alaahe yakalakalawene yatathanaqaqawe sawemaa;
'alaahe 'etakaalahu belo qaale yagabaawene 'ewenate nawe belo yataqabala;
malekaame szeraanenaa ba'alaahe manegade laaye ganezabe maawethaatene 'enaagaraalataalane.
maawethaate yaalabatene nagare kamaawethaate yasasata 'enaa 'alaahene katerufaatu mathayaqe teto baraasu ganezabe yatabeqaaqaawe;
'alaahe 'anedene sawe ba'alaahe manegade wachi kaawathaa 'enedamitakaalate qaale yagabaawene nagare yaasetabaabala;
malekaame szeraane 'akebedanebate mathefo szeraane 'enaagaraalataalane.
lathefaate tadaarego 'enaa 'esaate sigabaa yasasatawe ganezabu meneme 'ayethaqemaweme.
qenune manegade kathamaamaawe manegade layeto maaberaaraatunaa magelatzu ya'enyaa xaalaafinate nawe.
macharashaaweme heyewate yehune yamajamariyaawe heyewate yanyaawe nawe. 'enedafalagene 'enaadaregaacawaalane. yeheme kanyaa wechi yamaaneme 'ayedalame.
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'alaahene yamaatetaazazu kahona yameteneqalaqawene 'esaate 'asethanaqeqaacexwaalahu.
'ejege kathamamawe baqare maaneme yazihecene 'esaate qaathalo yamiqamese yalame.
yaa ya'alaahe male'eketanyaa (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) yezawete yamathutene yaasetabaabalawenaa ya'alaahene te`ezaaze mafatzamene 'emebi yaalawe.
ba'anetzaaru 'ejege 'alaahene fari yahonawe 'abubakere (radeya 'alaahu `anehu) kazihece 'esaate yereqaale.
yaa kahathi'ate matheraatene falego ganezabune yamiyaawathaawe;
ganezabune siyaawathaa ya'anedaacaweme welataa norobate welataawene lamakefale 'ayedalame yamiyaawathaawe;
yelequnese yehenene siyaadarege kafethuraanocu balaaye yahonawene yageetaawene fite kajelo nawe.
'alaahe bamisathawe yalaaqa menedaa dasetanyaa yehonaale.
'alaahe baqanu majamariyaa (rafaadu) yemelaale.
balaliteme sichalemenaa yasawoceme 'eneqeseqaasee bamisakenebate gizee yemelaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! raa`eye mawerade latawasana gizee siyaaqome 'enaziyaa 'agaariwoce 'enedamilute geetaahe 'aletawaheme, 'alethalaahememe.
kaduneyaa (qerebu `aalame) heyewate yeleqe bawesethwa zala`aalamaawi 'enaa yamaayeqwaarathe tzagaa yaalaate 'aakxiraa (yamacharashaa `aalame) laaneta balaache nawe.
laaneta lahhezebocehe batasathawe menedaa dasetanyaa tehone zanedeme geetaahe laaneta 'enaa lahhezebocehe kafetanyaanaa barekaataa menedaane yesathaacexwaale.
hetzaane honahe 'abaatehe motobehe 'aganyahenaa mathagiyaane 'adaragalehe. 'ayaatehe `abedule muthalibe qathelome 'agotehe 'abuthaalibe 'enediraarulehe 'adaragaacawe.
kitaabenaa maane mene 'enedahona yamaataaweqe honahe 'aganyahenaa sela 'eresume yamaataaweqawene 'asaawaqahe.
deha honahe 'agenyetoheme baraasehe 'enedetebeqaaqaa 'adaragahe.
'abaatune bahetzaanenatu yaathaane leje bakefu huneetaa 'ateyaaze 'enedihume 'ataawaaredawe.
falaagi yahonane dehaneme 'enedaataamanaacheqe.
'alaahe yamolaalehene tzagaa 'amasegaanye hune, 'enedihume sela welataaweme lasawoce gelatze.
'alaahe lebehene baregetheme 'asefetolehe yaraa`eye maweradeneme 'enedetewade 'adaragahe.
wanejaleheneme yeqere belanahaale. bajaahiliyaa gizee yanabarabehene shakeme hulu 'araagafenelahaale.
yaa jarebaahe lamasabare 'esekiqarebe derase yaadakamahene (wanejalene) 'araagafalehe.
zenaaheneme kafe 'adaragenelehe ba'azaane, baqaamaa 'enaa baleeloce 'agaathaamiwoce basemehe yametewasaa hona.
kacheneqatenaa kacegere gaare mecotenaa delote 'ala.
kacheneqatenaa kacegere gaare mecotenaa delote 'ala. bamahonume yehenene kaawaqeke hhezebocehe 'anetane maasecagaraacawe 'ayaasefaraahe, wada 'alaahe kamathaaraateme 'enedaayaagedehe.
szeraahene 'enedaathanaaqaqekenaa 'enedacharaseke geetaahene bamagazaate laaye tegaa.
felaagotehenenaa kejaalotehene wada geetaahe becaa 'aderege.
'alaahe babalasenaa bamiyaadegebate botaa 'enedihume bazayetunenaa bamibaqelebate 'enedihume `isaa (`alayehi 'asalaame) batalaakubate felesetheeme medere yemelaale.
nabiyu musaane (`alayehi 'asalaame) baanaagarabate yasinaaye taraaraame yemelaale.
bataqadasawe 'agare bawesethu yagabaa salaame bamiyaaganyebate 'enedihume muhhamade (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) batalaakubate bamakaa yemelaale.
ba'eregetheme yasawene leje yatasetakaakala qumanaa yatashaala qeretze yaalawe 'aderegane fatharenawe.

bamaqathaleme baduneyaa heyewate wesetheme wada 'erejenaa 'enaa wada majaajaate 'enemalesawaalane, tafatherwawi 'emenatune kaabalaashanaa ya'esaateme kahona basawenatu 'enedamaayethaqamawe hulu basawenate 'akaalu 'enedaayethaqame yehonaale.

genaa 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanutenenaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszarute meneme biyaaraju 'enekwaa raasaacawene bamaatzedaataacawe yatanasaa yamaayaaqwaarathe qwaami menedaa tazagaajetolaacawaale 'eresume janate nawe.
'aneta yasawe leje hoye! ya'alaahene taalaaqenatene yamiyaasaayu bezu meleketocene katamalakateke baxwaalaa lamahonu yaferedune qane lamaasetabaabale yaanasaasaahe menedenawe?!

lamahonu 'alaahe yatenesaa'eewene qane yamenedaanaa yaferede qane bamaaderagu kadaanyaawoce hulu balaachenaa fetehawi daanyaa 'ayedalamene?! bamahonume baariyaawocune malekaame szariwene bamalekaamenatu thefaatanyaawene bathefaatu saayemanadaanaa saayefarede 'enedihu yetawaacawaale tabelo yetaasabaalene?!
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! geetaahe yamiyaasetalaalefelehene raa`eye fethuraanene bafatharawe bageetaahe seme bamajamare 'anebebe.
kafetewate thabetaanate qathelo karagaa quraache dame yasawene leje fathara.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe yamiyaasetalaalefelehene raa`eye 'anebebe. caru geetaaheme bacarenatu tawadaadaari yamaayeganyelate 'ejege lagaasenaa malekaamene yamiwele nawe.
ya'eje tzehufenenaa babe`ere matzaafene yaasetamaara;
yasawe lejene yamaayaaweqawene yaasaawaqa,
ba'ewenatu 'eneda 'abujahele yaalawe thamaamaa sawe ya'alaahene wasane bamaalafe wasane 'alaafi yehonaale.
yeheme yahonawe baalawe ganezabenaa selethaane yatabeqaaqaa maselo selataayawe nawe.
'aneta yasawe leje hoye! batenesaa'eewe qane wada geetaahe tamalaashe nahe. 'eyaanedaaneduneme 'enedayaszeraawe yemanadaawaale.
bamakalekale darajaa ka'abujahele yabalatha yamigareme sawe 'ayetahalene?!
baariyaacenene muhhamadene (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) kaa`ebaa zanede sisagede kamikalakelawe yabalatha.
'eseti negaranye lamahonu yaa yamikalakalawe sawe sela geetaawe ba'ewenatanyaanaa tekekelanyaa godaanaa laaye bihonese?!
sawocene 'alaahene te'ezaazune bamafatsamenaa yakalakalawene bamakalekale 'enedifaru yamiyaaze bihonese? 'enedihe `aayenate sawe likalakale yegabaawaalene?!
yaa kalekaaye yahonawe sawe male'eketanyaawe yezote yamathaawene nagare yaasetabaabalanaa yaamatza mahonu 'ayegaremehemene?! lamahonuse 'alaahene 'ayefaraamene?!
yehenene yamisagedawene baariyaa yamikalakelawe sawe 'alaahe yehenene tagebaarune yamiyaaye mahonune 'ayaaweqemene?! 'esu meneme nagare 'ayesawarebateme.

yehe maayeme 'enedamigametawe 'ayedalame! baariyaacenene kamaawakenaa 'esune kamaasetabaabale yamaayetaaqabe kahona 'anaatune beretu yahona 'ayaayaazene yezane 'eyagotatene wada 'esaate 'enewarawerawaalane.
yazihe 'anaate baalabeete banegegeru hasatanyaa batagebaaru sehetatanyaa nawe.
mahaale 'anaatune yezane 'esaate wesethe senewarawerawe kaqethaate lamaadaane yeradute zanede gwaadanyocunenaa gebera 'abarocune yetheraa.

'enyaa yajahaname thabaaqi yahonutene ya'alaahene te'ezaaze kamafatzame yamaayaametzunaa yaazazaacawene yamifatzemu yahonu chakaanye malaa'eketocene 'enetharaalane. yatenyaawe thanekaaraanaa 'ashanaafi 'enedamihone yetaayaale.

yehe badaaye yahona sawe 'anetane lamagudaate 'enedaasabawe 'ayesaakaalateme. 'esune 'atetaazazawe, la'alaaheme segade, te'ezaazuneme bamaakebare wada 'eresu taqaarabe, ba'eregetheme wada 'alaahe yaaqarebehale.

'enyaa qure'aanene bamale'eketanyaawe (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) laaye balayelatule qadere (mawasanyaayetu leelite) baramadaane ware maawerade 'enedajamarenawe hulu bazihu lalite qure'aanene bajemelaa wada qerebitu samaaye 'aweredanaale.
'aneta nabiye hoye! lamahonu bawasaanyetu lalite yaalawene barakatenaa malekaame nagare mene 'enedahona taaweqaalahene?!

yehece lalite taalaaqenaa malekaame nagarene yayaazace setehone meshetune ba'emenatenaa malekaame menedaane 'aganyaalahu belo taasaabi 'aderego basalaate (segedate) yaasaalafa szeraawe ka'anede shihe ware yeleqaale.
malaa'eketoce 'enaa jiberile bageetaacawe faqaade 'alaahe yawasanawene ya`aamatune wesaanee (sisaaye, mote, heyewatenaa leeloce nagaroce yamiwasanebatene) te`ezaaze yezawe yewaredaalu.
yehece yatabaarakace lalite kamajamariyaawaa 'eseka macharashaawaa derase lalitewaa hulu malekaame nawe.

'ayehudaawiyaane, nasaaraawoce (keresetiyaanoce) 'enaa 'agaari kahadiyaane geletze yahona mamariyaanaa gulehe yahona maaserajaa 'esekimathaalaacawe derase bakehedate laaye yaalaacawene sememenatenaa yagaaraa 'aqwaame yamilaaqaqu 'alenabarume.
yehe geletze mamariyaanaa gulehe maaserajaa netzuhane 'eneji maaneme linakaawe yamaayegabaawene netzuhe matsehhafe yaanabelaacawe zanede ka'alaahe yatalaaka male'eketanyaa nawe.
bazihe matsehhafe wesetheme 'ewenatanyaa negegerocenaa mizaanaawi denegaageewocene yaala sihone: yasawene leje wada mithaqemawenaa wada qanaawe manegade yamimaru naacawe.

'enaziyaa taweraate yatasathaacawe 'ayehudaayaawiyaane 'enedihume nejile yatasathaacawe naswaraawoce lamalayaayate yabaqute 'alaahe male'eketanyaawene kalaakalaacawe baxwaalaa nawe. kanasu 'eselemenaane yataqabala 'ala; yanabiyune 'ewenatanyenate 'eyaawaqa bakehedatu laaye yaqathalame 'ala.

ya'ayehudaawiyaane 'enaa yanaswaraawoce geteretanyenate 'enaa wanejalanyaa mahonaacawene yamiyaagolaawe nagare 'enasu baqure'aane yataazazute bamatsaahhefetocawe yataazazutene 'eneji yatalaya nagare 'alamataazazu nawe. yaame te`ezaaze 'alaahene ba'amelekotu laaye meneme saayaagaaru 'esune becaa 'enedigazu, salaatene 'enediyaaqwaaqumu 'enaa zakaa 'enediyaawathu nawe. yataazazuteme meneme gobaathaa yaleelawene qenune haayemaanotene nawe.

'enaziyaa 'alaahene yakaadu 'ayehudaawiyaane, keresetiyaanoce 'enaa 'agaariyaane batenesaa'eewe qane zawetaariwoce sihonu jahaname 'esaate wesethe lazalaalame yenoraalu. bakehedataacawenaa male'eketanyaawene bamaasetabaabalaacawe mekeneyaate kafetherataatu hulu kefuwoce naacawe.
'enaziyaa ba'alaahe yaamanunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru 'enasu kafetherataate hulu balaachoce naacawe.

menedaacawe geetaacawe zanede sihone 'eresume kahenetzaawocunaa kazaafocu szere wanezoce yamifasubaacawe yahonu janatoce naacawe. bawesethwame lazala`aalame nawaariwoce naacawe. ba'alaahe bamaamanaacawenaa la'eresu taazaazhe bamahonaacaweme yatanasaa 'alaahe wadwacawaale. ya'alaahe 'ezenateme selagathamaacawe basethotaawe raketawaale. yehecene 'ezenate yamiyaaganyaate geetaawene bamaferaate te`ezaazaatune yafatsatzamanaa yakalakalawene yaraaqa sawe nawe.
medere batenesaa'eewe maderase mekeneyaate kabaade yahona maneqatheqathene bataneqathaqathace gizee;
medere bawesethwa yaalutene mutaanenaa leeloceneme baawathaace gizee;
yasawe lejeme geraa bamagaabaate <<medere mene honaa nawe 'enedihe yameteneqathaqathawe>> baala gizee;
baziyaane bataalaaqe qanemedere balaayewaa laaye yataszaraawene malekaameme yehune mathefo tagebaare bametaawaraabate gizee;
yeheneneme yametenaagarawe 'alaahe yehenene yaazazaate yaasaawaqaate bamahonu nawe.
baziyaane taalaaqe qane medere bameteneqathaqathebate qane sawoce babudene honawe baduneyaa heyewate yeszarute yanabarawene yaszeraa wetheete lamamalekate kameremaraawe seferaa yewathaalu.
yaquchaache kebedate yaakele malekaame szeraa yaszaraa kafite lafitu yaaganyawaale.
yateneshe gunedaane yaakeleme kefu szeraa yaszaraa 'enedihu yaaganyawaale.
'alaahe 'ejege kamarothaacawe yatanasaa ya'esetenefaasaacawe demetze 'esekisamaa derase bamirothu farasoce yemelaale.
shakxonaacawene baxaayele kadenegaaye gaare bamaagaachataacawe yatanasaa 'esaatene bamifatheru farasoceme yemelaale.
bamaaladaa thalaatene bamiwareru farasoceme yemelaale.
baruchaacawe 'abwaraane bamiyaabonute.
farasanyocene yezawe bathalaate sebesebe mahale bamigabute farasoce.
yasawe leje geetaawe kasu yamifalegebatene malekaame nagare kalekaaye nawe.
'esu malekaame nagarene bamakalekalu masekaari nawe. geletze bamahonume liyaasetabaabele 'ayeceleme.
'eresume laganezabe kaalawe leke yaalafa wedeetaa yatanasaa nefuge yehonaale.

yehe baduneyaa yatashanagalawe sawe 'alaahe mutaanene 'enedamiqasaqese, kamedere lameremaraanaa lamenedaa 'enedamiyaasewathaacawe 'enedihume nagaru 'esu 'enedagamatawe hono 'enedamaayaaganyawe 'ayaaweqemene?!
balebe wesethe yaalu 'asetasaasaboce, 'emenatocenaa leeloce nagaroce geletsenaa yefaa bamihonu gizee;
baziyaa qane geetaacawe sela 'enasu theleqe 'awaaqi nawe. kabaariyaawocu 'anedeme nagare 'ayesawarebateme. baziheme yemanadaacawaale.
yatenesaa'eewe qane 'ejege 'asefari 'enaa 'asedanegaache bamahonu yasawene leje lebe yaanekwaakwaale.
yehe ba'asefarinatu 'enaa ba'asedanegaachenatu yasawene leje lebe yamiyaanekwaakwaawe menedene nawe?!
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! yehe ba'asefarinatunaa 'asedanegaachenatu yasawene leje lebe selamiyaanekwaakwaawe mene 'asaawaqahe?! 'eresu 'eko yaqiyaamaahe (yatenesaa'ee qane) nawe.
yasawe lejocene lebe bamiyaanekwaakwaabate gizee sawoce bayabotaawe 'enedatabatanu biraabiroce yehonaalu.
gaaraawoceme baqalaalu sigwaazunaa sineqasaaqasu yatanadafa thethe yemaselaalu.
yaa kakefu szeraawe yeleqe malekaame szeraawe yaamazanalatemaa;
'eresu janate wesethe 'erekaataa yaalawe heyewate yenoraale.
kamalekaame szeraawe yeleqe kefu szeraawe yaamazanabate dagemo;
batenesaa'eewe qane maarafiyaawenaa maqamachaawe yajahaname 'esaate yehonaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! sela 'ereswa mene 'asaawaqahe?!
muqatwa 'ejege yamiyaaqaathele 'esaate naate.
'enaaneta yasawe lejoce hoye! baganezabenaa balejoce mafokaakare ka'alaahe te`ezaaze 'azanaagaacehu.
motaacehu qabere wesethe 'eseketegabu deraseme tezanaagaalaacehu.
yehe mafokaakare ka'alaahe te`ezaaze liyaazanaagaacehu 'ayegabaame nabare. yazihene mazanaagaate wetheete saataawequte 'ateqarume.
'ahuneme yamazanaagaatune wetheete saataawequte 'ateqarume.
ba'ewenatu 'enedameteqasaqasunaa 'enedayaszeraacehu 'enedametemanadu 'eregethanyaa betehonu noro baganezabenaa balejoce baaletafokaakaraacehu nabare.
ba'alaahe seme 'emelaalahu yatenesaa'eewe qane 'esaatene temalakataalaacehu.
'awo! meneme therethaaree yaleelabate `eyetaane ba`aayenaacehu babeleenu temalakatwataalaacehu.
baziyaane qaneme 'alaahe yawaalalaacehune welataa (theenenate, habete wazata) yethayeqaacexwaale.
'alaahe ba`asere waqete yemelaale.
yasawe leje bamulu bakeseratenaa thefaate wesethe naacawe.

nagare gene 'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'eketanyoce yaamanu, malekaame szeraane yaszaru, 'erese baresaacawe ba'ewenate 'enaa bate`egesete yatamakaakarunaa 'adaraa yatabaabaalu 'enedihume ba'enazihe baaheriyaate yatagalatzu sawoce kakeseratenaa kathefaate yamidenu naacawe.
'abezeto sawene yamiyaamaa (hameetanyaa 'enaa sawocene yamiyaanawere) yaminaqefe beretu qethaatenaa taalaaqe thefaate wayolate.
hasaabunaa cheneqatu ganezabene kamasabesabenaa kamaquthare wechi leelaa hasaabe yaleelawe sawe;
yehe yasabasabawe ganezabe kamote yamiyaadenawe maselote bazihece heyewate zawatere 'enoraalahu belome yaasebaale.
yehe maayeme 'enedagamatawe 'ayedalame. yelequnese kakefaatwa yatanasaa bawesethwa yagabaawene hulu yametaawademenaa yametesabaabere yahonacewe 'esaate wesethe yethaalaale.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lamahonu yehece bawesethwa yatathaalawene hulu selametaawademenaa selametesabaaberawe 'esaate mene yametaaweqawe nagare 'ala?!
'ereswa ba'eregetheme yatagaagaamace ya'alaahe 'esaate naate.
kasawoce 'akaaleme 'alefaa wada lebe yametezaleqe (saretzaa yametegabaa) naate.
kawesethwa mawethaate 'enedaayecelume batazaragu 'a`emaadoce yatazagaace naate.
lamahonu 'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'alaahe yazehone baalabeetoce bahonute 'aberahaa 'enaa gwaadanyocu kaa`ebaane lamaaferase baasaabubate gizee mene 'enedaadaragaacawe 'alaawaqekemene?!

kaa`ebaane yamaaferase 'eqedaacawene 'alaahe 'akashafabaacawenaa kanetu 'adaragabaacawe. selahoname sawocene kakaa`ebaa lamaazore yaasabute nagare 'aletasaakaalaacaweme. kaa`ebaa laayeme meneme maaderase 'alecaalume.
banasu laaye bamanegaa yatasabasabu baraariwocene laakabaacawe.
yadaraqa cheqaa denegaaye yamiwarawerubaacawe sihonu laakabaacawe.
'alaahe 'enazihene sawoce 'enesesoce baletawe 'enedaragaagathute qethale 'adaragaacawe.
laqurayeshoce lemedenaa maalaamade sibaale yehenene 'adaraga.
bakeramete wada yamane; babagaa dagemo wada shaame basalaame magwaazene 'enedilaamadute bamaaderagu;
yehenene guzo yaamacaacalaacawene yazihe yataqadasawene beete geetaa maaneneme saayaagaarubate babecanyenate yegazute (yaamelekute).

yaa karahaabe yamagabaacawene, ba`aaraboce lebonaa wesetheme lakaa`ebaa 'enaa lanawaariwocwa teleqe kebere 'enedinoraacawe bamaaderage kaferehaahateme natzaa bamaawethaate salaamene yaagonaatzafaacawene geetaa liyaamaleku yegabaale.
yaanene yatenesaa'eewene qane menedaa yamiyaasetabaabelawene sawe 'awaqekawene?!
raasuneme yehune leelaawene dehocene lamaabelaate 'ayaanasaasaame.
lasagaajoce thefaatenaa qethaate 'alalaacawe;'enaziyaa segedataacawene yazanagunaa waqetu 'esekamiyaalefe derase gede yalashe lahonute.
'enaziyaa basegedataacaweme hona bamalekaame szeraacawe taayetaane lamifalegu 'enaa szeraacawene la'alaahe becaa fetzume yamaayaadaregu lahonute.
bamaredaataacawe meneme yamaayecagarubatene ya`eredaataa `aayenate nefugoce: thefaatenaa qethaate 'alalaacawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! 'enyaa bezu malekaame nagare lagesanehale. kalagaseneheme 'anedu janate wesethe yamiganyawe yakaweszare meneche yeganyebataale.
la'eziheme tzagaa 'agaariyaane lathaa`otocaacawe maqaarabiyaa kamiyaaredute bataqaaraani lageetaahe becaa bamasegadenaa bamaarade mesegaanaane la'alaahe fatseme.
yaa 'anetane yamithalaahe sawe nawe yatarasaawe 'enaa kamalekaame nagare hulu yataqwaarathawe. semume binasaa 'enekwaa bakefu yaminasaawe 'eresu nawe.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye!:: <<'enaaneta ba'alaahe yakaadaacehu kahadiyaane hoye!>> balaacawe.
<<'ahuneme hona wadafiteme 'enaaneta yametaamalekutene thaa`ote 'alaamalekeme.
'enee yamaamalekawene 'alaahene 'enaaneta yametaamaleku 'ayedalaacehume.
'enaaneta yametaamalekutene thaa`oteme 'enee yamaamaleke 'ayedalahume.
laraasaacehu yafatharaacehute haayemaanote 'alaacehu; lanee 'alaahe yaawaradalenye haayemaanotee 'alanye.>>
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! lahaayemaanotehe ya'alaahe 'eredaataanaa thenekaaree simathaanaa makaaneme dele setaadarege;
sawoceme wada 'eselemenaa babudene babudene honawe takataatelawe magebaataacawene setemalakate;

yamale'eketehe magabaadajaa 'eyataqaaraba mahonune 'aweqahe geetaahene la`eredaataawenaa ladelu lawaalalehe welataame bamaamasegane kamesegaanaa gaare 'atheraawe ('aleqawe); maaretaaneme thayeqawe 'eresu yabaarocune neseha taqabaayenaa wanejalaacawene mahari nawe.

yanabiyu (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) 'agote 'abulahabe bine `abedu 'ale-muthalibe nabiyune (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame) bamaasaqaayatunaa bamaasecagaru szeraawe bamabalaashatu 'eju 'amade 'afaashe hona, theratume kanetu hono qara.
ganezabume hona lejocu mene thaqamute?! qethaatene 'alemakatulate; wayeneme 'ezenatene 'alaaseganyulate.
baalabeetume 'umu jamile ya'alaahe male'eketanyaane (salalaahu `alayehi wasalame)ne bamiheedubate manegadaacawe laaye 'eshohe bamathaale taasaqaayaacawe yanabaraceweme 'esaate tegabaalace.
wada 'esaate yametenadaabate badanebe yatafatala gamade chaaneqaawaa laaye tadaregobaate 'esaate tegabaataalace.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye!:: <<'alaahe ba'ameleko becanyaanaa 'anede nawe ka'eresu leelaa 'amelaake yalame>> balaacawe.
'alaahe bamelu`e 'enaa bawebate magalachaawocu ragade yabalaayenatu kahulu yalaaqa taalaaqe nawe. fethuraane bamulu wada 'eresu tathagiwocenaa ka'eresu falaagiwoce naacawe.
maaneneme 'alewaladame; kamaaneme 'aletawaladame. lejeme hona walaaje yalaweme (yataqadasa geetaa nawe).
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! banegaatu geetaa 'ethabaqaalahu wada 'eresume 'ethagaalahu bale.
kafethuraane hulu tanekolenaa kefu nagare;
balalite gizee kamiganyu nafesaate, leeboce wazata... kefu nagaroce kefaate ba'alaahe 'ethabaqaalahu.
bataqwaatharo keroce laaye kamitafute seete degemetanyoce tanekole ba'eresu 'ethabaqaalahu.
meqanyaa bameqanyenatu tanasaasato kamiszaraawe tanekoleme ba'eresu 'ethabaqaalahu.
'aneta male'eketanyaa hoye! basawoce geetaa 'ethabaqaalahu, bale.
yasawoce negusze bahonawe; banasu laaye yafalagawene nagare yamiyaadarege ka'eresu wuchi leelaa negusze yalaacaweme.
'ewenatanyaa 'amelaakaacawe nawe. ka'eresu wechi ba'ewenate yamimalake 'amelaake yalaacaweme.
sawoce 'alaahene maawesaate sizanagu wesewasaawene(gutegotaawune) yamilaqebaacawenaa 'alaahene siyaawasu kamireqawe shayethwane tanekole ba'alaahe seme 'ethabaqaalahu.
basawoce leboce wesethe gabeto yamigotagute kahonawe;
ya'agaanenete shayethwane 'enedaala hulu: yasawe shayethwaneme 'ala.
